review_text: I have this dress in Olive.  It is SO comfortable.  I have paired with with tights and boots, and will be wearing the plum with tan sandals, gold sandals, and black patent leather pumps for dressy ocassions.  Very versatile.  The top of the dress is SO flattering and adds some shape to my small bust.  It also fits perfectly on my shoulders/upper arms and is slimming.  The color in real life is a bit deeper and more purple  I was hoping for a more muted, earthy purple like the monitor shows.  But, it's not a big enough deal to return the dress.  A great buy!  I am 120 pounds, small upper frame, slightly pear shaped.  I take a medium in many other ModCloth dresses that zip up and are fitted without give (I have a big rib cage but small cup size), but the small fits me PERFECTLY.  A medium would be tentlike.
Fits great. Very comfortable. Easy to dress up or down, versatile.
My favorite dress so far that I have ordered from Modcloth.  The material is not very heavy, so it is more of a spring time dress.

Bought a medium, am 5.1, 135lbs.  Bust 36B.  Fits nicely and the colour is quite lovely.  The only thing I don't love is that it is the typical clingy jersey fabric and for some reason makes my backside look frumpy.  I will try it with my Frame it, Girl slip and hopefully that will make it all better.

This dress is simply beautiful. The fabric is amazing, and so soft! The top is very flattering as well as the waistline. The area around the armpits is awesome!!! I was worried it would be too long for my preference but it is a good length. I'd prefer it about an inch shorter but I don't think I care enough to hem it ;) Its a lot less casual than I expected for a cottonmaterial, especially when adding jewelry. I think it will look more fun with a cute scarf or some textured or printed tights!
This is super comfortable, great fit, roomy and easy to dress down or up.
First dress I bought from ModCloth and it is perfect! Fits wonderfully! Love, love, love this dress!

This dress is beautifullycolored, and the cut is simple, yet flattering on me. I have only worn it at night, with black tights, but if I wear it during the day I will make sure I wear a slip, as the fabric slightly lets light through. This is a perfect dress for a variety of occasions!

review_summary: Great dress! I love the l
review_text: Great dress! I love the length because it makes it appropriate to wear to the office. Very flattering cut. I have super wide hips and it fits great!

Great dress! Rich color, good quality, soft cloth. After reading other reviews, I was afraid it might be on the sheer side, and the fabric is somewhat thin but I think will have no problem wearing this without a slip or tights. The waist is a little high, which makes my rear look like it starts a little higher up than usual, but it's still pretty flattering. The gathers on the bust have potential to look just sightly baggy if you're not the right shape for it but, again, not bad at all. Short enough to feel a little flirty, long enough to be good work wear, soft enough to feel casual, pretty enough for a night out. This one is a keeper!
The dress fits very nicely and feels great. I was afraid it wouldn't be large enough in the bust, but thats not an issue.

review_summary: Gilli dba Solgee is one o
review_text: Gilli dba Solgee is one of my favorite Modcloth designers! I bought this dress in the olive color and it was so comfortable and flattering that I had to have it in purple, too.

review_summary: I have this dress in oliv
review_text: I have this dress in olive and love it so much.  Buying this dress in purple was a no brainer.  Like the olive dress, this one is comfortable and a good length.  It can be dressed up and be dressed down.  This dress is so flattering, and the color is gorgeous.

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favorite dresses I've ever bought from ModCloth. Everything about it is flattering; it's fun and flirty, but at the same time modest enough to be appropriate for more professional settings; it's comfortable; and the color is beautiful! If this ever shows up in other colors, I'll buy them in a heartbeat.
this dress is very comfy. i got it for the summer. i needed more dresses that are airy. this will be great! cant wait to wear it.

This dress is gorgeous! The fabric is soft and flows so nicely, and I LOVE the deep purple color. The fit was perfect as well, I ordered a small and it was just right. Not too tight and not too loose, and the length hits me right at my knees, which is perfect for me (I don't like really short dresses). I love this dress and every girl should own it! :) I can't wait until it gets a little warmer so I can wear it out!
Love this dress! It fits perfectly in every way!

review_summary: I have this dress in gree
review_text: I have this dress in green and ADORE it, so I was thrilled when they added it in another color. Unfortunately, it was sold out, so I had to stalk it for several months waiting for it to return. It was totally worth it like the green version, it is very flattering but still loose enough to not cling to stomach and thighs. If they make any more colors, I will get those too!

Wow!  This dress is lovely!  Even prettier in person!  It's a fantastically pretty shade of plum, nicer to my eyes than what's pictured on the website.  The fabric is indeed quite thin, which other reviewers have noted.  It will be perfect for summer (and as previously noted, very versatile for winter layering), but I do think the thinness of the fabric makes the dress show every detail of my backside if I'm wearing leggings or cotton undies.  However, you'll probably want to wear a slip with it anyway since it's rather sheer, and that will make the dress drape perfectly.  It is extraordinarily flattering to my figure (long torso, petite bust, curvy hips), and the armholes are the perfect size and shape!  Very comfortable, very versatile, and very pretty.  This dress is definitely a winner!!PS I bought it with the All Eyes on Me Scarf (a peacock print), and they look ohsonice together.

review_summary: I love this dress!  I had
review_text: I love this dress!  I had been scouting it for months, even put it on my wishlist so when they restocked, I would get an email.  Then it did, but it sold out within a day!  The SECOND time I bought it as soon as I got the email. Everything about this dress is flattering on me.  The waist hits at my waist, the dress falls just to my knees, and I can wear a bra under it without any strap reveal.  I feel comfortable and it is slimming without grabbing on to every imperfection.  I'm wearing it to work today with tights, boots and a cardigan, but know it will also be great for spring or summer.  A mustbuy!

I received and wore this dress on my birthday, my first Modcloth purchase.  It was perfect.  It has a very flattering cut, a gorgeous color, and I love how the top part covers without hiding the bust.  My husband still stared but at least I didn't feel exposed ;).  One note of caution, the material is very thin and sheer.  The first dress where I feel a slip is necessary as an adult, if only to know if the skirt of the dress is hanging as it should or stuck up in my undergarments if not for any other reason.  I purchased the Can't Stop Dancing half slip in bronze to fulfill this purpose and to give the skirt of the dress a little more shape/body/volume.Overall, a very comfortable and versatile dress that I can wear all throughout the year.  Light enough to wear in the southern summers and flexible enough for winter layers.  I paired this dress with the Tale as Fold as Time wedge; another fantastic Modcloth purchase.

review_summary: I was so excited when thi
review_text: I was so excited when this dress arrived. I already have the same one in Olive. The color is even more stunning in person! The plum is so rich. FANTASTIC dress for all shapes and sizes!

review_summary: This is going to become o
review_text: This is going to become one of my favorite dresses.  Length is about an inch above my knees, which is perfect, since many ModCloth dresses run a bit short to wear worryfree.  The fit is spectacular, with a gathered empire waist and nice thick straps so you'll never have to worry about your bra showing.  The skirt moves well; the only thing I wish is that it flared a bit more away from the body, but that's just because I like a bit more movement when I walk.  All in all, well worth buying and I would recommend this dress to anyone who's still on the fence about it!
This dress is perfect! I love it! The color is definitely a plum, not a purple as it appears on screen which made it even nicer for me. It is so comfortable, and I can't wait to wear it somewhere!

LOVE this dress and Modcloth! I was very impatient for it to come back in stock and I snapped it up the moment it did! It's more plum than purple and very soft. I wish they had an XS though, because it's a tiny bit too big for me and about three inches too long.

review_summary: I had read all the great
review_text: I had read all the great reviews for this dress in the Olive color but I didn't think it was suitable for my complexion (I have yellowtoned skin). So I quickly snatched this up when it came out. The style and material make this dress incredibly flattering, probably for all body types. The top is surprisingly flattering for my small bust but the folds/pleats provide plenty of give to accommodate larger cup sizes. The high/empire waist is great for my short torso. The rayon material is soft, cool, and drapes well, hiding all the bumps and lumps underneath. The dress is exactly kneelength on me. Overall, an excellent purchase for the price and I think I'll be getting a lot of use out of this dress. It's both comfortable and flattering, and can probably be worn in nearly all types of settings and occasions  work, parties, weddings, or even just casually lounging around. Hopefully ModCloth will put more back in stock, because I recommend this dress for everyone!

review_summary: The color is a rich purpl
review_text: The color is a rich purple very pretty and fabric is of great quality. The dress highlights the waist and tricep areas. Based on the high waist I recommend pairing with a short cardigan or jacket.

review_summary: Love it.  Fit is good.  M
review_text: Love it.  Fit is good.  Material feels nice.  Very flattering and easy to wear.
After all the rave reviews for the olive color when I saw the purple I had to get it! It is a very flattering dress and the fabric is super comfortable. Very pretty!

review_summary: I usually wear an XS, so
review_text: I usually wear an XS, so I was a little worried about this purchase.  Fits perfectly though. The empire waist is very flattering. The dress hits just above my knees. And so comfy!

This dress is so versatile and flattering! It looks great with a sweater and leggings for winter and can definitely be dressed up or down with accessories. The material is so soft and has a nice sheen to it as well. Overall, it's a great addition to any wardrobe.

review_summary: I ordered a Large and tho
review_text: I ordered a Large and thought the fabric was soft and very comfortable, it was very clingy and unflattering to my stomach.  Curvy girls, beware of this.  Great quality though.  I was quite sad that I had to return this.

The olive version of this dress was one of the first ModCloth items I purchased a couple years ago.  Gone up a size since then so I'm glad I was able to snag this up, and in my favorite color! Soft, comfortable, drapes nicely and covers everything to be work appropriate.
I bought this dress for my Wedding. Everyone loved it. Thanks Modcloth

review_summary: Everything I ever wanted in a wedding dress
review_text: I ordered this dress one size bigger and it fit perfectly. I have read reviews about need for alteration and that the arms were too big. I happen to carry more weight in my arms so this was sized perfectly for me. I ordered both colors just to see which one looked better because pale colors wash me out. To my surprise the pink was the better choice. The lace is gorgeous and a great contrast to the pink underlay. You will not regret this one curvy girls!!!
Perfect for my wedding. Fit perfectly and was super comfy.

We purchased this for my wedding dress. It is absolutely stunning. I do recommend sizing up. In most brands I'm a US 22. In my experience with Chi Chi London I find I run a 24 and it fits like a glove. I did get a 22 in a different dress from Chi Chi and it was too small. So size up and you'll be in great shape. I recommend this dress if you're thinking of buying it.
it was absolutely perfect for my wedding day! My hubby loved it?

review_summary: When I saw this dress I k
review_text: When I saw this dress I knew it was the wedding dress of my dreams and had it saved to my wishlist before my nowhusband proposed to me. The fit was perfect, I didn't feel like I was being stuffed into it. It has enough of a poof to stand out but won't get in your way of sitting comfortably. The lace along the neckline and arms is probably my favorite detail of the dress, it was the most complimented.

This dress was amazing!!!!!! I bought it last minute for my Vegas wedding. I am typically a size ten but I am a 36ddd so I sized up to a 12. It fit perfectly ! I didn?t even need to wear a bra! The pictures don?t do it justice! The sheen and look is just amazing. Very vintage. I added an ivory petticoat for more oomf at the bottom. I would highly recommend this dress.

I bought this dress for my wedding (another year away) and I am so excited about it! I'm short and curvy, so I was looking for a kneelength vintage dress, be comfortable to wear, suit a Fall Wedding, and was under $200. This dress hit all the check marks, and I got it during one of the sales (win!)I was worried being such a low price, that the fabric would be a little cheap looking or the dress poorly made. But when I opened it, I was really excited to see how delicate and ornate the details were! The bottom half of the gown is really lovely, the top is flattering but conservative, and the side zipper really helps getting the dress on/off. It also has builtin bra pads (which I missed in the info description) so that's a win! I don't think I'll end up needing to wear a bra under the dress which was a concern I had. I only have a few notes to share that I consider really minor and easy to fix: there's 3 layers of tool between the dress and the slip, so it jets out a little more than I like (my hips are about 38, plus poofy dress). I'm considering removing at least one layer to calm it down, but I have a lot of time between now and my wedding so I might change my mind. A frequent note in other reviews is that the top neckline lace work near the collar bone sometimes folds in on its self, which I also experienced. A little fabric tape would do the trick though.Overall, I'm really happy with this dress and I can't wait to wear it for real!
OMG! I'm wearing this dress for my court house wedding and it's just beautiful! The lace is so pretty and it fits like a glove

review_summary: I was so pleased with thi
review_text: I was so pleased with this choice for my wedding day. I bought my true size and it fit like a glove. If you are on the fence about sizing, order up one. Alterations would be worth it.
The dress was lovely and fit well. My biggest issue was tiny threads pulling and getting caught on things.

I bought this online just days after I got engaged, the week the wedding line was released. I wore it for my backyard wedding and the second I put it on, I couldn't believe how beautiful and perfect it was! I received so many compliments and couldn't have imagined a more perfect dress!!!

I bought this about 8 months in advance for my outdoor wedding. I tailored it a bit myself, capped the sleeves and took in the waist a bit but it fit pretty nicely right out of the mail. My usual size fit with minor alterations. It was maybe a tad longer than I would have liked. I'm 5'5 and it hit a few inches below the knee, but overall it's a great dress, especially for the price.

I loved this dress so much and got so many compliments, everybody wanted to know where I got it from. I ordered a 10 and the body fit great but the arms were too tight so I exchanged for a 12. The sleeves fit great so I took it to a seamstress to have the body taken back in to a size 10. I felt amazing and looked amazing all night.

I bought this to wear as my wedding dress and I loved it! I wear a 16 so buying dresses online usually leaves me a little bit sad. Not the case with this one! It fit perfectly! I really wanted a short wedding dress but was having trouble finding one that still felt special. The Gilded Grace Lace dress in Ivory was exactly what I was looking for. One thing for when you look at my pics: my friend's mom is a seamstress so she made 2 alterations for me. I wanted the sleeves to end just above my elbows so she shortened them a little. I also apparently have a short torso, so the neckline of the dress was folding over in the middle unless I constantly pulled it down at my waist. So she cut off a little at the top. It wasn't noticeable at all though.Oh! I just remembered something else. I noticed a few people complaining about the scratchiness of the lace. This was not a problem with me at all. I was actually really (pleasantly) surprised at how soft the lace was. I wore the dress all day and had a great time!! < 3

I bought this dress for a private ceremony between my fiance and I. Pictures do not do it justice. For what I paid, I am beyond thrilled with the dress. I tried on numerous dresses that were easily five or more times the price of this piece and none of them came close to how beautiful this ended up being. It isn't heavy material and made for an easy escape when removing it. Not scratchy. The arms were a bit tight but nothing I felt I'd hulk out of. I wish I could time travel! I felt so beautiful in this dress. I wear a size 13/14, wedding dress is a solid 16. I went with a 14 in this and do not regret it a bit. It fit like a glove. Plenty of room for a  bra underneath, too. Not too tight in any one place. Just right!

This dress was perfect for my outdoor August wedding at a farm. It was very true to size, though I originally ordered it in a size up and returned to get the smaller size. It fit perfectly, no alterations necessary! The lace was comfortable and I had plenty of movement in my arms. I loved that the skirt had a little body, but not too much poof. Every order I made came so quickly, and the return process was super easy. I loved this dress and got lots of compliments on it. Wonderful!!

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this dress for my wedding, but it's just not right.  I knew it would be poofy and I was OK with that, but it's CRAZY POOFY.  To the point where it seems some of the tulle was removed for the photos.  I would feel ridiculous wearing this, it feels like something a 7 year old girl would wear playing princess.  I also felt it ran small...I'm a 36D and ordered a size 10, but it was way too tight across my chest.  It was a good length, right at the knee.  The material is pretty, but it's shiny and I would call it ivory (I ordered champagne and expected it to be darker, more gold/bronze).
this dress was the perfect fit for my vintage themed wedding. the color was just right. the fit was spot on. I was so happy to walk down the aisle in this!
I bought this dress for my wedding and I loved it!I'm normally size 8 but went one size up to be on the safe side and it fitted perfectly except for the sleeves but they we're fixed easily.

review_summary: I wore this dress for my
review_text: I wore this dress for my wedding reception. This dress has the perfect amount of vintage flare and class.

I'm a little disappointed, and not sure if i going to wear it. In the title it says it's ivory, but it's not. It's champagne. It actually says champagne in the email confirmation for the color, which I didn't notice. It should not say it's ivory in the dress title. It is still a pretty dress, but I wasn't hoping for a yellowed ivory. It's also hard to zip up, but it's doable. The front fits a little odd, but I'm am also an odd bust size and it still looks decent.
Had a small courthouse wedding and went with this dress, it was amazing and got so many compliments!

This dress is gorgeous! It was perfect for my vintage style wedding in Vegas. The quality is great and it fit perfectly. It's a tad difficult to get off. The belt and shoes pictured also came from ModCloth.

i bought this dress for my wedding after being told by so many bridal salons that tea length dresses were not in style so they didn't carry any. i took a leap of faith and bought this dress off of Modcloth. when it came in, i was excited however the bottom half didn't seem poofy enough for me. (i wanted to feel like a cupcake lol) i took the dress to my local seamstress and she added several layers of tulle and chiffon IN RAINBOW COLORS underneath the dress. she also fitted the sleeves for me and it all came together perfectly. i also purchased my hat from mod cloth. all anyone could talk about the entire night was my dress! it also ran very true to size unlike most bridal sizes.

It was the most beautiful dress I've ever had. I bought this dress for our rehearsal dinner and I was really thinking of wearing it for my wedding. I felt it was more beautiful than my wedding dress! It was a perfect rehearsal evening with my dress! I am waiting for the perfect occasion to wear it again.
This was my Wedding dress!!This dress was Perfect in every way!!!
loved this dress! It fit perfectly and photographed really well. I got tons of compliments on it!

I ordered this dress three weeks before my wedding and had it shipped overnight in case I needed to return it and order a different size.  It fit wonderfully, although the side zipper did tend to stick.  As others noted, the lace at the neck did lay a little quirky as I had to order a dress made for my much biggerthanmyshoulders waistline, but I just made sure to adjust it occasionally.  Both issues were very minor on such a special day.

I fell in love with this dress immediately! I has a very clear image in my mind of how I wanted to look. This dress exceeded all my expectations and when I told my husband how much it cost, he was shocked! He thought I had spent hundreds! Love it!

review_summary: Wonderful dress, perfect for a small wedding.
review_text: I got this dress for my wedding in April. I was very discouraged when I started looking at plus size gown, but then I found this dress.  It was perfect. I had read reviews about the sleeves being tight, so I did order it a few sizes up(usually a 18, and I ordered a 22) I did have it taken in around the waist, but the sleeves were perfect.

review_summary: Still so happy with this dress
review_text: I bought this last year for my wedding in May. The quality is great (especially for the price), and I love this dress because I feel like the length and fit make it accessible to anyone, and it's not too difficult to alter. There's plenty of room in the chest and sleeves, which is usually my issue with nonstretch material. I got a few alterations: tightened the sleeves, and hemmed the skirt to ~2 inches above my knees (she shortened it at the waist to I didn't lose any of the detail on the bottom of the skirt). Then it was too poofy, so I had some layers removed. There are A LOT of layers, which again makes it so much easier to customize to your preference.

Amazing fast shipping. I had my wedding in Lima Peru and they fast shipping really helped make my special day amazing. Dress is close to true size I had to wear an extra padded bra because I'm pear shaped with a large bottom and smaller top. This dress photographs so nice and was perfect for a Peruvian summer wedding. Thank you Mod Cloth for you dependable service and quality!!!

When I first saw this dress I immediately knew this was THE ONE. I had bit of a struggle with the sizing (solely my own fault) and had to return this dress several times. I'm a size 16 on top but a 12 on the bottom. I thought I could get away with a 14 and was wrong. I ended up getting a size 16 and had a friend take it in. The dress went perfect and I would highly recommend it. It's beyond beautiful in person and the color is striking. When I walked out in this dress during my wedding day..my friends and family literally gasped. I know....DRAMATIC. Some things I'd suggest if your considering this dress: size up and have it altered, if your over a C cup have the bra padding removed, have the sleeves taken in. This dress is all lace so there is no give. There are several layers of tulle in the skirt..so if your not using this as a wedding dress I'd suggest having some layers removed. Also as others have stated it does get snagged a bit...but I can overlook that.

review_summary: The wedding dress of my dreams!
review_text: My husband and I got married in a little garden in Philadelphia. Small ceremony, only 15 guests. And this dress was perfect. Sent to me from the universe! You can see in the pictures that I did have the dress altered slightly to make the neckline fall more off the shoulder, and I added a belt from davids bridal. I would definitely recommend using the size charts I wear a size 16 in pants but I ordered a size 22 dress and it fit like a glove. I received ENDLESS compliments while walking around the city and to the day people still remark on how beautiful my dress was. On top of all that, the quality far surpasses what I paid for this beautiful little number. The detailing on the lace is even more beautiful in person than I imagined when I ordered it. My seamstress told me she couldn't even get the beautiful lace fabric for what I paid for the dress! Not a single person could believe I ordered this dress ONLINE and spent less than $200 on it. Overall completely obsessed and would HIGHLY reccomend.

I bought this dress after looking through thousands of vintage etsy shops  it's really hard to find anything that isn't a small or an extra small if you want to buy vintage.This dress has that great vintage look and comes in all sizes, perfect!

I was internet browsing for my wedding dress and once I saw this dress I knew it was the one for me. I usually wear a 24 in dresses USA size and had to go up a size with this dress. I bought a 24 and ended up exchanging it for a 26. I was going for a vintage look and defiantly achieved the look with this dress. Shipping didn't take long either.

The reviews had me scared about the tightness of the sleeves. So I ended up buying a size 26. I will have to take the dress in about a inch on either side and a little in the sleeves but in my size I'm pretty sure they would have been too tight. I don't understand the complaints about the itchy lace. I think its actually pretty soft. The color is a great soft gold and looks very vintage. It feels very high quality for the price and the skirt is much more full than I though it would be. I cant wait to wear it for my wedding next spring!!

We decided to do courthouse wedding and small family dinner with Parisian/vintage theme and this dress was absolutely perfect! Definitely measure yourself and talk to customer service before picking your size.  I ordered a size 8 and it was a little loose in the waist but slightly tight when it was delivered. Luckily, I had a month to lose a few pounds to ensure it fit perfectly on the day.  Sad I won't be able to wear it again, I felt so beautiful in it.

review_summary: I couldn't love this dress more.
review_text: I absolutely love this dress. I bought it as soon as I got engaged, and I'm so excited to wear it for my wedding  one year from today!I fell in love with the dress the first time I saw a photo of it, and everyone who's posted photos here looks so beautiful! While there are many more positive than negative reviews of this lovely frock, I started secondguessing my decision when I read the negative reviews. Seriously, go read them! You'd think this dress ruined people's lives. I ordered a size 16 (larger than I need, but I'm quite busty  36G  and I knew I'd have to have whatever dress I bought altered to some extent), and I'm happy to report the bust fits perfectly. I did not find the lace to be at all scratchy, as some others have complained about, and the sleeves and shoulders aren't restricting at all. Because of the placement of the zipper (underarm rather than in the back), you WILL need help getting this over your head if you've had your hair done already. The skirt is fuller than it looks in the photos online, but one commenter suggested removing one of the layers of tulle (there are two), and I think I will end up doing just that. Another commenter said having the dress professionally pressed to help with the poofiness was also effective. I found the color to be a true champagne, not a shiny gold as others have suggested. I think it's very true to the online photos. This was the first dress I tried on, and I was immediately sold! It's exactly what I wanted.
Great dress!

I bought this for my wedding while it was on sale and was so nervous to buy anything online! I went a size up and it was perfect, even on the bigger side. It was so perfect for my outdoor forest wedding and went great with my Frye boots! I can't believe the quality for the price. Everyone kept commenting on the detail and the vintage look!

This was my first ever purchase from ModCloth; I actually stumbled upon a picture of this dress in the blush color on Pinterest after looking at hundreds of other dresses online, so when it was time to actually start seriously finding a dress I decided to check this one out.  It was miraculously in stock in all sizes so I ordered it immediately in a size 16 (to accommodate for my bust) and it came just 3 days later despite the winter storms on the east coast!  This dress fits like it was made for me and I almost cried after slipping into it because something I had ordered online actually fit for once.  The length is perfect (I'm 5'7 and it's true tea length on me), the material is not itchy at all like some of the other reviews say, and I have no issues at all with the lace being frayed in some spots or being floppy at the neckline.  It is exactly what I was looking for without breaking the bank and I cannot wait to wear this dress in September when I marry my best friend.
I was more than pleased with my dress and shoes.

I bought this dress for a second wedding.  I just loved everything about it.  Fit was perfect,  look was perfect.  Gave me the vintage look without the high price.  The only flaw in this dress is that it snags very easy.   You have to be very careful.  I would recommend this dress to anyone.

I knew I had to have this dress the moment I saw it. It was perfect for my wedding. It was timeless and I got so many compliments! ModCloth also had fast shipping and wonderful customer service when I needed an exchange. I'm wondering how I can modify it or dye it so I can wear it again!

I felt like a princess on my wedding day < 3 I ended up altering because the lace across the top and arms was ill fitting and felt a little overwhelming for me. Once removed it truly became my dream dress. The sizing of the dress was perfect and i added a petticoat for extra poof!

I just wore this dress as maid of honor at my sister's wedding.  It was perfect.  Extremely comfortable and fun and full.  What girl doesn't love tulle.  Tons of compliments.  Paired perfectly with the bee belt and some fun conversation heart shoes.

review_summary: I bought this dress for my wedding
review_text: I ordered a 26 (which relates to a 4X), and as anticipated by the size chart, it was a couple inches too small. A few grievances I have with the dress are: the color is darker than anticipated, the zipper goes right up into the armpit, and the fabric is itchy. The sleeves aren't tight to my arms, and the lace on the chest doesn't lay flush. I'll probably have the chest lace tailored. The dress isn't as poofy as the pictures or customer service lead me to believe, so I will be purchasing a crinoline. However, the length is absolutely perfect and the bust is nice, and the in sewn cups fit nicely (which is a surprise for my large breasts, but I'll still wear a bra), and overall I feel nice in my dress.

I bought this dress a year before my wedding, I was married on 10/16/16. The reason I say it was almost perfect is because the sleeves were much too large, they belled out oddly and the scalloped neck stuck out a bit. I'm sure it has something to do with the fact that the dress was plus size. I understand it's difficult to get the fit perfectly without knowing how a person is shaped. That being said the rest of the dress was perfect! I needed no changes made to anything else. The length and style were exactly what I wanted for my wedding. This dress is stunning. I always worry about things being underwhelming when I receive them compared to how gorgeous they are in pictures. But when I pulled this out of the package I think I actually stopped breathing for a second! The pattern and material is delicate and lovely. A few big problems though: it is very itchy which is to be expected with the material. And you cannot raise your arms above shoulder height, if that. The stiffness was a let down. We all want to look pretty, but still be able to move almost like a normal person! I wore this for my college graduation, and I was in it for a whole day and managed to deal with the itchy fabric and lack of range of motion. It's also incredibly difficult to get in and out of with the side zipper under the armpit. Prepare to contort yourself into unexpected shapes to get this off. The difficulty of wearing it has deterred me from putting it on more than a couple times. But I hope to have more events to wear it to in the future. Side note: there is so much tulle and layered fabric that it made me look a little chunkier than I am. Small price to pay for such a lovely dress though. Also, it would be nice if this came in a short size, not just regular and long. On my 5'4 frame, it would have been more flattering a couple inches shorter :)

First off, this dress is darling.  As many before me have said, the pictures are beautiful and it is unsurprisingly even more gorgeous in person.  I normally wear and ordered a 2. The dress had a nice, tight fit, but I couldn't zip the dress on my own. I sized up to a 4 which was more comfortable but still appeared tight.As several have said, the lace top and sleeves are a bit itchy.  I have very sensitive skin but it wasn't a problem for me.  The bodice and skirt are lined with a lovely silky material, so no itch there. The silky skirt clings so be prepared to deal with that one way or another. The high waisted skirt does make me feel a little selfconscious and poofy, but worrying is all for naught because it looks great on. I love how it hits the midcalf of most girls who have posted photos here, however it was a bit short on me, coming just below the knee.My dealbreaker is that the tulle DOES provide stretch, but not in the direction that anyone wants.  The tulle stretches if (gently!) pulled vertically, but not horizontally.  This means that there is no room to breathe since the bodice doesn't give any.  It also makes this dress a nightmare to try to get into and out of.  The only way I can get out of this dress on my own is to unzip, bend over, and slowly and gently pull the back of the skirt over my head, thus slowly turning the dress inside out. Painful and not very dignified!I'll try my luck with the longer one that is available in March!

Probably no one could see it if you did not know it was there.  I would not have noticed it if I hadn't noticed all of the threads.  If she can fix it for me it is a keeper.  I hate to send it back,  I am afraid the next one I get won't fit or may have more problems or at least like ones.  I did speak to a customer service representive who assured me if I was unable to get it fixed I could return the item.  The wedding is November 1, 2014 So I have time.  The customer service team at Mod cloth is the best ever.  Thanks for being so nice.

Everything about this dress was lovely concerning the actual manufacturing of it. My problems mainly had to do with the fact that it was way too small.  I planned on wearing it as a wedding dress so I made sure my measurements were spot on, ordered according and waited patiently. I'm in Australia so I needed to be certain.  Unfortunately upon arrival, I tried it on  too small. I actually needed assistance getting it off. The lace, although beautiful is rather thick but I'm sure if I would have flexed my shoulders and chest enough while I had it on I would have ripped it.It's also worth noting that the color in the picture appears to be a lovely nude,  it's not. Very gold in some lights, this wouldn't have been a problem for me but perhaps with some it could have potentially been a disaster. It was a shame about the length too, a bit shorter than expected.

Pretty, but the fit wasn't quite right for me and I returned it. The dress had a bit too much poof through the hip area, so it made me look much wider than I really am. Also, the fabric is quite itchy and I could imagine it would be uncomfortable wearing it for long periods of time. I'm really bummed this didn't work as a wedding dress for me because the style is fantastic.
It was a beautiful wedding dress
Scratchy, lace needs to be stretch not stiff.

The color is perfect. It's a champagne gold, not a yellow gold. Length is great. I would like the waist to be a bit longer/more dropped, but still fits well. The quality is really sturdy, in fact it's a bit heavier than I expected. Overall I'm very happy with the dress and excited to wear it to a dear firend's wedding as a bridesmaid.

review_summary: I will be using this dres
review_text: I will be using this dress in march 2015 for my wedding! im in love with the dress i went with such a larger size due to the size of my large chest and back end.. my arms also had to play a role in the size i chose as well due to the material not having any give. There are some spots that i could go ahead and get altered in at the moment but i would rather focus on slimming down between now and at least jan/feb before taking in for alterations.. But over all great quality yes the lace is a bit scratchy but nothing that cant be tolerated.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m

The quality was very nice and had I been looking while younger I probably would have gone for it!

The dress is stunning!!!  The biggest down fall was the material of the sleeves were so rough and so itchy, it truly felt like sand paper on my arms.  I thought maybe I could get over it but after wearing it for 10 minutes my skin got so itchy that I knew I had to return it :(

review_summary: I love this dress but eve
review_text: I love this dress but even though I ordered a size bigger than usual I still need the next size up. My advice is that if you are on a time crunch, orders two sizes up from what you normally wear and you should be set. Mostly it was too tight on my arms where the most delicate fabric is. A 14 should be just right though! I can't wait.
absolutely LOVED it! just a little bit itchy!

This is a beautiful dress. It was a little too short for my torso, so the skirt flared out above my natural waist and made me a little selfconscious about how wide/uncurvy I looked. The lace is beautiful though (very gold colored), and it was a great price for a wedding dress!

This is the most beautiful dress in the entire world. Everything about it is amazing. The golden, detailed lace is perfect for a fall wedding. I can't wait to get married in this. I may be trying it on every day from now until October 25th. :) It is REALLY tight in the arms so I suggest sizing up a bit. I'm usually a 10/12 but I got a 16 to be safe. The sleeves are loose, but the good kind so I can move my arms, and the skirt is perfect. The chest/waist area is super loose but can be easily taken in for cheap. Better bigger than smaller!

Very pretty dress, it fits like a glove, it's not itchy at all, I agree with the reviews here to order a size up, I am usually a 10 but after reading the reviews here decided to order the 12 and I am glad I did :) I am excited to wear it at my wedding :)

review_summary: I ordered the dress in a
review_text: I ordered the dress in a 14 which I could tell would fit in my bust and waist but did not fit in the sleeves. I couldn't even get it over my head  not even with the zipper undone. (The zipper is useless, I think, for getting the dress on and off.) I exchanged it for a size 16, and I was swimming in it in the bust and waist. I'm a 36B. However, the sleeves fit. This time, I couldn't get it off. I had to bend forward and inch and wiggle it off. All in all, very frustrating. The dress is very pretty, though. It is a dark ivory with gold embroidered lace. I would have liked it better if it were a lighter ivory, but, still, very pretty. I'm disappointed it didn't work out. I will have spent $12 returning wedding dresses to try on. I've decided to go with a custom made dress from Etsy for the same price and with higher quality fabric. I should also note, I don't ever have size/fit issues. I rarely have to try anything on in stores or online, so this was odd for me.

review_summary: The dress is cute but MUC
review_text: The dress is cute but MUCH more glittery in person and the feel of the material is rough. If really girly apparel is your style then I  definitely recommend going up a size, sadly I returned this item but I got in store credit for other purchases so yay!

Size up, ladies! I'm thinking this may be UK sized. I'm typically a size 8, but had to order the 12, as the sleeves were tight and the waist was smallish. Dress is a great color, a light champagne/gold. Classy and demure. Would be beautiful for an outdoor wedding.

Size up, ladies! I'm thinking this may be UK sized. I'm typically a size 8, but had to order the 12, as the sleeves were tight and the waist was smallish. Dress is a great color, a light champagne/gold. Classy and demure. Would be beautiful for an outdoor wedding.

I absolutely love this dress, but it was too gold for what I was wanting it for. I was interested in using it for my wedding, but I was looking for more of an actual ivory or white!I wish I had a reason to wear it though. It's gorgeous!!

review_summary: I am so happy with this d
review_text: I am so happy with this dress. I based my size off the measurements in the size chart and the fit is perfect. The lace is a bit itchy, as some have stated, but I only noticed it if I was moving around a lot. I thought the coloring was gorgeous. It is a gold dress but it's a light gold and the lace detailing is the right amount of shimmery. I'm using this dress for my fall wedding and I think the this will be a great dress for the season. I did notice a slight unraveling in one of the lace details but it's a very small patch and barely noticeable. Overall, I'm extremely happy with the dress and I can't wait to wear it in my wedding.

review_summary: A little tight up top if
review_text: A little tight up top if you have big boobs, but otherwise a beautiful dress!
I may have purchased this dress as a possible wedding option. It was everything I wanted, but I ordered way too small and had to return it.

review_summary: This dress is so so so it
review_text: This dress is so so so itchy!! I could barely keep it on! It was also just okay looking, really puffy and strange fitting. Returned immediately

review_summary: I order this dress for my
review_text: I order this dress for my graduation party, I was looking for something different from the other girls with her tight satin finish, rocky dresses and then I found this beautiful dress. This was my first ModCloth order, it took a little while to get home but it was worth it, the quality isn't perfect but at night, in the party, nobody is going to examine anything but how you look in the dress. And I looked good. I got so many compliments about this dress. I'm a big girl so, it has a few complications, it's a little tightfitting so I need help taking it off not to rip it. It's a little hot, too. Anyways, I love it and I would buy it again everytime.

review_summary: Oh man, the 6 fit me like
review_text: Oh man, the 6 fit me like it was custommade. (Also tried the 8, which was an inch or so wider in the waist.) That said, the material looked a little too costumey/cheap. It photographs almost white, but much of the dress is actually a champagne/gold, and had an inelegant sheen. Even the sleeves fit great despite providing no stretch (I've got slightly flabby arms so I was surprised they fit nicely), but I had very limited range of motion. Since I was considering this for a wedding dress, I was joking with a friend that I'd have to underhug everyone because I couldn't raise my arms above shoulder height in this; my biggest fear was that it would rip if I did make too sudden of a movement. All told, if it was a more ivory white throughout with slightly more flexible lace, I would've been sold on it.

I was a little skeptical about the reviews on the arms but I should've listened. I could BARELY get it on. It was the most uncomfortable, Illfitting, ugly poof I've ever seen. Whoever designed this dress didn't put it on a human. If you're going to put in a zipper there should be one all the way up the back. The side zipper is USELESS. It's nearly impossible to get your arms into the tight gaudy gold lace up top. I haven't decided if I want to try a bigger size, get this one altered without all of the crap on top (sleeves, neckline), or just say screw it. This was supposed to be for engagement pics next weekend andy rehearsal dinner. At this rate (because none of the dresses fit) I have nothing to wear for pictures.

review_summary: I'm so in love with this
review_text: I'm so in love with this dress!!! It's the perfect length and color. The only thing I don't like about it is the itchy neckline, but it's so worth it.
fabric itches like wool.
Though it's huge and kind of itchy, the dress is amazing! I love everything about is especially because I'll be using it for a little something special :) can't wait to alter it and wear it :)

This dress is beautiful! I bought it for my grandparents 50th anniversary party where I will be performing and thought this was a perfect stage dress. There are only 2 complaints. 1) The chest area is cut very small if you are larger chested like myself you will need to go up possibly an extra size. 2) like others have said the neck fits loosely. I am getting this part altered but for the price and since the chest isn't large I didn't expect the neck to be loose. The arms are rather slim but manageable and there we're a few frayed strings hanging from the arm and because it is not a cheap dress I expect more. All in all though none of these grievances are a deal breaker for me. I love the tone and look that this dress gives and when I showed my grandparents they loved it so it's a keeper!

review_summary: This is a really gold dre
review_text: This is a really gold dress. It's beautiful, vintage and has a slight rose tint to the slip which gives off this really warm color. The lace is too itchy for my sensitive skin but all the same, it's a very well made dress. The bell of the dress falls at about 3/4 down my legs. I'm planning on wearing it for engagment photos, rehearsal dinner and possibly my getaway dress.***Definitely order up a size!***
It's perfect except for the little detail in the neck which actually is not very serious, and it's more golden than the picture. But definitely this is the dress for my wedding day

review_summary: The lace on the sleeves o
review_text: The lace on the sleeves of this dress is very stiff and itchy, and something about the top looks a bit cheap. However, the skirt is lovely and full and soft, and the overall effect of the dress is quite good. I bought this for my wedding and despite some reservations, I think it's a good choice.
absolutely beautiful .. I got so many compliments
Beautiful dress but extremely stiff and itchy fabric. Could not wear it because of this.

review_summary: I was so excited for this

review_summary: I am SO sad this will not
review_text: I am SO sad this will not be my wedding dress. The look is perfect, but as other reviews say, it's pretty itchy on the lace and my arm movement is restricted by the lace, which has no stretch at all. If it was less itchy and more moveable it would be an easy yes to this dress. I will be returning this dress against my wishes.

review_summary: This dress is a dream. I
review_text: This dress is a dream. I fell in love with it the moment I saw it and, although the color is darker (more of a gold than a cream for the lace portions), it is GORGEOUS, love it to death. I have big arms so usually dresses with sleees don't fit me well but this dress has just enough give and surprised me when I didn't rip the (forgivably itchy) sleeves. Can't wait to wear it next weekend!!

review_summary: I purchased this for my w
review_text: I purchased this for my wedding day and, wow, it is far more beautiful in person than it could ever be in pictures. It looks glamorous and expensive and vintage in the best way. The fit can really make or break this dress for you. The lace has basically no give, so you have be fairly confident that size you've ordered fits not just your bust, but your arms too. As per other reviews, I ordered a size up, which worked out great. Oh, and along those same lines, because of the nostretch, you'll need someone to help you put the dress on and take it off. I personally run petite, which makes the dress hit me mid calf rather than at the knee (still cute). Be aware that, because of the design of the lace and the placement of the side zipper, it's a tricky dress to get tailored. The bust is so structured, I probably won't even need a bra to wear this dress! It's still the best purchase I've made for my wedding, and I can't wait to get married in modcloth!

I ordered this dress for my wedding. I had already returned three dresses so I was freaking out a little. This dress was out of stock until 3 weeks before the big day. I ordered it and had it in 6 days! I ordered a size up which turned out to fit perfectly. It is a lot more gold than the picture shows but was exactly what I wanted. The neckline doesn't lay flat and is a little itchy so be prepared for that. Once I put this dress on none of that mattered. It fit perfectly, was beautiful and made me actually feel like a bride. The quality is awesome. I adjusted the neckline with a quick stitch and the itchiness goes away. I'm only sad that I can't wear this dress again!!!

I had been searching everywhere for the perfect courthouse wedding dress. I knew the second I saw this one that it was THE ONE. I ordered up 1 size like everyone recommended and it fit almost perfectly. The sleeves were WAY to big and I had to sew them to make it fit. After I sewed it, it fit like a dream. Yes, it's itchy. But its LACE not cashmere. Please don't be silly and expect it to feel like silk. It wasn't bothersome at all. I adore this dress!

I really wanted this dress to work! It was one of the most beautiful dresses I have seen, and reminded me of Classic Grace Kelly. I purposely bought a size 18 because the 16 was sold out. I would have paid for alterations but ultimately did not love how the dress fit. The skirt is very full, and not entirely flattering to bigger hips. The lace sleeves were too loose and the color wasn't especially flattering for a pale complexion. If this would have been for my own wedding, it would have been worth the alterations, but it was just for fun, causing me to return it.

It is a wonderful dress. It fit perfect. It was a bit itchy when you first put it on but nothing that I couldn't get use to. I did have a little problem with snagging it though. All in all I loved this dress and would recommend it to anyone.

I've seen this dress come and go on Modcloth, so I knew I had to get it ASAP once it was back in stock! it's beautiful and I'm so excited to wear it for my wedding next spring. the collar is a little itchy but it's a minor thing.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my very small wedding and it was PERFECT. It was risky, because it literally showed up the day before, but it fit fabulously. The lace is really itchy, but that's to be expected. Fair warning: If it does fit you like a glove like it did for me, have someone who can help you out of it because it has a side zipper and the lace doesn't give so it's going to be relatively impossible to get out of on your own.
More on the golden side, but beautiful anyways!

Beautiful dress, but the neckline did not sit well on me and the sleeves were too tight. Sad to return it.

Very pretty detailed material

This dress is truly beautiful.  However, the bust runs small and like the description says, fabric does not provide stretch.  If the bust wasn't smaller than a typical size 12, this would have been rated a full five star.

This dress is absolutely breathtaking. It has quite a few more layers of tulle than I expected, but it looks wonderful. I have no problem with the front laying flat. Although the lace is a little itchy, I got used to it very quickly and I'm honestly so pleased with the dress. It's gorgeous and I can't wait to wear it. I had no problem with sizing, although the bust is a little small. I'd go braless or wear a bandeau something strapless and flattening would help.

This dress is absolutely stunning.The neckline does droop a bit but I plan to have that fixed.And it is a little itchy on top but nothing that I can't deal with.It's so pretty I don't even want to take it off!

review_summary: Be warned, there is a LOT
review_text: Be warned, there is a LOT more gold on this dress than you can see in the picture. It is quite sparkly.Also, VERY itchy. There are small remedies for this, but be expecting to have to make some alterations to this dress for it to fulfill your hopes.

Really pretty dress, well made but had to return because the lace that goes over the chest area did not lay flat and the sleeves were too big and loose. I would have needed to have it altered and I needed it for a special occasion that was just days away so there was no time for it.

The dress is definitely more gold than anything. I was very pleased with the shape of the skirt and the quality of the fabric. However, the manufacturers did not redraft the bodice for larger sizes, so the sweet lace detail on the neckline does not match up properly with the sleeves, causing gapping and uneveness. Boo, I really wanted to like this one! :(

I purchased this dress hoping to wear it for my courthouse wedding.  The dress fit me perfectly as per the measurements recommendations.  Did not have a problem with the lace not laying flat against by chest as some reviewers have stated.Unfortunately I had to return it because the material was just too itch for me against me neck and arms, but mostly because even though I knew there was gold in the fabric it was way more prevalent than the ivory which is what I wanted.

This dress. This amazing dress!!!!! I have no words to describe how amazing and beautiful this dress is. Fits perfect. The quality is not cheap! It's just absolutely amazing. If you're hesitating to purchase this dress...STOP and just buy it. You will not be disappointed. So happy!!! I highly recommend this dress!!!!

So this dress looks really lovely on the model. Elegant, and lacy. Problems: The lace is VERY scratchy and rough. The fabric where the neckline is doesn't lay flat on the chest/collarbone (it folds over like a wilted flower). Does not flatter people with not very narrow waists.

review_summary: I have been trying on so
review_text: I have been trying on so many wedding dresses, usually $1000+, in so many stores, all of which seem to be made for the tallest people in existence.  When I would ask, Do you have any tea length dresses, I was usually given a quizzical look like, why would you want that?  MODCLOTH TO THE RESCUE.  3/4 length sleeves? Check.  Lace?  Check.  Tea length? Check.  Reasonably priced?  Check.  This dress is perfect in all those aspects.  However, I agree with the other reviewers, it is itchy.  But only when you first put it on, after that, it definitely is pretty comfortable.  My issue is with the sleeves, my swimmer shoulders could definitely use more room.  I also intend to fix the so called neck line won't lie flat issue at my local seamstress.  For the price, alterations really aren't a big deal.  We'll just see if they can do anything to the sleeves to let me be able to raise my arms up all the way...Really, thanks again ModCloth.  You saved me from buying a wildly expensive gown and cutting it in half to fit me.

I bought this dress last minute for my upcoming weddinghad a change of heart about my original dress. Think finding a wedding dress is stressful? Try buying one online a month before the wedding! Procrastination at its finest, and thankfully ModCloth came though on this gem! I was a little skeptical at first because the dress was REALLY hard to get on and was REALLY scratchy, like other reviews said. I ordered up a size and am very glad I did because the top/arms are super hard to get onlike I thought I was going to rip it hard. Once I tried the dress on a couple times it kind of loosened up enough that I can get it on without messing up my hair or makeup. It is scratchy, but it is really not that bad. Overall this dress is beautiful and the detail is amazing. I feel awesome in it!!

I was recently married 5 months ago and went a little more traditional with my wedding dress then I thought I would. Unfortunately our wedding pictures weren't what we expected so my husband and I decided to do a newlywed shoot in our new home together. I immediately knew what I was going to wear. I have loved this dress the moment I saw it and ordered it as soon as it was back in stock. I was apprehensive because of some of the negative reviews, but they were quickly put to shame the moment it arrived and I tried it on. I am usually a size 12 so I did as instructed and ordered up a size, it fit perfectly. It isn't as itchy as some have reviewed and even with my 36 d chest the top panel laid flat as it did in the pictures. It is a little difficult to get on and off as others have stated. But I managed to maneuver it myself without help from my hubby. Overall my favorite Modcloth purchase. Take a chance on this dress! You won't be disappointed :)

review_summary: I was nervous to buy this
review_text: I was nervous to buy this dress for my wedding reception because of the complaints listed against it in the comments. But I am happy to say that despite the fact that many of the negative remarks were true, this is definitely the dress!Bad things that were true  The fabric is in fact really scratchy around the arms and shoulders where your skin is directly touching the skin, but this doesn't bother me too much. The lace also really limits the mobility of my arms, and because of this it's a huge pain to take the darn thing off. the zipper was a bit fussy as well. The lace around the neck does drupe forward a bit, but this is an easy fix with a double stitch.Good things  It fit me perfectly. There is enough support in the bust that I will not have to wear a bra (though I am small chested, so keep that in mind). The dress is high quality and is just absolutely gorgeous. It is incredibly flattering. I am excited to be getting #marriedinmodcloth!

This dress is gorgeous, I loved looking at it, just not on me. The skirt is incredible, one of the prettiest things I've ever seen. The top is the issue. What everyone says about the sleeves is true, you feel like you can't raise your arms, and getting it off is a feat. I was afraid I was going to tear it and had to come up with some crazy contortionist maneuvers to get out of it. The material isn't lace, it's a glossy thick tulle, which has no stretch or give to it. The trim around the neckline stands out instead of laying flat and I can see how it could get stretched out and never go back. It's also not very flattering, it's sheer and shows off any sort of back or arm fat.The sizing is true but snug. I think this dress is best for small chested or petite women on top. If you are larger on top I'd recommend going a couple of sizes larger and having it altered.

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought it for my junior prom, and it couldn't have been more perfect. I felt beautiful and different. Everyone wanted to know where I got my dress.

review_summary: Love this dress so much b
review_text: Love this dress so much but just about had a panic attack trying to get it off. The zipper is on the side which makes for a beautiful seamless look but a huge pain to get off. Make sure you have someone else around to help you out of this dress. I haven't decided if I'm going to keep it or not as I would have to exchange and size up. It was a little small. If you're getting married and are looking for something inexpensive, simple, and elegant  this dress is it!

Searching for a wedding dress on Mod Cloth is quite the challenge and such a fun experience. This dress popped up and after half of day of debating to buy it, my size was already gobbled up. Going one size up, this dress was still all looks but no bite. The material was SO scratchy it just wasn't worth it, and the arms just didn't fit right. Sadly, I had to return.

This is literally the best dress EVER. I ordered a 24 and it seems for plus sizes that its best to size up because the dress is a little tight in the waist, but thats my fault on ordering, the length is perfect and as other reviews said the dress is more cream colored and gold not really white, but I didn't really want a white dress so it works for me. I know in other reviews people said the gold stitching was itchy but to me its perfectly fine... Over all this dress is probably the best thing I've ordered from any online clothing store and don't let the $139 price tag scare you this dress is totally worth ever penny!

Beautiful.Definitely need to have a petite frame. As I am very muscular this just didn't work in the top and arms lol I wanted it to work so badly! I highly recommend it for the quality and the fact that you feel like a princess as soon as you put it on

First of all, this dress is GORGEOUS.  When I put it on I was immediately overcome with nervous excitement about wearing it at my upcoming courthouse wedding.  It is absolutely perfect in every way and it makes me feel like a princess.  I was afraid it would be itchy after reading all the other reviews, because I have very sensitive skin  but it doesn't itch me at all!!  I was afraid I'd have to size up because of what everyone said about the top being super small... I'm normally a 14 (because I have quite a large bust), and only the 16 was available so I ordered it thinking it would be perfect.  But it's actually quite large.  I will be taking it in myself, so it's no problem.  So for me, the top didn't run small.  Although it IS kind of difficult to take off yourself.  It's scary because you think you'll tear the lace in the dress.  I think there should have been a back zipper instead of a side one but then I guess that would ruin the lace illusion neckline at the back.  I think once I take it in, it's definitely going to be even more scary trying to take it off.  But this won't deter my love for the dress.  I'm actually going to tailor the top so that it's REALLY tight because this is the style of dress it is!  It looks better if the top is tight like a corset.  As for the people who think it's too puffy. This is a 50's style gown, why would you purchase such a sillouhette if you don't like puff?  This is the most beautiful dress I've seen.  It's beyond lovely.

I loved the dress online but when I revived it I realized that the whole dress is made of itchy tool. Not lace like I thought. The neckline drooped in front and back. I ultimately had to send the dress back because I wasn't about to wear it to prom.

review_summary: I bought this dress to we
review_text: I bought this dress to wear to my wedding, and I absolutely love it! I actually fell in love with this dress online when they were out of nearly every size, so I bought it in a size 16, even though I wear a size 8. A friend of mine tailored it to fit me, so it fits like a dream. The skirt on this dress is so beautiful, and I love the lace detail on the top. I will say that compared to the rest of the dress, the top was relatively small, especially in the arms. I have larger arms and they never would have fit if I bought it in my size. The top was a little itchy, but not as bad as I expected from all the reviews. I wore it all night without a problem.

I originally ordered this dress for my anniversary. And I've been daydreaming about this dress for awhile now, but alas, to my disappointment.I am so happy that I never have to wear this dress again. I wouldn't wear it if someone paid me to, or if the dress was free.I'm normally a size 2. A true size 2. (I thought it was nice that I didn't have to wear a bra with the dress, but that's hardly a positive in the grand scheme).The quality isn't as good as it shows in the photos. It looks kind of tacky and costumelike in person. The gold and the lace is just... meh. Dress went on nice enough. Zipped up good. Completely awkward fit. I looked like an old Irish bag lady. My skin is really pale, and I don't think the dress did me any favors as it completely washed me out into this nude, ivory, gold puff monster. The lace collar doesn't lay right and bunches up and shifts awkwardly when you move your arms because the whole thing is connected. The bottom of the dress doesn't lay very well. It's uncomfortable around the armholes and near the zipper. It's lined, but IT IS THE SCRATCHIEST thing I have ever put on in my life. I thought I was going to go insane. The greater problem is that I couldn't get out of the dress because of the fit of the sleeves and the collar. It took me a good 30 minutes to remove myself from it. I felt like I was trapped in a scratchy iron maiden. I don't think I could have returned this dress faster.Waste of money. Broke my heart.

review_summary: I got this dress for my w

review_summary: I bought this dress as a
review_text: I bought this dress as a reception dress to change into for dancing, and I wanted to love it. But it had a very different fit on me than the model. I am smaller on top and bigger on the bottom (the dreaded pear!), but the size 6 fit great (my usual size). I didn't have the puckering issue that others had... but the petticoat LAYERS! They were ridiculous. I looked like a cupcake. They had this weird twist in the hem which made them puff out more than they normally would. Also, the lace skirt of the dress was several inches longer than the petticoat fabric. So I found that the skirt would drape outward with the petticoat, but then once the skirt fabric surpassed that of the petticoat, it just fell straight down. Allinall a very strange fit on me. I think perhaps it might work better for someone who is a little smaller on the bottom, as I am already a little self conscious of skirts that puff out too far and accentuate that certain aspect of my bod. Beautiful lace fabric though, and the gold scalloping at the bottom is very pretty.
Very itchy as everyone describes and small is an understatement! The waist fit but I could never get the zipper up! This beauty is going back. And I'm sad as I love this dress!

I ordered this dress the same day it was first made available but as I live in Australia I only just received it today. That means I had no reviews to go on when i ordered it, and was getting more and more worried as more and more reviews came up saying it is not very roomy in the bust. When I finally tried it on to day I was relieved. The waist fit perfectly and comfortably and I was glad I had ordered a size 2 as anything else would've been too big. On top... yes I could've done with a bit more room, but nothing too bad. I think I might take out the padding though as they are not doing much for support and are taking up room that could be better spent on my actual boobs. But I can breathe just fine and they don't look squashed. My only comfort concern is the lace  it's itchy and it's impossible to move your arms up above your shoulders. I don't recommend trying to get out of the dress on your own, I did and I nearly dislocated my shoulder!Overall I am very happy with the dress  it looks great, a bit darker than I thought which is good as it doesn't look too much like a wedding dress and for the price you get a LOT of fabric. I recommend!

I still love the dress and will be wearing it at my rehearsal dinner.

I hadn't seen many reviews of this in a plus size so I thought I would put one up. First let me say: I love this dress, and I've worn it several times since I purchased it just over a month ago. I am usually a true 3X at Modcloth, but I often size up in dresses because I have a very large bust. VERY large. Since the fabric provides stretch I went with a 3X on this item, but honestly I might have even been able to size down. The 3X fits very comfortably, and if you don't want a dress that's bodycon I would order in your true size. However it does leave a little bit of room in the waist for me, though it still looks gorgeous. The dress is a heavy, sturdy material. The length hits me just below the knee and I'm tall, so it might be a little long on shorter women. I find the seams on the front of the dress very flattering, and it's a piece that's versatile enough I can wear it just about anywhere. The plus sizes seem to have more of a Vneck than the regular sizes, which I enjoy but people might want to be aware of. Overall I'm so glad that I took the chance on this item even with few plus size reviews, it's instantly become a staple for me. So comfortable!!

So I tried it on again, and started to rethink.  The material of the dress has a nice weight to it  not too heavy to add layers to it for colder seasons, but not too light to only make it wearable for the warmer seasons. To recap: I am a giant picky cry baby who nit picked this dress almost forcing myself to dislike it when it actually makes for a great staple in the closet. The neckline is perfect and the waist hits at just the right spot. It is incredibly flattering. This is THE perfect little black dress that you can pair with anything and wear anywhere. I highly recommend it.

In central Texas, the large and celebrated bat population means I can wear a dress with bats on it yearround. What a delightful addition to my wardrobe!

review_summary: If you have a larger bust
review_text: If you have a larger bust SIZE UP.  Got this in XL and I had total wonky boob syndrome (smushed down and pushed out to the side boobs).  It wasn't pretty.  I'm praying (and I'm not even religious) that the 1X will resolve this issue because the rest of the dress fit just fine.  But I'm a little nervous.  I'll report back if the size up helped.

I ordered the dress with the bats pattern.  I normally faithfully fit into a 3X in ModCloth's items, but based on other reviews I sized up to a 4X for this one.  The bottom half of the dress felt slightly too snug and the top half looked tentlike.  It seems a lot better worn with a belt but I just felt too selfconscious in it.  Also if you order the bat dress, it's worth noting that the color shown online is completely different than how the dress is in person.  Yes, I know that all monitors are calibrated differently (I color correct photography at my job and am very aware!) but the dress I saw online had a clear purple tint to it whereas the dress I received was inching more towards burgundy.  As a goth person who already doesn't have that many options with ModCloth... this simply didn't go at all with my aesthetic and had to go back.

review_summary: This dress is made of ver
review_text: This dress is made of very very poor material.  While many fabrics are somewhat sheer, this dress's fabric is so loosely woven it's like mesh.  A cheaply made dress and not worth even the 40% off discount they offered.  Sizing is also way off between regular sizes and 'extended' sizes.  I have a coach tour  dress in 1x and decided too late to return it that it was too big.  If a 1x is too big (gappy even) then presumably the XL should be spot on right?  NOPE.  This XL is  super tight over the girls and as a result it hitches up awkwardly.  The material is a bit stretchy so it could be flattering if the size difference between an XL and a 1x was the same as between an L and an XL but alas, like many clothing manufacturers, to make extended sizes you just blew up the pattern excessively.  So disappointed.

Especially for the price, I couldn?t have asked for a better dress for my special day. We got married at the courthouse and it was pretty last minute. I got the dress and it was a little small (which I should note  I am typically an 18 and it was snug), so I needed to order a bigger size. I was kind of panicked, because the wedding was less than a week away. I called customer service and they overnighted the dress to me free of charge! The stress that eliminated for me was incredible. review_summary: Beautiful and a fabulous price, but tiny sleeves!
review_text: I bought this dress along with two other wedding dresses to see which one would work best. This was the only one that I actually couldn't physically put on, because the sleeves were so incredibly tight in proportion to the rest of the dress. However, with that aside, the material and style looked really gorgeous. If it had fit properly, I probably would have loved it. But since one of the other dresses charmed me, I see no need to resize and try again with this one. If you have very slim arms and/or size up drastically to accommodate the arms, I think someone could be really pleased by this dress.

After my tailor messed up the original dress I ordered I was in a panic.  I was on a tight budget and didn't want to spend much more money on a dress than I already had. I remembered that ModCloth had plus size dresses at reasonable prices. I fell in love with this dress and ordered it.  It came quickly. It was beautifully packaged and took my breath away when I opened it.  I felt wonderful in it much better than my original dress.  I am sad to see that some reviewers felt the fabric was cheap.  I thought it was beautifully made, the fabric had a lovely sheen and of course the lace was amazing. The new tailors did a great job getting it ready in about 2 weeks. All in all I feel like the money I wasted was on the original dress (which was a knock off from overseasactually not a horror story until I took it to the tailor!). Anyway, if you are on a budget, love lace and want to feel bridal on your special day, I don't think you can go wrong with this. I added a belt which doesn't show in the long picture but I missed the bling on the original dress.  I also used a 1 hoop slip as the fabric is a bit sheer and I loved the way the lace looked when it was able to float a bit. Now that it's on sale, don't be shy.  It's lovely!

This was the perfect dress for our very low key wedding in the redwoods! No one could believe I got it for $200. It was extremely comfortable and looked great. I am a curvy lady and it was a little bit big for me (I sized up in panic), it was a little bit loose in the waist and arms but no one noticed. I added a crinoline underneath to give it a little more poof.

I picked this dress to be my wedding dress. It was the perfect choice for my dreary, snowy, January winter wedding on a boat! Loved the lace detail on the sleeves & the sweetheart neckline. The fabric wasn't the least bit itchy, and it photographed beautifully. The dress itself was cut to be flattering  so much so, I had no need for any additional shapewear. (Also, screw shapewear!! #bodyPositivity). I am a size 16, wear a 36L bra, and I still took it in for alterations to bring in the side a bit (I bought a size 16 dress and it was sized very generously), but there was honestly no need with a sash tied at the waist. I also have large arms, and didn't find the sleeves restrictive at all. There was lots of room in the sleeve without being loose. The color of the dress is a shade warmer than pure white, so keep that in mind when picking a veil. I also needed a slip underneath this for additional volume & to help conceal my goodies. Other than that, I have no complaints! I got a ton of compliments on the dress, and spent WAY less on it than I would have for a dress from some fussy bridal shop!

I bought this dress in December for my wedding in February. I was nervous because I am a plus sized woman and I didn't know how well it would fit and the time was cutting so close to the wedding. I did order the dress a size bigger because several reviews did say the arms were a bit snug.The package arrived 1 week later and I was so happy with how gorgeous the lace was and all the detailing. It was a great quality dress. Because I ordered the dress a size larger (size 24), I had to get it tailored around the waist and arms. My tailor did an amazing job and it really was the perfect dress for our wedding. (rustic country theme). If you are concerned with sizing, I do suggest going a size up and getting a good tailor to make the fit perfect for you. I am 5'7 and the length was perfect mainly because I opted to wear flats. If you are wearing heels at my height or taller, it will not hit floor length...and I also added a sash :)

I am getting married this week, and this gorgeous dress by Chi Chi London is what I'm going to be walking down the aisle to! I love so many things about it... let me count the ways! I think the length is perfect for shoes peeping out and also not trailing on the ground. I also love the fabric and the lace.
