review_summary: This is the ONE. Love it!
review_text: This is the ONE. Love it! So this fits a bit snug on me, but it would take losing less than five pounds and it will fit a bit more comfortably. Like many others, I found the shoulders and arms to be very tight, like if you're trying to lift your arms up it will pull in the upper back and prevent it (again, a few pounds should help). I imagine it's a bit like a guy's suit. No movement in your arms above 90 degrees. But despite that, the way I felt in this dress means I will absolutely make it work. It feels very bridal. Not just a white dress. I can't believe the value for the money. It would be a bit better if there was some stretch to the lace, but oh well. The length is perfect on me for flats because I don't want to wear heels. And because I read it on someone else's review, I made sure to have someone on hand that could help me out of the dress. Thank god I did or I'd be telling my fianc? to close his eyes and remove it by brail! There was no way I was getting it off on my own, but once a little fabric came over my shoulder, it came right off. I tried on four other online dresses (including two others from ModCloth) and this was the one by far. This dress is beautiful.

The beautiful details of this dress really show in person! I definitely felt like a bride as soon as I tried this dress on. It fits like a glove! Very comfortable and you really cannot beat this price point. #ReviewContest

Like other reviews have said if you want to spruce it up get a $15 petticoat which is what I will do. The chest is very small (I am flat chested and couldn't try it on with a bra) I would suggest sizing up if you are above a c cup. The I found the fabric more tolerable than the tea length version of this, it wasn't itchy and the neckline wasn't out of control. I was able to take the dress on and off like a shirt and didn't become stuck. Will you be amazed by the dress like you would at a bridal boutique? No. Are you paying like 15% of the price vs a store dress? Yes. This is something to customize and make your own.

I'm getting married October 16, 2016. 5 weeks before the wedding I realized that the seamstress had irrevocably screwed up my mom's wedding dress, which I had planned to wear. *moment of silence* So I started shopping! I ordered this dress, Perennial Poise, and Memorable Matrimony. So if you have similar measurements, feel free to check out my photos and reviews of those dresses, also! This dress is absolutely gorgeous!!! Fit perfectly. It seemed slightly long initially, which concerned me because I would hate to hem that beautiful lace around the bottom. But when I added a tulle petticoat underneath (a slip is necessary because it's a little sheer despite all the layers) and my flats, which add about 1/2 inch, the length was absolutely perfect! Other reviewers noted that it is difficult to get in and out of. I happen to have very skinny arms, so the sleeves fit perfectly. I had no trouble getting in, but I will admit it's somewhat tricky to get out! Be sure to have a friend around to help when you try it :) Only slight concern  the neck (front and back) can tend to be slightly floppy, I'm going to look into options including fabric tape, slight alteration, and/or starching the top couple inches of lace. But I think it's totally worth it, and I'm thrilled to get married in this dress in 30 days!

okay, first off, this dress is ADORABLE. I've been eyeing this dress for years (literally!) and I am so glad I finally decided to take the plunge and order it. The Good: the fit is spot on, and I imagine that it is a style that would be flattering on a large variety of body types. The color is a vibrant goldenrod, that again, will look quite nice with a wide variety of hair colors (as a blonde, I probably have the weakest hair color pairing). fabic is a light weight stretch cotton which is pleasantly cool even in intense heat. The NotSoGood: the dress material does wrinkle pretty easily, so I'd recommend wearing it on a day that you'll primarily be standing. The cloth covered buttons, though cute, aren't terribly well secured, so you should do as I did and this a couple more stitches into them because it would be a shame to loose them. speaking of the chest region, I am by no means a wellendowed lady in that department, and I can't manage to button up the dress without gaping. In all likelyhood, you're going to have to wear a cami or the like underneath, which isn't really my cup of tea. Overall though, I'd still absolutely recommend this dress to a friend. For the price point, you just can't find a better (or cuter) shirtdress!

review_summary: I ordered this dress in s
review_text: I ordered this dress in size L in black about a year ago. I loved it but it was too small. I had to rebutton it every five minutes because I'm pretty busy and ended up wearing it only twice. I decided to order the yellow one in size 1X, hoping it would fit me better. It arrived yesterday, and it is HUGE. It is way too big for me. I am really confused now. How can L be that small and 1X be that big? I am wondering if the sizes have changed since last year? It is really disappointing because it's such a cute dress, and apparently there is no size that will fit me. I am including a photo to show the huge difference between sizes L and 1X.

review_summary: I adore the color of this
review_text: I adore the color of this dress, but the fit is kind of off. It's really tight in the bust area, and I'm not exactly large there so that doesn't happen to me very often. The fabric is pretty thin, and I'll have to iron it before wearing it (ugh haha) but the color is really very lovely, so I think I can work with that :)

The fabric is pretty sheer. If you don't wear the right color bra under it, it is definitely visible. And also it has to be ironed and starched every time I want to wear it. And when it comes to fit, it's a little bit tight across my chest, so the buttons come undone if I'm not careful! But I still love it. It's cute, and the shape is lovely.
My first mod purchase. I would should have gotten the large since I'm a bit more busty than average. However, it works with a cute laced undershirt.

The dress is beautiful, but the quality isn't. I ordered a small the first time, which turned out to be a little too tight in only the top. Then I returned it and they sent me a medium, which fit just a little roomy in the top (better than too small), and it looked fine at first. But as I looked closer I noticed the buttons already looked like they were falling off, the fabric that holds the sash on has already come loose even though I haven't worn the dress yet, and the fabric is incredibly wrinkly! If you don't like ironing, then don't buy this dress. I would like to love this dress, but it isn't worth the 45 dollars I paid for it, I expected better for that money. I won't return it again though; it's too much of a hassle and I can sew it into a more durable dress than one I would probably get again.

review_summary: The top is quite tight, a
review_text: The top is quite tight, and the buttons pop open really easily. I think it probably fits better on smaller chested people. Thin cotton, unlined, and the finishing isn't very good. But! I love the look of it, the colour, it's long enough and I always get a lot of compliments when I wear it, so I'd buy it again.
Perfect dress! Very flattering. I have a bigger chest and it's hard to find dresses that don't make me feel like I'm wearing a corset but this one was perfect.

Perfect dress!
Love the dress style but between the material and the color I felt like a waitress at Mel's Diner. I am returning it for the same dress in pink!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress but sad

Completely unwearable. Size up if you buy this dress :(

review_summary: I LOVE IT!! The dress is
review_text: I LOVE IT!! The dress is slightly big on me, but not in a baggy or uncomfortable way. It just doesn't cling to my skin, the way it sounded like it did to other buyers. Slight pucker on the top button, I figure I'll just  unbutton it and slide a cami underneath.I don't know my exact measurements, but I do have a narrow waist and larger hips. (A large hourglass, if you will :P ) and it fits wonderfully. I'm not a fan of the sash, but that can easily be replaced with a fashion belt.Get this dress!!!

Pro: Beautiful color, kneelength, light weight, dress hugs the body in all the right places.Con: Wrinkle easily, runs small, material slightly too thin ( might need a slip on a sunny day)Conclusion: I'm usually a size 4US ( or small) when it comes to dresses. Due to the reviews, I'm glad I ordered a size up. Size M fit perfectly. Although I think the dress is a little overpriced due to the dress's material, I very much love how well the dress molded to my shape. I'm not very much into short short dresses so the length was a plus. My hubby loves the dress and so did everyone else who saw it, so it's a keeper.

I love everything about this dress and I've worn it on many occasions (valentines, wedding receptions, etc.) My only complaint was the fabric. When the dress got to me it was such a crumpled wrinkly mess. On that note, it speaks to how thin the fabric is which makes wearable in the hot summer.

Super cute dress!  wrote it to my sister wedding and got lots of complements

This dress is fantastic.  I am 5'4 115 lbs and ordered a small  it's *perfect*.  Love the color too.  I don't love the sleeves  they want to constantly creep up  but I will probably wear this with a little cardi anyway.

Disappointment.  I've been thinking over a year do I order this dress or not. My bust is quite small compering to my size so top overall looks very loose.  So to SIZE UP was VERY BAD IDEA.  But I already paid postage to Europe and 27? unexpected customs on top of it so I just hope it's going to shrink during first wash...

review_summary: I love this dress! It is
review_text: I love this dress! It is the perfect color and the perfect fit. I do agree with the other reviews that this dress is a bit wrinkly, but not so much to where I think it really impacts the dress. Iron it out and it will look fine. I love the style and the length. The sleeves are not tight on me at all, which is a relief because sometimes cap sleeves are a bit tight on me. It fits perfectly in the bust and torso. The waist is in just the right spot and I love how the skirt hangs! this is my first order from Modcloth, and I am satisfied.

review_summary: Love the dress. I had to

Great dress. Lots of compliments.
This dress i lovely. Cant wait to wear it.

review_summary: I adore this dress. It fi
review_text: I adore this dress. It fit like a glove and the color is fabulous. Definitely my new go to dress.

review_summary: This dress fits me like a
review_text: This dress fits me like a glove. It does wrinkle easily but not enough for me to care. Its a 97% cotton dress so wrinkle are going to happen and it is a light color so they will show. As long as you are ok with that the cut and color of this dress is amazing.

This dress fit perfectly! I was surprised when I tried it on that it even fit in the bust, usually I get a lot of gaping being quite small up top but I couldn't ask for anything better! The only downfall I can see is that the cap sleeves cut in a bit and I don't have broad shoulders at all, it also wrinkles quite easily but that doesn't really worry me.

This dress is totally cute, fit just right and is pretty much exactly what you expect from the pictures. I got it for a wedding and it was slightly less formal than I was expecting, but that was my error for not really looking closely enough. Really, an all around good dress, good job mod cloth!
Love the cut, very flattering, and a great color.

My wonderful big brother knew I had my eye on this dress for a while, and bought it for me as a Christmas gift!  At first, I was concerned, because as described, it does fit a bit small.   After excitedly wearing it once, I found it was tolerable, but I like to be able to move my arms around in my wild antics around town. My slightly broad shoulders weren't able to find their muchdesired wiggle room in this dress, and I hid my disappointment along with this dress for the next year in my closet  I finally invested in a lacy tank top, and I was able to experiment with leaving the buttons undone? What a transformation!  The dress had turned from a beautiful shoulderprison into a gorgeous land of fabric and opportunity!!  I am so pleased with this Christmas present, although it took me a while to figure out how best to appreciate it.  :)

Alas, the sizing of this dress is awkward and I ended up returning it. I'm 5'4, 130 lb, hourglass shaped, with a small bust (34B), and athletic booty and thighs. I thought the medium would fit my small chest, but the buttons literally popped open, and the cap sleeves sat awkwardly atop my fairly muscular shoulders and arms. The waist and length however were perfect! In returning it for a large, the size jumped extraordinarily, now with a bust quite large, a middle that leaves my waist line lost in several inches of extra fabric, and a length that hits below my knees.  I wish that the top of the dress were more accurately sized, because this dress is beautiful, but sadly it did not work out.

This dress is great highlights curves and accents the waist. It fits nicely. I ordered a Large, which is usually the case. Overall, a lovely summer dress; definitely not for winter, since the material is quite thin. Great buy!

I initially ordered this in a L (which is my usual sizing at ModCloth) and it was way too big so I exchanged it for a M and it was perfect.  It is a bit thinner and more wrinkled than I would like but the color is wonderful and the style is so comfortable, yet fun.  Looking forward to wearing it in the summer.

This is my first written review on ModCloth even though I've been buying from here for quite some time.  The reason I'm writing a review is because this dress, in my opinion, runs about 2 sizes too small.  I included my current measurements and I also took measurements of the dress that I received.  Let me state that this was a gift from my husband, had I ordered it myself I would've ordered the next size up.  He bought me a large.  What really concerns me are the measurements of the dress itself: Bust 32, Waist 28 and Hips 32!  According to the size chart, the dress that I received should, roughly, be a SMALL!  Regardless, I love ModCloth and will continue to order from it!

Not 100% on this one. Its still a cute, very vibrant dress that's sure to turn heads...but i'ts not as pictured. The belt loops on my dress are only 3/4 of an inch below the bust line whereas in the pictures its shown much lower down. This makes it fit a bit awkwardly so I added an apron to define my waist more. Also I don't consider myself as 'busty' at a 32 C but I had to wear a sports bra in order to even be able to button one button. I found the cap sleeves cute and they sat well on me unlike in some other reviews but this could be down to my husbands good ironing :) You will need someone who can iron well for this dress.

The dress isn't lined so wearing a slip is a must if you're going to sport stockings or tights, and expect to find lots of little strings hanging off the seams here and there. I'm on the busty side so I went with a 2X based on other reviews I read. I felt the need to replace the cloth belt for a better quality belt of the same color, but for the price I'm satisfied with my purchase.
I'm 5'5 and it came past my knee so I just took it and had it brought up a little. Now it's perfect. It also looks really great on redheads.

Maybe I would have benefitted from trying an XL but I figured the shoulders would be the same again and unfortunately International shipping gets pricey :( This dress was so cute though! I would highly recommend it. The color was so nice, it was around knee length on me, the fabric was a little thinner than I expected. I bet this dress would be great on a lot of people!

review_text: I loved this dress and I tried my hardest to make it work but it was just way too small. I am a size 0 and the small fit like an XXS. I tried the medium and sadly it was too big. #forgoodmeasure

review_text: I've had this dress for a couple years now, and I'm mixed about it. When I first bought it, it ran a little small, but not too bad. Even wearing for more than a couple hours causes bad wrinkling. I really love the style and the color however! I just wish it wasn't so much maintenance to wear!
Love this dress! I was  8 months pregnant at my 50's themed baby shower. The large fit perfect. Normally I would be a medium.

So I absolutely love the look of this dress. It fits perfectly and is completely adorable...however, if you buy it, plan on standing like a statue all day and not moving at all if you don't want to look like a rag. It wrinkles at even the slightest touch and was very hard to get unwrinkled in the first place. Literally, the fabric is horrible, they made it as cheaply as possible. Wrinkles worse than linen. Really a shame because it's truly perfect in every other way...you just can't wear it. Also, the bottom button comes undone every three minutes...slightly annoying. So sad :(

I get a lot of compliments on it and have gotten lots of use out of it.

I think the length is pretty good for Modclth dresses and I have worn it to work with some tights and felt completely comfortable and professional. One of the buttons has a habit of slipping out, but it's not too terribly low, so I just button it back up and go about my day. I bought this dress primarily because it was yellow and was one of the few that didn't look to yellowy . Being a redhead and pale, I wasn't sure it would be a flattering colour but it was fantastic. We had pictures taken to celebrate my husbands promotion and this dress transitioned brilliantly from day to night. I paired it with the Mango Salsa heels form Modcloth also.

And that was a wiser bet. The sleeves fit perfectly and give no trouble to move my arms around. Only little downside is that the dress wrinkles easier, but an iron or steamer can take care of that. Overall, I am a Happy Nancy and look forward to purchasing more dresses here.
