review_text: I wear a size 15/16 US in dresses, which is about a 1X in ModCloth  so as it was recommended.. I sized up and ordered a 2x. Everything fit great except the waist and tummy area  make sure you do your measurements before ordering.
Loved this dress. Wore it for our engagement photos and it was perfect !

review_summary: I was so shocked on how t
review_text: I was so shocked on how tight the bust area was on me. It fit in the waist and looked great from their down, but terrible on the bust and shoulders. I was pretty shocked because I am only a 34 B. I returned and am trying the next size up!

review_summary: This dress was sad for me
review_text: This dress was sad for me because I wanted to try it for ages but when I finally got around to getting it, it turns out to be kind of see through and have a weird fit. Tight armholes and not at all flattering. I had to pass. Probably works better for non plus size ladies.

This dress fit really nicely  I wore it with a petticoat underneath for two weddings this summer. It does tend to wrinkle quickly, but other than that  it's great. I got lots of compliments on it's retro vibes.

After getting this in black (cola) I had to get another and I just loved this color for fall. Like the other one, it's ridiculously long on me so I dropped it at the tailor this morning and it will be ready a week from tomorrow (just in time for a trip to celebrate our five year wedding anniversary). I plan on wearing it with knee high brown riding boots and a flowered scarf or possibly just barefoot with a cardi. Greatest dress ever!

Adore this dress. Makes me feel like I'm back in the '50s! It's a little sheer so I do wear a slip under it and it looks so cute with a sweater and flats! A little snug in the cap sleeves but that's because my arms are bigger. I hate to iron but it is a must with this dress!
This is my everyday dress.

review_summary: Got this dress in black a
review_text: Got this dress in black and ginger and like them both a lot. The ginger is a great mustard yellow. I'm not a fan of stand up collar being so high but after one wash they seemed to have relaxed a bit. The cap sleeves are weird and unflattering emphasizing my already wideish shoulders but nothing a sweater on top can't fix. At 45 I worried this dress wouldn't be right for me but with the right shoes and hair it works very well. Cute dress and easy to wear so long as I wear something over top. I'm keeping them but unfortunately my quest for the perfect button collar cotton dress isn't over.

review_summary: Love the cut of this dres
review_text: Love the cut of this dress, my only problem was the buttons sometimes come undone. But easy fix, reinforced the button holes. Love it!!
The material wrinkles easily (just from sitting) but falls nicely off the hips. Very cute

review_summary: The bust was a little tig
review_text: The bust was a little tight, even though I don't have a particularly large bust. Also wrinkles very easily. Besides that, the color is gorgeous and the style is so vintage and flattering.
Loved this dress, perfect length, although a little snug and shows perspiration readily.

review_summary: This was my very first Mo
review_text: This was my very first ModCloth purchase and I am absolutley head over heels in love with it. The cut and silouhette flatter my figure so well, and the length is just right, hitting me just at the knee. The material is thin so a slip is a neccesity and the buttons arent sewn on very well but these are both minor things. The only thing stopping me from giving this dress 5 stars is that the zipper is the most flimsy thing on this dress I HAVE to have someone else zip me up or the zipper snags, every single time. I find the colour hard to dress as well, every time I've worn this dress I've been compared to the man in the yellow hat from Curious George or a boy scout (when paired with my navy blue cardigan). Overall im a fan of this dress, shortcomings and all.
Very cute. Unfortunately, I'm a large chested gal, so I can't button the buttons. Still cute with a cami and the buttons undone.

review_summary: I am overall happy with t
review_text: I am overall happy with this dress. I am becoming an art teacher, so I want clothing that is both appropriate for teaching and something that I would wear outside of the classroom. I got an 1x because of my bra size, but the buttons are still a little strained and you can see my bra at the right angle. Nothing that a cami underneath or a sweater can't fix.

I really like this dress, my only issues are that I have long legs so it's a tad shorter than I'd like, it gets wrinkly pretty quickly unless you dryclean it and keep it hung up away from other items that might squish it in your closet. It's also a little snug in the bust but I'm a 34D, if you're any smaller than that it should fit perfectly. I do really like this dress though despite the issues I listed :)

I really hoped this dress would fit. It was a little more snug than I like things to fit in my lower belly region. The length was almost to mid calf on me (I'm 5'8) and I think that with the cut it'd be cuter at or even above the knee.

review_summary: I loved the color of this
review_text: I loved the color of this dress. There were comments about the material but that was not the issue for me. At 6'ft and a b cup the top was much too tight. There was no give with the sleeves either. Sadly this was my first return. Hope it is my last

I really love this dress! One of my first purchases from ModCloth and I am very pleased with it! Lots of people said it was wrinkly but I put it straight in the wash when I got it so it came out of the dryer unwrinkled. I thought the tiny creases it got after the day wore on we're fine because I hadn't ironed and starched this dress so they didn't look out of place or unfashionable.The belt it comes with is useable....if you iron it. So I paired this dress with an obi belt I'd made a couple of years back. Great combo!Thanks ModCloth, couldn't be happier!

review_summary: The dress is a fun color.
review_text: The dress is a fun color. The cotton seems stiff. The proportion was a little off for me. It was weirdly tight in the hip area that seems like it supposed to flare out.  Must return.
LOVE one of my favorites, will have to buy again soon, maybe in another spicy color or pattern

I absolutely love this dress!  It's perfect for just riding your bike, going on a walk, or even a regular day at work.  I'm a little bustier and it's a bit tight there, but it doesn't look awful.  I wore it to work today and got a million compliments.  It falls just right making my curves accentuated. Definitely a great buy!

review_summary: you know who this dress d
review_text: you know who this dress doesn't look good on? 1.) girls where capsleeves simply just don't work and 2.) girls that have a large waist to hip ratio. (small waist, big butt.) I have both so it's going back. The color was pretty though.

I wore this to my 1940s/WWII themed birthday party, and it was a hit! The color is a lovely vintage yellow, and it got a bunch of compliments. Besides it being great by itself, it's a flexible dress for layering and adding to. It is always a pleasure to wear!There are some reviews that complain that the dress wrinkles easy and/or arrives wrinkly. Well then, get out your iron, people! It's completely worth it to be able to find a dress this adorable at such a reasonable price.

Nice stretchy material and good quality. I ordered a Large and it was a bit tight on top and about an inch shorter than I wanted. I used the belt and a trim of lace to add an inch on bottom but super happy with how if all turned out!

review_summary: I loved the look of these
review_text: I loved the look of these soda fountain dresses online, but found the material too cheap feeling when I saw it in person. Not substantial enough to wear to work, so this one was returned.
Very flattering dress and super cute! If you're big chested the buttons have a tendency to pop open, so you curvy ladies like myself might want to size up.
I absolutely love it!!

review_summary: When I took the dress out
review_text: When I took the dress out if the package I was worried about what it would look like on because it was very thin. After putting the dress on with a slip and tank top underneath it looked fine, nothing showed through the fabric. It is a cute dress that's great for dressing up or just casual. The color is also flattering! I also like the idea of laying with this dress. It is advised on the description of the dress to size up but I didn't find that I needed to size up. While I am between a small and medium in most clothes, I usually fit into a medium with modcloth best. The Dress is a little snug around my chest and arms but it isn't uncomfortable. Anyone with a larger bust will most likely be more comfortable in a larger size. I'm not too sure if the dress is worth $45 but I think it's cute enough and offers enough versatility (laying and dressy/casual) that it is a keeper!
Definitely size up... I didn't realize that it said to, and I couldn't get it zipped up. It was cute, I just think I'm too busty for this dress.
I normally get a medium, but went up a size. still too tight across my chest! will have to wear a shirt or something underneath to keep the girls under wraps

review_summary: What a great fit and fant
review_text: What a great fit and fantastic color. I love the full skirt. From the pictures it looks like the waist falls a little lower. On me the ribbon rests on the lower portion of my ribcage. This is a cute cut but it dose not accentuate my waist.This dress arrived not fully stitched up the side, but with my sewing skills it was a quick fix. As others have mentioned the fabric wrinkles easily, but as long is you store it on a hanger and do not mind being slightly wrinkled it should not be an issue.so cute!

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this dress more than I do. I've had it in my closet for ages as I was waiting for warmer weather but upon closer inspection it doesn't actually fit me in the waist very well. It's also quite large in the chest for my small frame and also a bit too full in the skirt. I tried tonne it work with a belt but its just not happening
The seam that was supposed to go under my boobs was on top of them. :/ otherwise nice.

Man, this dress is super cute, and I was BUMMED that it didn't fit.  I didn't size up, got my regular medium (figuring that mediums are apt to be too big in the bust on me) and whoops!  I totally should've gotten a large, because I couldn't even zip up the side and the bust line landed right at midnipple rather than under the bosom.  The overall quality of the dress isn't awesome, but hey, it's a reasonable price.  Oh well...

Bummer!!! i always order a medium and it fits like it's made for me. this was like squeezing into a trap. i was scared that i would never get out and i COULD NOT zip it up. the color was gorgeous and the quality was nice, though, so i might try it again with a larger size.

review_summary: I am usually a medium, bu
review_text: I am usually a medium, but in this dress that size is much too tight, so I ended up with a large. I wore it once and it was fabulous. Then, I washed it (machine wash cold, like it said) and dried it. The label did not mention a drier. It turns out, the dress is not preshrunk. I took it out of the drier, and it took me an hour iron it back to something that looks normal. It doesn't look very nice now, and putting it on is 10 times harder than it was before drying it. This dress is cute, but do not make the mistake of drying it. The label needs to warn us of that.

I absolutely LOVED this dress, the colour, the style, the price, but sadly I had to return it.  It fit my shoulders a little funny, pulling in a strange way, and I didn't think going up a size would have helped.  I just think my body / shoulder shape fits a different style of dress.

This dress looks cute, but I'm not entirely satisfied with it when considering the price.  The material has a cheapness about it the lack of lining is evident in the way the dress moves around the body, and I've never owned a dress that wrinkles so badly.  I ironed it for quite some time before wearing it to work, and sitting down created deep wrinkles in the back of the skirt that lasted all day.  It made me feel very selfconscious.  I'm rather small at top and ordered a medium, but the buttons slip from the holes and the sleeves bunch around the shoulder where they don't fit correctly.  The skirt is very roomy.   People complimented the style of the dress, but I wouldn't recommend it based on quality or fit.  This was my first ModCloth purchase.  I love ModCloth styles and am willing to give it another chance, but I won't choose a dress without lining from now on.

I originally purchased the Soda Fountain dress in small, my normal size.  However, after discovering that it would not zip all the way due to tightness in the bust, I exchanged for a medium and couldn't be happier!  The Ginger color is a beautiful, deep golden yellow  I haven't seen many clothing items in this color.  The fit is great and the look is cute, yet classy.  I always feel like such a girl in my Soda Fountain dresses!
Love this dress. It gets very wrinkly, but it's such a cute little number, that it's worth the extra ironing.
LOVE this dress!! So cute and totally 50's!

This was the most heartbreaking return I've had to make! I purchased a size medium and my bust just exploded out of it (I included my size here so that others could compare!) I don't think the adorable clothcovered buttons could keep me modest through a day of wear. Of course, it fit perfectly everywhere else so I'm not sure if I should try a size large. So sad to have to return this item. Perfect price, adorable cut, vibrant color, and quality fabric made this a great buy. I'm jealous of everyone who gets to keep theirs!

review_summary: I love the color of this
review_text: I love the color of this dress, and that is why I purchesed it.  Its adorable, fits really well!  I sized up, as Modcloth suggested, and I am really glad I did. Great quality dress.

review_summary: I love this dress. I'm cu
review_text: I love this dress. I'm curvy so it's just a little bit snug, but I'm losing weight so it will fit perfectly in a few weeks. I was mostly worried about the color when I got it. I have pale skin and hardly ever look good in any type of yellow. But, this is more of a gold color and it's quite warm, which is nice.I loved it so much I decided to wear it for my husband and my kickstarter video. Perfect!
Shrunk after the first wash (washed on cold, dried on med heat) :( too small to wear now
Wrinkles easily, but fun color and fits perfectly.

Darling dress, perfect for summer. Usually a large, but I went with the 1X  glad I did! Plenty of room up top for my ladies, and no issue with fabric gaps around the buttons. Nice, work appropriate length. Plenty of options for layering, so it will carry over well into autumn. Love it! I want one in every color!

review_summary: I could almost get away w
review_text: I could almost get away with wearing this dress. I'm tall and the waist of this dress hit me just below my bust. I could tie it lower and no one would be the wiser, but the shoulders are just a little too snug. It would have been really adorable, otherwise. Had to return.

review_summary: This dress is very well m
review_text: This dress is very well made, and had no loose buttons or stray threads. The fabric was a nice weight, and had a nice amount of stretch. I was able to button it up over my chest without the buttons pulling, which is very rare for me. The length was a little longer than I expected, but other than that the fit was very nice. The color is also a bit brighter in person, and unfortunately didn't work for me.

review_summary: I adore this dress. I cou
review_text: I adore this dress. I couldn't have picked a better item to be my first ModCloth purchase.
Love this dress! Fits well. I'm 50, and It hits about right at the knee, but not past. Material is a little thin. Depending on the lighting you may need a slip.

The mailman knocked on my door and handed me my dress today. I was excited to open my ModCloth package and I was pleased with the product. The color is beautiful and bright!. The bust area fits a little snug. I can still button up all the buttons and be comfortable. The length is just right. Any longer and it would be too long. Great dress. I might get it another color. And the material is nice also. All I need to do is iron it and I will be good to go ;D
Looked really good and fit well. Slightly stretchy.  Gets wrinkly fast though nothing a quick ironing does take care of.
Cute, mustard yellow dress! It's a little long on me. I wear it with a thick white belt instead of the tie, and black and white maryjanes.

review_summary: I love this dress but I s
review_text: I love this dress but I should have read the reviews and went up a size, I'm 6ft tall and a size 6 but my bust is a 34D so I cannot close the buttons. I didn't mind for the garden party that I attended but I will have to wear a camisole if I choose to wear it to work.
Perfection. I own this dress in every available color and couldn't be happier. Perfect and easy to look nice and put together for work and play.

I have the Soda Fountain Dress in Grape in a size Large and if fits perfectly.  But when I tried on the Soda Fountain Dress in Ginger, also a size Large, I could hardly get it zipped and I was busting out of it.  I can't figure out why the two dresses fit so differently...it's like the Ginger one wasn't cut right.Sadly this dress will be going back.

So everything said to size down, and my measurements kind of fall between sizes, so I went with the medium.  It fits pretty well except that it doesn't easily zip over my bust, and that's even with the buttons totally open.  If I button it after it's zipped, there's some significant gapping.  I have to wear a slip/longline cami under it anyway since it's unlined, but I was kind of hoping for something a bit more modest I suppose.

I have gotten compliments on this dress every time I have worn it.  The color is so uniqueI would call it mustard rather than ginger, but I love it either way.The material is a bit thinner than expected, and it poofs up in the shoulders a little, but for the most part it's pretty flattering.  Overall, I am quite happy with this dress.

review_summary: I had hoped this dress wo
review_text: I had hoped this dress would work because it is such a pretty silhouette. Unfortunately, there was gaping in the bust area, so I had to send it back. I did not choose to order a size up because the dress fit so well in all other areas, that I feel while ordering a size up would alleviate one issue, it would create a few more. Still, it is a very pretty, vibrant dress, and perhaps if you're not as busty, it will work for you.

Love, love, love this dress!!!!! I am a wide shouldered gal that has a little extra fluff in the middle. This dress is not only comfortable but it does really well at camouflaging those um, pesky spots ;) Loved this so much I bought the black polka dot one too :)

review_summary: I found this dress to run
review_text: I found this dress to run small. I wear a size 16 and XL in regular stores, but have been purchasing a 2X at ModCloth. This is the only 2X item I have received that was too tight for me. The fabric was stretchier and not as heavy as I imagined, and it was just very unflattering on me. I live in Canada and was charged $80 in duty on an order of about $380, so I'm not sure if I'll be returning or just trying to sell it here, but either way I will not be keeping this dress.

When I measured myself I thought a small would fit but it was small in the bust so I exchanged it for a medium, which I found out wouldn't arrive in time so I did a lovely Live chat and we worked everything out perfectly! You guys are awesome!  This dress is very comfortable and has a clean look to it. The material is a little light so I am going to wear a slip underneath it.

review_summary: A little tight in the bod
review_text: A little tight in the bodice, but the skirt is the perfect length and shape.  Gorgeous color, and incredibly flattering for my body shape.  The other reviews that talk about how wrinkly the fabric is are correct  but a thorough ironing worked for me.  My first ModCloth purchase, and I love it!

review_summary: I love love LOVE this dre
review_text: I love love LOVE this dress!

review_summary: I WANTED to love this dre
review_text: I WANTED to love this dress. In fact, I was completely sure I would, and I almost did... Unfortunately, the cap sleeves just didn't work for me (I've run into this in dresses before). They sat awkwardly, and I just couldn't figure out a way to make it work. The color is lovely, and the style is definitely my speed, but I had to return it due to the sleeves.

The dress looks like the picture but the fabric is very thin. I had seen mixed reviews on the dress, but I wanted a yellow dress so I thought I would try the dress anyway. The dress was see through and tight through the mid section even though I went one size larger than I normally wear from Modcloth. The dress did hit right above the knee. I didn't have a problem with the sleeves or the bust, but I did go one size up.

review_summary: I love the color on this
review_text: I love the color on this dress so much! I wish it didn't wrinkle as easily as it does, but I use a steamer and a slightly haphazard fashion style and it works out okay. Note that I prefer to wear my clothes a little looser than some girls do it still looks nice on me, I just have plenty of mobility as well. Enjoy.
Love this dress. Fits perfect. I get tons of compliments on it.

review_summary: I've had my eye on this d
review_text: I've had my eye on this dress for a while, especially since I don't have any clothes in this color.  At first, I was worried about the color clash with my pale complexion and the tightness in the chest area, but this dress is great!  After reading a lot of the reviews, I decided to go a size up than what I normally wear for tshirts and casual clothes because of my chest size.  Definitely a good idea!  The dress was a little snug around my chest when buttoned, but I can wear it just fine with a tank top underneath and the top unbuttoned.  I like it better this way anyways :)  As for the color, the picture is very true to the actual color, and I think it looks fine on me despite my paleness.  The dress seems thick enough that you could get away without a slip underneath depending on the type of lighting you'd be in, but I recommend wearing it with a slip.  I decided to pair it with the Can't Leaf It Be Belt in brown (also sold by ModCloth) to give it an extra pop, and I got lots of compliments!  This was definitely a good buy!

I get lots of compliments in this dress. As a lady with a cocoa complexion, apparently yellow looks fantastic on me. If your looking to get this dress, go by the waist size more than anything.  My hips were bigger than the size dimension, and my bust small, but that didn't matter when wearing the dress. It fit wonderfully.

review_summary: The fit was nice  I have
review_text: The fit was nice  I have this one in black w white polka dots (love that one).  The color on this one is a little darker than I wanted.  This is not a bright yellow, but more of a dijon mustard yellow. Fit and quality are perfect, thoguh.
Lovely colour, but unfortunately it was very tight in the chest, I probably should've ordered an XL! Had to send this one back.

review_summary: love the look of this dre
review_text: love the look of this dress, but the brand/material is VERY cheap. something i'd pay $20 or less for, not $45. came super wrinkled, but irons out nicely. fits well for the most part, though it's a little snug in the bust. if you're busty, the buttons will pull a bit. i sized up and it still pulls at the buttons a little. if you're short, it'll also be a little long.overall, though, it does look adorable on so it works out alright in the end.

review_summary: I am normally a medium, b
review_text: I am normally a medium, but this dress is a tad bit baggy on the sides.  The buttonholes aren't very well sewn, so the buttons have a tendency to pop out regularly.  Also, it wrinkles really easily.  However, I love the color, which is really true to what you see in the picture!

This dress is gorgeous and I had been eyeing it for a while so when it was on sale about a month ago I decided to buy it. The colour is great, a very deep, vibrant yellow. Not too mustard, but still a nice darker yellow. The quality of the dress is very nice and the material does not feel cheap. However, as a fairly flat chested woman I found the bust area to be VERY SMALL!!! It was fairly tight over the bust and I am not able to do up more than one button. Two would be pushing it to say the least. Overall I'm happy with this purchase however the bust in the dress does run small whereas all other areas run true to size.

review_summary: I was shocked by how poor
review_text: I was shocked by how poorly this dress fit me. I ordered the size Medium, which says the bust is 3536 inches. I'm a 34C so I figured that would work great. When it arrived I was very excited to try it on, but I kid you not, I could BARELY get it over my chest, even without a bra. The seam that is supposed to fall well below the bust was cutting my through the middle. I had to unbutton every button on the top just for it to work, but the result was a style I really wasn't going for... The rest of the dress fit great, but there was no getting around the terrible fit on the top. Very disappointing. :(

Great dress!!! I had worries about the colour, but it occured to be rich shining yellow, as I like. A bit small in the chest, though I'm not a busty girl und usually wear XS. But it fits perfectly at the waist. So simple, classic and super for spring and summer!

review_summary: It's a shame this does no
review_text: It's a shame this does not come in an XL, as that would fit me perfectly. The large is too snug in the chest for me, I could not fully zipper the side. It fit like a glove everywhere else!If you're a DD cup or larger, I don't think the Large will fit.

Kinda sad this dress doesn't come in an XL. It's what I usually wear, but I sized down to an L for this order, and it didn't work out...I measure a 38 bust and the top was definitely too small. Would recommend sizing up to a 1X. Had to return this.

review_summary: Wore this to a fancy writ
review_text: Wore this to a fancy writer's gala. It was perfect! the buttons don't stay very well, but I had layered it over another so that wasn't an issue. It is very see through though, which I wasn't expected. Have to wear leggins and an undershirt that match or it just looks discolored.

review_summary: I bought this for my June
review_text: I bought this for my June Cleaver Halloween costume, and I have worn it often since. It's a bit snug, but cute.

First I ordered this dress in size M. However it did not fit. I had to order size up.  I have broad shoulders, so even size L is kind of tight in the shoulder area. I have to leave buttoms undone. But it's ok, nice lacy cami underneath looks really good. I really like the dress  material is nice, not thin at all as others mentioned, but maybe my dress is from the different batch. It does wrinkle, but I happen to own an iron so it's not a problem. The only thing I didn't like about this dress are the sleeves. I didn' like the puffiness. But I'm a seamstress, so it's no longer a problem.  I fixed the sleeves and now the dress is perfect. And the color is awesome.

This was (almost) exactly what I was hoping for. After reading the reviews, I ordered a large and it fit perfectly... everywhere but my chest. I could do up the buttons, but it pulled unflatteringly. Still, it was a really nice dress, so I ended up giving it to my sister, who is a bit smaller than me. She loved it too! :)

review_summary: it fit snug in the upper
review_text: it fit snug in the upper body...should have gotten a size large..i can wear a camisole under it

I gave this dress 5 stars because it is what it says it is.  But, in real life, I decided it was just too much of this color on me.  I have the dress in black and it's adorable.  So, it's really my decision about the color, and nothing wrong with the dress.  Back it goes.  Thanks, Modcloth, for easy returns!
Pretty thin but cute.

review_summary: I love this dress, it has
review_text: I love this dress, it has a cute retro feel, and the colour is perfect! Every time I wear this, people compliment the colour and tell me it goes well with my skin tone. Never heard that before!

I really like this dress. It has a nice vintagey feel without being exorbitantly expensive. I wore it to a job interview with matching yellow heel and got the position; so it's adaptable for a professional setting and for daily fun. I just wish the torso of the dress was as look as it appeared in pictures, although maybe that's just due to my large chest.

Ugh. I really wanted this dress like crazy. I'm going to have to return it though, because it totally doesn't fit. I'm on the upper end of Small on top, and low end of Medium on bottom so I've gotten a bunch of small dresses from Modcloth, unless told to size up or down...this is the first one that didn't fit at all/WOULD NOT ZIP. Holy poop. As soon as I got the zipper up to the seam under the bust, no go. I haven't seen any mention of this in the older reviews, but I seriously think that they size down the top, because all of my small dresses fit perfectly or might need to be taken in a little. I think maybe a medium might work better for me, unless I lose about 12 inches around the bust. Even tugging like mad, I couldn't get the edges of the zipper to touch. Thank god, Modcloth has an excellent return process.

review_summary: This dress is great. I ha
review_text: This dress is great. I have received many compliments every time I have worn it. The color is true to the picture and being an unlined dress, you will want to wear nude or white undergarments.

Love this dress! The fabric has some give to it. It hits me about 2 below the knee but I'm short so of course! I will take it to be hemmed up a bit to give me a little better bounce and swing. The cap sleeves have lots of room for my 15 bicep. I can pull the dress over my head and not even use the side zipper. It's comfy without being too large. Perfect fit. The fabric is what I would call light weight, not thin. The weave of the fabric is still good and strong. I am just going to wear a camisole and slip since I plan on wearing plum tights with it. The design is very flattering if you are on the broader side but still have a waist. Matter of fact, I think they used my measurements to make it. I've never had a dress fit so well in all the right places. ;) For the price it is spot on. The only thing that would make it better is double stitching on the hem and elsewhere but that would increase the cost I'm sure. My first ModCloth purchase and I couldn't be happier!

Okay so I really, really want to love this dress. It fits so much smaller than other dresses this size through the bust. I imagine if my chest was half the size that it is, it'd fit better. If I size up, I'll be stuck tailoring a lot of fabric as the large seems quite big on me otherwise. The fabric is a bit thinner than I was expecting, too.. so yes, you'll probably want to wear a slip under neath to hide undergarments.

I thought this dress would be very cute  and it is!  Unfortunately, it is just a little smaller in the bust than I can wear without it straining at the buttons.  It would probably fit well if I went up a size, but as it is a mostly cotton (and therefore very easily wrinkled) garment, and I don't love ironing, I am going to pass it up this time.  A lovely and flatteringly shaped dress, though.

review_summary: I'm a dress size 18 and t
review_text: I'm a dress size 18 and this dress fit perfectly. From bust, cap sleeves, length, waist, and silhouette I am pleased. The dress, to me, appears to be correctly represented on the site. It's a bright mustard. (My photograph was taken under harsh florescent lights so just look at it for fit.) My only gripe is that it isn't as opaque as I'd hoped. I wore a red bra and black underwear when I tried it on, and I could see them  with light undergarments and potentially a long tank or slip this dress meets my needs.Remember to wear the right bra with this dress, the material has the right amount of give, it's light and breathable but not cheaply made  the wrong bra may lead to puckering at your buttons, a simple switch works wonders!

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this dress.  I had to take off my bra to zip up the bodice and even then the buttons were straining so hard to stay in place.  This dress is a wardrobe malfunction waiting to happen.  Everywhere else fit wonderfully, but if you happen to be busty, you might want to size up.  Also, the belt is not very substantial and will most likely lose its structure after one washing.  I will definitely have to return this, but I have not decided whether to try the next size up or if this cut is just not right for me...

review_summary: I love this dress. If peo
review_text: I love this dress. If people are still complaining about it being flimsy, they should really learn to read reviews better. The dress fits me perfectly, but I can imagine that busty ladies won't love it as much because it is pretty narrow. It's cotton, so it's great for winter and summer and I love dancing in it !!!

review_summary: As much as I love this dr
review_text: As much as I love this dress, it breaks my heart that I will have to return this. It fits perfectly everywhere but my chest as I am a 36FF, and the fabric does not give much room to expand. Such are the normal dramas chestier women go through.

This dress is just gorgeous. While I love the design; the fit isn't great. If you are short waisted or small busted you should be fine. I however, am not in that category.On me the bodice is too short and the belt loops too high. I think the sleeves fit a bit weird on everyone though. With some tailoring I can make it work.The details clearly state that it is made from a cotton/spandex so ironing is to be expected.

This was my favorite fall dress. It's got a lightweight cotton feel, which was great for layering. The color is unique, which makes it stand out even more. And yes, it does come wrinkley. So what? A hot iron and a little spray starch keeps it looking nice all day. One tiny complaint the middle button kept popping open on me until I stitched it closed. Not a big deal though, because of the hidden side zip; the dress is still easily slipped on over my head. The hemline falls just below my knee, right where I like it (especially during cooler weather). Usually, I pair this dress with browns, oranges or coppers, but even some blues work too.

review_summary: I usually wear a medium i
review_text: I usually wear a medium in ModCloth dresses and I went up a size in this one! It's extremely tight in my arms.  Also in my chest.  I use the button were sewn a little better. Drives my crazy when you can see thread sticking out.  Also VERY wrinkly! VERY!!  If I had gone up a size it would of been to big everywhere else! I still love the dress though!

review_summary: I loved the color and it
review_text: I loved the color and it fit just right. The only thing I did not like was the seams
Love this dress!! Got several complements on it.
Very cute, fun dress.  My one complaint is that the buttons seem to be a little too unforgiving for my bustline.

Pros:Very flirty length, makes me feel girly, great color, fabric isn't as thin or flimsy as I was thinking it would be, snug fit. I also like the belt that came with it.Cons:The sleeve bits are a tight fit, makes it hard to move my arms around but I don't plan on doing any heavy lifting in it. The top part is also a tight fit, but not so much as the sleeves. Overall: I look forward to wearing this dress many times. I paired it with some deep purple tights since it's cold out. Also, i suggest a deep red thick belt for added flair.

review_summary: There is a reason the Sod
review_text: There is a reason the Soda Fountain Dress is so beloved it is super flattering a perfect length and appropriate for any occasion! I love the Ginger colour and aside from it having to be ironed there is nothing I would change about this little number!

review_summary: The colour of the dress i
review_text: The colour of the dress is beautiful and I quite like the cotton fabric.  I don't think it's too thin, nor excessively wrinkly as others have said.  It was wrinkled after being squished up in the package, but once I hung it up it's fine.  Since I have a small ribcage and shoulders, I went with the medium size.   It zips up, but it's very tight over my ribs as well as the bust, which surprised me. I thought about exchanging for a large, but I think it still works so I'm not going to bother.  The cap sleeves are kind of restrictive also and I can't lift my overhead without them doing weird things.  I'm considering removing them and making the dress sleeveless, but I might keep them (they are cute). The fabric belt is fine but not really my cup of tea, I will probably accessorize with other, thicker belts. Overall I like the dress, and hopefully my new workout regime means it will fit even better soon!

review_summary: I love this dress! I got
review_text: I love this dress! I got it and was a little worried, but it was perfect. the waist fits a little bit snug but was no problem. the top is very flattering and i love how it kind of flares out at the bottom. very cute and flattering; love it!
Bright and bold, but the fabric is a little bit seethrough.  I love the color and the flattering cut  it fits me perfectly (dress size 14).

I love these soda fountain dresses, but I've found that generally, buttonups do not work well for busty women.  If I buy my normal size (large) the buttons strain.  If I buy a size up, I have no waist.  I might've been able to have this tailored, but I chose to send it back. It also bothered me that the XL was considerably longer than it should have been.  I also agreed with another reviewer that the material in these dresses is very, very wrinkly and would likely require ironing before every wear.

review_summary: I love the color of this
review_text: I love the color of this dress, but it's not the easiest dress to stroll out in. The armpits are big and go too low (I have scrawny arms), so I never wear it without a cardiganwhich it looks great with. I often change out the ribbon for a brown belt because it's hard to keep the ribbon nice looking while wearing it. This fabric wrinkles very easily. Overall though, cardigan and belt changes in mind, I feel like I could walk into a 50's diner and fit right in. It's a really cutedress (though a little short to look authentically retro). Oh, and I'm not busty, but I have on occasion had issues with the buttons coming undone. I don't feel like the dress is that tight, but it doesn't take much for it to pop open. It could easily be resolved by stitching up the front. You don't need these buttons to be workable...there's a zipper down the side of the dress.
Fits nicely, but hard to button across the chest. Also, the Tsleeves are a little restrictive. The fabric wasn't a fantastic quality, but the dress fits well overall, and I like the silhouette.
I have 3 fountain dresses I love 'em all. They are SO versatile and they hide the belly. They are a little tight around the arms.I don't care!
My boyfriend loves how this looks on me. I am  looking forward to wearing this soon.
This dress is amazing, specially for girls like me that are in the petite side :D...love it.

Can't say I'm thrilled with this dress. The material isn't what I imagined, and it's a bit too large on me. This will be my first ModCloth return. But I haven't give up hope, and I'm sure I'll enjoy browsing this site for a replacement dress :)

Love this dress.  The quality is good, and it's long enough that I can wear it to work.  Hits about the knees.  Only problem for me (to be expected) was the sizing.  The bust is tight so the buttons always pop but the waist is on the larger size... but that's me, not the dress.  I still wear it all the time!

I was nervous ordering from Modcloth for the first time, especially since I live in South Korea so returns aren't easy, but I am very happy with this dress. It fits well, and is flattering.  The material is thin but it still seems well made. I cant wait to move back to the US and order more.

review_summary: I adore this dress and al
review_text: I adore this dress and always get compliments when I wear it. I also find that despite the material I usually only have to iron it every other wear. I even wore it for Halloween this year (I was Madeline)

This dress actually is really really cute. I initially bought it so it could be a costume for Halloween  my friend and I were dressing as 2 Broke Girls. But I knew the dress would be functional after that. The fit was way too big, based on my measurements (I have an hourglass figure), I chose a Large, I probably could have comfortable fit in a Medium. The quality is a very light fabric, so if you want to wear it in the fall, you can layer it with a cardigan and tights/boots. It's a really cute look !
The buttons aren't as well sewn as I'd like, but that's easy enough to deal with. It's super cute and the fabric is really comfortable.

review_summary: I love love love this dre
review_text: I love love love this dress! It hits just below my knee (Note though that I am super short) and is very comfortable. My only complaint would be how wrinkled the material is. I spent a while ironing it, and then the first time I wore it to church the back got all wrinkled because I had been sitting down. But if you don't mind the ironing, you will love this dress like I do for its color and the endless ways you can mix and match this with various accessories and styles.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my Halloween costume (the Morton Salt girl). I was very worried that the L wouldn't fit, but the 1X was sold out. I bought the L anyway and I'm so glad I did. It fits a little tight through the chest, but that always happens so I wasn't surprised. The fit is otherwise completely perfect. It emphasizes my best assets and makes my waist look so, so tiny. I might have to buy the same dress in other colors.I have very pale skin and auburn hair, and thankfully this color doesn't look terrible on me. It's not my perfect shade, but I can make it work. Maybe with bright red lipstick. I'm just so happy about this dress. It should be mandatory attire for anyone with an hourglass figure.

I orginally bought this dress in a large based on the given measurements, but it was too big and I had to exchange it for a medium. It's definitely just a cotton dress, but it's a great color and fit  although a little too long (I'm 5'3). I'm going as Max from 2 Broke Girls for Halloween and this is the perfect dress!

review_summary: I bought this dress to we
review_text: I bought this dress to wear to a wedding this summer and was SO pleased with the fit and look of this dress.  I've worn it to church a few times since and always get so many compliments.  First off, the color is beautiful and exactly as pictured it's vibrant and rich.  What impressed me most, however, was the fit.  I have a difficult body to dress.  I'm 5'4 and about 190 lbs, but I carry most of my weight in my tummy and hips.  So, I need dresses to have enough flare at the bottom to disguise my tummy and hips without being HUGE in the bust.  This dress fit the bill perfectly.  Like other reviewers have mentioned, it is on the thin side (I feel more comfortable wearing a half slip underneath, but it's probably not necessary for everyone...I'd just rather err on the side of modesty) and it does wrinkle quite easily, but that's nothing a little starch won't take care of.  Overall, I love this dress.  And this being my first purchase with ModCloth, I have to  mention how impressed I was with their customer service.  I got advise from the ModCloth stylists about styling this dress for the wedding and they did a brilliant job and really made me feel comfortable and confident about my outfit which is the most important part of looking great.

The colour of this dress is really lovely, a nice warm sunshine yellow. The fabric is nice, but wrinkles very easily. I wore it out yesterday for the first time, and even though i ironed it before going, it wrinkled up after a couple of hours. I guess that what you can expect though, from a shirtlike fabric such as this one. I am quite tall, so the belted waist on the dress cuts in above my own waist, which is a bit annoying, but i can fix that fairly easily. I would have liked it to be a bit longer too, it cuts above my knees; but again that's due to being tall. I could have bought it bigger i suppose, but then it would have been too loose on the upper body. The buttons are a bit loose, and the holes for the buttons are too big, so they come undone constantly, but that's fixable. The stitching also seems a bit loose in places. Overall I'm happy with the dress, but not as much as I'd hoped.
This was first purchase from modcloth and it sealed the deal for me! My only complaint is how easily it wrinkles.

review_summary: Had to return it I'm norm
review_text: Had to return it I'm normally a small but it fit everywhere but the bust! So I ordered a size up, got the new size dress, and it had the same problem! The buttons are very flimsy so they keep unbuttoning themselves throughout the day. Eek.

review_summary: I love the colour of this
review_text: I love the colour of this dress and the fit is amazing as it hugs my waist then flairs out hiding my tummy which makes it a very comfortable dress in my opinion. The material is thin but nothing that is a deal breaker for me. I love this dress and will definatly be keeping it.

review_summary: I am very pleased with th
review_text: I am very pleased with the fit, and it is very flattering on an hourglass figure. However, after one wear, the seams already look like they're pulling apart.
Cute fit, dress wrinkles easily and the arms chafe the upper arms after a few hours.  But I still love it.

review_summary: This dress has a very cut
review_text: This dress has a very cute shape, and I'm positive it would flatter nearly any body type.  That being said, it's wrinkle city.  The material is very thin, and of poor quality.  The belt is wacky and I don't even use it, because I wear a cardigan over it.  All that being said, I get tons of compliments on it because the fit is delightful.  It is especially good for a larger busted gal like myself.  I ordered the 1x since there was no XL option and it fits like a dream.  If I lose any weight I might need it taken in at the waist, but other than that.  I'm good.
The shoulders and chest fit perfect, but I need to take in the waist. Other then that its a great dress in a sunshine color.

This dress is awesome. I bought a size small and it fits like a dream. The fabric can get a little wrinkly but other than that it is very easy to wear. It comes with a removable ribbon belt, but I just wear it with a thick brown belt. LOVE!

I *love* this dress, and people FREAK OUT with delight every time I go outside in it!  It's a bright mustard color and it makes me look great  I do have a darker complexion.  I usually pair it with purple boots and a wider belt.  I guess the materiel is a little wrinkly, but I don't really mind.  I don't iron it or anything.ALSO: it's awesome by itself, but I got a petticoat to go with it and now it's EVEN MORE AWESOME.  It makes me smile just to be in it.  It actually doesn't look too silly either, even with the petticoat.  Except when I ride my bike, and then I feel like an indie rock song in motion.
This dress is super cute in person! The only thing wrong with it was that it was a little long on my daughter (she's pretty petite). I had it hemmed 2 inches and it's perfect!!

review_summary: This dress fit well in th
review_text: This dress fit well in the bust but was large in the waist and very long, so I altered it. The color was a little brighter than I expected.

review_summary: I really wanted to like t
review_text: I really wanted to like this dress, but its given me nothing but grief.  The fabric on this dress is quite cheap, almost like a 1thread count sheet.  After washing(I do not dry my dresses), the zipper jammed.  I was able to get that fixed, but then after the 3rd time wearing it, it came apart at the seams near the chest area.  Very disappointed.  Certainly did not get my moneys worth.

I ordered this same dress in black in the exact same size, yet this one was all baggy and poofy at the bust, and fit much larger everywhere else. Weird.. the material was also slightly lower in quality. Very thin and wrinkly. I am probably going to exchange it for one size smaller. I still like it a lot despite it not being quite as fantastic as the black one.

review_summary: I just put on this dress
review_text: I just put on this dress and love the fit! It is a perfect medium and very comfortable. I'm planning to buy other colors asap! The only drawback is the zipper, which is a little scratchy in the underarm. Plan to wear a slip under this, especially with the lighter color.

review_summary: I loved this dress when I
review_text: I loved this dress when I first saw it mainly for the color (it's a shade that can go for summer or fall quite easily) and also because it could be dressed up or down. Unfortunately I had to return it because it didn't fit my body type quite right. I am very shortwaisted and the tie hit me too low to be flattering. Plus, it was a little on the long side for me. I am short (5'3) and like my dresses to hit me above the knee and this was a bit below, making me look shorter than I am. This is a problem easily fixed if you can sew or have a tailor, but since there were other problems as well, it sadly wasn't worth me keeping. Other notes: Fabric was on par for a $45 dress. Nice and light for summer, and would just need a slip and heavier tights and a cardigan to translate it to fall.I think it could look great on some, but girls with similar body types to mine (short, shortwaisted, hourglass figure with small waist, big boobs and butt) it can make you look a little bigger or shorter than you are.

review_summary: I measured my self and it
review_text: I measured my self and it said 2x that is what I went with. I wanted to wear it today and I noticed it was a bit loose. I wanted to go with the 1x I knew I should have. I only wore it for maybe an hour. I had to take i off. It was too lose around the breast for me.

review_summary: When I got this dress, I
review_text: When I got this dress, I was so excited because it's so 50s! But quite quickly I realized that the fabric is very thin and the bust was very large. I'm small in that area and I just hate when that extra fabric is just hanging there. But, for someone with a bigger bust that can truly fit into this adorable dress, then they should try it out! They'll just have to navigate around the bad quality of it.

I absolutely love this dress!! It's exactly what I imagined and hoped it would be.  Out of the packaging it is a little wrinkled, nothing a quick iron can't fix.  The middle sash wasn't quite as sturdy as I expected and will definitely need some ironing after my failed attempts at tying a perfect bow, but it really brings the dress together.  The length was perfect, comes right to my knee and I love that even when I spin it doesn't float out and become too short.  The buttons don't seem to be held on all that well, the bottom button is going to need a little reinforcing but they add just the right touch to this dress.  I did find it a little tight across the bust so I'm glad I went with the large to avoid any gap between buttons.  Overall I can't stop loving this dress!!
Wrinkles up in the wash. So it always has to be ironed after a washing which is a pain. Great color, great fit. Easy to dress up or down. Love this dress.

I'm 5'7 125lbs and a 34c. If you are anything close to this I suggest getting a small still and just unbuttoning part of the top so the bottom half isn't sloppy looking. I ordered a medium because i was worried about the top being too small, but now its wide in the ribs, kinda sloppy. I'm gonna make due with a big belt and in the future order another color in small, this is a perfect everyday dress that can be glamed up.

Love, love, love this dress. Want it in every color. Had to tighten the buttonholes. Four of us got it for a dance contest, and it looked great on all of us different shaped wmen one tall pear, one medium curvy, me, a short apple, and a taller apple.

review_summary: oh this dress is too much
review_text: oh this dress is too much. it's perfect. simple and can be dressed up or down with the right shoes/accessories. the color is fab and goes great with my patent wine wedges.

review_summary: I like the concept of thi
review_text: I like the concept of this dress – it's got a classic retro look that can still be easily modernized, the cap sleeves help camoflauge bigger upper arms, and the cut could be very flattering and help define a waistline, with that lovely aline skirt. On me, it wasn't quite 100% right; maybe it's my shape – I'm not very curvy with measurments B34, W27, H35. Plus I was hoping it would be a little bit longer, the high wasit and slightly shorterthanexpected skirt made me feel slightly littlegirlish. As for the color, I think it's beautiful – a rich amber that makes me want to stroll down an lane in the crisp autumn breeze. The color on me was off however, as I have pale skin with yellow undertones and dark blonde hair. On someone with darker hair I think it could be very flattering. As for accessories, I really like it with darker tights, and a belt can help jazz it up and define more of a waist. I kept it anyway, and have worn it twice, most successfully layered with a brown patterned cardigan and dark tights.

review_summary: Great dress in a great co
review_text: Great dress in a great color. Fits very well and makes me feel very 1950s chic!

This dress is absolutely darling!  I can't wait to wear it out.  The fit is perfect.  The material is a great color but on the thinner side (which is kinda nice for summer) and that's the only reason why I didn't say it was the highest quality.

review_summary: Same fit as the Hepcat dr
review_text: Same fit as the Hepcat dress.  I have two of the hepcats and three of the soda fountain dresses, absolutely love them.  The fit is flattering and the material washes up really soft.  The saffron yellow was not very flattering on me, so I overdyed it with some Rit dye and now it's lovely.

review_summary: I bought this dress to we
review_text: I bought this dress to wear at my wedding rehearsal. We ended up having a courthouse wedding at midnight the night before the big, public ceremony, so this is technically the dress in which I became a wife!I love this dress. It's every bit as sweet as the photo makes it out to be, and quite comfortable as well. The fabric is a bit thin, so you might need to wear nude undergarments or a slip, but other than than I found the quality to be quite good. It's been through several washings now and has held up like a champ. My only fit issue was with the bust. I found it necessary to put a safety pin in between buttons in order to keep them closed  but girls with bigger busts will be familiar with this annoyance already. It's no worse than most buttondown blouses.I don't have a good photo of me just modeling the dress. This one shows me about five minutes into my new marriage. My husband thought the dress was very cute!

Vibrant color, great fit.. my only suggestions would be to use a higher quality fabric that doesn't wrinkle as easily and make another version for short ladies. It hangs just below my knee which is a little too long for me but other than that it's terrific for the price.

I really loved the color and fit of this dress! I did end up undoing the buttons and laying it with a tank top, but that's just because my chest likes to rebel against tops with buttons. The only bad thing is that the zipper on the size broke within a month of having it  I decided to keep it anyway, intending to fix/replace the zipper myself sooner or later. But it still is a beautiful dress!

review_summary: a little long for me and
review_text: a little long for me and a little tight across the chest. both are to be expected though. still. i love this dress. it looks great with a variety of belts and tights and shoes.
The fabric on this dress is too thin and cheap.  The stiching was fraying.  I sent it back.

review_summary: Due to reviews of this ru
review_text: Due to reviews of this running tight across the chest and that I have a larger chest, I sized up.  It was too big everywhere, chest included.  Looks cute on minus the baggy look.  Sizing down should solve the problem, but now out of stock.  May try a different color.  Other issue is that on the mannequin it looks longer waisted, but the belt falls above my waist, even in the too big size and considering I'm pretty short.  Will be interesting to see how the smaller size fits.

I really like this dress, the color is great and cheerful, and the shape is flattering. However, I do have a few complaints. The button holes are pretty loose and I've needed to keep safety pins there inbetween the buttons to make sure they don't pop open if I turn a certain way. Even though the length looks appropriate when I'm standing, if I bend even the slightest at the waist, someone can look up my dress so I always need to wear bloomers underneath or else be VERY cautious about how I pick things up or work at a desk. Also, the zipper is very hard to use and tends to get stuck, so I usually just put this dress on like a pullover; however, the zipper also comes up very high, even though I have fairly thin arms, it tends to chafe in the armpit. Other than that, I think the dress is a great warmweather dress, and a good wear for a gloomy day that needs some brightening.
wearing this now at work and I've gotten a million compliments! Only downside is that it wrinkles easily and its a bit on the thin side but it fits really nicely!

I received this dress as a gentlyworn hand me down from a friend this week. It's wonderful. I usually can't wear yellow with my fair complexion, but this color happens to work for me. As many other reviewers have said, the bust runs very small. I'm usually a Medium, but even with the large, the buttons just refused to stay closed. When wearing to the office, I definitely wear a cami underneath. Overall, I am super happy with the fit of this dress. It is very flattering, and has a distinctive, yet flexible style.

review_summary: I adore this dress. I lov
review_text: I adore this dress. I love it so much, I bought it in purple and also in red. I think it is fantastic for the price as well. People can complain that it's wrinkly all you want, but the material is completely iron safe. Like most clothing, an iron will take out the wrinkles! I don't even see why that is a concern. I get compliments on this dress and it makes my waist look invisible. Good job Mod Cloth. This dress is adorable. I originally got it in a medium but then switched to a small because it looks good when its nice and snug on you. PLus the length is great.

When I first bought this dress, it fit almost perfectly and I set it aside for some tailoring. Six months later, I put it back on to find that my increased workout regime has made it unwearable; the shoulders and cap sleeves no longer fit over my slightly broad shoulders, and the cap sleeves are riding on the tops of my shoulders because they're so tiny now. I don't remember how tight they were at first tryon, so maybe I just pushed them over the wearable edge. So if you have wide shoulders or muscular arms from ballet, lifting, etc... This dress probably won't fit you in the shoulders, unless you size up and risk everything else being too big. Other than the now tight fit, which hope i can fix, I love the dress and want to keep it in my wardrobe.

Perfect summer dress! This is my first Modcloth purchase and I'm really pleased! At first I thought it was a little expensive, especially that I had to pay customs fees (I live in Canada). It was worth every penny!
A fantastic dress, can be easily styled in lots of different ways. Only slight downside is the fabric creases easily.

review_summary: Yes, the fabric is on the
review_text: Yes, the fabric is on the thin side, but this is such an amazing dress so who cares?!  The color is becoming and the fit is almost perfect ( it strains a teeny bit at the bust for me, but not too much!).  I think this dress dress should be called amazing magic dress because it seems to be able to suit a large range of body types and heights.  I am also so glad this is made of a breathable cotton, because the summers can get hot around here!  I have the polka dotted hepcat dress in this style and can't say enough about how wonderful they both are. LOVE THIS DRESS!  Highly Recommend!

review_summary: This was my first dress f
review_text: This was my first dress from Mod Cloth. I love it, even though it is a bit shorter than I would usually wear. I had hoped that a longer length dress would come to my knees, but this dress stops just short.I also ended up stitching the button closure at the bust. It didn't effect the fit, but did stop the dress from gaping between the buttons.I wear this dress frequently, often pairing it with purple shoes and a purple cardigan.

review_summary: As any girl with my size
review_text: As any girl with my size chest knows, it is REALLY HARD finding a button down anything that fits without pulling.  The dress was a little snug, but in the way that showed off my curves without looking ridiculous.  I haven't tried it yet, but I'm sure if I wore it unbuttoned with a cami, there would be no snugness at all.As a heavier girl I was more worried about the waistline, but it was perfect.I didn't find any problems with tightness in the arms/shoulders like some people did.As far as the fabric, many reviews mentioned it was lighter than expected.  I found it to be exactly like a stretchy cotton blouse I already own and have been wearing for years, so I'm actually happy with it.  I didn't have any transparency issues, even wearing it with a black bra.And the best part  so many compliments!

review_summary: Love it, fit is true to s
review_text: Love it, fit is true to size. Not 100% convinced with colour BUT will defintely buy the other ones...ohh grape! :)

I received my Soda Foundain Dress in the mail today and let me just say I'm in love! The color is beautiful and very appealing. I wasn't too sure about getting it at first because I'm a little skeptical about ordering clothes off the internet (you never know if it'll fit or not) but I'm so glad that I did. I'm very happy with my purchase. I was also a little scared because I'm insecure about my arms but the little sleeves boost my confidence and the dress overal is now a stable in my wardrobe. The only cons I found was that being a 34 C and 135 pounds or so the top half of the dress is a little tight on the bust and that puts a bit of pressure on the buttons. Also, the side zipper gave was hard to zip up (I'm hoping this won't give me a problem in the future). I'm no doubt going to purchase the grape soda fountain dress  when it comes back in stock and perhaps the Papaya or Ice one as well! Just in my next purchase I'll be sure to get a large, just in case my chest size grows bigger I want this dress to last me a long while. Overall Modcloth has another devoted customer :) Thank you Modcloth!

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress to come, I almost kissed the mailman. However, when I tried it on it didn't fit well in the waist. Also, the fabric was flimsy, and it seems to wrinkle easily.

WOW. This dress is fantastic! I expected to like it from all the reviews, but I'm socked at just how perfect is. It's flattering and a great length (even for someone as short as me). A few loose threads here or there, but it's one of my favorite Modcloth purchases (of which there are many...)!
The dress fits wonderfully and is as fun to wear as I thought it would be.  I have a small bust, so I use a padded bra to reach a B cup.  As I expected, this dress flatters just about any figure.

review_summary: First of all I have to sa
review_text: First of all I have to say this is the first dress I saw when I ventured onto the Modcloth website for the first time and fell in love at first sight. After a month or so of debating it I purchased the dress with the support of my three year old nephew! I read the reviews which said the dress was tight around the rib cage and pulled at the chest so I was concerned this dress would not fit me. I'm 5' 2, 146 lbs. and a 42 DD and ordered a large. The dress fit me perfectly. I was able to slip it over my head without undoing the buttons or the zipper. The fit was loose enough to allow me to wear a slip under the dress. The fabric is a little thinner than I would have liked allowing anything other than a light colored bra to show. The belt that accompanies the dress is a bit thin in width instead I wore a large brown belt that cinched my waist perfectly giving me more of an hour glass figure. The length falls slightly below my knees and suits this retroinspired dress nicely. My only complaint is that once the buttons are loosened they easily pop open without any resistance and had I not been wearing a slip under I could have easily embarrassed myself! However, an easy solution will be to simply sew the buttons as I know I will not have to loosen them to slip the dress on. I'm very happy with my purchase as is my nephew who thinks it's a pretty yellow dress. I also received so many compliments on the dress that I will definitely be ordering it in some of the other colors!

Beautiful mustard color, nice cut, very well constructed. I usually can't wear dresses with buttons across the front because I'm chesty, but this one fits really well. I don't really have a problem with the fabric  it looks pretty nice, maybe that's because it fill it out pretty well. :)I don't like where the belt loops hit, and I'm not fond of the narrow self belt, but I just removed the belt and put another belt over the loops. It looks great.I'm really looking forward to the ice blue and coral colors coming back in stock!

review_summary: I love this dress!  It fi
review_text: I love this dress!  It fit me perfectly.  It's just a hair shorter than I was expecting, and yes, you will need to wear a slip with it.  But it is so cute and totally worth finding a really nice full slip to complete the vintage feel!  This dress is fun for the spring and summer, but I rocked it this winter with bright blue tights, boots, and a sweater.  Love it!

This dress fits perfectly. The color is pretty. The length is perfect; it goes to my knees (I'm 5'1). It is delightfully swishy and just looks great! I want to buy the other soda fountain dresses as well. :)(Sorry my face is obscured in the photograph.)
Nice fit, looks adorable and flattering. It's a little longer than I expected for my 5'2 figure but I like how wide the flare is on the skirt. I will definately be wearing this dress a lot

I ADORE this dress...I probably could have gone with a small, but was worried about it being tight. The medium fits perfectly, except for the bust, which could be taken in a tiny bit. Sometimes, it's hard to find a dress that hits at the right area being tall, but this is a perfect length for work! Definitely one of my favorite Modcloth purchases.
Gorgeous dress! Fits flawlessly and the color looks even better in person than online!

review_summary: fabulous dress I own it i
review_text: fabulous dress I own it in 4 different colors. Im not a big yellow person but the yellow on this dress is beautiful! The biggest complaint people have about this dress is that it fits a bit small on the bust.  On occasion this is the case so what I did being a big 36c is I simply sewed the button holes a bit smaller and this way the buttons do not slide out as I move.  Its well worth it to make this very easy and quick minor modification cause otherwise the dress looks amazing and gets you tons of compliments.
This a great dress!  I

review_summary: First, I have to say this
review_text: First, I have to say this dress is super cute!  It is a little snug in the bust area, but I'm kinda small in that department, so I find it flattering.  Unfortunately, the quality of the workmanship leaves a little to be desired.  One sleeve is longer than the other and it was the first thing I noticed when I looked in the mirror.  Hoping this was a fluke, I ordered another one in papaya and it has the same problem.  I have an appointment with a seamstress today (which is a little disappointing since these are $45 dresses).  However, I have a hard time finding clothes I like and this dress is sooo cute I decided to make the effort to have them fixed.

review_summary: I already had the Soda Fo
review_text: I already had the Soda Fountain dress in Grape, and wanted to get another color, as well as try another size. I had ordered the Grape in size S, and while it actually fit me perfectly all over the body (even making my small 32A bust look bigger!), it was too tight around the arms/shoulders. But I have broad shoulders for my body type/size, so that's not too surprising. I figured I'd try an M to see if that would work better. The M fits my shoulders well, but is also too roomy around the bust and waist. Not a terribly huge deal, as I can just make sure to wear a wellpadded bra, and the tie cinches the waist nicely. The color of this dress is very lovely, the style is, as always, very flattering—bustfriendly, good at hiding my baby belly flab, and camouflaging my naturallyhunched shoulders. I find that wrinkles show more prominently in the lighter color than in the darker ones (i.e. purple), but it's not a big deal, and not too much trouble to iron. Works great with sandals or pumps for summer wear, or tights, boots and a cardigan for winter wear!

I absolutely adore this dress. I ordered this along with the purple and black versions. This dress is my least favorite of the three, but only because the thin fabric and light color force me to wear a white bra. The buttons along the bust also pop open on me sometimes, so if you're chesty, I would go a size up. Other than some minor complaints, I look adorable wearing it, and I'm happy as can be!

I'm pleased with the fit and quality of the dress but glad I read so many of the reviews. It's just as wrinkleprone as others have said, and it is indeed a thinnish material. That said, it fits me well (I bought size M) and I got compliments on it right away. Some reviewers have said that they expected better quality for the cost. Maybe things cost more where I live, but I think that the quality and cost are in line. This dress won't wear as well as one that I'd have paid $80100 for, but neither do I find it overpriced for $45.Oh, and the length is just at/above my knee, which means I can wear it to work, hooray!

review_summary: I ordered this dress in a
review_text: I ordered this dress in a Medium and Large, but I just ordered it in a Small. The bust of this dress fit me well, but the waist was way too large, which is why I want to try a Small. I was surprised that people said it was too thin; I found the material to be just perfect. As for the wrinkles, they're not major at all and can easily be ironed out.  Also, beware of wearing anything but nude underclothing.

review_summary: I love this dress and own
review_text: I love this dress and own it in several colors! It is EXTREMELY flattering, accentuating great hips and flattening the tummy. I only have two complaints: One, the fabric is rather thin, and two, it is very tight in the bust area and I constantly have an issue with the buttons just popping open (I am a C cup). The color is a deep goldenrod yellow color (very accurate to what you see on the site) and while thin, it IS nice for a hot summer's day. The length is comfortable and a little longer than an average dress, coming to an inch or two above the knee.
This color really pops! Whenever I wear this I get a ton of compliments  it is just a beautiful dress. The silhouette is a dream. My only complaint is that the buttons sometimes pop open.

This dress fits really well and looks just like the picture on me.  The waist is a little higher than it looks in the picture, it's really  1.5 inches below where the buttons end.The cotton fabric is a nice summer weight but needs ironing often.

review_summary: It was a little tighter t
review_text: It was a little tighter than I expected in the bust BUT it's that time so may fit better this coming week. ;) Otherwise the fit was right on and by measurement I'm currently a little bustier than a L should be anyway. (So strange after being a pear for so long). I'm 413138 currently sigh, after being 362536 and would have fit a medium then. I also used to sew and I will say the fabric is more like shirt material then dress material. So that's why I only gave it good for quality. But I don't iron and after hanging a while it's fine to me.

review_summary: Pulled at the bust and I'
review_text: Pulled at the bust and I'm only a 34C! I got a L because I wanted it to be slightly loose, but it ended up fitting strangely all over. It made me look square! It also wasn't as bright as I thought it would be. I wouldn't call it goldenrod yellow, more a dark mustard yellow that didn't flatter my pale skin with pink and yellow undertones. I looked very sallow :(

review_summary: I love this dress!  It is
review_text: I love this dress!  It is very flattering and fun.  The only downside is that the arm holes are a little on the large side and the fabric wrinkles very easily.  Nonetheless, I always get compliments on it.

review_summary: The fit and length on thi
review_text: The fit and length on this dress are perfect. The color is exactly as in the picture and is a beautiful mustard shade. The only complaint I have of this dress is that it is a bit more sheer than I expected. I have to wear a slip under it, or as I did in the picture, a shirt and tights. Otherwise, you can see too much through it! Besides that I have no complaints, and it's just so versatile and can be styled for so many different occasions. I wore it to an evening bridal shower and received many compliments!

This dress is amazing! The color is great, which I was worried about because as a redhead, I often have problems with yellows. The only issue I have with it is that it gets wrinkly VERY easily, so be careful how you sit.

Spunky and fun while still being age appropriate. I adore the color and the feminine details. I bought this before the stylists displayed their ten outfits and now that I have seen what they have done, I am even more inspired and may buy one or two more in different colors! Fabulous!

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favorite dresses, I LOVE little yellow dresses in the Summer and warm seasons. I'm 5'2'' and 113 lbs; The small fits me everywhere perfectly, EXCEPT the bust. I have a 36D bust, and the buttons like to pop open occasionally; nothing a small safety pin can't fix. :]

review_summary: Too small for my top. The
review_text: Too small for my top. The buttons kept busting open.

I get a lot of complements.  Oh, also the fabric tends to wrinkle easily, but not so much it wolud deter me from buying another color

I didn't think the material quality was that bad, and it was wrinkled but it was a dress that had just been shipped in a box so I wasn't surprise. I just hung the dress in the bathroom while I had a very hot long shower and the wrinkles pretty much all came out.I was so excited for this dress to come, so I'm heartbroken that it doesn't fit my boobs :(.  The length is PERFECT (I'm sick of short short dresses) and I love the shape of the dress... But I'm a 34 D bra size (which is a pretty average size I think) and I couldn't' do up the buttons over my rack :(. Even with the buttons open I couldn't move my arms forward. I'll be returning this dress and maybe trying a large,(sad!) so I'll let you know how that fits!

Cute dress, fits well and roomy enough to fit my rather large bust, which I really appreciate. it's a bit on the longer side, hitting below my knees (I prefer dresses that hit right at the knees)  all in all a good purchase.

review_summary: Ok, so I thought I would
review_text: Ok, so I thought I would love this dress from the picture... unfortunately, I don't in person. This was part of my first ModCloth purchase, and I had been searching for a yellow dress for a while until I found this one. The goldenrod color is great, but the fabric is not. The material is way too thin (seethrough even), and the bust is really tight. I have an average chest size, so I was surprised at how the top fit. Also, the sleeves were a bit poofy on my small frame, and finally, the belt sat in an odd spot: not at the natural wait, but not just below the bust either. Overall, I just think this dress is ok, which isn't enough to justify the price. Sadly, I will be returning it.

review_summary: I had this dress in black
review_text: I had this dress in black (cola) in a size medium so I ordered the yellow in a medium. Bizarrely it is like a totally different dress. It's a little on the large side but I do manage to button it up over my bust which I struggle to do with the black one. I really like the colour but the material is a little thin (another things that is different to the black one). It is a nice loose fit for summer without being shapeless.

review_summary: Like this a lot, love the
review_text: Like this a lot, love the color.  It is very thin fabric and wrinkles very easily just like everyone else has said.  I pair it with a royal blue patent leather belt and shoes.

I actually ordered a small. The packing slip said small, but the dress that arrived was a medium. It was slightly big, but it pretty much fit. I had a party coming up that I needed to wear it to, so I kept it. The waist is well tailored, which makes it very flattering to the shape. I'm thin (110 lbs.), but curvy and this worked well with the styling. The material is a bit thin and does wrinkle quickly. I ironed and starched mine and it held shape better. The sash doesn't hold it's shape very well, but the dress looks great with a belt or scarf. I expected a little better quality fabric for the price. I love the retro design, it looks vintage. The color is perfect.

review_summary: I love this dress, it loo
review_text: I love this dress, it looks great with dark skin (which I don't have), but still! Perfect length, perfect fit, but pricey and very thin material... i love the 50's style though :)

review_summary: I was a little worried ab
