review_text: I was a little worried about buying a L because the size chart tells me I'm an XL but since there isn't an XL available in this dress, I decided to purchase the L. So glad I did! It fits me perfectly! It really flatters my shape and cinches my waist, making it look much smaller than it is. I'll be buying the vanilla colored one soon!

This dress is great. It's casual and a nice bright color, and it fits really well. I've seen it on coworkers with different body types, and the fitted waist and full skirt make it look great on all types. It's also fantastic for layering  I can wear long sleeves or sweaters over it in the winter, and the collar looks great peeking out. I only have ginger right now, but I may buy a few more colors.

I'm a pretty funky size5 feet even, 120 lbs, small boobs, big rib cage, long torso, medium in the hips department.  Finding anything that fits can be a real pain, so I played it safe and went with a medium on this dress.  The fit is a little loose, which is comfortable for workif I were planning on wearing this for a hot date, I'd probably go a size down.  It makes me appear to have boobs and a small waist, which is awesome.  The quality of the dress is sosoas others have noted, the fabric is rather thin (although not seethrough by any means), and it has zero lining.  Luckily, the cut is flattering enough that you can't really tell that the fabric is crummy when it's on.  The quality of the fabric puts in mind a dress you'd get from a street vendor, but the tailoring is much superior.  Probably about what one can expect from a $40 indiechic dress.

review_summary: i have this dress in purp
review_text: i have this dress in purple and polka dot. the fabric is a bit thin, but there is some give and it is so comfy.

Being plus size and hard to fit I generally do not buy dresses online but this was a perfect fit! I purchased the 2x and the fit could not have been better. The bottom allows plenty of room for ladies with larger behind and thighs. The top may be slightly small for women with a larger chest but it does have a decent amount of stretch. The material is thin and wrinkles VERY easily. Which I knew before purchasing before due to the reviews. In my posted picture it was the end of the night and you can see all of the wrinkling and that was after I starched the heck out of it. Despite that I really did love how comfortable it was and how well it fit. It was slightly long and I plan on shortening it and using it as a fun summer dress.
Great color and awesome fit! This is particularly flattering for curvy girls and not too short, though I would have preferred a touch longer.
Adorable dress. I love this mustard color and wear it with red (ketchup?) pumps. I'd love suggestions on what sort of sleeves would go with this.

I absolutely love this dress! It works wonderfully to flatter your bust and create curves. Paired with a petticoat, the skirt has such a fun and flirty shape! Fabric could be nicer, and the zipper felt a little flimsy. The colour is darker than shown, but it photographs brighter and looks fabulous in pictures. I love this dress to bits. The cloth belt can also be swapped for something bolder to change the look up. #freshphoto

I should've known better. My last order from ModCloth was 2 years ago and I was so disappointed with the quality and fit I vowed to never shop there again. But I got sucked in by the cuteness and sale items after stupidly opening an email from ModCloth. Once again, I found the fit poor, with this dress being loose through the bust and waist on me. The material is thin, extremely prone to creasing and badly finished (buttons not sewn on properly, seams with loose threads). I would have sent my order back if the cost of postage from Australia to the US wasn't so ridiculous. Also, I don't know why ModCloth advertises 'new lower cost shipping rates to Australia' because I paid $40 for four dresses to be shipped.

the dress looks great! I ordered a small originally but exchanged for medium since the zipper on the side was too tight.  I think the medium worked well overall because the small was a little too short too (I am 5'7'').  Looks great with the red belt i bought at ModCloth with this dress and my red sandals! First buy at ModCloth is a success! can't wait to wear it when it gets warmer!
Cute dress. Fits well, although I'd prefer it to be a little more snug in the waist. Pairs perfectly with a dark blue, black, or purple cardigan, tights and oxfords.

This dress fits very well and is super cute. The waist is higher than in the picture. It's just the color as pictured which is very pretty for summer. It shows off my curves well while being flowy. I got the medium and I'm 5'6'', 140 lbs, 34B.

review_summary: I saw this dress and had
review_text: I saw this dress and had a miniheart attack. So perfectly Vintage! So perfectly plussize! And I have been obsessing over this color all month...(just ordered a skirt from modcloth in the same color.) I talked the ears off of my parents about this dress all December. Then, come Christmas Morning, I opened this dress with delight. Then I put it on. I am not too short, but this dress is so much longer on me then other modlover's pictures. I don't want to risk hemming it, because of the amazing flair it has. Also, I went to three different sites looking for helping wearing this dress, and none seemed to work. It was too thin to wear with out leggings and a jacket in the middle of winter, and by summer it would have been too heavy. Finally, I settled on the outfits included, because the dress it self was too pretty to send back! (Sorry this is so long!)
The dress is adorable and the color is he same you see. My only complain is it wrinkles easily and I hate ironing. My fault, I know.

review_summary: I have this dress in cher
review_text: I have this dress in cherry, as well as the similarly styled hepcat dress. I love these dresses so much. The length of the dress is great, hitting at the knee, the cap sleeves can be tight, so if your arms are large, be warned, you may need to have the sleeves altered. The top is fitted, perfect for me with a small bust, but for small framed girls with a large bust size, I think they would have problems. The only other thing to note is that the dress, although made from a think cotton blend, is slightly seethrough in this colour. So it's white or beige underwear with this one.

Among the good things about this dress is that there is truth in advertising on the siteit fits more of less like it should (though I probably should have gotten the small, since the waist was surprisingly roomy on my medium.  Nothing the tie belt couldn't cure, though). In earlier reviews, some were surprised to find that material is thin or flimsy, but I didn't find it to be soit's just a light cotton weave.  There were also some complaints about wrinkles which I don't understand: when you take a light cotton dress out of plastic baggie, it isn't typically in perfect, readytowear shape.  Yes, it arrived wrinkled. Big deal. A little ironing is all it will take to make it look great.My biggest issue with the dress is actually the colorwhich was again consistent with that advertised.  It just doesn't look that great against my winter pale yet slightly olive skin.  I'm hoping it'll look better on when I start rocking my tan this summer.

Beautiful!!  I've been eyeing this dress for months and months, and finally snatched it up as soon as it went on sale.  It was still a little pricier than what I normally pay for dresses, but totally worth it.  Both the color and fit are super flattering, this is probably my new favorite dress. :)

review_summary: I LOVE this dress.  I rec
review_text: I LOVE this dress.  I received it as a Christmas gift from my sisters. :)Pros: This dress is a gorgeous color and is extremely flattering and feminine in style and fit!Cons: It's made of a very lightweight cotton fabric, so don't expect to wear it out by itself on a cold, winter's day.

super fun dress. The classic style is timeless and the color is gorgeous! I usually wear a Modcloth Medium, but this one felt just a little too skintight.  So I exhanged for a large. Now the sleeves feel a little loose, but I'm more comfortable in the body. (I'm hoping after I wash it, it'll shrink just the tiniest bit). Wear it with my own dark brown belt and matching boots...The flaring skirt is so fun!

review_summary: Ordered a size M and am p
review_text: Ordered a size M and am pretty pleased with it. I'd say that it feels 80% really classic, about 20% maybe a little dowdy. I think it probably looks amazing on taller girls, but at only 5'2 with a little bit of weight, it did not do anything to elongate me, but does have a lot of charm. I have a clothes steamer which worked great for the wrinkles that other reviewers were so concerned with  I don't see it being a deal breaker for me.

Love this! Size is perfect and it greatly compliments my less than perfect figure. The color is exactly as pictured and it looks great with my green heels! I've bought this dress in every color (except black but only because I have too much black already!)

Overall a simple, sweet dress. Very fitted but in all the right places. The fabric is on the thin side, which is OK because I'd only wear this in the warmer months anyways. The fabric also creases very easily, making ironing anytime you want to wear necessary. My boyfriend loves this dress on me, I usually pair it with a pair of red peeptoe pumps and a cardi or chunky bracelet. Really happy with this one!

got this dress after lusting after it for years, and it definitely holds up! the fabric is on the thin side and wrinkles rally easily, but I was aware of that from reading other reviews. the color is gorgeous and the skirt hits me right at the knee. I've been looking for excuses to wear this dress since I got it, even in the middle of a Wisconsin winter.

review_summary: I had my eye on this dres
review_text: I had my eye on this dress for a looong time and I'm so happy I finally bought it.  The color is gorgeous (fellow redheads: you need this dress), and the fit is perfect.  I wore it with white knit stockings, brown maryjanes, knit spats, and a brown tailored cardigan....super cute!

review_summary: I had my eye on this dres
review_text: I had my eye on this dress for a looong time and I'm so happy I finally bought it.  The color is gorgeous (fellow redheads: you need this dress), and the fit is perfect.  I wore it with white knit stockings, brown maryjanes, knit spats, and a brown tailored cardigan....super cute!

review_summary: The color of this dress i
review_text: The color of this dress is really pretty. This is the first time I bought a dress with this golden yellow/mustardy color and I must say I am certainly happy with it. Being mostly made of cotton, I am quite sure it will wrinkle after washing but I will wait to see what the outcome is after the first wash. The fit on the waist is smart and the sash is also good enough. You can always wear a different belt with it to jazz it up, in fact I plan on doing just that once I figure out what color would look good. Apart from that, the only downside would be that I just might have to wear some sort of slip underneath because the material seems to be a teeny bit see through. I didn't find that to be the case with this same dress that I bought in the cherry color but it really is not a big deal. The bust, waist, shoulder areas all fit fine. I usually buy XS but since this did not have that size, I bought a Small and I have no issues with the fit. This is a very smart dress, also has a 50s60s touch to it which is great. I like stuff that looks a little vintage! Length hits just above my knee.

Well, first the good things: Very pretty style, good fabric, great lenght, versitile dress, and excellent modcloth service! The bad things: The color is not as bright as I was expecting. It is very mustard! I am curvy, and 36C and normally between sizes ML, and for the previous comments I thought L would be good, but it was too big, so I had to size down. I exchanged it for the same dress in Black and size M and it fits perfectly!

The dress simply does not fit like it does in the picture of the model. In the picture, the tie appears to be right under the bust, but it's actually much lower. I'm 5'9 so I know it's not an issue of height. It is also extremely tight in the stomach area, so I would not recommend this dress unless you've very confident about your stomach. The material seems nice, and the style would probably work well for someone who is smaller.
I've been waiting for years for this to go on sale! I love the colour, and the dress over all is really cute. I am 5'8'', 110 lbs and I am a 34B. I got the Small, the length and fit are perfect.

review_summary: I bought this as a Christ
review_text: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my sister. I think she will love it and there are so many color options to pair it with.

review_summary: This dress is made of ver
review_text: This dress is made of very thin material, and the buttons are hardly sewed on very well. If you have a larger bosom I would suggest a large or extra large (I am a 36B). Other than that, the dress is super flowy and the collar is nice. I would suggest getting a belt or something around the waist to spice it up a bit
Very cute dress, but I'm a very small girl so its a tiny bit bigger than I would like. It doesnt look strange though, so that's good :) it gets wrinkles kind of easily, though.

review_summary: I love this dress. The co
review_text: I love this dress. The color is perfect for me! I am very pale with very dark hair and it accents me just right. The cut is great for my figure.I'm 5'6 with a Bcup and 42 inch hips. I definitely have some curve to me. I love the way it fits and the way it makes me feel.

Awesome dress! The color is a tad bit darker, do it's more of a   mustard and less of a gold. The fabric seems good quality, but a little thin, so be prepared to wear a slip on sunny days! It fits perfectly though, and it's flattering on any shape!

I'm very conflicted about the sizing of this dress:  on one hand, I do not have to lower the side zipper to slip it on, which means that the dress fits loosely around the waist; on the other hand, I cannot get the buttons to close without my chest looking like it's going to break out of the dress.  Even unbuttoned, there is a slight strain under the bust area, so this dress will always have to be worn with a camisole.  I don't want to size up and be utterly lost elsewhere in the dress, but I don't believe anyone with a bust larger than a B can fit into the top in small small.  Also, I have relatively small shoulders and arms, and the cap sleeves are slightly tight around them. The material of the dress arrived wrinkled and I foresee it will be a constant battle to keep it unwrinkled.  It is hard to get the collars to stay in place.  The dress comes to just under my knee, which is a tad long for me, so I believe I will have it altered.  The color is indeed a mustard, and contrary to other Asian posters, looks well with my skin.  The sash will most likely go unused because as other posters have mentioned, the fabric of the dress is very light and crumples easily  to get that perfect bow, you will most likely have to line it with another fabric or starch the heck out of it.It is a super cute dress though, so despite all these doubts, I will probably keep it.

Pros: This dress is very cute! The color really pops and it's great for layering. It was also a relief to find a size S dress that still fit my bust without very noticeable puckering at the buttons.Cons: The sleeves are too small and press down on my shoulders if I move my arms at all. Not enough to look ridiculous, but it does make my arms look fatter. I don't know if the plus size version is made differently, but there's no way you can roll the sleeves like that on the regular size. The sewing quality looks like my $10 dresses and mine came with lots of loose threads, which I don't expect coming from that price tag. The collar is so wide that it bunches up under blazers/jackets. Also, if you're short like me the dress will be a bit long. Mine goes past my knees which makes me look even shorter, but at least it's an easy fix.Overall, there are a lot a little annoying things about it, but I love the design and layering possibilities so much that I'll roll with it.

review_summary: Oh I love this dress, the
review_text: Oh I love this dress, the fit is perfect! I'm a busty, curvy kind of girl and this was perfect in all areas. Besides, the retro shape is absolutly sexy. I've been trying to think wintery ways to wear it now that the season changed, and I have the idea of buying this same dress in other colours. Ah! That's another thing, the color is amazing! Is a mustard yellow so inviting and beautiful.

review_summary: This dress and I might be
review_text: This dress and I might be soulmates. I'm so happy I got it. It does wrinkle very, very easily, and it's a little long and big in the waist, at least for me. But still, it's cute and flattering and I love it to pieces. The belt loops are great cause I didn't like the sash that came with it, but I can wear my own belts.

I love the Soda Fountain dresses. This is my second one, I own another in purple, and I want to own all of the colours! It's a bit wrinkly in my photo because I had just taken it out of the box to try it on. I was nervous that the arms might be too tight, but they're not (My purple one shrank a bit and the arms are a little tight for my liking, but not uncomfortably so). The dress is beautiful and as long as you take proper care of it, it will last! Totally worth the price.

This dress comes in various colors. I purchased the yellow and green one with white polka dots. In terms of color: I am lightolive skinned Asian and the yellow/mustardy color was unflattering on me…it totally washed me out and made me blend in. The green one with the polka dots was a little better; gave me some color and contrast. The fit for both colors was not loose, but comfortable in the waist so I could move around and sit. I have a slightly wide rib cage and broad shoulders for my stature, so the bust area fit JUST right. I am short, so the dress ran right below my knees. The material is cheap/okay and not worth $45, even though I got it 25% during a holiday sale (still not worth the sale price). You may need to steam or iron the bow so it ties nicely and doesn't wrinkle. Also, one of the deal breakers was that the collar is ridiculously huge!

Even though I have smaller ribs, I knew the chest line wouldn't fit over my chest, so I went a size up and I'm glad I did! It may be a little baggy, but it hits right at my knees and the dress fits wonderful! Since there is a tie on it, the baggy doesn't matter. It is sheer, but if u put a tank top dress under it, its beyond perfect! I don't feel the wrinkles are too bad, this is one of three of my first dresses I ever bought from modcloth!such a cute dress!!

review_summary: As soon as I saw this dre
review_text: As soon as I saw this dress I fell in love with it. I was a little hesitant on buying it from all of the mixed reviews from people. However not much can come between me and something yellow since it is my favorite color, especially when its on sale. I ordered a large I usually wear a size 10 or 12 in dresses. I have a smaller chest with a wide rib cage, and I almost bust out of this dress at my 36B. So if you are larger chested you may need to unbutton and wear a shirt underneath, which still looks great.

review_summary: I love the color of this
review_text: I love the color of this dress.  It definitely stands out!  My only concern (much like with the Hepcat dresses) is that the material might not hold up very well over time.  I'm particularly concerned about losing the buttons, as they don't seem very secure.  However, I am still glad I purchased it.  I just may have to practice my sewing skills!

review_summary: I was worried that the dr
review_text: I was worried that the dress might be to tight (I'm a size 6/8, 128 lbs), but after trying it on I was completly wrong   It fits perfectly, a Small would definitly be too tight and uncomfortable, a Large to floppy and loose. There is enough space for my bust, hips and shoulders to be comfortable. The quality is not great, but good enough for the amount of money you pay for the dress. Another huge plus is how fast I received the dress. Since I live in Europe, I didnt expect it anytime soon, but I ordered it on a sunday and I received it the next saturday. Way to go ModCloth!

review_summary: Well its a little short t
review_text: Well its a little short to be in the longer dress section altho I should not have put it in the dryer, so that was my fault. The cap sleaves aren't stretchy enough; they don't give enough to lift your arms too much, and its a bit seethrew i dont feel comfortable without wearing a slip under it.

review_summary: For the most part, I am m
review_text: For the most part, I am madly in love with this dress.  I am bustier and have a big ol' butt, so frequently, I have a hard time finding things that fit my bust and my hips without completely losing my waist in the mix.  I fall right on the divide between L and XL, so opted for XL in this case, and was pretty pleased.  This dress nips in beautifully, and makes my waist look even smaller than it is!The ribbon belt that comes with it vanished in the laundry a while ago, so I wear it with the Natural Wave belt (http://www.modcloth.com/shop/belts/naturalwavebelt) pretty frequently, and it could not be a more gorgeous color combination.  This shade of yellow pops nicely, and is a great backdrop for cute and colorful belts.Now, for the downside.   This fabric wrinkles INSTANTLY.  To get it smooth again, you have to wet it thoroughly and iron almost every time you wear it.If you're willing to do that, though, this is a great dress, and extremely figure flattering.

It's official: I can't wear yellow. *sigh* I wanted it to work so much! But alas, it will have to go back and I will probably get the black. The fit was perfect. I could have bought a medium but the waist would have been tight.

I simply ADORE this dress!! I literally just got the package 30 minutes ago and HAD to try on and it fits beautifully! I love the color! perfect for thanksgiving and since it is a little loose, I don't have to worry about it feeling tight after a hearty meal! =)

review_summary: I got a lot of compliment
review_text: I got a lot of compliments when I wore this to work  about the colour and the style. The material's a bit thin and wrinkles really easily, though  but that's my only complaint.

This fabric was thinner than I thought it would be; however, I LOVE this dress. It fits perfectly! I am anxious to order the other colors. A beautiful fit: stylish, yet completely appropriate for work. LOVE IT!!

Looks like I'll need this in 1x, because L isn't enough to cover my boobage: a button literally exploded from my bossom. The stitch quality isn't very good either, with threads dangling about the hems just out of the packaging. Nope, not for me.

review_summary: It's a little short for w
review_text: It's a little short for wearing to the office, but it's great for throwing on for drinks with your lady friends when you are completely out of outfit ideas. And man oh man, for someone of my dimensions (5'5', 170lbs), is the cut excellent.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress, wore once for a wedding and never could again because of the wrinkles and the fit...I am a size small, but I dont know my measurements, but typically buy 24 and I am 5'6...I bought another dress (forget the name) just like this in a medium thinking if I went bigger it would help the waist not coming up to the nipples...So, the dress is big, but not fitted properly...The medium looked like a potato sac and I havent even worn it....I think they need to make the waist area a little longer for people who are smaller in size but still a little tall..A different material would be perfect...~

Adorable, but TOO small in the chest. My bust is exactly 38 inches. I expected it to be snug, but the buttons burst open and it gapes be a few inches! Everything else fit well, but there is ZERO stretch in the bust, which probably is really only 36 inches around.

review_summary: I love this dress. I got
review_text: I love this dress. I got it for a Morton's Salt girl Halloween costume and it was perfect! Carrying an umbrella around all night in a bar on the other hand, not so perfect. I was a little worried that it might be kind of big on top, but I also didn't want it to be so tight that the buttons pulled. The only thing I would change about the dress is the fact that it doesn't have pockets. I might have to add those myself.

review_summary: This is the first dress I
review_text: This is the first dress I've ever ordered from ModCloth so I was super excited when it came in the mail today. The first thing I noticed was that the dress was ridiculously wrinkly when I took it from the packagingnot a good first impression. The second thing I noticed was that the material is really thin and kind of cheap feeling. When I put the dress on I was excited that it fitespecially over the bust but the material was thin enough to show any kind of imperfections in your body. Overall this dress was cute, but not cute enough to spend $45 on it. The material would be nice for summer but I'm returning this dress for something that's (hopefully) better quality for the money.

review_summary: This is a nice dress in t
review_text: This is a nice dress in terms of length, and how it flatters the figure. However, if you're above a B cup, it's likely to pop open and gap at the top. I wear it with a camisole underneath, and it's work appropriate. Be warned, the material does wrinkle easily. Overall a well designed, vintage looking dress that transitions well from summer to fall!

This dress does look lovely and it fits just like I wanted it to and is superflattering ... but it's very highmaintenance.  In order for it to look lovely, you have to iron and starch it, and there's no guarantee it'll stay that way the whole day.  Also, you need to wear a slip underneath it, because the dress tends to curl around your legs or stick to your stockings/leggings and bunch up around them, even if you put it in the dryer with anticling dryer sheets.

Awesome style and a great value for the price! Purchased a Large and it fit perfectly, 5' 7 and 160lbs. The color was a bit bold for me, but is perfect for Fall. I ditched the little matching sash that went with it, removed the belt loops and wore a larger brown belt instead. I also paired it with a brown cardigan. I receive LOTs of compliments when I wear it! Wore it to a wedding and the photographers were begging to take my pic because they said I looked so cute  had to have been the dress! Only cons: It is a basic cotton, not a heavy weighted material, but great for the price. The buttons do tend to pop out of their holes, but are easily fixed by closing up the holes with a few stitches. SO wish this came in more colors: BROWN, BLUE or army GREEN would be fab Modcloth!

This was my first purchase from Mod Cloth and I have so pleased!  I have a larger bust so I was worried how it would fit on top, but it hugged me everywhere I needed!  My only complaint is that it's a little long, but that's probably because I have to buy an xl and I'm only 5'1.  Otherwise, it's perfect!!

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a wedding I was going to. The photo was taken at the reception it was held at a bizarre art gallery in Pittsburgh. It runs very true to size, but wrinkles very easily. It's just a little bit sheer, but that often comes with the territory of light colours, I suppose. I had to be careful to wear light coloured underthings. I love the colour though, and I am overall very pleased with this dress. I got compliments on it all night long.
Take the previous reviews seriously cute cut.  Most DEFINITELY for the tiny boobs.  Anything over an A will alter the proportions.  Fabric not bad, but not stellar.

review_summary: Why oh why do these dress
review_text: Why oh why do these dresses skip from L to 1X? The large is too tight in the chest and arms, and the 1X is just too massive all over. It's a shame, because I love the cut. Also the colour of mine is much more brown than it appears on my computer screen. I really wanted a brighter yellow. Frown.

This dress is fantastic! I love the color and the feel of the material.  The only minor problem I have is how tight the top is.  I'm pretty busty so the buttons pull a little bit if I button it, but in every other way this dress is a dream.

review_summary: Love this dress and the c
review_text: Love this dress and the color is great!  Unfortunately, the fit is too small on the top  both through the bust and in the shoulders.  The waist is fine, even a little roomy.  Hopefully, I can exchange the Small for a Medium.

Really wanted to have this dress fit perfectly and I was so excited to try it on when it arrived. Unfortunately, this dress fit perfectly everywhere but in the bust. The fabric covered buttons just pulled too much and I had to send it back. Beautiful color and otherwise super cute on. Too bad for me the fit on top was too tight.

review_summary: This dress is a steal at
review_text: This dress is a steal at this price!  It is my favorite color and I knew I had to have it.  Perfect for fall.  I usually wear a size large in most dresses on ModCloth, and it fits true to size.  I have wide hips, and this dress seems to camouflage   them well while defining my waist.  I am 5'5 and the hem hits midknee.  It is a little bit strange that the belt loops and bow are lower than the bodice hem, but I still love it.

Everything like length, and waist fit perfectly. I am 5'2 and a teacher, so I do not like short skirts. My complaint is in the bust. That one middle button keeps popping open, and I've only worn it twice! I guess I could safety pin it, but what a pain. It also wrinkles very easily.

review_summary: A little tight in the bus
review_text: A little tight in the bust for an average person, the buttons pop open constantly.  With a couple stitches you can remedy the issue.

This dress definitely has its ups and downs. The shape and fit are classic flattering curves just the right way. And for the style, the length is perfect hits me right at the knee. The fabric does feel starchy almost and I can tell the fact that it does seem to wrinkle easily will be a problem. But I love the color and I'm convinced I can make this an awesome addition to my dress collection. woot.

Love this dress! The colour is a true mustard which gets tonnes of compliments! This is a little larger around the bust than it states, so if you're smaller on top, I'd size down rather than up if you're debating it. Also needs a good iron frequently.

I couldn't wait for this dress to arrive, and as soon as it did, I tried it on.Loved it!!It does run true to size and the large fit me perfectly.It was right above the knees;the material is lightweight and a tad stretchy and quite comfortable;it is flirty and fun as the skirt swooshes slightly as you walk(quite girly).I paired it with dangling stainless silver earrings and a silver cuff bracelet,with blue strap heels to work and received many compliments (and I'd like to think,envious looks:)).It does hide the tummy a bit and is quite complimentary to one's body shape.The only reason I did not give it a 5 star rating is because of the bust.At 36C(and not wearing a pushup bra),the chest was a little tight.The buttons would pop open occasionally and so I had to keep an eye on them,which was quite bothersome after a while.So it needs more give in the material in the chest area,and the buttonholes need to be smaller.That was my only peeve.Otherwise,love it,will wear it often...

Sadly this dress just didn't fit right.  Across the chest was so tight that the buttons were popping open, but strangely the shoulder area was very oversized and baggy, therefore going with a larger size would not have worked out for me.

This dress is absolutely lovely! The fabric was more of ginger color than is shown in the photo, but I still like the color. There are some loose threads throughout the dress which is kind of annoying on a $45 dollar dress but nothing drastic. I also can't get the buttons to stay shut even after making the button holes smaller so be sure to wear something underneath. But, overall it is a great dress that I would recommend.

I had okay expectations for this dress, but luckily it exceeded my expectations! It was only a little wrinkled upon arrival and can easily be ironed. This dress seems to be made for any body type and complextion. It goes well with my brown hair and eyes and slightly olive skin tone and I imagine it would go well with others as well. Most of my wardrobe consists of authentic vintage clothing, and this dress looks like it's right from the 50s! :)

review_summary: How do I love thee? Let m
review_text: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways. This dress fit perfectly, just as I hoped it would! There is just a little extra room under the arms (a plus in my opinion, and nothing that shows), but if I had gone any smaller, I think I might have had some gaping in the buttons on the bust. Length was just rightnot too long, but I'd certainly feel comfortable putting on some tights and wearing it to work. Absolutely thrilled to own this dress!!!

Beautiful!!!! It is such a well made dress, it seemed like it was tailored for me. The bust area is a little snug even for my 34A size, but no danger of the buttons popping open. It is a very versatile dress that can be played around with for several different looks. I can't wait to experiment more. Easily one of my favorite dresses! :)

review_summary: Love this dress and it lo
review_text: Love this dress and it looks adorable on.  My only complaints would be that it is a little tight in the bust area and the buttons are tiny, so I needed to use a safety pin to keep from showing off at the office.  My other complaint is that the stitching is not high quality and is falling out a bit, nothing major, but I would like to see modcloth have higher standards with quality.

My first purchase from Modcloth! I read that this was wrinkly but bought it anyway cause it's so pretty! I don't think the wrinkles would have bothered me that much, after an iron it was fine and didn't rewrinkle too much. But this unfortunately didn't fit me well at all. I'm 5'10, C cup with a 23 inch waist and 35 inch hips. I often have problems with dresses being too small in the waist and this was no exception BUT I've never had problems with the top part being too small! I felt like my boobs were going to pop out any moment! It also sit really funny on my chest, like the boob part only covered the top half of my boobs. But oh well, I gave it to my 11 year old sister and it was just a little big. The only thing is I'm not sure if I shop here again if I should get small or medium? I'm usually a small everywhere else and not sure if this particular dress was just a bad fit for me :/

This dress is soooooo cute. The color got me lots and lots of compliments. It fits in perfectly with my collection of vintage inspired clothing. The size was right on and I was totally shocked that it worked with my height (I'm 5'10). I'm also a little larger bust size (38 C) and it buttoned right up! The only draw back is that the fabric wrinkles pretty easily. I took a bottle of wrinkle releaser along with me last time I wore it and it worked like a charm!

Freakish fluke: I found something very similar in a thrift store after getting this, and my budget pointed its finger at me and said Your thrift karma may never bestow this luck upon you again.  As lovely as it is, you must return lovely Soda Fountain Dress in Ginger, keep the thrift dress, and use your refund to get something else glorious from Modcloth.  I'm sorry, Modcloth.  Bad things happen when I don't listen to this voice.
Cute birthday dress for myself. Only downside is the ends of the sash are starting to unravel.

review_summary: Got this in an extra larg
review_text: Got this in an extra large so as to fit my chest, but I think the plus fit made it too large over all. I did like the look though the color was much more mustard than I thought, trying again in the large to see if that fits. :] (fingers crossed)

review_summary: I love this dress. I love
review_text: I love this dress. I love this dress so much I want every darn color. The color is incredible and it's so great for crossing into other seasons. It's thin though, so I think a slip and some tights might make it work for the winter, we'll see. I think the only complaints I have are that the buttons are sewed on badly. Had to resew every single one. It's a tiny bit long, but I'm 5'2, everything is long on me. Looks like it can easily be altered.I really am going to get a second color but which one! So hard. This is the best thing I have ever gotten from Modcloth. My friend has it in black and agrees. Buy this dress, not a disappointment. I promise.

review_summary: I am a plussized gal at 5
review_text: I am a plussized gal at 5'6 and about 210 pounds. Based on my measurements, I ordered Size 1x, and it fits PERFECTLY. Be sure to order based off of your largest measurement.As for quality, the material is slightly on the thing side (which I already knew from reading previous reviews), but I haven't found it to be seethrough at all. The thinness makes it a little prone to wrinkling, but nothing horrendous, and certainly not as easytowrinkle as a fabric such as linen. I suspect that the selfbelt will never tie as beautifully as it does in the photo, but I swapped it out with my own belt to make it a little more me.The color is a mustard/goldenrod, not a bright yellow. The length is perfect for me  just to my knees. For me, the location of the belt loops was perfect  right on my ribcage, just below where an empire waist would be, but above my natural waist. But this would vary from person to person.As a larger gal, I often have trouble with the fit of items in the bust and shoulders, and the tightness of sleeves around my arms. I had no trouble at all with this dress in any of these areas. The bust doesn't gape, the shoulders don't pull, and the sleeves are cute large enough to accommodate larger arms (at least in the 1x size).I am planning on buying more of this dress in other colors!

review_summary: This dress is so cute.  T
review_text: This dress is so cute.  The color is beautiful on, and the length is great even for work (as opposed to many of the Modcloth dresses that are a bit too short).  The only problem is that the buttons are kind of slippery and tend to come undone with very little provocation.
My most favorite ModCloth dress. I could go on for hours! Fits very true to size, perfect length (midthigh), perfect across the bust even though I'm a bit small (34A). LOVE it!!

Wow! This dress is beautiful. I purchased this dress and the one in purple thinking I'd pick my favorite color and return the other. I ended up keeping both dresses. I like to use the yellow dress with the purple dress.

review_summary: I loved this dress, but i
review_text: I loved this dress, but it pulled in the bust.  I'm rather small busted, so it surprised me!  Material was light weight and wrinkled easily.  Great color, but had to return it...
Just as good as everyone says! It does wrinkle pretty easily, and the sleeves sometimes feel a little snug, but overall a great dress with great style.

UGH this dress was horrible. This review will probably get lost in the millions already on here. So perhaps I am too spoiled though. I prefer to buy clothes that are made very well and if that means spending a tad extra, I don't mind. First off, the sizing was way off. I do NOT recommend going up a size unless you are particularly quite busty.  The material and quality of the dress was verrrry poor and it just looked cheap. I could understand somebody loving the design of the dress, but you'd be better off spending your money and the many other 50s/vintage clothing sites out there. You get what you pay for...? For reference I'm 5'4'', 125 lbs, and a 32B. I was swimming in the medium.

review_summary: I love the colour and the
review_text: I love the colour and the style but the fit and quality is where it let me down.The top was tight around the bust unless I had all the buttons undone and the waist was far too big and too high up for me, which is probably due to my boobs taking up too much material. Despite that, with a cardi to cover the illfitting top it does look lovely. The finishing though (hems etc) was a mediocre.

review_summary: This was my first mod clo
review_text: This was my first mod cloth purchase (along with a skirt and boots) I was worried about the color of this dress since this isn't a color i usually buy. I was even worried after I put it on. But the more i wear it the more I am in love with it. I am wearing it right now at work and have recieved tons of compliments on the dress and on the color. and the cap sleeves mean i can wear it to work without a cardigan :)

review_summary: It fits so nicely but the
review_text: It fits so nicely but the color is a bit darker than in the photo, a little muddier, and ended up washing me out (dk brown hair, pale skin) so I think I'll have to go with another color. Also it's a fabric that needs ironing.

review_summary: I love this dress and it
review_text: I love this dress and it looks absolutely fabulous on me.  The color is beautiful and the cut is simple but beautiful and classy.  The only problem is that it's a tad tight around the bust and the buttons will pop open (I usually wear a M in dresses but decided to size up b/c of the buttons, which are still an issue.)  Regardless, I adore this dress and it's definitely one of the staples of my wardrobe now.

I really loved this dress but sadly it is on it's way back.  I am 5'4 and 27 waist... I ordered the medium and it fit everywhere except the chest, 34 C was just a bit much and the buttons were tugging.  Everything else was perfect especially the color!!

review_summary: I was so excited to see t
review_text: I was so excited to see that this dress was back in stock after looking at it for so long. I had tried 2 other dresses which didn't work out. I wore it to church Sunday and got several compliments. It fits my body shape very well being that I am a bit curvy in the hip area (I've had 3 kids). The bust is very tight, but thanks to the spandex it's not too tight. I know I'll be losing a few more pounds after having my baby in Jan., so it wasn't enough of a problem to send it back. I am short waisted, so it was nice that the tie goes around the bottom of my rib cage and then flares out. The material is wrinkly, but I can live with that. The stitching is a little messy. I've pulled out loose threads and the buttonholes are a little frayed. The buttons do come undone, so I have to keep an eye on that and I'm afraid I will have to reinforce them at some point because they aren't sewn on very well. I wish there was an extra button. But, it's very cute and I hope it holds up for many years.

This dress is so perfect! I couldn't be more happy with it :D It fits perfectly in all the right places. The only 2 *negatives* are that the top 2 buttons like to pop open on their own lol, and the dress does wrinkle easily. But those don't bother me enough to return it. In fact, I may just buy this dress again in different color(s) when they become available. Woohoo!

review_summary: I am in a bluegrass band
review_text: I am in a bluegrass band called Hot Mustard.  So, anything mustard color gets looked at.  Couldn't be happier with this.  It does wrinkle easily as some reviewers say, and is very light and can blow around some.  I also sewed the button holes a hair smaller, they opened a bit.I cut out the tag, bur I'm pretty sure I got a M.

i love this dress! however, the top portion does not fit as shown. the sash is is much higher and it is very tight around the bust. i have sewn the bottom buttoms closed, since they will not stay buttoned. as a 34b, i don't think i'm that busty! also, the material is thinner than i expected  you really have to wear neutral undergarments! i would buy this dress again, but in the darker plum color and maybe a size bigger instead.
Love the color

this dress is PERFECT. it was my first modcloth purchase, and i am 100% content with it. the color is a little more mustardy than i expected, but i like it regardless. the length of the dress is right at my knee, so this dress is really appropriate for any occasion where you have to be a bit modest. the fabric has a bit of stretch to it so its really comfortable. honestly the only issue i have with this dress is that its a bit tight in the chest area.otherwise, this dress is fantastic. perfect for an afternoon at the park, a day of shopping with the girls, or a lunch date with your gentleman. i'm very impressed with this dress. oh! and the belt loops are wide enough that you can mix and match belts and sashes to go along with the dress.

review_summary: I went back and forth abo
review_text: I went back and forth about ordering this dress.  The color stood out for me right away.  How many people wear this color!?  In the end, that is what made me want the dress.  The color in person is exactly how it looks on the site.  I am fairskinned and blond and it works.  The slight amount of stretch makes the dress very comfortable.  I am 5'7, 155 lbs, and a small C cup.  It's more empirewaisted than pictured on the site.  I've received many compliments on this dress at work and out and about.  I wear this with nudecolored high heels or brown wedge sandals.  It does wrinkle very easily but a slight adjustment of the skirt when you sit will ensure that the skirt lays nicely when you stand up :).  Another great purchase from Modcloth.

This dress is SO ADORABLE. I wore it out the other night and had so many compliments given to me! I like to put a crinoline underneath as the color is slightly see through on my tanner skin tone. The dress does wrinkle super easily, but people seemed so enthralled by the swing of the skirt they didn't notice! It'll make you look like a lil old fashioned good girl, but you can tart it up a bit with some cleavage. I probably could have gone down a size, but my breasts wouldn't have fit in it at all. I use a stretchy elastic belt to nip in the waist and it gives me a whole different set of options for accessorizing. A+!

review_summary: What a lovely dress for s
review_text: What a lovely dress for summer! I was a bit hesitant at first to purchase this dress, mostly because of the colorI'm a truly remarkable shade of pale, so I was afraid it would wash me out. However, as other reviews have stated, the goldenrod shade is actually quite flattering, and will certainly catch eyes. The dress was a perfect length for me, just hitting the knees, and the circle skirt is delightfulexceptionally suited for twirling and related girlish acts of whimsy. The bodice area was a tad large on me even in a small and with the belt tied snugly, but I'm abnormally thin and have come to expect this from most dresses. It would be wellsuited to someone of normal size, I imagine. My only footnotes for this easy, breezy, sockhopready dress would be to iron it before wearing, as the cotton blend material wrinkles easily, and to consider a slip beneath the skirt if modesty is a concern.

After buying the same dress in purple I have wanted the ginger color for a long time and I finally went ahead and ordered it. When I pulled this dress out of the bag I was pleasantly surprised with the color. I didn't like the color with my pale skin but once I tried it on with tights and a cardigan I liked it much better. So I'll be saving it for late summer/early fall or a colder summer night. It does requires a slip or flesh colored undergarments (I tried it on originally with blue underwear and you could see it through the dress) and I know it will wrinkle easily being mostly cotton but it will be a nice work or casual weekend dress.

review_summary: the top is a little short
review_text: the top is a little short  I am not overly busty but it still doesn't fit tidily under the chest line like it does in the picture.  Waist is roomy.  Even though all the reviews pointed out that the fabric was thin, still a little thinner than I expected.  All that said  REALLY cute, and will definitely get a lot of wear!  Should transition beautifully year round with such an earthy saffron color.

Super cute and super flattering! The wait on this dress is a little higher than i would like it to be but the fit is still great. The color is bright and cheerful. The cap sleeves and bow are very feminine touches. The fabric is a little thin and it wrinkles easily, but a very very cute dress.

review_summary: I really love the shape a
review_text: I really love the shape and look of this dress.  The color is awesome and I get a lot of compliments on the dress itself.  My only dissapointments are all the tiny loose threads and the fact that the buttons are always popping open.  I am 34D so I imagine that is a common problem for somewhat busty girls.  I sewed the bottom 2 button holes a little tighter and that solved the problem.  Other than that, it is very flattering and totally cute vintage style so all in all I LOVE it!
The classic dress for looking great anywhere. This was a great buy and I would reccommend to anyone. The material is great and so is the fit.

It's perfect.  Don't let the ironing intimidate you.  The color is amazing.  I'm going to be wearing red shoes and accessories with mine.  I'm very shortwaisted, and it makes me look longer in the torso.  My husband thinks it's sexy and that makes it even better.

review_summary: This is a fun, quirky dre
review_text: This is a fun, quirky dress.  I did find it to be a tad long on me for what I was looking for  I think that I'm going to hem it a few inches so that it ends a few inches above my knee.  The color is a little brighter and more orange than the mustard shown in the photo. Overall, I think it's a fun dress and I like that it has actual belt loops where you can interchange it with other belts to achieve different looks.  The top fit perfectly though!

review_summary: I think this is a very lo
review_text: I think this is a very lovely dress. The yellow is true to my monitor's size, I'd say it's the colour of the blackeyedsusan flower instead of mustard yellow.Past reviewers who were concerned with the poor execution of button holes were correct. I tried it just now without bras just to see if it fits. It fits wonderfully, and it seems to accommodate my 36B bras as well. But just in two minutes, the buttons popped out. Obviously needs some sewing later. The fabric is also thin, which is okay for my tropical area, but should have contributed to a lower price as well (like $35 instead of $45). Good thing that it's made in USA so I support local businesses (although I'm in Australia). Ordered on 2nd June, arrived on 14th June due to local holidays.

review_summary: I really like the color o
review_text: I really like the color of this dress, but since I'm larger on top it was a little small there.  The rest of the dress was okay, but there was a stain on it... :(  I think it should come out in the wash though.  Overall cute, but maybe a little expensive for the quality.
Giving this 3 stars because I had to send it back. I did the size chart, I got the size it gave me, and the buttons popped open across my bust every time. Shame, I absolutely loved this dress.

review_summary: I love this dress and the
review_text: I love this dress and the fit was amazing but I will probably be sending it back.When it arrived, all the buttons seemed a bit loose but the last one, I would button up and it would just as quickly slip itself back into the slit and unbutton. The dress fit across my chest just fine and it seems to be that the slit itself was the issue.Unless I can fix this, I won't be able to keep it. Which is really sad as it truly is a beautiful dress that seems to scream it was made for me lol

This dress is amazing; so feminine and cute and I think it would flatter any figure because the fabric stretches a little. My only concern is that the fabric around the armpits and waist is a tad roomy on me but it's not a big problem. I'd get a small but A: it's sold out (of course!) and B: it might be TOO small. The length is perfect; hits just at the knee. The color is slightly darker than in the picture but I'm not complaining!

review_summary: I was very excited to rec
review_text: I was very excited to receive this dress since it's been on ModCloth's Most Loved Items list for a while!  The color was spoton, and the quality was decent for the price. I was pretty disappointed with the fit of the dress on me...I'm pretty small for a tall girl, but I have broad shoulders from my swim team days.  This dress really accentuated that and made me look a bit like a linebacker.  It sadly had to be sent back.

review_summary: I love this dress! The co
review_text: I love this dress! The color is absolutely gorgeous and looks great on me. My one and only problem that is easily solved is that this dress wrinkles extremely easily. Not a big deal though, the positives outweigh the negatives. I definitely recommend this dress to anyone who is on the fence about it!

review_summary: Just got my dress and onc
review_text: Just got my dress and once again I love it! This is my fourth purchase from Modcloth, and I'm so happy with it! The color is a very saturated goldenrod, and even though I'm pale it works with my complexion. This style is GREAT for those of us with curves! for reference I am at the lower end of the measurements for medium, and it fits perfectly in all the right places. I totally recommend this dress!

review_summary: I REALLY wanted to like t
review_text: I REALLY wanted to like this dress  I even spent extra on shipping because I ordered the M right when it came in stock and then the L a few minutes later (I was afraid it'd go out of stock again for a long time!). I'm usually a M in dresses, but the reviews seemed to indicate it ran small, so I wanted to get the L just in case. The M fit, but if I had been at ALL bustier than I am (I'm a 34 B), it would've been too tight. Unfortunately, it just wasn't as flattering as I'd hoped. I think the problem might have been that the waist was several inches higher than my natural waist and the dress was a couple inches shorter than I'd expected (came about three inches above my knee). So instead of getting a slim waistline and lengthened legs, the immediate effect was a short torso and awkwardly largelooking butt. I loved the color (a vibrant mustard), but I think it would be more flattering on someone who is shorter, or at least someone with a shorter torso.

I absolutely adore this dress. The material is lighter and thinner than it appears in the picture but the style was meant to be a summer dress so this is perfect. The waist wasn't as snug as I thought it would be but the sash fixes this easily. The color is beautiful and the way that it drapes is lovely. I am very satisfied with this dress and can't wait to order more dresses from Modcloth.

review_summary: I do love this dress, alt
review_text: I do love this dress, although because I was coveting it for awhile when it was out of stock, I built it up a bit more in my mind. The fabric is lighter than I was expecting, the color a bit deeper, and, as other reviewers pointed out, it needs an ironing. All in all, a great dress for the price.

review_summary: I love, love, love this d
review_text: I love, love, love this dress!  Yes, it is wrinkly like the other reviewers said, but I was still able to wear it out of the box without ironing.  I am small chested so did not have the issues others did with but buttons.  I also switched out the sash for a proper leather belt.  This dress definitely requires a slip.

review_summary: It is LITERALLY true to s
review_text: It is LITERALLY true to size. I looooooove this dress. It was my brownie makin' dress recently ;)

I bought this dress several weeks ago and I'm finally getting to wear it tomorrow! It is just as adorable in real life as it is in the picture! The size chart was accurate. I bought a medium and it fits very well, and I'm 125 lbs, 5'2 and a 36C. The only mild complaint I have about this dress is that the top is a litle bit see through and because I'm on stage quite a bit, that means I'll have to wear something under it to cover up under the lights! Also, I wish the bow in the front would lay flat like it does in the picture! It tends to protrude out a little more which gives it a slightly less attractive look, in my opinion.  Overall the dress is a great color, it's super cute and a great fit. You will not regret spending your money on this cute little thing!

I had been anxoiusly waiting for this dress to come back in stock and as soon as it did, I bought it and coudn't be happier. I love the color, I know some of the reviews say the color isn't the same as the picture...but mine was the same. This definitely met my expectations and as soon as the other colors(black and purple) come back in stock I will be buying them too!

BEAUTIFUL DRESS!! Only thing that sucks is the buttons and the belt loops are incredibly poor quality, they are seriously about to fall off and I haven't even worn it yet. Not enough to make me want to return it... I would like a BETTER one, but I'll just have to do some sewing soon when they come off (and they will.)

review_summary: I was so happy this dress
review_text: I was so happy this dress was back in stock!  The dress is a little large in the chest and waist.  I ordered an L instead of an M because, despite the Aline, I needed to make sure there was room for all the junk in my trunk!  I'll be taking this dress to a seamstress to have it taken in...  it's just too cute to return and risk an M not being available or too small in the waist.  The buttons were loose and threads are hanging, but I fix those.  I love this dress; so, I'll make it work!

review_summary: I saw this on the website
review_text: I saw this on the website and thought it would be the bright shade of yellow that looks good on me...it's actually a darker yellow and so it doesn't look great on my skin, so back it goes. Which is a pity, because it's a really cute style!

review_summary: I have been pining for th
review_text: I have been pining for this dress since I first discovered ModCloth, and it's the first thing I've ever bought.  So far I'm quite happy with it, and I only have a few small issues with it.It's the perfect length, just above my knees, so I can wear it to school.  The color is great, although a bit mustardier than I had pictured initially.  The fabric is stiff enough that it will stay looking sharp but light enough that I should be able to wear it comfortably through summer.  The skirt falls perfectly and looks adorable.There are two tiny things that bother me.  The first is that it pulls eversoslightly across my rather diminutive bust.  The other is the sleeves: I know that these are designed to be cap sleeves, but I feel like a slightly longer sleeve might have been more flattering.All in all, this is quite an adorable dress!

review_summary: I was lucky to snag this
review_text: I was lucky to snag this dress when one came back into stock. (a return? I dunno) The fit is just about perfect, except that the belt loops are too high! They hit halfway between my waist and my boobs...not the most flattering spot ever for a belt. Fortunately, they are only sewn onto the outside and not set into seams, so a couple minutes of careful work with my trusty seam ripper, and I can put the sash on my waist proper, Or a regular belt. I really do love the style and fit, the color was a risk for me as I usually wear neutrals but am trying to branch out. Oddly, it does work with my redbrown hair, bluegreen eyes, and fair skin. (my boyfriend is telling me to say it's hot LOL)

review_summary: The dress is lovely and I
review_text: The dress is lovely and I always get complimented when I wear it, however I had two concerns: 1 wear 02 in dresses, so the dress was a bit big, I wear it with a leather belt which makes it a bit classier and helps with the loose fit. My biggest concern is that the dress wrinkles terribly! I've tried extra starch when ironing, but it still wrinkles the moment you sit down. I wish the fabric were a bit thicker, higher quality to prevent this.

I'm 5'7 and  this felt a little too short for me.  It hit a little too far above my knee. It was also tight in the bust for a chesty lady like myself.  I wore it out once because I couldn't decide whether I liked it or not, but I wish I hadn't so I could return it.

review_summary: I love this dress, it loo
review_text: I love this dress, it looks so good on. I got a medium and it's a tiny bit tight in the chest, but fits really well everywhere else. The only problem I've had with it is that sometimes it's hard to zip up myself because the placement of the zipper under one arm is a little awkward

Cute dress, and the color looks great with my skin.  The dress is very comfortable, so much so that I also bought it in purple.  I find myself wearing this dress a lot.  The reason why I knocked off a star was the material is not that great.

This dress wasn't exactly what I expected. For one, my body type isn't exactly the same as the mannequin's. (: But really, the dress is a bit tight over the rib cage and shorter than I expected, which makes it feel kind of costumey. I think this dress would look much better on a bustier girl that can balance out the tightness around the ribcage and waist. It is a cute summer dress though, and it can be toned down with a belted cardigan. Overall, I quite like it. (:

review_summary: I was SOOOO so excited to
review_text: I was SOOOO so excited to hear that Mod Cloth carried plus sizes...though when I received this dress, I would hardly call it plus sized...*sad face*  When I tried it on, it hugged in all the wrong places, and overall it was just too small. I hope that Mod Cloth starts looking into a larger selection of plus sizes that run true to actual sizes!

review_summary: I ordered one of these dr
review_text: I ordered one of these dresses for me and one for my sister.  I purchased a size medium for myself and had a few fit issuesthe waist fits flatteringly, but the chest and shoulders are very narrow.  I had a tailor remove the sleeves because they couldn't fit within them!  A size large was a bit small for my 34DD sister, but she wears it unbuttoned with a camisole underneath and it looks great.
This dress is lovely. Buttons are a little flimsy though.

Lovely dress, perfect for so many occasions.  However, is tight on top (you can see in the picture)  I keep checking my buttons to make sure I haven't come undone. Also, the cap sleeves strangely limit your shoulder movement...My first dress ripped the first time I wore it, reaching to the back seat  Not at the seam, mind you  the fabric on the sleeve just shredded.  I was devestated and MC did a quick exchange (thank you!)  so I'm much more careful now.
Too big around the bust, shoulders, and torso in general. Would be cute if it was tighter. Returning this item. Also the color is pretty, but not flattering on blonds in my opinion.

review_summary: Holy crow, the bust is sm
review_text: Holy crow, the bust is small in this dress.  I would only suggest this dress for petite women.  I have a small chest, but I'm pretty broad shouldered.  I've let the dress out and it's still small in the bust and the shoulders.  I may just turn it into a skirt.  The waist and skirt fit fine.
Beautiful little dress. I wish it weren't so thin. Perfect for spring and summer.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. I'm no
review_text: I LOVE this dress. I'm not a skinny girl, but I'm not a larger girl. I'm about 5'5 165 lbs. It fits wonderful, but a bit tight in the bust. I wore it with my big padded bra, so I'm sure it would fit better with just my regular bra. But it unbuttoned twice during the night. Luckily it was with friends and not a work meeting.

review_summary: Yikes! I'm unsure as to h
review_text: Yikes! I'm unsure as to how this is one of ModCloth's best selling dresses, as the one I received was very poor quality. The material is clingy, very thin, wrinkly and there are many stray threads around the seaming. The one I got was virtually shapeless as well, despite the bow belt. And, for some odd reason, it nearly reached my ankles.I'll definitely have to return this one.
I'm generally really happy with this dress, but it does run a bit small. I usually buy smalls, and while the cut is flattering, the buttons always seem to be ready to pop.

review_summary: I love this dress, it fit
review_text: I love this dress, it fits well, even tho i'm a bit busty.  I get a lot of compliments.  It's also easy to take care of.

Adorable! I tried to read as many reviews as possible before ordering, but I still had to order two and send one back. I have a 38D chest size so I first ordered the XL, but it was baggy all over and really long...I reordered for an L and it fits almost perfect. It's a little tight around the bust, but it fits so much better all over. The color is a bit more mustard than the photo, which I really liked. The material has a nice cotton stretch to it.
Incredible fit, but, once again, my overlypink complexion ruins the day.  This color would definitely work better on someone with a darker skintone, or at least more olive/tan.

Like everyone else, I am in love with this dress! I've had it for about a year, and the color is just as vibrant as the first day I got it. The length is perfect and can work for various occasions. The chest area is a little tight for me, but I usually unbutton the top button and it's fine. However, I was hoping for a heavier fabric than this considering all the hype over this dress. It also wrinkles really easily. If you have time to dry clean and iron this dress, go for it.

review_summary: I was very excited to get
review_text: I was very excited to get this dressmy boyfriend ordered it for me as a Christmas gift.  But when it came and we opened it up together we were disappointed. The color was totally different from the picture. Pictured is a beautiful bright, marigoldcolored dress, in reality what I got was this dull, mustardcolored dress. I tried it on, hoping maybe I'd change my mind when I had it on me... Nope. It was a lovely fit on top, my big bust actually not stretching out the button area. The skirt was quite a bit long, but then again I'm only 5'1. I was hoping to find myself in a lovely springtime dress, but instead I was in more of what I'd consider a diner waitress or hotel maid dress. Had the color been more like what was pictured, this would have won me and my boyfriend over. But unfortunately we'll be returning. Modcloth please quit making your pictures so bright, it's deceiving.

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this dress.  The design is SO cute, and the color is funky (a little darker than my monitor showed it, however).  Yes, it came TERRIBLY wrinkled and I was shocked at how thin and strange the material felt.  The large was a bit big for me around the top (I'm 5'8 and 165 lbs)  because the material did not hold a candle to the design, I will be sending this back.  Let me note that if this had fit or I had gotten a M, I would have kept it  its just when I had to think about $50 for this particular dress, it went into the return pile.

review_summary: I love the style and colo
review_text: I love the style and color of this dress, but it fit me all kinds of wrong. The arm holes were big while the caps hugged my shoulders too tightly (I'm in no way broadshouldered. Also, the bust and waist seemed to hang loosely and not at all flattering on my body. I guess if someone has a bigger bust, it may fit better, but I cannot recommend this to smallbusted, petite girls. I sadly had to return mine.

review_summary: I love this dress.  The c
review_text: I love this dress.  The color is awesome too!  Fit pretty good and the length is nice.
Great fit, great length (to my knees at 5'4) but the yellow ginger is a bit blah. Ordered the Redy for Inspiration in S also and LOVE it!

The dress is absolutely bright and sunny and fits perfectly. There are only two things that are slightly problematic. The buttons are so small that they pop out of the buttonholes even with the slightest movement. I'm wondering if the only way to solve this issue is to go hunting for matching buttons and replace the ones on this dress. Another issue that isn't as big a deal is static  this is really a summer dress. Wearing tights under this was impossible, the dress kept clinging to me and looked terrible. I think I would have been happier if the buttons were only decorative and didn't actually open up.

This dress is cute, modest and a good colour. The fabric is plain cotton and was tight under the armpit, but fits exactly if you're courageous. Just slightly tight in the bust for me, so it pulled,but I could've used a cami underneath if I was more in love with the dress. It is cute, but not particularly special (although, surprisingly, my boyfriend really liked it and loved the colour on me).

Super adorable dress, very comfy, and I get compliments every time I wear it. Two small complaints: the arm holes are a tad on the small side. I usually don't notice, but if I have to reach my arms over my head, it is difficult and the fabric cuts into my upper arm painfully.Second small complaint is this dress is very wrinkly! By the time I get to work in the morning, I look like I didn't even iron my dress before I left. These are minor things, though, and don't detract from the overall enjoyment of the dress!

review_summary: I love them. It fits grea
review_text: I love them. It fits great
Love the color and style! I got a M and its a little big, but I prefer loose than too snug. Cant wait to wear it in summer!
fabric wrinkles very easily so you end up with wrinkles on the back of the skirt from sitting

I lusted after this dress. I had it on my wishlist and it sold out before I got a chance to buy it, so on restock, I pounced at the chance. When it arrived I was surprised at the material choice. The cotton wasn't as flowy as I imagined from photos. The fit, which previous buyers said was spot on, was loose and baggy around my middle. Wasn't lined so it stuck to my tights. Wrinkles if I look at it wrong. I wanted to love this dress so much and I'm not going to chuck t out of my wardrobe, but I am going to get it tailored and lined. Can't do anything about the material and creasing, but the color is too fantastic and the style, too hard to find. I'm keeping, but I'm fixing. :)

review_summary: This is my second Soda Fo
review_text: This is my second Soda Fountain dress. I got my first one in Grape, which was a bit too tight in size small. I kept it, though, and just decided to order a bigger size for future Soda Fountain dresses. I like the design and the cut. However, I'm not a huge fan of the cap sleeves. They don't restrict movement, but they're also kind of stiff and don't move around with my arm/shoulder. I got the Ginger in medium and it's definitely a more comfortable fit with a just a couple of extra inches in the chest and a few extra inches in the waist, which I like. I can still cinch my waist with a belt, so it works for me. The colour isn't as vibrant as it appears in the photo. It's darker, more muted, and more mustard than a vibrant sunshine yellow.

What a cute little number! Not to mention the colour is absolutely stunning  great with olive complexion and dark brown hair! I've been searching high and low for a golden/yellow dress for spring and summer, and this was *exactly* what I was looking for! I'm a size 16/18 (463747) and the 3X fit perfectly. Looks great on an hourglass figure! Being a rather busty gal (DD), reading some of the other reviews got me a little worried that the bust would be too snug, but I could haven't asked for a better fit! Also, the length is great  I'm 5'9 and it hits at the knee. The only thing I?m somewhat frustrated with is the material ? I know this will be a real pain to keep from wrinkling. Perhaps in the future a blend of cotton with polyester may be the answer. This was my very first purchase from ModCloth, and I'm very pleased. Here?s to hoping ModCloth will start carrying more plus sizes in other styles!

This dress is super cute I love the fit except... well, sometimes when I'm in a meeting with male coworkers, the buttons pop open and show my bosom. It's no big deal I mean, it's really embarrassing, but I just pretend it didn't happen and ignore their stares. I got a small I know a medium wouldn't hug me like I want, so despite it being awkward occasionally.... it's a great dress!
The dress is very pretty and compliments my figure very well, however, after washing it a couple of times one seam was coming apart so I had to mend it.

review_summary: I found the material to b
review_text: I found the material to be a little flimsier than I would like and I envision that this dress will need a lot of ironing. It is an absolutely beautiful colour, very true to the picture, will look great teamed with red or black accesories and red lips.

The dress is very cute.  I'm 5'4 and it's a alright length, but I want to shorten it by an inch so it'll be a little cuter.  The buttons on top keep coming apart though, and the top isn't that tight.  If I got the next size up, it would have been too loose.  All in all, a cute dress, I just need to check my buttons every now and then.

I bought this for my senior ball and it turned out great! I am a fairly short girl with a small bust so usually strapless dresses don't work for me but this one stayed up all night! The only downside is that (thanks to the cheap price) it is made from fairly cheap meshlike fabric. I had to get the top of the back tailored because the rough mesh fabric folded over the top and rubbed a red line into my back. After I got that fixed, it was perfect! Really beautiful and sparkly. I got lots of compliments
This is gorgeous dress!  The fit is perfect and it's not too short.  I can't wait for my next special occasion so I can wear it!

Beautiful dress. I wore it to my senior prom and felt gorgeous the whole time! However, after a while of dancing, the stretchy material on the sides by my armpits began chafing to the point of pain and I had to make an effort to twist as little as possible. Good for anything but dancing for hours nonstop!

I've been coming here for the last five years, and this is one of my favorite purchases from ModCloth! I wore this to a holiday party and I received compliments all night. The bodice is beautifully adorned and hugged me perfectly. I actually wore this dress with flats and it still looked super cute. Love the uniqueness of this piece!

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much! It looks just like the picture!! Excellent pick!

review_summary: a little big in the top s
review_text: a little big in the top so I had to exchange for the next size down but I loooooved it. lots of stretch to the fabric which I wasn't expecting!

It's a nice unique dress. The amount of sequin detail means the front doesn't contour very well to the body, but it's still ok. For a tall girl it is a little short  would be more flattering just about the knee, not mid thigh as the skirt is so full. Initially, I tied the skirt down with a ribbon and let it hang for a week or so so the skirt would drop as it was too puffy, but overall I was happy with it.

review_summary: I love this dress! I init
review_text: I love this dress! I initially bought a size 10 but I had been working out and I lost weight. I returned my dress and got a size 8. Fits perfectly. I spoke to a Modcloth advocate and she was so helpful and immediately helped me get my dress overnighted to me for free. Modcloth was so efficient and helpful. This dress is so fun and colorful. It's nice quality and stretchy. Perfect!

review_summary: The quality of the back o
review_text: The quality of the back of this dress is poor. Specifically, where it stretches in the back reminds me of a cheap discount store tube. Based on the real life quality of this dress, it should cost no more than $30.

review_summary: I love this dress!!! My b
review_text: I love this dress!!! My best friend helped me pick it out for her wedding. Great fit, great look. I felt like a million bucks.
This dress is the perfect buy

review_summary: I wore this to an evening
review_text: I wore this to an evening wedding, it was a big hit and I got a lot of compliments:)
This dress is fantastic, but I couldn't come up with a single answer to, when the heck would I wear it? If you're better at finding excuses for these things than I am, buy this dress like, yesterday.

review_summary: The bust fit my already l
review_text: The bust fit my already large charge pretty large. I definitely needed to wear a bra. The dress was beautiful but kept bunching under my bust. I had to send it back.
I. Love. This. Dress!! I was stunned by the beauty of the embroidery, seriously pictures do not do it justice! It'll be perfect at my friends Art Deco themed wedding!

review_summary: I ended up selling my dre
review_text: I ended up selling my dress to a friend because it didn't work with my chest at all. It hit too low on the cleavage and was a little bit wide in the waist, not flattering.
Love this dress!

So the dress is phenomenal, if you pay attention to the size chart and know your measurements I'm positive you'll have a good experience with it. It's beautiful and was a unique prom style that I didn't see anyone else in at all which really meant a lot to me after i saw many other girls in the same dresses. The only reason the quality is a 4 is because of the tulle skirt. It snagged a couple times, but it's not noticable at all and that could easily just be me being clumsy.
Great quality, but too short for the wedding I wanted to wear it to. Being 5'2, usually these types of dresses land on the knees, but in this case, far too short for a special occasion.
Very scratchy and because I am small chested, it didn't look right on top. Also didn't feel very secure without straps.

review_summary: I ordered this dress in a
review_text: I ordered this dress in a four and I was a little weary about it all, because typically with strapless dresses they fit great until I get to the chest and it won't even zip. However, this dress fit me wonderfully and my chest wasn't bursting at the seams! If I were to find any complaint with this dress, the cups were ever so slightly small for me, but considering I was terrified it wouldn't even fit, I am highly impressed and would recommend this dress to anyone.
Fabric's a little itchy, but the perfect dress out.
