I love this dress!!!!! I was a little worried about the length because I'm so tall but it is the perfect length!!!!!! I have to put the straps on because my girls are so big and realistically I don't need a slip at the event I'm attending. I love the material and the style.

review_summary: Okay, first of all, I LOV
review_text: Okay, first of all, I LOVE this dress. I bought it in a size 8 first because the size 10 dresses were sold out. I had to send it back and get a size 6 because it ran a lot larger than I expected. I even measured myself and I should have been a size 10, a cording to the measurements listed for this dress. I wore it for a black tie wedding event last weekend and it looked wonderful! I received so many compliments on it. :) Unfortunately,  I cannot bring myself to give this dress more than a 2 star rating. Here's  why:1.) This material for this dress doesn't appear to be high quality. The elastic back is very very itchy. 2.) The sewing of the peacock on the bodice is very oddly placed. In some areas, it was stitched securely but it was very loose on the torso area. Sizing down helped this problem a little bit bit it was still very loose. It looked as if whoever had worked on it didn't get around to finish sewing.3.) I wore this dress only once for a few hours and the plastic lining at the ends of the tulle skirt are frayed. Alot of the plastic in the skirt came exposed and started to poke me in the leg! Like I said, I love this dress but for the money and all the hype it just doesn't seem worth the money paid. It was a pretty big dissapointment after stalking this dress and its reviews all year.

Not quite 5 stars ? but almost I had been looking for a dress to wow at a wedding and had looked at this dress several times and read all the reviews before I took the leap and ordered it. And so happy I did. The pictures do not do it justice. This dress it is amazing, cute perfect length for my 5? 1.5? height, the stitching and the peacock design of the sequins just set the dress apart from all the rest. I got so many comments on how amazing the dress looked how wonderful I looked in it and I felt amazing in it. Perfect for any special occasion. Only a couple of small point stops me from giving this 5 stars. For a strapless dress there is no elastic or gel to keep the dress up, unless you fill the dress completely you will need to use Hollywood / Miracle tape and as the dress has a stretchy back you will need a little help. I am a size 14 AU (7880kg) and a Size 14 D Cup / 36 D and without the tape I would have been pulling up the dress up all night as the cup is very big, I would suggest sizing down as the dress has a lot of give in the cup and back. Otherwise there is straps that come with dress but looks so much nicer as a Strapless dress... Well worth the money and postage for such an amazing looking dress, and, my husband could not stop complementing me that makes you feel like a million dollars.

I would definitely recommend this dress to others seeking a gorgeous wellfitting formal dress.
cute little dress that i'm super happy with! Feels very secure, even when most strapless dresses feel like they're going to fall down. Feels very unique and awesome!

review_summary: I love this dress! From t
review_text: I love this dress! From the moment I saw it on the website, to when it finally came in the mail. I feel like princess whenever I wear it. It is definitely my #1 favorite dress in my wardrobe.

review_summary: A little large in the wai
review_text: A little large in the waist but I wore it and it was cute

Bought this dress for my homecoming and I absolutely love it! Came three days before expected delivery which was awesome. So glad I didn't size up to a six because this fits great! Stays up so you don't need the straps. So beautiful!

review_summary: I got this dress for my h
review_text: I got this dress for my homecoming (I'm currently a junior) and I couldn't be happier! The straps that came with the dress were a little flimsy, so I used some black detachable bra straps I had instead. Also, in the back where the stretchy part meets the solid part of the dress was super itchy, but not so bad that I couldn't ignore it. Overall, it fit true to size and looked amazing!

This dress was so perfect! I wore it to my homecoming and everyone loved it! It was just the right amount of poufy ness and it fit extremely well! The back was elastic so it stayed up and fit to my body which was so nice! I highly recommend this dress!

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this but I was very disappointed when I took it out of the package. First, it was packaged up so tight that the dress was terribly wrinkled. The fit was nice but the dress is stiff/crunchy. The peacock is beautiful but the embroidery did not lay nicely. It just looked cheap. :( Size 4 fit perfectly.

review_summary: I had been an oogler for
review_text: I had been an oogler for this site for months now and all the time, I would just gawk at this dress. Homecoming is coming up soon and I knew I had to have it. My mom loved it, my step dad loved it, my dad loved it, even my aunt! We all fell in love with this dress! So today when it came in the mail, I immediately ripped into the package and tried it on. Fit like a glove! I never want to take it off!! But I have to because I still want it to be in great condition. I can't wait to wear it!!

review_summary: I ordered this for a form
review_text: I ordered this for a formal university ball I have coming up. I was really worried it wouldn't arrive on time so I ordered nearly a month in advance. Despite the website saying international deliveries to Australia take 14 working days, this item arrived on my doorstep on the morning of the 12th working day. So I'm definitely pleased about that! :)I'm normally a size 4 but because it's strapless (and I have a tiny waist and slim hips anyway), I chose to size down and order a 2. It fits perfectly, I don't have to tug up the bust, and the stretchy back is very forgiving. Plus it accentuates my small waist and draws attention to the DIVINE embroidery.If I could change anything (and this might be a little pedantic), it would be that the skirt material feels a little stiff where I expected it to be soft. You can't tell by looking at it though and it still twirls beautifully so this isn't a dealbreaker or anything.

This dress was expensive, but I'm really happy I bought it! I was a bit worried about the sizing because pretty little dresses like this are usually meant for women who are a lot smaller than me but have a lot bigger chests, but the twelve fits me like a charm. That being said, if I don't wear a strapless bra with it, the front likes to sag down, and the material is a little bit scratchy, but I feel lovely in the dress! The skirt practically floats and the peacock is cute and bold. I'd definitely spend the money again!

Beautiful dress! I unfortunately had to return it because the bust was too big on me, but I am extremely small chested, so that really isn't the dress's fault. :) The quality was pretty good, and I loved how it came with removable straps, perfect for a dance! I also liked the fact that it was stretchy in the back instead of a zipper.

The dress looked really small when I took it out of the package but when I tried it on, it fit like a glove! I have a pretty big chest and the bodice fit me perfectly in a size twelve. I'm also short (5'2) and I prefer my skirts to hit just above the knee and this dress meets that criteria. There's a black slip that's kind of staticy but the three layers of pouffy tulle sitting on top makes it hardly noticeable. The design is definitely gorgeous but also extremely delicate (the sequins are sewn onto a piece of mesh that is seen onto the dress with one thread, so be careful with the care and handling of this dress.) Overall, though, I love this dress. I feel so pretty in it and I can't wait to wear it to my homecoming in October.
This dress makes me feel amazing as well as look amazing. I'm never taking it off!

I purchased this dress for a wedding and I'm happy with the purchase. I had to take the back in just a little because the elasticity of the back made it difficult to stay up, but after that is was cool. Also, when it arrived, some of the wiring on the tulle was detached so I had to fix that as well. But still I love the dress and so did everyone else!

Fabulous! I got this for my prom dress, and I am so glad I did! Rather than pay $500 for a dress I'll wear once or twice, I paid $70 for this, which I can dress down for other occasions! I actually wore it with straps for prom, because I think it's actually cuter with the straps! This was a good investment for sure!

review_summary: This dress is a show stop
review_text: This dress is a show stopper! I looked at this dress for SO long and just kept it in my wishlist until one day my boyfriend bought it for me :) The elastic in the back allows for a comfortable and flattering fit. The tulle skirt is full and flouncy without being itchy. The sweetheart neckline doesn't slip or sag. The length is PERFECT  I'm 5'8 and it hits about an inch above my knees (much longer than many other Modcloth dresses). However, there are a few reasons I'm giving it four stars instead of five: the design is VERY sloppily sewn on my dress. When I took it out of its bag, sequences and netting went everywhere.  of the edges of the design are sewn down. Additionally, the back scrunches and bunches up in sort of an odd way. I'd actually suggest ordering DOWN a size for this dress. In normal stores, Im a size 810.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my school's formal, and it was perfect! I am a petite and relatively shortish person, though, so the dress fit a big longer and a bit bigger (in the chest area) than I would've liked it but it was no problem. The length ended up not bothering me (it hit just above the knee), because the poofiness of the tulled skirt evened things out. So if you do not like poof, you probably won't like this dress. It's not that it's overly poofy or anything, but there's like 3 layers of tulle. I'm not that big in the chest area either, so I'd recommend wearing a bra more padded than you usually would, if your measurements are similar to mine in width. The peacock design was gorgeous! Sparkly and not ripped or torn. EVERYONE complimented my dress! The sparkles catch the light and quite literally make you shine. It is very, very unique and I do not regret buying it at all! BEAUTIFUL DRESS, I LOVE IT!

review_summary: Oh my what a beautiful dr
review_text: Oh my what a beautiful dress! I wore this to an art gala and got so many compliments on it! It's a little on the shorter side, but not too bad. The colors in the peacock are more vibrant than in the photo, the gold is really GOLD! I found a pair of gold pumps that I wore with it and felt like a princess the whole night!
This dress is beautiful! I received so many compliments, it's exotic and so unique. It was a little large around the bust, but overall it was absolutely stunning. Wonderful first purchase!
This dress was as beautiful as I was hoping for. And since I'm very tall I was nervous it wouldn't be long enough, but it hits perfectly at midthigh.

I was running really short on time, and was about to give up on even going to my junior prom, when i remembered this dress. It saved my life. i love it so much! It fits beautifully and i got tons of compliments on it. The time it took to ship was perfect. it didnt need dry cleaned or anything when i opened the pack. I am 100% satisfied with this dress!

I bought this for my 14yr old daughter for her school ball.  We're going to add some material around the neckline as she's quite busty and it's not really appropriate.  It's gorgeous though and we're both really pleased with it.  Supercute!

Was unsure when I purchased this one.. didn't know if it would be flattering on me or not. I was so pleased when I tried it on! Fits perfectly!! And I love the tutu look of it also! Actually brought in the waist when I thought it may make me look a little bigger. Can't wait to wear it to an event!

This dress was better than I could ever have hoped for. I have purchased this dress for my graduation and it's detailing is brilliant for the price and not to mention it fits me like a glove. The only down side to it is that the material towards the bottom of the dress is a little scratchy but it doesn't bother me at all. My friends adored it when I showed it to them and   it's versatile for multiple events.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my senior prom but I was worried that I'd have trouble taking it in as I'm incredibly thin. Turns out there was no need! The dress's elastic back made it fit perfectly snuggly and the boning in the front made it hug my body in a very sexy way. The bust is padded in such a way that it could easily be worn with no bra, but I like to have a little bit of a pushup so I'm going to wear a strapless black bra with it.There are a few loose threads but my mum is very good at fixing those things, I would just warn buyers to be careful to pull them through delicately so as not to ruin the dress!The decoration on the front looks odd when you first take it out of the package but it looks amazing once it's on.My only complaint is unrelated to the dress itself; I received a hefty tax on it as it crossed the border to Canada  something I hadn't got on previous ModCloth purchases. Apparently it happens at random! Anyways, seriously a great deal and I snagged the last size 2!

review_summary: When I fist saw this dres
review_text: When I fist saw this dress on the site, I found it to be a bit odd, but most captivating, so in the end I bought it. I live in the Netherlands, but even with shipping costs it was a reasonable price. I got a bit of trouble during the shipping, but ModCloth helped out quickly after a small mail, and eventually my dress did arrive. Thanks to ModCloth for their honest and hard work.As for the dress; There were a few lose strings at the ends of the skirt, but they were easy to remove, so I do recommend to check for small mistakes/threads hanging lose, but all in all the dress fit very well! The only problem I had was that it kind of flattened out my bosom, but that's because it's a standard size! If i'd bought a bigger size the waist had not been ok, so that'd have been worse. The cloth was a bit itchy at the part where the skirt is sewed up with the top part (but that was easily to be overlooked, it wasn't too bad, maybe just a problem for people with a very sensetive skin), and the top would stick out a bit when I put on the straps(But my mum fixed this by adding a few stitches). Also it was a bit hard to take off because the cloth is rather stiff, but it was managable.I got a lot of compliments on the dress and I really did notice this dress is an eye catcher! If you want to impress someone or steal the show, then do wear this dress for an elegant but powerful statement, making you look sweet and pretty, yet also not too girly.

review_summary: I needed a prom dress for
review_text: I needed a prom dress for my boyfriends prom so i didn't want anything to big, when my sister saw this dress she showed it to me and since i had never heard of this website before i was very hesitant to order it.. Once i finally made up my mind i ordered it but i was scared it wasn't gonna fit right because of my large bust.. After thinking about it i decided to buy it because of the incredibly low price.. Once i got the dress in the mail i opened the box and tried it on ASAP!! Now that i have the dress on me i can honestly say that i fell in love with this dress!! The fit is perfect and it is so beautiful the photos don't make it justice i can't wait for prom day to show it to everyone !!
This dress is gorgeous! I just had to have it when I saw it.  the details are even more amazing in person.

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought it on a lastminute prom whim, and I am so happy to say that it is my favorite formal school dance dress EVER. It fit like a glove, the peacock detailing was beautiful, but I'd have to advise wearing the straps if you're planning to be dancing. I brought them justincase and ended up putting them on pretty early because it would slip down. Other than that, I LOVED IT. Buy it!

It was great! The material was a bit scratchy and obviously not very fancy, but I wasn't expecting anything extremely high quality. It was very comfortable and everything fit perfectly. The only thing that was slightly bothersome was that the gorgeous embroidery got easily caught on my beaded clutch, other girls' dresses, etc. etc. But this dress was perfect for me and I'm glad I bought it.
This dress is super cute, it fits great and the quality seems good. Can't wait to wear it out.

This dress is so beautiful! I ordered it for my grade nine semi, and I'm so happy with it! This is my first order from ModCloth, so I was a little worried about the size, but it's perfect! It's snug (but not tight) around my torso, and falls to just above my knees. This dress is so worth it; I'd recommend it to anyone!
This dress is really beautiful. I was worried it would be too short but its the perfect length. The only issue I had was that the top was a little large.

LOVE this dress  chose to keep this one (out of the 5 I ordered) for my formal event. It's fun, with the pouffy skirt and sequins on the front, but still classy. Could definitely wear it again to a new year's party or black tie event. Fits really easily even without a zipper, comfortable on the inside (I was worried about itchiness), and most importantly, provides plenty of coverage and stays up withut a problem.
My 13 year old wore this to a school formal.. It fit perfectly. She looked beautiful. SEVERAL compliments. The only issue is that she may outgrow it before she can wear it again!

review_summary: I'm not sure why anyone w
review_text: I'm not sure why anyone would hate this dress. It's absolutely beautiful! I waited and waited to get paid so I could buy this for my engagement party this last Saturday. I even bugged a few live chat staffers to see how many of the size I wanted was in stock to make sure it wouldn't sell out. As soon as I got paid ModCloth was the first site I visited. I bought my dress (as well as a dress for Valentine's Day) without any hesitation. When it arrived, of course I had to try it on! It fit perfectly! The bust can work with many different cup sizes. I'm small up top and big on the bottom, so naturally the dress widened my hips a bit, but I wasn't worried. Since I'm really short, the dress was a bit longer than I wanted, but it really didn't matter to me once I had it on. I'm sure it's the perfect length on girls taller than me. I wanted to wait until after the party so I could give a proper review. I never once tugged on the dress the entire night, and I was literally running around the venue, posing for pictures, and hugging friends throughout the evening. I could have wore a strapless bra with it in order to enhance my small bust, but it wasn't a requirement at all. Best dress I have ever bought from ModCloth, and I've bought quite a few! I can't wait for another reason to wear it! As for the quality of the dress... it's perfect! The detail in the peacock is stunning! For how many people that were asking about it and where I got it, I should be a ModCloth spokeswoman! :)

review_summary: This fit like a glove, an
review_text: This fit like a glove, and probably could for most given the back smocking.

First time purchaser, long time site stalker...When I first saw this dress, I knew it was the one to wear to my friend's wedding in 2014...when I was able to purchase it, I was a bit hesitant because I'm normally a solid size 10 in most brands and the size 8 was what was available...I figured if the dress was tight, I'd have a year to really get into shape and make it work...Got it today and tried it on and, surprisingly, it was a perfect fit...now hopefully I don't lose too much weight and then have to get it tailored next year...I predict future purchases...thank you, Modcloth!

review_summary: Wore this dress for New Y
review_text: Wore this dress for New Years Eve and it was PERFECT! I got so many compliments on it! It felt flattering to wear, it was comfortable and no one had anything close to it! The details on it are well done and BEAUTIFUL up close! Love this dress!

I ordered this dress for my Sophomore prom, as soon as I opened the package and saw the design I loved it. As soon as I slipped it on I really loved it, because it just fits right into place. I'm definitely keeping this dress.

review_summary: I was so hesitant to pay
review_text: I was so hesitant to pay full price for this dress. I won't say that I'm totally disappointed, but the quality was lacking in my opinion. There were several threads that were missewn and hanging about, but were easy to cut away without harming the bird detail. The skirt has plastic running through the hem to keep that nice shape, but on mine, where the pieces were sewn together, there were about two inches of extra plastic hanging off the hem on each layer of the skirt (there are 3 i think). Overall the construction was a bit lazy in the finishing and the material is a little cheap feeling. BUT it fit very well and the design is rather unique. There is NO zipper, which freaked me out at first because it looked so tiny out of the box, but the elastic on the back stretches to fit just fine. The dress also comes with adjustable spaghetti straps that you can attach if you want some extra security. I wore it for NYE and it was a hit. I knew all the little things that were wrong, but nobody else did so i guess it's all good. Overall, I love the look and the dress, but I wish the price point were better considering the quality.

review_summary: This was my New Year's Ev
review_text: This was my New Year's Eve dress and it was perfect!  I loved how it fit and how it looked on me. The boning and padded bust was nice, but I wore a strapless bra with adhesive sides (the girls need more lift than they used to). The smocking at the back was comfy and secure.  I could tell it was going to slip a little, so I just got some fashion tape and secured the top, and it never budged.  A party dress for $80 isn't too shabby!  Yay!
Fits marvelously, especially with the smocked back, and not too short. The sequined peacock is gorgeous, and the stitching is pretty solid.

review_summary: It's a nozip like said, b
review_text: It's a nozip like said, but surprisingly well made and well fit.  I didn't have to tug at it all night like with other strapless dresses.

review_summary: I love, love, love this d
review_text: I love, love, love this dress!  Just tried it on.  First off, I would like to say that the photos do not do the embroidery justice, it's gorgeous!!  I was a little concerned because other girls had mentioned high school dances so I was afraid it would look, well, high schooly, but it doesn't.  I'm wearing it to a semiformal Yule Ball for my Greek organization at my university and I'm gonna rock it!  Also the fit was perfect.  It hit me to the knee (for reference I'm 5'4 but have large hips that usually make my dresses shorter on me than on others) and the elastic back made the chest fit beautifully.  For the cup size, I'm a B but I wear a bra that makes me a C and that was perfect as well.  Other people mentioned that the tulle makes them feel hippy, but as I mentioned before I have very large hips and I looked like I had normal proportions (in relation to other people, not myself.)  Also the tulle makes me feel like a ballerina :)In sum, this dress is beautifully made, highquality, and fits perfectly.  I would highly recommend giving this dress a go!

review_summary: I love this dress!  I bou
review_text: I love this dress!  I bought it on a whim, but I'm so glad I did.  I often have trouble with fitting my chest into dresses, especially at Modcloth, but this fit perfectly, not too tight or too loose.  I was afraid it was going to be too short, but it hit me at the knee, just about.  The peacock design is beautiful in person, and the dress itself is very interesting overall; it's a little edgy, with the tulle and the boning, but it's still pretty and formal.  It actually looks a little Asian inspired.  I don't know where I'm going to wear this yet, but I'm very excited!

review_summary: I bought this dress for h
review_text: I bought this dress for high school dance. At first I was a little skeptical about how formal it was but it fit perfectly and I got so many compliments from people I didn't even know. However if you're going to be dancing in it I recommend wearing the straps I had to keep pulling it up. The netting holding together the sequins isn't uniformly attached so it is a little delicate otherwise very comfortable and beautiful! I don't regret this purchase at all even though it cost so much and don't foresee myself wearing it any time soon. Yeah, it's that pretty.

I just got it in the mail today with the other 2 items i purchased. Well, first of all it's really not too bad. It's a bit expensive for the material. It's comfortable and light and travelfriendly type of clothes as it doesn't wrinkle easily. I should have gotten the one (Navy Mustard) with the mustard striped bottom. Then probably i would love it more. The floral skirt does not come with a lining but it's fine. I am 5'2 so the dress comes down right at my knee. Honestly i prefer the other item i got, the Jersey Knit Kimono sleeve Romper (navy), because it seems trendier. The neck is a bit low cut but can be pinned up so no big deal. I want to exchange this for the mustard ones but it's out so i guess i will just keep it.

review_summary: I love love love this dre
review_text: I love love love this dress. Bit on the longer side and if you have a larger bust it really flatters your shape. It's warm without being uncomfortable or hot. This dress is perfect you can ware it to work or cuddle up on the couch with it. I tend to order a 4X but the fabric is forgiving and flatters your shape so if the size is a little off you'll likely still be happy with it. I am very very happy with the fit of this dress.

review_summary: This is a great dress ! I
review_text: This is a great dress ! I am pretty busty, but as long as I readjust the v neck every now and again, all is well. I find this to be very slimming in the belly region too. I would buy this in many different patterns!

review_summary: I am on the fence about w
review_text: I am on the fence about whether to keep this dress. The waist sits higher than I thought it would and the vneck tends to slide open a bit (nothing scandalous but still). But the thing that bothers me the most is that the stripes don't match up on the centerback seam, and it's pretty obvious. I guess I didn't notice that when I was scoping it out online. That said, the horizontal stripes are more flattering than I thought they'd be, and the fabric is super comfortable. It's a great latesummer, early fall transition piece, or an all fall long piece if you live somewhere as warm as I do.

review_summary: surprised by how much I l
review_text: surprised by how much I liked this dress but little disappointed that the print doesn't align at the back. flattering fit due to the way the material sits
Love this dress. It's so comfy but stylish.

Very flattering on a curvy girl and nice soft material. I have another color of this dress and the fabric is different, but this seems like it will be perfect for fall! It shows some cleavage but not too much, and I think the colors look better in real life, I thought the red might be too bright but it looks darker. Overall excited to wear!

review_summary: This is such a fun dress.
review_text: This is such a fun dress. I feel like a flirty librarian. The fabric is great and it fits well...good stretch to accommodate my ample bosom.

I wasn't sure about this dress when I saw it online, but I took a chance and bought it anyway, and I'm glad I did. I thought the stripes looked a little bit dull in the picture, but I'm pleased to say that I like them 100 times better in person. The fit is perfect, very true to size. I also own this dress in Navy Blossoms. While this fits the same as that dress, the materials are a little bit different. While the skirt on the Navy Blossoms dress is a thin, breathable polyester, this whole dress is made out of a warm, soft knit material. It's too hot for me to wear right now since it's still summer, but I'm really looking forward to wearing it in the fall and winter. Overall, its a great dress!
Stop, ModClotj, just stop... If you keep making this fabulously perfect dress in more colors, I will keep buying it!!

Without comparing this dress to anything else it's perfect. It grazes the top of my knee, it makes my chest look bigger which I always like since I'm slightly pear shaped. It makes your cleavage look perfect without looking like your trying too hard. Looks great with a tan leather belt! My only qualm is that I bought this because the botanical dress in back stripes is my favorite modcloth purchase ever and I wanted to get it in a another color, and the fabric is quite a bit different. I love how the black stripes dress has a thicker fabric on bottom so you don't have to worry about panty lines or cellulite, whereas this one the bottom fabric is thin and slightly more clingy...but nothing a pair or biker shorts or tights can't fix :)

review_summary: This is such a lovely dre
review_text: This is such a lovely dress. The fabric is not too heavy nor too light. it runs very true to size and the length is perfect. The top part is actually blue, not black like the photo shows. Nevertheless, this is a mega comfy, mega cute dress! I highly recommend it!

review_summary: This dress is so soft! It
review_text: This dress is so soft! It feels different than the other  botanical breakfast dresses in a good way! It feels almost like a sweater dress. I am usually between a 1xl and 2xl and I went with the 1x and it fits great! One of my favorite botanical breakfast dresses (and I own 5 of them)!

I really like this dress and it is very close to perfect, but the size was a bit off for me I think. The waist is perfect and the bust almost duts, but I think it's a bit on the small size and the fabric bunches awkwardly. I'm not sure about the quality. There was a pretty big nub of fluff woven into the knit so I would be returning it even if the size was perfect. I think I will try sizing up to a medium and hop the waist will still fit.

The sleeves are cute, but they're not for large armed women. Luckily, my arms are average, so I can wear this adorable dress with little discomfort in the sleeve area. The chest area would fit better if I had a C cup, but I just need to safety pin it and I'm good to go. Super cute overall and....POCKETS. Who doesn't love pockets? Nobody...that's who.

review_summary: A little big in the top,
review_text: A little big in the top, but easily fixed with a couple of stitches. I love this dress. I get so mNy compliments about ModCloth clothing, and it ships quickly.

review_text: I didn't like this at all. It felt cheap and the proportions were all wrong for me. The skirt added bulk and the arm holes were huge. Couldn't find the link to return it so have it away.

I must say though that whoever cut the pattern for the 2x must have that that we women have enormous arms. The arm holes are huge!  This means that there is excessive side boob. A black slip is an easy fix, but really for the price, the fit should be a little better.

This dress is beautiful and the reviews about sizing up is definitely a must.  Even with sizing up it's tight in the waist but I can still take a full breath therefore it will stay as the rest of the dress fits perfectly. Normally I wear a L in dresses at Modcloth and went with the XL.  Anything bigger would have not fit well and anything small would have not even made it on my body. Size up  but beware it's a little tight but not too uncomfortable.

This dress is beautiful onscreen, but very blah in real life. The fabric is woefully thin. It is quite large in the bodice and ended up looking like a hospital scrubs top on me. Though it has a pretty print and color combination, it arrived today and it is also going back for a return today.

review_summary: This is not a dress for s
review_text: This is not a dress for short girls. The waistline band is very wide and doesn't hit correctly. Sending back.

review_summary: Okay I love this dress in
review_text: Okay I love this dress in theory, but it is SO TIGHT around the waistband, and the pleats flare out, making my hips and rear look huge in comparison. If the waistband sat at my natural waist it would probably be fine, but it's up around my ribcage. I do like the way the top half looks though. With a cardigan it looks fine, so I'll probably only be wearing it in the winter.

I got this dress because Tracy0052 looked so ADORABLE in that photo. I'm so glad I did.Comfortable, breathable fabric, a flattering cut, vintage but still modern, I love everything about this dress.The only downside is that there is some of the sideboob gap that you get with dresses with huge armholes. I wear a black bra and honestly don't really think about it. It's not really noticable unless you lift your arms.Recommend, recommend, recommend.

review_summary: Oh my goodness where to b
review_text: Oh my goodness where to begin? This dress is so adorable and is light weight so it's still comfortable on a warm summer day. It goes perfectly with some red cork wedges!

review_summary: This dress is so cute! Th
review_text: This dress is so cute! The black waist was snug, but it fit great for me. The top was a little low, so I wear a black cami underneath. Good length. Overall, I love it. It's hard to find modest dresses these days. Very cute!
Such a comfortable dress and the purplegray color is just lovely. The size small fits me perfectly.
I was wearing this dress when I was proposed to.

Beautiful dress, perfect for my engagement pics. I found the fit to be just right, I'm 5'3, 120 lbs. the quality is just ok. It came with loose threads and could use a petticoat. Otherwise, it's a good buy!
Great dress for office or casual day out.  Light cotton fabric, no stretch.  Snug fit in the waist but not high enough to restrict the diaphragm (phew).  Perfectly hugs my bust not baggy at all.

I'm excited to wear this dress, and I love that it's machine washable. It arrived a bit wrinkled, though, so I'm guessing it will require a fair bit of ironing. It's very cute, though  a bit big in the chest, but otherwise it fits great.  I wish the sash/belt fabric around the middle were removable so that I could wear a belt instead (I think that might look a little more sophisticated), but no such luck.

review_summary: I love this brand, I also
review_text: I love this brand, I also got the Scotty Dog dress that this brand makes a while back. When I bought that dress, it was a little tight at firstnow after wearing it and washing it a few times it is so perfect. Soft, comfy, I STILL get compliments on it. I'm hoping this dress, since it feels like he same material, will work out the same way. I haven't ironed it all out yet, but right now the top gaps and the waistband doesn't lay like it should. It's a tight squeeze too, I was a little bit surprised. Usually a Large on me is comfortable, bordering loose, but not in this dress. I think it's worth the $90 based on my experience with this brand. :) If you want it to be instantly comfortable and not a little tight, I would size up.

review_summary: Way too small for me! I c
review_text: Way too small for me! I couldn't get it zipped up. Unfortunately I'll have to return it.  Too bad everything else about it was perfect.

review_summary: The dress is cute but not
review_text: The dress is cute but not flattering for my square shape. It is very loose in my chest but too tight in my shoulder. I can't even raise my arms. I think it is the best for tall and hourglass figure persons. Sad to return it.

review_summary: Bought this for a late su
review_text: Bought this for a late summer wedding. The style was perfect  formal enough for the occasion but lightweight enough for the season. The silhouette is perfect for hour glass figures and hugged me in all the right places. Couldn't be happier with this dress!

review_summary: This is a pretty dress bu
review_text: This is a pretty dress but the fit and quality were deal breakers for me. The chest and waist fit fine (a little gaping at the chest but easily fixable, no big deal). However, the armholes were way too small to be comfortable. As you can see in the photo it was difficult to raise my arms in this dress. I couldn't bend over (like to pick something up) without the fabric cutting into my arms. I've almost never had this problem before. I think the fabric itself looks too cheap and starchy for the price, even for 15% off in my case. Also the dress just wasn't flattering with my long torso. I returned it  overall I do not recommend this dress.
has a deep crossover but I wear a cami with lace under it. I am pretty old so don't want to flaunt it too much. so pretty.

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favorite dresses! It is very flattering on my figure; I have broad shoulders and the neck line minimizes how broad they are.

review_summary: Such a cute dress. Love i
review_text: Such a cute dress. Love it. It's very low cut, so it's not a work dress, not for me anyway. I'm between a medium and a Large. I have big boobs and this would not zip all the way up. So it's sadly a return.
Very cute and fit nicely, but too short for my taste when it comes to slightly more formal dresses. Would certainly have kept it if it had hit me solidly below the knee.

review_summary: This dress is so figure f
review_text: This dress is so figure flattering where it cinches at the waste, but be careful there is no stretch to the waste at all.. Luckily it fit me like a glove! The only fit issue was it was a little tight in the arms but nothing a few pushups can't fix. The length and quality were great and I'm using this dress for a 50's style photo shoot that it will be perfect for!

review_summary: This is a great dress but
review_text: This is a great dress but I was surprised with how snug it was in my rib cage area. It doesn't have a lot of stretch so the M would probably have been better but then I would guess it would have been too big. I will just try not the breath deep when I wear it.
It's a really cute dress.

review_summary: I love that this dress is
review_text: I love that this dress is crisscrossed on the top, but doesn't fly open when I move to show my big guns. There is no give in the shoulders and I have pretty big arms, so it's a tiny bit tight. Time for some pushups and salads! Despite that, it really fits nicely and is flattering to my curves. Glad I ordered in an XL! Usually I fit into a L, but the no stretch reviews got me to order a size up. Glad I did :)

review_summary: This dress is so lovely t
review_text: This dress is so lovely that I'm keeping it, even though it is very tight around the black waistband. The wrap style top is very flattering, and the length (just at/slightly below the knee) is perfect for me.

review_summary: Love it, cute and great f
review_text: Love it, cute and great for work. Not as good of a quality as some other Modcloth dresses, but nice none the less.

This dress is constructed just like the Garden Tour dress, but I found that it ran a teeny bit smaller through the waist. It doesn't seem to have the same problem with gapping in the chest that I found with the Garden Tour dress in this same size, which is nice. It still fits great and is very comfortable, but just noticeably more fitted in the waist. I love the colorit's much more purple in person than it appeared on my screen! Very comfortable, flattering, and versatile :)

review_summary: I love this dress!  The c
review_text: I love this dress!  The cut has a vintage feel to it, and it is really flattering without looking costumelike.  The fabric is wonderful since it is all cotton.  The waist is a little tight, but it wasn't a big enough issue for me to return it and go up a size.  The length is perfect for work, and the purple is not an overwhelming purple for this style of dress.
Perfect! I am 53 and was worried about the polka dots being too young but the color and shape made it work. Can't see in photograph, but length was perfect, just below the knee where I like it.

review_summary: I love this dress. It is
review_text: I love this dress. It is beyond cute. The only problem I have with it, is everything above and including the black band is very snug. Im normally a size 10. But I have a very large rip cage. Other than that, its a keeper.  I cant wait to wear it:)
Fit perfectly  love this dress!!
Love this dress. The length hit me right below the knee, fit was great, super comfortable.

Bought this dress and prayed it would fit. I LOVED it and it fit perfectly, no adjustments needed. I wore it the very next day to work with a black cardi and some vintage shoes and received soooo many compliments. Can't wait to wear it again and purchase more like it!

review_summary: I love this dress and wil
review_text: I love this dress and will probably keep it, but the sizing is a bit weird. The waste band is a little tight while the top is a little lose and baggy (even with my big chest.) I think some stitches will fix it because I love everything else about this dress The skirt is flowy and the sleeves are really interesting. It's not quite sleeveless, but covers just enough in the armpit region. I also like that the skirt is below the knees. It can be hard to find that length sometimes.

review_summary: I love this dress, it is
review_text: I love this dress, it is so cute and can be easily dressed up or down.  My only criticism is that i wish it had pockets, that would have taken it over the top. I did shrink a couple of inches when i followed the washing instructions on the dress (warm), i should have checked the site and followed my instict and washed cold.  On raising this issue with modcloth they were excellent and provided wonderful customer service.

review_summary: I received this as a gift
review_text: I received this as a gift, but it was not a hit for me. The waist band was too tight, and the bust was also small for me, causing the arm holes to pull. I was going to exchange, but I don't think the quality of the dress matches the price. If it were lined or less expensive I would consider getting the XL.

review_summary: It's a lovely dress but I
review_text: It's a lovely dress but I am going to have to get some adjustments done.  Too loose in the chest.  Also the waist is a tad high on me, and a little too big, and combined with the very full skirt it does make me look heavier than other dresses.  But, very comfy (I can imagine eating a huge meal in this dress!) and the neckline allows me to breastfeed (rare to be able to do so in a dress) so I will keep it!

Like almost everything I buy from ModCloth, I LOVE this dress! It has a very 1950s fit, hitting at the natural waistline and falling a few inches below the knees. I wore this on a Date Night with my boyfriend and paired it with black tights, black suede pumps, and a double string of pearls. I left my hair down and flowy to keep it from being TOO Mad Menesque. All in all I think this dress is perfect.

review_summary: Love the fit and flare. V
review_text: Love the fit and flare. Very flattering top, and not too short!
Cute fabric, but waist sits funny on me and there's too much fabric up top for someone with narrow shoulders. I think it'd look great on someone bigger than I am.

review_summary: Sized up to the XL per in
review_text: Sized up to the XL per instructions. This does run small, people. The top gapped in a strange way that made it a bit... inappropriate on me. The fabric was also a little lighter than I had expected. It was nice, but not nice enough for $90 for me. Alas, it went back.
The dress was lovely, and I wish it had worked on me, but unfortunately, I'm finding I'm a bit shortwaisted.  If this came in a petite length, I would have loved it for sure.

review_summary: This dress fit me well bu
review_text: This dress fit me well but it just didn't flatter.  The sleeves made my shoulders look broad and the seam between the skirt and the bottom of the waist band poofed a little too much and made it look like it was pinching in when it wasn't.

review_summary: I was so happy when this
review_text: I was so happy when this dress came back in my size and now that it's arrived, I'm even more excited.  When I tried it on it fit perfectly.  Like some others have said, there's no room for stretch in the waist and the chest was a smidgen too big, but it's nothing that a pretty pin can't fix or even a cardigan can't cover up.  the dress fell just below my knees so it could be workplace appropriate... too bad I can't wear dresses and skirts to work.  The dress could also be paired with colorful tights to brighten it up.  Now I just can't decide if I should take it with me to Istanbul, Paris, or both!

This item wasn't available for the longest time but once I got my email notification, I jumped on it.  The waist and skirt looked amazing but sadly, the top was quite large.  Not busty enough for this dress.  The material was kind of cheap for the amount of money spent. Back it goes!

review_summary: I love this dress! The to
review_text: I love this dress! The top fits perfectly! What I love is that it does pooch or make a gap when you bend over, where it seems like alot of v neck dresses or shirts seem to flash everyone if you move. The length is great. I usually wear a size medium and I had to buy a small since they was the only size and it fits great! I love it! The only complaint which is about alot of Modcloth items is, that you get a cotton dress for 90 dollars, when the quality isn't 90 dollars. It is still an amazing dress though.

This dress is super cute.  I love the retro shape  it makes me feel very feminine.  I'm usually a L, sometimes a M, but I took a chance on the M because the L was out of stock.  It's a bit snug on the waist, and without the proper undergarment, there's a bit of unsightly bulging under the waistband.  But what's a retro frock without some retro undies to give you the right shape?  The top is a bit large, but I'm on the small chested side (36B).  The shape of the top is quite flattering, but since I don't fill it out fully, I have to be careful not to flash people when I move.  A couple of stitches or a pin should fix that.  I wore this to dinner and a comedy club and got compliments from my husband and the hostess.  It's unlined cotton, which is nice because it's machinewashable, but also makes me wonder why it's so expensive.  Regardless, I'm glad I took a chance on this dress!

This was my first purchase from Modcloth, and I absolutely love it. Everyone compliments me when I wear it. My only problem with it is that the sleeves make it difficult to reach up in the air...so if I'm teaching my classroom, and I want to pull down the projector screen, that's difficult. But otherwise, fantastic dress. :)

review_summary: I want to love this dress
review_text: I want to love this dress so much but I have to return it! I am pear shaped and usually wear XS tops from retail stores and M/size 6 pants. I ordered a small and it fit perfectly EVERYWHERE (though as you can see  just a little bit loose in the chest area)  except my waist/ribcage. It was too tight where the black band was and I couldn't breathe. :( If I get the medium when it's back in stock, I would have to get the top part taken in since there would be way too much space. Overall, a very cute and well made dress  just wish I had the right body shape for it.

review_summary: This is an OK dress. It's
review_text: This is an OK dress. It's cute and quality is decent. For me, measurementswise, I decided on the XL and probably would have done better with the L. (I am usually a 12 in a dress these days, now and then a 10, for your reference). It fit nice on top, but was quite big on the bottom. The skirt is quite full and isn't at all flattering for me, with the hips I have. I've sent this one back.
Absolutely gorgeous, fits perfectly, the length is fabulous, and the skirt is very full.  The polka dots are black, with the grey / lavender backdrop.  Stunning.

Wow. That's what my husband said when I put this dress on and he's a picky guy (meaning that my creative style is usually not appreciated by him; He's not one who likes to stand out as I do.) He then asked me to twirl so he could see all of it. The fit is perfect on my body: hugging at my waist while showing off my great curves top and bottom. And I love the fabric I'm a huge cotton fan. The length is also great just below my knees. Not only is it gorgeous, but it's also comfy. I was pleased by the number of compliments I got with it at work paired with a black cardigan and black flats, which easily transitioned to evening dinner when I ditched the cardigan and switched to sandals.

review_summary: This dress fit like a glo
review_text: This dress fit like a glove!  Especially my big bust, no topping out.  Very classy number and the empire waist hugged my rib cage!  I was expecting to have to go to my tailor like I have to with almost every dress I buy (apperently big busts and small ribcages are not common), but no need.  LOVE IT!!!  (picture was taken by my 9 year old so not the best but at least u can see it on someone)

review_summary: I am in love with this dr
review_text: I am in love with this dress! I think it gives a great figure, and I received lots of compliments about it already. I am 5'6, 170 lbs but not very big chested, the L fits very well on me, and could accomodate more cleavage (but it looks fine on me). It defines the waist nicely and has a great retro look.

I'm torn about this dress. It is lovely, but feels cheap. Like the details state, it is unlined. Usually I find most dresses from ModCloth to be too short on me, but this falls a few inches below my knees and seems a bit long and would need to be hemmed a bit. It also need to be tacked on the top to keep it closed like other buyers have stated and the waist is a tad tight and provides no stretch. I'd feel it is more worth the price if it was lined and had pockets.

I finally found a Modcloth dress that fits!  Yeah!  In typical store sizes, I normally wear a medium or small (68), but many of the reviews indicated that the waist had no stretch, so I ordered a large  the waist fit me perfectly.  I am on the short side, and the dress falls about 3 inches below my knees, so I will probably be getting it shortened.  The top fits well  I will need to give it a little tack stitch to keep the top from gaping open, but the girls had adequate room without any excess fabric in weird places (I have a short waist and narrow shoulders, so this has been a problem on previous Modcloth dresses) and was very flattering.   The dress is super comfortable and though cotton, it looks fancy enough to wear out dancing or to a date night dinner.  I plan to glam it up with some pinup style heels and colorful accessories.  WINNER!
great dress

review_summary: I LOVE this dress!  I pur
review_text: I LOVE this dress!  I purchased it to wear to my friend's 1950s/Pushing Daisies themed Bridal Shower and couldn't wait to wear it.  It was absolutely perfect.

This dress is stunning. It flatters an hourglass shape, making the most of every curve.  The neckline is more modest than it appears for those of us with larger chests.  A few people have mentioned that the dress had no give at all in the waist, but I have a 34/35 in natural waist and I found that I could easily grab fabric on the waistline and find room  could probably be a solid 35/36 in natural waist and be perfectly comfortable. Caveat: I haven't washed it yet so I don't know if that room will remain.  Even though i'm short, I didn't feel overwhelmed with the length, the skirt was full but not overly so. All in all this is one of my favorite dresses, and I'd buy it again in multiple prints.

review_summary: I really want to like thi
review_text: I really want to like this dress and I might be able to have it taken in so that I can wear it, but right now it doesn't fit me well.  The length is great (at the knee), the quality is good and the cut and pattern is sweet, but there is serious extra material at the hips and in the bust.  Especially the bust.  I've tried to sew some discrete stitches in the bust to keep it closed, but it doesn't help the extra material hanging out in front.  As my boyfriend pointed out, this dress is made for bigger girls.

review_summary: This is a really cute dre
review_text: This is a really cute dress. The fit was perfect. The color is more on the gray side than the lilac side. I agree with other posts that the fabric is not the best quality, given the price of the dress.

This dress fits very nicely and the cut is lovely, I just think it's overpriced. It's a simple cotton dress and it's not lined, so I'm not sure why it's so expensive. The material is fine and I like the way it falls, but I had to pin the front to keep from exposing myself, and even so it shows too much for the office. I'll have to wear something under it if I wear it to work. I'll keep it and it looks nice, I just expected more for the price.

review_summary: I loved the polka dots, h
review_text: I loved the polka dots, however this had to go back.  The waist was a little high on me, and consequently all the volume in the skirt did nothing for me.  It's a cute idea, I just felt for the price it was not very well executed, it felt a little homemade.

Very cute dress. Falls just below the knees so it's modest enough for work. I don't usually order large, but the waist band, which actually hugs the ribcage, fits just right and lets me take a full breath. There is is bit of extra room up top, but a nice broach should keep me from flashing anyone. Also because the bottom of the black band is at the natural waistline, the gathering of the skirt does a great job of hiding any tummy pooch.

If there was a 6th star, I would have given it. When I saw this dress pop up for sale, I knew I had to have it. The size I ordered was the correct size. It is a little loose in the bust (my bust measurment is 40) but that can be easily fixed at the tailor's. The waist is snug but not too much, just be aware that there is literally NO give at all in the waist so don't push the edge of the size requirements thinking that you will squeeze in. The color is pretty much as shown in the picture on the website. The fabric comes off on the casual side (because it is cotton) but I think the dress can be dressed up with some accessories. I think this dress is going to get worntodeath.

review_summary: I think this is my favori
review_text: I think this is my favorite Modcloth purchase so far. Very cute and comfortable. Good coverage in to top for curvy ladies.

This was my first purchase from modcloth.  Love the clothes here and shipment arrived quickly!  I gave it five stars because this dress is really beautiful, and well made.  However, I guess my girls are a bit too big because it wouldn't zip up.  I say this because I am usually a mediumlarge depending on the clothing/brand and if I do go up to a large it's usually because of my bust, but here... that didn't work. I guess I'm an extra large in the modcloth world? darn boobies....... maybe hitting the gym a bit more often will make 'em go down? ;)love the silhouette, love the fabric and color!

Very stretchy all over, especially from the waist down! And long. So if you?re tall, this is perfect for you! It?s kind of snug in the bust area, but super loose below that area. If you have a large bosom and prefer more coverage, I recommend ordering from your size up and getting the dress tailored. I also recommend giving yourself extra time between ordering and the date you will be wearing it, because like I said, this dress is for super tall people, and if you either don?t want it to hit far below your knees or you?re below 5?9, you might want to get it hemmed. I am pretty tall and a 3X went down to my calves. Halfway between knee and ankles to be exact. If you like a loose fit and don?t want the dress to stretch on contour your figure, order your size. It you do want it to cling to your curves, order a size down. I ordered a size above my usual (2X) just to be safe, because of reviews saying it fits snug but it is suuuuper loose on me, and I?m pretty darn curvy. Velvet fabric is soft and the exact color that it appears as online. Made very well.

review_summary: This dress fit like a glo
review_text: This dress fit like a glove! I will admit it does run small in the bust and belly area so if you're like me with a spare tire I would recommend going a size up. Overall, this dress is gorgeous!

I bought this a while back for an occasion that I ended up not going to and only recently had the opportunity to use it. Such a stunner! Hugs your curves perfectly, and with some shapewear, it is smooth and sultry. I didn't feel exposed but still super sexy.

The fabric is soooooo soft and stretchy  I LOVE the velvet. It's also thick so hid all my lumps and bumps. With sucker knickers on over my legs, I looked so stunning, even though I'm a pear! I look for excuses to wear this  I love it!

Was a little apprehensive about this dress, but finally took the plunge because the color and fabric were too enticing.  I love being able to wear a bra with this dress, and the length is perfect for that old Hollywood sort of look.  The chest fits fine as long as I'm wearing a pushup bra (would be too loose to go braless), but a dress like this begs for a pushup, anyway.  I'm in decent shape, but still wear shapewear underneath for the best/sexiest results.
Got tonnes of compliments when I wore this!
Great dress! Sizing up was a good idea

review_summary: Probably best fits on a t
review_text: Probably best fits on a taller body. It's a little long and needed to put a snap on the chest to keep my bra from showing. Gorgeous color and very flattering though!

review_summary: I so wanted to love this
review_text: I so wanted to love this dress. But somehow it manages to look horribly frumpy. It mostly fits, but the belly pooches out and makes it look like I've got a pot belly. It is too long, and the hem wrinkles weirdly. This one's going back.
Speechless. Like, literally speechless. Just... Perfect.

review_summary: I love this dress!! I lov
review_text: I love this dress!! I love the color, the longer length and the stretchyness of it.

review_summary: I loved this dress but it
review_text: I loved this dress but it just didn't fit my body shape well. It's so beautiful and the color is perfect.
So soft and classy sensual, and very flattering!
Loved, but had to return because I purchased another similar dress.

review_summary: I am so happy this dress
review_text: I am so happy this dress came back in stock before my Christmas party. The fit is perfect besides just some body type issues. I have a small chest so the top was loose and I had to use garment tape. I wore a body shaper (to limit the jiggle of my back end) and the seams kept shifting to the middle of the front and back of the dress I had to continually adjust it. However, that did NOT in anyway take away from the beauty and comfort of it. I'm keeping it and can't wait for an excuse to wear it again!

This dress was perfect for a wedding. It's snug but stretchy in a curve hugging way. The favric is good quality and the red velvet is very close to the pictures. A great buy in my opinion and a dress I know I will get years of wear from.

(pictured: Medium. Exchanged for a Small.) I LOVE this dress, I wore it for my cousin's wedding, which was held on a yacht. We were told to be formal, but not black tie, and this fit the bill well enough! I originally ordered a medium, which fit just fine, but didn't hug my waist as much as I wanted it to. It was also pretty long, as you can see in the pictures. I had terrible lighting, but know that the dress really was a dark maroon color, really beautiful. It'll make your butt look AMAZING, btw. I got compliments on it all night! The dress, not my butt. Well, that too.

review_summary: I love this dress! I woul
review_text: I love this dress! I would have preferred to order a large, but I needed it for an upcoming event and all they had left that would fit was an XL. However, this wasn't an issue, due to the fabrics clingy nature. It still looked and felt amazing, and it was extremely flattering.
Love it!

review_summary: I'm 5'3 so I had to hem t
review_text: I'm 5'3 so I had to hem the dress 3 up to get it right under my knee. the fit is a big around the hips (cause I dont have any)overall the quality is good and was great for the event I attended

review_summary: I loved this dress! I wor
review_text: I loved this dress! I wore it on new years eve and felt timeless and beautiful. As has been said before though, the dress isn't super structured and it's very clingy, so if you're looking for a smooth silhouette, shapewear is definitely recommended. Also be aware that it is cut fairly low  I couldn't wear any of my normal bras with it, but it ended up working out alright. And for reference, I'm normally a size 14, 36G.

review_summary: Nope! I felt and looked l
review_text: Nope! I felt and looked like a sausage. Returned
Beautiful dress!

review_summary: I bought this for my daug
review_text: I bought this for my daughters wedding and received tons of complements. Love it!

This dress is so lovely. I can't wait to actually wear it out! The only thing I didn't like about it was that the zipper was a little thick and makes the back of the dress look a little thick/bunchy. If it was more of the invisible type of zipper then this dress would be even more perfect, but it's not a huge deal. I didn't feel the need to size up, there is a good amount of stretch to this dress as compared to other velvet dresses I've worn. It's pretty forgiving for a bodycon dress, however I'll definitely be wearing a shaping slip underneath just to smooth things out and insure there's no visible panty lines. review_summary: This is a nice dress.  As
review_text: This is a nice dress.  As a tall girl, I love the length.  However, I with the waist was either a little higher (like a baby doll) or a little lower to fit my natural waist.  This wouldn't be a problem for the shorter ladies.

Good light weight traveling dress. It was a great flattering length on me and cute but still kept cleavage/shoulders covered for when I'm at a more conservative event. It's hard to find modcloth dresses that are long enough. The tie waist is great for making it fit a larger chest, although I am not even sure I needed it. i have only worn it a few times, but will have to see how the jersey holds up  it seems like the type of material to pill easily

review_summary: Love it. Got tons of comp

I got this for Christmas and LOVE it!  I can wear it to work, at a concert, or on a date!  It has a good amount of stretch to it as I go up and down several pounds.  It's a fabulous dress!

I was a little disappointed as I read a lot of the reviews for girls with some curves like myself and that it was very flattering and I have to say it wasn't to flattering on me.  The waist up with great but the waist down... not so great.  Nothing that a little shape wear can't fix but I was a little sad it wasn't as perfect as I had hoped.  Still love the dress and it's a keeper! Plus get the hoodie in berry  it works great with the dress!
Love this dress.  Fits perfectly and feels great.

review_summary: Cute and comfy.  I love t
review_text: Cute and comfy.  I love the weight and softness of the material. I purchased both the black/grey and the navy/blue dresses. I went on the advice of the other reviewers and went up a size. I normally wear a small and went with medium for this dress. I am 5'5 and 110 lbs for reference. The bodice is perfect for me, so you wellendowed girls should be aware!  It may be a tight fit for you.  *it does stretch!One thing to note is my blue dress is one full inch shorter than my black one.  They are both marked medium and fit the same other than the length. All in all, I like these dresses. It is nice to see a longer (knee length) dress from ModCloth.

Very happy with this dress.  Flattering, comfy, cute, what more could you want?  The material is so soft, it makes it a joy to wear.  Not to mention, the lines and bow make it very flattering.  And the length is perfect, which is somewhat rare in a ModCloth dress.  Love love love this dress!
Thin and unforgiving. Go up a size and wear a slip
This is the perfect dress! It is very flattering on and so comfortable.

Love this very simple, but adorable dress. Soft, stretchy fabric, fits very nicely. I usually order S, but got this dress in M, and happy with my decision... It is not skin tight on me, but sits very well. Hits me at lower part of the knee.
If you're self conscious about your tummy, size up and/or plan in wearing heavyduty shaping garments. Adorable though.
Love this dress! It fits perfectly  I didn't want it to be too form fitting, so I ordered a M instead of a S and am very happy with it. It's comfortable, versatile, and cute!

review_summary: This is a great casual dr
review_text: This is a great casual dress for coffee shop time and casual boutique browsing.  Fits well, flattering on the shorter yet curvy figure and seems to be well made.

Awesome dress, bought on the recommendation of other reviews and they are right. I chose medium as it didn't have any gathers (I fit between a small and medium) and I'm glad I chose medium instead of small, the fabric skims over any bulges :) I get compliments when wearing this dress. The fabric is like a tshirt, it does get pilly with time though.I'm happy with the dress though.
Excellent! Comfortable and flattering, I'm looking forward to wearing it.
Fits well, soft material, may want to wear a slip underneath as it clings a little. Is a bit long on me because I'm so short, but it can also be easily hemmed.

Love this dress. The material is so soft and lightweight, yet substantial enough that it is not see through at all. The top fits perfectly and I love that the neckline is high enough that I never have to worry about bending over and showing boobs or my bra straps being visible. I also love the length  knee length! This dress is perfect for being the mom of a toddler  I can wear it and bend over and pick him up without worrying about anything showing.Cute alone with flats or with a cardigan. I'm going to buy the other color.
I love how comfortable this dress is, and how I can wear it both to work and out with friends!

review_summary: I get a lot of compliment
review_text: I get a lot of compliments whenever I wear this dress!
This dress is lovely  flattering, comfortable and very wearable for work or play, but not so long as to be dowdy.
Didn't look right on me. Don't think the style is for me
Good for work

review_summary: I've wanted to mix up my
review_text: I've wanted to mix up my style for a while now, and I was immediately drawn to this dress because of the stripes. Like other reviewers, I will admit it's a bit long for my taste (even as a dress for work), but it's also forgiving and made of quality material so I'll pay a good seamstress to shorten it up a bit for me. Overrall, it's feminine, classy, and versatile.

review_summary: It was a little high on t
review_text: It was a little high on the waist but it was still flattering

FUN. SOFT. STYLISH! Love the swoosh of the longer skirt, great for twirling ;) and so incredibly soft and comfortable. A must have! Just found out they have it in blue too..might just have to get that one too!

review_summary: I love this dress!  It fi
review_text: I love this dress!  It fits me perfectly and I can't wait to wear it out on the town.  It's easy to dress up or go casual with a jean jacket and sandals.

Great dress, very flattering.  I'm 5'11 and this hits knee length. Its plenty long for tall girls. The tie hits high up on the waist, I tied it at the front, I don't like bows in the back. Soft cotton with some stretch.

This dress is very casual and comfortable, and is great for summer. The material is soft, and the style is fitted but not too tight. The length is a little longer than your typical dress, which is great for my height. Love it!

review_summary: I wore this dress for the
review_text: I wore this dress for the first time today and it is soooo comfortable! It's lightweight and cool enough for a hot day. The waist is a tad higher than I think I would like it to be, and the length a little too long. I'm 5'6 and like my dresses to hit right above the knee but this one covers my knees.

review_summary: This is the first dress I
review_text: This is the first dress I've been brave enough to order from ModCloth, being a larger framed person. I am DELIGHTED to find that this dress fits perfectly! Very flattering, better than expected fabric, and perfect length. Great price on a fabulous dress!
I am incredibly happy with this purchase. It fits well, and the quality is very good. I get many compliments on it. The length is perfect for work.

This dress is magnificent. It is so comfortable and work appropriate. I picked it up from the post office and ran across the street to the grocery store to put it on straight away... and the compliments began! So I guess I'm not the only one who loves it! I was a little nervous that it would show my tummy too much, but I find the pattern and fabric very flattering.

Very flattering, great for work. Black band hits more as an empire waist due to my large chest, but hides stomach pretty well. Length is just below my knee (note that I'm short!) but that works out better than some of the shorter dresses when in work situations. I was surprised at how seethrough the fabric is though, stick to neutral undies or you'll be showing them off.

review_summary: this is a great dress! i'
review_text: this is a great dress! i'm only 5'5 and curvy and this dress is very comfortable. i wore it to work and received a bunch of compliments!! i went ahead and ordered the grey/black one.

review_summary: I tend to go for dresses
review_text: I tend to go for dresses with a little more flair, but something about this one struck me, even though it isn't too fancy. It's incredibly comfortable. I just got it a couple of weeks ago and wore it to work the next day. I'm just waiting to cycle through a few other dresses so I can wear it again and be extra comfy at my desk for another day!

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought it to take abroad with me but have already worn it twice while at home. It washed greatI love that it's machine wash. It is longer, hits me just below the knees, but that is what I wanted to I'm very happy with the longerthanmostmodclothdresses length. Can't wait to wear this around Istanbul!
Nice fit, comfortable, casual, easy. I'm not keeping because my pear shape Is a bit accentuated, making my top half look small and the bottom half look larger.
Super cute, especially for the value. Good quality cotton, seams lay well. The cross patterning and the waist band are really figure flattering. I got the medium, fits like a medium 5'7, 130.

review_summary: I love the cut and patter

It's a lovely weight and the fabric is really soft. So yeah, I do not recommend this dress to anyone under 5'5 unless you want take in to get shortened. Lower midcalf is just too long.

review_summary: NIce dress  It is very co
review_text: NIce dress  It is very comfortable and is a lovely length.  I bought a small and it fits perfect.

High quality, nice proportions, and soft fabric. I will undoubtedly wear this dress one to pieces. This cut probably looks better on those with a high waisttohip ratio than those with boyish figures; and I can understand how those with smaller busts would find the top boxy but for me this is perfect. Also, it's a little long on me, but it looks appropriate for the office.

review_summary: The length is a bit long
review_text: The length is a bit long and awkward but works for me. I get so mad because most dresses are too short on me. I am not a fan of my pail legs so I usually wear leggings underneath but this is long enought that I really don't need leggings and it covers enough. The material is so soft and comfortable.

review_summary: Wanted to like it, but it
review_text: Wanted to like it, but it just wasn't $50 worth of good. I think being busty, and having wide shoulders and short legs is a setup for failure with this dress. It pulled oddly across the torso, the sleeves stuck straight out, and the length felt a little long.  It looks cute on everyone but me, though!  The light jersey seemed like it would make it a really cute, comfy kickaround/casual work dress. Oh well, back it goes!

review_summary: I love this dress! I am t
review_text: I love this dress! I am tall and have a hard time finding dresses that are long enough to wear to work and this is a perfect length. It hits me right above the knee. The only drawback is the tag in the back. It is extremely scratchy.

review_summary: Super comfy and easy to w
review_text: Super comfy and easy to wear. It's definitely, well, monochromatic, but I like to wear it with a bright cardigan and shoes. Simple and durable, you can wear it as a dress or also with leggings and boots and be quite active. The material is thin, not transparent at all, but will show a lump or bump if you wear hose, but not tragically so. Soft, super comfy. Great for lunch, coffee shopping, errands, and casual things.

review_summary: You know it's a good dres
review_text: You know it's a good dress when you try it on and say, I'm wearing this to work tomorrow!  That was my first reaction to this dress on me.  It is very flattering on my pearshaped figure and is extremely comfortable.  I paired it with a bright colored cardigan for work and I got several compliments!  Love it!

review_summary: I ordered this dress as m

review_summary: I love the fit of the dre
review_text: I love the fit of the dress. It fits me just perfectly and hides all of my imperfections. I'm short so I always search for dresses that lengthens me. I feel confident enough in this dress to go to dance class in where the teacher has a keen eye on dancers' figures. The cotton is very soft but strong. The only down point to this dress is the plastic at the waist that I had to have my seamstress sew over because the plastic irritated my skin. Worth the cost. This is my second dress in this style. I have another one from Modcloth in grey and blue.

review_summary: I received this item as a
review_text: I received this item as a gift and love it! Its a little long, which I actually like. It is super comfy and slimming. I feel great in this dress!!
Beautiful stripes! A little clingy and longer than i normally wear. But loved the way the top fit and the sleeves were a real cute cut

review_summary: I love this dress  it's s

review_summary: I bought this for work. I

Will definitely be wearing this to work.  It's comfortable and conservative.

This is my first purchase from ModCloth and I am very happy. Perfect for pear shaped girls like me: comfortable, flattering and fits great. Finally I have found clothes that I am excited to try on rather than dreading how they will fit!

I love everything about this dressthe fit, the material, the length except for the color and pattern.  The gray and black stripes do nothing.  I might try the blue someday.  If you are looking for something basic, this might be a good choice for you.  But there are so many other amazing dresses on this site.  For reference, I'm between a S and M.  Because of it's comfy, loungy style, M would have been a better choice too.
This dress is perfecthides my postbaby belly.  There's a tie in the back that will help when I finally lose weight.  The sleeves hit at just the right spot and I love the longer length.

review_summary: Very cute, got lots of co
review_text: Very cute, got lots of compliments.  Much longer than a typical ModCloth purchase, which some might find helpful.  Looks great with black stockings, but you'll need your antistatic spray!

review_summary: This is a great dress. Th
review_text: This is a great dress. The jersey fabric is thick enough that you don't need a lining and the pattern is very flattering. I think I'd have liked it even better if the scoop neck was deeper, but the more modest neckline is lovely for work. I pair this dress with brightly colored cardigans and I always seem to get a compliment. It's also so comfortable, you're going to want to wear it all the time!

Soooo many compliments on this dress!  It's really flattering due to the draping and the optical illusion(?) created by the intersection of the divergent stripes.  This dress is really versatile and will be a featured staple in my wardrobe.  It's been chilly since I've purchased this dress and I've been wearing it with black tights and tom's.  I like to brighten it up with a bold colorful necklace.  As it gets colder I'll add a black T or turtleneck.  And when it's warm, sandals!I bought the dress thinking that I would only wear it casually, but it seems dressier in person and I've worn it to work several times.Oh, and for tall ladies, the length is awesome.  Hits me around midknee.

Cute, soft, comfy dress. The one thing I don't like is the diagonal stripes across one side of the top. They make my boob look...odd. Other than that, I'm very happy with it. I bought the XL and it is a bit big, but I wanted baggy rather than tight. It is longer than most (all??) ModCloth dresses, but it looks good with boots.
As many reviewers have already shared, this dress feels ohsocomfortable! Perfect length. Love the pattern, too.
Such a versatile dress! Super comfortable fabric and fits just right!

review_summary: This has to be one of the

I'd say it's cut a little strangely but despite that, it works and hides every body part that I want to. I think the high waist, bow, and the way it falls on the body helps with this. I'm not even that into the pattern (not a stripes person usually) but I love the dress so much I'm keeping it anyway.

review_summary: I love this dress. It's h
review_text: I love this dress. It's held up well after washing and it looks great on my figure. It's clingy without being too clingy. Shows off my assets and skims over my flaws. perfect!
