The most important thought I can share is how helpful the existing reviews were for this dress!  And because it runs a bit small, the medium fit me perfectly.  For the money, this is a wonderful, casual, warm weather dress.  It's a keeper!

review_summary: I love this dress! The st
review_text: I love this dress! The stripes are so much fun and it makes my curvy figure look awesome! However I wish that I had seen the blue one first because I would have totally jumped on the blue over the gray... but still a comfy and pretty dress none the less!

LOVE this dress. It fits wonderfully, is perfectly flattering and hits just below my knees. The fabric is sooo soft, with a little shine and a lovely drape. Perfect weight for swinging the skirt around with glee!

review_summary: I have a high waist and a
review_text: I have a high waist and am curvier on top than bottom  this dress is extremely flattering and fits perfectly! I love the length and agree with other reviewers that I wish ModCloth carried more dresses in this length. Paired it with a blazer for work, then fun heels for going out afterward!

review_summary: This dress is so easy to
review_text: This dress is so easy to wear! The fabric is great, very soft and swingy, a little clingy, so grab your Spanx. The length is absolutely perfect! Being a little bigger up top, I don't know if I love the fabric rotation from angled to horizontal because I feel like it accentuates that area a little more than I prefer.  Overall, a very nice dress that would be great with pretty sandals or riding boots.

Best dress I've ever purchased from ModCloth (and I've bought MANY!)! This is my favorite dress. I get so many compliments when I wear it. I am very curvy (32K bra) with a relatively small waist and a postbaby belly, and this is very flattering. Shows off my waist while the stripes minimize my bust and belly. Plus, it's comfy!

This is the peeeerfect dress. Couple it with leather stiletto boots and its a wrap! Enough coverage at the neackline but still sexy, perfect just below the knee, cute attached belt mininizes the tummy!

review_summary: I went with a Large on th

runs on the smaller side, especially in the hips. had to return this.

The fabric is nice quality and offers some stretch but it's a bit form fitting around the stomach so keep that in mind... however a pair of leggings would help flatten the tummy area if you're wearing this dress in the fall. Overall, for the price, this is a great dress!

review_summary: I love this dress. It's i

review_text: I am almost always a size 12 in other stores, and an L fit beautifully. It hugs all my curves without being unflattering. The length is also great at 5'2 it comes to just below my knees. I prefer this as it allows me to be less selfconscious about if the hem is riding up . The dress is great for summer, being light and stretchy, but will also easily go with a cardigan when it starts to get a little chillier.

review_summary: Just got this and I'm thr

After being forced to wear dresses and skirts for school uniforms most of my life, I'm dipping my toe into the world of wearing dresses in an environment that isn't church. That being said, my number one priority is comfort... and this fits the bill. I love this dress... it feels like a tshirt. I wish it came in other colors, because the stripes make me feel like the hamburlgar.

review_summary: This dress is great. It f
review_text: This dress is great. It fit me perfect. Each time I wear it I get multiple compliments. I highly recommend it.
So comfortable. The fabric is sturdy and soft at the same time. I love the cuffed sleeves. It is one of those dresses that looks appropriate out to dinner or running errands.

This dress is great!  It has chic lines and forgiving, stretchy, breathable fabric.  I love the more modest length, falling right at the knee.  I really wish more ModCloth dresses came in this length, particularly for dresses one might want to wear to work.  Looks edgy and pulled together with kneehigh boots.  Love the wash and wear style and the colors!  Also a great price.  One of my best ModCloth purchases to date!

review_summary: I loved the style and col
review_text: I loved the style and colors of this dress. I just barely fit into the small even though other ModCloth dresses in small fit me fine.  If you're right on the edge of small to medium, I would recommend sizing up because if it shrinks any during the wash, I might have to hang it up until I lose some weight. At least it's a good motivation.I'm 5'3 and it hits around two inches past my knees. It's a great length for the office and perfect style that can be dressed professional or casual depending.

review_summary: I can tell this is going
review_text: I can tell this is going to become one of my goto wardrobe pieces. It's a comfortable cotton that wasn't even wrinkled out of the box. Casual enough for Sunday morning errands, comfy enough for travel on a long car trip or plane ride, AND cute enough to wear into the evening for a casual dinner out with friends. That is versatile! The size small falls perfectly below the knee on me, great news for petites who feel like everything is a few inches too long.

I LOVE this dress!  I am typically a 12 or 14 depending on how things run and the XL fit perfectly.  It is very flattering.  I think its good for curvy figures.  I would say my figure is kind of a figure 8, I have broad shoulders and hips, and a full bust (G), but my band size is a 34, so I come in t the rib cage.  The dress comes in under the chest to accentuate the waist, but is looser fitting though the full skirt so its forgiving of tummies and hips.  It you typically like fit and flare cut dresses or Aline dresses, this should work well for you. I'm excited to wear this to my event next week, its definitely a great find.

I was disappointed by this one. It's a wellmade dress and I really like the style of it, but I felt like the pleated fabric ballooned out around my hips and it wasn't very flattering. It was also a touch loose around the bust/neckline area which is tricky because it's such a wide neckline. I was a little worried I'd be flashing people. Yet, if I sized down I think the waist would be too tight. Probably a lovely dress for someone with slightly different proportions, but it just didn't work for me.

review_summary: Love love love love this dress!!

review_summary: I love this dress so much

The fabric is light the fit is decent (I am usually an XS, but a S worked, though was a little big and could have been tailored). I wear it occasionally, but based on quality I wouldn't recommend this dress.

review_summary: This was a fiasco. I feel
review_text: This was a fiasco. I feel in love with this grey dress and was so excited to wear it. I'm normally a 2x in modcloth clothing. After reading a few of the reviews I ordered up a size. No. No. No!  The 3X was a pathetic joke!! It looked like a size medium. I returned it. I loved the fabric and quality so his was a real shame.

I mostly felt like the dress should have been lined or the material should have been some sort of heavier canvasy type. The fit is to size.

review_summary: Love the dress but, size up

The buttons are adorable! The flare of the skirt is gorgeous.  The sleeves are awkward.  I use cardigans to cover the funky looking sleeves. Over all its a beautiful dress.

review_summary: So cute and received so many compliments!

I ended up using one of my own thicker black belts to wear with it, because the ribbon was very thin and not sturdy enough to really emphasize my waistline. All in all, though, I loved it!
I'm usually an XL but since it doesn't stretch I sized up to a 1X. I couldn't even put it on! I don't understand how anyone was able to wear this without sizing up at least 3 sizes...

love this. work wardobe staple.
looks so flattering!

The dress looks great and is very flattering. Some of the stitching was loose and coming undone before I even put it on but that's an easy fix for me so I still love the dress.
Very cute!

But, throw a slip or something underneath and problem solved.Second, the sleeves are...kind of wonky. They fit me ok, but the sleeve holes seem almost too big. review_text: I wanted to like this dress, but unfortunately it was a nogo. It ballooned out from my waist making me look extremely pregnant. Maybe if it had been a different, heavier fabric that didn't billow as much it could've worked? I have an appleshaped body, meaning all of my weight collects in my stomach and I basically don't have much of a waist, so I prefer not to draw attenion to that area unless the garment is nice and slimming, which this dress was definitely not.

I absolutely love this dress! I got it as a brides maid's dress for a wedding I'll be in in just over a month! The material is comfortable, and the entire dress is beautiful! The only thing I had trouble with was sliding the dress on over my head. I'm a bit curvy, and the waist line and bust area is a bit tight trying to fit it over my chest. The waist fits my waist perfect though. XD  The dress definitely was not going to slide up over my hips. The capped sleeves are a bit odd too because they poof up and don't lie against the shoulder all the time. I'm also switching out the tie for either a wide black belt, or a satin purple sash for the wedding. I really do love this dress though. I think some of the other brides maids are shortening their dresses, but in all reality, the longer length is perfect. With the ruffles on front, the capped sleeves, heart buttons, and folded collar, the long simple skirt balances out the whole look. This dress really is well made. I'm really glad this was my first Modcloth purchase! Thank you!

review_summary: It's way too tight in the
review_text: It's way too tight in the chest. 1x usually fits me at modcloth but I can't button this. Bummer big time. I am pairing it with a sexy bra and shortening it big time to make it wearable for evening sexy nights on the town but it definitely isn't going to work during the day :(I recommend going a size up.
Love the length, love the color. It pops a little in chest area but I'm sure it's because I'm well endowed. Fabric is a little thin, but still cute!

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my sister and she absolutely loves it! As she is a bit taller than me this size fits her perfectly.
Very cute dress. Fit very true to size, however was a bit too long. Easy to fix, just altered the length. Paired it with saddle shoes, and red accessories!
this was an excellent dress! very cute!

review_summary: This dress was much too b
review_text: This dress was much too big for me. I always need to order an XS, because S just doesn't fit me. This doesn't come in XS, so I had to return it.

I finally got this dress after a bad first shipment (kudos to modcloth for their quick replacement time!). I really love it. It's a little smaller in the belly than I'd like so I may need to do some an work before I can comfortably button it, but it fits great everywhere else. Love the ruffles and the material, and the heart buttons. Could do without the poufy cap sleeves though.
This dress runs a little small, be aware. Otherwise, it is good quality although it is a little thin.

Bought this dress but it runs a little long on me and the armholes gape a little.  I have athletic arms and it doesn't look too bad except that the shoulder poof out a little.  I might take the advice of another reviewer and take the shoulders in a little more.  The fit in the torso is perfect.  Otherwise a very cute dress!

review_summary: I love this cut of dress,
review_text: I love this cut of dress, it's very flattering and gives you a smaller waist look. The fabric was a little thinner then I thought but still happy with my purchase.

review_summary: Cute but tight on the arm
review_text: Cute but tight on the arms and very thin material.
The dress is super cute.  Unfortunately, wearing this dress made me feel like a 1950s house wife.

review_summary: This dress is just as cut
review_text: This dress is just as cute as I thought it would be! :) It's my first time ordering clothing, so I'm very satisfied with it. It is a little longer than I expected it to be, but it's not a huge issue to me. Overall, it looks great and professional as well!

review_summary: It can't get any better t
review_text: It can't get any better than this dress! So adorable! Love it, great price too. A little long for me (what do you expect I'm 5'0!), but nothing my tailor can't fix!

review_summary: This dress is just as cut
review_text: This dress is just as cute as I thought it would be! :) It's my first time ordering clothing, so I'm very satisfied with it. It is a little longer than I expected it to be, but it's not a huge issue to me. Overall, it looks great and professional as well!

Unfortunately I am returning this dress because it is way too large. Normally, when I buy Modcloth dresses I choose the small size and it fits me nicely, but I purchased this dress right after I bought the Presentation Day dress, which was super tight and small. I figured I had gained weight and ordered the medium for this one, but it was so large that it looked like it belonged to someone else. The bust area was Ok, but the waist was too large and the sleeves looked odd. I am probably going to try the small size to see if there is any improvement. Overall, nice quality. The fabric is light enough to wear in the summer.

review_summary: This is one of my all tim
review_text: This is one of my all time favorite dresses. It is so cute and it's perfect for a casual day out or work. I love all of the little details, like the ruffles, heart buttons, and bow belt.

This dress is lovely. Keep in mind when trying it on that there is a side zipper and therefore no need to unbutton the dress. The buttons are not the most securely sewn. Really, though, this is one of my favorite items of clothing.

As previous reviews have stated the cap sleeves on this dress are quite puffy and float above the actual shoulders. While slightly strange it's only a minor flaw with an otherwise charming dress. The fabric is slightly thin but not seethrough and since it's cotton it does wrinkle.As for the fit on my frame the belt falls right on my actual waist which results in a very flattering effect. Due to the sleeves the area around the arm joint just flare slightly. The length is good , on the modest side, falling just below my knee. The dress is comfortable to wear and the wee  heartshaped buttons are delightful. I do not regret this dress.
Very cute dress that fit well. Excellent length. Fabric feels a bit flimsy, but you can't really tell visually.

review_summary: I'm tall and this dress w
review_text: I'm tall and this dress was the perfect length to be able to wear for work! Love it.

I really love this dress... I just wish it loved me back a little better. Unfortunately it really doesn't suit much of a bust at all. I ordered the large, but it was far too tight across the bust  I expect it wouldn't accommodate much more than a small C cup without gaping, and I'm at least a DD. I'm holding onto it anyway, because I'm hoping that once I finish breastfeeding I may permanently drop a cup size or two! Other than the bust, the dress fits perfectly and is super flattering  it makes my waist look tiny. The fabric is nice and overall it is well made.
Bust is tight

review_summary: I so wanted to love this
review_text: I so wanted to love this dress, but, as others have stated, the sleeves just lay kinda funky.  It is a bit big across the shoulders.  Oh well. :)

review_summary: This is one of the first
review_text: This is one of the first dresses I've ordered from ModCloth. I was so excited to get this dress and try it on. I'm generally petite (5'1), and dresses that are true to size for most people usually end up having a wait that is way too low for me.  Even if the waist of the dress did come close to my waist, and the dress wasn't 6 inches longer on me then I expected. The only measurement that ran somewhat true from the size guide to the dress on my body was for my chest. From my experience, if you're petite and on the cusp of two sizes, you may have better luck getting the smaller of the two.  Over quality of the dress was good. I did send it back because it didn't fit my body better. I'll be posting a similar review to the other dress I ordered.

This was my first Modcloth purchase and I was very pleased with it.  It fits me just right in the waist, but the bust was a bit big on me.  I have a shorter torso than normal though, so I had to get it tailored.  That seemed to take care of the bust problem.  I can't wait until the weather gets cooler so I can wear it again in the fall!

review_summary: Very cute, think I ll get
review_text: Very cute, think I ll get some more colors
Good fit all around.  Nice thickness and quality of fabric.  I love the versatility of this dress, and it is a great everyday dress.

Very flattering waistline, falls at exactly the right spot on me. Nice and light material so I can wear it in the summer, but also pairs nicely with wool tights for winter wear. I agree with other commenters, I ditched the belt the first day I got it and replaced it with a wide black band. The bust is a bit tight, but I'm a 34DD so I don't think this is too prohibitive.

I generally wear a size 16 dress, I ordered a 3x because some reviews said was a bit tight. I could not button it over my bust, I am only a 40 D or C (depending on cut of bra). The quality on this dress was also not as nice as the other two dresses in my order, it had lots of loose threads and the buttons didn't seem to be sewn on very well. I am returning it and getting a different style. I was very happy with the other two dresses in my order.
Love this dress! :D

I really like this dress. I had my eye on it for some time, and when spring finally hit I snagged it up. I wear this to teach in and it is a little cutesy with the heart buttons, but the vintage look and the length also make it feel a little pinuppy, too. I love grey, it is one of my favorite colors, and this dress is the perfect shade. I thought the medium might be a little snug, but it fits perfectly and isn't too long on my 5'10'' frame.

review_summary: I love this dress. The qu
review_text: I love this dress. The quality is great and I look good in it. A few problems though. One it is to long for my taste, and it is a little hard to get on around the bust area. Everywhere else it fits perfect. The length once fixed will be perfect.
Beautiful dress. I bought an XL, but in my opinion it is more like a small L. The thread around the button holes frays a bit, the button edges are sharpish. Overall a good buy though!

review_summary: After all the reviews I t
review_text: After all the reviews I thought this would be perfect for me.  Sadly I'm in between sizes and this dress looked horrible on my figure.  The waist hit me in an odd place and made this  look unflattering on me.  I'm 5'5 and the length was too long on me.  I found the style and material PERFECT though and exactly what I was looking for....just sadly this dress wasn't for me.  The returns were super easy!  Wish all companies were a breeze to work with like Modcloth!

review_summary: I love this dress! I got
review_text: I love this dress! I got it in grey and Navy. I love the dark stitching accents and the cute heart shaped buttons. The dress looks like it's from the fifties, but doesn't make me look like I am. Super flattering in the waist and bust without being revealing. Wonderful

review_summary: I loved that dress from t
review_text: I loved that dress from the moment I saw it. I have to say, the length, construction, color and details were darling, but I had to send it back. Maybe I'm just not used to that kind of sleeves, but I thought it made me look younger, as in naive, schoolgirllike. Not exactly what I'm going for  I'm 29, for Pete's sake! :) pretty dress, alas not for me.

review_summary: I love this dress! When I
review_text: I love this dress! When I first took it out of the box I didn't think it would ever fit over my large chest, but it fits exceptionally well. The length is perfect, just below my knees. I paired it with the black cat heels (found on Modcloth, thank you very much) and I have my new favorite outfit.  I also am impressed with the quality of construction of the garment. Very nicely done!
This dress looked very matronly on me.  I was hoping to wear it to work regularly, but it just didn't seem very flattering.
Based on the other reviews I thought I'd love this dress. But the material was too thin and the overall sizing was much too large.
wonderful work dress. a little snug, but still a solid buy.

This is a wonderful dress in so many ways.  It fit perfectly, cute details with the buttons and the contrasting piping, love the collar and the tie around the waist.  The fabric and weight were great for all seasons, depending how you accessorized.  The only complaint and the reason I returned it was because of the sleeves.  They were a deal breaker for me.  The way they poof out just made my already athletic upper body look like a football player.  So unflattering.  I wanted so badly to keep this, but other than putting a cardigan over it (which I didn't want to have to do all the time just to look good wearing it), there was no way to disguise it.  It transformed my body shape in a bad way.  If they ever change the sleeves  longer, less poofy, cut off... I will buy it.

review_summary: I adore this dress. The f
review_text: I adore this dress. The fit on top is perfect, and the bottom flares out nicely, very flattering. I would say this size would be fine for someone with 12 sizes larger bust than me  there's still room in there, but its not baggy. It is a touch longer than I'd like. I usually go for knee length and this is a couple inches longer, but its ok, I can always hem it if I want. The fabric is really nice and heavier than I expected, no need for a slip underneath. The ruffle is not distracting  it doesn't accentuate or detract from my chest... its just cute. The buttons are also nice and a good quality, and the bow ties well.

review_summary: This fit me well, it is a
review_text: This fit me well, it is a tiny bit longer than I am used to though.  I will probably exchange the belt for one of my own.  The sewing isn't superb, but it is really cute.  The sleeves also puff a bit more than I expected.  All in all, a decent dress.

review_summary: I love this dress and am
review_text: I love this dress and am so happy I bought it, however....I had to fix the sleeves, they were ridiculously wide and I also took it in a bit under the arm. I was a little nervous about the ruffles across my bust but the bodice is perfect and with flats, heels,  boots, tights or bare legs, this will be a lovely dress for many occasions.

Even opting for a 3x instead of a 2x (I'd exchanged the 2x for the 3x), this gapped and pulled terribly at the bust. If you're a largebusted woman, think more than once; cute it may be, but at a 38D I wouldn't have expected to have it pull so badly at the bust. Back it went.

This dress is super cute and such a bargain for the price!

review_summary: I love the fit, the quali

Absolutely lovely. The only thing that could improve this dress would be a lining at the bottom.

My roommate bought this for herself.  She wears a 2X and literally laughed when the dress came, it was so small!  I wear a size 810 and the 2X fits me pretty well.The fabric is light, but not too thin.  The armholes are a strange, large cut.  I'll probably have to have them taken in to make the dress look right.The length is a bit long, but it gives the dress a vintage feel that I like.

This dress was really cute and comfortable. It fit perfectly everywhere except for my bust. It was too tight to be comfortable around my bust and even managed to flatten it down somewhat. I was really sad about it, too, because I really loved everything else about it.

review_summary: I received this as a Chri
review_text: I received this as a Christmas present, and it's no wonder this dress has received so many great reviews. It's long, but still feels like just the right amount of length. I do feel a bit like a grade school teacher in this dress, but the cutest, hippest grade school teacher around!

Completely adorable dress. The fit was perfect for me, and the shape is very flattering. My only (minor) complaints are that the fabric is really lightweight and the belt is a little flimsy. But, considering the price, the dress is still a steal.

review_summary: I love this dress and hav
review_text: I love this dress and have it in navy as well. However, this one runs smaller in the waist than the other colors do as this one is not as stretchy. Compared to the other About the Artist dresses, this one's cap sleeves do stick out slightly more but not to the point where its unloveable. Overall, it's a great dress!
Had to return this unfortunately. I'm usually an xl or 1x, and I got the 2x in this, and it still didn't fit my chest.

I bought this as my 'groomsmaid' dress for my brother's wedding this summer.The colour goes with the theme, but it's a bit bland, so I'll be wearing it with a coloured sash.The fabric feels cheap and stiff definitely not worth $53, but I had so spend an extra $10 on duties into Canada, so I'm not spending any more to return it.It is WAY too long in the front, good length in the back almost like it was meant to be a circle skirt, but they didn't bother cutting it that way for the back skirt panel. The sleeves are puffy and gape open at the front. I'll have to hem it and add darts. The waist is also really low, but because I have big hips, it folds up and looks alrightish.I was worried from other people's comments that it wouldn't fit my GG's in the bust, but they fit just fine without pulling too badly on the buttons.Overall, I don't love it, but it'll do.

review_summary: I really wanted to like t
review_text: I really wanted to like this dress.  The cut is nice and the concept is great, but the quality is subpar.  It's a thin, stiff, uncomfortable material.  There were loose threads hanging off everywhere as well.  A slip, some snipping, and a few scissors would have helped, but for the price I want something I love and not something I can deal with.  As noted by other reviewers, the cap sleeves are a bit off looking as well due to the stiffness of the material.  I'm a thin girl and I ended up looking like my arms had awnings over them.

review_summary: What a nice dress. The fa
review_text: What a nice dress. The fabric is thicker and sturdier than I expected from the picture, and the details are just so pretty. Unfortunately I couldn't even button it, even though I sized up a bit, so it's on its way back. Sorry, pretty dress. It wasn't meant to be.

I disagree with the other reviewer, I am 5'7 (165lbs 33 inseam), and it is difficult for me to find dresses that are long enough. This dress hits me right around or maybe even just below my knees, It could be a little shorter and it wouldn't change the look or make me feel uncomfortable. No, its not lined, yes the sleeves are a little puffy and yes it is made of cotton but for $50 what do you really expect. This dress was my first modcloth purchase and since then I have bought it in additional colours. I got an XL and it fits like it was made for me.

review_summary: The second dress in my fi
review_text: The second dress in my first ModCloth purchase (the first was the Soda Fountain Dress in Ginger). Love, love, love it. It is very snug though. I can still pull the dress over my head to put it on without unzipping the side zipper but it is woohoo snug around my waist. The shoulders and bust are fine. I'm not scared to bend over or move. The fabric is what I would call light, not thin, because the weave of the fabric is still strong and has weight to it. Still going to wear a camisole and slip with it because I'm going to wear burgundy tights with it. The cap sleeves were fine and roomy without gaping. The length hits me 2 below the knee but I'm 5' 3 so ya know. I expect that. I will have it hemmed up a bit so I have more flare and swing. Hmmm, what else? Oh, did I say I love it yet?

review_summary: I Love this dress. It fit
review_text: I Love this dress. It fits amazingly, is an adorable length, and so far is of great quality. I wore it to school today for Valentine's day and the compliments are pouring in. It looks exactly like the picture, and is definitely worth the money.

This arrived the other day having taken plenty of time to get across the Atlantic. Unlike a lot of prior reviewers, I'm fairly happy with the cap sleeves. They don't hover so badly on me, but I do have fairly muscular shoulders. I'm planning to wait until it warms up a little before wearing it. I wanted to hem it, though my mother, who has more experience with circle skirts than I do, suggested it's quite difficult to tack a circle, so I'm planning on chopping maybe five inches off and hemming. It's just a little too far below the knee, and I'm quite babyfaced and too long skirts combined with my small bust make me look very young indeed. The dress itself is well put together, true to pictured colour, and the heart buttons are pretty cute. Could use a replacement belt.

review_summary: I love this dress! I trie
review_text: I love this dress! I tried it on as soon as it arrived and it fits nicely even though the bust is quite tight. I like the fact that this dress is a little bit longer than other ModCloth dresses. It's like made for a teacher. :)
Liked the dress more online then when I received it. Ended up giving it to a friend. I found the top to be small and didn't like that the dress was unlined.

review_summary: I have had my eye on this
review_text: I have had my eye on this dress for as long as I found out about ModCloth.  When my mother bought me this dress for Christmas this year, I was ecstatic!  I tried it on as soon as I unwrapped it.  Like other reviewers have said, the cap sleeves are a little big, but that's nothing a black cardigan can't fix.  The top portion is also a little bit larger than I would like, but it's not enough to bother me, especially since my torso is a little bit on the short side compared to the rest of my body.  I am student teaching at an elementary school this semester, and my students and colleagues were complimenting me on it all day!  I am really glad I chose this dress.  :]

review_summary: I like this dress a lot.
review_text: I like this dress a lot. I wear it to work but not much elsewhere. It's a little too much on the cutsie side for me.

Everything about this dress was great...except for the sleeves. Many mentioned the problem with the poofing sleeves, and they weren't wrong. I really liked this dress, but it didn't quite fit right, and due to the price I paid, I just don't see myself going to get it tailored for extra money :( unfortunately I am going to be sending this one back, but I have had many other successes with modcloth, so this won't be my last experience with them :D

Love, love, love this dress.  I am a pear shape so finding a dress that fits me both on top and bottom is difficult.  I'm in my 40s and I have hit the age where cutesy no longer works.  I have to admit I was worried about this dress, but once I put it on  the collar, shoulders, placard, skid were unique and made it look cool not cutesy.  I wore it to church today and every woman that approached me made a completely unsolicited positive comment.  The skirt is a bit full but I wore it with a cardigan which made it less poofy.  The fabric is thin, but for this southerner all the better.  I can wear it more than just 3 'winter' months of the year.  This will be a staple in my wardrobe for a long time to come.
