This dress was wonderful.I may wear it for numerous occassions.

review_summary: Huspand got this for me a
review_text: Huspand got this for me as a Xmas gift, I love it, great fit for someone alittle hippy.

review_summary: I had to get this dress t
review_text: I had to get this dress taken up, it's exceedingly long! But other than that I love it! Beware, this dress is not for the serious of you, it's choc full of whimsy! The ruffle and buttons are bigger than I expected, but I love that!

I bought this dress based on feedback from other people who have reviewed this dress. I have to say, I think they were either lying, or just don't know what a quality item looks like. First off, the belt looks like its a part of the dress but it isn't. Its really too thin for the length of the dress, and when tied it bunches. So I've had to replace that.A few people mentioned the shoulders being really pointy. I noticed the same thing. I have no idea what disproportionate measurements they used to determine sizing for this item, but the shoulders stick out a good 2 from my actual shoulders. And the dress isn't too big, in fact its tight around my ribs. The length is also ridiculous, it hits about 4 below my knee and I'm 5'8.The material used is very cheap, its so thin that I would have to wear something lined underneath this so no one would see my under garments. Lastly, the care instructions on the tag completely washed off in the laundry. So now I won't have those instructions in the future. Overall, the quality of this item is so poor, but the hassle to return it is more than I am willing to go through so I will be altering the dress myself.

(Reviewig this under my husbands account as he got me it as a Christmas present) I was very disappointed after trying this dress on! It is so cute but the design on the front flattens your chest and made me look awkward. I wear a size XL in most of modcloth clothes, but my husband got me so he got me a 2X and that didnt even fit! I would have to wear it in possibly a 3X for it to even work, So it was sent back. Definetly size up if your not sure because its NOT GOOD FOR ANYONE WITH BOOBS!

review_summary: I bought this dress in th
review_text: I bought this dress in the red as well and I like it a lot. However, now that I've worn it a couple times I don't think I will keep the new one in grey because the rib cage is just a little tight. I've already washed the red one so I'm stuck with it and the grey isn't available in a large so I'll just have to wait. I love the style of the dress. It's very pretty and flattering but I wear dresses all the time and bought these to wear regularly and around the house so they need to be more comfortable. I also bought the Soda Fountain dresses which I adore but they are too tight across the chest for me and the Hepcat dresses which are WONDERFUL! They are the most casual style of the three but also the most comfortable. This is a lovely dress and feels well made and I do recommend it.

This dress is super cute, especially in winter with black tights! The fabric is a little thinner than I expected, its also a tad longer that I thought it would be, but not in a way that I dont like it, I also have a Soda Fountain dress and by compassion to that its longer and thinner fabric.

I really like this dress! I adore the length of the skirt, and how it's long, but most dresses on Modcloth are that length. It wrinkles VERY easily, so don't pack it for a trip in a suitcase if you won't have an iron at your disposal. I did, so it kind of decreased my fondness of the item. That was also because of the sleeves. They are quite puffy, but I'm okay with it. Overall, I really like this dress, and I will wear it a lot :) Thanks, Modcloth!

I took my measurements before I ordered this dress, and compared them to the size chart, and fell within the large category, so that's what I ordered. Usually, if I have trouble with a dress, it's because it's tight in the bust and/or loose in the waist. This one was fine in the waist and hips, but TIGHT in the bust and along my ribs. It wasn't flattering, made me look lumpy along the ribs and gave me the pancake boob effect, and the sleeves wanted to float above my shoulders, much as one other reviewer said. Yet the length was lovely, the ruffles and heart shaped buttons are adorable, and I loved the color. I think this dress would be super cute on someone smaller in the ribs/bust. So sad to be returning it! It really is a lovely dress, it's just not right for my body type!

I'm 5'8, usually wear a dress size 16 in A line dresses. My measurements are currently 423555. Bra size 38D. I first ordered the dress in 2X and when it came it pulled across the chest and fit snugly around my hips. I could have gotten away with it with a tighter shaper, but I wanted to be comfy. I exchanged it for the 3X, and this one fits beautifully with plenty of room. I'm not having the same problem with the huge arm holes, but I also have a large bust and large arms, so they take up that space. I often have problems with sleeves not fitting my arms, so I was glad to see other have this problem. The material wrinkles fairly easily, but it's thick enough that I'm wearing it on a frosty day with tights and a cardigan and am warm enough. The belt is a joke, It folds up and doesn't hang prettily like the photo. I paired my dress with a pink Betsey Johnson belt and the pop of color is what the dress needed. Overall: I'm super happy with this dress and the cut. Great for girls with bigger arms and a pear shape.

review_summary: I ordered a size XL accor
review_text: I ordered a size XL according to my measurements, but it fits a bit large. It has an odd shape on the sleeves, they seem huge (the dress would be ok if it weren't for the large puffy sleeves). I love the large collar, and it is not so light, perfect for the nights of summer.

review_summary: This was my very first Mo
review_text: This was my very first ModCloth purchase and I was a bit nervous about it, but pleasantly surprised. It fit great and I was definitely happy with my purchase. The material is pretty thin so wearing a slip is a MUST with this dress. Overall, it's cute and great for a family party.
I like everything about this dress except the length  it came down to my midshin! Once I have it taken up, it will look great.

My boyfriend just gave this to me for Christmas, and I absolutely adore it! I wear a size 12/14 in the bust (I'm Australian), so the size was perfect. The only notsogood part were the sleeves, just because they puffed out a lot more than what they should (or I could just have little arms), but nothing a little needle and thread can't fix! Overall, totally happy with this super cute number!

review_summary: I don't even know where t
review_text: I don't even know where to start with this dress.  I really wanted to like it but I'm just so disappointed in the actual product.  The fit is good and the buttons and ruffles are super cute.  Other than that the dress fell flat for me.First of all there are the sleeves that are way too wide and stick out to a comical degree.  I could deal with it if that was the only issue but it's just the first.There were tons of loose threads in the botton holes.  The belt is thin and flimsy.Add to this the fabric of the dress which is just really thin and really cheap and I just can't justify keeping this dress. So sad, especially since I paid $40 in duty fees.

I really wanted this dress to work, but I'm too longwaisted for it. The tie was up on my ribs and no matter what I tried (wide belts, etc.) I couldn't make it look right. It was a great dress otherwise.

I bought this dress when the Black Friday sale popped, and I haven't regretted it. I'm even considering it in the other colors it comes in now! The dress fits perfect around my waist, as well as around my hips, which is a tough thing to do for me. The sleeves are just popped enough to be cute, not over the top. The only thing that makes me a little unhappy is how low under the armpits the dress is cut. You can't tell by looking at it, but if you had a high bra, you might be able to see it. It's not cut towards the front, though, only cut down. It's such a meager thing in comparison to the dress itself. I get compliments every time I wear it. It's a classic, timeless look, so I can dress it up or dress it down or dress it vintage whenever I want! This dress is a keeper.

This dress is wonderful for work. I got a medium, unsure about the bust fit. It fits wonderfully with a little cinch from the tie. I will agree with other reviewers about the sleeves, the caps stick out a little, but not enough to really bother me.

review_summary: My one issue lies with th
review_text: My one issue lies with the arms the cap sleeves are too large and jut out. I have folded them in at the back and stitched them in an effort to lessen the effect. Otherwise, a very charming dress.

review_summary: I got this dress in the f
review_text: I got this dress in the floral print a few months ago. It is gorgeous... IF you are wearing some kind of cardigan over it. The sleeves are ridiculously square out from the body and the openings are big, even though I have broad shoulders and big arms. I normally would wear a little cardi with it anyway, though, so it's not that big of a deal. The length on it is great, since I am tall  it's rare to get a dress I don't need to wear tights with to be decent.

review_summary: I sized up based on previ
review_text: I sized up based on previous reviews. Unfortunately it is much larger than the Soda Fountain Large. Also there is a wide gaping underarm area that even opens towards the chest. The cap sleeves were huge and were in a different zip code from my arms. Sadly I will be returning.

review_summary: I love love LOVE this dre
review_text: I love love LOVE this dress. I've had it for awhile and it's one of my favourites! It's really sturdy and I always get lots of compliments on it. My only teeny complaint is that it wrinkles REALLY easily (I also have the pink one and it's even worse for wrinkles!) but it's so cute I just ignore the wrinkles :) The arm holes are kind of funny but I always wear it with a cardigan anyways so I don't mind.Also it shrunk in the wash so it's a bit snug in the bust now so if you are big chested maybe don't put it in the dryer :)

I love this dress!  It's super cute and is made for a woman with hips.  It can be a bit tricky to get on, but once on, it beautifully highlights my curves.  It thins me out around my waist too!  Even my husband complimented me wearing it (which is something he never does).

Love this dress!I have been eying this dress for ages and just bought it on sale a few weeks ago. I'm so glad I did!It is super cute and smart enough to wear to a job interview. Feels very nicely made and durable as well.

review_summary: I wanted so much to like
review_text: I wanted so much to like this dress.  I'm usually a SM in ModCloth dresses, depending on the style/cut.  I chose the S. I'm able to zip up the dress but it's tight around my rib cage. Maybe if I don't eat anything all day, I'd be able to wear this dress comfortably.  But I love to eat, so that won't be the case.  I'm returning for a size M and see if that'll work better. From the reviews though, it may sound too big for me.  :(

review_summary: I love this dress! I wore
review_text: I love this dress! I wore it to World War II Weekend in PA and got a number of compliments. I replaced the buttons with regular black circular buttons though because I was not a fan of the hearts.

I really wanted this dress to look as perfect on me as it did on the website. The sleeves were really big and puffy and sat oddly on my shoulders. Napoleon Dynamite would have liked them, because they're real big. The collar was awkward. The buttons were sewn on crooked. I thought about altering this dress myself and making the wonky parts less so, but I think I can only be okay with having to fix a dress when it's from a thrift store.

review_summary: The chest area was too sm
review_text: The chest area was too small so I'm sending it back for a large. The side zipper was a little hard to get up and the belt looked cheap. I still love the style and length.

This dress fit great everywhere except for the arms. The sleeves just floated over my arms and looked really weird. Maybe my shoulders aren't wide enough or maybe I just need to get some muscle. It looked really weird though, had to send it back. Length was good. Quality is not too shabby.

This is another dress that I really really wanted to love and keep, but in the end it didn't do it for me. The chest area was too loose, which was okay, but I couldn't accept the awkwardly puffy sleeves. The dress had a beautiful silhouette and was otherwise flattering. The buttons and ruffles were so adorable. I guess it just wasn't meant to be (cry).

review_summary: I've had my eyes on this
review_text: I've had my eyes on this dress for a while now, but I was wary about buying a dress that I hadn't tried on. I don't wear skirts that are shorter than knee length, so finding a dress long enough that is still flattering and not a maxi dress is highly unlikely. Finding a flattering dress the right length with sleeves is near impossible. This is the exception. This dress fits my like it was made for me, if not better (having worn several homemade dresses). The bust and waist are snug, but not tight, even with an extra layer underneath.The fabric is fairly lightweight, so it is easy to layer with and should be comfortable in warmer weather (hard to say at the moment where I live). The hem hits just below my knees whether I'm standing or sitting. The sleeves are a bit puffy and do float a little off my arms, as mentioned in other reviews, but the style is complimentary to the rest of the dress while still providing ease of movement. Personally, I prefer to turn the belt around so that it ties in the back, but you know, to each their own. I am extremely satisfied with this dress and hope that Modcloth continues to provide dresses and skirts of similar length.

review_summary: I have this dress in anot
review_text: I have this dress in another color and I loved the way it hugged my chest and nipped in my waist. But the color on this one was a bit too dull for me. And the cap sleeves looked weird on me. Maybe it was a combination of the particular dress I got and myself. But it did not seem as flattering as the other one I had.

Beautiful dress, but a bit snug through the bust area (still totally wearable for me, though). I love the length, hits me right at the knee. I might need to wear a slip under it, the material is a little thin. I definitely recommend this dress :)

This dress is as beautiful and gorgeous as I thought it was! The only major cons for me was the sleeves were way too big (as stated by other reviewers) and it doesn't help that I already have small shoulders. The MAJOR con for me is that it's extremely hard to put on for curvy girls! The waste is so tiny that it can't slide up my hips, and its very awkward to pull it over my head and past my bust, but it can be done. Overall this dress is soooo very lovely and fits with even a little room to spare in the waste (when I can get it on.) I will definitely consider buying from ModCloth again.

review_summary: Fit's great! I think it s
review_text: Fit's great! I think it shrunk a little when I put it on the steam cycle in the dryer to get the wrinkles out (I'm too lazy to iron). I always get compliments when I wear this dress.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress, but was very disappointed with the quality of the dress. The material feels thin and cheap since the dress is unlined. The first time I tried it on, the zipper ripped and pulled away from the fabric. This one is getting returned.

I ordered this because of the length  I am just north of 5'7 so I have to be careful with short dresses. The dress hit me below the knee, so I feel like this would be a great dress for taller girls who work with kids or something. The problem for me was it was slightly too big. And I felt a little...twee in it. But it was cute and I still recommend it! May have kept it if it came in XS.

I ordered this because of the length  I am just north of 5'7 so I have to be careful with short dresses. The dress hit me below the knee, so I feel like this would be a great dress for taller girls who work with kids or something. The problem for me was it was slightly too big. And I felt a little...twee in it. But it was cute and I still recommend it! May have kept it if it came in XS.

review_summary: The dress is super cute a
review_text: The dress is super cute and fits well.  The bottom is quite full and seems to puff out on me though(perhaps because I have a small waist and larger hips).  It does sit awkwardly below my knees and so I think I'll have it taken up a little.  I have a long torso and short legs so I'll need to make it a little bit more proportional for me.

review_summary: It was not good. The leng
review_text: It was not good. The length was very awkward. While that can be fixed (for a price) I do not believe the shoulder issue could be solved. They are really out there, girls! I read the reviews and I thought I could handle it...I was wrong. Also from the pictures I felt like this dress was black and grey. In person, it seemed to be more like a dark denim then a grey. It was subtle but I didn't expect it. I looked very homely in this dress. A little too little house on the prairie as my husband put it. It's going back.

review_summary: This dress is so cute and
review_text: This dress is so cute and retro I would almost consider getting it in a second color!  I feel like I could walk onto the set of Mad Men with this stylish dress on!  The heart buttons are a super cute addition.  I also like the longer length and cap sleeve.

Love love love this dress!!! It is just so super cute and flattering on!!! I'd encourage anyone who wants a longer dress, that is super flattering to buy it.  It really flatters my curvy shape  accentuates a small waist.  Love the long length  it goes below the knees but perfect for the style.  Can wear it with a cute black cardigan to work.  The fit is superb. I'm totally average build, though slightly curvy, and it really is flattering. I can't wait to wear it out!  (just tried it on tonight)

I really liked this dress. The fabric was better than I expected. The fit great except a tid bit tighter in the waist in comparison to the rest. My biggest complaint is the dress comes to mid shin on me. No biggie. Nothing a simple tailor can't fix.

review_summary: Oh, my gosh!  I can't eve
review_text: Oh, my gosh!  I can't even say how much I love this dress.  It's absolutely adorable.  The fit was just right.  As other people have said, the sleeves are a little poofy, but I think I can fix that with a few wellplaced stitches.  The heart buttons are a sweet touch.  I'm not a huge fan of side zippers, but since the buttons are functional, it's not really a big deal in this case.  The belt is a little flimsy, but works well enough for the purpose.  I think what I am going to do is sew a wider black ribbon to it to stiffen it and give it an 'edgy' little border.  (See what I did there?  LOL)  I'm pretty tall, 5'11 and this dress comes down to a few inches below my knees, which is a nice change from things often being a little too short.  This was my first purchase from ModCloth.com and I could not be happier with the item and the service.  I will definitely be ordering again, and often.  Thanks!

review_summary: The cut, length and fit o
review_text: The cut, length and fit of this dress are all great.  The puffed sleeves are stiff and peaked, however, and the buttonholes don't seem to have been fully sewn, so that threads are beginning to fray out of buttonholes even before you touch them.  Would have liked for this one to work out  it's really cute.  Not crazy about having to have the sleeves fixed and the buttonholes unraveling, so this one went back.

review_summary: Just got this today and i
review_text: Just got this today and it's very cute and comfortable. Definitely lightweight as it is unlined but to me that just means I can wear it in the summer too! It hits me about 2 below the knees, I might have it hemmed as that is not my length preference. Shorter people beware!Overall ran more or less true to size. The buttons at the bust tend to pull despite my bust measurement being an inch or two below the measurements for 3X. I'm debating whether or not to put a couple of stitches in the front to hold it closed. It's snug but not uncomfortable at the waist, and there's a little bit of room at my hips but not a lot. Anyone with hips wider than mine should probably steer clear.Oh, and the sleeves sit a little weirdly on my arms, but I like this dress with a cropped cardigan anyway.Overall I'm pleased with my first order from ModCloth. Canadian shipping took 9 business days  not bad!

review_summary: I always get a ton of com
review_text: I always get a ton of compliments when I wear this dress  the buttons are very sweet without looking juvenile. It is a great dress to wear to the office or meetings. Personally I find the sleeves a little bit puffy so I prefer to wear a cardigan with this dress. As well, I resewed the buttons myself just to make sure they were on there properly. Overall I am very happy with this purchase.

I really liked this dress, it is so cute! The problem I had was in the fit along the bust. It fit perfectly in the waist but was very voluminous throughout the bust and shoulder area. It made the sleeves fit very oddly on me, almost like they were floating. I will have to return it but a quick chat with customer service has given me options of a different dress to try in the same general style that may fit me better.

review_summary: I am a petite girl and I
review_text: I am a petite girl and I was so excited about this dress because it's a very flattering cut for me but it is HUGE. The small swallowed me and the length is much too long for my 5'2 frame. Might be worth getting tailored as it's a really cute, well made dress, but I think too much would have to be done to risk it. Not sure the fit would ever work and sadly, I am sending it back. Wish this came in a petite!
I got so MANY compliments. Fits beautifully and makes you feel and look like a lady. =)

After reading dozens of reviews on this dress, I had a really hard time deciding what size to order since my measurements fall accross a few sizes.  I settled on a small, which fits perfectly.  I agree with a lot of people who were a little let down by the button holes.  They will need to be reinforced unless you've got a small bust and (for me) the collar lays better with the top button undone.  The sleeves are poofy as was mentioned several times, but it's not bad enough to bother me (it's a little drafty).  This dress is really flattering for anyone with an hourglass shape, but be warned, the waist is small.  It zips up (left side) like a glove, but I would suggest sizing up if you like to have some extra breathing room in the rib/waist area.  Overall, I love this dress, and I love wearing it.  The length is perfect, but a little sheer so I don't leave the house without a slip and my boyfriend particularly likes the heartshaped buttons.  I've purchased several dresses from ModCloth and this one is definitely my favorite :)

boyfriend bought this for me as surprise bday gift, very sweet of him, but the size runs way too small.  if you have chest, then i definitely recommend to get one size up.  the size small is too tiny that there's a couple inches cap at my chest area.  Dress is on the longer end, but i guess a good tailor would be able to customize it.  Super cute style, too bad it doesn't fit.
I adore this dress. I've worn it so much I might need to get a second one...

You know those mornings where you wind up being late for work because every single thing you put on looks, for some reason, absolutely horrible and you want to hide in the closet all day?  I was having one of those on Friday, and as soon as I put this dress on, it was over.  Wore it with some bright green tights and I have never gotten so many compliments!

review_summary: This dress did not suit m
review_text: This dress did not suit me at all. I'm 5'2 and about 100 pounds. The dress was big everywhere but especially in the neck/shoulders/sleeves and the skirt, which was too long and generally too wide. The material is surprisingly thin and wouldn't work very well in the winter. I do still love the design, but the dress isn't suited to petites.
This dress fits me perfectly, is very thinning and shows off my curves in all the right ways.

Love this dress. I usually wear a medium, but got the large because this looked pretty fitted at the waist and that can be a problem for me.  It was a good call, the dress fits me perfectly.  As others have noted, the cap sleeves are on the poofy side.  The dress requires ironing as well.  I get a lot of compliments on this one, so those issues aside, I recommend it.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress.  I not
review_text: I LOVE this dress.  I noticed that it was very popular and am so very glad that I bought it.  It is the perfect length for work and I've received many compliments on it. The cap sleeves are very cute on me and the ruffles add just the right touch!  I plan to get the same dress in other colors.
Love it! So professional and unique. I get tons of compliments every time I wear this dress.

review_summary: I got a lot of compliment
review_text: I got a lot of compliments the first time I wore the dress.  I absolutely love it.  I think if there is anything that could improve is the quality of the fabric.

review_summary: Too big and long for me e
review_text: Too big and long for me even though I usually order a small in other dresses from modcloth.

This dress is absolutely lovely.  It's the perfect length for autumn (both in and out of work) and it fits as it should all over.  The sleeves aren't too tight (which is often the case with cap sleeves) and the dress feels and looks well made.  It's going to be a staple!

review_summary: I love this dress, I have
review_text: I love this dress, I have had it for 6 months now and I wear it at least once a week! It is perfect for work with the length at that perfect spot just below the knee. The fabric is very comfortable and it would suit any hourglass or pear shape particularly well. My only complain is that the sleeves push up a bit, so the top of the shoulder ends up a bit pointy, but it is not a big issue.

One of my favourite modcloth purchases! I order the medium and found it a little bit roomy on top, but I wear it anyway because the dress still sits ok. I bought the S of this dress in the Coral afterwards and the S fits me a little better. I did end up taking up the hem 2 inches because I felt I tiny bit frumpy in this dress with my 163 cm frame.I am a high teacher and I find this a perfect outfit to wear to work, and my students have commented on the cuteness of the ruffles and buttons!

review_summary: I like this dress and it'
review_text: I like this dress and it's fairly well designed, but unfortunately there are a few problems. One: I have a rather large chest, which causes the buttons to gape, unsurprisingly. Two: there is no seam for about three inches below the zipper on the side. Not a tough fix, but a little disappointing. I'm hoping with the right combination of bra and wear, the chest with stretch a bit and fit more comfortably. It's super cute, so I'm keeping it.

Supercute dress. I'm pretty sure it's a juniorsized small rather than a misses small, so it's a little bit more snug than anticipated (oops!), but it's not bad at all. Very flattering, and covers you while still showing off your shape. The material and construction, however, really aren't great. I'd hope for something slightly better quality. Still, though, very cute dress, and I'm happy to have it!

Another perfect hit! I got this as a birthday gift and it fits wonderfully. The stomach is a bit taught, but the real, removable drawstring makes it a little adjustable; Plus, the fabric does give a LITTLE stretch. Didn't get any compliments the first day I wore it, but hey there's always tomorrow. ;)The fabric is my favorite: 100% breathable cotton.

review_summary: I really like the idea of
review_text: I really like the idea of this dress, it just doesn't flatter my body. After reading the reviews, I sized up in the hopes that it would fit my bust (42F). It was entirely too small around my chest, but almost too flowy from the waist down. Like others have said, the material is thin, but not see through. It is with regret that I return this dress, because it's really quite lovely. I'm glad it's working out for others, though!

review_summary: This was my first ever Mo
review_text: This was my first ever Modcloth purchase and I am so excited! I purchased this dress in hopes that I could find something not homemade or altered for once that would fit my shape, and it did. It's a bit big arpund my top, but I'm not super busty to begin with. It hits right at my knees and accentuates my smaller waist. I think I might wear this for my engagement pics!

Really cute dress, fit is okay, but when the bust for an XL is supposed to cover 40  42 and I have a 41 bust, this SHOULD fit. It doesn't without straining the cute heart shaped buttons to the point of bursting. I wear this dress open the top two buttons with a cami underneath. The fit in the waist is perfect, so I think it's cut a little smaller than size, as my waist is a 31. It's a little short, but I'm really tall, so it's expected.

This dress was gorgeous, but it was waaay longer than I expected, even though I looked at other pictures in the reviews. Other than that, I love it (the material was also a bit less thick than I expected, but that was no problem.) I like it enough that I'm going to get it hemmed, and I can't wait to wear it to school.

review_summary: I love this dress! It's s
review_text: I love this dress! It's so flattering and pretty.  I ordered to fit at the waist as my measurements spanned a few sizes.  I assumed the hips were free so that was easy and I figured the bust could be taken in.  When it arrived it was actually perfect in those 3 areas.  The only problem I have with it is some puckering right above the breast at the arm pit.  I'm not sure if it's just me, or the cut or something about my proportions but if you look at the close up shot you can see the gaping pucker, I can slide my entire hand in there and if I stand sideways you can see right in.  I also found the sleeves quite puffy, like ridiculously so.  They'll need to be taken in as well. Nothing simple alterations can't fix and definitely worth the price.

review_summary: I love this dress. It was
review_text: I love this dress. It was my first ModCloth purchase! It's cute, comfy and flattering. Fit:It is snug around the ribs but not uncomfortably so. As other people have mentioned the puffed sleeves are weird, possibly due to the large arm openings I found them to gape at the front. The cap sleeves sit way out from my arms and one looks kinda pointy compared to the other but nothing a quick stitch or a cardigan can't fix!The bust is, as expected, a little tight but the bodice is a flattering shape so it pulls everything in nicely doesn't look stretched or ugly. If this came in a size 4XL I'd probably jump up a size just to allow for those extra cupcakes ;)I love this dress, and intend to buy it in other colours. It's well made, flattering for plus size gals and sits nicely. Thanks ModCloth! 3

Great looking quality, color, and silhouette, but unfortunately this is NOT designed for very small girls.  The waist of this dress sat on top of my hip bones and the hem fell just a bit above my ankles.  I'm glad I tried though and I'm sure it would look great on a taller person.

The chest/waist area is super tightif I gained 5 lbs, this would NOT FIT.  But I like it so much that I don't care!  The sleeves could use some alteration since they stick out a bit on me.  But I love the heartshaped buttons!!

review_summary: I bought this dress for w
review_text: I bought this dress for work (I workin in a university career center so looking professional is a must) and I was a little concerned with the heart shaped buttons and the ruffles coming off as a little too cutesy. However, everyone loved it and I got compliments all day on it. Overall I'm glad I took the chance!

This dress is adorable, and the quality was good. The little heart buttons and ruffles are very cute. I think this dress would better fit someone who is a little bit taller or longer in the torso than I am. I bought a small and the waist and bust were a little bit tight, but the hips were too low or wide or something, so the dress stuck out on the side. It was really weird the way it fit me. Anyway, I'm going to have to send it back, but I'm sad to do so, because it is quite nice.

I actually don't like this as much as the soda fountain and hepcat dresses (which I love).  The sleeves are puffy.  It's not that obvious from the picture, but they're really quite puffy when you're wearing the dress.  I don't really like puffy sleeves that much.  The dress ends just below my knee and, as such, is a tad too long for my tastes.  But I've decided to keep it anyway because this is something that I can wear to work, and the sleeves can probably be altered pretty easily.  The medium fits me perfectly.  (This is in contrast to the soda fountain dresses, where the medium is slightly too snug and the large slightly too big.)

The material of the dress is thinner than I had expected, but not so thin as to be shine through in daylight, and I can always wear a slip if necessary. The S runs a bit small in the rib cage for me, but then again, my rib cage is rather wide. (I have 4 inches more in the rib cage than at the waist). The buttons are really cute, and I like the length. It's neither too long nor too short to mount a bicycle with it.
This dress is supper cute and very flattering to the figure.  It's a little snug in the chest area, but overall it fits well.

I am 5'8'' with a relatively small, shapeless frame. I was so disappointed with the fit! Although the dress itself was adorable, it seemed hang on me like a curtain, and the sleeves floated above my shoulders. My body seemed to drown in the dress. I also thought the length would be shorter, but it hit me at an awkward spot below the knee.

This dress was so adorable! The bust was too tight and the material is very very flimsy. However, I'm going to try again because it is so cute and shirtdresses usually are tight in the chest for me. Glad there is such a nice size range because this dress looks great on all figures!

review_summary: I got this dress to be a
review_text: I got this dress to be a bridesmaid in a friend's wedding (she picked it out, Great Taste!) After reading other reviews I decided to order the 2X. I was really worried about the fit since this was my first Modcloth purchase however it fit marvelously! I look forward to wearing it at the wedding, and probably many times afterwards.

review_summary: The material is kind of t
review_text: The material is kind of thin, but it's okay. I like the length of the dress very much, it falls just right on my knees.

Love this dress. Purchased it in February, but just wore it last month for the first time to a friend's wedding. The fabric is a great weight for spring and summer, even early fall. The construction is good and the details are delightful. Everything fit perfectly, which is saying a lot for me. I'm decidedly pear shaped and most fitted dresses that are comfortable and flattering in the waist and hip area leave my chest swimming and feeling unlovely. This dress was made me feel feminine and pretty. Loved the cute matching hairpins that Modcloth tossed in with the order; although I didn't wear them, they were a nice touch. I probably hesitated to purchase this dress originally because of the price. I don't have a lot of success buying things online that fit, and I hate returning stuff (free shipping or not, the disappointment of an anticipated purchase is crushing), so when I could see that the dress was popular and the reviews rated it highly, I was encouraged that it would be worth the price and risk. My only complaint is that I hate to iron, so I'll have to get over the wrinkles after wear and washing. Thanks, Modcloth. I look forward to wearing this dress again.

I received this dress as a gift, but will unfortunately have to return it. For the overall fit and quality of the dress, it would not be worth to keep it because of the alterations that would need to be done. The bottom of the dress hit me at a slightly awkward (too long) length. I would need the sides taken in, particularly close to my underarms and the sleeves would need altering. As well, I found the dress awkward to get on and off. My preference is a back zipper anyway, usually not side zippers for a dress.The design is lovely, but didn't quite work onshould I say, my petite frame. If it came in an XS, and had a back zipper, I think it may have worked. So not quite 4 stars, maybe 3.8.

Almost a very cute dress! I bought it because it's one of the few dresses with sleeves, but the cap sleeves were too wide for my shoulders (I'm slim but not unusually small) and gaped below my armpits as well. Although the bodice and waist area were better fitted, when the bow was tied the rest of the dress flared out oddly around it making my curves nearly disappear. It did go just past my knees, a good length. All in all it was very unflattering for my figure. Slim girls, look elsewhere!

According to the measurements guide, I should take 1X in ModCloth sizes. This dress didn't come in a 1X, so I decided to try 2X because I was sure XL would be too small. Well, I'm glad I went with the 2X. It actually fit quite snug. This dress does not run true to size. It runs small. So if you are considering this dress, especially if you are between sizes, I suggest sizing up. Other than that, it really is very cute!

I originally purchased an XL but it was a mite tight. Returned it, and within a week received the next larger size that was available.  The buttons still pull a little across the chest area, but nothing a safety pin can't handle (or a little weight loss).  The length is good; the dress hits me just at the knee.  I wouldn't have minded it being a little longer, but it still is suitable to wear to work.  My only complaint would be the sleeves/armholes.  Cap sleeves are not my favorite; I would have preferred regular short sleeves.

This dress fits me perfectly.  I read through tons of reviews looking for those with similar measurements to me, and I'm glad I did  according to the size chart I probably should have gone a size up.  If I was any bigger in the bust I don't think it would be as comfortable  the buttons do up neatly with no sign of straining, and the waist is snug.  The sleeves do gape oddly, but that hasn't been an issue as I have been wearing it with a cardigan (it's winter here).  The fabric is lovely  soft enough to drape where it should, but with plenty of structure in the collar and ruffles.  I have been wearing a slip underneath.  This was my first ModCloth purchase  I will definitely be back for more!

review_summary: I agree with most of the
review_text: I agree with most of the reviewers that the sleeve fits a little awkwardly on this dress. I'm choosing not to tailor it, and just wearing a black cardigan over it instead. I get a lot of compliments on the way it looks on me. The fabric is a little bit thinner than I expected, but I love the details  especially the heart buttons!

review_summary: so I got this dress recen
review_text: so I got this dress recently, and though very form flattering, I was disappointed by the actual quality of the dress.  One really does need a slip, but most frustrating is that the zipper on the side broke the first time I wore it.  Then the buttons on the front, as cute as they are, buckle the fabric a bit and undo them selves which is...awkward.  I got this dress on sale, so I won't be returning it, but if I had paid anymore for it I'm pretty sure I would be.

review_summary: I love this dress. I boug
review_text: I love this dress. I bought it in coral, and then had to have it in gray. The gray fabric is a little stronger/heavier than the fabric used in the coral dress, so it has a little less give to it. Because of this the dress was tight around the chest (bust size 39). I wouldn't go up a size though. I'd recommend wearing a thin bra (definitely not pushup or padded) with this if you're around my size. Love the dress. Love the way it looks and can't wait to wear it out.

review_summary: I adore this About the Ar
review_text: I adore this About the Artist dress. I bought it in Gray and Cobalt Swirl intending to choose which I liked better and return the other. However, I absolutely love them both and will not part with either! The dress has a little extra room at the ribs for comfortable sitting/breathing/etc which is exactly what I was looking for.

Very cute dress, and not too short for work. The material is a nice thickness and quality. I have received lots of compliments on it. If I had to buy it again, I would get a Small because the Medium is a little big on me, but I don't want to return it to discover that the Small is too tight.

This dress is beautiful and classy but the belt was awful. It was tattered before I even wore it once! The dress was a little small in the chest due to the fact I ordered a size down because 1X wasn't available. Still wear it proud though!

For some reason, this dress did not fit on my frame. It wasn't even an issue of sizing I just found the whole top bit (collar, buttons, frills, vneck) overwhelming on my frame. I guess I had envisioned the whole top part being less big. Had to go back. Not flattering. I also felt that I ran somewhat large. I am excited about the newer colours and may try my luck with a smaller size in a different colour!
loving this dress. I usually wear a size 1012 or large, but purchased a XL after reading reviews and it fits perfectly. I only wish the material was lined.

I absolutly love this dress!  The fit was fantastic, not too tight, very modest!  I love that I could move freely in it in all directions, including the arms, where things are sometimes too tight.  I would love to see a material that doesn't crease so easy, but all in all, a definate 10!  Thanks Mod Cloth!

review_summary: I bought this dress a siz
review_text: I bought this dress a size down to serve as a reward for getting in better shape, and while I haven't quite reached that point yet, I'm super excited! I've already lost 13 pounds, and if I manage to just lose a couple more inches around the waist and bust, I'll be there! The quality of this dress is absolute perfection the fabric is a good weight to be multiseasonal with the right accessories, the grey color is classy but still comes off as playful with the detailing of the dress, and the buttons and zipper are wellattached and of good quality so I won't have to worry about anything popping off. All in all, it's beautiful. I can't wait to be able to wear it!

Although the measurement chart seemed to suggest that the dress may be too tight for the size I bought, I decided to take the chance, and it actually fits fairly well in the waist. It was a little hard to get on and off though, as the fabric is a little stiff, and the side zipper doesn't loosen the dress as much as I would want for getting dressed.  As far as fit, I have a small chest and the top is a little baggy. As some of the other reviewers said, the sleeves are a little funny. I have skinny arms and they look a little too poofy. The thing I like least about this dress, however, is the collar. It's HUGE, and doesn't really lay flat. I think this is definitely a dess that I will always pair with a sweater. Had I tried on this dress in a store, I probably wouldn't have gotten it. However, I paid almost $35 to have this shipped abroad, so I'm going to keep it rather than lose even more to return. Despite the issues, with the right sweater this dress does look nice and I might even wear it for my upcoming engagement photo shoot.

The dress was great except I have to get it taken in a bit on the top and it seems to fall at kind of an awkward place on my legs. I have wide hips and kind of a big butt for my size though and this dress totally slims it :)
First time buying from Modcloth. I really like the cut of this dress. Very flattering fit.
I love this dress!!!

Received this dress today and found it to be a very nice cut and colour on me.  A little on the thin side so will be something to wear in summer here in Brisbane.  However as I guessed the sizing for myself (first purchase) I have miscalculated and bought one size too small, would really have preferred a 1XL.  However, I do believe it will fit eventually after losing the baby weight, so I will keep it and have something nice to aim to fit into

I really wanted this dress!  It was so vintage and was the main reason for my order!  So you can imagine how disappointed I was when it wouldn't fit.  I tried everything to get this dress on....I must have ordered too smalll or gained some weighty (sigh) b/c it just wasnt happening.  Besides the price, though, I wasn't fond of the stiff polyester feel of the material.  So, overall, it was three strikes and better luck next time.

Absolutely loved this dress!  I got more compliments on this dress than I could count!  The dress hangs to just below the knee, and is lightweight and comfortable.  It is thick enough fabric that you won't need a slip with it. I was concerned about the fit in the front, since I have a hard time finding dresses that I don't need to wear a tank top under, but the fit was perfect!  I LOVE this dress!

This dress is absolutely charming.  The heart buttons are adorable but subtle and the slight puff on the sleeves just adds a hint of doll to the style.  The fit is wonderful and highly flattering to my figure  I'm curvy and it is hard to find nonspandex dresses that don't make me look like a box.  It looks awesome with button up cardigans.  I highly recommend it for someone who wants something cute and appropriate for daytoday wear.
Fit perfectly and looks great!  I was worried because my shoulders are a little big for my frame, but the dress fit just fine!

Fitted perfect except for the sleeves.  The sleeves don't sit right and stick out. I have slightly muscular arms so usually I have a problem with sleeves being too small.  The length is longer than most Modcloth dresses, the hem sits over my knees.  Good for  West Australian winter with a long sleeve top underneath and tights.

review_summary: I saw this dress and fell
review_text: I saw this dress and fell in love with it. Love, love, love. When I received the package in the mail, I was super excited and practically danced to my room to open it. The dress was lovely the hemline was a little off but I figured hey, it looks a little long and I'll need to hem it anyway so what does that matter? I put the dress on and instant heartbreak! While it skimmed very nice over my waist and hips, it was just far too tight in the bust. I wanted to make it work but there was just no way. The darling ruffles around the chest brought the wrong attention to my chest which was already illfitted. Wasn't a fan of the feel of the fabric. It's a shame too, as I loved the color and shape of this dress. It's on its way back now but I am super excited to make more purchases from modcloth.

review_summary: I like this dress a lot,
review_text: I like this dress a lot, except as other reviewers have noted, the sleeves are not cut very well. They are a bit too puffy/poofy and stand off the shoulder, so I tend to wear it with a cardigan. Other than that, it is lovely. I found the wait to be a bit tight, but that just gives me incentive to lose weight!

review_summary: It was a very nice dress,
review_text: It was a very nice dress, qualitywise, but the combination of the length, the grey color, and the ruffles made it look much too matronly on me. Had to return it.

I was really pleased with this dress. I am 5'9'' and relatively thin, so I'm inbetween a M and a S. I went with a S, and though it fits a bit snug in the waist, the rest fits exactly as I hoped. Length is just below/at my knee and the top comes up high enough to be modest. The fabric is slightly thin so I wear a slip with it. The skirt is delightfully roomy. A very dainty but classy dress, practically perfect in every way!

review_summary: I thought that I would lo
review_text: I thought that I would love this dress, becuase I adore the soda fountain dresses, but it is cut just a bit different.  The capped sleeves stuck out a little to far for me, and the skirt did not hang well on me and made me look odd.  The material is also thin, so you may need to wear a slip.  The fabric weight might be good if you live in a warm climate, but I think I would freeze here in Alaska.  I think it would be cute on the right figure, it's just didn't work for me.
love this dress. the material is this light weight linen so it's great for summer.
I abosolutely love this dress. The fit and length is perfect and the fabric is light and comfortable for a warm spring/summer day.
This dress is perfect for tall ladies! I agree with the reviews, the sleeves are a little big, but it is SO cute.

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress, but there's absolutely no give to this dress and my girls did not fit properly into the teeny top.  The skirt is long and has a lot of fabric.  It would be super cute on someone with a smaller rack.  I ordered the XL and I would try the 2X, but the XL was already a bit too long on me, so I can't even imagine what the 2X would do.  I'm definiely a size 14, sometimes a 12, so i don't know why the XL didn't work. I think it's just the fabric having absolutely no stretch or give to it.  It's going back.  Too bad  really liked the way it looked on the website.

review_summary: This dress was tight in t
review_text: This dress was tight in the bust.  Call it vain, but I refuse to order up a size just because of the bust.  The material was flimsy, wrinkly and the sleeves were too puffy and the underarm area was too gappy.  Overall, it didn't fit right nor was it flattering.  Sent it back.
Very pretty. The material would have lain better if it was a tad bit heavier but then it wouldn't have felt as nice. A little tight in the rib cage/bust but other than that, very nice.
The overall fit is great, I didn't expect it to be quite so long, and I have long legs so that's saying something! Nothing a little hemming can't fix!

I'm busty and was nervous about the buttons at the chest (button up things always gape which drives me crazy). But the picture was so cute I just wanted to give it a try. This dress didn't have that problem at all, which was very pleasantly surprising. So good for busty girls. In fact, there was a bit of room to spare in the bust (I'm a 30/32DDD, 135 pounds, and got the medium) It's a great, professional length  fairly modest while still being fun. The bow was pretty bad. But that would be easily replaced with a different black belt. And the sleeves where kinda funky, but not too bad. Probably nice for girls with wider shoulders. I was on the fence about sending this one back. But the overall look on me was just sort of hohum. Cute, but not overwhelmingly cute. On the right person I'm sure it would be great.

review_summary: I bought this dress in na
review_text: I bought this dress in navy a few weeks ago and fell in LOVE!!! So I also bought the grey version. It fits PERFECT!!!  The only difference is the material. It is a little rougher than the navy one, but this dress is still super comfy!!

review_summary: I was a little nervous th
review_text: I was a little nervous that the small wouldn't fit me but its perfect! The dress looks adorable on me and I could not be happier with it! The dress is classy and rests right below the knee; its just my taste!

review_summary: I had to try this on as s

review_summary: I am a size 16 and got th
review_text: I am a size 16 and got the 2X. I could have easily sized down, although I like that there is a bit of a room around the waist. What I don't like about the sizing is the length; I thought it'd end below the knee but it ends about mid thighs for me. The material is OK, although a tiny bit scratchy. Wore it with opaque black tights, red heels and a red lipstick for a bit of a colour pop and it looked great!

I just received this dress yesterday and wore it today to work. It's very feminine and cute. I like the lightness of it, though I would have liked a higher quality cotton, but nevertheless, this is a lovely dress for summer.

review_summary: I love this dress, I'm we
review_text: I love this dress, I'm wearing it right now actually! Overall it's a touch snug for my size. An extra large would probably have fit me better, but I am loosing weight and didn't want it to end up too big. I plan to wear this dress till it falls apart!

I'm pretty happy with this dress. The capped sleeves are very awkward, unflattering, and bizarre (I will definitely be altering them), and it's a bit difficult to get in and out of the dress (I'm a bit curvy so it has some trouble coming up over my hips, and it's hard to get my arms into the sleeves), but overall it looks really cute on me. The buttons (which are functional, thank god) do pull a bit across the bust, but in no way does it feel too tight. The length is really great, and the fabric, though thin, is not flimsy or seethrough. Would look great with a shrug or cardigan! Will probably be getting my own belt though because the one it comes with is pretty flimsy. But overall, looks pretty great on me!

This is now officially my favourite piece of clothing in the history of ever.  I read the reviews before buying and was sort of worried about the fabric quality but I thought it was fine.  The single layer to the belt didn't bother me at all, the belt in my opinion is more decorative than functional so the one layer does the job.  The buttons are adorable.  The fit was just perfect and it looked completely cute on.  The skirt fell to just below my knees (great!) and it sat very nicely too.  I think it would sit well with a little pettiskirt under it to give it a bit of oomph too but it definitely doesn't need it.  Probably my only 'complaint' would be that it's a little tricky to get in and out of over the bust, but that is probably my fault for going for the Small instead of a Medium (I'm usually a stock standard small in most clothing but seem to be more of a medium with modcloth).  It also looks great paired with a cardigan.  :)

Cute dress, recieved TONS of compliments at the office.  The cap sleeves fit a little odd and my chest feels a little...compressed in this dress.  Maybe not made for the very busty gal.  Otherwise, great dress at a fantastic price

review_summary: This is a very cute dress
review_text: This is a very cute dress. Perfect summer day dress. It is small around the bust; I am only a 34b and it was tight. Not uncomfortably tight so I am definitely keeping it!

review_summary: I really wanted to like t

I typically wear a small but this was just too tight. I thought about going up to a medium but then there was an issue with the sleeves. They were just too puffy, even in the small. I could take them in I guess but it just seem like too much of a hassle.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much. I would buy it in every color right now if I weren't losing weight. When I get down another size, I'm getting it in Coral.

I also did find the material cheap feeling and not worth the price tag, but I love the style so I will live with it. It look amazing on, I'm sure it will get a lot of use over the coming summer months.

review_summary: I am very excited to wear
review_text: I am very excited to wear this dress.  It is the perfect length.  I am 5' 11 and it falls below the knees!  The fabric is lightweight as others have stated but perfect for summer. This will be my favorite new work dress.

I ordered this dress from Germany, so I made sure to get the right size. I'm 1,76 m in height, weigh 65 kg and wear 80A bras. I ordered the dress in M  it's quite tight, but wearable. The quality is okay, except for the poorly attached buttons.

I get lots of compliments when I wear this dress!  It fits me perfectly, although the cap sleeves sit kind of funny.  I just toss on a cardigan and go.  I'm thinking of taking it to someone to just remove the sleeves.  The material is a little sheer for a sunny day, so I like to wear it with a slip.  But all in all, this is a very cute and comfortable dress.

review_summary: I loved the idea of this

Unfortunately, it was way longer than I was expecting it to be and I literally could not fasten a single button over my chest. The waist fit perfectly, the sleeves and back fit perfectly, but the dress just did not want to accommodate my girls. I would more than recommend this dress to any plussize girl who has a smaller bust than me because other than the top it was extremely flattering, but unfortunately mine must be returned. :C

review_summary: It just didn't work for m

Also I agree with some other reviews that state the sleeves look weird, they look like little wings because they puff up. I was sorely disappointed with the quality of this dress :(

This dress fits beautifully, worth every penny and more! The skirt is such a flattering length, and the small waist with bow means I can wear it with flats or hells without looking like I have dumpy legs. The colour is gorgeous, not drab at all, and the heart shapes buttons are really cute! I was worried the buttons were going to pull across my chest (my chest can get a bit squished in a small, but if I order a medium it sags everywhere else); I didn't have that problem at all. So glad I bought this, am considering buying it up in all the other colours, too!
Great dress. Was a little thin, but I wore it with a black slip and it worked perfectly. Even on stage under lights.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre

review_summary: This is a very classy but
review_text: This is a very classy but cute dress.  It was way too long in the torso for me, but it fit my daughter like a dream.  It is soooo hard to find cute dresses for teens that aren't trashy.

review_summary: When I saw this dress onl

I was expecting it to be a longer dress, which I don't mind because I work in a corporate office so modesty is important. I noticed when I was reading reviews that a lot of bustier girls mention how tight the top was, so I kept that in mind when I picked a size to order and went up a size, which turned out to be a good decision because it fits my chest like a glove, no way that a Large could have contained me. I love how it fits snugly but not too tightly but there is one problem... holy crap was it long. I understand I am shorter, roughly 5'4ish, but it comes down half way down my calf, which just makes me look stubby. Luckily, I think this is a job that can be easily fixed with a seemstress. It's a very femenine shape, I love it. I can't wait until I can wear it.

So I now have a size small still sitting in a box on my shelf... sadness... I'm not sure what i'm going to do about it... SIZE UP LADIES

I waited forever for this to come back into stock and I read review after review about this dress, and I fell in love with it even more. I took the sash and decided to use it as either a match hair accessory or might attach it to a hat.  Thanks for bringing it back Modcloth 3.

The material is wonderful and light enough to be worn year round with tights and cardigan for winter. Great buy  would recommend highly!
nice dress

review_summary: Based on the reviews I or
review_text: Based on the reviews I ordered a 3X.  I usually wear a 1X and in ModCloth a 2X.  The fit across my ribcage is very comfortable.  It looks fitted but it doesn't feel tight.  Because I am short the waist (line with the belt) matches my own natural waist and that makes me look slimmer.  I have fat arms and sleeves with caps are usually a problem.  I love the fit of the sleeves on this dress.  As I have a smaller bust the dress is a bit empty on that area, but it still looks good.  My only complaint (and it's not a big one) is that it's a bit long, but it's not matronly.  The heart shaped buttons add a bit of flair and youthfulness.  The fabric isn't terribly thin so I could wear this dress well into the Fall. I probably could have gotten away with a 2X, but this way I can wear the dress even on my fattest days.  I got mine on sale and that is a more appropriate price for the dress.
Love this dress

I have a smaller rib cage and a fuller bust, so the buttons pull just a little at chest, but nothing that sliding the buttons over a 1/4 won't fix.  For girls with wider hips and smaller waists like myself it is very flattering, pulling the attention to your small waist and away from the hips.  I like it better with my own little black cinch belt and a rose in my hair  =)  Great dress, great price, and I highly recommend it!!

review_text: A very cute dress! I love it's light weight material and especially the full circle shape!

review_summary: This was a very cute dres
review_text: This was a very cute dress that I would have kept except for the top. My busty frame was too much for it! But had I ordered a size larger it probably would have fit. I will be on the lookout for more of my size to come in.

Aside from one heart button that came loose a little early, I am in love with this dress. If you are wondering if it will be flattering (I'm a bit pearly and it is the one goto dress for when I want to feel pretty.)  It's professional, great for work, the classroom or presenting at a writers' conference, which was its first duty with me. I ordered the large and it fit really well.

review_summary: I love how the dress is l
review_text: I love how the dress is long enough to be worn at work ! Even though it goes beyond my knees, all I needed to do was alter it shorter and it fits perfect.  As mentioned in other reviews, the sleeves are a little puffy, but once you get used to it, its not too bad. I too found the belt a little flimsy, but all you need to do is replace it with a thicker black belt and it solves the problem! I love the dress! This is probably one modcloth dresses that I really like even though I've done other purchases before.

review_summary: Honestly I had a tiny bit
review_text: Honestly I had a tiny bit of buyer's remorse with this one. The ruffles and shape of the dress are adorable. The sleeves stick out too far, even with my broad shoulders. The length is just below the knees. And I usually wear a different belt with it because the one it comes with is too flimsy. So it wasn't all that I hoped for but still really cute.

review_summary: I read almost all of the
review_text: I read almost all of the other reviews before purchasing this dress.  I was pretty nervous since shopping online can be such a pain but I was put at ease by ModCloth's awesome return policy.  I was even more excited that the dress fit almost perfectly!  I agree with the other reviews that the sleeves kind of float but I don't mind it.  Just be sure that your bra straps are secure because otherwise the way the sleeves hit, it feels like they're falling down.  The sash is also something other girls have expressed concern about.  It isn't great and I plan on replacing it with a thick black ribbon and bow, something that won't get twisted and fold on itself.  All in all, I totally love this dress and got compliments on it all day :)

review_summary: The dress was a little sn
review_text: The dress was a little snug in the boob area,but other wise I love it!
Love this dress. Get compliments everywhere. So flirty and sweet.
dress arrived today and is already boxed to return  dis
Love it! So flattering, and great for warmer weather.

review_summary: I just got this dress in
review_text: I just got this dress in the mail and it is lovely.  It fits a little tight across the bust but I'm hard to fit because of my bust line.  Great quality but I had expected it to be a little heavier material.  Absolutely a keeper and really cute! I'm rather tall so the length is great on this one.

This is a supercute dress overall. The shape is flattering and it can be dressed up or down. The basic color also makes it a great candidate for pairing with bright and fabulous shoes and/or tights.  The fit is just a little strange, though. I find this dress incredibly difficult to get on. The side zip is one of those goofy ones that doesn't go all the way up, (why do designers use those?) and it's a struggle to get this thing on over your head. It's worse taking it off, and I'm always afraid I'll damage it.  If you don't have flexible arms and shoulders, do not attempt! Once on it looks and feels fine, though it is just a tiny bit snug around the ribcage.  I have a fairly small ribcage, so buyer beware! Overall though this dress is worth a try, and if it doesn't work modcloth has a super friendly return policy!

The material is a little thin and wrinkly but still a cute dress. The tie belt is a little cheap looking but that is an easy fix.I like the length  just below the knee. The top is a little tight on me but it works with the right bra or wearing a cami underneath. Overall a nice dress and great value. I am including my measurements because that always helps me choose the right size when I read other reviews!

This is a very flaterring and cute dress. I received so many compliments the first day I wore it! I was expecting the fabric to be a little thicker; you'll probably need a slip underneath. The biggest down side is that the dress wrinkles easily. Other than that, the cap sleeves are darling, the buttons in the front super cute, and the style in general is slimming and elegant.

I really liked this dress; it was just as pretty in person.  I had to return it though because I couldn't get it on.  The item didn't allow enough space (at least for someone with broad shoulders) to put it on.  I was afraid I would rip it either putting it on or taking it off so I gave up trying to get it on.  It's really too bad because it was adorable.

After reading previous reviews I ordered a large. In other dresses I usually order ammedium but since my bust is larger, 34DD I went with a large. It fits great! Its a great length, right below my knees(I am am 5'5'')/ However, the quality of the dress is so/so. The buttons were barely sewn on, the hems were stringy and the fabric is not the best quality. I will think twice about ordering from Modcloth again. Why pay 40 or 50 bucks for a dress in this condtition????

review_summary: Just a bit too tight in t
review_text: Just a bit too tight in the chest area.  Thought about finding a tailor to move the buttons over, but all the ones in my area only work 95ish.

review_summary: The fit is great on me.
review_text: The fit is great on me.  Going strictly by the size chart, I should have ordered an XL, but I noticed that lots of other people with similar measurements had gone with the L, so I tried that.  The torso fits quite closely, but doesn't gape at the buttonholes at all.I'm fairly tall, and it hit just below the knee.  Shorter girls might need to hem it a bit.As several people have mentioned, the sleeves are a little funkythe arm hole is pretty low, and the cap sleeve gapes somewhat.  I got this for an event and needed to wear it right away, so I wore a black shrug cardi over it, and it looked great.  I will likely try to alter the sleeves a bit, though, so they don't do the gape thing.Full disclosure, I also switched out the buttons for regular round ones.  I wasn't too into the hearts...With the black shrug and black maryjane style heels, it looked fantastic, overall. Slightly retro without looking costumey!

review_summary: I would have given it a 4
review_text: I would have given it a 4 but I'm pretty busty, and based on other reviews I got a large. Its still pretty tight across my chest. I have to leave it unbuttoned and have a cami underneath. The dress itself it cute, and flattering as well as the perfect length.

review_summary: I love this dress and rec
review_text: I love this dress and recieve so many compliments when I wear it. Just get ready to iron, though.

best fitting item ( besides another dress from here of a similar style) that I have ever worn.  Very cute.  One button is already loose and the arm pit holes are a bit too large, but not a deal breaker.

This dress fits me wonderfully. I'm always particular about where the waist falls in dresses because with my body it's unflattering unless it's right at the smallest point and this hit it perfectly. The fabric isn't too heavy and feels beautiful and the fit was perfect all around except the sleeves popped out quite a bit. It looks cute w/ an off white knit croptop.

The shape of this darling dress is quite perfect.  The sleeves are it's only real draw back.  Unfortunately, the arm hole is rather gaping and the cap sleeve sticks out in an unusual way.  I can't bear to part with it though, so it will just be worn only with a cardigan.

review_summary: The sizing is odd.  The d
review_text: The sizing is odd.  The dress is HUGE on me up top and in the sleeves.  The waist is perfect...  too perfect.  I wanted to return it for a small, but I think the waist may be too tight if I do so.  So, I'm hoping to find a GREAT seamstress to take in the top and cut a few inches off of the bottom.  This dress is WONDERFUL for us pearshaped girls!!!
The medium was perfect for me except a little loose in the waist (a typical fit for many of my clothes). The belt gives the perfect fit. After letting it hang, I barely needed to steam it!

I chose this dress because I own a similar dress with the same cut/style as this one and I love it, but unfortunately my 34D chest is was too big for the M fit and got smashed.  Not attractive at all.  I also don't like how the skirt kind of sticks out at the sides, which is why I'm not going to exchange for a larger size.  Very cute, just not for me.

review_summary: This is a very cute and f
review_text: This is a very cute and flattering dress!

review_summary: It is a little big in the
review_text: It is a little big in the waist, but otherwise perfect. I get lots of compliments each time I wear this dress. I love that it is versatile enough for work or a date!

review_summary: I was very excited to ord
review_text: I was very excited to order this dress, but unfortunately it's not for me. I found it very long, and the sleeves very puffy. It was also a bit too big around the mid section. The material was also a lot thinner than I was expecting  basically I thought it would be like the soda fountain dresses (which are lovely). Sadly I'll have to send it back.

review_summary: I wish I had read more re
review_text: I wish I had read more reviews on this dress. I know it's a fan favorite, but it was just too big on top.  The waist actually fit quite nicely, it made my waist look tiny.  That said, the sleeves and bust were way too big and it was too long for me. It is a lovely dress, just not right for me.  I'll be sending this one back.

review_summary: I have loved this dress s
review_text: I have loved this dress since forever, but when I opened up the package I was pretty dissapointed. There were loose threads all over, and one of the heart buttons was hastily sewn and didn't really fit the hole it was pulled through. The skirt was beautiful, and the waistline fit me perfectly without feeling constrained. The armholes were really big; not only could you see my bra, but the poofy shoulders were loose and not as structured as it seemed in the photos. I tried to remedy the armhole situation with a cardigan, but every one I threw over it poofed out all weird around them. Just not what I was expecting.

review_summary: I wanted to like this dre
review_text: I wanted to like this dress, but it just didn't work for me.  The skirt had too much poof/flare for me and made my hips look big.  The top portion of the dress was too small.
Perfection.  This dress was exactly what I was hoping for.  The waist landed just right and the length is right above my knee.  I love it!

Pros:  Great shape  very fitted at the waist and makes you look tiny.  Cotton will be good for summer breathability.  Nice and long  just below knee on my 5.7 frame  again, good for summer when you don't want to be showing a lot of skin.  I'm 34B, 24/25, 36.Cons: Sleeves stick out a mile  I would have to tailor them.  Also, the material is very thin.  Nude underwear is a MUST, and I worry about it in the sunlight....  It's a wellcut dress, and the stitching etc looks fine, but with the flimsy fabric I am a little concerned about it's longevity.  At the current price, it's not too bad.  A very very cute dress, and versatile!

I've been dreaming about this dress for a long time. I really wanted it. I finally ordered it in a size 3X, which from the measurements found on the size chart should have fit me perfectly. The dress is adorable and seems to be of good quality. However, it did not fit at all! I could not get the zipper closed all the way. The hips fit fine; the waist was a little tight, but the bust was severely tight! My breasts were smashed down. When I took off the dress, the seem below the zipper tore about 1/2 inch, so now I can't return it. Luckily, I'm losing weight. Hopefully it will fit eventually.

I just received this dress today in the mail! I was so excited I ran upstairs to try it on. Fits like a glove! I can't wait to rock it more when the weather becomes warmer in Washington, with a red head band and some red shoes. Looks great!
Professional enough for me to teach in, laid back enough for the weekend, this dress is absolutely perfect.

review_summary: I've seen this dress on t
review_text: I've seen this dress on the MostLoved page quite a few times, and finally decided to try it. At first glance, it just didn't quite work for me. The sleeves were awkwardly loose. They didn't even touch my shoulders! The length was longer than expected, and the fabric of the entire dress just thin and scratchy. A busty lady would have no trouble filling this dress, I'm sure. I wanted to love this dress, but it fit so strangely. It was not for me. Sadly, this had to go back. :(

I'm small... 5'2 around 100 lbs... and I ordered the small.  I've gotten dresses from ModCloth before and never had a problem with size, but this small is huge!  It's so big in the chest/shoulder area that there is simply no way I can wear it.  The waist doesn't sit quite right and overall the dress is too long.  I was really disappointed :(

Initally I purchased the medium in this dress but I found the bust area and waist to be to big.  I did a quick return and got the small in a matter of days.  I must be right between sizes because the small is a little snug around the bust but not enough not to keep the dress.  I think the fit of the rest of the dress is great and length is perfect.

I absolutley adored the look of this dress online.   Once I tried it on, I realized it just wasn't me.   It's just a little too cutesy.  I'm 32 and I felt like it just wasn't adult enough and knew I'd feel silly wearing it.  On the bright side, it fit amazingly well.  The length was perfect, it made my waist look teenytiny, and the fabric quality was pretty decent.  Wee bit snug in the bust, but not badno gapping button holes.   Unlike some of the other reviews, I didn't have any issues with the arms...thought they looked lovely.    I debated whether I should just switch out the buttons for a more sophisticated look and try a different belt, but realized the ruffles were likely the main culprit with my dissatisfaction.  Oh well!  You never know unless you try, am I right?!    I can see why people love this dress...just not quite right on me is all.  Luckily with the fabulously easy return policy, I happily sent it back.  On to the next modcloth purchase!

review_summary: I fell totally in love wi
review_text: I fell totally in love with this dress the moment I saw it. It fit like a glove, especially in the midsection. What broke my heart was that it was not flattering on me in the shoulders. The capped sleeves are very puffy and the collar is large as well. It created a weird sort of shrunken head look, with my shoulders looking enlarged by the sleeves (that didn't even touch my shoulders at all) and the large collar. It's so unfortunate because even as I have to send it back, I still love it so much! But I am just not broad enough in the shoulders for it. It's a beautiful dress, but not for me, sadly.

review_summary: I waited for this dress t
review_text: I waited for this dress to get back in stock for months!! It does run a tad large, but nothing I can't look past. Other than that, I have no complaints!!
I really like this dress! This was my first Modcloth purchase so I was a little nervous. I did notice that the skirt stuck to my tights so I would recomend staticguard. Great purchase! :)

review_summary: I'm not sure about this d
review_text: I'm not sure about this dress.  The fabric is a little thin for my taste, and the belt may as well not even be there because, due to the cheap fabric, it looks bad tied.  I suggest a skinny waist belt instead (if only I had one, haha).  The arm holes are very big, which is funny, because, while I'm usually very comfortable in a S in my other MC dresses, I had to say a seriously moving prayer to get the side zipper up on this thing, and it felt tight along my notlarge bust line. It's not small enough to order a M, but then.. I don't know. It fits well everywhere else but the arm openings and chest.  I guess it wasn't made for me.I want to like this dress.  I'm really torn as to whether or not I should keep it.  If it weren't for the poofy sleeves that look ridiculous, I'd probably just say, OKAY, I'M GONNA LOSE THOSE FIVE POUNDS, YEAH! and use it to track my progress.  Even the buttons annoy me.  I like the heart shaped buttons, but they aren't even sewn on well, and I'll have to secure them myself if I do decide to keep this dress.Some positives:It makes my waist look small.  I consider myself to be thick waisted, so that is a welcomed feature.  That plus the lovely, longer length (hits me at the knee) makes me want to keep it.  I feel that with some cute Mary Janes and bright tights, this could be a really cute look for me.I think this review made me more confused as to my feelings for it.  :)
This dress looks beautiful online, but in reality the quality of the fabric is disappointing  it's pretty thin and overall has flimsy structure. Sad to return it, I had high hopes for the dress :(

This is a very lightweight linen dress. It comes down to my knees and fits my larger bust very well...the buttons don't even stretch! The only weird thing is the cut of the arms...the cap sleeves are a little loose on my shoulders and the cut goes in over my shoulders in a weird way. But not so weird that I will return it.
