Looking forward to warm weather so I can wear this, as it's a bit too light for winter.

review_summary: I love this dress!  The r
review_text: I love this dress!  The reviewers know whence they speak  the material is a little thin and the sleeves sort of hover  but I don't care.  The dress's fit is slimming and perfect, and the full skirt makes me feel like an awesome fifties lady who is so smashing that glass ceilings shatter of their own accord.

review_summary: I have a long torso and t
review_text: I have a long torso and this is one of the only ModCloth dresses that actually sits at my waist, rather than up around my bust. Nice long skirt. Not too much extra material that it makes you look bigger or hippy. I get compliments on this dress wherever I go. Perfect! I'm a 36D with 30 waist and 34 hips (I ordered a large).
This dress is adorable on, fits my size 12 bod just right. Quality is great.

review_summary: This is a great dress wit
review_text: This is a great dress with a great fit, but I must take off points for the giant armholes. I'd been planning to wear it to work, but you can see my armpits and some side boob. The puffed sleeves make it impossible to wear a cardigan over it. However, it is a cute date dress and makes my figure look fab. I may be able to wear it to work with a long sleeved shirt under it. I am keeping it, but please ModCloth, let's see some better sleeves! This would be my favorite new dress if it had shirt sleeves or half sleeves.

Love this dress  so classy and the fit is extremely flattering! My only issue is the lack of a lining on the skirt  static cling like whoa!  This dress looks great with tights, but I don't own a slip long enough (it's a few inches past my knees, which I love).  When I walk around, the skirt clings and bunches around my legs. Not too sexy.  Hey ModCloth  you should offer some costefficient longer slips to help out the vast majority of the unlined dresses you sell!!! Or sell more lined dresses :) Other than that, the dress is awesome and you should buy it.

review_summary: Whereas the fit of this d
review_text: Whereas the fit of this dress was very flattering, the style left something to be desired. It's hard to tell on the small pictures but the ruffles, collar, and buttons are all very large. It was too overemphasized and almost cartoony for my taste. So in the end, I sent it back. If they ever tone down the on the flair, I would love this dress!

Lovely dress.  I always get so many compliments.  Normally I'd be a M but I had to go a size up (L) for it to fit across the bust.  However, the sleeves are ridiculously poofy (both M and L) and look way too big around my arms.  The buttons are a little difficult to button, and although the buttons haven't fallen off, they feel like they might at any time.

I read many reviews before choosing a size for this dress.  I am 5'2 and typically wear an 8 in pants, 10 in dresses and lululemon tanks, M in most tops/sweaters.  I'm 138 lbs, and 36DD.  So I often have problems with dresses fitting in all of the right places.  I really like the way this dress fits!  I do find it maybe an inch too long, but I am also short  :)  I might hem it so I can show off my legs a tad more.  ;)  I have a strapless bra which actually works better under this dress than the normal one I was wearing in the picture it minimizes my bust, so the buttons weren't as tight.  The sleeves are a little pouffy, but I'll get used to it the proportions make it look good.  I am happy with the quality of the fabric, too.   Can't wait to wear it out!

review_summary: i love this dress! i hard
review_text: i love this dress! i hardly ever wear dresses because i can never find one that fits right (or covers up the right spots) but this one is definitely a winner.It's a bit longer than i'd like. i also thought the bottom would be more frilly rather than just straight down. the waist fits me a bit snug. but overall, i love it.

review_summary: I've had this dress on my
review_text: I've had this dress on my wishlist for a very long time. I finally got it this Christmas (from the boyfriend). I absolutely love this dress. It totally gives off a vintage teacher vibe suits me perfectly as I am a future teacher. :) BUY IT!

This dress fits perfect in the waist, but definitely a bit tight in the chest area  if you are any larger than a C cup I would definitely size up and get the Medium as I JUST fit in the Small and I'm a 34 C. I did contact ModCloth before purchasing the dress to get the measurements  waist is 14 across lying flat, and the bust is 16. Even thought this dress is tight in the bust area for me, the way the buttons are arranged and the fabric of dress somehow allows for very little pulling and gapping ... there is a TINY bit on me, but I might just have to wear a specific bra to help solve that small problem. Still, it's a super cute, classy, retro looking dress. And the tie is cute despite it being a little flimsy  I especially think it looks darling tied in front and to the side.

Really like this dress but wasn't sure about size and went alittle over board since Im in between sizes got a 2X (big mistake), had to take it in alot but now it fits good alittle big still. It'll work, should've gotten it in XL. Perfect for work!

This dress is adorable! If your chest is any bigger than a 34 DDE get the next size up! (Barely puckers at one button but easily fixed by wearing a sports bra.) Tiniest bit loose in the waist but i use a patent black belt anyway. The cap sleeves are a bit big, but easily fixable  or you can just leave as is and wear a cute cardigan. Material is on the thinner side, but not see through, and I wear a slip anyway! Great first mod cloth buy  very happy!

review_summary: I have never had to buy a
review_text: I have never had to buy a plus size ever, but for this dress I will.  It is so cute on even when I couldn't fit my bust in the top. Returned but rebuying in a larger size.

review_summary: Because I have a fuller b
review_text: Because I have a fuller bottom half, I need to order Larges which usually results in a top that is too large. This fit just perfectly top and bottom. I didn't even have to take the hem up! I wear this with bright red pumps and it is too cute. So deleriously happy with this purchase!!!

review_summary: so i got this dress, and
review_text: so i got this dress, and it had just old out in the xl, what i normally would've gotten, and my grandma, who got it for me, and i decided to take a risk and get the large. it JUST fits. granted, this is after the holidays and a big holiday meal, but i couldn't wear a bra with it (good support through so it wasn't too bad). it gapes a bit, but not in a matter of lack of fabric, the buttons just pull. it is so cute though. i haven't worn it yet, but when i do. just watch out.

Lovely dress that garnered lots of compliments.  Perfect for the office, meetings or a stroll around town.  I pair it with a bright cardigan and some heels.  The sleeves fit a bit loose and I may have my mom take them in a bit.  Otherwise  perfect!

review_summary: Do not buy this dress. I
review_text: Do not buy this dress. I am very disappointed in this product. I do agree with the comment that the cap sleeves are large and so I was going to have my mother take them in a little bit. Before altering it I washed the dress ONCE (to take care of any possible shrinking) half of the black stitching on the ruffles fell off! My mother, who is very good at sewing has no idea how to even repair this damage and now that it has been washed I can't return it. So now I'm stuck with a $53.00 dress I cannot wear. Thanks Modcloth.

It's the 3rd dress I got from ModCloth, and again, it fits me perfectly! It's as adorable as the picture shows and I will be wearing it pretty soon for sure. The good thing is: I think I could wear it for a casual party, with some lovely shoes, to go to work or to a romantic dinner. Even to go to the cinema I think it can be perfect with a ballerina.

I returned this dress :(. I still think it's a darling dress but the sleeves were very weird on me. There was three inches of wiggle room which made my shoulders seem very wide. I got a medium and I should have gotten a small, because it was large on me everywhere which I found rather surprising. I figured this might be made like the soda fountain/hepcat dresses which are a bit loose in my waist in a M but fit me otherwise perfect which is what I was expecting here. I'd say down size if you're borderline two sizes. I still think it's a super darling dress, and the quality was fine. I was actually going to order a smaller size of it but it was out of stock.

I'm petite and ordered this dress in Medium. I think it could benefit from a few improvements to make it perfect: The medium size fits me just right at the waist, but the top is slightly bigger than my bust is. The sleeves are a bit wonky in their own individual ways, as well, so I may take them in a bit to make them less poofy. I might also hem the skirt portion of the dress to shorten it up to kneelength, because asis it's about 2.5 below my knees. Despite needing these slight alterations to fit my body better, I like the dress very much.

i really like this dress! i am tall, and was worried that the longer length would actually be an awkwardinthemiddlelength dress, but it is definitely long enough. the ruffles and heart buttons are adorable, and the belt ties at my natural waist, accentuating the narrowest part of me. the belt is, however, a little cheesy to me. it's just a long, thin strip of the same material that the dress is made of. this doesn't make me like the dress any less. the sleeves were not too puffy on me, like other reviews have stated. the material is not thick, but by no means is it too thin, either. i feel very precious in this dress.

This one gets 3 stars because the top fit wierd, fine in the bust but a lot extra material in the shoulders. I am short, and do sometimes have this issue, but this one is going to be hard to alter. Other than that, nice fabric and like the longer skirt.

It was very cute although a bit tight in the bust area! I bet you didn't know that there was a size K, but there is. Imagine that and being three foot eleven! It's a bit like carrying a small child.The dress is really quite lovely. Dozens of compliments.I did have to cut it up and add parts to it!Love you mod cloth,Grunda Shmee

review_summary: The bust was a little tig
review_text: The bust was a little tight, but everywhere else fit just right. I love, love, LOVE this dress!

review_summary: I'm a 34 A (almost a B) a
review_text: I'm a 34 A (almost a B) and this is a bit baggy in the chest for me, but it's still worth it because the dress is so classy and unique. It's perfect for my job as a secretary because the length is modest and the style is professional, but it's also something I would wear to the mall because it has a hint of playfulness with the heartshaped buttons and ruffles. I do with the sleeves were full instead of just covering the shoulder because then I wouldn't have to shave in order to wear the dress. Other than that, I love this dress!NOTE: In the pictures, I put on a long sleeve shirt underneath because it was a cold night.

Very cute dress and quality is in line with the price. The fit is pretty small in the bust and a little small in the waist. I am quite busty so it's too small in the bust even though I would normally wear XL2X (18) in most clothes. I'll make it work by wearing a cami and leaving some of the buttons open.

I really really loved this dress. I was super excited to get it for Christmas. I am petite and I thougt that the small would work on me. It was huge. The shoulders were way puffier than in the picture and you could see down the sleeves at some sideboob. I was really sad that It didn't look right. I had to send it back. For a small that is supposed to fit true to size it looks like it was made for petite, busty girls.

review_summary: I do love this dress and
review_text: I do love this dress and think its a wonderful addition to my work wardrobe. That being said...the quality left much to be desired. The material is thin and not very soft but the softness I'm sure will come after being washed a few times. The skirt portion is long (for me, a little passed my knees! Little long for my taste) but it makes it undoubtedly appropriate for an office. My biggest complaint is the size of those cap sleeves! My arms aren't tiny but I still feel like I can fit an apple underneath them when I have it on. It's nuts! I do, however, wear a cardigan with the dress anyway so it hides it well. If you wanted to wear the dress alone, you would need to get those things tailored. Without a doubt. It's a real cute dress though!

review_summary: This dress is a little lo
review_text: This dress is a little long on me (I'm 5'0 and the dress hits a few inches under my knees) but I think it would fit fine on a taller person. It's such a cute dress. I've had my eye on it for awhile and got it on sale and am happy with the quality for the price.

review_summary: This is a great little dr
review_text: This is a great little dress. The fit is large on me. I ordered a large and it is huge in the bust, and a little big in the waist. I will get it taken in though, as it is so cute. The sleeves are a bit big too  so these need tailoring (as another reviewer has suggested). I may have gotten away with a Medium but didnt want to risk it as it was my first order on Modcloth. I am from Australia and usually take a 10 top and 12 bottom, and this is probably a decent size 12 in Australian sizing. Cant wait to wear it in winter with some black stockings and boots to the office :)

I ordered a 2x thinking it would be slightly large, but able to be taken it. The waist should've been about 38, but measured about 35. It wasn't a good fit. Other than that the dress was lovely the material was light, but not flimsy. Because of the color and texture it can be worn all seasons. It's a very classic, retro style that hits just below the knee. Customer service was wonderful. Jenn F. immediately had another one sent to me and was willing to have a warehouse rep measure the dress before sending. This was my first order from Modcloth and with all of the cute styles and great service it won't be my last!!

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought a cardigan to go over it and it's perfect for work. The bust area is a little small, but i put a black cami underneath and just left the top couple buttons undone. I'm really happy I bought this dress!!

*FINALLY* Modcloth carries a dress that is actually a DRESS length!  I find it so hard to find a dress on this site that is an appropriate length for work etc. but this is it!  It does fit quick snugly in the chest, but luckily I don't have much to worry about there  lol!  The length is perfect,t the cut is stunning and the cute frill and heart buttons make it super cute and fun.  SO excited to wear this everywhere!

This is a gorgeous dress! I do some issues with it though. The buttons seems flimsily attached though if they pop off that's easily fixed. The skirt is much longer than I expected and I'll probably end up taking it up a few centimetres. The bodice is a bit looser than expected and may need to be altered, and the sleeves are enormous, just as other reviewers have said! Why not exchange it for the next size down, I hear you ask? Well, I'm in Australia so it's not really a feasible option. It's just so pretty I'll have to make it work!

review_summary: I loved this dress as soo
review_text: I loved this dress as soon as I saw it. I was looking for a retro type day dress, and this was just screaming to me. The dress fit me well, except in the bust, because I just am rather well endowed in that respect, and I always have issues with that in anything I buy, especially with things with buttons. But the dress was so cute and looked great on  I am so glad I went this this dress! I would definitely recommend :)

Ladies, dont size up for this one. I saw that it said it ran true to size, but because some of the measurements were closer to a size large, I bought a large even though I was technically a medium. The dress came too large but they were out of mediums, so i tailored it myself and it worked out fairly well.

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this dress. Unlike some other dresses on Modcloth with similar styles, this one hits my waist line correctly. It looks absolutely adorable and is perfect with a cardigan. I love how long it is too! Finally a dress I feel comfortable wearing even when I have to sit down. ;)

review_summary: This is a great dress tha
review_text: This is a great dress that really accentuates an hourglass figure. I'm 5'5 and 135 lbs, and it totally flatters my waist while draping nicely in the skirt to minimize my wider hips. I did struggle to get the top two buttons to do up over my 34D bust, but for a smallwaisted girl with a larger bust, that problem was nothing new. Luckily it looks really cute with a black camisole underneath. The cap sleeves did hover over my shoulders in a weird way, but that was an easy fix. In terms of quality and cuteness, this dress is well worth the price.

This dress is beautiful!  It is a little big in the chest...but so am I.  I could have fit into a small, however it is 100% cotton and may shrink slightly.  Overall I'm very happy with this purchase.  You can dress it down or create a fancier look depending on how you accessorize.  I know this dress will be worn often.  This is my first purchase from modcloth and I'm very pleased!

What a bummer, I finally ordered this dress after looking at it quite a few times but it ran pretty small.  I am 5'7, 155 lbs and I am a size L in Modcloth and this was skin tight in the ribcage area.  Sending it back.  Might want to change the true to size to runs small.

review_summary: I am 5'7 and this dress w
review_text: I am 5'7 and this dress was PERFECT!  I feel like I can't do the supershort dresses anymore, and finding longer dresses is a challenge.  More like this Modcloth!  I did size up so it fit in the chest area and it is perfect.
heart buttons are cutesy

review_summary: I am in love with this dr
review_text: I am in love with this dress!! It fits perfectly, and the length is so flattering (for me, it's right at my knees). Normally I'm a fan of bright colors and tend not to be interested in neutral dresses, but this dress is my happy exception. The gray has a varied texture that keeps it from looking flat and dull, and the black lining on the belt and ruffles breaks up the shape to give it some definition and interest. And while the dress looks beautiful on its own (especially with such perfect tailoring!), it's easy to dress it up or down and make it your own with colorful shoes, tights, jewelry, or hair accessories. I plan on wearing it yearround!!

This fit my shape rather well but gaped between the middle two buttons from my bust size; the sleeves puffed out a bit too much (and I have larger arms!), and I think the frilly front was a bit much since I'm busty.  I was concerned about that before ordering but you never know until you try  love that ModCloth makes it easy to return!

review_summary: I love the look of this d
review_text: I love the look of this dress. It hits a bit below my knees. The fabric has a thicker linen feel to it. Overall it fits good but the chest. A padded bra will not work and makes the dress too tight. The zipper is also hard to pull up in one shot. Although it its great it all the other areas it is tight on my ribs, maybe I just have a large ribcage, and I have to be careful while taking it off to not rip the zipper. I've never had an issue with a true to size L from ModCloth fitting like this. ( I just make sure to unbutton in totally first.) I dislike the cap sleeves but was planning to wear this with a cardigan anyway:)
This dress is wonderful!  A+ on a tall, slim figure!

review_summary: it is a bit loose on top
review_text: it is a bit loose on top and i will have to get a slip since it is see through. I'm also going to have to hem it since it is about an inch or 2 below the knee. I should have gotten a small.
Great dress, not a great color on me, so I'm returning.
LOVE this dress. the cutest little number! i love it and can't wait to wear it out. the color is great, as is the legnth. So happy that I bought it!

This dress is super cute! I am a teacher, and this is sweet enough to make me feel fun, but covers enough to be workable in. The length for me is great, but anyone much smaller might end up a little swapmed in skirt :) The postage was great too. I am Australian and even with the new cheaper shipping option my clothes arrived in 8 days!

review_summary: This dress was not what I
review_text: This dress was not what I was expecting. The sleeves were way too big, and the felt very cheap and thin. I just don't think this dress is worth the investment.

This dress definitely runs small. I usually take a 1X with Modcloth dresses, but this one I ordered up because there is no 1X, and the 2X is definitely not a larger size! It is a *very* snug fit at the moment. Definitely size up if you're in the plus sizes.

Fit great, nice just past the knee length with a lovely cut and drape. I wish the arm holes were a little smaller, because they show a bit of my bra, but that's my only gripe. Also, I got a medium, because the Small sizes always fit everywhere but my bustthe medium works fine with a belt. Wore it to the ballet with a fascinator, gloves, and wrap and got a lot of compliments. One of six mod cloth items I own, and I'm happy with all of them so far.

review_summary: I am usually a size 4 in
review_text: I am usually a size 4 in dresses, but decided to go for the Medium and it fits perfectly! I was worried that I wouldn't fit in the bust area, but that's not an issue. Beautiful dress! Very figureflattering.

review_summary: I love it!  As you all kn
review_text: I love it!  As you all know I am short and small chested, but everything about this dress is perfect on me,  I just need to wear a padded bra (34C) so it will look better =).  It comes 34 inches below my knees which is good because I can wear it at work and church. Just like Elizabeth said, except the sleeves are little big, but I can I hide it with cute cardi=).

review_summary: I love this dress. I orde
review_text: I love this dress. I ordered to my size, but since I have a large bust, it fit perfectly in the waist, but was to small in the bust. I truly needed an XL for the larger bust. I sent the large back and got a 2X, because they were out of XL. I just had to take in the waist, but the bust now fit very well. I just wish that the XL was available, because that would have fit just right. I still love the dress, the cut of it and the style. Overall a great purchase.

review_summary: So, this may run true to
review_text: So, this may run true to size in the smaller sizes, but I have no idea what happens once it hits above an L.  I got an XL, and it was SO small.  The zipper on the side could barely reach the halfway point and I had to undo like, three buttons to just breathe even at that point.  Going to try and exchange it for the next size up because this would be perfect for work.  If you're going to buy this dress and you're an XL or up, remember to size up!

Most dresses allow for the fact that women have hips.  This one is very odd  the span of the shoulders seem to be equal to the span of the hip area  very odd.  So it fit great at the waist, too small in the chest, and waaaaaay too big in the neck/shoulder area.  I looked like a football player!  Not for busty girls.  Too bad, as it's an adorable style.

Very cute dress. I ordered a medium but it ended up being really big on top. Did a quick return the next morning (call lasted less than 5 minutes) and the new one was sent that day. Sleeves do float as one reviewer said and the waist is quite tight. The material is also thin, but being so cute, I love it. The easy return and great service made the purchase even better.

I was super excited when I got this dress.  I love everything about it except, its a little tight in the chest, but if i unbutton the top button it doesnt pull at the buttons. That was what I was worried about when I was trying to decide what size to order.  If you're on the busty side, you might want to go up a size.  The sleeves are a bit poofy if your arms are at your side, but you do have complete range of motion of your arms, which is a major plus.

review_summary: LOVE THE LENGTH! It is ju
review_text: LOVE THE LENGTH! It is just so elegant! Fantastic dress, my only qualm is that I really should have gotten a Small. I was afraid that it would have been too tight in the chest, but now my waist is swimming Medium and I think I could have gotten away with the Small in the chest after all... I think I may get it tailored at the waist as I'm in Canada. It's actually cheaper to get it tailored to fit than it is to pay for the shipping for the exchange!! :(

The first dress I ordered fit me great everywhere except for across the bust area.  I'm a 38C so not usually an issue.  I returned (very easily, I might add) for the next larger size and it fit beautifully!  I adore this dress!

review_summary: This dress is a bit more
review_text: This dress is a bit more paper thing and I was expecting  which is a little bit frustrating since I bought it to wear to a rooftop party in the fall. However, with a cardigan it is really nice and I can wear it to work  tons of compliments and the heartshaped buttons are cute. The one thing is the arm holes are weirdly big and low, but again, with a cardigan this doesn't show.

review_summary: This dress was cute but i
review_text: This dress was cute but it just was too big all around. The length was way past my knees, so that was the biggest issue. I wanted to love this one, but the length of the dress really threw me off. Plus the sleeves were really puffy. I think I could have sized down for this dress, but I wasn't sure if I liked it enough to exchange it.

A little thinner material than I was expecting, but still super cute! Seemed sturdy enough anyway. Based on the style and cut, I ordered a small. It fit fine in the waist and hips, but the bust was a little small, so I exchanged it for the medium. Hopefully it will fit perfectly.

I do love this dress...it's great for the office and great for going out with friends. The sizing is perfect for a fitted dress, but it does make it hard to pull on at first if you've got curves. I'm not thrilled about the sleeves (wide arm holes and cap sleeves so it exposes the under arm and a little more flesh), but really I'm usually wearing a cardigan with this dress so it's not a bit deal. I  love the style and this is the first dress that buttons up over my bust. I really hope that ModCloth puts out even more plus size dresses in the future.

review_summary: When I wore this dress, I
review_text: When I wore this dress, I got compliments all day!

review_summary: Not as bad as the soda fo
review_text: Not as bad as the soda fountain material, but very cheap...At least I can wear it again...Though I wear a thick belt...I am glad the torso area is longer than the Soda dress...Okay, but material could be better...

I ordered this dress yesterday and it came nextday even though I only paid standard shipping. I wanted to love it so much, but when it came  well it's hardly true to size. I had to squeeze and contort my body in ways I've never had to in order to get a dress on, and it just wasn't happening. This is weird, as I've ordered this size from Modcloth before and it is a little big on me  I like dresses a little big for the comfort. Will be returning, very sad.

According to the size chart, I am normally a 1X. My measurements are 433545. That said, this dress did not come in my size, so I ordered a size up, figuring I could always get it altered if need be. So imagine my surprise when I tried to put it on and found that the WAIST, of all places, was too small. My waist is 35, and the 2X is supposed to fit up to 39! The bust was also small, to the point where the buttons were pulling. My chest is 43, the 2X is supposed to fit up to 46. Either the dress I got has the wrong tag on it or the designers need to take a better look at the sizing chart, because it's as if I ordered down a size, not up one.The dress is beautiful; I didn't have problems with the sleeves like some other reviewers did, and the heartshaped buttons are extremely cute. The length is just a tad below my knees (which is where I like it) and it is an overall wellconstructed dress. I'm just wondering why a girl who should wear a 1X according to the size chart needs to buy a 3X in order for this dress to fit properly! I guess I have to exchange this... I really wanted this dress in time for this weekend, too.

After purchasing this dress, it took me some time to warm up to the heartshaped buttons and super puffy sleeves. But, my reservations were quickly put aside when the compliments started coming in. This is the perfect work dress. It falls below my knees, is made of a quality fabric that does not require a slip underneath, and is shapely without being obscene. I am most impressed by the color. When layered over bright tights, the gray pops and shimmers. I wore the dress with magenta tights, black flats, and an ivory cardigan and could not have been happier!
Fabric is much lighterweight than what I'd expected.  Length is great but armholes are very large and required altering so that my bra wouldn't show.  The heart buttons are really cute.

It's cute!  I'll give it that.  But it is just WAY too large on me.  I am 5'3, 102 lbs. and I was swimming in the small.  It was also long, like past the knee and since it was so big, it was just too much material.  Not sure why some reviewers, who are shorter than me didn't have a problem with it, but there's my review.  First return I've had to do so a little bummed, but happy returns are free!

This is my new favourite dress! It's extremely flattering and feminine  Perfect for work as it falls just below my knees. I've gotten so many compliments on this dress. I'm in between size Small and Medium but I got a size small and it fits perfectly. The waist is a little tight but its not uncomfortable  the fit of the dress actually makes my waist look really small. Sorry about the fuzzy picture, but hopefully you can see how it looks on. Overall one of the best dresses I've bought from Modcloth so far :)

review_summary: Best dress I've got so fa
review_text: Best dress I've got so far. Even though it's a little on the long side, it fits the style of the dress just fine. Wore it with a 3/4 sleeve cardigan and black opaque tights and felt quite snappy. I recommend this dress to anybody looking for a modern take on a sophisticated dress.

review_summary: I was so excited to get t
review_text: I was so excited to get this dress. It was something I could wear to work, but still feel young and cute. Unfortunately, the sleeves were huge! They made my shoulder look very broad and my head like tiny. I played around with different options: getting it tailored, trying a smaller size, but in the end I just decided that I didn't love the dress enough to try to make it work. I returned it.

I adore this dress! When I first tried it on though I found it a bit loose. The skirt part of the dress seemed to be a lot of fabric and the shoulders were loose. My solution: washing it and putting it the dryer at a medium heat (even though the tag says handwash and line dry). It really brought the dress together. Now it fits perfectly. Even the length was taken up a little.

review_summary: I ordered a size 2x but i
review_text: I ordered a size 2x but it is a bit too large in the arms and waist area for me. I wish I had ordered a lgxl but a 2x was that was left in stock. It's not a huge deal for me. A tight belt will fix this issue. Overall, it's a lovely, classy dress! Happy with my purchase!

review_summary: I love this dress! I simp
review_text: I love this dress! I simply cannot stress that enough! I bought this for our family photos this year for a cute/quirky/trendy twist, and it when it arrived on my doorstep it was everything I wanted and more! It fits perfectly from top to bottom and I will definitely be wearing this every chance I get! I'm hourglass shaped (kindof small up top and wider at the hips) and this fits me like a glove. I definitely recommend this dress! Two thumbs up, Modcloth!

I received so many compliments on this dress! The quality is quite nice, the fit was right on, and the length fell to below my knee, which I was especially looking for. I paired this dress with a cardigan sweater and heeled oxfords and felt great. Oh and the armholes are large enough that you can move comfortably without the garmet rubbing against your underarm (important for swing dancing!) but not so big that they show anything they shouldn't. I am SO pleased with this purchase!

The design of this dress is much more appropriate for a junior wearer than a misses. When it arrived the above the knee length and heart buttons didn't seem to say to me mid30s professional woman so I returned it with no intention of exchange. It seems to run small and was much too tight in the bust for me.

review_summary: This dress is a bit big,
review_text: This dress is a bit big, but it'll be ok.  It's not perfect, but not a bad price.

I was really excited about getting this dress when it came back in stock.  As a whole, I am very pleased with how it fits, feels and looks.  But I will say that I agree with what folks are saying about the fit of the shoulders; I think I will most likely end up taking it to a tailor to have the shoulders brought in a little bit  I'm worried I look a bit like a linebacker with how they are now.  But I love the rest of the dress: the length is great and very appropriate for work, and I love the color and fit (I usually teeter between small and medium, but I went with medium with this one because I didn't want my boobs to be busting out of the sweet heart buttons, which was a good decision in the end).
Amazing dress; the effect is incredibly classy. A small fits perfectly.

I normally find modcloth items to fit on the small side so I was very pleased that this dress came in larger sizes as an option. I was afraid that the bottom half would balloon out but it just flows smoothly. I'm so excited to wear it with some red heals and a black cardigan!

I'm a size 18 (Australian) and it fits perfectly. Can't do up the top button but that's ok, I'm an E cup so I'm used to that! The length is perfect on me (right on the knee) but might be a bit long for most (I'm 178 cm tall). have worn it with black tights and boots but it looks great with bare legs too! Very flattering on a large frame.

Adorable!  The fit is very flattering.  As I wear it, I instantly feel like a '50's gal in a soda shop!  Fun!  My little brother actually remarked that I looked like a lovely schoolteacher.  Perfect.  There were some loose threads on the ruffle detailing, but nothing some scissors couldn't snip off.

This dress has equal good and bad points.  First the bad points: Heart buttons?? If I had known that, I don't know if I would've ordered it. It makes the dress immature, but luckily, everyone I've shown it too doesn't notice unless I point it out.  Also, it's very tight in the chest area, but fits perfectly everywhere else, making sizing up not an option.  The material is thinner and cheaper than it appears in the photo and really makes the dress a bit overpriced. And I agree with the other reviewers that sleeves are awkward. But...... It does have a very nice shape to it, great length and makes your waist look very tiny.  I tried it on with some tall boots and a cardigan and it looked so good, I'm deciding to keep it. It was touch and go for a while though, but overall I think it will be a nice fashionable ensemble for work.  I have to say, I love most of my Modcloth dresses, but I am getting frustrated with how tight they all are in the bust. Hopefully I won't pop a button on this one!

Adorable is the best way to describe it. The heart shaped buttons add a bit of whimsy and love the length of the skirt so I can wear it in the office with or without stockings. The fit was perfect for me too. I have thin arms so the cap sleeves caused me no trouble at all.
This dress was so cute!... except for the sleeves. I really loved this dress, but the sleeves totally ruined everything.

review_summary: This is a nice and breezy
review_text: This is a nice and breezy dress that feels like a rough cotton blend. It fits me like a glove, but it's rather hard to take off lol. The belt looks good, but it would benefit from ironing it every time. My one complaint is that the capsleeves do stick out quite far, even with my quite broad shoulders... It's easily fixable though. I think I might just over lap the material and stitch a black button there so it looks like it was there on purpose lol. Thanks Modcloth!

review_summary: This is how every dress s
review_text: This is how every dress should fit. Modest yet doesn't hide the fact that I'm a lady the way it covers my chest, but doesn't bury it in fabric and the dress perfectly shows off my waist. The details make me feel so girly and the color makes me feel professional.  Love this dress for work and play.

I bought this dress, expecting it to fit all around, but I could close up zipper all the way because of my bust. Definitely try to size up if you have bigger boobs, ladies! I'm pretty sure you can use the waist ties to help decrease the look of any extra material elsewhere. Lovely dress, though.

review_summary: I really had high hopes f
review_text: I really had high hopes for this dress, but it didn't live up to my expectations.  First off, it was an awkward length for me, which isn't a huge issue since it could be easily hemmed.  My biggest issue was how incredibly thin the fabric was!  Also, the bust was a bit snug on me and the sleeves puffed out in an awkward way making me look like a linebacker.  It's gotta go.

review_summary: I'm only rating the fit a
review_text: I'm only rating the fit as just right because it was only the chest that wasn't quite right and I find in general that the chests of shirts never fit me so if you are below a 40DDD you will probably be ok here. I have pretty narrow shoulders so the sleves didn't sit funny on me at all and I actually liked the sleeves because I have big upper arms and usually sleeves cut into them, but these didn't. As I mentioned the chest was quite tight on me, the buttons gap a bit (but not so much I've pinned because I'm afraid a button will go flying) and the dart on my bigger breast does sort of make a weird line. Neither of these things was so bad that I felt I should exchange the dress, but if you've got a pretty big rack you might want to size up. (I bought the 2X.) The rest of the dress fit perfectly. I have a tiny waist compared to my chest and hips and rarely do I find things that sit properly and fit properly around the waist so I am so excited. If they would make this exact dress in other prints and colours I'd buy one of them all. The length is perfect for work. Others have complained about the belt, but I think it's fine (though I wish this either had proper belt loops or just none at all becasue I'm not feeling theflimsy single strand ones which always look terrible if you deside to go beltless) The dress also looks cute with regular belts too if you want something crisper.

Lovely lovely lovely dress! Gets a lot of compliments, especially on heart shaped buttons. The leaves are quite poofy, more so than they appear. Also had a few loose threads I had to cut, but no unravelling has occured from this!

review_summary: For me, this dress fit gr
review_text: For me, this dress fit great on the top but was very baggy on the bottom. You can sort see in the picture that there is a lot of material on the bottom. It looks really nice in the pictures people have posted but, for my body shape, it was very unflattering.

review_summary: I think it's time to admi
review_text: I think it's time to admit that for me, ModCloth is going to have to mean shoes, bags and accessories. It's incredibly frustrating to continue to purchase clothes here in hopes that this time they will fit, and having that not be the case. I am a size 14/1X, though I have items in my closet ranging from a size medium to a size 16. I have never, according to any other brand or store, ever, been a size 3X, yet the dresses I've ordered here in a size 3X have never, ever fit me.  This one in particular was so tight around my rib cage that I could not zip it. Even before I'd attempted to zip it the buttons across my chest were gaping. I am a size 40DD, and have a relatively small waist, so I don't think it unreasonable to expect a size 3X to fit me. I realize that this issue is primarily due to manufacturers, but it would be great if ModCloth could do a better job of selling clothes that fit ALL women, not just tiny ones.

My disappointment with this dress has more to do with my own personal taste than the dress itself. First, the things I liked: it fit great, the length was perfect (as a tall girl, things tend to be short on me but this dress hit at the knee) and the quality was what I would expect for the price. Unfortunately, the ruffle/collar combo just ended up looking awkward on me and was not to my taste  I think if it had been either or, it would have been fine but having both was just too much for me. However, one negative that can't just be attributed to personal taste were the cap sleeves: they poofed out very oddly! Maybe I just have skinny arms and shoulders but the sleeves just did not fit right and the arm holes were a bit too big.Anyway, this probably would be a great dress for others but it just wasn't what I was looking for so I will be sending it back.

I finally ordered something from here after I have wanted to for so long and I was NOT disappointed. The dress is fantastic, I can dress it up or down and it fits great. It is a little larger in the shoulder bust area but the waist and length are perfect! Thank you so much Modcloth for offering these fantastic dresses in all sizes!
Slightly tight at waist. Belt a bit flimsy, but still cute. Button holes sewn poorly and buttons will soon have to be resewn (had it about a week). LOVE the dress anyhow though.

review_summary: This dress fits me like a
review_text: This dress fits me like a glove. It's very flattering overall and is a nice length hitting just below my knees. The fabric is thin for summer and if you paired it with a sweater, it could be worn yearround. The only thing I didn't like were the cheap heart buttons on the bodice..I immediately switched them out and it's so much better. Heart buttons? Really? I'm not 12. That was easy enough to fix though. It's a very sweet dress. I highly recommend it. If you happen to be my measurements; it will fit you like a dream!

LOVE this dress!! I'm an athletic 41year old young woman with broad shoulders and the L was perfect!  Great length for taller ladies, very retroclassy.  Fabric is a bit thin but nothing a black lace half slip can't fix.  This one was a big winner for me...thank you, ModCloth!

review_summary: I love this dress! I'm qu
review_text: I love this dress! I'm quite short (5 ft. 2 in.) and the small falls about midcalves.  I always wear them with heels so it's fine.  The waist tie falls at just the right place, giving it a nippedin look.  The dress is of good quality and I absolutely love it!
Lovely dress, great length and definitely work appropriate!
This dress is VERY comfortable but the sleeves need to be taken in.

review_summary: This dress is so cute. Un
review_text: This dress is so cute. Unfortunately it fit very, VERY small in the bust so this will be an exchange. I'll have to go up two more sizes to get it to button.

review_summary: It was a bit tight across
review_text: It was a bit tight across the bust, but otherwise this dress fit perfectly. I returned it because I couldn't really afford it right now after all, but seriously, it's a beautiful dress. A bit too westernish for my style, maybe? Very professional looking, though, and the quality is great.

After falling in love with this dress online my fiance bought it for me :) I'm an Australian size 12, and the large fits nicely. Yes, it's a little seethrough in the skirt (when held against light), BUT I'm planning on wearing it in summer so the breezier the better (Australian summers... 'nuff said). I plan on wearing it as a teacher, so the longer length is appropriate  some may feel the need to take it up, especially if you're verticallychallenged like me, however if 'professional yet cute' is your aim, pick this dress.The sleeves sit a little awkward, but that's nothing some strategic ironing can't fix.This will be my graduation dress at the end of this year, and hopefully the dress in which I secure a fulltime teaching job! Altogether a gorgeous little dress for the price, and fits very well.(btw for any Australians, I'm a 10/12 DD bust  couldn't work out the US equivalent  so hopefully that might help someone!)

review_summary: I love this dress!  It is
review_text: I love this dress!  It is a little snug but looks really good on my frame.  Makes your waist look super tiny :)  I do wish there was lining in the dress, though.  the material is rather thin.  But you can't have everything, right!?

This is a very flattering dress  except the sleeves which are very peculiar! It's fine right now during winter when I can wear a cardi, but I'll have to tailor them before summer starts.  The silhouette is very nice though, and while the price is a little steep for the quality (not too bad, but a couple of loose threads, slightly warped seam), I know I will get a lot of wear out of it.

review_summary: I wanted this dress for a
review_text: I wanted this dress for awhile and when it was back in stock, I had to get it. It's very beautiful and true in color to the picture. However, it did not fit properly on me and I had to get it altered a few times. (Glad my father's girl friend is a seamstress and did it for free). I found the sleeves to be way to broad for my shoulders and sort of awkward. The torso was too long that the tie and where the last button ended was above my hips and not flattering. The length was below the knee, but after being altered, the sides of the bust were tightened, the sleeves were taken in and made tighter and two inches (the last button area) was taken out completely making the dress two inches shorter. Now it fits great!

review_summary: I was hesitant to get the
review_text: I was hesitant to get the Medium but for my pear frame, it worked perfect.  I am very pleased with the dress: the cut, the details, the skirt length.  The only reason it isn't perfect is the fabric.  It's not as thick as I hoped.  I live pretty far north so this dress will be in the closet from Dec to Feb.  Otherwise, fabulous!  I love it!  Just need shoes now!

I was fully expecting to love this dress, but after putting it on, it was just okay.  The material isn't the greatest quality, but it's not horrible either.  The buttons are cute, and I like the overall style of the dress.  However, the skirt was too long.  I could have taken it up a bit, but I wasn't sure I liked the look of it anyways.  I just felt so drab wearing it.  I didn't hate it, but I didn't love it either, so back it goes.

I was a little dissapointed for the first time with this purchase, the dress is lovely but it runs large in the chest, it was very loose, I ordered a small (maybe a xs would've been perfect for me!) I had to adjust it from side to side, the sleeves are also kinda wide. I'm not returning it because after I adjust it doesn't look that bad, I'm also wearing it with some little shirt or tank underneath, it's so loose on the chest it feels like the dress is dancing on me :/

The quality of the dress is very very good. I was surprised at how light the fabric was. The overall fit was great, but the bust area was too small. My size F bust is hard to fit through the dress to slip it on and is almost more than difficult trying to get off, but when I got into it, it felt very nice and I looked great! I'll start getting sizes bigger than usual to fit my bust; My grandmother knows how to hem so I'll have to take future orders to her to size parts down.

This dress is really cute, however it is a little too tight in the bust area for me. I am hoping to lose a few pounds anyway, here is hoping the girls shrink a little. Otherwise it is adorable and something I would wear to work or interview in.

review_summary: The sleeves are a bit too
review_text: The sleeves are a bit too puffy for my liking, but I wore a little black cardigan the first time. I think I will bring the sleeves in a bit on my own. Everyone loved this dress though! The details are perfect and I am very very happy with my purchase.

review_summary: Its a nice dress and coul
review_text: Its a nice dress and could be used for any casual occasion. It's a little tight on and would recommend going a size up for more room in the arm and chest area.

review_summary: i was SO excited to get t
review_text: i was SO excited to get this dress for a big meeting at work. Alas, it did not fit. I'm 5'7 and 230, and usually wear a 2X. ordered the 3x because the 2 was out of stock. Well, i couldn't fit into the 3 either! (which is indicative I need to stop eating, not so much the dress's fault.) it is ADORABLE in person, and i did not have misaligned buttons like some other posters. I got it on and zipped, but it pulled across my chest and was just not attractive. so sad!

review_summary: I am in love with this dr
review_text: I am in love with this dress. I had to sew the button up area so it wouldn't gape (I have a large chest). And, like others, I replaced the flimsy belt with a structured black belt. Super cute and flattering on my curvy figure.

This dress was *ROBBED* of being epic by way of cheap material and workmanship.  I drooled over this dress for months, watching and waiting (im)patiently for it to be put back in stock.  Imagine my disappointment when I puled it out and realized how cheap looking and feeling it was.  The fabric was seethrough, the edges and seems were haphazardly stitched and the sash was one layer of cotton and so flimsy it *floated* when I dropped it.  I was too busty for it even in an XL despite that being a full size up for me so I would have had to wear it unbuttoned or risk an incautious movement pulling the top two buttons out of their holes.  The fabric was a rough, thin and slightly seethrough cotton.  The cut had potential and the dress looks darling, but it is no where near worth $50.  I probably wouldn't have spent $20 on it if I saw it in a shop.  Note that it has a side zipper, I completely missed it in my first attempt to put it on, but the placement of the zipper made it practically pointless. Returned.
I always get complements when I wear this dress.  It was a little large around the waist but easily fixed.

review_summary: The dress is very tight i
review_text: The dress is very tight in the rib cage.  Everywhere else the fit was spot on.  I will need to get this dress one size larger in order to wear it. :(  I normally wear a size 18 and am 5'9.  I took measurments, but the dress is a little smaller than the size quoted.  Very cute love the way it looks.  Hopefully Modcloth gets the 3X in soon, becuase I want to wear this dress so bad.

The armpits feel a little funny with this dress. I think there is a little extra fabric there that might be okay for someone with more chest. Otherwise, a very nice style that seems like it would flatter most figures. It's not lined though, at all, which make it rather pricey for the quality. I don't know if I'll keep it, but I'm thinking about it.

I was really excited when this dress was back in stock. The dress is very cute however I find the sleeve unusually large and it will require alterations. I'm and 5'2  I find the dress a little on the long side which will make my legs look too short unless I wear it with super high heels. The material is also a bit lighter in weight than I anticipated.

This is my third purchase from modcloth and I am very disappointed. The arm holes are absolutely huge. My entire side of my bra shows. The waist fits fine but get's tight again near the stomach. Also, I'm from Canada and have to pay a lot for shipping and won't even get my shipping back and they don't even offer free exchanges for canadians. Will definitely be ordering from other dress sites from now on.

review_summary: If there's one thing to b
review_text: If there's one thing to buy on this site, it's this dress.  A perfect fit, and looks beautiful on just about anyone probably!  The material's 100% cotton, and it feels super light, so perfect for summer or spring wear!!!

This is my first purchase of clothing online and I am really happy (I ordered this plus 2 other dressed and happy with all). I was worried about the sizing as my measurements are difficult to fit but this dress works perfectly and is very flattering to my not so small waistline. I am not a huge cup size and the bust fit me perfectly so if you are a large busted lady this dress might not be so good, although I think it would look cute with a singlet under and top button left undone. For the price I do thing the material is thin and the sewing, especially the buttons, is a bit suspect. However I sew so its no big issue for me to fix. The belt twists on me but the dress looks awesome with a wide black belt  gives a nice hourglass figure. Overall, I am a bit dissapointed with the quality for the price, but I am in Australia and I am keeping it 'cause it fits well, is really cute, and is different to what I could buy in the shops here. Plus it only took 7 days to get to me! Thanks Modcloth.

review_summary: I normally am fine with s
review_text: I normally am fine with size L at ModCloth but something made me feel I should try the XL in this dress. I can tell you I am SO glad I did. It fits just right. It's great quality, a superb length (I wore it to work today and got so many compliments!) and the little details like the cute buttons and the puffed sleeves make this dress incredibly adorable yet very smart at the same time. My friends, my Mum and my boyfriend all like it, so that's saying something!BUY THIS DRESS WHEN IT'S BACK IN STOCK!

review_summary: I love this dress! The ca
review_text: I love this dress! The cap sleeves bite in a little but I have broad shoulders and expected that. I love the fabric, the length, the style!

Super cute dress.  I wanted it to wear it to a summer wedding but once I got it I realized that I preferred a more colorful fabric so I did return it.  BUT I loved the dress and was sad to see it go back. I liked the button down option because I am nursing my infant.  The buttons are hearts, I would have replaced them because they seem to look more appropriate for someone under 25 (I'm 33).  It's unlined, a mediumlight cotton and would be great for work in warmer weather and adorable layered up in colder months.  The fit... it RUNS SMALL.  I'm often a 1x in dresses at Lane Bryant with fuller hips and smaller waist.  The 3x fit like a dream. This dress is great for hourglass shapes.  I wish I had a use for it and didn't have to send it back.

review_summary: I love this dress, it fit
review_text: I love this dress, it fits my torso perfectly! I am slight of frame and I got a small, my torso is a bit long and it fit me great. It is a thin lightweight material, which I like, summers are hot here and it will be good for work during summer.

I was really looking forward to this dress, because the last dress I ordered from ModCloth (which is also the first one I have ever ordered) I LOVE.  However, with this dress I was let down.  I found that though the mid section is formfitting, it is a little too formfitted.  I am only 100lbs and had a hard time taking the dress off because of how it is sewn at the waist (even when I had all the buttons undone).  My husband had to help me get out of the dress (and not in a sexy, turnhimon kind of way).  More than being unhappy with the cut not working out, I was very disappointed to learn the material seemed very thin and poor quality.  Cute style, I had my hopes up to wear it to work, but not impressed with it in person at all.  :(

I bought this dress when it first came in stock and i love it! I got a small and it fits almost perfectly. It's very snug in the bust area and the buttons pull a bit.The only only only thing I don't love about it is that you MUST iron it if you're planning to wash it. It gets wrinkled VERY easily. All in all, a very cute, affordable dress(:

review_summary: I usually wear a M in dre
review_text: I usually wear a M in dresses, but the M was a little tight across my chest (strange, since I'm only a 34B  I don't consider myself busty). The L fit well, but unfortunately, it just wasn't very flattering. I have broad shoulders, and the dress's poufy shoulders made that all the more evident. I hate returning the dress, but it's just not for those of us with square shoulders! I'm sure it would be very flattering for most others. Otherwise, I liked the material  lightweight, but not flimsy. The buttons seemed a little tacky in person (would've preferred a simple circle), but buttons are easily changed.

review_summary: This is not for busty lad
review_text: This is not for busty ladies!!  I sized up after reading the reviews because I wear a 36D.  This just did not work well with the shape of my body overall it strained across my chest and did not sit right on my waist because the rest was too big.  :(  I wish it would have worked, because it is really cute!

review_summary: I am so sad that I have t
review_text: I am so sad that I have to send this back. The 3X fit me perfectly in the bust, but this is definitely fitted for ladies with a more defined waist than me. This dress does run small the 3X has a bust size at around 44 and a waist at around 38 according to my measurements, both of which fall under 2X on the size chart. The quality is okay, but nothing to write home about.

review_summary: This dress was much too s
review_text: This dress was much too small in the ribcage/bust area. Too bad because it's nice material and very cute! It was a little long as well, if I had kept it, I would have shortened it a bit. It's a little below my knee and I would prefer at the knee. I wish I could keep it, but I can't zip it up so I'll be sending it back!

I absolutely LOVE this dress!  It's cute enough to go out with friends, and dressy enough for work.  The skirt fit perfectly at me knees.  I did have a couple problems, the sleeves are a little weird (I tend to wear a shrug over it anyway) and I found it a little tight across the chest, but for those who have a smaller chest this shouldn't be a problem (I'm a 36 C).  It also can get wrinkly and the bow is a pain to iron, but over all I LOVE this dress.

I'm still loving this adorable dress to bits everytime I wear it and have received SO many compliments it's so chic, and elegant, yet fun and flirty, every girls dream for the best 'all round' dress to wear! I honestly believe that every girl would look fabulous in it, because it it flatters every figure (I am tall though, and love the length, but it still looks great on my friend who's 5'1!) I'm waiting and hoping for a Small to come back in for my sister, she loves it so much. Pro's the full circle skirt, adorable stitching, cute as a button 'heartshaped buttons' tiebelt and fitted waist. the cap sleeves are so unique (yes, there's a bit of gap under the arms) but all in all, I wouldn't change a thing. The material is comfortable and the colour way nicer (almost a threaded grey,black). best bit wearing it with black heels, or since it's winter here in australia, patterned tights with Ballet flats and pearls and a black or red cardigan. If you're after a demure but fun and sexy dress, try and snap one up! and at a great price! Totally worth the shipping;) this will be in my wardrobe forever. Thanks modcloth.

This dress is adorable!  Unfortunately the one I received was definitely NOT true to size.  It's at least one size smaller than it's marked or it doesn't correspond to the measurements in the size guide.There's no stretch since it's 100% cotton, so I'd recommend going up one size if you're worried about fit or in between sizes.
This dress is very cute!  Wore it with some great geen pumps!  can't wait to wear it again!

review_summary: You can wash it with no s
review_text: You can wash it with no shrinkage. I have an issue with the area around the arm hole and bust, weird gap, but no one has seemed to notice. Husband states I look like a naughty librarian when paired w/ knee socks and loafers. Dress comes to knees, and works great for my smaller waist and big hips. I normally wear a XL here, but ordered 2X after reading comments, runs small, but 2X fit perfectly. Wrinkle easily and belt is cheaply made, but easily forgiven, due to great length and cuteness factor.

review_summary: This is a great dress! Th
review_text: This is a great dress! The cut is very flattering, it sits at my natural waist and the overall fit was spot on  for us curvy girls that is a difficult feat! The fabric drapes nicely and has the right about of weight. The sleeves did poof up a little, so had it altered. I also changed the heart buttons – while it is a cute detail, I felt, at least for me, it was just a little too much. The minor alterations created a nice balance between fun/flirty and sophisticated. Very happy!

This is a beautiful dress but it didn't fit.  It's rather snug through my breasts so it pulls and gaps.  I suppose I could've gone up a size, but I followed the size chart and bought an L.  I would say it does NOT run true to size, Modcloth.
One of my favorite dresses! Flattering and fun!

I'm 5'10, 150 lbs, and this dress fit great.  The fabric is not the greatest qualityit split apart not on a seam the first time I wore it.  However, ModCloth was great and quickly sent me a replacement, which has held up just fine.  I really like how cute it is :).

review_summary: I ordered the XL since th
review_text: I ordered the XL since that is usually where I fall in size. The bodice is really tight and short, but the dress itself is cute, if a little thin.

review_summary: I like this dress a lot.
review_text: I like this dress a lot. It's a little long for my tastes, but it's always good to have something longer for more formal or official occasions. I haven't had an opportunity to wear it yet, but when I tired it on it fit perfectly!

Love, love, love this dress! Like the other reviewers already said, the fabric's on the thinner side, but not seethrough and the puffsleeves are huge (I'll have to look into getting them altered). But other than that, it's the perfect dress. Thank you modcloth for offering some longer dresses, I'm 5' 10, so a lot of the shorter ones would just look obscene on me.

review_summary: Very cute. A bit tight ov
review_text: Very cute. A bit tight over the ribcage. Looks good on its own or with a cardigan. Works for small and large busted girls. Overall, a great dress!

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favority purchases from Modcloth.   It fits perfectly...the length is awesome for work.  I wear it with a cute pair of red round toed pumps and get lots of compliments!

This dress is perfect for my student teaching coming up!  It is below the knee and professional while being fun for the elementary students (cute heart shaped buttons!).  I do need to iron it before wearing but that only helps to keep it crisp and professional looking. I am 5'7'' and 140 so I got the medium! It fits like glove. Sorry about the terrible quality photos!
Adorable dress.  Ordered a M, and have a 34 D chest...only one time did my boyfriend have to tell me that a button popped open!  Other than that, fits well and have received multiple compliments.

This dress is definitely my new favorite!  The measurements were spoton and fit like a glove.  (Just make sure you're measuring in the correct spot on your waist.)  The length was exactly what I was looking for, and just right for work.  I would describe the material as a thick linen, which would be great in the summer, but I was also able to wear it on a chilly day with tights and a cardigan.  Didn't wrinkle nearly as easily as my other linen dresses.  Just LOVE this dress!

review_summary: I loved this dress the mo
review_text: I loved this dress the moment I saw it, and still do! I bought it as a dress for work ( teaching) and it is pretty and professional. It was really long, so I got it hemmed, but it is a simple cut so it wasn't expensive to alter. the material is light so it will be perfect for spring and summer. :)

review_summary: I love the look of this d
review_text: I love the look of this dress! The waist is a bit higher than I thought it would be but I love how the skirt swishes when I walk in it. I'm larger in the chest so it's hard for me to find a good fit in this type of dress but it's just too cute to send back. I'll just wear it with the buttons undone and a tank underneath for now until I can have a tailor let out the bust darts. I agree with the other reviewers that the sleeves are pretty big for their shape but again, it's nothing a tailor can't fix.

This dress had great reviews and it looks really cute online so I bought it. The dress was way too long on me and the shoulder sleeves are too poofy. The material of the dress is mediocre. Definitely returning this item.

review_summary: This dress fits me like a
review_text: This dress fits me like a glove. It's like it was made for me. I bought a size medium and I am a size 810 Australian. My husband said wow when he saw me try it on. I love the dress but the quality is just okay. I'm actually quite scared the fabric might tear when I wear it out. I'm even going to leave a back up dress in my car in case I need to change if I'm wearing this dress out somewhere and it does tear.Postage only took about one week to Australia which is faster than usual. Usually when I buy from overseas it takes about 3 weeks, but postage is much cheaper. I'm guessing one of the reasons the postage is expensive is because it arrives faster and is safer and also it arrives in a box not a satchel.I love this dress! The style and fit make up for the quality!

review_summary: I am so pleased with this
review_text: I am so pleased with this dress. It came very quickly after ordering it and the material is super comfy. The length is a little longer than a lot of the dresses on this site so it is very office appropriate, but it is also very flattering to the bust area. Looks great with black stockings and pumps and has a sort of sexy librarian feel.

review_summary: This is my new favorite d
review_text: This is my new favorite dress!  It fits perfectly from the waist through the bust.  I agree with other reviews that the cap sleeves are a little superfluous but I generally like them.  If I ever change my mind they are easy enough to remove.

This fits me perfectly...no wiggle room, but that's ok.  I didn't realize the buttons were hearts...they are ok but not really my style so I am changing those.  Other than that very fixable thing this is very cute.  Good for summer!
Lovely.  Easy to just pull on and go.  Long enough to not need a slip, conservative enough to wear anywhere, but still pretty and different.
I ordered a 2xl here and it runs much smaller. It is a pretty design and but it tight at waist (and i have an hourglass figure) and at chest.

This is a really wonderful everyday dress! The material is lightweight, but doesn't feel cheap, the fit is well tailoredthough for me it is a little snug in the chest, a larger size would have been too big in the waist. Overall I'm very happy with this piece!

review_summary: This is a great dress, al
review_text: This is a great dress, although I agree with other commenters about the size issue.  I'm 5'9, 34D, and usually wear a size 10 and bought a Large in this dress.  The length of this dress and overall cut is fantastic  it's very flattering and long enough to wear to work (hits my knee).  But the top is a bit tighter than I'd really like.  I would return for a larger size, but the armholes are a bit on the large side, and they would be positively gaping if I went up a size.  As another commenter suggested, I will probably just wear a cami underneath and unbutton the top to give a little more breathing room.  Still happy with the purchase, though.

A really wonderful dress! One of my favorites from this site! The belt is fairly cheap looking and personally i think the dress looks better without it. Also..being 5'2 it was a little long on me, so I had it hemmed. The material is on the thin side, but not thin enough to need a slip or anything.  But overall a really cute and flattering dress. And as someone said earlier, it looks really cute with a little cropped cardigan! Thanks Modcloth!
Fits like a dream...a very good dream...love the buttons...accidentally ordered a M but received the S via exchange quickly

review_summary: This is such a cute dress
review_text: This is such a cute dress but sadly it is not for me. The puff sleeves stuck out too much it looked odd and the fabric felt thin and scratchy. The belt is flimsy and the finishing details like the overlocked edges were unpolished (loose threads). Sizing was a bit of an issue  I took a medium based on the generic chart and the buttons gaped.Needless to say, the dress was returned.

This dress is incredibly cute. I ordered the small and it fits perfectly, I love how small my waist looks in it. It falls a few inches past my knee, I might take it up a bit but I haven't decided. Overall, I really like this dress and I can't wait to wear it!

review_summary: Small was way to snug aro
review_text: Small was way to snug around my top (see measurements). I think a medium would have worked but I didn't feel that the quality of the material was very good.

Overall, I'm pleased with this dress. It fit perfectly although I had to be rather careful with putting it on as the zipper on the side is in the middle of the fabric and I had to unbutton all the buttons and pull it over my head  usually my hips are too big to pull dresses up over my bum. There were indeed loose threads, but I can just snip them. The buttons *were* a little off kilter but not enough to be noticeable. The fabric felt light, but it wasn't transluscent on me like others claimed it to be. It fell below my knees  a perfect length for me. I don't like showing cleavage or any thigh whatsoever so it was nice that there was actually a dress in my size that I'm happy with  I don't know why people complain about the material/length when it's listed in the description  it looked perfect on me and it was flattering although I do want to invest in a better belt for it. All in all, I am happy with this dress  I ordered Today I Met the Perfect Boot to go with it and they're awesome as well.

review_summary: This is a sassy little nu
review_text: This is a sassy little number that fits me snug as a glove!  I adore this dress.

review_summary: This is a great dress, li
review_text: This is a great dress, light, very flatering and excellent for work.  And just the right length coming in just below the knee.  Will get a lot of wear.  thanks ModCloth!

The dress was great except for the cap sleeves.  They sat so oddly on my shoulders and I kept trying to pull them down.  They seemed to float above my actual shoulder line!  The length was okay.  The buttons seemed to be sewn on crooked, so that the hearts were all slightly offkilter.  Honestly, I would've kept the dress if I had any sewing ability, as it is super adorable.

review_summary: Initially I bought a L, b
review_text: Initially I bought a L, but there was a gap in the buttons on the bust so I returned it for an XL. It fit much better, with just a little gap in the armholes. The length was perfect for any occasion, and it looked great with my pointy red shoes. HOWEVER, it's a very flimsy material, and the belt kept folding over on itself and making me bulge a bit too much. Then I noticed a hole above the zipper where the seam had split open!Sadly, I decided to return it. The material was just too flimsy and I didn't want to return it for a second time and have the seam split on me again. Don't worry ModCloth  I'm still a huge fan! 3

The dress was great except for the cap sleeves.  They sat so oddly on my shoulders and I kept trying to pull them down.  They seemed to float above my actual shoulder line!  The length was okay.  The buttons seemed to be sewn on crooked, so that the hearts were all slightly offkilter.  Honestly, I would've kept the dress if I had any sewing ability, as it is super adorable.
Perfect, sweet. Love this dress.

review_summary: I usually wear a 1X in dr
review_text: I usually wear a 1X in dresses on this website, but being since this dress didn't have one and I read a comment saying that the 2X fit a waist size 36, I decided to order a 2X. Unfortunately it doesn't fit.  I could get it on (barely), but it was tight enough to show dents from my bra and pantyhose (which is not flattering), and I had some stretching happening at the buttons. However, the cap sleeves fit right, the detailing it adorable, and the fabric is better quality than some of the other dresses I've purchased (although it has no stretch). So I'm going to suck up my pride and see how a 3X fits.Long story short they should have this listed as runs small not runs true to size. So make sure to order up a size or maybe even 2.

review_summary: I was a bit skeptical whe
review_text: I was a bit skeptical when I bought this dress (my first order from ModCloth!), but when I tried it on I was surprised by how well it fit and looked! It fits almost like it was made just for me! (5'3, 130lbs) The material looks good and everything (buttons, zipper, etc.) is secure.  I can't wear it right now because of the Colorado winter, but this will be one of my favorite pieces come spring!

review_summary: LOVE this dress!  It is a
review_text: LOVE this dress!  It is absolutely adorable.  Fits me very well and hits just below the knee.  As others have said, the fabric is thin but not seethrough.  I just wish the skirt were lined though.  Otherwise, perfection!

This dress fits perfectly. The material itself is not poor quality, but the fact that it is unlined and the belt is simply a strip of the same material makes it less nice. I knew all this prior to purchasing it however and I have to say that with a different belt or no belt at all, and a slip underneath, it will be one of my favourites.

My favorite purchase from ModCloth yet! It's quite the lovely dress, pretty good material. The zipper works pretty well in comparison with other ModCloth products. My only complaint is it's a tad hard to get out of. Other than thatI definitely recommend it!

review_summary: I love this dress! The he
review_text: I love this dress! The heart shaped buttons are adorable! Thank you ModCloth for making look like a real lady!
This dress just fit weird on me.  The waist was too high on me and the heart shaped buttons were difficult to close because of their shape. I am 5'3 130lbs. Cute dress but I had to return it.

review_summary: Love the dress, but it wa
review_text: Love the dress, but it wasn't a good fit for me and I felt like my hips stuck out too much (maybe I'm overly self conscious?). I'm 5' 3.75 (that 3/4 inch counts!) and the medium bodice was a bit too long on me (bodice is 16 inches, back of neck to waist). I wish it had a couple of pleats on the skirt to make it flair more.

Overall, this dress fits me pretty well.  In a large, it's a little tight through the chest but fits my waist nicely.  For reference, my chest measurement is 40 inches and my waist 31.  According to the size chart I should have gone for a size or two bigger.. but then the waist wouldn't have fit as well as it did. The length is great!

review_summary: I like this dress, it was
review_text: I like this dress, it was my first purchase on modcloth. It just fits in the bust, meaning there is no room, but the buttons aren't straining to keep my chest in :)i can wear it with or without a bra, but i recommend wearing a very thin bra if you are busty and got the xl. overall, that is the only issue. the cap sleeve is slightly bothersome for me, but i think a quick stitch or two will fix that annoyance. This dress was born to be worn with an apron.

review_summary: This is my new favorite d
review_text: This is my new favorite dress! The large fits perfectly. It's very flattering to hourglass figuresthe midsection emphasizes my slim waist and the skirt hides my large behind.

review_summary: This dress is just too cu

review_summary: Cute dress.  I am a curvy
review_text: Cute dress.  I am a curvy gal and it hides my hips well.  The top is really form fitting and the cap sleeves are a bit to big but a cute fall dress.  Its more of a casual/work dress then going out sort of thing but super adorable none the less.

review_summary: Very cute dress!  For a m
review_text: Very cute dress!  For a modcloth dress, it's actually pretty long, but I like it for this dress.  I'm 5'3 and it goes down to around the knees.  The material is somewhat thin, so it would make a better spring/summer/fall dress, although could possibly work in the winter with a sweater.  The buttons are a bit juvenile, and I'm thinking of replacing them.  Otherwise, I love the dress and think I'll get a lot of wear out of it.
Very cute and flattering!! I highly recommend this dress, as it fits perfectly.

But the chest is still too tight! I'm sending it back and ordering a 3XL in hope that it'll fit around my chest. The necessary alterations will be totally worth it! :)

review_summary: I don't think I have ever
review_text: I don't think I have every been so happy with a dress before. The quality of the fabric is nice (although the fabric is thinner than I thought, more of a spring, summer, or early fall weight) You might feel a little silly climbing into the dress, but fits me like a dream. I am a little busty, so most dresses gap and pull on the buttons, but this doesn't at all. And the price is fairly low! I recommend it to everyone.

review_summary: I have only worn this dre
review_text: I have only worn this dress ONCE since receiving it in the mail 2 months ago. Not because it disappointed in real life, and definitely not because I grew sick of it. It was because one of the sleeves ripped after 3 hours of my wearing it!!! Right under the left armpit, horizontally across towards the bust, about 1.5. And all I was doing was reaching over to get my handbag before getting out of the car! I am heartbroken! I was so excited when I got this dress, and it fit me perfectly.

The rest of the dress is perfect.
