I'll agree with some that the belt is a bit thin, but I am going to try starching just the belt. Also, the sleeves do seem a bit large, but otherwise I love the cut, the fabric, the style :) Definitely worth the wait :)

review_summary: A very pretty dress. It d
review_text: A very pretty dress. It does feel a little Amishesqe due to the length [hits me below the knee] but my platinum hair offsets that enough, I think. It is flattering on my hourglass figure, it makes my top half look very small due to the big skirt. The cap sleeves are nice too, not too tight like many others I have run into. Plus how can you pass up heartshaped buttons!

review_summary: I looked at this dress fo
review_text: I looked at this dress for a long time before I finally bought it, debating whether or not to get it.  But I'm so glad I did.  It's really cute, and at a modest length, too!  It fits wonderfully.  I have a long torso, so I wasn't sure if the S would fit, but it's perfect!  I'm a 34A/34AA with a 26 inch waist and 35 inch hips, and it fits so nicely.  The cloth is nice, a little seethrough so a slip is necessary, but on the whole the quality is very good!  The only reason I didn't put perfect quality is because there were a few strings that I had to cut off and the sleeves aren't quite the same on both sides, but that's easy enough to fix.  I would definitely recommend this dress.  My first ModCloth purchase, and definitely not my last!

LOVE this dress! My boyfriend couldn't stop complimenting me when I had it on which is always a good thing! It is modest with cap sleeves and it ended at my knees (I'm 5'9).  It is very comfortable and fits true to size. I am so glad I bought this dress!!
Fabulous dress  great fit, very flattering.

review_summary: Such a cute dress, I feel

Also, I think the supershort puffed sleeves look kinda dumb; I'd feel compelled to hide them with a cardigan, which would kind of thwart the perfectforsummer thing. Alas.
This dress is amazing.  It makes you look good and feel great. The size worked out great.  Just throw a petticoat underneath for some extra swing and you are good to go.

review_summary: I ordered this when it we

It just seemed like too much fabric for my small frame, but because I am a 36C, ordering down would have me busting out of the top. Will be sending back, but sooo cute!

review_summary: I'm not quite sure why an

I am a little short and mostly torso myself, but this is a little below the knee and an ideal length for me. In addition, I have broad shoulders and am still very comfortable in this dress. Would go great with flats and heels/wedges (short or tall). Pairing suggestions: You can dress this up or down easily with black, red, yellow, gray, burgundy, or beige/tan/taupe shoes. Any bag, specifically a clutch, shorter shoulder strap, or handbag, will accompany this well :)

This is the first crossover neckline I've been able to wear that does neither.  I love wearing this dress; I've gained weight in my middle as I hit my midthirties and it's very flattering, highlighting a nice (but again, not excessive) decolletage and emphasizing my waist.  The sleeves are also the perfect short length without being cap sleeves.  My only problem is that the extremely soft and comfy fabric shows wash wear really fast.  I've washed it probably four times and it's already so fuzzy that I probably would wear it only as a casual, comfyathome dress now.  I really love it for the sale price I bought it at, but wouldn't be as happy with it if I'd paid full price.

I probably should have sized up on this dress to accommodate shrinkage (my husband tried to do me a favor by tossing it in with his stuff so it'd be ready in time for a function I was going to wear it to and subsequently shrunk it quite a bit more than if I'd done it separately with cool water/air dried it) I did find it showed every lump and bump but maybe that is because of how much it shrunk, and wouldn't have done so if I'd sized up. Oh well, it worked out ok in the end but I did end up wearing shape wear underneath to smooth everything out. This probably wouldn't be necessary with a larger size and/or for someone smaller than I am. It looked wonderful on and I got so many compliments from everyone. Even complete strangers stopped me to what brand it was/where so had bought it from so it was more than worth the trouble. I wore it dressed up with a black camibra underneath for coverage, opaque black tights, black wedge heels, and silver jewelry but I think it could easily be worn more casually as well with a belt, leggings and boots in the fall or winter or some strappy sandals and sunglasses for warmer months. It's super soft and comfortable too, even with being shrunk before first wear and if it hadn't been an important occasion, I probably wouldn't have even bothered with the shape wear at all. I definitely will be ordering more colors when they come back in stock in the size I need.

I am a paleontologist, and when I saw this dress, it was a musthave. I tend to fall between a S and a M in Modcloth sizes, and I didn't want to risk buying the wrong size and then having it sell out (which as of right now, it has!), and so I bought it in both S and M. The photos are attached, the skirt of the M is a nice length (hits right above me knees), but it is too large for me in the waist and chest (in one of the pictures I am pinching the excess fabric in the waist, about 12 inches). The small is the perfect size in the body (again picture attached), though the skirt is shorter (about 23 inches above my knees). Since that doesn't bother me much, I'll be keeping the S and sending the M back. If you are like me and smaller in the chest, then the small is the way to go, it doesn't seem to squeeze too tight in the waist. But if you are a bit chestier, I'd go with the M. Also, if you want the dress to hit your knees, order the M and then have the top tailored to fit better.Another thing I noticed on BOTH dresses they keyhole in the back of the dress was not symmetrical, and zips more towards the left than the center. It isn't egregious enough for me to return it, but just something to keep in mind as it is a little strange and consistent on both dresses!Overall, I love this print, very jungle safari with hidden dinosaurs everywhere! Quality seems nice, if you really like the print, then it is probably worth your purchase!

The fabric is soft and stretchy and a little weighty, giving it a feel of great quality. The flare of the skirt is fun and flirty (a word I totally wouldn't use to describe myself normally, but that is how this dress makes me feel!) My *only* complaint is that the belt is a little flimsy and I'm not sure if it'll last, but so far, so good (and the charms on it are too cute and also a very fun detail).  I'm not a shopper and not always that into dresses, but I really am kind of obsessed with these!

I am usually a small in most dresses and tops or a medium if it's tight fitting. The material is flattering on the body and starts to flare out at the perfect spot. I got plenty of compliments from the green dress in one day!

This wonderful dress was just as described and has been one of my favourites since I got it! The fit is nearly perfect for me, but is a little long in the torso. Also I was surprised by how much fabric there was in the skirt  this is a full circle skirt!
Everything about this dress is amazing! I will be buying more ASAP; it fits like a glove and is extremely high quality. If you're thinking of buying it, don't hesitate any longer!
Good quality, fit was alright, but wow this looked awful on me.

This dress is beautiful.  It is made from a heavy fabric with and a quality gold zipper.  I use the belt from another Closet dress that I like better, but I am in love with this dress. I wear it mainly to work with a short sleeved, scoop neck shirt underneath (I hate exposed armpits at work).  I own five Closet dresses now and I will continue to collect them all!

What an amazing dress! I wore it to a convention and received compliments all night long. No gaping at the bust or waist, the quality of the material is great and to top it off, the belt is really cute. length is slightly long on me but that only makes the dress look dressier. Need to find more places to wear this dress!

review_text: I love love LOVE this dress! I've already gotten it in purple, green, red and the black/white dice...I'm eventually getting every color. One word, ladies....POCKETS!!!! It's the perfect blend of fun and dressy.
Windy day? Hold the dress down, but it's an amazing fit and make you look super slim!

Be careful which deodorant you use, because like any black dress, it will show. This dress looks great with or without black tights and can be complimented with any color. It is incredibly versatile. Overall, excellent dress and fit, and I am in love with this purchase!

review_summary: I bought this dress as pa
review_text: I bought this dress as part of my early Black Friday shopping. I wore it for an event at my work and it was a huge hit! I've never gotten so many compliments! The fit description is dead on! It's the first time I've ordered something with a UK size and the trick is to subtract 6 to get the American size. This dress is extremely well made and the fabric feels expensive.  It is an extremely flattering shape as well. There are also hidden pockets which are very hidden and don't show or look lumpy as pockets sometimes can. This dress is more than worth the price and I am dying to get some of the other colors.

The LBAL dresses are hit or miss with me. Even though they're all the same cut, some seem to run small, and some seem to be made out of heavier material than others. This one, however, is perfect! The material is light and flowy and it fits TTS. I usually wear 4 in dresses and a UK10 fits perfectly. I own a few of these dresses because I always feel so cute and sexy when wearing them. The brand, in case you are wondering, is Closet.

This dress is wonderful. I bought it for New Years Eve and it was everything I'd hoped for. The material is very comfortable and thick but not heavy. The dress is tight in all the right places and loose everywhere else. It manages to be very conservative and sexy at the same time. In the pictures I'm not sticking out my butt at all, that's just how awesome the dress makes it look!!I adore this dress and I can't wait to have an opportunity to wear it again

I'll wear it everywhere else though! Sitting in a desk was just a bit of a hassle. It is a BEAUTIFUL dress though! And I was pleasantly surprised by the pockets!

review_summary: I love this dress. The fi
review_text: I love this dress. The fit was perfect, the length is great and versatile, and the skirt flares beautifully. I was expecting a simpler jerseytype material, but the dress is actually a lesssoft and more linenlike material to me, which I think will wear very well and has a nice weight. A good, easy dress that you can wear to work or out.A word of warning, the belt it comes with is absolutely awful, which is a shame since I actually liked the charm and buckle on it. The one that came with my dress was too small for the dress and of horrible quality. Some of the patent leather bits scraped away just from undoing the belt in order to put on the dress. I bought a new belt to use with the dress before I could wear it and I plan to get a few more narrow belts in different colors to change it up. Any 1 or smaller belt will fit the loops, though it comes with a 0.5 one.All in all, great dress, terrible belt.

Beautiful design, flirty length. I was initially confused by the UK sizing but I chose well; usually I'm a US 12/14 so I went with a 16 in this one. The silhouette is ideal for my shape. Definitely a keeper.

review_summary: It was more snug than the

The ladies that got this one, wear it proudly.
It flatters every body type, is comfortable and elegant.

I already owned this dress in violet and love it (I also am awaiting a shipment of the same dress in pumpkin). I was thrilled to see this dress released in black during a great Black Friday sale! The black is even more versatile and easy to dress up with different cardigans and tights for a completely different look each time! I agree with other reviewers that the black felt slightly thicker than the material used in the violet, but in a good way. The pockets are convenient for carrying my phone, ID, and credit card without messing up the silhouette. Such a useful detail for a party dress!  This hits me just above the knee and can easily be worn to work or out to a more festive event. I'm unsurprised this seemed to fly off the shelves as soon as it was offered. I'd recommend it to anyone.

review_summary: I have two of this dress

review_summary: I own this dress in 3 oth
review_text: I own this dress in 3 other colors, two in cotton one in polyester (The plaid one, the green one, and the blue flowery paisleyish one, I think they call it potpourri? and this one makes 4). So I was extremely pleasantly surprised to find this a *much* thicker material than the other versions, but in just the right way.I sized up with this dress to a UK 16, as I did with the second and third ones I bought, after I found the 14 a teensy snug in the waist, but still wearable. This one I feel like I could've gone with the 14 or the 16, so I'll keep the one I got.I pretty much only buy these when they're on sale (hello black friday 50% off!), as the price is a little steep for me. I still agree with that and would price these dresses closer to being worth $60 than the listed $75. But again, sale! So this purchases was a 5 star.Oh and hello POCKETS!!! Instant love right there.
This dress is super good and looks perfect!!!! Chic, elegant

I would say size up if in doubt as this brand is definitely on the smaller size of things, and you just get more skirt that way. The quality is pretty good, but I think it'd be nicer lined. Very happy with this purchase!

I am sad to say though that I have decided to return it but only because, after giving it a lot of thought, I feel that at 46 yrs old, the flounce at the bottom of the skirt makes the dress look a little too young for me.

The dress is also fully lined (sans sleeves) which you can almost never find in fast fashion. all in all, a perfect style and dress for a fullfigured office worker :)

All in all very disappointing and a must go back.

I'm a dark skinned AfricanAmerican girl, so I was a little concerned about how this would look on me since the nude color underneath doesn't even remotely resemble my actual skin tone, but it worked out just fine. I actually preferred that it didn't match my actual skin tone exactly because that could have been a little scandalous :) I wore this dress with nude pumps (the same color as the nude in the dress) and a black clutch. review_summary: I bought this dress a few
review_text: I bought this dress a few years ago and it's still one of my favorite dresses to wear! It's held up well but mostly because I don't wear it very often. The material is thick and soft and relatively stretchy, but I can see it not retaining that quality with constant use. The color is a brighter, more candy red than the picture, which caught me off guard, but it still looks nice. I bought a size M, which gives me some nice wiggle room if I want to layer the dress in the winter time, but I might have been able to go down a size. Problems: The buttons in the neck scarf are starting to hang a little more loosely and I'm afraid they might come off. Again, I've only worn this a handful of times, so with regular use this dress might come apart quickly. Another issue is that the skirt falls widely around the hip area because of the built in pockets (a feature that I love, so it doesn't matter to me that it makes me look a little flounderlike). If you have a bit of a belly, the dress material will definitely catch on that.

I felt that way about the houndstooth style which I have owned for a year, but I want to try the XL to see if it will be a little more flattering around the waist. I'm concerned it may be too much of a stretch across the bust, however the fabric does stretch. My other complaint about the houndtooth is that I got a snag in the material about the 2nd or 3rd wear. The pattern hides that snag, but in a solid color it would be a visible flaw. I do like this dress enough to try out the smaller size to see if that fits a bit better, and I'd be more conscious of not getting a snag. Bottom line, its a cute dress, and definitely worth a try. I suggest going by your waist measurement more than the bust.

The fabric of this dress is wonderful, very soft but nice and sturdy. I love, love, love the neck area. It falls right in place on its own, you don't have to bother with it too much. I'm a 32B and it fits a bit snug in the chest area, but maybe that's just me being picky. It's really comfortable and the color is wonderful, just as pictured. I'm not exactly crazy about the pockets, as they make me look like I have bigger hips than I already have, but again, that's probably me being picky. I got an XS and I think it fits true to size, the S would have probably been a little too big. Overall, it's a keeper, another great purchase from ModCloth!

Love this dress! I normally wear a medium, but opted to go up a size because the dress is a tad on the short side. It looks fantastic with leggings and riding boots! Perfect fall/winter dress! I plan on getting this dress in more colors :)

Though I will say it's borderline too short for me to wear without tights or leggings of some sort (to work, at least).It's a great quality fabric, that's warm enough for the fall/winter (I love to pair with a cardi, tights, and kneehigh boots).  ...and A++ for POCKETS!!
It's very flattering and comfortable to wear. I love the pockets. The length hits me at my knees. The  dress is thick enough to wear with tights and a sweater on a brisk fall day.

review_summary: If you have a wide rib ca
review_text: If you have a wide rib cage like me and border two sizes, I would recommend sizing up. I'm glad I did, otherwise it would have been too tight. The rest of the dress is a little big, but it's heavy weight means I will wear it in cooler weather with a shirt underneath or a sweater over it so it works out perfectly. It is very comfortable and suits work as well as casual functions. The pockets on the sides have been said to flare out, but it actually helps my lack of hips and makes me look more shapely. The buttons are getting a little loose after a few wears, but it should be easy to tighten them so it's not a problem. I own this dress in violet as well and the red is a little softer in comparison. I'm happy with both purchases.

review_text: I was excited to get this dress because it looked so adorable on the site but I was a little nervous about the fabric... review_summary: This is a lovely dress wi
review_text: This is a lovely dress with a casual but classy look. The only gripe I have is that if you don't have a classically small waist that tapers in sharply from your bust [i.e. more straight line boyish torso] this dress will advertise that fact, especially as the waist is high up on this dress. I'm not sure whether I should have gotten the small. Having said that my bf liked this one the best on me so perhaps it's down to perception. The material is stretchy, but part of me thinks a lining of some sort to cover the quite large seams would have been nice. However, I am considering other colours as it allows you to wear a sleeved top underneath and not many dresses do that!

The neck and the arms felt a little tight, so movement was a little constricted.Good quality fabric, it's nice and soft and the color is lovely. It's a bit thick, but I don't mind it for the fall/winter months. The neck pokes out from my coat and looks like a little scarf, and helps to keep things insulated, which I liked a lot. The pockets are also a useful addition, but did need a bit of smoothing out every once in a while, to avoid bumps. Two buttons on the collar and the waist fell off so I resecured them a bit better and they haven't been a problem since.All around a great dress and it's even better as a casual party dress during the Christmas season!

The cut is perfect for accentuating the body in a nice and wellproportioned way; the effect is supple and feminine. I tend to feel selfconscious about my tummy but this dress just glides over that area and accentuates the waist and hips in a pretty way. The style is brilliant. I like to wear mine with high black boots, and it looks very 60s but not OTT. I wish more shops were so artful in their technique in both designing stunning dresses but also getting the cut so bang on. Brilliant first purchase.

I've been lurking on modcloth for about 3 years now. Never buying things, because anything over 20 dollars was just out of my price range. Now that I'm a adult with a decent job having I've decided it's time to buy. This was my 1st. Dress fits and looks great. The fabric is not thin and does not feel cheap.Thicker than a tshirt. I won't be worried about panty lines in this. Stops right above my knee. The dress was better than I expected. I think those people complaining about it feeling cheap or too thin don't buy actual cheap clothes. If you've been looking at this dress for as long as me, buy it! You won't regret it!

Sadly, I am returning this dress. The quality is nice, and the color is beautiful, but it simply did not look right on my body. The pocket lay on my hips weird and makes me look lumpy. I really wish this would have worked out for me.

review_summary: Not really for me. I had
review_text: Not really for me. I had really high hopes for this dress when I bought it during the black Friday sale, but unfortunately I will be returning it. It is just slightly too big for me and the fabric is just slightly too thin and wrinkles easily. It does not sit quite right on my waist or chest, and the pockets seem to stick out a bit. Also, it is slightly too long for my taste (but that may just be because I am so short). I love the unique collar and the rich red color, but this dress is just not quite right for me. The strange thing is that I bought the exact same dress in the purple shade and it fits like a glove.

review_summary: I bought this in light bl
review_text: I bought this in light blue originally, and decided to splurge for the red one when it went on sale. Glad I did, because it fits awesomely just like the blue one. I got a size M. I am usually between sizes. Last summer, I was around a size S. Now I am closer to M/L. I think I could be S, M, or L and still fit into the M comfortably. Yes, this dress is that awesome. I am 5'5 and I wish it were a tiny bit longer....

I couldn't be happier with this dress!!  It fits perfectly (thanks to wonderful reviewers supplying their measurements and what size they ordered) and the skirt accommodates my wide hips very nicely.  The fabric is thick and sturdy so I expect to wear it all winter (I live in Ontario) with a long sleeved top underneath and my Business Major tights I bought to go along with it.  Yay!

review_summary: This is my second coach t
review_text: This is my second coach tour dress and it won't be my last...LOVE!!

review_summary: I am very happy with this
review_text: I am very happy with this and have already ordered it in violet.  This is a dress that can be dressed up or down, is comfortable and looks super cute on anyone.  A definite wardrobe staple.

LOVE this dress!!!  The color online is very accurate.  Looks and fits wonderful!  Got it as a Christmas dress last year and received multiple compliments!!  And then wore it as my Valentines dress too.  I love how I can dress it up with black pumps or dress it down with my boots.  If you're thinking about getting this dress, my advice would be to go for it!!  I fell even more in love with it after getting it.  The neck detail and buttons give it a unique look and the length is perfect (hits just at the top of my knees).  The fabric is soft and it is extremely comfortable to wear.  Thank you ModCloth for offering it in an XS!!!!!  More XS please!!!

review_summary: I love this dress, get co
review_text: I love this dress, get compliments on it every time I wear it.

This dress is amazing!  Every time I wear it people compliment me and my boyfriend goes ga ga.  Be warned however that the dye on the dress does come off when you first get it, I noticed it on my bra after wearing it.  Also I would suggest line drying the dress, my very sweet boyfriend trying to helpful washed and dried it in the dryer and now it's a little more snug in the chest.  I plan on buying this in at least one more color.

review_summary: I am so happy with everyt
review_text: I am so happy with everything about this dress.  The quality is great and the fit is good.  My actual bust measurement is on the border between Modcloth's medium and large and I ordered the medium as I rarely wear a large in anything.  As this dress is stretchy I could have actually got away with a small, but the medium is fine.  The length is shorter than I normally wear, but from previous reviews I knew that before buying.  With black tights it's perfect for work, and I also ordered the Oh How Happy boots and they look awesome together.

It wasn't as flattering as what I thought. The top is extremely flattering but the lower half is not as cute, not sure about some of the rouching in the front area of the bottom. But the length is perfect! I think it will grow on me :) It is very cute and just not a dress style I've done before. For the large chested women, it makes your girls looks amazing!

review_summary: Love this dress! It's a p
review_text: Love this dress! It's a perfect, snug fit at the perfect length and the fabric feels good.
Beautiful dress! It fits perfectly and will work well for any work or holiday party.

review_summary: Every time I wear this dr
review_text: Every time I wear this dress I get compliments from strangers... it is just so darling! It is a tad short (I am 5'8 and 130lbs.) and I ordered a Medium. It washes really nicely, which is a plus as I hate drycleaning. I am hoping they make one in pink that I can buy next!

This dress is very popular on Modcloth, and for good reason! It's just as cute in person as it is in the pictures. My one complaint is that the pockets stick out slightly  however I'm very tall and slender, so maybe curvier girls won't have that problem. It's not that noticeable though, and I'm looking forward to wearing this dress to Christmas parties!
Love, love love.Fits perfect and looks great. Comfy and great for work.Wash is COLD water before wearing. It bleeds a bit.

I bought this dress because I was going to a SEC game and needed a fall dress for tailgating. This absolutely fit the bill! All day I received compliments on how pretty I looked in this dress. It looks great with or without a black cardigan and a pair of black heels. The only downside to this dress is that it has pleats on the waistband directly underneath the breast area. I guess if you are bigger in the chest area then the pleats do not show as much, however, I am only 32B so the pleats were a little more obvious and baggy looking, but it didn't bother me enough to return the dress. Other than that, the dress was extremely comfortable and flattering. This was my 1st order from Modcloth so I ordered the XS and the S to get the right size. The S was too large everywhere for me but the XS fit like a dream! (For reference I am a 0P at Banana Republic).

review_summary: I love how this dress doe
review_text: I love how this dress doesn't need ironing!! It works well as a spring/autumn dress as you can pair it up with tights and a tee underneath. I have to wear it with tights as I'd bought it as a dress for work and it's a bit on the short side. That said, I'm now thinking of buying all the other ones in the series!!

review_summary: I've been on the fence wh
review_text: I've been on the fence whether I'm a small or a medium in Modcloth items. I bought this in a medium since the soda fountain dress worked well for me in that size. Turns out I probably could have taken a small in this dress because there is plenty of give in the fabric. However it still looks cute so I'm keeping the medium. I love to wear this with black tights, a cardigan and booties.
Excellent dress! Very unique. Unfortunately, it was too big, so I'm returning it for a smaller size!
Fits very snuggly in the bust, but has no sleeves so it can accommodate broad shoulders.  Lots of room at the hips, drapes well.

This dress is adorable and comfortable. It does poof out a little on the sides on the bottom, but other than that it's adorable. I love that is has pockets and looks totally cute on. It's so comfortable, like other reviews said, and fits really well. I'm small but it seems like it could work for any size/body type. I'm glad this and the Chevrondezvous dress in rust and navy were my first purchases from ModCloth; I'm very pleased! Great dresses for the money.

review_summary: I bought this dress in bo
review_text: I bought this dress in both the violet and the rouge.  I really like both colors, but I like the bright pop of color in the rouge best.  Also, I like the quality of the buttons on this one a little more.  The waist in this dress seems to run just a tiny bit large for a size small, causing a little bulge in the back.  This probably isn't even noticeable to anyone else but me and doesn't seem to be a problem.  It's better for the dress to be a little loose than too tight in my opinion.  Everything else is great about this dress other than the length.  Tights will definitely need to be worn with this one at all times since it's so short on me.  I bought it to wear as a winter dress, so that's not a problem.  All of the reviews say that it is a short dress.  That wasn't unexpected.  The length is the only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5. Can't wait until it gets cold here in Texas so that I can wear this dress!

review_summary: The waist was a little hi
review_text: The waist was a little high, but that's because I have a bigger chest and a long torso. Great quality cloth, too.
Love the dress! Feels very soft, super comfortable, flattering length. Two thumbs up on my first Mod Cloth purchase!
This dress fits me perfectly. I feel so good in it, and I love that it has pockets! I've received nothing but compliments when I've worn it.

I really love these 'Coach' dresses. They're such a great dress for a Canadian gal, because the material is heavier than many other dresses, while still stylish and cute for winter. A tiny bit too short for my height  but since I'm pairing it with tights anyway for the cold, not a big deal.Thanks Modcloth!

review_summary: I was hesitant to get thi
review_text: I was hesitant to get this dress since some of my previous ModCloth purchases did not fit well, but this dress is AMAZING!  I am so happy I bought it!  I am 5 ft. 2 in. and the length is PERFECT for us short girls.  The fit is very flattering (I am 150lbs and bought the large) and best of all you can tell the fabric is great. longlasting quality.  I can't believe this dress was only $50!
Cute dress, wellsized.  Length came just above my knees.  I only returned it because I had another dress too similar.

This was my first ModCloth purchase and I'm soooo glad it was! I loved this dress the moment I saw it online and it did not disappoint. Even though my measurements are bigger than the XL I ordered I thought I'd give it a try and to my immense happiness the dress fits very nicely and is extremely flattering. I thought the pockets might make it a bit less flattering, but they lie flat and only add to the awesomeness that is this dress. (I mean who doesn't want a dress with pockets?) I'm now thinking about getting this dress in one or more of the other colors.

review_summary: I love the fabric of this
review_text: I love the fabric of this dress and the high collar  it will be perfect for winter! It is short and needs tights but I expected that from the other reviews. It doesn't ride up though, which is a very pleasant surprise! The only reason this didn't get 5 stars from me is that the placement of the pockets makes me look quite hippy but I'm wearing a long cardigan over it to fix that issue!

review_summary: I bought this dress in a
review_text: I bought this dress in a Medium based on other reviews saying it ran short.  I normally do not have issue with the length of things as I am only 5'3 however this dress was too short.  It would look cute with a long sleeve and leggings however came several inches above my knee which would not be work appropriate.   The red is a deep red that would look great through fall/winter and even the holidays.  Sadly, I am returning this dress as I will not get enough wear out of it being so short.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress, but it just didn't look right on me =( It's so well made, and feels fabulous on: The fabric weight is great and moves wonderfully. Nonetheless, each time I tried it on, it just didn't look right. Sadly, I returned it.

review_summary: I bought this for my mom
review_text: I bought this for my mom and she loves it for the winter!

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this dress the first time I saw it. It was the first thing I ever bought on ModCloth and I absolutely love it! I am so excited to wear it out and show it off!

review_summary: I really love the fit of
review_text: I really love the fit of this dress. I love the feel and weight of the fabric, but I only wore it one time and it is pilling up. It looks like the dress is worn out already only after one wear.

This dress is unbelievable, it works for every season.  I adore this dress and get compliments everytime I wear it.  I could have probably gone with a medium in the waist but the length of the large is great so that I can wear it to any sort of event no matter how conservative. I would recommend this dress to anyone who is considering purchasing it.

review_summary: I had been holding off on
review_text: I had been holding off on buying this dress, but I am very glad I finally got it.  It is really comfortable and very versatile.  Plus I love the red color.  The pockets will come in handy when I wear this to school.The first time he saw me in this, my boyfriend informed me that it was probably his new favorite outfit, which is saying a lot. :)

I already own this dress in purple; I loved it so much I bought the red and the black too. It's very flattering on my apple shape and fits just right. I'm fairly short, and the dress hits just above the knee. There is some pilling of the fabric if you wear a shoulder bag and it rubs, but I can deal with that.

Super cute, just awkward with the high neck (winterish) and sleeveless (summerish) in the same dress.  Also a little short on my tall frame, not appropriate for the conservative office where I work.   Otherwise, I do get a lot of compliments when I wear it.

I absolutely Love this dress! I have never bought a dress online, but this dress fits perfectly. The waist is a little loose but if i had gone a size down, the bust would have been too tight. The pockets are a little bulky though but nothing a little ironing won't take care of. The length is also great as it hits just above my knees. Thanks ModCloth for a great purchase! I will definitely be back for more!

review_summary: I bought this dress in a
review_text: I bought this dress in a medium.  It fits tight in the bust on me and is a tad shorter than I would like for work (I'm over 45) but looks great and I get a lot of compliments.  If I gain 5 lbs I can't wear it, it's too tight so if you like a looser fit order a large.

I love this dress. Especially in this color. I'll be buying more of the other colors soon I'm sure! The fit is great and has some extra stretch in both the bust and waist area. I previously bought a coach dress in size S but decided to go for a less snug fit with the M. I generally don't like tight clothes so I'm sticking to M for now on.

I've wanted one of these dresses for a while and grabbed the red color during the coach tour dress promotion recently. The red is not as true of a red as it looks online. It's slightly darker and more blueish. It fit me okay. However, the material is not flattering to curves, and feels thinner than expected, low quality. Very sad to be sending it back.

review_summary: I am so happy with this p
review_text: I am so happy with this purchase! This dress is absolutely amazing! I wore it to work the other day with a black sweater and black booties, and I received SO many compliments. I may even buy the houndstooth version!
This dress is super cute and 60's!

I thought this dress was amazing since I first saw it, and after seeing all the great reviews I decided to buy it.  Being my first Mod Cloth purchase, I was a little torn between what size to get; Technically my waist is 26.5 inches and bordering the small/medium measurements I decided to size up to the larger size, figuring a little extra room wouldn't hurt. While the dress is perfect around the chest area and comfortably big around abdomen it's a bit big in the back, where it ruffles in an unattractive way on the lower back. I'll probably be exchanging it for a smaller size but other than that I think it's a great dress. It's a perfect length for me (stops right above the knee on me, so it's great for those who are a bit shorter) and the color stays true to the picture. The fabric is a tad thinner than what I expected, but thick enough to be sturdy and it's also slightly stretchy, so for those who are bordering in between sizes like I was it wouldn't hurt to go with the smaller size. If your measurements are a hair off the dress will allow for a little bit of stretch. It's a great dress because while it's knee length and sleeveless, it also looks great with a long sleeved shirt and tights/leggings so you can wear it almost any time of the year. Once I get the exchange I plan to wear this to my family's Christmas party and I can't wait
This dress is absolutely wonderful! I just received it today and it fits perfectly! I couldn't be happier with my first ModCloth purchase :)

review_summary: This was my first Mod pur
review_text: This was my first Mod purchase.  After seeing some of the photos of people wearing it, I was a bit hesitant to buy this. It looked tight and short.  But I took a chance and I'm glad I did.  This is hands down my favorite dress of all time.  I'm petite and small on top so it fits nicely. And the length is border line too short for work, but I'm short so I get away with it. Not sure what I'd call the fabric.  It almost feels like that stuff Halloween costumes are made from, though much thicker.  But it hangs nicely.  It was great in the summer and would be good for a California winter layered with a long sleeve shirt and tights.  I might need another one.

review_summary: This dress I ordered in R
review_text: This dress I ordered in RED. I love it! I bought a Large and IT FIT PERFECTLY!!!!! I Love this dress!!!! I will order from mod clother over and over. I got more compliments on this dress than any other dress I own. If you are thinking about it............JUST DO IT!!!! You will be so Happy!

review_summary: This dress is so cute! I
review_text: This dress is so cute! I just had to get it when I first saw it. I've only worn it once so far, to my grandmother's wedding, but I got a lot of complements. It fits nicely, and doesn't distort too much on the top (my chest is big enough that it usually changes where the waist is supposed to fall on dresses). I can't wait until it cools down so I can wear it with tights!

This is a good, versatile dress. I frequently wear it to work, but can also wear it out to dinner or out on the town. It's going to be a hot summer where I live so I might have to rest it for a while  it's definitely not the dress for a subtropical summer. But, I look forward to wearing it again with a cardigan and tights next winter.

review_summary: I really wanted to like t
review_text: I really wanted to like this dress, and it was super comfy, but the pockets made the skirt hang funny on me, it just looked like a balloon skirt.

review_summary: I have always wanted a Co
review_text: I have always wanted a Coach Tour Dress, but I normally go for the fun option over more basic pieces.  When I finally decided to break down I couldn't decide on a color finally i narrowed it down between rouge and stripes, but was still undecided!  What finally helped me decide was the shop our outfits starring the coach tour dress!  I loved the look with the I Can Seed Clearly Top under the dress and I knew it would be perfect under rouge!  The dress fits perfectly like a glove!  The material is nice it's thin enough for summer, yet thick enough for winter.  Length is perfect.  I can't imagine this dress not flattering every figure!  If you're delaying on getting this dress get it today I'm already trying to decide which color I want next (i'm leaning towards winter)!

review_summary: I was happy with this dre
review_text: I was happy with this dress its very soft and feels comfy I regret the color (for me i just think i don't sell it) its a bit long for MY taste but It should be fine for other people :3 i am so happy i really want all the other colors hahah, also i think this looks better on curvier girls but that's my opinion I actually think id like it more if I was curvier

review_summary: Love this dress! I wore i
review_text: Love this dress! I wore it with tights (felt a little short), and got so many compliments!

review_summary: Fit like a dream! I'm a b
review_text: Fit like a dream! I'm a bit short, so dresses tend to be hit or miss on me, but this was perfect. It fell right above the knee, and there was just enough in the high waist to give me a nice waist without it being uncomfortable. I love it so much that now I'm eying the the other colours...

I am really excited about this dress now that the weather is getting cooler. The fit is just right, the length is just right and the quality is good, especially considering the price. I'm not terrified that the buttons will fall off, like I do with some other modcloth purchases, and the dress is exactly as pictured. I think the dress would be flattering on most body shapes, and the collar is particularly cute and unique. If only there was more room in my closetI would definitely buy this dress in other colors.

review_summary: This was a bit of an impu
review_text: This was a bit of an impulse buy, but I don't regret it at all. I was a bit nervous about buying a dress from modcloth because a lot of dresses and skirts have reviews about the them being too small, but this isn't the case for this dress! It fits really well and is a great length, right above my knee. Now I'm tempted to buy it in all of the other colors!

Reading the reviews I could tell that everyone falls in love with this dress.  I am no exception.  The length is just right, it looks adorable with stockings, and the cut is so feminine and pretty.  I got tons of compliments on this.  It is very figure flattering.  Also, the pockets add just the right amount of casual so you can wear this almost anywhere.

review_summary: I had to write a review b
review_text: I had to write a review because as a buyer, I appreciate reading the comments before I get it.  This is my first purchase from modcloth...and it is great!  I am usually unsure about a medium or a small but the small fits perfect.  The dress is super comfortable and has lots of stretch.  I also have long legs so lot's of dresses look very short on me.  This one hits about 3 inches above the knee.  Good job modcloth!

review_summary: I want to love this dress
review_text: I want to love this dress, but I can only like it. The reason is that the pockets make the dress stick out a bit at the hips. If this dress didn't have the pockets, it would be a 5star at under $50.

review_summary: Pro: This dress is very f
review_text: Pro: This dress is very flattering. Tight (but not too tight) at the bust, cinched at the waist and flared in the skirt. The color and unique collar make it stand out, I get a lot of compliments on it. It is also very comfortable to wear. Con: As Lauren and Heather said, the dye bleeds a bit. I didn't get any on my skin but some did come off on my purse. Need to resolve that issue. Also, it is a bit short on me but I'm rather tall so it's to be expected. I'm very pleased with the dress over all and would definitely recommend purchasing it.

review_summary: I love how its very stret
review_text: I love how its very stretchy. its very flowy. the color is true to the picture shown above. the material is a bit thick but not so hot your pores cant breath. but it was just too short.i have big bottom...so it made it an inch short from the back. even thou im short i felt it was just a bit too short for me. but overall great dress!!

LOVE this dress! The knit material is comfortable with the right amount of weight. I love the fact that this can be made into a Fall dress by pairing it with a long sleeve knit jersey inside. The shawl collar makes my shoulders look really nice, and the side waistbands helps with visual minimizing of the waist line. I haven't tried washing it yet, as I've read some of the reviews mentioning colour fastening. I would probably hand wash in cold water, by itself :P To sum it up, I am extremely happy with my purchase!

This dress is awesome! It fits me great and I got tons of compliments on it. I wore it ALL day tailgating and attending a football game and it was perfect. I could easily wear it to a dressier occasional as well  like out to dinner. I just ordered it in violet and houndstooth. Obviously I am a fan!!!
Comfortable. There are pockets in the sides of the dress which make my thighs look bigger. Still happy w my purchase.

review_summary: I love this dress. I also
review_text: I love this dress. I also own it in polka dot, black, violet, and blue w/ red buttons. It's perfectly fitted on top and flares out nicely (which is helpful since my hips are 10 inches wider than my waist). On me the middle hits slightly above my natural waist, and the length is slightly below my knees. I would definitely wear my long hair up so as not to take away from the beautiful neck of the dress. It's soft and moves nicely, too! I can wear this in the autumn and spring as is, and pair it with a cardigan and tights in the winter. I can wear this to work, and to dinner and a Broadway show (I live in NYC). I love dresses I can wear year round and to just about anything. That's getting your money's worth!

review_summary: Exactly as it looks in th
review_text: Exactly as it looks in the picture. I combined it with a sheer black sleeve top and a pair of sheer leggings and I will be fashionably set for fall/winter season! The dress by itself is wonderful to wear during the summer as well with the sleeveless arms. Fabric quality is fantastic. After reading all the reviews on the Coach tour dress, I will have to definitely agree with them about the satisfaction.

review_summary: I adore how this dress lo
review_text: I adore how this dress looks. I bought it in a large because I'm tall and the length turned out to be perfect about three inches above the knee but it was big in the waist so I had to get it taken in. It fit perfectly after,  but now I am disappointed in the quality of the fabric. I have not washed it yet, worn it maybe four times to school, and it's covered in fuzz balls. The fabric also feels cheap to me but I can look past it because the dress is so cute.

Amazing dress. Beautiful rich red color. Good quality fabric with some nice weight to it. I wore it to a wedding and was complemented all night! It cam to right above my knees (within 2 inches above) which is long enough to be conservative enough to wear to work, church, school, social engagements, etc. and short enough to not look ma'army. Also short enough to wear stockings/leggings during cold weather. The neckline is so lovely. So lovely. It frames your face and arms very well. This is a great dress for bustier girls because you are not spilling out or looking cheap, and good for smaller chested girls because it does hug you on top and the collar, again, is so lovely. I'm in love. I have one more in another color, and would buy more, but I don't want to be that lady who wears only the same dress all the time haha. But I just may purchase more...
Fits like a dream!

review_summary: First thing I want to say
review_text: First thing I want to say make sure you have the right bra for this dress. The arm holes are a bit on the bigger side so it will reveal some of the heartier bras.Otherwise, this is a pretty cute dress. Sadly, the red hovers right on the line of an orangeyred and a bluered, and didn't go very well at all with my complexion (pale, pinkish and ginger). I maybe want to try a purple in this dress. However, the waist was a bit baggy on me even though the chest fit well, and it doesn't go too well with a belt. This dress seems to look great on almost everyone, so I'd say go for it, make sure you choose the right color, and make sure the fit is right and you'll probably adore it. IT HAS POCKETS! I mean, come on!

review_summary: I had a dress similar to
review_text: I had a dress similar to this one (streetcar tour dress).  I liked that dress, but I have to say,I prefer this style.  This style has a more flared out skirt, which gives it a bit more sophistication.  The color of this dress is beautifully rich.  The fabric is thick, which makes it great for the cooler months. I ordered a size up because I can see myself layering under this dress for the winter.

This dress is perfect. It fits very comfortably. It correctly runs true to size, as stated on the site. I have no complaints whatsoever. It has lots of stretch and I probably could have gotten away with an Lsize. I haven't worn it much but I hope I don't run into the colourspotting issue other users seem to have run across. If all the dresses Modcloth sell are like this, I'll definitely be buying more.
my first purchase from modcloth, money well spent. very comfy and good for all seasons. it is a tad short for what i'm used to but it is gorgeous in person.

I really like this dress, although I didn't expect the fabric to be so stretchy. Had I known, I may have ordered a small. That said, I'm sure I can layer underneath the dress this way for a warmer fall/winter look. It's a very classy and lovely piece!

review_summary: I love this dress!! It is
review_text: I love this dress!! It is one of my favorite purchases from modcloth! I had bought a similar coach dress in gray a few years ago and love how versatile it is. This one is no different. The medium fits me perfect and the colour is gorgeous. It is a little short for work but, with tights or leggings it will be perfect. I can't wait to wear it!! So happy :)

I love the slight shimmer this dress has! I'm only 5'3, so the length is just right in my opinion. It hits slightly above my knees. The fabric is rather stretchy, so it gives you more wiggle room to move around in.  It'll be great for when it's cooler out, so I'm super excited to wear it then. I love it so much that I may have to order it in other colors. :)

This dress is very pretty! I'm not sure how long the fabric will continue to look as good as it does, but it looked really nice coming out of the box. While it is a tiny bit large on me, I don't really think it's a problem. I'll probably be saving this for fall though! Gorgeous dress.
My husband said it looks like a top designer dress! Fancy! It is a little on the short side for me (I am 5'6) so tights will be required. Perfect for work or going out with friends.

This dress fits me PERFECTLY! I am in love! Perfect for football games in the fall. The fabric is not the best quality, a yucky polyester, but it fits so well that I don't even care. I love this dress!

This dress is super cute and flattering. Material is soft and comfortable. Seems true to size, mine is on the smaller side of a S, but it has stretch, so don't worry. It's a little bit short, and I think that since it's an A line skirt, it might be somewhat unforgiving if you have a lot of junk in the trunk.

I LOVE this dress! :) It is so classy, and so comfortable. I've received lots of compliments on it. Wore black tights and a black sweater with it. It's a little snug on top and at the waist line  a little tough getting it on and off, but very comfortable once it's on...possibly should've ordered a S, but happy enough with the XS.

Sadly, I will be sending it back. Just to add, it was a little above knee length on me, the bust fit great (38e/f), the waist was loose enough to be very comfortable and I just love the light orange color. review_text: I really, REALLY wanted to love this dress but the fit was all wrong. Well, that area fit but every other part was far too big on me.  The shoulders were too big, the arms were too loose and the dress was crazy long on me.  Altering wouldn't have worked and shortening wasn't an option because that would mean cutting off the lovely scalloped bottom. If the dress had some give I would have ordered a small (which is what I usually wear but I think it still might have been too long.)  I'm happy it's worked for others because it really is a oneofakind dress.  I've already sent it back.

Also, a little bit of the lace was ripped out of the package, but not enough for me to go through the hassle of returning. All in all, I LOVE IT! :D

I think I might have been able to wear the 3x. Although the photos all show the sleeves to be quite closely fitting even the ends and I didn't want them to be too tight my arms are a problem area. The 4x fits exactly right there and the ends of the sleeves don't cling. I feel loose and comfortable & I can move my arms easily. My bust fits a tick loose the waist more (which is where a 3x would have been okay but with an easy alteration or even a belt I can cinch that waist. It's got a nice weight to it and feels really good on, not itchy or stiff. It's a beautiful dress it makes me so happy just looking at it. The mesh is really fine so be careful of snagging it on things like hang nails, jewelry and such. My upper arms measure 16in at the heaviest part. This fits comfortably with a little room at the 3/4 length end.

The embroidery is absolutely gorgeous! Be aware that the fabric has NO give  it fits well everywhere but the ribcage, which makes it a bit hard to breathe when sitting down. I also raised my arm too fast and almost had a heart attack when I heard a little ripping noise from my shoulder, but then couldn't find any tears. Overall it's a marvel!

review_summary: I had been wanting one of
review_text: I had been wanting one of the Coach Tour dresses for quite some time based on the wonderful reviews they had received.  I initially just passed these dresses by because I thought the neckline seemed odd and like it wouldn't flatter my upper body.  But once I started noticing people raving over these dresses, I decided to give it a shot.  And I'm so glad I did!  This dress is incredibly flattering and seems to be quite slimming.  I've only worn it once so far, but I received compliments from coworkers (although they were concerned that I was heading to another job interview because I looked so professional and fancy).  My concerns regarding the neckline weren't completely unfounded, as I'm just not accustomed to wearing this sort of thing.  But once I got used to the look of it, I actually quite like it.  I will say that the dress is a bit short, but not nearly as short on me as other reviewers noted.  It's perhaps threefour inches above the knee.  I paired this with a bright cardigan and heels for a stylish, yet comfortable office ensemble.

Unfortunately, it's not for this particular big body. It doesn't look bad exactly, but it's not very exciting, and for the price and hubbub, I was dead set on exciting, so will be returning.I think if the waist were an inch or two lower, it would work well. The waist falls on my ribcage. My hips are HUGE, so having the waist so high meant the bottom half was dictated by the size of my hips, which led to this adorable top half paired with an absolutely enormous shapeless triangle for a bottom half. I tried belting it at my natural waist, and it went from whatever to NICE WHERE DID YOU GET THAT  if this dress were easier to disassemble and I were better at sewing, I would modify the waist downward and then buy one of every color.  Maybe if they had this in 1X it would work. As far as that goes, the XL felt like it fit  nothing was tight or uncomfortable.It was also fairly short. If the dress had been as awesome as I was hoping, I would've made it work, but since it was soso, the shortness really wasn't doing it for me, either.Great design, wellmade, good fabric, definitely wish it could've worked, but just not for my body.

review_summary: I loved this dress so muc

review_text: I love this dress. I also own it in polka dot, red, violet, and blue w/ red buttons. I can wear this to work, and to dinner and a Broadway show (I live in NYC). I love dresses I can wear year round and to just about anything. That's getting your money's worth!

review_summary: This is a great work dres
