My first purchase from ModCloth. Very happy! The dress is a great length  just above the knee. Fits well. Love the collar.

This dress is classy and fun.  When I ordered I was a bit worried about the length given my height and a lot of the reviews.  I tend to be between a M and a L depending on the dress, and opted for large in this case.  I am glad I did.  The length is still on the short side, but is just long enough and adds a flirtatiousness to the dress. The waist fits nicely although I picked the larger size.  The skirt drapes in a flattering way and the neckline is lovely.  I adore the pockets.  Overall a great buy.

This dress is wonderful! I was on a rampage of buying black and navy items for prac and the uniqueness of the design grabbed my attention. It is so comfortable, I just couldn't get over how soft and lovely the material is. It fits really nicely to the point where you don't even notice you're wearing it if you know what I mean? It's the slightest bit short for work but with flats it's okay. My only gripe is that after walking from the bus stop into the office it had already started to pill where my handbag hangs on one side. I really expected it to last a bit longer than 10 minutes before showing signs of wear, so this is why I gave it 4 stars. Otherwise, a great dress!
Fabulous dress! Love the button details. I typically wear a size 2 in a dress and the small fits perfect.  The pockets do make my hips look a little wider though.

review_summary: Very cute design and I wa
review_text: Very cute design and I was very excited to receive it. The fit was great around the bust and the length was perfect, BUT the dress made me look pregnant. It was sad but I returned it.

review_summary: Just got it in the mail,
review_text: Just got it in the mail, and I love it! It's a little big around the waist, but other than that it's great. The only issue I have is the collar flaps around a lot thanks to the weight of the button, but that's easily fixed with a couple tacking stitches.

review_summary: Just got it in the mail,
review_text: Just got it in the mail, and I love it! It's a little big around the waist, but other than that it's great. The only issue I have is the collar flaps around a lot thanks to the weight of the button, but that's easily fixed with a couple tacking stitches.

review_summary: This dress fits like a gl
review_text: This dress fits like a glove. I was drawn in by its black buttons, side pockets, and asymmetrical collar. It's a stretchy poly/rayon blend, so I don't expect the black to fade into a dull gray, even though this dress is going to see lots of wear in the near future.

review_summary: I have a very short torso
review_text: I have a very short torso and this dress hits just above my waist  I think this may fit as more of an empire waist for most others.  I'm busty, and the medium was just snug enough, a large may fit better in the bust, but may be too loose in the waist.  I recommend hand washing or dry clean.  I got lazy and washed it insideout on the gentle cycle and the material isn't as smooth anymore. The length is a little short for what I'd be comfortable wearing to work without stockings; but with them it is very officeappropriate!The buttons are adorable and the collar always looks perfect!
Generally, Modcloth larges fit me perfectly, but this was a little big. It's still nice, and very flattering, so I'm keeping it.

review_summary: This is the first dress I
review_text: This is the first dress I bought from this website and I LOVE it!  It fits me perfectly (thanks to reading the reviews first) and is a very quality material.  It's super cute and I love the pockets!
Very cute. Accentuates my already wide hips a little bit, but I still love it :)

I was very pleasantly surprised at the weight and feel of this fabric!  It has a great drapey jersey feel to it and is extremely comfortable and flattering.  It can be worn year round with layers and is perfect for my music concerts where I need to wear all black...the fabric has just enough give for a musician to play freely and still maintains its shape.  Thanks to ModCloth for providing such fun and unique vintageinspired styles that allow me to show my personality and stand out in a crowd!  I also love that so many of your dresses are subtly sexy yet appropriate for school or work.

review_summary: I love this dress. I love
review_text: I love this dress. I love the material, and it looks even better on than in the picture. I am very happy, it fits well. The only thing is that I'd like it to be just a bit shorter. Another  5'2 review of this dress says it hits mid thigh, but mine hits at my knees.

This is the first purchase from Modcloth so I was a little skeptical about buying online but I am sooo glad I went ahead and did it. The cloth is amazing great for all times of the year and it can be casual or fancy for recitals. I read the other reviews so I went for the XL just to be on the safe side and the fit works :D I love it! Thank you Modcloth! Hopefully I can get more colours!

Gorgeous dress. I'm 5'7 and an Australian size 12, and this dress fits very well. It slightly tight in the chest area but still looks fine, and is a bit shorter than i would like, falling mid thigh but again thats to be expected with my height. But definately love the classic look. Favourite modcloth purchase so far.

review_summary: I love this dress! It fit
review_text: I love this dress! It fits well and looks adorable!

review_summary: This is a really cute spi
review_text: This is a really cute spin on the standard black dress. I like wearing it with tights and adorable boots. I especially like that it has pockets, always a bonus in a dress!
Love this dress!  I wore it to work and my coworkers were all in love with it.  It fits well.  I now want it in all colors!

When I ordered this dress I thought I would be getting the one with gold buttons and they were black instead. I thought it looked cuter with the gold buttons, but oh well still a cute dress. I'm on the smaller side of a 34 B, so I think i could have gone with a small since there's enough stretch in the fabric. Good quality material and great for wearing around the office,

review_summary: I have had my eye on this
review_text: I have had my eye on this dress for a while, and I'm so glad I finally decided to get it. I know I am going to get the Houndstooth one as soon as it is available in my size. I always order a large due to my bust, and I have room with some to spare. The cut is so flattering! It covers my tummy without looking dumpy. A fabulous LBD!

review_summary: I wore this to two family
review_text: I wore this to two family Christmas dinners and got lots of compliments. The fit was perfect for me and I didn't have any problems with the length. Fabric was a little thicker than I expected with a nice drapey weight and seemed to resist wrinkles, which I loved! The only problem I had was that my dress didn't come with the brass buttons pictured, instead they came with the black buttons that are pictured with the rouge and rose versions of this dress. I wish I had been notified sooner if this was intentional.

review_summary: I love love love this dre
review_text: I love love love this dress!  I am a size 68 and this dress comes just above my knee and fits beautifully.  It is a really fin dress to wear!

review_summary: I got this dress in three
review_text: I got this dress in three colours: bleu, noir and rouge because i knew it'd suit my body type and had such great reviews.  I am happy with the dress, but I guess I had imagined the fabric to be better than what it is, but I guess the price would be double if it was.  It's not as thick a material as I imagined and the weave is not as tight as it could be (i.e. if you hold it up to the light you can see light comes through).  This also means the dress is not as stiff as I expected so the collar is floppier than it looks.  Length wise they're good, falls about 1.5inches above my knees which I think is still office acceptable. Anyway, these dresses are a fantastic style and are good enough to keep.
Love this top, it's simple but the brassy buttons are a fun detail.

review_summary: I did end up keeping this
review_text: I did end up keeping this dress even though I probably should have returned it. It fits very large on me and I have to wear a sweater to hide the huge arm holes that reveal my bra. The buttons have turned a brassy color already (they're very cheap anyway) so I'm going to have to replace those. Wish I liked this more, I loved it in the picture!

review_summary: I was not at all sure if
review_text: I was not at all sure if this would fit me due to having a large chest and bad luck with pullover dresses. However, it goes on great. It's quite fitting across the chest, but I was happy that it is a nice relaxed fit around the waist and hips. Bonus: it has pockets!

My first ModCloth purchase and I'll definitely be ordering more! :) I am in LOVE with this dress! I got it the day before Christmas and I was ecstatic! The dress is a little short, it hit me a few inches above my knee, but because I walked around barefoot  it ended up being just fine. (if you're tall, this might not be the dress for you.) The fabric is fabulous and felt wonderful and the top was snug on my bust but not uncomfortably so.Overall, I'm very happy with this dress and I'm excited to be ordering more!!

I was really disappointed in this dress and now know that I need to pay close attention to the sort of material used. I was thinking it would be more of a heavy wool dress, but it was flimsy, like a Ricky's halloween costume. I couldn't get the neck part to look right, the stretchy waist was at an awkward place on my body, it was was just uncomfortable. Definitely getting returned.

This dress is great!  Super cute!  I just got it and it's a keeper!  I ordered a Small and it fits, although I wouldn't want it any smaller in the bust.  Its possible a Medium could have worked too but the small works just fine.  I say it wouldn't be worth it to send it back just to try the medium.  It doesn't look too snug or anything.  I can just tell I wouldn't want the bust area any smaller in the dress.  SO CUTE!  Can't wait to wear it out!  I'll try to repost with a photo soon!  Oh, and the material is great. It seems thick and strong.

review_summary: I love this dress! I am b
review_text: I love this dress! I am busty, so the waist comes up a little bit higher then I thought. However, it still looks really cute and it is an awesome fit!

This dress is perfect for a night out with friends to matching it with tights and going to church.  The pockets are a great touch.  My only problem was that there was a little bit of gapping around the side of the chest, but it's not a serious problem.
In love with this dress. It is perfect alone and paired with a long sleeve shirt and tights or leggings. I loved it so much, I ordered the red!

review_summary: i LOVE this dress! so cut
review_text: i LOVE this dress! so cute, flattering, and comfortable! Perfect for any season! It ran a smidge too big on me, so I'm going to be exchanging it for a Medium. I can't wait till it comes, so I can finally wear it! :)

review_summary: I took somewhat of a gamb
review_text: I took somewhat of a gamble on this one. I live abroad and therefore lack the luxury of free returns.Thankfully, I was beyond happy with the dress! Despite the its incredibly modest price, I found the quality of the dress to be excellent. The  material is thick and hence perfect all year round; dressed either up or down. The real seller of course is the style of the dress though. The flow of the dress is flattering and chique, whilst the colour and the buttons add a very playful and casual touch. There are a few things that any potential buyers should bear in mind:Taller girls should be aware that the dress is quite short. This is actually one of the few occasions where my feeble size of 5'0 is great, as i can get away with wearing the dress without any tights or leggings underneath.Additionally, I found the arms to be far too wide on my frame, meaning that my bra was constantly showing. It was however, easy to alter and now it fits perfectly! It really is an absolutely wonderful dress!

This dress is awesome, awesome, awesome.  The material is a nice thick cotton, and with leggings and some cute shoes, it is a very eyecatching look.  I got compliments from strangers the first time I wore it.  Now that its getting cold, pairing this dress with a short jacket adds another dimension to the look.  You'll have fun with this one!

way shorter than expected. cannot comfortably move around or lift my arms up without it creeping up too high. also i don;t like the front pockets. the version with side pockets is better and longer enough for work. overall style is gorgeous but have to return it b/c of the lenght.

review_summary: I like this dress, but it
review_text: I like this dress, but it is very short. Tights will be a necessity. Also, the material under the arms tends to stick out a bit. Other than those two things, the dress is adorable!
Super cute. Runs a teensy bit small

review_summary: Not a fan of this dress.
review_text: Not a fan of this dress. The material is awkward and the gap in the armpit is the main reason I am returning.

review_summary: I got the Coach Tour dres
review_text: I got the Coach Tour dress in both black and green, thinking they would be identical fitwise.  They weren't.  The black version just gapes under the armholes so much, even with a pushup bra on.  The exact same dress in green (granted, the pockets are different, but that shouldn't affect the fit) does not have the gaping issue.  Therefore  keeping the green, returning the black.

Like another reviewer, I bought the similar Streetcar Tour Dress in Noir and was was much happier with that purchase. It's quality is better and it fits better around my bust area than the Coach Tour Dress. This dress is much shorter than I was expecting and gapes at the armholes near my bust. I also prefer the cleaner lines of the Streetcar dress that is without the pockets of this dress. I'm extremely disappointed in this dress given how much I love the Streetcar Tour Dress—which is not available in any of the wonderful colors this dress comes in.

I love Modcloth and this has to be one of the best items I have ever purchased. Cute, chic, and very versatile. My only note is that I am petite and the arm holes are a bit too big for me. I probably should have ordered a small (the sizing fiasco that was the champ de mars dress made me seriously doubt what size I am!), but I like the length so much that I'll fix it on my own. Thank you, Modcloth!

This was my first purchase from modcloth and I'm so disappointed it didn't work out! I wanted so much to love the dress but it was a couple inches too short. I'm 5'6 and it hit well above the middle of my thigh, yikes! I was planning to wear this dress to work since we have a black dress code but it's not going to work even with tights. Returning it today after buying the houndstooth pattern that came back in stock today, hopefully that will be about 2 inches longer!

review_summary: The minute I saw this dre
review_text: The minute I saw this dress I was in love! I hoped so hard that it would fit (it is one of my first modcloth purchases) and it was amazing!! The neck is my absolute favorite and at first I wasnt crazy about the pockets at the hips but after wearing it once I found them to look super cute! I'm rather short so I usually have a problem with dresses but this dress is surprisingly short! I could actually use another inch or two at the bottom and still look good. I'm also usually frustrated with wearing tights or nylons with dresses because I get that ugly bunching in the front when I walk (because it rides up) but the fabric is heavy enough that wearing it with tights was perfect! I also love the gold buttons because I rarely wear gold and it gives me the chance to finally wear some gold jewelery! My only problem with it was that I have worn it once so far and all the buttons have fallen off! I was a little frustrated because I was at work (but I did a quick fix with a safety pin) but sewing them back on was really easy when I got home so this is not a big problem. Definitely recommend this dress! I got many compliments on it already!

review_summary: I bought this dress as a
review_text: I bought this dress as a nice fall look and to wear to work. A few points: My buttons were sewn on securely unlike other reviewers. However, as you wear it, you start noticing how shiny and cheap they areso I might change them out. Secondly, HUGE, huge armpits. I have to tack these downI have a large bust, so I'm really not sure what's going on here with these. Thirdly, it is not super short, but rather a loose fit on the hips and legs and then a tiny bit short, so it just makes you feel a bit unsecure about your butt showing, for example. I always wear leggings with mine. Now, the super strange partI ordered a small. My tag says large. But it isn't large at allthere's no way a genuinely sized large woman could wear this, so I'm just not sure what's going on with that.

this dress is very sweet and FLATTERING on a curvy girl, im pear shaped and it minimizes my hips. i was kind of worried about the high neck making me look like i had a zillion chins, but i was stupid to even worry:p it was totally fine! the only problem was the arms gaped noticeably, i had to have them altered!

review_summary: I needed a simple black d
review_text: I needed a simple black dress that I could dress up or down to wear in the fall. I saw this dress and bought it. It is just that, a simple black dress. It looks great on and I have received a few compliments on it. My only complaint is that modcloth just came out with this dress in about 5 other colors and I am sad that I missed out. I might just have to order another ;). All in all it is a great dress. Just heavy enough for the fall without being too much and looks and feels good.

I would give this dress 5 stars if it wasn't so short  other then that, everything fits perfect. Looks cute with leggings. There is just enough room for the girls which is often an issue for me when buying dresses. Now that there are other colors for this dress I am thinking of getting a 2nd one.

I've always done well with dresses in this style on modcloth, but on this one the arm holes are weirdly large and gap awkwardly.  Not sure if ordering a size smaller would make any difference?  Had to return this one.
Absolutely perfect! Very flattering fit! Good quality.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. It's p
review_text: I LOVE this dress. It's possibly my favorite item that I've ordered from ModCloth. Other reviews suggested I go up a size and I did. I'm right smack dab in the middle of a med. and a large on almost everything.  Took the advice and it's perfect. Great quality. A heavier fabric than what you typically get with cutesy dresses. With tights, this will take me right through winter...never really gets that cold here anyway. May need this in more colors.

review_summary: So sad that this didn't w
review_text: So sad that this didn't work for me because it is a super cute style.  The fabric is very cheap polyester and kind of shiny in person.  Also, I seem to have a problem with all modcloth dresses being too short and this was no exception.  It fell just a couple inches below my butt.  If the fabric were nicer, I would wear this short of a dress with opaque tights and boots.  I was tempted to keep it but again, the polyester fabric was just too cheap looking.

review_summary: I love this dress. It's m
review_text: I love this dress. It's my first Modcloth purchase and I was a little hesitant to buy since I couldn't try it on.

review_summary: Love this dress! I like t
review_text: Love this dress! I like the fabric, which hangs very nicely on a curvy figure. The cut is very flattering for someone like me who has a little to hide in all areas. The stitching on the pockets is a little flimsy, though, and I found a hole in the bottom of one of them after only wearing the dress for a few hours. Nothing a few seconds with a needle and thread can't fix, but annoying nonetheless.

review_summary: I loved this dress, I sho
review_text: I loved this dress, I shop on ModCloth A LOT so some things don't fit but this fits perfect. It looks heavy in the picture so I was a bit concerned when I bought it, living in FL I hardley ever get to wear heavy clothing. The dress came and it was light and the big gold buttons are the perfect accent pieces to this cute black dress. BUY IT!

review_summary: I love this dress! I got
review_text: I love this dress! I got so many comments and it fit and felt perfect. However, on the first day I wore it, one of the buttons on the waist came off. The second time I wore it I noticed that the back, where I wear my bag, had started to pill. But that may be more me than the dress. I still love the dress but I'm a little disappointed it isn't as robust as I would like.

Wonderful fall/winter dress. the material is thick which A) compliments my body especially around the midsection and B) makes it a dress for cooler months. C) The style itself is unique which I like wearing dresses that no one else will have. CONS: It is short but the style will allow me to wear dark leggings w/ it and hopefully will still look appropriate. Love it.

I absolutely love the design of this dress, but a have a couple of minor problems with it. Firstly, it was much to large around the bust, but I fixed this by taking it in with a few stitches on each side. But more irritating is the quality of the fabric. After wearing it for only one day the back of it started pilling, which is really unfortunate. It would be a perfectly designed dress were it not for the bad quality of the fabric.
This dress is adorable.  It hits above the knee and I love how it has pockets.

I'm taller and weighing in on the thinner side these days, so I ordered a medium to cover the length of me. The great, comfy collar lays just right, but I found the cut of the sleeveless arm holes to bare a bit more under arm (and some bra) than I would like. The skirt lays well above my knees, but it was well accepted at the cocktail party I wore it to. This dress is definitely well made and comfortable!

My first ModCloth purchase, and I couldn't be happier  completely perfect dress! Not only are the buttons adorable, but they're reflective so each of them is like a tiny mirror. The material is really comfortable and the collar is super cute, and the waist clinch is in just the right place. I'm sold! Definitely won't be my last buy from the site. :D

I ordered this dress four days ago and it came today. I tried it on and can't take it off. I love it.  I am 5'2 and 105lbs. It fits perfectly on me. The material is soft and comfortable. This dress is not too short, it comes to the mid thigh.

review_summary: I was a little unsure abo
review_text: I was a little unsure about this dress at first but after staring at myself in the mirror for a few minutes I started to love it. It hits my waist at the right place. It's a little long on me; it went past my knees but I'll just hem it about an inch or two. Seems like a great dress for winter! :)

Based on previous reviews, I thought for sure this dress would be a keeper. The fit was fine everywhere EXCEPT for the arms. The arm holes were enormous to the point that with my arms by my side, the dress would poof out a good few inches at the armpits. I am definitely pearshaped, but my arms are not that skinny. Being bustier might have alleviated the problem, but alas, it was not meant to be.
Holy shortville, Batman! If you're over 5'7 don't even thikg about this dress unless you plan to wear it like a tunic!!! :D Super cute, just not what I wanted.. this one got sent back today!

I absolutely love this dress. Before ordering this dress I was afraid of where the waistline would fall because of my bust but it is a perfect fit. The material is soft but holds a good shape. I like short skirts and dress and this one falls in a good place for me, above the knee. This can be an isssue for a tall person. Awesome purchase.

review_summary: Sorry I don't have my mea
review_text: Sorry I don't have my measurements but to give you an idea I have a DD bust and hips in spades. I am 5'4'' and the dress is short on me. I could wear it without tights if I was cautious but since the fabric is thick and wintery I plan to wear it with stockings at least (or knee socks!). I'm also really excited to throw a white turtle neck under it. I usually don't wear dresses with high neck lines, because lower necklines balance out my hips but the draped fabric and synched waist looks amazing with my curves!!

review_summary: This is such a great dres
review_text: This is such a great dress!  I've just worn it by itself so far without even dressing it up with some tights, and it's already a favorite in my massive dress collection.  While it is a rather simple dress, the cut is so flattering and the style is so different that it is incredibly eyecatching.  Overall, the material and the dress itself are very high quality, as well. The length is great  short enough for hot summer days, and throwing on some tights underneath in the fall.  It seems really versatile too, since it is kind of simple.

The dress itself is lovely quality, I'm quite happy with it.  It will be a great winter dress.  The length is just right to wear with tights.  My only qualm is that the sleeves gape slightly on me.  I'll have to find a way to fix them.  I don't think the smaller size would have accommodated my chest or my height, so this was probably the better option.

My first ModCloth dress, and I love it! This is such a cute dress, and it was exactly what I expected it to be :) The fabric is good quality, the length is nice (about midthigh, perfect!), and it is all over very flattering and comfortable. I am a bit on the shorter side and curvy, normally wear a medium in dresses (68), got this dress in a medium and it fits just right! My only little complaint is that the dress gaps a bit in the arm openings by the bust, but it's really not a big deal, not enough to keep me from loving this dress! Thanks, ModCloth :)

Love this dress! It fits me perfectly and somehow balances out my large chest and hips. It's short, and I'm short so that's saying something... things are NEVER short on me. The material is nice, but the cut is so amazingly flattering. I love it, great dress!

review_summary: I'll say it again; I wish
review_text: I'll say it again; I wish the length was just a little longer. Length aside, it feels so soft and comfy. I can't wait to wear it on vacation next week in Germany!
I absolutely could not wait to get this dress! But I wanted to cry  when it arrived and hardly covered my behind. Granted I am 5 10, but the medium was too short.

review_summary: If this dress came in dif
review_text: If this dress came in different colors, I'd probably have to buy them.  I purchased this with some hesitation, but tried it on and was so happy: it IS a bit short, so it's GREAT for showing off your legs... or just pairing with leggings and heels.  Got many compliments on how skinny I looked... thanks, dress lots of smoke and mirrors helped me look and feel sexy.
I wasn't impressed  with this dress (shirt) and my 16 year old daughter wasn't either.  Just wasn't great quality or fit.

I came across this dress and fell in love with it! The buttons are gorgeous and the flopped neckline is exactly what I wear...a lot. This was my second modcloth purchase and I will definitly continue to shop here! The only problems I had with the dress were: the neckline which was not connected to the rest of the dress where the buttons are (I am going to tack it into place) and the armpit area is a tad big and pokes out when I raise my arms (I am going to pinch, fold and sew that to a closer fit like you would do with a dart). I had no problem with the length of the dress like other customers have had so I would definitly recomend this dress to anyone looking for a fun, classy, modern, and edgy dress. THANKS MODCLOTH!

I loveeeee this dress.  The thicker fabric is perfect for fall and the buttons on the waist make it really slimming.  I think it will look really cute with a bright long sleeve shirt, tights and boots!
This is a lovely dress.
although a button fell of on my first day wearing this dress...i love it very much;0)

I bought this dress last December. I loved it even though it was a bit on the shorter size. I'm glad I didn't buy a size up though because the fit is good otherwise. I've been wearing it with skinny jeans during the summer, but I'm excited to wear it with tights again once the weather is cooler.

I really adore this dress!  I'm pretty curvy, but this fits exactly right on my waist with enough room on the top for the girls, skims over my hips, and falls straight hitting about midthigh .  It is definitely a bit shorter than I expected, but I was planning on wearing it with some opaque tights anyway.  Also, I didn't read the full details and was expecting it to be more of a cottony knit, but it's actually polyester/spandex which really does give it a nice weight and just enough stretch to make it comfortable.  This is definitely going to be one of my fall staples!

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this dress. I ordered it hoping it would work well for class and work but it is SO short. I was hoping that since I'm so short (5'2) that it would work on me but I would have to wear it with tights and even then its too short.I have to say I was also disappointed with the fabric of the dress; I found it itchy and not very comfortable compared to what I'm used to from Modcloth. I was also disappointed that one of the buttons was not even attached and was just floating in the bag when I received it. Its one thing for a button to fall off after a couple of wears but it should be attached when shipped. Overall, I was pretty disappointed and plan on returning it on Monday.

I've been waiting for this dress to come back in stock for FOREVER now :) I was so giddy when I purchased this dress and counted down the days until it's arrival. I was not disappointed. This dress is absolute perfection. I made sure to read the reviews ahead of time from the previous dress (many of the reviews stated the dress was too short). Therefore, I ordered a size up. I was worried that my bust would be too small for a Medium, but the dress fit to absolute perfection. I plan on wearing the dress to present at a research conference and the length (if you go a size up) was just the right size! The quality of the dress is beautiful and it is such a lovely material that you can dress it up and dress it down for almost any occasion. I do agree with another review though, this is one of my favorite designers. I always love their work. Please add them to the designer list. :)

review_summary: So Cute but the side zipper isn't great and runs small
review_text: I wanted this dress to fit so badly, and it almost did but I couldn't get the zipper up past my bra area  it's so cute so it's such a shame.

review_summary: What can I say about this
review_text: What can I say about this dress? I love wearing it. Compliments galore and I feel awesome! So happy to have purchased it and I love the quality.

I so wanted to love this dress, since it's classic, smartlooking, versatile, and a nod to kitties and Mr. Bowie  it has a lined skirt, pockets, an embroidered collar, and a color/pattern/weight that is wearable yearround.However, the dress runs quite small and has no stretch  I have a short torso and muscular arms/shoulders and initially tried a Medium and then Large but found that I was unable to raise my arms comfortably. (I wanted to wear the dress to work in an office and also as a cantor/songleader). I also had to take care when removing the dress, even with all buttons undone and the zipper open, which I had to pull over the head like a Tshirt, since the buttons only come to the waist.I appreciated that the dress is washable, but the polyester blend fabric isn't the softest. I would recommend for less busty/muscular wearers.

This dress fit me perfect! I love the material and its at a perfect length. I love the peter pan collar so much! I thought it was a great fit around the chest as well. I was worried it was a bit see through from the pic, but I was wrong. Its more on the thicker side. My only complaint is the the petal pink is out of stock ; ) I have my eye on that one and hope it comes back in stock soon!

This dress really fits great. I think it makes me look thinner at the waist and I feel great wearing it. My only complaint is that the fabric is slightly seethrough. I have only worn it with tights so far.

The material is thick and heavyish, which I like because I can wear it in the colder seasons. Not sure how good it'll be for summer though as it doesn't feel like the fabric will absorb sweat or let air in. It's a bit long on me, but I'm short and tend to prefer dresses that hit mid thigh. Nothing my sewing machine won't fix. Also love that the neck is wide and shows more collar bone than your usual peter pan collar as I don't like it when the collar hugs around my neck too closely.
GREAT dress!! I receive compliments on it every time I wear it. Perfect fit, great length, and super cute with my colored tights.

I absolutely love this dress! I am 5'2, 123lbs. I am a size 6 normally in most stores so because this dress is true to size I should technically have been a medium BUT the small fits perfect, like it was made for me. I agree with another reviewer that the sleeves were a teensy bit tight but it's definitely doable. I get many compliments on this dress. It's extremely figure flattering and comfortable. I'm especially happy that even with me having a bigger bust for my height and frame, this dress made everything look very put together.

My first ModCloth purchase. I love this dress! Fabric has a slight stretch and interesting texture (I was a little concerned about at first, but I've come to appreciate it). Lovely neckline.  Perfect style for hourglass girls; The M fit me just right! It was, however, a bit shorter than what would have been ideal (I suppose it was 23 inches above my knee) but with stockings, it's well enough. I enjoyed this dress so much that I hope to soon get the petal pink color!
This dress is well constructed and very cute.  I wish it was about 1 or 2 longer... but no big deal.  I'm thinking of sewing a bit of lace along the bottom just to make it a bit longer.

I absolutely adore this dress. I had been looking for a black dress with a white peter pan collar that was budgetfriendly, and this definitely fits the bill! I love that the fabric is stretchy but also thick, which means it's pretty forgiving if you don't have washboard abs, and is able to fit busty ladies comfortably. #FashionDeux  I styled this dress with white knee socks and oxfords for a school school look, and for Halloween I styled this dress to be Wednesday Addams by adding a black with with braided ponytails and black flats.

everything fit perfect, but the sleeves are to tight for my arm, cuz I have big shoulder and arm because of my big muscle. But I really like it, so I will do some arrangement to fit perfect, cuz im in love with this dress!!!!

Two amazing things about this dress: 1) it is cute and flowy and charming without being too young or schoolgirlish and 2) when I noticed the collar was a bit offset, Customer Service had one on its way before our chat was even finished. I thought I would feel like this dress looked too young or would be too short, but it is absolutely perfect now that the collar meets in the center of the garment rather than just off to the side. It is playful and classic and I feel like a million bucks when I have it on. Wore it with big gold jewelry (including the Hammer It Home earrings), High Dramaturge tights in black, and a pair of green/black/orange platform pumps I've had forever. When I wear those, I ALWAYS get asked about the shoes (they cost a million and a half dollars and are definitely a statement piece). This time, I got questions about the dress. An A+ in my book, especially to MC Customer Service.

Just perfect! The fabric is semistretch so it gives a great fit. The pictures give an accurate representation of the garment and the quality exceeds the price. I have no complaints about this dress and am sure it'll become a fast wardrobe staple!

review_summary: What a cute dress! I love
review_text: What a cute dress! I love the way and both fits and looks. I was very surprised at the fabric when I first pulled it out of the box but it turned out to be so comfy and smooth. My only tiny complaint is the sleeves are just a teensy bit tighter than I would normally like. However, the dress is way too great in every other way for that to be a deal breaker! And the length is perfect on me...I'm very short so normally I have to get my dresses hemmed but this was just right!

review_summary: This dress is so cute and
review_text: This dress is so cute and so flattering! One of my favorite purchases here on ModCloth. I love wearing this dress with colored tights and my big black boots.
I really disliked the fabric, which was coarse. Also, when I wrote it, I felt like it was a bit too baby doll for me.
This dress fit perfectly! The fabric has some stretch, so there is some give but my shoulders fit the Medium. The waist sat on my natural waist. The length was just above my knees. I love this dress!

This dress fits perfectly and is so rockin' cute. The material is kind of thick, which makes it very forgiving, and it has just the right amount of slight stretch. It is quite wellmade. Like another reviewer, I'm not a fan of exposed zippers in general but I'll forgive it in this case :) I think it's a great multipurpose dress. Love!

I really liked the dress on picture, but wasn't really sure if it fits my style or anything else I already had in my closet. And I have to say it doesn't so much :( Still don't really have ideas about how to combine the dress... but it fits really nicely and it's a good quality so I didn't want to return it... and my bf says I look cute in that :) So thumbs up...

review_summary: I am in LOVE with dress a
review_text: I am in LOVE with dress and have been waiting for it to come back for a loooong time. It doesn't fit me perfectly, but well enough. I do think this fits true to size. I'm very short and petite, so if this was offered in an XS it would fit me like a glove. I'll be altering the length a bit, it's a tad big overall, but not baggy. I'm naturally busty so that helps balance. I think shortening the length will really help. I'd love love more advice on shopping for petite sizes on Modcloth!

review_summary: I am usually a L in modcl
review_text: I am usually a L in modcloth but I ordered up because it was a tiny bit snug on me. Even with the XL I just couldn't convince myself to keep it. It fit great, and I'm a huge fan of peter pan collars, but I just couldn't help but feel juvenile and too old to wear it (I'm 23 lol) but the garment itself is very good quality and it seems like it would last for a while. So, I returned just because of my preference, not because of an issue with the dress!
LOVE this dress! It fits perfectly and I can wear it to work because it hits just above the knee. Very versatile and can be dresses up or down very easily.
Very nice a sweetlooking dress, but so very short(in my terms at least)!

I took someones advice and bought as soon as it was back in stock in my size. And I'm glad I did. But when I took it out of the box and felt the material I thought I wasn't going to like it. But I put it on and it felt right. It was a nice length for me and it wasn't big in the front even though my chest is a a little smaller than others. The sleeves are wonderful! They aren't cap or puff or long. They're just right. I don't mind the exposed zip. The collar is just darling and sits at a very nice place on me. I've bought 2 other dresses from Modcloth and I don't wear them, mostly because my mother took one and I lost the other one. But I really do love this dress and it is by far my favourite purchase.
Really happy that I read the comments before buying. L fits perfectly. I love the dress, it looks really cute
Runs small in bust area, so short so almost does not covers my panties, and fabric looks cheap, not lined. Disliked and returned.

review_summary: I was hesitant to get siz
review_text: I was hesitant to get size S as I am quite tall and I'm sick of buying dresses which end up being too short. The size M was perfect! A flattering longer length which was a couple inchs above the knee. I am slender but not extremely skinny and the top of the dress fit perfectly too. Unlike other reviews on here, the zip didn't worry me at all. Definitely recommend size M for tall, slender girls.
Love this dress! Fits perfectly! Looks really adorable and classy :)

review_summary: I love this dress! Was ey
review_text: I love this dress! Was eyeing it for a while and finally bought it, it's adorable.

This dress is super adorable. It is very mature however, my dad even said I look like a little nun in it.. But I love it, and if you dress it up with a cute belt you should be okay. The material is really good quality and stretchy, with just the right amount of heaviness. It doesnt hold any part of you in though, so if your looking for a form fitting dress you'll probably need something underneath to hold you in. This dress is super high quality, I adore it. Thanks Modcloth!

review_summary: This dress is one of my f
review_text: This dress is one of my favorites! It's so cute and comfy. I was on the fence about getting this dress since a few people didn't like the fabric but it's really nice fabric in my opinion, none of that flimsy stuff! Overall, I'm super happy with this purchase. It was perfect.

This dress is perfect in every way. It's very flattering, with a seam at the waist and a flared skirt. I'm a little over 5 feet at the dress hits above my knees, so I don't look stumpy. The dress  material is light and crunchy and sort of reminds me of parachutes. This doesn't bother me at all, but some people might be expecting/want a wool or cotton dress.

review_summary: I have this dress in red
review_text: I have this dress in red and I wasn't completely impressed with it even after hemming it shorter a little but this one (in black) is great. The length is perfect and it's slimming and pretty. It just simply works. I am quite certain this dress would flatter mostly anyone and it has a bit of stretch too which is nice. Large will more than accommodate most girls that are a little above average weight wise Usually if there is an XL on modcloth I order it and in this dress I definitely am glad I got a large.

review_summary: I was so excited for this

review_summary: I am so, so, SO happy wit
review_text: I am so, so, SO happy with this dress! It fits me like a glove, hugs all the places it should and hides everything I was hoping it would! It comes to my knee which I love because it's flirtatious without being uncomfortable for me! All in all, I'm incredibly happy.
I really love this dress! It has that perfect Wednesday Adams quality. The fabric feels cheaper than I had expected but I'm still happy with the dress overall.

review_summary: I love this dress! I was
review_text: I love this dress! I was a little concerned about the peter pan collar being to precious, but it's adorable without being juvenile. Pairs perfect with any color cardigan or tights. It's a goto for the office, and I get compliments every time I wear it!

My favorite dress I've ever owned. Perfect in every way. great quality, love the material. I have no complaints, I even love the chunky visible zipper in the back. MODCLOTH, PLEASE GET THIS DRESS IN EVERY COLOR, I WILL BUY ALL OF THEM!
Love the classic styling, fit and quality of this dress. Very pleased with this purchase.

Very adorable dress!  It's a little bit short for my taste, but that definitely won't stop me from wearing itwith some leggings it looks just fine.  I've worn it out a few times and always get compliments on it.  Sometimes the zipper sticks a bit, but it always (eventually) zips up.

review_summary: I love this dress the wei

Received this as a Christmas gift from my boyfriend and we are both in love! It's amazing quality for a great price. I feel like a flirty little nun. The length is shorter but with tights it's not a problem! My broader shoulders aren't great for the fit, but I want to wear it every day it's so comfortable and cute.
I love this Dress!  Wore it to a Black and White Party and got loads of compliments.

This dress is very comfortable, and very flattering! There is a good amount of stretch, so this dress fits to your body well, without constraining! Looks great with a pair of colored tights (my fav, burgandy ones!) I am super happy with this purchase!

review_summary: So, I adore this dress. T
review_text: So, I adore this dress. True story. But, the sleeves are a bit tight. Otherwise, no complaints :D

I really recommend this dress. The cut is beautiful. The fabric has a nice drape and weight to it. It's very comfortable, but flattering. My singular complaint is that it's a little short for me, but it's not intolerable. I have a quite large bust size, and the large it perfectly, with a little room to spare because of the stretchy material.

review_summary: Oh my god this dress is a

Wow!  Just received this dress tried it on, and it's perfect !  I was seriously debating between M and L but after reading all the reviews decided to go with a L. This dress is my favorite Modcloth purchase so far. The material is very comfortable and it looks great on. I usually wear it with a mustard colored cardigan.

I love this dress. :) it makes me feel like Wednesday Adams, but not. I just adore it. Being a curvy girl, the only thing I have a complaint about is the zipper that runs down the back. If you don't have a really smooth behind and back, it looks a little funky, but I still love it. It looks great with a belt too. :)

This dress is awesome.Thicky stretchy fabric which is super dooper comfy. I'm a large 99% of the time in Modcloth items but wished I'd ordered a medium in this as it is so stretchy and I like my dresses fitted. The large is a little roomy and I need to wear a belt to draw the waist in but other than my own sizing error its perfect. Not short in length either which is fab.

This dress is so adorable. It cinches at the waist and actually falls right above the knee (just where you want it to!) I am 4'11 so I usually find that dresses everyone else considers short are ok for me, but this length is better than ok. It is also a cute dress for work or going out. The material is a bit different (I am too lazy to read the description to tell you what it is), but it's still great!

This dress is really lovely, I was between a few sizes but opted for an XL now getting it I feel as if I would of fit in a Large but it fits well anyway. It's a bit long for my tastes and I'm pretty short, but the quality it amazing. Great buy for a nice simple dress!

Love this dress! The sleeves are not cap sleeves at all, which is nice. I find the neckline flattering and the length great, but I am short, so that's usually not a problem for me. Others may not agree, but I love the large zipper in the back because it takes a conservative, almost a schoolgirl look and gives it a tiny bit of edge. Looks great paired with any belt.

review_summary: The fit on this dress was
review_text: The fit on this dress was o.k. but i felt that the waist kept rising up making it look like more of a babydolltype dress.  i love the peter pan collar and it's an adorable dress overall.
Great dress. Strange material....but I love it! Even with my 50+ inch hips it fits perfectly!

review_summary: I am in love. This dress
review_text: I am in love. This dress is so perfect! It is a thick, textured fabric, but totally smooth on the inside. It's not too long, not too short. It is nice and simple, looks great on, I am SO pleased. My favorite Modcloth purchase to date, and my 3rd Sunny Girl dress. Awesome liine for girls with a smaller bust (I have the Jazz Club dress and the Take A Half Daisy dress as well) but will fit bigger sizes, there is lots of stretch.

review_summary: Love love love this! I am
review_text: Love love love this! I am wearing it right now with a mustard cardigan, tights, and the Love Walks in Boot. Super cute! Super comfy dress, I could pull it over my head to put on, I did not need to unzip the zipper. The length is great, only an inch or two above my knee, but I am a shorty. I usually wear about a 12 and a L to XL in Modcloth dresses. The only thing is that it does ride up a bit at the waist, and until I pull it down it kinda looks maternityish, but not too bad. I thought I might be too old for this, being in my early 30's, but I found it is super cute and tasteful, not too young at all, just fun! Not too gothy either.

This is the cutest dress I have ever owned. Ever. And the price! So affordable. Thank you Modcloth!My only tiny complaint: the fabric of the color rustles against the fabric of the dress, so it's kind of noisy. But whatevs. I love this too much.

Hourglass girls, buy this now. The bodice is formfitting, but not tight. The lower half is forgiving but doesn't make me look pregnant. Totally mod and dark and awesome. 1960's vogue. This dress should be sold with dark eyeshadow and a pout.

Well this isn't anything I was expecting, the fabric is textured and very strechy. I appreciate that, its from the brand Sunny Girl. Also the material is kinda heavy weight and thick knit type. I was expecting a ponte type material, but its not. Its unlike any other dress and it very cute. I plan on wearing it out for a nice movie date. Its so cute. It's short so I must warn, on me it hit right above the knees so I'll probably wear solid black tights and cute oxford flatts. I am very VERY pleased with this dress! so cute!

Overall a very sweet dress. A bit on the dressy side for me so I mostly wear it when going out for family dinners or things where I want to seem put together. I haven't yet felt comfortable enough to wear it as a casual dress for class or walkin around the mall... but maybe that's just me. It's a cute cut though, and though it's not as tight as I'd like it to be, it fits well enough. I think an XSmall would have been a better option for me if it were available.

Oh my goodness. This dress is so simple, but so perfect and amazing. I have been looking for a dress this exact style forever, and was bummed when Modcloth sold out the first time, so when I saw that it was back in stock I immediately snatched one up. Wow wow wow this dress is gorgeous. The fabric feels nice and worth the price, and it fits like a dream. I said this about another dress, but THIS one is definitely my favorite Modcloth purchase so far. And it came with a lovely hair clip as a free gift!

This dress is adorable, comfortable, and perfect in every way.  I cannot wait to wear it.  My only  teeeeeeeeeny  grumble is that i'm not a fan of the chunky exposed zipper,  but i'd have known that if i'd read the description.  Otherwise its perfect! Definitely a keeper!I'm including my weight with all of my measurements, because i find it the most helpful when i'm trying to figure out the fit of online items so you can add 200 lbs to that little stack of stats over there.    :) Apologies for the Lowfi images.  I was too excited to wait and so I modelled it right out of the box.

Love this dress! The material is a coarse polyester with just a touch of stretch and is surprisingly soft. Other reviewers made me worry about fit, but it fits perfectly. It's fit to form, without being overly tight. The scoop neck line and peter pan collar are darling and just the right place. It's lower than it appears in the pictures, but looks really flattering. Looks great with accent belts of many colors. I wore it with some lace tights, black heels and a belt. This is a definite wardrobe staple.

review_summary: Cute dress, but I don't l

This is the perfect dress! It fit me a little snug, but has stretch so it is very comfortable to wear. The neckline is great and I love the shape. I highly recommend this dress!

The fabric is stretchy which is nice, but it doesnt look cheap, which sometimes happens when fabric is stretchy. It a little shorter than I like for the style of this dress, I always like when the cutesy type dresses are knee length. I get TONS of compliments on it and I'm def very happy with my purchase.

This dress is so lovely. I didn't expect it to be a polyester material (hey that's why you read the details!) but the lining is a much smoother, lighter material so it's still really comfortable against your skin. The fit is just right, it's not too long or too short for me being a shorter girl, the sleeves are just the right length and aren't too tight. Like others have said the collar is lower and wider than I expected, not your typical peter pan collar, but still very modest and very adorable. Every time I pull this dress out of my closet I swoon all over again!
Love, love, love this dress!The collar is so cute and the neckline just low enough to make it a little different from traditional peter pan collars.The fit is great too.
Super cute dress!  Great length and I love the exposed zipper.

review_summary: Wore this dress with a re

review_summary: Well I love this dress. T

It's really cute and figureflattering, works even for those of us with an ample bust (the waistline doesn't ride up too high because of the girls, yay!), is a great length... As another reviewer mentioned, it's sewn on a bit crooked (on mine, anyway). It isn't so much that it's particularly noticeable, but I know it's there and it bothers me. Otherwise, I love love love it!

I've been wanting a black and white peter pan collar dress for quite some time, so when I saw this one, I had to have it. A great little dress for the price. The fit is good and comfortable. My only complaint is that is a little shorter than I would have liked.

This is defiantly an amazing dress! It fut me like a glove and it's very flattering.  The neckline it's deeper than it seems which makes this dress even nicer. The fabric is very nice not too soft nor too stiff, just perfect.

review_summary: I just got it in the mail

The size was perfect and I can see this dress being flattering to almost any figure. My only complaint is that the stitching was off on the zipper making the zipper a bit sticky towards the top. I am worried that the stitching in the zipper might even come undone so the quality is not that great.

I absolutely LOVE this dress! As soon as It popped up on the website it took my breath away. It is flattering and charming on. I feel like a cute/sexy Wednesday Addams. The peter pan collar is adorable also. Go for it!

this dress is PERFECT! the dress did not feel short for me, it comes a few inches above my knees. the fabric gives enough stretch but it didn't feel tight at all, the neckline is flattering as well as the cut of the waist. so happy.

The material isn't bad at all and it fits me almost perfect  it's little bigger on me than I would have liked but not too bad.  I would definitely recommend buying this quality piece of clothing.

review_summary: I've been looking for a b

Very cute in a mod, '60s way. The neckline is a bit lower and wider than it appears on the mannequin, which is unusual for a peter pan collar, but it still looks good. It's not that short; it ends about 5 above my knees. The top part fits snugly and the bottom hangs more loosely, in an unstructured way. It doesn't do much to hide your stomach. The sleeves are actual sleeves, not cap sleeves, which I really like.

review_summary: Oh lawd, I never want to
review_text: Oh lawd, I never want to take this dress off. First off, I REALLY like the feel and weight of the fabric, plus the fact that it has a bit of give. review_summary: Pretty color, love the pleating, weird fit, needed alteratio
review_text: I bought/wore this as a bridesmaids dress.  I am 5'4, 126 lbs, pear shaped, and wore heels.  I bought a medium and it fit well except the top/bust was too long/large (and I am a ccup) and the overall length of the dress was too long (that is normal for me though).  I had straps altered/taken in which fixed the top and the overall length, so a pretty simple alteration.  I really liked the vneck as it did not show too much.  The dress was very comfortable and flowy.  One weird thing that I did not like was the seam at the bottom of the waist  it showed too much (see close up photo).  Also, where the fabric changed at the bottom of the drop waist to the pleated fabric brought more attention to the hips (which I was not a fan of). Overall the dress was pretty and fit well after some alterations.  PS the colors in my personal photos are weird, and the dress color was pretty true to the photos modcloth uses.

review_summary: I bought this dress to we

Holy mackerel I'm in luuuurve! It may run a teensy bit loose, but the L would have been snug. The tie belt cinches things in perfectly, tho so no worries. It looks super cute tied in front OR back. I'm pairing this with black Mary janes and pearls. I eyeballed this one for a long time. If you're on the fence, hop over. You NEED dis!

I love Effie's Heart and this dress doesn't disappoint. The color is beautiful and the planes look amazing with the feminine black ruffle combo.

This dress is adorable! I?m a little busty so I thought that this would be too tight in the top as there?s not much give however it fit perfectly and I received so many compliments! Definitely a must buy!

review_summary: I ordered a Large with fi
review_text: I ordered a Large with fingers crossed, hoping that it would fit. Not even close. I'm 5', 34DD, smallish person.
