When I pulled it out of the box at work my coworker asked if there were fingers or lipsticks on it and that honestly made me like it more.

review_summary: This is a very high quali
review_text: This is a very high quality piece. Completely worth the price, the fabric is heavy and thick making it perfect for winter even though it has short sleeves.

This is honestly the best dress I have ever owned.  The material gives in all the right places and hugs in all of the right places.  The side pleat offers a small disguise on the tummy so, after lunch, you don't have to walk around sucking in all day long!  It's the perfect length, the pattern is beautiful.  SO Beautiful!

I was a little afraid to get this dress after I've read the reviews, but I'm so happy I did! I'm 5.9 and 155lbs, I've got size L as I don't like when clothes are too tight on me.  This one fits perfectly,  has plenty of space for the chest part (I wear 38C) and has surprisingly long body part so it looks good on the tall lady like myself.  I love it.

I lust after Modcloth dresses often but being 6' tall, when I buy them they usually look like empire waist or baby doll dresses, alas. But this one I took a chance on, I couldn't resist those pockets. And I'm so glad I did! The dress is beautiful and while the waist sits higher than my natural waist (as to be expected), the detail on the waist makes it look totally normal. The pockets are a superb touch and the dress is just poofy enough to give your waist the cinched look. Highly recommend to one and all! Also a note, a couple of reviews highlighted that the top is small, and I was worried as I have broad shoulders. I'm a 14 usually, with a 42 bust, but XL was the largest size available so I took a shot. FITS PERFECTLY.

review_summary: Small in the bust but so pretty
review_text: I am a 12UK and 68 US, so I was right in the zone for a medium here, which is what I usually wear.  This would not zip over the bust.  I have time before I need this (wedding) so I'm sending it back to size up.  I love the retro design, and I hope to make this work.

review_summary: Hated it. The color was g
review_text: Hated it. The color was great but that's pretty much it. It was a bit too ill fitting.

This dress was very high waisted on me and longer than I expected. Because the waist was at my ribs I couldn't zip it up. I would probably fit well into a large but that size isn't available. I'll be returning this dress but it is very good quality and the green is just as bright as in the photo. May be meant for women with shorter torsos and longer legs than mine (which people always comment are her long already).

review_summary: NOT true to size, but is lovely
review_text: I purchased this dress in Clover for a fall wedding, and was so excited for it to arrive in the mail! Unfortunately, when it arrived it was super wrinkled. I wasn't too worried, though, as I figured I could just iron it. The fabric is good quality and perfect weight for fall. Other reviewers state that this dress runs large, but in my experience, the top of the dress runs VERY small. I purchased a size small based on other reviews of this item. I am 5'5 and about 135lbs, 34B. When I tried the dress on, I could not zip it over my chest. If you have a curvy upper body you will want to be careful with the sizing with this dress.

Waist was tight. I always wears S or M. I ordered an M. The dress runs small. I've returned and ordered a large. It will be here today. Quality was impressive. Fabric beautiful. Lays well.  Beautifully lined. Great dress. Hope the larger size works.

Such a gorgeous dress, and so well made! The green is a perfect emerald color. It's very comfortable, and the fabric is heavy but soft. I got the large, but would have done fine in medium. I will probably hem this, since it's maybe 4 longer than I'd like. But it hits that sweet spot between classy and sexy, for sure.

review_summary: I love this beautiful, flattering dress!
review_text: This is an amazing dress! The red flower pattern is very pretty, but what really sets the dress apart is the mesh and polka dot overlay. It gives the dress a slightly vintage feel, without moving into costumey territory. The length is perfect. The dress hit me at the top of my knee, while the overlay hit at the bottom of my knee. The top fit very well, which is important with a larger chest, and the Aline waist was very slimming. I wish I had a photo to post, but the event location was too dark for good pictures. You'll just have to take my word that this is a fantastic dress! I wore it to my 20th high school reunion and got a ton of compliments.

The bodice of this dress fits like a dream and I love the contrast of the red floral with the black. I wore it to a party and received many compliments. The length is perfect, shorter on me than pictured on the model since I'm 5' 9, but I prefer it since the rest of the dress is so covered up.

Ordered a L, which is usually a safe bet for me, but I couldn't even zip it all the way up because the top was too tight!  It is beautiful, though  returning for an XL and hoping for the best.  Seems like great quality and a flattering cut.
I loved this dress, but it does run small.  Would advise sizing up/. Very nice quality.

I just received and tried this dress  very unique style and flattering fit. There is no stretch, so I went with a Medium instead of Small and was glad I did (still could raise my arms up all the way). Some of the appliques were also folded over, but doesn't take away from the beauty of the dress.

This is a very cute dress. I read the sizing chart and noticed that the review stated that this dress runs in a large. I'm in between a M/L. I went with the medium and it fit perfectly. It's a gorgeous dress with a very unique look. My only complaint is that it doesn't have pockets! But otherwise, it's easily going to be another staple/goto dress in my wardrobe.

I have a difficult time finding dresses that fit properly, and this dress fits well, it is form fitting where it needs to be but I don't feel like I'm going to rip a seam if I move. Fabric is of good quality. I love it!

Normally I wear the mod cloth labeled cloths in a size small. I expected this to be the same. It fit really big in the top (usually have the opposite problem) and the color was much darker; more of dark burnt orange verses a orangeymustard yellow as shown in the picture. Also, it came out of the bag super wrinkled and would probably require ironing even after washed and dried. The pockets seemed nice though and were very big. Bummed it's sold out in xs.

review_summary: A comfortable eloping in the woods choice!
review_text: I bought this for my elopement at a state park. Super flattering if you're curvy and have a tummy with the empire waist. The dress was actually very comfortable, beautiful and also has cups in the bodice. I added the Modcloth flower necklace and beetle earrings to compliment the setting in the woods. Dress is also very bra friendly, so you don't have to panic about low backs or straps. I am so happy with this dress! I am 5'1 so I had to hem the dress, but the lace at the bottom is on a straight hem, so easy to mend even at the dry cleaner.

Holy mother, this dress. I was surprised when I received the package because it was quite heavy, but it's just because the fabric isn't flimsy and it's a long dress. I order a lot of dresses (Mata Traders, Princess Highway) and will be locking in this Bright and Beautiful brand as well. The sizing issues are because the Small is actually a 10 UK, which is what I buy in other dresses (although I probably need to gain a couple lbs for a 10 UK to fit perfectly). All I can say is that I put it on, felt legit giddy, and was compelled to twirl. The length is great and I don't have any other dresses that compare. I think the color is a smidge darker or dustier than what's in the photos.
Perfect Dress for fall! Worked perfectly for work and then dinner out with the hubby. Very flattering and very comfortable!

This was one of about 12 items I bought from ModCloth for the first time. I love nearly everything I ordered, but this is really special. I can't believe I ordered something online that feels like it was custom made. It is simply gorgeousI'm a lot heavier now than I was for most of my adult life and feel very selfconscious in clothing that shows off curves, but this is just amazingly flattering. Huge volumes of cloth create an enormous skirt, but it is well constructed and sewn so that it isn't bunched up around the hips or stomach. The shoulders and bustline fit perfectly. The colors are really great too. I could go on and on, how much I love this dress. The brand is Bright and Beautiful and I wish ModCloth would identify the other items in this brand. It is the best fitting dress I've probably bought in my lifeand that includes when I weighed 40 pounds less! Make this in more fabrics, please!!

I absolutely love this dress. The colors are so rich and autumnlike. Sizing down was definitely the right thing to do. I added a burgundy cardigan to complete the professional look. This is definitely going to get a lot of wear!

review_summary: I just got a chance to tr
review_text: I just got a chance to try this on and my hubby had to take pictures! He loves how I look in it! I love the fabric, it's not thin but not heavy. Great quality! The cap sleeves are super flattering and the length is perfect. The cardigan and shoes add the perfect touch. Can't wait to wear this for date night soon!
Perfect dress to teach in! Very comfortable to wear all day.

I am so happy with this purchase! I love this dress. I purchased an XXL (my waist being 37 inches) and it fits perfectly. It checks all my boxes:I'm self conscious about my arm bulge and the dress covers it perfectlythe length is long and feels wonderfulnice quality fabricIt's a great fall dress and very professional. I'm planning on wearing it to a conference
Such a beautiful dress! Perfect fall colors! Absolutely gorgeous!

review_summary: There are not enough words to express my love
review_text: This is my favourite dress I have ever purchased from ModCloth ever. And I've bought a lot, lol. Seriously, though...< 3 < 3 < 3 I love this dress SO FLIPPING MUCH. It fits perfectly everywhere. And tall girls...the length is amazing!!! The colors are gorgeous, the fabric is quality....aaaaaaahhhh, I love this dress!

review_summary: I wanted to like this dre
review_text: I wanted to like this dress. I've been looking for a good lemon print for ages and it has several other features I like (the belt, the cowl neck). But in the event, the waist hit around my ribs, like an inch above my natural waist. I don't think I'm especially longwaisted. The skirt was also beyond my knees, but that's not unusual for me at 5'4. Plus the skirt was not full enough for my taste. But that's a me thing. Mainly it was the waist that did it.
This dress is beautiful, nice, flows fabric, good quality and fits well.  Draped neckline is perfect for me, as is the length.  So glad I made this purchase.

This dress is so light and flowy, it's truly perfect for spring/summer. I'm 112 lbs, 5'6 and ordered an XS. It fits beautifully around the waist, bust, shoulders, and neckline. It's also the perfect length for me, falling just below my knees. As a teacher, you definitely appreciate that extra length this dress offers. Another good one Modcloth! :)

I ordered the L and it fits perfect. The material is very light weight with out being seethrough. I ordered this in the lemon print. The background is actually navy, so the belt that comes with does not look as out of place as it does it the picture. Overall I cant wait to get this on. I live in the south, and I think this will be one of my goto summer dresses.
I was so disappointed in this dress. It's completely shapeless without the sash and the sash does very little to improve it.

review_summary: This is the worst dress t
review_text: This is the worst dress that I've  ever tried on , so unflattering. The material is very thin and poor quality for the price. :(

This dress really only gets a star for the cute print. (I say dress because it's basically a giant shirt with a sash.) The fabric is thin and easily wrinkled. One pocket was sewn noticeably smaller than the other. At $70, you're paying for the print, not the quality. I'd return it if I could, but I've worn it out once.

I'm glad I'm not the only one disappointed in this dress. I had to have it when I saw the pencil print, which looks just as adorable in person. The shape of the dress, however, does not. It's like wearing a pillow case. Not a good look for me, as I'm more of a fit and flare kinda girl. Also, mine was missing the sash. :( The material is lightweight and comfortable, so at least there's that. I'm curious as to why it can't be machine washed/dried (according to the tag) when it's 100% cotton. Despite its problems, I think I'll keep it. The white belt from another Modcloth dress (the Turn Back Timeless dress) makes it work.

When I saw this dress, I had to get it. I'm an art teacher and this dress is so perfect for me. I like the material a lot, it's breathable and comfortable. Material is not too thin or heavy. The fit is perfect, loose looking without the tie but with the tie it's just right. Not tight anywhere for me and it's a great length for school, stops right at my knees.

review_summary: I had such high hopes for
review_text: I had such high hopes for this dress. The cut of the dress is so strange to begin with. It is really tight at the top and gets super wide at the waist and even more at the hips. Your arms will be screaming for room and so will your neck. The belt they provide gives you a back boob and the buttons in the front are too wide to provide full coverage so you will probably be flashing people all day. The material is the cheapest I have ever seen on a dress before.. literally it's like paper thin and the belt is a piece of awkward fabric you tie around your waist with no belt loops to hold it up. Overall, NOT worth paying full price and I'll be returning :(

This dress is great, but two things to be aware of: 1) the belt, while cute, is SUPER cheap and will unfasten itself several times a day, and 2) the background color is a dark teal, not the blue that it appears to be in the pictures.

I thought this would be a bright summer dress. What I got is made of thick fabric, the color is dark greenish (not the lovely blue shown on pictures). The length is good (it covers my knees) but the waistline is high and a bit too narrow. The sleeves are awkward too.I felt relieved when I could finally take it off.

This print is even better in person! It is so adorable! The dress is true to size and fits well. I do not like the cappedlike sleeve. I ma having it altered to sleeveless because they just lay odd on me. The sleeves may be fine for others.
I really like this dress.  I received a lot of compliments at work.  It?s very unique looking.   Love the color as well.

I really really wanted to like this dress but I agree with the previous reviewer. The hip area is too tight while the waist is too baggy. I though about ordering the next size up and having the waist tailored but the fabric also feels thinner than it looks.

I was excited about this purchase but extremely disappointed. The mid section of this dress is very loose and the bottom around the hip area is tight. It fits and looks weird because of the loose fabric in the mid section. Returning.

I am very happy with this dress. Got size advice from a Modcloth stylist and the UK10 (US 4) is just right. As a taller (5'9) woman, finding a wellproportioned, longenough dress is a challenge, and this one is flattering and comfortable. I wear seamless underwear or spanx underneath but it is not too tight to get away without it. Easy to accessorize with.

review_summary: If you prefer a dress tha
review_text: If you prefer a dress that hugs any of your curves, this may not be the dress for you. That being said, it is a sheath, and although it makes my hips look even smaller than my bust, sizing down would have showed off my underwear in the worst way. It's classy, it's minimal, it's neat?definitely a weartowork number. The scalloped hem is a nice touch, and having that slit on the bottom makes it easier to walk in and more comfortable. I can pair with almost anything. (Excuse the mess in the photos.)

review_summary: The fabric was thin and t
review_text: The fabric was thin and textured in a way I didn't expect. Can't say I liked it. Although the fit was fine (I'm a U.S. O12 and ordered a UK 16), there was nothing to this dress to give it even the least bit of structure to lay on my body in a flattering way. Oh, and all my husband said when I tried it on and showed him was, Well, I guess you could wear it to a funeral. He wasn't wrong. Yep, returned!

I've been wanting a chambray dress for awhile and was excited to order and try this fit out. It's oh so comfortable and cute out. I felt great in it while I was running errands on Saturday and look forward to more opportunities to wear it!
True to size! Great material perfect for spring/Summer. I love it without the belt but love the belt option. They also send backup straps LOVE IT

review_summary: Beautiful dress but shows a full coverage bra
review_text: This is a well made and gorgeous dress but I would not recommend it for those of us who wear fullcoverage bras.  There is a gaping hole in the cleavage and no matter how I futzed with the pretty tie at the neckline, I could not get it to stay closed.  Also, I read one of the reviews that this ran small in the bust so, while I normally get a S or M, I ordered a L and it was way too big.  I sent it back and got the M and, while that fit, sadly it looked silly with my bra showing.

review_summary: Lovely and fairly well made, just runs small.
review_text: I bought this a week ago, and it just arrived. I bought a M (usually buy M/S), and it fit perfectly except in the bust  it wouldn't zip past my ribs. The color is lovely, but I have to return it because it's just such an awkward fit.
I love shirt dresses, and this one is perfect for the winter and fall. Nice and warm.
Love this cozy dressperfect for fall and winter, goes well with tights and boots. The buttons stay in place, which I really appreciate. No bulging or accidental button popping

Love the style, and it fit well overall, but the waist was too low on my 5 foot even frame.  The skirt also fell too long on me, even for a mididress.  Too bad  it seemed warm and wellmade.  Nice thick fabric.

review_summary: Good fit. Not thrilled with the length
review_text: I thought this dress fit my very well. I am pretty short and so I wasn't happy with where the bottom was hitting me. It looked awkward. Still deciding between returning or getting it hemmed. I definitely am not happy with the length as is.

SO HAPPY!!  Colors are exactly as pictured, fabric is soft and thick, and the fit is absolutely perfect.  No issues of buttons gapping open when moving or sitting down, and it lays properly in all the right places.  My only complaint would be that it?s a little long if you?re below 5?6?, but a quick hem job will take care of that.  Would definitely purchase again in other colors.

UGH  I was so in love with this dress when it arrived. Perfect fall/winter dress for here in SoCal. Pockets  which are my FAV.   The length was PURRRRFECT when it arrived though the rest of the dress was a bit large  it being 100% cotton I would not want to size down due to dreaded shrinkage.  My lovely midi went from perfect to petite. I lost close to 4 inches of length after my first wash, and now this dress is too short to comfortably wear to work. :(

I was wary of buying a ModCloth brand item as reviews seem to be consistently: fits weird, not worth the price... NOT true with this dress! I snagged it during a flash sale and am so thankful that I did! It is a gorgeous, highquality dress and the fit works perfectly for me (I am 5'7, 120 lbs. I will say, however, I am a 34 B. If you are a size small, though more buxom than this, the top may be too tight to button). I envision wearing it all fall and winter long!

I had considered buying the navy/red/creme combo version of this dress last year, but I absolutely had to have the red/black version and I'm so happy with it. The fabric has nice weight to it, seems like it won't wrinkle too bad and feels so soft and high quality. I love the length (I'm 5'8 and it's right at the bottom of my knees) and that the sleeves actually feel long enough. Plus it has pockets! Can't wait to wear this for fall/winter and now I will have to probably also buy the other colors!

This dress is AMAZING. I'm going to Japan in Nov, which is fairly cold compared to SoCal, so I needed a cute dress I could wear with all sorts of warm things. The material on this dress is so nice and comfy. The length of the sleeves and hem are perfect (which is uncommon, because I'm shorter than average). It's SO flattering too. Seriously I look so slim in this. Love it.

I couldn't wait to get this. I adore the uniqueness of the colors and style. I think it will be nice casual or dressy but my favorite way to wear it will be with casual boots/booties. Fabric and craftsmanship are sturdy. Won't need a slip. Warm but not overkill. However, a bit tight in the shoulders! And I'm not huge in the shoulders. I am 5'4 and 129 lbs and got the small. As the other reviewer indicated, not bad enough to return it (the medium would be huge and long). Fits just right at the waist but I had to unbutton more than half the buttons to get it over my head which surprised me. That's the only reason I didn't rate it a five.

Purchased this on a whim, and so glad I did. It's gorgeous. Material is high quality, and it seems like it will be warm in colder months. The only complaint, and it's small, is that the bust is a little tight. I ordered a medium, and I have a 36C bust. It's not enough for be to return it, but I won't be doing any jumping jacks in it!

I've been eyeing this dress for some time, and recently was able to purchase. It was previously sold out, and I am glad Modcloth decided to restock the dress. Probably from popular demand. It fits like a glove. It's very modest and hits slightly below my knees. It is true to size. I based the dress size off of the measurements from the size chart. The material of the dress looks to be good quality. I've had issues with buttons from previous Modcloth orders, but the buttons on this dress are sturdy. Big plus is that the dress comes with pockets. Overall, I would recommend this dressed.
Another amazing piece from Modcloth! It fits like a glove and seems to be incredible quality for the price. I absolutely love it.

review_summary: I love this dress! It fit
review_text: I love this dress! It fits so well and the length is perfect. It's also so soft and has pockets!

review_summary: This dress is warm and co
review_text: This dress is warm and comfortable as well as work appropriate.  It hits just below my knees, the length is the arms in perfect for me, you also have the option to call sleeves a button in place.  Love this dress and the fit is perfect for me.

review_summary: This is a great dress for
review_text: This is a great dress for casual and work. the material is great for fall.

review_summary: I didn't end up keeping t
review_text: I didn't end up keeping this. It was great quality and very comfortable, just not my style.

review_summary: I don't usually have a pr
review_text: I don't usually have a problem with sleeves, but they were very tight on this dress.  I'm usually a 1X and sized up to a 2X and ended up returning the dress all together because the 2X was too big on me, even though the sleeves were no longer tight.  I wanted to love this dress, for the price I expected a perfect fit.

Beautiful, thick fabric and the fit is perfect! I am used to buttonups gapping at my chest, but this dress doesn't do that and it's much appreciated. Wore this for my first day at a new job felt so cute!

review_summary: I had to sized up on this
review_text: I had to sized up on this dress because crossing my arms would tug at the back too much. Bonus: I can actually raise my arms up in a medium, however, what allows this is the waist size, which is now big enough to move over my lower ribs as the arm sleeves tug the dress upward. In short, the sleeves on this dress don't articulate well, but I'm still keeping it.
This dress is amazing! So soft, great fit, and it has pockets!

review_summary: The dress is made with a
review_text: The dress is made with a really nice flannel material and I was very impressed with the fit too! So comfy and versatile, oh and it has pockets!

I really wanted this one to work for me but I had to return it. I'm pretty new to ModCloth so I'm not really sure about my sizing here yet but for most tops I get I'm a medium (large if it's fitted) and an 8 in pants. I got this dress in large and it fit good. However, for me it just didn't look flattering. The lose fabric right above the waist made me look way too top heavy for my comfort. I think I need something a little more fitted to not feel like I look huge.

review_summary: I love this dress! It is
review_text: I love this dress! It is heavy and soft and perfect for cooler weather. The shape is very flattering and I am always overjoyed when I find a shirt dress that doesn't gape over my bust. I think the waist runs a tad large, but I don't mind since i think the style of the dress lends itself to be a bit less fitted and more casual. I can't wait to wear it!

review_summary: It was so big, plus the c
review_text: It was so big, plus the colors didn't look the same as they did on the app

review_summary: I'm a bit on the fence on
review_text: I'm a bit on the fence on this dress. My two biggest quips are the material and sizing. For the material I don't know why but I was expecting the dress to feel a softer sort of flannel. Instead it feels a bit on thinner side. And with the sizing I was surprised that the 2X actually fit me really well instead of being swamped in material. Unfortunately for my body type I can run anywhere from a L to a 1X (depending on the fit for my waist and tummy). This dress I was expecting to be huge but instead fit really well. I have a feeling that the 1X or even the XL would have been way too snug. So maybe be cautious and size up? Overall I'm definitely keeping it but still have to warm up to it. I'm sure it's going to be an awesome fall and winter piece but just have to figure out how to make it work.

review_summary: I love this dress. It was
review_text: I love this dress. It was worth the money. Perfect for fall. Material is nice and warm.

review_summary: I love this dress, it's s
review_text: I love this dress, it's so comfy! Runs a little large, I should have ordered down but I love it anyway!

Great quality. I wanted this to fit tighter to combat the more casual fabric, but in terms of quality it's hard to beat! Aaaaaaand pockets of course (modcloth brand loves a good pocket). Looks great with a navy blue velvet bootie.
Very Cute, thick material, closed around my chest (without gapping) which is always a plus! Cant wait to wear it!

The dress fit snugly tailored in the shoulder and waist but was six inches away from closing over my bust. The dress is a nice, thick flannel cotton that would be ideal for fall or winter and was good quality. The skirt was slightly less full than I was expecting, but still looked nice. However, if you're a busty girl, I'd either stay away from this one or plan to size up. (I'm a 34DD, size 8, and this dress was NO WHERE close to closing over my chest)

Wow this is lovely! It's very thick as others have mentioned so you will want to wait to wear until cooler weather. The best part about this is that there is NO gapping at the buttons on the chest! This does run a bit large, however I am keeping it and will gladly allow myself to be able to dry it in the dryer and let it shrink a bit.

review_summary: I love this dress! It's a
review_text: I love this dress! It's all flannel, so it's great for fall. The fit is just right for a 2x. Im a 40G, so I have a lot of problems with button downs. There was some gaping that was easily solved with an extra hook and eye closure added to the bust. This dress will be great with boots and tights come fall!
Adorable!

I absolutely adore this dress.  I usually stalk dresses on Modcloth till they go on sale, but I knew this wouldn't wait that long.  It's everything I expected. The material is heavy, not so heavy you feel overwhelmed by it, but it is perfect for cooler months.  I am a true Large on Modcloth.  This dress is just a tad small in the shoulders, but I can't fault the dress, I have strong athletic shoulders, but it's not a big deal, it's definitely wearable. I paired the dress with a Fly London Wedge Navy Bootie. Fall Perfection!

review_summary: Holy crap do I love this
review_text: Holy crap do I love this dress! It's the perfect weight for chilly fall and cold winter. The length hits a little below my knee which is what I wanted. To colors are great! I sized up from a 1x after reading the reviews and I'm glad I did. The dress would've been too small in the shoulders if I had gotten a 1x so if you have broad shoulders or big boobs I would size up. Otherwise the fit on the dress is perfect.

I really like this dress.  It is a thick material and has pockets.  It narrows at the waist and after I washed and dried it in the dryer it fits pretty well.  My only wish is that it would be slightly shorter, it hits right below my knee and being short that is kind of an awkward length for me (5'2). Otherwise it is pretty much true to size.  Sleeves also fit fine as well.  Can't wait to wear this for fall!!

This is a DARLING dress. Super comfortable and the pockets are actually worth something. I can fit my phone (iPhone 6 plus  size reference), car keys and wallet in the pockets without feeling like things are going to fall out and the pockets don't protrude making it look like I've got more love handles than I actually do. This dress is perfect for fall.

review_summary: Sizing Chart is Small  go up at least 1 size
review_text: This dress is super cute and quality is really nice (plus it has lining) but the sizing chart was way off.  I usually wear a medium and based on the sizing chart that should have been the correct size but it was so small I couldn't get it zipped in the back.  I'm returning it for an XL because I'm afraid even a L will be too small.

This '60s mod dress is in a gorgeous shade of tangerine and I'm really hoping I will be able to make it fit. I don't know yet because I will need help attempting to zip it up! I don't understand ModCloth sizing at all  with a 33inch waist, I fall comfortably within the XL range. But knowing that everything here runs small (in my experience), I went with a 1X to be safe. I went to put this on this morning and could not zip it up past my waist AT ALL. I'll enlist help later to see if I can make it work, but it should not be this tight!! And these reviews say that if anything, it runs large, so I'm stumped. Lovely if it fits you, though.
The fabric is substantial (with a liner) and feels well made. The fit was perfect!

I loved this dress but as a short person 5'3'' it was way too much material and too big. The skirt fell half way down my calves and the shoulders were too wide for my shoulders. It's certainly not a dress for short people if you want to be seen!

This is my new favourite dress, it looks great on me. I am small around the waist but have a large lower tummy and bottom, this dress clings in all the right places. It has a large twirly skirt. I have large arms and the sleeves fit really well. The material is stretchy and does make a strange scratchy sound, but all in all it's a great dress.

I have two other Collectif dresses that fit great.  This one was a little odd  the torso was long for me.  I considered taking it to the tailor to shorten the torso but decided the risk wasn't worth the cost.  The skirt is quite full, the fabric is a bit heavier than it appears. I love this dress! It's my new favorite.The material is a stretchy, weighty fabric that sits beautifully over the body. The skirt twirls so well! The fabric is thick enough to not need a liner, and will look completely awesome with tights and booties for fall and winter. The sleeves are gorgeous, the buttons are gorgeous, the way it darts out from the waist is super flattering. No issues with the shoulders or the buttons closing at the chest. The colors are rich, and the red is a true, deep red just like in the picture. In short, this is the best dress ever and I cannot recommend it enough.

I'm a sucker for plaid anything, so I had to have this! The fabric is soft and heavy  great fall quality  but the arms are a bit tight, the waist is a bit loose, and the length is Frumpville, USA. The fabric is too nice to return, though, so I'll be turning this in to a top and hand bag.
This is the perfect late fall dress  warm, but not bulky and super soft. The fit and length are perfect for me.

I'm so torn. I LOVE this dress but I think I'm gonna end up returning it. It's super weighty and warm and seems very sturdy. I love the pockets. I love that you can unroll the sleeves, and that they are long (not just ending at the forearms, which bugs the heck out of me, but going all the way to the base of my thumbs). HOWEVER. The material has zero stretch, and although the dress fits great all over when I'm just standing around like a mannequin, it doesn't feel like it's made for a real live moving person. It doesn't allow me to lift my arms fully over my head, for example, and if I even try to lift one arm up to fix my hair or something, the entire dress shrugs up like eight inches and it looks terrible because then the waistband is somewhere up near my bust. It's so hard to find warm dresses and so I am dismayed at this situation. Sigh... I just want a very, very warm dress that will still let me MOVE!

review_summary: Love the shape! Craftsmanship a bit off
review_text: i was worried about the previous reviews but I was looking for a jersey style dress that was somewhat more casual and I am also an avid runner. I went a size up to a large in case it was too tight. I probably could return for a medium but I have bigger boobs and wider hips so thr fit somewhat loose but comfortably so for me. I love the deep gray color. Some of the stitching is sketchy though...I will have to re hem and adjust the neck collar. If you aren't afraid of your own small alterations this is a good dress.

review_summary: I really, really wanted to like this...
review_text: ...but no such luck. It looked okay, especially from the waistup, but there's no lining, the fabric quality is downright terrible (think Windsor), and it's a straplessbraandspanx dress without a doubt. If you're in the absolutely fantastic shape that the model is, with very little body fat, then this dress will probably flatter you without any sort of special undergarments needed. For the price point and the fabric, it's a nogo for me.

review_summary: Too small. I wear a mediu
review_text: Too small. I wear a medium in everything I have purchased but this was a bit too tight for my taste ended up just returning but I?m sure the next size would look nice.

This dress seemed somewhat fitted on the model, so I sized up and I'm glad I did.  I typically wear a medium, but even the large size is a bit snug.  This is a Madmemoiselle YeYe dress and it's been my experience that they tend to run small.  It has no zippers or buttons.  It just slips on over your head.  Overall, I like the dress and intend to keep it but it is a little overpriced.  Glad I bought it while it was on sale.

The colors in this dress are deep and vivid but, sadly, it was just a bit too small in the torso. I typically wear 1X or 2X, but the 2X was tight around my waist and sleeves. The material has some give, but I had a moment?s trouble taking it off, even with the zipper. The skirt fit perfectly around my hips, and the length seemed good. I?ve ordered a 3X, but I?m guessing it will be too big. I have large arms, yet they are proportional for my size. Many designers don?t account for larger arms in plus sizes, so I do sometimes have a problem with arms/sleeves in dresses and tops. The sleeves in this dress seemed like they matched the proportions of the upper part of the dress. Meaning, the sleeves were about as tight as the rest of the torso.

review_summary: This dress fits like a dream!
review_text: This dress fits perfectly and the stretch in the fabric makes things easier. I intend to wear it to do reading  activities with very young children or to celebrate children's birthdays. What a dress for daydreamers who live eternally in Wonderland!

review_summary: Sizing is disappointing, but I'm hopeful
review_text: This dress is stunning and is obviously of a good, highquality fabric. That said, I could not believe how small the upper parts of the dress were. The hips and waist were roomy, yet the bust was so tight it was like wearing a heavyduty minimizing bra, and the fabric thinned. Then, the arms were so tight that they pinched into my skin and there was no way I could get the sleeves to lie flat. I am hourglass shaped, with some apple, for reference.  I ordered my usual size, a 2x, and I am proportionateit's not like my arms are WAY bigger than they should be for my overall size, and my bust is not outlandishly huge. It was just an odd, odd fit. I have exchanged it for the 3x and will update this review when it arrives. My hope is that the top part will fit, and if necessary I could get the bottom half tailored. We'll see.

So the fabric is absolutely stunning in person. SO pretty, and just as it's pictured. It's a nice, breathable material, but not too heavy. According to the size chart, I should be a 2x in this dress, but it was way too long and the teensy, delicate zipper wouldn't budge over the skirt seam unless I had it on (despite the dress being a little too roomy in the waist/hips/chest. Ultimately, I ended up returning it, and boy, am I bummed.

I love the fabric  it's a really nice stretch cotton that's not too thin or thick. The shaping of the bodice is awesome and flattering. However, the neckline just didn't work for me at all. It looks awesome on the models and it looked okay on me as long as I held my shoulders back and arms down, but any forward motion and it gaped wide open. It might be because I'm shorttorsoed and most clothing for normal people is too big on top for me, but it overall seemed a bit too open to work. For some dresses I can figure out how to safety pin/sew something in the shoulders to make it work better, but the construction of this neckline is just too solid for me to do that easily.I'm not a huge fan of the pleats, and I would also have loved pockets.

review_summary: Agree  plus size WAAAY too small.
review_text: I usually take a 2x,  but sized up all the way to 4x based on reviews (I never take more than an 18 or 2x in any plus size brand).  I'm glad I did, because it's not roomy on me at all.  And it is also much much too short.  I would only wear this with leggings.

review_summary: Great dress but plus sizes WAY small!
review_text: This is an absolutely darling dress made of a soft, buttery, high quality knit. But the terrible plus sizing brings my rating down from a 5 star to barely a 3 star! I'm a pearshaped 2X with most of ModCloth dress styles, so after reading that the plus sizes in this dress run small, sized up to 3X. The top fit, although a bit snug, but the dress barely fit over my hips! I was a little afraid that if I ordered the 4X the top would run too large, but the top fits fine...however, the dress is just barely big enough across the hips not to be snug. If you're a pear shaped plus size, I'd consider sizing up 2 sizes, not just one.
I tried this dress on right away and it fit just as I expected it to. I'm generally a size 8 and the Medium fit me just right. The pattern seemed even cuter to me in real life than in the pictures.

review_summary: Cute dress if your short and skinny

The material is uncomfortable and there were seams where the bodice meets the skirt that were separating from the moment I took it out of the package. For reference, I had ordered a petticoat to go under it in a size 3X/4X and it fits beautifully and comfortably. So I don't think that I'm just too fat for the 4X.

However, I ordered a small in this dress, and the bust area was still too baggy.  So sad, but I will be sending this back.

Unfortunately the size large did not fit my 30 waist, the top half of the dress was made for someone with much broader shoulders and the sleeves were sewn badly.  The zipper went all the way up to the armpit and  get this  when I took the dress out of the package three of the seems near the bodice were already separating.

Also, the bust doesn't spread one me, which is always an issue with shirt dresses (I bought a Medium, and am a 36C).
Beautiful! I actually had strangers come up to me in the El asking where I got this dress. It's just perfect!

review_summary: High Quality Dress in Soft, Thick Fabric and Gorgeous, Satur
review_text: Ordered this dress on a Thursday and received it the next Tuesday. Absolutely gorgeous, saturated colors and soft, thick fabric. Skirt is very full (I could probably play cello in it) and it has POCKETS! Incredibly flattering silhouette for this plussized, pearshaped girl. In the XXL it was just a tiny bit tight across the chest with all the buttons done up. The sleeves are unfortunately quite tight. I might have alterations done to loosen the sleeves and bring the hem up to knee length (I'm 5'8 and it hits about a inch below the knee). But don't let that deter you from buying! The dress is so amazing that it's worth a couple of tweaks to fit my body perfectly.Full disclosure: I bought this for a Halloween costume (pairing it with a black leather jacket and a Jughead Jones hat ? la Riverdale). But I intend to wear it throughout fall and winter!

I love this dress!The fabric is good quality, a little heavier so it hangs and swings well. I wore it at the beginning of the school year with sandals and it was comfortable, but I can see myself wearing tights, boots, and a sweater with it for the winter months too.

I bought this in green this summer and am so happy with it, I nabbed the fall fabric version without a second thought.  The dress is very full  which works for me @ 5'7.   The skirt is very full, the fabric is high quality with a bit of stretch.  The belt was folded for shipment and I worry it might crack over time on the underside.  But it would be easy enough to to use a red or blue belt if needed.  Very good quality for the price.

I LOVE this dress. It fits basically flawlessly. I bought an xl as a size 1214 and it fits like a glove. The only thing about the fit is that its looong. I'm 5'3 and it is nearly a maxi fit on me. The colors and fabric are great. The fabric is heavy and woolen. Its just a really well made dress. There's enough skirt too that you could wear a crinoline under it.
Gorgeous dress! A little loose at the waist but nothing the belt can't fix!

I couldn't size down to a Medium because the dress was tight enough already, and I can't size up because it'd be even more baggy in the front.I'm very sad it wasn't meant to be for me.

I'm sort of in between sizes at the moment (either small vs. medium). Love the pockets! The material was a nice heavy broad cotton blend with a lil' bit of stretch. I could see this being a bit short for taller gals but since I'm short, the length was fine. The print totally sold me. Doughnuts?! YES PLEASE!

I cannot express how much I love this dress. I have a wedding to go to and, since I've been drooling over this dress for ages, I figured I would splurge. Crossed my fingers that it would look as great on me as it did on the model and holy cow, it definitely does. Super flattering, gorgeously luxe, and such a beautiful color. I'm a 16/18 normally so I ordered the 1X and it fits perfectly. I can't wait to wear it!

I bought this dress to wear to a couple weddings this fall. It's is truly beautiful. The fabric has a nice weight to it and does not feel cheap at all (which it shouldn't for the price). I'm 5'6, around 145, 32B,pear shaped and I got this in a medium. I always gravitate to aline and fit and flare dresses as they look best on my shape and this one does not disappoint. The waist hits right at my natural waist and hugs my upper body then flares away from my tummy area without looking poofy. I do not have much extra room in the bust so I would be cautious if you have a large bustoverall size ratio. The length is exactly what I like and hits just barely (like 1/2 inch) above my knees. This definitely gives you more length than many other dresses. It's fully lined with a teal, stretchy underlay. This also feels fairly substantial and not like it will move around or scooch up on you as you wear it. The teal color is not super obvious but makes the lace stand out more. The dress is still overall a green/pine color. The neckline is very narrow for lack of a better word so I generally wouldn't want to wear anything but a delicate, short necklace with it. It has nice thick straps and the back does not swoop in at all on the shoulder blade area so you and easily wear a normal bra. it has a hidden back zipper that goes very far down so it's easy to get on. The zipper is just a little hard to zip I think because of the fact that it is hidden and the lace is not an even surface for it move against.Again, overall it is a beautiful dress and seems well made, I'm soooo glad I bought it. I plan to update this post with pictures once I get some with it on.

I thought this would be very flattering around the waist due to the design but instead it was the opposite. The waist pops out way too much. Additionally, the side zipper pops out so that there is a very noticeable bump on the left side of your waist.

I LOVE this dress. I usually buy a large / bought a large and it's a little snug on the rib cage but otherwise, it's perfect. It's extremely flattering. I'm 5 ft 7 in and it hits my knees, making it the perfect length for work. The neckline gives it a little something extra too, so it's a great dress for work or a more dressy occasion. I highly recommend!

I wasn't crazy about the texture of the fabric or the way the pleats puckered in the front of the skirt right over the muffin top area. I think this would be a decent clearance grab, but I wouldn't recommend paying full price for this one.
Love, love, love this dress! Wish I would've sized down so it would fit tighter in the waist but other than that it's absolutely purrfect!!

review_summary: I had been dying to get t
review_text: I had been dying to get this gorgeous cat dress since it first came out, but I could not justify $90 US for it. I already owned the All Eyes on Unique in Birdcage dress (via eBay) so I knew it just wasn't worth nearly $150 AU (inc post). But once it went on sale I snapped it up! I'm so glad it did. It is absolutely gorgeous! As the other version I owned was a 3X and was a tad small, I sized up to a 4X for this one. This was a mistake as Folter have obviously fixed their sizing since then. However, I'd rather something be too big than too small. I have already taken it in 6 inches at the bust and wore it out to dinner for my birthday last week. LOVE IT!I think the 3X would have even been a bit big, even with my 50 inch bust. I am very happy with the purchase though.

review_summary: I SO wanted this dress to work!
review_text: I've had my eye on this dress for quite some time, the cats are just too adorable, and I finally took the plunge and bought it after reading all of the stellar reviews. Sadly, not every dress fits every woman just right. Whereas this dress was super flattering on many lovely ladies who reviewed, it was not flattering on me. First, it was far too short on me; I felt very self conscious in it. Second, the cinched waistline just didn't hit me right. It needed to be an inch or two higher for my torso in order for it to provide that flattering feeling, and sadly it happened to lay on the worst possible spot. This isn't any fault of the design, just a result of my awkward measurements on different body parts. I'm usually a Large in ModCloth dresses, and it fit just fine, it just wasn't flattering. I decided to return this cutie for store credit in the hopes that something else will soon come along. The quality did seem nice, and it was very lightweight. So sad this one didn't work out!

review_summary: I loved this print but th
review_text: I loved this print but the design was too littlegirly for me. Skirt wasn't flattering, didn't hang well. Didn't like the white collar. A simpler sleeveless with a v neck and a less gathered aline skirt would be great!
This dress is another favorite! I got many compliments on it! Also it has pockets. And the print is super cute!!!

review_summary: The dress is an eye catch
review_text: The dress is an eye catcher. It was a bit short for my 5'9 height but with a pair of leggings ha it was purrfect.
I just love this dress,its colors, and the pockets.

review_summary: I have had this dress alr
review_text: I have had this dress already (for a year) in the Rad to the Bone glow in the dark bones pattern. The quality is fair, it's held up fine, but like much of the manifestly appealing patterned pieces you'll find on ModCloth, material is thin cottony, with no lining. You're paying entirely for pattern, not quality build or sturdy materials. This one you'll be able to wear summer sleeveless, or you can add tights and a cardigan (I have a turquoise one) and could do fall and maybe mild Southern winters. Fit is forgiving in hips, and just a tad bit short for someone my height; those fall tights double for modesty's sake. Pattern is worth it; several compliments on the awesome Dia de los Muertos gatos. :)

review_text: I have two of these dresses in different patterns. They look great on! I get tons of compliments!

review_text: The print on this is so cute!  And it fits in all the right places. There is enough room for both my bust and hips while still having a waistline. I've yet to go wrong with a Folter dress!

review_text: I love cats so this dress was a must have for me.  The print is adorable and keeps it from looking too formal. review_summary: I love my kitties, but do

The fit is great; right below knee, bust has room without being baggy, waist cinched with room to breathe. Not a lot of extra fabric, so lays nice and straight. The colors are vibrant. review_text: These day of the dead kittens are great for a fun day out. The fit of the dress  is flattering.

review_summary: OMG so very cute! I order
review_text: OMG so very cute! I ordered an xl and I'm exchanging for a 1x.
Fits great. Nicely constructed. My daughter bought this and felt beautiful in it!

Love, love, love! I bought this dress the minute I saw it! Perfect for a crazy cat lady/D?a de los Muertos fan! The print is super cute, but the style is too. Sweet white Peter Pan collar. Flattering waist line (might be a little high for some). Pockets! The fabric is lightweight cotton, and I will probably wear it yearround. The bright colorful print can be paired with many colors of sweaters on top or blouses underneath. Pay attention to sizing  Folter dress sizes are not the same as your local department store's!Only two things I would change: the arm holes are too big. I will probably end up getting the dress tailored, but I wasn't going to wait for that. The only other thing that would be great is if the dress were longer. . . but I frequently have this issue with dresses sold on this site. I solved the problem by wearing leggings. I'm used to that, however. I guess if these two issues didn't exist, I probably would never take the dress off, ever!Overall, I'm very happy with my purchase, even at full price. Tons of compliments and I feel cute in this dress!

This dress breaks my heart. Oh I wanted to love it, I love the fabric I love the piping and the pockets. The length is perfect on my short self.....but oh the fit. First, the neckline feels like it's cutting off my airway, it's so high, and the shoulders/Peter pan collar combo makes me feel very linebacker. The bust fits really well, but, alas, the back is too high and the armpits too low. The waist is too big by at least an inch on me too. It also hit me in a weird way, and the stretchy back waist made the fabric fall over my rear in a most unflattering way. I waffled between the XL and 1X based on the reviews of the other print of this dress. I think an XL would cause boob smashing . I considered having it altered, but it needs so much it's just not worth it. Probably going to send this one back for store credit. But I found the fabric online, so maybe someday I'll wear this amazing print. Just not this exact cut.

I love this skelekitty dress! It is absolutely adorable and it fits me perfectly. However, I knew the fit would be perfect since I have the glow in the dark bones version dress. I am so glad I bought it.

I love this dress so much. It isn?t form fitting but it?s true to size. It wouldn?t work without the belt. It?s the most unique dress that I have ever owned in terms of fit. It?s beautiful! My only complaint is that the ? unicorns? don?t have horns. Haha! I still give it 5 Stars bc I love it so much.
I love this dress, I get so many compliments. It's fun and flattering. My only small complaint is that the horns on the unicorns are very hard to see some people think I'm just a horse enthusiast.

I adore this dress. The print is just perfect. Most unicorn dresses are brightly colored, I love the fact that this dress is dark but also cute . Which is pretty much my style. It runs large but when u add the matching sash/belt it definitely adds some shape to it.

I cannot stop wearing this dress. I love it. The print is absolutely fabulous. I like that the unicorns are not super cartoony and have detail (the little hearts!), and the print looks good with a wide range of pinks and purples. It's a thick, sturdy fabric, but isn't heavy. It runs VERY large though, and sizing down helps, but it's mostly just how the dress is cut. I sized down from my normal medium to a small, and it fits in the shoulders, but has a very flowy shift dress shape and hits right above the knee. The belt changes everything! It looks just like the model photo when belted. I prefer it this way, because it allows for adjusting if you've had a big meal ;)

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my sister's birthday and she loved it! She has a passion for unicorns and all things magical, so I knew this dress was for her. The fabric was very soft and comfortable, the length was perfect at her knees, and the shape of the dress fit her beautifully. I can understand that if you're a very curvy woman it might not look that good on you because it is very loose and forgiving, but my sister has a boxy figure that looks perfect in this style of dress. My only issue was that the belt did not come with it,  it ModCloth was very helpful in compensating me for my losses.

I just received the dress. I normally wear a large so I ordered the large.  The dress is humongous!  I noticed  that they somehow pleated the fabric in the picture,  it looks very cute like that.  I could not achieve the same results.  Because it is such a cute print I am going to keep it and maybe use a larger/different belt.

I absolutely love this dress! The detail on the back of the sleeve and the flare of the skirt are lovely, unique touches. This dress was a hit for me! So many compliments! Ladies, they aren?t lying.. this dress has zero stretch. The first time I tried it on, I put my arms above my head to get the last bit of zip, and the motion popped a button off the sleeve. It was no problem to sew it back on real quick, but advice: Put on your shoes and do your hair first and get a friend to help you zip it up because range of motion is limited. To me that was all worth it because of its tailored fit and flattering form across the waist and hips. I usually am an XS on ModCloth, and this was indeed tighter than most other buys I?ve made, so consider sizing up if you?re on the edge of your usual size. Personally, I?m glad I went with the XS.

review_summary: Great size difference between L and XL
review_text: I am usually size L but sized up to XL based on reviews. XL was too loose for me (~2  4in wider in all places) and didn't look good with that fit, so I exchanged for a size L. However, I barely fit in it (exact dress measurement 40in at bust, 32in at waist, 42in at hip), the bust area is tight, making it difficult to pull the zipper. I will keep it since it is a nice dress and the quality is good.
The fabric and style of the dress is gorgeous. Too bad the sizing is so far off it's from Mars. It's AT LEAST 2 sizes too small, probably more.

This dress looks amazing on the model, and I was so excited to get it. I usually run between a medium to large in modcloth dresses. I ordered a large because this was a sheath dress and the description said no strech, and I could barely get it on! It looked horrific! Who sized this?? I would go up at least two sizes to make it work. Sad, this dress was made well and had great potential but it goes back.

This dress is so pretty, but it's a very strange fit on me. The waist is much too big, but there's barely room for my boobs, so going down a size isn't really an option. It's also a bit longer than I expected, but that's ok. Perhaps I'll try it with a belt, since it's really nice and I'd like to be able to wear it.
So small!!! Thought I?d been sent the wrong size. Will be sending back

Lighter weight than I expected, but pretty, solid colors and a nice shape.  It's a bit big around the waist and in the shoulders on my small frame, but not in an unpleasant way.  I'll be belting it, but keeping it for sure.

So like everyone said, the fit is on the larger side. However, I just wore this for a full day at work and where the waist is placed, the seams have torn. If I'd gone up a size I really would have been swimming in the rest of the fabric. I will say that it is quite pretty and I received several compliments. The print is super cute and the length wasn't too terribly long (I'm 5'0).I can fix the seams on the side of the dress but I feel sure that it will happen again. Given the price, I would just ask that the fabric be a little better.

Loved the pattern but that was it. The chest was too tight (fabric has no stretch). It was fine standing still but uncomfortable to move my arms. The elastic at the elbows was itchy. The fabric was thin and the zipper seemed cheap. This was a bit too short in length for my comfort too (I'm getting old).

review_summary: Such a cute dress in ofthemoment green floral!
review_text: I usually wear a 4 in dresses, sometimes a 6, and the size small fit me perfectly. It nips in the waist quite nicely for those with hourglass figures ? it is quite fitted in the waist so it may not work for everyone. My only con is that is truly is a mini dress on me, as I'm almost 5'9. I'll need to pair this dress with tights once it gets cooler (and I'm not overly modest, it's just that short on me). Overall, I love the shade of green, the girly floral and the super feminine fit!

I love this dress! It's got a nice flattering cut and is flowy and cute while still being work friendly. It does have some cons but I feel so cute in this they don't even bother me anymore. Cons that may be a deal breaker for someone else are: static prone fabric, NO stretch at all to the fabric, no clasp at the top of the zipper in back (but so far zipper stays up) the fit for me is loose in the waist and a snug in the bust
Fits perfectly! The material is a bit thin but it's not sheer. Perfect for so many different occasions.

review_summary: Size Down  and PLEASE come back in stock!
review_text: Like other people have been saying, it runs large, which is such a shame because I love it so much! But because it is too big, it's not flattering. I've been refreshing this page every day since I tried on my toobig medium, hoping someone returns a size small so I can snatch it up. Please bring this back ModCloth! You'll make a lot of people happy that they can return their orders and end up with this cute dress!

Super comfortable, easy to wear, and has a retro feel with the cut of the top and buttons on the shoulders. Ran it through the washer, hung it to dry and was surprised how well it held up because it is a very thin fabric. I keep finding random strings (only reason I did not give it 5 stars) I've had to tuck or trim but so far no issues. Fingers crossed!

This dress is very cute in person! However, it does run large. I'm usually a size XS or S, depending on the brand and item, and following the size chart, I ordered the Small in this. The dress is quite baggy at the waist on me. I would size down to an XS, which would probably be a perfect fit, but unfortunately there is none available. Adding a nice waist belt definitely creates the shape I want though. I just will not be able to wear it without a belt. So I would recommend sizing down, if that is an option. Otherwise, I love the cut, color, pattern and length. This will be a great dress for fall! Though, I do wish the dress was lined, so that it would be a bit thicker for colder days.

I can range from 1XL  3XL depending on the cut of the dress (usually a solid 2XL tho). The 12XL were already gone so I went with the 3XL because I loved the dress in the picture. As the other review said, it's huge on me. It doesn't even look like there is a cinch waist on it at all. When I unzipped the back, it was full of loose threads that easily got caught in the zipper. I would like this dress in a way smaller size, but since they all seem to be sold out, I'm not sure what to do. This was supposed to be my birthday dress for my upcoming birthday. I will say that the colors are the same as the picture. I enjoy the openness of the sleeves (I have flabby arms) and it's not too short on me. I could of easily wore this at work.

review_summary: This is such a cute dress
review_text: This is such a cute dress! I'm either an XL or 1X, so I went with 1X because I was worried the arms would be tight. However, I could've gotten away with the smaller size. This dress swallows me! It kind of looks like a night gown (eek). When I synch the waist with a chunky belt it looks better, but since the dress already has a synched waist, I don't want to have to wear a belt with it. I would LOVE to exchange for a smaller size, but all the dresses have been bought up!

This dress is really cute. It?s sleeves sit really nicely and the underdress is a nice soft material. The material is really bright like the picture. Once you tie the waistband the dress fits well and is perfect for summer

The butterfly print is so elegant with the lightness of the fabric, I've worn it bare arms and with a cardi and love it! The ties are actually sewn on either side of the front, not a drawstring so pulling them together just bunched the fabric over my tummy  my bad, I think it was supposed to tie in the back (?) I felt the elastic waist was fine and unstitched the ties to add my own belts instead, the arm holes are big especially with the flutter of the sleeves, but maybe size L would have been a better fit for me anyway, still the quality is great and I get so many compliments and it's truly been one of my goto dresses this summer!

review_summary: Does not run small at all
review_text: This dress does not run small whatsoever. I am normally a 1214 in dresses, so I ordered an XL since the description said the dress runs small, but it is huge! I probably could have even pulled off a medium. This dress is also a little frumpy in person  perhaps because it is so big, even when cinched. Seeing as I'm in Canada and returns are expensive, this will probably be going to a friend who it will fit better, big bummer!

I sized up as other reviewers suggested, and thought it was fine slightly baggy but there's a tie to cinch at the waist. The print is gorgeous, the dress itself is actually a green inner slip and a detachable sheer outer layer with the pattern. You can snap them together if you try, I found the process a bit cumbersome. It seems slightly flimsy for the price, not sure how well the outer layer would wash, but it's lovely just the same.

review_summary: Broad Shoulders and Small Waist = Fit Issues
review_text: This dress is adorable. It's a great length, it's flattering, and it has pockets. BUT, one of the issues I'm having all around with ModCloth is the fact I have to always order a size up due to items fitting way too small around the shoulders which leaves the waist WAAAAY too big. I ordered a L initially and just processed an exchange for an XL. I'm expecting to have to take it to the tailor for adjustments which is more $$ out of pocket, but overall, I believe it'll be worth in the long run.

review_summary: Eek! Finally a cute Hello Kitty dress!
review_text: Just wearing this dress makes me happy  it's that cute. The waistline is perfectly defined, making the dress very flattering. It is slightly tight on my bust line, but I'm okay with that, because it still fits and still looks very cute. So glad I decided to buy it!

review_summary: Such a cute dress! The pr
review_text: Such a cute dress! The print isn't too big, so it doesn't read like a novelty dress, but Hello Kitty fans will recognize it immediately. The back has elastic, so I sized down to an XS and the waist fit perfectly. The armscye was tight, but this is a common problem for me. The cotton fabric feels great and the pockets are big enough to hold my phone. I prefer slightly longer dresses, but it wasn't too short to wear without tights. I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.

I bought the Pine one and it's just perfect, just like on the model except for the lenght.I'm not so tall, so I already knew, but it still looks good on me and doesn't make me look shorter. It's not tight, very comfortable and I can't wait to wear it!

I read the reviews thoroughly before buying this dress, so I was aware that it would be short... but this is seriously short. It cuts you off midthigh. In my opinion, this is not at all flattering combined with the stripes in the skirt itself. It wants to be classy, but the length communicates that it's junior clothing. Too bad. I really wanted to like this. It's going back.

This dress is so cute! I wore it out with friends and received many compliments throughout the night. It fit very well on me, my only issue with it is that it is a tad short (nothing major). I wore tights with it.
Love this dress so much
So we'll made!  It's very apparent.
This dress, aw man, this dress is so so cute! Its so soft and comfortable, but still shows your sense of style. It is slightly shorter than I would like it to be, but still ok!

When I saw this, I needed it in my life. The other reviewers are right: the fabric is a little weird, but I have another dress with this same material so I'm used to it. I usually run Small in dresses on Modcloth, but this looked tiny so I went with a Medium. I kind of wish I went with a small because in the chest area (where I'm small) is loose. Waist/hips area fits very well, so maybe it is because of my small chest lol.

review_summary: The fabric is odd, the dress is fantastic.
review_text: The fabric is very textured and not something I would use for apparel, but this dress is stunning. I got 12 compliments, when I wore it the first time. It is so good that I came back and bought it in black too.

Purchased this item last week and find it pretty cute. The only drawbacks to this dress is that the material is kind of heavy/bulky and somewhat uncomfortable. Other than that, the dress is pretty flattering on me and I like the bow accent.

Oh my goodness this dress... Out of all 30 plus dresses I own this one is the best of them all! Excellent colors and print. The tie gives it the extra touch it needs. Everyone around me seems to want to own it! Incredible!

Returned this because the print placement across the chest wasn't flattering for me. There was a horizontal stripe across the widest part, I'm sure print placement differs on each garment. Other than that the fabric is thick with a little stretch, high quality, nicely constructed. Fit to size, good length at the knee. Skirt is very full, it would have been easy to put pockets in, but they didn't.

Got this dress today and was a little disappointed that it doesn't fit. It's very tight in a waist area. Dress has a side zipper and you can unbutton some of the buttons to give yourself a little room in a chest area but I would recommend sizing up. It's pretty, has pockets which is always a big plus for me. I normally wear US 4 or size small and I'm 135 pounds.

I wish I had known that this was IXIA, which always runs small for me (I am almost always a L but that wouldn't even come close to zipping. I had ordered an XL as well because side zippers always spell trouble for busty gals, but while the zipper was able to zip, the buttonup front gaped terribly. I am thinking about sizing up to a 1X in the hopes that there will be enough material to sit smoothly over my bust, and then have the dress taken in by a tailor, but that is a lot of work for this dress, which is also dry clean only. The beautiful pattern is the only reason this one isn't going back immediately (although it may after some serious contemplation about how much work I want to put into it).

I had passed this dress over initially when shopping and then saw it on someone else on instagram and thought they looked great.  I'm so glad I went back and added it to my cart.  It is very very comfortable and I feel super cute it in.  I am an hourglass who usually wears a 10/12 dress.  I could have sized down and been ok but I got a xl because I have a large chest.  I am pretty modest and I don't think this is too revealing in the chest.  The neck tie covers most cleavage.

review_summary: in no way would I call this fabric Knit
review_text: I consulted the size chart before buying but when it arrived it was way too big. The fabric is also what I would expect from a dress from Mandee for under twenty. Pretty disappointing, but thank goodness Modcloth is great with returns.

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress! The sleeves aren't too tight (unlike some other dresses), it's a good length, and just overall looks amazing on, but unfortunately my chest is too small. This has been a continuous problem with modcloth dresses that are wrap style vnecks. The bow covers a lot, but when I sit, the chest gapes and I'm constantly fidgeting to get to lie properly once I put it on. I don't think just tacking would fix it. So sad to be returning it.

review_summary: Love the dress, hate the fit
review_text: While the dress fit my waist and was an OK length, it was HUGE around the bust area. If I had a longer torso, it might have fit better in the length, but it just didn't work. I'm tempted to go a size down just to see if that works as it's a nice thick fabric with a lining.

review_summary: This is a super cute and
review_text: This is a super cute and fun Halloween dress. Not the right dress for the occasion I'd be wearing it to, so back it went. It fit nicely, and the fabric was a little stiff (but not a big deal imo) the lace was a little thin and felt like it would snag easily. Sad I can't keep it, but I was looking for something very specific and this just wasn't the one.

I agree with the other X sized girls. The bodice on this is far too small for me. I have a large bust (F or G) but usually fit 2X things just fine. I did get a 3x after reading reviews. I could not zip the top at all. Lovely dress, all cotton, except for the mesh at the top which I felt was reasonably durable. Sadly I will need to return.

just received this today, unfortunately it runs EXTREMELY LARGE in ALL AREAS. even the armpit, the weirdest place to have extra fabric. it is also unlined which makes it feel very cheap which is unfortunate because it is quite expensive. I still will wear it this fall however it is not quite as amazing as I was hoping

Bought this in a 2x based on reviews.  I am a faithful, solid Modcloth 1x. The quality is a little thin  but that works great in South Florida so I was kind of thankful.  Only size issue was with mid back  so I am returning the 2x for a 3x and hoping it works out.  The fit itself was flattering.

review_summary: I'm surprised everyone says it's too small!
review_text: I usually wear a medium, but seeing the other reviews I bought a large (and it's not surprising for me to occasionally have to size up with Modcloth stuff).  The large is HUGE.  I'm returning it and buying a medium and a small, because I feel like the large may even be 2 sizes too big.  Maybe the plussized dresses are sized differently?  For SML I'd definitely order true to size.I also disagree with the quality reported in other reviews  I think it's a really well made dress!  The lace is delicate, but it doesn't feel fragile to me!  I can't wait to get my replacement dresses!
I usually wear a size 20/3x in store bought clothes.This dress is maybe a size 18 or 16. It's beautiful and I'm really disappointed.

review_summary: Fit is astoundingly small, poor quality
review_text: Disclaimer  I had to censor the brand of this dress to post this review.I fell in love with this dress the second I saw it online. Unfortunately, it just is frankly bad on multiple levels. Depressingly so.I normally faithfully wear a 3X in ModCloth.  The fit on this dress was shockingly small compared to all my other H*ll Bunny dresses in my closet.  While I could get the dress on, I couldn't even start to zip the back of the dress closed at all.  That being said, the waist is higher on this than in many H*ll Bunny dresses.  If you are selfconscious about your waist, and are able to find a size of this dress to fit you... it will probably work great for this.Comparative to a friend who also wears H*ll Bunny, the width of the torso area for the 3X was slightly smaller than her 1X dress.  First time I've had this problem with this brand.The meshlike fabric at the top is awful quality.  I have other dresses and tops similar to this, but they feel much more sturdy.  I was so scared about ripping this material trying the dress on.  It seems like it has the fragility of wet tissue paper.  If the dress runs small or you have difficulty like I did... please keep this in mind and be very careful putting this dress on.The rest of the fabric material was gorgeous in person and I'm so sad I won't be keeping this dress.  It was lower quality though than I expected for the price of this dress.  Just a standard cotton and a bit itchy on me.As a goth person there aren't many options for me at ModCloth and I'm very sad to have to send this one back.
Loved the dress, but unfortunately the size runs a bit on the large side. It made me look frumpy. So size down if you buy this.

I usually love everything from this brand, but this dress was really heavy.  The dress is lined with the same material as the outside, so it's like wearing two dresses at once. That being said, I got a lot of compliments when I wore it. It might work as a later fall dress, as it is quite warm due to the extra fabric.

I bought this in that gorgeous green!It is flattering, good material, and really looks as good as the photo. My only reason for a 4 star is it was a little roomy (even though noting it is true to size) which is not necessarily a complaint as a size smaller might have been too small! I am very excited to wear this to my sister's wedding this month!

This dress lived up the photos. Color (green) is as shown in pictures, material feels quality and has a wonderful flow to it. The silhouette is very flattering and while I love the doublestrap, I agree with the other reviewer who said a strapless bra is necessary. (The lining seems adequate if you are the type to go braless.) I always order a medium on Modcloth, and results vary from very snug to oddly loose in some areas. This is a perfect fit  could be just a hint smaller and wouldnt bother me at all. At this point in my life, however, I am happy with a smidge backup room. Planning on ordering this in burgundy now :)

I had been eyeing this for a while and then finally splurged on the green version of the dress. It's soft, silky, and multipurposeful. I see me wearing it to work with a cardigan (I teach so the cutout sleeves would be a little too sexy for work without a sweater) but being able to wear it out to dinner with my husband, too. I will say that you will have to wear a strapless bra. Otherwise, the straps will poke between the cutouts. But it fit perfectly and will added to my rotation of dresses. Very pleased.

review_summary: Would have kept it except for the sleeves
review_text: This is the perfect style dress for my body shape. The dropwaist elastic waist is perfect for me and was not at all too frumpy as other reviewers said. I wanted to keep it and love it so much, however, when you move your arms the entire dress rises up and exposes your butt. I think it is because there is an elastic band in the arms. Moving your arms at all made the entire lower half of the dress rise up. I was so disappointed. I wanted to keep it.

I liked the print of this dress, but unfortunately it was unflattering. With the way the top draped over the waistband, there was no waist definition, and it made my hips look much wider than they are. There was also elastic in the sleeves above the bell sleeve that was tight and uncomfortable.

Returning because the fit wasn't right, but the dress is beautiful and the quality seemed nice. The waist has elastic in the back, which gives a decent little stretch but for me was still a bit tight, and sat a bit high on my longish torso. I would love to have sized up but it would be too large in the bust for someone very smallchested.
The fit was great, flattering and comfortable. And, pockets!!

I bought this dress for a wedding and it fit like a glove. I'm usually between a large/x large depending on the cut of the outfit so I ordered up for this dress and I'm glad I did. I'm pretty short so it came a little bit longer than the picture but that's okay because the whole midi length is in. The dress is also REALLY comfortable and the slit in the neck area is really tasteful and not really deep.

I found this dress to be really cute, especially with a cardigan. The shoulder ruffles are a little much for me, so I may have them removed. I really like it otherwise.In the XS it runs the risk of popping open in front, but a safety pin should do the trick. I'm not very busty so might fit better on someone else, but I still like it.

review_summary: Love it! I'm going to get
review_text: Love it! I'm going to get it in other colours. It's a bit baggy in the top which I like, and I think it's meant to fit that way. The v in the neck is not too low so it wouldn't be a problem if you're small chested to have it baggies but there's plenty of room for larger busts.
