I loved the Color and Pattern of this dress and thought the ruffles added a nice feminine feel. I wanted to love this so bad, but it just didn't fit quite right.  The way it fell made me look a little frumpy.  Maybe it would be better on a taller gril.
This dress is adorable and can be worn with flip flops or heels and I'm thinking I could wear it into Fall with a long sweater and boots.  The fit is just right.  It is lined and great quality too.
Love this dress! Great quality, great fit and very flattering!

This is adorable! One of my favorite buys, I was so excited to wear this. My legs are short, so this lays longer on me, and pretty loose but I don't mind. I would have ordered a size down from the size chart, in retrospect? It made me feel like I was in a 90s tv movie about a teen witch.

I bought this dress a few weeks ago and I absolutely love it!!  It took me a little while to write this review because I had to wait for the perfect fall weather to wear it for the first time.  I love the fabric, and I love the fit!  The color is a little bit darker than I expected, but I actually really like it.  Most of all, this dress is long enough for me!  I am 5 foot 11 and 155 and it's extremely difficult to find dresses that are long enough that I don't feel like I'm going to flash everyone at the slightest gust of wind.  This dress did the trick!Overall, I absolutely love this dress and would definitely recommend it to others.  It's perfectly stylish for the fall weather and I can't wait to continue to wear it!

review_summary: This dress is so, so beau
review_text: This dress is so, so beautiful. I already got compliments on it from my family, just trying it on around the house.  The colour is gorgeous and the fit is very flattering. The waist does sit higher up, but because I'm short (5), that's not an issue for me. I find it surprising people say that it runs small though; I ordered a size down on the offchance it might fit, since the size I should take, according to the size chart, was out of stock, and it's perfect on me.

Love the fit and colour of this dress, but the velvet is the wrong direction?! The main reason I love wearing velvet is how it feels on my hands and the fabric is upsidedown. Maybe I am just picky but it really bugs me. Also it is kind of seethrough for velvet and the seams are shotty.. not impressed for 60$.

The color of this dress is a rich, lovely burgundy and the velvet is very soft. It came to my knees. I was expecting this dress to be fairly clingy because it is a stretch velvet, so I had ordered a 3x when I really am a 2x. It was the wrong move. In fact, I'd say even the 3x is little larger than typical. I have exchanged it for a 2x and am hopeful that it will be true to size. I had a dress just like this one when I was in high school, so I jumped on this when I saw itsuper hopeful the new size works out.
It was a great fit and super comfy! Loved the material and how shiny and soft it was! :) The fabric is also a little stretchy so it?s very comfortable

review_summary: This was a bit snug aroun
review_text: This was a bit snug around the boob area, making it fall a bit differently than in the photo, but everything else about it is wonderful!
Perfect fit, not too short or too long, great piece for fall!

I was weary about this dress, as I typically shop for dresses that have a little more fitting to them.  This dress has the perfect about of subtle stitching that gives me a very nice shape! It it's me just above the knee and has a nice length that twirls super well!  The color is like a very dark red wine, which i love.  I ordered the XL I'm about 200 lb and it fit great, not too tight and not too loose.

Gorgeous velvet that washes and dries easily. I sized up to large, but even that was a little smaller than I'd like, in the shoulders and bust. Because of the cut, this dress hides tummy imperfections well. It's shorta little too short for my tastebut I'll wear it with yoga shorts underneath. Overall, I love this dress! So fun and cute.

review_summary: Absolutely darling! So comfortable and easy to accessorize!
review_text: I could not love this dress any more, hands down my favorite dress I've purchased in a long time. It is such a gorgeously rich color, the velvet is sooo soft to the touch, and it is so easy to accessorize. I will be wearing this nonstop this fall and winter with leggings, sweaters, and booties. The skirt is nice and full, but lays perfectly over the waist and hips. Extremely comfortable and flattering. The little cap sleeves are perfect and really give it a darling look. I am so, so glad I purchased this dress, it is an absolute must have. The perfect cold weather dress, thank you Modcloth!!

I was skeptical because I have never gotten a velvet dress before. When I pulled it out of the package I was so excited to put it on because it was so beautiful! I looked for a zipper and it didn't have one so that freaked me out but when I slipped it over my head it just fell in place and fit like a glove. It is twirly and girly and perfect for fall/winter. It will be so easy to dress up or down. It is very figure flattering too. It frames my chest without being too crazy and just fits my waist and is very slimming. Great quality too! If you are on the fence just go for it!

As with the majority of fit and flarestyle dresses, I found that the waist on this dress was at least two inches too high for my long torso, and so it was really huge on my waist and hips. The top was a bit too tight on my shoulders and chest, which was surprising because I tend to be on the small side of xs. The material is nice and so is the color, though, and it's a good length, just above the knee.

This dress is extremely flattering. The scoop neck and skater skirt creates a very delicate and feminine look. The velvet has a rich texture which will make this dress perfect for the late fall and winter. I'm 4'11 and an AA cup. Most tops of dresses are giant on me but this dress fits perfectly and hits me right above the knee. The color is darker in real life than picture, however, it's still a beautiful color.

I love this dress! I was nervous that the red velvet might look a little tacky in person but it doesn't thanks to its rich wine color and not too much shine. The cut is very flattering: the scoop neck is feminine but not too low, the top fits like a glove without clinging, and the skirt flares out just enough to be cute but not cutsie. I'm 5' 1 and the skirt comes down to the top of my knee, making it work or play appropriate. As with almost all skirts and dresses from Modcloth, the size small fits perfectly on my 120lb. frame. My only complaint is that the skirt is quite thin and see through in the light  lining would have gone a long way.

review_summary: I love this dress! It fit
review_text: I love this dress! It fits so well and it's casual enough that I can wear it everywhere. I was expecting the color to be a bit more red but I also like the actual color.

As a ModCloth employee I really challenged my ModSquad Austin Stylist to push me out of my bright and polka dot comfort zone. This Scoop Neck Velvet Dress is so adorable on. I usually am between a Medium and Large, the Large fit perfectly! It accentuated my bust and did not cling to my stomach..always a plus! The princess seams give it a nice fit with the length hitting just above the knee (I'm 5'8  tall lady approved). I felt a nice balance of casual/comfort whilst still making a feminine statement.Pictured with our Sleeveless Woven TieNeck Top in Patchwork...yay layers!

I fell in love with this dress weeks ago. When I saw that it was in discount and someone had returned one in XS, I bought it. After trying it, I'll say it's pretty tight and it makes you look a little bit fuller on the top. I like it but I do not love it (at least not as I expected). On the other hand, the quality looks very good.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress so much. It?s so cute, classic and vintage, and I love the color. Unfortunately it?s just a weird fit. Fits my chest perfectly but the hips/legs are WAAAYY too tight. Sizing up would make it weird and gappy in my chest area. *Sniff* back it goes.

I tried on two new Modcloth dresses this morning. This one zipped up even more easily than the other one. But both of them immediately then had the zipper teeth tear away from each other, all the way down the back. Toying with the idea of paying to have zipper replaced, but I'll probably just send this one back. :(

I was SO EXCITED about this dress. I am short, so I knew it would need alterations. As soon as I got it I took it to a seamstress who shortened it. Only after did I notice that the flaps on one side are reversed the shorter flap is underneath the longer one. Obviously I can't exchange it due to alterations, so make sure you check for this when you get it. Such a cute dress, but now I feel too self conscious to wear it knowing it is lopsided

This dress was cute on the website and out of the package. It looks just like it does in the photos. The fabric feels like a good quality and is comfortable, though the lining feels a bit cheap. Unfortunately, when I tried it on, it was definitely a size too big; it looked loose and matronly. According to ModCloth's measurements and recommended sizing, the XL should have fit me perfectly. A L probably would have fit me better, but I don't like it enough to exchange it for another size. I'll be returning this!

I wish this dress fit.  I have some underarm baggage from a rapid weight gain/loss and tend to struggle with short sleeves for this reason.  The size fit like a glove and would have probably been too fancy for my work environment, BUT if those things were different this would have become my favorite 'old school' style dress.

I love this dress! I originally ordered a size larger because it's form fitting, but I had to return it for my usual size and I'm so glad I did. It's retro without being costumey, and it hit me in all the right places. I'm on the short side so it fell below the knee, but the sleeves weren't too tight and it's not revealing or constrictive in the chest area.

review_summary: The Perfect 40's Style Dress for Work!
review_text: I LOVE LOVE LOVE this dress. I was worried when I ordered this dress because no one had reviewed it yet, but I'm so happy that I ordered it anyway! I ordered it in a size small and it fit like a glove. It does have a little stretch to it. It is the perfect dress for work or just a day out on the town! I love the ruffle detail. Highly recommend this dress.

review_summary: I love this dress! It is
review_text: I love this dress! It is a tad too big around my neck (the zipper comes up too high, and bulges a tad) it fits me perfectly everywhere else! If I were to go down a size I'd be afraid it wouldn't fit. I can't wait to this Halloween weekend for a very special family memorial.
I love the dress but had to exchange it for an extra small. The small was more like a normal medium imo.

review_summary: For the price it is low q
review_text: For the price it is low quality. Very costumey and with the fabric already being costumey there is no way to style it cute. Adorable pattern for a Halloween party or kids event.  Returning

review_summary: It turns out grown up me
review_text: It turns out grown up me doesn't play well with peter pan collars. It was worth a shot. I couldn't get the zip up all the way, and the dye of the fabric was fragrant. The print on the fabric was super cute though. So, not my style, needed an airing out, and didn't quite fit. I'll be returning.

review_summary: Looks so cute on the mode
review_text: Looks so cute on the model, but looked very costumey on me. Too long, too much fabric in the skirt. I have a stocky build and this dress just swallowed me, hitting midcalf which makes me look even stockier than I already am. Returned. I think taller ladies will be happier with the fit.

review_summary: Out of all the new Hallow
review_text: Out of all the new Halloween dresses, I was the most hesitant to order this one. It ended up being my favorite. Super crisp fabric. Skirt stands out on its own without a petticoat, tho there's definitely room for one. I was worried the print had too much green, but the pattern is balanced towards a true Halloween color pallette IRL.Don't be put off by the length, I'm super short, 5'1. Average height this will hit right at or slightly below knee. I'm between a L and an XL, the XL fits best. Between sizes I would order the bigger one.

This dress is soft, comfortable, forgiving, and the right touch ubtle weirdofun.  I'm 5'5, 130 lbs, 38B and a medium fits nicely.  I'm not a big person, but I've delivered 3 babies (who all love my crazy fruit dress!), so I like my clothes to flatter my body, baby/happy hour shelf & all.  If you've got one of those, you know what I mean ;)

Like the other review, the fit is a bit off for someone who has more curves then the product model, but I still really like the dress! The fabric is comfortable and I will enjoy wearing this as the weather gets cooler!

review_summary: I usually take an XL/14 b
review_text: I usually take an XL/14 because of my wide hips, but the L fit me perfectly. The fabric sticks out a little bit between the bottom button and the waste band so you need to play with it a little to make it sit right, but otherwise an awesome dress with a great print. one of my favorite pieces in my closet.

Lovely dress. Loved the details and the fabric, especially the blue and gold mix. Unfortunately, I am 4?11 and 135lbs and I have a short torso, so this dress wasn?t especially flattering on me. I couldn?t get the waist to sit right, the length was far too long, and the top was way too large. An excellent quality dress and I wish I could have pulled it off, but if you have a short torso and long limbs this may not work for you.

review_summary: Pretty dress, not a great fit
review_text: I ordered the XS and found the length and fit around the waist to be fine (it is elastic) but the fabric holding the buttons poofs out on me. I am going to try the XXS and see if it solves that problem. I am not very busty, and I fear the XXS may be too small otherwise.

This dress is lovely. The pintuck detail on the bodice and the cap sleeves lend character, but are subtle enough to not look teenagery. The colors are true to the picture, it's a nice muted gold with pansies in cream and indigo. Since I'm blonde and pale skinned I usually stick to blues and teals, but decided to branch out  and this shade of gold actually looks good on me! I usually wear a medium in Modcloth dresses, but this dress is so flowy that a small fit perfect and a medium would have been really baggy. And best of all, it's nice and long, for all us tall gals! Flattering dress for fall.

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought it for a fall wedding and can't wait to wear it. I'm very short, so I will say the length is much longer on me, with the skirt hitting me mid ankle, but I think it still looks great! The elastic portion seemed a little snug but not too uncomfortable. Overall, it's really pretty and I'm glad I picked this one!

This is a classy dress with a nice fit except for the waist! I am 5'2 and 110 lbs, without a large waist, and to me it was too snug. The elastic is quite firm.Otherwise it fit well including the top, and I am not very busty so it was a pleasant surprise. The length is a bit long but I think it's elegant. I may have to return though  I probably can't eat and wear the dress at the same time in comfort!

review_summary: Love the colour! It's a flattering fit.
review_text: I wore this to a 21st with nude heels and it looked great. Love the olive colour. I bought in M size and it fits well if not a bit snug in the side. I wish the zipper was not on the side as it's hard to pull up. Skirt is swishy and nice chiffon material but it's not see through. Top part is cute with the key hole which isn't revealing. Wish it was cheaper though.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much I bought it in two colors! Perfect for work. Long enough length on my 6 foot frame!
Such s beautiful dress with a great fit. Perfect fall transition piece, and nice, deep pockets. I'm a largerbusted 2x and found this to fit TTS.

I'm an international customer and was a bit worried about the reviews concerning the sizing. I went with the chart and it fits perfectly.Gotten so many compliments on it.Bought the entire outfit with tights and shoes.So pretty!

I bought this dress in the eggplant color and was hoping that it could be a work outfit.  As someone with an aboveaverage bust size, this fit perfectly  I did not have the issues some other reviewers mentioned.  On the other hand, it was lower cut than I realized, so it showed way too much cleavage (though if you have a small or even average bust, this might not be an issue for you).  However, I was able to wear a shirt underneath it that is similar to the Vanilla Milk Top that one reviewer suggested to make it work appropriate.  Overall, a really cute dress to wear out or to wear to work (with a shirt underneath).

I was worried about the belt from the other reviews, but the belt is perfect fits on the middle notch. It seemed a tiny bit big in the straps, but as long as I pull it down the straps fit and my mom easily hemmed the length (I'm on the shorter side) so all in all, this is a great dress. The fabric will be perfect for fall. I paired it with the dream of the crop cardigan and it's the perfect pair for chilly weather.

Fav modcloth purchase to date!! Excellent quality, lovely color and feel. Bought for my bridal shower and I'm sure I'll get lots of compliments! I'm a smaller busted lady so it was a little large in the top, but nothing I'm not used to.

This dress is adorable! Nice material, lovely finish, super cute pattern! I ordered up a little because of the U.K. sizing & because I am quite large chested. The fit is perfect. I can't wait for the weather to cool down so I can wear it!

Based on the picture and measurements I thought this was going to be a bit short for the office but it is prefect! It's light and airy but the exposed zipper on my back is cold. Wearing a slip to protect from shivers next time but this is too adorable and a prefect fit for the office

This dress is so so so cute. The print is adorable and the material is nice. Can be worn with a belt so a more fitted waist. The fit really is true to size, so make sure you check the size chart. I was debating an 8 or 10 and I'm glad I went with the UK 10.

The colors certainly pop and I do find they were as bold as the photos. Fits true to size and is made well and hangs nicely on the body. Great material for even a super hot day and lends itself to very cool accessory and shoe/sandal options.

This kind of dress can go so wrong on me so I was nervous when I ordered it. So it was to my great surprise that it fit perfectly  especially since there is no zipper. The fabric is thicker than I expected, in a good way. It is too lowcut to wear to work, but perfect for more social summer parties. It hits me a couple inches above the knee, and the skirt has a good swing to it. The pattern makes it though, and I was pleased that the there was no awkward pattern break between the top and the skirt.
This is a very cute dress.  I thought the colors were just as vivid in person and I love the shoulder tie details.  This fit as expected and true to size.  The material is soft and drapes nicely.

review_summary: I have this dress in anot
review_text: I have this dress in another color and I was happy to order a second dress. The material is light enough for summer but heavy enough to not feel cheap. The tie straps stay tied and allow you to adjust the top to fit your bust. The material has some stretch so the fit has some flexibility.

This dress is pretty and very colorful. The stripes are not as vivid as in the photo, but still very bright and cheerful. The darts on the bust fit me perfectly with the V of the neckline being modest, but not high necked, and the waist is about 2 inches above my natural waist which lets the jersey fabric hang perfectly without adding any bulk or unflattering lumps. The skirt on me comes to the knee and it hangs nicely from the waist. It is soft, substantial, but not heavy a great weight for summer. It appears to be well made and the lining in the bust is appreciated. The only thing I may change is to sew the shoulder straps into a spaghetti strap and forego the bow. That would be lumpy under a cardigan if I wore this to work. Right now it's a cheerful sun dress.

I purchased this dress (in rust) with the intention of making it one of my professional work dresses.  So glad I did!  The fit is so lovely that it feels tailored.  The structured look works very well for the office, but the pleated skirt keeps it from being boring.  The fabric is a great weight and doesn't feel flimsy.  It will work well with heels or boots.  I'm normally not a solid colors person, but this rich tone is very warm and flattering.  The style is retro but classic enough that it's not going to look dated.  I'm on the shorter side, and sometimes kneelength dresses hit me oddly not so with this one!Of course I have to mention that it has *pockets* ModCloth, I beg you for pockets in your work dresses!  I carry my phone around the building, and being able to drop it in a pocket rather than balance the phone, notepad, laptop, etc. is so wonderful.

I absolutely love this dress! From it's vintage appeal, to the pockets in the front! I can't even count the compliments I got the first day I wore this dress. So perfect for the office and fit like a glove. Just one of the many reasons I love ModCloth!

I was really hoping this dress would work. The only positive is that it's the exact shade of rusty orange that is in the photos, which was lovely. I'm usually a medium, but this was big on me in weird places. It felt boxy and the material isn't flowy like it looks in the pictures. It was weirdly stiff, like you'd expect from a store bought Halloween costume. It didn't feel like good quality, the sleeves were very long, and where it drops at the waist it kind of puckered/puffed out in an unflattering way... ultimately ended up returning it.

This dress just fit me oddly and made me look pregnant. So my build and this particular dress shape simply do not go together. I don't think it's either of us that's the problem: it's the two of us together. I'm sad because I really liked this color and style.

review_summary: I loved the look of this
review_text: I loved the look of this dress; I really wanted to make it work. The classicborderingonretro flair, the rich autumnal color palette, and pockets (!) we all perfect, it's just not cut for busty ladies; the fabric doesn't offer any stretch. I'm afraid sizing up would negate the tailoring and make it shapeless. Oh well, this one wasn't meant to be for this lady.

I actually really liked the rust color of this dress, contrary to other reviews.. I thought the dress itself was gorgeous but unfortunately when trying it on, the bust was incredibly small.. I ordered an XL to tailor this as the dress has no stretch, but I could barely get this over my chest! Sadly will have to return..

I own last year's version of the Just my typist dress (the one in Primary) and wore that one so much, that I was ecstatic about getting the dress in other colours/prints! Yay!Yesterday, the one in Rust was delivered  and I was sooo disappointed: The fit is great, I still like the weight and feel of the material  but the colour was dull. On the internet it seemed more reddish, like the perfect autumn red. In reality it is really rusty, more brownish. It did not seem like a colour at all  which would not have been something to lament on, but I looked boring and pale in it. As if I had dressed for cleaning the house. 8)With a heavy heart I'm sending this one back and put all my hopes on the ones in cloverstripes, which is about to arrive soon. ;)

Booo. I was happy when there was a deal on this dress...but it was not what I had anticipated. The overall look of the dress is less vintage and more halloween costume vintage. The waistband isn't actually a waistband but a decoration of one. The material was underwhelming. Modcloth, you are touch and go! This is one of those examples of too much money for not enough thoughtfulness. I got a large and the fit was too loose in the waist (I'm a 32'', 40'' hip) and too tight in the shoulders (but I have slightly larger shoulders). Returning. Hope this helps somebody!
In love with this dress! Can definitely dress this up or down. Also, fit perfectly.

review_summary: So I really adore and lov
review_text: So I really adore and love the color of the stress, but what drives me crazy is the fabric the material it?s sticks to everything I have almost every kind of color stuck to me by the end of the day, because I work in a clothing store. The dress is an a disappointment because of the pockets the color the extra layer underneath it?s a nice warm dress! It just drives me crazy that every sweater or blankets or anything else just sticks to me!

Based on the size chart I bought a medium. It fit everywhere just fine except for the chest. After 20 minutes of feeling like I waa going to break the zipper I finally got it zipped over my chest only to look down and see that the dress completely flattened them. The design and shape is beautiful. I just can't wear it because of chest sizing. Disappointed and a waste of $90.

I love the books pattern, and as an English teacher it's perfect for work. Unfortunately, the recommended measurements/size was an XL and it was too large for me. I'll exchange it for a smaller size and see how it fits.

I wish there had been reviews before I ordered.  I'm busty, so when I saw the fabric type, my gut said to go up a size (XL from my normal L) JUST IN CASE.  It was WAAAAY too big.  I was swimming in it.  I'm in the process of exchanging it for the L, and I hope it fits better!  I would have gotten the XL tailored if it wasn't bad, but it was just big everywhere, so hopefully the smaller size fits better!  The fabric is beautiful, so I can't wait to actually have this dress in my collection!

I have a really hard time finding dresses that fit my waist because I'm slender and have a long torso  I've had to return the vast majority of modcloth dresses I've tried on. I was incredibly surprised that this dress fit, and I'm so happy it did! I finally get to wear one of these super cute printed dresses! The book print is gorgeous  really understated but still visually interesting. The material is substantial without being thick or stiff. The torso is perfect to reach my natural waist and not the middle of my ribcage, while the rest of the dress is still perfectly fitted. The skirt is full but not a complete circle, which helps keep the whole dress very casual looking, and it hits right above the knee which is flattering but not too short. I will say that I find the top just a little bit roomy not enough to be a problem for me, but this would definitely fit a bigger bust well. I'm a teacher and I'm looking forward to wearing this to work when school starts!

I just received this a few days ago, and had purchased it before there were any reviews. Since I don't know my measurements, I decided to just go for it and order a Medium (I wanted to wear it on my first day teaching, which is coming up soon). The dress is beautiful  the fabric, cut, pockets, color  just gorgeous. However. I just perused some of the other reviews and it seems that others aren't having too many problems with sizing, but I found it very strange. When I tried this on, it was a battle to zip it up. Once I did manage to zip it all the way, I found that the waist was uncomfortably tight and the belt much too small, but the bust area gaped magnificently. I do still love it, so my current plan is to return it for a Large and see about getting the top taken in. I do, however, find myself a bit perplexed about these sizing issues. I quite often fit in Mediums, and though I am a bit plump in the waist I don't imagine that I'm much larger than most women who are Mediums. In fact, I tend to assume that my body is of generally average size (I'm about 5'4 and somewhere near 150 lbs) and I don't think I should need to order a Large. Perhaps I am mistaken. In either case, my first thought is that Modcloth would do well to make the sizes of the different parts of this dress more accurately proportionate to each other (and to let out the waistline a bit on the medium).

This dress is beautiful. The fabric is lovely, it's wellmade, and I wanted to like it. But the fit is no good for me. The armholes are too large, which is easily fixed, but the waist is too high, which is not. It looks like a baby doll dress on me, an effect which is amplified by the full skirt. So it's going back. It's such a shame, especially because it is nice to have a dress that fits a large chest.

review_summary: Beautiful dress, but sizing is weird.
review_text: I had ordered a small because I'm a small in most other modcloth dresses.  The dress fits on my body, but it feels a little tight in the bust, even though I am not a very busty person.  If you have a larger bust, I would recommend sizing up.  Beautiful dress otherwise.

My dress arrived today in the book print and I'm soooooo in love with it!! The print is perfect! If you are a book lover thinking about getting this dress, do it!!  I will say that I agree with other reviews, the sizing of the top is off. It fits me perfect everywhere else though, so I'm just going to get the top taken in.

review_summary: Great Dress Just Not for Busty Girls
review_text: I loved this dress and really wanted to make it work. Firstly, as with my last belted Modcloth dress, the belt is about 2 sizes smaller than the dress, which was fine as I usually then donate it somewhere. But the biggest issue is that I have large boobs and the cleavage was PROMINENT in this dress, I mean HUGE. the cut is cute if you don't have a chest but if you do it just looks too risqu?. I would've kept it regardless because I don't mind showing off the girls, but I wanted to wear it as a work dress and couldn't justify the price if I weren't going to wear it regularly.

review_summary: A Must Have for any Book Lover!
review_text: My favorite thing about this dress is the print! It is perfect for any book lover. The colors are right in line for fall and the print itself is subtle enough that those who aren't usually comfortable with bold patterns can still enjoy it. The fit of the waist is a little bit snug, but not uncomfortable. The dress is made of a lightweight cotton so it will work for warmer weather, plus it is fully lined and has pockets (a big plus for teachers!) As a ModStylist, I think this look is super cute with a blouse with fun collar detail layered underneath, such as our Vanilla Milk Top.

Okay LOVE this pattern. However, I did get a great deal with a promo code or I wouldn't have spent the $90. I ordered a small at first and it was a little too large in the bust so exchanged for an extra small which is on the way.

This dress is magnificent! As soon as I saw the book print, I just had to have it. The colors are beautiful and the dress seems to be very good quality. And who doesn't love a dress with pockets? At the time of ordering, there was only one review that suggested it might run a bit large, so I ended up ordering an M and an L so I could just return the one that didn't fit (thanks for the free returns, Modcloth!) without having to wait for an exchange to arrive to be able to enjoy it. I'm sometimes a medium, sometimes large depending on the material and brand. I'm going to say it does run a bit large compared to the size chart listed on the site.
I'm obsessive reader and was super excited to get this dress. The dress fits okay, and has pockets (WHICH I LOVE)! But even though the waist has some extra room the belt is WAY too small.

Color: My monitor shows the dress as more of a teal blue with navy color. In person it is definitely more green with navy. Loved the color though.Fit: Overall it looked great and fit okay. I'm between small and medium for Modcloth clothes. The medium fit snug at the waist, but comfortable. The straps and bust area felt only very slightly loose. However, I did end up returning it because the cut and position of the straps and top area made it so when I held my arms slightly together in front you could see down the front. It wasn't gaping, but I felt it wasn't work appropriate for me either. (I have a computer/desk job, and felt it gaped a bit even with holding my hands at my keyboard.) And for the price, I wanted a dress I could wear to work, not just weekends.Quality: Nice quality fabric. Thick, but not heavy. The belt has a velvety texture and didn't feel super cheap like some I've gotten from ModCloth.Extra: The dress is lined which was very nice. It also has pockets.

The plaid incarnation of this dress is cut strange compared to the navy and prism versions. The bust is cut too large, but is also shallow at the same time. The fabric is a lighter thread, so perfect for warm weather.

This dress is just lovely....I don't even know how to explain it. I like how one of the reviews calls it magical, as that's what it is! The little shoulder cape is precious beyond words. I am usually a ML in Modcloth dresses and the Large barely barely barely fits. So, please size up one or two sizes, depending on how you like it to fit. But order it, as it is soooo lovely!

This dress is so cute.  I love the style, the cape gives it a different look from all my other dresses.  However, it has one of these IMPOSSIBLE zippers.  Maybe it's just me and I got a dud, I don't know.  But my husband has to use massive force to get the zipper up every time.  The dress is not tight.  I typically wear a SM, and in this case I got a Medium. I am able to squeeze the zipper together to give it an inch of slack, but unless the dress is laying flat it's just ridiculously hard to zip up.  I love the style so I kept the dress (and the fact that I already warped the fabric around the zipper on the FIRST try), but I can't wear it unless someone is around to help me wrangle the zipper.

This cape dress has really fun details that run fairly true to size. I usually wear S to XS in the ModCloth brand and this small fits like a glove so if you're like me and are inbetween sizes I would suggest to opt for the larger of the two. At my height of 5'4, the length is perfect! The fabric is a very soft and flowy, but a little clingy. As a ModStylist, I have found the best way to prevent this is to spray a little antistatic on it before wearing.

I've been waiting for some good fall weather to wear this dress and I couldn't be happier with it. I normally wear XS but sized up to S for a looser fit and I absolutely love it. Not too short, sleeves are perfect length and it's just warm enough for cool weather. Very cute and very comfortable!

review_summary: I'm buying a second one because I love it so much
review_text: If you are tall buy this dress. Seriously, if finding short skirts that don't show your underwear and 'long sleeves' that don't fall three inches about your wrists is a regular problem, this is the dress for you. I bought this dress on a whim expecting to send it back but the sleeves are the right length and the hem hits about midthigh and I'm in love. Do not fear the horizontal stripes, this dress is incredibly flattering and ribbed fabric is fitted without being tight. My only concern is the fabric is slightly on the thin side (but so nice and soft) so I'm buying another for backup because I never want to be without this dress again

This dress is absolutely beautiful and more stunning in person! I wore it for a friend's wedding. Originally, I had intended it as a more casual wear, but it does look fancier in person. It fit great, but was a tad long. I am 5'5 and I wore heels with the dress or it would have dragged a little. This is probably one of my favorite dresses I own now! I am very happy.

review_summary: The rim of the dress is n
review_text: The rim of the dress is not even, the front is shorter than back.  For me(165cm) , the front length is just right, a little above the ground, the back the laying on the floor. I can pair it with heels, then you can see the heels all the times as the front is shorter. I have no idea if it is just my piece has this problem, or it's the dress' design.The fabric is very light, the color is kind of washed out in person, not as bright as the picture. The waist line is above the natural waist, for my body type (wild shoulder, thin waist) it's not very flattering. It make me looks bulky. Sorry, it's not a keeper.

I fell in love with this dress when I saw it. It's even more beautiful in person. The weight is perfect and the gold threads add a special touch. I feel pretty when I wear it. The only drawback for me was is that I found the arms and length a little short. It doesn't look right with flats, but works well with booties.

I had to have it when I first saw it, and it doesn't disappoint. What the pictures don't show you are the pockets, which are roomy and don't protrude. The metallic threads running throughout add dimension to the design. My usual size is XSS and I took a risk in getting an XS. It's fitting in the torso but not uncomfortably so, so I am keeping it. Super cute dress that is gorgeous and unique.
Fits perfect except slightly longer sleeve. Good quality with lining.
This dress looks great and is really comfortable.  Bonus: pockets.  Slightly small in the chest though, but other than that.

I've been wanting one of these dresses for ages because the prints are always SO beautiful, so I finally took the plunge on this one. The print itself is every bit as gorgeous in person, and the material is thick and highquality. Almost...too thick? This dress didn't conform to my body at all when I tried it on, leaving me looking somehow boxy and puffy at the same time, like a robot who decided to dress up as a cupcake for Halloween. The sleeves are too short and don't lie flat, making my shoulders look broader and my arms look thicker. I'm looking at the models wearing the dress, and the plussized model looks super cute, whereas the other model is experiencing some of the same problems I did. This dress might just be better for a certain body type.

review_summary: beautiful dress, but very full skirt
review_text: I bought this in my usual size and the top fit reasonably well.  Unfortunately, I'm short and the full skirt, plus the bold colors, are overwhelming for my petite frame.  The skirt ends just below the knee on me.  Very sad to send this back because I absolutely love the design and the cap sleeves.

Great heft to the dress, it's a heavy cotton with stretch.  The colors are deep and saturated and have a great design/pattern.  Unlike the other reviews, I thought it fit very well, no problem with cap sleeves.  I normally wear a size 8 and either a M or L, depending on cut.  I ordered a Large, and it fit perfectly.The dress would be great for a teenager (someone else said a homecoming dress it'd be perfect!), it is youthful & sweet... but at 35 I wanted something a little more mature looking.  Photo is of 'try on' straight out of bag needs ironing don't judge :)

This is my third Frondescent dress, and I think overall, I prefer the noncap sleeved versions.  This one is very shortwaisted, which when combined with the cap sleeves means it pulls at the bust and starts to flare out about 2 inches above my natural waist.  All that being said  it's a gorgeous thick material and the dress is lined and has !!POCKETS!!  I found the colors even more vibrant in person.  I'm struggling to decide if it's worth trying to remove the sleeves to improve the fit.  This is very much an Oh god, there's gotta be some way to make it comfortable, because it is so beautiful kind of dress.
This dress is exactly as shown. Colors are gorgeous and it is very well made. I am 5 and 110 lbs, I ordered xs but it is very snug. I may exchange for a small.

This dress is high quality, nice heavy fabric and good fall on the lining. Skirt feels nice and full. I am short from shoulder to boob, and I usually have to have straps taken up. I was particularly worried it would be too long there because of the gap on the underarm clearly visible on the model, but it's not too bad. (There is a gap there, but a bra isn't visible.) The color is really, really beautiful in person. I find the belt unnecessary, visually, and it's not hiding an ugly seam, so it's optional. Really a gorgeous dress, but I think it will look best on a slimmer figure (unfortunately).

I really wanted to love this  dress, but it just didn't work for me.  The belt was WAY too small which was frustrating, especially considering the dress was a little too big over all.The cap sleeves were a bit awkward, I think it would have been better sleeveless.  The fabric was an excellent quality though, and it is well lined.  It just didn't fit my body well at all.

review_summary: i love love love this dre
review_text: i love love love this dress! it's adorable and lightweight without losing any of its velvety goodness. the bats ice the cake on this one

review_summary: I am obsessed with this d
review_text: I am obsessed with this dress, can not wait to wear it in October but debating just wearing it every day for the rest of my life. It is a little bit short but you can tell that from the photos anyway. The velvet feels really nice and the collar and ribbon are nice details! I usually go up on modcloth dresses to a 1x but I'm happy that I went with an XL in this one, lots of stretch in the material so it fit just right!

review_summary: This dress is the bomb. Y
review_text: This dress is the bomb. You can tell it's good quality and it's adorable. It will be a staple for me this fall. I'm 54' and I'm a 32b and the XS fit like a glove!
Didn't weinkle even right out of the bag. Fit perfectly. Soany ways to style it to be demure.or edgy.

Beautiful, beautiful dress. It fits me well and I do not feel it tight anywhere. My only complaint is that it came with the seams at the end of the zipper loose (as if someone had tried it but it would have been small, so I'm getting off one star). I will wear it with long black stockings. :)

This is such a pretty dress. The mustard colour is gorgeous with a real mod vibe, worth 5 stars. The length is perfect, with my 5'8 certainly not too short. But deduction of 1 star because of the thin wrinkly material and somewhat broad chest compared to the rest of the dress.  Also it runs 1 size smaller, but thanks to the reviews I already knew so I sized up. A little expensive for the quality but where can you get a dress like this?

Perfect length, and fits like a glove. The fabric was a little thinner than I expected, but that's not a bad thing. After reading a few of the reviews here, I was afraid that the dress would be too tight in the waist, but it's absolutely perfect on me. I'm 5'3 and it hits me right at the knee.
Looks super cute and vintagey in person! I love the color as well. Very true to the photos.

Cute retro style.  I usually wear a small but this dress is too tight so back it goes which makes me so sad.  If I get a larger size I will for sure have to have the shoulders altered otherwise it will be way too low cut.

I bought this dress last week. Very cute! I usually wear an extra small in most dresses and bought an xs in this one as well. I will say that it's pretty fitted through the waist and chest. I have a very small chest so not an issue for me but if you're much larger than a B cup it might really pull across the chest.

This dress is beautiful  nice fabric, good cut, great styling, my favorite color.  But the XL just did not fit  too tight in the chest and stomach for me.  I'd exchange it for a larger size if it came in a larger size.

I just received this dress in the mail, it is a good quality but extremely seethrough. I am afraid that pictures with flash would show everything. I ordered this dress for my reception party but sadly had to return it due to the sheerness of it. I ordered two more dresses from Modcloth in hopes of finding my perfect dress. Customer service was great and fixed a mistake I made in the return!

review_summary: Meh. I love the idea of t
review_text: Meh. I love the idea of this dress  that sort of classic Marilyn style but with a little bit of modern flair with the exposed zipper and shape of the back. Sadly, the bust is huge. I am a solid Medium in ModCloth dresses and every other part of this dress was perfection... but the bust was gigantic! Super roomy and baggy. If you have a tailor that you plan to use anyway, or you have an ample bosom, this might be your dress. Otherwise I don't recommend it. #ReviewContest

Not for small chested girls! The dress is a nice material and has a slit in the back that surprised me. It's very Marilyn Monroe. Unfortunately the sizing just wasn't rightsnug around the waist, way too big in the chest, and just right everywhere else.

review_summary: I loved it, it was is bea
review_text: I loved it, it was is beautiful! A little big but It's was an easy fix. Perfect for homecoming

review_summary: Yes, the body part is short
review_text: So, well, I hoped for the best but it happened as I thought :) the body part is too short.  Also,  the skirt is not as flare as it looks on the picture. For dresses like this one I usually get size M, but I decided to her L as I've read the reviews.  Well,  still short.  So it's big in width butt small in length. This dress in any size is good for ladies shorter than 5,3 or so.  I'm 5.9 and it makes me look like I'm a momtobe :)

I got my Modcloth order today and was so excited about this dress I had to immediately write a review.  The material of the skirt is thick (the top is a bit sheer, but if worn with a dark bra, will not be an issue) and it fits me perfectly!  It's not too tight and it sits exactly where I like this style of dress to sit.  The length is perfect.  I love two toned dresses (solid on top with a pattern on bottom) and am so pleased with this!

I purchased this dress for my 40th High School Class Reunion. OMG the fit was perfect. My daughter said it made me look 40 pounds lighter. It was like a custom made dress. I checked the size chart, measured myself, and WOW. The size chart was right on. I LOVE THIS BEAUTIFUL DRESS. I looked good and felt great at my reunion. The dress is well made, and the cut is so flattering. I might even get another one in another color. I'm not a tiny woman and it is hard to find clothing that fits  so it was so nice to find something that fits and isn't ugly. I usually don't wear dresses but this one changed my mind.

review_summary: It did not flatter my bod
review_text: It did not flatter my body at all. Looks way better on the model. Just looked dumpy on me.

review_summary: Cute dress but not for my body type
review_text: This is a great midi dress. It fits true to size and is the perfect weight for a hot summer day! Unfortunately, the style did not work for me. It was too long (hit well below my knees in the front) and the pleating made my hips look even larger than they are.
I love this preppy dress. I'm 5'2, curvy with a big bust and I got a 1X and it fits perfectly. It's even the perfect length as shown on the model. Might be shorter on taller girls.
I just bought this for my 15 year old niece. It fits her perfectly!

Love this dress! So cute and I received lots of compliments while wearing it. The 1x fit me well with some room to grow if necessary. The little cat detail is a nice touch and I found the length to be just above my knees.

I have the cultivated quirk dress in the red/white color.  It is one of my favorite Modcloth purchases ever.  It has been my go to dress for the summer.  It's the easiest dress to just throw on and walk out the door.  I even wore it to the first time I've ever been to Disney World. I was really hoping Modcloth would make one in another color.  I was so excited to see this.  I put it on as soon as I got it and it's not the same.  It's shorter than the red/white one.  Short as in I'm 5'1 and it didn't even hit my knees.  Unfortunately, this is not work appropriate with my very large thighs covered in tattoos.  I wouldn't say it's tight but it feels a lot more fitted than the red/white and not as soft.  I'm a size L in every Modcloth brand dress/skirt I own. I actually looked at the tag to see if it was a L (it was).  I'm considering exchanging to see if the XL is a little longer on me but it may be too loose.  We shall see.  I gave it an average as I'm hoping there is still potential for this dress somehow. Sorry, I rambled a bit.  I just feel this is one of my most disappointing purchases.

review_summary: I love this dress. It is
review_text: I love this dress. It is perfect for work because it covers what needs to be covered without sacrificing cuteness. And because of the longer sleeves, I don't need to wear a jacket or cardigan over. Plus I can go out with friends to drinks and still look good.

I couldn't wait to get this dress.  As soon as it came, I tried it on.  I couldn't get it to zip up so I had my husband help, but that didn't work either.  I always wear a Medium in everything tops and dresses because I'm busty, but this one runs small.I'm afraid to order a L because it will be way too much dress for my small frame.

I bought this on sale (clearance?) and can't figure out why there are still so many left in stock. It's adorable! I love the mustard yellow with the '60s floral pattern  so unusual!. Very flattering in the bust area, totally comfy, both cute and pretty, lined, the whole package. I wear a size 14/16 in dresses and my usual ModCloth 1X fits perfectly.

I REALLY wanted to like this dress, because the floral pattern is amazing. Unfortunately though I will be returning it because I cannot for the life of me seem to wrap it tightly enough to actually cover up my chest and bra properly. The fabric just falls ridiculously low in the middle, like, waaay lower than on the models in these pictures. It doesn't seem to be the type of thing Ican successfully alter on my own, either. I am pretty darn busty though, even for my 2X size, so maybe women with a more average or smaller chesttobody ratio will have better luck with it. I hope they do, because otherwise I really liked everything else about it. It seems to be of great quality and is really pretty.

If you have any kind of curves then this is not th dress for you. This dress is super cute but like the reviewer above said  it's very tight in the bust.  I'm only a 36C (more like a B and a 1/2) and it was too tight for me. I can still wear it but I'd prefer something a bit looser. Also I have some lower belly pudge and when I sat down the dress emphasized that.  If it came in XL then I'd find the fit much better since I can tie the belt to emphasize my smaller waist.  I do get disappointed when I see dresses that only go up to a large.  Does the designer not like curves?

I received my dress today and was a bit sad once I tried it on.  I thought if any part would be snug on me it might be around my waist or hips but those areas fit perfectly but the bust was WAAAAAY too tight.  Bursting at the buttons tight.   I like the dress so decided to wear it open with a tank underneath though.  Just disappointed because I was imagining this dress would be my fall goto dress.

review_summary: I love this dress. I am a
review_text: I love this dress. I am a little on the short side so it flows longer than I?d normally like, and I ordered a small so it?s a bit tight around the middle, but it?s very flattering. I bought it for a Halloween costume as a witch and I?m really excited to wear it around. Good material and can be dressed up.

Loved how this looked online. Upon trying it on I was sadly disappointed. It just wasn't the right fit. It was (for lack of a better word) frumpy on me . Maybe I ordered too big of a size, but I decided to send it back.... it was great in all other aspects, just not the right dress for me.

I'm usually a stickler for only buying dresses with pockets due to being the kind of person that loves to take their 3DS with them when going out. However, just from looking at this I knew aesthetics were going to beat out practicality when it came to loving this dress. I was right. It fits me wonderfully, something that can be hard to find being plus size, tall, and having an hourglass figure. I'll probably start mostly making my own dresses soon thanks to my favorite particular needs, but in the meantime I couldn't recommend this more. I'm very into the aesthetics of Halloween and I just love being able to feel like a vampire while also dressing reasonbly for a fancy country club dinner with my old Italian godmother. Truly a splendid dress. Tasteful yet spooky makes it perfect for anyone that lives in the Halloween state of mind year round. The only minor complaint is that fabric buttons can be annoying, but if that's the only complaint then clearly it's a quality product.

Okay, full disclosure, I bought this for the cape. On getting it, I can't decide if I'm going to keep it just because I'm not sure I can wear it a lot. That being said, the draping of the cape is SUPER flattering. I have lot of tattoos on my arms/shoulders and it is very flattering under the sheer cape. The material of this dress isn't soft and does feel a little flimsy. I hate the buttons, they don't right and the neck closure is NOT something you can do alone.But the fit is perfect and very flatteringperfect for any witch!

I love how much of a statement this dress makes. It is stunning. I wore it to ballroom dance practice and it has such great movement. It can be confusing to put on, but it is so worth it. The fit and length are just right!

review_summary: Absolutely in love with this dress!!
review_text: I simply adore this dress!!! It fits like a glove and is so flattering. It hits perfectly at my waist and accentuates everything I want it to. I am embarrassed of my arms and usually wear dresses with sleeves but this cape falls perfectly over my arms. Its a little tricky to put on, took me about 5 minutes to figure out but worth it! This dresses has such an amazing silhouette, true to size fit and great quality. I highly recommend.

I'm obsessed with this dress. I'm throwing a Harry Potter themed party but I don't like costumes but I love themes and looking pretty and this dress fit the bill perfectly! It did take me a full 5 min to figure out how to get in it, but I think that's just a learning curve :) I wanted a bit more coverage so I had a lightweight form fitting tee on under and it worked great! I'm so excited about this dress thank you Mod Cloth!
Fit is snug. It's difficult to pull the zipper up pass the waist due to there being too much fabric gathered at the waistline.

review_summary: So cute and well made but
review_text: So cute and well made but so disappointingly small.

review_summary: I usually wear a small, b
review_text: I usually wear a small, but I was multiple inches away from being able to zip up this dress. It was so tight in the chest that I can't imagine anyone being small enough to wear it. Too bad, because I loved the look of it and the quality was nice, too. I wouldn't order a size up because it seemed to fit right everywhere except the chest.
I really like this dress. It's not my favorite, but it's up there. It's comfy and soft. The fit is great. It's fun and cute!

I bought the polka dot with red skirt version of this dress. First, it's well made. It's nice material and the skirt has pockets! The skirt is more of an orangered. But the arms are tight! I ordered a medium based on the measurements and I'm hoping they loosen up some from wearing it. If you're big in the chest or arms, consider sizing up.

review_summary: Not as good as it looks
review_text: This dress sits so dang high! And I have a small chest, and a fairly short torso and it still sat above my natural waist. It was also incredibly short, not even midthigh on me.

review_summary: Not as pictured, defective, and doesn't fit
review_text: I purchased this in a size Small since my measurements are as follows: chest 32, waist 25, hips 35. I'm small on top, a little bigger on the bottom and my number one concern is comfort. I read reviews about how stretchy and comfy this dress was so I gave it chance. Sadly, the sleeves of the dress were insanely tight! And I have thin runner arms! Also the left pocket was defective, the opening was too small for me to fit my hand in it. Also online I see a beautiful bright Minnie Mouse red skirt but in person its a dark cherry red skirt. And there wasn't a care instruction tag in the dress either. I don't understand why Modcloth won't allow people to exchange for a dress of the same retail value. Why would I waste my time on a designer's dress that gave me such a poor experience? I doubt exchanging it would provide me with a better experience so I decided to just return.

I am so disappointed this dress didn't work out! It is so gorgeous and the pattern is even lovelier in person. Unfortunately, the fabric has approximately zero stretch, and if you have anything resembling boobs or a bit of stomach, you're out of luck. The dress fit me around the waist and the shoulders, but because there was no elasticity, the zipper wouldn't go up once it reached my upper waist. It just couldn't compensate for my chest, which is really disappointing. Maybe girls with flatter chests will be able to wear this dress, but if you aren't a stick this dress isn't for you. Would love to keep this dress, but it isn't for me :(

I am 5'7 and 140 lbs and ordered this in M in mocha. I loved the material and the color and the style, but the fit was terrible. It has a high waist, which is fine, but it seems like it's built for a shorter person because there was a big poof in the back above my butt that looks terrible. You can even kind of see the poof on the model (I hadn't noticed it initially)! If it fit better around the hips and butt, I'd love it. So tall (ish) girls, be warned.

I got it yesterday....so excited. However when I tried, I had issue with zip. I knew something wrong here. With one trial....zip is broken..as well as my heart. I love how the fabric is. I don't like the pocket that make my hip look huge. I have to return it.

I am in love with this dress!  It was just delivered today (Saturday) and I cannot wait for the workweek to start so I can wear it.  I tend to wear Aline or fit and flare dresses because I am self conscious about my hips, but this dress fits them (and every other part of me) just right!

Love this dress! I'm 5'7, 135 lbs, 34 B and a size small worked out great. I was worried at first that I should have ordered a medium, but there is stretch in the fabric and while the small fits snug, it's not too tight. The material is beautiful and very comfortable.I got the mocha color and it is just as pictured. Very happy with my purchase. I believe if more color options become available in the future, I will definitely continue to stock up on this style.

The print on this was too good to pass up, especially since I had a murder mystery event or two on my calendar. I read the reviews and was expecting sheer fabric, but since it came with a slip I figured it'd be okay. The fabric is not just sheer, though, it's well and truly flimsy, so much so that the ruffled collar can't support itself and drapes awkwardly around your neck. The armholes are also massive, on the dress and the slip, and gape terribly  but if I'd gone down a size, it'd be tight in the hips. I tried to fix this by sewing darts under the sleeves, but because it also zips all the way up one side, I'm having to add four darts total  to either side of each seam  and I think I'm also going to have to tuck the loose ends of the collar along the neckline and sew them in for a more finished look. For what a flimsy dress this is and how much altering it needs to work, it's just not worth the price. Too bad  I wore it (work in progress style under a cardigan to hide the sleeve issues) and got lots of compliments on the fabulous print.

review_summary: This dress is true to siz
review_text: This dress is true to size, got my normal size and it fits perfectly!Great length, goes just below my kneesThe feel of the fabric doesn't feel cheap at all
I bought the dress in green for my high school reunion. It was perfect. It fit well and was very unique.
Dress fit as expected for me. I always order an XL, and this fit fine, but I am smaller busted (b cup). Lovely pattern.
The lining was snug, but the shell swallowed me. It was a weird combination of fits. Also, the color and pattern are a lot duller in person.

I can't wait to wear this dress! I love the colors and style, with nice little button and pleat details. I would have given it a five if not for the short lining. I am no spring chicken and I don't like showing my knees so I will have to wear a slip with it and I'm not sure how that will pan out. But I am keeping it. I do like the length, pattern (unique) and the sturdiness of the slip. I got the blue/detective. I will wear it with an orange cardigan and other pumps or fall boots. I would have wanted to layer it with a long sleeved shirt but it is a bit snug. Fits just right at the waist but no room at all. Won't be wearing this at thanksgiving! Lol. I do like how easy it is to put on, unlike most dresses of this style with attached slip.  I am glad I got the small and not the extra small as the stylist recommended. I am 5'4 and 129 lbs, not a huge chest or shoulders. I am a 32C/D bra.

I love the prints and the style of this dress, but it's oddly constructed and runs very small. I'm size 16 with a larger bust, but most 1X from ModCloth will fit just fine (with a couple items running a little tight in the bust but not unexpectedly so). This dress, though, fit much tighter than most. The underslip really clings. It was so difficult to zip around the bust that I'm requesting two sizes up instead of just one. I hope the larger size works out, as I love the print and the colors. Fingers crossed!
I think I would've loved this dress but I couldn't get it past my chest. Runs VERY small. It said it fit True to size  maybe if you're a B cup.....

review_summary: This is a great play dres
review_text: This is a great play dress! It's super cute and has a classic 70s/80s vintage look. The stripes on the bodice and sash are muted feminine jewel pastels and the button details are lovely and whimsical. I love that the straps are adjustable for cleavage control. The pockets are placed flatteringly on the dress (not too close to hips) and button close so they're perfect for securing phone or credit cards. And it's lined! Based on other reviews, I ordered up a size and I'm glad I did. I do wish it were a bit longer in the bodice and length. I'm 5'3 and it falls to my lower thigh above my knee and the waist is just under the gals which isn't the most flattering on my waist but still looks good enough to wear often. It also wrinkles easily so it's not good to wear if you plan on sitting most of the day. But I can easily forget about all the things I don't like because it is so fun and unique! I'm looking forward to wearing this dress with a cardi when the weather gets cooler!
Quality & length is very good, just chest area a little tight

review_summary: This dress is so cute! It
review_text: This dress is so cute! It fit perfectly and is nice material but definitely small in the chest area.I wear a 36B and could barely wear the dress with a bra.Otherwise I love this dress!!
Size up if you wear a C+ bra size. This dress (while super, super cute) runs small in the chest. Instantly exchanging for larger size.

Love this dress, so 70s and sunny. Quality if pretty good and looks exactly as shown. Only thing that is off is the chest area. As with ALL ModCloth brand dresses, the bust area is so small! I'm a 34D on an average frame and I always have to order up for the ModCloth dresses if I want to even get them zipped up. They are SO narrow in the bust area and I typically have to have the length and mid section taken in to compensate. BUT for this dress, it's totally worth it.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress so much. It's long on me, but everything that fits my waist and bust is long on me, so I expect to have to alter everything. Like the other reviewer said  though (see her photo), the darts on the bust were sewn with dark thread, and you can see the tails through the creamcolored stripe right at the bust. It's so unfortunate. Otherwise the dress is good quality and the colors are so beautiful. Now I'm trying to think of a way to fix those threads. If I can't, I'll send it back.

The fit of this dress is lovely (and lined!), but the construction was poor. The stripes were placed differently on my garment, with a creamcolored stripe hitting me at an unflattering lowchest level. The stripes on the skirt were askew, but not enough to make it look jaunty and intentional. Finally, the bust darts were sewn with dark thread, the tails of which were visible through the cream stripe. Another version of this dress might have different stripe placement, but it may be luck of the draw. Back it goes.

I bought this for a birthday dinner and it was simply gorgeous. Versatile and flattering; I felt great wearing it. I did exchange it to size down so that it would have more of a form fitting look (like in the pictures). Its knit, so it has a lot of stretch!

Looks exactly like it does in the photo! The back is a bit more bare than I was anticipating, because of the back tie with everything from there to the waist laid bare. But I do have issues with thinking my back is overly broad, so, there's that. It's a gorgeous, classic madras, and my usual ModCloth 1X fits me perfectly (I'm a size 14/16 in dresses). You do have some leeway, sizewise, because of the elastic waist and back tie, so could probably size up OR down if necessary. I agree with other reviewers that the dress style makes a bra problematic; I feel fine skipping one, though, even as a Dcup, because the top of the dress feels structured enough.
This dress is beautiful! Well made and the fabric is a nice linen. I usually wear a 2 or 4 and am a 32DD  a medium worked the best for me. If you have big boobs, you probably want to size up.

Loved this dress when I saw it online and fell head over heels once I received and tried it on. Can't wait to wear it out!! Perfect fit, great length, and pretty colors. Can't see anyone not loving this dress.

I bought this dress in a 1x and it fit perfectly! The length is perfect as well. It looks just as pictured and it has pockets! The only problem with this dress (for me), is that I need to wear a bra with this dress and the ties in the back expose a lot more lower back area than anticipated. I will have to wear a tank or cardigan with it. But be aware that if you wear a cardigan with this, the bow in the back will create a big bump. None the less, I am keeping this dress! It's way to cute to return. I will make it work! Ha ha!
Very happy!! I thought I would need to return it but it fits perfectly.
Very well made dress however it slightly tight around the chest. I am a pear shape and slim around the waist so I was surprised when it was tight. This dress is fun to wear and is so unique.

review_summary: Love the Color (Just Be Careful Around the Waist!)
review_text: This dress is fun to wear for a summer event (and it has pockets!!!). The sash area of the dress is a tiny bit tight but not uncomfortably so for me. The color is more of a sky blue and white (pictures online made it look more metallic looking from a distance).

This has a slightly more tailored shape than I expected, in a good way! Fabric and construction is really nice, and the skirt is lined. Love the pockets, too. Workappropriate and cute for real life as well.
I really love this dress. Every time I wear it, I get so many compliments and it makes me feel really cute yet professional.

Not a bad little dress, but overall it was just too big.  Too long  very dutchy on a 5'0 frame  and the sleeves were bulky and too long as well.  If it had wowed me more in other respects I might have kept it and had the sleeves and skirt shortened, but it wasn't very impressive.  Better to return it and spend the money on something that fits better off the rack.

My favorite dress ever!! Great fit, perfect for work with a cardigan, and it's lightweight, so I can still wear it on warmer days. I will say there is a HUGE difference between the 1x and the xl the 1x for great but since I've lost some weight, it is much looser now. I just bought the burgundy version in xl and I can't close over my chest. Still love the dress, but had to return the burgundy.

As many reviewers have said, this is extremely small in the bust.  I have a larger chest and decided to go with a medium (but I fit a small in most other Modcloth dresses I have purchased).  It still buttoned without gaping, but the back of the dress was tight enough that you could see the outline of my entire bra.  So, back it goes.  I decided not to try one more size up because I was afraid that it would be too loose in the waist to be flattering.

review_summary: Like it was made for me!
review_text: This dress hits all of the right spots, I feel like Joan from Madmen. It is not too heavy and would be good with a cardigan and tights all fall. It is edging on long for me because I am shorter, but just right with healed boots. I would need to take up just a little to wear with flats.

I think another poster was right on in that this runs slightly small.  If you are between sizes you may want to go up.  I am solidly a S and this dress is just very slightly too tight in the bust and is a perfect snug fit in the waist (belt like snug), but I'm afraid if I go up a size it will be too loose.  I'm busty though at a 32DDD.  While it was slightly snug in the bust, I didn't get the infamous gap that you can get with buttons on the chest.  The dress is also a little long on me, but I'm 5'2'' so I'm going to have it taken up an inch.  It's a beautiful color (I would actually call it more of a lavender) and the quality of the fabric is great.  I think this is a great addition to my fall wardrobe.

This dress is adorable! I am either a Small or Medium depending on the clothing item, and I am super glad I went with a medium. While it's pretty long, the top fits snugly, and I'm a 34C. It's still very comfortable, but if I had gotten a small, I would have been in trouble. Overall, I am very pleased with the quality of the dress and how cute it will be to dress up or down!

I'm definitely going to exchange it, as it's super cute and really good quality, but it is so small. When I was putting it on I thought they had accidentally sent me the wrong size I ordered everything else I got in a medium and they fit just right, but I couldn't even button this. Definitely size up.

review_summary: Such a pretty dress with a darling cut
review_text: After reading the other reviews, I avoided shelf boob by sizing up. I'm usually a 68 in dresses and the large fits perfect on me.

I really love this dress. It's flattering and easy to wear, no fussy underpinnings to make it look right. I really appreciate how this dress is modest yet sophisticated. It gives plenty of room for my 40DDs and hits my waist at its narrowest point. I can see this becoming one of my goto garments!

This is my new favorite dress. The print is beautiful, the fabric is nice, and the fit is perfect. It's unique but also a perfect staple dress. I bought it for my rehearsal dinner for my wedding, and it's just the right mix of dressy and a hint casual. I am usually between a medium and a small; I ordered the medium, and it fits perfectly (I am 5'7 and about 140 lbs.). The high neckline is so cute, tooI just can't get over how much I love this dress!
I loved this dress but as a size 6 the large was too small.  I highly suggested sizing up on this one.

review_summary: I tried this dress on at
review_text: I tried this dress on at the concept store in Austin. I had no reason other than I wanted to try on a pretty dress. I'm small on top and usually wear a size small or medium dress. The medium was way too big, the small fit and felt great!  I might have to revisit this dress the next time I have an occasion to dress up.
This dress is stunning in person. It's a really nice, deep, vibrant red (I was worried it would end up being orange, but it's definitely not). The length is great

Love this dress! I found that there was no back or side zipper so it was a bit hard to get on and off. There is also no give to the material except for around the elastic and. I ordered a medium but could actually go up a size due to the the lack of stretch in material. I'm keeping it! It's gorgeous and looks beautiful once you get it on. If you are busty you may want to size up.

I agree with the other reviewers  this dress is quite thin and the bottom half is seethrough (the top portion was fine). I usually wear leggings with dresses, so I don?t mind. A slip would solve this problem for anyone wanting to go bare legged. Aside from this, I found it to be very flattering on my curvy figure and true to size. The tie is a mock tie, and it sits comfortably at my natural waist (I?m quite short though, so it may not work for taller gals). Overall, I?m happy with my purchase.

Extremely thin and you can see right through. The bottom half was a bit long but looked fantastic. The top half however... the tie is a mock tie and the waist hits uncomfortably tight above my natural waist. Sadly this is best for the larger chested gals, as mine did not quite fill the top out enough to look good. Returning.

Buy this dress!  It is so beautiful in style, fabric and quality. I was really shocked to find that it has a built in slip attached which is wonderful. I put this dress on and couldn't help but feel happy at the comfort and color.! Awesome~

review_summary: So many compliments from staff and students
review_text: At 5'2 this dress hits just above my knee...perfect to make my legs appear longer!  I bought the dress because it has  falllike colors but It makes a nice summery like dress as well.  The ivory slip has adjustable strap and the flower sheer over layer is so warm and cheery(with working buttons).  The tie on the back cinches at my waist quite well and flatters my figure nicely. My coworkers kept asking me where I purchased my cute little dress. FYI, I bought it because it looked fabulous on the model.

I bought this as a falltransitional dress and its super cute! It is extremely comfortable and is not too clingy, but just clingy enough! I am pretty petite (5'1 and short waisted) and it hits me right above the knee, so its great for work. The fabric is a bit thin, but its not see through. I feel comfortable in it, but if you really wanted more coverage a slip (I know, old school) would be an easy fix. The colors are true to the picture.

The reviews are 100% accurate: This dress runs small, so order a size up. I?m usually a medium and got a large, and it hugs my middle and hits about midthigh on me. The shoulders and arms fit great though. The fabric is also pretty thin and a little scratchy. I?m keeping it because it will still look cute with tights and boots this fall/winter, but it?s not the most comfortable fit.

I bought this dress hoping it would be appropriate for both work and date nights, and I actually ordered it in both a Medium and Large so I could try both on and decide which fit was better. The medium was definitely tight, as the other reviews noted, but honestly, it would have worked if I was going for that hot bodycon look. The large, however, is perfect for what I was looking for.  It is form fitting without being inappropriate, and since I am so short, the length is just right on me.  The color in person is deeper and more purple than the red in the stock photo, which I'm happy with as well.  I plan on wearing this on my birthday date this weekend and also to work (medical office setting) and work related events as well. I'm really happy with this purchase and will be returning the medium in favor of the large.

I normally am between a small and medium (5' 5 and 150 lbs), so when I read the other reviews, I decided to go with a medium.  This definitely runs smaller than I anticipated even with reading the reviews.  This dress is very form fitting in the stomach region and didn't provide the look I'm going for.  I'm going to exchange it for a large, as it is really cute, especially with the sleeves.  It is also very short, so I likely won't wear this as an actual dress  I'm going to wear it with leggings as a tunic.  If you don't like your dress to show what you ate for lunch, I'd definitely recommend going a size up!

Usually I wear a 6/8, so I bought the Medium based on the size chart  but this dress was pretty tight! I'm 5' 3 and the dress only reached midthigh. Based on the picture of the model and the knit fabric, it should have been somewhat loose fitting. This was not the case. I'm returning for a size large so I can get the fit I was expecting from this style. The dress also seems somewhat low quality for the price. If I didn't get this on sale, I wouldn't have purchased. Super cute style and pattern, but didn't love the fit.

I bought this thinking it was going to be too big since the smallest size available is a Small. It fits perfectly! I'm 5'3 and 98lbs and typically wear a XS or 00 so I would maybe consider sizing up. It is a little loose above my rear, but I am guilty of needing to do a few more squats. I bought it to teach it and I can't wait to wear it!

I ordered the medium,  since my bust is just a little larger after having a baby, and I was worried it might be to large. Ugh ! Tough thick yet stretchy material that I could not get zipped up with out extreme help. Which then made breathing uncomfortable. I'm disappointed the sizing was so off on this particular dress as I'm sure a large would definitely be too big. Will be returning.

I bought this dress because I needed something a little pinupy and the reviews on this one were very good.. I got the red and black one.. I chose Large and it was perfect..some said the dress was too long, but mine was great, it just hit right above the knee (almost right at the knee) and I am 5'4'' and about 140 lbs. Overall very tight fitting dress but that is the point of I think and I could definitely breathe and move and sit comfortably. With my measurements the Large was the right choice. I love it, would buy again.
It's such a pretty dress but the xl feels more like an S or an M. And I felt like a whale just looking at it. I'll have to return it or give it away:(

The colors and pattern of this dress are gorgeous!  Something a little different, and perfect for fall.  I probably could have gotten a 1X and it would have been fine, but sometimes ModCloth dresses fit a little snug and I didn?t want to take a chance.
