I agree with another review that there is quite a bit more cleavage showing than I expected, and it wasn?t going to be appropriate for work, so I?ve been wearing a brown cami under it and it has worked out fine.  The other thing I will mention about the cut is that the scoop back comes down a little farther than I expected.
Really nice dress. Really low cut, had to use a safety pin. Wore it to a fall wedding with navy heels and a navy cardigan. I loved it.

I was a bit hesitant, as the mustard yellow is not my favorite. But I do love paisley, so I bought the dress in my usual 2X. No regrets! The dress is very flattering, both in cut and color (turns out I look pretty good in mustard yellow!).  It has a wide, deep neckline with a dip in the back, so I do need to either pin the front or wear a camisole.  The wide waistband and flowy skirt should hide any tummy issues you may have.  I LOVE this dress.
I bought this dress and have fallen in love with it! I love the skirt length and the v neck isn't too revealing.

review_summary: I want this style in a billion more patterns
review_text: I'm a pale redhead and I've never bought anything even vaguely yellow that wasn't gold jewelry, but I was pretty sure this would be a flattering cut on me and I appreciate dresses with sleeves, so I took the plunge. Not only was the style perfect but the color combination was incredibly wearable  a beautiful autumn pattern. Fits well, looks lovely, got loads of compliments. The neckline dips a bit, so you'll either be readjusting a bit or you might want to wear something underneath if you're sporting this in a professional setting.

I loved this dress online but,  when it came in I was a little disappointed. The quality seemed a little lower than their normal. If I didn't get it on sale I would have returned it.  It fit good at the waist but too big on the top. But if we're to have ordered a small instead of a med it would have been way too tight on the waist and good on the top. This dress is definitely for someone with a smaller chest size. Still love mod cloth though! Just this dress was not for me!

review_summary: Cute design, poor fit on me
review_text: The thin crepe material unfortunately doesn't do great things for me. In addition, the vneck does not lie flat  part of it always pokes out and is uneven. The arm holes are also too low, which means you can always see my bra on the side. That being said, the dress is comfortable and the design is cute.
this dress is super thin and very rough. It is also cut for a tall person and is illfitting on someone petite.

I am in love with this dress, I'm a size S and it fits perfectly. The material is lightweight but it's not clingy at all. I wore it to church on Easter and everyone loved it! I'd say this is definitely a spring/summer dress. Overall great quality and fit and absolutely adorable!

This dress is so lovely and I adore the 60's vibe! I hate clingy fabrics & I'm so happy that this lightweight crepe flows just right and doesn't cling at all. I feel very comfortable in the dress, I can wear it to work & out for cocktails with the girls! Ohhh and it has pockets!!!

I was skeptical about this dress due to a review about the quality, but it was so adorable that I took a chance. I am so glad I did! The dress I received was high quality and very well made (and I noticed it was made in the USA). The fabric is the actually the perfect yearround weight! We had a cold snap and I layered a black mock neck under it and I'm going to wear it with gingham wedges for Mothers Day brunch. I am thrilled with this purchase!
I have made many Modcloth purchases that I am thrilled with, but this is not one of them.  The material is so thin and it's poorly made,  especially for the price.

I love the fit of this dress and the retro look of this dress! Hits my waist at the perfect spot and is the perfect length! Think it will be super cute with a blouse underneath it, can't wait to wear this all year long
It is a great dress but runs small! Ordered the navy in a med but got the multi in a small, which is ok but think med will be better

review_summary: elegant and playful at the same time
review_text: This dress was adorable: classy enough to wear to work yet would be great for date night too.  it was very flattering and hid my post pregnancy pouch well.  loved the pattern!

I took a chance on this one and was glad because it's super cute. The material is thin but not too thin, and the fit is fantastic. Hits just above the knee and fits my waist and chest perfect. Can't wait to wear this at work. My only problem so far is that I barely even tried it on and the loops that hold the belt in place both came loose. No big deal though.

I have to admit, I was a little worried... Would this look silly? Childish? The answer is nope, no way. The quality is actually better than I expected; the dress is fully lined and the material is soft and smooth. The length is just right for work, and I like that it's appropriate for casual day or work wear. I could have probably ordered a medium, but I'm glad I got the large, just to give the girls a little extra room. The fabric doesn't have much give.

review_summary: Not suited for pear shaped girls
review_text: fantastic quality fabric, colour and printIts not a modcloth brandthe lining on the skirt is a thick jersey fabricThis did not sit well on me and i feel it would suit top heavey or column shaped girls (I am pear shapedIts short on me, coming to mid thigh instead of just above the knee. If i had sized up i think it would look awkward
I couldn't believe how cheap the fabric was on this dress. Very disappointed.

This fit was so strange. the top was too billowy but the skirt was really tight.  I'm curvy, but I don't even think this would be flattering on a narrow bodytype.  It made my large chest look smaller and my average tummy look HUGE. Wish they would do these prints in some other styles

This was my first time ordering a dress online and I was super nervous about not trying it on, but I'm SO glad I did!! I wore it during Shark Week one day to work and got so many compliments!! I felt so strongly about it I felt I needed to write a review which I've also never done before!
Fits perfect!  Love the color and style of this dress

review_summary: Such a great fall dress for everyday
review_text: Really unique casual fall dress. It's a little pricey for a fairly thin knit dress, but it is very cute and flattering. It is actually lined, which I wasn't sure if I'd like, but it seems to make it fall nicely. I am usually a small but often need to size up at ModCloth. I decided to try the small and it fit perfectly. So it really is true to size.

I am largemedium in Modcloth dresses but tried medium  it fits perfectly. Te arms do set a bit high on the shoulders bc I have broad shoulders but plenty of room to do some chickendancing at an upcoming wedding without it moving around/hiking up. the color is gorgeous!!! and the lace is sturdy  unlike some other lace dresses i've bought on mc!

review_summary: Fell in love with this dr
review_text: Fell in love with this dress!  I wasn't sure if it would be too formal for the wedding I was attending, but it was perfect for the occasion. I got tons of compliments. I'm 5'8 so the length was great for me. I wore 4 inch heals with it and danced barefoot and both worked!!

This dress hugs every curve and is sexy without being revealing. It feels like good quality fabric, heavier weight than I expected and lined, which is nice. The plaid pattern has gray, cream, and a thin brown stripe. I ordered a large and it is very formfitting as I said, but it is not too tight. I normally wear a size 10 dress and I have an hourglass shape.

review_summary: Perfect size, but not my fit.
review_text: I loved the quality of this dress (thick stretchy fabric and fully lined) and large was the right size for me (exact according to the size chart) but I have lowslung hips and this dress is cut for higher hips. I ended up with a lot of fabric bulking up around my middle. I wanted a sleeker look, so belting it wasn't an option. Sadly it's a return.

I bought a small in this dress, and it was tiny?I think it's really well made, with nice cloth, but I could barely get it on. I'm 5'3, 128, usually a size six, maybe an eight on a chunky day, but I checked the label to see if it was an extra small! Here are the flat measurements from a 2X to help you. The bust is 23 inches flat (46) PLEASE see more specific as this dress' bust is not the whole story, the arm hole is 12.5 inches and the measurement right above the buttons is 21 inches (42). My thoughts The material is thick. The color is a bitter darker than the color in the model pictures. It is lined. Wished this one had pockets. The bust was my biggest problem. My measurement from my back to across the front of my bust is 47 inches. That said, I wear a 38B or 40B if I can find them. The flat measurement for this dress is 46, BUT the bust of this dress does NOT include the bust part that sticks out, the tailored darts for the bust. Though I always love this detail, not on this dress for me. If you lay the dress flat and keep it flat, there is room where your chest would fill the extra material. It's about 5 inches bigger! What does that mean? Small busted girls, this is not for you. Think those old pointed bras and put that room in the bust on this dress. There isn't much stretch at the bust, but there is the whole 'area' you need to fill. You can see that the second model with short hair doesn't fill out the dress as well as the top model pictures. It doesn't fit like the top model if you are small busted. So, endowed girls... rock this dress. Small chested, pass. Returning this one, but if it fit it would have been a great purchase.

Given the price of the dress, that's disappointing, but a) it's beautiful enough for me to have lusted after it in the first place and b) it's good quality with a nice thick material, so I don't really mind the alteration fact that much.Petite women like me, bewarean 8 probably will not fit you correctly and alterations will most likely be in your future. Rest assured, at least, that you'll probably look smoking when they're made!

I really love this dress. The fabric is pretty thick and stretchy, good quality. I have a smaller waist and wider hips so I usually wear dresses with flared skirts, but this is incredibly flattering. I've gotten so many compliments on this, probably my favorite modcloth purchase.

This dress is stunning! I haven't had an occasion to wear this yet, but I can't wait until I do!  The quality and construction are wonderful and the lace accents on the side are perfectly placed to accent a woman's shape.  I'm usually a size 6 and the 10 (UK) fit perfectly. I purchased this item as a ModCloth employee.

I ordered this dress the day it came back in stock. I plan to wear it to a wedding at the end of the summer. It is sexy but classy, formal but comfortable. Plenty of stretch but also sturdy fabric. The lace is made with shimmery threads, so it gives it a little extra dimension. My only wish is that the lace on the sides continued onto the back. Otherwise, a complete knockout.
Very classy dress. I felt sexy and comfortable all night.

I have been waiting anxiously for this dress to arrive and I am very pleased! I was nervous about the size at first, but as soon as I felt that there was some stretch to it, I knew it would work and voila! Fits beautifully! It's even got some wiggle room and I feel like I could have gone down one size, but it's great. I bought this to wear to a relatives wedding next month and it will do beautifully with some nude heels. I love that I can bend down without flashing everyone (I'll have my 3 children to run after) and that I won't be stuck under a ton of shapewear. It's very flattering. I do wish the lace detail wrapped around the back, but still, it's very pretty and classy. I'm glad I ordered it!

Sadly I ordered the wrong size since I don't know UK sizes. Had to return it. The fabric is great quality and the lace detail is beautiful. I was sad to see they didn't have a smaller size to exchange
Great dress, great quality, great fit.Little exception : loose fit at the waist  so I'll have to bring it to a tailor, since I like the dress enough to pay an extra to fix it.

review_summary: I got this to wear to a w
review_text: I got this to wear to a wedding and SHAZAAM! It's look phenomenal! The neckline is conservative but fits like a glove on someone as curvy as me so you still get the sex appeal.

review_summary: I ordered this in a UK 10
review_text: I ordered this in a UK 10 and 12, not realizing the corresponding US sizes (6,8). The 10 zipped because of the stretch in the material, but was too tight for me to feel respectable. The 12 was perfect. I tried it on with and without shape wear, you could probably get away without it if you are generally toned in the belly/hip/thigh region, but I liked the seamless look of the dress with the added support. I am curvy and found this dress to accentuate my assets in a feminine, flattering way. Classy with the subtle hint of sexy. I do wish the lace continued around the back of the dress, but as another reviewer noted, it would probably up the cost of the dress. As it is, my husband said this was the best dress he'd ever seen me wear, so I'd buy it again for twice the price to get a reaction like that!
A little tight but that's my bootay's fault. Great quality and beautiful dress!

This dress is absolutely magical! It is everything I'd hoped it would be and so much more! Super flattering and ridiculously classy.  I'm doing double duty in it  graduation during the day, and a wedding at night! I can't wait to throw on some red lipstick, super sweet heels (Dynamic Debut in Navy..swooon), and dance the night away!

review_summary: This dress is spot on in
review_text: This dress is spot on in every way. High quality material and tailoring make it for like a dream. The lace is beautiful and firmly attached. So glad I grabbed this as soon as it came back in stock!

One of my favorite ModCloth purchases yet! I don't know what people are talking about when they say it doesn't cinch at the waist. It has perfect amount of stretch and hugs all my curves (though I'm not especially curvy) without being too suffocating. Maybe they ordered a size that's too large or have a freakishly small waist?

review_summary: I loved this dress but I
review_text: I loved this dress but I really didn't love it on me. It was beautiful and wonderful quality and I wanted so much to like it on me but we just weren't meant to be!

review_summary: I have a very curvy figur
review_text: I have a very curvy figure, and with that being said, it's difficult for me to find a dress that fits at all. My hips are literally 12 inches bigger than my waist. I bought this dress in a size 10 because I didnt want it to hug my butt too tightly, but then it was huge in the waist. Since I loved the dress so much, I'm paying to have it altered. They're having to take it in about 3 inches in the waist. Just know if you're a curvy girl, you'll have to make some changes if you want it to be form fitting. Beautiful dress though and fabric is great!!

review_summary: Oh Modcloth I love you an
review_text: Oh Modcloth I love you and this dress!

Great material heavier and stretchier than I thought, which is perfect since I have a more hourglass figure. Hugs in all the right places. The UK 10 is a perfect US size 6. Cannot wait to wear this one!

THIS. DRESS. Amazing is an understatement. So in love! The fabric is a great, sturdy, stretchy quality (reminds me a lot of the Lady Love Song dress, which I also own and love). Like someone else has mentioned, the lace is more of a creamgold color, but it looks fabulous and rich on the dress. The length is just perfect, modestly hitting just over my knee. In addition, the shape of the dress is very flattering, conforming well to my curves despite the thickness of the material. I'm usually a US 6 in dresses and the UK 10 fit perfectly, despite looking small straight out of the box. So happy with this purchase! Can't wait to wear it to my friend's wedding in June!

review_summary: Oh Modcloth I love you an
review_text: Oh Modcloth I love you and this dress!

This dress is incredible! I ordered it for my college graduation and I couldn't be more pleased! I am relatively short and it fell just below my knees, but it gave me a modest look without looking like I was drowning in it! I have a very athletic body type and I am always looking for dresses to complement it. This dress is perfect! Don't hesitate if your size is in stock!

review_summary: This ran a bit too large
review_text: This ran a bit too large for me in the bust.  Which is odd seeming as I usually have the opposite problem.  The smaller sizes are sold out but I'm hoping it will be restocked again, soon.

review_summary: I wanted so bad to love t
review_text: I wanted so bad to love this dress, but sadly it must go back. I am pear shaped and this dress is definitely meant for girls with larger chests. I felt that the waist and shoulders were too baggy and the bottom was snug. I liked how the bottom fit, but the upper portion would have been a pain for someone to alter, especially because of the lace detailing. The quality of the fabric and length of the dress were spot on though! Hopefully someone else out there can enjoy this dress!

As mentioned in another post and visible in pictures the lace stops at side seam line and does not extended to true side/back. I think this makes the quality less than perfect, kinda of chincsing on the lace. Thus I gave it ok quality instead of very good. But where the lace is it is very well applied the lining of dress and the material feel like really good quality. I had wanted it before and it ran out so when it was added back I didn't delay to buy. I will definitely be wearing this. It's a good inch or more above my knee and will definitely ride up shorter when seated but not too extreme that I'm uncomfortable wearing although it's right on that edge of too short for my comfort. On a 1 to 10. I give it a 7. It's fits great for my pear shape.
Great for my office job

review_summary: I took a gamble on the si
review_text: I took a gamble on the size, and it ended up being perfect. I have a large ribcage and broad shoulders, so sometimes I can't get dresses zipped up that fit everywhere else. The material was stretch enough that it was no problem. I wore the dress to a company party, and it was a big hit. Paired it with some blue suede heels.

review_summary: I think this dress is amo
review_text: I think this dress is among my favorite ModCloth purchases! Sometimes, you've just gotta wear a doily. Or several of them. In the form of scrollwork.    This dress is very elegant. And every time I wear it it I feel like I should be throwing a tea party just to keep up with its level of class.    The fabric has just the right amount of tension and stretch, the cut is superb for a defined waist, all around there could not be a better choice of dresses.

review_summary: For a tall girl with all
review_text: For a tall girl with all legs I love this dress! I have a hard time finding dresses long enough for me and this on was perfect came to about 2 inches above the knee so I  had just enough leg to feel sexy without feeling overexposed. The cap sleeves are very tight around the armpit and left my arms red just from rubbing on my arms, I would recommend ordering a larger size and getting it tailored. As I saw in previous comments some people experienced bunching, I think I didn't experience this because I have a high waist. The fit was perfect for me except the arms. I paired with a gold feather choker and pearl earrings. I had a hard time finding shoes that would go with the blue or the lace because the colors are a little out of the normal navy and creme, but I love the colors still. I thought it might be fun to pair with pink heels and a pink skinny belt. I am just waiting for the next occasion.

I watched this dress for awhile because it was GORGEOUS but sold out, I guess someone returned theirs because a size 12 became available and I bought it without even being sure it'd fit. Well it did and it was perfect for the occasion I needed it for :D high quality, very comfortable, and provides stretch.

review_summary: This dress is nicer in pe
review_text: This dress is nicer in person! The lace on the sides is thick and it looks almost like it's crochet. It is definitely good quality and not delicate at all! The navy colour is exactly like the pictures but the lace is a bit darker and almost gold in person. I agree with the previous comments that if your waist is proportionately smaller than your hips and chest it might fit a little loose but for me the rest of the dress isn't too clingy either. The length is perfect for me, classy but still a bit sexy. Overall this dress is wonderful!
beautiful! and I feel beautiful in it!

review_summary: This is ac great sheath d
review_text: This is ac great sheath dress. It's rich and heavy, a beautiful dark blue with substantial lace work. It's great for those days when you need to turn up the volume a little. I'm pretty curvy but I think this would look great on someone who was more slim, it really is the tops

This dress is beautiful! First of all the fabric is a very high quality, and provides just enough stretch to be comfortable without having to worry about sagging. Secondly, the length is longer than a casual dress so it is perfect for colder climates when you want to wear a dress but the thought of going outside in 20 weather is deterrent. As someone who is gifted in the chest area I am always worried about how dresses will fit up top. This dress gave me nothing to worry about! Depending on the bra I wear I can show a little cleavage or keep it modest. My only complaint about this dress is that it kept riding up and I had to pull it down every now and then. But over all probably the best Modcloth purchase I have made!
Fits beautifully!!! Love it!!

I really love this dress! The quality of it is very good in my opinion, I was a little worried about that but I was all smiles when I got it. I do wish that the lace carried on through the back, but I'm sure that would effect  the price. It's a great fit and even though the fabric is stretchy it doesn't stretch the lace. Great buy!

review_summary: Fell in love with this dr
review_text: Fell in love with this dress when I saw it on the site and snapped it up when there was only one left in my size. It arrived today and unfortunately it's going back. Like other reviews have said, it doesn't cinch in at the waist enough and makes me look boxier than I am. I wouldn't be able to size down since the hips and bust are already being stretched. The fabric is a nice thick material with a good amount of stretch to it. The shape of the actual dress is just not quite right for me.

This dress is beautiful! Initial impressions: The material is a sturdy, yet stretchy fabric originally I thought it wouldn't quite fit being in UK size but the stretch saved the dress for me. The lace is actually more of a light metallic gold color (not white or offwhite as I thought) and the lace itself is heavier/more coarse not dainty and whispy. While not what I expected, I still really like it and will be wearing it a lot in the future. Thank you modcloth!

This dress is gorgeous! It's much higher quality than I expected; the fabric is thick and soft, and the lace is also quite substantial. I haven't worn it out yet, but its first stop is the symphony later this week, and I'm excited to wear it with a pair of gorgeous peach/salmon pumps! The lace's shaping is curveaccentuating and really flattering. In terms of fit, it's a teensy bit loose through the waist; it doesn't hang poorly, but it could be a bit more body hugging. I tend to fall between a US 6 and 8 right now though, so it makes sense for this size. A size smaller wasn't available when I ordered, and I don't think I'd switch it, but if you're between sizes, this one runs pretty truetosize, so size up or down according to your fit preferences. The fabric is thick enough and has enough stretch that sizing down could work if you wanted a curvehugging fit, without showing panty lines, etc.One thing that you can see in the photos, but didn't totally register for me  the lace detailing doesn't extend around the sides, so it ends somewhat abruptly at the side seam. This doesn't bother me, but I was expecting it to wrap around a bit. It does wrap over the shoulders.

LOVE this dress. So glad I snagged it before it sold out. Fits beautifully, only negative thing I can say about it is that it is a *tad* loose around the back of the butt area, but that's probably because I have no butt. Lace is lovely, and the dress feels heavy and very structured. It goes just past the knee on me, but it looks classy and sophisticated at that length. This is probably a dress that would not look as good tight, so keep that in mind.

This dress is absolutely gorgeous but the fit is a little weird.  Fit tightly up top and on the hips but was loose around the waist and bunched a bit.  I don't think the fabric is the greatest quality.  Definitely is a unique and classy addition to any wardrobe if it fits you correctly.  I tried my best to get it to fit but I had to send it back.

review_summary: Not a good dress for my f
review_text: Not a good dress for my figure. Nice lace and look on the hanger, but the stiff, stretchy fabric grabs me in all the wrong places, and none of the right. That is, it emphasized my curves  all the bad ones, and none of the good! It cups just under my big thighs and is nastygirl on my bum (again, cupping under), but it doesn't go in where my waist does. It just kind of folds and bunches at the waist. I think this dress would be rocked by a gal without a super curvy figure. And the lace will probably give some nice curves if you need them. It's a lovely dress.

review_summary: The fit was off for me, sadly.
review_text: I just had my 1st baby so I know my body was changing. Ordered a 1X based on the sizing chart and thought for sure it would fit like a glove, but I was wrong. I day dreamt of this dress fitting perfectly but the armholes were big and so was the boob/chest area. I will say the fabric and construction is good quality as well, if only it fit better.

review_summary: Fabric is not as nice in person, fits weird
review_text: I bought a medium granted my measurements. The fabric doesn't stretch at all either. Anyway, as you can see on the model, the fabric is sewn strangely around the bust. There are these like angles that make your bust look boxy. There was also gaping fabric where my collarbones should be, so I'm not sure if the dress was too small for my bust, as I couldn't pull the dress down to address for the extra fabric up top. This dress is not for those with long torsos either. The waist hit right on my ribs, which was tight, bust was tight, but the skirt was an obscene amount of heavy fabric and made me look very heavy on the bottom. I really wanted to love this dress but I couldn't.

First off let me just say that Modcloth needs to put out more pink plus size dresses. This one in particular is gorgeous and fits so well. It's a little long and a little tight in the waist, but otherwise fits me perfectly. The color is vibrant yet subtle, the print is pretty, and the silky slip of the fabric is pleasant and cooling. That said, it's a good all seasons dress that will keep you warm in the winter with tights and a cardigan and cool in the summer. This is the most stunning dress I've ever worn and I feel so beautiful and feminine in it it's definitely worth the hefty price tag. If you're a Torrid 5 the 4X will fit. If you're a Torrid 6 it's worth it to try on, but it might be a bit snug.

review_summary: The cut of the dress, for
review_text: The cut of the dress, for me, was less empire waist (as it appears in the photo) and more to my natural waist, which I preferred. The satin is thick and heavy, whereas I thought the material would be more flowy. I prefer the heavier material, as it feels more high quality. The dress in the picture looks knee length, but it went a bit past my knee (5'2). I like this dress a lot!

Impressed with the quality of the material. A beautiful print and a gorgeous shade of pink. The V neck and A line style is very flattering on my fuller figure. My normal size of 2x is slightly large on me, but not enough to size down. I'm 5'7 and it falls just below my knees. I paired it with Adored Addiction Cardigan in Dusty Rose and it matches perfectly. Feel very feminine in this dress. Perfect for our upcoming Spring in New Zealand. Thanks Modcloth.

The dress is a beautiful color. The lining and pockets are great.  Contrary to other reviews, I thought the pads were placed perfectly. Sadly, the first one I received had a broken zipper, but I was able to get another in a hurry thanks to the Mod Cloth support team.  The second dress had a working zipper and was just what I was hoping for.

Like the previous reviewer said  great dress, fit is perfect in the waist etc but the cups in the chest area are a disaster. As someone with a larger bust it made me look ridiculous  taking to a seamstress in the hopes that she can remove them! Also be warned that these get much longer with the plus sizes  it hits sort of mid calf on me! There is a crinoline lining and pockets which are great touches so if not for the unfortunate padding it would be getting a higher rating!

Unfortunately I had to return this dress. The fit was great on me.  The dress was fully lined and has pockets which was very nice. However, the padded cups in the bust were way too ridiculously high  like just below the neckline  and they were sown in so you couldn't adjust them to where breasts are actually located on the human body.  It's a big disappointment because this dress was great otherwise.

This dress is wonderful. The color looks like it does in the picture. Length is perfect. Tight fitting, but still work appropriate (which I really like). Material feels a little bit different unlike my other dresses, but it doesn't bother me all too much.

review_summary: I am obsessed with this d
review_text: I am obsessed with this dress! The color is perfect! The fit is perfect! I wore it for my engagement pictures and am so in love with it!

review_summary: This dress makes me feel so good!
review_text: I just received my Modcloth package in the mail today, only 2 days after placing the order.  I'm a first time mom at 36 years old, and let me say that my clothes just aren't fitting like they used to.  I tried this dress on, and it made me feel wonderful!  The neckline is sexy, but not risque.  The material is a bit stretchy, but instead of clinging to my hips and butt, it just kind of flows down nicely.  The only unusual part is the fabric around the neckline.  I can't figure out if it wants to be a collar or if it's supposed to be a little bunched like that.  But that's really not a big deal because this dress makes me feel like I've still got it!  It's a keeper!

I'm giving this four stars, despite returning it.  I have the same dress in a navy floral pattern, which I love, but the solid maroon didn't work as well for me.  The dress is well made, confortable, nice fabric, and a good length (falls about an inch above my knees).  I ordered a size down (normally wear a large), and it fit very well.  I'm sending it back because it just looked kind of blah on me.  The neckline doesn't sit flat, and the color just looks a bit washed out and not quite as red as the photos show.  It's a great dress, and you shouldn't hesitate to get it, but it just wasn't the right dress for me.
Love it!! It's a perfect fit for in and out of work!!

review_summary: So cute and sexy! Nice he
review_text: So cute and sexy! Nice heavy fabric and so soft!!! Can't wait to wear it again!

review_summary: I adore this dress!! I we
review_text: I adore this dress!! I wear a size 24 in pants and I have an apron belly. Plus ladies with similar bodies, this dress in burgundy is the PERFECT fall dress. And it's modest enough to wear to work, but still a little sexy for like a date or something! This dress is seriously a fall must have

Ahhh this dress is the best! I literally have to go the gym today but have been delayed by not wanting to take off this dress! So beautiful, and yet, really cuddly and soft? The cut and color are very flattering, and it's perfect for everything from dinner at a restaurant to school. If there were more colors, I would get them. I took past reviewer's advice and sized down. It was a good choice; the small fits me perfectly, whereas a medium is often on the tight side.
Very soft and stretchy material. It fits really well, I wish it was shorter, but it comes above right below my knee. The neckline makes it really easy to breastfeed in as well.

Love love LOVE this dress. I can dress it up or down easily, fits perfect and drapes well in the skirt. Mustard colours look terrible on me, but if it comes along in another colour I'll definitely buy another one!

I bought this dress on sale and thought it looked magnificent on the models... not so much in person.  The clingy fabric did not hide any tummy bumps like I usually expect in a fit and flare dress.  The construction was just unimpressive as a whole.  And as another reviewer mentioned, the collar stands out in a strange and funny way instead of laying flat.  It was just very unflattering overall.
Great dress for my first day back in the classroom! The length was modest without being matronly and the fit hugs the body without being too provocative. Great work outfit!
This dress is absolutely perfect for fall office wear. Super flattering and machine washable!

Super comfortable and the maroon color is great for blondes. I bought a Size L and I usually wear 1012. Perfect dress, the only potential issue is the extra fabric around the vneck. It is a little bunchy, with a prominent indent, than the photos show. I personally don't mind it.

review_summary: I'm so happy with this dr
review_text: I'm so happy with this dress. The fit is absolutely perfect and I love the length on me, just above the knee. The front V is a little low for work (in a high school teacher) so I'll simply pin it there, but outside of work it's perfect. LOVE the burgundy color.

I can wear small or medium depending on the dress. This particular dress has a lot of give and stretch, so I could probably fit into a small. I ordered the M and there's room for a bigger chest, so if you're between sizes, base your decision on your bra size...smaller chest, size down. It's completely flattering, though and I'd love to own more in different patterns.

This dress is my allinone, it's very pretty, figure flattering, comfortable, and versatile.  The only thing that would make this dress perfect is another split on the other side.  This is one of my favorite dresses!!!

This dress went out of stock this summer so when it came back I was all over it. It fits nicely; i sized down based on the chart and would not have wanted it my standard size. The colors are lovely. Sadly what I can't abide is the fabric. It's a cheap feeling poly spandex, thin, and while it's soft to wear it lacks that little bit of substance that I wanted. I am obviously in the minority based on other reviews but it's going back  it doesn't have the feel of a $70 dress. I wanted to love it but I'm sorry I didn't.

Comfy, beautiful saturated colors, great length, work, nightout, with heels or boots... all around versatile and lovely dress.  I have the 1X.  I am busty so, will need to either pin or wear a tank underneath but that is with everything I own.  Highly recommend!

I bought this dress, and it's amazing. I wish it were available in more patternsI would buy them all. It's super soft and stretchy and comfortable but also amazingly flattering. PLEASE make it in more prints.

I absolutely adore this dress!!! I am wearing this to a fall wedding and the colors are so beautiful. It's a super comfortable fabric and drapes really nicely without looking cheap or baggy. I am 5'5 and it falls pretty close to my ankle but I don't mind the length. I would recommend this dress to anyone in a heart beat!

I absolutely adore this dress!!! It fits flawlessly! The material and fit is slimming and comfortable and I cannot get over the gorgeous pattern and color! I'm 5'7 and I love the length. It's modest, but not too long. I can't remember the last time I was this happy with a dress! The only thing that could possibly make this dress better is if you can bring more options in colors and patterns! If you're considering this dress, don't hesitate. Just buy it!
I absolutely love this dress. Light weight, perfect for work. Incredibly comfortable and flattering. I might never take it off.

I bought this for a late summer wedding and OMG I'm in love! It drapes beautifully and covers problem areas without being billowy or looking anywhere remotely like maternity wear (because sometimes dresses either require uncomfortable shape wear or look like a maternity tent, and this is neither haha!). Yes, looks great, flattering even on my notso0inshape body, won't need Spanx, and is SO comfortable! I could sleep in this and be in heaven! My young son will be at the wedding with us, so I was excited to find a dress this comfy that I can move easily in because I will likely be picking him up and didn?t want something stiff. I am also worried about low cut or wrap dresses because if you?re holding a child the fabric can get pulled and revealing. This has a beautiful neckline but doesn?t seem to put me in danger of flashing the wedding guests if I?m carrying my son around!I?m usually between a L and XL and tried this in both. The L fit great too and there honestly wasn?t much difference, but there seemed to be a little extra length to the torso and the overall dress in the XL. I?m 5?7? and that extra length made the waist fall at a very flattering spot whereas the L was a little higher (and started hinted at the dreaded maternity look). I just can?t recommend this dress enough!

The only thing that would make this dress more perfect would be if it had pockets. Super impressed otherwise. The top is flattering without being revealing at all (it def looks like it will when you pull it out of the bag). Fabric is this nice, slinky poly/elastic blend that doesn't seem to wrinkle and has a faint sheen to it. So pretty. Flattering length for taller gals (I'm 5'8 and it is an inch or two below my knees) but I think it might be awkward (OR amazing?) for someone shorter.

I love this dress! Bought it for a September wedding and have tried this cut of dress before but they're often really tight or too revealing up top. This one did not disappoint! Very comfortable fabric, cute slit on the left leg, and very flattering. Large chestfriendly!

I ordered the coral/pink version of this dress, and it is stunning! It just arrived yesterday. I am typically between a size M and L, but ordered the Medium as I prefer dresses too tight than too loose. Upon initially taking the dress out of the box, I had a few fleeting thoughts of Oh man, this looks small, maybe I should've sized up. HOWEVER, this dress fits like a dream! It is very flattering! And the colour is so vibrant and gorgeous. I encourage you to order it when it comes back in stock!

So I'm not usually a huge fan of knit.  It tends to make me feel too warm and it snags and fuzzes out with each consecutive wash.  I won't say that the latter two issues aren't a problem as I haven't washed it yet and it arrived with two snags in the skirt (see picture), but the only person who would notice them is me.  you really can't see them when you're looking straight at the dress and I'm standing, so it's fine.  It's not too warm because of how much open skin there is on the top part.  The ruffles are just as lively and cute in person as they are in the pictures.  Such a great design.  XS is sometimes a little bit of a risk for me but this fit great!
Nice thick knit fabric. Very pretty color. Flattering cut.

Another great Modcloth dress! It?s very comfortable and material feels high quality. I?m not perfectly proportioned and had to have the shoulder/bust area altered, but that?s normal for me when it comes to dresses. I love this dress!

I bought this dress thinking it would be a cute fit and flair dress. There is absolutely no indication in the pictures that the material is clingy nor formfitting, it looks like a breezy summer dress in the photos, but fits like a Spandex bandage dress. Anyone with a belly cannot wear this dress, I question how much shapewear the plus size model is wearing in the photo. This is probably one of the least flattering dresses I've ever tried on, which is a shame, because it looked so flattering in the photos. I don't even think it's a fit issue, I think that just this dress was executed in the wrong material, which was then cut far too close  to the stomach, the dress should move instead.

review_summary: Very cute but requires fashion tape
review_text: This dress is very cute and made of a lovely fabric that seems to be well stitched. I'm 5'3 and a small hits me well below the knee, while the square neckline is high enough to cover my 32D cleavage professionally, so it's a great work dress in a brilliant power color.BUT. It is cut super weirdly, as others have said in their reviews. If you lay the dress flat, the shoulder straps are set wider than the dress's waist. And this is a highwaisted dress, so the waist is actually hitting at lower ribcage area. Translation: If your shoulders aren't broader than your ribs, the straps are not going to stay on your shoulders. There's no good way to cinch them together without causing gaping in the back.For those who want the dress anyway, the best solution I found was to make sure the dress is pulled down as low as possible on my body to maximize tension in the straps, and then use fashion tape to secure the straps in place the way you would if you were wearing some a backless deepcleavage halter dress. It's far from ideal  I'd rather be able to wear it without tape  but I decided to keep the dress and make do rather than return it, because it's so hard to find cute red dresses for work.

This was my first purchase on Modcloth and I wasn't sure what to expect. I was a little disappointed as this dress is a beautiful colour and the fabric is of a passable quality but definitely not value for money. Additionally, the cut is very strange. I had to pay a tailor to shorten the shoulder straps so I could wear the dress, as the straps are so disproportionately long.

I would not recommend purchasing this dress. I am a size 14 with a  36D chest. I purchased the XL and it fit around my waist great and was a little snug around my chest. The sleeves are the biggest problem. They sat a little off the center of my shoulders and were very loose.  They kept fall off my shoulders and there didn't seem to be a way to keep them up. The colorful belt is also completely separate and there are no loops on the dress to keep it in place.

Unfortunately, this dress is way too big on top! I didn't buy the XS (usual size) based on my waist vs. the size chart, and I regret it  it's one of the few maxi dresses that is actually long enough, but I'm swimming in it. Size down! This will, sadly, be returned.

I wore this dress to the farmer's market last week, and so many people stopped me to compliment me! This dress is fully lined, sturdy material, and fits beautifully! It's also nice to have a dress that is actually floor length on me.

review_summary: So beautiful! I feel like a princess!
review_text: This dress is so beautiful! In person it is just as good as the pictures. It is very well made and has a lining. I bought a backless bra to go with it, but I could probably get away with no bra at all. The cut is so flattering and I feel like a princess in this dress. Note: it runs large. According to my measurements, I am an XL (41, 34, 41) but it was a little baggy in the bodice and the length was too long. I exchanged it for the L and it fits perfectly! I can't wait to wear this to my summer events :)

I just got this dress and wore it. The fit is amazing and the material is of a very nice quality, heavier than I expected but still great for summer. The dress is lined means I don't have to worry about being exposed or wearing a bra; as long as the string is pulled properly there will be no problems with side boobs either. Yellow is my favourite colour and it is incredible difficult to find a good quality dress and a decent shade of yellow. I will definitely be wearing it all summer long.

review_summary: Another maxi dress that is long enough!
review_text: It is so hard to find maxi dresses in xs that are long enough for me, but this one is perfect!The bright color and fun print are lovely and I love the feel of the fabric.  This is going to be a fun dress to wear!

This dress made my frame look bulky due to the style of the top and how it wrapped around, compared to the models, where the dress makes them look petite. It is a good quality dress, but because of the cut and my smaller bust, this dress unfortunately did not work out.

I got this to wear as a bridesmaid for a friend's wedding and the fit was all wrong. I normally wear a 1X but this was just all wrong. The bottom was huge and the top wouldn't close. It's got an awkward side zip and the straps weren't long enough so the waistline was partially on my bust line. So yea. If you have a bust, this dress won't work for you. It's also crazy staticky!
I bought this dress to go to a wedding. It is very comfortable and flattering. The bust is nice because it feels like there is some structure to it. I'm very happy with this purchase.
Bought this for an upcoming trip to NOLA & I love the fit and a feel!  I'm currently a 2x & the dress fits me perfectly  I still have some room in the boobs

It's a lovely lovely dress. The color is true to the photo and the fine rose gold threading is a nice touch. The length for my height hits me just above the ankles when barefoot. Unfortunately, the top runs very small. I'm built like a reverse triangle  wide above, narrow below  and there's no way I can zip this dress closed. I need about two more inches of cloth in order to do that. Sadly I sent this back. I've purchased several dresses from Modcloth  all from different brands within the company  and am true to the med size.
I mean, it has ladybugs on it! How could it get more perfect?? Super summertime dress! A little long, but I'm very short so that's just my life.

I received this dress in the mail this past Saturday and I couldn't wait to try it on. It's very soft and all cotton, even the slip! However, the fit is a little awkward. It gapes on the side breast areas. I am assuming that it is due to being folded in the package. I plan to iron or steam it in hope of the gaping going away. The length is nice and the skirt part of it sits okay. I had to tug at it a couple of times because it initially looked like it was just sitting at my stomach. With all of that being said, I am going to keep the dress and make it work. It is perfect and I plan to wear it on my weekend getaway to San Diego...

I bought it thinking I need to put color in my wardrobe. I usually play it safe with black. When i tried it on i fell in love with it. The direction the stripes makes me look thinner, it feels so soft and feminine. It was a simple way to dress up for date night and super comfortable.

review_summary: This dress has a couple o
review_text: This dress has a couple of odd things going for it. The armholes are big and the elastic waist band is oddly tight. Other than those issues it's an okay dress. The material is a little knit like and warm too, I prefer lightweight materials, but lovely dress otherwise!

review_summary: Pretty dress but a little off in some ways
review_text: I bought this not sure if I'd like it, but I was pleasantly surprised. The band is somewhat tight so I'm glad I went with a medium (I'm usually in between sm/med), but wow, the arm holes are huge. My bra peeks right through if I lift my arms up. The colors are a little off from the photo more orange/purple than the pink/yellow I saw on my monitor. But it does have pockets, the front isn't revealing at all and hem is nice and not too short at the top. Overall a nice dress but I'm glad I got it on sale because it's not worth the full price imo.

review_summary: pretty, nice stretch for a good fit
review_text: Dress is very pretty and fit well due to stretchy thicker fabric.   Shortest part of hem fits about an inch below my knee due to my short stature but still looked nice due to handkerchief style hem.  Dress bodice looks fine with a camisole under if modesty is a concern for you.  the colors are not quite the same to me as the picture, I thought the dress included pink/fushia  stripes and mustrad yellow stripes, but they were more purple and orange.  Still pretty though.  Very pleased with this comfy attractive dress.

review_summary: So soft & summery, with deep pockets
review_text: This dress is great, I'd buy it in all the stripey colors. I'll have to put a small stitch in the bosom, as I have quite a bit of that, but no big deal. The fabric is quite soft. I usually don't go for a handkerchief hem, but with the stripes it works great. Also, capped sleeves are usually a bit annoying, but the thinness of the jersey means these work great, no weird puffiness, they're quite flattering. Please make in more colors!

I purchased the xl, I am tall and wear a size 14 in pants. This dress is beautiful on. It flows and is comfortable. I agree with another reviewer that the colors are more vibrant than they show in the picture. It has pockets!! The only thing I dislike is that the sleeves are cap and rather large. They also show a bit of my bra, but these aren't deal breakers by any means. If you are on the fence, get it, you won't be disappointed!

review_summary: Adorable dress, colors a little different
review_text: I love this dress.  The fabric has a nice weight to it and the cut is perfect.  The vneck is just right and not too low.  The colors are a little darker than they were on my monitor  on my computer it looks like bubblegum pink and sky blue, but it's more like fuchsia and periwinkle.

This is now the most flattering dress I own (and I have A LOT of dresses). It has pockets, it falls nicely, the material has a nice weight for spring summer. Make this in other prints and I'll buy every single one.

review_summary: Love it. This is my new p
review_text: Love it. This is my new party dress. Just the right lengthnot too short and the feathery details add some edge and fun.

I sized up on this dress based on a previous review and I'm glad I did. It's a fantastic easy piece. It looks great on it's own and looks fantastic with fun tights. I get a ton of compliments whenever I wear it.

I should have gotten a large.  I sized up because most items I've gotten from Mod Cloth run small, but not this dress.  I'll put a belt on and it will work, but is baggy.  The quality is great and it's adorable, especially for the price.

This dress is not in any way Aline as the pictures would lead you to believe. It actually has more tailoring than it looks. And, said tailoring for the waist is not for petites. I'm 52 and the waist hits me in the hips. I ordered a L to accommodate my chest, but the rest of the dress doesn't accommodate my short frame. The fringe is adorable but just doesn't fit a short person AT ALL. The lining also adds quite a bit of bulk, so the dress doesn't skim over my body but rather clings.

review_summary: Perfect dress for work or dressier occasions
review_text: I bought this dress and Love it! I often have a hard time with dresses since I have a large chest and smallish waist (size 6). the L fit well and was fitted but not snug and the dress was not too loose through the hips and waist. The fabric and fit of the dress is nice and the fabric is nice enough to wear to more dressy occasions and still be good for work.
Fit great everywhere except the bust. Otherwise, nice fabric, good length, lovely pattern. Just too tight in the chest :(
Ordered my usual 1X but this fit really strangely. It was tight across my chest so the buttons looked under duress but then the bottom part was too loose and baggy

Overall a very well made, comfortable dress. The fabric is nice and thick and holds its shape well. I'm planning to wear it for a November wedding (in the south!) with a shrug for a little extra warmth. It runs true to size. I typically wear a large, size 1012, and the large fit comfortably. The straps are adjustable and the fabric has a little give to make the sizing more forgiving. You *might* be able to get away without a bra (my hope with every dress...) because the fabric is thick, but the straps don't offer much support, so if you're largerchested, plan on a strapless.

Love this dress it perfect for a causal day or you can easily dress it up or add a blazer so it could be worn at work. I love the pockets they don't add bulk like most dress pockets do. My only issue with this dress is zipping up the dress on my own. It's a tight zipper.

I bought this for a November wedding, and I'm really excited now! I have a hard time finding flattering formal dresses because I basically have no hips, so there's usually a spark of anxiety before events, but I digress. So the fabric is very nice and soft, but it looks and feels high quality. The dress does have a bit of stretch, but I found the XL was just a *touch* on the larger side for me in the waist  (I prefer some breathing room, so no complaints). My biggest issue was the length ? I'm 5'0, so this is always my issue with all clothing. It initially hit right below my knee, which is a little matronly looking on me because, y'all, my legs are like 2 feet long. But once I shortened the straps by quite a bit, it hit right at my knee and of course made the top a bit more modest, so it was perfect. Despite the minor fit issues, I'm giving it 5 stars because of how flattering it was! It just fell so perfectly and gave me a defined waist. It made the girls look pretty darn good. The skirt was poofy enough to hide my tummy and love handles, but not so poofy that I looked like a cotton ball. It's SO cute. I wish there were more colors available, I'd buy them in heartbeat.

I bought this dress for an upcoming wedding I'm going to. I went with the medium even though my measurements are closer to the large size, because the fabric is stretchy. However the top of the dress still ended up feeling too loose on me and just wasn't as flattering as I had hoped it would be. Unfortunately I had to return it.
Bought for a wedding. It's super flattering and very comfortable. The fabric stretches and can be dressed up or down.

This dress is flattering without being too modest and without being too revealing on me. I will definitely wear this to weddings and dates and fancy nights out, and I can always accessorize with a cardigan depending on an occasion. The extensive size chart in ordering this dress really helped me out, too. Though unlined, the fabric is not too thin to be sheer and the top has a tiny extra thickness so that I might be comfortable wearing it without a bra (the adjustable straps will help!) I bought this at the same time I got the Date Night Done Right Aline Dress in Brick, and they are both wonderful.
Great fabric and fit. I am buying this in navy as well as the coral I already have. Nice simple dress you can accessorize, dress up or down.
I wore this to a wedding this weekend with a little sticky bra under and it was a smash hit! Perfect length, straps don't slide, very fun.

This fits so perfectly. The fabric is light and just a little stretchy. Adjustable straps make it easy to fit no matter your height (the bane of short folks), very flattering bustline. Definitely more red than coral but a sort of 85% bright red. Getting the navy soon.

review_summary: girlfriend review: You look like you're on the Brady Bunch
review_text: I'm not usually one for wearing much color, but this dress really caught my eye. Now that I've worn it to work once, I can confidently say that it was a smart purchase. The material is sturdy, and the embroidery is even more intricate than it appears in the pictures. The patch pockets are a great place to store my phone and other hand without adding extra bulk to my hips like side seam pockets sometimes do. The collar is bigger than it appears in the pictures  definitely a statement collar  and my girlfriend told me I looked like I was on the Brady Bunch  but 'in a good way'. I rated the fit slightly large because I had some extra room through the chest. I wouldn't size down because I think a medium would be too tight on my hips, but this should work well for girls with more going on up top than my sort of A cup situation. I purchased this item as a ModCloth employee.
Returning for a size down. Very nice material with sturdy construction. Color and style is spot on for the trends!

I love this dress!! I'm 5'10 and usually wear a small. I have a very small too but an ample bottom so I was worried this dress would sit too tight on my hips but it's the perfect amount of loose. The material is quite thick and sturdy so I see this dress lasting me forever. It also hits me around 34 in above the knee.

I bought the forest green version of this dress and absolutely love it! It can be dressed up or down and is very comfortable either way. It comes with a built in half slip, but I still opt to wear my own half slip with it. I'm hoping they restock the black polka dot one because I would buy it up in a heartbeat.

I'm wearing this guy right now and I love it. It's such a comfortable dress and it's even pretty cool for the summer months. I can tell it'll be adorable with tights and a cardigan too, once it gets colder. I'm so glad I bought this dress!

I usually wear xs, sized up to a small which fit pretty well except it is slightly tight across the bust. Even being tight there, it is gapping around the arm, it seems too long in the shoulder, if that makes any sense. I am going to try to find a seamstress to take up the shoulder seam. The fabric is beautiful and the dress comes just to the bottom of my knee. I will probably leave a couple buttons open and put a cami under it.

review_summary: Loose in the bust, snug at the waist, nice color
review_text: For reference, my bust is 31.75 inches, my waist is 26.5 inches, and my hips are 36 inches. I ordered the S. The waist is snug (just right for me), while the bust is a bit too loose. If you buy this dress, plan to spend some time ironing. The dress has a lining and is opaque  a nice but increasingly uncommon quality in clothes! The fabric does not stretch. Overall, the dress is cute and I'm pretty happy with it.

review_summary: Larger in the bust than needed
review_text: I have another Broadcast Coordinator dress in 2x and it fits great. This one is sleeveless, and it made the arm holes gape open, so I would need to tailor the bust in order to not show my bra. I wear mostly 2x but occasionally I order 3x. With this sleeveless dress, the 2x was very tight on my waist (waist is about 41). It fit, but it was tight and snug. I could size up, due to the waist, but then the bust and arm holes would be huge. The length is also short, above my knees and I'm 5'5. I got this on sale, but I may end up returning it.

I got this dress during a sale and am extremely happy with it  feel like it will be a favorite in my closet! Possibly the most quality garment of the Modcloth label I've ever gotten actually  it's like it was tailored, high quality fabric not flimsy or too stiff and seems like it will wash well, I was worried about buttongaping but had I gotten size L it might have been closer to the snug but not tight fit which I personally prefer, but there is wiggle room in case the cotton/linen ever decides to shrink  anyway, great dress  if I was braver I'd get the horse print too, but for now I just hope they can make some additional classic options like the blue plaid :)

review_summary: I love this dress, but I
review_text: I love this dress, but I had to return it and size it up. Modcloth brand clothes seem to be rather tight around the ribcage.

review_summary: Nice dress but small to start with and shrinks with washing
review_text: I bought this in medium even though I normally wear small or extra small. It was a reasonable fit on arrival but as soon as I washed it (in cold water) it shrunk significantly. Of course the lining didn't shrink, so now I have about 12 cm hanging down below the dress and will have to hand sew it into position so that it can't be seen. It's also significantly shorter than it appears in the photos. I still like it but I recommend buying 23 sizes larger than you normally wear.

This dress is perfect for wearing as a middle school teacher  no bra straps showing, no cleavage, good length, and super cute. It has POCKETS! And it's LINED for maximum protection from seethrough. If you want to make it sexier, you can by unbuttons buttons. The only warning I have is that the fabric has NO give, especially in the waist. I normally buy a medium but decided to size up because I've been burned before and it was definitely the right choice. I am so happy with this purchase.

I loved this dress...but it did not love me back. I must be between sizes in this brand. Medium too large in bust and waist, but Small would be too small. I would have had it altered, it was so beautifully made; however, the colors did not jive with my skin tone at all. It washed me out and I looked ill. Had to return. These colors would look great with cool skin tones.

I looooove this dress. I would definitely go by the measurements and not the actual size! I am usually an Xl and ordered to 3L because of the measurements and it fits perfectly! Can't wait to wear it to a Californian wedding!

I was so sad when I got this and didn't like it on me. I sized up, fearing it would be too small in my regular size (I got an XL instead of a L, I'm usually a 12). I felt it made me look much bigger and wasn't flattering. The dress itself is gorgeous. Sad I had to return it.

This is a lovely dress, but fair warning  it may run a little small even by this brand's standards. I own the same dress in a different pattern, in an extra small, and it fits perfect. This one, also extra small, is a bit snug. So you may want to at least consider sizing up (but I'm still happy enough even with my snug extra small).
This dress is amazing and I need to find it in more patterns. The slip lining the dress is great quality and fits very nicely. I'm on the shorter side so it comes just past my knee.

I bought this for a costume; I'm in the ensemble in a musical set in the 1950s and figured it fit the bill. (It can look modern, too... it's not TOO vintage in styling.) I had to order a second because, as others have mentioned, my usual size was too small. In fact I ended up with a dress 12 (1.5?) sizes larger than my typical. There's a lot of structure and no give to this dress, so be prepared. Even in this larger size, I can barely raise my arms for dancing scenes. With all that said, it's a cute day dress in a unique print.

I bought this dress to wear to church or special occasions. It fits very well and I found it to be true to size. It accentuates the waist and bust. The fabric is beautifully soft and the color and print are lovely. My only issue is that it's probably too dressy even for church. It will take a very special occasion indeed for me to feel comfortable wearing it.

This dress is beautiful and the quality is great, but I wish I had ordered it in a larger size. I ordered a 2X (dress size 20), but there is no give in the boob area. It's a bit snug, but not too terrible.

I ordered this for my son's wedding, and it was perfect, except it did not fit.  The fabric does not stretch at all, so be sure to order a size up if you are not sure.  I am ordering again, because it is such a pretty color and style.

review_summary: I ordered a small which i
review_text: I ordered a small which is normally fine for me from ModCloth.. but I kind of felt like I was swimming in this. I was unsure about the neck line but I think I would have been ok with that part If the dress was hemmed and brought in a size... sadly must return :(

I bought this for an upcoming cocktail party in my usual size XL. I am pearshaped and the top was roomy, but didn't look baggy. The tie at the waist sits exactly at my natural waist and fits well. Plenty of room in the hips. I was worried about the length being too short, but on my 5'5 frame it was not so short as to be immodest. Looks absolutely adorable with a pair of heels on.

I love the shape and pattern of this dress, it is so flattering. Yes, the top is a bit tight, not so much the bust but when you move your shoulders forward, it feels restricted. I am between a S and M, the M fits well.  The main issue is the material is thin, the stitching is very poor, there are threads sticking out and overlapping sloppy stitches on top of each other. I know I will need a slip, if the light hits this the wrong way you can see through it. However, I love the pattern and the old school style of this so much, I will just wear a slip. I do feel that there has been an influx of dresses on Modcloth with thin fabric and no linings which isn't great. Also, this dress doesn't have a hook and eye closure which makes it impossible to zip it all the way closed when wearing it. Modcloth should keep this in mind, it weakens the brand. The quality of the clothing that Modcloth actually makes is very good though, they should be more picky on what they purchase from other manufacturers.

review_summary: So it does run small, esp
review_text: So it does run small, especially in the chest (I'm a 36b and the large squashed mine done like no other dress has before.) and it is shorter than I prefer (about mid thigh, but flowy so a breeze would easily show off everything south of the waist)

It's a lovely and well made dress, however, it runs small in the bust. I think this is a brand issue; every Collectif dress or shirt I have runs small in the bust. As is, I can't zip it up all the way, so I won't be able to wear it. Probably won't bother with returning it, since I'm in Canada and the return shipping would cost nearly as much as the dress did (since I got the dress on sale).

Awkwardly large to the point where its unflattering, which is unfortunate. The tag says UK 8 for an XS, which is a 4, according to Collectif?s own chart. But I?m keeping it solely for the belt.  I?m gonna have to get it altered. Aside from the fit issues, it?s a great dress. It?s cute and I?m glad it has pockets. It?s a true swing dress which is great because I bought it to go swing dancing. The skirt is wonderfully twirly and I?ll admit it?s gonna be fun to dance in. Feels like good quality as well, not too light and not too heavy.

U.K. Sizing*** I'm currently a 1416 in U.S. Womens and I ordered the XXL which is a U.K. (18). The dress has pockets. The straps to the dress are adjustable like a bra strap. The dress is mostly cotton so I'm worried about shrinkage when I wash it for the first time. It needed to be steamed or ironed out of the box. The skirt is nice and full. It is an adorable dress that you could dress up or down really easily. I gave the dress 4 stars rather than 5 because the belt is a little small. I could only fit it in the last hole.

For a medium, this dress is a little on the large side. I'm 56, 135, 32F and it's a bit long and baggy. BUT it is absolutely STUNNING! Add a sweater and you can wear it year round. After I wash it, it will be perfect. And the pockets  are fabulous!!!

I completely disagree with the reviewer who thought the fabric on this dress was cheap, although the difference may be that I ordered the black version. The fabric on my dress is thick and has a nice drape, and I personally love the full skirt (note: for those of you who are squeamish about appearing curvy, full skirts do enhance hips). The waist sits are my natural waist and the skirt hits just below my knees. The pockets are a practical touch, while the belt is nice looking and average quality, although the material on the back is already showing creases where it was folded for shipping. As for packaging, the box arrived somewhat beat up and the dress was horribly wrinkled and smelled like chemicals. A quick run through the washing machine seems to have gotten rid of both wrinkles and smell, however, and there is no sign whatsoever of fading or pilling. I do find that the top is quite large, which can be attended to somewhat by cinching the straps as tight as they will go. However, for anything less than a C cup, you would probably need to have the top taken in a bit. For me, the straps are my least favourite part of the dress (and why I' giving it only 4 stars) and I may look into replacing them entirely with something thicker and more mature. I will also need to wear a camisole underneath for work, but paired with any number of the Cream of the Crop cardigans that Modcloth sells, this dress is a great addition to the work wardrobe. Or, you could throw on some heals and wear it for an evening out. I personally would not wear it as a sun dress, as the heavy black skirt would make it too hot, but I love that you can match it with literally any colour of accessories and basically have a whole new look. At the sale price, this was an excellent buy.

review_summary: Much better quality than expected, but also larger
review_text: Ordered a small and it was a size 10 (UK)  bit bigger than I expected. I'd really fit better into an XS, so keep that in mind when you order.I was pleasantly surprised as the quality of this dress. The material is thicker than I expected (while still perfect for the summer) and the pockets (there are pockets!) are doublestiched, which is very nice. I wish there was some boning in the top and I will need to shorten the (adjustable) straps... but that is more to do with me accidentally getting it bigger than I expected than with the dress itself.Overall, I love it and I'm pleasantly surprised. Haven't washed it yet but assume it will not fall apart!

review_summary: I got the black dress in
review_text: I got the black dress in size large. The top of this dress is super cute, but a little roomy on me (and I am 36D bra size.)The bottom of the dress is super thick, heavy, and allaround bulky. It makes me look like a linebacker going to a funeral. If you have hips at all, the skirt of this dress will bulk you out, big time. The belt is nice and helps to make the whole ensemble fit better, not hang off me. But ultimately this is a big no, sending back. :(

review_summary: cute dress, good quality, weird sizing
review_text: Good quality dress, very cute, but the size small runs very large. I'm a true small in tops, and the front of this dress was gaping about four inches out from my chest. I usually have to shorten adjustable straps, but I had to shorten these almost all the way, and doing so made the knots lay behind my shoulders instead of on top. The tag said 10 (S), which is a UK medium according to Modcloth's size chart. Positives: it's a nice heavy cotton material, and the skirt has tons of volume, which adds a great retro vibe. The belt cinched in the baggy waist and made the dress look more structured. Hopefully the XS will fit better, because it's a really cute dress!

review_summary: THIS DRESS COULDN'T GET ANY BETTER!
review_text: Get this dress. You won't regret it. It is adorable, well made, lined, fits perfectly and true to size, you can wear it with so many different accessories....I can't say enough about this dress! Every day that I wear it, I get atleast 5 compliments. The pattern is so cute! And it looks adorable on  super flattering. I have pretty big boobs and big hips, but this dress makes me look like I just list 10 lbs  a miracle!
Beautiful pattern!  I returned the medium for the small, and that one fit perfectly.  I love the pockets.

I bought this item about 2 weeks ago. I tried it on at the ModCloth store in Austin, and I absolutely adore it! It is a pretty and colorful dress that is great for summer and can be pulled off for other seasons. It's  great for casual and also more slightly formal situations. I  really like the belt and the fact that the dress looks great without it. It is very form fitting and has a slip underneath. Overall, I really enjoy this purchase! The only slight issue I have is it being a little small on my chest, but that's because I'm heavier on top and smaller on the bottom.

review_summary: Beautiful dress, looks good on tall figures!
review_text: This dress is absolutely beautiful in person, and looks great on me. It's a little snug in the waist, so I haven't decided if I'll end up keeping it or not, but I really really want to. I have a small chest and usually these vnecks cave in a little bit, but this one worked great. Good length if you're tall, too, and don't want to wear something that's too short on you. Also, I had an issue with another dress with the waist hitting me wrong, but as a person with a long torso, this dress worked great. Would definitely recommendthe pictures are accurate in terms of fit and color.(I don't know what my waist size is, but I usually wear a 46.)
Cute casual dress, material was a little thinner than I expected but not so much that I would return (though may not be office appropriate)

The mint color of this dress is great and the fabric a nice thick weight with stretch. I didn't find the v neck to be too revealing like some of the reviewers. Unfortunately this dress highlighted my two least favorite features  arms and hips. I didn't like the cap sleeves and the skirt was very full and made my hips seem larger than they already are.

review_summary: Beautiful Dress  lives up to its name!
review_text: The first time I wore this dress, I got chased down in the grocery store by 3 people that complimented me on it. It looks SO flattering on, and the mint color is spectacular. It fits amazing and makes you feel great. This dress is made with a slightly heavy weight fabric, I wouldn't necessarily say it is a winter weight dress  I have been wearing it on 6570 degree days and don't feed uncomfortable by any means. It washes and wears well  hardly any wrinkles form throughout the day!As a vertically challenged individual, I had to get this dress hemmed  as it came, it hit me midcalf which looked awful. At just below the knee, it is perfect. The V neck is rather deep, you'll definitely have some cleavage. I've work this to work with a cami underneath, and out with girlfriends in Napa without  and got a few free glasses of wine. Overall, a great dress. Totally worth every penny, this will be my new date night staple.

This print is great, very cute! Another review said the bust was too large and they were right, the dress gaps at the arm holes and the waist is tight at the same time, I am 3x and C cup size and there still is a large gap at the arm holes.  I am going to keep it and wear a sweater with it to cover the arm hole problem.

I love the print on this dress (horses)!  It is totally fun to wear.  And its a great classic style.  As other reviewers have pointed out, it has NO give whatsoever.  I had to go up one size (from 1X to 2X), and ir fits perfectly now.  Alas, I've read it shrinks when washed, even in cold water.  I'm not entirely sure if it just gets shorter, or if it shrinks overall.  NOT HAPPY about that.  I hope it will still be wearable.  Fingers crossed because I love it!

When this arrived, I thought I had found my new favorite dress. The print is fun, the buttons are closely spaced (no gaps!), it was nice cool cotton, and it hit right under my knee. Based on other reviews, I sized up and it fit well. Then I washed it according to the tag. It shrunk a good 3 inches! It now hits above my knee. I'm so disappointed.

review_summary: Lovely flattering dress but just too short.
review_text: This is such a lovely dress. The colour is great (more of a dark rust red than it looks in the photos), the fabric drapes nicely, the cut is flattering on a curvy frame, but it is just too short! On me (I'm 5'9) it looks like a beautiful dress that someone cut the bottom 4 or 5 inches off and the proportions just look wierd, with it hitting about mid thigh. So sad to be returning this but its just waaay too much thigh for me!

review_summary: Sizing too big, and unsightly darts on the chest area
review_text: Really wanted to love this dress, it's got pockets and the color is vibrant and beautiful, but the sizing ran big on me. I followed the size chart and ordered an XS yet it was still loose on the body. I have the same experience as another reviewer, with the strange darts on the chest area that makes it look like my boobs were pointing out. The fabric also wrinkles.

I really wanted to love this dress. It's so rare to find a nice dress with pockets! I was so excited when I tried it on  the fabric felt so nice on my skin and I loved the color. The length was right. The fit was nice. But the darts did a bizarre puckering thing at the chest and I'm not sure it's fixable. I was really hoping to wear this to a wedding next weekend. I can't tell if it's a flaw in the dress or just the way my chest is shaped that's making it do this.

Took a risk based on the reviews, but overall I'm glad I got this dress. I will need to have the straps taken up because, as others mentioned, it is very low cut. It is comfortable, especially with the stretch in the back. Length is good; I'm wearing it for a winter event, so I prefer tea length. Another note, thanks to the tulle, I'll need to douse the dress in static guard.

review_summary: This dress is true to siz
review_text: This dress is true to size, however, I am a c cup in the bust and found the stretch in this area a bit much and because it is stretchy it would make altering the bust difficult. If you normally order a size L dress I would recommend ordering a size down if you prefer a tighter bust area. I love that I can wear a bra and it is hidden (which is why I won't return for a smaller size as I will still feel secure)

I love this dress but I returned it. It fit well, and the length was okay (I wish they had a version of it that just covered the knees, this is almost tealength). I appreciated the elasticity in the back. It's comfortable. It does reveal a lot of cleavage, so be aware!  Ultimately it felt way too formal for a wedding guest dress, which is why I returned it. It feels much more like a bridesmaid's dress. Beautiful, but not what I'm looking for.

review_summary: Bulky dress, was not flattering at all
review_text: I was surprised when the large I tried was so huge on me, but even more surprised when the medium was too big, as well! This dress felt very thick and bulky, and hung open at the chest. Might be good for larger ladies with bigger chests who want something structured, but didn't do anything for my figure at all and felt like it'd be too hot for a sleeveless dress.

review_summary: Beautiful dress, but too much tulle
