review_text: This is an absolutely beautiful dress. The quality is fantastic. Unfortunately, the cut didn't work for me, and there is quite a bit of tulle. This is a perfect dress for someone looking for a prom dress or special occasion, but may be a little too much flare for a guest of a wedding (in my opinion). There was a lot more tulle than I expected that makes it difficult to wear for semiformal occasions.

review_summary: I am super pleased with e
review_text: I am super pleased with everything about this dress except the length. I assumed it would hit midthigh, but I guess the model is a little tall and I'm pretty short, since it hits at about the knee. The good news is that means the dress could be worn up or down. The Medium is a little loose, and I like that. I could have gone Small, but the arm holes on the medium are pretty small, so I'm glad I went with this. Super high quality, I would just keep length in mind.
This dress is adorable!  Fit is great, and quality is very  nice as well.  I feel like I could dress it up or down.  I am so happy with this purchase!  My favorite dress that I can't wait to wear.

This dress was my first Modcloth purchase and I am so delighted! This dress fits so well! I have very large hips and this dress just works so well with my body shape.  I love that I can cinch the waist in for the perfect fit.  It is a very thin jersey but the cut of this dress is just so lovely that I don't even mind that.  I do wish it was just a tad bit longer but all in all I love it.

I am a frequent purchaser of Modcloth dresses and skirts, and this one delivers!  It is a bit on the larger side, but I think that helps the shape of the dress.  I am a pear shape, but I have somewhat of a chest, and I found that the waist ties gave me the perfect amount of freedom to highlight my waist while still achieving the loose fit.  The material is on the thinner side, so I would recommend ordering your normal size, even though it runs large, because you can either wear a slip under it or rely on the looseness to keep it from being too clingy.

review_summary: VERY low cut but lovely dress!
review_text: This dress is an amazing soft material and clearly very well made. It's perhaps a little loose but the ties at the waist take care of that. Just one problem for methe neckline is crazy low. I tried altering it and nothing I did seemed to help, and it looks odd with a camisole underneath, so I actually just ended up wearing the dress backwards.
Really great classic black dress. Can be dressed up with fun shoes and jewelry. Ordered based on size chart and it's a perfect fit.

Such a gorgeous dress! The fabric is a lovely cream colour and the wrap fits very nicely across the body. I'm still trying to figure out how to wear it without exposing myself to the world totally. Like all wrap dresses, you run the risk of doing so. But I know there's a magical way that I haven't yet found to keep myself all tucked it (I'm going to continue to play around with it and see).  The Large is a true large, I'd say. I'm between ML and the large fits well, though a tad big in the chest for me. I may get it tailored just a tad so it's not too low for work as an elementary school counsellor. All in all, though, I love this dress and it's worth the minor investigating/tweaking.

review_summary: I feel like I've been wai
review_text: I feel like I've been waiting for this dress my whole life. It is so classic, the stripes and shawl collar give it 1940s style while the thin flowy material makes it modern and sleek. I am tall and very slim and this dress lays beautifully. The background is not bright white, it's cream, which makes it work in all seasons. I plan on owning this one forever!

review_summary: The strap fell off right on the first wear
review_text: I'm really disappointed with this dress. It fell of right on the first wear. And the color doesn't look like the picture.

This dress is gorgeous. I bought it for my honeymoon and to wear for my rehearsal dinner for my wedding. It fits like a glove. I also have a large bust (34DDD) and it fits the girls beautifully! The support is so good that I actually don't even have to wear a bra, surprisingly! The length is not too short or long. It's very nice that the straps are adjustable, as well. I could not be happier with this purchase!
All time favorite ModCloth dress!!! It fits perfectly!!!

I really wanted to love this one. The color is gorgeous! I'm usually a medium but this one was huge in the top area. Waist fit perfectly but somehow the back was gaping on me. I'll have to get this one taken in
The fit is great and so comfortable! I can't get enough of this dress! And oh, the pockets! It's so nice when dresses have pockets.

review_summary: Love it  but WHY do they never list the nonsize Small model
review_text: Modcloth  PLEASE  it would be so helpful if you listed the size and measurements of the non size small models!  We know every model is wearing a size small.  The other models look BEAUTIFUL in the dresses  especially this one!  It would not only help others gage their actual size, but show how wonderful girls look even if they are not wearing a small!  I wear a large in most dresses and this one is a bit tighter in the waist with little give.  Beautiful, not too short on me and I am 5'7.  I just wish they would show the measurements for both gals.  Also you used to include whether or not the fabric provided stretch please bring that back!
This dress is so freaking cute!! It fits very comfortably, though it is the tiniest bit tight in the waist by the end of the day with a belly full of burrito bowl.

review_summary: This dress fit like a glo
review_text: This dress fit like a glove! I wore this to a wedding and it was so comfortable and nice and flowy. I'd buy this in other colors. I usually go with a large but I'm glad I purchased this in a medium.

Great fit, great length. I bought a medium in black. The fabric is a night weight and has a stretch so that it fits well at the top and drapes nicely through the skirt. Now to find a cute belt to pair with it!

review_summary: Well made, too long for me.
review_text: This is a wellmade dress. It fit really beautifully through the torso. However, it was simply too long for my 5' 1 height  it made me look dowdy. Would look fabulous on someone taller. I normally wear a size 02 / XS in hightstreet fashion, and I'm finding that size S in Modcloth is almost always the right size in dresses and skirts.

review_summary: Poor Fit if you have a Bust!
review_text: I bought this dress because I liked the length, and I was hoping that since it has some stretch to it, it would fit well. It fit fine everywhere except the chest/shoulder area. It was hard to even breathe after putting it on, and it totally flattened my boobs! I am a 34D and I bought a medium, which usually fits fine, but this was like wearing a (not flattering) corset. Its too bad, because the dress is very professional looking and the fabric is pretty nice!
It fits perfect it looks great, I love the way it fits perfect.  It is the perfect length very appropriate for work
I love the dress. I'm not super busty so the chest and arms felt just right.

I bought this dress and I love the print. The issue I have with it is that is is made for someone with a longer torso.  Having a short torso the dress looks frumpy on me and I need a belt to cinch it in at the waist. I will keep the dress, but will have to find a belt to make it look nice on me.

I adore this dress! I wore it to work with nude heels and it was perfect. It was long enough to be professional and the cute sleeves provided nice coverage so I didn't feel like I needed a cardigan. It is lined and absolutely comfortable.

review_summary: Devastated the fit was terrible at the arms
review_text: This dress was soooo up my alley. Everything about it I just adored. However the sleeves had a weird cut to them that caused extra fabric to like puff out at my armpits and across the chest. I notice now how the models all have their arms down in the photos because I'm sure that extra puffy fabric is tucked in under the armpits. I could have taken it to the seamstress but for $80 I didn't feel it was worth the risk and extra money. Absolutely devastated it's going back.

I took a chance with this dress because it was so cute/used a sale code  but as you may have noticed the details merely indicate imported and if you're like me  when there are no helpful reviews posted for a garment yet, I try to refer to fabric content and other information which I cannot tell by looking at the pictures in order to decide as best as I can if I want to order it or not...So here's an item description for you ladies out there considering this dress! (refer to the pictures I posted for a view of the lining inside, opened view of side zipper and brand label with fabric content label which I laid next to it,100% polyester  translate to sheer, light chiffonlike fabric, also there is a spare button in the baggie)I bought XL and it fits me perfectly (refer to my measurements, and note that my personal preference is not for tight  but rather  snug to roomy fit for dresses)The garment is fantastic quality all around (as is my past experience with Fervour brand)It is fully lined (nice gauge, not too thick or too thin and seems to be cotton) except for the little sleeves, it has a side zipper under the arm of the sleeve but the buttons are functional too, there are no pockets and no belt loops (which would both be fantastic if it did)I will also say fabric does not provide stretch as they used to say in the details (I miss that feature of Modcloth descriptions...) so when reaching forward, the short sleeves will tug back a bit...Do not miss out on this dress because of the limited info posted  I think you will find it is absolutely worth it if you are able to figure out and order the right size for your frame! :)

This was a risky choice for my body type  I am a very curvy pear shape and find most shirt dresses are too straight and don?t fit my hips, or if they do fit my hips they are so baggy around my waist and shoulders that they are very unflattering. That is not the case with this dress! It fits my top half perfectly, and has just enough room to fit my hips without the buttons pulling and gapping. The waist doesn?t quite cinch me in enough on it?s own, but the included belt solves that problem! The birds are definitely more of a neon orange than the picture portrays, but still super cute. I think this is going to be my new goto dress. Would love to see it offered in more colours and patterns!

I bought this dress recently and was very pleased. I agree with one of the previous reviewers, the birds on the dress are bright red and not as muted as the photo.  I thought they still looked great. The dress fit well, but was a bit bulging at the chest, so I will either have to pin it or wear a slip underneath. It isn't lined at all, either. I'm tall (5 foot 11), and it was a little short but not too bad at all!

I bought this dress for work as well as going out after work. This dress fits great, I found it to be very flattering. Professional yet cute to wear out. It's also a nice comfortable fit. Maybe slightly short by not horribly short.

The only thing this dress lacks are pockets. I love the lightweight feel and flow of the fabric.I have to add a couple safety pins in the wrap section at the bust but I have huge tatas  and I hate sizing up just for the bust, so that is expected for me. The vneck of this dress is perfect for work, and has a snap that if left undone would be GREAT for date night. The mini length hits right at the knees so perfect for work too!
I'm about 5'4, 155lbs, 36C, and the Medium fit like a dream. My new favorite dress.

review_summary: Great dress, just sized a lottle small
review_text: I love the dressgreat color and a nice light fabric. I am exchanging for a bigger Sze than what I usually wear from Modcloth. This dress ran small.

review_summary: Perfect for the office in sumertime!
review_text: This dress has a lovely light weight fabric that drapes nicely, and just enough sleeve length for more exacting office dress codes where sleeveless isn't ok. Professional but pretty.

review_summary: The dress fit nicely in m
review_text: The dress fit nicely in my waist and hips, but was huge on top and ended up looking pretty sloppy on me. I do have a short torso, but it wasn't just big in the torso, it was also way too big in the chest. It came right at my knee and has no stretch whatsoever. The print and dress itself is beautiful, it was just unfortunate for me that it is oddly proportioned for my body type.

review_summary: I lOVE this dress. I've n
review_text: I lOVE this dress. I've never shown my stomach in public. Ever. Until this dress. It made me feel confident and adorable and sexy. I wore it to a double feature movie premiere event, about 6hours long, and I was comfortable the whole time.

I have a very short torso, so I'm not sure whether this is sitting the way it's really supposed to or not, but I will say that while I usually complain about bumpy/sloppylooking zippers, this one hides pretty nicely due to the striping on the print of the fabric.  Will probably try to iron it out, though.

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress and wanted to love it so much  unfortunately, I just don't think it was made for me! (short and curvy.) The fabric and print were beautiful, but the billowy skirt swallowed me whole, and the top fit awkwardly over my large chest. I'll need to send it back, but think it could really work for someone with the right proportions!

Really sad because it was an adorable dress and fit well, but the zipper stuck (where the stitching changes a bit in the fabric) when I had it on and I had to cut myself out of it as it's impossible to take this dress on and off without the zipper being down. So now I have a ripped dress after only one wear :(

I bought this dress for my senior exhibition at art school where most of my projects included  magnets. I knew I had to buy this dress when I saw it. Not only is the print cute, but its also comfortable and structured. It's really flattering! Also IT HAS POCKETS! I'm only giving it 4 stars because I wasn't a huge fan of the middrift showing but I sewed mine shut and you can't even tell. I get so many compliments on this dress every time I wear it

review_summary: I love this dress! It reminds me of my heritage!
review_text: So, let me just say that I am a Ghanaianborn American and the first thing I noticed about this dress was the print. Very Ankara print and I love it! This will be my quintessential summer '17 dress. It's perfect for practically anythingconcerts, festivals, picnic. Oh, and there are pockets! I bought the dress in a Medium and it feels tailormade like West African clothes are.  Thanks Modcloth! :)

The sizing on this is definitely off. It says true to size. I originally ordered the medium which had a 16.5 bust lying flat. Returned and ordered the large which had an 18 bust (consistent with medium size chart). Otherwise, SO cute. Love the pockets and the print.

This dress is such excellent quality, the fit is terrific, I love the quarter length sleeves and soft flowing fabric, the fit is comfy but classy and the elephant print is fun but still dressy  an instant favorite in my closet!
I got this dress, specifically because I am a member of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. and we have a thing for Elephants!!! Many, many compliments!!!!

I was so excited about this darling dress. The fabric was nice, construction was solid, and it could not have been any cuter. It could, however, have been about 34 inches longer. I'm so sad to have to return this but there's no point in keeping a dress that I can't wear to work because it comes way too far above my knees. I'm 5'6, about 145150, and a full size larger on bottom than on top (wide hips). I ordered a M. It fit perfectly except for the length. The sleeves didn't reach my elbows like they did for the two models pictured.

I only like dresses that are beautiful but feel like pajamas. This is perfect.  The cotton is good quality and study.  I paid attention to other reviews and bought one size down (usually a medium, bought small) and it fits nicely.  It is a bit long  I'm 5'10 and it skims my feet, so it may not work for petite gals without some hemming.  Thanks to a new baby I'm also pretty busty, and this dress doesn't really provide enough coverage/modesty for me without a layered tank or tee.  Great purchase, I wish I liked the other print more because I'd love to have another one of these dresses.
This dress was so comfortable, feminine, and very flattering.  A bit long, but beautiful, and the colors are amazing.

review_summary: I love this dress SO MUCH
review_text: I love this dress SO MUCH! The fit is perfect and it's so soft. Even better, I got it on sale! Yay!
This dress is wonderful! The material feels highquality, the print is gorgeous, and the fit is excellent. The length is just right, too. I'll definitely be wearing this little gem often!
I love this dress! Perfect fit and great colors..... havent washed yet but seems to be good quality.

review_summary: Lovely dress, but runs very large
review_text: I just wore this dress for the first time last night, and I have to say that I can tell it's going to be part of my regular rotation. I did notice a couple of things that I wanted to point out. First, I generally fall between an XL and 1X, but this ran very large. I honestly think I should have ordered the L. I adjusted the straps to their tightest position and wore a belt and cardi with the dress, but it still felt too flowy and unstructured to be polished. I think the print is really pretty and the fabric is high quality, but the sizing is way off. I am 5' 8 and I am considering getting this hemmed and taken in at the waist, or just relegating this to my casual/cozy dress collection that I mostly wear at home or while camping.

The material of this maxi dress is high qualityit doesn't feel like a cheap dress, in the least....which is always a good thing, lol. The straps are adjustable, like a bathing suit top, or an inexpensive bra strapwhich is a VERY good thing, considering I am 5' flat without my heels on (as if I ever go out in public like that, thoughwhen you're a short gal, platforms are your besties), AND I have 34DD tatas. This dress is as comfortable as a nightgown, as pretty as your favorite Who'sWho Dance dress from high school, and as sexy as you wanna make it. If you want a flowy, sexy, well made maxi, get this bad boy.

I bought this for my wedding reception and loved it. It was a bit on the snug side for me it literally fit like a glove so not much give. It was perfect for a summer outdoor reception because it's light and airy. Love the cut outs at the bottom of the skirt and back. Can't wait to wear it again.

This dress is exactly as shown on the model, in terms of length and fit. The quality of the material is very nice. It may have to be ironed, but that's the only downside I can think of. I highly recommend it.

I got this dress in white/cherry, and it's adorable. Now, I wash everything, even if it says dryclean only, and normally there's no problem. With this dress, the colors bled a little. If you follow the instructions on the dress and dry clean, you won't have a problem. The dress is still wearable, just there's a faintly pink tinge around the cherries. That said, the fit is great, the pockets are wonderful, and it's a really flattering dress. I'm going to order it in black.

I bet when you saw the space cat dress you thought the same thing as me  IHAVETOHAVEHTATOMG. I eagerly awaited for my package to arrive, and I ripped this one open first and tried it on.First of all, the fabric is *very* cheap and scratchy. I accidentally purchased another Retroliscious dress (the amazing rainbow one  WHY do they have all of the cool patterns?!) and had the same problem with that one  it's like using an exfoliator every time you put this on. I also find that this brand runs a little snug  especially if you have big boobs. When I got this one on, it zipped up just fine but gave me the muchdreaded monoboob.

review_summary: I love this dress but it'
review_text: I love this dress but it's not perfect. I'm short, curvy (AU size 1620 depending on style, brand etc) and large breasted and chose the 1X. The 1X fits ok in the bust and waste  I might have to do some adjusting for it to fit just right. The torso portion of the dress is a little long for me and it falls just below the knees, but that's normal given my height/size. The material is a thick cotton akin to quilting fabric so agree with the other reviewer on that. For the price you'd probably expect a nice feeling and quality material. The cat pattern is AMAZING and vibrant.

review_summary: The fabric was a bit iffy
review_text: The fabric was a bit iffy but once I got over that then it was perfect. There is a lot of comfort in it and the design.

review_summary: I wanted it to fit perfec
review_text: I wanted it to fit perfect so badly. However, It fit a bit tight around the top and waist.

review_summary: Totally in love with this dress!
review_text: I've heard great things about Retrolicious from other reviewers so I was extremely excited about this dress. It did not disappoint! It fits me perfectly! Light cotton material, plus there is a little elastic in the back of the dress so it stretches a little. I received compliments on it all day long. This dress is so adorable!

What I love about this dress: the silhouette is extremely flattering. The lace neckline emphasizes curves without showing cleavage. The waistline is also fitted but the skirt is not, which means that the dress gives you a nice hourglass shape. Also, I'm 5'5'', and often have problems with dresses of this length running too long on me, but it hits right below the knee  a respectable length for a family wedding (which is where this will be worn). The fabric itself also feels like good quality. The price is right now that it's on sale. What I dislike about this dress: the reviews mentioning the sticky zipper are spot on. I'm shocked that this has been an issue since the dress was released and has never been resolved. According to the size chart, I am an inbetweenie, so I erred toward the larger size to accomodate potential zipper issues. I'm glad I did, because I can pull the dress on without undoing the zipper all the way. Sizing up might be a good idea for others concerned about the zipper.

I love this dress so much! The color is gorgeous and I love the flowers and tulle. It definitely runs a hair small  normally I'd get the 6, but the 8 fits snugly on me. So happy I purchased this dress!

Purchased as a bridesmaid dress. I got it in a 12 first because I have a ChiChi wiggle dress in that size, but with the freehipped skirt on this one, I needed a 10. High quality lining and construction. No stretch to it, as expected. I'm very leggy, and it hits me just below the knee. The skirt is definitely poofier and it's more formal looking than the picture.

I'm not a big person, but this dress made me look like I was pregnant. The waistline fell at a very strange place, and the skirt poofed out all around so that I was shapeless and awkward. The dress itself is great quality; if you're skinny like the model, this might be a great dress, but on a normal body, this just does not look good.

review_summary: The dress was well made a
review_text: The dress was well made and I loved the detail and color! I am short and so the bodice was tight in the waist. It also was not a flattering look on me. If I was taller than 5 feet and had a long waist it would be beautiful. At 125 pounds a size 6 was too tight.

review_summary: Love this dress but go a size or two up!
review_text: I love this dress soooo much. The flowers are sewn only partially, so the appliqu?s stand up in a 3D like texture. There's also sequins in the top, which make it sparkly. The tulle is fuller than the sample photo, and because I'm a busty girl, the top was a lot tighter on me than the model. The zipper was a bit of a pain, but that's to be expected with tulle and appliqu?. I'll be exchanging for two more sizes up for a better fit.
The dress was larger than I expected. The bottom part of the dress is too puffy. It makes me look shorter. I ended up return the dress.

This is a gorgeous dress. I am in love with the tulle and I really wanted to keep it. Unfortunately, the leaves on the top of the dress and my lack of bust made the dress appear awkward. This is a beautiful dress that I am sure many will love for fancy occasions. Keep in mind that there is a lot of tulle, which may not work for everyone (very high quality and soft!)Unlike other reviewers, this fit to size for me.

review_summary: Cute, but order a size up!
review_text: I ordered this earlier this month, as I was looking for a rehearsal/rehearsal dinner dress for my wedding next year, and the color and look are gorgeous!  I am currently a size 8 but am losing weight, so could be a size 6 with some clothing; but I went with the size 8 to play it safe.  Well, the size 8 was TIGHT on my stomach and hard to move my arms!So I returned the size 8 to exchange for a size 10, which came today.  It definitely fit much better.  While it was still a little tight around the arms, it's definitely manageable.  I may look to bringing to get altered if the arms become an issue.  While I'd probably only be wearing a few hours for the day before the big day, I would like to wear it more than once!

This dress is beautifully made. I sized up based on one of the reviews and was too big so I recommend staying with your regular size. Another point that isn't as obvious in the pictures is that it is very full, which is not a negative point by default but it wasn't exactly what I was looking for. I did end up returning the dress because I ordered too large of a size but I didn't exchange it for a smaller size because the skirt was too full for my taste.

Such a beautiful dress! It arrived today and I'm in love,  I put it on straight away and danced around the house pretending to be a princess in my castle.On a more serious note though; it's a beautiful, well made dress. It does run slightly larger,  but that turned out well for me since there's no way I would fit my big boobs into the dress if it was the smaller size (I have decently big boobs for my small frame). I was expecting it to be a bit shorter than the knee length it is, but that's probably again because I'm rather small. All in all its an absolutely gorgeous dress. 5 stars.

review_summary: I ordered this dress to w
review_text: I ordered this dress to wear to a wedding in September.  I love the colors and the poofy skirt.  I normally wear a 6 in dresses and 8 in pants, and based on the reviews saying it ran a little small I decided to order an 8 in this dress.  It is very snug, I probably even could have gone with a 10, but I'll be keeping this size.

I bought this dress for a wedding and it is so stunning!! Definitely puffy like the reviewer earlier mentioned, but it is a classy, timeless piece. Normally I wear size 8 in US,  but this dress cuts a litttlllee small, just a smiget!. The material is thick, so i wouldn't wear it in 90degree temperatures. However, the dress looks the same in person as it does online. Enjoy!

I bought this item last week and it is so pretty! I really like the fabric and the style, would buy this again! But make sure to look at the size chart!! Good for curvy girls!! I'm 5'4.5 and weigh 145 lbs. I usually wear a medium or a 6, and a size 10 fit well.

review_summary: The fabric is decadent and it's absolutely stunning!!
review_text: I ordered this a week ago and it arrived yesterday. I was so excited to try it on. For reference, I am 5'3, sturdy build, about 140 lbs. Everything else about the dress was stunning and I am SO SAD that I'll have to return it. I have a dinner coming up in a few days and was hoping I could wear it. My advice, if you are anything more than maybe a DD cup, don't take the risk.

The waist seam is also quite thick and bunchylooking and hangs too loosely around the waist(there's a reason the front view in the ad has the model with her arms covering her waist!).The flutter sleeves hit at an unflattering spot on my upper arms (and I usually find flutter sleeves very flattering). The dress arrived with a small stain on the skirt that I couldn't remove. It is also dryclean only (which is listed in the item description)and I only want to go to that hassle if I LOVE the dress. Not quite how something that looked so perfect in the picture ended up so dumpy inperson.

I am a topheavy, appleshaped woman with a very long torso. I hesitated for a long time before buying this dress (or any garment online) because I couldn't tell if it would be too short, or if the slight gathering at the waist would make me feel like a thirdtrimester pregnant woman (which gathered waists tend to do on me), or if it would look more like an empire waist on me, which makes me look even more like a pregnant woman (as I mentioned, my torso is long and my boobs are huge, so waistlines often sit way too high on me), or if the neckline would be too high (low necklines seem to balance out my topheavy proportions). I took a chance and got it. I love this dress. I almost ordered a 3X, but I'm glad I didn't. It fits with a good deal of ease everywhere, even the waist, where almost all dresses are too tight on me. Most surprisingly, the waist seam sits at my actual natural waist, not right under my boobs like I thought it would. The length is just long enough that I never feel uncomfortable, even when I sit down or even bend over. The armscyes are a little big, though not so much that it looks gross. The print is irresistible. Make sure you get a belt for it,  though (I wear it with a wide elastic belt. It's black, but I'd wear a red one if I could find it). It looks great with bright primarycolored accessories and a short cardigan. And IT HAS POCKETS. The price seems high for basic woven cotton, but I love cotton anyway. It doesn't wrinkle like I thought it would. A+
