I'm 5'1 and it's well above the knee almost thigh hitting so I suspect taller buyers will find this tunic length at best. it's an adorable print and I like that it is cotton. had I sized up it likely would have been too big in the waist. over all a 3/5 namely because of length and fit.

Exactly what I wanted. Adorable print. Light. Fun. Flattering. I am usually an inbetweener with sizes, but I am content with the medium. A big snug around the chest, but it actually creates some sort of cleavage for me, which is otherwise nonexistent. It zips up without much effort. Very satisfying first ever ModCloth dress purchase.

review_summary: I love this dress! This d
review_text: I love this dress! This dress (like many modcloth dresses) fits a little tight in the waist and bust. The shape is super flattering and the print is unspeakably cute.  I am very happy with the purchase.

review_summary: I love this dress!  It is
review_text: I love this dress!  It is really cute and everyone loves reading the cat articles on it!  I am a true cat lady so this dress was perfect for me and I had to have it when I saw it.  My only complaint is that I am small busted and the bust was too big and low cut for me.  I tailored it to make it fit better and now it is perfect.  I would definitely recommend this dress to any fellow cat ladies, meow!

review_summary: This dress is so cute I c
review_text: This dress is so cute I can overlook the fact that it smooshes my chest. I did however read that in other reviews and I bought it anyway. I wear a size 36 D, and though the dress fits great everywhere else, the bust is small. I would recommend wearing a petty coat underneath (I purchased a black one), because the skirt if the dress hangs much better with a petticoat. Super awesome dress, and the print is hilarious.

review_summary: I loved the print of this
review_text: I loved the print of this dress, but the size just didn't work out for me.  Too small in the chest and way too short for someone who is 5'10!  Wish it came in a longer length!
After reading the reviews, I decided to order size M, but fits too small for my busty chest. Exchanged for a L.

I loved this! Usually it will take me hours in a store to find a dress that fits because I have a large bust and a small waist. I don't ever order anything online since it doesn't fit either, but I had to when I saw this dress. I'm so happy to say that the fit is perfect! It's a little bit tight up top, but it's so cute, and I get compliments every time I wear it.

Fit just right around the waist, a little too tight in the chest to be entirely comfortable, but I can still get it done up.  I have a largish bust and tiny waist, so I run into this problem frequently. Quite short and flirty!

review_summary: I love this dress!!  It i
review_text: I love this dress!!  It is fun to wear and gets many compliments.  The lenght is work appropriate. There are so many different ways to wear it (with a cardigan, as a skirt, leggings). I pair it with my newsprint shoes from TUK.

review_summary: Despite the fact that I a
review_text: Despite the fact that I am a dog person (not a cat person), I do like the dress. It fits well, and definitely has a very interesting pattern on it. Make a dog print and I'll definitely snap it up as soon as it comes in!

review_summary: It's a dress with cats an
review_text: It's a dress with cats and newspapers. What more could you ask for? The cost of Folter/Retrolicious dresses is in the print/pattern, not the fabric, so keep in mind that it's just 100% cotton. But I love it anyways!

review_summary: Wore this baby to a geek
review_text: Wore this baby to a geek convention and got SO many compliments  it stood out even when so many attendees were in amazing cosplay outfits  so you know it's awesome. I wore it for 12+ hours that day and it was comfortable the whole time. My only complaint was that the top stretched out a tiny bit and I went from thinking that I could wear this without a bra, to wishing I had brought a bra. ;)

review_summary: I love this dress! I was
review_text: I love this dress! I was unsure when I first got it how the newspaper print would look, but it's perfect! You can actually read the articles! The only issue is that I'm smaller chested, so it was a little big around the bust, but even so it fit pretty well and I got a ridiculous amount of compliments when I wore it. I can't wait to wear it again!

Adorable dress. Comfortable fit. Material is a tiny bit more sheer than I'd thought, but really who cares about that when you have a dress that makes you smile all day long!  Definitely a keeper. My cats agree!

review_summary: In no world should I have
review_text: In no world should I have bought this dress. It is way too expensive. But I did. And I LOVE it.I wish there were an xs, as it's a bit big in the bodice. But then I am flatchested. I love that it has pockets, but the pockets are sort of strangely placed. They look like they're on the side but if you put something in one it feels like it's hitting the front of your thigh and coming forward. But still, pockets. :) The zip works fine, the print is TO DIE FOR. I'm a journalism major and a crazy cat lady so this was perfect. A real conversation starter, and so easy to pair since it goes with everything. The biggest problem, which isn't really a problem, is just that it's thin and unlined. Sorry you can't see it very well in the photo  it was a cold day. :P

I sized down after reading that this runs large, but in truth it runs only slightly large, if you are in size limbo some where between medium and large go ahead and size down, but if you are not in between sizes go with your normal size.Otherwise this dress is really cute and light, perfect and fun for the spring and summer.

I'm completely in love with this dress! The print, the fit, the shape  everything. It's so unique and hilarious. If you have a larger bust I definitely wouldn't size down, I was debating between the large and XL, and I ended up getting the XL and fits me purrfectly! (cheesy pun, I know, but the dress is covered in them so I thought it would be appropriate!) p.s. please excuse my appearance, I threw it on to take pictures as soon as I received it!

Argh!!!  I've been wanting this dress for forever so I finally broke down and bought it.  It totally did not fit me though.  I bought a medium and it was too baggy on the top and the waist feel to low.  I was afraid to try the small because I have a big bust and I usually don't fit in a small.  This dress was not made for someone with my body shape.  I regretfully had to send it back.  The print is super cute and if you are taller it would probably look really cute on you.

review_summary: I am in LOVE with this dr
review_text: I am in LOVE with this dress! I bought it because I'm a journalism student, and thought it would get a lot of nice compliments from people at school/ my internship. It fits perfectly, and the fabric doesn't feel cheap. Even the stories are couldn't be happier with it! Thanks ModCloth!

I was delighted when this dress came back into stock, and immediately purchased an XL on the first day of availability.  I'm busty (38DD) so I hoped this size would accommodate my chest and I could possibly take the rest in if necessary.  Turns out, it almost fit perfectly: kind of smashed my chest a little, but nipped nicely in the waist and was ultimately superflattering.  I'm a bartender @ a touristy restaurant and I received no fewer than 15 compliments from all age groups and genders the first time I wore it, ranging from teenage girls to older biker dudes.  Everyone seemed to appreciate a 'silliness' that looked great!  The dress isn't flimsy and I was pleased with the drape of the cotton fabric and the fact that the pockets didn't add bulk to the hips whatsoever. Completely in love with the dress.
Adorable dress for cat lovers. Unusual fabric design, news articles are even readable. Perfect fit. Great for casual, outdoor event.

I've been lusting over this dress for a year and it always out of stock when I go to buy it. Not this time!!This is a gorgeous dress, i love the pockets. I's definitely not too big at the bust, if anything its a little small but I do have a larger chest, but definitely not over the top big. The fit is soooo flattering but I wouldn't say it gives stretch. It's not a going out for a massive meal dress as it doesn't stretch. ;)excuse the photo, it's not ironed. I was too excited to put it on.

review_summary: I am so happy with this d
review_text: I am so happy with this dress! I loved it the second I saw it. It's so me. I love quirky prints and cats! Unfortunately, while it says it runs large in the bust, it did not run large enough. I have a very large chest and most zipper dresses don't fit, so I wasn't surprised, just disappointed. I love it too much to return, and I think the XL would be too large in other places, so I'm going to sew a swatch of fabric into it so that I don't have to zip it all the way. But if it didn't have such an amazing print, I don't think it would be worth $70 for a dress I have to alter.

review_summary: Was very happy with the l
review_text: Was very happy with the length. I was worried it was going to be too short. Slightly too big up top so will need to get about an inch or so taken off of the strap areas. Otherwise, quite happy with the quality and fit. Oh, and I love that it has pockets. Not enough pockets in women's clothing.

Another one I was heartbroken to return for being too small (at Nordstrom/Target I wear an XL/14; at ModCloth I wear a 2X/20). It is the most adorable kooky dress; I'd have absolutely kept it if I were small enough. Them's the breaks.
This dress is just brilliant, I love it! The fitting is perfect, everything sits in all the right places. Fabric is very light!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. The pr
review_text: I LOVE this dress. The proportions, pattern, and pockets are perfect! Admittedly, the fabric is a little coarser than I was expecting, but that's certainly not a deal breaker. It's the kind of dress that flatters your body and brings a smile to others' faces when they see you. How could you pass that up? If you're on the fence about this dress, pounce like a cat and purchase it!
First purchase from Modcloth and it won't be my last!  Love the dressfits great!!

review_summary: As a cat lover and a jour
review_text: As a cat lover and a journalism major, it was impossible to say no to this dress. It's adorable in person, and will make an excellent addition to my summer wardrobe. It was only slightly snug around the waist, so slightly heavier girls (like myself) might need to watch out for that.

Note for those that wear a 1416: Folter's/Retrolicious XL is a size 12, not a 14 (unless noted as a fits large)! While I could get the zipper to zip around my waist no WAY was this going to fit my chest or torso! Great print  I'm really bummed this didnt work for me.

review_summary: This dress is to die for.
review_text: This dress is to die for. It's made by the same company that makes the Good Enough to Eat/Premiere/Strut dresses so the fit is very similar. I ordered an XL to accommodate my bust (38C, sometimes 38D depending on the brand) and it turned out to be a wise choice. I think I could've squeezed into the L but I'd rather have extra bust room than have it be too tight. Anyways, the waist is a bit large but that isn't out of the ordinary for me. The print is to die for, and since it's black and white you can pair it with any color! I've already worn it with a red cardigan and a purple one and received so many compliments. The price might seem a bit high but you'll never see another dress like this again. I'm going to be an enabler and say GO FOR IT, this dress is worth it!Exact measurements: 403041Size purchased: XL

This dress is so absolutely unique and cute, and as a cat lover I had to have it. I am usually right on the borderline of being a M/L, so I went with a medium on this one since it says it runs a bit big in the chest (and I'm not super busty). I actually found it to be very snug..to the point where I could zip it, but just barely. I have a wider rib cage and a very straight shape. I'm worried that I'm going to wear out the zipper super quickly since I have to work so hard to get it up, so I'm quick exchanging the medium for a large. I think it should be fine. As far as the fabric goes, I do wish it were either a little thicker or lined (it is a bit seethrough), but I'll live since I plan on wearing it with opaque tights and a cardi anyway. Other than that, I love it, and I can't wait to get my new size!

review_summary: I was waiting for this dr
review_text: I was waiting for this dress to come back and so happy it did. Love this dress and love the pockets. I first ordered a small but returned it for a medium which fits like a glove. The length for me is a little long but I can always have it shortened. Only downside is it wrinkles easy. Very happy with the dress and even though it's covered in cats, it's puppy approved too :)

I love almost everything about this dress! The pattern is adorable and hilarious if you read it. The pockets are so lovely to have as well, although they're a little small.As far as the fit goes, it fits rather strange. It fit really snug in the waist and loose in the bust. Being 100% cotton, I'm terrified to wash/dry it. I would definitely recommend going with a medium if you are close to my measurements since it will shrink down.

review_summary: Very cute dress. I wish i
review_text: Very cute dress. I wish it was lined, because it is white and cotton, but a half slip solved bleedthrough issues.It is TINY for those of us with big boobs. I'm a 38D, and I was squashed a bit. Still love the dress, but for work I have to wear a cardigan buttoned up.

review_summary: I didn't find that this r
review_text: I didn't find that this ran particularly large in the bust at all, but to be fair, I usually have trouble finding things that fit me in the bust. I'm completely in love with this dress. I wish I could wear it every day, but it's too memorable to do that. :D

Meow! Can't get over the cute/unique pattern of this dress. I am always on the lookout for unique and quirky items for my closet and this is exactly what I needed. Looks so adorable on its own or with a little jean jacket and cow boy boots. Its a really fun dress!

review_summary: Man, oh man. I stalked th
review_text: Man, oh man. I stalked this dress for a few weeks and snapped it up as soon as they had one in my size. I was so excited to get it and it didn't fail my expectations. The fabric is what I expected  somewhat thin, but not sheer. The fit is perfect for me, although someone with a bigger bust might need the next size up. I love this dress, but I'm not giving it 5 stars because of the price. It's a great dress, but this was a special purchase because it is exceedingly expensive for the quality.

review_summary: Simply put, this is the d
review_text: Simply put, this is the dress to end all dresses.It's perfect. And I'm a stickler for the cons, always looking for that little flaw without which a dress could be so much better. But this dress... is perfect. The straps are the perfect length. The bust is just the right size. The waist doesn't puff out like so many other Aline dresses do. The length is cute and flirty, but you can bend over and not worry about flashing anyone. The material is soft and comfy, and light enough that in the summer it'll be nice and airy. The zipper actually zips, all the way up, on the first try, smoothly. The print is obviously adorable. It goes with everything.It feels like it was custommade to fit and flatter my body. I'm a cheap shopper, and normally only go for dresses $50 and under, but this is worth every penny. If you see in come back in stock in your size, don't even think for half a second. Get your clicking fingers on and BUY THAT BABY! Seriously. Perfect.
My favorite dress purchase from modcloth yet! Picked my husband up from the airport when he came home on leave and he loves it as well. It does run a tiiiny bit small.

review_summary: I am in LOVE with this dr
review_text: I am in LOVE with this dress!!!  I've tried to buy it the last two times that it was in stock but it sold out before I could make it to my computer!  Best Modcloth purchase ever!!

It's stiff competition, but I think I'm going to say this is my favorite dress I've ever bought at ModCloth. It fit me just right and is flattering, the print is hilarious and it has pockets! I can pair it with so many things and it can be worn year round. Absolutely no complaints with this dress. I'm thrilled!

review_summary: I loved this dress and sh
review_text: I loved this dress and should have jumped on it when it came back in stock, but I didn't suspect my size would sell out in 3 days! If you are thinking of getting this dress, do it and do it fast because it will probably sell out again. I am usually a medium and while the small fits, it is definitely snug. Also, maybe this is because I went a size down, but I did not find the bust to be too large.
This is the most perfect piece of clothing I own. I couldn't be happier with it.
Everything was perfect except the size :(  I ordered a size too small and the L is now sold out.  It's a waiting game now.  I am determined to have this dress!

Not what I was expecting but a quirky dress nonetheless. I expected that it'd have a 50s silhouette but it has more of a babydoll dress one. Contrary to description I found this dress actually runs small. It is extremely tight in the chest area and I don't even have massive boobs (normally a b or c cup). I'm a size 12/14 (Au) in dresses but found the L in the dress fit me like a size 10 Au would. The skirt bit juts out at the waist but in a weird way like rather than flowing down it squirts out. So squishy up top didn't even have room for a bra! I love this dress but the tightness make me feel overstuffed so I'm returning the L and ordering the XL.

This dress is awesome!  When I first took it out of the bag and put it on, I wasn't sure if I was going to end up keeping it because the bust/arm holes gaped so noticeably on me.  After deciding that I loved the pattern enough to keep it despite its gaping, I considered taking in about half an inch on each side to fix the problem.  Luckily, I looked at the tag before taking a needle and thread to it and saw that it's made of 100% cotton.  So instead of jumping right into sewing, I threw it in the wash (following the tag's washing and drying instructions).  Now, it fits me perfectly all over!  (The shrunken length is great too  it's about 3 above the middle of my knee, so it was probably around 2 above the middle of my knee prior to washing.)  Basically, my takeaway point is: it might run large at the bust prior to the first wash, but due to the nature of its fiber makeup, IT DOES SHRINK IN THE WASH.  Just something to keep in mind for anyone who is considering buying this dress and getting it altered prior to wearing it out for the first time!

review_summary: It's a nice dress. But it
review_text: It's a nice dress. But it's not great. The only thing keeping it apart from any average dress is the print, not even the fabric. I'm not too crazy about it. It's completely unlined. And squished my chest completely.

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this dress! I had to wait to order it because it was sold out when I first discovered it. The fit is wonderful. It feels like it was made just for me. I think the overall dress is made very well. I love that is was made in the USA. I wish that is was lined though, it is slightly see through. It's nothing that a slip can't fix though. Was it a little over priced, yes. I do not think it should be priced at $69. My feelings about the price would change if it came lined. Overall I am very excited to have the dress. I am a cat lover and this is perfect!

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this the first time I saw it but when I finally got an opportunity to purchase it, it was all gone. I pounced on it the moment it came back in stock. As a proud (but allergic) cat lover, I am very happy with this dress, It fits perfectly although it is a bit snug in the chest area. I have received many compliments already and have caught many more trying to read my dress.

This is quite possibly the greatest dress I own. I've always been a crazy cat lady, as are most of my friends, and when I saw this dress I knew instantly that I had to have it! It looks absolutely beautiful, the length is perfect, and it's just quirky enough to grab attention without looking tacky. Couldn't be happier with this dress! It's a little loose in the bust, but a belt and a padded bra solve that problem. Thank you, Modcloth, this dress is perfect!

This dress is unlined, but not see through.  I wore it with black tights and a black patent leather belt, since it's a little on the short side..  It's hard to zip by yourself due to zipper placement, but it's really adorable.
This dress is amazing. Very cute, great fit, flattering cut. The top is a bit tight, but I not to the point where it's hard to breathe or anything, so I don't mind :) New favorite dress!

review_summary: This was my first ever Mo
review_text: This was my first ever ModCloth purchase. After seeing it on the homepage I absolutely HAD to have it, and after almost a month of anticipation it finally arrived! However, after such a long time (and almost eighty dollars, because I live in AUS) the dress really didn't live up to my expectations.The whole thing was slightly loose  not enough for sizing down to be worth it, but enough to make it a little bit shapeless on me. This was odd, 'cause I'm at the top of the Medium size range (except for the bust). Overall it was seriously unflattering, making my shoulders look disproportionately wide, flattening my chest and broadening my waist.This is probably the shortest dress in my wardrobe, but given that it hits just above the knee and has a nice big skirt I'm not overly concerned about it. However, if I'd seen this in a physical store in the city (having the opportunity to examine it and try it on) I couldn't have justified spending more than forty dollars on it.I'm not going to return this, 'cause in a few months I might fit it (and the postage costs would cripple me!) but right now I definitely regret the money I've spent on it.

review_summary: This dress fits like a gl
review_text: This dress fits like a glove. The description said it runs large at the bust, so I thought I would need a padded bra, but it actually couldn't fit any better. And I absolutely love the James Catterson article printed on in the fabric! I'm a big fan of Mr. Patterson's novels!
Love this dress and it's super flattering.  It is quite tight in the bust, but I felt a larger size would have looked too big.  All in all, pretty happy with this purchase!!

review_summary: I'm not sure I'm going to
review_text: I'm not sure I'm going to have to ever buy another dress after this one. It's more expensive than I'm usually willing to spend, but it is so comfortable and I feel so cute in it. I don't have a problem with thinness of fabric, the length has been approved for work by my managers, it comes in right where it ought in the waist and the neckline is flattering without being inappropriate. Highly recommended. I would buy one for each and every one of my friends if I could.

review_summary: I love this dress! I get
review_text: I love this dress! I get so many compliments on it. Wonderful dress!

review_summary: This dress is so cool! I
review_text: This dress is so cool! I love the cat print. Unlike another reviwer I don't feel to old at 33 to wear this great dress. I just wore it with a black cardigan and black tights, and I find that it's modest (yet quirky) enough to wear to work. Only disadvantage: it's all plain cotton, so I won't be able to wear this for autumn and winter over here... So just wearing it a lot now while I still can!

This dress fit very nicely and was well made (unlined but no seethrough), but I'll still be returning it. I love newspaper print things, but this design is too twee for me. Secondly, the dress is both a little too high and a little too low to justify keeping it for work: it's several inches above my knees and shows a touch of cleavage. A shame, but it's so cute I'm sure it will find a good home!

review_summary: I love this dress! The fa
review_text: I love this dress! The fabric print is very original, and  the text deals about cats! I love them, I did not take care about it when I bought the dress, so I got well surprised when I received it. The fabric is thin but it neither shows through nor seems a delicated dress. I ordered size S; it fits well but it is a bit tight for me in the chest, altough I think a bigger size would be too much wide. The dress has a zip on the back and two pockets on the skirt.

review_summary: I love this dress. Love l
review_text: I love this dress. Love love love. The quality is good and despite being worried about the length (I'm 5758), it's not too bad  comes maybe mid thigh on me.  However, to me, this definitely does not run large in the bust.

This dress fits perfectly! Although they say it runs large in bust, but the small size was perfect for me. Since it came to me a little bit crinkled and folded, it really looked like a newspaper! The length of this dress is great too  it just touches my knee. The quality looks fine too, but I don't know what happens after washing it a couple of times. So far, I love this dress.

Absolutely adorable!  This dress is very cute and quirky, but does not stand out enough to create too much attention.  The length comes to just above the knees, making it okay to wear to work.  The side pockets are sewn on the outside towards the front, so they don't make you look hippy.  This is a fun fabulous dress that makes you feel and look good!

There was no hesitation when I noticed this dress in the new arrivals section. I needed it, and that was that. It arrived super fast, and fits pretty good, but the bust is a bit on the small side. I have no intention of returning it though, as it's not even noticeable really. It fits perfectly everywhere else, and the length is perfect. No need to make up for the shortness with leggings. You're all set.My favorite part is the review of the Twisted Whiskers show at Radio Kitty Music Hall. Seriously.

This is listed as sheer, but you can barely tell. It's pretty snug on me in the bust, but a size down would be too big. It comes down to my knees, which I like, but I imagine it'd be shorter on tall people because I am pretty short. I'd recommend this dress.

review_summary: I am in love with this dr
review_text: I am in love with this dress. As a former journalism major and a proud cat lady, I knew as soon as I saw it that we were meant for each other. I ordered my usual Medium, and the fit is pretty much perfect. I found that it fits basically the same as the Good Enough to Eat Dress, with maybe slightly more room in the bust. I'm looking forward to pairing it with colorful tights and cardigans!

This dress is amazing! It's hilarious!!!! Even though in the details it says it runs large in bust.. I'm not so sure of that. It's very tight.. I know I have a rather large chest... but I could barely do up the zipper! I'm going to keep it and sew in some  extra room with either black or white fabric... it's too awesome not to keep!

review_summary: I guess I'm just too old
review_text: I guess I'm just too old (33) for this dress.  :(  It's cute, but it's too short for me.  The fabric is sweet  I wish I could find it and make some other piece of clothing (I'm a crazy cat lady)!  I guess it's all just too much (for me) in a dress.  It fit nicely, and it was wellmade, highquality, so that's a plus  love the pockets.  This is probably a great dress for a teenager or someone in their early 20s with great legs.

review_summary: This has got to be the mo
review_text: This has got to be the most perfect fitting dress I have ever gotten from Modcloth. Since the bust runs small, it's perfect for my pear shape. It's ridiculously adorable and the cut is just perfect. The quality is not so bad too, which I was worried about at first. Also, it has pockets!!! 5 stars, thumbs up and all that jazz! I love this frikkin' dress! _
SUPER cute but unfortunately does not run very large in the bust like the description says. :( It's a bit too tight in the bust for me. Hopefully it'll come back in stock soon so I can get it in XL!

This dress is amazing.  I wore it for the first time today and got at least 20 compliments.  The pattern on the dress looks just as good in person and is a great conversation starter.  The only problem I had with the dress was that it ran large in the bust AND the waist.  An XS would have fit me better but wasn't an option.  The cuteness of the dress totally makes up for the fact that its a little ill fitting on me.  I still love it.

This dress fits like a glove. I am a big fan. I love that it's lined. Well made. I have to say the belt could use a how to guide. I need to practice tying it. It says dry cleaned but i washed it on cold gentle cycle and let it air dry and it was pretty good  some light ironing.

review_summary: Adorable, well made, but odd fit
review_text: This dress is fabulous and well made. The material is very nice and soft, but thick so it would not be great in heat. It is lined and does not stretch. I will admit that the fit is a bit odd. I wear a S or XS in most things. The top of the dress is not tailored for curves, it's pretty straight. Fits well in my shoulders/chest, but I *almost* can't close that lowest button just above the tie. Thankfully, the part that is pulling a bit is covered by the tie, otherwise I would probably have to return it. I would not size up, because then I fear it would be too loose in the shoulders and chest. It's slightly longer than I'd like, but at 5'1 that's sort of my life story. Great buy for the price!

Wow, I almost always order xs but I couldn't even get the first few buttons shut. I'm a 32B on a good day and the buttons wouldn't close. Probably won't size up because it's a little long as it is. Material is good quality but thick.

review_summary: Looked great on the model, but not on me...
review_text: Was excited about the dress when it arrived but when I had put it on, it just looked odd and unappealing on me. Waistline was weird and the dress just looked like a bag on me. I think this is more of a dress for thinner women.
The back half of the elastic gave out after one wear.  Big inconvenience to have it fixed.  Cute and comfortable otherwise

This is such a cute dress  flattering, incredibly comfortable, perfect for summer. Unfortunately, the translucent material on the sleeves and the skirt overlay doesn't hold up well. I'm wearing this dress for the second time, and my son just pointed out that the left sleeve already has two holes in it. I have no idea whether this can be repaired. I'm disappointed as I had plans to wear the dress to an event next week. For $50 I expect to get more than two uses out of a dress.

The cut on this dress is perfect for me. I have some trouble finding things with flattering necklines for my petite, somewhat broad chested frame. A lot of things that only show a normal amount of skin on most people look like whoa thats too much skin for the workplace on me. I got a size small and it fits amazing. I would love if they made this dress in a more summery color, like a coral. I would race to buy that.

I'm guessing this is for someone much shorter than me, because it's way too short and the waist is so high this basically makes it an empire line dress. Really unflattering. The upper material shows every tiny lump and bump.
A nice dress for many occasions that is very wearable and comfy. The black looks just dressy enough. I usually order XL in dresses and this was true to size. I may get the pink too.

I haven't purchased anything from Modcloth in a long time. I think it has been a year. I saw this dress and thought it looked different from some of the loud, whimsical prints that aren't exactly my style anymore. I purchased this in black. When it arrived I was very excited. The length is great for work, it's a couple inches above my knees. The fabric is soft, and though the pleated skirt material is thin, the layer under it is soft and opaque, which is perfect for me. I'm so tired of having to try to layer things and add camisoles and slips and what not to ensure no one sees my undies underneath. My boyfriend kept complimenting the dress, and I received several other compliments the first day I wore it. The hem of the pleated fabric is raw, so I hope it holds up and doesn't start shredding. Also the tie at the waist is not adjustable. I would have liked to cinch it in slightly, but after the big meal I had, it's probably best I didn't have that option. This dress is very lovely, and was comfortable throughout the workday and for dinner out afterwards. I hope Modcloth continues to stock dresses like this along with the crazy tacoprinted dresses that not everyone is into. I'm considering buying it in pink also. MORE DRESSES LIKE THIS MODCLOTH PLZ!!!

review_summary: I love how this dress fit
review_text: I love how this dress fit. I am a huge fan of the material because it has a lot of play and will never wrinkle! The slit makes it easy to move in and the top is constructed perfectly to never let my bra peak out.I am 5'4 and 145lbs (athletic build)

review_summary: Doesn't quite look like the photo
review_text: The length on this dress is nice, but the waist sits pretty high. Since the fabric is a little stretchy and clingy, it's not super flattering in a plus size. The surplice bodice is pretty. It's going back because it's just a bit too clingy.

I own the Travel Sprightly dress in a floral print that fits perfectly. Unfortunately, this version of the dress is much larger. There is a ton of extra fabric in the top and the arm holes are huge. I was so excited to see this dress in a new print and I was so disappointed in the fit. I love the fabric and the pattern though and it would probably look great on someone else.

I have no memory whatsoever of deciding to buy this dress.  When it arrived, I was like, wait, what's that?  But I'm so glad I got it!  It fits so nicely and the fabric feels like a dream.    Note that the seam does go straight down the middle which might not be everyone's favourite thing, but I kind of like the way it made the pattern double  added more interest to the front!
I bought this when it was on clearance so I can't return it, but it is way too big in the chest and above area. I can tell it's high quality, but I'm sad about the fit.

review_summary: Perfect blend of not too formal and not too partyish
review_text: I wasn't blown away by the pics online, but was pleasantly surprised by the quality and fit. Being plus size makes it difficult. The dress tapers in a little at the waist, giving a better silhouette than other dresses. I usually have issues filling out the bust area, but this dress is forgiving and gives the illusion you have more going on up there. Plus, pockets! The button detail on the back gives it that vintage feel, but the dress is super comfortable. Thank you Modcloth for offering wedding dresses at reasonable prices.

pretty dress, the length is great. the top doesn't fit very well. the waist fits. I'm usually a Large in dresses and this is a large. The chest is very low and not very fitting. I'll have to get it tailored.

This was one case where the dress looked so stunning on the model that I just had to have it even though it's not necessarily my usual style.  I'm usually not a fan of smocked waists because they wind up looking cheap or being too loose, but this dress is gorgeous and both looks and feels quality despite being a warmweather garment.  I will say  beware cleavage.  Holy cow, the twins are out.  My one real complaint is that I wish they'd designed it without a seam going straight down the middle.  It's not as noticeable in terms of the print and the way the skirts fall, but with some light behind it you can see the seam.

This dress is absolutely beautiful in person  a floaty and flowy skirt, and the cotton material makes it perfect for sticky humid days in the summer! I originally bought this in a size small, which fit perfectly fine everywhere except the bust (hence why I rated it 'slightly small' instead of 'very small'  it's smallish in the bust area only). it was almost as if there wasn't enough length to it (which is unusual on someone my height, although I am busty for my size). The transition to the elasticized waist started at just about the widest part of my chest! If I rearranged things a bit (so to speak!) it seemed to help, but I am going to exchange this for the size medium and see if that fares any better, after which I will edit my review. I hope it does because this is an ideal summer dress for me!

I'm usually a small, but seeing the comments here I decided to size up to a medium. Absolutely did not run small for me. The medium is huge on me; it's too big in both the waist and bust, so it falls and only stays up at my hips. I will need to exchange it for a small. However, the material is super soft and the print is just as folorful in person.

I love both colors of this dress, which is why I bought both!  I felt that my closed was lacking cute summer dresses, and as soon as I saw this one, I had to order it.  I love that you can wear it multiple ways, and that all the straps are removable.  It also has pockets, which is a great bonus!  I like that the length hits me right at the knees.  The fabric is light enough to stay cool in the summer, but is fully lined.  If this is made in more prints in the future, I will order them too!I reviewed this as a ModCloth employee.

Agree with those who say runs small. I would just add the word very. I always get XS, but the zipper had about 4 inches across on my upper back that wouldn't zip (and I'm a flat chested 32B on a good day). I question whether sizing up to a small would even be enough. Bummed bc it's sooo cute and my nails are teal right now so would've been perfect for this weekend. :(

I am in love with this little summer dress! The fabric is beautiful, the length is just right, and I love the convertible straps. I usually wear a medium in dresses and the M fit me perfectly. I can't wait to wear this all summer!

I wear size medium and mediums sometimes they are bit loose on me and I will wear a small. This dress I should have ordered a large. Definitely runs a size smaller. But I love this dress! I love the convertible options with the straps and the dress comes with pockets!!! Pockets in dresses are the best! Fabric is very comfortable.

review_summary: such a sweet summer datenight dress
review_text: I bought it in pink, size M. (I usually am a S on ModCloth, sometimes M, but since this was final sale/no returns, I wanted to know it wouldn't be snug anywhere. Also wanted to err on the safe side with length because I am only 5' 3 but I don't want dresses much above my knees.) The pink lining hits a few inches above my knees, but the overlay is close to the top of my knee so I feel it's a good length. Fit is greatloose and swingy but not a big sackpretty much like it fits the redhaired fairskinned model in the pictures. Just a very sweet, easy look. I bought it for dates in the spring/summer, since I feel it might not be quite right for church (except Easter?), and it's too delicate for everyday. The only area I'm worried won't last well is the flutter sleeves, since they aren't finished in any way and the delicate netting material arrived slightly frayed already (there's no way to prevent fraying with no seam). I may apply clear nail polish to the cut edge to prevent fraying, but I think this part of the dress will still wear out very quickly. Can't wait to wear this out on a date with my husband.

I love how soft this dress is! It is a shift dress, but still hugs me curved ever so slightly which is nice. I cute off the frilly sleeves because they looked funny on my arms, but overall super happy with this dress. It's fun AND comfy!
Bought this dress in a 2x because I wanted to make sure I had room to move and it fits like a dream. So comfy! Perfectly above my knee (I'm 5'2), and flowy. So excited to wear this!!
This was my wedding dress a year ago and was perfect for our Irish Pub ceremony and dance.  Fit perfectly

I bought this and another dress with the intentions of wearing one to a wedding and then returning the other, but I love them so much I think I'm going to keep both and wear one to the rehearsal dinner! This dress is very flattering. I love the collar and neckline.The hem sits above my knees. One side of the neckline came to me sticking up awkwardly, but I think some ironing will take care of that.My only complaint is that I wish this dress was made of cotton and not this heavier polyester material. It doesn't feel very breathable, which is unfortunate because I'll be wearing this in the heat of summer. I love the neckline of this dress and I would love to see dresses with this cut in cotton.

I loved the material and quality. The length was prefect. I really wanted this dress to work because it is so cute. The top part fit perfectly and was very flattering but the bottom half clung too much to my curvy hips and belly so that it ruined the look  looked amazing from waist up and horrible from waist down :(

I wanted to love this, and the colors and fabric are great! Unfortunately I found the top to be CRAZY baggy on me, while the bottom fit perfectly. I would get a different size, but I think the bottom would then be too tight. Too bad, I'll be returning this one.

I was a little weary purchasing this dress, but I am so happy that I did! The colors are so cute, and the fit was very flattering on my frame. The fabric is a true knit, so if you are looking for a more formal dress than this isn't the one for you. Perfect for a summer wedding!

I bought the blue one and I like it so much I'm buying the orange too! It is comfortable yet stylish. The stretchy fabric makes it an easy wear in warmer weather. I'm really conscious of length and for me it was perfect. Casual and cute, great for a poolside bbq or bridal shower brunch.

review_summary: I just LOVE this dress! T
review_text: I just LOVE this dress! The color, shape, fit, everything! I love that it's lined cotton, and it's so flattering. I just wish it was a TINY bit shorter, it hits me right at the knees so I might have to get it hemmed. Otherwise, it's one of my favorite ModCloth purchases!

I'm 5'6 about 150, 36B, and pear shaped. I got a large for the tiny bit of extra length and to accommodate my hips. So the top half is too big, as usual (the never ending curse for pear shaped women). The extra fabric bunches up inside the belt and the skirt looks much fuller than its intended design, so it's obvious just by looking at me that the dress is too big, but I can't go down a size because of the length. The large is borderline not long enough already, so although my wide hips would have fit in a medium, I have to stick with the large just to keep it work appropriate. I have this problem with Modcloth dresses a lot. Why are so many of them just a little above the knee when knee length is an office requirement just about everywhere? It's like the Geico commercial, dangling adorable dresses and saying oh, you almost had it when I find out it's just a few inches too short. And don't even get me started on everything being sleeveless. Maybe I don't want to have to wear a cardigan every single day! So frustrating. Anyway, the blue is stunning, the material is thick, the dress is nice, and returns are a hassle so I'm keeping it.

I really love this dress! The pattern is cute and unique and the tie in the back is just adorable and so different from my other dresses. This fit me really well (I'm 5'4 and about 150) it was a bit big in the chest but you can adjust the tie. All together I think it's a great dress
This dress is super cute and summery. Even though it's got an open back, the length makes it modest. Dress hits me right below my knees. It fit me perfectly. Love the color and the unique design.

This dress is really cute. Very short in the body so the waist sits high on my ribs but that makes it quite flattering. It does mean that you need to buy a size larger (luckily I did) so that you can actually breath when wearing it even though it's not small in any other way. It's hard to tie it behind your back so I might have to end up modifying it in some way....

I fell so in love with this dress that when the 24hour dress sale expired before I could check out, I decided to buy it anyway at full price.  For the most part, it doesn't disappoint!  My one real complaint is that I can fully reach around my own back and can do most zippers and ties myself, but I can't quite get this to sit right when I do the bow on my own.  I think it can be /made/ to sit right so I don't think it's a flaw in the dress?  But I'll need help to get into it.  That aside, the colors are spoton, the liner is fun and reminds me of watermelon.  Be warned that I'm usually somewhere between S and XS on Modcloth and I had a hard time getting the elastic of this S over my hips.  It didn't stretch completely out but I was worried, so I'd recommend putting it on over your head even though the top comes completely undone.

This is easily my favorite ModCloth dress I've ever purchased! I have a short torso and the waist hits in exactly the right place. The tie on the back is extremely flattering and can be tied to that I can comfortably wear it without a bra and the goods are up where they need to be. ;) The quality is excellent and I get so many compliments on it!

review_summary: I thought it might run la
review_text: I thought it might run large in the breast because other reviews but that wasn't true for me. Super cute though!

review_summary: I normally wear a large i
review_text: I normally wear a large in modcloth and originally ordered this in a large but sent it back for a medium (medium shown in photos). The large fit just right in the waist  not to snug, not too loose. But the top portion was so awkward. It was loose around my back and my chest didn't fill out the top correctly. It just felt so big! Mind you, I wear a 32DDD but my chest really isn't as big as my bra size makes the girls sound (postbreastfeeding size, not originally this big.. they need major support). So this top might be good for truly large chested girls but if you're not super wellendowed or your ladies just need a ton of support, I'd size down. OR buy both sizes and return the one that doesn't fit best.ANYWAY.... So I got the medium instead and it fits MUCH better on the top but is pretty snug in the waist. I can only secure the belt to the second loop hole. That being said and since this dress is also 100% cotton, it will need to be washed/cared for appropriately to avoid major shrinking.As far as the material quality  SO GOOD! This is probably the best quality modcloth label purchase I've bought in a long time. The fabric is heavy but still perfect for summer. It's lined. And it feels/looks expensive. AND IT HAS POCKETS! I LOVE this dress!And it was perfect for my vacation to Hawaii! And for my office... because I'm a travel agent for Aulani.  :P
Fit me perfectly & looks fabulous.  Nice quality to the fabric as well.  Love this vintage feel dress!

I really wanted to keep this dress, but the fit was very strange. It was too big around my back, but fit in the waist. The top of the main halter part (with the fabric folds) gapped strangely and I don't know what sizing would have fixed that. It may just be made for people with a flatter chest. The print was super cute and the fabric was really nice quality. I'm really sad to send this one back!
Love the printing, the vivid colors, the fabric... well I think is the perfect dress for me. Fits great, a lilltle thight around my ribs, but I?m used to it cause I don?t fit one size.

review_summary: Dress was a little on the
review_text: Dress was a little on the short side, was a little tight, but I will be keeping it because the print is so cute!

review_summary: The print of this dress i
review_text: The print of this dress is really cute. It?s lined and has pockets.  Size S fits me perfectly.The only thing I don?t like about this dress is the quality of the textile. It looks cheap. I bought it on sale so for the price I think its still a good buy.

review_summary: I wanted to like this dre
review_text: I wanted to like this dress!!! It was really hard to get on even with all the buttons undone. When I did get it the waist and bust were a bit snug which was surprising. I'm sure I could get through the day if I decided to wear it, but I would suggest sizing up one with this. The belt was also way too small and wouldn't even fit around my waist. I'm sure taking away 10 lbs of my girth would help. Haha! The quality of the dress itself and material is really good, and the pockets are super roomy.

review_summary: I should have ordered a s
review_text: I should have ordered a size up. From review I thought the large would fit perfectly but I don't like my clothes snug. Oh well, I'll give it as a gift. Love the quality and colors.

It's a great cotton dress and very sturdy. I usually wear between a 1012 US women, and got the XL since I bought it final sale. Unfortunately, it gapes a little at the arms. Otherwise, the belt makes everything look perfectly fitted. Very nice, deep pockets. Be wary of the color though. It's a lot brighter than expected: the pale pink is more like a dark, neon pink and all the colors are similarly darker, more neon. More highlighter marker than the pictured pastel tones.

review_summary: The color was not as brig
review_text: The color was not as bright as I'd hoped for and it wrinkles really easily.  Wish I had gone for the 2X, would fit a lot better.  Got it on super sale, so I won't mind taking it to a tailor.

review_summary: This has to be my new fav
review_text: This has to be my new favorite dress. I got so many compliments with it and there are so many pretty colors and the matching belt is just perfect!

I just love this dress.  I have a hard time zipping up the side of my own (#plussizeissues) but once I got it zipped I felt so cute.  I can't wait to wear this to Disney.  The pockets are DEEP.  I am a size 18 with a 44DDD bust.  Ordered a 2x.  Got it in 2 days.  I am a happy girl.
This dress is fabulous. I sized up hoping to avoid the large chest/button up issue, but it's such a good quality I think I would have been fine with my normal size.

I'm curious if this dress was designed with an outstanding fit for everyone, or if it was just accidentally designed for my body :). For one thing I can button all the way up without gaping! And the waist is not restrictive while sitting but still looks fitted and flattering. It is also fully lined in soft cotton. The construction feels very sturdy i.e. I will definitely ruin this dress by staining it, not ripping it ;).I like the length as well. I'm 5'8 and it hits right in the middle of my knees. In short I love the fit so much I'm considering the other colorway (the one I have is the print).

Despite being within the sizing for a Large, this was too big, a medium would have worked just fine. But I wasn't as impressed with it in person, so I won't be exchanging it. Colors were nice, fabric was okay, just overall not as flattering as I thought it would be.

I love this dress, everything from the fabric to the fit. And it has pockets! I really enjoy the broderie anglaise fabric and have found it to be a bit scratchy in the past but this is so soft. The length was perfect for me. I actually sized up to a large (normally medium) and it fits well, fair amount of room to move in the bust area, probably could have just fit in a medium.

review_summary: This dress is so comfy an
review_text: This dress is so comfy and cute and the colour is the best for anything It's too the knee on me and I'm 5'7 so if a shorter girl had it it would be quite long

This dress is so pretty! The material is stiff but I really like the slight flare style. Also the pockets are a bonus, who doesn't love pockets?! I am usually a medium but this dress ran a little big in the waist, I am going to have to get it hemmed. However, I have a feeling that if I bought it in a small that it would be just a little tight. I still recommend it. I am very excited to sport this dress.

review_summary: I really wanted to love this adorable, high quality dress
review_text: But its not great for the flat chested ladies. There is something abut the way the front gathers that just doesn't work for me. Bummer, its really nicely made.

I really love this dress. The colour is exactly as shown in the pictures. It looks adorable on and I can't wait to wear it out. I did order a size up as I have large breasts and was worried that without any stretch that it might not fit, but I should have ordered a size 3X as the 4X is definitely too big, so I would say this dress is true to size. I will just tailor it to fit me.
Very cute dress!  I worry wearing it a little because it fairly delicate, but get many compliments.
I ordered from France and I am very surprise by the quality and the precision of the size
Great dress. Fits snug on me at a 2x. I ended up returning it. I didn't try the 3x. But it was well made. Lovely.

review_summary: Really cute but not for my body type
review_text: I was so stoked to get this because I adore peter pan collars, but unfortunately it just looked kind of silly on me and made me look like a chubby babydoll. The materials were nice though and it seemed relatively wellmade. The medium was too small to zip up, but the large fit perfectly (I am normally a size 10.) I think this would look cuter on more petite ladies.

review_summary: A cute dress with lots of compliment possibility!
review_text: I bought this dress earlier in the summer and have been wearing it any chance I get. I always get so many compliments about how cute and quirky it is. The dress is not lined but I like that since it works for keeping cool in the summer time and it easy to layer if I did wanna wear something a bit warmer. I love the colors so much and do not regret purchasing this dress! The medium fits well for me there is a bit more space in the waist than I would like but not by much! I love wearing this dress with a cute brown belt!

review_summary: I got this dress the mome
review_text: I got this dress the moment I saw the print. Fortunately, it fit me just like in the photo. SUPER comfy, albeit a bit stiff, which is why I knocked it down one for quality (It is $80, after all).
I love this dress!! Super fun and fits great. The cloth material thin but flattering and also nice and cool on a summer day.

review_summary: I loved it!!! At first, I
review_text: I loved it!!! At first, I was concerned with the fit of the dress because it has no stretch. So I sized up to a 3x just incase I needed extra room. It fit perfectly! I'm usually a 2x and I'm a DDD bust but in these, 3x fit perfectly. The print is so cute and the fabric is of good quality! Great to wear to the County Fair or anywhere! AND IT HAS POCKETS! Even though it was a little pricey for a casual dress, I think it was worth it. I was very happy with this item!

review_summary: Extremely cute & soft, cut is illfitting
review_text: I am 5'1, 135 lbs, 342637.  I could not get the side zipper on this dress up there was a 7 inch gap.  The size chart states that a small chest is 3435, but this dress is cut for someone with a 30 chest (also someone with no boobs or ribs).  Super disappointed; I know why this is Final Sale/No Returns it's oddly shaped and doesn't fit like a qualitymade garment.  I can't return it  I would give it to a friend but I don't know any adult women in my circle that this would actually fit.  The bottom half is cute & roomy.  I would say if you have a tiny, flat, and/or concave chest and a big old booty, this dress could work for you.

This dress is so adorable! It fits perfectly, the waist and the pleated skirt are very flattering, and I LOVE the pattern of pineapples and flowers! It's casual enough to wear to school or work, yet dressy enough to wear to a wedding or other formal event if you pair it with heels. The length is perfect, just a little bit below the knee on me. The zipper did stick a little bit when I zipped it up trying it on, so hopefully I won't run into issues with that over time. One thing that's a little odd is the left side of the skirt (same side the zipper is on) is sewn to the lining almost all the way down, whereas the right side is not. It's not noticeable standing still, but makes it a little less twirly on the one side! Not a big deal, I still see this becoming a dress I wear quite regularly!

I love the print, color and fit of this dress. It is really flattering and is long enough for me to wear to work. The materials and construction are on the cheap side, the zipper keeps getting stuck, making it challenging to get in and out of.  I don't think it is worth the listed price, if I am honest.

review_summary: I love this pattern bit t
review_text: I love this pattern bit this dress has issues. it runs small. The button on the collar is nearly impossible to work and it's necessary to get it on and off. And, the zipper was of poor quality and wouldn't work consistently. I'm bummed to have to return it.

Love this dress. It was the perfect look but sizing was off, bad zipper (had to cut some of the inner fabric for it to go up.) That took a while. I was very lucky to not be late to our ceremony.  And lastly quite a few of the beads fell of within one wear. (Thank goodness it came with extra beads) other than those things I loved how I looked. Def one/two time wear.
Absolutely beautiful dress and it fit perfectly! It was comfortable as well.
Feels great, looks great, I can't recommend it enough. I feel like a magical fairy going to a forest ball!

review_summary: I was SO excited for this dress, but...
review_text: I can't even describe how excited I was to receive this dress... but OMG, it runs SO small.  I even double and triple checked the sizing chart.  I purchased this dress for a wedding this fall and I think it'd be perfect if I'm able to get a larger size.  Great quality.  Fantastic color.

I was looking for a longerlength dress that would be both comfortable and flattering, and this is it. The detail on the bodice is really beautiful, and I couldn't be happier with the fit. It's also seems to be relatively good quality. I'm between sizes right now, fluctuating between 6 and 8 in pants and 4 and 6 in tops, and the medium fits me perfectly. Can't wait to wear this one.

I bought this dress in navy to wear to my sister's wedding. It's beautiful and is made very well. It flows really nicely, and is very flattering but elegant at the same time! I'm going to sew a silver sparkly belt onto the waist to complete it, but overall I'm really excited to wear this dress! Since I'm very petite (97 lbs, 5'), the dress is long and will have to be cut, but the XS fit perfectly otherwise.I bought this dress on sale + free shipping and think it was such a steal!

I absolutely love this dress! But if you are short like me, be prepared to have it hemmed. Also, the zipper could be a higher quality, but it's not enough of a deal breaker for me to return. Aside from those two issues, this dress is incredibly flattering, flows nicely while walking, and makes me feel beautiful! I am between a size 1214 and ordered the XL. It is a little snug in the chest and ribs, but overall the fit is nice.

Beautiful dress but the vertical seam on the back of the skirt was very puckered and uneven. You can tell if you look closely at the picture of the back of the skirt (although the ones in the picture are not too bad.) I got this dress in the lavender as well and that was extremely/even more puckered. So much so that I had to exchange it. The one they resent was a little better but still puckered in some areas especially along the lower end of the zipper. I want to exchange this one too but they have limited sizes and I'm not sure if the new one will be even worse so I'll just deal with it since I purchased it at a discount. But for the original price of the dress I would be very concerned with that issue.Fit is great though, and I'm 5'3 so every dress comes down longer on me than on the models pictured. I wear between a size 8 and 10 and the large fit great even with my bigger tummy.

I bought this dress for a friend's wedding and I think it is going to be great.  The color is beautiful and even better in person than it looks in the picture.  It is more of a sage green whereas the picture online makes it look more minty.  It is definitely on the long side .  I am very longlegged (34 inseam) and it feels even a bit long on me.  I will definitely need heels.  I wish it was about 46 inches shorter but otherwise it is very nearly perfect.  The fabric feels sturdy and the dress is wellconstructed.  The top does not have much stretch at all so if you are between sizes you might want to err on the side of sizing up.

review_summary: Doesn't fit in any of the right places. Definitely not for b
review_text: I love flowy dresses but this falls short of any expectations. I'm currently a 36D and refusing to look at maternity clothes. Flowy dresses work amazing for me right now and this dress is *not* flowy. The slip didn't fit over my chest, so I unclipped it and just tried the overlay. The ruffly overlay doesn't lay properly. I couldn't get past the fact that it looked like it should be 2 inches lower based on how it was cut. Do not recommend even if you're tall and willowy.
Looks just the same in person as it does online, super comfy and exactly what I expect from a shift dress. Love it.

I love this dress! So glad I bought it. I got the navy and it's really flattering. It's super stretchy and soft, way more than I was expecting, but doesn't cling to my tummy pooch. The vneck isn't too low and it's not too short either, making this perfect for worktohappy hour days. The quality seems good so far, but I'll probably be very careful when washing, because the material seems it may be prone to shrinking. I kind of want the pink version, but I'm worried that may show more lumps and bumps due to the overlay being a different color than the lining.

I bought this dress to wear to my husbands college graduation dinner. I wore a strapless bra but I probably didn't need to, and it fit like a glove. Like a skintight, sexy glove with tons of cleavage... anyway, I loved it so much I just bought another one in a different color. I am usually between a small and medium, and even though I'm sure the small would fit, I'm glad I went up a size. The material is a stretchy

Holy wow, this dress is AMAZING. I feel so sexy in it and cannot wait to wear it for the dress up night on the cruise I'll be going on in November.
