review_text: Just in love with this dress! Bought it on small and not extra small because the fabric is kind of elastic. So I didn't want it too tight. I look a little like Annie though, but it is the vintage look I was going for. The structure is really cute. And the quality it is also very good.

I looooove this dress! The price was right the quality was good, and the fit is very flattering. I love the thicker fabric it was a very nice suprise. The length was perfect so I'm happy that i can wear it to work!

This dress is completely adorable. I am wearing mine for the first time today, and I've already received so many compliments! I do have a few gripes, though. The fabric does have a tendency to ride up a little bit in the waist, and the skirt is very short. Bending over without leggings on is a bad, bad idea. Curvy girls, I would suggest that you don't size down. The zipper in the back is also very visible, which isn't a feature I particularly enjoy.  That said, this dress is DARLING, and wellworth the purchase.

review_summary: This dress was so cute on
review_text: This dress was so cute online and even when I first took it out of the box, but on me, not so much. With me being taller and with the shape of the dress and where the waist sat on me, it needed about five more inches of length to be flattering. It was just awkward. Plus, the zipper was terrible. It kept catching on itself even when I didn't have the dress on. Also, the collar was super wrinkled and wonky looking when it arrived, though I'm sure a good ironing would remedy that. This dress is a nice idea but just didn't work in reality.
This dress is adorable! It definitely runs large so the xs was the right choice for me and fit perfectly (normally I would have opted for a small).  Love the collar and the bright red!
This dress is adorable! The fit is nice, the fabric is thickish so it will be a nice fall dress.  The small fits a little loose on my waist but it still looks nice.

This dress is really feminine and fun, and the sale price point is crazycheap for the label.  Just keep in mind that this brand's sizing tends to run big, actually sometimes it runs HUGE.  I often usually wear a 4 or 2 and always take 0s in Donna Morgan. There is a bit of stretch in the fabric.  Buy a size down (maybe even two sizes down) or the shoulder elastic will be way, way, way too roomy.

The dress is running large. I bought 6 is just for safe as it's final sale. I ware 48, some times 10, depends on brand and cutting. I should buy a 4 for this dress, plus the bardic is kind of stretchy. I love the drama of the ruffled shoulder piece and the thin waist, but this dress is not cutting right on the waist line. It can be hide by the sash, but better dealt by tailoring. As I am kind of lazy, I found a wide belt can just fix the problem.The dress is long, 15cm pass the knee, so it looks a little bit heavy. I wish it just hitting the knee, then it looks more cute.

Disappointed when I tried it on that it was slightly big on me in the top area. I really could have just used a size smaller but I got the smallest size available. I plan on wearing this for my birthday and I really like it so I plan on getting it tailored.

review_summary: This is a really pretty d
review_text: This is a really pretty dress but it's all misshapen. The zipper gets hung up right at the seam at the waist, the top is huge and doesn't sit at all right and the waist is way too small. The lace seams are pulling apart all around the shoulders also.  This is a very disappointing dress.

I bought this dress because it looked gorgeous in the pictures, and it is a beautiful dress. However, it is way too big. Unfortunately, I cannot wear this dress and I am out the money. While the customer service representative was nice, they refuse to offer an exchange.  What a bad experience with an online clothing company.

This kept slipping off my shoulders so beware if you have narrow shoulders.  Still looked nice anyway but the top isn't optimally (hehe) designed for the offtheshoulder style.  Too bad because the rest of the dress fit great and was actually decently comfortable as the lining material is soft.

I bought this for a birthday high tea and it was fantastic! I sized up and it fit perfectly. The lace sat a little funny around the chest but it wasn't too noticeable. The only downside of this dress was that I needed to wear a strapless bra. The color is even more magnificent than in the pictures and the fit is great.

I returned this dress. It's a really pretty dress but the neckline is so weird. It looks like it's unfinished. The quality is great and I loved everything else about this dress, but it just look too weird on me.

I just received my dress, I have to say that i loved it. It fits me a little bit tight but it is my fault be cause I gained weight and was in denial. If I had being honest with my self, I would have chosen a large. But usually I am medium.

I just received this dress and it is very beautiful. I really wanted to love it, but the neckline stuck up in a weird way and I knew I wouldn't wear it. Otherwise, the quality was nice and the lace was very pretty. 5'6 and 130 lbs and the small fit well. I probably could have tried a medium but I think it would have been a bit too big.

This dress is my first purchase from Closet London line and I am SO impressed.  The quality is outstanding.  The dress is very well made and designed and made in London.  Please, ModCloth, continue to carry dresses like this one.  It is a nice weight fabric that hangs beautifully and is perfect for any weather.  The tie bow waistline, comfy pockets and golden tone zipper are beautiful details.  The modest and elegant style is very flattering and comfortable.  Seems like something Audrey Hepburn, Jacqueline Kennedy or Kate Middleton would wear.  I'm 5'2 and 105 lbs., pear shaped, and usually wear a small in ModCloth and with UK sizing, the size 8 fit perfectly requiring no alteration.

I absolutely love this dress one of my new faves! I starched and ironed it really well, it will get wrinkles easily but that's a given with the material. The fit was perfect. I'm usually a m/l I went with the 14uk since I'm 3 month pp baby.

This dress is lovely and makes a girl look so lady like. the color is gorgeous. think white with hint of purple. Looks very 60's. I wish it came in other colors. I'm a size 10 US and the size 16 was just right.

I ordered this dress for a wedding. I was actually pretty nervous because it looks so white in the picture and I didn't want to offend anyone, but I just couldn't resist because I was so in love with the dress. I'm glad I did, because the dress was even more beautiful and flattering in person, and it's much more cream than white in real life. I wore a blue cardigan over it which was cute, but by the reception I was confident enough to wear the dress alone. I just love this dress so so much and I now want to look for opportunities to get dressed up to wear it :)I felt the dress ran very true to size, but the fabric does not stretch and I wouldn't want to strain it in any way since it's chiffon; plus the dress looks so much prettier in my opinion when it can gently hang, in a more relaxed way. I'm between a small and a medium normally but I went for the medium and, for these reasons, I'm really glad I did. Basically, if you're not sure which size to get I would suggest getting the bigger size :)

I bought this for an agency fundraiser, ordering a size larger than my measurements based on the comments here.  It was still too tight to zipper.  It fit if I put it on without unzipping it, but the bust didn't fit right without a bra.  I had to have a friend remove the zipper, and she sewed it back up using the large seam allowances that were thankfully there.  Otherwise, we would have been adding grommets and ribbon to tie it up, because I didn't have time to do an exchange.  I definitely recommend buying 2 sizes bigger.
This just came in the mail today and it's perfect!  The crinoline is built in and it's a nice quality fabric.   So excited!!!!
Very voluminous, looks better with a belt to give more shape. Pretty colours.

review_summary: I loved the style and fit
review_text: I loved the style and fit and I always get compliments when I wear it. However, it may be a bit tight for someone with a larger bust. Also, within the first day there was a tear in the lining

review_summary: It is a little tight in t
review_text: It is a little tight in the busy area. But it is made with excellent quality material. The pattern in too cute and colorful to resist. And the length is great! It comes down to my mid calf. I just wish this dress had pockets!

This is not a dress to wear with a padded bra as it will fit tight in the bust. I bought a L for a looser fit and I am a 36B, fits right with a lightly lined bra w minimal padding.I bought this dress for work and to easily transition out of the work look. This dress is super playful, the colors are more vibrant in person not as muted as shown in the picture. I did not give this dress 5 stars bc the dress is thinly lined and the liner ripped the first day that I wore it, that being said, I would still buy again, but would spend a bit more to reinforce the lining seams at an alterations shop.

review_summary: Not a great style or fabric for curvy girls
review_text: Sadly this fabric has zero stretch and therefore the size small, while a good fit in the waist and hips, did not work for my size D bust. I could barely get it over my shoulders and it completely flattened my chest. It also weirdly pouched out at the waist, but I'm not sure if that was just because of my more athleticallybuilt body type. Super cute, but not something I can pull off.
Just fits weird and baggy in the breast area. Massey me look fatter. It's a lot cuter on the model. So if you weigh 110 lbs. I'm sure it will be great

review_summary: It's OK. It's a decent le
review_text: It's OK. It's a decent length. I wish the knot was better placed  it feels a bit awkward.
Bought this for my businesscasual office. Love the length, it is definitely appropriate. Very flattering, easy to work with, and comfortable.

This dress is amazing!  I love that you can wear it with the belt or without depending on what look you are going for.  It can be super casual, or dressed up with some fun accessories.  It's so lightweight and comfortable.  The strap length is adjustable since you can tie them as short or as long as you need in the back.  Normally, I don't like midi length skirts/dresses, but with the handkerchief hemline it works well on this dress.  Normally, I wear a size medium because of my lower body, but because this has such an aline shape I fit in a small.  I reviewed this as a ModCloth employee.

I tried ya'll, I really did, but I just could NOT figure this dress out. It seemed cute, but very large on me. However, due the ties, I thought I could adjust it and make it fit me better. But I fiddled with it for 20 minutes and it never laid right. Either it came down too low under my arms, or came down too low in the back.  It just didn't look flattering without the waist tie either.  The print is super adorable though! Just wish it was a little less fussy.

Very comfortable, doesn't wrinkle easily, so great for travel. The color was an ivory for me. Hits right at the knee for a petite. There is give in the fabric at the waist and chest, so if you're on the line between two sizes ( like I was) don't be afraid not to size up. The fabric is slightly textured, which I feel gives it a dressup factor if desired. I paired it with some leggings for a more casual look as well. Versatile piece.

This dress is just as featured. It has a bit of stretch and camouflaged my stomach that I'm always trying to hide. I wear it to work then to a party at night. The quality isn't the classiest, but no one can tell just by looking at it!
The color is more of a peachy hue than an ivory like the photo. Still an amazing dress. It will show through for dark fabrics or tight undergarments, but overall it's a winner for me!
look closely, the pattern on the top half is off center to the bottom half. returned.
This dress fits me perfectly well.  Love the color

review_summary: It's a lovely dress! I ju
review_text: It's a lovely dress! I just thought it was a bit tight on me as it revealed my lumps and bumps (other than the belly,  since it was an A\tline dress) more than I would have liked. It should be fixed with some shapewear.

review_summary: Just be warned that the p
review_text: Just be warned that the pictures look black and white, but the white is more of a cream, beige almost. Still lovely and comfortable and fits wonderful, but if you want something white I wouldn't go with this.
This. Dress. Is. KILLER!!  I'm not one for using the word slay but that's what a bunch of people said to me the first time I wore it!

I am a college instructor and wore this with black tights, a punkstyle belt and cat heels (also from ModCloth) and I got a ton of compliments on this dress. The fit is lovely, and extremely flattering. Buy this dress and you will look flawless!

This is a beautiful dress and will be great for the workplace. The dress has stretch and hides all my imperfections. The only negative is that it is a much darker cream color than what is pictured. Looks almost white in the photo, but it is almost a bone color in person. Other than that, it's a very cute dress.

I expected a different dress than the one I received. I do agree, it's a bit darker, darker than cream, but that's not it. I was expecting a different material, thicker, stiffer, more like a Closet Luck be a Lady style. It's very thin, and I missed the over the head versus a zipper setup. It fits nicely, but I'm not in love with it. It'll be nice for days where I'm not feeling very motivated to get dressed up, but I need to be anyway, so I'm holding onto it.

review_summary: I wanted to like this dre
review_text: I wanted to like this dress, but it was a big disappointment. Unfortunately the material was too stretchy and felt very cheap. It runs large, and although it seems to have a flattering silhouette, the waistline fell just a bit too high and ended up making me look large.

I got so many compliments on this dress at the wedding I went to. It's very flattering for those like me with a bit of a belly, however I did purchase a petticoat to wear under it to help smooth things out and add a little extra flare at the bottom.
So gorgeous and unique!

ModCloth has an impressive collection of Aline dresses, and this like the others is incredible.  The print is adorable and the fit is super flattering, especially for a pearshaped body like mine.  The only thing I don't love about the dress is the material, doesn't seem very sturdy if that makes sense.
I got lots of compliments on this dress. It's dressy looking but comfortable for allday wear.

I agree with another reviewer about the oddness of the prints not matching up on the bodice and the skirt. It's a pretty dress, but I felt that the price was a bit much to ask for the quality. I returned it, but if you get it on sale it would be a better value.

review_summary: I love the look of this d
review_text: I love the look of this dress on the model however I thought for the price the dress itself would be thicker. I mean the quality is good and I was aware from the photo the pattern does not line up. I am debating keeping this however b/c I am wicked pale and I am not sure the cream color looks so good with my skin.

This dress is beautiful and very comfortable to wear!!! The description says it is cream and black but the dress is a darker cream than my monitor showed. Not a problem for me...just an observation. I feel like I'm channeling my inner Duchess of Cambridge when I wear it!

review_summary: This is a Gilli dress, wi
review_text: This is a Gilli dress, with typical Gilli cut and material quality for better or worse. The material is thin, and unlined, contrary to my expectations. The biggest differencce between this and other Gilli dresses is that it runs borderline large. I ordered a small, and it was very loose around the rib cage and bust.Overall not impressed. With higher quality/thicker material, this would've been a beautiful dress. The whitishcream is a true biscuit/cream color in person.

I really love this dress.  The fabric is stretchy and comfortable.  It fits me perfectly.  It is classy and flattering. If you want tons of compliments and where did you get that!? Then this dress is for you!

Took a chance with this dress since it was on sale & I'm glad I did! The color is great & the pattern is even better in person, just like the inside cover of an old book. I wear a 16 and found the 1X fit well. There is a bit of underboob fabric, as the other reviewer mentioned, but it should be easily fixed with an interior dart. Overall I'm very pleased.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much I tried it twice...but though it's great for a tummy it accentuated my hip fat too much to ignore.  Great dress otherwise.

This dress is awesome!  It does resemble an oversized sweater in feel.  I find sweaters normally make me feel frumpy, but this one really highlights my curves well.  I'm normally in between a small and medium and I went for the medium and am so glad I did.  It is slightly too large on top (in the chest and shoulders area, which is uncommon for me), but when I knot the tie, it pulls the fabric on bottom tighter.  I have bigger hips and a booty and I think the small would be too tight.  I would probably recommend sizing down only if this is not a concern for you.I wore this as a dress, but you could add some leggings for work.  Due to my body type and the formfit, I will probably not be wearing this one to work myself.  Overall, awesome winter addition to my wardrobe!
Perfect dress for work and to go out.

I'm so happy I pulled the trigger and bought this dress! I was nervous and contemplating sizing up after reading previous reviews that said the dress ran small and wouldn't zip up, so I took a quick bust measurement and reached out to one of the stylists through the live chat feature (thanks Franny!) to be absolutely sure that it would fit. Turns out, my normal size works just fine in this dress, but I do have a smaller bust, so if you're fuller in that area, I'd size up, or better yet, use the live chat to make sure you'll be happy with your purchase. But really, this dress is probably my new favorite. Date night, wedding guest, special occasion, you name it, this dress is perfect. Super flattering over hips and tummy without being overly flowy or losing shape. Oh, and bonus points because it has pockets! The pockets do poke out JUST a smidge, but not in any way that detracts from the dress or your figure, just something to note. 10/10 would buy again.
I waited until I saw this on sale.  It's very pretty.  It's a bit tight in the ribcage but not deal breaker tight. So happy with this dress.
This dress fits wonderfully! I?m carrying 10F boobs and they looked killer in this dress! Absolutely perfect for a night out with the girls or a hot date!

I bought this dress to wear to an upcoming wedding. It is perfect and fits like a glove. I am so excited to wear it. FYI, I am 5'6, 30 inch waist, 41 hip, and I got a large. Hey ladies, if you want to feel sexy and look classy (my husband also agrees), then purchase this dress NOW!

review_summary: I love this dress! It's s
review_text: I love this dress! It's soft and feels good. The material has a little stretch to it and I'm really short but it hits exactly where it's supposed to which never happens so I'm extremely happy about. Highly recommend this dress

review_summary: I am usually a small from
review_text: I am usually a small from ModCloth but all of the dresses I have been ordering have been a size too big... this dress fell under that category.. the length was work appropriate and it was nice but I guess if you're tall(ish) and thin size down?

I love this dress...the pattern, the color, the Aline. It's very flattering. I had to exchange it twice and get a bigger size each time. I usually wear 8/10 for dresses...but I could not get the zipper all the way up. Usually I have problems with dresses fitting over my chest, but this was a bit tight through the bodice below chest. I finally settled on the 12, although it still feels a bit snug.

So fair warning, it has buttons all down the front. I sewed it together up to about the waist cinch, because I worry about it slowly unbuttoning and me not noticing. The dress is very light and airy. It was longer than I expected it to be. I am 5'10 and it hit me just below the knee. which is rare. The chest area is also on the large side; I don't fill it all the way out as a Ccup, but it doesn't look terrible and its better than having it gape.

review_summary: Bought this for a baby sh
review_text: Bought this for a baby shower and it was a star attraction. Perfect, beautiful and made me look and feel amazing.LOVE LOVE LOVE ITTrue to size, i went 1 size up for a flowier look

review_summary: Need a big chest to fill out top
review_text: I have a Ccup chest, but my waist and hips are bigger than my bust. Empire waists usually work for me. But because this dress is pretty loose, the chest looked really bad on me  the fabric just hung limp. Also the sleeves hung strangely. So I returned it. Cute print though!

The dress is light but not sheer. The color and fabric looks like the pic. I do not recommend it if you are not busty because it will hang a tad too lose on the upper part. Maybe I would have sized down ideally but I will keep as it is.

review_summary: I love the pattern of thi
review_text: I love the pattern of this dress. It's really cute on. I really like the 3/4 sleeves and the lining is great. The only things keeping this from 5 stars are..The top is baggy on me as an ibtc member.I don't know if I like the weird neck trim? It leaves a little triangle right above the buttons. Maybe this would look better on someone who filled out the top more? Idk. Neither of these things bother me enough to return it.

I am hesitant about buttonup clothes because I am terrified of gapping, but this dress falls so perfectly on me. I wanted a summer dress with sleeves, and the draping on these ones is lovely. It is a bit big in the bust on me, but any smaller, and I would have had gapping I assume. It gives a kind of oversized feel, but the cinching at the waist keeps it flattering. I love how it flows over me! Colors are true to picture, construction is solid  I am a very pleased customer. In terms of size, I am normally a 16 in dresses, if that helps other shoppers!

I reeeeeeally wanted to love this. Looked at it for months, took the chance when it went on sale. No stretch in this fabric, of course, but the 1X felt way too small. I accurate sizing, in my opinion. Sooooooo beautiful though!

review_summary: Such a pretty print, I wanted to love
review_text: I loved the weight of the fabric, and the print.  It is not very forgiving though.  Very tight around the bust area.  I had to send it back

review_summary: So disappointed, I really wanted to like it
review_text: I'll start with the pros the fabric is thick, the colors are amazing, it has pockets. Cons the skirt hangs terribly...it's rigid and stiff and it might just be my body type but it made me look puffier than I liked. I love the colors so much, it's such a bummer.

I am extremely disappointed in this dress.  The dress runs small.  I am usually a 1x, and it was too small. I would need a 2x if I were to exchange, but I'm not even interested in exchanging.  The fabric is extremely thick and stiff, I felt like I was wearing a curtain!  The pleats also did not sit like they did on the model, and made my pear shape look more like an apple, and I could tell sizing up would not make a difference!  I was planning to wear this at a wedding shower, but I would be sweating in it, because it's just too heavy of a fabric for summer.  The only reason why I am giving this two stars, is because the print is gorgeous.  I wanted to love this dress so badly, but this just doesn't work.

review_summary: Love the print but the fabric is way too thick!
review_text: I didn't like how thick the fabric was. It's a shame since the print is awesome.

The dress is adorable, and the print is super cute. However, the fabric was not what I anticipated as it is a lot heavier. I thought it would be a summery fabric, and not as long. Also, I am usually a six/medium in Mod dresses, this was WAY too big (I wish ModCloth would go back to telling us in the product description how items fit. As we all know, sizes vary by brand). The waist was too big, and there was a lot of room in the arms. Seriously debating if I should exchange this dress or just return it and get something else. :(
I wore this dress to work today and paired it with a blue jean jacket. This dress is amazing. Fits true to size and I received so many compliments.

So, this is my first ModCloth review.  I have some hit and miss with sizing, so reading that this didn't have much stretch I bought a 2X with hesitancy.  Turns out it fits perfect.  I have a large bust (38Dish) and this fits well.  It's not too low cut so the girls don't fall out.The length is a smidgen long for my height, but not atrociously long.  I love the wild colors and print and the fabric is a thick, solid, nonflimsy deal that doesn't show every single bulge and fat roll, plus!  Basically, I'm just plain digging the fit.

I love this print. I've never been able to find Marimekko prints in plus size so I pounced on this. I ordered a 3X since it doesn't have stretch and it was large. I am normally an 18W in dresses and should have trusted the size chart. Reordering in a 2X and crossing my fingers that it works. The texture of the fabric is a little odd for summer and reminds me somewhat of drapery fabric but the cut and print are too cute for me to pass up.

just got this dress today (prepping for the winery wedding season ahead of me), and it is everything I wanted it to be. It fits well, good quality, and the pattern is beautiful (a little more rich/saturated than pictured  but stunning). I sized down per reviews and it fits like it was tailored for me. highly recommend! I'll add photos later if possible.
Love it!
Ordered this for my mother in law. She loves it! It fit her perfectly and was very flattering!!

I sized down according to other reviews and the dress was easily still a size too big.  I wanted to like it but felt it was still too shapeless in the waist and made me look bulky in the middle. I ended up returning it because I couldn't see myself wearing it.
Ehhh not really worth the money.

The material felt a little cheap and the ruffle on the hem seemed more pronounced than in the online photo. I'm a busty gal, so was also surprised that there was still extra material on top  felt a little baggy. Color and pattern are great.
Loved this dress but just too puffy on top. Made me look larger than I am.
Very cute and fluttery, but the top was very big compared to the bottom, not very flattering.

While the dress is definitely more roomy on top than it appears in the picture, I really liked this aspect. It was comfortable but covering enough that I didn't need a camisole for work (my work is fairly informal though). I didn't size down, and because of that, the pink slip underneath didn't show when I sat down (also I am not in the habit of crossing my legs anywhere but at the ankle, this probably also helped). It was a super windy day when I wore this dress, and I felt like I was in a photo shootit was so airy and billowy without being revealing.

review_summary: This was too big large fo
review_text: This was too big large for me, especially in my chest.  The quality of the dress compared to the price was not worth it for me. I returned it.
Unflattering.

I was surprised when this dress arrived because it has a short slip dress on the inside and then the long parts draped over it, crossing over like a robe almost. So if I sat down, the two draped long pieces would fall to the side and I would only see the pink mini dress inside, which was not cute. I sized down to a 6 from my usual 8 but this still just felt baggy and made me feel shapeless. I will be returning.

This is literally one of the most hideous designs I've ever tried on. I honestly don'tknow how anyone could wear this without feeling like an actor from the  90's . I'm usually a 12, but as this is a maxi and I'm tall I ordered up a size for length. First it was still too short by about an inch, then the bust was gaping so badly (even though I'm a 30G) it hung open about two inches, even the inner slip of the gown was too big on me. The fabric is also a little cheap and seems like it would pull or get damaged easily, and the ruffles made me feel like I was either wearing my grandmother's couch or I at least resembled it. Return.

review_summary: Very flowy and I love the
review_text: Very flowy and I love the cut. The colors are very spring! My problem is that a size 10 works great for the bottom half/length...but around the arms was a bit saggy. I feel quite sure an 8 would be tight around the hips.

Its a cute, bright, classic retrolicious dress! The fabric is a little thinner than usual, but was really nice for the hot months. Fits pretty much like the other retrolicious dress I have, maybe a touch smaller, but not enough to make a difference in sizing at all. Totally a keeper!! Fyi, I am always 2x for dresses in modcloth and retrolicious

review_summary: Wore it to Pride, Wear it All the Time
review_text: A really comfortable and nofuss sundress for summer, especially on those hot days. I can wear it without a bra, but it is unlined so some may not be able to depending on their comfort level. Also, pockets!!

review_summary: Great color, nice fit, cheap material
review_text: This dress is rainbow brite and fits me in all the right places. However, the fabric is exceedingly thin, unlined, and with cheap seams (it does not even appear to have overlock stitching at the bottom.) For 90 dollars, I would expect a better product.

I'm usually a size 1618 and I purchased the dress in a 2X and it fit very well. I might have to make some minor adjustments around the bust but other than that great in terms of sizing especially for a plus size girl like myself. The design is gorgeous, the only thing that I was little bummed about was the quality of the fabric. It felt a little flimsy especially with how much it cost. There is no lining on the inside of the dress, but it does have pockets so that's a plus. I see this more as a really light, summer dress.

review_summary: Stand out in all the right ways
review_text: This dress is from my favourite clothing brand, Retrolicious, and it is lovely. Brightly coloured without feeling like a costume, this is a nice cotton dress that works well in the summer. I've received a number of compliments when I've worn it, and it has the extra bonus of pockets. I wear mine with a petticoat for a little extra oomph, which works very nicely.

Love this dress....very pretty and feminine however the top is too big. The cap sleeves keep slipping off and it exposes more cleavage than I would want.  I tried to salvage by sewing the sleeve area but still had to wear a camisole underneath.
It's very pretty but for someone who is not too heavy it was too large up top for me and sat very low.

I really really wanted to love this dress. It was soft, feminine, flowy, and the right length. I tried 2 different sizes and in both the back of the dress towards the top, seemed like it had extra fabric and wouldn't lay flat. Additionally the cap sleeves kept slipping down and it seemed to expose much more decolletage than pictured. It just didn't work for me, and I was so sad to return it.
It's exactly what I was looking for, classically vintage and funky. The fabric is soft and flowy!! Love it!

One thing I will suggest: be careful wearing this dress on a windy day; I had my fair share of Marilyn moments throughout the evening!

review_summary: I love the style of this

review_summary: I wish they had this in X

review_summary: I love this dress!  I bou
review_text: I love this dress!  I bought it for my company Christmas party.  I bought my husband a wine colored button down shirt and black bow tie to match me.  You can dress it up or down depending on your accessories.  It's very comfortable!

I ordered this dress for my graduation in a few weeks time and it's gorgeous. The material is quite thick and feels like good quality fabric that will last a long time. The top does have quite a lot of stretch in it at the sides and I sized down as per the suggestions online (I generally wear a size 1416 in Australian sizes). I will probably sew the straps to the back as well as I find the knot from the halter neck is a little uncomfortable but I'm not used to wearing this style of dress. You could definitely get away with not wearing a bra with this as there is double thickness in material at the front, but I'll probably try hunt down a good strapless/halter one because I'm a little selfconscious about not wearing one. Looking forward to getting a lot of use out of this dress!

review_summary: This dress did not work f
review_text: This dress did not work for me. I have an hourglass figure and the chest area did not work at all. It was much too small and didn't line up with my chest appropriately. It's super cute and I almost kept it but decided it was too expensive to keep if it wasn't perfect.

review_summary: FYI, DO attach the ties t

review_summary: Love how it fit! I wore i

Love this dress! A little big in the bust area.
The director of this video picked this dress for me to wear.  It is beautiful.

review_summary: I loved this dress! I wor

review_summary: I ordered this to wear wh

Size Down!!! I am usually an S/M, but I didn't read the reviews too thouroughly so I went with size M. It turned out waaay too big around for me! review_summary: Love it! Glad I had the a
review_text: Love it! review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a wedding with a 50's theme, it took me a very long time to make up my mind about ordering it because I have never ever bought clothes on line, I'm the type of person that likes to see how it fits before purchasing because my body has a weird fit. I read almost all the comments and decided that it was worth a try. I followed most of the recommendations and sized down to an XS however, when I finally received the dress it was a bit to tight around the waist area I ended up returning  for a size small which fit me perfect except the bust area was a little big but I m very small up top so I am used to this , besides you could not even tell. I received so many compliments on my dress and together with my 50's makeup and victory rolls people at the wedding kept stopping me to tell me how pretty I looked and they loved the dress. I was VERY happy with my purchase and will definitely keep shopping here

I originally bought a large cause that's what I usually have to but when I got it I had to return it because it was too big I exchanged it for a medium and it's still loose in the busy but otherwise it's a beautiful dress

review_summary: I have a very hard time f
review_text: I have a very hard time finding dresses that fit my bust but don't then fit like a sack on the bottom.This dress was perfect!

review_summary: This is a really cute dre
review_text: This is a really cute dress, and as other reviewers have said, it runs large.  I typically am a 1X, but the XL fit just fine here sizewise.  However, after a lot of consideration, I've decided to return it.  As a busty lady, I absolutely must wear a bra and one with straps is much preferred.  However, the placement of the straps are much more forward than they appear in the picture.  As a result, I couldn't find any halterstyle bras whose straps wouldn't show at the bottom of the straps.  Second, also because I'm busty, the bodice came down really low, leaving lots of real estate exposed.  A larger size might have fixed this, but would have been way too big in the waist.  It looked okay with a cropped jacket (pictured), but ultimately I decided not to purchase the dress since I could really only style it that way.  My recommendation: Maybe not the best option for busty gals unless you want to go fully strapless for a bra.

I fortunately have long legs so the dress hits right above my calf. Anyone shorter than 5' 5 might find the large hitting at an unflattering place. The bust is only an inch or so too big around, which can be easily taken in. The synching on the back isn't even necessary for people my size, no stretch needed really but it's not an issue. The cotton is nice and light weight but not cheap. Overall I'm quite happy with it.
I like this dress... considered sizing up cause it wants to be a little snug but I think I can deal. It's really cute my fiance adores it and wants me to wear it out asap!

review_summary: It's a cute dress, but un
review_text: It's a cute dress, but unfortunately I followed the measurements entered by a reviewer that were close to mine. Either hers weren't accurate or I got a freak dress, because it was HUGE. I needed about 3 sizes smaller. The stretchy panels on the back are good if you're worried about tight fit. I now learned my lesson and ask ModCloth customer service about measurements.. Hopefully it will save me another return.

I literally ordered this yesterday and it has already arrived!  I bought this dress for my friends' wedding and I'm very happy with the purchase.I have a large chest, so based on the reviews I figured the bodice would be just right on me where on some smaller girls it might be too big.  I was right!  The only real issue is that where it goes from bodice to black waistband, it does squish the girls a little bit (but I'm not gonna complain!).  Also, if you are a larger girl pay attention to the sizing information.  The larger sizes run small where the smaller sizes run bigger.  I would normally wear a 2X, but the 3X was just right.It did take a bit of work to find a bra that doesn't show, and I quickly nixed the halterstyle strap and sewed the existing straps to the back waistband instead.  It's very flattering on me, which surprises me.  Dresses with the higher waistline can tend to make me look pregnant instead of hiding all my lumps and bumps.  I did end up wearing a slight waist cincher underneath to remove a lump caused by the tight waistband.  All in all, I'm very pleased.
Amazingggg

This dress is perfect! The fit was great and I felt wonderful in it. I wore it to Vegas and even got compliments from people on the street. The only thing I didn't like was the fabric wrinkles very easily.

After reading the reviews, I bought a size down, and I'm very glad I did  it fits like custom made! The waistline sits right at my natural waist, the hem hits just below my knee, and the bodice hugs my ribcage in a perfectly comfortable snugbutnottootight way. Very happy with my first Modcloth purchase!

review_summary: I took the advice and ord
review_text: I took the advice and ordered a size smaller. It fits perfectly! Just enough stretch to make it super comfy, and oh my gosh the compliments I got from perfect strangers was amazing! It's also the perfect lenght,I'm 5'7 and don't like anything too short, this came just below my knees. Sheer perfection!! I LOVE it!
This dress fit perfect!! Fits perfect and looks perfect! Knocked my fianc? off his feet :D

review_summary: The dress was too big in

review_summary: I really do love this dre
review_text: I really do love this dress. The shape is lovely, I get all kinds of compliments. I was definitely expecting more structure in the waist/tummy area but it's just a thin bit of cotton fabric there, which bumped it a notch on the quality rating. Other than that, it's fantastic. My chest fits in it just fine with a strapless bra and it makes my curves pretty darn luscious!

review_summary: I bought this for my daug
review_text: I bought this for my daughter who normally wears a 3X. This dress fit perfectly and is beautiful on her! It hides the tummy and makes her waist look smaller. It also comes up high enough that it covers her ample chest! I love it, she loves it, another win for Modcloth!!!

review_summary: I love this dress. With a
review_text: I love this dress. With a pair of cowboy boots, it's going to be perfect at a ranch wedding in August in Wyoming. I plan to buy it in the other two styles as soon as they are back in stock!

This dress does run large.  I normally wear a large and this one is too big.  I will be returning it and ordering a medium. I was disappointed in the condition of the dress when it arrived.  It was extremely wrinkled from not being packed well in it's plastic bag.

I have drooled over this dress for at least a year and finally received it as a gift for my birthday!I was a little worried, after reading previous reviews that the bust would be much to big, since I am usually a L/XL and the size I got was XL. I guess I'm just busty enough to fill out the top, because a size smaller wouldn't have zipped up. The drape and style of the dress is incredibly flattering and the material seems sturdy.My only complaint was that it seemed like the fabric wrinkled really quickly after steaming, but that could have simply been my overeager desire to put the darn thing on.(I had no access to a floor length mirror for picture purposes, but this dress definitely hits calf length. If that's too long, which I may decide it is for me, it's still worth buying and having altered in my opinion.)Overall this is a highly recommended purchase.

review_summary: I wish I had ordered this
review_text: I wish I had ordered this as an XS, the bust is a touch loose and has stretchable sides that accommodate ordering the smaller size if you are an inbetweener like me. I adore this dress and will be taking it in to get tailored so it's just right. The skirt part is full full and a bit too much fabric for me as I'm a wheelchair user, trouble with fit and flare styles but I love them! :) Highly recommend this dress!

I heeded the warning to size down, and the medium fit loose in the chest/ribcage (the stretchy material in the back does this) but the waist is a bit tight. Still, it fit fine, and I got a ton of compliments when I wore it. Can't wait to wear it with a petticoat!
Went smaller as suggested and the dress fits perfect. The elastic shirring at the side makes the bust very forgiving and makes it look great.

This dress fits uber weird but I know once I have it altered, I will love it.  The top is HUGE!!  It will need at least an inch taken in on both sides before I can wear this.  I don't think I would go a size down, however, bc the lower waist is actually a pretty good fit.  Overall, this dress fits weird but I wouldn't return it because it has amazing potential and will be a perfect dress for my bachelorette party!
I absolutely adored this dress and wore it for my prom! Received so many compliments! I wish it were slightly shorter on me but I'm short so for taller people it might not be that bad.

Gorgeous dress!  I'm usually a M and sometimes a L in Modcloth clothing, but the M on this fits perfectly.  I'm 5'10 so was watching the lengths on various Modcloth dresses closely, and this is perfect.  Covers my knees.  Will be worn to a wedding this summer.  Can't wait!

review_summary: I have such a hard time f

Absolutely love this dress!  The fit is perfect and the material is high quality and should wash well. I ordered the XS and fits like a glove.  Am planning to wear it to an upcoming lindy hop dance venue...it will be perfect!

review_summary: I want to love this dress
review_text: I want to love this dress. It's a great shape, perfect length, pretty color... but it's just not going to work for me. It does run large, like many of the other reviews say  I'm actually a little too big up top for a medium, according to the size chart, but this dress is still too loose. And the fabric is stiff and wrinkles easily. I was expecting something nicer than just cheap cotton, for this price. If it weren't for the fabric, I'd probably have it tailored to fit (or exchange it, but the smaller sizes are out!). Unfortunately, this has to go back.

review_summary: I make my own dresses, an
review_text: I make my own dresses, and since ModCloth can be so expensive and I want to buy ALL the dresses, I often use it as inspiration for my own clothes.  This was one dress I'd bookmarked for such a purpose.  However, I lost 20 pounds recently, so I wanted to treat myself, and decided to get this dress.  I LOVE IT!  It fits perfectly.   I saw some comments about how the top is a bit loose.  I've had a lot of problems since losing weight with the tops of my dresses practically falling off, and this one is loads better than those.  Maybe it's a bit roomy, but nowhere near the point where I'd have to take it in.   I did order a size small (I'd normally order a medium) and the advice to size down was correct.  This is a very flattering dress, and I can't wait to wear it for my anniversary this weekend!

review_summary: I loved this dress! the m
review_text: I loved this dress! the material wasn't quite what i was expecting however it was a really comfy fit, I'm going to change the halter neck to just straps as i had some problems with the back not staying up but i think that's just cause i got 1 size too big.
I absolutely love this dress. I bought it for my graduation and a few other events. I ordered a size down, like everyone said to, and it fits perfectly. I'm so happy with it.

My dress arrived today and I could not be happier! This is my first time buying from modcloth so I was very nervous, especially because I sized down as per their recommendation. But my fear was all for naught, because the L fit perfectly. I'm definitely an XL/1X here but the back is partially elactisized so the fit of the L was perfect. The neckline and full skirt is very flattering on my pear shape and the skirt hit me just below the knee (I'm 57). It's the perfect mix of playful and sophisticated. It did come a little wrinkled, but nothing a good ironing can't fix. I do wish there was a hook at the zipper, because the fabric is stretchy, so it's a little hard to zip by yourself, but that's certainly not a big issue. I love this dress and can't wait to wear it to my convication in June!

Larger ladies SIZE DOWN at least one size and probably two. I'm usually an XL in ModCloth sizes, but the M in this dress fits me to a tee. The bust cut is especially generous because the back panels of the dress are lined with wide elastic. This dress is completely adorableoften tealength dresses make me look stumpy, but this cut is super flattering. It's comfortable, flows nicely, and makes my hourglass figure pop. If you don't have a strapless or convertible bra, fear notthe halter ties in the back and the straps are definitely long enough to pin to the back of the dress to cover your bra straps.

I bought this dress thinking it wouldn't work and I would have to return it all while hoping as hard as I could that it was perfect because I really adore this style.Good news, I'm not returning it! The elasticized panels on the back make it slightly too large but that's nothing that I or my mom can't fix. The length is perfect (still showing the tattoo I've got on my leg which is always something I think about). The fabric is light and airy, ideal for the June wedding I'm wearing it to. The red is a little more burgundy than red but it's gorgeous nevertheless and the shape of the dress over all is REALLY flattering for us curvier girls. I'm very happy with this dress and definitely recommend it.

review_summary: The waist on this dress i
review_text: The waist on this dress is so high that it partially includes my breasts, and I'm wearing a bra. If I wear it low enough so that the top of the waistband hits right between my breasts where it should, the low bra I'm wearing is in view at the top. The top pulls way down in back when I sit, showing the back of the bra entirely, and it pooches out in front a bit. With the shirring, the top's a lot larger than the waist, so back it goes. I tried the ties as a dress with straps, as a crossback strap dress, and as a halter, but there's just no way to make it work. Back it goes, alas.
Love this dress. Ironing/steam needed as it is cotton. I would actually love it if ModCloth had more dresses that are made of nonsynthetic/nonpolyester fabric! Love the length and flow of the skirt.

DEFINITELY order a size down with this one! I am usually an XL in ModCloth sizes, but I took the chance on buying a L in this dress, and it fits BEAUTIFULLY. VERY flattering, given how wide my hips are, and works with flats AND heels. I can wear it to campus with flats once the weather's warmer, and still be casual  put on some heels and a nice black shawl and it's fancy enough for a date to the theatre. The fabric IS a little light, so in windy weather be prepared for some nearMarilyn moments. May see what i can do to sew something a little extra into the skirt in order to weight it down some, but on the whole I am VERY pleased with this dress!

review_summary: I love this dress. It doe

review_summary: LOVE this dress  it is ad
review_text: LOVE this dress  it is adorable. I have the XS and it has a little extra room, but not excessive.

review_summary: It runs a very large but
review_text: It runs a very large but the dress is super cute! I got so many compliments! I had to alter it so that it would fit me,. But over all this dress is amazing!

I absolutely love this dress! The style, the fit, the material; all of it is amazing!

This dress is a beautiful color and has a terrific shape. Here are the problems that led to its return: I ordered a medium and it was too large on the top. Like I said, really pretty dress, but not quite the fit I had hoped for. As an overall review of the business, I will definitely keep shopping at modcloth, however, this is the first item of many I have had to return.

review_summary: I am so happy with this d

This dress is beautiful and I was so excited to try it on. Unfortunately I could not zip it all the way along the side. My boobs were too big for it. My measurements match with the measurements specified in the Modcloth size chart for Large, so I ordered a large. But it's too small in the bust. With a heavy heart, I returned it. I won't try the XL because every dress I've ever ordered from Modcloth in XL ends up being too large, even if it does fit in the bust.

review_summary: This dress made me so sad
review_text: This dress is so pretty and I was so excited when I first tried it on and it was actually floor length on me.  As other reviewers have noted, the bust is a little big considering the proportions of the rest of the dress so I planned to have the straps shortened a little and the sides taken in but I wanted to wash it first in case it shrank at all.  Well, it did.  I washed it on cold on the hand wash setting of my washer and hung it to dry but it shrunk up by at least 3 inches on the bottom.  Now it hits me mid shin, which is just a terrible length.  I'm so, so disappointed that this shrank so badly.

The dress is super, SUPER cute. I am a large in pretty much everything. The front is great and not too tight on my girls, but the side is. I can't zip the side all the way if I wear a bra. I know if I size up, the entire dress will be way too loose, especially the chest, even with a bra. The length is perfectly fine for me. I'm keeping it because the general fit is fine and I'll just be getting it altered to fit with a bra.
Snug around the ribs and difficult to find a bra so it requires a strapless bra which is never a preference.  Otherwise the colors were bright & pretty.  Some random strings needed to be removed.

review_summary: Do NOT size up in the smaller sizes!

I'm hoping my mom can alter it for me since I bought it on clearance sale and can't return it! The fabric is so pretty, I'd love to be able to wear it.

SO glad it did!! Seriously, this is at least a full size too small! Ive bought a ton of modcloth dresses in 2x over the years, and this is one of the two 3x dresses I have in my entire closet. At least for the X sizes, I'd recommend sizing up.

I am usually a 1X, but they were out of stock, so I ordered a 2X.  The dress was extremely small in the chest and waist!  I had ordered another dress that was a 1X in the same order, and the 1X dress fit larger than this!!! I couldn't even zip up the side!!  I may try to exchange for a bigger size, but I'm very disappointed.  The color is a little off, too.  The only reason why I'm giving this dress 2 stars is because the fabric itself is nice, light, and airy, and the print is still pretty.

I ordered a med but should of gotten a small, I'm sure its true to size I just greatful for free returns!I love the cut, it's very flattering and modest. review_summary: I LOVE LOVE LOVE this dre

review_summary: The print is to die for!
