Now I sit in here in bed trying not to cry because it will ruin my eyeliner feeling like the fatest Girl and feeling stupid because I bought this marked down which means no returns. Pretty fabric though.

review_summary: I was a bit skeptical whe
review_text: I was a bit skeptical when I read the reviews of this dress but decided to order it anyway because I liked the print/concept. I have to say I pleasantly surprised with it. I chose to size up based on the reviews, and it fits me well. I do agree with what was previously said about the shape of the bodice. It is a bit more awkward than the other dresses I have in this style. But with the right bra, it isn't as unflattering as has been suggested on other reviews.

I bought this a couple weeks ago, and yes, the colors are gorgeous but it's not entirely flattering. The tie doesn't hit at my natural waist but almost directly under my breast. Which would be extremely flattering for maternity photos but not so much on me. I was wishywashy between buying a 4 or a 6 and I should have chosen the 4. The 6 is a bit big. I'm so happy I was able to buy it 30% off.
Just bought this dress and it's so cute. Fits perfect and is very well made.

This just arrived today and I can't wait to wear it! The fabric is nice crisp cotton, it's lined inside and for me it's a great fit/look. I wear size 12 and always look best in A lines. The only issue I have found so far is that the cross straps in back (the X) are a bit loose and gaping. But I dont' think it will be that noticeable and they could always be shortened. I am 5'41/2 and the length is good  hits me right at the knee. Could possibly be shortened a touch but I don't love my knees so it's fine with me as is.

review_summary: Fits well, but lining emphasizes midsection
review_text: This dress is such a great style, I wish I could make it work for me! Fit was true to size and as expected for a shift dress, and I liked that the armholes weren't too large. It wasn't too tight in the hips like some shift dresses are, but the lining was thin and emphasized my little tummy pooch, and the lace overlay did nothing to hide it. It seems to be good quality though, just wasn't flattering on me.

review_summary: This is a cute dress. It
review_text: This is a cute dress. It fits well, but take care because the fabric pills easily.

This dress has a real '40s feel to it and is incredibly comfortable. I am a size 12 in conventional retail sizing and XL according to the ModCloth size chart. I got this in XL, but could definitely have sized down to a L. (It would be nice if Modcloth gave actual item measurements, because the sizing can be rather inconsistent) However, the wrap style is forgiving and it still looks great. The armholes are curiously large, but that lets my pits air out, so it's not too bad. I'll be interested to see how it launders  I'm not sure about ironing polyester crepe...

review_summary: I love this dress it fits
review_text: I love this dress it fits great and the quality is excellent. Absolutely worth the money. This is my first purchase and I will be a return customer:)

This dress runs very big. I'm usually a medium in dresses and exchanged it for a small. Even with the small, I felt like I looked bigger in the hips and stomach than I am after seeing pictures of me in it. A lot of fabric that can't seem to be wrapped tight enough. I wish I had gotten an XS or just went with a different style for my body type. The waist sits pretty high.

I just bought this dress for a party on Saturday.  It is the best dress I have ever purchased!! I am a 16 with a larger bust (38DD).  This dress makes me look a size smaller.  No joke!  It is sexy and feminine without being fussy.  It is very, very cool and I feel like a million bucks!!

review_summary: So Cute and so worth it!
review_text: Bought this dress for an overseas vacation, and I absolutely love it. Very comfortable and extremely well made. I'm 5'2 with a long leg and the length was perfect. Taller ladies may find it shorter. I have wide shoulders so the capped sleeve was probably more snug than most, but very confortable. I ordered a medium and I average a size 8 in dresses.
I have small breasts compared to my waist and hips, so although it fit my 40 waist, it did NOT fit my boobs.  It was baggy in the bust area.  Oh well.

I am a size L according to the Modcloth size chart and this true wrap dress fits over my 34F girls perfectly with no bra peaking out from anywhere.  The dress is lined and the wrap portion wide enough that you won't flash anyone in a breeze.  Purchased the navy floral print and wore it to work Memorial Day weekend to compliments from both coworkers and customers.

I love this dress, and it fits like a glove!  The fabric is gorgeous and thick  the dress is well made and fully lined.  The only reason I am deducting a star is because the zipper will not stay zipped unless the hook is hooked.  Also, since the hook is under the armpit, it is nearly impossible to hook yourself.  But, I'll just have someone hook it for me  I'm keeping this dress!  One last thing  I am 5'8 and the skirt comes right to the floor if I'm not wearing shoes.  If you are shorter, this dress will probably be too long.

Not for pears.The hips and waist area fit really well but the bust was huge. Had to return it. Also as mentioned by the other reviewer, the dress is heavy and full lined so definitely not a the light sun dress it looks like in the photos.

This dress is very pretty and flattering on the body.  I am on the larger side of the 4X, and it fits well. The bust area is a little large, but that is always a problem for me. The straps are adjustable which helped with the fit.  The fabric is very heavy, so I will not be wearing it in hot weather.

I purchased this dress in the ghost print because let's face it...the print is so DARN ADORABLE! I wear either a small or medium dress in the Modcloth label. I bought a small this time. While the slip lining is stretchy, the shell has zero stretch. I could zip it but there wasn't a lot of breathing room. I waited until the medium came back in stock. This fit & flowed so much better. There wasn't any struggle to zip the delicate shell (since it has a side zipper) & it hugged my curves perfectly. It's office appropriate where my cleavage isn't popping out. I absolutely LOVE the way this fits. I received a ton of compliments from ladies AND men. It pairs great with a Charter School cardigan. Even though it may have a Halloween seasonalfeel, I'll be wearing this year round. It's one of those hidden prints  you have to really look to see that the pattern is littered with bootiful little ghosts. I also purchased the Detective & Violet prints in this dress. Let the wearing begin & the compliments pour in!

I really like this dress.  The neck cut out is interesting and can be worn open or closed.  It's very light and flowy and I feel like it would be a great traveling dress that would just shrug off suitcase wrinkles. My photo doesn't do it justice, it looks much better in person.

I felt beautiful and confident in this dress! The small was a bit tight on my bust, so I could have gone with a medium, but I feel comfortable in the small so I think I picked the right size. Wish this dress could have been in natural fabric; alas, I still love it!

review_summary: This dress is so much bet
review_text: This dress is so much better than I expected! I'm normally an XS or S in dresses, and since this is the Modcloth namesake label, I decided to go with the smaller of the two. I'm so glad I got an XS! The waist sits perfectly at my natural waistline, and the cutout really flatters my smaller bust. This may be my favorite Modcloth purchase yet!

review_summary: Great fit with high impact color!!
review_text: I recently bought this in purple and wore it to work today. I've received so many compliments on this dress, mainly great colortype comments! I love the pleated/button detail on the front. The cut out created from the color is business appropriate and I'm pretty busty. The opening stops right above my cleavage. I normally wear a medium or large and the large fits like a glove. Super cute with the cropped cardigan!
I bought this dress dress for a pub crawl event. It is easy to dress up or down and it was so comfy!
Love this dresscan dress it up or down. Super flattering!
Great quality, perfect length, new closet staple. Can easily be dressed up or down, very comfy, and held up in the wash.
GET THIS DRESS!!!  the fit and cut are perfect  i feel so pretty and girly...

review_summary: I adore this dress! It fi
review_text: I adore this dress! It fits so nicely and hugs my shape perfectly. I love the casual retro style and the print works beautifully with any green landscape. If they had this in other patterns, I'd buy them all!

Bought a 3x. I'm typically a large 2x, small 3x but...   I am Swimming in this  its way too big. Has short (34 inch?) zipper in the back, which didn't need unfastening to get on. Mostly droopy under the arms. The cut seems flattering though so I'm exchanging for a smaller size. Length was great, I'm 5'7 and it covers my knees. Fabric is silky but breathable.

The dress is BEAUTIFUL  the fabric is exquisite, the lace is gorgeous, and it feels wonderful on.  However, be aware it can run big.  I bought based on the Modcloth chart for my waist size, and it?s HUGE up top.  Fits my waist a little loose, but that?s okay  means I don?t have to wear shapewear. The straps are pretty long, too, so if you?re short busted and short waisted like me, you?ll need alternations. Its nothing my seamstress can?t fix, though, and I got it for a steal!
This dress is so Beautiful! The quality is great and the fit just right! You might have to adjust the straps a bit since they're a bit long. Over all i love it and promise it's a great buy!

I really love this dress however the bodice doesn?t fit quite correctly it?s a little loose at the sides of the dress as shown in the pictures which makes it feel a bit uncomfortable as if when you bend over you?ll show your bra I fixed this by wearing a wrap around cardigan with it The material is really good quality and the dress length is perfect

Thicker material than expected, with a lining! Yes! Can't wear a normal bra with this but whatever, the design is super awesome looking on, very flattering. Fits everywhere perfectly except in the chest I may have to take it in. I figured for a 1X (size 17) a 40D would be more than ample for this dress but wow, I've never had a dress be too big in this area! Still  I love this so so much.

review_summary: The print is fun, but it
review_text: The print is fun, but it runs very small. From how much gap between the zipper, I think instead of s, I should get a large. I normally ware 48 dress, depend on cutting and brand. So bad, it is a final sale that I can't exchange size. It's such a cute dress.

review_summary: I Love This Dress And The
review_text: I Love This Dress And The Style, the print it's so cute, plus it has pockets. Great summer dress:)
This is an adorable dress, very cute print. I had to exchange it because it ran big. I sized down and it still fit a little large but worked. It's a nice fabric and the tie straps are a nice detail.

review_summary: Super nice, it's was a li
review_text: Super nice, it's was a little roomy and a little long. But I'm not complaining it's beautiful. It's got a pale pink lining which is pretty af. I'm a medium in most things but next time I'd get a small

review_summary: Pretty dress but difficult to fit for long torso
review_text: I was compelled to write a review for this as I saw someone with a 32 inch waist (it looks like they deleted their measurements on their review now),, say they got a medium and it was ROOMY. I don't understand this at all.Last year, I ordered the Windy City dress in pistachio in XS. It was just a tiny bit TOO small for me. So when I saw this was on sale, I ordered the S and M. The small was too small, and the medium just barely fit me. THEN AGAIN, the banding hits RIGHT at my ribs as I have a long torso. It's a pretty dress and I kept it, but if you have a long torso, you may want to go up a size to accommodate for your rib cage.

review_summary: Love this dress. Got it b
review_text: Love this dress. Got it both Navy and Bubble Gum.  Little big in the bust for me. So I took in the bust a few inches. Was forgiving in the waist and hip. Rather be comfortable than a size down. It sits perfectly as is.

review_summary: Cute and Modest and yet a
review_text: Cute and Modest and yet a little sexy perfect for the summer

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a wedding. It looks just like it does in the pictures and can be causal or semiformal! The zipper is on the side, so zipping it over your hip can be an issue. I ordered an XXS, but the band around the waist makes it a little too tight when you zip it (there is no stretch). I reordered a XS and it fits perfectly, but it is a little longer the higher in size you go.
Perfect fit, awesome printing. I really love it. A little tight around my ribs, but I?m used to it cause I don?t fit one size. The quality of the fabric is great.

review_summary: This dress is the least f
review_text: This dress is the least favourite of all the dresses I?ve ordered at Modcloth. The fit is perfect. The print and the belt is quite cute. Its lined and has pockets.The design of the dress is ok but the quality of the material is not good.  It looks cheap.

Wonderful feeling fabric! Very comfortable. Perfect summer BBQ look. The arm holes are a little low; I need to buy a bra that is cut differently so as not to show so much on the sides. I love dresses and cardigans though, so I'm not too worried about it. GREAT quality.

I LOVE THIS DRESS SO HARD! I was really worried that it might be a tad too small (ordered an XL) because I have been eating a LOT of really unhealthy but scrumptious food...but it fits SO WELL. The pattern with the popsicles is SO perfect for July 4, and I love love love that it's 100% cotton. The pockets are of course a plus, and it looks good with OR without the white belt. The *only* downside for me was the arm holes are a tad large (I'm 36DDD) so my bra shows a tiny bit, but honestly everything else is so great I don't really care. I found it work appropriate personally  the Vneck is not too low at all, and since I'm short (5'3) the hem hit at my knees. Now I need to order the geode one...
I recently tried this on at the modcloth store and loved it. The fit was great for my body type, definitely a fun dress for summer.

review_summary: So adorable, I could just die!
review_text: Fit great! VERY flattering! I sew professionally, and can say with authority, this is an excellent quality garment! ??

review_summary: i bought this in a 1X, an
review_text: i bought this in a 1X, and im a pretty standard 1X i modcloth dresses. unfortunately, this was too big in the top. it had extra space on both sides in the armpit area, and a significant enough amount that it looked odd. it was also just a hair too short for my liking, i prefer dresses about 40 inches long so they come to about my knees (im 5'75'8ish). if it fit everywhere else, i could've dealt with the length, since it was only maybe an inch shorter than i prefer.appearance wise this is really cute! sturdy cotton fabric, adorable print, sort of a slightly raspberry leaning red instead of a tomato one. i dont think its worth $85, though, not for a simple cotton dress.

I love this dress. I received tons of compliments on it. It is a sturdy fabric and comes lined (always a plus). I wear and xl in ModCloth brand and this was no different. Fit perfectly. I paired it with the red crop cardigan and it was a perfect work dress. I am 5'5 and it hit just at my knee. Grab this one while you can ~ you won't regret it!

I got this on super sale so it was worth it. I love this dress but I kind of wish I bought two, because like the other reviewers say the mesh part does snag easily. But it's so comfortable and fits so well. It is slightly see through.

review_summary: beautiful dress; worth the sale price
review_text: I love this dress; it is so fun and makes me think of the 90s. I would love to wear this with combat boots and a choker, but I don't own either anymore lol. Very comfortable and flattering. But I don't think I'd pay full price for it. I'm worried the mesh overlay could easily snag on something. But for half off I am glad I got it! I usually wear a 12 or 14 and got an XL, and it fits comfortably (I'm an apple shape). I wish it were a little tighter on top, but the waist and hips are the perfect shape so I don't think I'd like to exchange for a L, though I probably could. Still, I think it looks really good overall.

I usually wear a medium (or size 8) in dresses, and this dress in a medium fits pretty much as it should. My shoulders are somewhat broader, so the sleeves are just a tiny bit tight under the armpits, but not enough to be terribly uncomfortable. The material also seems like it will be comfortable to wear, being that it is fairly lightweight. Good buy for the sale price!

review_summary: I love this dress! I wore
review_text: I love this dress! I wore it to one of my best friend's rehearsal dinner, and it was so fun. Love the combo of stripes and flowers. It has two layers and the outer layer is more like thin sheer mesh making it slightly more formal so you can dress it up. Extremely comfortable.

review_summary: Cute dress but seems really overpriced
review_text: I ordered this in a XXL and the top seems to run large. Admittedly I have been losing a bit of weight, and I am probably closer to a XL now. BUT for what this dress is, a simple sleeveless dress without pockets or extras, I returned instead of exchanging for a smaller size. Don't get me wrong, the print is really nice in person and the stripes are actually under the floral overlay. It feels like a better quality with better construction; however I don't feel comfortable paying this much for it. When it gets to 50% or more off, then I would buy it. TL:DR seems to run large in the top; stretchy; too expensive IMO
I love this dress!!!!! The blue is amazing, it?s so comfortable, and it sits well. I can wear it all day and still feel amazing.

review_summary: Good wear to work for the price
review_text: Color is very bright and pretty and fit is flattering.  The material feels and looks somewhat cheap.  For the price (at least on sale) this was still a good dress to add to my wear to work set.

This was stretchier than I expected but it doesn't feel cheap.  It fit me nicely.  The pucker at the back of the neck with the zipper is pretty significant, but there's no weird bumping at the zipper along the waistline so I'll take it.

I'm 5'6 and 126 lbs, and the small fits me pretty well. I probably could've ordered an XS, but that might have been too tight for work. I love the royal blue color, but like some other people said, the neckline is definitely off center. I plan on wearing this dress with a blazer so I don't think it will be that noticeable, but I probably won't wear it without a jacket.

review_summary: I love this dress! I boug
review_text: I love this dress! I bought it in blue because the green was sold out, but I love the color!! The material is thinner than what I anticipated, so I'll probably wear something underneath as to not show the indentation of my belly button. It fits absolutely perfect, as well. No alterations necessary. I can't wait to wear it to work this week! This is by far my favorite dress I've ordered from ModCloth.

review_summary: XS too large for narrow hips
review_text: I purchased this dress in blue and black hoping it would fit perfectly. The material is thin, but somewhat structured and stretchy  would have been perfect for summer events. The XS was too large for me in the stomach and hips. I'm 5'6, 115120 lbs, and wear size 2426 jeans (depending on the brand). The waist and chest fit pretty well. If you're thin and have some hips, the XS would probably fit perfectly, but my hips were too narrow for the silhouette.

review_summary: I was looking for a nice,
review_text: I was looking for a nice, goto business casual dress and this is perfect! The fabric is highquality but stretchy enough to still be flattering & comfortable, and the color is even better in person. I will say that it does accentuate your stomach to an extent, but it's nothing some light shapewear and/or a pair of tights can't fix. Also, this dress hits slightly below my knees, so I could see it being a little too long on shorter ladies. Overall though, this is a really nice dress that I definitely plan on wearing a lot in the future!

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a wedding i went to last weekend, I felt like a princess in it  it fit like a GLOVE. I can't wait to buy more stuff from Modcloth. : )

Decent enough quality, but the dress looked shapeless on me. My torso is fairly long, and the waistline hit me way too high, and the dress was far too baggy (ordered a medium). My sister is larger than I am, but the dress was baggy on her as well. A host of my friends of all different shapes and sizes tried it on, but the dress always seemed too big on everyone.

LOVED this dress fun pattern, great cut and fit.  Was bummed to have to return it but it was just too short for me.  At 5'10 I'm pretty tall but I think it would work for most people.   Definitely not a work appropriate length for taller folks.

review_summary: I was worried when I orde
review_text: I was worried when I ordered this dress because of some mixed reviews on fit in the busy but it?s perfect! I didn?t even have to wear a bra with it! The length is perfect and I was super comfortable in it! The wrinkles steamed out easily and I can?t wait to wear this all the time!

Who are we kidding, I bought this otherwise slightly boxy dress because of the Dino print. But it's quite adorable  the sleeves have an interesting cut, the dress is lined, the colours are beautiful. Very happy with it. I see that another reviewer added a belt, for sure I'll try that next time I wear it. A little short if you have long legs: wear with either confidence or leggings. I'm 5'7/175 lbs, smallish chest, and Large fit perfectly.

Y'all! This was my first Modcloth purchase, and it's great. I was a little worried because I have a long torso, and most dresses that look great on a normal person end up coming way to short on me.  It's not too short at all!  The length is exactly where I like it to. And the fabric is WAY better than I expected.  It's really great material.  PLUS, it has dinosaurs on it!

I am usually a medium in Modcloth dresses, but after reading the reviews here I went with  a small. It fit OK, but was too short in the torso (and I have a short torso already), rode up to an NSFW level when I sat down, and fit a little tight in the shoulders. I exchanged it for a medium and that fits perfect. Granted, it does bunch quite a bit up top and sort of droops down over the waistband, but the adorable dinos and gorgeous colors make up for it. I tried it on with a belt and boots and it is perfection. SO I would say if your size is similar to mine, choose a small or a medium depending on where you want to wear it. The small did droop less up top, but was just a bit too short and small up top to to be comfortable for allday work wear. The  medium is much more flattering on my body type at least.
One of my favorite items of clothing ever! I get compliments every single time I wear it. I call it my good luck dress. It just makes me feel confident and happy.

Words cannot adequately express my love for this dress  I got it in the mail yesterday and wore it to work today because I was so excited about it. I was hesitant to order a 2x because I was worried it'd be too big, but I should have learned by now that my chest always takes up more room than I count on. SO  if you're busty, order one size up. The waist of the dress doesn't sit at my natural waist, but no dresses really do. I paired this dress with a belt to emphasize my waist more and that absolutely did the trick. I've gotten compliments from about ten coworkers (and even a stranger in the bathroom just now). I don't wear many dresses because of the size discrepancy between my chest and the rest of me, but I love this one so much I'm willing to try to branch out more.
I love this dress! It is comfy, and stylish, and fits great!Keep having compliments about it! Looks great with an orange cardigan. And I mean... it's dinos!
Great fit.  Really flattering. Will order in other prints.

I've had this dress for a few years, it's comfortable and works for many occasions  fancy birthdays, bridal showers, dinner parties.  The split sleeve offers coverage if you're self conscious of that area, and it's just short enough that it looks cute with or without leggings. Never fails to get a comment or compliment once people get close enough to see the pattern.  The fabric of the dress makes it more formal, and as I'm short + busty, it fits like a bloused empire waist. Love this dress.

Been watching this dress for some time and finally decided to grab it! I am SO glad I did! Such a fun print! I am 5'2 and it hits about 2 inches about my knees, so could be a bit short if your taller! The cinched waist is super flattering. My only gripe is that its SNUG across the chest. Not unbearable, but snug nonetheless. With that being said, it doesn't look snug because the way the fabric falls, but it feels snug. Glad I ordered up in size (usually a M, ordered a L)
Love this dress! The length is perfect and the lining makes it a nice weight. It's a little bit baggy/ poofy on top right where the elastic waist is, but I think a belt would help.

I really love this dress but unfortunately it was too big on me. I'm pretty short at 4'11, so the dress was long on me (way past my knees) and the top part was extremely baggy and ill fitting. I have a small bust so that probably contributed to the bagginess, so if you're short like me but bigger on top, it would probably fit fine. Overall it basically looked like I was a little kid wearing my hip mom's clothes. If it came in an XS I think it would've been perfect. As much as I don't want to, I have to send it back but would definitely get it again if it came in a smaller size.
This dress is super cute. My daughter is really into dinosaurs and loved my dress!

review_summary: Very cute! Who DOESN'T want to wear dinosaurs?! :)
review_text: I bought this dress in a Large because I'm both tall (5'9) and busty (30H UK). It fit as I expected it to fit. It is a bit snug in the bust, but not uncomfortably so and not in such a way that the dress is distorted. I likely get away with it because my rib cage is tiny so the elastic is on the looser side. Because I carry most of my height in my torso, the dress ends up sitting a few inches higher than I would like  it didn't pass the bend over without showing my underwear test. But that's what opaque tights and leggings are for! Overall I'm pleased with the purchase.

review_summary: Too short for me. Hit mid
review_text: Too short for me. Hit mid thigh. Sad but going back.
This dress is phenomenal! I love everything about it! I receive so many compliments when I wear it. Everyone should have one!!

I love the dino print! Unfortunately the top was too boxy on me. It is sewn with two layers and with the under later pulled down all the way on the top,  the outer layer was still too boxy because it is larger than the under layer. So because of the way it's sewn,  you can't really adjust the amount of fluff up top.  I'm sending it back, which is fine with my three year old... according to him dinosaur dresses are only for boys!

review_summary: Love this dress with a be
review_text: Love this dress with a belt.  Very easy to care for and hangs out beautifully.  Wish it had pockets.  That would make it perfect!

I. LOVE. THIS. DRESS. As an adult, I clearly needed this dinosaur dress. It fit exactly as expected and hit eight above my knee. The quality was better than I expected and while it says dry clean only I have been able to wash it on my own washer on delicate in a mesh bag with no issues

review_summary: Easy and comfortable dress that always looks good
review_text: I really love this dress. It's super comfortable and looks really smart. It's the type of dress I'd buy in different colors.

review_summary: I have worn this dress ou
review_text: I have worn this dress out 4 times and on each occasion a stranger has commented on how cute it is. I was worried it would be too much fabric and not shapely but the elastic waist hits me in the right spot so it's flattering. I love it, just ordered the shark print.
Cute dress great quality but runs extremely smalll.  I normally  a 4 so I ordered a small. Really tight in the bust.  If you are on the fence definitely order a size up.

review_summary: I love this dress. Wore i
review_text: I love this dress. Wore it to the Museum of Natural History with my godson. I am an XL now so had to get rid of it but would buy again.
I bought this dress a few weeks ago and it deliverers on the adorable factor. It JUST fits my bust with very little room but a size up would have been too large.

review_summary: I love this dress. For my
review_text: I love this dress. For my straight and heavy frame, it fit and looked great.

I've been debating on getting this dress for a while. I read all the reviews and I was in between sizes L and XL so I bought both to try on and return one. with the XL it has enough room for my bust (36DD/DDD) but it was a little large else where. under the bust is some elastic which is nice. the L fit every but was a little snug in the bust. the girls were squished. the large would probably fit a C or D cup better. I ended up returning the XL and keeping the L just because I'm in the process of losing weight and the large for everywhere else. I can try a sports bra to better accommodate the girls. the fabric is a little loose up top which is flattering. the dress is slimming. the patter is adorable! the length is great. I have a long torso and short legs so it hits me above the knees mid thigh which works perfectly! only thing that would make this dress even better would be pockets. let's face it, everything is better with pockets!

I am so delighted to have found the perfect print to wear to my nephew's dinosaur themed  4th birthday party!  Originally bought this dress in my usual size of Large but needed to purchase a size up to accommodate my bust (truthfully, the XL size felt a little tight across the chest too, but was wearable).  I found the cut of the piece to be very flattering and got many compliments!  :)

review_summary: The Dinosaur Dress of My Dreams
review_text: I love everything about this dress. It's comfortable and adorable! Like others have said there is a sheathe that's smaller than the outside fabric, so be mindful when choosing sizes. I found I was more comfortable personally in a minimizing bra, but I did not need one to fit in the medium. This looks great with flats or wedges, belted or unbelted, with regular sleeves or under a cardigan. I will be getting a TON of wear out of it.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much! I wear it every chance I get :)

review_summary: This dress fits like a dream
review_text: I'm apple shaped but really love the way this flatters me. I'm a 1x2x in dresses, but I ordered a 1x and it fights perfectly. Not too tight and not too big. Be aware, the navy blue dino dress is more of a violetblue. Orange still goes well with my red hair though so I'm keeping it!

review_summary: Oh MY GOSH! are those dinosaurs!?
review_text: You will hear that every time you wear this dress. everytime. this is my happy dress. I LOVE IT.Upsides: um. dinosaurs. the sleeves are perfect if you tend to have larger arms or want to move in your clothes. its such a classic colour combo  with the orange and navy. I get compliments everytime I wear it. (and I am not a kindergarten teacher  I am a receptionist!)Downsides: the lining is cut significantly smaller than the dress in the bodice. so my boobs are a bit smooshed. I believe this i both a combination of the smaller lining and my gigantic boobs. I love the dress enough to put up with this (and it fits perfect elsewhere) so sizing up wouldn't solve this problem for me. again  I put up with it because, dinosaurs, people. Dinosaurs!no pockets. this dress needs them. NEEDS. well all dresses do, but this dress would be absolutely perfect if it had them.

My sister in law was wearing this dress the last time we had dinner and I just had to buy one for myself. It just came in the mail and I'm so excited. The print and fit are perfect! I normally buy XL but used my sisters advice and got the 1X. I'm so glad because I have a large chest and this size is perfect. Only thing that could make this dress better would be pockets.

I wanted to like this dressI loved all the pics everyone else postedbut alas, this wasn't meant to be.  This dress fits me like a potato sack.  The XL is also tight across the shoulders and in the arm pit.  And as the dress provides no give, it couldn't be saved, so back it went. I had the opportunity to try this stunning dress on at a ModEmployee event. I was a littler nervous about how it might fit, since the sizing can be a bit tricky on it, but I lucked out. I fall squarely into the XL size range, and it is as the Details say  the XL runs true to size. The fit was absolutely *perfect*! It's just snug enough across the bust and through the waist to be flattering and sexy, without being too showy. The lattice neckline is both sophisticated and fun, and details like that and the bow at the waistline lend a perfect 50'sfeel to this dress. The quality of the material is super high  it fees like it will last me a very long time. I bought it on the spot (as an employee); and after seeing the pics of me, my mom had me buy her the navy version. I can not WAIT for my first opportunity to wear it out!

I originally purchased this in a 2X, but even with the stretchy material, it would not zip up to accommodate my bust. I exchanged for a 3X and it was a perfect fit with a clear strap bra and Spanx. I originally wore it to a Navy Ball and got sooooo many complements! I styled my hair in traditional pin curls, added a flower and totally pulled off a 50's look! Recently, I wore to the party we had the night before our wedding. My husband loves my curves and loves how they show off in this dress! Its a great dress for busty women and it is so comfortable to wear for a long evening of moving and shaking. I cannot say enough!

The sleeves are not too tight, which I was worried about. The only suggestion I will make about wearing the dress is to make sure you have proper undergarments. It does stretch, which can allow for some lumpsandbumps showage. I'm planning on wearing it with a fullbody slip that should smooth things out. Overall, I'm very happy and highly recommend this dress :)

The material does have a bit of a stretch to it, so I'm sure that people who are slightly larger than I am could fit into the XS as well. If you are contemplating ordering this dress, I suggest you do! Talk to a stylist for the most accurate size and I guarantee you won't be disappointed either! The color is absolutely beautiful! The color and material are gorgeous, but the netting stuff at the top isn't attached very well and the bodice will completely cancel any boobs you might have.  I'm a pretty generous C cup (42 bust) and it made me look like an A at best.

This dress fit perfectly!  Reading everyone's reviews really helped with the sizing/fit.  The length was a little long because I'm short, but with some heels it wasn't too bad.  I think it hits a bit below knee length.  Beautiful color and I felt the dress was made really well.  Nice material that is comfortable in the summer, but also would be comfortable in the winter as well.
I have had more complements on this dress than any other! It fits perfectly and can really be dressed up... BUY ME

review_summary: The fabric is a good weig
review_text: The fabric is a good weight, and the color very well represented in the picture.  It is comfortable and hugs my waist nicely without being clingy or showing too much.  The bust, however, is a disaster.  The darts in the bodice, for me, create two pointy bits right over my breasts, giving the illusion of some crazy nip action.  I find this not flattering at ALL.  I thought, oh, hey, maybe it's just because I am on the smaller size (36Bish)...let me do this very scientific experiment where I stuff my bra and see if this pointy trouble works itself out.  No dice!  Disappointed, I struggled with what to do next.  Ordered a smaller size? But the bottom fit very  nicely, I didn't want to push that....by this time, one of the ribbony bits around the collar had become dislodged....maybe I should just admit defeat and return it entirely?  No, I like it too much to give it back  I deserve something nice. :)  To make a long story somewhat shorter, I ended up taking apart the bodice part of the dress, untacked the darts, sewed it back together taking in about an inch on either side....and then futzing with the liner, collar, and ribbons to make it all match up again and not look weird.  Also, DON'T IRON the dress  it leaves the fabric looking eversoslightlymoreshiny.

This dress is everything I could have hoped for! The material is a dream to wear and because of the thickness and stretch is incredibly forgiving. I have worn this dress for formal events but also with a cardigan to teach school. Every time I wear this dress it is almost embarrassing how many compliments I get.

This dress is stunning and worth every penny. I can't express how well it fits my frame, although the material is a little unforgiving and will show bumps and bulges  so shapewear is required. A small price to pay for an otherwise perfect dress!

review_summary: Every time I wear this, I
review_text: Every time I wear this, I get multiple compliments . Occasionally people will come up to me the next day to say how nice it looked!  ( it's odd because I wasn't too big on this particular shade of green)
Purchased for my sister for a bridesmaid dress. The chest was very odd and with the fabric being so thick altering it would not have helped. Definitely for the more well endowed up top.
Beautiful dress! Loved it! Would recommend highly

review_summary: This dress gets so much a
review_text: This dress gets so much attention. I absolutely love it, finally a dress that fits on my breasts!

review_summary: I bought this dress as a

review_summary: I plan on wearing this to
review_text: I plan on wearing this to a summer garden party style wedding reception. I already know it's gonna be a hit! Fits great!

I ordered the XS (I'm 5'4, 115lbs) and it fit a bit big. But I took in the bodice and hemmed the length and now it's perfect.

The green is stunning, and the fit is incredibly flattering, as the fabric is sturdy but still has a slight stretch to it. I was really glad I ordered an XS instead of my normal size, S. Such a unique, beautiful dress. I got dozens of compliments each time I wore it.
The dress fit beautifully.  It was very comfortable and light weight. I am very pleased.

review_summary: I love love love this dre
review_text: I love love love this dress, the amount of compliments I received was embarrassing.

This dress is so lovely! More than I'd usually spend, but I decided I had to have it. The fit is perfect  I sized down, as suggested, and thank goodness! A medium would have been too big. The fabric is nice and has a little give to it, and I'm in love with the latticelike details at the top. Fair warning though, if you have ARMS instead of TOOTHPICKS, you may want to go with your usual size and then have the waist tailored in  as a woman with some upper body strength, I am struggling to be comfortable with the bands around the arms on this dress. Otherwise, though, it's a comfortable dress, and I highly recommend it!
It's a gorgeous color and silhouette. I wish it was three inches shorter, though, because dresses that go past my knees make me look shorter than I already am.

review_summary: I bought this dress to ca
review_text: I bought this dress to carry me through last summers wedding season and it was perfect. It is weighty and comfortable, it doesn't wrinkle much after sitting in it off and on for hours and it is super fun to dance in! I'm a curvy hourglass and the cut was perfect for me. The fabric is stretchy and really enhances your figure. The sleeves don't stretch much and were a little tight on my arms but it looked okay and wasn't terribly uncomfortable. I got lots of compliments. I didn't size down and it was a good fit. Not my usual size but definitely my Modcloth size and true to the chart.Just a note: It was flawed when I received it (the netting was a little frayed where it attaches to the bust line) but I didn't have a time to exchange it so I fixed it myself.

review_summary: Wow, I feel like a 50?s r
review_text: Wow, I feel like a 50?s rock princess in this dress. I am totally in love and found that it was flattering in all of the right spots. I wore it for Easter and my cousin?s wedding and it was just perfect! I have a large bust, so the fit was great there, but I imagine those with a smaller bust may want to size down as besides the waist, this is the only formfitting part of the dress. Seriously contemplating buying this in more colors if it wouldn?t make me look like a nut to wear them everywhere!

I can slip the large on without unzipping it, and the mesh and band of fabric on top do not lay flat, but rather kind of wrinkle up and I think this is due to it being a bit too large. Bustier girls, don't be afraid to go for a smaller size, the fabric is stretchy.

I am longwaisted for my height and even the waist falls below my natural waist.It's very cute and well made and if they had XXS I would certainly buy it.  Boo size inflation!

review_summary: I wore this for my weddin
review_text: I wore this for my wedding last year on St. Patrick day.  It was a bit snug but I think Canadian and American sizing might be different. I love the style and colour.

New to ModClothThis is my first purchase, but not my last.  My daughter and I were looking for a dress to wear to a Tea Party.  Both of us purchased our dresses at the same time.  Her dress is Haute Here in The Field. According to the size suggestion, my dress runs a little large.  I usually get a large but I ordered a size down, as suggested, and it was perfect.  The color is outstanding, and the fabric is worth the money. The length was a little long for my taste (almost down to my ankles because I'm only 5' 2), but that wasn't a problem, because I hemmed it up to my knees.  I received many compliments on the dress, that day. It made me feel real girlygirl.  As you can see, I tried to keep with the 60?s look by teasing up my hair and having flipped ends.  My accessories (tear drop earrings, bangle, purse and strappy shoes) were soft pink.  My daughter is in the picture with me in her new dress too.  She also loves her dress (you can see her review in the Haute Here in The Field review section)  Thank you, ModCloth for making our day special.Margo

review_summary: I wore this dress to our
review_text: I wore this dress to our company holiday party and I am positive I received more compliments than any other woman in the room.  The color is lovely and the fit was perfect, I am glad I read the reviews first and decided on the medium instead of the large.  It has the vintage vibe I was going for with the additional benefit of being totally comfortable.  Looking forward to wearing it again.

review_summary: You know those items of c
review_text: You know those items of clothing that just make you feel GOOD when you wear them?  Like, you can just trust you are going to look beautiful, are comfortable, and get tons of compliments?  Yeah, this dress.The fit: the fabric is very stretchy and forgiving, yet not flimsy at all.  The bust area is a little finicky, as the way the lattice collar falls depends on how well your boobs fit.  I think mine were just a little on the larger size so the lattice didn't lay flat.  That said, it wasn't that noticeable or a deal breaker by any means.  I have big hips and the dress is really good at highlighting my waist and minimizing my hips.The length: I'm 5'45'5ish and the length is a little long, definitely too long to wear this with flats and even kitten heels.  I much rather this though than too short!  With a pair of heels it works out just fine.So yeah, I love this dress!  It's so classy yet young and I can't wait to wear it to so many different places!

review_summary: I love, love, love this d
review_text: I love, love, love this dress. I wore it to an auction and got a ton of compliments on it. It was a bit tight on me around the waist and bust, but not too bad.

This dress fit me absolutely perfectly! On my frame it has a fantastic slimming effect. The fabric is nice and airy and the detail at the top of the dress is so intricate and beautiful. I am so pleased with my purchase!

I love this dress! super flattering, and makes the most of my curves.took a little work to find a bra that worked for me, but totally worth it.  I got so many compliments, and people asking where I got it
This dress runs slightly larger than true to size.  The material is also a bit stretchy, but it fits well.  I love the way it looks with a crinoline.

This dress is very flattering! For girls with curves it is a real twirler and my favourite kind of shape. I have bought Bettie Page dresses before and the material is quite thick and stretchy, almost like a bathing suit. I like it, though, as it makes me feel comfortable and secure. The colour is a little darker than it is in the pictures, but I have found that to be the case with everything from Modcloth. When the dress arrived it was VERY creased and I will have to iron it well (on the inside, I imagine) to get those out, but I suppose travelling to Australia will crease most things! Also, the armholes are a little tight on me, but I have large upper arms so that was to be expected. I will wear it with a cardigan anyway because of my insecurity over my arms and I could even let them out a bit if need be, but they aren't so tight as to cut off circulation. Bustwise, this fits me snugly, but in no way does it flatten out my breasts. As I said, it is extremely flattering and makes me look even shapelier than I am. Lovely. Great length for tall girls too. Also, it has to be said  I am so happy to see beautiful women of all shapes and sizes being able to wear the same dress, it's a wonderful thing! Thanks, Modcloth, keep it up.

review_summary: This is such a great dres
review_text: This is such a great dress! It's flattering and fun. My husband even said that it's his favorite dress that I wear :) Can't wait to wear it to some weddings this spring and dance and twirl in it!

review_summary: I bought this dress to we
review_text: I bought this dress to wear to a Christmas party and it did not disappoint! I received sooo many compliments :D Very rarely do I find an item that follows my curves so well!

review_summary: I loved this dress! I bou

review_summary: I decided on a small beca

review_summary: I have been eying this dr
review_text: I have been eying this dress for months and after a 20 pound weight loss and a wedding to attend I recently bought this dress in 3 sizes  XL (the correct size based on sizing down recommendation), 2XL (the correct size based on chart), and 3XL (the only one available at the time). The 3XL was too big, as expected, but I could see the dress' potential. the next shipment included the other two sizes. I actually found the 2XL to be smaller in the shoulder and chest area (which I usually need) than the XL, but slightly larger in the waist so the dress hung just right. The material is very comfortable and the dress has a lot of twirl to it (great for a dance floor). I got tons of compliments at the wedding from little girls all the way to the grandmother of the bride. I felt like a princess and cannot wait to wear this dress again!

review_summary: I was so excited for this

I totally recommend buying it and seeing if you happen to have the sort of figure it flatters, but in the event that it doesn't work out, be prepared for a bit of heartbreak as you fold it back into the return box.

This dress fit perfect in the waist, but was huge in the bust and was falling off my back. I might have been able to go for an XS if it had been available. Very cute on the hanger but didn't work on me.

I love the interesting neckline on this dress! At first I was worried it would be too costume looking to wear for real. But I wore it to a wedding and got a ton of compliments. Definitely size down like everyone says.

review_summary: I love this dress!  It is

Gorgeous! Stunning! The perfect green dress I've been looking for! I'm a Medium and I ordered a Small based on reviews and that was definitely the right decision.

review_summary: I love this dress. I wore

It is a little tight in the top, but the stretchiness of the fabric makes it still a very wearable dress. great  dress, much greener in person

love love love the dress... unfortunately i am very flat chested, and it simply did not fit my bust. i am generally a size XS but, as previously mentioned, the sizes run large. this was very disappointing to me, as it is hard enough to find dresses for my minuscule frame, much less this retro 40's style! the way the bust is tailored will make it very difficult to alter, so unfortunately i will most likely return it. :(
