This dress has an amazing weighty fabric that falls very nicely, and the color is very unique.  But it is NOT for girls with small busts.  Even though my measurements added up to a size small, the cut of this dress is designed for a narrow rib cage/big bust situation.  I'm trying to have it taken in because the rest of the dress is so beautiful, but there is a LOT of extra fabric.  I would guess a full B or C cup size would fit comfortably in the size S.  The waist/zipper feels like the perfect size.  Also, I'm pretty tall, so it's a bit shorter than I had hoped  right at the knee as opposed to right below.  I hope I can get the bust tailored because it is really such a comfortable, fun vintageinspired dress.

This is the best purchase I have ever made from ModCloth (and there have been a lot)! I adore this dress. It fits perfect and is wellmade. I wore this dress for Christmas with red shoes and received so many compliments. It's perfect for any season.
LOVE this dress. It fits perfectly  and I'm curvy, so I was worried, but it's AWESOME. My hubby loves it too, which is really important.

review_summary: Based on the reviews, I d
review_text: Based on the reviews, I did size down and bought the XL. Because the polyester fabric was so stretchy, it zipped, but the fabric looked strained around my ribs and bustline in the back. I don't have fat on my ribs, so that's not an issue that losing five pounds would fix. That's a pity because it looked fantastic from the front. I'm sad to say the dress is going back. Busty girls (DD and up) might not want to size down. Go with your first instinct based on the size chart.I will say that the length was classic and graceful, and the warm medium green was very, very flattering to my fair, warm complexion.

I'm 142lbs and this dress was fantastic on.  The arm holes were fitted a little snug, but not uncomortable.  The material is thin and had to be ironed.  The mesh top adds just enough sexiness.   I added a black crinoline with just a little poof and it peeked out from the bottom.  I wore it with black pumps, red lipstick and a little rhinestone barette and topped it off with a little leopard swing jacket.  I was worred it would be a little costumey, but frankly I felt so good in it I didn't care.  I wore it to my husband's company Christms Party and got tons of compliments.PS  it really helped to have the reviews with the individual measurements  thanks to Kla 's previous review that gave measurements close enough to mine to feel confident to buy the dress  huge success and I can't wait to purchase again!

i love this dress. after ordering and returning 3 other dreses in search of one for a christmas party i finally found this. sizing down is a good move i normallywear an xl at modcloth and the L fit perfectly. i have alot oh trouble finding dresses that fir and are flattering on me, and this dress is made for girls who are busty like me. the latches do tend to come undone when you move around i replaced the hooks with snaps to fix the problem works like a charm.

review_summary: I ordered a size down and
review_text: I ordered a size down and the fit was just right; plenty of room for my curves!  The fabric has a beautiful drape; I haven't even worn it out yet but I'm already excited to do so.I do think the ModCloth photo isn't the best representation of the color; it's a slightly brighter green in person.  I think the photo that Kitty posted in her review was more accurate.  Still, it's only a slight difference  worth mentioning, but no more.
This dress is fantastic!  I sized down as recommended and it is perfect.  More like this Modcloth!

review_summary: I can't even tell you how
review_text: I can't even tell you how excited I was to get this in the mail today!!! After reading the other reviews i ordered a size down and it fit perfect!! I bought this for my bridal shower for a vintage 40's theme and it's going to be great! the material is so soft and has some give in it so its super comfortable! This is my second Mod Cloth buy and I'm so happy! Defiantly worth the money!

review_summary: Okay, first it must be sa
review_text: Okay, first it must be said that this dress is magic and it may cause men to fall in hopelessly in love with you when you wear it. No kidding. I wore it to work and I swear men looked at me differently...in a good way.I love this dress! The only thing I can complain about is the arm holes...the sleeves are a little tight for me and I needed a strapless bra which kept falling down. Other than that, the dress stretches a bit so it's comfortable, the material is thick enough so that you won't need a slip and it is sooooooo flattering! I absolutely love this dress!I got so many compliments when I wore it that I want to buy all Bettie Page items!!!

Great, simple but unique, and vintage style dress. The size Small dress fits surprisingly well for me, I usually wear a 6 or 8 petite dress size (I included my measurements), but it isn't quite petitefriendly. In my case, the fit would be passable, but the waist hits about an inch too low for my taste, and I plan to make the alteration. Since the dress isn't lined, tailoring isn't quite the challenge it could be. The dress is simply constructed but too bad there isn't a petticoat liner with a touch of netting for volume.

review_summary: I love this dress. I size
review_text: I love this dress. I sized down to an XS as recommended and the dress fits perfectly. The fabric has just the right amount of stretch. It is a little long for my short legs so I will have it taken up. I am long waisted and it is not very often I find a dress that hits exactly on my waist so I am excited this dress is perfect!

review_summary: I give this a 5 out of 5
review_text: I give this a 5 out of 5 and i can not believe how in love I am! I love 50's dresses for car shows, dinner parties, and more so this dress is PERFECT. This will be worn to many events and i will be getting many compliments. The dress fits like it was made for me. Could not be more happy!

Definitely order a size down! I am 5'10 145 lbs, and the small fits perfect. One of my favorite dresses ever! The quality, shade of green, and the cut of the skirt are what makes the dress. oh and the bow.

As an overseas customer, I was so disappointed when this dress arrived today.  I LOVE it, but it is really just a bit too small.  I have ordered 1 other Modcloth dress @ a large which is fine  but ordered this in an M after advice to size down.  How I wish I didn't listen!!!  A Large would be perfect.  I can fit the M but it is simply not flattering.  Now I have to go through the pain of an overseas return.  And no guarantees I can get a Large anyway, now the dress is out of stock.  So sad.....  :(

Bought this as a potential rehersal dinner dress and was VERY impressed with the quality and fit. Perfect length.. Just decided that the mesh top was not all that flattering. Great fabric, great color, but I will be returning it and looking for something that is just right for me.
Very disappointed that this did not fit! I'm 100lbs 5'4 and usually order a small. I got the extra small and it was still VERY big. Will have to send back :(

review_summary: I bought this dress in a
review_text: I bought this dress in a medium and I regret not sizing down, which it suggests to. The previous review made it sound like there was no need to size down, but I would recommend it. I am 5'9 and about 150 lbs. I haven't worn a small since high school, but the medium was far too large on me. This dress has SO much stretch, and if you don't fill it out enough, it will bunch up in funny places. It is meant to hug your curves! size down!

The colors are just as bright as advertised. 59, 155#, athletic build, usually a 4/6 and ordered the medium. I might have been able to do a small, because the material is loose and stretchy, but it still works great. Wore all summer so still light enough to wear in the heat but the sleeves are nice for a cool building
Love this dress. You could wear it on the 4th of July, or anytime. Great casual dress, it?s very soft too.

I totally did not expect this to work. I bought it on a whim since it was on sale. The color is not something I would normally choose (orange with blue stripes at the bottom) but the fit is amazing. I am top heavy with wide hips and this really accentuated the positive while hiding flaws. Great for curvy girls. I'm not afraid to show a little cleavage but wear with a lined bra since the top half is the kind of fabric that shows all bumps (if you get my drift). The material on top is more substantial than the bottom which is more flowy. I guess I have to order another color now!!!

The material is soft and light weight which makes it perfect for hot humid days in the summer! The fit is true to size. If you have a larger chest the v cut may be a little too deep but a cami or bralette works great! I will definitely be buying more!

review_summary: Love this dress, despite some faults
review_text: This is one of my modcloth favorites yet. It is simple and fun  great for work and also almost fancy enough for going out.Caveats: the skirt fabric is a bit too heavy for summer, and I suppose that the 2X dress is intended for larger breasts than my C cups.

review_summary: Depending on the color it can be good or bad
review_text: I bought this dress in both the red and navy floral. I loved the navy floral one, though you must know the skirt part is very very thin material and you will need a slip or shorts underneath. However I liked it overall, I am short and the length was just at my knee which I like. I am typically an XS but the small fit well, I think this run a bit on the smallish side. The red colore dress however is going back! The pattern in the back was not sewn to match so it looks very cheaply made. For some reason mod cloth does not give attention to this since this happens very often with patterns.

Love this dress! Wore it work today for the first time and I gotta say, I felt like I looked amazing! Very comfortable, and even a reasonable length (which is sometimes an issue with ModCloth). If in question about sizing, go up slightly. But no need to go up a whole size.

review_summary: This dress is very cute a
review_text: This dress is very cute and well made. The cut and print are also very flattering. However, it is a lot shorter than I was expecting. Granted, I struggle finding longer maxi dresses, but this one hit me just above the ankles. I did keep and wear the dress though with a pair of cute oxfords and still got a some compliments.

I got this in black and love everything about it. The length is perfect for me, and the v neck is deep but still looks nice (I have a small bust).  I can dress it up to wear to a wedding, but it's also great for more casual wear or a date. I thought the quality was quite good, but I'm also a fan of rayon. I find it's pretty breathable, and I don't mind some wrinkles. Overall, glad I splurged on this one!
A beautiful dress. The bust was slightly large on me. The front was very low cut.

I love this dress. Comfy as a nightgown but I get nonstop compliments when I wear it. I feel so glamorous! It is a bit tricky to wear a bra with you may have to pin/sew/tape the neckline if you want to do that... but the cut of the dress also lends itself to going braless... I cannot recommend this dress enough! The pattern is pretty much exactly as pictured. The material is thin and cool. It does wrinkle a bit but it has such a I'm on vacay vibe that the wrinkles don't phase me too much.

I love this dress! However, it does fall off my right shoulder easily and I sewed the middle area so that my cleavage and bra don't show so easily and makes the dress also more secure when worn. I wear this dress with heels and platform shoes as I'm about 5'25'3. I was wore this dress before I was pregnant and I still felt good and fitted in it while pregnant!

I bought this while pregnant to wear to a wedding that I was going to soon after my son was born. I wanted a dress that was long, feminine and pretty, flattered my postbirth tummy and that I could breastfeed in. This dress ticked all the boxes. I took a gamble buying it while still pregnant as I wasn't sure what size I would be but it turned out that with the lovely gathers and elasticated back, it fitted me (albeit a little oddly through the bust) while pregnant, and postbirth the fit was perfect! It is a very forgiving style. The print is lovely. Fabric quality is OK but not amazing  what you'd expect for viscose. Construction was good  couldn't find any issues. Overall I loved the dress and am looking forward to summer to return (I'm in Southern Hemisphere) so I can wear it again.

review_summary: Super flattering  not very good/durable material though
review_text: Love this dress  very flattering for my figure and height. Shows some cleavage but doesn't plunge. Got tons of compliments.Only downside is the quality of the material, it's rather light and thin and after a couple of washes it already shows it's not going to be long lasting. Such a shame, that's a dress i'd love to keep for years

Live this dress! The fabric is quite breathable. I ordered a large, but could have gotten away with a medium, as the area around the busy and armpits feels a bit big. It runs long. I have to wear with heels so it doesn't drag. I've gotten so many compliments on this dress! Would love to order in the other colors!

This dress fit perfectly and was the perfect length. At 5'10 I was nervous about the length, but it skims the ground when I'm barefoot. The material is good quality but still nice and light for summer. The sizing was spot on too. I love it so much that I've ordered it in the blue cherry blossoms!

This is the absolute most beautiful dress ever!! I got it in black and I've never been happier with a ModCloth purchase. It's beautiful and flattering. I was a little worried about sizing, but I got a large and it fits like a dream. The back is elastasized so there is a little bit of give. It's very forgiving on my larger hips. I can't wait to wear it everywhere!!

I bought this maxi dress using a gift certificate with some hesitation due to some mixed reviews. I'm so glad that I ordered it...it's so beautiful and forgiving that it is very flattering. I'm almost 5'4 and am smaller on top and shortwaisted. I am heavier on the bottom, but have long legs. So, the length is perfect for me! I could wear flat sandals or 23 wedges. My top was a bit loose, but fits well enough (with a pushup/padded bra) so that I'm not flashing people nor does my bra strap show in the back. An insert (I have, but didn't use) would've helped me to relax a bit and to avoid any possibility of cleavage overexposure. The empire waist band on this dress hits above my natural waistline making me appear thinner and taller. It is very comfortable. I wore it on vacation and did not need to iron it out of the suitcase. I washed it and it still fits perfectly. (I usually hang to dry, but it was thrown in the dryer for a few minutes.) I chose the black dress, so it was not too sheer. I can easily see how the material could be a problem with the other colors. Although the dress is thin, it hangs nicely. It was perfect on a hot, sunny, yet breezy day. (My husband and) I love it!

review_summary: Nice pattern, Strange Fit & Cheap Material
review_text: I had gotten this dress to wear to a wedding, but it ended up being much too casual. The material was much thinner/cheaper looking that I anticipated. It is a very flat, thin cotton. Also, the waist hit me too high on my 5'9 frame, making my waist looks larger than it is. The length was also an inch or two above floor length, which was awkward looking. Definitely not made for taller frames.
This dress is really comfortable and absolutely gorgeous on. I love it!!

I loved the print but the fabric was sheer enough I could see through it even in my dim house. I was able to wear it with a V cut bra and the straps did not show.  Unfortunately I am returning it since the style would be difficult to find a slip for the bottom half.   I got the black and the colors popped and the print is beautiful.  This dress would also be super adorable if you wanted to shorten it!
My second purchase from Modcloth.  Gorgeous spring dress and very flattering!  Can't wait to wear it.

I just got this to wear to a spring BBQ. I love it!I feel like I could dress it up and wear heels or sandals and the right jewelry but I wore it with doc martins and made it look a little punk. It is super cute and has a little stretch. I want it in other colors now! The only thing I wish is that it had pockets! Then it would be perfect. ;)
Very pretty dress! Good quality and lovely print, only downfall is that it looks like it has sleeves online but really has none and neckline is very low.

This dress is so beautiful. I received this is a gift, which I am ecstatic about, since it never appears to go on sale! I think for what you get the price is a bit high. But once on, the dress works some magic. It's terrifically flattering. The colors are more vibrant in person. I sized down since there is quite a lot of fabric and it looks better a bit more fitted especially on top. I now have this color and the pistachio green which is equally vibrant and fun. I would get them all if Modcloth still carried them!
Best. Dress. Ever.

The dress is beautiful, the picture doesn't do it justice. But there are small beads all over the dress that fall of really easily. I pulled the dress out of the box and tried it on and there were already 3 beads on the floor. I ordered a medium first, and it zipped until it came to my chest, it was too tight. I had to return and get a large. But overall, I loved the dress and I'm going to keep it.

review_summary: Loved the fit! I'm very b
review_text: Loved the fit! I'm very busty, and shirt dresses can be a large chested girls enemy, but this fit great, no pulling! Lots of compliments at work :)

review_summary: I think it is a great qua
review_text: I think it is a great quality dress and a steal with the sale price. It hits a little below my knee, which I love and has a full skirt. Only thing that's a little big are the arm holes, but that's not too big of a deal. I also love the really fun pattern and the collar.

I sized down for this dress because my regular size was too long for my short torso. Really well made dress, and the arm holes are cut perfectly   no bra band peeking out and wide enough that armpit boob doesn't squish out either. Flattering and comfortable!
I've worn this dress a few times and every time total strangers approach me to tell me how cute it is.  It's so much fun.  Highly recommended.
Love this dress! It fits perfectly and the colors are more vibrant in person. The quality is amazing as well.

I knew I was taking a risk by buying this dress on clearance (no returns). I'm 5'2 and 140 lbs and bought a small. I can't even zip it. Had a smaller Co Worker try it on. Same issue. The bodice is more like an XS. Had my 15 year old try it on. It fit but looked frumpy. I'm very sad.

The fabric wasn't what I was expecting but it was still really nice. Kind of shimmery and flowy. Sadly, I have too much torso for this cut though so I had to send it back. Wish it would've worked as other than that, it is a very attractive dress

The cherry blossom design of this dress was really pretty and unique, and I really wanted to keep it! I normally wear a dress size 2/4, and I ordered a small.  I could barely zip it up past my waist without feeling like the dress was going to bust open  It didn't help that the zipper was really cheap, as I was already expecting from other reviews.  There is zero wiggle room in terms of sizing, know your measurements before you order this.  The material is also somewhat translucent, so you need to have the right undergarments (the black bra I happened to have on when trying it on was not a good look).

I just received this dress and had been SO excited to try it on. Imagine my dismay, then, when I realized it makes me look like an extremely busty waitress at a stereotypical 50s diner. Don't get me wrong, my chest actually looks good  but I can't think of an occasion when it would be appropriate to wear this out in public. The fabric is also kind of cheap looking.
I thought this was adorable! Very comfy! The quality was great.

I love this dress. The coral color is the perfect tone to stick out in the crowd during spring. The length is not to short, not too long. If you have more of an hourglass shape, this dress will make you look fabulous. The neckline is a little deep, but I have a smaller chest, so I think it wasn't too overthetop. It took me a minute to figure out how to wrap the strap around. Notice how the models shown wear the strap a couple of different ways! I find that having the strap wrap around the front of you is best, and makes it so they aren't uneven when you tie it in a bow.

I really like this dress. I usually buy dresses that are fitted so I thought I was going to need to belt it to be happy with it. I was wrong. This happy little sack dress is so comfy. (Also; POCKETS!)

I was so sad when this was out of stock that I snatched it up as soon as it came back in a medium  and it was so worth it! The color is a beautiful coral and the sleeves are simple and fluttery. I'm a 36 C and it is a bit tighter in the chest than I expected but it skims over my hips perfectly and is so so comfortable. Got tons of compliments the first time I wore it out! So happy.

review_summary: If only it were a little longer...
review_text: I was looking for a comfortable, light, cute summer dress. This fits the bill, except it's a tad bit short on me, and I'm 5'3''. I wanted it to go comfortably to my knees, but when I sat it made me uncomfortable. It came slightly wrinkled, would need steaming or ironing at first. I really wanted to keep it, but I knew I wouldn't wear it if I didn't feel comfortable in it.

Very cute, I love it. I ordered a size larger than I normal would have and I think I could have gone with my normal size. It was a little big but I am still super excited to wear it. I just wish it was a little shorter.
I love this dress but I got the medium and its too small where my hips are and I wanted it to fit loosely like it does in the photo. Will most likely exchange for a larger size.

I am so happy I bought this dress. It fits well and seems to be well made. I didn't realize until I tried it on that it has pockets, which was a nice surprise. The color is also really pretty in person.

I am usually a medium in ModCloth dresses, but the medium was huge on me for this dress. I exchanged it for a small, but even that was a bit large and looked sloppy. The real deal breaker was that the dress is cut so that the sides of the hem rise up higher than the rest of the hem, which makes it look cheap and poorly made and also makes it too short to be SFW for those of us who are on the tall side. The fabric was also thin and felt cheap. The colors and style of the dress are cute, and it was flattering on top, but overall not worth keeping for me.

I bought this dress and loved it. It was perfect for work. Unfortunately, once it was washed (by hand and laid flat to dry) it shrunk up about 6 inches on the side where the zipper is located. ModCloth was great and shipped me another since I loved it so much. I tried it for the second time and the exact same thing happened. Glad that ModCloth is great about returns for these types of issues.
This dress went above and beyond my expectations. I'm a size 16, curvy, 5'1, and it fits like a dream. I'm a children's book writer and this dress was necessary in my wardrobe. It's fun and colorful.

The cut and fit are flattering and the color is as shown. The material is OK, kind of thin, but this is offset by the lining. Gave 4 instead of 5 because it's not cut the same as the picture. The sleeves are not fluttery as shown, and also that bit of gathering shown in the pic is nonexistent, don't know what that's about.

review_summary: This dress is so very cut
review_text: This dress is so very cute!! I love the mod style and it's perfect for summer. The reason I gave it four stars is because the bust runs small and there isn't any give. I bought to wear to work but there is way too much cleavage.
Great fit! Good for just a cute dress but also works for special occasions! I got lots of compliments! I paired mine with some cute yellow heels from modcloth!
LOVE!! The quality of the fabric is fantastic, and the dress fits like a glove!
Love this dress! The print, the fit and the quality are fantastic. It is a teeny tiny bit tight in the bodice but still fits great. It's a nice, light cotton summer dress.

The print and button up style on this dress are really cute.  Fabric is nice.  Fit from the waist down is really nice (love those pockets!) and gives great shape.  As mentioned by others the dress fails at the bodice.  It is a bit large, too much room in the chest and armpits.  The straps are not adjustable and just a bit to long.  At the on sale price I felt it was worth it to get some tailoring done.

I have a long torso and small waist, so I wasn't worried by what other reviewers said about the long straps and tight waist on this dress. And I guessed right: For me it's a perfect fit! The waist is nipped in but not especially tight, and for me the straps aren't long at all. The fabric isn't the nicest but the print is SO good?it's totally worth it. Only one real complaint: The cut across the bust is slightly uncomfortable and not that flattering. The dress is cut almost straight across?a more sweetheart or vee neck would look and feel better on pretty much anyone, I think. Still totally worth it. So glad I snapped this up.

Other than the ridiculously long straps, this dress fits wonderfully.  The bust only just gapes between the second and third buttons, which is quickly fixed with toupee tape; the waist nips in but isn't restrictive, and the bottom just grazes my hips.Love it.

I really loved this dress but it did not fit me across the bust, and I do not consider myself large busted as a 38B. Sizing up would have made the dress too large everywhere else. Too bad, it was really cute, but had to return it.

Love the fabric and print. Agree with other reviewers that the waist is a little tight and the straps a little too long. Would be great if they were adjustable. Will be keeping this because its cuteness outweighs the negative.

As with some of the other reviews I found the bust was roomy and the straps were long in proportion to the waist which fit perfectly luckily (I marked the fit just right though because it's totally dealable whereas a too small waist is not so much) so I'll just make the minor alterations and enjoy the cool cotton for the summer!

review_summary: I love this dress! The pr
review_text: I love this dress! The print and colors are beautiful. The dress has a flattering fit and does run a tad tight in the waist and a bit big in the chest as one of the reviewers states. This works really well for my shape and may for others with an hourglass shape. The length is just about to my knee (I'm 5'3). The only wonky thing is that the straps are long which makes them slip off the shoulder easily. I also love the button down style as it allows me to easily feed my new baby. Overall a win for me!
The dress has an adorable print. The fit is odd, really tight in the waist but baggy on top. The material is really thin. Not worth the price. Sadly, this one didn't work for me.

I originally bought a different wedding dress that was on sale from ModCloth, but it was too small and I couldn't return it. That ended up being the best thing that could've happened because I found this dress instead! I'd been eyeing it, but wasn't sure if the detailing was my style. When the dress arrived, it took my breath away because it was GORGEOUS.Based on a different review, I bought the dress in a M and Lmy wedding was approaching rapidly and I wouldn't have time to do a returnand the L was a perfect fit for me. I'm top heavy, but I felt totally comfortable and beautiful in this dress all evening. I wore a strapless bra underneath just in case and was able to dance my heart out with my new hubby.The dress was a bit long on me, but I'm very short so I think I would've had that problem with most options anyway. I actually loved the length of this dress on me because I thought it gave just enough of a peek at my shoes, which I also purchased through ModCloth! The ivory color was perfect too because I really didn't want a stark white dress.If I did have to critique anything, it would be that the metal hook on one of the detachable straps broke when I was hugging my friend right after the ceremony. Admittedly, it was a very enthusiastic hug, but I thought the strap would hold up a little better. No big deal though because I simply wore it as a strapless dress for the rest of the night instead. Also, the zipper kept getting stuck so I had to get zipped up very carefully.Overall, I couldn't have been happier with this dreamy dress! I have gotten so many compliments on it and I felt amazing in it. I actually can't believe how much it's come down in price now because I think it's a total steal. 11/10 would purchase again!

I bought this dress in an XS after reading the reviews (normally I wear a small, though smalls can sometimes be a little big up top). It is an absolutely beautiful and wellmade dress. It has multiple liners so there are no fears of it being seethrough. As I am petite, the bottom tulle layer did make it a little too bulky for my frame, but I simply removed it myself and it still is beautiful and not seethrough. I am not blessed in the bust by any means, but the XS fits perfectly. Finally, I did have it taken up about 2 inches for my own personal comfort, but with the sale price, it more than accounts for minor alterations like putting in a hem. Great dress, especially for the price!

I bought this dress in both XS and S for an all white seaside soiree.  I expected it to be light and airy.When the dress arrived I was pleasantly surprised by the beautiful textured flowers and stitching, however with 3 layers of fabric, the dress is quite heavy and felt more formal than summery.  I thought it might be worth removing one of the layers because the outer is so beautiful, but once I actually put it on I realized the fit is not for me.  At 5ft3, the hem was basically at my ankles and looked  like a baby doll nightgown .  I'm a 32B/C and the cups on both the XS and S are HUGE. this dress is definitely meant for someone who is tall and very busty.It's a shame because I really did fall in love with the flowers :c

review_summary: I was so reluctant to ord
review_text: I was so reluctant to order this dress because I?m not usually a fan of this style. I am so glad I did!!!! I took the belt off and it?s so cute! It?s soft, comfortable, and easy to dress for spring or fall.

This dress is so comfortable! The top portion is a different material than the skirt, so it forms to your bust which was really flattering. The skirt will naturally flow out and its all around just a really comfortable dress. Honestly, I cut the belt loops off and wear it without the belt, I think it looks just fine with or without and then you don't get that really constricting feeling after you eat a big meal! The fabric is thick enough where you don't have to worry about anything being see through either. Loved it!

I like this dress a lot! It fits very true to size, has a nice amount of stretch, and the fabric is lightweight and breathable but doesn't seem to be seethrough. I really dig the lengthnot quite a maxi dress, obviously, but long enough to feel flowy and pretty. I think if it was the usual mini/skater length it would be boring/basic. The floral is very pretty in personlooks just like the picture. I don't really have any complaints except that maybe the top half looked almost black in person, which bugged me at first because I am adamantly opposed to black/navy combos, but it is navy and it's super cute. Plus, it's so comfortable I wouldn't even mind if it was black on top :P. I'll be wearing this to work all the time, for sure.

review_summary: Love the color, useless belt, it's okay
review_text: The top part is a thinner material than I expected, but it goes with the thin material of the skirt. It's also stretchy material, which is kind of nice. I'm 5'7 with a long, hourglass torso, and the top stops just below my ribsbut not quite at the smallest part of my waist. My ribs jut out a bit, so the belt barely fitsonly on the first notch. If I decide to keep this dress, then I'll probably drop the belt completely. My legs are pretty long, so the length works well for me. Overall, it's a light, flowy, stretchy dress with lovely color (and is comfy), but I'm not so sure that it does a good job of accenting my hourglass body shape and overall curvy body. This is my first ModCloth purchase, and while it's nice and I don't necessarily regret it, I'm not super impressed or dazzled with the fit or style.

This dress has been the easiest thing for me to literally just throw on this hot summer! With the great print, light fabric, carefree elastic waist and drop shoulder baby sleeves, I was in love from the first time I pulled it over my head  the only sad thing it is not so carefree in the laundry department  if I do not ever so carefully handwash it because of the fabric content  it will become an uncomfortable shirt instead of an easy going dress  there is no forgiveness lengthwise for my legs and height (I'm average  not tall), wish it was inches longer so I could relax...
The fabric was very stiff and cheap feeling to me. I liked the pattern and shape but ultimately decided to return.

I bought this dress a few weeks ago in size M.  The top is a little bit large on me because I have a very short torso and the stretchy band sits at your natural waist, but it doesn't bother me enough to not wear!  I am very short but the dress isn't too long, goes right above my knee.  The pattern and color looks even better in person.  Only real downside is that is wrinkles easily if you sit in it all day, but I still love it!
The colour of this dress was lovely, but the fit was quite strange. Sadly I had to return it.

Print and quality are amazing! Beautiful! I got a large (my measurements are (342940); the length was perfect (I'm 6ft) the fit skimmed my body just right. Only complaint is that the bust is proportionally too large. It's an easy fix if you're willing to do quick altering. its worth a few more $ to have it done

I measured up my whole body and ordered the size that fit all the measurements (first time in my life!!) but...it came and was too big. So sad! Because the fabric is soft and beautiful, the dress is substantially solid and feels awesome on, the colour is perfect.

I ordered this dress to wear to a summer wedding.  I just received it in the mail and it is beautiful!!!  The fabric is more casual than I expected, which was good news for me, as I thought it might be too dressy.  Fit is perfect as well, I'm very busty  (36DD) and got a medium, and it fits me very well.  So happy with this purchase!

I bought this a month ago for a bridal shower. It was cute and cut just right for my body type. I sized up based on the sizing chart given. However, the waist of the dress had NO give. You would think a wrap dress would have a little more give and take, but I could barely get it off once I had it on! Overall, nicely made and beautiful, but be prepared to have a friend help you get dressed!

review_summary: Very cute dress! I was be
review_text: Very cute dress! I was between sizes I went up and unfortunately it was still a little small and I couldn't get the side zipper up! Very nice length at close to the knee and would have been a new favorite if it fit! I got an XL and have a 35 waist for comparison!

I absolutely love this dress. It?s so beautiful and I love the material as well as the fact it has pockets. The only thing I didn?t like is that it is pretty big across my chest. And before I bought the dress I checked the measurements and it said for my size it should fit perfectly ... which it doesn?t .. but i guess it can be fixed . It fits the waist perfectly and everything else, just across the chest is the only issue

The fabric is gorgeous thought very heavy and lined with polyester (so it's sculptured very nicely, but suitable for colder weather. Maybe with a cardigan?)  The zipper gets stuck like others have mentioned and it's the way the dress is made, no amount of greasing will solve this. Also didn't like the square top, i think it's unflattering for a larger chest. It was a final sale so can't return it, will probably give it away. The size was spot on.

I LOVE the color of this dress. The dress itself is also very elegant. I bought this dress for a wedding I am going to for ym friend next week. for those unsure of size, I would recomment ordering a tad bigger and if need be, have a seamstress take it in. Zipper does get a little caught, but SO worth it.
The zipper is not able to go up or down at a certain spot so I am taking it to a seamstress this week. Sigh. Hopefully it can be fixed!

I bought this for a college formal event and it worked out great! It's a beautiful dress with gorgeous detailing. The material is a little heavy and can get hot, but it's definitely bearable. Loved wearing this dress!
Thin and clingy so I will definitely need to wear spanx, however the length is good the cowl is perfect and the color is very pretty.

I was skeptical buying this dress as a final sale, but it was worth the risk. I fluctuate between a M and L in Modcloth dresses, but I went with the M because this material is stretchy. The dress is beautiful, lightweight, and a great color. The length is good, and it doesn't show much cleavage. It's a great work or play dress. Highly recommend.

I just received this dress today and I have to say I was disappointed. The material felt very slick and cheap, and the cowl neck is a lot more pronounced than in the images. The sizing was fine, but the thinness of the fabric was apparent and unflattering. If you desperately need a cheap, work appropriate dress, it'll do. I probably will never wear this dress, but unfortunately can't return it as it was on final sale.

I bought this for a friends wedding that I knew was going to end at a bar. It was way too big in the chest, which NEVER happens to me. I ended up having to pin the top close. Also, the stitching on dress was not great. I ended up having to sew a seam down to make it work. The waist strap is already fraying after washing it once. However for a dress I will only wear a few times it worked out fine.

Very nice dress. I really like the fabric and think it looks flattering (as in doesn't show many bumps and flaws). The color is VERY dark, almost black. It is much darker than the picture. The top is a little large on me, especially under the arms and through the chest. I will have to pin the top to keep from showing a tremendous amount of cleavage. It's not too big to keep me from wearing it. If I had more time I would get it altered, but it looks fine for now.I am wearing this to a 5:00 wedding with some vintage heels.
Very cute on.   I typically wear a 14, but ordered a 16 just to be safe.    I could barely get it over my head.    Order a few sizes up.

review_summary: I was so excited to get t
review_text: I was so excited to get this dress, BUT the quality wasn't as good as I thought it would be. The first time I tried it on two buttons popped off. Material was cheap. Better to just save your money.

This dress worked for me. Amazing quality and is lined  always a plus!  Wore this for a wedding (as a guest) and received many compliments. The neckline is adjustable (due to the ribbons), and it looks nicer if you pull the neckline a little higher. Unlike an earlier reviewer, I had no issues with side boobs :) it is a little long for me (5' 3) so I would have to alter this slightly.
Love Love Love this dress!!! Quality is excellent. It's long! I like long dresses. Great for work with a sweater. Great for parties. Great find.

review_summary: Just didn't look right on me
review_text: The stripes on this dress are a very nice combo of colors. The ribbon was also a nice navy grosgrain type ribbon. The fabric is substantial but not heavy, the lining a nice touch and the  drape was flattering. Why I am returning it is because I have rather muscular shoulders and the neckline with the gathering just makes me look manish. The waist is also only 2 inches below my bust line which makes me look more preggers as the skirt hangs. If the waist had been lower, that would not be an issue. I also felt the blousyness of the top didn't flatter me. I guess I do better with a more structured dress. The skirt hung to the top of my foot. Disappointing, but the dress just didn't look right on me. The quality and colors were great though.

The positive reviews are all true! This is a STUNNING dress! It is very wellmade and is quite professional looking. The colour is beautiful and calming. The only thing is, if you're between sizes, go with the bigger one! I'm between ML in dresses and the medium is quite clingy on me. I would send back for a large, but it seems like they're all out of stock. I'm going to keep this baby, though, as it is so beautiful.

This was one of my best purchases. It's a perfect inbetween dress for upscale casual events. It's just absolutely beautiful, and the fabric is great quality. It does wrinkle a bit, but it more than makes up for it. Love it!

I bought this along with several other dresses. It was on sale but only available in an XXS rather than an XS so I was a little nervous about it since it was nonreturnable. Once I saw it I thought it looked like a very wellmade dress and it fit perfectly, an XS would have been a bit big. And all that worry was for nothing, it is by far THE best purchase I have made on ModCloth. I continue to receive complements on it every time I wear it. It's nice for both work and outside of work, cute with cardigans. I wish it was made in a few other colors. I am going to rate the fit as a little big bc I went down a size and it fit well.

review_summary: So close!! But beware if you're busty
review_text: I am SO sad this didn't fit!! The quality is amazing and the print and color are lovely and true to the picture, but the fit just didn't quite work. I'm a 36C so I occasionally have problems with buttonup shirts and dresses pulling and gapping but this was worse than I usually deal with. All of the buttons pulled over my chest but the arm holes were practically gaping so I don't think it would work to size up. It fit fine in the waist as well and length was fine, though a bit frumpy looking on me. So sad, but I bet it would work beautifully for someone tall with a small bust!

review_summary: I'm usually an XS, but wh
review_text: I'm usually an XS, but when this dress arrived it was HUGE.  There were a solid 23 inches of extra space in the chest and in the waist.  I would have sized down, but I'm not sure the difference would have been enough so I returned it.  It was also a little long on me, but I am only 5'2 so thats pretty normal.  The dress itself is adorable and seems well made, but be wary as it runs large!

Bought this ruffley, breezy dress for fall. It runs a bit large and is longer than expected. The actual color is mustard, not the bright yellow pictured. I recommend sizing down, as if you go a size up (like I did) hoping for a relaxed fit, it'll just be unflattering.

This is super unflattering. And the color is more mustard and less bright like in the photos. It would be one thing if I could return it but it's final sale. My mistake for buying it. I wouldn't spend the money on this one if you have curves.

Really cute dress. Color is like the stock photo and length is just above knee on me.  the dress has a lining so it is not see through which is nice.  looks cute belted as well.  The fabric is cool and reasonably comfy, but it is prone to wrinkle, so a good ironing or steaming session is required.  also, my dress came defective;  the ruffles were noticeably uneven, as one was and inch and a half wider and drooped much lower than other bodice ruffle.  however, Modcloth came through and is sending a replacement, so hopefully this one will have no issues.  good customer service so I am pleased.

review_summary: It is more of a mustard b
review_text: It is more of a mustard but I like it. It was pretty wrinkled when I got it, but after you iron or steam it out, it's all good. It's cute and fits right.
This dress is absolutely amazing, always got compliments when i wear it!

review_summary: I like the idea of this d
review_text: I like the idea of this dress, but it wasn't for me. My bust really filled out the top part and made the skirt part come up farther than I liked. I also couldn't wear this to work, so back it goes. The material was nice and it was good quality, just not for me.

I eyed this dress for months before I finally decided to snag it.  It is absolutely adorable on.  The material is a nice, sturdy, high quality cotton.  The length on the skirt is perfect.  It hits just above my knees.  Only regret is not buying it sooner so I could get more wear in before this cool weather takes over.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much. It's very pretty. This is the dress you wear to the museum with your lover. I just love this dress. It makes you feel very lady.

review_summary: Already Got Three Compliments on It!
review_text: Okay, I've been eyeing this dress for months and it finally went on sale so I snapped it up! It's very cute, nice heavy material, pockets . . . did I mention the pockets?!?!?! At first, it seemed a little complicated to put on, but I managed. Also, when I put it on, the skirt was just hanging there weirdly. Like there was a big gaping hole between the top and the bottom  not at all like the pics. I thought, Oh, geez. Now I have to send it back because it's too big. I got a size small which I thought would fit  I'm 5'2, 110 lbs. 26 in. waist. That's what the chart said, so I went for a small. I was not happy with the fit, but I gathered it with a safety pin and it looked okay. I read reviews saying that the midriff part was too big or the top was small and the skirt was big and weird. Yet, no one mentioned the key fix! After I took the dress off and put it on a hanger, I noticed there is actually a belt loop on the front inside part of the skirt. It doesn't show it in the model photo, but it's there. All you have to do is put the top ties through it and it keeps the skirt up and the midriff from showing too much. It's functional and looks even cuter that way. I like the length of the dress because it hits just above my knees and overall I'm pretty happy!

I am usually between a S and M in dresses. The S in this dress pinched me in the sides where the top and bottom meet, but then the skirt portion gaped in the front. The M was a bit loose on the top, and thus less flattering. It almost didn't pinch me on the sides, and again it gaped in the front. Maybe I'm too wide for this dress? Besides the fit just not being right for me, I found the skirt to be very poofy and kind of childish. The dress was very nice quality though, too bad.
These dresses are so adorable and well made! I initially only ordered the floral print but I loved it so much that I went back and ordered the magnets the next day. More prints and patterns please!

I ordered the size based on the provided measurements, but it is bigger. The top fit fine, but the waist has far too much fabric so it looks frumpy. The fabric is a good, oldfashioned cotton quality and the print seems bigger in person.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress, but it was way too short. And I mean short! I love the embroidery on the dress, but it?s too short to keep it. It looked very nice on my friend, so I decided to give it to her.

I'm not sure I got the same dress that the model is wearing. I mean, it looks similar but mine looks like I'm wearing a long blue paper sack! Even though I'm short, Modcloth dresses usually are fine on me length wise. This one comes down to my shins! I wish I could return this. It's terrible. Why did Modcloth stop including dress lengths in their details? They were so helpful.
It's a little frumpy but it's 100% cotton so hopefully it will shrink a little in the wash.
Love love love this dress!I got it for Italy and it was perfect.Nice material and fit just right.

review_summary: I really want to love thi
review_text: I really want to love this dress but I'm torn. The fabric is great and the Colour is beautiful but the sizing is off. I have two other dresses from this brand both in small that fit perfectly. The sizing on this dress is weird. It is so small up top that I can't even zip it up but the skirt is quite big. I was able to pull the dress on with the zipper done up and it looks ok but is definitely tighter than I would like. Sizing up is not an option though as the skirt in a medium would be way too big. I am quite curvy and not lacking in the hips, thigh and bum department so this is strange. It looks a bit like I'm hiding a baby bump from the side. The dress is also too short to wear to work without tights so it is a strictly fall/winter dress (I'm only 5 feet). I will be keeping the dress but wish I hadn't paid full price.

I got this dress in purple, and I absolutely love it. The medium fit my bust perfectly and the cut is very flattering. Because I am short it goes all the way to my knees, which is what I wanted since I plan to wear this to work. My only complaint is that I wish it either did not have loops of fabric for the belt or that they were made of thinner string instead of the same thick fabric as the dress. The dress looks cute without the belt, but the belt loops poke out too much to wear it without a belt or cardigan.
This dress is perfect and that's all there is to it. High quality, thick material. Beautiful colour, flattering and perfect fit. I wish it came in more colours!! I highly recommend purchasing this!

review_summary: What a cute dress! I like
review_text: What a cute dress! I like the color combination, and it fits really well. The fabric is pretty thick, so this will be a good dress to wear in the colder months as well. The belt loops are a little weird because they're made out of the thick fabric (not string like some dresses have), so if you don't want to wear a belt then it'll look a little weird. But overall the dress itself is really nice.My only problem with it was the shabby belt, which was both too small and started falling apart right away. I'm not sure if they just have one standard belt that they use with every size of the dress, but I had to put mine at the largest setting and it was still a little snug. It also started cracking and peeling immediately. I'll be replacing it with one of my own for sure, which is kind of a bummer because it matches the collar so perfectly.
One of my favorites.  Really comfortable.

review_summary: I like the cut of the dre
review_text: I like the cut of the dress, though the collar looks too young on me (not the fault of the dress). But it pilled something fierce. I rarely wear it as a result.
Great fit. Fabric gives. I just wish the fabric were better quality. Very cute. Great length.
Dress was a little shorter than I expected, so I just wear it with tights or leggings.

This dress is beautiful. It looks nice enough to wear to a wedding (which I did) and also relaxed enough to wear to class (which I did). It's a wonderful dress that is so versatile. I'd highly recommend this!
Love this dress. Super cute  exactly as pictured, however it was missing the belt.
Very heavy fabric, so good for winter. Soft and comfortable. Very happy with my purchase
Great fit! Love the colors

review_summary: I adore this dress.  It i
review_text: I adore this dress.  It is perfect is almost every way.. EXCEPT the fabric pills up :(

review_text: Fits like a glove, but clings unprettily to tights. I looked forward to layering it, but I will need to figure out how to reduce the leghugging quality. Still, totally worth every cent!
One of my new favorites...

review_summary: It was well made but the
review_text: It was well made but the top is too short/tight on me, so I think it isn't made to fit larger chests. Also a bit short for me.

review_summary: It doesn't look good on m
review_text: It doesn't look good on my body type.

review_summary: It's a cute dress, and fi
review_text: It's a cute dress, and fits well. Not great quality  after one wear and wash, it's already starting to do that synthetic fiber thing where the there are little strands on the fabric, so pilling seems inevitable. It is, as other reviewers noted, a potentially dorky collar, but with a cardigan and some flats, it is really cute.

Another great Modcloth dress, perfect for fall! Fits great and you can tell the material is a nice quality. The collar is a light shade of purple, I had previously thought it was grey in the photo, but the purple is lovely. Overall excellent dress!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. The le
review_text: I LOVE this dress. The length is perfect and the material is soft. Love the color, fit and style. A new favorite for sure!

review_summary: I was so very sad that th
review_text: I was so very sad that this was so large and long on me. I typically wear a 1x, and I feel like I could have fit into a Large because it was that big. If it was restocked in my size I would definitely give it another shot but I was simply swimming in it. The quality and style of the dress were great, but this definitely ran waaaay large for me.

review_summary: Very nice quality and a g
review_text: Very nice quality and a great fit!

This dress is actually a knit, which came as a bit of a surprise for me, since I was expecting something for the fall/spring that would be a little thinner. The fabric is a little thick, which makes it perfect for wearing with tights or leggings in the fall or layered in the winter.The belt is also completely detachable (though there are tiny string belt loops on the sides of the dress that can stick out if you don't have the belt on). I ended up taking off the original belt and substituting it for a black one to change the look a bit.
attractive burgundy purple color. the grey color collar is a nice change from the standard white collar. nice medium weight knit cloth. good fit all over. a keeper!

review_summary: It's a bit bigger with th
review_text: It's a bit bigger with the arm holes than I was expecting, but is easily reconciled with a sweater. I went with 2x because, well, hips. However, I probably could have had a slightly better fit with the 1x as the fabric provides some stretch and a bit of length to work with. The dress is cute, but I am fairly disappointed that after only 1 wear, the fabric is already starting to pill.

review_summary: I have the navy of this d
review_text: I have the navy of this dress and maybe this sounds crazy but I feel like this one fits differently? Either way I wasn't in love with the color (I Love the blue version) so I sent it back.

review_summary: Got this as a lowkey ward
review_text: Got this as a lowkey wardrobe basic but every single time I wear it I get a compliment. Not too short, not too clingy, very cute.
It's extremely comfortable and I got so many compliments, it's awesome for colder fall days and pairs nicely with a white cardigan.

review_summary: Very cute dress, but I ju
review_text: Very cute dress, but I just wasn't digging the way it fit me.
It's adorable and I greatly appreciate the WednesdayAdamsesque neckline but it started peeling after one wash which is incredibly disappointing.
the collar was larger then I was expecting, but other than that perfect!
I love this dress. Beautiful color and fit just right! Perfect dress for work! Think I'll get it in Navy as well!

review_summary: So, I can pull the dress
review_text: So, I can pull the dress over my head and onto my body without unzipping the side, which would suggest that the dress is to big, but the fit is still nice. I don't feel sewn in nor do I feel like I'm swimming in fabric. However, if I do end up buying it in another color I may consider sizing down.

LOVE. I'm pretty short and very short waisted, so the waist could have been a tad higher, but it fits very well. I've gotten lots of complements. Looks great with grey tights and/or a black cardigan. Only complaint is the belt, which is absurdly cheap and shows a lot of wear after only a use or two. But the dress is so great, and belts so replaceable, that I'm still delighted with this item!

review_summary: I was unhappy with the fa
review_text: I was unhappy with the fabric, very clingy.

So comfortable and fits like a dream! And it's a perfect color for fall. The hem hits right above my knees. The armholes show a little bit of my bra at the sides, but that usually happens to me with sleeveless clothes (the curse of an ample bust!) and I like to wear cardis with my dresses anyway. The first time I wore this, I paired it with the charter school cardigan in navy and the dance instead of walking heels in gray and got a ton of compliments. The only thing that could make this dress better would be pockets!
Love this dress ! It fits really well and the collar is my favorite part of the dress.

review_summary: I love how this dress loo
review_text: I love how this dress looks on me, fits my style super well but..... I've maybe worn it twice and only hand washed it. it already has a bunch of fuzzies. I thought this would be the one good quality thing I bought from ModCloth. Im super disappointed in the quality of clothes I have from here.

Fits perfectly although the belt is a bit snug. The side zippers make getting in and out of this dress very easy. No pockets on this one, but I didn't miss them much.Love the Peter Pan collar and the color is rich and gorgeous.Sleeveless, but the shoulders are wide enough so you can wear your favorite bra without the straps showing. And the armholes are a regular size (not too big or too small).Material is soft and stretchy. Shows a few bumps here and there. This is a super comfortable dress.

the quality of this dress is outstanding. the color is a rich eggplant (much more purple than the picture), and the material is stretchy without being cheap. the only complaint I had was that it was a little tight. I would have preferred it to be a little looser around the bust area, and the belt was almost too small. other than that the dress was a wonderful buy. it looks wonderful paired with my sage Charter School Cardigan and a pair of cute mary janes (which I am not wearing in my reference pic because I wear them at work all day and I was 100% done with heels lol)

So cute and flattering! I'm really happy that I sized down for this dress because it flows so nicely. My only qualm is that the belt is too small for where the waist hits. It sits at my ribcage so the belt is just a smidge too small but I love the dress so it's not a problem.
beautiful good quality dress but is too short for my torso and legs. it didn't hit me at my waist. I got large but it was too roomy and didn't quite fit.

Love this dress! The fabric seems to be of good quality. The belt is adorable and really makes the outfit. Can't wait to pair this with cardigans and boots for fall!

review_summary: I ordered a size up to be

very cute dress. fits well. husband immediately complimented me on the style and fit. yay!

review_summary: I was so happy when I got

This dress is super beautiful and the fabric is really soft and thick. I have 36 DDD chest so the belt loops don't rest on my waist since my boobs take up all the top space...but I still really love the dress.

review_summary: I love this dress! it is
review_text: I love this dress! it is true to size, it srly fits perfectly, also very soft material. My boyfriend was very impressed with it too. This is my first purchase here and I am very happy with every dress I bought.
This is my favorite wear to work dress. It pairs perfectly with boots and tights.
I love this dress!

Perfect fit, really flattering, and nicely snug without being too tight or loose. Fits like it was made for me! Good fabric too, and great amount of modesty/coverage for a mini dress. I would definitely recommend this and come back for more colors.
The actual dress fit, but the belt is tiny. The dress provides stretch, which is awesome, but the belt will not fit around my belly. Sucks!

The ONLY reason I'm giving this a small fit is because of the BELT that comes with it that must be worn with the dress (there are two small belt loops on the dress, so going without is kind of impossible without looking weird).First off, the dress. It's flattering, its super soft, it's thicker material. It's everything every reviewer had praised. The colour is nice and plum, it's nice for larger, curvy girls as there is some elasticity to it and it's cut a bit generously. BUT. But...the belt appears to have shipped from the next size down. I don't see how they can possibly have shipped an XL with this tiny beltit barely goes around my waist. In fact, I have to suck in to even get the first notch. NOT very sensible, or flattering.
