review_text: This was my bridesmaids dress for my best friends wedding. It looked so great on all 5 of us! Love the cut of this dress, the lined but still light fabric, and pockets! So comfy, cute, and wellmade. My only complaint is it's dry clean only. Anyone have any success machine washing this dress? I don't want to ruin it but that would definitely be convenient!
Good quality, great fit, and even pockets. Longer than I expected, even on my tall frame. A great workappropriate dress for summer.
I sized up for this dress and it fit beautifully. It's well made and adorable for spring and summer!

The quality of the dress is nice. Good weight to the material, lined, cute style. But it was very big. There were about 3 inches of extra fabric in the chest, but not that much extra in the waist. I think if I'd sized down, the smaller size would not have fit in the waist.

I bought a size 6 and I have 34A bust, 27 inch waist, and 36 inch hips. I am 127 pounds. It was too big especially right underneath the armpits. It gaped out quite a bit there. I wouldn't say it had a fuller skirt, but the dress reached a little bit past my knees and I'm 5'5.5. I think I will exchange for a size four! Beautiful material and lightweight. Great casual summertime dress. I would say size down!

The skirt is more full than pictured, but honestly I loved it even more. The pockets are such a cute edition and the print is perfect for summer weddings and date nights. It was a little tight in the chest, but not enough to have to size up or down.

review_summary: If you like a fit and flare, this is for you.
review_text: I love seersucker, but this did not work for me. The fabric gapped out under the armpits and the skirt was way too full for me, so I'm returning it.

review_summary: Top was cute, skirt was fuller than expected
review_text: The top of this dress is super cute. It has pockets which is always a plus. The skirt was much fuller than I expected. I think it runs a little bit big. If you're between sizes I would size down.

Neck strap should have a couple extra holes for adjustments because you can only make one adjustment with it... I would've preferred the neck strap to be tighter to lift the dress up so my bra wasn't showing.

I bought this dress to wear to a wedding, I had to take the bodice in about an inch. Sadly, some water got on the skirt and the red from the roses bled into the white background, I'm really hoping that a dry cleaner can fix it. Other than that, I really loved it and got a lot of compliments on it.

review_summary: Very cute, but it was tig
review_text: Very cute, but it was tight in the chest area, which made it difficult to zip up. Definitely size up if you're heavier on the top. Very bold print and vibrant color.

I didn't quite know my size on Modcloth, and with the reviews it was hard to tell if I was a Medium or a Large. After ordering one in M, the waist was fine but wouldn't fit over my chest. The Large fit much better, although the halter tie comes loose now and then. Girls who are somewhat petite but have larger than average chests like me, I would suggest sizing up!The pockets are also really nice, and fit my phone nicely. I also just love how the skirt spreads out, and makes me feel ladylike when I sit. The waist does sit quite awkwardly on me, but maybe it's just me needing to get used to it.

I was in between sizes Small and Medium at the time of purchase  my waist was Small but my bust Medium  Modcloth stylist recommended Medium. It arrived quickly, and the dress fit, but it was a bit big on me all over so I ended up getting an exchange for small. There is some stretch to bust and waist areas so I suggest sticking to the size chart and size down if you're in between sizes! Size small fits perfectly and with an ivory Dream of Crop Cardigan the outfit is just plain dang adorable :) The quality of the dress itself is also great: the material is thick and the dress has some weight to it. The best part, of course, is that it has pockets!

review_summary: Fits better on a bigger chest
review_text: The quality is nice and it is overall very flattering. I am a 36C and I barely fill it out. It is snug around the waist and flair in the skirt. The fabric provides enough stretch and is high quality. I love the red floral print, it looks better in person.
It made me feel special

This dress is top notch! im a bigger bust gal and it holds me in all the right places. the top excentuatse my small waist and the skirt is too darn adorable, very fit and flare and a must have summer dress. if i could buy it in all the colors of the rainbow i would!

review_summary: Cute but I don't love it.
review_text: Cute but I don't love it. The red is a little too bright red and length is a bit short. Also if you are thicker around the bust or barrel chested you might want to order up, otherwise the girls might make more of an appearance than you'd like

This is a beautiful dress! It looks just like the picture. However, the eye was missing from the back of the dress and the strap was too long for me. I'll need to take that in and buy a new eye, but overall it is very pretty.

review_summary: Love the fit! The strap i
review_text: Love the fit! The strap is a little too long though.
bought this for a charity gala and it was perfect! got compliments all night long

review_summary: Love this dress! It's a l
review_text: Love this dress! It's a little bit big in the waist on me so I think I'll get it taken in an inch or two, which I have to do on most dresses from Modcloth, but other than that it's a great dress!
Great quality! I'm busty and didn't need a bra. Super cute!
Very pretty dress. Lots of compliments. I can see though why others have complained about the top. It looks boxy and scrunches up on those with short torsos.

Gorgeous dress! When I saw it I had to order it. :) I normally wear a 2X and I read a few reviews about it being a little small so I ordered a size up and got a 3X and it fits well. The strap is too long but I plan on adding my own straps so it isn't a big deal. The fabric is also not stretchy at all so keep that in mind if you prefer fabric with some give. Good quality material and I love how the skirt flares out. I've gotten a ton of compliments on it! Overall I really like it! So bright and pretty. :) Definitely recommend!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress! The cu
review_text: I LOVE this dress! The cut is supper flattering, the fabric is super nice thick quality, AND it has POCKETS! The only reason I didnt give it 5 stars was because the hook and eye broke when I first wore it, and it came with this red mark across the front of the skirt(I didn't notice until after I wore it out)! Plus, $70 is a bit on the pricey end ... I own two other dresses in this cut (both the pink polka dot and the blue check colored ones), and the only differences are the pockets and an added inch of length. They all are too long in the straps though, but sewing could fix that. I normally wear an undershirt and cardigan for modesty with these dresses, but I thought a clear picture of me in just the dress would give you guys a better idea of how it looks. This is deffinately a dress you could go braless in gals. :)
I loooooove this dress! My boyfriend bought it for me and it fits perfectly. I am usually a Medium and sized up to a Large. It fit just right. My only issue is that you can't wear it with a bra.
Cute

review_summary: Holy moly I love this dre
review_text: Holy moly I love this dress!! It's cute, sassy, and it has pockets!! The strap is a little long for me, so I had to make a new button hole, but that's no big deal. The back is stretchy, which is slightly weird, but it's not really noticeable when you're wearing it. And for me, the waist is ever so slightly a little small, but it doesn't make me look stuffed nor does it make me uncomfortable. If you like a traditional fit and flare type dress, this is right up your ally!!

review_summary: Too cute. I've had my eye
review_text: Too cute. I've had my eye on this dress forever!  Everything fit perfectly!

I love everything about this dress except the bust area. I love the built in bra, but it hangs a little low and is a little big, which is strange for me with my bust. Other than the strange bust, this dress is absolutely gorgeous!

review_summary: This is my third cake pop
review_text: This is my third cake pop/ cupcake dress. The material is very nice weight but definitely heavier than my plaid and strawberry ones. I did read that some found it to run small. I didn't. Actually it fits bigger than my others and they are a size 2x. I have lost weight since having those and this one is a bit big around the bust and the waist. Now I didn't have on a bra so that may change the bust. But the waist isn't too big that I would go smaller. I just figured I can belt it since I'm still losing weight. I'm tall and it was a good length. Would look great with a petticoat too! I love these and am thinking of getting the striped one next! Ixia brand for those who wondered. Love it Modcloth!
If you're thinking about, think no more and just buy it. Gorgeous dress, fit and flare skirt, and pockets what more could you want?

review_summary: I saw that the top wasn't
review_text: I saw that the top wasn't stretchy at all and figured I needed a larger size to accommodate my broad chest and back. But I was swimming in this. The dress is very cute (and it has pockets 3 ) and I wish it fit better! ModCloth sizing has been very confusing to me lately. Had a XL in one dress that was way too small, so I sized up here and it's huge... thank goodness for free returns!!

This dress is super cute. The material is a really really good quality and it fits like a glove. Also you don't have to wear a bra with it because it's padded at the front which is nice. The strap is a little long but that's an easy fix. Over all, I adore this dress.

review_summary: I love all the cupcake dr
review_text: I love all the cupcake dresses and this one is my fourth! it is my favorite by far!
I've been eyeing this one for a while now.  Finally bought it!! Cute, but I wish the skirt part was lined.  I'll just wear a slip, but without it can be see through in the right light.
Beautiful, wellmade dress, it was just too big! I went by the sizing chart, which said a medium would be snug. But instead it was falling off! I'm sending it back, but I would have loved to keep it.

Super cute dress! The top has built in padding so you don't have to wear a bra, even if you're busty! I think girls with smaller busts might have problems with the room in the top of this dress. The strap is wayyyy too long so I'll have to shorten it, but otherwise I love it! :)

review_summary: A couple of the seems wer
review_text: A couple of the seems were too close so the threads were showing. Otherwise I love it!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress! It has
review_text: I LOVE this dress! It has pockets! It's cute, a great length (flatteringly short, but not too short where you can't bend over). It fits well around the waist and hips, my girls are the only issue but only when I try and wear a bra with the dress. The shape and cut of the dress works best without a bra or with a thin strapless bra, your choice. My only real issue is that there were some loose threads and frays, so I'm not sure the quality is perfect.
slightly smaller fit, but not tight enough to return.

Fit beautifully, I was the star of the show all day (Valentines Day) and it gave the illusion of me actually having pretty big boobs. I was pleasantly surprised. One of my favorite dresses, I paired it with the Fine Dining heel in rogue and they looked excellent together. The fabric is NOT stretchy at all though, just be aware of that when you buy it.
absolutely gorgeous dress! it's a smidge tight around the ribs and the strap is way too long but I love it so much!

I'm SO disappointed in this dress!!!!! Though the material is thick and sturdy, the fit is TERRIBLE. Yes, I am short waisted and usually need garments altered, but this was beyond repair. The red upper half of the dress is way too long for a petite frame; it's not just the strap that's too long, it's the whole thing. Now I have to return it and suck up the loss of money to send it from Canada. I'm just not having much luck with Modcloth lately :(
This is a beautiful dress but the large was too snug and the extra large was too big on top. It just didn't work out for me.

review_summary: I have this dress in plai
review_text: I have this dress in plaid and I love it, so I had no doubts about this gorgeous print. Unfortunately, and to my surprise, I'll be returning it. The fabric is much heavier than my other one,and while that works beautifully in the skirt, the bodice looks like I'm wearing armor. I'm a Bcup or so, and I couldn't even tell they were there. So weird how different it is from the other one I have. I think if I had giant boobs though, it would be a very fetching garment. If that's you, I'd say go for it!

this dress is perfect. I had previously tried to get the cupcake trunk dress and it was hilariously short on me. this one is just above my knee and fits very flatteringly. I'm so happy with it.the cups have a little extra lining in them so I don't have to wear a bra which is an extra bonus. plus pockets.

I bought this dress along with another dress, it's a little smaller than the other one, this is the first dress that I had troubles putting it on . The hook on the back came off but I sewed it back on. Overall it's pretty great, I love the dress. Wore it to my Valentine's date

review_summary: I wanted to be best frien
review_text: I wanted to be best friends with this adorable dress, but unfortunately while the skirt portion is darling and has awesome pockets, the top half did not fit and looked horrible. I am a pear shape with A cups, and I'm sad to report that the medium I ordered is great in the waist, but boxy and unflattering on my chest. The seams on the breasts do not lay well without some shape under them, and the strap only has two adjustment options, both of which were way too loose. A small size might fix some of my problems, but then the waist would not fit me. This one is reluctantly going back to Modcloth. :(

I am an XL in 90% of the things I have bought from Modcloth, but this one I ordered a 1X after reading some reviews. Well, I'm fairly busty (40D) and this thing is SUPER tight on top. No breathing room whatsoever. Order up at least 2 sizes if you're plussized or largechested!

The quality is great, the fabric and details are gorgeous. Unfortunately I ordered, and then returned, both the medium and large. I was told that this dress runs big, but in my case that was not true. My bust is 38 and the large was still far too tight. If I wasn't in such a hurry to have a dress for an upcoming event, I would have ordered the XL and had it altered  it was that lovely.

It's a heavy material and it made me look  like I was swimming in dress. It was too large and poofed out at the sleeves, at the waist and the bust! I loved the print and the colors are great, it's just comically large on me.

I got a heck of a sale price on this and really happy I took the chance. Ordered an XXL because I was worried about the material and no stretch but I definitely would have been fine with just a XL.  It is such a neat and interesting dress. and garners lots of attention. The fabric is a bit strange with its stiffness but I think its adds to the overall uniqueness of the dress.
I adore this dress! I'ts so so beautiful, well made and just yes!I ordered a 2x which fit me really well so I'd say this one runs a tad small, the fabric has no stretch whatsoever. I love it!

I can't wait for the weather to cool down a little so I can wear this dress! (the fabric is very heavy and lined with polyester). The shape is sculptured and the color is gorgeous. The stitching is a bit uneven but not too bad.

I bought this dress despite the iffy reviews because it was on sale.  It is practically perfect.  I was between a M and L and went with the L; it was a little loose, but not unflattering, and I think that the M may have been restricting.  The fabric is of a nice weight and I do not feel like it is upholstery at allit is very similar to good quality vintage fabrics! I'm definitely going to order the other color!

Bought this dress a week ago. The cicada version. Super cute dress and I will be keeping it. I know the skirt is supposed to mimic a petticoat effect, but the poof of the skirt from the front is almost comically large. The chest is tight and the arm holes are small. Usually I wear an XS, but I went for a small and I'm glad I did. It is very tight across the chest but loose and baggy in the arms. Most people won't notice, but you, the wearer, will. The fabric is almost upholstery like, but it is firm and sturdy! I got MANY compliments on it when out and about.

I love the look and feel of this dress. The material is high quality. The chest fits perfectly for my B cup, but there is little room to grow there  might be too tight for larger sizes. My one issue is that the shoulders are tight so that i can't raise my hands above my head. So, I want to love this one, but I just like it.

The awesome fit, length, and print of this dress make it everything. I love it so much. I recently wore it to a wedding with block heels also from modcloth it was perfect. I got so many compliments. So happy with this dress

review_summary: This dress is me personified: Dark green, has insects, sligh
review_text: I bought this for the opening of an entomology exhibit I've been working with, and might I say it was an excellent conversation starter. The colors and print are wonderful in person, and the fabric feels high quality. However, the fabric is stiff and I kept fiddling with the bottom while wearing it because it felt a bit awkward. I am generally a small, but I have a small chest and could have benefitted from getting an xs.

Okay so, pros this dress is lined, has very nice fabric (heavy, like a brocade material, this is not a summer dress), the print is flawless, great length. I'm 5'10 and this sits around knee length. Cons weird pleating action happening around the hips/waistline (I expected this from the photos, but just why? Who is that flattering on?), the bodice is small as all get out. I am always a true Large in modcloth house brand, but holy macaroni. I literally got stuck in this thing when trying it on the first time and later when I had my husband zip me up, it barely fit. Without my bra. And I can't lift my arms over my head. TRY HARDER, MC.For reference since the reviews aren't helpful without sizing info, I'm 38B, 31.5 waist, 42 hips and I ordere a large.

This dress print was too cool for me to pass up, but the fit didn't work. I'm a M on top and L on the bottom, and I normally find fitandflare dresses flattering. The flare on the bottom here was just a little too wide. I also found the sleeves very tight around my arms. This may work better for someone with a straight frame, who wants to create curves.

review_summary: Overall Pleased but Shoulders are Weird
review_text: The shoulders do fit me (thank god), but the pleating on the shoulders is strange. They pleats kind of pop up and make me look like I have a shoulder bubble when I put my hands on my hips.  Also the buttons on my dress were navy, not magenta, but that doesn't bother me at all.I was worried about the shoulders not fitting since I have really broad shoulders (17.5 inches across) but they surprisingly fit just fine. The material of this dress is a heavy, brocade like fabric which I am not sure will really work for Texas spring and summers. But who cares, I can definitely wear it during Fall, Winter and early Spring and I'm 100% okay with that since I bough the dress for the print. Busty friends do beware since I found that the bodice is also quite fitted, I'm pretty small chested for my build and even my chest felt compressed in this dress's bodice. Also the pleating on this skirt doesn't lie as nicely as it does on the model. It kind of looks halfhazard job for a $40 dress let alone a dress retailing for $120. Still going to keep it though because I'm in love with the print and can deal.

I'm suprised this dress hasn't been snatched up. I absolutely adore this one. I got it several months ago. It's a great length (right at the knee), and you don't have to iron it! Plus it looks great with any colors (red, green, blue, black, etc). I wear it all year, but it's a little warm for summer. I didn't have issues with the seams or mismatched print.

I hate wearing dresses or skirts, but I needed one for fancier occasions, like going to nicer restaurants or the rare play. This dress is so silky smooth and drapes very nicely. The skirt has a double layer so there's not much static that makes it stick to your legs and outline...things. The neck also drapes down a little bit, which might be a fit issue, but looks stylish to me. The only complaints I have is that this runs a little small for a M, as I am usually an M and this was slightly tight. It also comes with a thin, black leather belt, which is very small. Maybe that's how it's supposed to be, but I could only get it on with the last belt hole. However, this dress is so pretty and cute, I don't care about those two things. I paired it with some black tight, black booties, and the black Charter School Cardigan, and it looked fabulous! The belt under the bust and around the waist makes it super flattering too.

review_summary: I love this dress. It's s
review_text: I love this dress. It's so unique. I the production line was a little more thoughtful about where they place their seems, though, because I have a giant Eiffel Tower in the center of my dress that's cut off at the top by the seem. That's really the only reason this dress didn't get a perfect score from me.
The print isn't aligned particularly well, but it's a good fit for me, and the slightly stretchy fabric works. C'est quand m?me assez chic...
The image is clear, crisp, and stunning. Tower was centred in both top and bottom. Fits nicely. Soft fabric. Love it!

review_summary: Just a tad too big around
review_text: Just a tad too big around the armholes but still a lovely dress....the print is eye catching and detailed.  However. print doesn't match at the waistline....minor issue.

This fits as expected I'm super busty and not small waisted, so although I usually wear a large in moderate brands I sized to an XL based on the size chart and it fits perfectly. It really needs the belt, since the print otherwise looks strange. But I adore it! I'm a French teacher, and this is exactly the dress I needed to wear to tonight's French Honors Society induction (and of course, to teach in). Super comfy, and it is fully lined so it doesn't even need a slip unless you want to poof it out on purpose.

I bought the dress because the print is absolutely beautiful.  When buying it, I was looking at the sizes to see if it would fit and I saw that I was in between a XL and a 1X, so I picked the 1X.  When I got it in the mail, the waist of the dress fit perfectly, but unfortunately, my boobs were swimming in fabric.  I would have exchanged it for a XL but at the time, there were none available and I was doubtful that would even fit because presumably, the waist would be too small and there is no stretch to that waist band.  I was sad when I returned it.

When I read the other reviews, most people saying the dress was too short were much taller than me (I'm only 5'3), so I thought I'd be safe, but somehow, it's pretty short on me too! I bought the dress specifically to wear to work as part of a Halloween costume (a 60s secretary), so I'll definitely need to wear tights to feel covered up enough. The fabric is nice quality, love the patterns and the colors, though I feel like the colors are brighter in the model pictures than in person. I also love the fact that it has pockets!
I loved this dress.  Unfortunately the top runs small and is tight across the bust.  After reading the reviews I did size up, but it didn't help.

This dress is very cute and folksy, and I think a younger version of myself would have died for it. The nowme, however, thinks it's a bit noisy and colourful for any sort of regular wear. It is a beautiful dress in all ways: the colours are vibrant and full, the fabric is of a good quality (and it's lined so is quite sturdy), and it fits well. I usually am between ML in Modcloth dresses, and the L fit me well, though the bust was a tad tight (but still very wearable). My only issue with the dress is that it is too busy for my style, though I really do love it. I will be returning it, as I can't imagine any situation in which I would wear this. But if you're a fan of vivid and chaotic colours, please do order this as I think that you will love it! Order up if you're between sizes.
Love the dress . But I bought it to go out with clients and it's too short (I'm 5'7) ! On a lighter note it's not to short for date night!

I wear between a medium and large dress depending on the cut. I had been eyeing this dress for sometime and decide to buy it. It was way too small cut for a large and I could not even zipper it close. Back it goes and back to shopping I go!

review_summary: i love it but too tight around shoulders and upper back
review_text: I love it but if you lift weights and are broad shouldered  size up lol. I thought i could get away with a small, and I should've got the medium. But it fits everywhere else great except around my shoulders and my armpits it is tight when I raise my arms.  I got 39 inch shoulders but i figured I fit into small into all modcloth tops which run big to me. But the dress was too tight  up on my shoulders but only if I move them around a lot. I am still keeping the small because I know the medium will be too big :( The dress is lovely!

I coveted this dress for two weeks. I rushed to try it on and was disappointed by the length. It was not long enough for me, I'm nearly 6'. What I liked most was that it has a sewn in slip. Now I'm debating on whether to return or find a pattern close enough and extend the length.

I love this dress! Everything seems true to size and fits perfectlyhits a good spot on the leg, sleeves are the perfect length, bust and waist are perfect width, etc. The fabric seems to be of very high quality, is lined with navy blue fabric, and has pockets, so between that and the long sleeves it is quite warm for a dress of its length and flowyness. My only complaint is the first time I handwashed it, blue dye POURED out of it, (but it did not ruin the lighter parts of the dress whatsoever) so don't wash it with anything else (or at least light clothes), at least in the beginning. I would totally recommend this dress though, I feel great in it!
Just received this dress. Very good quality just too small. The waist doesn't give at all. Not sure if I would need to go 1 size up or 2.

This is a Modcloth brand dress, which I love everything I have bought of their label thus far and this one does not disappoint. It is stunning in person. Gorgeous colors and patterns. Top quality fabric and a great fit. I do run between a small and medium and went with the medium and it fits perfect, so if you are between sizes I would go up. One of my favorite dresses!

This dress is absolutely beautiful! It's well made too. The fabric is soft and sturdy. The colors are vibrant and beautiful. The only issue with the dress is the fitting. The waist is slightly small and the upper arm part of the sleeve is slightly small. If I am standing still the dress fits fine, but I have can't lift my arms up very far. I am typically a true medium so I was very disappointed with the fit. I feel as though a large would be too large, so I may just see if there is a way I can add an extra inch to the waist section.

I bought this dress last month, and unfortunately it wouldn't zip higher up than the middle of my ribs. I am 5'10 & about 190 lbs. I bought a Large.  I gave this dress to a friend of mine who typically wears a medium and it fits her like a glove. Great material, just not a right fit for me. Try ordering a size up.

LOVE this dress. It?s great to pair with boots for a punk look or heels for a business casual look. Very modest but still trendy and very comfortable. It is fully lined, which I love. I wore this to work during our National Conference week when he had several visitors to the office and received a plethora of compliments.

review_summary: So Cute and Fit is Amazing
review_text: Just got this for a shower and the fit is so amazing. I think this is my new favorite dress and the $25 price is amazing for it. good quality fabric too. Also, I read the other reviews, and my chest didnt feel too tight at all and I am a 34D with a 27 waist. the top of it was super flattering.

review_summary: I was in love with this d
review_text: I was in love with this dress, super excited when it got here!! Went to try it on and the zipper immediately broke... not impressed!!
I bought this dress a few days ago. It's perfect for work or a night out. The material feels good, but it is slightly tight in the bust area. Great dress for the price!

I would have given this dress five stars but it is, as other reviewers have said, a little tight in the bust. But nothing major, in my opinion (of course, I'm a C cup). I think for the sale price this dress was a great value and I'm really happy I bought it! The fabric seems quality and the fit isn't bad overall. Love the skirt, too. The fabric doesn't have much give. The stripes and cut make it flattering on curves. Can't wait to wear this one!

I was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the fabric! It's not what I would describe as tie fabric, but it is very nice quality woven cotton not shiny. If you can't tell from the photo, the stripes are light beige lined with a thin red line on each side. The bust fit me just fine wearing a bralette, but I wouldn't recommend it if you need a supportive bra, at least in your true size. Great autumn happy hour dress with a fun hemline varying between knee and fingertip length! Perfect value buy for $20!

So, this is a greatlooking dress. The fabric reminds me of tie fabric, which I honestly wasn't really expecting. I thought from the pictures that this might be some kind of jersey a la the Coach Tour dress. As much as I love the fabric, I still wish it was  because it gives me major uniboob. The rest of the dress fits just right, but the chest is so tight that it flattens my boobs. I think that this could have been avoided if the button down went further, and I could just wear a bandeau, but as it stands it'll have to be a weight loss goal dress or a present for someone else.Lovely dress, but largechested ladies beware.

I was super surprised to find out this dress was chiffon material! I didn?t read the bio on it I just basically shopped without hesitating. None the less this is a beauty! Perfect fit and the pockets make it that much better! Also if any of you ladies watch ?Fuller House? Kimy wears this dress!!!! Like WHAT!? So cute.

I really love this dress! The print is beautiful and whimsical and very eyecatching and unique. It fits perfectly, like a glove! I'm so glad I chose the XS rather than the small. My one complaint is that the dress is made out of cheap material, and the zipper is kinda fragile. Definitely not worth 80 bucks, but I got it for 40% off. A cute dress, quality could use improvement though :)
Great fit all over, except a bit loose in the bust for me personally compared to similar sized cuts

I Love everything about this dress but the zipper. Cute print and flattering, it is a little but snug so I had an extremely hard time getting it on by myself. I had to zip it first than wriggel to get in, if you don't have someone to do your back zip you or if you are large chested I would size up. Besides that it's awesome.
One of my favorite dresses I've ever bought. Fabric is lightweight and quality is great. I'm 5'6 165lbs and a large fits great.

This dress was worth the $80 price tag. The colors are beautiful. The fit and length are perfect. The material and weight of it, perfect. I am about 5'4 and it fell just above my knees. Also there are pockets, hello! I love this dress and cannot wait to wear it everywhere. This was a great item, thank you Modcloth! ?

This is one of my favorite dresses I own. The colors and print are magnificent. And I LOVE THE COLLAR. The fit is loose but does not give that appearance. The only downside is that it came with a bit of a pointy thing coming out of the zipper that occasionally stabs me, which should probably be a big downside, but I just took some wire cutters and cut it down so it is less painful.

review_summary: Great pattern, comfy, a bit tight in the neck
review_text: I LOVE the pattern on this dress! Length is great, fabric is lightweight, overall a great dress. The collar is a little tight, I'm not a fan of collars and you can feel it when you wear it. The zipper on the back and the hook at the back of the collar is a bit tricky to do yourself, you might need a roommate or partner to help you getting in and out of this dress if your arms don't bend backwards easily. I don't regret purchasing, but I'm glad I didn't pay full price for this dress.

I just received this dress in the mail today.  I'm so pleased with the lightness of the fabric, I live in the Deep South, so it's basically summer year round.  I'm happy I'll be able to wear this in the summer and not feel like I'm wearing a sweater.  There are only two things that made me take a star away, the under arm area has a bit too much slack and exposes my bra more than I'm okay with and the buttons seem to be a loosely sewn on.  Those problems are both easily taken care of, so I will be keeping the dress for sure, just going to take it to the tailor to fix that gap.I'm really impressed with the collar and I'm so glad it's not too tight, also the dress hits me just above my knee.  It's a great length for work and still cute enough to wear on days off.  Overall I'm really pleased with my purchase and recommend it to plus size ladies for sure!

I got this dress when it was on sale a month or two ago. I really, really love it! The fit is a bit snug around the waist and chest, so I can see how someone who's well endowed might do better to size up. However, the dress was flattering and made my (small) chest look bigger, my waist look tinnier, and slimmed my thigh/hip area. I've received a lot of compliments on it worth the buy!
It's a little roomier in the boob area than I'd like, but I'll wear it with a cardigan, so no biggie.

10/10 for fit  the 1X hugs me like a glove. I'm 5'7 and about 215 pounds. Very curvy, so I like the fact that this dress hides my flaws and accentuates my small bust to make it seem more proportional.10/10 for pattern! I get so many compliments on this dress. One lady thought it was unicorns, but when she saw it was constellations she was like even better!! It's gorgeously pale and pastel. 89/10 for quality: The collar lays perfectly, the buttons are a lovely touch, even if they might not last forever. Zipper closure never sticks. Clasp at the top ensures it stays on. My only real complaint is that the dress is very thin, but worn with tights, it's not too much of a concern. Also, I don't think the buttons will be lasting very long. They are very delicate, which makes them beautiful on the dress but very easy to pop off.My biggest issue to be honest is the lack of sleeves! I'm wearing this in the winter, but it's SO COLD. The material is very thin, even with 2 layers, and without sleeves, it's even coldr.
So cute! Lots of comments. Fully lined, high quality, great pattern.

I am forever between sizes in the modcloth namesake label. I ordered this in both a XL and 1X. The 1X is too gapey in the bust and the XL is just a bit tighter than I like in the waist. I will be keeping the XL since I won't have to get it altered and it is wearable. The dress is a lighter material than expected. For those of you that live up north, it would probably have to be a spring/summer dress. Overall, I am happy with the purchase. The pattern is beautiful. I do wish it was a tad longer.

This dress is *****everything*****. I was worried about a shirt dress having the weird gaps in between buttons at the bust, but the buttons are just for show and there's a discrete zip up the back! I was so relieved. The dress also has pockets, because modcloth does not disappoint. The colors are vibrant and the pattern is so much fun. I'm usually an XS, and the XS fit well on me.My only qualms are that the waist doesn't have any give so make sure it fits, and the zipper could stand to be of higher quality, so you might run into trouble is a size runs small on you.
I honestly need this dress in every pattern (please restock)! I ordered it on a whim for a wedding and it fit perfectly. I got so many compliments and it was incredibly comfortable.

I bought this in the pink because I thought the colors were so cute and it'd be perfect for teaching. I got it in the mail today and I'm so happy with it! It fits really nicely (fitted but not tightI can put it on without unzipping it but it definitely doesn't have gaps or anything), is super comfortable, and looks professional and pretty. I also love what it does for my shape; it doesn't emphasize any lumps at all. I also really like the lengthjust above the knee, very flattering, not too short for work. I can't wait to wear this teaching!

I just got this dress today, and I'm so thrilled with it! The material is stretchier than I expected, but that gives it a really nice fit. When I first realized it was stretchy, I was nervous. I thought it might cling a little to much to my cellulite and look unattractive on my bottom, but the pattern and the material hide the dimples and I look better than I ever have! I got a large even though my hip measure was sort of in between sizes, and with the stretchier fabric it fit perfectly. I bought this for my pinning ceremony in May, but I'm so excited about it I may need to find an occasion to wear it to before then! Oh, the belt that it comes with is cute, but strangely inflexible and kind of hard to buckle. Just a little annoying. And Modcloth was great per usualreceived a couple days before I expected. Oh, and the model must be pretty tall. I'm 5'7 and this dress hits me just at the top of my knee.

I'm very happy with this dress.  The length is just above the knee and the neckline is prefect.  I have a slim/ athletic build,  but am a little bigger on the bottom and didn't have any problems the others did with the hemline in the back. The colour is great. The material isn't my favorite,  but it flows and fits the cut of the dress vey well.  The botice print and skirt print also lined up perfectly,  wish is key in dresses with horizontal lines.  I usually wear any xs in modcloth dresses,  but the small fits perfectly around my ribcage. I'm a 0/2, so maybe size up for a size 4?

This dress fits great! I feel so feminine and fun with the length and color. The fabric on top is a little thin, but very soft, with great stretch. It *is* a bit low cut for work/ family events, but I just put a white cami under it for some modesty. My goto pick for dates with my fiance ;)

This dress is much nicer in person than what it looks like in the picture. Great fabric quality, great color, not a great fit for short, curvy, busty girls. Very sad it didn't work out for me and that I have to send it back.
I love this dress! It is so flattering and you just need to ensure a good fit and the cleavage isn't bad at all.

I feel so cute in this dress. It is a bit low cut so you may need a cami depending. Very versatile for at work or day out and the fabric feels great. I wish there were more styles in this because I would buy them all!

I love the bold color, the pattern, and as a curvy pearshaped person with large hips and a smaller waist and bust, it's super flattering! It would be office appropriate with a cami underneath. I usually wear a large with Modcloth dresses, and this was no exception. Fit as expected.

Bought this during a sale. Very pleased with this dress! The top is a little baggy, but that means it doesn't cling too much and thus makes it perfectly appropriate for the office, and I prefer more room in the bust than super clingy anyways. The skirt is just past the knees. Love the vibrant red color. Goes really well with the Dream of the Crop Cardigan I bought from Modcloth previously.

World's best zipper.  This fits me snugly, but the zipper went up like greased lightning and down with just as much ease.  The shoulders don't want to quite sit as wide as I think they're meant to, and when they sit closer in there's a lot of gaping in both front and back at the neckline.  Might employ some fabric tape.  Still love this dress, but the worst part is the inconsistent embroidery.  If you look at the picture, you can see that the long, full black ovals are the way it's supposed to be, but these three flowers seem to be missing thread at the tops or bottoms.  And given that the embroidered section sits slightly away from the lining, I think it would look weird if I embroidered over it straight through the liner.  :(  really cute dress though and the flare is so nice.
On a hope and a prayer I ordered this for Easter. It arrived next day and is a delight! Not to long, not too short. It's sophisticated, yet playful. Works for a woman from teens to 50's!

Like other reviewers have said, the cut on this is strange. The waistband is disproportionately small when compared to how much fabric there is on top. It fit me in the waist, but was gaping under the arms and just way too big overall on top. I can't figure out what body type this would even fit. Too bad, because it's a really pretty dress!
This dress was perfect! I couldn't wear heels with the length but it was super cute with flip flops. Very comfortable!

review_summary: Poor Fit and Product Not as Advertised
review_text: Not even worth the sale price ladies. The dress that was advertised was a chambray color with pretty, whiteedged ruffles. The dress I received was a dark jean color with singletoned ruffles that look thin and cheap. I'm 5'5 130 pounds and the waist came up a full inch too high making the dress look very illfitting (so it doesn't matter how long or short your torso is). God forbid you wear a bra with it  it's so poorly cut that you'll see the sides of your bra through the arm holes.

My complaints about this dress have all been pointed out by other reviewers: 1) It's too tight across the chest/shoulders (I typically fit a 4 / Small; the small was far too tight up top). 2) Material was shiny, giving it a cheap appearance. 3) Length was awkwardly long for me (I'm 5'4 and it was well below the knee). Too bad as it looks great on the model.

I had ordered this dress expecting that it had the possibility of being a little big on me, but I was surprised to see that it was actually a little tight around the shoulders and chest! It was especially surprising since I ordered a L instead of an M! Aside from the sizing, the material is lovely and it's a very comfortable dress!

I was drawn to the dress because of the color and the cute print, but alas I think it was the print that didn't sell the dress once it was on my body.  You know those old plus sized prints that just make you look even bigger?  That's what it looked like on my bod.  It didn't help that one of the white flowers ended up right on top of my boob. :/  I think if the print were smaller it would be more flattering.  I ended up just looking frumpy and chubby.  I think this dress would look better on someone who isn't as curvy as I am.  Fortunately ModCloth has an awesome refund policy, so I'll be sending this back and trying something else! (Thanks ModCloth < 3 )

It's a little longer than I was anticipating, and the chest is ALMOST too tight, which isn't usually a problem I have, but I wore it to work today and got lots of compliments! If I had gone a size up or down it definitely would not have fit.

I was really excited for this dress and my husband took the hint and bought it for me for Christmas! Unfortunately I could barely get it on and he had to help me get it off. The silver flecks in the fabric look much cheaper in person. I won't be exchanging it for a L, partly of the quality and partly because I don't have faith that it will fit well either. (I am always a M, this dress runs small). I'm disappointed, but at least I will get some in store credit to buy something else!

This dress is very pretty in person. The fabric is lovely, soft and comfortable, with sparkly silver stripes. You do have to actually button the dress to get it on. I expected the buttons to be for show and a zipper to be hidden somewhere, but no go. The 1X was surprisingly loose on me, not enough that I couldn't see myself wearing the dress, but even that I would absolutely need a belt, and even with the ribbon tied it was still baggy. Something about the fit or the fabric, or maybe the overblown flower pattern, didn't work very well with my body type. It made me look larger and sort of frumpy.
I'm fairly tall and this was still knee length which was perfect for me. The material has a gorgeous sheen to it and was a huge hit at my office holiday party.

I LOVE the metallic thread in this dress. That's what made me determined to keep it even though it kind of looked like a robe on me at first. It's a little baggy by the arm pits, and just looked odd in general until I paired it with just the right belt. So if you have the right accessories it's great, but a bit off on its own!

I liked everything about this dress apart from the material (and the fit on me, but that's not the dress's fault  that's my thick waist!). The material is really shiny and I thought it made the dress look cheap and not at all the look I was going for.

I ordered this twice, the first time I ordered a M, which fit great everywhere except across the chest. That was a first for me. Looking at the size chart I decided to exchange for a L and hope it wouldn't be ill fitting everywhere else. Customer service was awesome in getting my new dress in a timely manner despite the Thanksgiving weekend (need it for a wedding this coming weekend)! The new size fits across the chest just fine and upsizing didn't cause anywhere else to look too big. Love the print, can't wait to wear it!

I am pretty bummed about this dress. This was my first ModCloth order and I loved the print, length, everything I saw in the picture. The dress wasn't really what I envisioned when it arrived and went way past my knees. The sleeves were fairly baggy as well. I couldn't have sized down because it was already very tight in the chest area. There is also a weird silvery thread running through the fabric that made it look pretty cheap. This dress would work best for taller, slimmer ladies.
Really wanted to love this dress but the fit was odd. There is not enough room in the chest so it rises making the waist line way to high.
Another great dress from Mod Cloth.  Stretchy material is great.  Great for work!

review_summary: I picked up the last one
review_text: I picked up the last one in my size on sale and I'm so glad I did. Such a sexy dress while still being classy and not showing everything. The back does gap a little bit but I could get that tailored if I wanted to, but it doesn't bother me too much. A very versatile dress, I definitely recommend!

I needed a nice cocktail dress for more formal occasions so I ordered this sheath dress in medium. I am about 5'6, 140 lbs, 34C cup. It fits very well. Good length, it hits a few inches above the knee. The v neckline is low but not so low it would be inappropriate for a formal occasion like a wedding. Also, the material has quite a bit of stretch to it so its not too confining. I can't wait to wear it!!
Cute dress. I accidentally order a size too small but easily exchanged it. I'm a teacher, so I'm still debating if it's too sexy for school.

review_summary: The green fabric is higher quality than blue/black
review_text: I've had this dress in green for a while, so I was excited to see that it was now offered in both blue and black. I bought both new colors, but I didn't realize that the fabric would be different. The green is very thick/soft, and it doesn't wrinkle or show dog hair. The blue and black feel much cheaper. I love the cut and length, so I decided to keep them and not go through the hassle of a return. I wouldn't have paid the same price if I had known the quality was changed, though. I'm 5'7, 140 pounds, 32D and a medium is perfect. I only have the arm/bust gapping issue others complain of if I wear a heavily padded bra. The green dress would be 5 stars, and the blue/black would be 3.
This dress is even nicer in person than I expected.  A bit big on top, I ordered a medium and had a little bit of extra room.

Like other Emily and Fin pieces, this one is just lovely. It hangs and swishes in a very elegant way. For more petite ladies, this will be a bit on the long side (I'm 5'2 and it hits me in the middle of the shin). Absolutely get this dress at such a low price!

review_summary: I had no issue with the l
review_text: I had no issue with the length of the dress and found it hit me right at the kneea great midi length. Great quality, only downside was the zipper was a little difficult to get it past the thicker seams (waist and neck).
I'm so happy I took a chance with this dress after reading the reviews. I was worried it would be too long but it wasn't the length is perfect.
This was such an awkward fitting dress. Not flattering at all.
Very cute dress.  The material is a good weight and such a cute pattern!  A bit big in the bust, but everything is big in the bust for me!

review_summary: Not a great idea for busty short girls!
review_text: I was so excited for this dress. I bought the L, my usual Modcloth size, and was disappointed to find that I couldn't zip it up all the way (not even close), and pockets were gaping tremendously. Additionally, the length of the dress hits at the worst possible spot for this short girl (making my legs look stumpy), but because of the lace on the bottom, I don't know about hemming it. I do love the neckline, though, so I am going to size up to the XL, although I have a suspicion that it might appear a bit dumpy (length, etc.). Fingers crossed!

This is a cute, comfy dress, but it's definitely warm. It's lined with the same jersey fabric which is also super thick. Though it's shortsleeves, this sucker will keep you warm. It also seems like it'll hold up well because of the thicker material which is nice. The tie waist detail is pretty, but it adds bulk to your waist rather than slimming it, though it does disguise your stomach, so it's definitely a trade off. If you're a Torrid 56 the 4X will fit perfectly.

This does run big so maybe that was the problem, but when I tried it on, it hung poorly. I like a fit and flare which this is not.  It just wasn't flattering.  I did like the color and the fact that the skirt was double layered.

I love this dress! The quality is very nice. It is lined and very soft. I can say it is SLIGHTLY big on me, but I am petite and so a little big and a little long is not uncommon for me. It comes to my knees, but fits nice in the chest. The fabric is pretty forgiving and somewhat stretchy so I think I could go down a size. I definitely want to get another color so I might try sizing down and will comment on the size for that one. I got the gray color and it is exactly as pictured. Perfect for an everyday casual summer dress.
Material was thick and slippery. It was ok. Not my cup of tea. It made me look heavier than I am. The high waistlines really aren't flattering to me. I returned it.
This dress fits better than any other item of clothing I have ever worn.  It's like it was made for me.  And it has pockets.  So, it's the best.
I ordered according to the size chart but this dress was about two sizes too big.  50 inches in bust and 43 inches in waist

I'm traveling to Europe and needed a couple stretchy, stylish dresses. This one fits the bill! It actually looks better in person than on the models. Super polished look with the ease of a stretchy style. Paris, here I come! I am 140 pounds, 5'5 and got a medium. Perfect fit.

I got this in my usual size, and it was way too big in the torso, though it felt right everywhere else. When I cinched it in to see how it would look if I sized down, it still looked frumpy and unflattering, partially because it's so heavy with fabric. I do like the material, but the styling is off to me.

review_summary: A little small in the shoulders but so comfortable
review_text: Although a bit small in the shoulders, I really love this dress. It's so comfortable and easy to wear. I probably could have gone up a size, but I was worried if I did, it wouldn't fit as nicely in the waist anymore, so I decided to sacrifice slightly smaller shoulders for really good fit otherwise. I love this so much I think I might get another in navy (I bought black). The hemming on the neck is also ever so slightly off, which is why I'm going to say good, not great quality, but as I said, it feels so good on and looks good otherwise that I don't care!

review_summary: Good dress, but very basic, possibly runs large
review_text: I was so excited about this dress but it's just good, not amazing. I ordered the ocean color and it's much darker in person! So much that I thought MC sent me the wrong dress at first. It's very forest green to me, not a blueish green like I expected. I went with my normal medium and it's looser on me than it is on the model, making me look a little frumpy, so I suspect it runs large...but I think washing will do the trick! The knot is barely tacked down with a couple stitches and I'm worried about the fabric quality. The good parts of this dress is that it's very soft, lined, and makes a great work staple. I was hoping it would be cuter for going out or running errands, but it needs the right accessories to punch it up.

I feel this dress was true to size and a good length (hit just below my knee) and the color was beautiful but the material is horrible! Its a shiny, thin, cheap material. When I tried it on you could see every detail of my bra and panties, I dont even think wearing a slip would help. So not worth $60.
This dress is true to size. It's beautiful and I absolutely love the feel and flow. The color is exactly shown.

review_summary: I love this dress. It is
review_text: I love this dress. It is really comfortable. It has pockets which is wonderful. I feel it is a little short on me but I?m 5?11?.

review_summary: I love this dress! The ki
review_text: I love this dress! The kitty pattern is adorable and the dress itself is very comfortable. The material feels like great quality. It might do well to iron occasionally.
Love this dress. Fits great, a touch too short but I'm on the modest side. I usually pair this with a mustard cardigan and oxfords. Big fan of the print!
This dress is precious! So flattering and great quality. Wonderful for the crazy cat ladies out there! ;)
The waistband is thick, sturdy and supportive with a little give, and the dress's fabric is nice and springy. Great for all weather, and the print is to swoon for!

Probably my most fun purchase from ModCloth! Was nervous about the buttons in the front but I normally fit in a 1X and this fit perfect on me as usual! Would buy this dress in another pattern or color!

I purchased this dress in the cat print and it is so adorable! I am usually a size small and the small in this fit perfectly. My only note is that I am small chested, so larger busted ladies might run into trouble.

It has good, thick fabric. I felt like the length was just a little off on me (just above knee on 5'4 and I didn't like how it flounced). It ended up being a bit awkward and looking kind of wide in the hips, so I cut off a few inches, hemmed the bottom, and turned it into a super cute shirt.
Material is good, great for summer. Love the dress, got a ton of compliments on it.

Adorable dress! I've received a lot of compliments while wearing it. There's a little bit of extra room in the chest, but if I sized down I feel that it would be difficult to button up, so I don't mind. The sleeves are also a bit puffy and I felt like it made my shoulder area look broader, but it's still cute! Figure it might flatten down with a few washes.

loved everything about this dress.brint is to die for, and the material is thick and stretchy.Sizing seems to be off though.  i wear MXL at Modcloth depending on the material and design due to my ETlike belly : (  For this is  a dress that is not empirewaisted, I ordered XL then exchanged to L, and if I didn't have my big belly, I would have asked for M because the shoulder is still too big. i may bring it to my alteration person and keep it. it is long for my taste, so I'll have to shorten it anywayi am wondering how it would look after washing though. some of modcloth dresses i have (way more than 50!) don't wash well. some of them don't even hand wash well! color would come off and white part of the material would soak up the other color and gets ruined..

According to the measurement chart, I should have ordered a 3x, but I read some other reviews that said the dress ran big and ordered a 2x. They were so right! This dress is super comfortable and light weight with a sturdy construction. A 2x was more than enough room for me. The buttons do not gap, and the fabric has some stretch to it. The sleeves are a bit blocky, but the retro kitty fabric is cute that I don't care. It's a great dress for apple shaped ladies like me! The skirt is full enough that it hides any tummy bulge. The neckline has a nice dip that's still work appropriate. I'm 5'4 and it comes to the bend in my knee. I've gotten tons of compliments on it!

I love this.  The tie back waist gives me a little help in the area where the dress is a little too big.  I always over estimate my size but fear returning and having the size below be too small.  I'm 5'7 and when I do tie back to highlight my waist it makes the back of the dress just a wee bit too short.  I'm still keeping and ill still wear. It's not flashing anyone short (unless I bent over).  I also would consider a pair of cropped red leggings with this dress if I ever happen upon them.
Very cute. Sturdy material. Nice stretch. I could def have sized down 1. I feel it runs pretty large especially compared to Modcloth brand dresses.

I usually wear an XL or 1X, tending toward the 1X side of things. But the 1X of this dress is way too big. But I can't wait to get my exchange for the XL because I la la la la love it. The fabric is thick and a little bit stretchy and the length seems right. There's a tie that you can wrap around to the front or tie in the back, so you can decide how tight it is around the tummy. Super cute, but size down if you're sort of in between sizes!

This is another great dress from Fervour brand! The fabric is nice and stretchy and has some weight to it without being too thick for summer wear. It has pockets and there is no button gap across the chest! It's hard to tell in the photos, but the cats have electric blue collars that stand out from the navy blue background, but it works!

I wore this as the maid of honor at my best friend's wedding. It was even more beautiful in person, excellent quality, fit perfectly.  It was comfortable and the perfect length. I got a million compliments and can't wait to wear it again. I'm sometimes between sizes and order a size up, which was perfect.
I love this dress, I been wanting to buy it for a long time but I was waiting for it to go on sale. I finally gave up and I don't regret it, it looks great on me.
I love this dress. It's too dark in my opinion for the event I was buying for, but I'm keeping it because it is just so perfect. It was even comfortable! Not itchy or confining.

review_summary: Great quality, fit wasn't great for small bust
review_text: Very pretty and comfortable dress, but the fit just didn't work for me. I have a small bust, and the mesh was really baggy on the top. The waist was too big, as well.

I bought this dress for a rehearsal dinner for a friend's wedding and got so many compliments on it! At first I was a little apprehensive to buy it in my size because of some of the reviews but found that it fit me pretty close to perfect. It was a little larger but if anything, that made it comfortable and I was able to actually eat in it! I also did not have any problems with the material so maybe that issue depends on the size?

So I have to say I find the way all mod cloth dresses fit quite odd. I'm an hour glass, with a smaller waste than my chest or hips. And all dresses in the signature label fits HUGE on top while fine in the. I'm not who they're meant to fit! That being said, the dress is really pretty and on trend with the tulle overlayer and embroidery! I agree with the other reviewer, there is so much extra tulle over the bust, it definitely sits way out from the under material (which is slightly padded). And the bust itself is roomy (again, I'm not sure how big the label thinks an xl girl has). So your bust definitely looks bigger. I was going to try to fix it but then said whatever, you're always moving in it so hopefully wouldn't notice! The waist is slightly roomy too (but ok for hitting the buffet) but I went down a size and it would not have been comfortable for the night. Also note, this is hand wash only the dry cleaner will NOT take it!

review_summary: For the money I spent, I
review_text: For the money I spent, I was expecting better quality. But while most of the dress fit OK, the seethrough black shell was all over the place at the chest. No matter what I did, I could not get it to lie flat. It bubbled out away from my skin and looked really baggy. Maybe the smaller sizes don't have this problem, but as it is, I was unimpressed. It went back.
This looked so cute.I was really disappointed in the cheap,ugly material.The polka dots were huge and ugly.The sleeves were puffy and the fabric stiff.Worst thing I have ever bought.

review_summary: The dress fabric was a ni
review_text: The dress fabric was a nice cotton with a bit of stretch, but the fit was boxy and too short for me. I don't know if the proportions were off, but the dress looked very odd on me.

I'm a challenge to fit. I'm smaller on top and larger on the bottom (fun!) so many things fit me in certain areas and not others. This dress fit perfectly. I'd have ordered it in the other print as well but my size was sold out.

review_summary: Awesome cut and print, but low color fastness
review_text: I bought the navy and red kitty print about a month ago.  I love the style, pattern, and the pockets.  I've received many compliments on the dress from strangers, too.  However, I am disappointed that the dress faded noticeably after 1 wash (on cold, gentle cycle).

Bought the black and white polka dot version kind of on a whim because I need some new work clothes. This dress will be really nice for thatit's a good length, nice quality material, cute pattern, and fit well. My only complaint would be I think the top is a little baggy on methe sleeves feel slightly larger than they need to be, but it doesn't look bad, I'm just picky haha. Might work better on someone with bigger arms/shoulders or a bigger bust. Still, I'm very happy with it and it'll be great for teaching. < 3

I bought this dress on a whim, and it is beautiful. It definitely accentuates an hourglass figure; highlighting the shoulders and chest, nipping in perfectly at the smallest part of my waist, and then flaring out over the hips. Very cute and sexy. Pairs perfectly with a bright berry lip and red shoes! My only complaint is that they don't offer more colors or prints. This cut is one I would purchase over and over again.
Great dress. Good quality and as advertised. Using it for a bridesmaid dress and it looks good on all of us.

Really beautiful dress. I wear it with the bee belt positioned over the flowers more than the belt it comes with.

love the embroidery. must wear strapless bra. big in the chest area on me (32C). hand wash only, do not dry clean per tag on garment. outer shell is 100% polyester. beautiful dress

Absolutely stunning. I bought it for a wedding and got so many compliments. super comfortable as well. Love it :)

The material is structured well and I love the cut of this dress!

review_summary: I got a UK 10 and it fits

I can still wear this dress though and it is gorgeous!
Stunning dress but the smallest size is still a bit big. Looks fine with a belt.

Wow!  This dress is stunning!  It's very flattering, makes my waist look very small. The fabric is great, and the flowers are so lovely. The belt is a great addition. I also love the tulle underneath the skirt of the dress, makes it just perfect!

I adore this dress! Fits like a glove! I was worried it might be too small but it is perfection! It has a built in petticoat to it so the bottom bells out nicely very excited to wear this out on the town!

review_summary: I have never gotten so ma

review_summary: I bought this to wear to
