review_summary: I bought this dress to we
review_text: I bought this dress to wear at my sister's wedding.  It fit perfectly, and was so comfortable to be in all day.  I received so many compliments about how cute and unique the dress was.  Great quality and couldn't' be happier with it. I have purchased several dresses from ModCloth and this is one of my favourites so far.

review_summary: It didn't fit me very wel
review_text: It didn't fit me very well unfortunately. It's too roomy in the bust which causes the dress waist to be lower than my own waist (the narrowest part of my body is just below my ribs). This in turn causes the back of the dress to gap at the top, and when I wear the belt, it will sit higher than where the dress' waist line is. I think might not overly noticeable since it's a solid dark colored dress, but I don't have the time to get it tailored and don't want to risk photos otherwise. The dress and belt is very good quality though, and I would recommend trying it out!
The dress is wonderful and very pretty. The embroidery work is beautiful. The only drawback is there is no way to wash or dry it. It's a hand wash only.

I was nervous about this purchase because of the price but I am thrilled! The quality of the fabric is beautiful and it fits perfectly!  The belt is just as nice quality as the dress and stitching. I want to wear this dress every day!
This dress is amazing. It fit me like a glove. The shape is very flattering. The color is just as pictured. It has tulle underneath to give it shape. I can't wait to wear it out!!!!

I was nervous when I got the dress because the fabric looks very delicate. You can't really notice it in the images but the fabric is some kind of mesh. The dress is gorgeous! I love the pattern in the fabric and the way it falls in my body. It is also a very cool dress so it's perfect for a warm climate. So far I have worn it two times and I have had no issues. It seems it is more resistant than what it looks like. Of course, even though I have noticed it is stronger than what I thought, I will be extra careful to wash it by hand and make sure to not sit on something that could pull the fabric and break it. I would give it a 5 if it were not for this detail. I would highly recommend buying it but no for full price (I am still a bit nervous it will break easily!)
I actually really like the look of this dress. Yes, I'm a little nervous about snagging it but expect that knowing the type  of material it is. It's kind is sexy and cool.....

I am beyond pleased with this purchase! Besides it being about an inch too long, this dress fits me perfectly! There's nothing better than a dress with pockets, is there? I ordered an XL, my usual size in Modcloth dresses. As other reviewers have stated, the colors are definitely more vibrant in person. The fabric is easy breezy, it's got a really nice lining, and the print is exceptional. A+ on this one, guys!

I was so excited to purchase this and when I opened the box I squealed at how lovely the print was! But then I tried it on and I was so disappointed! The top fit great, but the bottom poofed out awkwardly making my hips look 5x the size they already are. It didn't fall nicely and I don't think it would because of the material. I didn't even think it was worth taking to the tailor to try to fix. Sad day. :( Would love to see this print used in the future on something else.

I absolutely love this dress and feel like a fairy queen whenever I wear it  it's so ethereal and floaty, and the fabric is beautiful  soft, gauzy, and just heavenly to wear. I am short (5'3) and this dress is very long. I washed it as soon as I got it, and it shrank lengthwise (which was a good thing for me). I've worn it with 3 flatforms and it's still just a touch too long (e.g. I might step on it while walking), so hemming might be in order. The top is also strangely fitted, but wearing a shrug covers it up. I received so many compliments from coworkers and complete strangers and just had a smile on my face the entire first day I wore it.

I bought this at the 2nd street Austin store and so glad I got to try it on first. It was a good thing I tried it on because the small was a tad long and loose around the chest. After wearing it a few times though, I tripped and ripped the super skinny strap. I'll sew it back together though!

I was hesitant with buying this dress because of the other reviews, but I was so in love with the print I just decided to go for it. I'm usually a medium, but went with the size guide and ordered the large. It was HUGE. I decided to give it another try and exchange for a medium and I'm so glad I did! It fits like a dream. Hugs all the right places, lots of room for my hips, adjustable straps and has pockets! I'm 5' 8 and the length is perfect. I know this dress is going to get a lot of wear this summer!

I originally orders this dress in a 1x, but the top way way too big, so I exchanged it for an XL, which fit perfectly! The dress was very lightweight and comfortable to wear to an outdoor wedding. I received a lot of compliments on the interesting print. And...It has pockets, which I love! I was a little nervous about the time it took to exchange, because I needed it to wear to a wedding. I called Customer Service to check on the status of my exchange and the gal I spoke to was very helpful. She reordered the dress in the proper size, and requested a refund for the original (instead of an exchange). She even honored the sale price (I got the original at 40% off), and gave me free 2nd day shipping to make sure it arrived on time.  This was my first time purchasing from ModCloth...I was very pleased.

This is super long and fits really weird in the boobs. I actually really love the print and really like the material (super light/airy for summer). BUT, it was way too long (I'm 5'7 & 155 lbs and ordered the large) & large under my arms and sits too high up in my chest. The darts are also in a really weird spot in the chest area. and I like just a little cleavage to show and this dress sits WAY too high up.

I love this dress. A couple other reviews almost turned me off of it, but I'm so glad I took the plunge! Fitting my boobs into just about anything is a hassle, but this dress wrangles them spectacularly. I don't need to wear a bra with it, though I might use those silicone nipple things. Idk yet. I'm 5'3 and the length is a smidge long. Haven't decided if I wanna wear this with heels or flats, so I may have to get it hemmed. Material doesn't feel cheap to me. It's very breathable and light for summer. The colors are better in person, I think. They're a bit brighter and the animal pattern shows up more prominently. This is an absolute winner for me. Oh and it has pockets. And the skirt billows out which is nice. I don't feel restricted at all. Ok I'm done.

I love everything about this dress! I'm used to a fabric that doesn't give so that about it doesn't bother me. It is, however, super large up top! About 2 inches too wide. I'm a small in most things but I am definitely exchanging for an xs. The length will be fine and it should still hang at a good place on my waist so we will see! I could might even do the xxs, but I'm an adult so no :)

In theory I loved everything about this dress. In actuality it was a disappointment. The print is super cute and the dress shape is lovely, but the fabric is thin, papery, starchy, and cheapfeeling. It does not flow or swish like it seems to on the model and the fabric has zero give or stretch. It is hard to imagine why the price tag for this item is so high. If you want to try it anyway, be sure to fit it to the biggest part of your upper body because largewaisted and/or largebusted ladies be warnedthis dress will not adjust itself to your proportions and needs to fit super well to be even remotely comfortable or flattering.

I bought this for spring/summer and am so happy I did.  It is an unusual print but I love quirky styles.  Airy fabric, nice true to size fit, and forgiving on a postpartum body.  It is a bit long but then again I am only 5'2 so I expected that.  Looks great with a jean jacket, floppy hat, and sandals.  I can't wait to wear it to the zoo with my daughter.  :D

My husband bought this dress for me for Mothers Day.  I LOVED it!!! Unfortunately, as I put it on to wear a second time I noticed the embroidery coming unfrayed in many places. Too many to justify keeping it for the $249 spent on it.  Customer service was great about responding and willing to refund my money. I would have loved to just exchange it hoping it was just a fluke. However they sold out.

review_summary: This is the beat dress th
review_text: This is the beat dress that I ha e ever purchased in my lifetime! it is more than stunning!

The details on this dress are unique and stunning. Sleeves are on the long side but I like that. Ordered a small and going to return for a medium to see if a slightly looser fit hangs better. Really gorgeous and hope it works out because it would be perfect to wear to a Fall wedding.

The lace detail and embroidery on this dress is gorgeous! My biggest issue is with the seam under the bust I continue to struggle with inconsistency in the bust measurements at Modcloth. In some designs, the seam under the bust fits well and follows the size chart,  and in others, the seam is about 1/2 too snug. Unfortunately for me, this dress was another one with a too smug bust seam.  The measurements across the rest of the dress fit great! Given the beauty of the dress, I debated taking it to be altered, but Modcloth dresses don't leave room to let out a seam.

I bought this dress to wear to a wedding. It's beautiful. The embroidery is really stunning and the lace is a fun touch. It's my new favorite dress. I ordered my normal size and it fit perfectly. The sleeves are loose, just like in the photos. The colors are exactly as depicted. I'm looking for reasons to wear this dress!

The beautiful color (mint), highlow hem and the knitted/crocheted details make this truly striking!  I could not get over how lovely that top layer was. Unfortunately all the detailed knitting also made for a very heavy dress!  I had purchased this with the intention of wearing it in the summer, but the sheer weight made me think that I would severely overheat.  But I tend to run hot, so my issue may not necessarily be an issue for everyone.  Anyway, I decided to return it despite how much I wanted to keep it.    Honestly, if the navy option was available when I first purchased, I probably would have kept the dress because then it would have been suitable for the colder seasons.

review_summary: This was all kinds of wro
review_text: This was all kinds of wrong on me. Same issues others have mentioned black part is too tight, top is too loose. I hoped it would fit differently on me, but sadly, no.

This dress definitely makes you feel marvelous especially if you find those hidden Alice in Wonderland creatures. The fit is just perfect and I also love the length since I'm pretty tall and dresses usually are a little too short on me.I would buy it again any time.

review_summary: I found the bust to waist
review_text: I found the bust to waist ratio was a little off. I recommend this dress to the bustiest women of the world.

I have other dresses from the Folter/Retrolicious brand and I go between a medium and large depending on the cut.  Based on reviews I went with a large and imagine my surprise when I couldn't even zip it up! He waist was even smaller than other dresses I have in medium but the print is so nice.  I'm not even sure an XL would work because then it may be too big on top.

review_summary: Super cute but the fit is a bit off.
review_text: I love nearly everything about this dress. It is so cute and flowy and my husband complemented it as well. My issue is that the waist band is significantly looser than I would like and sticks out in the back but it is too tight on my boobs. I can wear it but it is a bit of a process to get everything adjusted so that it fits and looks good. I was hoping to use this as a maternity dress as well in the future and while there is plenty of room in the front for a little human I don't know if it will work if I get any bigger on top. We will have to wait and see how that works out.

This dress is beautiful and I absolutely love the whimsy of the pattern. Like others have said, there is no give in the waist so make sure you order appropriately. I am a solid xl in Retrolicious brand and this fits, but just. The bust area is a bit weird as well. Mine doesn't cross over like it does in the picture but instead comes straight up making for a strange gap. I will have to pin it and/or wear a tank under it to wear to work. Not a big deal.

The waistband has NO stretch, which I expected. What I did not expect was that there would be no way to get the waistband over hips or bust! I unzipped it all the way, had my husband check to make sure it was unzipped all the way, we both inspected it for hidden zippers or buttons or anything that would give a little more space to slide on. Nothing! The dress is BEAUTIFUL, but that doesn't matter if it isn't wearable! I normally wear a M/L and ordered the L because of the waist, I'd have to size up twice to feel comfortable going over my hips or bust just to get in it. Then it would be too large everywhere but at least I could get it on. I was SO excited about this, it's really such a shame.

review_summary: This would have been a gr
review_text: This would have been a great dress, but the waist is tiny compared to the rest of the dress. While I have a wider waist compared to my bust and hips thanks to my german ancestry, this was way too small even by usual standards. I usually wear between a large and an extra large and the extra large in this dress had over a 2 inch gap in the waist when I tried to zip it.  Unless you were born with a tiny WASP waist or plan to wear a waist training corset, you might want to go up a size or more.

I bought this dress and it had a nice fit. It is true that the black band is tight, but I have a small torso and it fit perfectly. I love the pockets in the dress. Unfortunately, I felt that the dress was too expensive for the quality. When I got the dress, there were a lot of strings coming off of it and the material of the dress seemed like it wouldn't wash well.

The fabric of this dress is so gorgeous! The Alice in wonderland images are hidden amongst the flowers so very subtle  and the colours are gorgeous! The fit is really flattering to my curves and true to size. Love it!

This dress is so whimsical! From a distance it looks like a beautiful spring floral dress! When you get closer, you get fun surprises of Alice in wonderland characters subtly throughout the pattern! It's delightful! The black band sonches the waist nicely. A little big in the chest but not that bad. Long on my 4 11 frame but I expect that. One of my favorites for sure!!!

review_summary: A bit tight around the waist
review_text: Retrolicious dresses in size L usually fit me perfectly, but I too feel the area around the black band is a bit too tight. I can still wear it, but it's definitely tighter in the waist than the other size L dresses made by Retrolicious. With the dress laid flat, it's about 141/2 across the waist, while they usually make the large about 15 or 151/2. I also ordered the XL; the waist was perfect, but the top was much too big. The print is really pretty with the small Alice details so I decided to keep the L and returned the XL. Hope this helps!

This dress is just so adorable  very flattering, great length for me at 5'10 (not too short), and has pockets. However, that black band around the middle is so tight on me and does not stretch at all. I usually wear a size M in dresses (S sometimes depending on cut); I already sized up to a L in this dress since the product description alluded to nonstretchy cotton (I have hips :)). The top is already too baggy on my small chest, so I can't size up to an XL. I am sad I can't wear this dress and jealous of those who can!

This is a very pretty floral print, the hints of Alice just make it better. I love the colors. I would say this fits true to size, although it was a little large on me as I am loosing weight and in between sizes. It fits well in my 44ddd chest but my mid section was a little roomy for my now slimming waist line. I am usually and bought this in the 3x. I wouldn't be able to go down a size because it fits right up top. My shape is just off. I like the black waist band but this is one that I wish had a tie so I could cinch it in. I'll have it altered for Easter.
This dress is amazing!  The lace is incredible and it true to size.

review_summary: Fits great and very good quality
review_text: fit like a glove i am a dress size 6 and it fit perfectly. you may need assistance with the zipper because if it isnt perfectly straight it wont go up. Overall in the rich navy blue with the lace and the poofy princess bottom it was a bit too much for me. I was intending on wearing to a wedding but i think i would have looked fancier than the bridesmaids.

review_summary: Gorgeous, but Sadly Not for Me
review_text: I fell in love with photos of this dress, and desperately wanted to love it as much in person.Unfortunately, it is JUST. SO. POOFY.Maybe I should have assumed that from the pictures, but it seemed more Aline in most of them. I'm short, so maybe some height would help compensate, but I really looked like a cupcake. I could maybe have cut out some of the pooflayers, but was afraid that wouldn't work and then I couldn't return it.Also note that if you buy the navyoverwhite, it is definitely more creamcolored than I expected. Still beautiful, but darker than I imagined.
Great fit and color.

review_summary: Didn't fit me in the ches
review_text: Didn't fit me in the chest despite my measurements matching what the site said was appropriate.....gorgeous and lacy though! I returned mine, but would recommend it to others. :)

review_summary: My bra and waist size sho
review_text: My bra and waist size shown are my actual inches.  This dress fit me in the chest, but was a little to big, but was way too big in the waist and the poof was just too much. The waist was also really high on it, nowhere near my natural waist. It made me look 20lbs heavier than I really am due to all to poof and the waist being too big.  Didn't love it enough to pay to have it altered, so it is going back
This dress fits me perfectly! I can't wait to wear it to prom!!

review_summary: Not A Keeper but Stuck With
review_text: I ordered the 4x in this and ... I am small busted and apple shaped and this was a BIG mistake.  The color is nice, the tie doesn't really work because the material is too limp; had they made the bow a contrast or pattern material of stiffer fabric would have been cuter but this shoes lumps, bumps and full stomach.  That's what you get when you look like an apple.

review_summary: This is a great dress for
review_text: This is a great dress for work, just a little different without being inappropriate. The teal color is really beautiful, and the dress is very comfortable (and didn't wrinkle!). Plus, it has pockets. The material is just slightly odd: kind of slick and slinky. The outline of my bra shows. It may run a little small, or it could just feel that way because it's really clingy. With a cardigan over it, though, no problem.

I'm a 38 DD. The material was thin & my bra showed. I purchased the black one with white poka dots in L & it didn't have pockets. That material was thicker & you could not see my bra. Now I order size L in Purple & Tile. This model comes with pockets. I don't like the fabric but I love the style so I have them in all colors. Just want to share.

I bought this because I have the same dress in black polka dots. Curiously this one and the other solid color now available both have side pockets that the polka dot version does not. The dress is great  it has more of a sheen than the other one seems to. I'm not sold on the pockets since you can see them but I love the dress. I am wearing it now with a charter school cardigan. The length is just below my knees, the rouching at the waist, and the pleat detail at the neck are flattering. It's modest and sexy.

review_summary: Very long for a short woman
review_text: Dress was cute, don't get me wrong the quality and cut and color were all there. But holy cow was this SO LONG. I felt like a nun in it. For sizing reference: I am 5'2, and the dress hit me at the shin. Also I am 120 lbs size 4, small or xsmall thinner with big hips and thick legs and I could have gone to an xsmall in this.
I purchased this dress to wear to a wedding. It is high quality. the fabric has a nice weight and the dress is fully lined. You really cant beat the price for a dress this nice.

Some friends and I have an annual fancy dinner party during a convention in Boston, and since many of us are from across the country and only see each other once a year, everyone in attendance is dressed to the absolute nines. This was my pick for this year's party (2017) and it went over very well! The dress is the softest mint color, the little cap sleeves are SO cute, and it falls just right on my waist. I'm 5'4, a little pudgy at 145lbs, and a little bit busty, and this dress felt like something that really flattered my hips and bust. The neckline is VERY low though, so much so that I had to just accept that the edges of whatever bra I wore would probably peek out.The make of the dress is very high quality. The fabric is thick, soft and heavy, so it falls nicely and has a good swish when I walk, and was actually quite warm even though it was in the 30s out. It feels very well made, and the zipper feels sturdy, although it is quite small and can be hard to zip up on my own. I've worn it to work with an undershirt to tone down the neckline and felt quite comfortable in it. Overall a gorgeous dress that I feel like I will get lots of wear out of, likely for many years!

Love the color of the dress. It's between mint and sea foam. I love the midi length. The vneck is so low that I definitely turned some heads! I bought a bralette and it's the only way I'll wear it. I have a large chest but small waist. The large is a bit snug on the top. The material is nice and thick

My boyfriend gifted this to me for our second anniversary, and he and I both love it! The color is exactly as pictured, the cut is feminine and flattering, and the fabric is so comfortable. The skirt falls a few inches below my kneesnot the best length for someone who's petite, but I like not having to worry about the skirt hiking up. Overall, a lovely dress.
The dress is beautiful and very comfortable. The length however is very long.

review_summary: I love love love the colo
review_text: I love love love the color of this dress. fits me perfectly. I'm sad about it now because I have a smudge of foundation left faded on the skirt but that's on me.
Fits great! Love the length. Fabric quality is just ok and shows some rolls but with a slip it works well.
One of the most flattering dresses I have ever owned.

Nice dress, unfortunately did not fit.  I bought a size large, but couldn't get the zipper up...ugh, I'm not THAT big, but ce la vie,  instead of returning decided to give to my daughter, she loved it and it fits her well.

review_summary: A little tight in the arm
review_text: A little tight in the arms but lovely dress.

This dress is perfect! It is so soft and hangs beautifully, I want it in every color. I am busty and this does show some cleavage, but not in an inappropriate way, I just love it. Also I normally wear L or XL and the large fit fine.

review_summary: I bought this dress for a

review_summary: This is such a lovely dre

review_summary: I wear this dress and my

My only complaint is how low cut the bust is. For a night out, or a nice dinner, it is fine. When I wear it to work, I must wear a cardigan, fully buttoned over it. Still, a great buy and worth the money.

I didn't keep this dress because I would've had to buy a slip to wear it and wasn't sure I could find one in time for the event I was attending. The quality seemed fine especially for this price point, and the color was beautiful.

This is my favorite dress that I own. The color is so beautiful. The material is thick and it is a very well made dress. The length hits at my knees and is so flowy and fun. It's very classy yet sexy with the v neck.
Got this for a wedding.  So cute a comfortable.  Lots of exposed d?colletage if you're busty, but that's what I was going for.

review_summary: This dress is a lovely sh

The neckline is an awesome plunge, but not great for me since I'm a nursing momma ;)  Returning as the front seams are poorly set under the lining and make the nursing goods have lumps on them.  Also the back in unlined so any bumps are visible. It's a good dress! I just know that if I'm not fully comfortable to begin with I won't be confident in it!

review_summary: OMG!! tris is going to be

Fabric is lovely and cut is insanely flattering. Would highly recommend!

review_summary: I bought this dress for m

I love this dress!!! It's so flattering and beautiful. I'll definitely be wearing it a lot! It comes down actually below my knees and I'm not super short, so keep that in mind. Also, it's definitely not TOO low cut.

This dress is gorgeous!! I love the color a nice mint and it has a very flattering silhouette!! The only reason I took off a star is because I have narrow shoulders (pear shaped body) and the shoulders and back fit slightly big on me. It's noticeable but still looks good enough for me to keep it and make it work. The Neckline is somewhat deep yet still tasteful.

review_summary: I love the color on this
review_text: I love the color on this and the fit. It's classic and flattering. My only issue is that the vneck can sink low, so be mindful of that when choosing a bra.

review_summary: I really wanted to fall i
review_text: I really wanted to fall in love with this dress! I'm 5'9, so finding something knee length and flattering can be tough. From the waist down, I was so very happy. The flow of the skirt is great! It fit my waist perfectly! But, beware of how low cut this dress truly is... I bought it to wear to a wedding later this month, and my fiance kindly let me know that this would raise some eyebrows among his conservative relatives. If the neckline were just a half inch higher I would be happy. Sadly, I will be returning...
Amazing dress

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a wedding this July and I'm really happy with it. I generally worry about things fitting with my hips, but this dress highlights my smaller waist and then just cascades down to just past my knees. The neckline allows it to be fun, without being too low and the length of the dress keeps its classy enough for a summer wedding. The only complaint I would have is one of the seams under the arm was a bit loose when I received it, which I reinforced before wearing. I can't wait to wear it again!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. The co
review_text: I LOVE this dress. The color and length are perfect. It shows some cleavage, but not too much. And I can wear a normal bra under it which is always a selling point.
This mint dress is amazing! I love the soft feel it has and love the longer length. Being tall, I am so happy that it is to my knees. YAY! Will be wearing it a lot.
Adorable dress, classic feminine style, gorgeous color!

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much. it makes me feel so beautiful. I am quite chesty though so I need to make sure im careful with that.

This dress looks perfect and sweet all the way. I couldn't wait to get my hands on it!I was not disappointed! My favourite dress to date by far.The only surprise was that this dress is not as sweet as it looks. Without a slip underneath, or buttoned cardigan or sweater. . . This dress is over the top sexy. TONS of cleavage on top of being super figure flattering. I don't mind this, but if you want modesty and don't care for layering, this may not be for you. That is, if you are somewhat busty like me. (In case my measurements don't show, I'm a 28DDDDDD/I ) Another huge upside is that it has a good amount of stretch. The fabric is fabulous. Sturdy, soft, and has just the right amount of give. So this means I have no trouble with a curvy, athletic figure. Even fits my broad shoulder comfortably! It's insanely flattering and feminine on me. Highly recommend for athletes and bodybuilders alike.

I love everything about this dress! The soft minty color is so fresh, the lining is silky and the flowy nature of the skirt makes me feel like I'm in the final scene of Dirty Dancing. Where the skirt hits and how it moves make it really flattering.

If you have broader shoulder like me, I would stay away from this dress.  It was too small in the shoulder for me and made the fabric sit weird and was uncomfortable. It was super cute, but sadly I did return it.

This dress is gorgeous! The color is exactly as pictured, and I love the texture of the fabric. I'm fairly tall, and the dress still went past my knees. I also love the neckline and the fit of the top (the fit could not have been better on me), but it might be a little too revealing on someone with a bigger chest. Overall, I highly recommend this dress!

Finally! A dress that's long enough :D I'm not super tall but I too often struggle with dress lengths on Modcloth..there are tons of cute things that, at mid thigh, are too short for my tastes and age. Anyways, besides the wonderful length, this dress is gorgeous. Amazing mint (more green, than blue), flattering cut, and  twirlable! Perfect. I marked as runs long, but, I mean as in compared to most items. NOT a complaint. Its knee length for me, and I love. it.

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for an upcoming audition and it couldn't be more perfect. The fabric is high quality, flattering cut, and the color is exactly as pictured. I bought the Little Bit of Glitz belt in ash to go with it and it really brought the whole look together.

This is what Judy Jetson would get married in.  I ordered this for my wedding dress with a few options. It was hard to let this one go. I typically wear a XL in most stores and a 2x in modcloth dresses. The 2x was very tight on me. Just an FYI

review_summary: Yes, order a size up when
review_text: Yes, order a size up when doing the plus sizes, as recommended!  I'm a 2X but the 3X fit perfectly.I wore this to a friend's wedding where she wore black and us bridesmaids wore white.  It felt scandalous wearing white to someone's wedding!This was a great dress.  I didn't like some of the folded down fabric in the chest and considered cutting it out but didn't want to mess with it.  The little clasps in the back wouldn't stay in so we barely sewed them in right before the wedding so I wouldn't have to worry about it coming undone.Even with those things, I felt so confident in this dress. The circles were a fun flair (though nearly impossible to see online).  Great dress.

review_summary: I wore this for my weddin
review_text: I wore this for my wedding and overall the quality was great but I had to have the arms altered as they were too small. Also had to purchase in a 4x even though I never buy anything larger than a 2x so definitely size up. I did purchase a petticoat for added fullness.

review_summary: I have this dress in 3 co
review_text: I have this dress in 3 colors. I wore the white one to my wedding rehearsal and dinner. I love that it's a little stretchy. The netting at the top has had a couple of casualties, but it's not too noticeable.

review_summary: Ok so this dress was fun.
review_text: Ok so this dress was fun. I got compliments on it all night. But my honest opinion is it doesn't meet up with the hype of the price. (Maybe if I got a diff color). Pros is it does provide a some stretch, not a lot but the kind of stretch where it forms to your body. The netting is ok, since its white it does compare to that of a basketball net. This print/color in particular has some sort of circle pattern. It wasn't a big deal to me but it can make or break anothet decision in keeping it or not. It shows in the pictures but not too much so it could be missed easily. IT RUNS SMALL IN PLUS SIZES!!! When they say to size up SIZE UP. I fall between 1X and 2X in modcloth (mostly 1X) so I thought 2X would be fine. Wrong. lol. My gripe with the dress issss, although the 3x fit me fine the arm holes are sooooo tiny!!! I'm not sure what world a plus size woman would have arms the size of a regular size woman so Im still baffled by that. I'm not exgerating when I say the arm holes are small lol. Althought I received compliments on it, for the full price I don't think its worth it. At all. I rly wanted the red dress but the event I was wearing it to was a BandW party so maybe I would have been happier with red.Overall I wasn't dissapointed, I felt gorgeous but my buyers remorse it still outweighing the good so might want to take that into consideration. That is just my thoughts tho. :)Mahalo!  Anastasia
I absolutely love this dress! I wore it on my wedding day. We had a halloween wedding 10/31/14. I wore a small white tip hat and white converse! it was perfect for my special day!

review_summary: I LOVE this dress! It is
review_text: I LOVE this dress! It is even more gorgeous in person. I wore this amazing dress for my Commitment Ceremony and received tons of compliments. At the time my measurements were slightly different than what is listed on ModCloth (it was only a few months ago, but gained some weight after moving)   when wearing this dress (in a size Small) I was a 34D (bust), 29 (waist), and 37 (hips). I would definitely recommend this dress  it's beautiful and very unique! (you can't see it in the picture, but I also wore a teal colored petticoat with this dress)

review_summary: I love the detail in the
review_text: I love the detail in the fabric and in the neckline. Very flattering design. My only complaint is that the fabric is a tiny bit sheer. It would have been perfect with a liner.

review_summary: You guys helped to make a
review_text: You guys helped to make a beautiful and memorable wedding. I couldn't have been happier with the style and sizing of the dress. I'm pretty full figured, busty and curvy. My only complaint were the fabric was a little thin, (just having it lined would have helped) and the pattern on the fabric was more iridescent and prominent than I expected. All in all I was tickled pink! :)

review_summary: I had to send this one ba
review_text: I had to send this one backcouldn't even get my upper arm into the sleeve. The fabric seemed cheap, and the skirt hem was roughly finished.

review_summary: Very pretty! It is a litt
review_text: Very pretty! It is a little long on me (I'm short). I could have had it taken up but the dress was already pricey so i sent it back.

This was my wedding dress and I felt amazing in it!  The only complaint I had was with the hooks in back; they don't stay closed.  I ended up taking it in and having the hooks replaced.  It was really big in the bust.  I bought an add 2 sizes bra and it STILL was a little baggy in front.  I highly recommend the Va Va Voluminous Petticoat with it.  Otherwise it's kind of flat and hohum.  The color is odd.  It looks white until you hold it against true white.  But still, it's not very ivory.  Overall, I was happy with it and got a ton of compliments.

beautiful dress for my wedding! I'm a bit short so i had to have it hemmed, and worn with the petticoat I don't think I look like a L, it's very flattering. I did have trouble keeping the uppermost hook in the back secure, so I just had to safetypin it.
Received many compliments! Perfect dress!

review_summary: This was to be my wedding
review_text: This was to be my wedding dress. I measured in the bra (boosted and lifted, for maximum measurements, just in case) I intended to wear so I could be sure to get the right size. I was right in the expected range of a 2X (small end of the scale in the bust, upper end in the waist and hips), and sized up as instructed. I did everything right, to the letter.The dress still didn't fit. It was STILL small in the bust (the one area I was presenting small), and I tried it on in my minimizing bra. Also, it was small around the arms and shoulders. Waist and hips fit perfectly. It seems like the maker sized up for plus sizes in the waist and hips, but didn't size up in the bust and shoulder area, which seems more than a little ridiculous to me.I'm afraid I have to return this otherwise beautiful dress and find a different one  even if I go a size up, I doubt it will fit my bust correctly, as I had to wear a minimizer just make the 3X fit pretty tightly.

review_summary: I bought this as my weddi
review_text: I bought this as my wedding dress for this September, and overall I'm very happy with it. I was pleasantly surprised by the subtle print and shimmer.I would recommend this dress for curvier girls  it hugged my waist perfectly and didn't gape at the top like most nonpetitesized dresses do on me.My only complaint is the styling of the closures. The dark zipper is noticeable and a bit tacky, and the hookandeye closures at the top are just totally useless. I am getting it all replaced with buttons for a classier look. These upgrades are worth it for a wedding dress, but maybe not if you're wearing it more casually.

I purchased this dress in Greed and wore it to a wedding on the weekend with a pink petticoat underneath!  EVERYONE loved it.  It is a beautiful dress that swings the way its suppose to.  If your going to be dancing this is the dress.  Nice material with a bit of stretch.

review_summary: I think that I may have o
review_text: I think that I may have ordered a size too small, but I was not impressed when I saw the dress.  The fabric is stiff and very shiny, with some strange circle patterns on the dress.  I agree with a previous poster that the netting looks just like a basketball net.

review_summary: I bought this dress to ch
review_text: I bought this dress to change into after my wedding reception. I love the look of it. There does seem to be extra fabric in the bust, so I ended up having it altered.

review_summary: I wore this dress to my E
review_text: I wore this dress to my Elvis officiated Vegas wedding last spring. I wanted something fun but pretty and this fit the bill perfectly. The fabric has the slightest bit of shimmer which doesn't show in all photos but it's beautiful! I paired it with a red crinoline, red shoes, my borrowed, and my blue. I felt pretty and was so glad that the only gambling that weekend happened in the casinos. I love this dress so much I also ended up buying a red version too for Valentine's or our anniversary! :)
First order with modcloth and was very disappointed it didn't fit. Got the XS and it was just too big. Otherwise dress is nice.

This dress is super good quality. The material isn't thin or weird feeling. Definitely comfortable. It fits well and it has pockets (this is important to me, I gave it a star based solely on pockets).However, the skirt poofs out at the front of the dress oddly and makes me look pregnant. If it didn't do that, this dress would be my allaround favorite. It fit true to size and it's adorable. I just wish I could fix the skirt poof without constantly smoothing down the front of the dress.

review_summary: Fabric is great, Sizing is weird
review_text: I'm exchanging this dress in hopes that sizing down fixes some of these problems.  I know that other reviews commented that this dress was too small but I found the opposite problem.  There was too much fabric in the chest, but the fabric is a nice jacquard and the stiffness helps to hide the empty space where my boobs just didn't fill in.  The bottom is a lot poofier than the pictures show and made me feel like a balloon.  The zipper was difficult to get past the waist seam, but no more than other invisible zippers.  I am worried that if it fit tighter at the waist the zipper would have been a problem.I had maybe 1 to 1.5 inches of wiggle room at the fitted waist, so I am trying to size down to  an XS in hopes that it makes the dress look more fitted up top without squeezing me to death.  The overall quality was wonderful and the woven dimensional print makes this dress feel lux.  If you get the sizing right it is an amazing dress!At 5'2 it hit below the knee and looked a bit long.  I would consider getting it hemmed if I get the other sizing right, but it is definitely wearable and cute asis.

review_summary: Surprised no one else noted how Poofy this dress is
review_text: I love the pattern, I love the fit of the bodice and the length but the fabric is so thick that the dress juts out in all directions from the waist making the skirt really really poofy. I kept it, I teach Environmental science so I wear it for teaching but I am going to try to

I received this dress as a gift from some special saltines. I LOVE IT SO MUCH. I'm not sure why people are upset about the sizing...I found it to be quite generous. No issues with the zipper either. The fabric *is* thick and heavy, but I like that because it's an embroidered dress and it just matches the whole look/style. PLUS it keeps its shape well so no ironing needed at all! Lined, with pockets. Very flattering for gals like me who have a little more cushion for the pushin'.

review_summary: I had to exchange this fo
review_text: I had to exchange this for a small because it was just a little bit tight in the waist not leaving any room for bloating or a full belly. The fabric is thick and high quality! It's super cute!
Dress is gorgeous! The print is adorable and the fit is super cute!

Heads up  order a size up if you get this dress. I should have gotten an XL. Otherwise, the dress is beautiful and I got a lot of compliments on it. The print is vivid and stitched, and the fabric is sturdy but not too heavy.

review_summary: Panda LOVE! Runs small... more like Junior's sizing.
review_text: I'm obsessed with pandas and when I saw this dress, I immediately bought it! Normally in fit and flare styles, I'm a medium if the fabric has give, but as the fabric is pretty substantial (really high quality but not too heavy), I definitely needed a large... should have better paid attention to the size chart combined with the fabric description, oh well! In the process of exchanging now, I'm so excited to own this gorgeous dress!

review_summary: Cute dress but fits small + zipper problem
review_text: As the previous reviewer mentioned, this dress has zipper problem. I can only zip it when it`s laying flat but once i put it on i could not zip the middle/waist section where the skirt meets body. It also runs somewhat small in the waist but too much poof and fabric in the skirt. I ordered a small but will return with a medium instead. Other than the sizing and zipper issues, the fabric is super cute, just like the pictures if not more vibrant, nice jacqured texture gives it dimension and durability.

I want to love it. The fabric is cute, nicer and thicker than just a basic cotton which I wasn't expecting. There's a little bit of a sheen to it and the pockets are great. The problem is the zipper. I had one where the zipper got stuck in multiple spots so I exchanged it. On the second one the zipper still gets stuck where the bodice and skirt meet which makes getting it on and off an olympic event. Sadly, I don't want to fight a zipper every time I get dressed so I will be returning it.

The fit is perfect!  This is a very unique dress with thick fabric. I'm 5'1 with large bust and got a Large. Fits well at the top and waist, but there is extra fabric after the waist. Also, the model shows it coming above the knee, but for me the hem fell about 2 inches past my knees. Nothing a trip to the tailor couldn't fix!  No stretch.

Beautiful material and design, but definitely not summer weight. The zipper gets stuck where the bodice meets the skirt and requires much fidgeting. Hoping a bit of wax might solve the problem. Would rate this higher if the zipper was not so problematic.
Love. Super cute. Fits well. Looks great on. Definitely recommend. And it has pockets!

This dress is really nice and great quality but was just too long on me.  I'm on the shorter side so it came down even farther on my legs than it does the model so it was a bit overwhelming.  Too bad because I really do like it otherwise.
Love it!!!!! Will be wearing it to my best friends wedding.
Beautiful dress. Beautiful fabric. Colors are vibrant.

I originally bought this dress in a medium, but exchanged it for a small because it was extremely large. But the small fits perfectly! It's very well made and the material is nice and thick. I'm rather busty(32DDD), but the top fits nicely and is very flattering. I'm 5'8, and the length is perfect. I would definitely buy again.

I love love love this dress. The material is a thicker weight while also being a very comfortable style. I wore this dress to my sorority formal and I danced (badly) the entire night without being uncomfortable for a minute. The pockets are also a musthave. I also found that the top is very flattering for a larger bust. Also, the colors are even more vibrant than in the picture. I highly recommend.

I loved this dress in yellow. I had a nice heavy fabric that flared away from the body, showing my waist without clinging to my hips. It is my favorite dress. But I bought another in poppy and the fabric was completely different. It was slinky and showed every bump and curve in an unflattering way. I wish I could return the second one.

review_summary: Very well made! It is nic
review_text: Very well made! It is nicer than I had expected. I really like that there's a lining. However, this is too hot to wear in the summer, the only drawback.

Bought as a potential bridesmaid dress and the only thing that worked was the color. The material was cheap and would likely get stretched out very easily. The fit was completely off and the gathering up top was super unflattering. Sent back.#ReviewContest

review_text: Comfy and cute. I wish that the skirt part wasn't lined so that it would allow a little more air flow on these humid summer days in Pittsburgh. A teensy bit long for me, but not a problem. I bought this as a ModCloth employee.
Not great for busty women

review_text: Comfy and a very nice shade, will be my bridesmaid's dress

Loved the dress, hated the color. Exchanged it for the Plum.
It's really pretty and fits great!

review_summary: Pretty, but the fit is all wrong.
review_text: This dress is soooo short. The top detailing didn't even cover my chest ( yes I'm tall with a big chest but still, I've never had this happen with a 3x).    Might be better for a short person.

Dress material is not bad, it looks like decent quality, the color is a bit darker than I thought it would be but I guess that?s champagne and it looked so different as I ordered a white dress in the same order. I wish I paid attention to other reviews before I bought because the dress is WAY TOO BIG!! I usually wear a M and I have had trouble losing weight since my 2nd kid so I?ve been wearing L (size 1214 in bridesmaid dresses). I am 5?6? and about 165 lbs currently and I could pull the dress (zipped up) over my hips.. so basically the dress falls off me not holding on to any part of my body and I am not skinny right now. In fact I considered keeping it to alter it as a 2nd dress for my wedding in the future but it?s so darn huge that I can?t imagine the chest area being altered, it would be like making a whole new dress. I am thinking I can try to sell it and advertise it as 1X or 2X. I would probably need a size S to fit this dress.

review_summary: Cute as heck, GIGANTIC in size though!
review_text: I had gotten a large, as I tend to waver between L and XL, and goodness, this dress was at least 34 sizes too large for me. I'm already a 34DD34DDD, so I'm by no means a small lady, but the chest was just gigantic. Cute dress, way too big!

The dress is very pretty and I like that it has a built in petticoat to make the dress flare out! The lace looks very nice and like a high quality fabric. I wear I size 20 and I purchased a 3x I was a G cup bra and the cup was really large which normally the cup is too small for me. The dress also is a bit big, but I wasn't sure if the sizing if it runs small or large or the equavalance of the size to compare. A size 20 to a 2x or 3x. Overall a nice dress very pretty!

I tried this on in a 3X and it was a bit big all around but enormous in the bust. I wear a D cup bra and this would have fit a a much, much larger chest. I also know dresses that accommodate very large chests are hard to find so if that is you, I definitely recommend it!

It's beautiful! Love the lace and the length. The pockets are a great touch too. I'm pretty small busted, so I was expecting to have to get it altered, but even so, it seemed like the bust of the dress was way too big. The padding in there was also weird since it wasn't sewn down, so it was just floating between the outer layer and the lining. except for that, seemed like a well made dress

Well, I'm in the same boat as Megan. The other reviews swayed me in the wrong direction. I'm normally an XS in dresses, but after seeing several reviews that stated the dress ran small, I decided to go one size up and ordered a S. As someone else stated, the chest area is the biggest problem  way too big. Oddly enough, the waist and hip area was a bit big for me, too. I have a small frame, but I'm a pear shape so something not fitting my hip area is somewhat unusual. Considering the amount of people who have had issues with this dress, it would be super nice if ModCloth threw us a bone and allowed us to at least exchange it, if not get a refund...

So I read through the reviews prior to ordering this dress and chose to order my regular size since I usually order a bit bigger and it fits a little loose.  However, when I put this dress on, I had to laugh.  While I may be well endowed in the chest( 40 d)this dress is made for a girl with an extremely ample chest.  It was seriously six or more inches more than what I have.  Since I bought dress on final clearance, I'll have to have it fitted.

review_summary: Don't Listen to the Other Reviews!
review_text: I listened to the other reviews that said this dress ran small. SO. WRONG. I'm normally a small, so I sized up and got a medium. Fully zipped it fell in a puddle at my ankles. Not even close to fitting. Sucks bc it's final sale so I'm stuck with a dress that's beyond too big. Quality's pretty good  may bite the bullet and take it to a seamstress since I got it so cheap.

I bought this for a wedding because I wanted something more out of my color zone and I thought the product was pink however it was more plum. That aspect disappointed me because I've never been a fan purple, hard to find shoes to match it. The fit and feel of the dress is phenomenal for my body type; I'm extremely curvy and it made me feel comfortable and mature. I recognize most of these reviews say the top was baggy and I can see that being an issue. I had it tightened where you tie it at the neck so it doesn't hang as baggy. Works for me but I cant say it will for everyone!
Too tight around the waist band but way too big around the chest.
Cute dress very flattering. Great for office job in the summer
It's a cute dress, but on me it was too short and too roomy in the bust.

I bought this at the end of fall.  I bought a large it has room for growth.  I ended up getting it hemmed, and with 3 inches gone, it is now the perfect length.  The sweater is a high quality knit it doesn't feel cheap and irritate my skin.  As it runs a little big, I do put it in the dryer.  I will say though this is definitely a winter dress and it is very warm.  I live in Baltimore, and its been a mild winter, and I've not had many days where I can actually wear it it needs to be 40 or below or I will sweat.  Its a great dress for ladies in the cold climates!

This is a gorgeous dress in a rich colour that's perfect for the cooler half of the year. Unfortunately, while this fit me nicely in the bust, waist and hips, there was too much bunching around the shoulders, which is was quite unflattering on me since I already have pretty wide shoulders for my frame. A small would be too big, and I think an XXS would be too small in the bust. Back to the drawing board...
For anyone who gets this remember to treat or keep in mind of the fabric when washing. If you don't it will feel rough. Don't worry. It is a easy fix.

The quality of this dress wasn't great. The fabric isn't very soft, the knit was a bit see through, and it felt cheap. Even the colour just wasn't vibrant like the pictures show. For $80, this one went back.
Love this dress! It's so cute and comfortable, perfect for summer.

review_summary: Most of the time, I need
review_text: Most of the time, I need a L in MC dresses (and then I typically have the top taken in). Since this looked so flowy, I went with M. I might have been able to wear a S though. This dress is lined from the top down to just low enough to cover my rear end  and I mean just barely! The outer layer is very silky and would be very sheer if it wasn't a dark color. Here's where this gets weird. The lining isn't super large in the chest but the outer layer is. I could have several inches taken out of the top outer layer and then this would be much less of a sack. The straps are really far apart as well and they fall down often no matter what length I make them. I think another poster's suggestion to criscross them is excellent! I'd send it back if I hadn't gotten it so cheap.

review_summary: Too wide, but got it altered
review_text: I bought it and it came in super fast, I was seriously impressed with that aspect.  I saw that some reviews were saying that the size was a bit large, so I went with medium as I'm between medium and large, but... Yeah, I should have ordered a small.  Thankfully, the helpful people at the help desk were able to give me a partial refund as I wanted to keep the dress and went and altered it as there were no more smalls in stock.

It's a really great dress and the material, length, and fit is all amazing. It does have a good amount of stretch in it. The only thing I can say that I don't like about it is that it shows a bit of cleavage just a little, but it's nothing major. I'm also a little annoyed that it went on additional sale a couple days after I bought it, but it's such a great dress that I don't mind that much.

I bought this dress in an 1X and it's so beautiful! It fit bigger than expected and I am thinking about ordering a smaller size. And it is longer than I thought it would be. But I am planning on having it shortened. I am 5'4 and it was way too long. I would suggest downsizing one size unless you are very very busty. I wear a bra size d cup and I still could have downsized one more size. It is stretchy from the back. The material of the dress is pretty heavy and the belt is just a black ribbon. Overall, I am pretty happy with this purchase. :) I cant wait to wear this on my vacation to Paris this summer! A photo to follow!

review_summary: So cute, but had to be taken in!
review_text: This dress is soooo my style!  However, because I'm only '5, it was pretty long, and while I usually wear a medium, it was too big! I didn't have time to send it back to get a new one, but I did have it taken in a bit by attaching a hookandeye clasp to the back!  The fabric is a nice material, but will need a good steaming! Also the belt felt really cheap, it was just a ribbon.  I ditched that and added an elastic belt!Overall, cute!

Lovely dress and entirely my style. Usually I have a lot of trouble with dresses being to small in the bust and fitting well everywhere else.  This dress was actually a bit too large in the bust. I ordered a large and wear a 38C. So maybe size down.

review_summary: I'm going to live in this
review_text: I'm going to live in this dress from now on! It is so cute and comfortable!

This dress is actually better quality than I anticipated. The material is thicker almost like a nice Tshirt material and has a nice clingy quality to it. It flows and bounces nicely and is very flirty and fun.
I have smaller bust and wider hips (pear shape figure) and this dress is flattering and comfortable
Fit nicely and was great for warm weather. Thin fabric and soft.

review_summary: I'm short so the length w
review_text: I'm short so the length was fine. The dress isn't bad but isn't worth the price I paid. The bottom is a thick material but the top is pretty light. Not good if you're like me and have back fat. It's super obvious. I'm about 220 lbs btw.
I am tall and large breasted, 5 ft 9, 34G, but even so the waist on this was comically high and was very short. Otherwise nice fabric and drape but hilariously poor fitting.

I'm not a really tall girl, but I found the skirt part to fall short down my leg. I was expecting it to reach my knees, but it went halfway down my thighs. In that sense, it felt underwhelming, even if the fabric is nice and thick.
This dress is so cute on!  I want to wear it for upcoming engagement photos, even though I've already planned 2 other outfits.  It's super comfy and cute!!  Fits perfectly, not too big or too small.

This dress is adorable and very flattering. I have no complaints at all about it. It's high quality and overall a great choice for spring. I tie the little belt in the back and in my opinion that looks way better, but to each their own! The colour of the skirt is darker than in this photo but it actually looks better that way I think. The length is perfect and the skirt is thick material while the top is quite thin. This means minimal wrinkling on the bottom and comfy and breathable on the top :)
This is an adorable dress. Great colors, very comfortable. Only thing I would note is that the top part is thin, so if you wear a dark bra it will show through a little. Otherwise, super cute!

review_summary: I love this dress! It was
review_text: I love this dress! It was more of a coral color in my opinion, which made it beautiful! I'm only 4'11 and the dress comes right below my knee. The top is a little thin but I wore a cami under so it doesn't bother me. I really love this dress :)

This dress looks great in the picture... but when I got it the fit wasn't right for me.  It's big everywhere! It gave me an extra (not needed) 510 lbs to my look.  It does run big as well.  The bow is massive, and the skirt portion was extremely large and poofy.  Would look cute on some, but not me... Returned!

This dres is so cute on the site. I really wanted it to work. But it is HUGE in the chest area (everywhere else is fine), and that's saying something for someone who wears a 32I. The wrap pleats also do not lay well. Otherwise, the print is cute and the fabric is nice.

Just got this the other day and couldn't wait to wear it! It does run quite large in the chest. Had I known the dress had some stretch to it (hooray!) I probably would have ordered the XL but whatever, I'm keeping it and will just get it tailored. Also, the evil side zipper (I HATE side zippers) gets ignored because of the stretch, I can just pull it over my head! It is very large in the bust but I love this dress so much it's worth getting it tailored. Besides, no item of clothing will ever fit perfect off the rack. I may even get it hemmed a bit because it is a lot of dress for a little 5'2 lady. Bottom line.. this dress makes me feel so fabulous!

This is a very cute dress, really nice fabric but it runs large.  Only place it fit me was in the waist.  The bust area was HUGE and I'm a ddd and usually have the opposite problem.  Very large in the hips as well and way too long if you are a petite.

First let me sayI worked with a ModStylist to find the right range for my dimensions. Shopping for my size is a bit of a pain, especially online. I was hesitantbut lordy! I am so glad I took the plunge! This lovely number accentuates my little waist and flatters my sashay hips.  YAY for Aline dresses! As a lady with a VERY ample bust, the neckline is flattering (surprisingly with a bit of wiggle room too).That being said, I may add a snap or a small stitch to the neckline as it does tend to open up when I bend. The dress looks gorgeous with the sash it comes with,  and even without it (if the belt loops are removed). Although it is not lined, the material is of excellent quality.This GORGEOUS dress has me feeling like a bombshell. Ladies, you will not regret this purchase (especially if you're a curvy girl like myself). If you haven't, try working with a ModStylist, they're very friendly.I couldn't be more pleased and will add pictures to my gallery soon :)
Loved it! Had a few alterations done with the busy cups and hem but it was perfect for my wedding day!

The zipper sticks at the waist seam like nobody's business. I was able to try this dress on in store and lucked out that I was able to have my sister zip it closed with minimal effort. The size is 100% correct, but the zipper refuses to go over the seam  it is not getting stuck or snagged on anything. This is very disappointing because it is a beautiful dress made from absolutely wonderful fabric. I bought this with the intention of wearing it to my wedding and now, with the way this dress is constructed,  I'm looking at what may turn out to be an expensive zipper replacement so I can actually close it.  I write this as a ModCloth employee.

review_summary: A beautiful dress that kinda let me down
review_text: I bought this dress to wear on my wedding day. It ran a bit large in my opinion, but I had in taken in so it fit perfectly. Getting it professionally pressed made all the difference, and it looked stunning when I tried it one prior to the day of the wedding. However, on the day of, I was putting it on to go the venue, and the zipper stuck half way up, and wouldn't budge no matter how much tugging and guiding I or my wedding party did. My tailor assured me that she did not touch the zipper in her alterations. It was totally busted, and had to be removed, leaving me with no zipper at all. It could not be attached due to the faultiness of the zipper pull itself. This was two hours before my wedding, so it was really disappointing. My grandma sewed the back up for pictures and the ceremony, but the thread broke and I had to have a costume change. It was all part of the memories, so it in no way ruined my day, but the dress became unwearable so easily the one time I actually needed it, so I thought I'd let others know.

review_summary: Fit is a bit odd, but I love this dress!!
review_text: I LOVE THIS DRESS. The color is a little less yellow in person, and I think it actually compliments my pale, pinkish complexion without washing me out (which is a miracle in and of itself). The narrow straps and waistline are not a problem, which I thought they would with my broad shoulders, largeish bust, and long waist. It is so flattering that I did not want to take it off. Part of me really wants to buy the navy blue one, too, even though it's very similar to the Here Comes the Stride Midi Dress in Midnight dress that I already have. Even if I don't use this as a wedding dress (which I probably will), I plan on keeping it! Having said all of that, there are some odd points. 1. There are builtin cups which are incredibly obvious. These may have to be removed during alterations. 2. The sizing is weird. Initially I purchased an 18, since it was the closest to my size that was still in stock. This surprisingly fit very well, even though I'm actually between a 12 and 14 in this brand. When a 14 came in, it was only a little smaller than the 18. I don't know if the 18 is really a mismarked 16 or if there are just really subtle differences between the sizes. 3. The bust is too big. This is just a matter of tailoring, but I was disappointed to see I'd have to take a good inch or two off of the bust and waist to make it work to its fullest potential. I'm tempted to try a 12 if it becomes available, but when I've tried that in other Chi Chi London dresses, I can't zip it up. There's something weird with their sizing.4. The dress' weight makes the straps dig into my shoulders. I anticipate this is because the bodice is not fitting more tightly, but it is a bit of a nuisance. I still love the dress even with those (admittedly small) negatives. There's a lot of thought that went into this dress' design, even down to lining the inside with a silky fabric so nothing is scratchy. I definitely recommend it, and I encourage Modcloth to not only restock all of the sizes but also to get a larger size model showing this dress off, because it can be stunning with curves!

I bought this dress last August (2016) to wear to my Court wedding and reception. I'm 5'3 120lbs and I ordered the 4. The 4 fit fine, but I had it take in a bit underneath the arms and had the straps shortened. If I ordered the 2, I was afraid it would be too small. My dress was cute and chic and perfect for my simple wedding.

review_summary: Waaaay too poofy and poorly made
review_text: I bought this to use as a bridesmaid dress and it was just way too poofy, like I really felt like Ana in the King and I  it looks poofier than the pics I'm posting and it just made me way too self conscious and felt inappopriate for a bridesmaid. I had read the reviews and planned on removing a layer or two but decided the dress was too expensive to spend more money on and I wasn't sure how it would turn out. The dress also felt like it was going to fall apart and was cheaply made  definitely not worth $175. The bust had weird lines in it, I think it has a builtin bra inside of it but it's not removeable and it just looks really weird. Huge disappointment. It fit well though and the length was great, I'm usually a 6 and the 6 was a great fit.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress so much but I just didnt. the fabric it's made of is really nice but the dress itself just seems cheaply made; the skirt underlay is cheap tulle and it rustles so loudly when you move, the sewn in bra cups are puffy and wrinkly and they were very noticeable through the fabric, the difference in the layers of the liner in chest were also really noticeable ( I'm Native American and Mexican so there's a chance my skin color was making the difference in layers more noticeable, perhaps on a paler person they wouldnt show through as bad), the zipper didnt seem very strong and it was tough to to close even when I wasn't wearing the dress. one strap on the dress i recieved looked like it was already stretched at the seam and i was worried it would break if i had the dress on for a long period of time. I was nervous to even let it hang on a hanger!  as other reviewers had mentioned it had a very strong chemical smell when I first opened the box it came it but it went away after u had left it out of the box for a few days. All in all this dress just was okay at best.

review_summary: I was looking for a simpl
review_text: I was looking for a simple, but fun dress for my gardenparty wedding. It was surprisingly difficult to find something that was modest, but also flirty. This was the very first wedding dress I tried, and it ended up being perfect for me! It did arrive wrinkled, but that was easily fixed with a quick steaming. It does fit true to size. The fabric is nice and weighty, and it's nicely lined. The braarea padding means I won't have to wear an industrialstrength strapless. The skirt is very full, but I love that look. I do wish it came with pockets, but it's an easy fix.Cons: the bra padding is somewhat visible through the fabric; I'm working with a tailor to see if there's anything we can do to fix it. A number of reviewers pointed out that the zipper is quite flimsy. I've put the dress on twice and did have problems zipping it up. I was definitely worried the zipper would break, so I'll be replacing it proactively to avoid a disaster on the big day. Overall, I loved this dress as soon as I put it on. A few minor fixes will make it perfect!

review_summary: I bought this for my cour
review_text: I bought this for my courthouse wedding, which is still to come but I love it. It's beautiful and it fits like a glove. I can't wait to wear it and share pictures.

review_summary: Too big and bulky for my
review_text: Too big and bulky for my liking. Cute though!

review_summary: I love love this dress. I
review_text: I love love this dress. It's a little long for me because I'm on the shorter side but I'll rock it!!

Originally ordered the Aisle Be There dress for my upcoming wedding, but then this one caught my eye! It's gorgeous and simple, but I think a little too big for me. It has a built in petticoat, so I was surprised how MASSIVE it was when I pulled it out of the box. Wish I could keep it, it is lovely. Just not quite what I need.

The Good: I'm very petite and didn't expect a size 2 to fit me so well, but this dress was almost perfect! I ordered the Gilded Grace dress in a size 2 and it was way too big, but even though Chi Chi London makes them both, this dress was MUCH smaller in the same size. I'm one of those unfortunate people with the bust of Keira Knightley, so finding formfitting tops is next to impossible. Of course, the bust on this dress was just a tiny bit loose. If I wear it with a bra (although you could totally hang free; it's verywell padded), it will fill out the bust perfectly. That's super hard to find when you're a 30A.I have a very small waist (24 in.), but the middle fits it perfectly, just like it was made for my body. I'm 5'3, and the dress falls right at midcalf. I was expecting it to be just below the knee, but I actually like it better that it's more tealength and retrofeeling. Wouldn't change it.The Bad:When I took this out of the package, I was overwhelmed by a very strong fishy/saltwater smell. The tag says it's made in China, and from the way it smells, I think it was shipped over on a fishing boat. I've had it for almost a week and even after airing it out, the underskirt still smells like an episode of Deadliest Catch. Five stars if it hadn't been for that.Also, the zipper keeps getting stuck. It's a minor issue, but have an extra person hang around to help wrestle you out, just in case.

review_summary: I should of ordered a siz
review_text: I should of ordered a size smaller. It recommended a size 14 but that's too big on me. next time doing a size 12.

This is a beautiful dress, and very high quality. The fabric is thick and has a nice weight to it. The tulle underskirt is very puffy, and rustles audibly when you move. The dress fit true to size. I ordered this dress and the aisle be there as possible wedding dresses, and ended up going with the aisle be there. The bodice of this dress just wasn't as flattering as I'd have liked. I have fairly broad shoulders, and the tiny straps emphasized that somewhat. The padded bra cups are also slightly visible through the fabric, and made my chest look larger in a notsoflattering way. Zipping the dress up also requires either extreme flexibility or a buddy. I'm glad I got the dress to try on, but it's not the right wedding dress for me. However, I would consider getting this in the navy blue for a different event. I think the chest would look much better in a darker color.

this fits me perfectly! I went by the size chart and had help from a mod cloth chat person because I fall awkwardly between sizes. I am a shorty, and yes the dress is too long.  I did what another reviewer did and cut off the bottom strip (very easy to do) and it is now the perfect length with a 2  4 heel.  If I wanted to wear with flats, I could simply cut the next lace section off as well.  Nosew hemming works with this dress, yeah!!!!!!  The dress in medium fits with plenty of room, and as I am large waisted and large chested, I conclude that it must run slightly large.  It still looks good, though.  This dress also looks nice paired with a cropped cardigan (I used the ivory or grey dream of the cropped cardi from modcloth).  The back of the dress works with a regular bra.  Very nice summery dress, and perfect for days when you don't have time to shave your legs haha. Good buy!

I wanted this dress when it was full price and semistalked it as the price went down. When it hit less than $20, I ordered it, even though the only existing review said it was laughably long. And that's trueit's absurdly long. I don't know a single person who'd be able to wear it, even with heels. BUUTTT. I cut off the last band or two and viola! It's perfect. Now, I have the *perfect* summer dress, good for all things BBQ and outdoor dinner and shopping and relaxing. It's light, easy, breezy, and lovely, and saves me the inevitable  what do I wear? flurry of indecision before I head out the door. Fit: I'm fairly athletic with a bit of a bum (it's a booty). I'm usually a S in shirts and dresses, a 26 in pants. This dress fits like a dream. Hides my tummy, makes me look slim, etc. Wonderful aside from the length.

review_summary: Wore this dress to a wedd
review_text: Wore this dress to a wedding and it was perfect! I don't usually wear fitted dresses, but this dress hugged all the right curves!

I was wordered the dress would be too long (I'm 5' 3 and usually have to shop in petites) but the length is perfect (a few inches above the knee). Overall, the dress strikes that perfect balance of being sexy and elegant. For sizing reference, I have a 36 bust, 26 waist, and 36 hips and the small fit like a glove.

This is my first purchase from ModCloth. I'm impressed. The material feels strong and it hugs every curve. I sized up and I'm glad I did because it fit just perfect. I went by bust size which is 38. The extra little detail at the side helps hide my mummy tummy. I will be getting some shapewear for a little more confidence though. I feel like this is a dress that really does require heels because anything less just wouldn't match. Reminds me of a dress that someone in a high end business meeting might wear. Perfect for an evening semiformal wedding or rehearsal dinner.

I was a little worried about this dress 'cause I'm a curvier gal, but this dress is amazing. It accents all my curves without pointing out my flaws. It's perfect for work and special occasions. It was a little big in the bust, but a different bra will fix that issue.
Great dress for all sizes as it disguises unflattering areas around the tummy and hips.  Material has some slight stretch making it comfortable to wear out or at work.  Would recommend to others!

Gorgeous dress that is fine for evening or with a blazer for daytime

However, the material is incredibly thin to the point where my underwear and bra straps are completely outlined. I wore a skirt slip under it and it fixed the problem. I love the color and can easily see wearing it in the spring with sandals or in the fall with boots and a sweater. Would love to get this in another color!
This is a very cute and casual dress, but I don't agree with the pricing.  The material is very light weight.  I'm not sure how durable it is, but hopefully it lasts a long time.

I'm a petite 5 foot woman and I was nervous about this dress being too long. It's the perfect length and fits perfectly! Can wear it as is or accessorize with a cardigan or long necklace. Also looks super cute with leggings, boots, and cardigan! Absolutely love.

I was pleasantly surprised by just how soft this dress is  like a tshirt.  I'd read in other reviews that the thin material made it not so flattering but I found the opposite.  I'm busty and curvy and this still draped well.  It's also very versatile  I wore it today to work, then on a date, and now to a dance class.  And the fact that it's sleeveless means I don't have to worry about getting sweaty.  In the fall, I could throw a little jean jacket on top and get another season out of it.  I definitely love and recommend this dress! PS You can put it in the washer/dryer and get away with not ironing.
