This is the most comfortable most flattering dress I have ever worn!!! The fabric is soft and stretchy so it fits around a full chest without difficulty and without sheerness. The cut is fit at the waist (but again stretchy material so super comfortable!) and hangs a bit loose at the stomach. It creates a perfect silhouette and works well with natural hour glass shapes. Honestly it was the one dress I bought from here I wear the most and get the most compliments on. I loved it so much I bought it in Olive as well!
Clingy fabric, but the style and color are worth it. Top part stretches out the design in the larger sizes but it still looks good.

This is my favorite article of clothing!  It is so comfortable, very flattering, and the perfect length.  Right now I'm using it as a house dress/PJs because that allows me to wear it EVERYDAY.  I have the dress in navy, but I crave this dress in light blue!  My only wish is that it was washing machine friendly, but I would still buy another one in a brighter color.

Very  flattering! I am very curvy and busty. This dress covers my chest,  hugs me at the bust where I am the smallest, and is flowy on the bottom.  The material is light weight which is perfect for summer. I love the olive green color. I am wearing it with a gold necklace and earrings set and some gold sandals to dress it up a little bit.

The top half of this dress is unbelievably flattering, especially if you have a smallish chest compared to your hips  the gathering really evens things out visually.The biggest flaw with this dress is the skirt  it's not lined and therefore clings to every lump and bump, unless you wear a slip under it or go commando, even the skimpiest underwear will be giving you a panty line. If the skirt was double lined this dress would get an easy 5 stars from me.I bought mine in Olive, size L and the top fits me perfectly  I don't like tight clothing, but this is definitely not loose.I have a long torso which does make this dress seem a bit skimpy in length, but would probably be perfect for those of you in the 5'45'6 range.Due to the cost of international returns, and the fact that I am in love with the top half of this dress, I am keeping it, but I am on the prowl for a complementary fabric to rebuild the skirt portion.

I have seen this dress on the site for quite some time and since I had some store credit to burn, I decided to purchase this lovely item. It is very pretty, good lines, strong color, it's jersey so the fit is pretty much spot on, however, I could have gotten away with going down a size which is rare for a plus size outfit. I like this dress because of it's versatile nature, it can be dressed up with fun chunky jewelry and a cardigan with boots or pumps or stay simple and do a fantastic job at both. I think the only thing I would say against the dress is the the price point, it just seems still a bit high for what it is.

I am 5'1 with a shortish torso. This dress fits me perfectly. The color is as shown in the photos. I am giving the dress 5 stars because I always receive compliments. The only disappointment I have is how thin the material is. It is a stretchy jersey type knit that will cling and show panty lines. Also, after handwashing the dress, reform the bodice layers before allowing to dry. It will help keep those adorable layers looking their best.

I'm somewhat pearshaped and this is the kind of dress that gives me an hourglass... very flattering to a small bust and the skirt, while not exactly Aline, has plenty of give and drape. The waist is a slight empire which works fabulously well on me. Jersey fabric is a decent midweight heft. I wore it the other day to church with a black cardigan, leggings and boots and got lots of compliments. I see it gliding effortlessly into spring (with capri leggings and ballet flats) and summer (with ethnic jewelry and sandals). I only wish there were more colors. I'd love to have this in the plum (which is out of stock) and in black! or oooh red... anyway, very happy with the dress. From my experience with this type of fabric, I imagine it may pill slightly, so I think I will probably line dry to keep it as nice as possible. I also imagine I'll want to wear this with a light slip if I ever wear it with stockings, as I can see the bottom possibly clinging in such a situation. Thanks Modcloth!

review_text: I LOVE this dress.  I want it in every color of the rainbow.  The waist is a little big on me, but I had to get a large to accommodate the girls.  Comfortable and a beautiful color  VERY figure flattering.  One of the sleeves is sewn a little oddly, but it's not a big deal.  More colors, Modcloth, please?!

Beautiful Dress! The color is very pretty and the material feeling amazing on the skin. The cut of the dress is very flattering, I have big hips compared to the rest of my body, but this dress hides it perfectly and makes me look super slim :) I love it!

A very versatile dress so easy to dress up or down with a very forgiving cut. I think the stretchy fabric can accommodate just about any body type. I've worn this to church, as well as to work functions and girls' nights out. The only thing that might be a concern is the thin, clingy fabric of the skirt. If I don't wear flatseamed undies, my panty line is glaringly obvious mostly from behind. Just keep that in mind. Regarding the sizing, I was pleasantly surprised by the near perfect fit. At 5 ft 3, and about 105 lbs, I'm used to not being able to fit cute stuff in size S because I usually can't wear anything other than XS. (Or even XXS in brands with ridiculous sizing... But this fits so well, so I'm going to go ahead and say that it runs a little small, as many ModCloth items do.

This dress is very flattering and fun.  I like how it camouflages my problem areas (hips and stomach).  The material is soft, but not too clingy.  The color is beautiful  having auburn hair and hazel eyes, it was just what I was looking for.  I can wear this dress as a casual day dress, or add some jewelry and a sweater if I want something nicer.

i don't usually wear dresses, but i'm so glad i bought this one! it's one of the best modcloth purchases i've ever made reasonably priced, well put together, and super flattering without being revealing or fussy. if they made this in more colors i'd probably buy every one.

I bought a medium rather than my usual small because I was afraid the top would sit strangely, so it's my own fault the waist is too loose. That's not the reason I'm leaving off a star, thoughthat's because, as can be seen in the first picture, there is a pale white smudge on the dress. I don't know what it is and I haven't tried to get it out yet, but it's rather unfortunate.Otherwise, the fabric is ridiculously comfortable and I can't wait to wear it around this fall.

Classic, gorgeous, very flattering and well made.  Hides stomach pooch and thighs.  Shows off nice arms and flatters the bust, even if you're a little small on top like me.  If you're on the fence just order it, you will not regret it!  It is THE most comfortable dress I own and looks fantastic.

review_text: I get a lot of compliments on this dress and it is unbelievably comfortable.

review_summary: I ordered both a small an
review_text: I ordered both a small and a medium to find the best fit, but neither ultimately worked out for me. The medium fit me pretty well, but the shoulders were really unflattering on me. The material seemed kind of thin, as well. I sent both back.

This dress fit exactly as expected and is so lovely! It is a nice quality jersey and the style (with the ruching and bands at the waist and neckline) makes it look nice enough to wear for a nicer occasion. Definitely a great purchase!

This is a beautiful dress. The cut is so flattering, and it's as comfy as pjs. The armholes are a tiny bit big on me, but nothing to worry about. The color is a deeper olive green than the brownish green pictured here.
Very comfy and great for summer.  Love the Grecian element.

I absolutely adore this dress. I got the dress for my birthday, and I love it! It fits very well, which is hard because its sometimes hard to find clothes that fit well. Its very comfortable and stylish too, which is a very hard thing to accomplish! So if you are looking for a comfortable, fun dress, that is very stylish and perfect for everyday or a party, this dress is for you!
This is the most perfect dress. The shape is so flattering for curves, the color vibrant and it is SO comfortable. I have washed it several times and it has held up beautifully!

review_summary: This is a great dress. Th
review_text: This is a great dress. The ONLY complaint I have is with the ruching on the front. The middle part kind of sags, like it wasn't completely finished or something. However, this dress is so flattering and I cannot say enough about it. LOVE it! I am almost 5'8, 150 pounds, 34D/32DD bra size and got a medium and it fits perfect.

This dress is beautiful and fits very well thanks to its stretchy nature. I ordered the small which fit my body like a glove. My only complaint is that the material sometimes sticks too much to cotton underwear so I recommend silky panties to avoid this.

I almost never wear dresses and often feel uncomfy in them but this dress was different. I didn't want to wear a pants under my graduation gown and went searching for something I thought would make me look nice on a very special day. This dress was better than I ever expected! It flatters my large bust without showing too much, hides any little pooch I have and makes my legs look long. I would buy this design in every color! Thank you Modcloth for this special dress! After 4 years of nursing school, I walked across the stage feeling proud and pretty (under my gown)!

review_summary: This is by far and away m
review_text: This is by far and away my favorite Modcloth dress (and I have quite a few)!  It's remarkably versatile  I've dressed it up and down  and ridiculously comfortable.  Sometimes, when I come home, I will change out of another dress INTO this dress because it's more comfortable than sweats.  I LOVE wearing it, and it's the perfect length to wear either with tights or leggings, or without when it gets warmer.  It drapes wonderfully and is perfectly flattering  it even looks good on my more poochy days :)  Buy it if you're considering it, you will get a ridiculous amount of wear out of it.
Lovely color, PERFECT fit. I love this dress.Buy it right now.
I lo
This dress is very comfortable almost tshirt material. It gives the illusion of a larger bust which I need! It was longer than I expected but it makes it a more versatile dress.

review_summary: I love this dress. I thin
review_text: I love this dress. I think it would be a little nicer on me if it were a bit shorter (it hits me right at the knees) but otherwise it's a great fit and so comfortable to wear, and yet it's still pretty enough to dress it up and wear it out to lunches and dinners.
This dress is amazing. it's light enough to wear in the summer, and it can be dressed up or down. A friend borrowed this for graduation and it was perfect.
This dress fit perfect and the fabric is perfect, light and airy for the summer time. The shade of green is slightly different then on the computer but still gorgeous.
super soft, comfortable and flattering. Falls nicely on the hips. a staple in my wardrobe!

review_summary: This is my first dress pu
review_text: This is my first dress purchase from Modcloth and while I was concerned the lining of my undergarments would show, the dress fits perfectly.  The color is beautiful and the material is wonderful for the upcoming summer.  I will probably need to shorten the hem of the dress a little but this is a wonderful dress and very much worth the money!

This was my first ModCloth purchase, and it is AMAZING! As a 34 DD, I've *never* been able to find dresses that fit at department stores but for some strange reason, my bust/waist fits exactly into what Modcloth considers a large. I've barely taken this dress off since I got it. It's comfortable, light but not too flimsy, fits my chest, *and* flatters my waist. I appreciate that it's not too low cut, meaning I can wear it pretty much anywhere, and that the straps hide my bra straps (pretty essential with a chest my size). The dress hits me right below my knees. Color, as others have stated, is actually a darker, greener olive: much more attractive than the picture. (I'm super excited about the color.) Thanks, Modcloth, for the awesome dress! I'll be coming back for more... maybe I'll actually be able to have a few dresses in my wardrobe now.

review_summary: This is a lovely, soft dr
review_text: This is a lovely, soft dress that I plan to wear during the cold months with brown boots and a short chocolate or orchid cardi.  It makes me look quite shapely and falls just at the top of my knees.

review_summary: I want this dress in ever
review_text: I want this dress in every color!!!  The fit is amazing, the green hue is beautiful, and the fabric is super soft and comfy.  What a fantastic find!  This is great for a lightweight summer dress, but can also be worn with leggings and a cardigan when the weather starts to cool down. I LOVE IT.

Dearest ModCloth:Please purchase these in all the colours of the rainbow, so I can have them too.  Pleasepleaseplease!The large fits juuust right on my frame  which is tough when you're like me and sorta toe the line between normal sizes and plus.  Just the right amount of stretch to accommodate the boobs and slightly larger build.The fabric is thin which is a win and a loss: it'll definitely require thong or boyshort wearing, as those lines will show (or wear a slip).  I call it a win, though, as it's incredibly light and comfortable as a result, and not seethrough in the least.As reported, the colour's a little more browny/neutral/olive than the photo might suggest, but it certainly flatters my own slightly browny/neutral/olive skin. ;)Thanks ModCloth  now find someone to make me more!  Saved a very busy wedding season... I hate dress shopping.
I love how comfortable this dress is while still looking very flattering. Perfect for work and play! The fabric is a nice knit of medium to light weight, so great for summer.

The dress is very flattering on my curvy figure. It hides all that I want to hide and flatters my curves perfectly.The material is very soft and flows naturally when I walk. My only small gripe is that it is a little too long for my 50 frame. I would have preferred it to hit the top of my knee, not the bottom. I am very happy with this dress overall.
The dress is darling. True olive color, perfect length and perfect fit.
I love this dress. I'm 5'6, about 140 pounds, and a B cup. The dress fits me perfectly, hits me a little above the knee, but not too much so. Very cute, great purchase, highly recommend.

Gorgeous color and overall fit.  It looks perfect in the front.  I wish the material were a bit thicker. The back of the dress shows off unflattering bra lines like crazy because it the fabric is SO thin.

review_summary: This is a cute dress, but
review_text: This is a cute dress, but I just don't like the clingy material. It isn't very forgiving to my tummy. It is beautiful on the top though.
Perfect dress!

review_summary: I have a lot of the same
review_text: I have a lot of the same comments as other reviewers. The color was greener than it'd anticipated (more foresty than olive). The fabric is SUPER comfortable. Most important for me was the fit. I'm pearshaped (small chest, narrow ribcage, but big hips). This dress flatters my narrow waist, but the ruffles in the bust help make me look less flat, which is great.The dress is a good length for a wedding/similar event (ends right at the top of my knee), which I love, but it might seem long to those who really like the short/flirty look that a lot of dresses have right now.

review_summary: I love this dress. It fit
review_text: I love this dress. It fits like a dream and is so soft! This is a very flattering dress and the color is perfect.
so soft. a different cut than i'm used to, but it works.

review_summary: This dress is great for t
review_text: This dress is great for the office, the beach, or strolling around in the city doing some errands.  Light, with a great flor.  I thought it was going to be clingy, but it wasn't at all.  The fabric is so cozy and so light for hot days.  I wasn't sure what size I should get, since I'm normally between a small and medium, but the medium fit perfectly.

This dress clings perfectly to my figure and is not very forgiving if you have love handles. Thankfully I don't at the moment, but I could see it being unflattering. It's easy to wear but the quality is cheap, I don't expect it to last forever. BUT I love the shape it gives me and it's very beautiful.
Gorgeous! So comfortable and flattering. Easy to dress up and down. Love it!

review_summary: I was not sure about this
review_text: I was not sure about this when I first tried it on, but must say that I have had positive comments every time I have worn it. Very comfy, but make sure you feel OK wiith some cling around your bottom :)

The photo simply does not do this dress' lush green color justice. It's very breezy and feminine, and not clingy at all. The day I wore it after it arrived I received more compliments than I knew how to handle! It's unlined, so if it's cooler out I suggest some bright tights (I wore orange!) and a cute coat. DEFINITELY worth the investment. Thank you, Modcloth, for a dress a busty girl can feel confident in!

review_summary: I waited a while for this
review_text: I waited a while for this dress, but it was definitely worth waiting for. It is beautiful, and the color is a little more green that what the picture shows. It feels great when being worn, and can easily go from casual to dressed up. The only issue I have had is that it easily wrinkles, but that is easy to fix. It was a little loose in the top, but after one wash it fits perfectly. I would definitely recommend this dress.

review_summary: I love this dress. The co
review_text: I love this dress. The color is flattering, the flow is feminine but not childish, and the fabric weight is versatilecold weather with tights, spring with a cardigan, on its own for summer. With a teething puppy, I am considering purchasing a second just in case!
This dress, like every Gilli dress I've gotten through ModCloth, is awesome. It's cute and comfortable, stylish and easy to wear. Highly recommended!

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favorite dresses!  I love the weight of the fabric and the fit.  It is a very flattering shape and a beautiful color.
Fits nicely, nice curvy silhouette, nice material and detail. Great for travel. Best of all it's made in the USA! :)

Love this dress. I initially ordered this dress in a small since there were no mediums available at the time.  However, considering the fact that I have a heavy bottom (see measurements), the material stretched out a tad too much for my liking around my butt. When the medium came in stock I ordered that and couldn't be happier. It is roomier on top and flows nicer on the bottom. It does show off any lumps so shapewear is my friend with this dress. The green is also darker than pictured, which I like better. One thing though, the medium came with a plastic thing in the back (normally used to hang dresses/shirts) and my small didn?t.
The fit is amazing!!! Makes us look as a godess! I would be so happy if I could have it in other colors as well! I couldn't be more happy with this!

Just like everyone else  I love this dress! Very flattering.  My boyfriend doesn't usually like modest dresses (typical boy), but even he liked this dress because it's flattering. I highly recommend this dress!

review_summary: This dress is made of ver
review_text: This dress is made of very soft fabric, that has some stretch.  It is very thin, but there's no issue with seethrough.  It's a very comfortable cute dress, great for work with a cardigan.

Great dress. It shipped on Jan. 25 and it arrived in 7 business days on Feb. 2, which is very good considering the package crossed the border into Canada. Fabric is soft and comfy. The dress fits well around my bust and is a tad large around my waist, but I'm OK with that as I feel it would be too constricting if I went down to a small. The length goes just below my knees, I would have preferred just above my knee, but this is a common issue for me since I'm on the short side. The color is a darker olive in real life, which looks even better than the picture.
This dress is perfect. The color, the length, the fit. It looks absolutely gorgeous. It makes me look like I have a fabulous figure. I love love love it.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress! It is
review_text: I LOVE this dress! It is a lovely color, very soft, and the perfect length. If they had it in other colors, I would buy those too! I highly recommend it. It's perfect for those days in the office when you really don't want to dress up with this dress, all you need are heels and pearls and you are set!
Love this piece.  Well made and very flattering fit.  A bit short as a dress for my taste, but perfect with leggings.  I hope to see it in another color as well.

review_summary: Not sure what it is about
review_text: Not sure what it is about this dress, but somehow I look fitter and more buxom in it. Perfect for work or anything really. Hit just above my knee. Very soft cotton material.

Love.  Classy, hits just above the knee, amazing fit in the upper body whether you're busty or not.  I will actually be able to wear this when I'm out with my little kids because the skirt won't be blowing up in the wind and the top has just the right amount of coverage to keep my privates private.  :)

This dress moves beautifully!  The material is soft and the cut is feminine.  The dress is definitely olive, as the name denotes, even more so than the pictures show.  The color is prettier in person!  Great stretch through out, especially in the neck and bust line, so there is plenty of room for my friend (two cup sizes larger than I am) to borrow it, yet it doesn't look baggy on my tiny top.  It falls right above my knees.  I've worn it with heels, the Fold Friends Flats found here on ModCloth, and Doc Martens, receiving compliments on the DRESS in all three style I wore it.  It worked great as a holiday dress because it's green without being obnoxious green... you know what I'm talking about.

review_summary: I ordered a small based o
review_text: I ordered a small based on review comments, but I should have gotten a medium.  The dress is very nice.

A very flattering dress for a busty girl like myself.The cinch accentuates the waist nicely. A longer length than usual for Modcloth, so great for those taller girls. Hit at the knee for me, so I will take it up an inch or so. Very flattering casual dress.

review_summary: The dress has a great col
review_text: The dress has a great color (slightly darker than what is pictured), light weight and soft material. Very flattering over curves. I highly recommend this dress!

review_summary: I really went back and fo
review_text: I really went back and forth about this dress before ultimately deciding to return it. The color is just as pictured, and the fit was perfect quite flattering and pretty. However, the length makes it more formal than an everyday dress, and that combined with the simplicity of it just made me question how often I would actually wear it. Overall, really pretty, wellmade, and flattering, but just a little too simple, modest, and formal for my personality.

review_summary: I had high hopes for this
review_text: I had high hopes for this dress.I'm tall, have a decent chest, and a curvy figure.This dress wasn't flattering, but it was not that far off.  It was clingy in the hips, and the neckline made me look overly Matronly. Can't win them all, I'm returning this dressbut I'm sure I'll be ordering other dresses from Modcloth very soon.

review_summary: There is a reason this dr
review_text: There is a reason this dress has so many positive reviews. It's great! Flows nicely and fits well. Highly recommended.

I got this dress because I love the color, it looked comfortable, and it got perfect ratings. it didn't let me down much...but the shoulders just looked kinda weird on me, i feel like it made me look kinda bulky there. Considering switching it for another style..
The color is simply gorgeous.  The waist sits a little high on me and the dress is a bit clingy, but it's still quite comfortable (just not so workappropriate as I would have hoped!).

This is my FAVORITE dress in the whole world! It falls just the right way, it fits perfectly, and the material is perfect. I've washed it so many times and it hasn't changed a bit! So pretty. Looks great with a cardigan as well! I wore it to take self portraits for my digital photography course! #freshphoto

It's perfect soft and flowy.  I could probably go to a small but I like that the medium hits just above the knee on me and the waistband doesn't squeeze.

review_summary: I was worried about the b
review_text: I was worried about the bust not fitting me since I'm very small up top but I had nothing to worry about, it fits perfectly! The length is even good for us short girls. It's very comfortable and I think it could be dressed up or down easily. I can't wait to wear it out!

Joining in with the hundreds of other reviews... this dress is fantastic! I was deciding between two and am keeping this one. The color is slightly darker than pictured but still olive green. The length is great and the design is flattering. I do wish the fabric was a little thicker, so that's my only complaint. I am normally between sizes, and sized up due to how thin the fabric is, so that it would drape nicely.
Great, very flattering!  Would have been nice if the bottom was thicker or lined.
This is a nice lightweight dress for spring or summer.  The fabric is very comfortable too.  I can't wait to wear it!

review_summary: I love this dress. I feel

I love this dress, every time I wear it out I get a few compliments.  I'm a bit on the busty side so I ordered up and because I'm short the dress hits knee length.

review_summary: I love the color of this

I probably should have gotten a medium in this for my size, but it still fits okay. I don't know if i want to go to the trouble to exchange it though. I really like the color and the fact that the fabric isn't super clingy! It's quite flattering.

review_summary: This is the first dress I

The material is super soft and the style is versatile  I can wear it with a cardigan for work, but I can also dress it up for a fancy party.
I've gotten lots of complements on this dress. It is a tad bit thin making it slightly shear so you might need a slip to feel more comfortable.

This dress fit and looked way better than I thought. The ruching around the waist is slimming. The material is soft and comfortable. The length is perfect, long enough where I don't have to worry but still short enough it's not matronly. Great buy for me.

review_summary: I took a long time decidi
review_text: I took a long time deciding whether to keep this one. I ending up keeping it because the price right, it fits well and is made well. It is just not as *special* as I was hoping for. Had it been in a warmer, less dull color, I probably would have ripped the tag off and added it to my closet immediately. But still, I do not think I will be disappointed that I kept it.
Very comfortable.  Flattering for small busts.

review_summary: I have never had so many
review_text: I have never had so many people compliment me on anything I've worn. I've gained a bit of weight recently, and wanted to get something that would make me feel beautiful every time I put it on. The color is a perfect olive, and it hits right at the knees for me. You will probably want to wear some noshow panties with it, since it can be a bit clingy, but really it's just about perfect.

Because of all the positive reviews I was afraid I might be the one person who didn't like this dress. Nope, love it. The fit and length really are perfect. I agree with some of the other reviewers, though, the dress is not quite an olive green so stay away if that's what you were hoping for. I second the request (or third or fourth...?) for this dress to come in more colours.
Love this dress! I'm normally an Australian size 810, 10D bust, and this dress is so flattering I want to wear it all the time! It sits just above the knee and the ruching falls perfectly.

This dress is incredible.  I have a large hip to waist ratio, so I always look for flowy dresses that accentuate my waist.  This does exactly that.  The ruching is perfect and stretches to fit my curves.  I'd recommend this to anyone.
perfect summer dress. very chic and comfortable. the color is a dark olive color and the fabric has a little give. very happy with my purchase.

This is a beautiful dress it's very flattering and elegant. The color is not at all what I was expecting; it is much darker than olive and than in the photo, which makes the details of the fabric get lost a bit more than if it was lighter. That said, I will be keeping and enjoying this one.

This dress is super flattering (especially for someone curvy, like myself) and equally versatile; I absolutely love it!  The color works for every season, and it can easily be worn with a cardigan and leggings or on its own.  The fabric is soft and flowing, lightweight but substantial.  It's hard to imagine this dress not working for someone I would highly recommend it!

For reference, I am 130 lbs. and the medium fit perfectly.  I love the top part of this dress; it's beautiful and flattering.  Also, I was pleasantly surprised that the color turned out to be definitely a rich green color, not the almost brown that it appeared on my screen.  The only thing that bothers me is that the bottom of the dress is pretty thin and flimsy, but I guess for $30 I can't expect perfection.  Otherwise, great dress!

review_summary: Go buy this now! Grab you
review_text: Go buy this now! Grab your credit card and get it now you will not be disappointed! Received this perfect dress today, as per other reviews clearly state  olive green is a lot darker than in the photo in a good way  nice and deep colour. I'm just shy of 5'4 and an Australian size 10, pear shaped and the Small size fit me like a glove. Awesome wide straps, soft, high quality fabric, falls to just above the knee.  Arrived in Australia in only 11 days, so happy with my first Modcloth purchase!  Would definately buy this in multiple colours if available.

Perfect dress. Modcloth should convince the makers to produce this in a myriad of colors. The material does feel thin (and dare I say it, a bit cheap) but the fit is incredible  the pleating really does conform to and flatter every body shape, and the modest neck line is actually great  it makes this dress suitable for wearing anywhere. Great summer dress  for us in Australia.
LOVE this dress! It's very comfortable and flattering.  I was worried it wouldn't fit over the bust area, but no problems. I wish it came in more colors!

This dress is so amazingly soft and has just the right amount of stretch. The color looks just as good on me as I thought it would from the picture. I'm usually a medium but since they were out I chanced a small and it still fit just right. I wish it was a tiny bit shorter since I'm not keen on longer dresses, but it still looks amazing! I like the fact that I can dress it up or dress it down for the occasion.

Very happy I bought this dress.The draping is lovely and the color is a nice warm shade of olive.The only thing to be wary of is that it does drape against the body so take care when choosing your foundation garments.  You could end up with some SERIOUS V.P.L. :)But with the right undergarments it looks really lovely and pairs well with a cardigan or a fitted blazer.

review_summary: I love this dress!  As wi
review_text: I love this dress!  As with some of the other reviewers, I am a shorter girl with big hips and thighs and I love these waisthugging, medium length dresses. For me I wish the waist was a *tad* lower  I am very short and still for me this waist is above the small of my waist and the smallest part of my back.  It's not empire, but it's definitely not at my true waist either.   If the waist were 2 inches lower it would be perfect.  It's comfortable, pretty flattering, the quality is great.  Overall I am happy!

review_summary: The skirt is a lot less f
review_text: The skirt is a lot less full than it looks in the picture; the gathering is only at the center front and the center back, and the skirt is fairly straight. I have a curvy hourglass frame and a bit of a stomach from some recent unwanted pounds, and this dress made me look pregnant :( Its too bad, because it fit wonderfully on my large chest, which is always the hardest part of me to fit. Its a beautiful dress, but it may not look right if you're bottom heavy.

Adorable, comfortable, charming, chic. Just a few words that have been uttered to me while wearing this amazing garment. Its just the thing for a warm lazy summer day strolling through the streets of a small town in Italy, or wherever you happen to be.

review_summary: This is by far my favorit
review_text: This is by far my favorite modcloth purchase to date!  The dress fits perfectly, is easy to care for, is comfortable, and can be worn for a number of different occasions.  With a nice cardigan and some flats it is perfect for work.  Dressed up with some flashy heels and a funky necklace, it is actually really hot!  I have gotten so many compliments wearing this dress.  You won't regret this purchase!

review_summary: This is a really comfy ca
review_text: This is a really comfy casual dress. The fabric is light and a bit thin, so it's great for warmer weather.

This dress fits WONDERFULLY. As a classic pear, sometimes it's hard to find a dress that fits on top AND on bottom, but the flowy bottom half doesn't just FIT, it FLATTERS. It just hits the tops of my knees, so the length is really perfect for any occasion, and the modest neckline means I can wear it to work! I'm DEFINITELY happy with this purchase. Thanks for another great one, ModCloth!!

Two small but really thoughtful details that make this dress for me: (1) there is enough room up top that the waistband actually hits my waist in front and back, without riding up to create that awkward babydoll/empire/maternity look, and (2) the modestbutcute neckline means there will be no need to layer a cami underneath in the dead of summer (hurray!).  So soft, so pretty, so easy to wear.  Winner.

This was my first modcloth purchase and I was a bit nervous. I tried it on and it fit better than any dress I've ever had. I absolutely love it! Everything fit great and the material was heavy enough to lay perfectly. I wore it to my Thanksgiving dinner and had so many great compliments. I definitely think that if anyone is interested in it, she should purchase it because I doubt she'll regret it.

Brilliant dress, brilliant color. It is an extremely flattering fit and makes your waist look tiny. It is a bit too short to wear for work, but when matched with some nice boots, scarf, and cardigan it is the best thing to wear out on a sunny fall day. Perfect for the summer and spring, as well. I love this dress.

This was my first Modcloth purchase and it was a great experience.  The dress fits perfectly and doesn't look cheap.  The color is more of a dark green than pictured, but it looks nicer than the photo.  The length is perfect; it hits right above my knee.  It's a few inches longer than a lot of other dresses on Modcloth, so I'm worried most of them will be too short.  Modcloth should definitely carry more dresses in this length.

review_summary: This dress is a great sta
review_text: This dress is a great staple. perfect default dress for any occasion as it is easy to dress it up or dress it down.

Love this dress.  It's ridiculously comfortable and flattering.  The fit is perfect...usually dresses this style are too big on top for me.  The quality is much better than I was expecting for a $43 Modcloth dress.

This dress must be flattering on every shape! The cut is fabulous! The skirt has a nice flow to it. It can easily dress up or dress down. Super comfortable and versatile. They should make it available in lots of colors?it's a definite win.

This dress is wonderful. The material is very soft and comfortable. It's easy to dress up or down as well. Throw on a pair of tights/leggings underneath and a light cardigan and it's perfect for fall!
Not great for the shortwaisted, unless you're superskinny.

With 195 other reviews, I know this dress doesn't need another one, but I had to leave this anyway, because I LOVE IT. It's a very light material, and though I usually find that light material shows every line, this dress is really flattering. It looks good and feels pretty. The fit is fantastic, tooeven if I gain or lose a little weight, this dress is going to look stunning. (Also, ModCloth threw in a little matching bow hairclip with my order, which was adorable!)

I read many comments gushing about how perfect this dress is, and I think I just had expectations that were too high. It is a nice dress, and I do get compliments, but it's not close to my favourite. It's also longer than I thought it would be; it hits just above my knees. I'm not crazy about the fit on me, but my friends liked it. The jersey fabric means it is a little clingy, but it's fine if you wear a slip under.

Absolutely flattering and comfortable. PLEASE if you ever get this dress in another colour (blue, red, purple.....) let me know, you could never have too many of this style (and I am mutton dressing as lamb and getting away with it).

review_summary: For some reason I was exp
review_text: For some reason I was expecting this dress to be more like something I could wear to work if dressed up properly, but it's just too casual. It's made out of a very soft tshirt material though, which makes it suuuper comfy, and great for wearing to school. Just gave it 4/5 stars because it wasn't QUITE what I was expecting, but I love it nonetheless.

review_summary: This is a really cute dre
review_text: This is a really cute dress. The fit is just right and it's totally comfortable, as well. What I like best about it is that it's not too short and perfect for the office.

My favorite modcloth purchase so far. The olive green goes perfectly with my tan skin and the dress comes down to the knees. The fabric is really soft, semistretchy, and not seethrough. And for some reason it makes my chest look huge, which is a great thing.

review_summary: I love, love LOVE this dr
review_text: I love, love LOVE this dress. So simply yet so elegant. I usually worry about dresses like these clinging in all the wrong places but this little gem couldn't be more flattering. Its length hits me on the knees which is fabulous as I am relatively tall and trying to find dresses that have a decent length is a nightmare. The color is beautiful as well, a really great buy at such a great price!

review_summary: This is a great dress! It
review_text: This is a great dress! Its kinda casual but i don't think I'd have a problem dressing it up a little. The material is good quality and the color is very olive, more green than pictured. It is a little longer than i would have hoped for but I'm gonna keep it, perfect for everyday.

review_summary: This dress is such a gorg
review_text: This dress is such a gorgeous colour! Good length and fits nicely. Being jersey it shows off a few more bumpy bits than I like but nothing a pairs of spanx won't fix. Lovely dress!

review_summary: As soon as I put this dre
review_text: As soon as I put this dress on, I was SO glad I bought it!  It looks simple and elegant, but is so flattering to my curves.  One of the most feminine dresses I own, even with the modest neckline.  I had no problems  pulling, etc   in the chest area with a S.  This doesn't get 5 stars for 2 reasons: 1. it's already pilling after 2 wears!  This makes me so sad, because I'm afraid it doesn't have a long life ahead of it.  2. Even with a slip, tights, and a fullon dryer sheet rubdown, the skirt still clings to my legs.  But it's still a good choice, because it looks so nice on and is versatile and classic.

review_summary: The rouching on the top a
review_text: The rouching on the top and the gathered waist is so flattering! Love this dress
Pretty dress, fits well. The band under the bust is really flattering. It was a little expensive for the material used, though.

review_summary: At first I wasn't sure if
review_text: At first I wasn't sure if this dress would fit, you can see by my measurements that I have a hard time with anything, but the dress fit perfectly!! This was my first modcloth purchase and I'm 100% pleased with it. The gathers don't emphasize my bust and the skirt drops straight down instead of poofing out. The color is a darker olive than pictured, which was what I hoped for, and it hits me right at the knee. Super super pleased, and I will definitely be back for more!
Simply perfect. It won't last forever, but I will get a lot of use out of it before I run it into the ground. Good for dates, work, classes, anything.

Love this dress!  My favorite Modcloth purchase so far.  The fit is incredible, through the arms bust, waist, and length.  The fabric is really comfortable and versatile, and the cut is very flattering.  I'm going to get a lot of use out of this one!

The wildly positive reviews of this dress convinced me to buy it. As others have said, the real color is much nicer than in the photos. Though I do think the dress is overpriced, I have such a hard time finding cute, comfy, workappropriate items like this that I am willing to pay the extra cost. I will wear it solo in the summer and with boots, leggings, and a sweater in the winter. Also, the shipping was crazy fast and I got a cute free gift with my order!

Love the dress. The color is the perfect sophisticated olive green. You can wear this dress day or night. It's comfy. It's jersey so it doesn't wrinkle. I've worn this to bible study. Can't wait to wait it more.

Another pretty dress demure, yet figurehugging in all the right places. Be warned, this will highlight your chest (ruching right there), but it doesn't cling to hips and nips the waist in very nicely.

The perfect little casual, comfortable dress.  The weight's more appropriate for spring and summer, but I may try to brave the elements and wear it with a cardigan, boots, and opaque tights (though that would cut down on the comfort factor).  The top part of the waistband hits right under the bust and the bottom at my natural waist.  It's very flattering and, it you have a bit of a tummy, surprisingly forgiving for such a lightweight garment.  If you don't believe the gazillion other positive reviews, believe me: buy this dress!
Love this dress!  Gorgeous, flattering, comfortable as a tshirt.  Would love to see this in other colors too!

All the previous reviews were helpful in helping me pick this dress, and I love it. It's supercomfortable and so easy to throw on. I'm long in the body, so it comes up a bit short for my liking (it's cold here) but I just throw it on over some tights or leggings and it looks fabulous! Also, the soft jersey fabric crumples down well and still looks great. I ride my bike to work, so I like to pack a nice lowmaintenance dress to change into. This fits the bill.

review_summary: I was expecting so much f
review_text: I was expecting so much from all the great reviews, but I found this dress very thin and very clingy on the bottom.  While the top is flattering, for those of us with nice big bottoms and real hips, this dress hits awkwardly.  It is not right for my figure (with a big booty!).

Love this dress! It's so easy to dress down and up, the length is perfect on me, just on the knee and the colour is a little ''richer'' (more beautiful I think). I got strong shoulders and it hits just right. VERY comfortable. For the cold weather, you could easily wear it over a long sleeves shirt and a pair of leggings, boots and it look nice too!

review_summary: This was my first buy fro
review_text: This was my first buy from Modcloth, and I am very impressed! Shipped quicker than I thought and fits like a dream! The color is slightly darker and greener than the picture (very glad about that) but the material was a little thinner than I had hoped. I can't wait to sport this for my holiday adventures :)

This dress is ADORABLE. My mom bought it for me as a present to replace a similarly colored dress which kicked the bucket, and this dress is SO much cuter! The color is fantasticit's a bit deeper than shown in the picture here, very attractive. I chose the large because of my chest, which tends to destroy any cute ruching detail by stretching the fabric, and it was a good choice. The dress looks great, and the waist is elasticy enough that it doesn't hang from my chest like a curtain, instead flowing down beautifully. It hits just at my knees, which I like a lot, and as others have noted, the top covers those awkward little sidearm bits, making it SUPER flattering. LOVE this dress!
Excellent dress...fits perfectly!! very happy :) with purchase

review_summary: I love this dress! It is
review_text: I love this dress! It is super soft and comfortable. I have 44 inch hips so tights or Spanx and helpful in smoothing some bumps, but the dress is gorgeous either way. I would definitally recommend it! Cant wait to wear it with cranberry tights and boots this fall!!!

Amazing dress. A little bit darker than the picture but very nice. The fit is really forgiving of any problem areas and the fabric weight is suitable for a range of seasons. The best aspect of this dress is that makes unbusty girls look endowed. For a gorgeous semicasual/casual dress that makes you look fantastic, go no further

review_summary: Tis is my new go to dress
review_text: Tis is my new go to dress for any occasion! You can dress it up or down. The fit is perfect and very flattering accentuating the waist while not flowing out too far to make the bottom half look wider. The chest fit perfectly with enough pleating left to not make it look like I was smooshed yet modest enough to wear to the office. I would imagine this dress would look great on most body types. The color is a deeper darker green than it looks in the picture which I actually love.

review_summary: This is going to be one o
review_text: This is going to be one of my favorite dresses! It is very comfortable and I feel pretty when I wear it. I recently wore it on a cross country trip and it was very comfortable to travel in easy to pack and looked great! Highly recommend!

You're reading these reviews correctly, ladies: this is in fact the world's most flattering dress. This is now my worktime goto. The fabric is a little thin but so far it's held its incredible shape just fine, so five stars it is.

review_summary: I ordered this as soon as
review_text: I ordered this as soon as I saw that it was available :) I love the quality, the length, and the color. It is very flattering with the waist detail at the perfect place, and then flowing away from the hips... I love it

review_summary: The cut on this dress is
review_text: The cut on this dress is amazing I am a little topheavy and this dress fits well up top without being baggy at the bottom due to the flowy draping of the skirt. The cut is modest enough that I'll be able to wear it to work, but with a quick change of jewelry and shoes it'll be really cute for postwork drinks or dinner after work. The quality seems good, and the jersey material is soft and comfortable. I pretty much plan to live in this dress.

This dress looks gorgeous in the photos and on. I wish it had a little bit more of a sleeve, but that's probably just me. It's super soft and comfortable without being clingy. The fabric is thin and stretchy so Im a little bit worried about how it will hold up to washes, but so far it's done well.

I'm a size 8/10 still fighting a belly bulge and this dress makes me feel like a million bucks. The cut is fantastic, the fabric is comfortable and I'm so happy I bought it! If they made it in more colors I'd but them up!

After reading other reviews I thought, I have to have this dress, especially at that price!  I've never seen such consistently good reviews on this site before.  I have to say they may have lead me to expect a lot, which can be hard to live up to at times.  I wasn't sold when I first opened and tried on the dress, but I've come around to quite like it.  This dress is as described, the length is perfect, falling just above my knees, longer than many from this site, the front is modestly cut, very work appropriate, the colour is quite a deep olive (a bit darker and greener than the pic on the site), a neutral but by no means blah green.  The sash hits at just the right part of the waist, letting the skirt hang nicely from the right height, hiding anything you want it to below it.  The construction seems solid.  The only strange thing is this little plastic strap across the back of the neck, meant to keep the dress on a hanger.  It's very strange when you wear it, because it's visible!  I'm going to get rid of that, otherwise quite pleased with this purchase.

review_summary: I just got this dress in
review_text: I just got this dress in the mail today, and I love it already! The fabric is soft and flowing, but not too clingy. The length is just right for taller girls (falling just above my knees at 5'10), and the cut is figureflattering. The color is a much darker green than what you would expect from the pictures, but I love it nonetheless. Definitely pleased with my purchase!

review_summary: I love this dress! Very c
review_text: I love this dress! Very comfortable, very flattering. I was iffy on the color but it works really well with my tan complexion.
Dress is flowy and looks awesome.  It's the perfect weekend dress

review_summary: Color was more of a dark
review_text: Color was more of a dark green than the lighter more golden green color shown, but the dress fit perfectly and was a big hit at the 2 weddings I've worn it to so far!
Great casual dress, so comfortable to wear. Colour is more green in person but still happy with purchase. Fit great (I'm 62kg and 28 waist)

I bought this dress based on its reviews as a good dress for women with larger bottom halves. I'm 5'1 and roughly 130 lbs, and thanks to my little extracurricular habits of dance and roller derby, it's all in my thighs and butt. I love my curves, but it sucks not to be able to fit my butt in a dress sometimes. That is NOT AN ISSUE with this one! If you tend to wear two different sizes on top and bottom, as I do (usually a S on top and a M on bottom), base it off of the size needed for the top. The dress is super flowy below the ruching at the waist, and will accommodate your lower half :)The dress garners zillions of compliments! Looks great, it's super comfy, the fabric is really soft, and you don't have to dry clean it. Love.My only complaint about this dress is that I've worn it three or four times and it's starting to pill a little bit (hence why I knocked off a star). Not an insurmountable obstacle, but mildly annoying given that it's still fairly new.

I cannot express how much I LOVE this dress. I would wear it every day. It fits like a dream. I have a slightly curvier body and it accentuates every good curve and hides the bad! I love it. Its a beautiful olive green just like in the picture. It's a little sheer in the sunlight, but that is easily fixed. Perfect for fall!

review_summary: I love this dress! It can
review_text: I love this dress! It can be dressed up or down, depending on your accessories. I've worn it to work a few times and gotten lots of compliments. The green is a beautiful shade and will bring out the color of your eyes if you've got hazel or green eyes. The dress is comfortable and the quality of the material is good.

review_summary: I love this dress and so
review_text: I love this dress and so do all of my friends! The fit is great and it's a perfect length for someone taller like me. The fabric is a little thin, but not seethrough.

Beautiful drape, great color, very flattering fit, and amazingly comfortable.  I wore it to work today with a cropped denim jacket, violet lace stockings, and cognac heeled loafers.  I can tell I will get a lot of use out of this dress.  Really a great purchase!

I'm really happy with this dress. It's comfortable, and looks cute. I'm pretty busty, and this shows that off without being  obnoxious. My only complaint is that the color in the picture is not a good likeness to the color the dress actually is. This dress is far more green than the picture shows (and is actually a much nicer color than the one in the picture).
I liked this dress enough to keep it and the color is great but the fabric is super clingy so not possible to wear without spanks.
New favorite dress! It is so flattering and extremely comfortable. I also like the arms holes  they don't show anything you're not supposed to see!

I worry about Modcloth running too small for my curves, but this material and style are perfect. The only critique is that it is quite a bit darker than expected from photo, and more green but I still love it. Material is wonderful soft jersey and it hits almost at the knee, just above it! :)

This dress is very flattering, and also very comfortable. It looks great up top, as long as you like an empire waistline. It flatters my larger hips, but it doesn't do it in a way that makes them appear smaller, if that makes sense.Length is at my knees, which I like. It's very soft and not clingy. Overall, a very good buy, especially for the price!
Really cute and modest. The color makes my greenhazel eyes pop!

review_summary: Oh my god this dress is p
review_text: Oh my god this dress is perfect! It fits so beautifully and really gives you the hourglass figure. It drapes gracefully and my boobs look fantastic in it! I have purchased from modcloth before and this is by far my favorite purchase! Love it!!

review_summary: I wasn't sure if I could
review_text: I wasn't sure if I could pull this color off since I have medium tan skin because I am Asian and my skin has yellowish undertones but I love Greens and Blues....this actually looked perfect on me...the fit, quality, comfort, silky feel of the fabric, and beautiful pleating, folds, and band were just PERFECT.  I wore it to work with a cream cardigan and brown wedges with gold jewelry.  Very good for the price!  Thank god I got the last one!

review_summary: I have to agree with a lo
review_text: I have to agree with a lot of the other reviews, this is a dress that will look good on almost everyone.  I have a slightly darker skin tone, which doesn't work with all colors, but this one looks fantastic.  It's comfortable, and can be used for a variety of occasions.  Highly recommended!!

LOVE this dress!  I never know how big a small will turn out to be, but this dress fit perfectly.  The color is beautiful, and with the higher neckline and length (right at the knee), it's conservative enough for work but not so much so that it can't be worn for an afternoon of shopping or out to dinner.  It's also going to transition well from season to season, so I think this is going to be one of the most oftenworn dresses in my closet!  One of my favorite ModCloth purchases and I'm an avid Mod shopper.

This dress is beautiful!  I've only worn it once, but I got so many compliments.  It's very flattering, at least it is on me (I don't have much waist, and empire styles mask that a bit).  The material is soft and fairly thin, but it seems well constructed, at least for the price.  If I could change one thing, I would have it a half to a whole inch longer, so that it hit right at the center of my knee, rather than brushing the top of my kneecap.  But that's not such a big deal.  I can't wait to wear it again!
Happy! This dress is form fitting, flattering, and feminine. It is just the right length and has just enough sleeves to wear to work. I'm sure this will become one of my goto favorites.

So happy with this purchase.  Love the styling, which you can dress up to be sophisticated or dress down to look more casual, and the soft fabric.  Beautiful olive green color.  Fit me well all over.  The waist band is definitely an empire waist, but the flow of the fabric minimized my stomach rather than emphasizing it as empire waists sometimes do to me.  The bottom hit about an inch about my knees.

First off, shipping was fast and that's always a huge plus. The dress is flattering for the most partthe band sits under the bust and the color is lovely. The only part I wish was better is the quality. The skirt part isn't completely sheer by any means, but I prefer thicker fabrics. Overall, I'm quite happy!

Gorgeous dress, would suit most body types. I've had so many compliments today while wearing it! Please modcloth, order this dress in other colors like navy, light blue, or back. I would purchase more!

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much! It's so slimming and flattering, and the color looks great with my redhead, freckled coloring... though it can work with just about anyone I imagine. The gathers at the bustline and waist are so feminine and lovely, and it falls right at my knees. I love wearing this with some crocheted tights, a cropped 1/2 sleeve cardi, and clunky platform heels. Very stylish... A+, Modcloth! :)
Really great quality for what you pay for.  But there is a clear elastic thing running across the back at the top of the shoulders (so behind my neck), am I supposed to leave it or cut it off?

Bought this because I needed a summer dress that was still appropriate for work, and this fits the bill perfectly.  The large is a little snug around my chest, so I usually have to wear a bra that doesn't enhance the girls at all, but that's not an issue.  The length is perfect, falls about 11/2 to 2 inches above the knee.  The material is light and slightly seethrough, but not to the point where you would need a slip.  My biggest issue is that there's not a ton of stretch to the dress, and I have to be very careful when putting it on: I have bigger shoulders, and if I'm rushing to get into it, I can hear some seams ripping!  Nothing too major, thank goodness, I just slowly eaaaase into it and I'm good to go! :)  Definitely a good, reasonablypriced staple to have in your summer wardrobe, and I imagine it will transition nicely into fall and winter with some stockings and boots!  Can't wait to wear this over and over and over!

review_summary: I love this dress. It is
review_text: I love this dress. It is the most beautiful color,  and fits my DDs perfectly.

review_summary: I love this dress! The co
review_text: I love this dress! The color makes my skin look pretty, which isn't always the case. And, it can be so many different things depending on what shoes and jewelry I wear with it. I would not hesitate to recommend this dress!
Great item, so flattering, has a great weight fabric and hangs well.  Highly recommend!

This dress is a musthave. The quality jersey fabric, complemetary cut, and deep green (olive) color make it a prefect summer dress. After waiting and waiting for the small to come back in stock, I finally broke down and ordered a medium because I wanted it so badly. And am I glad I did! The medium is perfect for my size 34D chest. It hits at the knee. Very cute and classy. I love this dress!

This was my first ModCloth purchase and I have mixed feelings. The dress is beautiful, but the fabric is flimsy and the waist falls under the bust rather than cinching midtorso.  Just moving the waistline down could have done wonders.  Otherwise, the Medium fits well, the color is beautiful and I will keep it. However, I will be a bit more cautious about the fabric quality and the exact fit.   I'm a bit obsessed with checking the website almost dailly, so I will likely buy again. Thanks.
Love this dress. The material is a little thin, I have washed it three time and it seems to be holding up, hopefully it will continue to.
Perfection. Love love love this! Very comfortable and attractive. For reference, I am 5'7 and 125 lbs.

Simple, well constructed dress. Knee length. Darker green than in the picture. Also, material is more of a casual/sundress than it looks. However, with nice shoes and jewelry this could be work at work or to a dinner date. Dress is priced right.

Very versatile, flattering dress! I had trouble deciding whether to buy the S or M, but ended up getting the M. I usually wear a size 4 or S dress, but with MC dresses I often have to size up to get them to fit my bust. In this case, the M fits just fine in the bust and is loose and floaty around the hips, so it was the right decision. The waist hits a bit high on me, which is usually unattractive because I have a wide ribcage, but in this case it still looks great. The style is slimming and so very flattering. I really think MC has found the universally flattering dress style! It shows off a small bust, flatters a large bust, and hides larger hips if that's a problem area for you. The neckline is lovely, and the little cap sleeves slim your arms. It's not a short as many MC dresses, so it could be worn when a mini isn't appropriate. Because I got the M, it is actually a bit longer than I wanted (covers my knees), but I'm only 5' tall so that will not be a problem for most people. The only thing that might not be flattering on everyone is the color. I like the olive green (it's a bit greener thant it appeared on the website), but i'm not sure if it would look good on all skintones. I hope MC carries this dress in more colors, because I'd definitely buy more!

This dress is pretty much perfect. The color is lovely, and the fit is great. It is so flattering. On someone who is not so well endowed (like me), it give the appearance of a larger bust and helps balance out my top and bottom. What's more, it's so comfortable that it practically feels like I'm wearing pajamas. I get tons of compliments whenever I wear this.
Beautiful! Made by the same people who make the Closet Braid dresses and has the same very soft fabric. Flattering, and both long and professional enough to wear to work. And so reasonably priced!

This dress is so sophisticated and sexy in such an understated way.  As soon as I tried it on, I knew this one was a keeper.  It drapes beautifully, is a modest length and an easy to match color.  I wore this dress with the Old and New Pocket Watch Necklace and Iced Coffee Wedges, and I had effortless beauty and sophistication.

Love love this dress. The fit was perfect and the length just right. The material is very soft and light  perfect for summer weather. The color is exactly as shown in the picture and it complements my skin tone perfectly. Great purchase from Modcloth!
This dress is wonderful! Classic, elegant, and perfect for almost any occasion. It's great for warm summer days. It's very flattering and very feminine. I love it!!

review_summary: This is the type of fabri

review_summary: The olive green of this d
review_text: The olive green of this dress is quite a bit darker than I thought it would be (and my computer screen has generally been accurate on other orders). I don't love the gathered fabric over the rear end, but will keep and no doubt wear this dress a lot as it seems versatile and nice and light for summer.

This dress is wonderful! It's very soft and comfortable, but looks neat and polished. The cut makes your waist look small and your bust look bigger (but not ridiculously so). The fabric is thin, but by no means sheer. Because of the stretch and the flattering cut I think someone with a waist size a few inches larger than mine could wear the large without a problem.

How lovely! This dress is modest without being boring and elegant without being too fancy to wear every day. I absolutely ADORE this dress. The only problem is that it's a little small around my bust, which I'm kind of used to from ModCloth, but otherwise it fits very well. If it was currently in stock I'd probably exchange mine for a medium, but I don't want to wait indefinitely so I think I'll keep the small.

review_summary: This is one of my favorit
review_text: This is one of my favorite Mod Cloth purchases. I get so many compliments when I wear it!! It's very flattering in every way. It's a keeper!!!

review_summary: This dress is GREAT! I wa
review_text: This dress is GREAT! I was a little concerned when I took it out of the box since it looked small (and I'm def bigger on top than the average bear) but the material hugs my curves without gapping or bulging. Another feature I LOVE is the gathering at the front of the skirt....sometimes dresses like this make me look like I have a bun in the oven but the slight gathering under the waist just makes this curvy girl look HOT! Perfect with a cardi and flats for the office or with sandals for a weekend brunch.

I absolutely love this dress! I was worried about how it would fit, but I'm so glad I got it. The color is exact shade of of green as my eyes. It is a little bit darker than the picture, but not by much. The fabric hangs beautifully and the chest has plenty of room which is usual a problem for me. The rushed waist is very slimming. The sleeves are a little shorter than I thought they would be, but all in all this dress absolutely perfect.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress, it han
review_text: I LOVE this dress, it hangs beautifully, has a light (but not flimsy) fabric and a very flattering cut for curvy ladies. I have an ample figure that sometimes makes me look too busty for summer dresses but this one is spot on!My only criticism is that it's slightly small. Expect a snug (not tight) fit. It does gave a bit of give to the fabric so I am still happy with the item, but I am hoping it will loosen up in the shoulders and chest once I wear it a few times.

review_summary: I love this dress!  I bou
review_text: I love this dress!  I bought it to wear to my bridal shower (olive green is one of my wedding colors).  I was worried that the fabric might cling is places like my stomach and booty, but it hangs beautifully.  It clings a tiny bit to my bottom, but nothing a slip won't fix!  The fabric has a bit of a sheen to it and it is super soft and comfortable.  I was worried that it might wrinkle easily because of the type of fabric, but not a problem.  It barely wrinkles at all.  Definately a dress I will wear again and again!

review_summary: I love this dress.  So si
review_text: I love this dress.  So simple but it looks great.

OK, first off, I paid $7 for the basic ground shipping, and the dress arrived in two days.  TWO DAYS.  That's what I'm talkin' about!Also, the fit is perfect.  The material is very light, so before I tried it on, I was worried it would cling in all the wrong ways, but no.  It floats flatteringly over all my midsection imperfections and as my roommate said, works well for the bust.  I have an average size chest, and it accentuates that area without being ridiculous about it.  (I bought a medium and it fit me perfectly, at 5'7 and 165 pounds.)I have yet to wear it out, but I can see myself adding a little shrug and wearing it to work, or rockin' it sleeveless with some big heels for a night out.  This was my first ModCloth purchase and I couldn't be happier.

Great dress! I was worried it would cling in all the wrong places, but the pleating makes it flow away from my lower half while accentuating my waist. The coverage up top works well for large chests. I typically wear an extra large in Modcloth clothes, but the large was perfect in this gently shaped cut. It's work appropriate with a light crochet shrug. The material is thin, though, so I added a darkcolored halfslip to prevent v.p.l.

review_summary: This is a lovely basic dr
review_text: This is a lovely basic dress. It's fits me beautifully and is so comfortable. Flattering on every level. I'm especially pleased with the length of the dress which makes it appropriate for work and play. I'm always a little appalled at the prices of Modcloth's more basic pieces, but it is worth it if you want a good quality garment with just enough flair to make it stand out from similar pieces you can easily find at Target for half the price. I get easily frustrated when shopping for clothes, but so far I have been very pleased with my Modcloth purchases.

review_summary: I ordered small and it fi
review_text: I ordered small and it fits perfectly. This dress is just pure awesomeness, I'm so happy with it! It's great for the summer. The fabric is breezy and comfortable. Love love looove it!
This dress is perfect and comfortable. The color is a little more green than the picture shows, but that's not a problem, as far as I'm concerned.  I absolutely love it.

Fits like a glove!  This dress is so comfortable and feminine and flows so gracefully. I especially love that the straps are wide and cover that awkward spot outside your armpit (you know?).  And the ruching is just beautiful and flatters the top and bottom halves very well.  It's a tad short on me, but I do realize I'm above average height.  Love this dress though.

This dress is amazing!!!!! Very flattering cut and colorand it's finished really well. I usually wear a size 16 dress and the large still fits and doesn't cling to all the wrong parts. Id recommend this dress to my best friend. That's how much I love it.
This dress is fabulous. It's long enough and the neckline is conservative enough to wear to work with a cardigan, and it's easy to dress up to go out to see a show. Perfect!

LOVE this dress!  Fit like a glove and as a small woman (100 lbs and small B cup bra) this dress made my chest look larger and complimented every curve of my body.  My husband loves this dress too  he can't keep his hands off me when I wear it!  lol  :D

review_summary: Wow this dress is super s
review_text: Wow this dress is super stretchy comfortable and did I say cute! I am 34c, 108 lbs, 5'2. Its not too low cut, and long enough to wear to work. The quality is nice and for an unlined dress its not see through at all. . A wonderful rich olive green, the ruching highlights your chest, and the banding flatters your waist. I'm extremely pleased :)

review_summary: This is a very cute casua
review_text: This is a very cute casual dress that could be dressed up for work with the proper accessories and a cardigan or blazer. The color is beautiful and the dress has a comfortable and flattering amount of stretch. I recommend this one for my largerchested sisters out there.

Wore this dress today to explore a new city.  Very, very comfortable all day while looking classy.  I received several compliments.  Light but sturdy material, wellmade and wellcut, perfect length.  Even though I am not your typical hourglass figure, this dress gave me one.  Now I want one in navy and one in black!

Perfect!  Soft material, rich color, length comes right to my knee, decent quality for the price, and VERY flattering!  I am usually a L in Modcloth dresses, but read the reviews and am glad I got a M  though the bust is about as snug on my 32DDs as it could be, in a good way!

Fits absolutely perfectly. Snug on top and flowy on the bottom.  I'd say if you have a bust any bigger than mine it might be a little too snug on top.  I have long legs so it's hard to find a dress that isn't too short and this dress hits me a couple inches above the knees.  very happy about the purchase!

review_summary: I just got this dress tod
review_text: I just got this dress today, and it is so cute! I love the color, I love the cut, and the neckline is so classy and cute! The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because mine seems a little messed up the shirring on the bust part of mine is missing in some random places. It's MOSTLY shirred, but there are pretty noticeable and sizable gaps where it just is flat, and looks kinda weird. If the blank nonshirred spot was in the center it might look more intentional, but it's not. However, I don't think anyone else would notice or care, and there are no smalls left to exchange it for :( So I'm keepin' it! :)
Fits perfectly!

This is a fabulous little day dress. Easy and comfortable, very flattering cut on top without being too revealing. Great color, too. Can definitely wear with sandals in the summer or tights, boots and a cardigan in the winter. Fit true to the size chart on me. I often size down on styles like this, but the medium was perfect. Would have loved an extra inch or two on the length, but I'm comfortable wearing it as is.

My first ModCloth purchace; saw this dress and fell in love, the reviews helped too.  The medium fits me perfectly.  Great coverage on top, not tight in the armpits.  Falls just above the knee.  Material is a tiny bit thin but I don't think it should be a problem.  Can't wait to wear this dress out and about!
I'm a petite, pearshaped, 810 dress size woman and the size L fits just right. The color is more of a forestgreen, but it is a lovely shade.

I was so disappointed when this item sold out immediately, and had been oh so impatiently awaiting the restock. I jumped on it within minutes, and wasn't disappointed! Fabric is higher quality than I was expecting at the price point, and the dress is lined through the bust. Super flattering, and love the color, which is slightly greener than the photos. GORGEOUS!

review_summary: I had been waiting for mo
review_text: I had been waiting for months for this to come back in stock and it was worth the wait! The dress is actually more of a forest green than it looks in the picture, which I was actually happy about. It is very flattering it accentuates my waist, keeps my chest in, and skims over my larger hips and butt. I was worried it would be too long since some taller reviewers said it was the right length for them, but it hits me right at the knee.

This is a darling little jersey dress.  Lightweight, supersoft, and easy to wear.  Can easily dress up or down.  The draping gives me a slightly Grecian feel.  The banding at the waist really makes for a skinny silhouette and gives shape to a fabric that isn't usually shapely.  The color isn't a drab oliveno brown undertones.  Instead, it has a touch of forest green in it, which is quite stunning with my pale skin and red hair.  This dress is going to get a lot of wear!!

review_summary: This showed up at my door
review_text: This showed up at my doorstep just as I was getting dressed this morning, and I put it on right away. I cannot express how much I love this dress! The fit accentuates my waistline and figure beautifully, and I got about halfadozen compliments for it from random strangers today. The material is quite light and perfect for a warm summer day like today. I paired it up with a black pearl necklace and it looks great. My complexion is medium with goldyellow undertones, and I was concerned the color might not suit me but it looks just fine. It is a little darker than it appears in the picture. What I love about this dress is that it is so basic and versatile I can pair it up with a number of my accessories for different looks and occasions. I wish they made it in more colors I could not be happier with this purchase!

Words cannot convey how excited I was to finally receive this dress after basically stalking the site every day all day. I wanted this dress the moment I saw it, and the reviews just confirmed how awesome it was. The fabric is lightweight but not flimsy. The construction is beautiful and really flatters my figure. I got a large because I am pretty tall with a curvy figure and I wasnt sure if a medium would cling in all the wrong places. The large is a perfect fit for both my height and size. Plenty room for the girls and no clinging to the rear. I am super happy about this purchase.
Best Modcloth purchase in awhile! Good price, flattering dress, and not too short! It looked beautiful with a beaded cardigan and brown strappy sandals. I can't wait to wear this again!

review_summary: I have never heard I love
review_text: I have never heard I love your dress!!! more than I have today.  Walking up the stairs to work with an older German gentleman, he told me the dress made me look almost like a European girl. Unique. Beautiful and he said Thank you for your appearance. Definitely worth buying.Great cut for someone like me with a large butt and skinny legs who looks awkward in shorter dresses.

A great, comfortable dress that is very flattering and not too revealing.  As a girl who's 5'9, I definitely appreciate when ModCloth has reasonably priced dresses in longer lengths.  This hit just above the knee, and the good price included no sacrifice in quality.

Living in the Miami of Australia and had it shipped here. Came today and fits like a glove. It is so soft, light and the fabric is fabulous. The cut works well with hips, and I could not be happier!  As a teacher, I can safely wear this anytime!

I have the Navy/Flowers, Black/Poka Dots, Navy/Mustard Strips, and the Red white and blue.  The cut is great! I am curvy and I feel like it covers me enough for work, which is very important.Notes: the Red white and blue and the Navy/Flowers is a light material.  the top is think enough to not feel sheer, the bottom is light and flowy, I did add dress weights to the bottom seem for windy days.The Navy/Mustard and the Black and white poka dots is a heavier feeling fabric for the bottom, which is nice, a little warmer and I feel like I could pull on tights and wear them for fall, they are also good fall colors.

Beautiful and comfy dress, but a little large on top, something that's not usually an issue for my bust. If you have a smaller bust, size down if you can (however, be aware of the waist and hip measurements still).

I bought this for a trip to Florida and loved how well it fit. It's lightweight and the silhouette is perfect for curves. I dressed it up with wedge sandals and for day when I did a lot of walking I wore white converse. I am 5'2 and the hem hit about an inch above the knee. I also wore a cami underneath as it can be a bit busty.

I got this 50% off on a sale so for the price it was a steal. The fit is perfect formfitting up top but not tight. I got the black top/red plaid skirt version, and was pleasantly surprised that the skirt was in a contrasting material, it had more texture like a wool plaid (although I'm sure it's not wool), while the top was as soft as it appeared. Definitely going to try for other patterns in this style, it's great.

review_summary: I own this dress in the f
