review_summary: Ordered this in an XL and
review_text: Ordered this in an XL and then ordered a 1X. I have another Gilli dress in XL that fits really well but this one fits much better in 1X for me. It's a great length and super comfortable.

review_summary: This dress is soft, has s
review_text: This dress is soft, has stretch, and oh so perfect for the holidays! The downward angling of the plaid works wonders for rear end minimizing.So comfy! Love love love! Would definitely buy again.

review_summary: i love the cross top of t
review_text: i love the cross top of this dress. its doesn't cut you off and if your bigger chested it gives you a slimming look. i am long waisted so i try to stay away from dresses with a solid waistline. this was close to perfect! the skirt is a nice medium heavy material perfect for most seasons. i also love how the skirt doesn't look like a ton of fabric but is still a nice length. great buy.

These dresses are my absolute favorite.  I have almost all of them and they fit great.  Not too tight on top and great length.  The bottom of this one feels a little different, like a different material, but I love it just the same!

This dress is very cute, and the fit and length of the 2X was perfect for my hippy, busty, tall, size 18(US) body. I also didn't have any issues with gaping at the bodice, but the black part of the dress hit me at an awkward spot  not high enough to be empire, and not low enough to be at a natural waistline, so it made my top half look short and stumpy. I will try the cut again in on of the allonefabric styles because overall the silhouette is flattering.

review_summary: I am a huge fan of Gilli
review_text: I am a huge fan of Gilli dresses and knew this was one when purchasing. The fit on this one is perfect for Gilli  (which I think runs slightly large, so I always size down).  The quality is on point.  It looks GREAT on me.  However, the style just wasn't working for my personal taste.  It looked either too holiday to wear any other time or too school girl for someone my age (mid 30's) to pull off.    I'd definitely buy it on sale,  but can't justify full price for something I'm not likely to wear outside the month of December.

This dress fits beautifully, and it falls at a lovely length. It may be a little unforgiving for the odd lumps and bumps, but nothing a decent pair of tights wouldn't fix. At first I found the fabric difference between the skirt and bodice distracting, but it was easily forgotten.

Perfect Holiday Dress!

ModCloth, stooopppp making this perfectly amazing dress is so many great colors! Just stop! This is #3 for me and has yet to disappoint. They just keep getting better! Fits like a glove, perfect length; just have to tack the vneck closed.

The tie covers up most of the open area, but it may be too daring for some to use at work (I would probably only wear this  at work with a cardigan). It's a gorgeous date or party dress though.

This dress feels like sweatpants and a tshirt had a baby, which is to say, awesome. The fit is outstanding and it makes me feel great. I would buy this dress a thousand times.
I've had several misses with Modcloth recently, but this dress is perfect! It fits like a dream and is so comfy. I couldn't be happier with this purchase.

review_summary: Print Might Be a Little Too Young
review_text: I received this dress as part of the surprise mystery item special.  The quality is really great especially for such a casual item, where quality often tends to suffer simply because it's not meant for special occasion.  The fabric is so soft and the neckline is gorgeous and flattering.  My one complaint is that the print I received this in is...somewhat...young.  While the other prints that are offered for this dress seem like they suit a wide range of ages, the one I got is white with little delicate purple flowers and a bold purple waist band.  Don't get me wrong  I like bold!  But something about the pattern is very baby blanket to me.  (Though that might be because it feels so soft and nice.)  Not sure if I'll wear it myself for that reason, but it's such a cute dress!

This dress is really cute and made of good, thick fabric, but it's just too short on me, so I'm returning it. I'm 5'8 and 160 pounds and the large fit me really well everywhere else, but the dress only came down to about midthigh.

This dress is shorter than I expected so I will have to wear some shorts beneath it but other than that I love everything about it. The material is nice and thicker than I expected. No cleavage and it fits my chest in it fine.

The colour is beautiful and it's a little shiny even; I get a lot of compliments wearing it. The cut is a little low so if you're busty, beware cleavage. Otherwise, it's very comfortable and made of good material.
This dress has poofy sleeves...I felt they looked flatter in the photo. It's still a pretty dress and fits perfectly, but a little more cutesy than professional like I wanted.

review_summary: I loved the fit of this,

I just received my order in the mail, and I could not be happier! I was nervous to order without any reviews, but I could just not pass up purchasing it when I received a discount code. My main concern would've been the sleeves but they are lovely and roomy. This is definitely going to be great for autumn and winter and I can't wait to wear it more. I am normally a size 14/16 UK.

I've wanted this dress since the first day I saw it on the site but put off buying it because I never have any luck ordering the correct size on Modcloth and always end up returning everything. When this was half off however, I couldn't resist. I'm a 14/16 dress (closer to 14) and the XL fits nicely. It's flattering, the pattern is obviously very arresting and unique. I'm pleased.

This is my first Modcloth order. I bought a lot of different styles and brands to see what might 'stick.' The Modcloth brand seems to be a great fit. I am 5'10 and about 170. I don't have a super long inseam but often with dresses, they are too short overall arena too short in the torso, especially with 'unique' brands. This fit perfect in a L. One button gaps a little but can be fixed with fashion tape. I can see how the pattern might not work for everyone. I am am bit on the fence but think it would look cute with offwhite or brown oxfords. Anyway, I am sending it back because when I opened the bag, it smelled. I thought it was the fabric, but in getting it unfolded and such, I caught another whiff and it was strongest in the armpit area  definite BO. Super gross and icky. I am sure it would come out if I kept and washed it, but, ewww..... really??

review_summary: I feel like Mary Tyler Moore.  But when she was alive.
review_text: Holy pants.  This dress is everything I hoped it would be and so much more.  It's perfect.  The fit is 100% onpoint for me as a size 26 wearing a 4x.  I'm a 44G/H in bra size, I don't think a more busty woman than me could wear this.  Comes to below the knees and I'm almost six feet tall, so longer than in the photos, but I wanted that.  Lucky for me, it's just right for my body.  Keeping it, never letting it go, making it my newest best statement dress. I may give it a funeral when it finally gets too worn to keep wearing.

Great unique style and print. Not see through and no weird drop or empire waist. True knee length. Fabric wasn't scratchy or wrinkly. The only reason that I am returning is that my current measurements are between sizes on this dress.

review_summary: I'm a pretty solid XL, an
review_text: I'm a pretty solid XL, and this dress fit like a glove. However! There is no stretch whatsoever, so if I gain a few pounds, I won't be able to wear it, so definitely size up if you like things to fit a little loose. It's also a bit long (hits right at my knees), so if you like that in a dress, it'll be perfect! But sometimes I like mine to be a little shorter. It'll be a great work dress, though.

review_summary: I ordered this one size t
review_text: I ordered this one size too big because ModCloth sizing has been so unreliable lately, at least in my size. This fits me like a tent, but I can say that had I ordered a smaller size, I would like it very much. The fabric is definitely kind of a sweaty poly; not a summer dress. But I like the pattern and the colors, and the length is great.
Unfortunately I had to send it back. It was too large.

Colors a lot more vibrant in person. Very cute dress but sizing was odd for me. Medium was too tight around the lower chest and large was too big. For the ladies who find either of these sizes just right, it would be a perfect little dress.
Love this dress except the bust is tight.

review_summary: I got this in a 3x becaus
review_text: I got this in a 3x because I was worried it would run small. Just the opposite I was swimming in it. Returning it for a 2x today.

review_summary: This is a super cute dres
review_text: This is a super cute dress, and it fits nicely. I'm really happy with it.

review_summary: I went out on a limb with
review_text: I went out on a limb with this one because it's such a crazy print, but decided to throw caution to the wind and I'm glad I did! Such a unique piece and pairs well with tights (but looks great without) and I've gotten so many compliments while wearing it. There's no give or take with the material though, so you need to be absolutely sure of the size when ordering.

I was initially anxious to order this item because of the buttons on the front. As a relatively large busted woman (36DD or 38D), I am always wary of buttons. However, I was pleasantly surprised with how well this fit. There was plenty of room to accommodate my bust, and I had breathing room in the arms as well. Very work appropriate yet unique and colorful at the same time!

review_summary: This is a lovely dress bu
review_text: This is a lovely dress but the midsection runs small. It fit but just barely, and at that time I usually wore a firm medium as I ordered. One of the buttons fell off the first time I wore it. I love the dress despite the issues.

review_summary: such a cute dress, very b
review_text: such a cute dress, very bright, and attractive. I don't know how many places I'd wear this though and for that reason. I might return it

The last 1X dress I ordered from Modcloth was too small, so I figured I'd better size up. Not a good plan, this would have fit true to size. The fabric was surprising. It's a bit thin and flowy which is odd because it is also lined. This gives it a little bit of a frumpy look.It's a nice dress and I'll wear it to church but it's not something I'd wear to a wedding (the reason I bought it).

Love this dress!!!! Probably my favorite dress from mod cloth. The fabric is a little thin and the lining is also not the best quality but it looks great! The retro design is just beautiful. Can't wait to wear this to work.

I have only been able to wear this dress twice.  It fits well but It ripped 10 inches along the seam while I wore it the first time.  I took it to the tailor to repair, but it ripped along the seam in a different spot the second time I wore it.  The pattern is cute and the cut is very flattering, but the make and material are too poor to make this a good purchase.
Typically I am somewhere between a M/L so typically I order a ledge and go down if necessary. This dress fit me perfect!! Also the quality is fantastic

review_summary: Trying to love it as much as the photo
review_text: I bought this dress a little while ago to replace a very similar wrap dress I'd grown out of (same exact design, but black and a different fabric). I've tried everything I can think of to make it work, but it's just too awkward. I'll be taking it to a seamstress soon to see what they can do. Pros: great color, light fabric, high hopes of replacing a muchloved dressCons: tight on the arms, very low bust (hard to find a matching cami to wear under because of fabric), loose waist, if you pull the tie tighter it bunches at the waist and is too tight in the chest. Neutral: it was a good length for a short person like me, but I really wanted to wear a slip under it because it flares open too far in front, maybe due to my stoutness.

The color is as pictured and the polka dots are adorable. I wear anything from a 16W to 22 depending on the style/cut of a dress so I ordered a 3x after reading the reviews that said the sleeves were tight because the fabric has no stretch.  I'm leggy and busty but had no problem with excess cleavage or leg showing. The sleeves were tight though.Unfortunately the dress made me look like I had put on an extra 30 lbs and 15 years. Main problem, the waist did not wrap tightly enough or high enough to show off the narrowest part of my torso. As a result there was an excess of fabric at the waist making me look as though my bosom had sagged with age (even though I was in a push up bra) and I had put on even more weight on my more than ample belly.There was just too much material in the back. I'm so disappointed because I love wrap dresses and polka dots but since it looks awful on me, back it goes.

Print / style exactly as pictured. Suits a pear / bowling pin type of body shape. As someone who's 5'2, rarely I say a dress is shorter than pictured, but this one is! So if your tall and don't like to show off your legs, maybe give this a miss.

The quality of the material, color, and print are great, however I'm small chested and it was more than lowcut it didn't fit at all. I usually get a small, but based on other reviews I got an xsmall. I liked the dress enough to get it tailored and now it's perfect (the waist fits better, as well)!
I loved the look of this dress online but it just didn't work for me  it actually reminded me of an apron so I returned it.Would probably work better for taller, thinner gals though.

review_summary: I love this dress the fit
review_text: I love this dress the fit was perfect, the color is a dark green with black dots (accurate to the photos), hits at the knee, a bit lowcut but it doesn't gap open or anything. Perfect dress for a date or party.
Really great dress! Perfect for my work Christmas party :)

This dress confuses me greatly. It's beautiful. A great color. But, the arms are super tight. And the waist is huge. I was trying to figure out how to tie this bad boy, but it seems like the proportions are all out of whack. If I don't want my boobs on display, I have to tie this at my back, but the sash was not designed to do that. I don't think a smaller size would help the arm issue. Just super bizarre. I'm going to try it on one more time and if I can't make it work, it's gonna have to go back, which is such a bummer. I've been wanting this dress for ages. It finally comes back in stock and it's all kinds of strange on my body.
super cute dress.  wore it for a Christmas party

review_summary: Great fun dress. A bit lo
review_text: Great fun dress. A bit low cut and material is very very thin. But, still loved it.
Strange fit

Yes, ModCloth! Yes yes yes! I love it! So flattering and so cute. The material could be a bit thicker and will require steaming, but I am so impressed with the cut of this dress so I won't complain! It is very flattering on me and I feel so cute in it. I especially love the sleeves.
So flattering, especially if you've got curves. I get compliments every time I wear it. One caveat: the fabric doesn't breathe well, so not for sweltering summer days.
Very thin fabric. Little to no support. Didn't cover much. Warning to those with larger busts.

review_summary: Love this dress, I feel s
review_text: Love this dress, I feel so pretty in it

review_summary: I am a full XL in Modclot
review_text: I am a full XL in Modcloth dresses of any style, hands down, and this was HUGE on me. I thought I could get away with pinning the bust because it was too late to exchange (I bought for a cousin's wedding), but even the waist and length was too big: I tied the belt as tight as I could, pinned the bust, and kept my shoulders back, but I still looked a good 10 pounds heavier + frumpy. The good news is, it washes in the washing machine like a dream (I even put it in the dryer) and the color  is gorgeous.. Trust me: SiZE DOWN!!

I really like this dress, but i can't give it 5 stars because it's kind of flimsy and it shows way too much cleavage. There's no way i can wear it without a tshirt underneath. Also, i AM very tall, so i understand it would not be an issue for most, but i found it a bit too short on the front; at least for work. Otherwise, it's a nice colour and on trend dress, but maybe a bit too expensive for it's quality
Cute dress, runs small

This dress is classy and sexy at the same time. It really shows off your figure while hiding any belly pooch you might have. It only lost a star bc I am a medium in all things modcloth and this was a little big in the chest area. Being a wrap dress and large in the chest area made it show a pornographic amount of cleavage. I ended up pinning it up bc I just had to wear it the day I got it, but I will eventually add a few stitches to the neckline of the dress to keep it closed. Other than that, beautiful color, very soft silky material and I was bathed in compliments all day while wearing this! Being a very modest dresser I rarely feel sexy in the traditional sense but in this dress I definitely felt very sexy!
This dress is adorable. The ruffles are perfectly placed. The 1x is a bit big on me, but gives me more options to make the neckline adjustable for work.

review_summary: Not a fan of this dress i
review_text: Not a fan of this dress is person. Looked cheap although the quality was fine.. just LOOKED cheap. I felt like Rizzo in it. HadTo go back

review_summary: A little low cut and fabr
review_text: A little low cut and fabric does not have much give.  but overall i love the fit and the quality.  color is awesome!
I ordered my normal size, but this dress felt somehow big on me(especially the sleeves and chest area).
This dress was disappointing lived the green color but made my hips look wide and the ruffle is not flattering. Had to send back.

review_summary: I'm usually an M but I bo
review_text: I'm usually an M but I bought the L just to make sure it has a good coverage; you never know with wrap dresses. It is a bit big but it get coverage; I don't know if M would do that for me. It's not lined but it looks adorable

review_summary: It took me a bit to figur
review_text: It took me a bit to figure out what was going on with this dress when I first opened it. It's a wrap dress. I had to make some adjustments on the arms because it was very tight. My arms are HUGE and I have that problem with fabrics that don't stretch a lot. So you'll probably be fine. I have a big bust and this dress is super busty. I have a picture with out the pin holding it together to show what I'm talking about. When I first tried on the dress I didn't know if I was going to keep it. But now that I've already made my alterations I think it will be a great collection to my wardrobe. The length is just above my knees which is perfect. The dress looks better than in my pictures.

This is an extremely flattering wrap dress.  The ruffles are just the right size to avoid being too cutesy or too dowdy.  The fabric is a little bit on the swishy side, but stylish dresses with sleeves are too rare to fault it for that.  I found that in order for the waist to be comfortable on me, the dress is wrapped so that the neckline is a bit low, but nothing a pin or cami can't fix.

Just got this today...absolutely beautiful.  The dress is very heavy as the fabric is thick, but it looks exactly as in the photos.  Due to the thickness of the lace, it does feel thick in the waist.  I think the dress is cut on the larger size...I usually purchase a 2x in other dresses and there normally is a size difference between xxl and 2x however, I got this on overhead with no problem...no need to zip or unzip.  It does gap ever so slightly on the corner edges between the arms and bust, however I'm hoping it won't be too much of an issue to taper since the fabric is thick.  Be advised that because it is a thick and heavy fabric, the dress is very structured, do not expect it to be draping or flowing, it is very, very structured.  Also, on the model it looks to hit right below the knee,  depending on your height (I'm 5'5) add about 2 more.

According to my measurements, I'm in between an S and an M and can usually wear either pretty comfortably. At the advice of a Modcloth stylist, I bought an M because I was told their clothing runs small. Big mistake. This was the largest dress I've ever received. It gaped so much in the bust that you can see my breasts and back through the arm holes. The straps kept sliding off, the zipper gets stuck each time you try to zip up, and the material is thick, which is usually a plus but in this case it was ao thick and stiff that it stuck out at weird angles at the pleats.

I ordered two sizes to see.  The large was WAY too small and I could not zip.  The zipper has issues even when it is off.  The XL was WAY too big.  The material was very thick and heavy.  Not sure if that would work when the dress is made for summer.  I was so sad because I love daisies and the dress was a dream for me.  Back both dresses went.
wore to a wedding, plan on wearing on both Easter and to a spring work event. thick fabric that feels very lux. minor note is that it is true tealength, below the knee.

They have to be kidding with this one. The tulle under skirt makes me look like I'm hiding balloons under there. I'm a bigger girl and I don't need anything that makes me look much bigger. I def don't feel good in this at all. Super unflattering.

review_summary: Sized small especially in the bust
review_text: The print is lovely but the top of this dress is so tight on me. I wear 2x usually, so I ordered xxl. The top squeezes my 40D chest. The sleeves are snug but not unwearable, however, the bust is what makes this dress stay in my closet rather than being worn. I worry it will shrink after 1 wash. Print, cut, and subtle ruffle on the bodice are all nice, the sizing is small.

review_summary: Did not fit, waste of flare.
review_text: I was so disappointed when I tried the dress on. The fit across the chest was ok and it was fit and flare as expected (usually works well for those of us that are a touch bottom heavy) but the sleeves were absurdly tight. While I could put my arms through I was concerned my biceps would hulk through the dress if I made a muscle. The dress itself was very cute but I'm not sure they worked in that your arms can go up in size proportionate with your size.

I bought this for my senior prom  definitely looked a little different from most of the other girls there but I look different anyway. My fella and I were the cutest couple there. A little tight in the chest and waist (but that's probably just my chunky self)  and I wish I had taken some of the material out from the skirt. There's a LOT. But I loved it and felt beautiful dancing the night away :)

well, it's my daughter wedding and I liked something different, vintage and just me, so, MODCLOTH. Usually I'm 1X, so I ordered XXL, just in case, its better bigger than smaller, I have a machine and I'm seamstress! i'm 39x37x44, and 5.6 feet. The beautiful dress, excellent finished, nice, inside and outside tissue, beautiful embroidered, glamour, bigger than that pic, it was 1.5 bigger than me both sides, so I tailored it, and PERFECT. My daughter happy, the mother of the bride happy, so, let's do it (15 april)

review_summary: I loved the design and qu
review_text: I loved the design and quality of this dress. I wore it for my small wedding and it for my vision exactly. It does appear more of a nude color in some light, but is actually a light blush. It was so comfortable and I received so many compliments from strangers, etc. My alterations lady was so happy to. It alter a fluffy white dress. She applauded the uniqueness. I originally bought the XL as it aligned with my measurements, but the band between bust and lower ruffles was too tight. I could get it on, but it was so uncomfortable. The top was still too large and it was too long for this 5'3 girl. So I ended up ordering an XXL (after the return period, so buying another) and having to have some serious alterations to the top and length but for $60. I got the original on sale and it was clearance priced for the 2nd, so with alterations (and hopefully selling the XL) I still did pretty good.

I can't fault this dress! The colour is beautiful and the length, which is usually a problem for me at 5'3, is perfect with heels. It fits true to size. The other reviews are true when they say it's lower cut than the photos suggest, but I actually think it looks much nicer with a plunging neckline.
I bought this dress to wear at my brother's wedding, and I love it! It fits me so well, and it's just amazing!

Such a pretty dress, but it just didn't work on me. I'm 5'4 & about 195, a size 1416. The top of the dress fit me but was wayyy too low in the cleavage, & the first ruffle hit me in an unflattering spot that made me look pregnant. I think it would be great on a slimmer figure, but be warned: It's much pinker in person than you'd expect it to be from these photos.

review_summary: Love the dress but it was
review_text: Love the dress but it was too small on me so I am returning it. I always were a large but I am broad through the back and this was too tight.

I bought this dress to wear in my wedding, not being a traditional bride I didnt want the giant white dress. I loved the dress, my figure is made for a fit and flare dresses like this one. I had originally ordered this dress and another one here from Modcloth and picked this one as the winner but there were A LOT of loose threads all over the skirt portion. So I called and they sent me an replacement that was much better. The only other compliant I have with the dress is along the same lines as others here, the neckline. I not only had some stiffener put along the neckline but then also had to use tape to secure it to my chest and back. Not a deal breaker of course but something that the manufacturer may want to think about. Overall I loved the dress, the fit and the look were exactly what I was looking for on my big day. Oh, I am 5'3 so this dress is more tea length on me but I knew that going in.

I have a 26 waist and a 34 bust (hip measurements don't matter with the fit of this dress) and I ordered a 6. It's a tiny bit big, but not enough for me to exchange it for a smaller size. Some reviewers seemed concerned that this dress might be measured in UK sizes, but it's definitely US sizing. There's no way I'd ever fit in a UK 6!As for the quality of the dress itself, it's very well made. The only noteworthy thing is that it's more of an offwhite, cream sort of color in person than it appears to be online. There's also a hint of a shimmery kind of gold on some of the layers of the skirt. Still beautiful, though! I'd definitely recommend this dress.
I bought this dress for my tea party themes bridal shower. It was perfect. Only complaint was that I felt it ran a bit large but I was able to get it tailored.

I bought this dress as the mother of the groom dress.  It was amazing. The perfect fit, length, comfort, flare and colour. I received over 100 compliments at the wedding and hundreds more on facebook when I posted pics. My all time favourite dress ever!

I'm 5'1 and 135 lbs D cup it fits like a tea length; which is exactly what I wanted. Hugs all the right places. The floppy lace part at the neck can be fixed with double sided sticky tape. Make sure to clean your skin with an alcohol wipe so the tape will stick. ;) love it!!!

review_summary: Fell in love with this dr
review_text: Fell in love with this dress 2 years ago, finally bought it, and got married in it! Couldn't love it more.

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my college senior photos and it did not disappoint a bit. I received so many compliments!

review_summary: Cute dress, plus size a little wonky.
review_text: I am exactly a size 26 by measurements, and I had seen some of the reviews saying this tends toward the small size, so I was worried it'd be small. I found the exact opposite to be true. I was absolutely swimming in the 26. It's a beautiful, high quality dress. It does have a lot of layers of tulle, so I agree with the other reviewers who said it's not exactly slimming for us plussize ladies. It just felt a little more prom than I wanted because of all the layers. I was expecting it to look a bit more sophisticated, but it's possible it's just not really my style. The quality is still impressive and the lace is beautiful.
I bought this dress for my winter ball at my school. It was absolutely stunning and the fit was perfect!

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress. It's just too small. My normal size is too tight and too short, I will be returning it for probably 2 sizes up.m, which is why I'm giving this beautiful dress 3 stars.

I bought this for a wedding. When it arrived I was immediately disappointed, it most definitely was not navy and white as the description says, it was a very dark cream, almost beige (quite ugly) and the lace at the neck line flopped (as another reviewer mentioned). There was a huge amount of tulle underneath and I looked like one of those toilet roll cover dolls. I sized up as other reviewers suggested and even then it was snug. I feel I got one from a new batch where the colour was 'off' and the amount of tulle seemed heaps more than in other people's photos. Overall disappointed and being an international customer it has cost me a fortune to send back.
The top gapped significantly  the lace didn't lie flat. The lace is also VERY itchy, and the white/blue is actually a cream/blue (it's hard to tell from the pictures).

Bought this dress after seeing the pictures only be and falling in love. It's even more beautiful in person! The tulle underneath has sparkle in it so the whole dress just kind of glows. It's a little more full than I was expecting so I steamed the tulle layers & that made me feel a little more comfortable. I didn't wear a bra with it which also was a little uncomfortable for me, but the inside had cups/is lined so it truly isn't necessary. Wore this to a wedding last night & received so many complimentsit's just beautiful!
I love this dress. You can wear it to any fancy event. People asked me where I bought it and loved the design and rich color. It was perfect for a wedding reception.

review_summary: I wore this dress to a fr
review_text: I wore this dress to a friend's wedding and it was gorgeous. Definitely something that catches the eye. I felt beautiful in this and that's not something that I often feel like.

I have never purchased a dress online because I always struggle finding a dress that would fit me perfectly. I have a small bust but very wide hips.I got married April 8th of this year and I decided to buy the Navy blue dress in size 6 and 8. Ordered them Sunday April 2nd and I got them three days later. The size 8 was too big and the size 6 was perfect, maybe even too tights in the shoulders. When I was ordering the dresses, the white one was not available in size 6 or 8. On Wednesday, I checked and it was available in those sizes. So I decided to order the white in 6 and I did ASAP shipping. Ordered it on Wednesday and got it Friday. The dress was beautiful. But the sizes are not always identical. The white dress in size 6 was slightly bigger than the navy dress in size 6. With the navy dress, it was a little tight even without a bra. For my wedding day, I wore the white dress without a bra and throughout the day, the dress loosened up. Maybe I should have worn a bra but I really do not care.Also, for some reason the zipper would not zip all the way every time. For a second the night before the wedding,  I started to think it was some kind of a bad sign or omen because whenever I had the dress on, the zipper would stop right when the material ended and the upper lace started. But when I took the dress off, the zipper would zip fine.
I ordered this dress for my wedding dress, it fit perfect and was gorgeous!!  Thanks so much for the lovely memories.

I purchased this dress for my friends wedding and couldn't be happier. I had strangers coming up to me all night telling me how beautiful my dress was. I order 1 size bigger than I normally do and it was a little baggy on the stomach but perfect on the bust/arms. The photograph doesn't do the dress justice.

review_summary: Holy Moly, this dress is amazing
review_text: I found this dress while searching for something special for a wedding in April.  I hemmed and hawed at the price and at the lack of sizing info.  I finally decided to order it and gave myself plenty of time in case it ended up being all wrong for me.  I read a ton of reviews and after some deliberation, decided to size up to the 12.  Normally I am an 8/10, but so many reviews said the material has zero give.  I am so glad I did.  The 12 fits perfectly.  This dress is so incredibly beautiful!!  The pictures do not do it justice at all!!!  I am only 5'1 and it is is definitely a tad long, but that is not the dress's fault at all.  The builtin bra is a nice feature, since the back is sheer and finding the right bra would be a hassle.  I can't wait to wear this next month!!!
Amazing dress!!! wore it to a black tie event. makes you feel old world charm, a throw back to the days of class!!

review_summary: Loved this dress for my w
review_text: Loved this dress for my wedding. I ordered two sizes and opted to go with the larger size so I would be comfortable. Got lots of compliments and felt so great in it!

review_summary: This dress was just the r
review_text: This dress was just the right amount of magic I was looking for to celebrate the 50th anniversary of my parents. The skirt is lined so there was no itchiness with the crinoline.The lace at the neckline and around the arms was a bit itchy and didn't always want to lay flat but it was bearable. Overall, I'm extremely happy with this dress.

review_summary: It truly is a fabulous dr
review_text: It truly is a fabulous dress that looks just like it does in the pictures. It is true to size.

review_summary: I love this dress but wha
review_text: I love this dress but what's better is that my husband does too! We always get stopped at the symphony by people asking about it.
Gorgeous!!!!  I got so many compliments on this dress.  Just stunning.
great quality, made well! Wearing to a New Years Eve wedding!

The quality of this dress is to die for! Unfortunately I'm a busty girl with a D/DD and a normal waist, not super thin but no rolls, and in order to get the right size to fit my top, I had to size up but then the waist just hung there. If this dress was less quality and not as much beautiful embroidery, I would have gotten it altered! It is the prettiest dress I've seen, I unfortunately had to return. I even went shopping for a week after at department stores and this dress cost less and was more beautiful then all of the dresses they carried. I settled for a little black dress but I really wanted something blue for my graduation.

Oh my goodness!! Absolutely gorgeous dress! Wore it for several occasions. Incredibly happy with the way it came out. This was the first clothing item I purchased on modcloth, and I will definitely be buying more now! Awesome awesome dress

This dress is beautiful!! I wore it to my dress rehearsal for my wedding. Then I wore it on our honeymoon cruise. I've gotten so many compliments on it. It looks even better in person than in the pictures. It does run a little large in the top so I would order based on your bust.

This dress is exactly what I wanted and more! The fit is pretty good and it comes with built in bra cups. I usually go braless with these types of dresses but might wear a strapless bra anyway to fill out the top a little as its a tad bit roomy , but probably not noticeable to anyone but me. The material feels very high quality. Similar to other reviewers the top lace bit is a bit floppy but I plan to just starch it out. I might belt it to create more of a visible waist but is totally fine without. I am wearing this to a wedding in late December and will update with pictures from the event. But overall I highly recommend this dress from my first try on!
I'm tall and long bodied. The waist hit me too high. It's a very pretty dress. Sorry it didn't work.

review_summary: I've never had so many pe
review_text: I've never had so many people tell me they loved my dress before.  All night peopled commented on how beautiful it is.

This dress is absolutely fabulous. If you're looking for that majestic vintage dress vibe you have come to the right place. The shoulders were a little itchy after a while but that didn't matter because I felt AMAZING in this dress. The skirt has some tulle under it to give it some nice floof shape. I have a smaller chest so it didn't fit there too well, but all was still good, I still wore it and looked majestic anyways
This dress was very small (UK sizing maybe) and VERY puffy. Wanted to like it but just wasn't for me. The top of this dress is gorgeous, I just didn't feel gorgeous in it.
Beautiful dress. Great detailing. Fit true to size.

review_summary: I saw this dress months a
review_text: I saw this dress months ago, and knew I had to have it!  I finally purchased it for an upcoming dance, and it fit perfectly. I couldn't be more pleased.  The material wasn't uncomfortable, but there were a few loose threads from the embroidery, but that was easily solved.

This was my wedding dress and it was wonderful. I decided to buy a size 12 to accommodate my bust but then did need alterations in the top half . The ivory was really more champagne which made the shoe thing a bit tricky, but as it was a registry wedding then it was ok. I've since worn it in a pin up photoshoot and everyone comments on it.
I returned for the lighter color but this dress is absolutely brilliant!! Wish I had an event to wear it to!

This dress was absolutely amazing! I have never received so many compliments on a dress in my life. Had a wedding at West Point in NY and needed something on thr fancier side. The fit is perfect, though I'm usually a size 8, but glad I read the reviews and went one size up because of my bust (36DD). The quality is absolutely worth the price: built in petticoat and slip, hidden zipper (which is a pain, as usual), and built in bra padding  no bra needed! review_text: MADLY in love with this dress! I ordered it to wear for my daughters communion party and the compliments from family, friends and party staff were nonstop! it fit like a glove! Overall this dress is very pretty and I'm going to keep it.  It will be perfect for either my bridal shower or rehearsal dinner. The lace is over a netting/tulle.  There are quite a few layers underneath the dress so the skirt is quite full.  I will probably have a layer taken out.  The side zipper doesn't have an eyelet loop which makes it a little more challenging than it should be, but you can still get in and out by yourself.  The neckline is very floppy; I'm probably going to have to starch the neckline so it doesn't flop over.

I'm a 4 but apparently the dress fit like an 8, so go a size down at least.

I purchased this dress is blue for a fall wedding option (I was the cinematographer, so pockets are a must). I love the colors, and the jersey fabric is warm, thick and stretchy, a great quality all around). This is NOT for someone who has a LONG TORSO. I also have a bit of an apple shape with a slight lower tummy bulge, so pocketed dresses often help disguise the bulge. I knew that this dress was going to hit high on my waistline, but sometimes I luck out with a faked empire waist look, so I took a gamble. The length, even if a bit short, was ok. I planned to wear leggings/thick tights and boots with this for easy moving around, so the skirt length wasn't as big an issue to me as the overall fit. I normally order a size XL or 1X, and in this case it was the right choice to order an XL. The fit is still just not flattering for someone with a long torso and slightly busty. Even with shapewear, it made me look a little preggo. So sad to send this dress back because I loved many other things about it. I can see why this dress works for so many other people, just not me.Memo to Modcloth: more clothing for us long torso'ed ladies please! Cheers! ^_~

review_summary: I ordered this dress to w
review_text: I ordered this dress to wear in a friend's October wedding, and now it's my absolute favorite item in my closet. I'm thinking about ordering the one in purple, too. It's incredibly comfy, the cut is super flattering, and the material is thin enough that it's comfortable to layer with, but heavy enough that it doesn't feel clingy and gross (though, let's be real, it IS made of fabric and will stick to leggings a little if you style it that way). It's great in the summer if you'll be inside/outside and might get cold in the AC. I wore it in the wedding by itself, and then quick threw on some leggings and long cardigan after pictures because it was freezing that day. And now I wear it to work all the time with leggings, boots, and a long sleeve shirt underneath. Some people say the pockets make the dress hang weird, I haven't noticed that (but I'm not hippy so maybe that's a factor). My only negative note is that the first few times I pulled it on/off, I heard a couple stitches ripping, even when being super careful not to stretch it. But that stopped, and the dress hasn't fallen apart anywhere! If you're debating, buy this dress. It's casual enough that you can wear it any old day, but simple and chic enough to rock it at an evening affair as well.

review_text: This dress is a staple in my closet. Works well for summer and winter! Very flattering cut.

review_summary: This was part of my first
review_text: This was part of my first order from modcloth and I'm hooked.  I'm a classic inverted triangle shape. I have broad shoulders and arms, a small chest, but am more slender through the waist and hip. If you are a girl with bigger arms, do not be worried about arm hole size, they are sufficient without being too big. That is usually my biggest trouble area and I had no problem. If you are a girl with hips and bum, the pockets will add bulk to that area, but since my hips are my slimmer area I didn't have any issue with them laying flat.  The fabric gives a fair amount of stretch which leaves it hugging where it should.  I'm very happy with this dress overall and see many different styling options.  If it helps,  I'm typically an XLXXL on top and a size 10/12 US on bottom.

review_summary: I was given this dress as
review_text: I was given this dress as a present for Christmas from my sister.  I already loved Modcloth, and had been scoping this dress out for a while after I saw it in a local store. I found the material to be soft and stretchy, perfect for if you have to move a lot. I thought it was a bit short on me, about midthigh, but I'm just going to wear opaque tights with it anyway. I definitely love the dress, and for me it fit perfectly to size.I would recommend this dress to a friend, but then we would be dressed up the same, and no one wants that.

I'd been devating this dress for years and I finally invested. Worth every penny. It gives my very straight body the best curves and I love that the buttons are different for every color. Such a great dress I have it in three colors! A definate buy!

review_summary: This is one of two dresse
review_text: This is one of two dresses I got in my firstever ModCloth purchase and I'm beyond happy with it. I'm very picky with dresses seeing as I've never been fond of them to begin with, but when I saw this and its sibling in violet, I wanted them immediately. The fabric feels great: it's very soft, smooth, stretchy(!) and there's the slightest weight to it likely because of the polyester, but that's exactly how I like my dresses. I'm a relatively tall, busty woman, and have difficulty finding dresses that suit my figure, but this dress fit my bust nicely and left the dress hem about 2.53 inches above my knee, both of which are perfect for my tastes. There was a hole in the right pocket when I took the dress out of the package (like it hadn't been sewn), but that's easily fixable, so I'm not worried about it. Thank you so much, ModCloth, for making my first purchase a great one!
This was my 6th Coach Tour Dress. I love these so much! Been waiting on the navy color for sometime so as soon as it was back in stock I ordered it right away. It's so pretty!

review_summary: There's a lot to like abo
review_text: There's a lot to like about this dress, but it fit very awkwardly on my body.  Loved the great quality fabric and texture, LOVED the pockets (more pockets in dresses please!) the color is a true deep navy and unlike some of the other reviewers, I didn't have a problem with the buttons feeling cheap.  However the fit on me was incredibly awkward. The collar with the buttons and folds  over the bust  over the empire waist with the tabs and buttons  all happening within 12 of real estate under my chin  made this look super bumpy crazy on me.  It's like my hair, face, and boobs were all stuck too close together and then there was the blank slate of the ribcage to ankles.  For me, I looked like I had no neck and like your eyes wouldn't know where to fall if you looked at me.  Also from the back, I had tons of gathers on the upper back above the empire waist line. It was as if there was enough room for a padded bra on my back as well as my front  but a size smaller would have been way too small on me.  So although this dress was so cute out of the box and I love the pictures on others, it didn't work with my look or my body type at all.  I'm 5'4, 34 B, 28 waist and 37 hips, long waisted and athletic build and I got a Medium.
Yet another addition to my coach dress collection!  This is my forth!   I just adore this dress, and the navy color is divine!  Thanks ModCloth!
My first Modcloth purchase was a classic. The dress is adorable and can be worn so many ways. Very happy!

review_summary: I was afraid the Large wa
review_text: I was afraid the Large was going to be too big, but I bought it for the length and am glad that I did (I'm 5'8 and 148 lbs). I wore this along with the New Approach Heel to my work Christmas party and it was a hit! A successful first purchase from Mod Cloth.

review_summary: I bought this dress a whi
review_text: I bought this dress a while ago, and have worn it several times. Every single time I get awesome compliments about how beautiful it is. I've had to give out the modcloth website to so many people. The fabric feels great, the pockets are amazing. I love it!

review_summary: The fit of the XS on me i
review_text: The fit of the XS on me is perfect, very flattering. It hugs just right at the waist but has enough room for a bustier person like me. I only wish mine came with the copper buttons, I got grey buttons. Otherwise I love it :)
This dress is very adorable and comfortable.
This dress is very adorable and comfortable.
This was my first ModCloth purchase and I absolutely love it! It's so chic but also comfortable. I get lots of compliments every time I wear it.

This dress gets a 5 star review from me. A little on the short side; be careful when bending over at work! I have an hourglass shape and this dress shows it off. Lots of complements from friends and coworkers.I will say, my friend tried this dress on to see if she wanted to order it. She has a more boxy figure. There is a reason she will not be ordering it! She also happened to be wearing a strapless bra that day, it looked terrible.

Pros:  substantial fabric, construction, button details, classic retro style, plenty of room in the hipsCons: a bit too roomy as a large, but a smaller size wouldn't really work since it is already shortwaisted for this average to tall girl

review_summary: This dress is so cozy and
review_text: This dress is so cozy and fits just right to my curves. I love wearing this to work with a cute cardigan and tights. If you want to wow your coworkers while remaining tame, wear this dress.

review_summary: I can't even count the nu
review_text: I can't even count the number of compliments I've received on this dress. The fit is SO perfect, the pockets are a great touch, and the fabric is a great, cozy heavyweight jersey that felt amazing when I first received the dress. However, after a couple of washings (by hand or on the gentle cycle), the fabric began to pill, the buttons lost their sheen, and I'm just not as excited to wear it anymore because it very quickly seemed to have lost its luster. I'm still a fan, just a smidge disappointed in the quality.

review_summary: I ordered this dress at t
review_text: I ordered this dress at the same time as the houndstooth version. This was much less flattering in comparison. Because of the dark material, you loose some of the shape of the dress. Interestingly, the bleu dress in size small was noticeably smaller then the houndstooth in size small. I was surprised they run that differently. I sent it back. Too snug.

review_summary: This dress is a little ti
review_text: This dress is a little tighter in the bust and a little shorter than I expected. I paired it with tights, boots, and the Charter School cardigan in Charcoal to provide a little more coverage and stay warm. The material is thick and comfortable. It covers my troublespot midsection nicely and the color is a lovely deep blue.

review_summary: I'm so in love with this
review_text: I'm so in love with this dress! However, the size S was a bit long on me, coming just to my knees (I was hoping it would come just above the knee), which wasn't too big of a deal considering how flattering the fit was. I just purchased it in Rouge as well (will be perfect to wear over the holidays), but ordered it in an XS.

review_summary: I am a pear shape with a
review_text: I am a pear shape with a bit of a tummy, so finding flattering dresses can be a bit of a chore. This one was perfect! The skirt portion is nice and flowy, but thick enough to hold shape, and everything fit well. I paired it with tall brown boots and will be wearing this to my family thanksgiving meal. It can be dressed up or down for those outing where you do not want to be too formal or underdressed. I love the pockets, over all this dress is adorable.

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this dress! If you're on the fence about buying this dress (whether in navy or any of the other colors), consider how many reviews there are  it's worth it! The XS fits perfectly and the hem hits a little less than 3 inches above my knee. A classic dress I know I will wear many more times!
Beautiful shade of navy, fits perfectly, a thicker fabric that makes it perfect for fall/winter. Perfect length!

I already owned this dress in red. Same material, same fit, same awesome style. Perfect for my proportions  I have a short torso and flat chest  so probably more of an empire waist for other ladies. My only (minor) complaint is that the buttons are a metal pewter, not the beige fabriccovered buttons I was expecting based on the picture (which would have matched perfectly with a pair of boots that I own), but I'll just have to find other shoes to pair it with :)

The bust fits perfectly but it's a little large everywhere else. I wish the waist was a bit tighter but that's nothing that can't be corrected with a wash. I'm between sizes right now so I would rather have a garment slightly larger rather than too small.

Huge compliments on this dress no matter where I wear it. The material isn't breathable, but its a great fall look and keeps you warm. Same issue as with other posters, the arm openings are a bit small for me which creates a weird flattened out chest (first photo) but otherwise it hangs great and is super flattering! The pockets gave me hips which I don't usually have, so I loved that aspect too.

Originally I bought this in the blue and loved it but the XS was too small and had to go back. Be warned that even though the pic shows brasscolored buttons, they may send you a dress with pewtercolored buttons. I ended up with the violet dress in small (since they were out of the blue) and am very happy, although I'm having the sides of the skirt tailored because it's very Aline and looked a bit twee.

review_summary: I love this dress! I love
review_text: I love this dress! I love the nautical feel, the navy color, the length, the fit, everything. Definitely a great buy!
I love everything about this dress. It's flattering and comfortable, and it even has pockets. I get nothing but compliments when I wear it.

I was hoping against all odds that this dress might be long enough to wear without leggings, but, alas, it was not to be. It's still very cute, though, and the fit is good if not the length. Overall I'm pleased with it.

The fit and quality were fine. I got one with silver buttons, and I would have preferred gold ones. The dress flared straight out at my hips from the pockets, and I couldn't get it to lay flat. Also, the blue is so dark, I exchanged it for the violet one. There was really nothing wrong with the dress, it just wasn't what I was expecting. I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.

review_summary: I usually wear a XL from
review_text: I usually wear a XL from other stores and this fits the same way. My favorite dress by far, the fabric feels nice and thick enough. Gives me shape, and allows me to dress is up or keep it casual.

review_summary: I love this dress! It's a
review_text: I love this dress! It's a little short for work (I work in an office), but with tights it's great.

Great dress. Material is on the thicker side so it's good quality. Got many compliments on it. Fits me just right. Dress falls about 4 inches over my knee  appropriate for work and stylish enough for going out.
Perfect fit and incredibly versatile. Wearing it for a concert on my birthday, and then dressing it up for dinner with the inlaws. Love it
nice material, fits well, a little shorter than expected and I am quite short myself! good for work.

review_summary: I did my research on buyi
review_text: I did my research on buying this one (love this site for that!) and was not surprised to try it on and find out it was completely cute and awesome. great for work with the charter school cardigan in honey and some high boots.

review_summary: I can only really give th
review_text: I can only really give this three stars because it was damaged when I received it. I already spoke to a Modcloth customer service rep, and she was fantastic in sorting out the problem for me (thank you!)  I have been able to fix the issue though and, while I agree that the pockets stick out a bit oddly, the dress does otherwise look nice. The fit was completely true to size also.

review_summary: I love this dress! IT HAS
review_text: I love this dress! IT HAS POCKETS! Best surprise ever. The fabric is also really nice. I am leaving this review after buying it almost exactly one year ago and I am still in love and still impressed by how great this dress is.

review_summary: I loved the way this dres
review_text: I loved the way this dress looked when I saw it online. First impression out of the box was that the fabric was pretty heavy, definitely more of an autumn dress than summer. After having it on for a few minutes, I couldn't decide if it was suposed to be empire waisted or natural waisted  it hits me somewhere between the two  but the pockets seemed to be in the correct place at my hips, so I figured it belonged where it was. Fits great across the bust and the collar is very cute. The back lays a little funny with my hands in the pockets, but I can't imagine actually using them much. The only thing I really didn't like about it is that it seems very short (several inches above my knee). I will have to wear tights or leggings under this one to be comfortable.

review_summary: I love this dress and so
review_text: I love this dress and so does my husband. It's so versatile and can be dresses up and down. I think it's perfect for fall and spring, and I think it will do fine in winter too when paired with boots and a cardi. The fabric is sturdy but not too thick. The waist band hits just at the right spot on me  just below my chest. It helps accentuate my chest and waistline. And one of my favorite parts of the dress is that it has pockets. After a couple wearings, seeing how it turns out, I may even order it in another color.

LOVE LOVE LOVE (did I mention love?) this dress? Bought a medium and I am a shorty so the length was perfect (just at/slightly above my knees. Works great with a long sleeve white shirt and white leggings with high boots underneath. Quality of fabric is good. I've washed it many times now and it hasn't shrunk at all. Depending on how busty you are it could be more empire style than waist but it is still an adorable dress.
This dress was so perfect that I bought it again in a different color! A must have for every girl.
Everything about this dress is wonderful. The fabric is stretchy and breathable and the buttons accent the design perfectly.

review_summary: This is the first I bough
review_text: This is the first I bought from Modcloth and I was very happy it was a perfect fit. The material of the dress is soft and sturdy. It accentuates the waist very nicely. I get nice comments every time I wear it. It was only a bit tight on the top.
The fabric of this dress makes it feel less casual than some of the other coach tour dresses. Also the XS fit is perfect!
Everything about this was perfect, it just didn't look that good on me for some reason, I'm not sure why, however the fit and quality were just fine. Had to return it though.
The perfect dress! I have received many compliments while wearing this darling dress. The buttons are the perfect!I ordered a medium. I have a 28.5 waist and a 36D chest.

review_summary: I love this dress.  The n
review_text: I love this dress.  The navy color is perfect.  I can wear it to work or just for fun.  I always get compliments on this dress.  I got an xs and it fits perfectly.  The great thing about it is it's got a bit of stretch so it fits nicely.  I'm usually a 0 or 2 in other brands.

review_summary: Not sure how I feel about
review_text: Not sure how I feel about this dress. The length and fabric are great, but it makes me look really flat chested. There are puckers about an inch below my boobs and I'm not quite sure how I feel about it. I also thing the waist is too wideset, the buttons are too far apart. If you're about my size, I'd recommend the medium.
Didn't like the look and fit and had to send it back.

review_summary: This was my first order w
review_text: This was my first order with Mod Cloth and I am perfectly pleased with this dress. It sits just at the right place on the waist and cover enough the shoulder to cover the bra straps. It is maybe a bit short for my taste but I find that with a pair of opaque tights, it looks really great. Also, the pockets are really subtle and the collar is great looking. I recommend it!

review_summary: I bought this dress as so
review_text: I bought this dress as something cute to wear to work. After getting it, I agree with a lot of other reviewers that it IS really cute, but I don't like the feel of the material. (I know it's a polyester/rayon blend, but it's a little heavier and I can just foresee it bothering me.) I'm going to return it and see if I can find something in a similar cut with a different material like cotton. Thanks anyway, Modcloth!

review_summary: I was impressed by the qu
review_text: I was impressed by the quality of this dress.  The fit is very flattering and it is super comfortable.  It hits above the knee on me  not too short, but I wouldn't want it any shorter.  I definitely recommend this dress!

The first one I received had a flaw in it, but customer service was so nice, and sent a new one right away. Fits well! I thought the buttons were more coppery/ brass looking in the photo, but in person they are more of a darker pewter color. That might just be a result of the restock... Anyway it's pretty short, but I intended to wear leggings under it anyway. Very flattering.

review_summary: Love this dress. I went a
review_text: Love this dress. I went a size up mainly bc I plan on wearing a long sleeve shirt underneath for Fall/Winter, and I need the length to be work appropriate. The fabric's got some stretch to it, which is nice and the pockets are awesome.

review_summary: I received it and I loved
review_text: I received it and I loved it. I tried it on and I wasnt sure about it because my armpits felt a bit tight but then I was loving it too much to return it :) I just need to work out my arms a bit more :D My chest looks amazing in this dress!

review_summary: I had this dress on my wi
review_text: I had this dress on my wishlist for ages and I finally bought it and could not be happier. It is very high quality and is comfortable so it will be great for work or wearing on the weekends. I can't wait to wear it with tights and wedges!

review_summary: When I saw this dress I k
review_text: When I saw this dress I knew I had to have it's SO cute. It was the first thing bought on ModCloth so I was kind of concerned that it might not fit since I am really tiny, but when I put it on it fit like a dream. The quality is good and it's exactly what I had wanted! I love it so much I'll probable be buying it in the other colors!

review_summary: I thought that as I have
review_text: I thought that as I have a sizable bust I could get away with getting this in an XL to have a wee bit of extra length. Big mistake. Fits me like a potato sack and it's still really short. I have tried belting it which kind of helps but it hides the cute buttons at the side. For shorter girls I'd say go for it  it is a beautiful dress and a really good quality  but if you're taller then I am then you ought to give this one a miss. Unfortunately I'm from New Zealand so I can't return it but hey! It's the chance I gotta take in order to find decent clothes!

A very classy, ladylike and good quality dress. I love the idea of layering shirts underneath it (a striped shirt would look cool). I was surprised to find that it was a bit big in the hip area on me, it seems to sort of flare out a bit. I don't know if its meant to do that but anyway I still like this dress.

This dress was spectacular. I bought it for school so I could wear something comfortable but also very in my style. The first time I wore it, I got loads of compliments. The length hit just above the knee which was perfect; not too long and not too short. The fabric was wonderful, and this is now easily my favorite dress. The only thing that caused any problem at all was the cowl neck. It does take a bit of adjusting now and then, but it's nothing that could possibly make me love this dress any less.

Love this dress  the style, fit, material, and buttons :) The only downside is it's a little short (3 inches above the knee for me) so I can't wear it to work until the cooler months with some leggings underneath.

review_summary: I wore this dress to see
review_text: I wore this dress to see the POTUS speak. I received numerous compliments from strangers on how professional I looked for the event. It never occurred to me that I was wearing Democratic colors. LOL. I find reasons now to wear it whenever and where ever I can! It is really hard for me to NOT order this dress in every color! I have been fighting the urge for weeks now, and buying different shoes to wear with this one instead. I did cave and buy the Coach Tour top in stripes though. That's different enough right? :)

review_summary: I was very pleased with t
review_text: I was very pleased with this dress, although I wish the hem had fallen a little closer to my knee. I'm a graduate student and plan on wearing this between class and work in a museum. The hem is just barely long enough to be appropriate.

This is my first purchase on modcloth. I cannot be happier about it. It is not too formal looking and is extremely wearable. The quality is good: thick and elastic material.I am so happy about it I told my husband: hi to modcloth, the selection at modcloth is wider and better than other stores.

review_summary: This dress is WAY too sho
review_text: This dress is WAY too short! I couldn't wear this on a Saturday, never mind to work. Sorry, but have to send it back! The rest of the fit was fine.

Great for work. I've gotten many compliments on it already and I've only worn it a couple of times. It's quite short so it should be paired with leggings or slim fit capris. Definitely more of a longer tunic than a dress on girls who are average to tall. My only complaint is that I didn't see the note that buttons vary. I would have preferred the copper buttons to the pewter colored ones that I got.
Comfortable and both professionallooking and fun! The copper buttons pop just right on this dress.

This dress exceeded my expectations. It is made well and has thicker material than I expected. Very appropriate for fall weather. The length isn't as short as I expected which is good. The hem hits of couple of inches above my knees. I am very very pleased with this purchase.

It came with pewter buttons which is fine. I Hate turtlenecks but the cut of this neckline is perfectly comfortable. The quality of the material seems great, so far.  I'm planning on wearing this to a big work wine tasting in January and pairing with the  class at the conservatory wedges.  So far, so good! great buy!
Amazing dress. Fit is right on with the size chart. The fabric is lighter than I expected making it absolutely perfect for an all weather dress. Really great buy.

review_summary: I love this dress. It doe
review_text: I love this dress. It does run small  it just fits at size S, but I usually wear 0/2 or XS. My one complaint is that the neck hole is so small that my head had a tough time getting through it!

review_summary: I got a small and fits a
review_text: I got a small and fits a little snug in the torso and I'm only a B cup. I don't want to exchange it because that is a process and I'll just live with it. Just hope my boobs never grow..

review_summary: I LOVE this dress.  It lo
review_text: I LOVE this dress.  It looks as gorgeous in real life as in the picture.  The only difference is that the buttons look more silver than copper to me, though that isn't a problem.  I ordered a medium because many people said the dress was short, so it's slightly large, but not enough for me to want to return it.  And as for the length?  It's perfect.  Maybe an inch or two above my knees, and I'm about 5' 6.5.  The material is soft and light enough to wear comfortably enough in summer, but thick enough to wear in winter with a cardigan and leggings.  Now I just need to find some shoes to go with it, and I'm set.  Thanks for a great first purchase ModCloth!  I'll be buying from you again soon.
The dress is adorable. It's a little short so I can't wear to work. A little snug on my chest.

review_summary: I think this dress has gr
review_text: I think this dress has great potential to look adorable on somebody. However, buyer be warned  the cut and the color mean that it likely won't be universally flattering! I'm tall and fairly hourglassshaped, so on me, the top part (which makes shoulders look narrower, I think) and the bottom part (which makes hips look WAY wider, I think) made me look pretty pearshaped. The length was also sufficiently short that, when combined with an empress waist, it had kind of an awkwardlittlegirl appearance. If you have very straight lines and want to add some curviness, this would be a BOMB dress. On me, though, it sort of added ten pounds. Super cute, though! The material is nice, but it looks like it wouldn't be so good after a few trips through the wash.

This dress just arrived in the mail today and I am already in love!  The fabric is thick and warm, although it does show some panty lines, so I need to wear a slip.  The cowl neck drapes perfectly.  The buttons on my dress are more a shiny dark silver rather than the copperish color they appear in the pictures and some other reviews.  The length is an inch or two above the knee, still appropriate for work, and the bust and waist fit perfectly.  Overall, a great dress!  My only disappointment was the buttons, which ended up not being the same color as in the picture.

review_summary: This dress is so cute, so
review_text: This dress is so cute, so I bought it in 2 colors (navy and red).  I am 5'3 and normally a size 4, but I have a 34 C bust size.  I ended up getting the medium, and it fit perfectly in the bust area.  Not too tight.  These dresses are a great choice, and can carry you through different seasons.

Beautiful dress perfect for the office with some brown leather pumps, or out to lunch with equestrian boots. The length is just perfect and I love having the pockets. The fabric is soft and has a good weight to it so that it's flattering. I gave it four stars because I wish the waist was just a drop lower  it sort of floats up. It's still going to be a favorite in my wardrobe, however.

Fabric is a great weight, I didn't have an issue with the pockets bunching, they almost seem to push out the skirt slightly to give it a flowy Aline feel. I didn't realize that the buttons on the collar didn't actually button down to anything, it just flips down and lies there. I can imagine myself playing with it a lot, so I might tack it down. It is about 3 inches above my knees, so it's at about the shortest I might wear to work with tights.

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this dress. I was a bit worried about the fit, but as a bit of a bustier girl, I couldn't be happier. The length is wonderful, just below the middle of my thigh, and the waist is very flattering. If I could give this dress  6 stars, I absolutely would!

This dress is super cute, pretty, and fun. :) I love the length; the hemline rests at about 1 inch above my knee which is just what I wanted. The fabric is soft and comfortable but not too thin or cheap in appearance/feel. My only concern is with the buttons. They hang a little loose and I question if they will just randomly fall off or be easily ripped off. Despite the button concern, overallthis was a satisfying purchase and I would love to have this dress is some of the other colors too! :)

review_summary: I love this dress! I alre
review_text: I love this dress! I already bought it in the color jade, and I am just as happy with it in navy as I was in the green. I was a bit surprised to find the material was slightly thicker than the other color, but not significantly so. It may be a bit too warm for a summer day, but it would work well on a summer night when its slightly cooler. The length and fit were perfect, and I love the button details on the neck and waist.
what a darling dress! love the button details and the collar.  It *is* quite short for me (reaches ~3 inches above my knee) so I wear it with leggings/tights.  Still love this dress
This dress is so cute!

This dress hits the mark! I love the way I look in this dress, the cut really flatters my curvy figure. The dress nips in just above my natural waist disguising my hips. The material is light jersey material and is perfect for warm evenings that cool down after the sun goes down. Good quality material and stitching.

After the last modcloth dress I bought did not fit at all, I didn't have high hopes for finding a dress that fits and flatters my straight up and down frame. But I LOVE this dress!! First of all, the quality is amazing. Very thick and soft. The color is great too, and it's probably the classiest item of clothing I have in my wardrobe now. The collar and buttons add just the right amount of interest and uniqueness to the dress without it being too busy or overwhelming. As far as fit goes, I consider it a miracle when I find something that fits me, and this fits like a glove. At first I thought the neck hole was too small but it turns out I put my head into one of the arm holes the first time I tried to put it on... whoops! The waistband is only a smidge above my natural waist, and I have a long torso. Also, the dress fits about 4 inches or so above the knee... one of these days modcloth, I'd like a dress that hits me at the knee... but I think it's JUST long enough that it's still classy. A couple more inches would've been great but it's not trashy or anything. If I have one more suggestion (and I'm being nitpicky because this dress is awesome) I'm not a huge fan of the pleats up at the waist, but the dress is so dark they're not really noticeable. And the price! The price is great! I will be wearing this to my cousin's wedding in the fall, and probably a lot of other places.
wonderful, comfortable, professional, soft, high quality dress!  so cute with nude coloured pumps and so professional looking!  can't wait to wear to work!  true to size.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress.  It wa
review_text: I LOVE this dress.  It was my first purchase from ModCloth, and I am very happy with it!  I rely strongly on recommendations, and it seemed that everyone had great things to say about quality and fit.  Same for me.  The materials is beautiful and soft.  Great navy blue color.  I like that the armholes aren't right close to my arms.  I'm 5'0 and petite all around.  I wasn't swimming in this dress.  It is flattering around the waist and doesn't hang or bunch unattractively.  It falls to the middle of my knees, which is where I like it, since I bought this for work.  The price is very reasonable, and the quality excellent.  Thanks, ModCloth!!

review_summary: I own the Coach Tour Dres
review_text: I own the Coach Tour Dress in Spearmint as well, and for some reason the one in Bleu is significantly larger even though they are both Mediums.  Overall, I do like the dress and am making it work.  The collar is the highlight, definitely it really makes the dress standout.  However, I find the back of the dress to be not so flattering, but that is easily solved by wearing it was a long cardigan.

I've been looking at this dress, trying to find an excuse to get it for months, and I finally gave in.  I didn't regret it.  It fits like a dream, is super flattering, and is comfortable to boot!  I love the pockets and was surprised when the buttons were silver (they look goldish to me in the picture) but I already have shoes to match, what more could I ask for?  Definitely a great purchase, in whatever colour you please.

My very first Modcloth purchase, and I am very happy! The material is thick, which makes it perfect for almost all year round. I probably wouldn't wear it when it's super hot outside. I got a size small, and it fits amazingly.

My favorite dress!This is the cutest dress ever. I wore it to a work event and got tons of compliments all day. It's very crisp and professionallooking, although I wished it was a teensy bit longer.
