review_text: Very cute! A year ago I bought this dress in black and the size small was too big for my waist. I'm so glad Modcloth has the blue one in XS! Perfect fit, great material, and it comes with pockets!
Perfect fit! Very classic look!
Nice, thick material and great blue color! Fits great and flatters my curves. I saw someone walking around my school in a red one definitely a great dress!!
Cute little dress. It is longer than I thought it would be but that's good because I needed it for work. Fits perfect everywhere.

Who doesn't love a dress with pockets? Very happy with this dress. It is very comfortable, and I love the way the collar sits. I bought an M going by my waist measurement, but as the skirt flares out from the base of my ribs I probably should have used my bust measurement and bought the S. The fabric is stretchy and there seems to be a lot of ease. Still very happy with this dress overall.

This really is an amazing dress. It's simple andelegant, can be worn to work. It's not too short on me, I have long legs and was a little worried. I wear it with thights and a cardigan and it's perfect. I think I could have gone with the small, but the medium feels comfortable and the fabric is not made to be really thigh on. Also I'm impressed by the shipping, in only a week it was in Canada and just before Chritmas, I wasn't expecting it for at least two weeks.
Love this dress, can't wait until its warm enough to wear it without leggings

review_summary: This was one of three dre
review_text: This was one of three dresses that made up my first modcloth purchase, and I am definitely buying again! I love all of my dresses equally. This dress is wonderful material, that is thick and almost has a sort of shine to it. High quality. The collar is adorable, and even though I am taller...I feel comfortable wearing this without tights. Nice little surprise...this dress has pockets! I was debating between a medium and a large and I am so happy I got the medium. So many compliments!

review_summary: My mom loves this dress a
review_text: My mom loves this dress and said she had one just like it back in her day.

Lovely dress with some snap to it. Love the collar and the buttons. My only complaint is that it is too short. I'm 5'2 and busty (36DD). If the length was 3 inches longer, the dress would still be midknee when my arms are at my sides. Overall a good value for the $. I wish that some of the dresses sold by ModCloth would be a little longer and a few had sleeves. The sass could be taken to most places of employment then.

review_summary: Love this dress!! I put i
review_text: Love this dress!! I put it on straight out of the box and now I am going to wear it out for dinner and a party. So comfy and I know I can wear it to work too!! I think when I get my next pay check I will be buying it in a few different colors.

This dress is really chic and artsy! I paired it with grey/black snowflake print leggings and a cute cardigan for the winter weatherI can't wait to wear it in the spring/summer, too. This is a really versatile, allseason dress. The navy blue is exactly like the picture, and the fabric is a little bit thicker but still very soft. I am 5'2, 127 pounds (short, pear shaped, athletic build) so I ordered the small. The length is perfectmid thigh. I may invest in a few more of these dresses because of how great they fit, and how I can wear them in any season. You definitely get your money's worth.
This was my first ModCloth purchase and I could not be happier!  I love, love, love this dress!   I can not wait to wear this one, it's perfect for both work and play!

review_summary: I wore this dress on Chri
review_text: I wore this dress on Christmas Day and even my ultraconservative, extremely traditional Grandpa was impressed. Yes, it was on the shorter side but I am only 5'3 and just prefer my skirts and dresses to be at my knees or just below. It was a couple inches above but nothing scandalous, although I am glad that I had leggings on underneath (that would be true of any dress, regardless of length, thanks to an overexcited 4 year old kid and equally hyper dog). I did end up sewing the pockets closed and cutting them out because it was VERY roomy in the hips, allowing for enough movement that the pocket would end up bunched in the worst spots. It's gorgeous even before doing that and I intend to buy one in every color as soon as I can!

I honestly couldn't be happier with this itemthe material's a bit thicker, which is absolutely lovely to haveit helps hide any little bumps your body might have!!! The pockets are an awesome bonus and are really nice to have. I got a large for my 36c, 28 waist, 41 hip daughterit's very figure flattering and really compliments her curves.  It's well worth the money, and it's not too short to be workappropriate,but is also daytime appropriate! Love it!

review_summary: I bought this as a work d
review_text: I bought this as a work dress and it is perfect for this purpose. I thought that the large might be a bit snug for my frame but it fits well. The waist sits just below my bust and the hem is just above my knees. I think I will definitely be buying this dress in a few other colours.

I am completely over the moon with this dress. Fair warning though: you won't be able to walk past any reflective surface without checking yourself out. I just love looking how great I look with it one. For any Australians  I'm a size 12 with a 12C14B cup and the dress fits perfectly. The colour, length and style are all great.
very comfortable and forgiving! i orginally ordered the XL based off of the measurements, but it was loose, so I tried the L and it fits comfortably.  I will be buying this in another color!

review_summary: This is a great dress! Tr
review_text: This is a great dress! Truly! I was worried it wouldn't fit well since I'm 5'2 and pretty small, but it works! I wore it to work with a long sleeve shirt underneath and was so comfy all day. Its so cute!

Like everyone else, I love this dress! It's extremely comfortable, versatile, and excellent quality. The fabric is thick and soft without being too heavy. It is the perfect length on me, hitting just above the knee. This dress works great with tights and a longsleeve tee or a cardigan for the fall/winter (my favorite is with a light blue tshirt, grey patterned tights, and boots). And the pockets make it perfect. :) I ordered this and the houndstooth version of this dress, and I get compliments every time I wear them.

review_summary: I didn't find this as cut
review_text: I didn't find this as cute as some other reviewers did but will probably keep it. Maybe it's the darker color or the color combo with the buttons, but this somehow felt just a touch too conservative than I usually like. It's a nice basic though. The material is fairly substantial and it's comfortable to wear.

PERFECT dress for work or a nice fall day/night out. Dress is a nice length, but a tad on the short side for work. It is perfectly fine with tights tho. I am a bit wide in the hips, so usually I cannot pull off any dresses with pockets(which is a bummer). I don't know if it's the quality fabric or what, but the pockets on this dress are perfect. They lay flat and don't add size to your hips. The button details are great. The size is just right, but if you are worried about layering I would reccommend ordering 1 size up. Fitted in the chest area. I ordered both the blue and the red, with the intention of only keeping 1. Loved them so much, I kept both!

Very cute.  I was worried about the sizing, since I've not ordered from modcloth before, but it worked out great!  The fabric is a heavy weight, and a bit more clingy than I was expecting.  Over all, good casual dress.

Little blackdress with some sass (or littleblue dress). A wonderful dress that is really multipurpose: party, work, where ever! I wore this to a weeding with some great yellow heels. The high neck and collar give more length to the piece visually and make you (or me, at 5' 2) look much taller and leaner. If I was any taller it might be too short, but for me, PERFECT. I will wear it to many different events.

Absolutely love this dress! Great quality material and fits really well. I'm 5'10 with a 38DD and the XL fit perfectly if a little short.  I could have pulled it off alone and just not bent over all evening, but I wore it for New Year's Eve with a cute pair of black tights and I got compliments all night!  Thanks so much ModCloth for finally getting larger sizes that fit girls who aren't a size 2! :)

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this dress online, and after receiving it, I'm even more in love with it  The fit is perfect, and the material is very comfortable (kind of like a thick jersey).  I can see how the length might be a tad on the short side for some people, but with tights, it's fine.  Very happy with my very first ModCloth purchase, and super impressed that it arrived the day after I ordered it.  ModCloth, I will definitely be back.

This dress is super cute and fits perfectly! The pockets are great, too; it's taking me a little time to get used to them on a dress, and they can poof out a little bit and make a weird little bulge in the dress, but if you just keep the pockets flat it's not a problem. It also reached me quickly! Overall a great buy from Modcloth!

Love this dress! I'm normally a size 8 in dresses, 5'3'' and 140 pounds. The material is stretchy and a small fits perfectly. It is a true empire waste so the band hits right under the bust. Very flattering! It is so comfortable but classy at the same time. One of my favorites :)

review_summary: I was searching for the p
review_text: I was searching for the perfect dress for my boyfriend's upcoming flight school graduation, and this was IT! I am in love. I ordered a medium, and it fits just right. The perfect appropriate length for such an event, too. The only thing I am going to have to adjust is that I am a busty girl with a petite frame, and when I tried on the dress, the waist line curved directly under my bust because I was wearing a more structured bra at the time. I will have to wear a more demure bra for the event so the dress falls into the proper places. Other than that, as a first time ModCloth customer, I am head over heels! :)

review_summary: This is a tad on the shor
review_text: This is a tad on the short side for me.  I wish it was just an inch or two longer. I am wearing it to see the Civil Wars in concert with cream colored tights and brown flats.  I love the neckline and the details on the waist! Such a flattering dress!

review_summary: I was so excited to recei
review_text: I was so excited to receive this dress and ordered it when it was on sale. I am glad I waited because despite all of the glowing reviews, I am just hohum about the dress. The knit is thicker and good for the fall and winter with tights underneath and the length is below midthigh on me. HOWEVER the waistline is unnaturally high, right beneath my boobs so i am constantly adjusting it by pulling it down. If you are at all longwaisted, avoid this dress! Also, I love dresses with pockets but the pockets on these ones seem to be sewn in strangely and fit better if they are placed backwards. If I wear them the way they are supposed to face, they create an unflattering bulge at the hips. Will definitely be removing them altogether when I get the chance. Finally, because of the neckline, it is hard to find a suitable cardy or topper to wear with the dress considering it is a thicker material and warrants wearing in colder weather. I was considering returning the dress but it seems like a hassle from Canada.

review_summary: This is such a cute dress
review_text: This is such a cute dress.  I bought this in Noir before, but it was a much shorter length.  This new version has a longer length (right above my knee) and the waist is actually at the smallest part of my waist instead of at the top of my ribcage like in the earlier version.  I also love that the skirt is lined!  This dress is very versatile; I can wear it in all seasons paired with leggings in the winter and there is just enough room for me to slip a white shirt underneath for colder days.  The only con is that the shoulder top ends slightly before my shoulder ends so shows the seams of the shirts I wear underneath in the winter.  Overall, great dress!

After reading the 140 reviews that the dress had when I was looking, I decided to make this dress my first modcloth purchase, and it was so worth it. I'm 5'4 and 140 lbs, so I have a little bit of a tummy and am usually very picky about dresses because of that. This dress nips in at my smallest part, right under my chest (so it would almost be empire if the skirt was poofier) and makes me look like I didn't eat at all over the holidays. The color is beautiful, the fabric is soft and comfortable, and the fit is perfect. If you're considering this dress, just get it, you'll love it.

review_summary: I am in love with this dr
review_text: I am in love with this dress!!! I plan on buying it in at least two more colors, it is so flattering on me! I feel very confident in this dress, it really hugs my curves while hiding spots I don't love. My less curvy mother tried it on as well and it was a little less flattering but I love it! I thought for some reason that the fabric was going to be a wool or something but it turned out to be a lighter fabric that is still weighty so I can wear this out in the winter with tights and a cardigan. LOVE!

This dress took forever to arrive and it was worth the long wait! I just had to jump into the dress the very moment i opened the box, and it fit like a glove! It is so slimming and i absolutely am loving the collar! I'm planning on getting this dress in other colours. Definitely worth it!

review_summary: I own the Coach Tour dres
review_text: I own the Coach Tour dress in several colors, but this might very well be my favorite. The pockets are what take it over the moon. Soft, movable fabric that breathes well, and the navy color is awesome to play with. HIGHLY recommend!

review_summary: I got this dress in three
review_text: I got this dress in three colours: bleu, noir and rouge because i knew it'd suit my body type and had such great reviews.  I am happy with the dress, but I guess I had imagined the fabric to be better than what it is, but I guess the price would be double if it was.  It's not as thick a material as I imagined and the weave is not as tight as it could be (i.e. if you hold it up to the light you can see light comes through).  This also means the dress is not as stiff as I expected so the collar is floppier than it looks.  Length wise they're good, falls about 1.5inches above my knees which I think is still office acceptable. Anyway, these dresses are a fantastic style and are good enough to keep.

review_summary: This is my first dress i
review_text: This is my first dress i purchased from Modcloth and I love it! It is absolutely gorgeous and I can't wait to wear it. Just like many people pointed out, it stops just about an inch or two above the knee but looks very appropriate. I absolutely adore the button details. Amazing dress!!!

Love this dress.  Recieved many compliments over Thanksgiving.  Fits very nice even for the busty.  Waist comes a little lower than empire but very flattering. You can't see much of the dress in the pic but you can make out the length.
My favorite dress in the whole wide world! Everything about it is perfect! Sooo comfy, classy, and beautiful!

I absolutely love this dress. The material is excellent quality: fairly thick but with nice stretch. The skirt does flair out a little more than I had pictured, but I love it. It's so versatile, and the pockets are such a fun and comfortable touch!

review_summary: I love this dress.  The c
review_text: I love this dress.  The color is beautiful, the details are perfect, and it's exceptionally comfortable.  I wear it to work with a pair of dark tights and boots and it's wonderful.  My favorite feature  POCKETS!!!

review_summary: I love this dress! The fa
review_text: I love this dress! The fabric feels wonderful and is such a lovely color! It fits great! I can't wait to wear it out!

I love the colour, buttons and collar of this dress. I ordered a size S and it was slightly loose around my hips. Bear in mind that the pockets add a little width to your hips if you do not smooth the inside to make them lie flat. The collar is adorable but I personally cannot seem to keep it looking perfectly arranged when I am out and about all day.

review_summary: I LOVE this dress. It is
review_text: I LOVE this dress. It is a little bit shorter than what I am used to, but I quickly got over that when I looked at the rest of the dress  the pockets are my favourite part! The cowl neck is gorgeous and the buttons are a cute touch. If it wasn't for the international shipping charges I would buy one in every colour!

review_summary: This is the kind of dress
review_text: This is the kind of dress that will flatter literally every body. Period. Super cute. I am pleased.

My second ModCloth Purchase and again I'm very happy, its a lovely dress that can't wait to wear out, the material is fabulous, the length is great and I love the way the dress shapes my body, so happy with it

review_summary: I love this dress! The fa
review_text: I love this dress! The fabric is nice and heavy and it is well sewn. It hits just above the knee on me. I was very happy with this purchase.

This arrived in two days (on a Saturday) I couldn't be happier!! It fit perfectly and I got sooo many compliments on it! I did feel it was short enough to require leggings/tights but that is just a personal preference. And this pairs beautifully with a long sleeved top to be able to wear it throughout the year. I was a little surprised by the material. For some reason I thought it would be more of a sweater dress material and its not. But after wearing it... I prefer the dress as is and I can't say that I would want to make any changes to it. I did have to be careful with which undershirt I wore because if the shirt fell past my waist I could see the line of it throught the dress. That is the only reason it didn't get the full 5 star rating. Overall, I am very happy with my purchase and can't wait to wear it again!!!

This dress looks great with a pair of tall brown boots. I get tons of compliments on it.  It's a bit short, so be careful around the office.  It easily converts into a coolerweather dress by putting a thin white sweater underneath and a pair of white tights. I love wearing this.

This is a perfect dress, incredibly flattering and so uniquely styled. It goes extremely well with kneehigh socks and a wool hat, and makes me feel like I'm living an Agnes Varda film. My sole complaint is that the pocket interiors sometimes slide to the back, but that's nothing a little bit of thread can't fix.So satisfied.

I was ridiculously excited about getting this dress. And rightly so, I am absolutely in love with it. I only have two complaints. I feel like it's a bit short and the pockets are kind of funny. They fit like they're supposed to be facing backwards. Also one of the buttons on the collar is a different color but you can hardly tell unless you look closely. Overall, for a first purchase, it's just right. I can't wait to order more from the site!

I LOVE THIS DRESS!!!!! This was my first time order. It came really fast and when I tried it on I could'nt take it off. I ordered a little big but still very flattering. Idk if it would pull over my chest if I got a small. I just love it so much!!!333
Wow, talk about a perfect dress. It gives plenty of wiggle room for us curvy girls and accentuates not emphasizes. I love this dress.

I always worry about buying a dress from the website because of constant mixed reviews. However, with this dress ALL the reviews are positive, I knew I couldn't go wrong! After seeing this dress be out of stock for what felt like forever, I jumped on the chance to buy this! I don't regret it all.  the dress is a gorgeous navy color and the fabric is comfortable and of good quality.  The pewter buttons add just the right amount of detail and accessory.  I have a pear shaped body and it is usually difficult to find something that flatters me shape but this dress certainly does! I cannot wait to wear it and show it off! This is the type of dress that will look good on ANYONE. I recommend this dress to everyone reading this review :D

review_summary: Great dress!!! It is so s
review_text: Great dress!!! It is so smart and the fit is just perfect. The material is so soft and comfortable. It provided ample amount of stretch. I bought the XS because I am very petite and when I opened the package, it looked like a dress for someone who is much more petite than me. That scared me a little but when I tried it on, I realized that my worry was all for naught. The jerseyish material gives enough stretch and the waist area does not feel uncomfortable. Only complaint I have is that the pockets in the skirt area disturbs the nice Aline look of the dress with funny bulges. I don't really know why this is happening and the dress definitely flares out more than what you see in the picture. If you can make do with this little anomaly, it really is a great buy. I think some warm ironing should do the trick to straighten it out, so I have no plan of returning it. It is short, hits about 23 inches above my knee and my height is 5' 4 but I like it that way as well so this is definitely a keeper!
This dress is super cute.  I wore it with leggings and brown boots and got lots of compliments. The quality is a thicker jersey and I love the buttons.

review_summary: This dress is SO CUTE on.
review_text: This dress is SO CUTE on. It gives you a teenytiny waist and it has POCKETS. I plan to wear it on Christmas day. The only thing I would mention is, if you're taller than 5'2you might want to watch for how short it is. It's barely long enough for me. It's probably the shortest dress I own (and I like to keep my dresses above my knee). It's about 2 1/2 inches above my knee and I can't stand on my tiptoes or (heaven forbid) bend over in it. But it's the PERFECT dress for some of us shorter gals! :)

review_summary: I should have gotten a sm
review_text: I should have gotten a smallit would have fit fine but they were out so I got a M. So that's my faultI think it does run true to size.  It is very cute and comfy.

This dress fits PERFECTLY. I was afraid it might be too small in the bust, but it fits so nicely. Its comfortable, a great material for the fall, and I got a lot of compliments on it. One of the buttons fell off on the waist, it was probably my own fault, but its nothing you can't fix with a needle and thread. Best modcloth purchase by far.

review_summary: This dress was my first b
review_text: This dress was my first buy, and I love it.  It fits great and looks amazing.  It's a good length, but if you're not used to shorter dresses, it may be a little odd at first.  All in all though, I love it, and it's a great piece.

Love it! Fits quite well overall and is the simplest dress to just pull on and dash. I do wish the waist buttons hit more in the front of the dress than the sides, and I would be happy with a threequarter length sleeve on this too. As it is I've been wearing a shit underneath to make sleeves in the cooler winter weather.

Ordered this on Wednesday and got it on Friday, amazingly enough. I didn't pay for expedited shipping, so I was really pleasantly surprised.Fabric has a nice weight to it, so it lays very nice., and is a nice shade of navy blue Love the cowl neck and the coppercolored buttons. Fits perfectly across bust and is a nice length on me. The only thing I dislike are the pockets, which move around and get bunched at times, adding a bumpy element to my already pearish shape. I think I'm going to sew the pockets shut and cut them out so that I don't have to worry about lumpiness. Overall, so glad I got the second to last dress. ^_^

Just like everyone else, I love this dress. So comfy, so flattering and so versatile. I can see myself wearing it almost all year round. Nice deep blue color, nice thick fabric, good fit and even the length was better than I expected. Based on the other reviews, I thought this might be a tad short on me, but I figured I could wear it with tights. It was longer than expected and hits about 2 inches above the knee. I measured my dress and it's 36 inches long. I don't know if that is a mistake, but it's perfect for me, so I'm very happy. I just wish it was still available in the other colors.

This dress is fantastic! Wanted a Small, but they were out so got a Medium. It's a small enough difference and a flexible enough fabric that it still looks and fits quite well. Very classy, very versatile. A Great addition to any wardrobe!

Absolutely adorable! The material's a little thicker then expected, which is awesome. You can tell its well made. I'm glad I listened to the other reviews, they were very helpful in figuring out my size (first time buyer). I have a small chest and this fit it perfectly! I've been debating whether or not to buy this dress for a while, and I'm so glad I did!
I paired this with brown riding boots and a cream long sleeved shirt for Thanksgiving. I got a ton of compliments on it :)

Jeez, how can I describe this dress? It's soft, sexy, and definitely worth the money. I am a bigbusted gal and opted to get a large because I've had more hits than misses in my past purchases and boy am I glad I did. The top fits perfectly, not too tight nor too loose and the hemline hits me right above my knees. I'm glad I caught the mail man before the boy did because I can't wait for Christmas to wear this dress! Thanks!!

Wonderful dress! This was my first ModCloth purchase and I normally don't shop online for clothes since I am so particular about fit. I was concerned about sizing but went off the measurements guide and it fits perfectly. The material is so soft and the dress is very comfortable. Very happy I bought this dress!

This dress is very flattering, very cute, but it has too be the shortest thing I've ever purchased past the age of 22.  It's length is just right if you're 5'2 but at 5'7, my roommate could actually SEE the curve of my backside below the hemline of the dress.  I understand that even though I'm average height in the real world, I'm 90% of the time extremely tall by modcloth clothing standards, but this one is especially ridiculous.  Handily my roommate is 5'1 and she liked it so I sold it to her, haha!  :)

This dress is adorable. Flat out adorable. It fits perfectly, the quality is great, and the material has a nice weight to itvery easy to transition it into the colder months! I don't think I have a single complaint about this dress at all. I'm incredibly satisfied!

This dress is simply AMAZING. Stunning, totally flattering (especially for a large bust, like mine.) It's not too long, not too short. The fabric is thick so you actually feel covered and warm, and the gold buttons are an adorable accessory. I'm wearing this dress for Thanksgiving and I'm sure I'll get compliments. Bravo!

review_summary: I love this dress!  It st
review_text: I love this dress!  It stretches, it's very flattering, and I've gotten many compliments on it.  It's a tad short, but it looks good by itself with flats or leggings and boots.
Perfect in every way.

review_summary: The waist hits at the wro
review_text: The waist hits at the wrong spot for me, but the material is really soft and I can cover it with a cardigan to hide the poor fit if needed.  Its not perfect, but its wearable.

This dress is absolutely perfect. I'd previously returned most of my Modcloth orders, but this dress was a definite keeper. Everyone else loved it, so I thought I would too. It's really cute and flattering. It is very comfortable. I love how it's comfortably fitted at the bust and waist, but not fitted on the hips  perfect for ladies with an hourglass or pear shape. I love the pockets too. I wore this for my birthday party and loved it.

This dress is exactly as pictured.  Despite it's lack of sleeves, it is pretty thick and warm!  I had read other reviews saying this dress had a little bit of give to it so I sized down and the small fits just fine.  Very cute and classic!

This dress is amazing! The fit is perfect and the shape is very flattering. I didn't realize the dress had pockets so it was a nice surprise. I love how versatile this dress is as well.  I highly recommend.
Absolutely LOVE this dress. It's so comfortable and adorable

review_summary: I love this dress!  I lay
review_text: I love this dress!  I layered it with an oatmeal/cream long sleeve sweater and paired it with wine colored tights and tall brown bootslooked so cute!  If I had pics I would share! I sized up so I wouldn't have any stretching across the bust, but the arm holes fit a bit strange now, but with the sweater underneath it was fine.  All of my friends were looking at this dress too and were so jealous I ordered it first!

This dress is beautiful! The upper half is a little snug/short feeling, but that is probably because I have a longer than normal torso. The quality is very good. It's a teensy bit shorter than I normally like for a work dress (23 inches above my knee  I have a very conservative workplace) but not a big deal. I'm very excited to wear this throughout the fall and winter!
nice work attire, comfortable feel..

review_summary: I love the fit of this dr
review_text: I love the fit of this dress: it's made of soft material and cinches perfectly in at the waist. You also can't go wrong with a dress with pockets! There are 2 small issues I had with the quality (might just be a personal preference  1) the buttons are large and plastic, and look cheap (I ended up replacing them with nautical gold buttons), and 2) the cowl neck does not actually have button holes on the other side, that would allow you to button it up into a turtleneck. The asymmetrical neck is just for show and not functional. Other than that, perfect for fall  loved the color, fit, and length!
This is a seriously cute dress. It's just as perfect as I imagined it to be.

This item would probably fit a short ( 5'3) or a shortwaisted gal best. IMO it would work better on someone with more of a straight body type, rather than curves. The color is lovely and it is nice for layering.

I previously purchased this dress in the pink.  Loved the fit and look but hated the color on me.  I exchanged it for the navy blue.  It's very flattering.  It has cute side pockets in the skirt.  The only thing I hadn't realized is that the buttons are a bronze color.  I was hoping to wear it this winter with leggings, but will have to figure out what color leggings will match.  Will probably go with brown but it will require new boots.  I would still definitely recommend this dress.

review_summary: I have received tons of c
review_text: I have received tons of compliment with this dress. I definitely recommend!
Fabric was a bit different from what I was expecting, but I definitely still recommend this dress! Easy option for business casual attire.

This was another dress where I found myself awkwardly in between several sizes. I am pearshaped and VERY shortwaisted and usually wear an 8 standard or a 10P in dresses, so I tried the L.  The fabric is ultra soft  like pajamas!  and the blue is a bit brighter than it appears on screen.  I confess, I didn't measure what a 34.5 length would be on me, so the dress was borderline scandalous instead of cute.  Judging by others' pictures, I thought it would hit just shy of my knees, but it was definitely midthigh.  In the size L, I found the ascot collar more awkward than pictured, as the buttoned part of the collar doesn't stretch all the way across the shoulder in the larger size.  I also thought the collar was substantially less full compared to the picture.  I agree with previous reviewers who have commented about the pockets: they are adorable, yes, but if you have fuller hips, they may hit at an unfortunate height.  I looked tiny and fey from the ribcage up, but my lower half simply exploded.  My hips jutted the dress out into a very abrupt triangle, which detracted from the dress' overall simplicity. review_summary: I have quite a few clothi
review_text: I have quite a few clothing items from ModCloth, and in general I have been very happy with nearly every thing I have purchased or gotten as a gift, but this dress TAKES THE CAKE. It is simply perfect. The fabric is very good quality, and the pattern on the dress is very feminine without being too much. The bow is a nice touch as well, it is subtle but adds that quirky edge that so many of us love in ModCloth clothes. The cut is perfect for my body type and both the top and the skirt are incredibly flattering. I think another reviewer mentioned that the arm holes on this dress make it very comfortable, and I'd agree 100%. The designers definitely took plussized bodies into mind when they made this dress and, in my opinion at least, didn't just size up a straight size pattern. I wasn't necessarily concerned about the length per se, but sometimes dresses ride just a little bit higher than I'd like but again, this one is perfect, it hits right above my knees (I am 5'6.) I did get this dress as a gift, but I would absolutely buy it for myself, and I can wholeheartedly recommend it to others too. It is flattering, comfortable, stylish, unique, and wellmade. I know ModCloth used to carry other prints in this design, so I hope they add more to the selection, because I could wear this dress in any color or pattern. Absolutely this is my favorite item I have ever gotten from ModCloth and possibly my favorite new dress.

review_text: I am in love with this dress! It is the perfect fit for me! I partnered this with the charter school cardigan in red and it makes the dress shine even more!
Loved this dress!

review_summary: I've never had a dress to
review_text: I've never had a dress to fit me in the hips and chest as well as this has, given it had little to no stretch. It's adorable. The fabric and zipper seem to be excellent quality. And the color is exactly as shown.

I really wanted this dress to fit me but, alas, it was too big to wear for the anniversary dinner I was attending a week after my purchase, It was the largest in the bust area, as well as the armsyces. I would have considered returning it due to the lack of fit, but I didn't have time since I had to leave so soon after my package arrived. Ah well...
This dress is just plain adorable. Fits like a dream, good quality fabric and also super comfortable. I wear it all the time and feel so cute in it!
Amazing quality, a little short. Tight in the bust. I'm a DD and ordered a large because there was no XL so I guess it's my own fault. Beautiful pattern.

review_summary: This is by far my favorit
review_text: This is by far my favorite ModCloth purchase. I only looked at this dress from the mobile app, so I couldn't see how big the bow was. My mother who sews removed the bow and is going to use the leftover fabric  for matching hair accessories, it looks so much better without it.. The quality is wonderful, I wish the length would reach to my knees instead of above,but not a big deal; taller ladies should be careful with this dress. I am 5'1 and curvy and this dress fits and flatters beautifully. I love this dress so much that I bought both patterns of it!

review_summary: Love this dress. I'm a su
review_text: Love this dress. I'm a sucker for vintage floral, so this one drew me in right away. It fits well  perhaps not a dress I'll wear to go eat a feast in, but one that's comfortable throughout the day. From the front, it's very flattering. I worry I look a bit boxy in it from the side, but overall, this suits my waist. At first, I thought the bust was snug, but after one wear, it's stretched a tiny bit to accommodate my chest. Overall, I'm happy with this one!
Lovely dress. It's a little big on me, but not so much that it looks bad. The fabric is thick and high quality. I got a lot of compliments on it. It was a bit short.
This dress was extremely large on me, especially under the arms. I wanted it to fit so badly, but unfortunately it didn't

It's a beautiful, high quality dress but I think the sizing is off. I could certainly do with losing a few lbs, but according to the size chart the Large equates to a US 10/12 so a UK 14/16. I am a large UK 14 and this is very small. I'm getting married in 6 weeks so losing weight anyway but just beware this is on the small side. Also  if you're ordering from the UK  I just got stung for ?30 import tax which pretty much took the joy out of receiving my delivery!

I love this dress! Great quality and looks just as amazing in person as if does in the photos. I always have problems getting things to fit my bust area and could use a little more room up top. I love it so much though!

I bought this dress back in January as the Matron of Honor and only bridesmaid in my best friend's wedding in August. It was simple and fit perfectly. I loved the pockets, as I had her vows in one and the rings in the other! I cannot wait to wear this dress again.

I wore this as the maid of honor in my friend's wedding and I loved it! It was comfortable, pretty, and flattering. The detail on the top creates a beautiful shape and the low back is lovely. Two notes: it wrinkles VERY easily, and it seems to attract fuzz from all over the place. I used a lint roller before the wedding, but within a couple hours it was covered in lint again. I also ironed it twice and still didn't manage to get all of the wrinkles out.

review_summary: I'm so in love with this
review_text: I'm so in love with this dress! It fits very true to size, perfect length, classy, and has pockets! The only downside is the typical delicate  zipper. I typically wear a medium 8/10 and bought a large, it's got the perfect amount of room without being baggy.

review_summary: The bust was small and th
review_text: The bust was small and the waist hits a bit high but the fabric weight is heavy with great bounce. Love this dress and wore it for my birthday a few weeks ago and think it will get a lot more wear this spring when it warms back up even though it looks good pretty good with a sweater for fall. I have to wear a very thin bra for it to zip but otherwise the fit is good.
Shortwaisted..not flattering.too tight around the side, gaps around bust.

This felt like a reasonably nicely made dress, but the sizing was odd, and it arrived in poor condition. PROS: Nice, heavy materialSkirt had a good drapeCONSArrived extremely wrinkled, and with pleats, not an easy thing to take care of myselfHad a small stain on the right breastToo long in the torso, and not as fitted as the picture lookedOverall, it seemed like it would be too highmaintenance for everyday use in the office (what I had intended it for), and given the poor condition, I would have had to spend money to make it presentable.

Well made, well lined, pleats laid flat, beautiful seam work on the top portion, looks exactly as pictured. The small fit my waist perfectly. And there are POCKETS! The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the wrinkles were near impossible to remove completely with the heavier cotton fabric. I must have steamed and ironed for an hour.
This dress is perfect  great material, great fit, great length! And pockets! I love it! I'm 5'9 and 170lb and the Large fit me perfectly.

review_summary: I sized up based on other
review_text: I sized up based on other reviews but the large was way too big.  Will be returning it for a smaller size.  Very nice quality!! There is no stretch  to the fabric. I hope the medium fits better.
Very nicely made dress, very.  Love that it has pockets!  I got a small and I couldn't zip up past my waist. Had to return unfortunately.  Medium would have be too big in other areas.

We were renewing our vows and I had bought a lovely cotton maxi dress from another plus sized company, I loved it, but I kept being drawn to this one. One day I caught it on half price so I followed my instincts and bought it. It fit me perfectly :0) and the color was spot on for my color scheme. I'm a 4X, so finding a good fit is hit or miss, and I am so glad I was able to find this gorgeous dress. My bridesmaids wore Modcloth too! (Not to mention some of them have since become customers) thank you for making our big day so beautiful.

Absolutely gorgeous dress, gorgeous pink color (slightly muted not too bright). Bought it as a potential wedding dress but it didn't make the cut. Only reason I docked a star is because it was a little tight in the rib area but loose/comfy everywhere else.

This dress is very beautiful and looks great.   I normally wear a size 8 or 10 and the medium fit perfectly, although I the tummy area is not forgiving in this and can give off a slightly pregnant  look if your tummy isn't perfectly flat due to the empire waist combined with the loose area around the natural waistline. It is not bridal gown quality because there is no internal shape wear like the bridal gowns I've tried on, but the fabric is thicker than a normal dress.  I highly recommend some Spanx or shape wear under this dress because I personally would have returned it otherwise had I not tried it on with strong shape wear. the bra cups are nice, although again I wouldn't rely on just the dress itself for shaping. I'm glad I bought it for an informal ceremony. The height is perfect for me in flats... I'm 5'10. It'd be perfect for a shorter person while wearing heels though.

My nowhusband and I struggled with a theme for our ceremony. Once I put this dress on, the idea for a quaint garden ceremony came to me and we never looked back. With some minor sewing adjustments on the sleeves that I did myself, this dress fit perfect. I'm 5'4 and I could wear flats! Could not recommend this dress enough in this color for any bride looking for something that melds traditional, vintage, and modern together.

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a friend's wedding. It travels well, is comfortable, and the fabric feels lovely. My only quibble is the bottom: there's a plastic thread run through the hem, presumably to keep movement in the mesh layer. It keeps poking out of the hem, so I keep having to trim it, because I can't push it in. At times, as much as four inches of it will poke out at once.

This dress was super comfortable! I wore it to homecoming and it was beautiful. I usually wear smaller sized, but I got the 1XL to accommodate my bigger bust size. It fit perfect! It wasn't tight in the bust, and it didn't look like a bag on me.
Way too long

Purchased for my sisters wedding and it is perfect.  Once it is streamed it will lay better.  Also, the zipper has a weak spot so I needed help to zip it up.  Once zipped up; it felt good.  The lac is very soft!
Lovely dress, nice colour, good fit although a little narrow in the shoulders

review_summary: This is my new favorite d
review_text: This is my new favorite dress!!!! With my large chest, it fits a bit more like an empire waist, which I prefer. I wish I could make more versions of this dress.... longer for work and more colors for other days of the week!
Beautiful dress, very unique
Too short... Way too short.
This dress is so beautiful. I'm wearing it to an outside wedding in Texas and it's just perfect. It's lightweight and fits just right.
Love this one!

I am 5' 6 at 110 lbs, so the size small is slightly big in the waist. However, with some minor alterations, I know it'll fit perfectly. I chose this for my rehearsal dinner dress for my wedding in October, and I'm beyond thrilled with it! It's so darling with amazing details. I love it!

review_summary: I tried this dress on for
review_text: I tried this dress on for a wedding. I liked it but it wasn't my favorite choice. The fabric is light, airy, and comfortable. For someone who is larger on the bottom, like me, it camouflages all of those problem areas. The zipper transition between the lower blue fabrics and the lace was difficult and I had to have someone help zip me up for fear of ripping the dress. Once zipped, it fit great in all areas. I eventually exchanged it and opted for a dress with pockets. No complaints just not what I needed for this event.
Love this dress  the colors, the fit, the style, everything. Wore this as a maid of honor and I got so many compliments on it! Just a tad bit big for me, but I'm still able to wear it.
Absolutely gorgeous.  The beginning of a ModCloth love affair.

This dress was a disappointment. The quality was nice, but the fit was short in the torso and very boxy.  It did nothing for my figure, which made me so sad, because it would've been a great dress for the wedding I am attending in July.

I absolutely ADORE THIS DRESS!  It fits perfectly!  And it looks lovely.  The quality is very good  I had no problems with it.  It fits true to size.  You will NOT be disappointed!  I was so happy it comes in this color, as the mocha version turned out to be the same color as my skin, which was weird.  THIS DRESS IS AMAZING! :)
This dress is beautiful but the opaque layer underneath the longer sheer layer was extremely short. I had purchased this dress to wear for my wedding but do to the length issue, I had to return it.

I actually really liked this dress. It was very flattering, true to size, and super cute on. My only hang up, which led to me returning it, was that the flowers seemed cheaper in their make than the rest of the dress.
It's not grey, it's light blue. I look 12 in it. I'm returning it.
Fits beautifully! The fit is flattering and the length hits about three inches above my knee. The color is exactly like the picture. I love this dress!

Purchased a size Medium, I am usually a size 68 in street clothes. I couldn't get this thing over my head or up over my hips. I am an athletic build so if you have any sort of squatsized legs or pullup type shoulders, order a size up, or two. It was a bit traumatizing. I actually got stuck in the dress. Yikes!

This dress could have been the one for our wedding!  It is a perfect mix between understated and classic wedding dress.  The fabric is slightly stiff and heavy, but it lays well and hangs nicely.  The weight, fabric and color lends itself to a slightly cooler weather dress.  Detail is beautiful for such an inexpensive dress.  According to the size chart, I fall between a small and a medium.  I selected medium to handle my larger ribcage and DD chest, assuming I could have it tailored down as needed.  Sadly, the medium would not even zip past my ribcage and larger sizes have been continuously unavailable.  Luckily, I am not in a rush, as we are not planning an actual wedding...we will simply decide today is the day and have a pop up J.O.P ceremony somewhere.  I will keep checking for the larger size to become available and keep my eyes open for something of similar style.

review_summary: I bought the first gown i
review_text: I bought the first gown in my usual size medium. It would not zip way too small. The large came and fit perfectly! I did alter the cap style sleeve as it was too wide and not flattering for me. I made it into a tank style top to show off more shoulder and neckline. Did not need a hem but I wore 23 heels. I made a veil out of the first dress that was too small! For the price, you cannot beat it! The detail is amazing! I received many many compliments. My absolute dream wedding dress for our vintage barn wedding. 5'6 158lbs 38 D.

I wore this dress for my wedding and loved how pretty and affordable it was.  I am normally a M but had to go up to a L because the empire waist felt too tight around my ribcage. I then had the sleeves and sides taken in professionally.  It's a long dress but I found platform wedges that worked well with it and were tall enough that I didn't have to have it shortened. Shortening it would be difficult because of the detailed lace at the hem, but could be done from the waist. This dress was so comfortable, easy to move in, and felt simple and elegant.

review_summary: Not flattering, seam in front at bust looks awkward, zipper
review_text: I bought this as a wedding dress in the pink color. There is a seam right in the middle of the bust that looks awkward because the pattern is mismatched and the seam makes the two separate pieces of bust fabric lay at different angles. The models make the dress look like it has soft delicate fabric, but it is stiff heavy fabric, so the fabric at the shoulders does not drape over the shoulders; instead, the shoulders jut out stiffly, which makes me think of 1980s women's power suits with broad shoulders. The fit of the dress is off somehow. The bust is tight, but then the waist is big and puffy. The models in the pictures all have defined pretty waists, but my dress is very straight and has no defined waist. I did not wear it, the cost to get it altered and have the bust seam area fixed was more than what I paid for it, so I bought another dress elsewhere.

I originally ordered the XS, but found it pretty loose up top, so I figured that exchanging for an XXS would be a safe bet, but ... oy. It was pretty tight around the ribcage, and just a teensy bit small in the waist, but it was almost doable. The main problem was the way the zipper is sewn onit's REALLY difficult to zip up past a certain point. And then I had a hard time taking it off without anyone helping me, such that I sprained my shoulder. Shucks. Otherwise, it looked gorgeous.

I loved this dress. The length was perfect with my cowboy boots and the lace was beautiful. I was really impressed by the quality of the materials and sewing. My mom needed to do about 20 minutes worth of alterations because of my small bust. My only problem was the zipper stuck around the ribbon, even when the dress was off. I'm super happy with my purchase.

I bought four dresses from ModCloth to try on for my wedding.  This one was a favorite until I tried it on.  The fabric was beautiful but it fit a little strange on top.  I have a larger chest and the Large fit but smashed my boobs and the XL was looser in the shoulders.  I wanted

I ordered this and two other wedding dresses to see which one I would feel most beautiful and comfortable in. This was the winner! Right away when I put it on, it felt natural (like something I would really wear rather than something overly formal that I don't feel like myself in) and I felt beautiful. It's a bulkier laceish design than on most classic wedding dresses, but that totally works for me! I love how ornate yet...humble?... it is, and I'm so excited to get married in this ridiculously affordable wedding dress! It's a bit big in the shoulder/armpit area on me, and it's slightly too long for me (though wearing high enough shoes might be able to make it workable), so I'm planning to get it altered professionally. But I am more than willing to spend some money on perfecting the fit after getting the dress for such a comparatively cheap price! It's not totally opaque, so I will most likely wear a slip under it, along with nude underwear. But that's no problem!

review_summary: Able to be refitted a few times
review_text: I bought this as court house dress to get married in. I was going to assume my size was 1x, I'm 5'8 size 16 190lbs...38dd... they were sold out. My friend suggested going to a 2x said she could fit it for me. The dress was only huge at the top which was okay cause normally the girls are to big and cause issues, for once they were to small. My friend was able to fit it just right... then I got the flu a week before and dropped 10lbs... so she had to fit it again and had to take a ton off... and it still looked beautiful and fitted after she was done. She did take some fabric out of the strap from the front it was a little thick but the back was fine. She also dyed the bottom top layer multiple times, she she paint it rather that dip to keep it controlled.

This dress fits perfect! It was perfect length for me, but I'm 6ft tall. It was gorgeous and well constructed. It wasn't flimsy or cheap. There was a little bit of a gap on the sleeves, but I'm small busted. This dress was so flattering and comfortable.If you'll be in direct bright sunlight, you may need to wear a slip underneath the skirt part. Dress isn't hot and very comfortable to move around in.

review_summary: Beautiful Lace for my Rustic Wedding
review_text: I bought this in Ivory and Pink. The pink was much darker than the picture, but I feel in love with the Ivory anyway. These were the first dresses I tried on in my wedding dress search and I didn't try on another dress! I am 6' tall and have slender arms and legs but a very round middle and big belly and flat butt. The pics here are without a bra, but I will purchase a nude regular strap bra as the lace is such that a nude strap won't show. I tried it on with padded and lined bras and the padding in the dress combined with the padding in the bra was too much. I tried it on with an unlined bra and it gave me just the support I needed.The lace up top is not dainty but it is very pretty. I am having a rustic outdoor wedding so this fits the tone perfectly. The buttons up the back are a sweet touch. It is a little snug but I plan on losing about 510 lbs before the wedding in five months so it will be perfect. I could wear it as is but don't want it to ride up, which happens when my dress is snug.I usually wear a 3X in Target, Lane Bryant and Old Navy styles, sometimes even 2X but all the Modcloth dresses I have purchased in 3X are snug.  4X is loose. I guess I am just a little out of the perfect size for things.

Length was good.  Skirt is thinner than I would like  I feel I would need to wear a slip with it.  Wish the skirt had another layer to it.Very gapy at the arm holes.  A good chunk of my bra can be seen on the sides.Lovely color.  Love the top.
Beautiful heavy lace but very long! It would be too challenging to hem the lace so I had to return it.

review_summary: WOW. When I first got eng
review_text: WOW. When I first got engaged, this dress didn't exist, and none of Modcloth's other dresses felt quite right for my small summer backyard beach wedding. I wanted a simple Aline lace dress without bling or showy details, not too revealing, with an interesting back. Easy, right? Nope. I looked everywhere; bigbox, scary boutiques, other online shops. I even ordered a custom dress from Etsy for 2x the cost, which I still had to alter (and it ended up butchered). With 3 weeks left, I was panicking. Luckily I checked here again and even with no reviews, I ordered this. When I finally opened the box my heart skipped a beat. It is SO gorgeous in person. The texture/quality of the fabric and detail are so richlooking, yet understated. I am between sizes XS/S and chose the larger. This was bad because I have a small bust and it was way too big up top. If you are bustier, order your usual. It?s also very long but works with 3.54inch heels for shorties like me. Even with an odd fit, I got goosebumps. Ended up quick exchanging for XS, which was great in the bust, but it needed to be let out 1? at the waist by a talented seamstress to fully zip (no stretch). Dress was perfect (July+FL=HOT). Bottom is seethrough in light, so wear nude underthings (best part  regular bra!) or a long slip. I added a simple satin sash for another dimension. This dress is so much better than anything else I tried on. Everyone was shocked at how beautiful it is and how little I paid. Thank you, Modcloth!
I originally ordered an XL but it was way too big. The L was almost perfect  a bit tight around the top, and the sleeves will need a little tailoring to sit right  but I can't wait to wear it!
This dress is stunning! The zipper is a bit difficult near the waist line because of the ribbon, but once it's zipped, it's perfection. The quality is amazing! Beautiful lace!

I'm 5'8 and the length is just perfect on me. It is rather see through but I'll be wearing a slip or Spanx underneath so it'll be okay. The top lace part on the shoulders does lay a little weird but it's not too bad. I want to say that it runs a little large only because I'm normally an xl/1x in dresses and I ordered the 1x and it fit me even a tad loose at 8 months pregnant! But the xl was too tight in the bust so if need be I'll alter the 1x. It is such a beautiful dress though. You can't beat it for the price!

While I decided to return the dress, it was absolutely fabulous.  The soft lace exuded vintage and as another had mentioned, very couture feeling, and for the price?  Hard to beat.  However, It just did not fit well.  The intricate design of the lace may not be amenable to any major alterations.  If you are 5'5 and taller, with a tad longer torso, this dress if for you.  Me, 5 feet tall and short waisted, it just felt off.  Terrible shame.

I'm getting married October 16, 2016. 5 weeks before the wedding I realized that the seamstress had irrevocably screwed up my mom's wedding dress, which I had planned to wear. *moment of silence* So I started shopping! I ordered this dress, Perennial Poise, and Sophisticated Ceremony. So if you have similar measurements, feel free to check out my photos and reviews of those dresses, also! I LOVED this dress online, and couldn't wait to try it on. I was just between sizes, so I ordered the XS. Perhaps I should have sized up to a S, as I wasn't able to zip it up all the way!! However, my friends and I agreed that the zipper should have closed, but it kept getting stuck at the seam. It would have been tight anyways though. The dress is much darker than the pictures seem to show, it's a lovely cream color. Other than the zipper, I ended up deciding against this gorgeous dress because it was far too long and I felt that the lace would have been difficult to hem, AND even more so, because the sleeves fit oddly on my skinny shoulders and arms. (May not be obvious in the photos) So, it wasn't right for me, but it's a wonderful highquality dress and I wish it could have worked.

review_summary: My fiance and I haven't e
review_text: My fiance and I haven't even set a date yet, but when I saw this dress pop up while browsing Modcloth, I knew it could be the one  and it is! My measurements are between L and XL, so I originally ordered XL (plus, the large had already sold out). It was wellpackaged in a nice box with its own hanger. The XL mostly fit OK but was definitely too large up top. I was going to meet with a seamstress about alterations, but in the meantime the Large came back in stock so I ordered that and it's a perfect fit! Now I have to not gain any weight in the next year, but that's a good motivation :). As others have mentioned, the quality is great and I just love the classic styling. It's very comfortable. It has a side zip so you don't have to unbutton all the back buttons to get into it. The bodice/bust is structured on the inside and slightly padded, kind of like a bathing suit. Wasn't sure how easily this could be altered if necessary, but it's probably doable. If you are inbetween sizes and smaller on the bust, go for the smaller size. And don't despair if the size you want is out of stock  sign up for an alert and keep checking, as it looks like they keep restocking. Customer service has also been GREAT through this whole process. I'm so thrilled to have found a lovely dress within my budget and to have escaped the bridal boutique experience! I also decided to take a credit for the return of the XL so I can splurge on more Modcloth goodies.

This dress is amazing. I'm very short and busty, so it can be very difficult for me to find things that fit right off the rack. This dress, like everything else I own, needed some alterations to fit, like bringing in the shoulders and taking up the hem, but surprisingly little else needed to be done. The woman who does my alterations said that the quality of this dress is one step below couture.  French seams all around, quality lace. She was really surprised at the low price tag. I truly couldn't be happier with my wedding dress.

review_summary: It was a little long but
review_text: It was a little long but I am 5ft 3 in tall so most dresses are long on me. The dress is beautiful!

I really like the simple, feminine, vintage look this provides! The fabric is lovely and not too heavy for warm weather (if you stand with light behind you it can be a bit sheer).  I have broad shoulders and a short shoulder to bust measurement (I always wear adjustable straps on the shortest setting) and because of that the heavy detail on the collar/neckline was a bit much for my build. Overall it's a pretty piece and I would recommend it!

Love this dress! The detailing, the neckline, the length. All of it. I'm sure for some it might be too long but I'm 5'9, so it works out. My only 2 minor complaints are that the chest is roomier than I anticipated, even for my D cups. And it's a bit seethrough. Both problems easily solved with the right bra and spanx! Otherwise  really comfy dress and I can't wait to wear it for my wedding.

Very Downton Abbey. It was really pretty, but the neckline was just too busy for me ultimately, and with more of an hourglass figure it just flattened me out. It was a bit of a bummer. I find with the modcloth label I have to size down. Normally I'm an xl for the bust, but ordered a large based on past experiences and it was the perfect size, just not as flattering as I hoped.
This dress is extremely comfortable, and fits great. I love the color (eggplant) and receive compliments every time I wear it!
Love this dress. My measurements are more often 2x, but the 1x of this dress style fits perfectly.

review_summary: I ordered this dress in p
review_text: I ordered this dress in purple and it's really cute! My upper arms are a bit flabby so I'll get something with long sleeves to put underneath it as was shown by someone else who bought this dress. The skirt part of this dress was a bit more snug than I had thought since I ordered a large, but not so snug that I would send it back. Overall, it's a really nice dress.

I wore this for a formal event at my school, and while it doesn't hit below the knee, the coach collar make it look sophisticated enough to pass by. I love that it has pockets that are big enough to fit my phone, and that the stretch makes me comfortable. I got a size Medium, although it might be better for a large.I haven't tried washing the dress yet (since it says to handwash and I didn't have the facilities to do that for a while), but the buttons do seem precariously on, if you're worried about that.

review_summary: I always wanted one of th
review_text: I always wanted one of these dresses since discovering ModCloth and finally got it on sale. Fits great. Material is nice and thick but can be worn in all weather. The purple is surprisingly bright, which took time getting used to. First time putting in on a couple bottoms fell off. It was an easy fix but a little annoying. Over time the material is pilling a little. One of my favorite parts is the pockets!

I ordered this a couple of months ago and I have a lovehate relationship with it. I love the color, the style and pockets. I think it fits me pretty well. The skirt hits me at the knees, but the waist sits a little high due to my chest size. The hate: the fabric started pilling pretty soon after I started wearing it and the big brasslike buttons at the waist were ripped off the first time I wore it on the crowded subway. I replaced all the buttons with some really cute, colorful ones, and I get lots of compliments on them. Overall, I had been wanting this style of dress for a really long time and though I like the cut my experience with this fabric makes me hesitate to purchase in another color.

review_summary: I gat this as a birthday
review_text: I gat this as a birthday gift a few weeks back and I adore it! I fits almost perfectly and now I'm just waiting for an excuse to actually wear it instead of just trying it on.I'm actually on the short side so it ran a bit longer on me than it probably does for most and I also have a fairly large chest so it can be a little bit difficult to get over my bust but is otherwise a perfect fit.

review_summary: Great in the front, notsogreat in the back
review_text: The dress is super comfortable, I love the pockets and how it looks in the front.  however, the back looked horrible on me.  I am a curvy girl and it made my hips and butt looks much wider than it did in the front.  Also where the band hits me, it made my back bulge out over the dress.  The dress fit everywhere, I even had some room, but just didn't look great in the back.  I'm so disappointed as I have literally been looking at this dress for almost a year.

I've had this dress for about two months and it's very comfortable and looks great on. It's a good length for someone tall like me and the empire waist, which usually looks terrible on me, is a good fit. Be careful of the buttons as they seem a bit thinly attached to the dress. Otherwise I recommend it!

I bought this to wear to my sister's bridal shower.  The fabric is really soft and good quality.  The only little problem was that it had a hole in the pocket when it arrived.  But no one can see the hole and I will get around to sewing it shut at some point.
I have this dress in three different fabrics and I love them all.  They look great with or without a cardigan and run true to size, flirty but not too short for my 5'10 frame.
This dress is fabulous! Comfortable and perfect for every occasion. The fit is true to size and works nicely for my body shape. I would buy this in every color.
Material is nice and it's a lovely shade of purple!

review_summary: Love the color and fit co
review_text: Love the color and fit comfortably.

review_summary: I was really excited to g

The fit was exactly as expected and very flattering (which is especially nice since I'm a larger girl), and I've gotten many compliments on it, ranging from a coworker who commented on how pretty it was (a WEEK after I had actually worn it), to people who I didn't even realize were Modclothusers until they point and say THAT'S IT! IT'S *THAT* DRESS!All that said, my only complaint would be that the thread keeping the buttons on is a bit thin/flimsy and trails a bit off the buttons, enough so that one of the buttons came off while in the wash (though to be fair, I probably shouldn't have thrown my shining star in with the rest of the plebeian laundry). Easy fix if you've got a needle and thread, but a little disappointing for a dress that's otherwise wellmade.All THAT said, it's a freaking awesome piece of clothing. Continue to covet, my Modcloth friends, and lay in wait as I did...

review_summary: This was my first order f
review_text: This was my first order from modcloth and I was very nervous about the fit. I usually wear a small in juniors' sizes and oftentimes don't fit into even an extra small in women's. This dress was so cute (and in an extra small!) that I decided to give it a try anyway. I'm so glad I did, because it fits perfectly. I've gotten a lot of compliments on it in the one day that I've worn it! The material is thick and sturdy, and I know I can wear it with tights and a sweater as it gets colder. The neckline drapes perfectly and the dress clings just right. Plus, it has pockets!

I LOVE THIS DRESS!!!!!! :D The style and cut of it is just perfect for someone my size (large/XL) and height (62 inches). The color goes nicely with my skin tone and hair color. The cut of it takes the emphasis off of my chubby stomach, because the waistline is just under the bust, which is a flattering cut for larger ladies. I plan on wearing this with some patterned leggings and boots, maybe with a white halfsleeve shirt underneath. My only problems with this dress (though they weren't enough to make me return it or bring down the rating) is that it makes my bust look a little bit (which, since I am a 38D can be a bit inconvenient) and the neck flap thing can slide a little bit so it looks awkward. But that's easily fixable. Overall I love this dress and recommend it for anyone! It really works for any type of figure, skin tone, hair coloring and height. I plan on ordering the rouge one as well :D

It feels a little more polyester than cotton, but it's soft to the touch and while wearing it so no complaints. Love that it has pockets. This dress is definitely easy to dress up or down. So many outfit possibilities going on in my head... can't wait to wear them all! Even considering buying it in another color!

The good thing about this kind of dresses is that it provides some stretch, so busty girls can wear their normal sizes instead of sizing up simply because they couldn't zip pass their ribs. This dress will look good on most body shapes. I plan on wearing it with tights and heels or boots. I think everyone should have a dress like this!
