review_summary: This is my second Coach T
review_text: This is my second Coach Tour dress and I'm thrilled with it! The fabric provides a lot of stretch, so I ordered a large and it accommodates my bust very well while cinching in my waist. This dress is perfect for hourglass figures, and I can imagine that it would create the illusion of curves for those not as curvy as me. The color is gorgeous and compliments my brown and blond hair very well. I wear this dress with a longsleeved black tee underneath, black tights, and purple flats. Would highly recommend this dress to anyone!My exact measurements; 423042Size: Large

review_summary: There is a reason all of
review_text: There is a reason all of the girls in the pictures of this dress have their hands in the pockets or at their sides! I was super excited to order the last L in this color. THRILLED when it was shipped super fast. However, upon trying it on I realized the pockets at the side 'poofed' out and made it look like I have an exaggerated pear shape. Don't get me wrong I am still going to rock this dress since it is SO comfortable and unique. I'll probably be a little self conscious of my hips while wearing it tho!

I was really excited when I saw that this was on sale, but the Mediums were all sold out. Then I saw a review from another girl who usually gets Medium, but tried the Large and said it worked out well for her, so I gave it a try too. I am so glad I did! This hits just above my knees and isn't too big anywhere despite being the next size up.

Lovely soft and lightweight material  it's very comfortable to wear even in humid, warm weather and looks very nice. The brass buttons are heavy and may pull on the material a little bit.This dress hits me just beautifully an inch above the knee! Love the colour and draping of the collar  it is VERY cute. This dress loses a star because it is unlined and slighly sheer so you have to make sure you're wearing nude undergarments but otherwise it's a lovely piece!

I absolutely LOVE this dress! I am always apprehensive buying online but I fell in love with this dress and I had to get it! I got the XL because I have a large bust and I'm glad I did it fits perfectly and it falls just above my knees which is also perfect. I bought it as a birthday present for myself and as my first purchase on modcloth I could not be happier! It is so comfortable and its dressy enough to wear to family get togethers and casual enough to wear out anyday. I love this dress!

review_summary: This dress is so cute! I
review_text: This dress is so cute! I was worried when I bought it because my frame is pretty pearshaped and I'm short, so sometimes these dresses are too long or fit my hips awkwardly, but this one is perfect on. It's about kneelength on a 5' frame and the flare around the hips is just right! IT HAS POCKETS, YOU GUYS!

review_summary: One of my first online dr
review_text: One of my first online dress purchases, as I'm hippy with a waist...but I took the plunge!I tried the dress on, and it fit perfect!  I got a large to ensure it fit properly as per prior posters, and it was great!  Another dress my Husband was wowed at when I tried it on for the first time!   It will be a great dress for work or play!Highly recommended ALine type dress for girls with hips and a definable waist.
Gorgeous dress! Incredibly flattering. I wear the Winter print of this all the time! Slightly tight through the chest for me so went with a size larger.

review_summary: What else is there to say
review_text: What else is there to say? All the coach tour dresses rock.

I thought this dress was okay, good quality for the money. The fabric and colour are lovely, the buttons are cheap and plasticky, but the dress was on sale and was very, very cheap. My main disappointment is that it is so short, which I guess I was expecting. Since i'm so short I was hoping it would be longer on me, but alas I'm not sure I can pull it off at my age. It was very inexpensive (although I had to pay duty on it) and I doubt I'll return it, but I'm not sure I'll get much wear out of it.
Great product and beautiful color!

I was so disappointed with this dress. I saw all of the good reviews so I finally gave in and ordered it. It makes my hips look massive.  The combination of the pockets and the pleats just adds way to much fabric to a problem area. Unfortunately I will be sending this back.

review_summary: It just feels so great, n
review_text: It just feels so great, nice fabric, not too thin, could wear on a chilly day ;)

I will be exchanging this for a medium because I have a wide rib cage, but otherwise I am happy with this dress. It is comfortable, can be dressed up or down and with tights or a shirt underneath it can be worn for three out of four seasons. (Summer may be too hot with the fabric.) I am happy with this purchase and the quality.

review_summary: This dress fits like a gl
review_text: This dress fits like a glove.  It doesn't look too small, but it feels a little tighter in the bust than I would normally buy and I'm worried that it might be too small once I wash it.  If I didn't live in Canada, I would have probably made the effort to exchange it for a Large.  I also wish it were an inch longer.  I'm a teacher and wore it with tights and sleeves to school.  I felt decently covered, but thought that due to the length the look might be just a little too youthful for my 31 year old self.

LOVE this dress.  The color is great.  It's a bit short, but completely fine with tights.  It's definitely not so short that it will keep me from wearing it to my conservative office.  The color is great, maybe with more of a red undertone than pictured, but it is definitely violet.  So glad I purchased!

review_summary: This is a lovely colour i
review_text: This is a lovely colour in real life, the pictures don't do it justice, I wore this to my team Christmas lunch and boss lady thought I looked adorable!  One tiny thing  this fabric tends to peel, so try to avoid having your handbags etc rubbing onto it... unfortunately after one wearing I have some quaint pills on my sides where my bag has made contact with the dress.  Mostly fixed it with disposable shaver and tape.  Will not be making the same mistake with this again!

This dress  wow.  It fits so well, not too tight and I love the pockets!  The first day I wore it I got 5 different compliments, coworkers, a random child and strangers out and about.  The quality is amazing and I definitely recommend it.  I ordered a large and it fits really well.  It seems like it would be flattering on all body types as well.  Keep up the good work ModCloth!  Bring more dresses like this one!

This is a fabulous dress! I hemmed and hawed between buying in blue or purple, but picked up the red and purple during the Thanksgiving sale. Fabric is nice and heavy, drapes well but is also breathable. I got one with gold buttons and it looks fantastic. As far as fit goes, I have a weird body and was pleased it worked on me, it emphasizes my large bust but not in a bad way, and since I'm not very hippy the pockets don't make me look larger. I was also pleased to find out that for once with a ModCloth dress, I wasn't stuffing my chest into a size L. I was accidentally sent the red in a S so I had the chance to compare the size range, and if you are trying to decide between a M and L, I easily could have fit my small bottom end and my chest a little less comfortably  into a M. I have two caveats for this dress: one, the cut emphasizes a belly on short/shorter waisted people, so unless you have a rack of doom to balance out your belly like I do, it may not look very flattering. The other note is about the buttons and fabric...one star came off this dress because the buttons are hollow and I can't stand how cheap they sound (the black/silver buttons on other Coach Tour dresses are much nicer) and because the fabric rubbed magenta off all over my white leather phone case when I put it in the pockets, but I don't remember any warnings about dye transfers with this product so beware! Otherwise, fantastic purchase and I can't wait to get my other one in the correct size!

review_summary: I bought this for my birt
review_text: I bought this for my birthday.  I was concerned it might be shortwaisted, but it fit well with that look.  I got numerous compliments, and especially loved the way the buttons go with the violet color.  I am short, and this hit above my knee, which is important to me.  I wore it with mustard tights and black sandals.  The next day, I wore it to work with a long sleeved black shirt underneath.  My high school students loved it, too.

The quality and style of this dress are good, though I could have sized down to a medium. The fit isn't noticeably off, but there is a bit of extra room and the buttons on the waistband sit on the sides, rather than towards the centre, as a result. I went with a large because I was worried about the length (which is perfect, especially with tights).

review_summary: I have to say, after want
review_text: I have to say, after wanting this dress so badly for over a year, finally getting it was a bit of a let down. I know this might be nitpicky, but it would be more accurate to call the color plum rather than violet. It's definitely more of a redpurple than a royal purple, which is what I was expecting. It's a nice dress, but not perfect, and I guess I built it up too much in my year of wanting it.

I've gotten so many compliments on this dress. The color is great. It can be layered with so many difference pieces. Treat it as a jumper and wear a contrasting colored knit underneath... One day, I wore it with mustard. For work I slipped a plain black cardi with nude fishnets and a pair of heels. The dress is very wearable if you're a curvy girl. I love that it has pockets too! Such a great purchase that I was seriously pleased with!

review_summary: I had this in Rouge and s
review_text: I had this in Rouge and so when it came on sale in Violet, I had to snatch it up.  These Coach Tour dresses are the best.  My favourite part of this one is the brasslook buttons.

review_summary: love love love! I had the
review_text: love love love! I had the blue coach dress already and got this one on sale. The color is a gorgeous purple, the buttons are a rich dark offgold color, and the dress fits perfectly! I definitely recommend ordering the size based on your chest sizeI had gotten a small at first but the xs ended up fitting better. The only slightly negative thing is that the dress seems to pill a little too fast for my liking...but still great overall!

A really cute dress!I wanted it for such a long time and I'm glad I bought it. The colour is lovely and the fabric is comfortable. You can style the dress in many different ways, great for work or going out. All in all is it's a great little dress. I'm 5'3 and it hits me just above my knees and falls on my highwaist.To be honest, I think the dress will look better on someone with a smaller chest, but I like it on me anyway. The best part  pockets! Definitely considering ordering its sisters in more colours.

Beautiful, beautiful, beautiful! I'd been eyeing this dress in all its colors for quite some time now, and finally broke down and bought it. Worth every penny. It will seriously flatter any shape or size... I'm an hourglass, and it looks really great on me. A little too great, maybe haha. It's actually a little sexy for work, but I'll manage (maybe I should have gone one size up? It emphasizes my chest a bit. Something to be aware of if you've got something up top!)The color is absolutely gorgeous, AND the material is surprisingly high quality. It has a nice, soft texture, and feels very sturdy  this dress will definitely last for some time. It's true that the buttons are a little cheap and I think they might fall off before too long... buuut I personally think they look nice with the dress and complement it well. It's also a little short, so I wear it with leggings for work (and I'm only 5'4), but it looks great all the same. I'm so thrilled about this purchase  get this dress, you won't regret it! :)

I eagerly awaited the arrival of this dress couldn't wait to try it. It didn't disappoint. The fabric is soft, the colour is lovely and the fit is wonderful. I got a large due to my chest size and it fits perfectly (not overstretched in the slightest). The waist sits exactly where it is supposed to. I would note that it is a short style, so if you are on the taller side, it may be far too short. It sits about 23 inches above my knee and I'm not particularly tall.

review_summary: I felt wonderful when I p
review_text: I felt wonderful when I put this dress on! This is my second purchase from Modcloth and I'm extremely happy. The fabric is soft and a perfect thickness. I'm not much into sleeveless dresses, but based on reviews and pictures from other people, I liked the look of it for winter with a long sleeve underneath. The collar is attractive and didn't feel unnatural at all. The buttons seemed to be attached well. I wore this to a concert a week after I bought it and got compliments from friends and a random stranger. When I told her where it was from, she looked at her husband and stated, Look at this dress! Christmas! Christmas! Christmas! Guess it was a hit! I felt quite stylish in this and can't wait to wear it again!

This was my first purchase on ModCloth and I could not be more happy with it! It definitely hides all my problem areas. The dress is made of a light material so you could probably wear it in the summer too. The pockets do make the dress stick out a little more on the sides, but it's not a big deal. I did think it was a little short on me, so it may not be work appropriate. The material is stretchy, so I don't have to worry about the chest being too tight. The color is very nice, I also bought another one in the color Rouge and I am keeping both. I am so glad I bought this dress, it was a great purchase! Thank you ModCloth!

I absolutely adore this dress!!! My only qualm with it is that the waist hits a little high for me. :/  But that doesn't stop me from loving it!! The waist hits about right under my bust, but is still quite flattering. The fabric is so soft and so comfortable! I can even wear this for a 10hour work day and be perfectly content afterwords! My favorite way to rock this frock with with opaque black tights and suede black wedges!! Perfection! 3

review_summary: I love the Coach Tour Dre
review_text: I love the Coach Tour Dresses so much. This was my 5th one I bought. The purple color is even prettier in person. If you shop on here, you really need to at least own 1 Coach Tour Dress!

This dress makes me happy :) It has pockets, which is GREAT, the colour is different than shown on the mannequin (darker, more purple), and the fabric is nice and stretchy. Totally happy from this purchase!

review_summary: love this dress!! i was a
review_text: love this dress!! i was a little nervous about getting the XS, but i'm so glad i did. it fits nice and snugly, and accentuates what little curves i have :o)! it's a beautifully made dress, and the collar is to die for. super pleased with this!!

I have been stalking Mod Cloth for months and when the Black Friday sales rolled around and this dress became available for half the price I jumped on it. I have never ordered anything from Mod Cloth before and I am always hesitant when I can't try something on first but based on the reviews I thought to give it a try. The dress is more of a maroon/burgundy color than the purple color in the picture, which is okay b/c my school color is maroon. The length is about 45 inches above my knee which will be fine because I plan on wearing it with tights. The waist is a little higher than my natural waist, but that could be because my chest is larger than normal so it pulls it up some. The fabric is even better than I thought it would be and the buttons are very nice. The arm holes are perfect too. I sometimes have a problem with arm holes being too tight b/c of my wide shoulders or so loose you can see your bra through the hole (tacky imo) but these were perfect and allowed for the raising of my arms with ease. LOVE THIS DRESS!!

I had already ordered this dress before in the Tangerine color and LOVED it, so when I saw this on sale on Black Friday I was all over it. This is just an all around perfect dress. You can dress it up or down with no effort at all. I adore this versatile dress. If you had any doubts throw them out the window and add this to your bag! The colors are perfect, the fit is perfect and whats really nice is that if you live up North or somewhere cold, this dress is heavy enough to keep you warm!! Dresses in the winter? YES PLEASE!

The waist falls DIRECTLY under my bust. However, this is still long enough to wear to work with tights!! And something about it makes it SUPER flattering, making my waist look tiny from the front view. The arm holes are perfect and the fabric is like a soft, heavy jersey with a little bit of sheen to it. The color is between red and purple, leaning purple. Definitely going to wear this to work!

This was my first Modcloth purchase.  I just love the cut of the Coach Tour dresses and was so excited when it went on sale.  I was surprised by the brand when I opened it up; it's a familiar label.  The color is pretty and the cowl neckline is actually quite flattering (particularly if you're on the busty side).  The material is thick and quite stretchy.  I think this will make a nice 3 season dress.  I paired it with a sky blue cardigan and some black riding boots.  The buttons do hang a bit loosely, and I've seen this brand at a few discount stores, but for the sale price it was definitely worth it.  I'll wait for some of the others to go on sale too and scoop up another few colors.

review_summary: I got this dress during M
review_text: I got this dress during MC's Black Friday sale, so I got it for a good price. Unfortunately, it arrived to me defective. The domed buttons at the waist were crushed in. The seams around the waist on the inside itched against my skin. Other than those 2 things  the dress fit pretty well and the fabric is a smooth midweight knit. The cowl neck is perfect. The length on my 5'3 frame reaches a respectable inch or so above my knees. This dress has pockets, which I LOVE. I would recommend this dress (when on sale). Be aware of the cheap buttons. MC Customer Service took excellent care of me when I contacted them about the defective buttons. I'm a satisfied customer at the end of the day :)

review_summary: I bought this in black ab
review_text: I bought this in black about a year and a half ago, and I wear it all the time, so naturally, I had to have purple, since it's my favorite color! The waistband is fitted enough to show my hourglass shape, but not tight. The length falls to about the width of my hand above my knee, conservative enough for work, but also transitions nicely for going out. The fabric is a decent weight, so you have the ability to layer a longsleeve tee underneath or a cardigan on top in cool weather, or wear alone in warm weather. The collar lays nicely and stays that way. The pockets are a nice bonus. This dress is the ultimate in comfort, style, and figureflattering versatility.The only thing I am not too crazy about is the buttons. They're hollow, and 2 of them are smooshed already. I might sew on different buttons, but it's not enough for me to deduct a star. I wore this today with a black tee, black tights, and bronzygold flats.

review_summary: Just got this and I LOVE
review_text: Just got this and I LOVE it. I put it on to show my husband and he was like wow! The buttons are a little on the cheap side but that's my only problem (for lack of a better word) with it and its a tiny bit on the short side, but it'll look great with tights, boots, and a little cardigan. I plan to get the winter version the moment I can!

review_summary: I'm so glad I went ahead
review_text: I'm so glad I went ahead and bought this dress (along with two others in different colours) the fit is flattering and the length is perfect. I love how there are pockets and the collar flap with buttons is cute. I bought up a size for extra wiggle room.

I have been lusting after this dress for months!  Finally, it goes on sale on Black Friday and I grabbed it!  It will NOT be a purchase I regret!  The fabric is much thinner than I expected which is a good thing!  I thought it would be thick and stiff but it's not.  The length on the medium is perfect for work!  (I also ordered a small in another color and it is a tad short for teaching...).  It is fitted through the bust and rib cage but not so tight that it stretches awkwardly.  I love the pockets!  The waist hits exactly at my natural waist!  So far it's an awesome dress, we will see how it wears!

review_summary: Let me start off by sayin
review_text: Let me start off by saying  I.LOVE.THIS.DRESS. I will definitely be buying this in more colors down the road!I originally bought this with work in mind, but I think it might be a little too short for work or I'd definitely need a nice pair of leggings to pair it with. I bought this as a reward for losing weight and for motivation to lose more (so I'll fit into it). Obviously right now it's not a perfect fit, but I included pictures for reference in case it helps. I love the style and cut of this dress  it's not revealing, but I still feel like it hugs and hangs in all the right places. The material is soft, yet feels sturdy and the stitching seems to be well done. The buttons are super cute and make the dress. I didn't realize their were pockets, but their not too bunched up, and I think they'll lay better as I fit into it better. The length is about midtoupper thighs on me...(I'm 5'6 and I have a long torso, short legs  if i bent over, I'd be flashing people). If you're looking to accentuate your top half and minimize your bottom half, this is a GREAT dress for that. The color is more Merlot wine/purple to me than the brighter purple than the product photos, but it's lovely and luxurious. I can't wait until I lose the weight so I can wear this ALL the time  I feel like it'll be a goto dress for me.

review_summary: Oh, this dress! I could n
review_text: Oh, this dress! I could not be happier. Bought it at the black Friday sale and I just love it. The color is very vibrant  it's almost more of a rich plum color than a true purple, but it is gorgeous. I love the pockets and it fits me like a glove. The buttons are good quality, and the material is as well. The only weird thing about it is where the waist sits  at some side angles it seems like it bulges out a little bit but it is absolutely not a big deal. It's probably just because I'm so short. I wore this with mustard tights and a mustard hat, gray boots, and a gray cardi, and there are many more looks to be created with such a versatile dress. Thanks Modcloth!
Been coveting this dress for a while now and so glad I finally bought it! Classy, a gorgeous color, and the most comfortable dress I own!

review_summary: I ordered the XS and it's
review_text: I ordered the XS and it's a little loose from the waist down, but otherwise I really like the way the dress fits. Lengthwise, it stops just above my knee, which I'm fond of. The material is very comfortable and warm enough to wear under a coat for fall with some leggings. Overall, I'm very happy with this dress.

review_summary: This was my first dress f
review_text: This was my first dress from ModCloth, and I love it! The fit was perfect. The long was good, not to short, not to long. I would say that the fit at the upper waist is almost tight. So, if I gain weight, the dress would not fit. The fabric is thick and smooth, perfect for winter. I feel very comfortable using it. The color is wonderful, I though to buy the black dress, but the violet serves the same purpose since it is dark as the picture shows. Finally, I love the pockets!!!

review_summary: I asked for a dress from
review_text: I asked for a dress from my wishlist for my 22nd, and was so happy to unwrap this dress! It fits perfectly, flatters my figure, and is great dressed up or down. I don't even want to take it off sometimes!
i love this dress ... its so cute.. and its fit perfect !!!! no regrets at all

I really like this dress. The color isn't exactly what I expected but that's part of the deal with online purchases. My only real issue is a silly one  the buttons on the collar sometimes knock into each other when I move and make this annoying clinking noise. It's not very loud and probably wouldn't bother most people, but it's just an odd thing.

review_summary: All in all, I agree with
review_text: All in all, I agree with everyone else, a cute dress in a good color.  My only issue with the dress is that the gathering below the waistline in the back hits me in the middle of the small of my back instead of the bottom.  I have a slightly long torso, but this is still unusually high up, and looks a bit unusual.  This is still one of my favorite purchases however, and I am keeping it.

My first coach tour dress was black, I loved it so much I got this one. Might get the teal next. They are so comfortable and versatile.  I've worn this dress out for cocktails, to the movies, and for a lazy movie day. A staple to any wardrobe with a pair of hose/leggings and some cute boots!

Customer reviews indicate this dress flatters multiple body types and that is so true! I am a size 14 on top and size 16 on the bottom so have the usual problems with dresses either fitting well on the top or the bottom, but rarely both. This dress however manages to hug my bust without the ghastly stretching across the bottom. Highly recommend for women with pearshaped figures and generous hips. I have ordered the XL in red and am eagerly waiting for the houndstooth to be restocked as well.

I absolutely love this dress. I love the fit, color, length, and style. I purchased the XL because I am chesty and I wanted to make sure it wasn't too short. The only problem or rather concern I have is the stitching is a little flimsy.

Love it!  Flattering, chic, great fit.  The only problem I have is that it's a little shorter than I would like but at 510 this is a common problem for me.  Looks great for the office or with tights and boots out on the town. Great value for money!

review_summary: This is going to be a new
review_text: This is going to be a new favorite of mine! Comfy and fits my body! Grade A

review_summary: love this dress as i have
review_text: love this dress as i have it in a few other colours. the violet is especially nice and have received many compliments at work after wearing it for the first time. love the pockets and buttons. length is perfect falling just at my knees.perfect with or without tights.

After reading all the reviews, it sure seemed like this dress ran a little small.  I looked at measurements and saw girls that I thought would be mediums were buying larges and thought they fit perfectly.  Unfortunately my assumptions were wrong.  This dress still fits enough to keep, but it would fit perfectly if I had purchased a small.  For reference, I'm 5'7, 135 lbs.  Otherwise, I love the buttons, the cowl neck, and have gotten many compliments on it!

review_summary: Nice fit. The small was v
review_text: Nice fit. The small was very tight so had to exchange for a medium. The material feels really nice and hugs your body in a nice way!
This dress is perfect! Perfect for work and cute for going out! I love it!

review_summary: Need I review? This is a
review_text: Need I review? This is a closet must have! Every one seems to agree. I will probably own all the colors in time.
My first modcloth experience. I COMPLETELY LOVED IT. Perfect color. The collar is wonderful. I suggest it times ten.

review_summary: I love this dress. It is
review_text: I love this dress. It is beautiful and it fit perfect. I will be wearing this dress for quite a long time and I've had many compliments on it! already I paired it with a pair of black leggings and boots and it looked great! I'm thinking about buying the same dress in spearmint.

review_summary: I love this dress! The co
review_text: I love this dress! The color is lovely, it's really lowmaintenance, the pockets aren't bulky at all and can hold things without looking weird, and it's very unique. It's long enough for school and work (just above the knees) but short and fun enough for going out to dinner. Definitely too warm to wear in the summer, but great for fall, winter (with leggings, boots and a shirt underneath) and spring. Looks great with the Turn Back Time pocketwatch I got at  the same time.

This dress fit me perfectly! I am pretty small, so the small might not work for anyone taller or bustier than I am. But for me, it was great! There was no extra fabric in the chest as is usual when I purchase things like this. The color is a bit more vibrant in person, but it's not a downside at all. I found it to be a well made dress, the material is heavy enough to wear in colder weather (with leggings and a jacket of course!).Overall, a great classy dress that I could dress up or down pretty easily.
this dress is darling very flattering on top, which is hard because I'm a busty girl. looks nice with boots.
This dress ended up being waaaay shorter than I thought it would be.  I'm still going to wear it because it's cute but tall girls be warned.

I have previously bought this dress in the dark red, in a size small.  I have always been a bit conscious of how short it is (that waist wants to sit like an empire line rather than truewaist).  The large gives me a tad more length but is a little loose around my torso now  I still love the design though and the purple colour is great :)

review_summary: I really love the color o
review_text: I really love the color of this dress.  The material is very soft and comfortable.  I love the collar.  I also have the coach tour top in navy.  I plan on using this dress for Fall and Winter with a black shirt underneath and black tights.  The waistline is a tad too high but I can make it work.

review_summary: This was my 1st dress I h
review_text: This was my 1st dress I have purchased from ModCloth and I am very happy to say that I will be buying more in the future!  Your clothes are FABULOUS!  And a special thank you to the ModStylists for giving me some great tips on how to wear the dress.  You ladies are amazing!

Overall I'm really happy with this.  It's a bit short, and runs a smidge larger than expected, and the fabric is a LITTLE on the cheap side (kind of like...athletic wear??).  And yet  it's pretty flattering and cute!  And who doesn't love a dress with pockets?

review_summary: The fit is great! Very co
review_text: The fit is great! Very complimentative and the cut makes my legs look great. The only flaw is it has gotten a little warn and fuzzy after a few washes. Other than that it is perfect!

review_summary: Arm holes are a little ti
review_text: Arm holes are a little tight
Always wanted the dress, and finally bought it :)

review_summary: I love this dress! I have
review_text: I love this dress! I have it in houndstooth, and now in purple. It's so cute, classic, and gets me lots of compliments. I think the only reason I didn't give it a 5 is the material COULD be better. I wish it was a cotton or jersey material instead of what it is, as it's not super soft. However, I will overlook that because it is pretty affordable and looks great on me!

review_summary: This dress is a very pret
review_text: This dress is a very pretty color and the fabric is nice and soft.  It actually turned out to be more of a warm purple color. I guess it could be considered more of a magenta.  It is definitely not violet.I do wish that it could be a bit longer and a little more fitted in the waist area.  I would have ordered an XS but definitely cannot afford for it to be any shorter.  I had hoped to be able to wear this one to work, but I'm not sure that it would be appropriate, maybe with opaque tights.Due to the fact that I have a few other winter dresses in this same color, I will be exchanging it for the same dress in red.

Love this dress! First purchase from ModCloth  I went with the measurements provided for the dress, which sized me at a large, and it fits perfectly. I like that the fabric is substantial but flexible and that it hits perfect at my waist. Really lovely, rich color.

review_summary: So sad. Loved the idea of
review_text: So sad. Loved the idea of this dress but I guess I'm too big for an XL. I normally wear a 12 (sometimes 14) in womens but this was extremely tight fitting, super high waisted, and mini short. This was to be my first purchase for myself since I've gotten dresses here for my 14 year old daughter. So sad, I guess I'm a plus size for this website. :(

I probably could have gotten this in XS, but I really needed the length. The small fits pretty well with a little room in the bust. I really like the rich color of the fabric and it's weight. It's like a heavy jersey. The only thing I'm not crazy about is the way the pockets make the dress kind of stand straight out from my hips rather than allowing the dress to drape from the waist. Either way, I'm happy with the dress and I can't wait to wear it. I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.

review_summary: Cute dress! It is a littl
review_text: Cute dress! It is a little more plum than I saw on my monitor, but it's very pretty. (I matched it to a Pantone 511 C, for you graphic design nerds out there :)The brass buttons are a cute touch, and the dress held up well during its first wash (by machine, cool dry). I did turn it inside out so the buttons wouldn't snag so much, and that worked well.The only negative so far: the first time I wore this dress, I wore it out to a dance club and had my purse on my shoulder the entire night. It's already starting to pill on the hip where my purse was rubbing. But I guess that's my own fault!

review_summary: I've been a fan of Mod Cl
review_text: I've been a fan of Mod Cloth for years and have always wanted the Coach Tour dress, but never purchased it. I finally decided to buy it in purple using a bunch of referral credits I'd racked up and I couldn't be happier!!! This is the perfect dress for every occasion. It's long enough to dress up and wear to work and it's casual enough to pair with tights and boots for a casual night out. The color is absolutely gorgeous and the fabric is really a great quality. It's comfortable, beautiful, versatile and has pockets!! What more could you want in a dress?

review_summary: I loved the rich colour a
review_text: I loved the rich colour and the buttons on this dress. The fabric is super soft and provides a nice amount of stretch. Downsides: if you are a bit taller, it runs short (not too short, but gave me second thoughts about wearing to the office). I think you'd definitely need to pair with tights. Also, the pockets give a LOT of volume to the hips (maybe because this is already my widest spot so it drew extra attention there for me). I pulled the pockets out and it helped a lot, so I may have them sewn shut, but I bought it partly for that feature, so if it's important to you, keep this in mind. Overall, cute dress, I'm pleased with it. I would size up if you want a bit of a looser fit which I think might be quite flattering.

review_summary: I bought this dress for a
review_text: I bought this dress for a couple wedding I'm going to this fall and I just love it! It fits well, looks great,  and is super comfortable. I may have to buy one in another color.

review_summary: I like this dress so much
review_text: I like this dress so much I will probably buy it in another color. It's comfortable but looks sharp. The color is slightly more of a reddish purple than I expected, but I still like the color. I find myself drawn to it so much I have to plan in advance when I'm going to wear it so I don't show up at work wearing the same outfit twice in a week! I'm not wild about the hip pockets, as they tend to flip backwards under the dress and add a little volume at the hip, but it's easy to fix and doesn't bother me enough to affect my rating. Overall I'm very pleased with this dress.

review_summary: I wasn't sure what I thou
review_text: I wasn't sure what I thought of this dress when I first wore it but it grew on me. It is a beautiful color and fits well. If you have extremely wide hips it may not be the dress for you but it is very cute. Perfect for lots of occasions!

review_summary: I wasn't sure what I thou
review_text: I wasn't sure what I thought of this dress when I first wore it but it grew on me. It is a beautiful color and fits well. If you have extremely wide hips it may not be the dress for you but it is very cute. Perfect for lots of occasions!

Really cute dress, flattering waist band and love the pockets!  Not the best quality material but worth the price, I wore it to the office.My first ModCloth purchase, wasn't sure what to expect in sizing, but ordered a M (usually wear a S at stores)

This dress is fantastic  it fits fabulously, is supercomfortable, and got me so many compliments the first day I wore it. Everyone just loved it on me  and so did I! It fits my shape nicely, accenting my curves without clinging unflatteringly anywhere. I was worried it might be a bit short, but it hits just above the knees  flirty without looking trashy. My only concern is that, after wearing it just one day, the fabric already seems to be pilling a bit. Anyone have suggestions for dealing with this?

This dress doesn't really need any more glowing reviews, but I couldn't resist.  My goodness, where to start?  The purple color is wonderful, and truetocolor to my computer screen.  It feels very durable, and the seams seem sturdy.  I was a little worried about the quality, since I have had some trouble with other Modcloth dresses feeling rather cheaply made, but this dress is wonderful.  I wore it with the Now and Ladder Tights and a pair of ankle booties, and got so many compliments!  The length is a little shorter than I normally wear, but not short enough to make me nervous about wearing it to church.  For reference, I have a long torso and shortish legs, and it hits me about two inches above the knee.  I'd consider it a modest length and appropriate for most outings.
Love this dress!  Beautiful color, very soft, wonderfully flattering.

review_summary: I love the overall look o
review_text: I love the overall look of this dress.  the button details on the collar and waist make the dress look expensive.  However, the fabric was much thinner than I expected and length is too short.  THe skirt part also flares out too much for me.  I will have to return this dress.

The material is warm without being too heavy, and the skirt of the dress has a fun flair to it. You can't even tell the dress has pockets when you look at it, and the pockets are huge! And it does run true to size. It's definitely a complimentmagnet.

review_summary: Being in Canada, I am alw
review_text: Being in Canada, I am always very careful about what I order from Mod Cloth given I can't return things and have to pay taxes and duty. I decided to order this dress based on great reviews and the NEWHUE coupon code that was on for a few days that basically allowed me to offset what I would pay in duty. I originally ordered it in bleu, but it was oversold, so my order was refunded. Eventhough the coupon code had expired by the time the order was cancelled, the modstylist I chatted with was super helpful and let me order it in a different colour with the discount. I just noticed bleu is back in stock, so am a little disappointed in that, but c'est la vie. The dress is great for work. I am a middleschool teacher and have received many compliments on it. I do wear it with opaque tights just to ensure it's totally appropriate for work. The fabric is soft and great. It's stretchy, but not cheap looking. My only slight concern is that it's one of those dresses that is the same length all around, meaning that if you have an actual butt (like I do), it is a little bit shorter in the back than the front. No bending over even slightly, crouching down only. However, when standing straight, it is 23 longer than where my finger tips reach on my thighs. I am very happy I went with the small. The medium would have been way too big. For Canadian girls, I would compare the coach tour dress in size small to a small from Smart Set. Hope that helps anyone ordering over the border! :)

Love this dress! Nice thick material but stretchy enough, looks great with tights or without.  It's not too short  for work maybe a teeny bit too short but I paired it with flats and a cardigan and my coworkers loved it. I need to get more of these in different colors!
I absolutely love everything about this dress.

This dress is fantastic. The fabric weight is perfect, not too heavy to wear in the summer, but not too light to wear in the winter. And it has pockets.The cons. I may get the skirt hemmed as the L hits just below my knee, so it's long on us short girls. Also, and this may just be the particular dress I got, but the pleating seems much more articulated in person. The skirt looks really full.Overall, I love this dress and plan on getting it in at least one other color.

review_summary: I'd been eyeing this in n
review_text: I'd been eyeing this in navy for ages, and it just sold out when I was going to make my purchase. Purple was my back up, but I'm really really glad I got it. I love purple but find plummy purples don't usually suit me well, but this is actually a bit of a reddy purple, which works much better for my palepalepale yellow skin tone.I ummed and arred over whether to get L or XL, and decided on XL. The smaller probably would have fit, but I'm busty so high waists tend to be ridiculous if my boobs hike the waistline up too much. The XL gives me more boobroom, so if you have similar issues go for it. It's fairly freeflowing from the waist down so L or XL doesn't make a huge difference there. Highly recommend this dress.

Loved this dress! The fabric is a little thicker (read: warmer for the fall/winter) so it smoothes curves well. The waist was at the perfect height for me, it even tucked in just slightly to make it look like I had a smaller waist but hid my lower tummy. I can't wait to get this dress in more colors!

review_summary: It's a little short but o
review_text: It's a little short but otherwise very cute.

review_summary: I love this dress. It's w
review_text: I love this dress. It's warm enough for a fall day with a sweater, and sleeveless for summer months. The ascot portion isn't sewed down, so it does flap around if I don't settle it properly after taking off a scarf or coming in from outside. The fabric repels some water I spilled on it too, very easy to brush off, didn't sink in like it would for cotton. I highly recommend this dress, instant classic.

Had to return this dress as it emphasized my already curvy hips making them look even curvier. The pockets stick out weirdly and give me a very strange shape. The high waist didn't help either it sat about 22.5 above my natural waist, but not high enough to be a true empire waist... another reason why the fit was weird. I hope this helps a gal with a similar shape as mine to decide whether to get this dress or not.

For my first purchase from Modcloth this was perfect! The colour is a little more magenta than pure purple like in the pics but till a lovely colour.  It fits perfectly. A great length and the style is exactly how i imagined it would be on me. Only little thing was that the back of the collar had three sets of stitches as if they had originally put the buttons on the wrong side of the collar. I am going to try and carefully unpick them I guess!

review_summary: One of two dresses that m
review_text: One of two dresses that make up my first ever ModCloth purchase... And I'm in love. It fits perfectly. I normally am quite hesitant to buy dresses online because I am really hard to fit. But thanks to all the helpful and descriptive reviews, I took a chance. And glad I did!

This dress is super cute and I receive lots of compliments on it.  I'm satisfied with the initial quality, but the fabric is starting to pill and I've washed it probably a half dozen times over the 9 months I've owned it.  I have two cats, so I lint brush it a lot, which could contribute to the pilling.Other than that, I wish the collar were a little lower, I feel a bit constricted around the throat.  This also keeps it too warm for hot summer days, a bit of a contradiction to a sleeveless dress.  Great design, just a little out of sorts with its purpose.

review_summary: The color on this dress i
review_text: The color on this dress is amazing.  I love all the coach tour dresses but this one is my favorite.  Fun and flouncy!
This is really cute dress and I LOVE that it has pockets. Runs true to size.

Such a gorgeous shade of plum!! The Aline hugs my curves just right~ it's incredibly flattering, and I love the flare of the collar. A unique find that you feel comfortable wearing for all kinds of FUN!

This dress was perfect! I received it in less than a week and when I tried it on it was gorgeous. I wore it to church today and received so many compliments :D A great start for a 1st purchase at ModCloth!

review_summary: Just got this dress in th
review_text: Just got this dress in the mail today, and I love it! It's the perfect color for Fall and the fabric is thick enough to keep me warm (maybe some leggings for my chilly legs though!). I like how different this dress is from what I would normally wear (it has pockets!). Also, the neckline is neat which was what made this dress stand out to me in the first place. =) The waist line sits perfectly on my waist and really draws attention to it (which is a positive in my opinion). If you have an hourglass shaped waist, this dress will look great on you! =) Thank you so much, ModCoth!
I get so many compliments on this dress. The fabric has a tendency to snag but not enough of an issue for me not to love it to bits. Very comfortable to wear.

review_summary: Just got this in the mail
review_text: Just got this in the mail today, and I love it!  It fits me perfectly, this is seriously the best fitting dress I own, and I have quite a few dresses.  I love the material this is made of, it looks very nice and classy but it feels just as comfy as a wellworn tshirt!  If anything, I would have to say the only downfall for me is the buttons.   They are plastic and don't seem to be sewn on super well, but I'll probably just buy some nice brass ones and just resew them all if they start to fall off, it isn't a big deal, especially not for the price and the quality of the rest of the dress.

VERY nice dress, very flattering cut. Fabric is flowing well and seem sturdy and thick enough for the cold season. The medium was fine for me but the Small could have been a better choice. because of the space in the breast area. It kind of wrinkle in my case. The color ir more rasberryish than the purple I saw on my computer screen but looks awsome ! Get the dress before you buy any jewelery to match the color !

review_summary: I bought this dress for m
review_text: I bought this dress for my birthday and love it! I was a bit worried it would make my hips look big since I have a curvy figure, but it is really flattering. I got the dress in a medium and the fit was perfect, the length of the dress hit me just above the knee, I'm 5' 2 1/2. I'm so glad I bought this dress, it's my new favorite to dress up or down.

This dress is so adorable! It fits me perfectly, is completely comfortable and can be layered with a long sleeve T for extra warmth. I have been wearing it like crazy and enjoying every minute of it.The dress does flare slightly more than I expected at the hips (due to the pockets), which might be bothersome for someone who is self conscious about their hips. It does not bother me though.
Favorite dress in my closet. Everything about it is perfect. And, I adore the color.

This dress is very flattering. Totally hides my poochy tummy.  It's professional looking for the office, although on the short side if you work in a conservative environment.  The fabric is pilling a little after several washings. However it looks great and for the price, I would definitely order it in more colors.
I love this dress! Great quality and perfect fit!
This was my first ModCloth purchase, and I am in love. The fit is perfect, and the weight means I can use it into the MA fall! I'm so glad I bought this dress!

review_summary: I was so excited for this
review_text: I was so excited for this dress when I ordered it. Everyone seemed to rave about the fit and style, and when I saw the purple, I knew I had to give it a go.The quality is nice, thick enough I can wear during fall/winter and be fine. I will admit that I wasn't as thrilled with the fit as I thought I would be, but I think that's more about me not feeling confident in the shoulder/arm region. I do LOVE that it has pockets though...I can be on the fence, and if a dress has pockets...I'm sold! Although the color is a pretty close match to the picture, it didn't give me the wow, that's awesome moment in person. Overall, I do like the dress, just not in LOVE as I am with some other ones I've purchased from ModCloth. Think I'll give it another shot in a different color in the future though :)

review_summary: I really love the style a
review_text: I really love the style and color of this dress. The things I'm not so pleased about are that the buttons on the ascot collar, while cute, are really low quality. I'm afraid they'll fall off easily. The other thing I'm not crazy about is the fabric itself. It's pretty polyestery feeling, and I was hoping for something a little softer and breathable. Those things said though, I'm pleased with the dress, especially given the price.

review_summary: Wow!! my first dress I bo
review_text: Wow!! my first dress I bought online since losing 20 kilos (now at 57 kilos)!! Perfect around the waist and under my bust line!! Length was just before my knees
LOVE THIS DRESS!!!So perfect and exactly what i was expectingI love the colour and unique neckline and it will be so versatile, so cute with tights and boots or flatsLove, love, love!

This dress is almost perfect. I have a loooong torso, so the waistline of the dress is higher than it should be. Thankfully, the fabric provides stretch so it makes it perfect.The color is more a plum than violet. It is more red than in the picture, and it is better! My complains would be for the length. I knew that it would be short. It is really short. Tights cannot be seethrough. It is still work appropriate.Also, the buttons are not great quality. I soaked the dress in a vinegarwater mix (as I usually do) to fix the color and the buttons turned bad... They are now uglyweird leopard patterned. I will replace them.Besides all this, I really LOVE the dress and I am thinking about buying other colors.

Everything everyone has said about this dress is true.It's amazing, you should buy it and then all of the other Coach Tour dresses. The material is nice and sturdy, but still very comfortable and soft. It definitely is a bit warm for this early in the fall, but I was so excited to wear it that I suffered through it. It sits really nicely, is very figure flattering, the pockets are awesome. Also, this color is simply beautiful. A very pretty deep purple with a kind of magenta undertone.

This dress bunches very oddly right above my butt. I'm probably pushing it with an XL for my size, and I've got enough going on back there that I don't need extra bunching fabric. Also, the buttons on the belt part need to be closer towards the center of the dress, the visual proportion on the XL just seems off. This one is going back.

review_summary: I love the way this dress
review_text: I love the way this dress fits! I have an older version of this dress in Olive, with front pockets, that I also love. I like the design of the pockets of this one better. This dress is so flattering and so comfortable I can look really nice while feeling like I'm wearing sweatpants!One thing the purple of the dress is a little more reddish in tone than the bluish purple tone that shows up on my computer screen. I don't know if it's my screen or what. Still a great color though.

review_summary: This dress is soo cute. T
review_text: This dress is soo cute. The color is more of a plum than the picture showed, but I actually like it better. Also, like other reviewers have said, the buttons are a little cheap compared to the rest of the dress. Lengthwise, it hits just above my knee (dress code!). I absolutely love it!
Love this dress.  Seems to flatter every figure too. Unbelievably comfortable!

I had high expectations for this dress  after reading the many reviews, I was pretty confident I would love it. And I do! Its such an unusually beautiful colour, and the length is just right. I normally find that the dresses I get from Modcloth are just that little bit too short  but this one is perfect for me :) Every time I have worn this dress out, I get many compliments! And also, the buttons are not sewed on very well. one of them fell off after the first (gentle) wash. I don't mind sewing them on too much however. Overall, I LOVE the dress and will be back for more :)

review_summary: I love, love, love this d
review_text: I love, love, love this dress! When I saw all the comments I knew it had to be great and it was!! I usually order a large, but after reading other people's comments and seeing pictures the bottom half seemed pretty loose and I have a small bust so I went for the medium and it fits perfectly. I can't wait to wear it to a conference I'm going to this week. Oh and the material is pretty thick I love that. The color is not as dark as the picture but I still like it.

This is a darling dress! I love the pretty purple color! The brushed metal buttons look fantastic as well. I'm very tall, with long legs, so it looks quite short on me, but so does everything, really. I haven't gotten a chance to actually wear it (beyond just trying it on), though, but I can say that I can't wait for Fall! This will look so good with tights/leggings and boots, but it's so versatile that you could wear it with almost anything! I would definitely recommend this dress; if you get it, you won't regret it. :)

review_summary: Love this dress! Its a bi

Love the material, fit, style and pockets! It looks great, stylish and cute

review_summary: I love this dress. I also
review_text: I love this dress. I also own it in polka dot, black, red, and blue w/ red buttons. It's perfectly fitted on top and flares out nicely (which is helpful since my hips are 10 inches wider than my waist). On me the middle hits slightly above my natural waist, and the length is slightly below my knees. I tend to run between a Small and a Med in dresses, and the Med fit better with all the Coach Tour dresses. I would definitely wear my long hair up so as not to take away from the beautiful neck of the dress. It's soft and moves nicely, too! I can wear this in the autumn and spring as is, and pair it with a cardigan and tights in the winter. I can wear this to work, and to dinner and a Broadway show (I live in NYC). I love dresses I can wear year round and to just about anything. That's getting your money's worth!
This dress is absolutely lovely! The buttons at the side of the dress sit a little bit funny on me but nothing serious. The fabric is a great quality too, very soft.
Great color, and the fabric is nice and thick.  I have more people asking me where I bought this than anything else I own.  Classy without being revealing, and a flattering cut on any body size.

Verry happy with this dress :) I usually order a Medium but I sized up on this one due to a friend's recomendation, the fit is still fine, although a bit roomy  I could have easily gone with the medium. I was worried that the collar would be a bit frumpy, but I didn't need to as the material is perfect and sits wonderfully. So soft and comfortable. I'm reasonably tall so it is a bit shorter than I'd like but with tights there is no problem. Great to dress up or down, a highly recomended buy!

review_summary: I love this dress! The le
review_text: I love this dress! The length is good on me but might be a bit short on taller ladies. The fabric is soft and good quality and the shape is very flattering on my apple body. Great first Modcloth purchase! I'm going to buy this style in a couple of other colours.

review_summary: I love this dress it make
review_text: I love this dress it makes me look 10 lbs lighter and it is my husbands favorit of all!I did move up one size due to cheast size and that was wise to do.

I absolutely adore this dress. It is snug in the bust, but not uncomfortable. The skirt really flairs out at the hips, which I think is just the style, but it does tend to make your hips look a bit wider. Overall, the dress is beautiful, in color, shape, and style.

review_summary: Great dress! I have a fai
review_text: Great dress! I have a fairly slender, slightly pear shaped build, but I think this dress will do well on most body types. The material is form fitting but thick, so it doesn't cling to unflattering parts of the body. Easy to dress up or dress down and the color is beautiful (really close to the picture). If you are tall or have long legs this may run a little on the short side for you.

review_summary: I love this dress. I've g

However, I'm a little less happy with the view from the back, I think I have a little too much butt for it. The ruching in the back is a little off, and it rides up a little strangely on me. Also, beware of panty lines when you wear this one. If I had gone with the large that might have taken care of those problems, but it fits perfectly everywhere else and probably wouldn't have had that nice nipped waist if I'd gotten a larger size, so overall I'm happy with my purchase.

review_summary: i love love LOVE this dre

This dress is beautiful. I'm so glad I bought it. I can't wait for an opportunity to show it off.

review_summary: It's a great dress, and I

This dress is wonderful.  Very comfortable, fits well, and the color is great.  Can be worn as is, or for the colder months, I usually have a long sleeve underneath.  Flattering to the figure.

review_summary: Love the dress.  I will e

Love love love this dress! It's so adorable! I've worn it by itself and with jeans, and it looks super cute with burgundy tights. The fabric is thick and better for cool days. Beautiful color as is in the picture; great strong material  not too think and not too thin; a bit on the short side so I can't wear it to work but it looks great for a casual evening out. This dress is wonderful. It's simple, fun, comfortable and classic all wrapped up in one. The fabric is definitely thick enough for autumn/winter and the color is very rich and true to the picture. The length is just right, about two inches above the knee. I would recommend the M size for anyone with a larger bust because it's a tight fit for me.

review_summary: I love this dress, but it
review_text: I love this dress, but it's slightly shorter than I expected (I'm 5'2, and the M hits 4 above my knee).

Lovely! Got the purple for my younger sister... she measures more at a medium, but she wanted a longer length so we went for a large. It still fits her fine, gives her room to grow into! A dress to love for years :D

review_summary: I also love this dress. L
review_text: I also love this dress. Like another user had said it will be great for winter either with a jacket on top or with a long sleeve underneath. There are so many options with this dress. It is a good length (I have a long torso so this is a challenge for me sometimes). I love the button details and it just fits great. I predict that this one will be paired often with some leggings and slouchy boots once the leaves start getting crunchy.
This dress is adorable! I've gotten so many compliments wearing it. I love the pockets too!   Can't wait to wear it in winter with some cute leggings/boots.

Great summer/fall dress! It has a thicker material than I expected and I love the color. Also, I love that it has pockets!

pretty comfortableI have this in the blue, green and this violet and they are eacha  little different. I originally used the size chart and it had me in the medium (maybe even large range) so I got the medium. It was very comfortable but quite loose and looked big. I think I might get it tailored.So when I reordered, I got a small and it fit sooo much better and looked better. Only the neck hole seems snug. I got something on it and rubbed it off with a white towel which quickly became mulberry. I wore a little shrug with it but after wearing it for a few hours (not sweaty or anything either) the shrug turned mulberry from having touched the dress. So be careful around it until you see how it behaves.I really wish there were a longer version of this dress available w/lower waist 2. review_summary: I got this dress for my b
review_text: I got this dress for my birthday, and I'm really glad I put it on my wishlist because it's a really comfortable, well made dress. It's also a dress that fits with no altering! (OMG! That's rare!) The cut is very flattering, especially the neckline. It came with no frayed ends or ends coming undone or other defects. The fabric is medium weight and provides stretch. The buttons are hollow plastic made to resemble bronze metal, which is a tiny bit of a bummer as I thought they would be metal, but they look nice all the same. My favorite parts are definitely the pockets and the color. It's a neutral plum (rather than warmtoned, so people with cool and warm tones can wear this dress), and it's GORGEOUS. The fit is right on. The waist band is the tiniest bit tight, which is from the elastic being so new, but it's not uncomfortable. The hem ends about an inch above my knees. If you buy an XS and are taller than me, know that the hem will be higher than an inch. The armhole area (everyone forgets these) fit well, but because you do have to take this dress of by lifting it over your head, be careful how much you stretch the armhole area or your dress will lose shape over time. I haven't washed the dress yet, so I can't tell you how it washes. It's definitely worth the price. It's a versatile piece and I definitely see myself wearing this many, many times in the future. I would definitely recommend it!
