review_summary: This is a great dress. To
review_text: This is a great dress. To my eyes the shade of purple seemed a little darker in person that it does on the website, but maybe that has to do with lighting. I actually have a dress in the same style in charcoal grey that I got a couple of years ago from another online boutique. I always refer to it as my easy dress, because it's so easy to wear. This one from ModCloth is no different. It's very comfortable and effortless. I love the big gold/brassy looking buttons.
Love this dress. The fabric is nice  durable, and the colour is gorgeous! Fits great, a little short if you like longer dresses.

review_summary: This is a great dress for
review_text: This is a great dress for all seasons. It is not lined, which makes layering in the winter easier and the pockets really come in handy. The length is good for both flats/sandals and high heels or boots. Thank you ModCloth.

I loved this online, but once I got it on it was a different story. The top half of the dress fit me well, but the waist portion was too short for my proportions. As a result, the hip flare started at my natural waist and the dress looked awful on me! The fit made my waist look very short and my hips look much bigger than they are. The only aspect of the dress that looked better in person than online was the color. I think this would be great on someone with the right proportions, but it's not right for me. Back it goes!

review_summary: I love, love, love this d
review_text: I love, love, love this dress!  I've been watching it for months and am so glad that I finally decided to buy it.  The only thing is the color is a tad darker in person than it appears in the picture, still an amazing dress.

review_summary: I already own the red one
review_text: I already own the red one and my sister fell in love with the style, so I ordered it in violet for her birthday! Can't wait to wrap it up and give it to her! She's going to be thrilled! She's a few inches shorter than me but same bra size so I'm sure it will look great on her!

I love this dress.  It's cute and extremely comfortable.  I've only worn it this winter, so I'm not sure how I'll feel about its weight come summer, but, with some cute wool tights and the right jacket, it's adorable.  It hits me right just about everywhere and I like that the pockets make the skirt flare out a bit at the hips. Really, I cannot express how much I really love the dress, I keep making excuses for myself to wear it and probably will continue to do so.

This is my second ModCloth purchase. I LOVE this dress. Its the perfect length. I can wear this dress to work and not worry about it being too short. I can wear this dress to school. I can even wear it to a night out. This dress is worth every penny. I'm debating buying this in red as well. Decisions, decisions :)

Just like other reviewers, I foundand was very happy to findthat the material is fairly heavy and is perfect for a Midwest fall or winter!  The color is very deep and the cut is very flattering for my type, it flares where I need it to but is loose enough to hide the holiday pudge!  Very satisfied with this dress.

review_summary: Perfect fit. Is so nice a
review_text: Perfect fit. Is so nice and cozy and warm. Is flattering, a lil too flattering around the bust if you know what I mean, but as much as I try it can sometimes be just too hard to make them look smaller than they are w/ whatever I wear. So if you want your girls to stand out, this dress is for you.

review_summary: I got this dress in the r
review_text: I got this dress in the rose color as well, and what I really like is that the buttons are different on each dress. Which makes each one unique, other than just the color. I wore this dress to a ballet, and it was perfect for the occasion. It would go well with a casual outing though too. Muah, love it!

I absolutely LOVE this dress!!  I got it as a Christmas present (after a LOT of notsosubtle hinting).  I put it on immediately and fell head over heels in love!  It's so comfortable, also, and the pockets just make it even better!
love it! comfy but professional.  I wore with dark tights...wished it was 2 inches longer....

review_summary: I love it! It fits great,
review_text: I love it! It fits great, and it's so elegant!

review_summary: This dress fits like a dr
review_text: This dress fits like a dream and is so comfortable. I'm pretty short, so it might be a bit too short for taller girls, but this is the absolute perfect work dress!

review_summary: This dress is soft and co
review_text: This dress is soft and comfortable with some stretch and flow.  I love the flattering look and it is easy to dress up or down.  VERY happy with this purchase!

review_summary: seems like i wear a large
review_text: seems like i wear a large on this site (usually a medium) it fit well, it is a little short but it looks great with tights.  the color is fantastic and i love the feel of the fabric.  it would be perfect if the bodice was a little bit longer but i still loved it and it was very comfortable.

Dress fit perfectly! Nice thick quality dress, not too short for work. I paired it with the charter school cardigan in charcoal. Note: the color is more of an eggplant rather than a bright purple. I'm buying this dress in more colors!

review_summary: I am so pleased with this
review_text: I am so pleased with this dress! Worth the wait and the headache of all the extra charges I had to pay customs. It's just so cute. The colour is gorgeous, the fit is perfect, and most importantly (since I'm quite tall) the length is just right! It hits just around my mid thigh.I can't wait to wear it out somewhere.
Really nice fit, quality thick fabric and love the pockets!

Very comfortable, unique, and classy dress.The purple is a great color, very similar to the picture and the fabric is thick and high quality. The dress waistline sits a couple inches above my actual waist, but it still works and looks really cute. The neck is not tight at all (I hate turtle necks and anything tight around my neck)  and the dress falls just a couple inches above my knee, which is my ideal length for dresses. Can't wait to wear this with a bright yellow or black cardigan and some funky stockings and boots! Definitely grab this dress when it comes back in stock!

I really like this dress, its comfortable, it fits great and the color is fantastic! The only problem I have is that the pockets are two totally different sizes, one is twice the size as the other one. It's not like anyone sees it, it's just awkward when I put my hands in the pockets.

Thicker cotton than the streetcar tour dress (and weirdly enough even though the two dresses look SO similar they are made by different companies). Perfect for winter, it looks great with tights, boots and a shrug.

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this dress the moment I saw it  and when I got a gift certificate for Christmas, it was the first thing I thought to get. Everyone says it looks great on me, and it fits so nicely!

I love the vintage inspired details on this dress.  I'm petite, but it fits a bit snug around the bust area.  Even so, the length is perfect when matched w/ a pair of leggings and boots!  I'm loving it in the Fall, and I can see myself wearing it even into Spring!
Adorable!  The pockets are great as well.

Beautiful colour. Surprisingly warm for a sleevless dress. The gathering under the bust hits at the perfect place. A little shorter than I was expecting, so I'll probably always were it with tights, but that's not a problem. Love it!

review_summary: This is my very first Mod
review_text: This is my very first ModCloth dress and I am always very nervous about sizing. I'm a very curvy 5'4 and nothing ever seems to fit right, but this dress fit like it was made just for me! I couldn't be happier and will be wearing it to my company Christmas party later this week! I think this dress would flatter any body type. Totally recommend!
I was hesitant about the high neck with no sleeves, but this is just so cute. The foldover flap on the neck line looks really cute.

review_summary: I debated on this one but
review_text: I debated on this one but ultimately felt it wasn't as flattering as I would have liked; the waistline ended up as more of an empire waist on my figure, just under the bust.

review_summary: I loved this dress from t
review_text: I loved this dress from the moment I saw it online to the second I tried it on!  I'll have to wear leggings with it for work since it's a bit short.  It's a very comfortable fabric.

Definitely my best purchase off ModCloth so far. I'm usually a medium, but since it was out of stock and I really wanted to get my hands on it while the sale was on, I read the reviews and decided to size up since people complained about the short lengthand I am so glad I did! The fit ended up being a little big, but it's not noticeable, and leaves a bit of wiggle room. The length ends up being perfect, falling just above my knees. The material, however, is a bit clingy and might show your bra outline depending on the bra! Other than that, the material is nice, thick and cozy; I wore it on a sunny, windy day and it was both breezy enough so I wasn't sweating and heavy enough so I didn't accidentally flash anyone. The colour is a bit odd, though, depending on the lighting it looks anything between purple and blue, as you can see in my pictures. All in all, it's just a great, versatile dress perfect for every season!
I'm usually concerned about short length dresses/skirts, but this is just below the fingertips if you leave your hands by your side. It's great. First buy from ModCloth. It's a winner. =)

review_summary: I wanted this to be cute
review_text: I wanted this to be cute on me, I really really did, but it just wasn't meant to be.  The dress is adorable, the fabric is a heavier weight, and the buttons are a good quality.  My only actual complaint about the dress itself is the armholes were bit on the small side, and it got uncomfortable rather quickly even just while trying it on.  I'll be sending the dress back, but not because of the arm hole issue.  The problem for me is that I have a longer torso and am, shall we say, gifted in the chest region, and while the waist band appears to sit at the natural waist of the mannequin, it hit me as more of an empire waist.  It just wasn't flattering.  Definitely a cute dress, and I definitely recommend you at least try it.

As my first purchase from Modcloth.com I bought this for hosting our family Thanksgiving this year. I felt like the hostess with the mostess. The fit is flattering on my hour glass figure and I LOVE the pockets.  This will be the first of many future modcloth.com purchases for me!
I always feel very classy when I wear this dress.  The material is thick, but not too thick.  My boyfriend calls it the Jackie O dress.  Love it!

review_summary: Love this! I only wish it
review_text: Love this! I only wish it came in this color, but with silvery buttons. Regardless, it fits very well. I got a medium, and it is just a tad tight across the bust and just underneath, but thankfully not too tight as to be inappropriate for work/school. I love that it's a bit longer in the back! The skirt part flares out more than it looks like in the photo, not sure if it's just me, but anyways, I still like it. And probably, you could worry less about hip measurements since it does flare. Also it has pockets!! You could totally go casual with tights and boots, or dressy with heels! No belt or necklace needed due to the style, but cuffs/bracelets, and earrings would be great.

review_summary: I was so nervous as this
review_text: I was so nervous as this is my first online purchase, but it fits PERFECTLY. I love the buttons and it is well made. The length is really ideal; it hits just above my knee. If I had any complaint, it's that the pockets are positioned in a way that they really flare out from the hip, but it looks more like a flared skirt than a hippy wearer, so it's not a real concern. And I LOVE that it has pockets. I just ordered it in green as well. I  can't wait to start wearing this dress! Re: shipping: I'm in Nova Scotia and it took about two weeks to arrive.

I *love* this dress! I'm tall, so the dress hits me a little on the short side, but nothing scandalous. I've also got a small bust but curvy thighs/behind. So I ordered both a small and medium and found the medium to be more comfortable (the small ended up too short on me; plus it made it seem like my behind should be higher than it really is, which didn't look right at all!). The fabric is comfy and more of a jersey. I've worn the dress for work (with some cute heels and tights) as well as for going out, so it's very versatile! I loved it so much, I snagged it in dark blue, pale pink, and red (for holiday parties!).

review_summary: I was worried about how t
review_text: I was worried about how this dress would fit as a large, but there was no need. Every part is perfect without me feeling like I'm going to pop a seam. It is very flattering in bust and hips. I was unsure about the pockets, but they aren't obvious or anything. The color is great, just like the photo. I love this dress and I'm definitely thinking about getting it in other colors!

This dress fits beautifully! The hips are a loose fit and therefore very comfortable and definitely work appropriate. It hits just above my knees, and the color is exactly as described. I love the flattering detail around the waist. Great purchase!

Love this dress! I ordered it thinking it was a sweater dress, but it's not. And I couldn't be happier with it! The color is gorgeous and the collar is not too tight or too high. My only concern is that the length is 2 or more inches above my knee, but I have a very large inseam, so that is expected. I won't be able to wear this without tights or leggings, but I don't care as this won't be worn in the summer. It's stylish, warm, colorful, and has pockets! A great addition to my closet, and I couldn't be more pleased.

review_summary: I love this dress. I boug
review_text: I love this dress. I bought it in both violet and vert, and they're both lovely. At first, I was worried that the cowl neck would look awkward in person, but  remarkably!  this has not been the case. Also, I was not aware when buying this dress that IT HAS POCKETS! Best dress surprise EVER. My main critique is that it is almost too short to wear to work  you almost definitely need to pair it with tights. Then again, that could be because my legs are about a mile long. Still, all in all, this was a great buy and I am very satisfied with the dress.

Very nice!!! Thicker material, great for fall and winter. Length isn't too short, even for me, with some leggings underneath. The large does seem a tad smaller than I expected, it fits a bit snug, but it's a flattering fit so this is a definite WIN for me!!! I plan to sew the pockets closed and remove them because they add more width to my hips. Love this dress... got so many compliments, and even hit on in my defensive driving class!!! I'm very happy with the speedy order delivery I ordered Thursday morning, and had my box at my door on Friday night! Wow!!! This was my first purchase and most definitely won't be my last!
The color is lovely, and  I've received many compliments........but.......the dress is a tight fit.  I wish I'd ordered the L.
Great, versatile dress. Fits well and is a nice thickness for moderate to cooler weather. Love the rich purple color, too.

review_summary: I LOVED this dress! It re
review_text: I LOVED this dress! It really accentuated my curves without being tight. Plus, the material kept from wrinkling too much after being in a suitcase for two days.  Everyone kept complimenting me on it.  Plus, the purple is a pretty, dark shade that is flattering.

review_summary: I love this dress so much
review_text: I love this dress so much that I bought it in red also.  I got a large due to my chest (36DD)and It fits fabulous.  My only complaint are the pockets hit right at the widest part of my hips and make that area look a little wider but I loved the dress enough that it was worth having the pockets sewn shut.

review_summary: I saw this item and insta
review_text: I saw this item and instantly fell in love. When it arrived, I loved it too. The thing is, I wanted to wear it to work, but feel it was a little too inappropriate to be wearing without sleeves (i'm a tv news reporter). I kept trying to pair it was a cute mod blazer and tights, but it was just a little too short and the collar really doesn't work with a cardigan or blazer (in my opinion).Still love it, but sadly, I am returning it.

This is my first modcloth purchase and I love it!! The material feels high quality and I love that I can wear it without tights underneath. It is a little snug in the bust area but not binding at all. And it has pockets!!!

This is the perfect little dress! And, not going to lie, I own it in three different colours! They are all slightly different, from the fun button accents, placement of the pockets and colour/pattern, I can change my aceessories, tights, cardigan and hairdo and nobody is the wiser (except the friends who I gush to about how much I love the dress).The fit is good but it is a little short so I pair it with leggings. I had some issues with washing, but if you wash cold or by hand and hang to dry it is alright (pattern faded somewhat on the houndstooth). The colour is slightly more redviolet than the online picture shows, but it's still delightful!

review_summary: So comfy and cute! A bit
review_text: So comfy and cute! A bit formfitting, without being snug enough to show everything, at least on my frame. The fabric feels really nice. I got a lot of compliments on this dress the first time I wore it. I paired it with a pair of brown tights and matching brown wedges. I have to say, this shade of purple goes great with red hair!

Truly one of the greatest dresses. Got mine in Noir (black): hugs me right under the bust, creating a perfect shape over and around my hips and falls perfectly right above the knee (Noir is 34.5 in length for M, half inch longer than this purple). The fabric is comfortable with a little stretch but is thick enough to appear more formal than traditional jersey. The Pleats are well placed. Only warning is to try it on carefully; the thick waistband has little stretch, and I got too excited, over stretching it, and head some threads snap (no damage could be found though). LOVE this dress.

review_summary: This one hit me just righ
review_text: This one hit me just right all over (just at the bottom part of my natural waist, and just above the knee). I love how the neck is really a faux cowlneck, since I always fidget with the true cowls; it just falls perfectly when you put it on. I thought the pockets and buttons were all well positioned, and that this was a good weight a little too thick to be a summer or spring dress, so it will definitely be comfortable with thick tights, boots and a cardigan this fall and winter.

I got this dress within 40 hours of ordering it, which I thought was incredible in itself. I absolutely adore it. The material is incredibly comfy and it somehow manages to make me look thin and my bust amazing. The neck is so cute and original. My one complaint, if you can even call it that, is the waist, although I bought the dress knowing full well it would be a little short. I'm a pretty well built and tall girl and the large was perfect; I was so hesitant to buy from ModCloth because I'm normally too big to do dresses well. But I bought some leggings and boots and now I can look adorable for the fall/winter! So excited!

very cute, comfortable and wellmade. medium was just right. the purple is sort of a subdued plum color, so it's bold without being crazy bright. good fit, thick, soft material. the buttons are adorable (though i agree with earlier comments that the waist buttons are too far to the sides). i was most happy this fit well at my waist AND chest (which is rare). hooray!

I'm very short and curvy so I always buy dresses with the correct bust size so I bought a large, and it turned out to be a nice fit! The material is thicker than I thought it was going to be, so there is some stiffness, and the pockets are a major plus.  The color is true to what you see in the picture, a nice deep purple.  On me the dress falls right at my knees, but I'm very short.  Overall great dress, very flattering, such a good buy  and it comes in an olive green color too!

review_summary: I would buy this dress in
review_text: I would buy this dress in other colors if it was just a little bit longer.  It's almost the perfect work dress.  It will be fine with tights but I can't get away with bare legs.

review_summary: This dress is a perfect c
review_text: This dress is a perfect color and the material is very soft.  As a curvy girl, I love Alines and this is definitely more of an Aline skirt.  It's a bit short, but adorable with some black tights or leggings.  I'm working on finding a good cardigan to match it with, because I want to show off the waist detail.  While it's a bit tight around my bust, It's fairly flattering for us ladies with some hips :)
This dress is awesome.

review_summary: I'm in love with the top
review_text: I'm in love with the top half of this dress, I still can't decide if I like the bottom part as much. Maybe it's just me, but the way the pockets hit my hips makes it flare out a bit more than in the picture. Since I'm small it's not really a big deal, but if you have large hips this could easily just make them appear larger. Other than that, the color is perfect as well as the quality and length, so it's a keeper.

This dress is fantastic. Can't wait for the weather in California to get a bit cooler. Plan to wear it with tights and brown leather ankle boots. I think the thickness and stretchiness of the material made it fit a bit more snugly than other dresses I've purchased. Luckily it hugged all the right places on me. The price was just right too. I was able to buy the What a Nice Flight earrings on this site to go along with it and stay within budget. Another exciting purchase! I heart you Modcloth!

review_summary: I love this dress! As soo
review_text: I love this dress! As soon as I tried it on, I wished I had bought every color. It fits very snugly on the top, hits right at the perfect part of the waist, and gently flares out from there. I cannot wait to wear this out to dinner or just to work!

This dress was everything I hoped for. Especially because this is my first ModCloth Purchase! I have wanted to buy other things but I am a little bigger than the L measurements. This fit great! I love the fabric, which is exactly what the photo displayed. The cut of the dress is very nice and the pockets lay nicely. It is defiantly something I can dress up or down. I will be buying many more things in the future!

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this dress. I'm wearing it right now and it's so flattering, coming up high enough under the arms, cinching at the right part on the waist and falling away to hide the belly but not bubble out. I would wear this every day!

review_summary: I loved this dress when I
review_text: I loved this dress when I saw it and really hoped it would work for me.  It just didn't.  The front (especially the top) looks great, but it kind of bunches up oddly in the back, which throws off the hem, making it look longer in the front than it is in the back.  It also somewhat flares out at the bottom, making me look wider than I actually am.  The fabric is great and I love the color, but it just doesn't look great enough on me (4 or 5 stars) for me to keep it.  If you have a bigger rearend and wider hips, the flare of the dress may not suit you.

The skirt is far poufier than the pic shows. And it's much longer on me than on the model. I am 5'4 and it's past midcalf. But it's so pretty I'll have the skirt tailored to remove some pouf and some length and wear it for my wedding!

I ordered this dress along with the Memorable Matrimony mainly to have something else to try on (I was pretty sure the other dress would be The One, and it is). The styling on this dress is supercute  I love the dotted swiss, the sleeves and the decorative skirt. Ultimately the waist was a little too girlishly high for my tastes  but probably adding a ribbon/sash would help with that. The top layer of the skirt was also a little scratchy, but the lining is comfortable so I don't think that would be an issue. I ordered an XL because my sizing was inbetween L and XL. It was a little too big up top  if keeping this I probably would have exchanged for a Large. Overall  cute dress, I just ended up going with something else.

review_summary: I wanted to love this dre
review_text: I wanted to love this dress!  I had been dreaming about it for the past 8 months!  The quality was great, cut okay, and design to die for.  With that being said I felt like a 5 year old that was trying on her first communion dress!  I can usually rock the vintage look but the entire look was off.  Perhaps if I had gotten the ivory not the pink it would have made the difference.  I kept the dress for a while deciding if I wanted to give it a shot, but in the end it was not for me!

review_summary: I wore this for my weddin
review_text: I wore this for my wedding dress and I LOVED it! Perfect fit!

review_summary: I looked and felt beautiful in this dress!
review_text: I bought this dress for my wedding based on the strength of the reviews here, so I am happy to contribute my own!  First things first, there are only a few tiny things that I found 'wrong' with it it was annoying to steam the creases out of the dress (they didn't fall out naturally by letting it hang up for *months* before the wedding) but they came out with time and patience, there were a few imperfections in the lace that I needed to cut carefully with nail scissors (but worth it for the price), and thanks to seeing reviews that warned me ahead of time, the lace at the neckline indeed needed to be taped down with fashion tape.  I then wore a necklace over it just for safety to keep it in place.  That's it.  It was otherwise pretty much perfect. I wore another crinoline underneath for extra poofiness because why not, and added a sash around the waist for the ceremony because I needed somewhere to clip my mic pack as it would be too heavy for the lace, but the blush shade was easy to find something the right colour to match (but I wore a ivory veil and nobody said it didn't look okay to mix whites with pinks/golds). Oh and it was also pouring rain on my wedding day and we did a bunch of our photos outside anyway. It still looked perfect in photos AND dried quickly when we got inside, so if you live someplace rainy, this might be a good choice.

I bought this dress in March for my October wedding.  I was certain I did not want to wear white and I didn't want a long dress. My only concern was not being able to try the dress on before purchasing, but I ordered it anyway and couldn't  be any more happier!! If you are thinking of ordering this dress....do it! I promise you will not be disappointed. If you a busty likke myself you will need a strapless bra. I've read may reviews about the lace being itchy,  but it wasn't a problem for me.
Received my dress today and it's fits perfect!! Can't wait to wear it for my wedding!

I broke my ankle and leg just weeks before my wedding (*sad trombone*). Since the fiberglass cast sticks to fabric like Velcro, I couldn't wear the long sheath dress that I had originally purchased for the wedding. We decided that we should embrace the cast rather than try to hide it so I opted to wear this dress instead. BEST CHOICE! I got so many compliments about the dress and it ended up matching the vintage theme of my wedding much more than the original dress would have. I wear a size 4 normally and the size 4 dress I got fit like a glove. I agree with other reviewers that this dress has no stretch to it so do not attempt to try it on alone as you will likely need help getting out of it. The sleeves didn't seem itchy to me although I was also battling some pain throughout the wedding so maybe I just didn't notice. The lace up near the neckline never flopped or drooped, it stayed perfect throughout the ceremony and reception. The skirt had just the right amount of poof. I wasn't sure how beautiful I would feel as a bride on crutches but this dress made me feel so elegant that the broken leg wasn't even a big deal. I felt feminine, vintage, and beautiful :)

review_summary: I thought I'd love this d
review_text: I thought I'd love this dress because of the cut and lace sleeves but I was incredibly disappointed. It's very cheap and promy. It has a shimmer to the lace that gives off a off brand Barbie look. As mentioned in other reviews, the arms are very wide and you'd definitely need to have them taken in. I have large hips and a small back, I recommend ordering a smaller size than your norm.

I bought this dress for my wedding back in July. It got here in a timely manner and it fit perfectly and true to size. I got sooo many compliments on it and it photographed beautifully! I could not have asked for anything better!

I wore this dress for my surprise wedding 7/7/17. It photographs beautifully and you can easily add a pop of color with a petticoat and converse! Thanks modcloth for allowing me to find the perfect dress and plan my wedding in less than 6 months! ps this dress is super flattering on all bodies! my dress was a size 20 to fit my chest ;)

This was the perfect wedding dress for me. I got so many compliments and everyone raved that it looked so expensive. I didn't need any alterations, although I had to lose some weight as it was a little small. I love this dress!

I received so many compliments on this dress! The bottom snagged a bit, but I attribute that to rustic old picnic tables. The fit was perfect. I could've done some tailoring to the arm lace, but I like the roominess of them. I wear a size 18 pant, XL shirt, and a 40D bra. The top made my chest look way bigger than it actually is, so no padded big bra was needed in this dress! I ordered a size 20 and it fit perfectly! The front kind of puffs so I look slightly pregnant, but I'm not. But that's ok because the poofiness hid the rest of my belly! A great dress!

I absolutely LOVE this dress. I ordered this dress for my bridal shower. Most of my clothes are an 18 but because I am very top heavy I ordered a 20. The 20 was a tad too tight in the bust so I had to exchange it. Customer service was top notch and they sent me the 22 very quickly. I got so many compliments on this dress. I ordered the pink and it was super stunning. Everyone kept saying,  If this is your bridal shower dress we cant wait to see the wedding dress!. I love this so much I decided to wear it again for my engagement photos. Great quality, great structure, overall a great fit!

I wore this dress in the blush color as my wedding dress, and it was stunning! A little bit of static guard along the hem helped, and I bought a coordinating sash and floral headband to round out the look. I got SO MANY compliments, and the dress looks lovely in our photos (if I do say so myself). The 3/4 sleeves were comfortable, not too baggy, not too tight, and not scratchy at all. The length was just past my knees, which was just right for me. I especially loved that the lace on the top was thick enough that I could wear a bra with clear straps, as I hate the fit and feel of strapless bras.The quality of this dress is really outstanding. The lace was thick and beautiful. I did not find it scratchy, nor did I find the dress hot, despite it being an outdoor ceremony in the sun. The whole thing was just perfect, and I couldn't be happier with my purchase. If you want a nontraditional, BEAUTIFUL wedding dress, this one is a pretty great option. :)

It took me a long time to find a dress appropriate for an older bride who has previously been married. Strapless dresses are so overdone, and I wanted my dress to have sleeves anyway. This is the perfect style and length. Our wedding guests provided a lot of positive feedback on the dress.
I Love the dress and it was very classy looking. How ever I felt that it wasn't very flattering to me because I have such a large chest.

review_summary: Cupcake dress, in a not so good way

review_summary: Positives and negatives, but very clearly not the dress for
review_text: This dress has a warm, antique look to it, but unfortunately that just washed me out. The netting has a yellowish tinge, and the lace is a light brown (sort of tea stained). The white lining underneath the netting can be seen, which makes for an interesting effect with the three colors (white, yellow, brown). That said, I think I might prefer a more monochromatic look. I also found the bodice to be too large. I could zip it up with no problem while wearing a bra, but that defeats the purpose of the builtin cups and made me look enormous. However, the shoulders fit perfectly, meaning I couldn't size down. The hem stopped around my ankles, which I didn't end up liking. One thing that was nice was that the lace collar lay flat (unlike the collar for the Exquisite Elegance). Also, the lace was extremely soft, much more so than the Exquisite Elegance.Given how big the bodice was on me, I recommend sizing down if you're on the border between sizes or at least anticipate some alterations. I also recommend adding a small hook and eye closure to the side zipper.

review_text: I loooove this dress. I bought it as a second option for a wedding and ended up wearing it to the rehearsal dinner since I didn't think it was quite formal enough for the wedding. It's not silk or anything, so it can be quite casual. Wearing heels probably would help dress it up, so would some big bracelets. I didn't find that any of my necklaces really worked with the neckline but I also didn't feel I really needed one.This dress is so soft and comfortable that it's like wearing really pretty, sociallyacceptable pajamas. It is very long, so if you're short I would bank on only wearing heels or getting it hemmed. I could stand to get it taken up, but it's not so long that it's a problem. I wear it with sandals but hold it up a lot as I walk and it's probably still going to quickly get dirty at the bottom. The fit is amazing, flattering and tailored without clinging, though it gapes a little at the top where the two sides of the vneck overlap and shows my bra sometimes because of that. I've worn it to the office and on the weekends and to parties and it really works for everything, though it's probably best served hanging out on a yacht while drinking some wine. By which I mean, it is effortlessly beautiful and chic. Can't recommend this enough.

review_summary: I am beyond happy with th
review_text: I am beyond happy with this dress. Perfectly made and completely worth the money. Fabric is heavy, so the flare on this dress falls perfectly. Plum color was beautiful (maybe a bit darker than the photo). Belt was meh and cheapened the dress. But I just replaced it with my nice skinny black belt. The dress even looks good without the belt, depending on how you accessorize. You can wear the dress alone, but I paired it with a creme cardigan and a lavender and green printed pashmina, which made it work appropriate. Fit and flare is not an exaggeration. If you are curvy this will hug everything, but in the best of ways. Top half of the dress is tight all the way down to your natural waist, then flares out. If you don't have an hourglass figure, this dress will give you one. Bought in a size 10 (UK) hoping that it would fit, but it didn't. It was running a little on the small side. This is probably due to my bust, however. The waist was perfect, but it was too glove like for me to feel comfortable, since it showed any imperfection. I am exchanging for the next size up (I'll update with pictures after it fits). Bottom line: This is a stunning dress that you can accessorize to your heart's delight. Work, date, church, vacuuming. You can wear this thing anywhere. The compliments will be rolling in. Just remember, if you have a larger bust, I would suggest sizing up.

review_text: I have about six of these on m wishlist and have been wanting one forever.  When I saw this one on sale, I jumped at it.  I wasn't sure what size to get since I have never bought anything in a UK size.  According to the size chart, I was between a 10 and 12 UK.  I was concerned though about which to pick because I'm smaller on top and didn't want something to be too huge on top to where I would have to have alterations done.  So, I contacted the stylists on here for help.  Now, I was at work so had to chat fast and can't remember who I spoke with (my bad), but the lady I spoke with was great; very helpful.  She suggested a 10UK so I went with it even though I was nervous.  Well, it works!  Now, it's a little snug in the middle, but nothing too terrible.  It just gives me motivation to get my butt back into a workout schedule once the madness of the holidays is over.  It fits great up top, but a 12 would have been way too big.  I read a lot of reviews from the various dresses in this line and I know the belt has been a problem, but for me it fits great.  The material is thicker making a great dress for winter. review_summary: This is the 4th Luck Be a
review_text: This is the 4th Luck Be a Lady dress that I own, and I can't get enough of them! This dress is growing on me. The belt, as others have noted, is junk. However, it's easy to swap in something that fits and is higher quality, and since I own a couple already, I'm not annoyed by the extra cost of replacing this one. The beltloops themselves are nice and thick, but you could remove them if you didn't want to get a different belt. As for the rest of the dress, there are a lot of pros. It's not lined, but the fabric is heavy and flows nicely. The tailoring is decent, although the pleats in the back don't lie exactly as they should (I think the zipper was slightly mislayed). Overall, I'd say my Cue The Compliments dress is far superior in quality (for less $$), but it's hard to wear a bright red dress all the time and this purple Luck Be A Lady adds some nice variation to my wardrobe. It can be styled quite easily  so far I like it with either the Dream of the Crop Cardigan in navy or the Black Tea with Milk Top (please excuse the bedhead in the picture)  and while it is shorter than expected, it's not too short for work if you wear tights (a must for Canadian winters anyway). It's also very comfortable  I wear dresses all the time, and thanks to the elastic, this one is very easy to move in.The 12 fit perfectly, even in the chest (which can be an issue with my small bust). Overall I think I will get a lot of wear out of this from fall through spring (it is too heavy for summer), and I'd buy another in the same style if they offered a pattern I liked.

Also, the skirt does tend to show stuff if you spin around a bit too much (I'm 5'1 and it hit to right above my knee and still showed), so wear spanx or something with it.The dress and how it's pictured:This dress is great but not quite how it's pictured for two reasons. Each button has fallen off with minimal wear (the first few times I wore it), so make sure to give those some reinforcement. One other thing: the interior of the splitfront has a fold over piece that ALWAYS goes inside out. I pointed to this challenging detail in my included picture. I had to sew down the flaps of material so they wouldn't keep popping inside out. This is a unique item, and I really enjoy wearing it. review_summary: I LOVE THIS CARDI!!! It i

Minor issue in an overall great sweater.

review_summary: I liked the shape of this
review_text: I liked the shape of this on the website. It seemed like it would be flattering for the broadshouldered gal that I am. When I got it I was less sure.  But since I have worn it a few times this has become my goto piece for work travel. It has enough structure so that it passes for blazerish, but is comfortable enough to endure Economy air travel with suprising ease. It is very warm when buttoned up due to the density of the knit, and paired with long gloves and a scarf it's all I need. But it is also surprisingly comfortable in the average 72 and fluorescent conditions of the workplace when unbuttoned. When I fly now I've literally stopped wearing a coat, and just wear this sweater to travel. The color is a very neutral heathered gray as pictured and goes with pretty much everything in my work travel collection. If you get this, you may be unsure at first but I bet you'll find as I did that you wear this more than you thought you would. Good on you ModCloth!

review_summary: I bought this as a Christ
review_text: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my mother. She is very busty and loves this kind of sixties feel. This sweater can dress up an outfit instantly, and it's not too hot because of the waffle weave. It has become a staple of her wardrobe.

review_summary: I didn't like the way it

review_summary: This was a little bit nar

review_text: I love this sweater. I think of it more of a sweater than a jacket because it's mandatory to wear a long sleeve shirt underneath it or you'll freeze your arms off. Love it. Quality could be a touch higher, but good enough. The cut is great and fits well

review_summary: I love the concept of thi

This is a great purchase! The sweater is very structured but extremely comfortable and the quality is excellent. It's also quite warm. I look forward to wearing it with skinny jeans and ballet flats this fall!

This sweater is PERFECT! From some of the pictures, I thought this would be a much flimsier fabric or that it would be too boxy. Both concerns were unfounded. This is a piece I can definitely wear to work (over some of my sleeveless mod cloth dresses!) but would also pair with jeans and boots for weekends. Wondering if I should buy it red too!

review_summary: I have gotten so many com

This is such a functional and adorable sweater  it's a staple in my closet. I don't have any trouble getting the collar to stand up like in the picture and the material is thick and luxurious. I've worn it with both long sleeve shirts underneath and sleeveless dresses  it works great for both!

review_summary: I was so happy when I got
review_text: I was so happy when I got this, I felt like Audry Hepburn in Breakfast at Tiffany's!

This sweater is terrific  the collar folds over in a very interesting way that doesn't really come across in the product photo. Seems to pull any outfit together.

review_summary: I am deeply in love with
review_text: I am deeply in love with this cardigan! The collar doesn't stand up quite as nicely as in the photo, but I love the way it sort of falls in soft folds. I have spikey hair, and whenever I wear this, I always feel like a character from Final Fantasy!The quality on this could probably be a TINY bit better  mine had a number of loose threads that needed to be trimmed, and I needed to tack down the interior edges of the button bands so they didn't unfold weirdly.I will also say that while this claims to run large, if you have a largish bust and/or broadish shoulders, definitely don't order a size smaller than usual. I'm glad I paid attention to the reviews and got a Large anyway  I don't think a Medium would have fit me.

Love this cardigan! Perfect for those days when it is a little chilly, but not cold enough for a big jacket. The sleeves are very roomy which is great because my upper arms are a bit muscular. I have had no problems with the collar, it seems to stand up just fine. All around a nice, unique addition to anyone's closet.
Love it. Works perfectly with a turtleneck or a tshirt underneath. Wish it came in more colors! Would love it in ivory. Or red. Or green. Or navy...

i love this! the grey/brown color is good for fall and winter. the collar is a little more oval or boatshaped, but it looks great buttoned and unbuttoned. very warm. it is hard to wear with another coat/jacket over top if it is that cold outside because of the sleeves, but i love the look!

I ordered a small (usually a medium) because the description said it ran large and it definitely did. The small fit perfectly. My only complainant were some long loose threads around the buttons. This cardigan is a great way to class up an outfit.

review_summary: I love this! It's the per

I did notice shedding immediately out of the box, but not any since!
I love this cardigan.  I have to confess  I am pregnant and it fits perfect because it is so open in the front.  I wear it with suit pants and it is a reasonable standin for a jacket.

review_summary: i love this sweater! it i

review_summary: This was a huge WIN for m
review_text: This was a huge WIN for me! It definitely runs big so size down. I'm a true medium and the small fits perfect. review_summary: Runs slightly big but I r

review_summary: I didn't try this on for

Super cute.  Not as fitted as in the photo. The back is not snug to body.   Sweater is medium weight and very versatile.

review_summary: Love it!  I want to wear
review_text: Love it!  I want to wear it every day!  I usually wear S or M, depending on how the top  my shoulders are a bit wide for some S tops.  The M fits really well.

This is a cute layer for fall/winter to go over a sweater and be layered up with gloves and a cute scarf!

review_summary: I was worried when I read

review_summary: I really love the style o

It's not really that close to how it looks in the picture but I think I still like it enough to keep it. It's a sweater OR a jacket! That's kind of awesome.

I wish it looked as good on me as it does on some of the other reviewers, but I'll have to return this one.
Bigger than I expected, but it's still cute

review_summary: This is a super comfy car
review_text: This is a super comfy cardi that I wear quite a bit. Like others have said, the cardigan isn't as structured/stiff as it looks here, since the collar doesn't always stay up like it's pictured. However, I love wearing it with the top button open, which falls naturally into a big collar and enough space for a scarf. When competely unbuttoned it loses it's overall shape, at least on me. Also, the front edges of the opening has flaps of material which are not attached to the sweater, and were  sometimes visible which looked messy; I just did a few whip stitches to keep them down and now it's great. Kind of annoying that wasn't done from the beginning. Also, be careful as it tends to snag easily. Although, I had to make a few modifications to get it to where I wanted it,  I totally love it now. I practically live in it; so easy to throw on over pretty much anything.

All in all, I absolutely love the fit and look of this cardigan!!!!  I expected it to be sturdier more like a jacket but it's soft and slouchy, and so comfortable!!!  I had to iron some hemming tape ($2 from the grocery store) in either side below the buttons, because the fabric kept popping out toward the middle, and I have already sewn 2 of the buttons back on, but minor fixes aside, I am loving this sweater!!

review_summary: I love this sweater! I we
review_text: I love this sweater! I wear this it all the time.. but like any wool sweater you're gonna have piling...Love the cut and the buttons. Wish it was just a tad longer... I don't have a long torso and this sweater comes down just to the top of my pants.

I'm usually petite small or xsmall in most stores and this was just too baggy on me. The sleeves are bell shaped and looked very big on my thin arms. It's cute but I wouldn't recommend it for people with small frames

I bought this sweater because I needed something to wear over dresses when that would keep me warm when it was chilly but wouldn't be as heavy or cumbersome as one of the long coats I usually pair with my goingout attire. The sweater does work perfectly in that capacity: it looks like a cross between a coat and a cape and it has an aspect of oldschool glamor to it that can dress up any outfit (it is made of actual sweater material but it looks more like a textured coat unless you're standing two inches in front of it). The collar does tend to fall since it's made of sweater material, but it's versatile and can be styled in many different ways. However, when I bought it against my better judgment based on the fact that 60 dollars is a lot for a sweater, I expected the quality to reflect the price and it does not. Taking it directly out of the packaging, there were many loose threads and actual knots of loose threads that had to be carefully cut off and which I now worry are going to put the sweater at risk to unravel. There are also obvious flaws in the stitching. I have yet to wear the sweater out but I worry that it is going to catch on things very easily and prove to be too delicate an item to have much use as a piece of outerwear. I do love the sweater and its style, but I expected much better quality for the price.

review_summary: I picked this out and rec

review_summary: Cute cardigan but cut a b

I had mistakenly thought this was a lined jacket, but the fact that it was a thick woven, high quality cardigan was an excellent surprise. I was really pleased with the feel of the knit and the fit was super flattering. I usually have trouble finding cardigans that flatter my large bust/ribcage, so this is awesome!

Brilliant! This sweater is so wonderful. Fit is great, loose enough to wear a sweater underneath but still just form fitting enough for me at the top to be comfortable. The buttons are awesome and I actually don't have too many issues with keeping the collar up while it's fully buttoned. The material is also warm enough to where I have been able to wear this cardigan with a longsleeved sweater and a pair of gloves on mild winter days and I've been fine! Pretty amazing since I'm usually cold. This could be partly due to the fact that the sweater is very well made and the material used is a thick, but soft, wafflelike fabric. All in all, an absolutely darling sweater. I have worn it more times than i thought i would have when i first bought it and I get loads of compliments on this thing. Works with SO many things. Ive used it with jeans and dresses already. I'd buy it in different colors if it was available!

High expectations for this sweater/jacket. Unlike the photos, it's very slouchy and snags VERY easily! Even thought I purchased this on sale, it was not worth the money. First major Modcloth purchase dissappointment.

Love the way this falls, very flattering. Unfortunately, it is not quite the season to be wearing it... but I am looking forward to the spring when it warms up a little.The slight flare in the 3/4 length sleeves and the wide collar make for a very chic look, and it falls at just the right spot.definitely a good purchase.
This sweater fits so cute.  It has a wonderful vintage shape and looks great with a bright pencil skirt or skinny jeans.  I am very pleased with it.

Plus, it doesn't really stand up on its own and it looks silly hanging there, and even more silly unbuttoned.  The shoulders fit just fine, but the bust area was too big on me. Also, it looks like this will be fitted through the waist, but it isn't  it's more capelike and flares out.  The ends of the sleeves flare our too. Overall, highly disappointing.

review_summary: quality is just OK but th
review_text: quality is just OK but the look is so very unique i absolutely HAVE to keep it!

I can't stop throwing this cardigan over everything; it works open or closed, and even though I'd agree with other reviewers that the collar doesn't stand up exactly like in the photo, it still looks great and works. I ordered a medium and could have gotten away with a small, but I'm happy as is.

Very cute sweater. While the collar doesn't stay up exactly like the picture, it does have enough structure to stand mostly up. I recognized the issue other reviewers had with the lining needing to be tacked down, but I don't think it is necessary. Overall, very well made and interesting piece.
This sweater is really worth the price! The material is surprisingly comfortable even though it's very textured, and I really like the retro buttons! Another winter staple for me :)

review_summary: Very cute, but a couple o
review_text: Very cute, but a couple of issues  after a couple wears, the collar looses its hold and sags a bit.  Also, it's a very loose knit, so easily snags.  Even with those issues, it's still a very cute, unique look.

I LOVE this sweater coat! I get compliments everytime I wear it and it is a lot warmer than I thought it would be. The folds in the front tend to want to stick out a bit at the V but I think I just need to iron it so they will stay flat. Nice and thick and super duper cute!

The fabric is a nice quality but I wasn't too happy with the flare of the sleeves. The front hem doesn't lay flat either. Also, I couldn't get the collar to stay up like in the picture.
Love this jacket!! I have been looking for a nice dressy jacket that didn't look too formal or heavy. This is perfect for dresses and formal pants. :)

Another ModCloth item that I've been coveting for months...but, alas, it failed to live up to my expectations. Did not feel streamlined  and modern like I was hoping, but instead felt bulky and the material was oldladylike. Sad...really loved this in the photo!

review_summary: It was love at first sigh

The neck doesn't stay up, it is quite floppy.  I had to resew the buttons on to secure them, and I also added a few stitches to the bottom to secure the inside fold.  Now that it is winter I bring this sweater along in my bag to put on after I take off my winter coat.  Highly recommended, it is very cozy.

This sweater is warm, super cute, and comfy.  I ordered a large (most of the time I'm a medium) because I believe this sweater is meant to look a bit oversized.  I'm glad I did.  I wear it all the time!
LOVE this sweater! I have broad shoulders and sometimes getting a size to fit them means the garment is bigger in other places, but not this!!!! It fits beautifully!

So if that is very important to you, I wouldn't recommend it.  But I wore it folded down and think it's really cute anyway.  I have included pictures so you can see what it looks like.
Love this sweater but it lays really funny in the front, I think with a smaller chest it would work or maybe a little tailoring.

I love the sleeve length and the flare at the end. I actually ordered a large, when I'm normally a medium, but it didn't seem too big, and I think cardigans are okay a little roomy. Love it.

Otherwise, the quality and style were great! Sad I couldn't make this work. :(
Everything I expected. Very elegant and classic.

review_summary: This is a very cozy cardi

This seems a pretty gross oversight by whomever designed it and the manufacturer.  But, luckily I am headed to have some pants hemmed, so I figured I would just have the tailor do it for me.

review_summary: It was love at first sigh

Ideally it could have been slightly longer as I like to cover my bum but over all this was a great buy for me!

Also, as soon as I took this off from trying it on, I was left with fuzzy pieces of fabric completely covered my shirt and my floor.
nice and cozy;0) love the way the arms flare out.

Very cool sweater! I've had my eye on this for a while, but was unsure this shape would work on me. I'm petite with a larger bust, and I was concerned that this would look like a tent on  me, or the collar would be too big or the sleeves too long. I usually wear a M in MC tops/sweaters, but tried this in the S and I'm glad I did. I really like it, and the S fits with room to spare. The sleeves and the length of the sweater are fine also. It's a swing style, but not too full. I have a short neck, so I probably would not wear the collar buttoned all the way up, but I can button it and then scrunch it down and it looks fine. It can also be worn open (with the collar spread out like a blazer), or with just the second button buttoned. I attached some photos of different ways I tried the collar. The color is a nice deep gray that is very versatile, and the weight is good for fall/winter here in the South. The only negatives in my opinion are the shape of the sleeves (I wish they were straighter and not so flared at the hem), and I wish it had pockets! I also wish it was a natural fiber, and that's why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5. I would recommend sizing down if you are petite or if  you have a slim torso and shoulders. Overall I'm very pleased that I took a chance on this one and can't wait for cooler weather so I can wear it.

I was recently in my Wellness Center and my nurse was wearing the oatmeal color she filled me in that MC was still selling it and on the new colors so I rushed over to buy an updated gray version and a red and green (would also love a black one in the heavier fabric, just  a recommendation). Like the old version better.

First impressions: the fabric is oddly scratchy. So much that I doublechecked the label to make sure I didn't accidentally order something made of wool (I'm slightly allergic). It is also quite tight across the bustline; I can zip it, but is smooshes my boobs a bit. Overall, the quality is good, but there are several uncut strings on the hem and cuffs.Final verdict: The scratchyness has lessened some after a couple washings and I can live with the tightness as I am currently losing weight anyway. It is a good warm layer to wear under a lighter coat in fall, and it looks a lot classier than a hoodie. I'm going to keep it.

Fit:Finding tops that will accommodate my 38H chest without looking like a sack on the rest of my body is a challenge: the 1x works great.  My bust fits without feeling like I'm going to pop out at the zipper, and there's enough room to accommodate everything so that the arm holes don't get pulled forward weirdly.The sleeves are a little loose, and a long sleeved shirt fits pretty comfortably underneath. They are also a little long, and drape around my knuckles, but I appreciate this kind of fit: It complements the cut of the cardigan, and gives a little extra warmth on chilly nights.I'm about 5'3, and most of my height is in the torso.  That being said, this jacket reaches about two inches past my butt.  The hem in front is a little shorter.  Cut/ details:I love the cut of this jacket.  It is interesting and works great with some of the cyber punkish styles I like to wear. It gives a very flattering silhouette and the flare at the bottom balances out my chest.  The magnet that holds the inner flap to the collar works ok:  I need to sort of pull it flat once the zipper is up, but after that, it holds nicely.  The seams sewn under the arms and on the back make a nice visual detail. The zipper is a little tough at first, but gets easier to use.Color:I actually bought this jacket in two colors: the Charcoal and the Burgundy.  Charcoal is wonderfully desaturated, and makes other colors pop.  Burgundy isn't too bright: a great earthy fall and winter color.

review_text: I love the fit and style of this top! I'm a big fan of the cowl style like this one for fall. The Airport Greeting Cardi is part of my favourite #cosycombos with a pair of skinny printed pants in a lowkey plaid, similar to Modcloth's own Books and Crannies Pants (http://www.modcloth.com/shop/pants/booksandcranniespants). Add a contrasting coloured ballet flat (or bootie for better warmth in fall) for some excitement to liven up some dreary Vancouver days. Although this cardigan doesn't really need it due to the cowl, fall is the time I like to layer on the fabric around my neck and shoulders, so I often wear this cardi over my loose cowlneck sweater (that looks a lot like ModCloth's Scenic Route Ready Sweater: http://www.modcloth.com/shop/pulloverssweaters/scenicroutereadysweater) and leave the cardi open a little at the neck to show the fabric contrast. Or, pair this cardigan with a woven tunic like the Back Road Bramble in Black for less business around your neck and shoulders and a more polished look with the whole outfit.

I bought it to be zipped up, so it just wasn't going to work for me.  If you're going to wear it open or you're very slender (i.e. no hips) this would probably work really well!  I also have very sensitive skin and the material was very scratchy which I think would have irritated my skin after a bit.

I love the style/cut/fit, however the two things that I don't like are that it must be dry cleaned (I know it says on the page, but it's just annoying) and that there is a lot of fabric in the front bottom of the garment, creating a poof right where you don't want one.  The sections are overlapping and there are pockets, so there is like 48 layers of fabric and bunching in the same area.

I've been waiting anxiously for this one to come back into stock and excitedly ordered it once it had.  It's slightly tragic that I got it right before the temperatures skyrocket here in SoCal so I don't think I'll get to wear it until fall, but that'll be something to look forward to, as the material is so soft and snuggly, and feels like it'll be nice and warm.  It fits like a glove, I am so excited for the appropriate weather.

review_summary: I wanted to love this swe

Things you should remember about this item, as fantastic as it is, it doesn't wash very well (in fact it's dry clean only, which is odd for a lounge item, I believe). In fact it pills the moment water hits it, I suspect. The zipper is pretty cheap so it catches a lot. While the front panels are nice and thick(double layer), the back material is one layer and thin, so if you have a little back fat/muffin top, its quite apparent. And yes, the arms are kind of wonky (too short).If you're just going by aesthetics, it's awesome. I have an awkward shape (to me hourglass, but not in the Kim K kind of way) and I usually stay away from things that are asymmetrical as they make me appear super wide, however, this is just an awesome piece. I wear it entirely too often because its both casual and comfortable looking. There is a bit of a buttflap, I suspect for those legging wearers, it could do without that. Otherwise, it is a nice piece to own, but perhaps spending $55 on it was a bit wasteful considering the quality (it's really a $20$30 item).P.S. It has pockets, which are also awesome.P.P.S. It falls nicely when unzipped, perhaps because of the weight of the zipper and extra fabric in the front.
