It looks a bit awkward when its open, you have to drape it just right. Otherwise a great length: the front hits me just below my jeans and the back goes down another 4 inches or so.

review_summary: I got this in paprika for
review_text: I got this in paprika for Christmas. My magnet seems strong and I love this piece. It's versatile, since you can wear it zipped up, not zipped, with the magnet done, or without it. I've worn it with skinny caramel cords and brown wedges and it's adorable. The color is gorgeous and the shirt is fairly true to size.
This is so comfortable and soft. Perfect casual sweater.

I absolutely adore this sweater!! I am so incredibly happy with it!!  I was worried that it would be too much fabric or too heavy to wear unzipped or that it would look too bulky zipped but it looks fabulous either way!! I am so incredibly pleased with this sweater! Glad I stopped debating and finally bought it!

review_summary: This is comfy and I like
review_text: This is comfy and I like the design

review_summary: Well, this is why I love
review_text: Well, this is why I love Modcloth review system. I would NEVher have tried this were my curiosity not sparked by the raves! I hate pilling, and avoid acrylics like the plague  but I gave in to the features everyone else has mentioned. I am going to take real good care of this baby, and groom it after I take it out, like I did my late shihtzu. ; )  I think an award should do to the designer of this (the shoulders are super flattering on me!). A pie in the face for whomever decided on the fabric content. I wish this came in cashmere. I would wear nothing else. Okay well maybe pants.

I absolutely love this sweater! It's super light and cozy. It's warm without being heavy and bulky. I always wear it zipped all the way up. The magnet that holds it together on the inside works great! I REALLY wish you had it in XS so I could order one for my sister for Christmas! I would order it in other colors if it wouldn't be so obvious that it's the same sweater!

review_summary: This was a great buy! So
review_text: This was a great buy! So comfy! I do need to read the reviews to understand this magnet however  I can't find it on my own (I just opened it)! All in all, great buy.

review_summary: Love it! Got lots of comp
review_text: Love it! Got lots of compliments on this top!

Love this cardigan. I get tons of compliments. Only reason I went with 4 stars instead of 5 is I've only worn it a handful of times and there are already a good number of fuzz ball things on the bottoms of the sleeves. Of course this happens to even the best sweaters, just usually not this fast. Still very happy with my purchase.

LOVE THIS TOP! I've only worn it twice, but got bunches of compliments each time! It's soft, comfy, and warm. Makes it SO easy to be fashionable while staying warm and cozy! From the reviews I expected the magnet that holds the inner part of the sweater up (to prevent awkward bunching) to fall down all the time and be fairly useless. I was pleasantly surprised to find that it holds up well! A wonderful purchase... Keep 'em coming, ModCloth!

While the design of this cardigan is awesome, the fit is not great. The sleeves are a little short and the armhole on the left side pulls and doesn't fit properly. Not sure if it is just the construction on this individual piece, but it is slightly off. I will still wear it (international returns are a pain), but it's not as great for a taller person as the previous reviews led me to believe.

I bought this sweater in it is definitely shorter than I was expecting from the picture. It is as bit longer in the back which covers the top of my bum, but the front only just hits the bottom of my torso and I was hoping for it to be long enough to wear with leggings. That was a bit of a disappointment, however, it is very flattering (especially on a bit more curvy figure like myself)!  I am only going to hang this to dry just in case it shrinks in length. It also is a little thinner material so you can only really wear a tank top or undershirt underneath it. I do love how flattering it is on my body and that it compliments my curves nicely. My husband really loves it on me :). Bottom line...I very much love this sweater!
I love this cardigan. It's light weight but not cheap feeling, and hangs nicely in all the right places. Another reviewer was right; I'm living in this this winter!

Loved this sweater! Texture of the fabric is great! Sits right at my hips, similar to as shown in the photograph. The medium fit my frame comfortably close, form fitting, but not to tight. Perfect! I have gotten great complements both times I've worn it out. I wore mine, layered with a leggings and boots. The only downside is that I have already experienced a little pilling on the underside of the arms. Overall, I love the sweater.
I love this cardigan! It goes well with most things and is great open or zipped up.

Definitely size down.  The shoulders were not in the correct place on my body, but overall it wasn't worth returning because it's not that obvious, and I bought it as a comfy item for my meditation classes anyways.  As far as fit/style goes, I don't know what everyone is talking about.  It fits as it does in the picture, nothing awkward about the style of the way it hangs at all.  I don't know what else everyone was expecting, but I found that part quite fine. So fine in fact, that I ordered it in a size smaller in another colour three days after it came!
Love this cardigan! The fit is a bit snug, but I'm carrying some extra weight in the middle. Not too flattering on my muffin top but a great piece. Thinking of getting the coral colored one too!

review_summary: I bought a size up on thi
review_text: I bought a size up on this one to allow for wearing layers underneath and it works great.  This is my new favorite!

The cotton/polyester blend fabric makes this sooo soft!! I absolutely love the side zipper detail, it really gives this cardigan a twist! I bought the large, but I wish it was available in bigger sizes! I would have sized one up from the large, as it's a little tight around my backside but fits well in the other areas. I'm keeping this, because although it's a little tight, it's such a unique cardigan and I love the zipper. My friend who usually wears Mediums fit well in the Large. If you're considering, size up!

The material of this cardigan is fabulous, it is super soft and with some stretch. Color is an amazing charcoal grey with lighter bits throughout. Fit is a little odd when compared with most cardigans, but if you mess around with the zipper and try it zipped at different heights, it is easy to find the perfect look. Even better is the fact that it has side pockets that lay in a way that if you put your phone in it you don't get a weird bulge! Size was very accurate, don't size up or down.

review_summary: I was a bit hesitant to b
review_text: I was a bit hesitant to buy this sweater because I'm very particular about the quality of material. But this piece exceeded my expectations. It is so soft, the fabric is wonderful quality, and it's warm even though the material isn't super thick. Drapes around my curves nicely.

Nice and slender around the arms which is great for me when you have normal arms but a curvy figure in general.  I like how the back goes lower so it's easy to pair with leggings.  It's so soft.  It doesn't fall on me quite like the picture but it still is very flattering. I'm going to be able to wear this to work and be comfortable but still very stylish.

review_summary: This truly is a perfect c
review_text: This truly is a perfect cardigan. It makes even my crappiest, bargain bin shirts look like part of a polished outfit. I love it best unzipped or just with the magnet because of how nicely it falls in the front. The zipper almost just looks like a design element. It's incredibly soft and the gray just goes with everything. I also think it looks more expensive than the paprika color that's available. Worth every penny.

This is a great cardigan, but the shoulders fit a bit odd.  This may be because the cardigan is a little big on me and since the shoulders are welldefined, it makes my shoulders look bigger than they are.  Regardless, it's super versatile and great to throw on over anything.

review_summary: I bought this in a Medium
review_text: I bought this in a Medium first and it fits ok, but I have very long arms and I prefer my sleeves a bit longer. I also have a slight muffin top and since the Medium is form fitting, it shows my roll. I am keeping this one because in the summer I tend to lose weight. So i ordered the grey and the paprika in a large. I love this sweater. It's more like a shirt as it's not heavy weight. But with the larger size, I was able to wear a long sleeved t shirt under it. It's so snug and cozy! I love the pockets too. So yeah, I have 3 of this sweater... :)

The material was a thicker material than i was expecting, but looks beautiful on, especially unzipped. My only complaint is when the cardigan is zipped, the bottom tends to bunch and look unflattering, and needs readjusting as you wear it. Overall, I'm keeping the sweater and its a great basic piece.

review_summary: I was skeptical of all th
review_text: I was skeptical of all the glowing reviews, but I haven't taken this off since I got it. Don't overlook the magnet closure for the first week like I did  it really helps the sweater hang properly.
This cardigan is really cool, and fit me pretty well as a medium. Even though I decided to send it back because I reconsidered the price, I would recommend this!

review_summary: It seems to run a little
review_text: It seems to run a little big but maybe it's not such a bad thing.  It's super cozy and the material I love!  Perfect fall addition.

After reading all of the reviews kvelling about this piece, I was excited to purchase it and even more eager to finally try it on.  Unfortunately, it wasn't love at first site.  The fabric is soft and beautiful, the piece is well made; but I don't think it's made for someone so short.  Considering proportions, it looks like it's too big for me, and the longer back nearly covers my bottom.  I usually like sweaters that are more slouchy and longer; but this is illfitting on me and makes me look rather frumpy.

review_summary: Cute design but on me it'
review_text: Cute design but on me it's too long. It is thick so I just don't know what to do with the extra material in the front that crosses over my body. Lots o material. I will try it open to see if that makes a difference. It doesn't look good on my healthy busted, straight body with muffin top zipped up all the way.

I am loving this sweater! Great quality, the fabric is so soft and cozy. I've already received a lot of compliments, and my husband's a big fan of it too. It's flattering (which is very importing, being a curvy gal) It's unique, a little edgy, and can be worn several different ways. I usually wear it zipped up all the way, or zipped halfway down to flaunt a little boobie! ;)
I love this cardigan! It's not my goto coverup for running errands, going out, or just bumming around the house in something warm and cozy.

This is the softest, most comfortable top for fall. The bottom hem on the front is a little odd and uneven but the comfort and cut zipper made it a keeper. Agree with previous posters that the magnet to keep the wrap up on one side isn't strong enough to work. Not a makeorbreak issue though as the one side sort of stays up on its own anyway once you zip it up.
LOOOOOOVE this sweater! So nice and cozy and the fit is great. I predict it will be my new fall staple :) Thank you once again Modcloth for making my day!
It is nice and soft.

This sweater is super comfy and the quality of the material is really great.  It is also versatile in that you can wear it multiple ways...zipped or unzipped.  My only real complaint is that it kinda bunches up in the front at the bottom where the interior flaps and pockets meet. Unless you constantly tug at it and keep it straight, it can make you look like you have somewhat of a pooch. Otherwise, I think I will get a lot of wear out of this sweater!

review_summary: I just got this and I LOV
review_text: I just got this and I LOVE it! Its SO soft and it fits perfectly. I think this is the best purchase I've ever made from Mod. I love how the zipper is offcenter. You can totes dress this piece up or down. It will go great with jeans, dress pants, skirts etc. I'm so excited for tomorrow to wear it!

Nice soft weight, warm but not heavy. Snug in upper arms but OK with the stretch in the fabric. Length is tunic length on me (I'm 5'0). Really flattering seaminggives a soft cardigan a really structured look. I love the asymmetric zipper. I had a baby 3 months ago and am not quite back to my old shape, but this is flattering and hides the lumps and bumps that weren't there before.I ordered a mediumI am 5'0 and 129 lbs. Snug but not too tight.

I'm not as impressed with this cardigan as I thought I would be, for the price. It IS very cute and comfy. Other people have talked about the weird magnet already, but that has actually grown on me.My main issues are that the zipper isn't the best and keeps getting stuck, and that I've only worn the cardigan 3 times and already it's pilling like crazy on the underside of the arms (where your arms brush against the body.) Hopefully a sweater shaver will help, but I feel like I haven't had this item long enough for the fabric to be deteriorating like this already. I'll keep it because I do think it's cute and comfortable, but for $55 I expected a little better quality.

After desperately coveting this top through many cycles of it selling out, coming back and then selling out again before I could get my pretty little paws on it  I finally caught it at the perfect moment and pounced!  I'd read the reviews with the complaints about the armpits and that many found they weren't able to layer, so I sized up.  Typically I'm a small in ModCloth tops, but I went with a medium and it's absolute perfection!  I can layer it and I have NO problems with the armpits (which is one of my biggest pet peeves with the latest fashion it seems).  I love the extra length over my butt, the fabric is so soft and cozy, and THANK YOU to the previous reviewers who clued me in about the magnet  it's magic :)  Overall  I'm so stoked I finally got my hands on this beauty ... Patience and perserverance paid off! ;D

Super soft fabric, flattering on my hourglass figure, so many ways to style...I don't want to take it off! (I always order a M in Modcloth tops, but the L fit perfectly especially since I have wider shoulders.)

review_summary: I wasn't sure that I love
review_text: I wasn't sure that I loved the material, but it is growing on me,since it is soft and cozy.  I ordered a large and the sweater fits me well

This cardigan was my very first ModCloth purchase, and I'm pleased to say I love it! The shirt runs true to size, and is quite comfy (not scratchy)! Perfect lounge, weekend wear. Only con, I wish the sleeves were a bit longer, other than that, very happy with my purchase.

it is soft, comfortable, perfect thinkness and the fabric has a bit more texture than i expected from the photo.  i agree that the sleeves are just a smidge short.  more importantly i have one HUGE complaint; i like to wear the cardigan unzipped and the zipper is VERY sharp, because of the location of the zipper it catches on my left sleeve and after wearing it two times find it is wrecking havock on the material.  So much for investing in a $50 cardigan.

review_summary: I love this sweater! It f
review_text: I love this sweater! It fits great, the length is good and the detail is very cute. It is a little inconvenient that it is dry clean only. I did find some sweater fuzz balls on it before even wearing it, which was odd but I had my dry cleaning shave it off when they cleaned it.
Very stylish, flattering, beautiful sweater.  The material is supersoft and thin but warm.  The armholes do go a bit low, but it's not bothersome to me.  Overall, a great purchase!

review_summary: Love Love. Just got it to
review_text: Love Love. Just got it today and I am itching to wear it. The cardigan fits and drapes perfectly effortlessly. Do not hesitate to buy. I want to buy this for all my friends

review_summary: This is more than I would
review_text: This is more than I would typically spend on a cardigan but I'm in love with this, so it's worth the price. It is super soft, not too bulky, and can be worn two different ways. I think this will be a staple in my wardrobe.

review_summary: I love this sweater! I ha
review_text: I love this sweater! I have ordered it immediately when I was notified it was back in stock. I love all the different ways you can wear it. It looks just as cute open as it does zipped up or half way up. Really happy with my purchase!

I just received my cardigan today and I am so excited!  This is my first purchase from ModCloth, and I couldn't be happier.  I usually don't spend that much money on clothing, but I like clothing that is unique, and that's what you pay for here at ModCloth.  The fabric is medium weight and super soft.  I debated a small or medium as I am 5'4 and weight about 135 lbs.  I still have 15 lbs to lose from baby so I bought small hoping it would fit while I lost weight.  It fits!  And it still has enough room to be drapey.  I think this will be my go to cardigan for style and comfort this winter!

review_summary: I waited for this to come
review_text: I waited for this to come back into stock and I am really glad that I did.  It is incredibly soft and comfy.  (I'm not sure what happened with the person who said it was scratchy.)  It looks amazing zipped 3/4 of the way up.  The only thing I wish is that it were a bit more formfitting in the torso so it had more shape.

review_summary: This sweater is so very c
review_text: This sweater is so very comfortable and looks great worn three ways: unzipped, half zipped, and zipped up.  I love that it's cozy enough for weekend wear but looks nice enough to be worn to work.  Plus the three ways of wearing it make it quite versatile  people might not notice if I wear it every single day!  My only complaint is that the sleeves are short on me. Otherwise, the medium fits me beautifully (I'm normally a size 8).

review_summary: I have been waiting for t
review_text: I have been waiting for this to restock for awhile  it's worth the wait!  I love it!  I bought the medium and it fits perfectly.  I am 5'3 and 38D and wasn't sure what size would work.  I ordered the small and medium, but at separate times, so I received the medium but not the small yet.  I think the medium is perfect, however.  The magnet that holds the cowl closed is a nice, nonbulky way to keep it closed and it works.  The fabric is drapy and soft.  This is a definite keeper!
Perfect! Love this very much. Super cute and flattering.
Love,love, love this! I'm 5' 2 and 160lbs, and this fits me beautifully! Its warm, and comfy, and looks great.

I absolutely LOVE this cardigan! I always get compliments on it. It is a little long on me, but I'm short (5'1) and I don't mind it. It is really comfortable, easy washing. It's versatile, you can wear it open or closed and it looks great. I would buy one in every color if it existed!!
Beautiful fit and the quality of the fabric is lovely. I am somewhat busty and broadshouldered, so I am typically hesitant to order online; this sweater fit like a dream

Great sweater for fall...lighter weight than I had anticipated, but so soft and comfortable.  Fun and versatile, you can wear fully or partially zipped up.  I waited three restock cycles to get this, but am glad I did!!! Definitely grab it if it comes back in stock! I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.

review_summary: I love this sweater and m
review_text: I love this sweater and my only concern is that I am going to wear it out before the end of the month. I took it on a trip as my only sweater and basically had to wear it for two weeks straight, luckily since it's gray it went with everything! The fit is great and is slimming. The draping is unique and pretty. My only complaint is that the left front pocket is actually a bit longer than the sweater itself so it sticks out a tad. And for those who can't figure it out on their own (it took me about four days before I did), there are magnets on the inside panels and it goes with the magnet on the inside of the right side of the sweater... that probably doesn't make any sense, but that's how that inner panel stays in place... in case you are wondering!

review_summary: So happy I signed up to f
review_text: So happy I signed up to find out when this was restocked although by the time I got on the site (during my lunch break only a few hours later) my choice of size medium was already sold out so I went for the large and have not been disappointed. I figured that it's a cardigan to be worn over things so being a little bit bigger can't be a bad thing. The fabric is so soft (and a bit stretchy) and it's a great length, it's almost tunic length. The arm length is also just at my wrists. I did have to do a quick sewing repair on the inside of one of the pockets but it's not visable (and my sewing job is neat!) not worthy of removing a star. Great cardigan, worn immediately and so unique!

review_summary: I was expecting to like t
review_text: I was expecting to like this cardi more based on other reviews...the arms are a bit awkward because they don't quite reach the armpit, and the fabric is a little scratchy.  Other than that, it's an interesting sweater and I think it will be great for the fall!

review_summary: I LOVE this, I just wish
review_text: I LOVE this, I just wish I had bought a larger size. Small fits me JUST right (maybe a little too small in the sleeves, but barely noticeable). A medium would have allowed me to layer it better.

review_summary: Super cute! I wish the sl
review_text: Super cute! I wish the sleeves weren't so short though. It's tough being a tall girl

This sweater is sooooo soft.  I love the way it drapes  both when zipped and when left open.  I am worried a little about the fabric pilling...I have worn it three times and it it starting to a tiny bit under the arms.  I will monitor it and get back to you in a month or two (as I plan to wear it OFTEN).
Love this sweater. So cozy!
Amazing find!  I absolutely love it.  It's my goto comfy jacket.  Absolutely love it over a dress, with jeans and boots... with anything.

This cardigan is a necessity for any wardrobe. Not only is it versatile, but it is so cozy. You can wear this anywhere!The asymmetrical zipper creates such a beautiful detail making the piece both unique and edgy. The draping caused by the zipper creates a waist which is flattering, and creates an adjustable cowl neck effect. The fabric is thicker but not overly so; it is very soft and perfect for cool weather. I paired this with a black cami, dark skinny jeans, wedge kneehigh boots and a black beret.In addition, my husband LOVES it! I have received multiple compliments from him about this cardigan!!!! Highly recommend!!!!!! Buy this!!!!!!!!!!
Love! Perfect for fall traveling. Will be staple in my wardrobe! Friends are asking where to get it, it's been sold out for a while.
Really unique cozy and flattering
Really unique cozy and flattering

Just like everyone else has said...great sweater!! I like that its longer in the back than the front, my only complaint is that its a little too long! A friend referred to it as a duck tail. Still love it enough to keep it. Great find!

review_summary: This is a great little ca
review_text: This is a great little cardigan for the fall! I've worn it a few times and I always receive complements on it. The only reason I didn't give it a 5 stars is because I feel that the sleeves are a little bit shorter than they should be.
Soft, flattering, beautiful. Fall perfected.

Like others have already said before me, this sweater is super soft and comfy! The only thing I don't like about it is it's length. It's simply too long for short girls like me and doesn't look flattering due to length. Other than that, I'd say go for it if you're taller. You'll absolutely love this sweater and it'll become one of your new favourites.

LOVE IT. I actually ordered both a S and an M because... well frankly the M was back in stock and the S wasn't in yet. I didn't want to miss out. But I'm glad I got both. I'm inbetween sizes in most things Modcloth, often a Medium is a little too big and looks garbagebaggy, and a small can sometimes be a bit too tight. In this case, the S fits quite snugly and looks super flattering on, but the arms are a little short. I might get annoyed with that if I were to wear it around the house or try to just be comfy in it. The medium on the other hand is super comfy but it's not quite as flattering on. That being said it will be really good for layering. So I'm not returning either, I'll keep both! It is a super soft material and I think it'll be pretty warm for fall. Thank you Modcloth for another winner. (Oh and for the super fast international shipping too!!)
This cardigan is gorgeous; soft and comfortable, with a very flattering drape.  It fits true to size, with a long back panel.   This is supercozy fall wear.

review_summary: No wonder this is so popu
review_text: No wonder this is so popular! This is a truly wonderful garment. The fabric is really soft, almost like cashmere, the garment well made, and the variety of interesting ways to wear itzipped, zipped partially, unzipped with collar magnets connected, all the way openkeep it interesting and stylin'. And pockets!I wore it for the first time today, and women were literally stopping me on the street about it. My only problem with its being so wonderful is the obvious amount of women who already own itand the possibility of running into them!I normally wear a 10, sometimes a 12 in a more fitted top, and a Large fits just right. Not too snug, though I couldn't wear anything other than a thin shirt underneath. I'm 5'8, longwaisted, and the longer back length just barely covers my butt. Even though the grey is a great color, I'd love to see this in other colors with its next production.

review_summary: I ordered this when it be
review_text: I ordered this when it became available again and I love it. Absolutely love it. I marked it as a little long, because it was longer than expected (over my butt), but I love it, I think its a good length. I also love the little magnet to keep the inner flap in place, good idea. I can't wait to wear this!If I can edit this later with photos, I will! Plus I'll double check all of my measurements.Would recommend, for sure.

Couldn't be happier with this sweater. The fabric is SO comfortable  warm, but not hot or itchy. Soft, but still holds shape. It's formfitting, but not too clingy. I had a little trouble figuring out the top at first  if you're confused like I was, there's a magnet on the left side of the blouse that pulls up to meet another on the right shoulder. But once I had it on, I felt cute (and comfortable!) all day. Might be my favorite purchase from ModCloth yet  except for maybe the boots that I'm wearing with it :)

Unfortunately, this didn't seem to fit me like it did everyone else. I couldn't get the cowl to fall in a flattering way, and the pockets looked bunchy at my hips, making them look wide. I was really hoping this could become a new fall favorite, as the material is superb, but it just wasn't flattering on my frame.
Very happy with this item. The fabric is so soft, its extremely comfortable, it drapes perfectly. So glad I grabbed it.

Love this sweater! It's super soft, the dark grey color is right on and it's just the right size. I wish the sleeves were a tad bit longer but it does hit right below the wrist. It was a fabulous purchase!

review_summary: I love this so much! I'm
review_text: I love this so much! I'm extremely busty, and I don't know  if it's the way the neck lies or what, but it's ridiculously flattering on me without my chest looking too big which it often does. I also love the uneven hem. A lot of the time a shorter front is just too short for me, but this hits just at my hips.

This was my first purchase from Modcloth and I am very happy with it. The sweater is very flattering both open and zipped up. The racerback creates a nice shape and fit. It is perfect for a chilly day on it's own but still thin enough to wear under a leather jacket for colder temps. Love it!

review_summary: I sized up on this b/c I
review_text: I sized up on this b/c I didn't know how fitted it would be and because I wanted to be able to wear it over other things. Although a little large, I really do like the fit! It's a very flattering cut and length (covers my bum in the back) and the other reviewers are totally right about the softness of the fabric. Not a super warm piece, but would add some warmth. I am superhappy with this purchase!
Oh my goodness. So comfortable and cozy. It really is like that casual, but totally stylish celeb airport look. I love curling up in my new cardigan. I'm also a sucker for grey!

Super cute, super soft. I can dress it up or down which makes it very versatile. I think I snatched up a returned one at around midnight after it had gone out of stock about a week ago...lucked out :)

review_summary: SO CUTE! The magnet is a
review_text: SO CUTE! The magnet is a great feature and I love the asymmetrical hem. If this comes back in stock, order it! It's super comfy and sooo soooo soft.
Perfect cardy! I wear it all the time it's great!!
This sweater is RIDICULOUSLY fantastic! The material and fit are bangon. So glad I bought one before they went out of stock!!!

review_summary: I think this is going to
review_text: I think this is going to become one of my favorite sweaters this fall / winter mostly because it is super soft and comfortable. I agree with other reviewers that the arms are a little strange (see one of my pictures) because they come down really low. But, I think that is just how it is made. I like the magnet idea (to keep the back flap flat in the front) but the magnet is really weak so it doesn't quite work. It is quite a bit longer than I expected, but I still really love it! Also, for me, it fit fine and I usually order a size Medium from modcloth.

The sleeves go to about the middle of my hand, and the hem comes down lower than many other sweatshirts, meaning I can just about wear it with a pair of thick tights without being indecent. My sister and best friend both loved it so much after seeing me wear it that I got them each one as well. If it ever goes on sale I might entertain the idea of getting a second one in case something happens to the first (which should give you an idea of how much I love this sweater).

review_text: I bought this shirt to wear to work while I'm teaching. I like the whole stripe look that is popular now, but this one really stuck out to me because it has the larger black stripes, which I think keeps it from looking too casual. I didn't realize this when I ordered the shirt, but the material is really nice. It feels like a professional tshirt, and I think it will look nice under a blazer or cardigan, which I was hoping for. The one caution I'd give most ladies is that this shirt is really long. That's why I ordered it, since I'm so tall. Even being 5'11, I found this shirt long, which was fine for me because I wanted a tunic fit. I think for shorter ladies this would work nice with leggings or skinny jeans, or if you dare, as a dress. My only complaint is the sleeves are supposed to be stitched up, but only one sleeve came that way. The other humorously was only stitched in one spot, so I just decided to rip out the other stitches and make them both down. It worked for me, but might not work for someone who isn't capable of fixing their own stitching issues. Also I usually wear M/L and went for the large for a looser look, and I think it ended up working nicer, especially since it has a longer looser feel. It might be large, but it drapes nicely.

review_summary: I shrieked when I saw thi
review_text: I shrieked when I saw this cardigan was being offered in plus sizes. I've woefully admired this from afar ever since it's debut on the site and finally it's mine! It's definitely a cardigan, not a jacket or a hoodie. Nice and light weight, easy to layer with light weight tees and tanks, and actually looks pretty cute under a medium weight leather jacket. I find it looks great done all the way up, as pictured in the photo or hanging open. Allinall, super flattering. The seaming on the back is something I didn't even really notice in the photos, and it just makes everything that much better in person. I sized up to a 4X, even though I figured a 3X would be alright. 3X would have been fine too, as I do have a little extra room. However, if I had gone with the 3X I wouldn't be able to wear anything bulkier than a thin tee or tank underneath: the cardigan would function more as a primary shirt than a layering piece (if that makes sense?!). The 4X is a little baggy, but because the cardigan is so structured it's a nonissue. I think once I put it in the wash it may shrink a bit too, so I'm not too worried about it. Now I'm thinking about getting in the charcoal... and if it were to be offered in the red or forest green too... well, I don't know if I'd be able to stop myself.

I have a temporary ileostomymost people are familiar with the term colostomy bag and it's the same ideajust a different part of the colon.  I had mine placed this summer after a horrific car wreck that broke my back and shredded my colon (and many many other awful things but those 2 were the worst!)  Having woke up after surgery with a new flesh colored accessory meant that I was going to have to make some wardrobe changes and Modcloth was my first buy. There are MANY  of us Ostomates out there and most are embarrassed to speak out.  It's hard for me!  But maybe a young woman looking for an article of clothing has a secret ostomy and is scared to shop online wondering How will this fit with the bag?  On ALL of my reviews I will have an Ostomy Grade. So first:  This gets an Ostomy A+.  The sweater is truly oatmeal colored and not a white, cream, or light brown.  It can be worn multiple ways. The neck line has been easy to handle and I am OCD!  The weight is thicker than I expected but I'll wear a tee or a tank under it and feel fine walking around the mall.  It's cardigan weight.  There's lot of options to dress it up and dress it down.  It has a tulip like over lap in the front and the side zipper is unique.  It's kind of a challenge to zip bc the zipper gets stuck. It fits JUST as it said it would.  I'm very pleased!   I do plan on buying more in bright colors!  Might even wear it to work tomorrow over my scrubs!  Might bring a little personality in to my uniform!

review_summary: I read almost all of the
review_text: I read almost all of the reviews before making my purchase. I was a little worried about the issue that other buyers have had regarding the fabric pilling, but decided to take the chance. I LOVE THIS CARDIGAN. I've had mine now for about a month and have washed it at least four times. My cardigan is the same feel/quality as the day it arrived. No pilling issue and I haven't dry cleaned it. I put mine in a garment bag, wash with my normal dark colored clothes in cold water/normal cycle, regular detergent and liquid fabric softener. I fold it over a plastic hanger (rather than actually hanging it on the hanger so that it doesn't stretch or have weird marks from the hanger after it dries). After it is dried, I put it in the clothes dryer for just a couple minutes set to normal temp to get any wrinkles out and soften it up. I went with a large because I don't like my sweaters to feel super tight in the arms. My only regret is that I didn't order it in black too when I had the chance.

When it's zipped the torso can also be just a tad clingy. Occasionally it makes the fabric look bulky as the fabric clings to itself because of the nature of the asymmetrical zipper. If you have a little flab to hide in your mid section, it can sometimes cling to that, too. But allinall I loved wearing this sweater, to the airport no less! It was great for travel :)

If I were to remove it I am afraid it would completely unravel the sleeve. Lastly the color was totally grey. No oatmeal about it. Guess this is just one sad purchase I am going to have to live with and learn from.

review_summary: I got this as a present a
review_text: I got this as a present after wanting it for months and a bit disappointed as many little things about it make it difficult to give it a great review despite its comfort and being really cute. First, the zipper is of very cheap quality so if you're trying to zip up the cardigan quickly, you'll either catch something in it (hair, scarf, shirt...) or the zipper pull will get stuck on its casing and it won't sit flat which is awkward. And like others have said, the fabric does pill... and quite a lot. I wore this frequently for about a week and there was some serious pilling on the back of the sleeves and the lower back; I'm afraid to remove the pills in case I rip the fabric. Lastly, the color is not much of an oatmeal but instead more like a light heather gray color, which is not what I had wanted, but it looks cute anyway. Had this been made with sturdier fabric and a better zipper, I feel like the price would have been more acceptable. But unfortunately this feels like a coollooking $20 cardigan, not something over $50. Would buy again, only if it were much, much cheaper.

review_summary: By the time you zip it up
review_text: By the time you zip it up and arrange the material the way you want it to lay you have about 4 layers of material over your chest and abdomen...so it makes you looks a little bigger. review_text: I ordered a XL because everything from this website comes ridiculously small. It's soft, but very thin for a cardigan/sweater. What bothers me is the magnet. A button to keep the inner fold would have worked better because when you wash it, the magnet sticks to the metal of your machine and distorts the fabric from all the pulling during the dry cycle. I would suggest hangdrying this item. I have not seen any pilling of the fabric yet, but it's only been washed once and barely worn. The zipper is really cheap, constantly feels like it's going to break. And the color of the fabric is darker than the image, it's less oatmeal and more beige. Still very cute. It's good enough quality that I won't send it back but overall it's not worth exactly how much you're being charged.

It's a shame it's put together in such a sloppy way.

When filling in the category of fit, I was torn between saying too small and too big. My reasons are that the fabric was very constraining at the arms, such that I couldn't imagine pulling the cardigan over a longsleeved shirt, yet there was tons of extra fabric around my belly. Admittedly, I have a bit of junk in the trunk (and I rock climb, so maybe my arm muscles are making the sleeves tighter than intended), so it's possible that the loose draping effect they were going for just couldn't be achieved on a person with my dimensions. Despite that, it does look really nice when open and freeflowing! Unfortunately, I don't find the quality of the fabric to be so high. The outside is nice when you run your hand on it, but the inside was vaguely itchy against my bare skin. The zipper is also kind of tricky since the fabric is very lightweight. Lastly, one of the stitches was loose and fraying when it arrived. Overall, I think the look is in principle really cool, and I can imagine that this would look nicer on someone with a slimmer figure (or maybe better on me if I got one size larger). Sadly, I think I'm going to return it ultimately because I just don't find the quality up to par.

This cardigan stops right at them.  I prefer to wear my cardigans with the sleeves pushed up, so the fact that this one was already 3/4 sleeve is a nice bonus.  It is lightweight enough to wear even on warmer days.  I get a lot of use out of it.  It is nice and soft and washes up well without any pilling.  Overall, a great value at $27.99.  Rebecca Jean of Midnight Maniac
nice little cardigan to go over skirts and dresses  perfect length for my short torso and is a vibrant red colour.
This cardigan was shorter than I was expecting. It finishes just below my bust, not on my waist (it would be nicer if it did). Also it is just a fraction tighter than it should be. Don't love it.

review_summary: I've been looking for a d

The cut is so flattering I might order it in a few other colours too! Highly recommended.

review_summary: I have a long waist and s
review_text: I have a long waist and short little legs  I love cropped cardigans  they seem to do wonders for my proportions.  I wear them with dresses, tops, and they're actually kind of difficult to find.  SO, when I saw this in red, I snapped it up. The L fits perfectly.  I liked this so much, that when I saw today that it had been released in navy, and brown, and that the black version was back, I snapped all those up too. The $27.99 price suits the quality  I wouldn't pay over that. It's a good basic, but I wouldn't expect it to last for years. I was a little wary about ordering from the UK (What if it doesn't fit? What if I have problems returning it?), but I'm happy to say I had no issues.

Fit pretty well, and the cropped length was exactly what I was looking for, but the color was too bright for me. I felt like the fabric was a little thin, although not cheapjust made it lay funny over my clothes.

Thin fabric and tiny size. i usually take size L for everything and I can barely do this up over my boobs. When I do the buttons nearly pop open and the fabric stretches to the point of being see through. Would have returned but can't because i live in Australia. i've lost over 25lbs since i originally purchased this cardigan and it still doesn't fit.

review_summary: I got this to go with a v
review_text: I got this to go with a vintage style dress, and it's perfect as a bolero length top. I'm a 38 C, and the fit was great.

Love this cardigan! Its very warm and the material really soft and comfy. The cut is flattering and it goes with many of the summer dresses that I've bought from Modcloth, allowing me to wear them well into the fall season.
Love it!! Only just reached my waist, so it's quite short, which is what i wanted. My new favorite cardigan!

review_summary: Perfect for a not so cold

I decided to get a Large, but even with my 36C chest, I still had puckering when buttoning the buttons, which is a complete shame. Sadly, this is one cardigan that I will have to keep open. I also wish the sleeves were just a tad longer, as they hit at my wrists (and I'm only 5 ft 2in!), so just a bit more material would have been nicer. Other than that, it is a very nice color and material. I just hope it doesn't shrink any more, for the sake of button puckering. Sort of a disappointment.

Bought this for my senior photos and it looked fantastic!
Beautiful colour and really well made. Fits really well and clings to your curves without looking too tight. The perfect cardigan to wear for a 50's look with full skirts or high waisted jeans.
Having a short waist the short/shrunken cardigans are better on me.  this is no exception.  Fits great, hits in the right spot and is a beautiful shade of red.

The material is not too heavy or light but just perfect for those slightly cooler days.  I do see myself wearing this with many outfits!

review_summary: Sigh, I just adore this s

review_summary: Fits very well with my me

The weight is great; not super thin, but not so thick that it can't make it to the office during the summer.  I've been wearing it everywhere and it is already becoming a beloved statement piece in my wardrobe.

Another reviewer said the following, I would usually wear a 2x, but sized up and it seemed to fit better. I can't close it and wear it that way (it would close, but it's too tight to be worn like that and feel good about it)... I have to agree. Although it is marked as fits true to size the cardigan fits really small.  I wear a 2X in ModCloth sizes and most items fit slightly large on me.  However, this cardigan fits very small.  I can't button it up all the way without the buttons pulling either. I have more than enough under arm room to the point it looks strange in the arm pit area. I sized up to a 3X and it fits decently but it reall is TOO SMALL TO BE A 3X.  It fits in a way that makes you say if it was just a tad bit larger or want to pull at it some.  So I did pull at the sweater to make it comfortable but you can't pull at the shoulders to make them more comfortable. There just isn't any room in the shoulders to stretch. I also purchased the cantaloupe color that is supposed to run small in size but really the red and cantaloupe fits the same.  If you want a cardigan that you can button up without gapping at the buttons size up 2 sizes. I am a 1X in the chest and the buttons still pull in a 3X.  I wished I would have gotten a 4X but they are sold out. The 3X will work but it makes me feel like adjusting it too much.

review_summary: This top is thick and stu
review_text: This top is thick and sturdy. It?s heavy enough that I might not wear this in hot weather. It?s very fall. I was initially attracted to the texture and the keyhole opening. I didn?t even notice the high collar until I received it, though I do like it. It is very body skinning on me, and I like that. It?s a clingy enough material that those who prefer a relaxed fit may not care for it or may go up a size. I found the sizing to be true to house brand sizing. The keyhole and collar area have a long lining area. It?s thick and did show through a little on my bust. I though it was my bra line, but it was the shirt liner. This could be trimmed and sewn though. The fit is super flattering for me, and the sleeves weren?t constrictive. I?d definitely get this in more colors in addition to the two here that I already purchased.

I am one of those people who adores October because of Halloween, and celebrate all month long. I have some festive tshirts, but have been looking for a sweater for the month, so when I found this, I completely fell in love! The design is so cute, and since it's a Modcloth Intarsia sweater, I knew it's be a decently thick, knitted fabric. The Intarsia Modcloth line is my favorite, and I've already purchased several from the collection, but to those who haven't: these sweaters run SMALL, I am normally a size M or even a size S for oversized sweaters, but these have a more flattering cut than a normal sweatshirt, so they do cling a bit. Also, the Intarsia sweater line is meant to have 3/4 sleeves that end above your wrist; I'm only five feet tall, so they are like normal sleeves for me, but if you are taller or have longer arms, they will be shorter, because they are meant to be. I see a lot of reviews complaining about this, when it is shown in the picture they are meant to be shorter, so be aware of that. Overall, this is probably my favorite sweater in my entire wardrobe, and as long as you are aware of how this sweater fits (smaller, shorter sleeves), then I HIGHLY recommend it!

I was very disappointed by this, as they did look nice on me. Same story for the cute cropped versions that Modcloth sells, made by the same manufacturer, I think. I kept them all around for about a year, hoping that this would change ('maybe it was just a bad day?') and couldn't believe it when it was a clear pattern. I felt I needed to donate them, to break the cycle of disappointment, really. I guess I'll have to continue my search for the same pretty styles cardigans with some different sort of fabric blend. The dark grey is a little bit shorter and less drapey, though it still hangs nicely. I have worn the light grey everywhere: to work, camping, and hiking; it's a great casual tunic. Leggings must be worn with either, unless I'm lounging around the house or sleeping (the light grey also makes an excellent nightgown) because the front part is very short. But I'm very happy with this new style and am definitely going to stock up on more colors! Sidenote: I also have this top in the tomato red color, which is a totally different material than both greys. The dark grey is my favorite iteration of this top so far.

review_summary: I am a very tall woman at
review_text: I am a very tall woman at 6'1. I was excited to read all the reviews about how long this tunic was because I am sick of ordering blouses only to receive them and feel like they are more like crop tops.  This tunic is very long and, in that respect, awesome.  What I do not like about it, however, is that the sleeves from one color to another are different.  I ordered this tunic in both navy and green  I tried the green one on and it fits pretty good (the sleeves are a little tight, but manageable and not uncomfortably so).  I figured since the two tops are the exact same style, they would fit exactly the same.  I pulled the tags off both tops and hung them in my closet.  Wrong. The sleeves on my navy top are so tight that I can barely wear it.  I can wear it with a loose cardigan to hide the appearance of the sleeve around my arm and to also hide the fact that the arm pit of the sleeve stops about 2 inches from my armpit because it simply won't go up any higher; there is no give on the fabric.  I can't return it since I took the tags off of it.  And it's not like it's a low priced item, so there goes that money down the tube.  I'm just super disappointed with the way it fits.  It fits great everywhere else and looks amazing with my height, but the sleeves make it unwearable. For an XL, it should fit. I do not have ginormous arms of a weightlifter.

review_summary: I usually wear a M/L. I d

The sleeves come down to my wrists, and the shoulder seam ends right at my shoulder. The upper arm is a bit tight, so I feel like I have to be careful not to move too fast or raise my arms too high. I took a picture so you could see better, it's as if the sleeve is the same width the whole way down, which means the forearm is baggy and the top is tight, which looks nice, it just feels a little tight. I get what people mean too about the hips being a bit snug. I had just enough room for the fabric to flow around my hips, but not much, and at times it does seem to feel snug when you move around. With that said, I think if you're measurements are close to mine, M is still better, because the L blouses seem to be too baggy. The length is perfect and I think this will look great layered. So glad to find more blouses that I can wear as a tall lady.

Very cute design, but fabric is very cheap, the kind that pulls and snags easily and then leaves a long run on a garment (kind of like snagged pantyhose). This didn't bother me so much though it was the snagged and short threads on the seams of the garment that looked the worst. Wherever there is a seam where you can see the stitching on the outside of the garment (like on the button band straight down the front), there were tiny snags and gathers and puckers in the thread. It is the effect you see on either a poorly made garment or an extremely old garment that has been washed so many times, the thread starts to fall apart and disintegrate. If you only planned on wearing this top underneath a sweater, you wouldn't notice the poor construction. If you plan on wearing it by itself, this might be pretty noticeable. Also, since I don't recall anyone complaining about this before, it's possible I just got a damaged top. Either way, I will be returning this item.

BUY THIS.

review_summary: I hope more tshirts in th

review_summary: This is a great T! It's j

review_summary: This is a great top. The
review_text: This is a great top. The cut is really nice and flattering. The reviews had me a little confused as to what size I should get so I got the Medium and the Large (I'm normally a Small). Honestly, I could have worn either, but I'm sticking with the Medium. It is more fitted on me and I prefer that to the bagginess of the Large. The armholes on the Medium are just right, a little snug, but there is stretch. Note: On the Large, the armholes were loose, but still comfortable on me. I provided some photos that might help. I'm wearing the Medium on the left and in the top right photos (it was a little baggy tucked into a skirt). I'm wearing the Large in the bottom right photo.  There were concerns about the length in some reviews. On me, the banded bottom of the Medium is 5.5 inches from my natural waist. The Large was a little over 6 inches. If you raise your arms at all, the top will ride up, that's just a given. If you want to wear it with jeans and not have to wear an undershirt, I would recommend sizing up.

The unusual sleeve shape makes it great to throw on on a day when I want to be comfy, but wear something just a little more special than an ordinary tshirt. The fabric was super soft when I received it as well, which is always nice.

All in allthe price is worth is as the quality is thinbut great and it is just so darn cute! I may try it with a pencil skirt!

The thin fabric and short length wouldn't have bothered me if there'd been shape to this shirt, but that was just the final straw. The overall effect was no better than your standard cheap crew neck tshirt. Not worth the price charged. Back it goes.

review_summary: I'd been looking for a de
review_text: I'd been looking for a decent mustardy yellow (instead of neon) cardigan for a while, and this definitely fit the bill. The color is not quite as bright/saturated as the photos show (as tends to be the case with ModCloth photos of yellow things in particular), but honey leaning towards mustard is a pretty good description. It is a cute shape and seems to be well made, but has a few key differences from the sweaters I'm used to:First off, the material is pretty thin.  This is actually ok  it's not a quality issue, but it definitely makes it better for a daytime/sun cover up than a warmer layer for evening.Second, the fabric is actually a little bit shiny, if that makes any sense. I'm used to cardigans being fairly matte and fuzzy, but this uses a thread/yarn with a bit of a sheen to it... makes for an interesting textural contrast.The sleeves are shorter than I was expecting (and I do NOT have long arms) and the fit is a bit snug  the buttons definitely pull a bit across my chest, but I don't tend to close my cardis anyway.Overall, I like this as a really nice, feminine cardigan (as opposed to the more boxy boyfriend styles that seem to be everywhere these days). It's a little pricey for the quality and weight, but it's a hard to find shape/color combo, so worth it for me!

The quality is superb, the color is rich and the fit is more flattering than I thought a cardigan was capable of being. You won't regret purchasing this cardigan!

review_summary: I'm very happy with how t
review_text: I'm very happy with how this top turned out. The overall length and sleeve length is just right for me. There is a good amount of room around the bust, which works for me because I am planning on wearing a light cami underneath.
White fabric is much cheaper and thinner than it appears in photos. Also was several inches too short for me. Not a shirt for tall girls! Sending back.

review_summary: Could have gone for a sma

Didn't fit asWell asI'd hoped had to return
Love the collar and ruffles on this!
Ehh... was much more fitted than I thought it would be, and the collar seems larger too. Cute idea though!!

review_summary: Good fit, a little big in
review_text: Good fit, a little big in the waist though, but all together, very nice and super cozy!
I had high expectations for this shirt. Sadly I'm returning because I doesn't have much stretch and is too short and awkward for my body.
Heavier material than expected; very nice quality. Sleeves are a bit on the long side and the shirt itself feels a size larger than it is. Hoping it'll shrink a bit. Super cute shirt
It's a nice, sturdy, thick top. VERY cute!
Love this top!

review_summary: I love this shirt it?s ve
review_text: I love this shirt it?s very comfortable and looks great for work!

Beautiful shirt tiny bit smaller then I would like but that's OK. Holy tiny arm!. I'm going to have to take it to my seamstress and have her undo the selves so my arms can fit. If you have ANY muscle on your arms shy away from this one unless you want to pay to have your seamstress undo the sleeves.

The arms on this shirt were way too tight.  At first they seemed okay but was hard to move around in.  The tight arms also made it hard to take this shirt off.  Wanted this top to work but the design in the arms was not right.  I returned it.

I'm so in love with this top that when I accidentally shrunk it in the dryer  I went immediately online and replaced it! I intend to be much more careful with the second one (everyone out there  be safe with rayon ok) and if it had not still been available in my size, I would have been heartbroken that I only got to wear it once!

I love the feel and look of this top! The only problem is it does run a tad big, so I wish I had sized down, but it is final sale so I knew I was taking a gamble. However I think it will look great tucked into a skirt for work or tucked into jeans for a casual look.
Color was listed as navy. Super see thru in pastel blue. Fabric has a strange texture and fit is boxy, wide, and short. Not a fan, though I wanted to be!

I don't know how this shirt is not selling out.  I literally bought a second one because I wore the first one too much.  It's adorable, neat feminie feature in the collar.  You can dress it up for work or pair it with nice jeans.
Very cute, fabric leaves a bit to be desired. It can be opaque or see through, based on the lighting.
Simple and adorable. If you like flowy, soft and comfortable shirts I highly recommend this one, especially for the price.

I ordered this hoping to pair it with a cute skirt, but even though the neckline and sleeves are adorable and perfect for dressing up a tshirt, the shirt from the boobs down was too shapeless on me to work, looking at least a size or two bigger than the top part of the shirt. It's also a thin material and draped nicely but it was just too baggy, even with a belt. If it were fitted just a little through the waist it would have been perfect, but alas, for me it's going back.

Definitely this is the top you won't want to take off during the super hot days or throughout all summer! You can also wear it with a light cardi or denim jacket. God material, vibrant colors and I just love everything about this piece!
Beautiful shirt, just not flattering for me. I thought it would drape nicely and hid an imperfect belly. But is more sheer than I thought so it isn't hiding anything.

Typically I'm a snug fit in a size large and the size chart was consistent with what I normally wear. The top I received is easily a size larger, my bust measurement is 39 and I'm sure a medium would fit with room to spare. I'm definately going to exchange for a smaller size.
This was super boxy on me.  The material is also rather stiff.  Sending it back.
I thought the material was great but as much as I loved it, it was so large! It has super stretch and I got a 1X. I have 40DD boobies and I wish I had gotten a large or an XL instead!
Not for me... definitely too tight for a curvy girl with a bust. Nice quality but def returned.

review_summary: I think this is a really
review_text: I think this is a really cute top, but not exactly what I was expecting. It's definitely more of the length of a crop top, and the knit is pretty loose, and it's pretty see through! Not the best quality in terms of material, it doesn't feel as much like a sweater as I thought it was, which might be good for warmer weather if you want something more synthetic rather than heavy.

review_summary: Cute design but SO see through!
review_text: You must wear a bra or something else under this top! You could see everything, I thought like, why wear a shirt? I returned because I thought it would be an opaque shirt, but some people might like that. Also had a sweater texture, which some people might like, but I didn't.

I bought this for layering over tanks and tees at work and it will not disappoint. The collar, sleeve and keyhole make it more interesting than just a plain longsleeve shirt. The material feels soft and strong and the V neck is flattering. Somewhat sheer, but not as sheer as it appears in the pictures.

I like this top a lot. It clings enough to be formflattering. Right now I'm a large in tops, but I go this in a medium and it *almost* works,  so I'd say it runs a little large. I'm shortwaisted, and this top, like most, is too lowcut on me, but I'll wear a tank or cami under it. Love the color, and the neck has a little ruche or twist that gives it a stylish look.

review_summary: It is kinda small so I su
review_text: It is kinda small so I suggest you order a size up
I adore this top. It's flattering and comfortable.

Bought this top to go with a few solid pattern skirts.  The pattern is very cute and overall the top fits pretty well.  As others have mentioned, the arm holes are quite large.  I wouldn't have kept the top if I had to pay someone to take in the arm holes, but since my mom is a great seamstress who will do it for free, it wasn't a big deal.  I am not a fan of the tie in back of the shirt, and am just cutting it off; since I plan to wear it mostly tucked in with skirts, the waistband will do the same cinching as the tie.  Overall a nice top, and I'm looking forward to wearing it for a long time, but only worth it if you can fix the arm holes on the cheap.

I returned this shirt. The shoulder width was great, but the body of the shirt was too loose and baggy for me. I thought about sizing down, but decided a smaller shoulder width would look silly. The print is so cute in person, just like in the picture!

This is my first purchase from Modcloth along with some cardigans.  I am very pleased.  Great top, decent fabric, nice length, does not pull anywhere.  Not too low cut where I can't wear to office.  I got in sz med.  I am a 34 DD, about 135.

review_summary: This top is cute, but I w
review_text: This top is cute, but I would say not a must have.  It is true that the buttons don't gap (if you have a larger bust), the bust darts are well placed and that it creates a flattering shape.  I am on the fence about the flutter sleeves, but like this overall.
Cute and flirty.
Cute top, great for work with a cami underneath

review_summary: Terrible fit on me. Way t
review_text: Terrible fit on me. Way too large in the chest and snug at the waist. Return.

I really love this shirt, it can be dressed up or dressed down. It is very girly. You can wear it year round. I thought based on the photo that the back ground was white but it is a very light mint green. So much prettier in person than the photos.

review_summary: This is a perfect piece f

I was worried the fabric would be uncomfortable, but I've had no issues with it so far. #ReviewContest
Very flattering, lovely print, great quality fabric. Love it!
Very pretty and girly. Runs true to size!
Cute!

review_summary: This top works for me pai
review_text: This top works for me paired with the school style white cardigan for work.   It creates a nice waistline and the busy colors work with covering any problem areas.  I do recommend this for work or even cute with capris or jeans.
I have broad shoulders so I was a little worried about how this would fit but it was perfect! Looks great with anything!

I purchased this from the Modcloth IRL in Portland. Actually, I tried the coral color and it fit perfectly. This colorway fits smaller and has a deeper vneck, which is extremely annoying. The colors are great and the overall cut is perfect, so I'll hang on to it
Fits well with skinny jeans

review_summary: This top has been one of
review_text: This top has been one of my favourite Modcloth purchases to date. It's just a little on the roomy side, but I don't mind because it makes the top more comfortable. Looks lovely tucked in with a skirt, or with dark wash jeans. I'd definitely recommend it and am considering buying it in another print.
This shirt is RIDICULOUSLY flattering. It has excellent shape, accentuates the hips in an excellent way. I wish I could rate it higher than 5 stars!
Loved this top! Looks great and is super flattering!

I wasn't really sure what to expect when I got this, but it exceeded whatever lack of expectation I had. The colors are very nice and pretty true to the photos Modcloth has. The fit, for me, was TTS. I got a small and it fits perfectly (32C2639). It is definitely cropped, so it will pair nicely with all of my highwaisted skirts and pants. The material is nice and light, good for warm weather. I'm definitely glad I got this.

review_summary: I was a little nervous ab
review_text: I was a little nervous about purchasing a crop top, since I don't have the kind of figure usually considered a prerequisite, but this one is so flattering and pretty. The material is soft and the colors are beautiful, just like in the photos. The only issue, as you can see from my second picture, is that the top seems to be cut for a smaller bust than mine (34D), since the seam under the arm shows my bra and doesn't sit under the bust line. I'd therefore recommend sizing up if you have a larger bust.

review_summary: Probably not best if you are large chested.
review_text: I recently purchased this sweater in a sale. I knew going in that it was going to be short but I didn't realize it would stop right under my bust. I'm going to try wearing it with a minimizing bra in the hopes that I can get some wear out of it. The quality is very nice and it would look adorable over a dress or a skirt. The blue is a nice shade as well. I just wish my chest didn't take up so much of the fabric.

The blue/cream combo is great, and while the fabric itself isn't very soft, it is still a comfortable top to wear. I was surprised to find the sleeves were long enough for my monkey arms, and the bottom of the sweater went landed just below my belly button.  I don't wear a lot of highwaisted bottoms, so for me this is mostly a casual top to wear around the house or places where showing my midriff would be okay.  The weave is on the loose side, so probably wouldn't work in a conservative setting without a layer underneath.

review_summary: if only this sweater could be 5 longer...
review_text: This sweater was 2 above my belly button! It's super cute, and maybe if I was 20 yrs old and just by looking at food didn't give me bloat, then yeah, i'd rock it, but sadly that's not the case anymore. Seriously, can they make this sweater in a longer version?
I had really high hopes for this and was so disappointed. The quality is great but the fit is terrible! Super full yet short  it looked 100% like a maternity top, just way too much fabric.
Not for bustier gals. Take my word for it! The fit would be perfect for a girl my size but with a smaller chest.
I loved the color of this top, and the quality was better than I expected, but it's waaaay to short. Too much belly exposed, even with my highest waisted jeans. Sadly returning.

I don't normally wear crop tops but this one looked cute so I thought I'd give it a try. I'm sure it would look cute on the right person, but it made my chest look bigger than it already is and I wan't feeling it. Fabric was nice though  in both color and texture.
Very cute!  Love the color!  It sits a little higher on my belly than I'd like but it's a cute piece.
I normally get a Medium in Modcloth sweaters and had to get a Large in this one. The material was a bit scratchy at first but softened after a wash.

I just got this sweater today and I ordered a 2x because other reviewers said it runs small.  I normally wear a 1x... I actually probably need a 3 or 4x in this style because it runs extremely small.  The 2x is about a size 14/16 I would say.  Just a heads up if you plan to order, go up a size or two.  Other than that, it is super soft and comfy and adorable!

I have several of this style sweater produced by Modcloth, and I love them all! The material doesn't shrink in the wash, and is thick enough to be comfortable but not suffocatingly hot. I have short arms, so the sleeves are a little longer than the 3/4 length shown, but still work for me. I also like this sweater because the dark blue hems make it look layered when it's not. And the design is cute and unique. The only thing I could complain about is that these sweaters (the Modcloth line of these style, at least) run a bit small, because usually I'm an M, but I have to order an L in these otherwise they show my pudge too much. I like it though, I'm looking to get the others of this collection. This is basically like the Snazzy Saurus sweater but different colors/design.

review_summary: This did not fit like a l
review_text: This did not fit like a large. I wanted an oversized sweater look, it fits me very well. It's a little tight. I think I will have to refrain from drying it. But it is very well made!!

The material is really soft. Unfortunately for me, the Medium was too short and the Large was too big in the sleeves (pictured: Large). I'm usually a small or medium in cotton tops, so if you're the same and have a shorter torso, I definitely think the colors, feel, and image on this shirt would be worth a try!

review_summary: So pretty, but sleeves were way too long for me.
review_text: I loved this blouse.  It was soft, the colors were very pretty, the ties were just right, it was a light airy material (i.e. see through) but the sleeves were way too long for me.  I tried to adjust with the arm ties thinking I could shorten the sleeves by creating a puff on the upper arm, and you guessed it, that looked ridiculous! So back to Modcloth this gorgeous top goes, for someone who is much taller than me.

review_summary: Like it even more in person
review_text: It's more of a cream/ivory in person, with white lace overlay. Beautiful and a great length.
I have trouble finding tops that are long enough, so this is perfect. It's flattering and cute. It is pretty dressy, too.
This is such a sweet cardi, I love it! Bought it in medium and is just right. The contrasting colours and knit of this top make it so special, great for the summer!

I ordered this in XS along with the same cardigan in navy blue. It really seems like this one ran small compared to the other one (or maybe the navy ran large?). I'm in the process of exchanging it for a larger size, and I hope it works out because I adore the colors and stripes on this sweet little sweater! Also, I didn't find it very itchy like the other reviewer commented; actually, I found it quite soft  though of course I haven't worn it for a full day or washed it yet.
I loooove this cardigan! It's extremely soft and comfortable! I like that you can pair it with 3 different colors depending on the look you want. Super cute!
It's got very pretty colors and is so soft.  It's meant to be a little big, but the cut is flattering.
Soft. Flowy. Shorter than it looks. Great bright image on front

review_summary: Finally have a shirt to match my shorts!
review_text: Soft, and just the right amount of baggy. And the colors go with my patterned shorts perfectly!

review_summary: This top felt more like a
review_text: This top felt more like a pajama top, comfy material, but the fit looked unflattering on me (I'm busty). Returned it.
My new favorite top! Hits a little higher on me than I thought, but looks great. The material in a little thin, but not see through or anything. A great buy! Very girlie ;)

review_summary: I'm just too hippy for a
review_text: I'm just too hippy for a peplum top. I did think it was going to hit a little lower down my thigh but it hit me just under my hips.

I love the fit and the stretch to this garment. It is soft and drapes nicely without being loose or baggy. I did size down to a large. I ordered an extra large previously and it was too big. Usually, I need an XL so the fit on this garment is generous.

review_summary: So Happy I Bought This Top!
review_text: The popsicle top was more of a splurge for me and I almost didn't buy it.  Even on sale I thought it was a little high at $29.99 sale price, but I am a sucker for a novelty print + cute detailing so the fashion lust won out.  I purchased the 1X and it fits PERFECTLY.  I am busty and my waist is NOT small, but it is still comfortable and floaty.  Material was very wrinkled when it arrived, but 5 minutes on the low dryer cycle fixed that and it is wearing very well throughout the day without wrinkling back up.  Fabric weight is wonderful for this hot Georgia weather!  I paired it with an electric blue Aline skirt and nude flats and have gotten many compliments.

I get a lot of compliments on this top! It's very cute and I think true to size. I normally wear it out, not tucked in and it is a little poufy on the bottomit's certainly not form fittingbut it is super comfy. Comfort and cute all in one top!  I always order a size up (or sometimes 2) on this site, because I believe ALL Modcloth items run small.

I really love the shirt. The length is perfect for tucking in, but not so long that you can't wear it otherwise. Not too loose. The material is thin, so I worry about how it will hold up long term, but so far no issues.

I immediately fell in love with the vibrant print as soon as I saw it online! When it came in the mail, I was very pleased to that the color was as bright as it had been in the ad. After trying it on, I found the fabric was not only super light, but surprisingly soft and comfortable! The only con I've found so far is that the tie/ribbon can come undone when there is tons of friction (I wear a small messenger bag that rubbed against the front of it), but this was easily fixed with a double knot. Overall the color and feel of the shirt was amazing! The length is good, but since I am a little on the short side (5' 2), most things run a smidgen big anyway.

review_summary: I love this top! It's ver
review_text: I love this top! It's very light, and it's neither too long nor too short. I also like the depth of the neckline and the little tie. Only con  a bit prone to wrinkle.

I was hoping everyone else in the reviews was wrong, but they weren't. This is the most ugly cardigan anyone will ever own lol. It is scratchy and even looks scratchy if that's a thing. I can not imagine what I will ever wear this with sadly
The colors are just like what the pictures show, but it feels a bit itchy when I first put it on

review_summary: If a stoplight was a sweater
review_text: I'm usually an 8/10 in dresses and a M/L in tops. I bought the L of this sweater and found that it fit well, but the colors were *really* bright in person. I felt like a party clown in this, and not in a good way.

This shirt didn't really look like it did in the picture. It was a little darker in real life and the stitching was a shade of gold that I did not love. The arm holes were small but the shirt itself was boxy and long. Sending it back for a refund.
I bought this last week and was excited to wear it! It fits true to size, with the arms being a little small but doable. I got several compliments on this shirt when I wore it too!

review_summary: Lost Opportunity   too tight in the arms!
review_text: So I bought this on Final Sale.  The fabric is thicker than I anticipated.  The flare out at the bottom is pretty substantial.  But the sleeves were WAY too tight!  Honestly, if you have super skinny arms and are looking for a maternity shirt, this would probably be perfect.

I think I ordered the wrong size 'cause the xs was a bit tight on me but since I like the way it looks, it should be ok :D Love the colors and the details of the straps in the back, also the lace in the front and it's great with and without a cardi for hot & cooler days. I found it kinda pricey for the quality tho', but definitely a keeper!

The pattern is really cute. I was worried about the cut  sometimes the lace at the top cuts my boobs in half and makes them look weird, but that isn't an issue with this top. The fabric is super thin, I actually almost tore it while I was trying it on. Also, the back doesn't lay as nicely as it does on the model, but that could be because I should have sized up.Overall,  I got it on sale, so it's fine, but I would not have been pleased if I bought it at full price.
The print is adorable. Good to wear on its own, or under a cardi. If you have a longer torso however,  keep in mind that it is a tad short.

I love this top! The pattern is nice, and it is flattering to wear. The only complaint I have is that it is a little shorter than I'd like it. This may be something to consider before purchasing if you have a long torso like me.
Very adorable, somehow it's much cuter in person. The fit is great, very flattering. Very cute but with an edge

Love this shirt! The print and cut are so cute. Fabric is light and silky. Fits so well (I have a short torso though, so not sure how this would work on a longer torso). I think the shirt has more shape than picture shows and I like a lot better than I thought I would.

review_summary: Professional top with a fun design!
review_text: Often peplum tops don't work for me as I'm longwaisted.  This one is long enough that the peplum seam still hits around the right spot.  Looks great with skinny work pants.  Runs small, so I'm glad I bought the medium, as I usually wear a S or XS.  Made of a lightweight material that is still durable enough that you can't see through it.

review_summary: I love this top! I normal

I was meh about this from the pictures. I generally look good in peplum tops and have a small frame but I was afraid this would be too boxy. Nope. Jesus, this one was so stinking cute it may be my new favorite.
Really love this top. The length of the straps is a bit long but nothing a simple alteration can't fix.

Just bought this top and its so adorable perfect length too.

I had been looking and looking and finally bought this top. I am so glad I took the plunge. review_summary: I have this top in 3 prin
