Nice, basic top. Nothing that special but if you're looking for a nice, soft top to wear with leggings etc. this is great!
Great basic top. Fantastic with leggings and boots.

This is my third purchase of these Freeloader brand tees.  I have two of the tshirts (Yours Chill the End) in size M.  I ordered both a M and a S in this longsleeve tshirt, and I ended up keeping the S.  Yes, the back does come down far, but that is the intention in this style (the long and short sleeve tshirts both have this feature).  The fabric is so luxurious, so soft!  The fabric is tshirt thin, so I would consider this a layering piece.  I love it!
The perfect tunic to wear with leggings. It covers what needs to be covered and fabric is lovely.
This shirt does run large! But not so much that I feel it warrants a return. it will be great as a layer for my dresses this winter.

Amazing basic top. I want one in every colour and I want to tell everyone I know about how amazing this top is. It's so soft and comfortable but still makes you look great whether you're trying to dress it down or up! Going to go look for more colours!

review_summary: not quite as long as I wa
review_text: not quite as long as I was hoping, but very soft and comfortable!

LOVE THESE SHIRTS! I have this shirt in 3 different colors now. I am normally a size small on ModCloth but I went with an extra small for this color since they were out of stock in my size. The sleeves are the perfect length, (the colors I have in small the sleeves are a little long but nothing to complain about) Definitely a great layering piece for fall especially with flannel. Will probably continue buying in other colors.

review_summary: I love this top. I want t

Thin and breathable, but not see through. I always push the sleeves up because they're awkwardly shaped like bell bottoms. I was worried after reading reviews that dye from the shirt turned people's skin, but I haven't had that problem at all. I want to order twenty more of these!! #reviewcontest

review_text: Love it.  Very soft and close fitting without being tight. I want to sleep it in it!

Great casual wear. I have had it for a few months now and it IS starting to pill, so be gentle with your wash and cautious with regular wear.

Super comfy. Add leggings and boots for a put together look that feels like pajamas. Definitely on the looser side.

review_summary: For me, the sizing was al
review_text: For me, the sizing was all wrong.  I'm usually between a M and a L, but this was huge. Soft and comfortable and I may exchange for a S, but it's going back.
This is my favorite shirt that I own. The cut is very flattering, it is long without being frumpy and the vneck isn't too deep. I'm planning on buying one in every color.
My new favorite shirt! It is flowy and beautiful. It matches with everything.
Love the style, the length was a little long for me. Otherwise a great shirt
My new favorite shirt! It's soft,  slinky and super flattering.  I loved it so much that I bought two more in other colors.

Love this fit! The material is super soft and breathable. It's perfect for work attire that can go out for drinks after.
Cool and comfortable .  I tied it low instead of at the neck.  Happy with my purchase.
Cute too, nice stretchy material, but the strings have to go. Will alter to remove. If you are smallbusted I'm sure it's ok. But for me the strings are too constraining and don't look good tied.

As a life long tshirt and jeans girl, I'm now trying to brach out and try new things in my wardrobe. This shirt is perfect for that first step! I found that this fit pretty true to size (I ordered a Small). As most clothes fit on me, it is a little big in the chest. However, the whole fit of the shirt is slightly oversized, so it's not very noticeable and doesn't make me self conscious. It does wrinkle easily, but it's not a big deal. Very comfy to wear on a warm day, very light weight.  Overall, I really do love it and plan to wear this until it's too cold to do so.

review_summary: I bought this on sale and
review_text: I bought this on sale and didn't read the review until after. The last review I read said it ran way small. I was nervous because it was on sale I wouldn't be able to return it for a larger size if it didn't fit. When it came in, I was pleasantly surprised. That being said, I wore it for a few hours today and found that the buttons come undone quite easily! It's is a crop top, but I wear high waisted jeans with it and it's perfect. review_text: I love this top. It's perfect tucked into jeans. I did end up removing the elastic from the bottom of the sleeves because my upper arms are a little thicker and it just wasn't doing it for me. Great shirt though. Highly recommend.

This kind of boxy polyester shirt needs to have gone out of style yesterday. The blouse is a fine length but it's wide, and the fabric has no weight at all to make it drape nicely. I sized up to an S, which is a good fit in the shoulders, but an XS wouldn't make enough of a difference to make this shirt wearable. Maybe taking in the side seams will. I'm keeping it because yes, the print is lovely.Like other reviewers, I thought the sleeves were silly. They weren't uncomfortably tight on me, but the elastic pulled them up into frumpy little poofs on my upper arms. The stylist must have taken the elastic out for the photos  that's what I did to get this more relaxed look.

Bought this blouse because I've had my eye on it for a while and I am a little disappointed. The color is closer to cream than ivory. Even with a nude bra on, I need to wear an undershirt with it because it is sheer. The cut of the blouse follows the current block shape trend, so it's not as flattering for every body shape (especially if you have a long torso like me or are busty). It looks well enough tucked into a skirt but I wouldn't dare wear it with pants as suggest by the photos given by Modcloth.I love the floral pattern and colors, and have received many compliments on it. The ruffles around the shoulders are absolutely darling, but the sleeves themselves are awkward and constraining. The mouth of the sleeves has a harsh elastic that causes me to worry for those of us with sensitive skin or thicker arms.

If you're hoping to match this with something, think again!It's definitely more of a tan or dark cream colour than ivory. It's very short, and the elastic cuffs on the sleeves could be irritating if you don't have thin arms. Slightly transparent, but not terrible with a nude bra.
I liked the material and pattern, but I don't have very skinny arms and the elastic in the sleeves was too tight.  I had to return this, unfortunately.
I bought this blouse for the unique sleeve, but unfortunately the sleeves are tight. I wear a L and my arms aren't enormous  I rarely have a hard time with sleeves. Otherwise the quality was decent.

review_summary: This top is as adorable a
review_text: This top is as adorable as it looks in the pictures. I love the collar + button combo makes the top very unique. It obviously requires something underneath it due to its sheerness, but I expected that. I paired it with long shorts and loved it. I have a very short torso and a large chest, and the 2x was pretty flowy on me (see my measurements to compare to yourself), but I hate formfitting clothing. Love, love this.

Cute top.  I bought navy blue.  Nice and sturdy stretch to fabric, good fabric thickness and the navy is not at all seethrough.  I am petite so the length is great on me, but if you are tall then you might find it to be a short hemline.  I might buy the other colors.

review_summary: Who Wants to Be the Next Floppy Squid?
review_text: The ruffles run from the front to the back in one continuous line. It looked too weird when I looked at it from the side, so I'm returning it. It would probably look nice in a vacuum, but I don't live in one, and I don't feel like adjusting my clothes all day.

This was just not a good look, as it turned out. The ruffle reminded me so much of a sea slug that I couldn't quite get the image out of my brain. Even worse, the ruffles in the back brushed against my arms every time I moved. It was a very weird and not particularly pleasant sensation. The quality of the garment was fine and the color seemed similar to the picture. It's possible that this would look better on someone with a smaller bust, although I'm not sure how the back ruffle thing would work for anyone.

This is cute but it didn't dress up as much as I needed it to for work. I also think being larger chested causes this lay too low on the chest, making it kinda ruin the feminine quality with too much cleavage, I could probably size down to bring the vneck up some but I decided like I said it didn't work for work. Very soft and seems like good quality.

review_summary: Love the fit and way it l
review_text: Love the fit and way it looks feels great on in the cotton and looks great for work or casual

I love this tank top. It's my new go to, I'll order it in every color once more come out. It is pretty at the top with the pleat details and doesn't hug on my stomach where I don't want it.  The only reason I gave it a 4 star is the fabric is super soft and thin, which is nice, but I somehow mess up shirts like this easy. But is still buy it either way.

review_summary: I really like this top. S
review_text: I really like this top. Soft material. My only complaint is that it's very long but I can fold it under & it works.
I don't like the fabric as well on this. I should have read the description more carefully.
Shirt fits well and looks nice but can get very wrinkly. Not a good plan to pack this in a suitcase. But it's thin and not shear and good for summer weather.

review_summary: Love the Fabric and the Detail
review_text: However, the color is much more dark with a greenish tinge than what appears in the photo online.  It looks good with my coloring so it ended up being a win.

I'm usually a 3X or 4X in tops and I bought this in 4X because I wanted it to be loose.  It is, it fits perfectly, is a great length and the arm holes are not gigantic!!  I wish this came in more colors, I would buy them!
Love love love!!! This was the perfect length and flowed just right.  I wore it with Black Leggings and Classic chucks for the perfect, errand running day! ??
This shirt is super cute and unique! It's very small so size up! It zips down the side and the fabric doesn't have any give to it. I love this shirt!

review_summary: The fit was perfect but t
review_text: The fit was perfect but the whole look was a bit much. My husband loved the shirt and how it fit, but the poofy shoulders and the bow and the busy print made for an overthetop look that made me feel a little loud.

review_summary: Fun, unique top, but runs small
review_text: This top is super fun and unique, but it runs very small  I always order up when in doubt (I fit between S/M) and am glad I did in this case  when it arrived I thought it was a small! It's cut well enough that it still sits right, so I don't personally feel the need to exchange sizes. But keep this in mind if you run between sizes. Also, the capped sleeves are a wee bit poofier than in the photo, but I'm hoping they'll relax a bit after I wash.

Cute, but returning because it doesn't quite work for my professional wardrobe. A little low on the side arm holes, though it does not show my bra. A little too low in front for work. Keyhole in back was odd construction and a little saggy. The higher you pulled the front up, the more saggy the keyhole. Torso fit nicely without being too baggy or too snug. Soft fabric, not see through. Pretty color and I liked the ruffles and how the fell.

I bought the navy in a large and was very pleased with this shirt. I debated about an xl, but the ruffles really do camouflage all my trouble spots like back of the bra, love handles, and belly. The navy was on the lighter side, more like a denim color, which will be great for summer...and denim! The armholes and the front vee are not too deep making this a great staple to dress up or down. I also like the tie feature at the back of the neck, which I did not register seeing when I bought it. Very pleased! If you are between sizes, though, I would suggest sizing up.

review_summary: The larger sizes look nothing like the photo
review_text: I was so excited to see this design in plus sizes and commensurately disappointed when I saw the top in person. The ruffle isn't scaled proportionately to the sizing, so instead of a ruffle with a seam cutting down midbust and the edge of the ruffle flaring to the edge of the tee, it's just a tiny ruffle poking out like I'm wearing suspenders meant for toddlers. This is not how you scale plus sizes.

I loved everything about this shirt.  The cut was nice, the colors are amazing.  I wore it for a few hours, and noticed threads started to come undone from the shirt.  The shirt wasn't too small, nor was I busting out of it.  I'm fully confident if it was stuck in the washer, it would get torn apart.

So I was really liking this shirt when I saw it online. Was a fun print. Got it in the mail today tried it on fits a little bigger than I was expecting. The one thing I dislike that wasn't noticeable in the photos where that this fabric has a pretty serious sheen almost an iridescent quality to it that I'm not totally into.
Colors are just as shown.  Love the feel of the material and the vintage look of the pattern.  Overall happy with the purchase.

I ordered this on a whim when it was on sale, and was surprised by how adorable, cute, and soft this top was! It fits perfectly tucked into high waited shorts, skirts, etc. Its incredible soft and flowy in a nonclingy way. The arm holes are not too big and my bra doesn't show and material is thick enough that you dont need a cami underneath  which is a definite plus!

I wasn't expecting an amazing product when I ordered this, I just wanted a cute summery tank top the was a step above the ones I have, so I didn't have to wear a tshirt every day. The colors are bright without being obnoxiously loud and colorful. And the yellow is more of a golden yellow than mustard, which I like because I hate mustard colored things. And regular mustard. The peephole tie adds a cute touch and isn't too immodest or anything. This can also be casual or fancier, depending on the bottom you wear and if you wear a cardigan over it or something, which is great. The only complaint I have is that I has smaller shoulders, so the shoulders on this look a little bit longer than a widestrapped tank top, but shorter than a shortsleeved tshirt, if that makes sense. Not weird enough looking to send it back, but I wish it would have just looked like a regular lasagna strap tank. It is a little baggy, so if you're debating sizing up or down, I'd go down.

review_summary: Love the colors and print, but runs a size large
review_text: Love everything about this colorful retrolooking top except the sizing.  I wear a medium, and ordered a medium.  The fabric is very stretchy and the cut is generous.  It sagged on me a bit, and I had plenty of extra room in the waist and hip.  I love the cut, and it looks adorable with pink shorts.  I am seriously considering exchanging for a size smaller (though I could make it work in the medium, i think it just looks a hair too sloppy on me).  My advise is size down if you want the fit to look the models.

I took a chance on this top because I love the print but I didn't want to look like my grandmother, and I am so glad I did!  I love this top! I normally order a 3x because I have a large chest, but since this top is sleeveless I went with a 2x and honestly, I probably could have gone with a 1x because this top is very stretchy. But I like the way it fits at a 2x so I'm keeping it. It doesn't have an arm gap and the length hits me right at the hips so it covers up my stomach. The photos show it as a tank but my sleeves are more like cap sleeves but that doesn't bother me. My one gripe is that because it's got a lot of stretch,  the keyhole opening in the front tends to expose my bra if I move certain ways.
This shirt is beautiful! It's a little loose, which is my preference, so if you like a tighter fit I'd recommend sizing down. This shirt is so soft!

Very soft and comfy! Bought this in swimmers in XS. The fit is quite loose through the top, but I think to go down a size would make it too tight across the hips for me. Button holes are quite big, so am going to put a couple of stitches in there to prevent the buttons casually popping undone at inappropriate moments!

review_summary: Cute and perfect for work or casual
review_text: I now have two Cafe au Soleil tops, the phone pattern and one with fishes. They are so comfortable. I love the cotton fabric, which is a little heavier than some of the other cotton tips I have purchased, so it feels nice and silky. It drapes perfectly, doesn't have any boxiness.
Love it! Soft, comfortable, suitable for work/nonwork. Armholes not too big for me, perfect fit.

I purchased three of these top:  sailboat striped, swimmers, and telephones.  They are all slightly tight around my hips, but I bought mediums and should expect that.  The sailboat print shirt seems cut slightly smaller, as it gaps a bit at the buttons; but I can sew it closed so it is not so much a big deal considering how inexpensive it is at the sale price.  Shirts looked good untucked and tucked, and with or without a cardi (I also bought the charter school cardi in indigo to go with the sailboats and the swimmers and it pairs very well with both).  Very pleased and would recommend this top.
I loved this at first but unfortunately, it shrunk.  I have two of these tops and both have shrunk even though I washed on cold and did not use a dryer.
It's even better in person, colours are very pretty and the fit is perfect. Love it!

Beautiful shirt, good fit. I ordered the black and didn't experience any of the bra showing problems the previous review mentioned. It hits right at the waist so if you're looking for something long enough to tuck in this may not be it. Overall very happy with this purchase.

I just received this shirt and it was not nearly as opaque as what the models are wearing. It's clear that they are wearing a white shirt underneath, but even where the shirt overlaps the jeans it was pretty seethrough. The texture of the shirt is a little rough and I found the stretchiness of the shoulders to be too tight, but the fit of the shirt was overall good. I wish it were slightly longer.

review_summary: I love this top! It is in
review_text: I love this top! It is incredibly flattering and cute. I only wore it a couple of times before my sunscreen stained it. I think I am going to try and dye it because the cut is just too good. Very good quality, it has held up to my repeated attempts to remove the stains in the wash.
The frilly ruffles didn't lay flat and looked weird. Would only work with a very high wasted bottom.

This is a fantastic summer top. It has a very 70's vibe to it, and the waist ties cinch you in at just the right place! Bought this in medium, it is a slightly looser fit, but the ties make it more fitted if you so choose. I've worn this with the Stay Sweet Cardigan in Coral(like the model) It is a proper clash of patterns but it really works! Another winner Modcloth!

Very happy with this purchase! I love the pattern and colors. Looks just as pictured. The size large fit perfectly. I also bought the similar patterned Best and Brightest Tank Top in Floral in a medium and that fit just right.
Super cute. Of course! lol goes perfect with poppy tieks
I've been buying blouses for work here and have been pretty pleased. I wear a 2x and this top seems a bit snug around the waist. Colors are vibrant and fun.

review_summary: Had to take this blouse i
review_text: Had to take this blouse in and have the elastic in the back taken in by many inches. I think it could have been built adjustable and would have made it an amazing shirt. It will be cute after it's altered.

I like this halter a lot, although I need to get a better bra with it because I've been using a strapless and it keeps falling down, which in turn makes me have to hike everything up all the time! The material is average, it kind of wrinkles a bit,. but the pattern is cute and it's very comfortable. It is a little longer in the back like the previous reviewer said, but I don't notice it all that much and I like that it covers my butt a little bit.

review_summary: I usually wear an XL and
review_text: I usually wear an XL and this was a size too big for me. It may be perfect for those who wear 1x or XXL.

I am a fan of all things floral, so when this top made its debut I knew I had to have it. The fabric is thick yet flowy, and the waist tiein adds a bit of flair to the whole ensemble. However, as much as I love this shirt, I do not love the fit of it. The fabric in the shoulder area leading down into the neck is strangely lose compared to the rest of the shirt. Because of this, it kept bunching up around my neck when I wore it. I will be keeping the shirt, but will be putting in a little extra time and effort to fix the fabric pucker issue. Cute top, but be wary!

It is cute, the material is fine. The under arm situation is better than with the same top in Grey but still i wish they were not nearly as roomy as they are. It's a bit longer and wider than i would like it to be, but i will probably end up wearing it just around the house.
review_summary: I have mixed feeling about this top

review_text: Cute top! Buttons weren't sewed on well, but an easy fix. It's a tad snug on my hips. Although, I had a baby recently. Lots of compliments when worn!

review_summary: If you like wearing a sho
review_text: If you like wearing a shower curtain, this is the top for you. The material is awful, definitely polyester!

review_summary: The collar on this top is
review_text: The collar on this top is so beautiful! The fit is small (I'm normally an XL to 1X and the 2X fits perfectly) but the material is slightly stretchy so I can only assume it's meant to be a former fit.
Finally a top that isn't too long and fits just right!!! And I am totally diggin' the style. more like this top please, Modcloth!

review_summary: Agree with previous reviewer  too small!!
review_text: I am an XL in ModCloth sizes and ordered knowing it might fit a little snug. If I had to guess I'd say the XL is really more like a M. It's also really short. It's too bad because the shirt is super cute in person and seems to be well made.

Almost all of the tops I order from ModCloth are 2x. This top was beyond small, it was super short and fit more like a bathing or body suit than a blouse. Such a bummer since this shirt is adorable. Already starting my return. I'm not even sure a 4x would suffice.

I was waiting FOREVER for my size to come back into to stock. I'm a paleontology student, so I get everything I see with dinos on it, so I was super excited to find something fancier that met the goal. This is really pretty and a nice, silky material. But I'm a small person with shoulder length hair that can't really be styled all that much, so the bows looked large and strange, which is why I returned it. Also, the cut is loose (not baggy), so while it isn't bad looking, it doesn't flatter your figure much unless you tuck it into highwaisted bottoms, which I don't like. I got a size M, which is what I usually am in tops and dresses, so the largeness seemed strange. Also, the bows on the wrists get in the way of doing things because the wrist holes are big, so they move around. Really disappointed I waited so long for something I thought I'd love only to return it :(

review_summary: Not for a short, busty woman
review_text: I had been eyeing this top for a long time, but my size (xs) was unavailable. I guess someone must have returned their's because sure enough one day there was 1 available in my size! So naturally I got it with the utmost gusto. I was super excited for this shirt and was disappointed when it didn't fit. I thought it would work considering other reviews saying it's narrow in the shoulders. Perfect for the petite woman! But, the sleeves were too long and due to the material cannot be easily cuffed well. Another matter is that the darts did not fit me in the right spot at all! Though I am petite, I am fairly busty for someone my size, which probably caused the odd placement of the darts.

First of all  SO. STINKING. CUTE. pattern is flawless and the material of the shirt is a very professional silklike rayon. Gorgeous. I will say that it's bigger around the middle than it is across the shoulders, and I'm not wide across the shoulders, but it fits a little tight there. Sizing up would make the middle gigantic on me, so I'll make it work. Adorable and well worth the price!

review_summary: One of the Best Tops I've ever purchased!
review_text: Needless to say, the print is awesome. In addition, it fits perfectly, and it's made from a nice silky fabric! I love it so much that I wore it countless times in spring and will wear it many times in autumn for sure. The only downside is that those bows on the wrists get untied once in a while.

I love this shirt but I am so bummed that I got the wrong size! I followed the size chart but I should have gone two sizes up! It didn't even fit around my shoulders to go up for me to even try it on fully...size medium says M for bust size 3436, I am a 36 but CLEARLY it did not fit properly...so I will exchange it for a bigger size.

review_summary: ADORABLE, exactly as pictured, SUPER soft... size up
review_text: LOVE the dino print!  Both colors and pattern are exactly as pictured.  The fabric isn't as sheer as some of the reviews make it out to be, and it's SUPER soft and comfortable to have on.  The sizing is great EXCEPT for the bust... Let's just say it was gap central.  As I've never been blessed in that area, I always have the opposite problem of not filling it out enough.  However, this must be the one exception.  Especially having a smaller bust for a girl my size, I was a little surprised at how tight a fit it actually was.  So if the bust is the area you're concerned with most, I would definitely size up.  In my case, I will be exchanging for the next size up, as it was perfect everywhere else.

This top is absolutely lovely in person! I was pleasantly surprised by the thick, silky texture of the fabric. The print is absolutely adorable and just as pictured. I would definitely recommend this.

Really love the pattern and the fabric is more comfortable than I'd feared, although not especially breathable. I ordered a too large 1X because I'm busty and with buttons down the front gaping across the bust happens to me all the time. ModCloth's own brand runs large but I still didn't want to take the risk. Turns out I might have gotten away with it but I'm still happy with it being a little too big as it gets tucked into a highwaisted skirt or pants and I'm an hourglass so I can make it work.My only complaint would be the painfully stupid ties on the sleeves  they look silly and childish and spend all day trying to come undone because the fabric is silky. Luckily my mum is handy with a sewing machine and I can get her to sew them down so the sleeves look normal.

Aaaah!! This shirt is one of the best things to come from modcloth in a long time. Super cute juxtaposition of dinosaurs and work attire. Slightly tight at the shoulder blades for me (i'm somewhere between a 2x & 3x in tops), but if i'd sized up it would have been too loose, so i'm happy with it. Tons of compliments at work. Only complaint is that it's a little short. But I'm tall so it's expected and looks great with skirts.

Like everyone else, I had to wait until my size came back in stock. I could wear a XS or S, but they only had S. It's a little big (but doable), so I would recommend sizing down if you aren't super busty. The texture is silky. I love the ties and flowing quality of the shirt. The best part, though, is the print, which is wonderfully uncanny. People do a double take when they realize you are covered in dinosaurs!

I really wanted to love this shirt, I was so excited to get it. But when it arrived I was slightly disappointed. I am always between sizes m/L, so I ordered a large. It was a little too loose. The material is also polyester and I found that the cute little accent ties would not stay tied. I wanted to exchange to see if a Medium would fit better, but it sold out before I could make my exchange. It was well made, just loose fitted and slippery material.
I fell in love with this the day I saw it but it's even better in person!! The material is silklike and the print is absolutely stunning. If you're on the fence, go for it!

This blouse is even better in person, the fabric is soft and resembles silk and these dinosaurs look friggin' elegant.  Fit is great, I love the bow tied cuffs, lots of subtle colors to pair with bottoms, the whole thing is so much fun.  My only complaint is that the arm holes are a bit low  ModCloth, I know you can overcome these low arm holes so we can all have a better range of motion in these button up blouses!

Love, love, love this top! I love dinosaurs and always on the lookout for dino clothing that I can wear to work. This is perfect. The material is silkyfeeling and the colors are subdued. The shirt is a bit sheer, so you will have to compensate for that. There slight gaping around the bust area. If you are busty, I recommend sizing up.

I'm surprised at the less than stellar reviews on this top! I bought it in mauve and loved it so much, I bought the other two colors! It's so pretty yet simple. The vneck is perfect, not too high or low. I can be a small or a medium in knit tops, but usually go with a small because of my small shoulders. I think for this one I could have gone with my normal size medium because it's not stretchy, but the small isn't *too* small, just more fitted. The length is perfect! I wear these everywhere  with jeans and sandals, tucked into skirts, etc. If they make more colors, I'll buy them!

I ordered this in charcoal and mauve, both size L, and both were quite disappointing. It runs small so it was not a flattering flowy fit, but more boxy. The material for both colors is very seethrough, and overall it looks more like a pajama top than a blouse I could wear in public. I'm returning both and would not recommend purchasing these shirts.

review_summary: I love these colors and t
review_text: I love these colors and this pattern. I was so hopeful for this shirt, but I tend to order sizes too large. I was swimming in the medium. Definitely showed my bra under my arm. I'm not convinced a small would completely hide it either. The front was a little lower than I'd hoped and showed off a lot of my chest if I leaned forward. Besides those issues, with the pattern, I could probably get away with a nude bra and no undershirt, even at work. It is comfortably light and cool fabric that would usually be sheer in a solid color.

review_summary: Not for me  But still cute
review_text: I'm 5'6, 150 lbs, and a 34DDD. The cleavage was a little awkward for me since it opened too much. On a smaller chested person I imagine it lays flat and gives a cute flirty little opening, but on me it just looked weird and didn't lay right. It was otherwise VERY boxy on me so a larger size wouldn't have helped. The length was fine on me and the fabric was ok. The pattern also washed me out a little, but that's just me. I wasn't feeling it and the hubby hated it so it will be going back. Might look adorable on the right person though so give it a shot.

I bought the boho  the color is paler than expected.  I thought it would be a bolder color, but it still works.  The length is just right, but I wouldn't wear it with leggings.  I wear it with a tank underneath.  Perfect for summer in the South.
I love the pattern of this top. It runs slightly loose, so order your true size or a size down. The neck opening is a little bit low, but doesn't bother me.
This is a very nice shirt! The color is lovely and it fits very well.

review_summary: Bust area too small  color is great in person!
review_text: I ordered a large in this and was SOOO disappointed that the bust area was too small. Everything else fit perfectly and the mustard print is just as pretty in person.I wear a 36B and the bust area really could have benefitted from an extra 2.5. Really odd specs!
Really pretty, soft, and well made.  Runs very large and not a flattering cut to wear.  Makes me look pregnant. Sadly will have to send back.

review_summary: Cute Blouse for Casual or Work Wear
review_text: This blouse is really comfortable and I don't even need to wear a camisole underneath it.It is a little tight in the shoulders but that's normal for me as I am a little broad there. Overall, a great top for work or to wear with jeans!
The color is beautiful. Very comfy around the middle. I would absolutely buy this shirt again if it came in other colors or prints.

This shirt is terrible. Totally 110% terrible. Made me look like I was 7 month pregnant. I'm average built. I usually wear a large and ordered in that size. The fit was fine, but the cut and flare of the shirt made me look 50 lbs. larger than I really am. Honestly cannot say how bad this shirt. is.
This top is cute and I'm excited to wear it this fall!

I bought the floral pattern of this top to wear to Easter dinner.  The material is silkysoft and drapes nicely over my curves, with plenty of room to skim over my big hips.  I did have to wear a bandeau to make this top inlaw appropriate, though I probably would have done that regardless of where I was wearing this top.  My biggest complaint is that it is impossible to figure out what color cardigan to wear with this  you'd think that any of the colors in the pattern would work, but they clash horribly when used on a larger scale.  I tried pale green, emerald, purple, and pure white, but eventually settled on ivory (navy probably would have worked but I didn't have anything in that color).  Nobody could figure out exactly what color the background was supposed to be, either (is it salmon? coral? flamingo? Congo pink? who knows).  Overall, this is a pretty top at a reasonable price, and I'm sure I'll wear it a number of times through the spring and summer.
This shirt is gorgeous.  Goes perfectly with leggings.  It's my new favorite top and the colors are so springy.
Bought in all colors that were on sale. Hesitant to rate so high because I'm afraid they will up the price!

The fabric on this cardigan feels amazing  very soft and pleasantly thick. The light gray is a fantastic pale silvery shade. Unfortunately, the cropped length just didn't work on my shape, (hits at bra line, not at my natural waist) so it's going back.

Bought this sweater in honey to go with a navy blue shirt and it is perfect.  The color is actually a little darker than in the photo, which I love.  I'm definitely going to buy many more in different colors!  Perfect for throwing over tanks and short sleeve shirts to transition from summer to fall.

review_summary: Great if you are looking for a VERY cropped cardi
review_text: I am very happy with these since I am only 5'2, slim, and short waisted.  Most of the other cropped cardis or shrugs I've tried on are too big or too long for fitted dresses.  I saw these on a petite bloggers site and gave it a try in XS.  It is really good for over dresses or high waisted bottoms.  It hits just above my waist, and XS is very fitted but not too tight anywhere (and I have muscular arms). 4 stars since it is not the best quality and the buttons make it look less dressy, but I'll work with it for the perfect fit! I actually bought 2 more after my first time ordering these!

I love these cardigans crop or full length! The brand has changed (used to be mak) but I don't see much of a difference in the look or feel of them. They fit the same in my opinion as the old brand. These do run slightly bigger but if you order your true size it's not a huge difference. If you want it to hug you more I would say go a size smaller. If you want it a tad looser or be able to fully button it up go with your true size. I normally wear between a 2x3x I went with 3x because I was afraid with the different brand it would run smaller. But since I'm not a fan of buttoning up my cardigans I wish I went with a 2x. But overall these are a must in every wardrobe! Nice durable fabric VERY comfortable and stretchy. This works well. I sized up from medium to large and it fits well (usually medium in tops).I have a bunch of the charter school cardigans and I can say this charcoal one is different. The buttons are a different style and the trim is thicker than the others. It makes it a little different feel but the overall fit seems fairly similar and I still like it quite a bit. I compared it to the ivory charter school cardigan in the same size (and some other colors), also this year's model. The ivory one (MAK  like most of the orig style) has slightly wider shoulder seems, thinner fabric, smaller buttons. This charcoal one (diff designer  fervour same style name), has thick ribbed edging, larger buttons, wider body, longer overall and is made of a softer, maybe slightly thicker fabric. For me, they both work. They do fit a little differently. The charcoal may fit me a little better and is a little comfier.I'd be interested in seeing more colors of this charcoal version. The larger buttons and thicker ribbing could be toned down a bit, but I would guess most people may not notice. It does feel a little more substantial, but the difference is minimal.bottom line: You probably want this as you can wear it with everything.If the trim/buttons and sizing diff might matter to you check the designer first. If you just squeezed into the fervour style (this), order a size up in the MAK version (ivory, other colors).

I thought it would feel like your typical stretch cardi but it's not cottony at all  more like a medium thick, super stretch knit. I mean really, really stretchy. I am busty and am used to just fastening my middle cardigan buttons but can button this all the way up with no gapping. Now about size: I  feel that Modcloth's plus size items can be tricky. Elsewhere I am usually a 16 (occasionally an 18) but I seem to consistently take a Modcloth 3X in dresses. That said, I've always been a department store XL in cardigans and avoid plus size cardigans as I like a tighter fit. I chatted Modcloth up for advice thinking I'd go with a 1X this time but she suggested I stick with my typical 3X which is a top size I've never, ever taken. I knew that I didn't want it to look too big over a dress so  I split the difference and bought a 2X which fits quite nicely (if not a little long). It's stretchy enough that I could pull off the 1X for a tighter look but will probably stick with the 2X when I buy so, so many more of these cardigans. A score. Really. Now I know what all the fuss is about. :)

review_text: I finally have my very own Charter School Cardigan and I must say I'm very happy with the purchase. The sweater is very soft and fits well. Other reviewers said this had a brown tinge to it, but I thought it was more on the blue end of the spectrum. The color is lovely with khakis or jeans. It's a more fitted sweater, but I did not see any gaping between the buttons.

I really love this cardi!  The color is a dark gray with just a touch of chocolate.  It adds enough color to make it clearly a different hue than other gray things I own, like some work pants and skirts that I often wear with it.  The fit is great for, and I like the 3/4 sleeve.  It's thick enough that I don't get cold at work in the Florida air conditioning, but thin enough that I can actually wear it on chilly nights.  My only complaint is that after washing it several times, it has started to pill a bit.  It's not surprising, but I have been pretty good with it  line dry only, never tumble dried.  It's not a huge deal, considering I get so much wear out of it.  I really want to get it in the teal color, so obviously it's not that much of a downside!  My included picture is from my rehearsal dinner, wherein I am also wearing the Strawberry Iced Tea dress, which I adore!
I love these cardigans, they are soft and have just the right amount of stretch. i wash mine in the delicate cycle and hang to dry and they maintain their shape and softness really well.
The cardigan in charcoal is a must!  Paits well with khaki, black, or jeans. Also leaves a lot of options for fun makeup color schemes!
Super soft and super perfect. This is the 2nd of this sweater I have gotten and I love it!! it does pill a little, but not too bad.

review_summary: Needs to come in XL!!! An
review_text: Needs to come in XL!!! And as always, it was so soft first coming out of the packaging. 3
Fantastic color. It's grayer than the picture shows, which makes it easier to match with silver and/or gold jewelry.

The PERFECT cardi! having fat arms i never go anywhere without a cardi on and this one is fabulous! perfect 3/4 sleeve, sits on the waist, quality is great.  Looks perfect open over dresses!Will buy this one is every colour!!

The Charter School Cardigan's are WONDERFUL! They fit like a dream and are so comfortable. The medium fits perfectly for buttoning it up or leaving it open. I would definitely recommend this and the other Charter School Cardigan's  they are a great to have in your wardrobe.

review_summary: I got this cardigan as a
review_text: I got this cardigan as a Christmas present and the first thing I noticed was how SOFT the fabric is! It is amazing! And I love the length of itI'm on the short side, and I find a lot of cardigans hit me halfway down my butt instead of at my hips, but this one is perfect. The only thing I find weird is the length of the arms. I have short arms, because I'm a short person, but even though the overall length of the cardigan was perfect, the arms are a bit too long to be 3/4 length, but definitely too short to be full length sleeves. It's easily remedied by pushing up the sleeves a bit, which is usually what I end up doing anyhow. Overall, I love it, and I used the ModCloth gift certificate I also got for Christmas to order it in another colour!

I first purchased this same cardigan in yellow, and I loved the style, fit and feel so much that I had to get it in a few more colors! I'm happy that the fit remains consistent in every color I purchase!

Love these cardigans. The fit is just rightsnug but not so much that you can't button it up if you want. The 3/4 sleeve length is great (I usually roll up the sleeves of longsleeved cardigans anyway!). I've got the mustard one as well, and plan to buy other colors eventually.
Lovely cardigan! If I was purchasing it again, I would probably go with a medium, but I wanted to be sure I could do up the buttons, which I can with the large. Perfect piece for layering!

I've owned this cardigan for about 7 months now, and it gets an awful lot of wear. I try to keep good care of it by hand washing and air drying, but after wash after wash it's taken to pilling on the sleeves. A good little cardigan, but not equipped for longterm wear and tear.
These cardigans are so soft and nice! I want to get them in every single color!

review_summary: I just can't say enough g
review_text: I just can't say enough good things about these sweaters.  I'm in the process of building up my collection.  The color on this one is rich.  These are always a good buy.

review_summary: Very soft and cozy! The c
review_text: Very soft and cozy! The color is accurate, it fits well, and goes with anything!

This sweater ALSO came with two pulls in it.  I'm keeping it because I really do love the fabric and 3/4 sleeve cut of the Charter School cardigans, but I feel like the worksmanship is getting sort of sloppy.

review_summary: This is a very cute sweat
review_text: This is a very cute sweater but it seemed a bit small to me.  I cannot button the sweater without there being gaps between the buttons around my bust but it fits well on my waist.  The curse of a larger bust.  It is also a bit short on me compared to the model but I just wear it open and it looks cute anyway.  The quality of the sweater is very good and it stretches well and is nice thicker material.  If this sweater came is XL, I would buy more of them.
This cardigan is going to get some heavy use this fall and winter...maybe spring as well.  Perfect length, fit and color to go with everything!

Love it!! This is my 4th Charter School CardiganI am addicted. I would wear an XL but the L works great for me if I wear it open. The color is a dark gray that almost looks like a dark brown in the right light.

Just like every other reviewer, I have nothing but praise for these amazing cardigans! The colors are gorgeous and I love that the charcoal was as dark as it appears in the picture. The first day I wore this, I received two compliments. The material is thicker than many of the cardigans being sold these days. I now own this in Peacock and Honey. GREAT deal!!
Lovely cardigan! This cardigan is just as lovely as the others I own.
Love this sweater! It's so easy to dress up or down. I've ordered it in another color and can't wait for it to get here.
Love these cardigans! I have two colors and plan on buying a few more. They are a bit more pricey than I'd like but well worth the money considering the quality. And they're super soft!

It's no great surprise that the Charter School cardigan is pretty great. The charcoal is perfect and beautiful  everything I could have wanted out of this color. The one thing I find with this cardigan is that it does need special care in order to keep it from pilling (little fuzz balls). If you follow the washing directions exactly as they're stated, this isn't a big problem. The fuzz balls are worth noting to highlight the importance of the washing instructions, but it's such a soft wonderful cardigan that it's worth a couple tiny fuzz balls :)

review_summary: I had been looking for a
review_text: I had been looking for a new cardigan for a while and after reading all the positive reviews, I decided to give this a try. It was well worth it since I absolutely love it! The fabric is soft and comfortable and the charcoal goes with pretty much everything I own. I will for sure be ordering it in more colors!
Unfortunately fits smaller than expected.  I'm ordering a bigger size.  Great sweater and really versatile, though

review_summary: If I could afford to, I'd
review_text: If I could afford to, I'd own this in every available color. The material is so soft and flattering, I just love it!!!!

review_summary: This is a pretty solid ca
review_text: This is a pretty solid cardigan for the price. Fits well and is comfortable. Will be buying more in different colors
This cardigan fits very well and is very versatile so it can be worn with many different outfits.
As many others have stated this is a great cardigan. It's warm, cozy and not too heavy. I want one in every colour!

review_summary: I can tell why a simple c
review_text: I can tell why a simple cardigan has been getting such good reviews!  It is a nice weight, soft, and flattering.  The sleeves are a little long on me, but that is not unusual given my height, so I can't fault the cardigan.
The color of this sweater is hard to capture in a photo. I was expecting it to be a more faded color but it's a very solid gray (which is nice).

Love this cardigan. After reading the hundreds of rave reviews I decided to give this a shot. The quality is wonderful and it is super comfortable. The sleeves are intentionally short, which is not my favorite, but on this cardigan it works. A little pricey for a cardigan but the price is worth it in my opinion.

This is a great cardigan. I have been buying too many cute things on ModCloth and must put myself on a spending moratorium. When that is over, I will be buying this perfect cardigan in more colors! Fortunately this pretty brown will go great with tons of colors until then.  In case it's not in the description, or in case you are like me and, in a rapture, do not notice those types of details, these are not full length sleeves, but much cuter at 3/4 length.

review_summary: I have this cardi in rasp
review_text: I have this cardi in raspberry and absolutely love it.  I know this is pickybut I just didn't like the color of this sweater because it's more brown than it is charcoal (which should be grey).  I'm really disappointed it didn't work out because I've been looking for staple grey sweater for a long, long time.

This is the first Charter School Cardigan in my closet. I love it. The sweater is a good weight to layer over items in the fall and winter. I like that the vneck is not extremely deep. And the color is perfect. Because I am so short, the sleeves hit right at my wrist, which almost never happens! Great sweater and I definitely see myself ordering more colors.

review_summary: I love this cardigan. I b
review_text: I love this cardigan. I bought it in three colors, charcoal, black, and orchid. It's a perfect fit for me. The only possible issue I could mention is that the sleeves may be a bit of a weird length. It's perfect otherwise.

I really like this cardigana lot.  It fit well, the colour was lovely and I was very happy with it until...I wore it and discovered that it piled quite badly.  After the first wash I had to take a razer and shave it because it was so fuzzy. This is my only complaint about this pieceif the quality was a bit better I would have given it 5 stars.
Definitely a must have staple for every wardrobe. I love it.
Love this cardigan! I go to church on Sundays so its perfect for a modest cover up and looks good with everything in my wardrobe :)
I love these cardigans. They are light enough to layer without being too heavy as the day goes on. Super comfy and does well with washing too.
The cardigan fit perfectly and colour was just right. It goes with almost any outfit if you are ever stuck for ideas! It is a nice shape and style too, not too boring or flashy.

A little scratchy at first, but after worn once or twice it's comfy. The 3/4 sleeves need to be bunched a little to look right, otherwise I feel like they look like a mistake. There is a bit of straining across my bust, but I just don't button it there. Like the other reviews say, it is pretty much the perfect cardigan.
It's great! Handwash only and I'm lazy. But it's dark and doesn't need washing often so it's... great :P

Arrived very fast in adorable packaging! This looks to be the perfect cardigan, I fully intend to buy the other colors. I do wish it had been a tiny bit softer, but it will probably wear in nicely. Also the sleeves are very long for a 3/4 length, they reach my wrist, but its not hard to push them up as there is a nice stretch to the fabric. Definitely recommend!

Adorable! I have been looking for a charcoal grey cardigan for months and months. It is so, so soft and fits perfectly. I also bought it in a pretty mint colour on a different website. They are the perfect cardigans!

review_summary: This is my new favorite c
review_text: This is my new favorite cardigan.  The fit is a big snug if buttoned, but I don't normally wear my cardigans buttoned up anyways.  The fabric is so soft.  I recceived a lot of compliments on it the first day I wore it and so I promptly ordered it in more colors.  It's a great staple piece for any wardrobe.
I love this sweater! It's lightweight and fits great and goes with everything. I wanted to get it in more colors but now they're out of stock. :(
beautiful cardigan will go with anything and perfect for Australian Autumn and Spring. I ordered the large and it fits nicely a little big but that doesn't bother me. Beautiful quality

review_summary: Fits me like a glove. I w
review_text: Fits me like a glove. I want this cardigan in every color.

review_summary: I got this cardigan a cou
review_text: I got this cardigan a couple of weeks ago, and have literally worn it about 8 times since then.  I love the 3/4 length sleeves and the weight is perfect for a lightweight sweater.  I do have a larger chest, and the buttons don't gape!  I wish Modcloth wasn't out of the medium in other colors!

Cardigan lover  look no further!  As one of my favorite pairing items, I wear them with pretty much everything so I was delighted to find that this is a great little cardigan. It fir perfectly, formed well to the body, quality is good which makes it surprisingly warm. I love it so much I bought it 3 more colors shortly after receiving it. Def worth the price! (fun fact: also wearing the chocolate chip dress (as a shirt) from mod cloth in the first pic) Cheers!
Another awesome product from Modcloth.

review_summary: I now no why these cardig
review_text: I now no why these cardigans have such good reviews. It is really lovely. Good fit, goes with everything and is warmer than I thought. I'v already got plans to buy more colours:)

Bought the Honey color of this, too, and am very pleased with these cardigans. I'm actually able to button them all the way without too much pinching if I don't want to have to wear them open. Very soft and comfortable.
Very comfy, Size is right.I am 38''. and no gaping. Thank you ModCloth.

I've had this cardigan for a long time now (late review!), and it's holding up really well. It goes with nearly every outfit and fits wonderfully even after all these washes. I definitely recommend it.
Gorgeous and fits perfectly!

Great cardigan!  It is soft and fits perfectly.  The sleeves are a bit shorter than usual, but not quite 3/4 sleeves.  Because I have shorter arms, the fit is great. I love the color and anticipate wearing it out this season.
Very good quality. The fabric feels like silk. :)
Just as pictured; soft material; looks and feels good quality. I usually wear an XL or L (I'm an apple shape) and got an L for this item and it fits well.

review_summary: Really Cute sweater, a little short
review_text: This is a really cute sweater, and great for high waist style pants and skirts. Its a little short in the torso to wear with just a pair of jeans, and my belly does show a bit if I were to do that. Overall, its a really fun bright color and I love it.
Perfect! Looks just as it does on the model and it is sooooo soft

review_summary: Top is a little thin. The
review_text: Top is a little thin. The bow above the chest loop does not hold up as it is heavier than material of the shirt. I like the color, it?s true to the photos.

Super cute, great quality top! Just upset it didn't fit me so well. It was just long enough to look a bit awkward once it was on, and much too tight around the boobs. Color was a little darker than it appeared online but was still beautiful. I was surprised about the fit because I've never had a problem buying an XS from Modcloth. Bummer, but this top is great if the fit is right for you!

Runs a full size small if you're busty at all. I am a true to size 12/14 and wear a 36/38 C and I ordered the XL. It will not button up all the way and the buttons that do button near the chest, pull tightly. This is really disappointing seeing as how I fit perfectly in other XL tops/dresses/skirts from Modcloth. Other than the sizing issue, I really do like this top. I think its really cute, I just wish it fit me. I probably won't go through the hassle of exchanging it, I'm sure if I wear a sports bra I can make it work.

Bought this to pair with a navy swing skirt from Modcloth and LOVED it the first day I wore it. I'm 5'5 and 32C and a small fit all right, while sitting a little higher on the waist than I would have liked. With convenient front tails that tie up and a lovely striped design, it received tons of compliments. But after I threw it in the wash, it shrunk to the size of a doll shirt. I can no longer wear it without my belly showing, and that's definitely not my style. Word to the wise: size up to avoid the same shrinkage or hand wash and hang dry.

I really wanted to love this shirt.  I like the crisp cotton and the classic navy and white.  As an apple shaped person, I love a peplum.  However, this particular peplum was a little too poofy, and when combined with horizontal stripes, it made me look even wider than I already am.  I am sad to be returning this top.

Cute color and pattern. It's slightly small for me up top. The front slit wanted to gape open(can see straight down to the middle of my bra), the shoulders were a little tight but not unbearable(my shoulders are 17in wide measured across the clavicle), but the neck was bothersomely snug since it's buttoned in the back. Nice fabric but it does need ironing (the photo was after it had been crumpled up for days though). Wouldn't need an undershirt at my very conservative work. I'm debating getting a 12 and just hand stitching the slit closed halfway or all the way. But the 10 is definitely going back. Oh also, it arrived smelling strongly  like incense maybe?

review_summary: I love the cut of this bl
review_text: I love the cut of this blouse!  It fits perfectly and although I am small chested, I think it would be good for busty gals as well!

I got this shirt in a 10 (UK).  I don't have an extremely large chest but it definitely pulled and was very tight on my boobs.  I would say if you have a larger chest, size up.  I thought the material was nice and pretty (although unforgiving) but one of the buttons came off the back the first time I tried it on.  I am returning.

This a very pretty top and it can be both casual and dressy.  I normally wear a medium in tops, but I ordered a small since it looked really flowy.  I was right, and the small fits perfectly. Having an hourglass figure and being shortwaisted with a larger chest size, I was delighted that it hit me in all the right spots.  very flattering fit, and the colors are lovely as well.

I sized down based on reviews, and it was too small. I wear a lot of tops that fit similarly, but the sizing seems off on this one. It was too short in the front. I also just don't like the fabric. Clingy in the back, and accentuated my upper arms in an unflattering way.
Cute shirt. Love the front where the lace is. I love lace and the pink is pretty too.

Really thin, easily wrinkled fabric, too long to wear like the girl in the photo, and see through. It?s a stiff fit as well so you can?t move well in it. Honestly a weird fit. Sucks because it?s a really pretty design :(
I normally wear either a 1X or an XL but I am glad I got the XL. Very soft fabric. Looks great on! Very flattering.

review_summary: Very soft, but a bit too large
review_text: I ordered an XL, which is my usual size in Modcloth tops, but it is very large, I could have easily gone with a L. I'm hoping it shrinks a bit in the wash. Otherwise very soft and comfortable and nice detailing!

This shirt is surprisingly super cute. I got it in a 4X, my normal Modcloth size and it fit perfectly, I would assume it runs a little large, I had room to spare in my shirt. But it fits excellently, it's very cute, very soft and lightweight, can't wait to wear it!

I hesitated a bit because there were no reviews yet, but I got this top and it was exactly what I wanted. It looks great with the Leave Knit to Me sweater in Frost, which I was trying to match. I got the 2X, although I usually wear tshirts in 1X, but I think the 1X would have worked too. The fabric is thick enough without a cami. The ivory color is not as light as pictured but still closer to white than oatmeal (I was concerned about this).
Lovely colour albeit a bit darker than the photos.

I got this shirt and the matching skirt. They're so cute together, and the shirt is very versatile. It's become a staple of my closet. Looks way better in person than in the picture. Only issue is is that you can see your bra through the eyelets, but it's not really noticeable.

This is an adorable top, but it runs a bit small. I normally wear a S, and that fit well enough, albeit a bit on the tight side. After washing and drying it once according to the instructions on the tag, it became even smaller! I was hoping to wear this with a highwaisted skirt for work, but now it's a bit too short even for that. You may want to size up.

I have this in several colors and love it, but do NOT recommend it in Oxblood, which does not have lining and the eyelet fabric means everyone can plainly see whatever's underneath the shirt through all of the holes.  The whole joy of these shirts is that they're workappropriate while still cute and not too hot for summer, and the shirt makes no sense if you have to wear an undershirt.Highly recommend it in the other colors, though!  It is a lifesaver for the summer work wardrobe and cute enough that you can wear it out on the town afterward.

The material is kind of battered. It frays very easily and the material can be itchy if you have sensitive skin. This cardigan is not all bad though. The size is very appropriate and I like that the material is very thick, during the fall and winter with would be cute and appropriate. I almost feel as though the fabric is so thick it may break the buttons off. I do like it with the first outfit pictured because I purchased it and it is very flattering.
I got this a month ago and it was really good and it was comfortable to wear

This cardigan is very pretty. I love the muted, melony colors. When I pulled it out of the box, I was so excited! I tried it on and it fit just right. My excitement faded when I realized that the fabric was the type that would pull super easily. The buttons were already pulling the fabric into puckers where they were sewed on and the seams inside the garment were kind of fraying in places. As much as I loved the look of the cardigan, I had to send it back.

I bought this because it looked so cute and preppy on the model with the shorts. When it came the colors don't quite look the same. My kids said it looked like a grandpa sweater and not in a good way. I'm afraid they're right.

I bought this cardigan very recently and was really excited to wear it since the pattern is so cute. I don't know if it was already frayed to begin with or if it frayed with use, but after the first day of wearing it to work, I noticed that the ends of the sleeves had frayed. Because the material of the sweater is really weird (another reviewer mentioned this as well) it will be very difficult to fix this by hand. This cardigan, although cute, certainly isn't worth ~$60.
The material is AWFUL. The best way to describe it? You know those mesh bags that oranges come packaged in? It feels like that. Do yourself a favor and don't buy this cardigan.

this shirt is REALLY pretty. i love how delicate and feminine it is. however, there is no darting. the shape is very loose and flowy and hides my waist. even with it tucked into a skirt, it makes me look shapeless. the puff sleeves also add bulk and dont lay properly.
Buttons are dark blue not white. Otherwise a fantastic shirt.

Admittedly, I don't have average proportions. I'm tall and my shoulders are a bit wide as a result. I have a narrow waist for my height. The size M fit through the shoulders, but it was way too big through the waist, and a little too short to be able to tuck it in properly. I considered getting it tailored, but it was not worth it since the shirt was already $50. It was not flattering for me.

The color is lovely and on the models it looks fantastic, but the fabric this shirt is made out of it a nightmare when it comes to wrinkles. Another reviewer mentioned this and I should have heeded that warning, but I thought I'd try anyway. Such a shame, as a nice jersey material would have had a better drape and would be less likely to wrinkle. Linen/cotton was just a poor choice here!

This looks cute on the models, but something about it just didn't work for me in person. It hit me in a weird spot on my waist, and I wished it had more of a fit & flare cut to it to flatter the belly area. It's also super wrinkly. This one just wasn't a winner for me.

review_summary: Cute but be prepared to iron it
review_text: This is a cute top to add a little flair to a skirt, jeans, or shorts, but it was not at all flattering to my admittedly fat arms  the sleeve didn't have the little cap that seems to show in some of the images but ended higher on the shoulder, barely covering my bra strap. It was also extremely wrinkled, leading me to believe it will not be as easy care of a garment as I'd prefer. It's going back for me, but if you have toned arms and like to iron (possibly that's how you keep your arms toned?), it's cute.

Really pretty, but a little more casual than I was hoping for. It seems a little bit tight as well, I'm generally a solid 1X in Modcloth but this seems to be tight in the chest. It'll do the trick for what I need it for though. The length is bolero which is fine for a dress.

review_summary: Just what I had hoped, cu
review_text: Just what I had hoped, cute bolero for a layer of warmth and cover
Ordered a 1X based on the size chart and it was huge. Disappointing because it is really cute and well made.

review_summary: Another Unique Item from Mod Cloth!
review_text: Overall, this a wellmade shirt.  Nice cotton material.  The bees on the collar appear larger in person, but they do not look tacky.  The one drawback about this shirt is that it is not a good shirt to tuck in the shirt puffs out around the waist no matter what you do.  However, it looks adorable under a sweater or sleeveless dress!
I have a problem with shirts either being too large or pulling on my chest but this top fits great!  Will be perfect to tuck into a skirt or to just wear with pants.  The bees are a cute addition!

review_summary: One of the Best Pieces from the Spring Collection
review_text: I haven't had good experiences with MC's spring line, but this was a delightful exception! It's made from good quality, 100% cotton shirting material, which I love. It's a bit see through since it's white, but it's sturdy and has a nice weight so I wouldn't call it sheer. The fit is great! It fits me just like the model...a little roomy at the waist when tucked in, but no gaping at the bust. I like that the sleeves have room and aren't meant to be tight. I just adore this top for work or play.
Bulky by the shoulders but perfect everywhere else! The print is beautiful and the fabric silky

I ordered an L and it was too big, but I feel like the problems I had with it wouldn't change if I sized down. It was baggy, not just big, and I don't like having to wear a tank top underneath another for modesty, which I would have had to with this. And even though it shows in the picture, the fabric bunches near the shoulders which looks weird on me.

review_summary: I'm a huge fan of this bl
review_text: I'm a huge fan of this blouse! I'm the curator of a state map collection and I knew I had to add this to my wardrobe as soon as I saw it. From the picture I was expecting a georgette/chiffontype material. The blouse is actually made from something a bit more substantial that feels like satin. I'm 5'0, so it's pretty long, but that's an easy fix. I also wasn't expecting it to not have any type of closure. I PROBABLY could've sized down, but getting stuck in a blouse is not my idea of a fun time. Go with your normal size or one up if you're not 100% sure. Overall I definitely recommend it!

I love the subtle map print on this. It does run a bit small  I am normally a Medium, and the arm holes and bust are just big enough. It covers my butt, so I'll be able to wear it as a tunic or tucked in.
I absolutely love the design of the shirt! And the length is perfect on me. My only issue is that the sleeves seem a little tight around the armpit area, but it doesn't really bother me.

review_summary: Not so muted sleeveless map top
review_text: This is the little top that could?, soft, drapey, covering front and back and matching a myriad of colors. You cannot go wrong wearing it as a casual piece with jeans or colorful slacks. It is wonderfully versatile paired with a suit.

This shirt is cute, I actually got it to wear underneath some sweaters, but that didn't work out because this top is really boxy. It's also really sheer, so you'd have to wear a very obvious tank top underneath it. And the collar is really big, it stands up and out a lot, so it isn't flattering. I wanted to love this top but it just didn't work for me. It might work for some, but I definitely would wait until it's on sale, I'm glad I did so I didn't pay full price. The bugs and lacing around the edges are so cute, I wish I could have kept it :/

I really liked this top, and I loved the lace detail. It fit great, I usually wear an 18/20, and I bought a 3X. It's a little big, but it is 100% cotton so after washing it will probably be perfect. The print is adorable. I bought both the white bug print, and the peach floral print.

review_summary: This top is a nice, silky
review_text: This top is a nice, silky material with really vibrant colors. Perfect to wear with a cute pair of shorts!

review_summary: I'm often between an XL a
review_text: I'm often between an XL and a 1X in tops, and this was slightly snug in the bust and hips for me. Returned it, sadly, but I loved the color and the fun print.

review_summary: Great Print and Style, fabric snags easliy
review_text: Bought this about 2 months ago but hadn't had a chance to wear it until recently.  It's a great top, fits well overall but runs a little small so if you're unsure size up.  The fabric snags really easily so keep that in mind when picking accessories and activities.

review_summary: I bought this because I w
review_text: I bought this because I was fond of the pattern.  I was not looking for more floral pieces but liked the color scheme on this one. Very comfortable and cute.  Four stars because it does seem a bit more flimsy than I'm used to from Modcloth.
Material feels a bit cheap and I'm worried that the top won't have a long life. I only wear it to work for special days just in case.

Recently bought this navy floral top on sale and it beat my expectations.  The material does not seem see through but it's not thick either so great for summertime wear.The back and underarms are a bit more cut out that a standard tank, but overall very nice.

I really like the fit of this tank. Its loose fitting but not so loose it will look like a maternity top. It is loose enough to hide your imperfections, but just enough fit to give you a nice shape. It also has a nice long length that can also cover your imperfections.

So glad I purchased this blouse.Will be pairing this with Breathtaking Tiger Lilies Skirt in Mustard. New favorite outfit.

One of my favorite tops.  Looks great paired with dark wash jeans.  Feels silky smooth.  Hits at just the right spot, which almost never happens for me since I'm 5'10.  Would definitely recommend!
Usually me and polka dots don't like each other, but I love this one!

review_summary: The fit is perfect, and t

This top satiny soft and perfect for Spring or Summer. It was a little snug around my hips, but other than that it is a wonderful top!
Love it!!!!

review_summary: I love this top and is a
review_text: I love this top and is a staple in my wardrobe ! Love it!

review_text: This top is very cute and seems durable. Absolutely no give in the material (as stated) so it is snug on my belly (my problem area) but with the outfit it works well. Will buy this in all colors!
The polka dots are adorable, and this fits great!
Super comfy! Have gotten lots of compliments rah time I've worn it!!

Cute. Bought this top in a larger size and wore it as a maternity top. Belted it and it looks so cute with a baby bump!

review_summary: My second shirt of this s

As others have said, the fit on the bottom is a bit tight for us wide hipped girls but I still love this top. Also, it does collect a lot of static cling too. Looks great tucked in with a colorful skirt and is very versatile.

review_summary: Nice shirt but it was too
review_text: Nice shirt but it was too tight in the hips. Not what I was expecting but it is a beautiful shirt!

I'm a tad chesty (36 DDD) so this shirt is a little tight in that area and it's long, but looks funny tucked in. Overall it is super cute and I solved the fit issues by wearing a CAMI so I can leave it unbuttoned and tuck the bottom under the CAMI.

review_summary: It is a blouse with VERY
review_text: It is a blouse with VERY good quality. I was pretty impress when I saw it. I bought it XL, but it is a little big bigger than I thought. Also, it is longer than I expected. I'm 5'9 and the length is in the middle of my tights.

review_summary: This top is going to be r
review_text: This top is going to be really handy as a layering piece, and a great pairing for most of the bottoms I own. It fits rather large in the bust and body (I often wear an XL at Modcloth, and the L of this top has room), and a little tighter in the hips.
This top is really cute. It does fit tight around the hips though. The length is also a bit long. I guess I have to start tucking my shirts in!

review_summary: This is such a cute top!
review_text: This is such a cute top! The material is lightweight, but not seethrough. Like some other reviewers said, it does sit a little tighter on the hips, but as I'm planning on wearing this mostly tucked into skirts for work, it worked for me. It's also very comfortable for those of us with broader shoulders...I could move and breathe without feeling like I was going to Hulk my way through the shirt.

review_summary: I am busty so I usually o
review_text: I am busty so I usually order blouses like this a size up to prevent button gaps. This large was huge on me, especially in the arm holes. I could probably go down to a small. I like my shirts a little flowy so I will be returning for a medium. I am excited to wear this. The length is perfect and the quality is very nice. The material is flowy, without being tissue thin. On top of it, the seams and bottons in the front give it a tailored look. Good marketing with the name too, I love Scranton!
Thin material. Loose up top and super tight on the bottom. Not flattering and not worth the price tag.

This shirt would have much higher ratings if it wasn't so snug in the hips. It would be much too large everywhere else if I went up a size but I can't wear it loose in the small without having a weird roll in it (because of it having to sit on my hips instead of draping). It does look very nice tucked in but that's not normally how I wear tunics like this.
Just what I wanted
Would be super cute, but instead it's cut weird and huge in the chest and tight at the hips. I'm not sure who designed it, but it was a terrible idea.

review_summary: I had to return this. Unl

Love love love

This top was really cute, actually; I loved the material, very smooth and satiny. However, the cut was kind of odd. Instead of going straight down, or even tapering out slightly like a lot of tunics, it narrowed in at the hips, which created an odd bunching effect at the waist (which was overall unflattering). Had the cut not been so odd this would have been a keeper.
Really wanted this shirt and glad I bought it! Its soft and really cute!
Fantastic!

really nice!

Beautiful shirt that can be either dressed up or down. On my short frame, it definitely works best being tucked into whatever bottoms you have. Looks good with skirts and even more awesome with my favorite burgundy skinny jeans. Definitely pleased with my purchase.
Nice tunic.

While I find ModCloth's sizing to be wonky given the variety of juniors and women's plus size, this top was above and beyond my expectations! It has a great lightweight feel, the shoulders are cut so they aren't boxy and thus very flattering, the vneck is buttoned and thus adjustable (nice transition for day to night for more modest @ work folks), and the length is perfect for summer. I'm 5'7 and it falls midtolow hip, so basically a short tunic. I've received so many compliments on it, too!

review_summary: I love this top!  Fits pe

I really like this print and the quality is nice. However, sometimes the top button pops open for me and the hip area is a bit tight. I don't think I would size up since it would probably be too big if I did. I still like this shirt though; I just have to occasionally pull it down and I have to be careful with the top button.

review_summary: This looked so cute and I

The shirt was small and large in the wrong places. The neckline didn't fall on me quite right and it was very boxy. I could've made it work but I mostly just didn't like the material. Sad this had to go back.
Perfect, love it!!!
Very happy. Cute and comfy.

review_summary: Shirt runs a little big a
review_text: Shirt runs a little big and is soooo long. I do like it though! Cute pattern.

review_summary: I love this!  My only sma
review_text: I love this!  My only small comment is that the arm holes are a teensy bit small for me, but I like roomier arm holes in general.  Love the tunic length.  (I am a ModEmployee)

review_summary: I wanted to love this top
review_text: I wanted to love this top, but I am a 34D so the shirt was tighter (Not super tight) on the top, and I have large hips, so where the shirt ended it was tighter (not super tight), but in the middle the shirt bagged out so it just didn't look right. review_summary: I got a medium and its ju
review_text: I got a medium and its just a tad tight in the hips. Larges usually dont fit me well because I'm smallchested. Love this top! Very forgiving!

Really great top. Just not for me. The fabric gives no stretch and is extremely straight with no hint of a curve so it was tiny in my chest and hips, but really baggy in the waist. It's really cute though. If you have a straighter frame, I really recommend this shirt. It would look really cute tucked into a skirt or over leggings. Very versatile for the office or at home. Alas, this shirt and my figure just weren't meant to be.
Love the length! Great with jeans or leggings. Plenty of room in the chest. Might have been fine with a large.

review_text: Way to long and tight at bottom
