review_summary: Why is this so, so long?
review_text: Why is this so, so long?  I mean, I know it's a tunic, but this came to below my butt.  Belted it was a bit better.  Armholes showed a lot of bra.  Neckline was great, but I worry that the couple of buttons at the front would have gaped.  It went back.

This top has such great potential: long, flattering, cute print, not too thin, but the manufacturing/construction quality is poor. On the top I received, the stripes were not straight where the pattern meets the neck seam; it skews upward to meet the seam, making it look like the fabric is sagging down my boobs.

review_summary: I love this top. Mint is
review_text: I love this top. Mint is my favorite color and I love ruffle type blouses. This blouse is pretty long but it makes it great for tucking it into a skirt or pants.
Super flattering. Definitely tunic length, and on the boxier side  I plan to wear it tucked in primarily, so that's less of a concern for me. Great color and fit.

review_summary: I love this shirt! It's s
review_text: I love this shirt! It's super comfortable in warm weather and layers nicely under a cardigan when it's colder. The seam tucks in right at the smallest point of my waist, and the length is just right. I've gotten a lot of compliments on it!
Looks like a maternity shirt. If I sized up it would be way to long. Le sigh, the struggles of being short waisted and large breasted.
Meh, not my favorite. It makes me look frumpy. I didn?t return it but hardly ever wear it

Super soft! I grabbed these in several prints and love them all. Works with leggings or skinny jeans  just right! And did I mention they're soooo super snuggly soft? Love
This is the perfect sweatshirt for a summer evening! A looser fit and pairs nicely with jeans or shorts.

Fit well, perfectly true to size, which is hard to find on Modcloth. Like others said it was SO soft! Purchased the polka dot one, and unfortunately, regardless of all the good things it's being returned. It just looked too... clowny. The first polka dots I've ever met that I didn't like.

review_summary: I look like a pokeadot potato sack
review_text: I really wanted to like this shirt, but I look like a pokeadot potato sack. I usually wear a small or a medium depending on the style of the shirt. I opted for the small because other reviewers said it ran large...it runs VERY large. I realize this is supposed to be a comfy oversized shirt but I think an XS still would have been too big and unflattering. Unfortunately it will have to be returned.Pros: Made in the USA, cute patterns, super soft materialCons: Sizing is way off, not flattering

I just got this delivered and I'm pretty obsessed! My sizing on ModCloth can be literally anywhere from S to L, but generally, I'm a size 4 and am safe getting a medium in tops. I have a pretty athletic frame with broad shoulders, a little chesty, and not much in the hip department. I always go for peplums since they're flattering and I just hate wearing tight clothes! I went with a medium, and I probably could have gotten a small, but it's perfectly billowy and very comfortable and still looks great. It's a comfortable stretchy tshirt material, and the detail is gorgeous. It's work appropriate (I work in a fairly casual office setting) but it's easy to incorporate into my casual wardrobe too. I'll be wearing this a lot, I'm sure!

review_summary: It's cute, I'm not sure i
review_text: It's cute, I'm not sure if it's built to last though. It feels like it'll start falling apart after a season or two of wear.
The feel of this fabric is really light and soft. It's really beautiful! Fits great too!
Wanted something simple but playful for summer to wear with my white shorts and jeans, this is perfect. Could have gone up a size but they were sold out, but without a padded bra it still fits well.

This top is really cute and fits just as it looks on the model.  It's true to size (I'm 5'7 120 pounds and the small fits perfectly).  I really like the simple silhouette (especially with all the weird ruffles that are all over everything this season).  It's very flattering.  One thing to note is that I expected both shoulders to include the side ties, and it's only on 1 shoulder.  I immediately went to look at the pics again and I think because the model's hair is constantly hiding the other shoulder, that wasn't totally obvious.  Either way though, the top is super cute and classic.
Great Collectif  brand top. Super cute and super flattering; I get compliments every time I wear it.

review_summary: A very cute top, just a biiit small for me
review_text: I got this shirt to wear with a high waisted skirt and it works beautifully. I have been a large in every other Modcloth purchase, and this fits too but it is a bit small. An XL probably would have been perfect but I still love it regardless. I am a C to D cup, so B probably would fit fine

I bought this at the 2nd street store in Austin and it is my go to crop top for all my high waisted clothing. I can cinch it in to accentuate my waist even more and the collared neck is perfect for brooches, collar clips, or a statement necklace like my rainbow necklace from Vinca. For some reason I love it in the chambray, but not the other materials this is made in. The chambray has a light stretch and just matches everything!

I don't do crop tops. I have a tummy pooch and I'm a little modest, so I find most crop tops bare way too much. Not this one! It's cropped but still long enough to wear with highwaisted pants and skirts. The tie is kind of adjustable too, you can make it shorter or longer based on how you tie it. I personally love wearing it with skirts because I don't like tops that poof out around your waist when you tuck them in, and this covers my navel but emphasizes my waist. It's cute and flattering, and best of all, there's no button or armhole gaping! I tried it on the ModCloth store in Austin in my normal size Medium and it fit perfectly. I got the chambray and it goes with nearly everything I own. This is one of the few MC pieces I will buy in other colors.

I was hesitant about this because of the buttons and I usually have gaps between the buttons on these types of shirts. It fits just right and there is no gap and there is even some room in the chest. I have two things that I think modcloth needs to change with their shirts: 1) make the button holes bigger, it takes forever to button and unbutton y'alls shirts and 2) y'alls button up shirts always have the sides cut too low so no matter what bra I wear you can ALWAYS see the sides of it. I have several of y'alls sleeveless button up shirts and it is a problem with every single one of them. Other than those two things this is a great shirt and it will get lots of wear this summer.

I'm a cup size C and a size 4 usually and I ordered a small to start with. It was a bit too tight in the armpits was all, so I exchanged for a Medium. The fit is now perfect!! I LOVE this cute top and the rich blue hue, and the husband likes and thinks I look flirty ;)

review_summary: This top is super cute. I
review_text: This top is super cute. I found it fit a bit tight over my chest, but despite that it was very comfortable and looked great. I think it'll be fine as long as it doesn't shrink.

review_summary: This shirt is too big and
review_text: This shirt is too big and loose. I tucked it and it still fit weird. Would not recommend.

review_summary: I love the print! It's an
review_text: I love the print! It's an odd cut as in it fits weird around the chest area (34A) but overall it's a super cute shirt! And it's work appropriate!

Definitely not workappropriate without a cami or fun bralette, but it's such a pretty shirt!  It just sits in such a way that the boob window is danger city.  I will say though, the collar wants to perk up like a pair of alert dog ears.  Not all the time, mind you.  But when I leaned over to type something while standing and then stood back up, the collar was standing straight up.  Just something to be aware of!

As a wellendowed woman, I'm always apprehensive about buying tops online, but I decided to give this one a go. I'm so glad I did! it is the most flattering top I've purchased recently, perhaps EVER, and I wear it on days when I need to feel my fiercest! It does tend to  slide down in the front, and its little keyhole feature can get pretty cleavagey, but if you know that ahead of time, you can be prepared with a cami or less revealing bra, etc. LOVE this top!

review_summary: Fit me a bit awkwardly, b
review_text: Fit me a bit awkwardly, but I think it's just not the best fit for my shape. Works great with a cardigan, though, and the print is super cute!

review_summary: Beautiful shirt, but fit could be better
review_text: I love love love the pattern and the cut of the bottom of this shirt. For those of us ladies who are busty the large whole in the collar does not help, unless you don't mind crack cleavage....I find it inappropriate for work. Also the fit of the collar was a lot wider that it looks on the model, it sits wide on my shoulders and give an unflattering look on top. Definitely need to wear with a sweater. I'm disappointing this cut isn't the same as their other collared tank blouses. Buy at your own risk.

I really love this shirt. The bright color and pattern are so fun. I didn't mind that the key hole was so low because I always wear a cami under my shirts anyway. It definitely looks better tucked in with a high waisted skirt because otherwise it seems a bit boxy. The extra small fit me perfectly but I could see girls with a larger chest maybe having an issue.

The good: the fabric and style are super adorable. The bad: I am so devastated that the key hole on the front of the shirt is MUCH bigger than it looks on the models. I even sized up because I'm a little busty! The shirt fit comfortably across my chest, but the key hole exposed the cups of my bra.

I bought this in a small, since it said that the fabric isn't stretchy. But it was still too big. The key hole showed off my bra if I moved a certain way. I was also swallowed by the color. I might order a smaller size in the fall, if Modcloth still has this item. It's straightup polyester and felt a little itchy, so it's not suitable for spring and summer.

Love this shirt! True to size if not a little big. I thought the straps were large enough to cover my bra. Keyhole is a little low but not a problem. Love that I can style it untucked or tucked in. Very cute, will definitely look into getting it in a different print

I love the style and pattern of this shirt. I ordered a small. When I tried it on, I noticed this pudge as I call it, of extra fabric underneath my bust when I knotted the ties. I thought a size down would fix this. Nope, now my boobs don't fit, and the shirt still has the pudge. Sad I had to send back.

review_summary: Adorable, but runs a bit small
review_text: I adore this top, and have returned to buy it in a second colorway! It's a bit longer than some of the other tie top I have, which is nice for when I font want to show a ton of skin. However, if I do want to show a bit more, I can unbutton the bottom button or two and tie it up tighter. The waist is pretty free, compared to the bust, which runs a size+ small. I typically wear a medium, and ordered a large, but still experience gaping. A few safety pins mostly do the trick, though. This is great with pair of high waist shorts!

This top is adorable. The fabric is light and airy. It fits almost perfectly; the buttons gap a little if you are busty, but I think with one of my minimizer bras it'll be just fine. The pattern is so darling and it's lined with a gingham fabric. I love it!
I really like this shirt. Fair warning it did shrink, but I got it about a size too big so it shrunk to the perfect size for me. It's really comfy and soft. Good quality.

review_summary: A little too big, but cute
review_text: I'm a paleontology student, so I like anything dinosaur or geology related, and this was perfect! I though the lining would be red, but it's actually a hot pink color. The M was a bit too small in the tummy area when I sat down, so I sized up and it's a little big, but nothing I can't fix if I lose weight, and it's not too baggy to look bad. This can be casual or a little fancier depending on the bottoms and top you wear, which is great. The only thing I don't like about it is that the top and second button down has a gap between it that didn't go away between sizes.

review_summary: Pretty nice but not the best
review_text: I've had my eye on this shirt for a long while (boy, do I love piping details and colour contrast), so I finally managed to nab it during a sale. I'm... *slightly* disappointed, but that's not to say it's a bad shirt. The quality is a bit flimsy for $30+ in my opinion, and the print of the gems is a bit blurry in some places. I also thought the piping would be red, but it's more of a fuchsia (thought this is more my fault for not looking too closely). It's still a pretty cute shirt overall though, but not particularly flattering on me. I'd say to grab it on a sale, if you can.

Love these shirts  the prints are great and material is not cheap! I am generally a large in all tops, but this one was a little tight across the bust. It pulls slightly, even without a padded bra. Will have to size up when I purchase more of these!

I'm very disappointed with this top. I LOVE the pattern, and the material is very nice. It wrinkles easily, but it's light and soft, and not staticy at all. I originally purchased a medium, but that was snug up top and the bottom of the shirt didn't fit over my hips. So I returned it for a large, which fits over my hips great, but I now have the dresses boob gap  curvy ladies, you know what I'm talking about. So disappointing. I plan on taking it to my seamstress to see if she can put some darts in, but I fully expect her to tell me the material won't hold them. :(

I'm really happy Modcloth started selling some dinosaur stuff, because I'm going to school for paleontology and love to dress the part! This shirt is has a cute print and colors, with a flattering cut. I don't have the weird bunching in the armpits like others do, but if you are busty, then the buttons may gap. I fix this by undoing the top button, but then it wouldn't be work appropriate, so you may need to size up, or alter the gap. The fabric has no give, so sizing up may be a good idea. This top can be worn on it's own, or would look cute underneath a cardigan. Very versatile, I love it!

I love this top. The material is soft and comfy and the print (I chose the geology print) is positively amazing. The piping and buttons are adorable. The fit is perfect, except for a little bit of pulling at the chest between the two buttons. It's a little frustrating because a M would be too large everywhere else. I'm only a 32B, so bustier ladies beware of that! I'll probably try to sew in a little snap to fix the issue. Otherwise, though, I couldn't be more pleased!

My mom always fawns over my clothes from Modcloth, so I got her a few items for her birthday. She absolutely adores this tunic! Since I introduced her to leggings, she refuses to wear real pants, and was in dire need of some longer shirts (she doesn?t seem to grasp the whole *we can see your underwear* concept). This shirt is a perfect length for her, she?s 5?7?. The bright color looks great on her olive undertones!

review_summary: Very small arms in this s
review_text: Very small arms in this shirt, especially for the plus sizes.

review_summary: Cute pattern, tight sleeves, sad face.
review_text: I love the pattern on this top and was really excited when it came in the mail. Unfortunately, the sleeves are just way too tight for the 2x, I was afraid I was going to rip the seams if I moved. The overall fit in the body area was perfect, but those sleeves.....I thought about maybe taking it to the tailor to remove the sleeves and just make it a tank top. But I honestly don't know when I would have the time to do that so I'm returning it. :( So sad.

Yet another beautiful garment from Modcloth! The colors are exactly as pictured  vivid reds and soft neutrals. The fabric is lightweight yet durable, which is fantastic during the oppressive Texas heat and if you happen to sweat a lot. It is also very easy to iron; however, the button on the sleeve does not come undone, so you'll have to be a little more diligent with your iron. After the first pressing, though, it's remained wrinkle free through multiple wears! Makes getting dressed quick and easy. The tunic is slightly see through; however, if you have neutral/skin tone undergarments, no one can tell.I paired this tunic two ways. The length of this shirt landed an inch aboveboard my knee, so I was able to wear it a dress. If you were to do so, I suggest loosening the sash, as when you raise your arms, the tunic travels with you. With leggings, the sash can be tied as loose or as tight as you desire (I prefer a more form fitting appearance, so I keep it tight with leggings). It's a little bulky with jeans. The length of the tunic looks odd tucked in or left flowing, but I've found that high waisted anything with just the front tucked in and the back left out looks really cute. I highly recommend this if you want comfort and style in one. Easy to dress up or dress down, and therefore perfect for someone like myself!

review_summary: I am all about color, and

It was more like bracelet length which is a little longer than 3/4 length but shorter than full length. Personally, I prefer that. Ultimately, if you're like me and love teal then go for it! But be careful with the sizing if you want to button it up.

review_summary: Let me just start by sayi
review_text: Let me just start by saying that I LOVE ModCloth! And I also really like these Charter School Cardigans. That said, something funky is going on with them. I ordered multiple colors, all size large (to replace the ones I've been wearing over and over for the last two years) but the sizing is off. Check out the pictures I included. these are fresh out of the box. The cardigan on bottom is the Honey color, size large. The one on top is the Peacock color, size large. The measurements say L should be 23.5, which the Honey colored on is. But, the Peacock, Black and Charcoal colors all seem to run even smaller...just a little over 22 in. long. What's up with this ModCloth?

review_text: Love the color of this peacock cardigan and pretty happy with the fit. This goes with so much of my wardrobe. My only gripe: the quality of the material for the price; even hang drying, it started to pill after its first cycle in the washing machine (in a lingerie bag to protect it). Besides that, right out of the box the side seam on the sleeve was slightly split at the wrist. Since I'm in Canada at the moment, the shipping and taxes were astronomical, so a return or exchange was not viable. Too bad. :/Sidenote to editors: None of my recent reviews (from the past 2 months) have been posted. I am not sure what the issue is; when I retry it says I already submitted reviews. Any ideas?

review_summary: I had very high hopes for
review_text: I had very high hopes for this cardigan that I purchased in both Charcoal and Peacock, size Large. I've had them for about 6 months now. My beef with the cardigans is that they have pilled like crazy, and not just in typical spots like under the arms. They've pilled all over. I realize this happens to most any knit garment but it seems to be in excess with these. They also attract lint a lot. I took one of those pumice stones made for removing pilling to one of them and it did help some, but it will never look new again. Next time I buy a cardigan I'm determined for it to be a material that doesn't pill so easily so it will last longer!

This cardigan is really lovely and pairs well with most of what I own. I wouldn't call it especially warm but I have had to take it off in overheated spaces. I think every stylish shopper should get at least one in the color that sings to them! #forgoodmeasure
Love this sweater. I adore the color. It's a perfect peacock blue/green. It fits perfect and I wear it all the time. Success!
Beautiful color, fit great once I sized up! Goes with sooo many different outfits. Love the versatility. Wash with care!

I was worried about it being a bit too thick for this season, but actually it's thin enough for the spring/summer season, and to layer in the colder months as well. The color is richer in person than on the photo, so that was a pleasant surprise. Overall, a really great purchase, and I think I might get more in other colors.

review_text: It seemed silly to me to get so excited over a simple buttonup cardigan, after I read all the reviews extolling the virtues of this sweater. But after seeing it on sale, I gave it a shot. I can see why people like this little cardi so much. It's so simple, but it fits so well that you just feel great in it. After buying dozens of cardigans over the years in a quest for a decent one, well... ..my search is over. This isn't frumpy, it's not cheap, and it feels so soft. I will be wearing it a lot and giving my crappy stretchedout, frumpy cardis away.  I only wish I'd bought more colors when they were on sale. Now I have to wait again 'til the next sale rolls around. I hope ModCloth keeps these as part of its permanent inventory. Now if only I could find the perfect basic tee.....

review_summary: I love the color! It's ve

I'm really impressed by the value of this cardigan; it's a great piece for the price. While I'm usually a fan of having some natural fiber in most of my clothes, I think I actually prefer the way this synthetic blend fits me. The knit is sturdy without being bulky. The color is really fantastic  I think peacock is a perfect description. I purchased this cardigan to pair with the As Noir as I'm Concerned Dress but I also wanted to have it on hand to mitigate the overwhelming amount of black and grey in my wardrobe. I will see how it holds up over a couple washes, but to be honest, I already added this in black and charcoal to my personal wishlist  these cardigans definitely have wardrobe staple potential! My only issue is that it is a teensy bit big on me in the arms, waist, and bust. I think an XS would be fantastic but, in a pinch, I think the fit of this cardigan will improve once I wash it and reshape it to dry. Also, I'm a huge fan of the sleeve length. They are short enough to not get in my way, but since I am petite, they are not a true 3/4 length on me which is actually absolutely perfect for concealing my partial sleeve tattoos at work ;)

If you look at the third display photo, you will notice the neckline is notched just above the side of the outter breast.  If you try to wear this with a tank and you aren't as perfectly SLIM as the model is ;  it creates a weird looking patch of skin that resembles unsightly armpit / side boob.  I'm fairly fit and still found it to be really unattractive;  if you carry any extra weight in that area it's unlikely to work for you with a tank under it.  I'm going to try it with a few sleeve style shirts but if nothing works this will be being returned.   I also would size down.  This may have prevented that notch from exposing so much.

review_summary: I wanted these to work so
review_text: I wanted these to work so bad and I was so disappointed in the reality of tunics. I bought them in almost every color because they are so perfect for virtually every scenario, but they are so cheaply made that I've had an identical tear in more than two of them. They are not made of a stretchy material, but if you put any pressure at all on the seams surrounding the buttons it's just straight up tears. It's not that these are too small or constantly of pressure on them, but for the occasion where you are reaching something or using your shoulders in a way that stretches the center it doesn't even have any give. The material is some kind of synthetic polyester I believe so when it tears it basically frays into a bunch of tiny little threads and I just don't see how I can fix it without it looking poorly done. I will fix them anyway but considering the spot and the lack of extra fabric it's gonna look very clearly taped or glued. They should not be $40 if they are going to tear in the first three uses. I am a diehard ModCloth shopper partly because they have such good customer service and respond so well to the situations but there's nothing they can do about this one. I have a bunch of $40 shirts that are worth about $8 each. Oh well. You live and learn.

I love this sweater! It's my first Christmas sweater, ever, and it's just amazing. It arrived two day early, just in time for me to never take it off until after Christmas! It's thinner than I imagined, and more along the lines of a boyfriend fit. But the roominess of it makes it undeniably comfortable. I'm an inbetweener in sizing: Not quite a large, and not quite a medium on ModCloth. Despite my measurements, I come across as generally petite in most sections, save my tummy, and so my waist naturally sucks in the some of the extra baggage of the sweater, which makes it almost flattering on me (it's a Christmas sweater, remember?). If you're after this for a fashionable fit, I'd order a size down, and keep in mind that it wasn't knit to flatter! I've gotten so many compliments on it all day, and countless laughs and highfives from fans of the movie. The cotton content allows for breathability, while the acrylic will keep this baby from wearing down after the washes. I'm not sure why they called it intarsia, as it looks to me more like double knitting on the front panel and sleeves. This means that the parts with color work on it (the Leg Lamp, snow, etc) are twice as thick as the sleeve cuffs and back panel, which is nice, considering the thinness of yarn used. Technical jargon aside, this is a highquality knit sweater that I'm sure will become almost as legendary a Christmas piece as the movie that inspired it. :)

I majorly fluctuate in ModCloth sizes, but I got the 2x in this because I've ordered a 3x in this style of sleeveless top before and I was swimming in it. Unfortunately, the sizing was super weird. As others have mentioned, the arm holes were huge, but somehow it still pulled a ton across the bust when I had the buttons done up. The collar was also way too high (I saw that mentioned in a couple reviews and I was like, meh, they're just nitpicking, but it was kind of an issue) and looked weird. I fixed all my problems by tacking the collar open so it wasn't so turtlenecky, wearing the buttons undone with a navy camisole underneath (also helped with the slight transparency issue) and topping it off with a navy cardigan to hide the gaping arm holes. All in all I think the styling of the top makes it even cuter, but it definitely won't look perfect straight out of the box.

review_summary: I now am a proud owner of
review_text: I now am a proud owner of three of these skirts.  BRIGHT red, black, and this lovely green.  I would generally agree with the folks here who say these skirts fit about normally.  However, they do fit on your real waist, above your belly button.  Now, I am no huge fan of high waist things, especially if I am not tucking in my blouse.  Therefore, I ordered a size up, since I am typically wearing it lower.  My original skirt, the red one, is my normal size (S), and is a bit tighter than I'd prefer.  Though the elastic has gotten better with more wear.However, when I do wear it high and tucked in, the extra leeway provides some comfortable space for my blouse.  In the already rising humidity here in Japan, I can definitely say I appreciate it.The fabric is very polyester, flows nicely, and hides your pockets well.  I can fit my larger smartphone in the pocket, with no qualms and minimal pulling.I typically teach in these skirts (because ELASTIC!), and even with leggings underneath, they flow nicely.  You cannot see the black leggings beneath the skirt, even on the bright red one.TL;DRWhat I am longwindedly saying is: order up a size if you prefer your clothes to sit lower on your hips or for some extra wiggle room for tuck ins.  The waist is elastic.  It is a solid work skirt that can be dressed up and down. +10, would totally buy again and again.  Also, POCKETS!

There's enough fabric so the skirt is billowy, so watch out when you walk out in windy weather!Pockets are deep and well hidden. The belt is not great quality leather, but it's not very noticeable. The belt is also very very long, about 1.5 times my waist. If this skirt came in other colors I would absolutely buy all of them!

The fabric is a bit cheap looking upon close inspection, but once the skirt is on, it doesn't feel bad and looks fine. The construction is okay. review_summary: Oh boy....it took me a fe
review_text: Oh boy....it took me a few days to decide to keep this skirt. I ordered a size up from my usual M after readin the reviews about this strange lining. They weren't kidding! I don't understand how the company that produces this skirt could be successful if they can't comprehend the simple concept of a lining. The lining is oddly tight, has no stretch, and  you guessed it  does a weird pulling thing when you sit down. So much so, that it causes the skirt to become wrinkled instantly. I thought ordered a size up would hopefully fix this problem, but alas, it didn't. I took the recommendation from another reviewed to cut the lining. I just cut slits where the lining meets the buttons and the problem is relatively solved. Not sure why the product creators couldn't figure this out, but I digress. The material is cheap, construction is poor, but I'm keeping it. I like the style, and, while I don't know how long it'll last at least I used a coupon!

review_summary: I really do like this ski
review_text: I really do like this skirt, but I kinda had to fix it before I could wear it. The main problem  the slip is horrific. I had the same problem that other people here had. The slip is attached funny. I'm not even sure how to explain it. But, when you sit, the slip makes the button area pucker and you can see your undies. The slip doesn't even cover where the buttons connect, so the slip is pretty much useless and makes the fit awkward. I cut the slip out as soon as I tried on the skirt. So much better! The button area lays flat now and fits better.  I do recommend another slip of some sort. I already had one that works fine, so I'm glad I don't have to go buy one. It was very wrinkled but I kinda expect that when clothes get shipped. It wasn't too hard to iron them out (use low heat). Also, one of the buttons fell off as soon as I put the skirt on. Not hard to fix, but for $50, the buttons shouldn't be falling off the first day. So, after I made small adjustments, I really do like it. I love the vintage style and the length. I plan on wearing it often. :)

review_summary: I bought this skirt as a
review_text: I bought this skirt as a wildcard in an outfit I was trying to put together, not really expecting that it would work. I have wide hips, so skirts that flare like this generally don't do me any favors, but sometimes you throw caution to the wind. I'm really glad I did, because I love (almost) everything about it. The color is a little lighter than the photo, which is actually an improvement, I think. The belt is good quality and detaches. The waist stretches and the length hits exactly at my kneemy perfect length. Two things that lead me to lower the review from 5 stars to 4: first, the lining of the skirt, as a few people have already pointed out, is at least a size smaller than the skirt itself. I love that it's lined, but it pulls at the widest part of my hips and causes the fourth button down on the front to pucker. I'm going to unstitch the lining at the seam and see if I can expand it to accommodate my hips, but it's the extra effort of having to do so that really drags the overall quality of the skirt down. Second, the buttons themselves are sewn on very shoddily. They're loose, and even before I put the skirt on, the one at the waist on the interior popped off. This is fixable, so it's not a BIG deal, but I'd expect to at least get the skirt on my body before things started bursting off. Be aware that it also will arrive in a wrinkled ball, so have an iron handy.

I love several things about this skirt (the color: grey chambray, the belt: vintage college girl charming, etc). However, the negative outweighed the positives for me at this price tag. The elastic waist makes it look oddly tight, though it could fit someone a few inches bigger than me still. It digs in slightly at the back, giving the appearance of a bulge where it meets the skin. The bunching around the waist and hips seems to add a few pounds there, and my hips are not big compared to the rest of my body. And, for some inexplicable reason, I feel very strongly that this skirt should have pockets. It doesn't, and I didn't expect it to online, but when I tried it on, I found myself reaching over and over again to put my hands in a pocket that didn't exist. Strange, but I couldn't shake the feeling. Finally, as some other reviewers have mentioned, the lining is a bit smaller than the rest of the skirt, and it is attached to the seam with the buttons, so it makes the buttons gape ever so slightly in a weird way (especially when you move). Mine was actually missing a button when it arrived, but I could still tell that this wasn't a keeper, even if I'd exchanged it. If this were on sale in a major way, I might buy it and make some adjustments, but as is, it just doesn't work for me.

review_summary: I grabbed this just as it

It does have a very distinctive swishing noise.  I'm only giving it a 4 because the lining is a bit odd and doesn't go over the buttons in the front. Advice to modcloth: Don't shove this skirt into a teeny box. If you packed it more neatly, it wouldn't arrive wrinkled and I would have probably liked it a lot more. Besides that, it's too long. review_summary: I had been looking at thi

It's cut in a straight/pencil shape, and has no stretch so anyone with hips might have a problem. I have large hips, but this wouldn't even button because of the way it's attached to the skirt. I detached the lining from the sides and am in the processes of expanding it with additional fabric. The buttons are a little loose, but that's also easily fixed. The silhouette, the color, and the length of this skirt are very flattering, versatile and appropriate for many situations, and I am sure I will wear it constantly once I'm done fixing it, but for a $50 skirt the construction leaves a lot to be desired.

In the picture, the black looks faded, it isn't, it's just washed out from the lighting. I pretty much only wear this skirt to work in a normal office setting and I never put it in the dryer so it doesn't get a lot of wear. The weirdest part about this is back in the day I ordered this exact skirt when it was still offered in charcoal grey. More than TWO YEARS later that skirt looks like i just bought it!!! I don't know if there is a quality issue/difference with the black ones vs the grey (the fit is a little different too) or if I just got a defective skirt but I cannot in good faith recommend this skirt to anyone.

review_text: This was my second pair of Karaoke Songstress jeans and I don't think I'll be buying anymore in future. I originally got the regular length about 1 1/2 years ago, and as I am short (5'4 and a half), they were way too long and I've always worn them rolled up. They wore out in the crotch after a few months and the right leg was twisted which was annoying but they fit me like a dream around my waist though. So when they started carrying the cropped length, I thought that would be much better for me. Unfortunately, they're right at that awkward length where they're not quite long enough to be regular jeans (just barely though) and not short enough to be cropped pants on me, and for some reason are too tight around my ankles/lower calves to roll up (which is weird because I found the full length ones to be not tight enough at the bottom...). I do still wear them sometimes because, again, the top fits like a dream, but guess what? The right leg is twisted on this pair too! And even worse than the first pair! I think there must be something wrong with their pattern...  The twisted leg drives me so insane that, even though I've had these for six months, I've probably only worn them less than 20 times in that time period and definitely washed them less than 10 times, and STILL the crotch is starting to wear out on these ones too! So sorry Judy Blue Jeans, I won't be giving you another chance. I will have to find me some better quality high wasted jeans instead.

I've been looking for some great looking highwaisted pants for my curvier figure and based on all the rave reviews, these seemed perfect. I was having difficulty choosing a size, and I wanted to make sure I chose the right one, as returns are more complicated for me because I live in Canada. I spoke to one of the online customer service reps, a cool service, except, after figuring out my measurements (according to the guide) and telling the rep, she advised I go with a 1x, This was pretty unexpected, as I'm usually a 12, and most of the reviews said these pants were a bit stretchy, but I compromised this advise by going down to a 15. Boy, should I ever have listened to myself! the pants were waaaaay too big! I definitely needed an 11, or at the very largest, a 13.To be honest, I'm really upset that modcloth has this service that is supposed to help me find the right sizes and then they advise me to purchase as size that was so far off! To make matters worse, I had to pay 20$ in customs fees to get the pants shipped to Canada, and it would cost just as much to ship and return them back to modcloth, so I'm now stuck with them! VERY disappointing. That said, I have to give this item at least three stars, because I can tell they're great quality, and the length was great for me, as a short girl, the length works perfectly as either cropped or fulllength pants. These pants would've been great if I only HADN'T listened to the person from customer care.

This jumpsuit. THIS JUMPSUIT.The fabric has both a nice weight and enough stretch to make it comfortable, though it does come fairly wrinkled. It feels very wellmade. I was also VERY pleasantly surprised by how flattering it was, given my odd proportions: I'm 5'2, plump (I wear anywhere from a 1216 in dresses, depending on the cut) but have a very long torso and short legs. The length of the torso was perfect, and didn't hike up in my crotch like I was afraid it would. While I may get the legs hemmed because I plan to wear this with sandals, the pants are nowhere near as long as I anticipated. They would be perfect with a pair of heels.I do have a few small complaints. The fabric was fairly wrinkled when it arrived, and it's almost impossible to see the beautiful pleats on the legs. Nothing some ironing won't fix, but a little annoying. Additionally, the zip down the front is somewhat wiggly and distorted when done up, but I suspect that's just because the XL fits juuuust right and may be a teensy bit too tight, though the 2X would definitely be too big. This is also much less noticeable with a wide belt. Finally, while putting the jumpsuit on was a breeze, it's a little tight to get out off. It left me worried that I would pop some stitches trying to get it over my shoulders, though it wasn't tight at all once it was on. I just wish I didn't have to take it off so gingerly.That being said, this is a gorgeous piece and I'm thrilled to have it!

review_summary: I bought this in teal and
review_text: I bought this in teal and black.  The fabric is thick and of good quality.  Beautifully tailored and incredibly flattering, hugging all the right places and falling just right.  I'm a size 10 and short waisted and the teal was a perfect fit.  The black one for some reason is a smaller fit. I read previous reviews that said this about it too, but I thought perhaps it was a one off. I plan to exchange the black one for a large. review_summary: OMG I have never owned a
review_text: OMG I have never owned a jumpsuit and am a tshirt and jeans kinda girl but wanted to look classy and professional for an event. This is the most amazing thing I've ever purchased. Only minor things: the button hole is very tight and if you are not well endowed there could be a little gaping at the chest when bending over. I'm buying the maroon too!

review_summary: I am now a HUGE fan of Mi
review_text: I am now a HUGE fan of Miss Candyfloss!! The workmanship and details and overall quality  just, wow.Lovely button detail at the bust, and even though I don't usually like pockets on the bum (since I don't need anymore bulk back there!), they're flat and cute, too.The length in the torso even has spare room, which is shocking to me; if a jumpsuit is long enough for most, my ample rear usually shortens it. Not this time. (I waver between size 8 and 10. I'm a 10 right now.)As mentioned by other reviewers, it curves in and out in all the right places.I could go for another inch in leg length (I'm 5'8 1/2), since I like high heels and long trousers to make me look taller/thinner. But I will not quibble here! This is beautiful. Pricey, yes  more than I normally spend for any article of clothing. But I feel very worth it this time. If ONLY it came in nonwinter palette colors! Sapphire, emerald, turquoise? I'd be all over that!! Teal is out in my size, or I'd even try that, despite not being my best blue or green. That's how much I love this.

review_summary: Where do I start? This ju
review_text: Where do I start? This jumpsuit is amazing. I was a bit worried with the length and sizing but it fits great. I usually struggle to find clothes which will fit both my smal bust and my smallish waist. At 24, the size XS is perfect although it could have been a little bit tighter. In saying that, it comes with a belt which fits my waist perfectly. The length is also great. I do wear heels but not very high ones, and even with 1.5 to 2 heels, it just works wonders. The wide legs are well.... VERY wide, the real deco style, so if you're not much of a wide leg trousers person, I wouldn't recommend. Otherwise just BUY IT ALREADY! The 3/4 sleeves are very flattering, the fabric is heavy and the whole jumpsuit is of the highest quality (not surprising seeing it's a Miss Candyfloss jumpsuit. YAY!)I wore it with a colourful sash instead of the belt for a deco dance event at the weekend and everyone loved it and I got tons of compliments. This is definitely the kind of outfit you need accessories with to give it a true vintage feel

After reading the reviews, I opted to order a 3x over my usual 2x. Given that I am rather busty, jumpsuits are not something I usually try. I am glad I sized up, but I honestly wished I had size up to a 4x. The 3x is very tight over my bust and therefor the crotch pulls a little. This also seems to affect the length also. In flats, the sizing is perfect, but even with a 3 inch heels, its a little shorter than I would like. The fabric is lovely and the little details are wonderful. Having pockets for such an event is going to be wonderful. It is just a little frustrating that the sizing is so off. Sadly this isn't the first time I have experienced this with mod cloth's plus sizes, there is such a tiny difference between the 2x3x4x that I often have to size up twice. But with the ball being a few months away, I have time to figure out my options. I honestly am really looking forward to wearing this out in all my 1940's styling.

Super amazing!!!! Was worried my husband would think it was too out there, but it looked so damn good he loved it! I am so impressed with how well this fits me like a glove. When getting into it, the crotch area could be a little more forgiving...once it's on it fits great! Could be a prob with those with a longer torso. I'm busty so I might have to pin the top closed a little, easy fix!

review_summary: Nice Color, Decent Fabric, Difficult Sizing
review_text: I'm so grateful to everyone that reviewed this and specified their size, because otherwise I would have gotten a drastically wrong size.My waist is 39, I got a 3x (!) and I am tailoring it down 4. A 2x possibly could have fit, but with all the talk I went up just to be sure.For those who tailor, there are a good number of pleats so it isn't too hard to take in. Also, there is no inner liner, which doesn't speak to quality, but does make it easier.I am 5'3 and will likely be taking it up about 2 (like most of my clothes) to get to a true midi length.Nice color (I would describe as forest green), the fans are in fuzzy black, so a very fun fabric. Good, deep pockets  I can fit my whole hand in and a little more, but my hands are a bit small.The lack of liner and good amount of pleating makes me think this skirt would be best with a petticoat to fluff it up a bit.

Perhaps I should have called one of the stylists, but while they're super nice I was lead astray once (I'm sure it was a fluke!!  Just saying where my head was at) and I've never had an issue of a skirt being too small!  Every S skirt I've ever gotten from Modcloth, including the ones I've kept, I've had to think about and wish they made it in an XS before deciding the S will be fine.  This was a first, lol!  I deeply considered keeping it regardless and working around how it was almost too small because the fabric really is as beautiful as all the other reviewers say it is.  But between it not exactly fitting perfectly and that the top button kind of stuck out funny (I don't know if it was just mine or what but I don't think it was exclusively because of the wonky fit...) I decided to send it back.  FYI to all the skinny girls out there...a small (might?) be better than an xs!

review_summary: I always have to wash you
review_text: I always have to wash your garments before I wear them, because they're all a bit flat from being packaged  this one says definitely don't dry clean!The colour and shape are gorgeous, just like the photo. The sizing is pretty generous and the length is fairly long on me, but that's fine.

review_summary: I was in virtual love wit
review_text: I was in virtual love with this skirt, then i receved it and was so captivated. This skirt is so lovely and versatile. Got so many compliments on it. #loveit!

THIS IS MY FAVORITE SKIRT.I've had my eye on it forever, and finally got it. I'm rather short, so it's very long, but it isn't a problem for me. The fabric isn't too thick, and the huge pockets are a giant perk. It's the perfect design and color to wear with a variety of tops (although I mostly go for black).The only thing I'm not a fan of is how tight it was on top. I got a small, which was perfect except for the button. It is very tight and I could barely fasten it. Going up a size would have made the skirt too big. My solution was shapewear. I bought the Simply Smooth Waist Corslet, also from Modcloth, and now it fits perfectly! I'm wearing it in both pictures. I've gotten nothing but complements every time I have worn this skirt, and am very happy with my purchase. The raised velvet fans pattern is also lovely.

review_summary: LOVE THIS. I went ahead a
review_text: LOVE THIS. I went ahead and ordered my regular size, despite the warnings that it runs small, and it was actually perfect. Needs to be worn at the natural waist, but that's where I like my skirts to start anyways. Wore it with the Cafe Parfait top in Noir, fishnets and purple suede wedges and got a lot of compliments for the vintagey feel. Can't say enough great things about this skirt!! A bit pricey, but I'm looking at it as an investment piece that I'll wear for years. Go for it if you're on the fence!

Lovely! I don't know how I lived without this skirt! The material wasn't as thick as the other reviewers led me to believe it was but that means I'll be able to wear it during the summer as well. The colors aren't as vibrant as in some of the picture and I wish it was lined but that's just me being picky. I sized up as suggested and I'm glad I did.

review_summary: This sat in my closet for
review_text: This sat in my closet for a while because I didn't know what to pair it with. But after I found a shortsleeved, longhipped black cardigan to wear it with it became part of one of my favorite outfits. The length is a little long but this way it works somehow. The fan pattern is really nice, velvety.  A very unique skirt. I love it. #forgoodmeasure

I really really adore this skirt.. if only I could wear it. I ordered a 3x based upon my measurements and what a staff member told me, and it's just too small around the waist. I tried moving the button over as some other reviewers mentioned and it still is too tight to be comfortable.Unfortunately I am stuck with this skirt as I am international. Definitely size up! The waist is tight and there is zero stretch.

Oh my goodness,  I don't even know where to begin with this skirt. I have loved it for awhile now, and finally bit the bullet when I had a code. I sized up to a 3X (I am almost consistently an 18W and a 1X or 2X in most Modcloth purchases). Like other reviews have stated, this dress is tight in the waist. I couldn't button it at all, and this was pulling it to where it was literally right under my breasts, so the smallest part of my abdomen. Even pulled up, or lowered to not be high waisted, it hit me at the worst part of my legs. I have very stumpy legs, and this did them no favors. If you are a somewhat tall, hourglass, plus size lady, you will probably love this and it will be amazing. Otherwise, I would just love it from afar. The quality of the material is very good, and I also saw it on a TV show on Investigation Discovery right after I sent it back.

review_summary: Love this skirt! Fits a l
review_text: Love this skirt! Fits a little tighter than I had estimated, but still fits very nicely. The green color is so rich and makes a statement without being loud, and the black details are velvety and really pop! I love how it falls it is very flattering. Also love the pockets!

review_summary: I love this skirt. It's w
review_text: I love this skirt. It's well made, thick material (so maybe not the best for warm weather).The colors are as they appear on the site. I needed to get it altered slightly has the waist was too big. But mind you I'm a 24 inch waist and could have probably got away with an XS.But overall great quality and great skirt.

review_summary: Just got this item, and I
review_text: Just got this item, and I'm very pleased. It does fit small, but true to the size chart. I ordered M, my waist is 2829 with a small rib age, and it is lovely. The length is perfect  difficult to find this 'vintage' length that I think is so classy, but this skirt nails it. Darling print, nice medium weight fabric, just what I was looking for!

review_summary: I've got short legs so it
review_text: I've got short legs so its a little long on me but easily fixed with a pair of heels. Amazing fabric not to heavy but fantastic quality. So much fun for dancing and twirling.

review_summary: Way too much skirt, too l
review_text: Way too much skirt, too long, had to go back.  It is a very pretty, highquality skirt.  However, I think I am too short for it.  I am 5'4 and I looked silly in it.  It's a lot of skirt, though very lovely.  I was sad to send it back.

I absolutely ADORE this skirt.  It's so unique and the quality is definitely worth the dough.  Extremely flattering on the figure, too  it makes my waist look TINY!  I usually pair it with The Answer is Sheer top or some sort of black cowl neck.  Be prepared, however  this skirt draws a lot of (positive) attention!

review_summary: I have a short waist so t
review_text: I have a short waist so the wide waistband folds down when I wear it and the pleats open because I am curvy. I feel like I am swimming in fabric even when I wear a girdle. The fabric is nice and heavy fit for winter. But, I regret not returning this skirt (its been a while now)

review_summary: I fell for this skirt the
review_text: I fell for this skirt the instant I saw it. Dark green is one of my favorite colors, and it goes just beautifully with the delicate black velvet fan pattern. It's a perfect balance of elegance and simplicity.I probably could have gotten a M, but my waist measurement tends to fluctuate a bit so anyone smaller than me should be fine with a S.It's one of my absolute favorite things to wear, and I get stopped for compliments and questions every time. Definitely worth the price.

review_summary: I love this skirt! This i
review_text: I love this skirt! This is my very first modcloth purchase and I am IN LOVE!I was a bit worried that it would be too tight in the waist but it fits well, up high. I am losing weight at the moment so didn't want to go up a size and am really happy that I got the large.Australian customers: I know you're all keen (like me) to know how long it took to get to me. I live in Brisbane (a metro area) and ordered this on 6 Nov and it arrived on 25 Nov. Really happy with that! I was expecting it to take a bit longer. I wore this skirt yesterday and nearly everyone I came across complimented me on it. It's an absolute stunner and the quality and colour is just as it appears. Thanks modcloth!

review_summary: I am really tall so I was
review_text: I am really tall so I was so happy to get a skirt that actually has some length to it.  It's a nice swirly one for dancing too!  It fit perfectly and when I ran a warm iron over the thick, high quality material it hung beautifully.  I love this skirt  it's already a favourite!

This skirt is beautiful! The quality is perfect and... it has pockets!!! My measurements at the time of purchase fit the XL size, but now it fits a little loose. I look forward to using this skirt often.

review_summary: I adore this skirt. I get
review_text: I adore this skirt. I get compliments every single time I wear it! I'm thinking about getting another just like it because I wear it so much. It is my favorite item in my entire wardrobe.

I love this skirt! Length falls right below my knees, which is perfect because I would rather longer skirts. The great things about the bettie page label is that I need to alter it like other clothes I purchase, just right for my waist

Love this skirt. I'm 125lbs and 5'2. I have a fairly small waist. This skirt fits just right.  I have people stop me every time I wear it! The skirt is excellent quality but is not lined. I've also seen this skirt in fashion magazines as an editors pick

review_summary: I LOVE this skirt and get
review_text: I LOVE this skirt and get so many compliments when I wear it. I'm glad I read the reviews and got a large, it fits perfectly.
Amazingly great quality! I get compliments where ever I go with this beauty!
Love this skirt. Great quality. I will have it hemmed a bit but I have very short legs. Super happy with this purchase.

Have been happy with this skirt for awhile now!   You can really pair so much with it, and while I use it during fall/winter, you can easily use it in spring/summer too!  It is just a little to thick for me to use in summertime  way to humid in Indiana for all that skirt for me!
Great skirt with thick fabricalthough it's polyester and not cotton. I get complements on it all the time and I love that it can easily be dressed up or down.

This skirt is so unique! The green with black fan motif is a show stopper. I wear a simple black tank top with it and feel amazing in it. The fabric is really nice and high quality. The hidden side zipper is topped with a button which I think is a must for skirts! Perfection!

review_summary: To my fellow women of a c
review_text: To my fellow women of a certain age out there trying to get your style back, and maybe more worried about age appropriateness than pricetag  I really like this skirt on myself at age 47 after 4 kids and a fair bit of extra tummy to show for them. After wear and tear I can't go as short with hemlines as I once did and this skirt gives some coverage with a cute waist that, yes, is a bit snug but I am a lumpy size 8 and a Medium works for me. The hue of green is truly an unusual old classic color that I used to search out back in the day, and the velvet flocking is of a quality that makes it look almost preppy vintage if you want. I like it with a fitted black top and belt or sweater. Looks cute with black tights which I think flatter any older person.  Give it a try, it sure brightened my day.

review_summary: I wasn't sure what my mod
review_text: I wasn't sure what my modcloth size would be when I ordered this and it ended up being to small. I decided not to size up because the color was lighter than it looked on its photo and did not fit what I was looking for.  It seems fine, just not right for me.

I really like this skirt. I love the color and the fan print. It has pockets too! Length is a little long for me. It hits below the knee and I wish it was above. The waist it slightly big but since I usually wear this in the fall/winter it's good that I can layer thicker tops with it. I am worried about washing it with the velvet print. I don't want to ruin it! This skirt is great. I wanted it for a long time and finally hot it on sale! Thanks Modcloth!

review_summary: Love love love it! The fi
review_text: Love love love it! The fit is perfect, the fabric is comfortable, and it can be dressed up or down very easily. The flocking on the fans is such a cute touch. Definitely want more things like this!
For anyone over a large...,,this skirt runs very small!  Size up

review_summary: Even though I sized up on
review_text: Even though I sized up one size (from 1x to 2x), this skirt was still too small in the waist for me.  I had to return it, which is a shame because it is lovely.  Very nice quality fabric and beautiful print!  Wish I could have kept this.

review_summary: So much love for this ski
review_text: So much love for this skirt! Colour and the flocking are adorable and the pockets are super convenient. I ordered a large, judging by other accounts, even though I'm only a 1012 (Aus size) but this means it sits very comfortably on my waist. Best worn with a slip to help the boxpleat sit well. Will attract a lot of compliments!

I love this skirt. Love, love, love. I have weight problems where I am always fluctuating in the 145155 range and that also effects how tight or perfect this skirt feels on my waist but regardless it's absolutely darling! If you're considering this skirt, GET IT!

This skirt is WONDERFULLY soft, the perfect length for modesty but flirtatiousness... Wish it came in another print and color, then I would've kept it!I decided to send it back because I wasn't a huge fan of the, well, fans, and because I didn't get nearly as many compliments on this dress as the Essential Essence skirt I bought with itand my wallet deemed I could only keep one.

review_summary: I love, love, love this s
review_text: I love, love, love this skirt. I don't own anything like it, so I was taking a chance because I'm usually conservative. I paired my skirt with a black shirt, wide black belt, ModCloth mustard yellow cardigan and mustard yellow heels. This is officially my favorite outfit. I agree with others in that the skirt is a bit tight in the waist. I'm a solid size 12, so I took the advice of others, and sized up. I'm glad I did.

review_summary: Skirt is too long and too
review_text: Skirt is too long and too small (I'll get it taken up from the waist to make the waistband bigger)If you're normally a Size 4x from bettie page then this will be too small for you.

review_summary: I don't think I would hav
review_text: I don't think I would have purchased this without reading all the reviews.  Its one of those 'things' that kinda grows on you.  It is definitely green, a serious green, the fans have a slight rise, like felt.  The first time I wore it, got compliments.  I wore with black turtleneck for winter look.  I think it can be an all season favorite, perfect with a patent leather belt.

Cute skirt.  A bit tighter at the waist than I expected.  I usually wear XL for my bust, and often a L in skirts, but this XL is a tight fit.  It you're not sure or retain water now and then, go a size bigger to be safe.I'm not sure how I'll wear this, but I will upload a better picture once I figure out what makes this one pop  maybe a black tank and Charter School Cardigan in Honey (current in the delicate cycle of the washer).  Temporarily, I've paired it with the Overnight Travel Top bc they came in the same shipment (but I'd never put these two together). Love this skirt!

Unlike another skirt I ordered, this was perfect in size. It gently sits on my waist, the fabric is really nice, not too heavy not too light, and the colour in the picture is accurate. A really really nice skirt good all year round!!
beautiful skirt!  it looks great on me and seems to have the effect of slimming me down too.... now to either move the button or lose an inch or 2... :)

review_summary: It is a pretty skirt but
review_text: It is a pretty skirt but the L was too small for my waist. The lenght was good the fabric is ok but the look was not too flattering for me somehow I was not as wowed as most of the reviewers are so I am returning it.

review_summary: This was one of my favori
review_text: This was one of my favorite items for my ModEmployee shoot. I love the color, and the design and cut of the skirt were great as well! It flows really nicely from the highwaist over the hips. It is a heavier fabric, so I think this would would have to be reserved for a cooler night or fall/wintertime. Either way, it's lovely!

This skirt is so gorgeous! it was a birthday gift from my folks (after a few winks and nudges from yours truly), and as soon as I opened it the day of my party I ran upstairs and changed into it, with a strapless black bodysuit, a black braided belt, and little black loafers. I have a 26 inch waist and the small fit a littlle tighter than I was expecting, but I figure this gives it room to stretch without ruining the fit. the fabric is sturdy and the color is just gorgeous. I got compliments all night!

review_summary: Over all the skirt is nic
review_text: Over all the skirt is nice, but a bit long. The button is sewn in crooked, so the waist becomes to small and the skirt wrinkles. This means I have to move the button, which I think compares badly to the price!

review_summary: I wore this to a Fall wed
review_text: I wore this to a Fall wedding and received so many compliments! Paired with a simple black tshirt, black belt, black blazer, and lots of jewelry, it was a perfectly polished outfit! I am normally a 1214 on top and between the L and XL I went with the XLruns a tad small.
Ran small.
Snug but beautiful. Bday present to myself! Simply lovely fabric. The zipper is just awful though, I will be replacing it with an invisible one. The length is almost right, to the seamstress I go!

I LOVE this skirt!This is my first ModCloth purchase and I will be a very loyal customer because of it.I'm always hesitant to shop online, but this was so cute, and I read through the sizing chart and reviews first, as well as the return policy, so I felt pretty confident with the purchase.Even though I went up a size based on the size chart and reviews, it was definitely tight in the waist  like I was feeling faint it was so tight. But what really sold me was even though it was so snug, the button didn't budge and seams didn't pop, even as I moved throughout the night. This skirt is super well made.It also looked adorable. I'm pretty body conscious, and I have a hard body to dress, but this skirt was perfect.Thanks ModCloth!

This skirt is wonderful. I waited so long to buy it and I am so happy I did. It is such good quality; the zipper is easy to zip up and fabric is very nice. It's quite long, but I don't feel like I am drowning in fabric. If you're questioning whether to buy it not, you definitely should buy it. I am going to get a lot of use out of this skirt. Thanks ModCloth!
I love the velvety fans, so cute. Really great item and perfect fit.

review_summary: I can't even say how disa
review_text: I can't even say how disappointed I am right now. I've purchased from Modcloth before shoes and jewelry, but this is my first experience with an item of clothing. Having read the reviews for this item, I sized up as many recommended. Perhaps others, even with sizing issues didn't have as much of an issue because of my particular body shape. The fact remain though that I couldn't get it halfway zipped, much less buttoned. It's a shame because I wanted to love this it's a gorgeous skirt. I love the velvet details. I think I'll be sticking jewelry and accessories from now on in my Modcloth purchases.

review_summary: At first I was really unh
review_text: At first I was really unhappy about the length of the dress.  I looked into getting it altered, and thought about just returning it.  But then I paired it with a form fitting black shirt with sheer sleeves, a pair of black leggings, and some punk rock chic black ankle boots and I relaised the length was actually sort of adorable!!  I have gotten so many complements on this skirt, I wear it at least once a week now when I go out, or even just to class.  It is heavy material and keeps me toasty warm in the winter!

review_summary: i bought this skirt in ju
review_text: i bought this skirt in june (it's december now) and i have TOTALLY gotten my money's worth. i am 5'11.5 so skirts tend to be too short or too old ladyish on me, and this one is so perfect for me. it hits a little below the knee, so it's great for work and for commuting (no worrying about it riding up!). through the summer for work, i paired it with a vneck black tee and a pair of wedge sandals (as seen in the photo). if going out, i wore it with a black tank top. it worked perfectly for a family engagement party in july because it's gorgeous and fancy and appropriate. i paired it with a fitted black tee with lace shoulders and sleeves. this fall, i've worn it with a couple different long sleeved black tees (a standard crew neck, and a button down style tee) and opaque black tights. i've also paired it with a tank top and cardigan, and plan on wearing it with this button down camisole with a frilly pretty collar.this skirt is so pretty with its fuzzy fans and nice fabric, but it's also so comfortable. the slight stretch to the fabric is breathable and forgiving, and is perfect year round. the fit is very complimentary to me, a tall girl with love handles (because that sounds cuter than muffin top). i had to go two sizes up. i am on the lower end of the 2X measurements on the modcloth size chart. i bought the 4X and it fits perfectly. i suggest going to bettie page's website and checking out their size chart for the closest fit.

Quite possibly the best purchase I have ever made on Modcloth thus far. This skirt is to die for, literally. The fit is perfect and very flattering. The pockets are a great addition. I bought a size small and had no problem zipping up and buttoning. It's great for the holidays, can't wait to wear it for Christmas. Oh, and it is well worth the price! Will post a pic soon.

Absolutely amazing skirt!  I love it so much.  It's a beautiful bottle green as per the picture.  The velvet fans are awesome and overall, the skirt is very good quality.   It is quite long, it reaches below the knee  about mid shin (I'm about 5'6).  I like this though, I pair it with black heels and it looks quite dressy.  I usually wear a small, but they button does up nice and firm so I went for a medium for comfort.

beautiful beautiful skirt!!! amazing material, perfect quality. worth every penny!!!! i am 5'4, but mostly torso, so the length was very awkward on me  however, i hemmed it about 3 inches, and have a new favorite modcloth item. i would definitely recommend this skirt!!

review_summary: It's not just small in th
review_text: It's not just small in the larger sizes. I've been eyeing this skirt for months and was thrilled when it was on sale earlier this week because it was an excuse to buy something beautiful.  I generally wear smalls in skirts like a 2 at other stores but I think this sizing must be for Juniors, because I had to suck in for it to fit at the smallest point of my waist, and I am quite thin. Also, on those of us with short legs, it runs rather long.  That said, I will probably take a look at it with some of my better blouses tomorrow, because it is a beautiful skirt, but even at the sale price I feel it needs additional consideration before a reorder.

Beautiful skirt!  I love the color, design and the quality of the skirt.  I found that it fit true to size.  As I am pretty short (5'2), it did fall at an awkward midcalf length on me.  However, that was easily fixed with some simple hemming.  Overall very happy with this purchase :)

I love this skirt! (Sorry, I thought I had more photos, but none seems to really show off the skirt) I bought it to wear in Italy last summer, because I knew there would be a lot of walking involved and it would be comfy, etc. Though it is that, I do not suggest it for warm weather. This skirt is very thick (which I still love!) The waist band does seem a bit tight at times, but that's probably more to do with me than the skirt. The skirt is very flattering. It is unlike anything I own. Such a beautiful beautiful item!

I absolutely adore this skirt.  I'm typically not a skirt person.  It's skinny jeans or dresses for me but sweet jesus is this a great find.  I've been looking at it for well over a year, never buying thinking that my hips are too wide and I would look much too hippy.  Last week I just went for it and finally purchased this in a medium.  It fits PERFECT. It is longer than I'm used to for being 5'5, so i'll try to wear it as it is and if I need to take it up a few inches then I definitely will. It his me at my lower waist just right and if you want to wear it a little higher, you could always belt it.  I'm shocked that it worked for my bodytype and I couldn't be more pleased. I wore it last night and got SO many compliments.

My best modcloth purchase ever. The skirt is very long, flowy, and well made. The patterns on the skirt are made from a different material glued onto the fabric, giving it a 3D appearance which is very nice. I have an hourglass body shape and this skirt is perfect for me.  I'm 168cm and 125lbs and ordered small. The waist is perfect (my waist is about 25)  but will probably be tight if I had a huge meal.

review_summary: i love these skirts  i st
review_text: i love these skirts  i started with the purple, and have just got the green and red. i got the exact same sizes, however this seems tighter than the purple version of this skirt. i do love the length, and love love love pockets. it's a fun skirt that flows beautifully. these is some room to move the button out a little so may need to do that so it doesnt dig in so much.
Nice, thick fabric. Color is true to photos, and the fans are velvety (great!). This will make a nice fall/winter skirt, but is too thick for summer.

I generally wear an 18 or am on the smaller side of a 2X, so when I ordered a 3X to be safe, I was surprised to find it didn't fit. I returned it for a 4X and have worn the skirt a bit over the summer. I liked to pair it with a light pink top for some contrasting colour in the warmer months, but I think I'll go with a black collared shirt and heels as autumn sets in. Although it runs small, it is a beautiful and wellmade skirt.

This skirt is a brighter green than it appears in the photos, but beautiful.  I was suprised by how narrow the waist is, but I think it can be fixed by simply moving the button closer to the edge of the fabric (there is quite a lot of spare fabric right now).  I anticipate that this skirt will be one of my favorite items for fall.

review_summary: I was really on the fence
review_text: I was really on the fence about getting this skirt.  I looked at the skirt for months and read all of the reviews twice.  I'm usually a small, so I was unsure whether to get a small or medium based on previous reviews. My waist is 27 and, based on the size chart, I ordered a medium.  It fits perfectly!!  Snug at the waist, giving me an hourglass shape, but not too tight.  I will have to get the skirt taken up a few inches, however, as I'm very short and it's a long skirt.  However, I could probably wear it out without getting it taken up and still get plenty of compliments.  The quality seems great and I feel the color and pattern are as pictured.  This is such a unique yet tasteful fall/winter/spring skirt.  A bit too heavy for summer, but I have plenty of summer skirts and dresses already.  If you have the money, it would be well spent on this skirt!
Love this skirt!  High quality.  Great vintage look.

This skirt is beautiful and beautifully made! I love the thick material and flocked, black fans. The zipper is a nod to vintage garments. It's lovely on it's own with just a slip underneath and equally comfortable and a standout with a large petticoat. I wear mine with the First Name Basis Heel and VaVaVoluminous Petticoat in Black.My only negative is that it is a bit tight in the waist for me and I would have been better off ordering the larger size.

review_summary: The reviews and info on t
review_text: The reviews and info on this skirt, and the size guide, led me to order a medium. It's absolutely too big for me! I'll have to see if I can move the button and/or have it tailored because it currently sits halfway between my waist and hips. I'm not particularly skinny, and the skirt is supposed to be quite narrow in the waist, so I'm not sure why the fit is so off. An exchange from Australia simply isn't worth the trouble, so I'll just have to deal with it.I'm also quite short, and will have to take up the hem a couple of inches as it currently hits me on the lower side of midcalf rather than at the proper tealength range. The green colour is less rich/deep/bold in person, more of a bright grass green than a forest green (which was what I was hoping for). The fabric also isn't as heavy as expected. The flocking is lovely and the zipper seems sturdy, but overall this skirt is overpriced for what you actually get.

review_summary: This skirt has a lovely p
review_text: This skirt has a lovely pattern on it. The material is a nice, mediumweight, which allows the skirt to drape and poof perfectly. It is a bit long on me, as I am really short. But I am sure this will not be an issue for any girl taller than me.

So this skirt is amazing.  I normally run a 20 in skirts at places like IGIGI and Lane Bryant or a 2X but here the X's run small so I went with a 4X and I'm definitely glad I did.  I'm short, 5'6 so this skirt is a bit too long for me to wear with flats (shouldn't be a problem if you are taller) so this will definitely be a pumps only skirt for me.  Also love the pockets.  I can't even wear dresses or skirts without pockets anymore.  Overall I love this skirt and it's color and style will be make it a versatile piece in my wardrobe for many seasons.  I definitely recommend it.

this skirt is beautiful I have totally fallen in love with it. I did size up and got the biggest as a precaution because it can always be taken in, but it fit perfectly. so ladies if your measurements are close too/the same as mine I recommend going 4X. Also first time buyer from modcloth and I'm a very happy customer! (from Australia)

This skirt is great; excellent quality and beautiful color and style. However be warned, on us shorties it WILL be tea legnth. And I sized up as the previous reviewers suggested, which was a good idea. Bettie Page sizes are different than Modcloth. 2X: 34 3X: 36 4X:38... keep this in mind and you'll be EXTREMELY happy with your purchase!

As mentioned by others, this does run small in the waist, but this is not a problem as the fabric has a bit of stretch and I like a fitted waistband. Very pretty fabric, nice length for a vintage look. I don't think pearshaped girls should be scared off by other comments  the pleats may not work for all, but I enjoy volume on the bottom, balanced by details on the top. I only wish for this price it had been lined and that it was a bit of a deeper green.

review_summary: I am very small! I am 4'1
review_text: I am very small! I am 4'11 and weight between 9095lbs. I got the xs and it fits but is still a little large overall. The waist is really small and I was worried it wasn't going to fit. It sits just under my ribs and it has a tiny bit of space leftover for me to tuck in my shirt. If you don't have a flat stomach I wouldn't recomend this since the please are large right over the belly and made me look a little round on the stomach but I don't care, i still get tons of compliments when I wear it. There's a ton of fabric so it weighs a lot but i think because it's made by bettie paige fashions, it's supposed to have that vintage feel and vintage clothes have thicker materials. This is a dry clean only and boy did I learn my lesson. I thought I could wash it and the fans are made of black velvet so the ink from that came off onto the dress. Hardly noticeable but I'll never wash it again with water and detergent! Lastly the length goes to my mid shin so it works good for church and short girls, i assure you won't drown in this however when i sit down in it there is so much material I have to bunch up to not flow over my chair.  I think anyone over 5,2 this dress would go right under their knee.

So beautiful! I sized up after reading the reviews and was rewarded with a perfectly waistdefining fit that includes some breathing space. The quality is great, the weight of the material is just right and it has a wonderfully sturdy looking zip. The length is about an inch below my knees, but I'm rather tall. Oh, and the pockets! Best ever. This is definitely a new favourite.
I simply adore this skirt! I had to take it to the tailor straight away to get it taken up because it was quite long on me, but other than that, it's perfect :)

This skirt is beautiful, but incredibly tiny. It sits at my natural waist, which I love, but it is TIGHT, ladies! Consider sizing up if your waist isn't especially narrow. I'm a plus size girl, so I like things that nip in at the waist a little because it creates one for me  but I wouldn't dream of calling this a 4x. If I had to size this from the way it feels, I would guess it's a 14 or a 16. I'm a size 20, if it helps, and I can barely get it buttoned, even with sizing up. I will say that the hip is incredibly free; the waist is the only restrictive part, so if you have larger hips and a whittled waist, you should be AOK. I'm keeping it with the hopes that I will be able to lose a few pounds to make it more comfortable. I just can't send back a skirt that a.) is long enough, b.) is so beautiful, and c.) has pockets. Forgive the crappy phone picture!
I absolutely LOVE this skirt! I pared it with a tight black long sleeve top and a orange scarf for a Euroinspired look that everyone at work adored! Such a great buy!
I really like this skirt, Because I'm 5'5 ill have to hem it. The fans are very velvety, very cute!

review_summary: Love the color, and the v
