review_summary: This skirt is such a drea
review_text: This skirt is such a dream! I am showered in compliments because of its velvety little fans and its 50's style. Its such a skirt of class! I am usually an L, I went an XL and am glad that I did to give myself a little more room to move, but it may need a slight adjustment

This skirt definitely makes a statement! The color is gorgeous, and velvet fans are wimsical and sofisticated. I love an Aline shape of it, it has a vintage look and looks very chic. Quality is great as well. This skirt is very unique, and I am very happy to own it! #freshphoto

The thickness and flow of the fabric just makes you feel so feminine when you wear it! This has become one of my favorite items of clothing.

I love love love... love love... love love love this skirt. I think it might be my favorite purchase of 2011.  The skirt is a great length, and is very well made.  The fabric holds shape, but the waist does have a bit of give, so you don't feel like restricted. The flocked velvet fans give it a very classy, ladylike feel, and it is such a unique patter! Also, I didn't even realize until later that it had pockets, but it is now my favorite thing about the skirt. I wore it to a few holiday parties and was showered with compliments. It really is an attention grabber. Buy it.
This is a wonderful skirt! I am so pleased with the quality of the fabric, the length of the skirt and how nicely it lays on me. I love it!

review_summary: I ended up sending this i

review_summary: So this is one of my most
review_text: So this is one of my most recent, and currently favourite purchases. I love the colour and the vintage look. Plus I can wear it to work and swing dancing. The weight also means it's good for winter/spring/autumn, and since summer doesn't really exist here in Wellington, it's a skirt for all seasons. The fans are also made out of a groegous velvety material. Please note that the length is very long. Still can't figure out if I should take it up or not. I'm currently waiting to receive a petticoat so I'm waiting to see how it looks with that before I decide whether or not to give it the chop. :)
I returned this dress because it was EXTREMELY  unflattering. I liked the quality and pattern, but if you are at all curvy or have hips this will not suite you.

My very first Modcloth purchase and I was super satisfied! The color is just perfecta classic green that pairs well with lace. Thanks Modcloth!

It hits right at my natural waist and is comfortable throughout the day. The swing and quality reminds me of how skirts in the 1950s were and makes me feel fabulous each time I wear it.

Beautiful skirt with a chic pattern. Nice stretch and it has pockets (always an added bonus for me). I'm 4'10 so I did have to alter it but it was perfect after that. I feel like I'm walking through the Parisian streets when I wear this skirt. Just gorgeous.

I had planned to wear the Dot in the Act Top with this skirt, but it didn't work for me, so I think I will pair it with a cute, short sleeved, black sweater that I already have.

Beautiful and fun! This skirt is wonderful and I am so excited to wear it teaching!

As everyone else has said, this skirt is absolutely beautiful.  The material is very gorgeous.  The fit is perfect.  I had my doubts because I've had issues with the fit of Bettie Page dresses, but the fit on this is flawless. It's very comfortable.

review_summary: I waited for this to come

The back pleats seem to sit slightly off, just not quite right but its doesn't detract from the overall flow of the skirt at all. I think it will also work for light summer and winter months (in Australia). Very happy with this skirt and love the pockets!

review_summary: I had my eye on this skir
review_text: I had my eye on this skirt for a long time and finally ordered it when it came back in stock.  It fits really well and hits just below my knees.  The fabric is great and falls nicely.  The skirt isn't quite a dark as most of the pictures indicate though, the last picture shows it most closely to the colour, which is a little brighter.

review_summary: Due to my size and Modclo
review_text: Due to my size and Modcloth's notoriously small sizing I decided to err on the side of caution and get the 4XL. It ended up being too large but not by enough to worry about exchanging. It hits mid shin if worn high on the waist. The fabric is very thick and solidly sewn, this will last you a long time. I can see myself wearing it for many years.

review_summary: I was very excited to get
review_text: I was very excited to get this skirt for spring/summer, unfortunately when I got it it was not what I was expecting. For one, the length was way too long. It almost went down to my ankles, and I do not consider myself short (I am 5'6). Two, the fabric was thick, heavy, and unbreathable. The fans on the fabric appear to be made of black velvet. This would not be a skirt I would ever wear in summertime. Third, it is a very high waist skirt and it hit me at a strange place, right above my natural waist. It is cut pretty small as well, and is very tight on me. There is a zipper on the skirt that also looks strange. Sadly, I am returning this skirt. I would not recommend buying this one for summer.
This skirt is beautiful and fit well. I couldn't see myself wearing it, though, possibly because it's a little long to look informal.
Such a great skirt!You can combine it with a blouse [elegant] or with a shirt above [looks a little 'baggy' and cool ]I love it and will wear it a lot!

review_text: The skirt is so retro and adorable﹗I like the cut and the saturated green color. Can  have a vintage look simply wear tshirts or cardigan with it. The zipper is large and metal, so there is no worry that it will break on me. The only thing I could improve would be that if the waistband was about an inch thicker, just because I think it would be a bit more flattering Overall Love and am glad I waited for it to come back in stock.

review_summary: I love this skirt! It cos

I love the vintage feel to the material, as well as the length.I ordered the XL  I usually run between an XL and 2X, depending on the garment. I do think it runs a bit small in the waist. I got it on and buttoned, but it's not a terribly comfortable fit, even very high up on my waist, and even given that it is on the smaller end of my size spectrum. So, if you typically need to go up in the waist at all, definitely do in this skirt.That said, I am keeping it because it is so beautiful and versatile. I'll just have to get nifty with sewing to make it a tad more comfortable.

I am always worried about wearing midi skirts, as I am a bit short. However this skirt hits perfectly. Probably a little longer on me than others but not too long that it looks like drapery. The colour is bright, and gorgeous! The belt is from my Luck be a Lady Dress (blue floral). The skirt lining is comfortable, and a bit warm. I don't wear the skirt on overly hot days (anything over 25C for me) but this will be perfect come fall and winter. It looks fabulous over dresses, shirts, and paired with many prints. I would definitely recommend it. The skirt fits true to size maybe a little larger in the waist than I was expecting, but add a belt and you can't even tell. There is some stretch to it from the back. For anyone shorter than 5'3 you may have to do some hemming to keep it at the perfect length.

This is the best skirt! I wish they made it in more colors. I always get compliments when I wear it, such a flattering cut. The Small fits snug, but not uncomfortably, with no weird rollover. It comes down just below my knees, approximately as pictured. I'm gonna get another one in Sage.

review_text: I bought this skirt because I love the strips. The skirt fit really well but I'm a stickler for proper stitching. I noticed that the front and back stripes lined up really well on the seam on one side but not on the other. I knew that this would drive me crazy so I decided to return. Otherwise, the skirt it really pretty and fits well.

The stretch in the waist is also nice since I like to go big or go home when it comes to icecream. The pattern is really bold and can be a little overwhelming, but it's fun! Also, pockets.

I measured the skirt around the waist and sure enough, the waist of the skirt was 38 inches around. Either this skirt was mislabeled, or the size chart is completely incorrect. Unfortunately, the skirt is now out of stock so I can't exchange it. Quality wise, the skirt was a really great quality and if it was in stock I would definitely exchange it for another size. Super disappointed.

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this skirt, as I have been hunting for one like it forever, but it just didn't work for me. I got the 1x, being a 1416 in pants, since I knew that ModCloth skirts in the past have been a bit tight at the waist. The elastic on the back didn't even stretch out when I tried this on (it wasn't needed), and there was still room between my waist and the skirt. I'd definitely size down if you're considering this skirt. Other than the fit, the material turned me off a bit. It is pretty, but the material is pretty stiff, unlike other skirts that I've ordered from here that are shapely but still flowy. This one reminded me of highly starched fabric or thin canvas. It's striking, but I don't know how comfortable it would be. It would certainly require ironing to get wrinklefree after each use, and I like my clothes to be a little lower maintainence ;)

review_summary: I love this skirt! The le

The skirt is wellmade and has a nice thick fabric. [If I have any complaints, it's that the waist is a little tighter than I expected I won't be able to tuck a shirt into the waistline like the model. Perhaps I should have sized up?] Otherwise, I'm pleased to incorporate this into the wardrobe!

review_summary: I sized up bc the Modclot
review_text: I sized up bc the Modcloth label usually fits a little small on me. Glad I didthe medium fits perfectly!! The material is sturdy so it feels like it'll hold up for a long time. It has really deep pockets and the elasticized waistband (in the back) makes it incredibly comfortable! It does run a little long on my 5'6 frame but a quick alteration and it'll be exactly what I was looking for.

review_summary: Really wanted to love these :/ that waistband though!
review_text: I ordered these in a medium and they fit like a glove! Oh my goodness and they looked fabulous! In fact, when I first put them on I realized I had never felt so good about how I looked in a pair of pants. Usually trying on pants leads to me feeling frustrated and often bad about myself. I have a very petite frame, but am also really curvy for my size so pants almost *never* look right and much less feel comfortable enough to wear. Anyway, these looked fantastic and I wanted these to be my goto pants for every day (considered ordering several pairs), however, They are only comfortable while standing. If you sit then they dig into your stomach and become really uncomfortable. :/ These would have been my perfect pants if they had a more flexible waistband or something they gives a little. I was SO sad to return them. I even ordered a larger size to see if maybe that could work (maybe I could adjust the waist or something?), but nope. They simply don't work functionally or comfortably. SO SAD. :(

These didn't look horrible (though an XL may have been better), but the material seemed cheap. It was crinkly like tissue paper. If you don't mind the material, the look of them was fine and accurate to the photos!

review_summary: Not quite what I expected but it still works
review_text: After reading reviews from people with similar measurements to mine, I went with the XL and it's a bit big (especially after it's been on for a little while because it stretches), but not so big that I feel like I need to return it and get the L. The length is longer than I was expecting based on the photos, and while I am 5'4, my legs are pretty long for my height. So they weren't quite what I was expecting, but they're fine.
I love these so much that I bought two more pairs! They are great to wear to my workplace, they look professional but are very comfortable.

The length is too long for me, but I expected that. I will have to take them to a tailor and have them hemmed. The material is good for Spring or Fall. These were exactly what I was looking for and expecting.

I went back and bought a pair in L. Those are my goto slacks. A step up from leggings. I wear them with booties and all manner of tops. Absolutely flattering to my bottom and waist. I am 5'8 and these feel a teensy bit short (about 2.5 inches above my ankles). I do wish they were half an inch to an inch longer, but it is definitely not a deal breaker.

I give this 4 stars because the fabric is cheap...but then again so was the price. I also found it was a little tight and clingy in the waist more than I like, but no big deal. All of this being said, a past reviewer, Gwendolyn, wondered how to fix a twisted waistband. I'll say if you are comfortable making a cut and sewing it back up it's SUPER easy. You need to make a small cut inside the skirt waistband where no one could see and cut the elastic and pull it out altogether. THEN put a safety pin at one end of the elastic and feed it back through your skirt waistband using the safety pin to guide and know where you are in the skirt. Of course being careful you aren't twisting it  Once you've made it back around to the slit you cut, sew both the hole and the elastic back in place. I hope that doesn't sound more complicated than it is, I bet there are youtube tutorials on it too. Super easy if you have a needle and thread.

However, it is a tad too long and overwhelming for me. My short little body was literally engulfed by the swaths of material, and my lower body seemed to morph and expand right before my eyes. I think for a person of my stature  short and curvy  this skirt just eats you right up. I am a teacher, and was hoping to wear this in my classroom with some cute heels and blouses. I think if I walked into my classroom with this skirt on, though, the kids would ask me which century I came from, as it is very classic looking. So, to reiterate, beautiful, gorgeous, stunning skirt.....for people with long legs and less hips, or for those who enjoy wearing long things on the lower body (I don't). review_summary: I ADORE this skirt. I'm s
review_text: I ADORE this skirt. I'm super picky about my skirts, especially as someone with long legs and a tendency to sit with legs splayed. I bought it for work, because my slacks were getting worn too quickly, and I literally wear this skirt day after day. My only warning is that the skirt IS quite long. I am 5'8'', with decently long legs, and the skirt hits just below my knees. However, it is literally a circleskirt, so if you're a hand with a sewing machine, a little basting will tuck it up nicely. Run an iron over the seams, and the fabric will keep the hem for a good long time. I was surprised, when I opened it, by the fabric. I expected something softer and heavier, like a twill. The polyester is fairly stiff, and I was worried that it would feel cheap. Turns out, though, that because of the stiffness of the polyester, the skirt keeps its body wonderfully, and it still has that marvelous pooling effect when you sit down. It also doesn't wrinkle easily, which is wonderful, and seems pretty stain resistant. I can wear this skirt four days in a row, just running a lint roller over it, and no one would know I hadn't washed it. And it totally flares when you spin! 10/10 would buy again. I'm a cheapskate, and I even think the price is fair.

review_summary: I'm so in love with this

review_summary: I love this skirt! It's m

Still, since this is a full skirt, it's relatively easy to fix thisjust size down! The other problem is the starch. Lots of it. Literally leaking out of the fabric all over me. review_summary: I love love love this ski
review_text: I love love love this skirt! The only thing is it is a bit heavy so I only wear it when the weather is cool.
Beautiful skirt. Love to twirl in it. Super girly :). Need more excuses to wear it. Slightly heave tier than I anticipated. But it gives it nice body to the skirt so it has a very flattering shape.

This is easily my favorite piece I own from ModCloth  definitely the best quality, most unique, and most versatile. It is absolutely perfect for work, and I think it lends well to going out afterwards also. I was hesitant about just how full it would end up being after reading the reviews, but I think the fullness is lovely. I constantly receive compliments (especially, I've noticed, from older women  it truly salutes the style of the '50s). The waist did seem a tad small at first, but I have since lost a bit of weight, and now it fits perfectly.. not exactly sure what that means for others, but I would say it's definitely worth trying. Would buy another if more colors were available...

Perfect fit for a waisted skirt and lovely quality. The skirt was a stiffer fabric than I anticipated, and the fullness of the fabric gives it a more dressy look. Sturdy material, excellent body, and versatile! A great basic skirt!

review_summary: If this skirt came in a b
review_text: If this skirt came in a billion colors and patterns, I would buy all of them. The construction is good, the fit is great, it looks awesome, and it's super comfortable. Worth every penny. Only two notes I sized up, according to the size chart, because I wanted it to sit a little lower. Also, the waistband does gap a little, as someone else pointed out, but it's not bad.

review_summary: I love this skirt! It's f
review_text: I love this skirt! It's flowy and fun. Great for a professional or casual environment.

I ordered the size large and it fit well in the waist, however, the length of it was way too long. It fell to mid shin on me. When I pulled it out of its package it was wrinkled beyond recognition. I really wanted to like this item. I will be returning it.
A great skirt. Definitely runs a bit on the formal side but I'm sure I can find an occasion to wear it.

review_summary: This item is small, and I
review_text: This item is small, and I did order the size that I am normally. However, it is of great quality, and a nice length. I dont want to return it because It will fit me at some point. I am in the process of losing weight anyhow, so i'll just wait a couple months until I can fit into it.

I love this skirt there's nothing bad that I can say about it, the only thing is that it's just a tiny bit tight on my waist but other than that its perfect! I love the length and how full the skirt is.

review_summary: A few things about this s
review_text: A few things about this skirt: It's a lot of black, which I don't usually wear, but it's just so wonderfully made and feels so heavy that I love it. It goes past my knees, and I'm about average height, so only get this if you like longer skirts.  It's very thick and twirly (if you plan to dance in this, wear shorts underneath or you'll flash everyone!) It goes with everything! You can dress it up or down, which is fantastic. I attached a photo where I dressed this down. Paired it with a black and white boat neck 3/4length shirt and canvas shoes... and was told by two people that I looked very refined and classy :)

I LOVE this skirt!!  The material is heavy enough that it can be worn in the winter and keep you warm but not so heavy that it can't be worn in Texas summer.  But I don't feel like every breeze is going to blow my skirt up and I like that. :)  I love the way it hangs with and without the crinoline and I can wear it to work or swing dancing.  Every single time I wear this skirt I get compliments by the dozens!  And the versatility of this skirt makes it one of those must have basics for any girl with a little vintage style. :)

review_summary: I want to love this so mu
review_text: I want to love this so much but the waist was so tiny!

I absolutely love this skirt! The waist could be the tiniest bit smaller but that was to be expected. When I spin hard there is only the tiniest chance of my underwear being shown, which wouldn't be a problem for someone shorter than I am. With the two layers, the material is heavy enough that it doesn't blow everywhere in the wind.If you're on the fence about this skirt, I would definitely recommend it. It is absolutely amazing.
I have 3 of these skirts!!! I'm obsessed! Such great quality and it goes with everything!! For me the small is snug and I Also have a medium which is a bit too loose. But I really love this skirt!
A beautiful skirt the quality was excellent but it was a tad tight. I got a small but I think the medium would still have been too big. I still live the skirt!
Gorgeous skirt and incredibly flattering! Received many compliments. I am so glad I bought this though it was a little big around my waist but nothing a scarf belt  can't do to fix it.

Nothing I could say here, I think, that hasn't already been said. Medium was a perfect fit for my measurements. Think it'll go with just about anything. Beautiful cut, lots of twirl appeal, despite the loads of fabric, still very flattering. Paired it with a collared white buttonup, pearls, and black ballet flats, and it was off to the June Cleaver audition.
Lovely skirt :)

review_summary: I loved the skirt when I

review_summary: I wear this to work all t

review_summary: I loved this skirt. I jus

review_summary: I love how full it is!
review_text: I love how full it is!

Unfortunately, the skirt was wider and longer (and heavier) than I thought it would be. It had a lot of material and made me look shorter and wider than I already am. Might look cuter on another taller body type.

review_summary: I live in this skirt. Pai
review_text: I live in this skirt. Pairs well with any formfitting top. Can be dressed up or down. So versatile. Must be worn at your natural waist or it will be way too long. At my natural waist, it comes just barely below my knees. The tiers are subtle and add volume without bulk. An excellent purchase!

The quality of the material and construction is quite good.

This skirt is very flattering on my figure. My waist is my best feature and this piece accents it perfectly. It's very well made. I was hesitant at first, thinking the skirt was too pricey, but it is a very classic piece and a good basic skirt to have in your closet. It works well for many different occasions.

#FashionDeux This skirt is a bit snug but not where its uncomfortable. I love love this skirt so much. It's well made, the material is heavy but it doesn't lose its shape.  I love twirling in this skirt and feel like such a girl.  Its pretty versatile too! Here, I've style it for a business meeting or for a a day at the beach or park!

review_summary: Love it! The fit is just
review_text: Love it! The fit is just right, a bit on the tighter side but doable. I feel like I'm in between sizes, so if you prefer more breathing room, I'd go a size up.

The fabric quality is perfect! The fit is great and the silhouette is perfect for the vintage lover! It was a little too long for my height (5'3), but I could get it tailored without problems! The waist fits nicely and gives you the perfect 1950's look!

Whether you style with a light top and comfy flats or a sweater, heels, and pearls, this double layer skirt will bring elegance to any outfit. Highly recommended!

Great skirt.

review_summary: I hesitated a long time b
review_text: I hesitated a long time berfore bying this skirt, cause i'm short and pearshaped so I was afraid it would look terrible on me. I have to say that I was right, it did look terrible! i usually wear an M with high waisted skirts but this one was a bit too snug. The length was definitely too long for someone my size, it hit under the knees. The skirt has a beautiful volume, but it was just adding up to my hips instead of concealing them so I looked puffy... all in all, not a skirt for me!BUT I'm happy to say that I gave it to a friend of mine who's taller and really slim, and it was perfect for her as it's giving her the hips she lacks!so the skirt is beautiful, great quality, but just not for any shape of woman!

Love this dress! It fits very true to size, it came out of the box with no wrinkles at all, the length hits right where I expected it to, and it gives a very flattering silhouette. My one issue is that I'm not quite sure what to wear with it yet, but that's something I'll figure out in no time!

This skirt is just lovely!  Quality soft material is on the thicker side giving it some fullness and makes it feel substantial.  I ordered both the Small and Medium.  I have a very small natural waist but rather thick hips/bum  the Medium fit me better just below the waist line, but because of the way the waistband is constructed and because it sits high on the waist, if the waistband is too big then it sort of sticks out away from my waist leaving a funny gap the whole way around.  The waist band on the Small fit perfectly and sat flush against my waist.

review_summary: This skirt is the most, f
review_text: This skirt is the most, fun, sturdy, flattering thing I have ever worn. I love it! It is heavy fabric and doesn't blow much in the wind. It's simple and comfortable. A little long for fellow short girls, but easy to fix with a cute heel. Can be style a dozen ways!
Heavy material, which I prefer. Cute skirt on. Fits my waist perfectly and I am still able to tuck in any shirts.

review_summary: A LOT of fabric! Way too
review_text: A LOT of fabric! Way too much for me, I felt swamped by all the layers and the poofiness of this skirt. Others say they loved the swishiness of it, but with the tight waistband, the long full skirt just overwhelmed me. Good quality for the price though.

review_summary: I adore this skirt. It ha
review_text: I adore this skirt. It has a great weight to it (feels like it can withstand some wind gusts). It was quite wrinkly open arrival, but being crammed into a tiny box will do that. I ordered the XL and I have a 32.533 inch waist  the skirt JUST fits (no wiggle room). If your waist is bigger than mine then please size up! I paired it with a little white belt in one picture  cute! I am only 5'2 so it is a little below my knee in length, however that works for me :)

review_summary: I have a full, black, kne
review_text: I have a full, black, kneelength skirt that I've worn out, so I bought this as a replacement. I would probably have kept it anyways, but it was also a bit too snug around the waist, even sitting high, and wasn't very comfortable. All and all, it's a really nice skirt, but just make sure you order the correct size :)

review_summary: I love this skirt! I was

I wear it through all the seasons. I did move the button on the waist over a bit to make it fit a bit better, but it wasn't strictly necessary.

review_summary: This skirt is worth it. I

The zipper isn't of the highest quality but I sew and don't mind one bit. If it fails some day I'm on it ! Now I'd like this skirt in a million different prints.

Perfection!  I love this skirt.  It is the perfect length and fit, and it is nicely bouncy/flouncy. Also, the style is perfectly neutral, so you can easily transform it in to a vintage or modern piece, depending on the top, sweater, shoes, and hair you pair with this one.  It's a musthave, ladies.

review_summary: This skirt is so pretty a

review_text: I had to order an XL and although it did fit comfortably, I felt that it did not flatter my midsection. Also, the XL hit me at mid calf and I would have much preferred knee length. review_summary: Sigh. I had really high h
review_text: Sigh. I had really high hopes for this skirt. Now, don't get me wrong, the skirt was great. The material was heavy, and it seemed to be constructed very well. Also, where the skirt hit my waist I felt as though I looked like I was all boobs, and then big fluffy skirt. It was overpowering on me, and I by no means have a tiny frame. I wish it would have worked out better for me, but I couldn't justify keeping something I wasn't happy with.

Very cute skirt, however it is much fuller than I expected! There are multiple layers of fabric and combined with my large hips it makes me look as if I am wearing a petticoat underneath. It is also a bit loose on my waist. Over all, great item, very good quality.

review_summary: Such a cute skirt, and so
review_text: Such a cute skirt, and so heavy!  I love that the fabric is so sturdy, and it doesn't wrinkle easily.  Even though I'm short, I like the lengthit hits about midcalf for me.  I did have to get the waist taken in, so you might want to size down!

The fabric of the skirt IS heavy so it could easily overwhelm the wearer if not bought in the proper size so do pay attention to your measurements!

This is my best ModCloth purchase. The skirt has a simple look, but that makes it easy to dress up or down. I love wearing it with a simple tshirt tucked in and a pair of flats. The fabric is of the best quality, and the skirt has many layers, making it warm enough to wear during the Colorado winters (with appropriate stockings, of course). It flatters the waist and hits at the perfect spot on my leg. I ordered this skirt expecting to be pleased, and I ended up falling in love with its versatility. It has become a staple item in my wardrobe!

review_summary: I love the skirt. Its so

review_summary: This skirt is lovely! I a

review_summary: I bought the size large b

I highly recommend it!

This skirt is wonderful and I'm very happy I bought it. The fabric is nice and has a solid weight to it ? good quality stuff. THIS SKIRT IS PERFECT. Thank you, ModCloth. I've been looking for a skirt like this for ages and now I finally have it!

The waist is a little snug, but the skirt fits my waist. It would fit better on a 39 inch waist than my 40 inch, but that just motivates me to lose an inch from my waist. Wore it with a waist cinching belt and a button down blouse with puffy cap sleeves. It is a perfect skirt for a retro look.

review_summary: This skirt is a classic a
review_text: This skirt is a classic and I love it. However the waist is not quite as fitted as I would like it to be, and I was nervous if I exchanged it the small would be too tight. It does have a button closure at the waist, maybe I can move that over to help the problem? Overall this skirt is a winit can be dressed up or down and can be paired with many different tops. A staple for any wardrobe.

review_summary: I love this skirt! It is
review_text: I love this skirt! It is warm and really nice quality material. It is very full and this might be unflattering on some shapes but it worked ok for me. It is longer than I was expecting, though this wasn't really an issue, beside i am pretty short. I paired with the bed of roses top for work and got loads of compliments!

review_summary: I decided to write a revi
review_text: I decided to write a review because they've been unspeakably helpfull for my purchase. If you have a 30 waist measurement like me, you might be uncertain between M or L,reading the previous comments.TAKE THE L: the length is perfect, the fitting on hips and booty is super  it is something to consider with full skirts if you have curves!  and lastly, the waist is perfect too.( Just a little comfy but that's good if you want to tuck in a thick shirt o sweater).The material is quite good, it doesn't stretch and it's slightly stiff and heavy so that it flows really nicely around the figure when you move.In the end, I had to wait a bit for this skirt to arrive but I couldn't be more satisfied,it will be a passepartout in my closet!

Really love this skirt!  I got it for work and other conservative environments, but I've also worn it to a couple social gatherings because it's so flattering and warm.  It fits perfectly at my waist and falls a couple inches below my knees.  The quality is great and I'm very happy with this purchase.

Definitely runs small! Returned the Large (normally 1214 on bottom) and still need to reorder the Xlarge, but I can see myself wearing this a LOT. Fabric quality is amazing for the price, especially considering you get two layers of it in the entire skirt.

I *LOVE* this skirt  its so comfortable and pretty :D I'm so glad that it comes in larger sizes because I have a small waist and large hips. The waist of the skirt is a tiny bit loose, but it looks great. I like that its nice and full on its own, I don't think I would even need a petticoat underneath. I would gladly recommend this skirt to anyone who wants a fun vintage look.

This is a beautiful, simple full circle skirt. I have been looking for one like it for a long time, but was reluctant to pay this price. I almost tried to sew one, but the cost of fabric (and my iffy skills) made me change my mind.I have a 29 inch waist, and according to the size guide I ordered a large. I had to return it for a medium, which fits PERFECTLY (no gaping for me) with room to tuck in a blouse or thin cardigan.I only have two criticisms: for the price this skirt should be 100% cotton, and the zipper is identical to another dress I have from Modcloth and it often sticks, and the tiny zipper pull is annoying.Overall, very happy with the purchase.

I thought this skirt was so pretty! I've wanted it forever, and I finally went ahead for it. I've heard mixed feelings about it being too tiny in the waist, but I had NO problem at all with that. My waist is right at 29 inches, sometimes a little less, and the waist was perfectly comfortable in a medium. No flab or muffining. I could probably wear a sweater tucked in if I wanted to. It is a quite full skirt, but it's really nice and versatile. I could wear this buzzing around campus, to student teaching, or to a nice occasion if I wanted to. If you're thinking about it at all, just go for it!

review_summary: I was a bit hesitant to p
review_text: I was a bit hesitant to pay this much for a skirt, but I ended up loving it. It fits perfectly and hits me right at the knee. Definitely my new favorite skirt.

The small was quite snug on my 2728 waist, but after reading reviews I am sure that the medium would have been too large and awkward looking. I love this skirt, however the reviews didn't mention that while the fabric is heavier, it is somewhat stiff. I haven't washed it yet and may consider adding in some softener to help with this. Since I got the small I have to wear it a little higher above the natural waist, but it still looks very good, and it works since I'm so short and the length is quite long. Overall I love this skirt! :)

review_summary: So I wanted this skirt fo
review_text: So I wanted this skirt for AGES before I finally bought it. I have to say if you have curves like me....there can be a little too much flare out just after the waist if you have a teeny waist and considerably larger hips like me. Still love the retro dinner party feel of this though :)

Been waiting for this skirt to be back in stock for a few months, so when I got the alert I ordered it immediately. I read almost all of the reviews to make sure that I got the sizing right, but I got it wrong. My waist is 36 inches, and I usually wear a 1X. But all of the reviews said to size up, so I ordered a 2X. It was way to big :( Really confused because that measurements say that the 2X is 26inches... Maybe I'm measuring myself wrong... So I need to exchange it for a 1X. Hoping that works! Very excited to add this to wardrobe!

I read the reviews before buying this, and I wanted to give it a try because my favorite black skirt does need to be replaced. This skirt was just not the one. It does have a small waist. I normally buy skirts and pants in a large to fit over my hips and butt, and they are usually fine if not loose in the waist, but this one was just too tight for comfort. Also, the length is great, and so is the fullness of the skirt. I'm 5'4 with thick legs, so this skirt just added to my heaviness on the bottom. I still like it, but it's not for me!

I'm very pleased with this skirt  the material is thick and wellconstructed, and it's really just a perfect full black skirt. It might be a little heavy for the summer, but I'll definitely enjoy wearing it through the winter, fall, and much of spring! For a basic item that I hope will last me a while, I'm pleased with the price.

review_summary: I love the skirt. It's pr
review_text: I love the skirt. It's pretty with lots of layers which makes it very full. I didn't iron it out of the box for the pictures  which it really needs. The fabric is a little lower quality than I would have liked (thin and stiff) but they layers make up for it. It does seem like it will wrinkle and attract pet hair, so if that is somewhat of an issue, it might not be the skirt for you. The cut is flattering on an hourglass figure though!

This is my first purchase from ModCloth and I just received it in the mail. It fit perfectly. It was snug but not too tight that I couldn't tuck a shirt in. Overall I am very satisfied and I am definitely going to be buying from ModCloth again.

review_summary: Ahhh! I don't know. I REA
review_text: Ahhh! I don't know. I REALLY wanted to like this. And I kind of do! But I look like a huge cream puff. And when you sit, none of the pleats/folds are visible, so you kind of end up looking like a pilgrim.

review_summary: I love, love, love this s
review_text: I love, love, love this skirt!  It is very true to the measurements.  The waist fits me perfectly  as in I really can't gain any weight in my waist now!

This skirt is amazing! It fits true to size, the waist hits in the right place, and the hemline is not too long or to short for a long skirt. The fabric and lining are very sturdy, and the cut is very classic and versatile. Really great piece! I paired this skirt with the Point Me Toward the Shore earrings and the Teal a Glance top.

I'd been ogling this skirts since the summer (when I discovered Modcloth). I like it in person too, but having just turned 27 I worry about looking too childish in it, mainly because it's got a lot of volume. Of course, it helps that it's black, which always gives a garment more gravitas, but I'm looking for a skirt that I can wear on a regular basis, and I need to be 100% comfortable in it.

review_summary: I adore this skirt. It fi
review_text: I adore this skirt. It fits snugly, but comfortably right around my waist, and the justbelowtheknee length and volume of the skirt is flattering and a ton of fun. The heaviness of the skirt is a plus for me, as it makes it suitable for fall, winter, and spring wear (which is usually when I find myself needing a good black skirt more than in the summer). I've worn this skirt out dancing, and it couldn't be more fun to twirl around in. I really recommend getting a nice, waistlength blazer to pair with this for a fun but professional business look!

This was my Christmas miracle! It came back into stock, but the largest they had was an XL. I got it, and... it was too small. I was in the middle of losing my divorce weight, though, so rather than return it, I decided to keep it.Three months later, on a lark, I decided to give it another try. It was perfect! It sits high on the waist, which is a new look for me, but I've decided I really like it that way. It also comes below the knee, which is another thing I'm getting used to. It twirls beautifully, and makes me feel like sashaying about.It's not a deep black, so be prepared for that.
This skirt fits perfectly.  It sits snugly around my natural waist before flaring out, which gives it a very retro look.  I think it will quickly become one of my favorite pieces of clothing.
I originally ordered a medium and exchanged it for a small. Super cute. Heavy double layered fabric hangs well and can be worn into the colder months.

review_summary: I love this skirt. The on
review_text: I love this skirt. The only issue is that it is made with cotton. It will need to be dewrinkled before each wear. But I stuck it in the dryer for a few minutes with a towel and it was ready to go. It is full of air and bounce (for a cotton skirt). I love its look!

I just adore this skirt  it is my goto skirt to wear with just about everything. The material is lovely and heavy enough for winter. It's also so nice and full  I've gotten many compliments on it. A must have staple piece for anyone.

review_summary: I have to be honest, when
review_text: I have to be honest, when I pulled this out of the box I almost put it right back in and returned it. This is a LOT of skirt and I just wasn't sure about it. I'm glad I kept it because it's now my goto item. I like that I can dress it up for work or dress it down for more casual days. It is so insanely comfortable! I am in love with this piece and plan to buy it in every color it comes in.

review_summary: It twirls so well! i felt
review_text: It twirls so well! i felt like a little girl again when i was wearing this. Couldn't stop spinning!
This skirt is beautiful and fit perfectly! I like how heavy it is, not likely to blow up in the wind.

review_summary: This has become my goto b
review_text: This has become my goto black skirt!  Beautifully made, elegant and definitely twirlworthy!

Not happy with this skirt at all. Waited a longtime for the skirt time arrive and that it was too small. I also thought it was heavier. Size up as it is very small. I would have returned it it I hadn't left it so late. Shame as I like through skirt

review_summary: I was looking for a long,
review_text: I was looking for a long, flouncy skirt. This skirt is exactly this. The fabric is thick and the look is elegant. I ordered a large because, though my waist is small, my hips are large. The fit of the skirt was perfect in the length and in the body, but the waist is so small that it fits above my hips rather than resting on them. Because the skirt has so much body, this makes it difficult to find shirts to wear over the skirt (for fear of making the shirt distorted) or tucked into the skirt (for fear of making my torso seem very small). Because it rides so high on my body I do not wear it as often as I'd hoped I would, but for the outfits I do wear it I love it so, so much.

This skirt is really pretty and full. It is pretty heavy too, so I think it will be great for the winter. It sits at my natural waist, which is quite a departure for me. If you have any chub in the lovehandle area, be aware that it will poof a little at the top of your hips, creating a pleatbump right below the waistband. It is a very retro look, but if you, like me, try really hard to minimize bumps in your figure, this look will take some getting used to. The length is just below my knees.

review_summary: I wanted to love this ski
review_text: I wanted to love this skirt, but it just didn't work out for me.  I ordered a medium instead of a small with the hopes that it would sit slightly lower than my natural waist.  Instead, it sat just above my hip bones, but the waist band gapped unflatteringly.  I think it might actually be wider at the top of the twoinch waist band than it is at the bottom.  Definitely plan for this skirt to sit at the bottom of your rib cage instead of at the top of your hips!

review_summary: I love this skirt so much
review_text: I love this skirt so much! It has become a staple of my wardrobe. I feel like a little witch everytime I wear it. The fabric is nice and thick and it fits perfectly, but if my waist were even an inch bigger I'd size up.

This skirt is BEAUTIFUL! The length is perfect and I love the amount of fabric, but unfortunately it wasn't right for my body type. Instead of making me look streamlined, this skirt added about 5lbs to my hips! I'm a curvy girl, but I was hoping this skirt would smooth out my more troubled spots instead of emphasizing them. I'm glad this skirt works for so many women, but unfortunately it wasn't right for me. I'll keep looking though; Modcloth is great!
Love. Beautiful, but I haven't gotten a chance to wear it yet because it seems so nice. I am giving a speech soon and plan on wearing it with a nice tucked in blouse for the dress to impress look.

review_summary: I was in need of a goto b
review_text: I was in need of a goto black skirt and this is perfect! I love the retro flair and the high waist.

review_summary: When I tried this on and
review_text: When I tried this on and declared that it fit perfectly, my husband almost didn't believe me.  Often even an XS is too small for me, so I get really excited when I find nice clothes that fit.  It's just a simple, fun skirt that can be dressed in many different ways.

review_summary: I'm glad to have found a
review_text: I'm glad to have found a black skirt at last! the material has a nice weight to it, and the skirt is full (it's so cliche, but I love to do the twirl and watch the folds spread out!). The only thing is that, while the waist band fits my waist, there is some poofing at the back. It's less noticeable when tucking a shirt in, but still there.
LOVE THIS SKIRT! it's the perfect length, the perfect poof, the perfect everything (except for the way it attracts cat hair  haha!)

I like this skirt, though even with a large it was a bit tight at my waist. I have to wear it almost right under my bust for it to be comfortable. Sometimes I just deal with being squeezed. The material is sort of stiff, which gives it nice shape, but it also makes a sort of annoying swishing noise (almost like those windbreaker pants?) when it's moved. I do like this skirt, though, and I think it's quite versatile. I'm probably going to look into getting/making a petticoat to wear under it, because that would be super cute. :)
This skirt is AHMAZING.  It hits higher on my waist than I thought it wouldright below my ribsbut it's perfect nonetheless.  Twirling is a genuine pleasure.  It looks great with a tuckedin blouse.

review_summary: I wish I had gotten a M.
review_text: I wish I had gotten a M. The small fits alright, but is a little snug at times, and creates the illusion of a fat blob under where the waist cuts off. Therefore, I wear it under jackets or dresses where this is not visible. All in all, very cute skirt! Length is a little long, but it has great swishing powers. You can spin around and have the awesome skirt effect. Love it, but the next color I'm buying I'm sizin' up!

review_summary: This is a really nice qua
review_text: This is a really nice quality skirt. If anything was wrong with it I'd say it's that it's a little bit too tight at the waist, but not unbearably so. I have to say, I always feel very pointedly 50's when I wear this though.

Beautiful skirt! The waistband was sewn strangely, so it is baggy at the top of the waistband but not at the bottom (if that makes any sense...). I will have to alter it a little, but it's not such a big deal. I also really could have sized down.

review_summary: I love this skirt. I am s
review_text: I love this skirt. I am so happy that I finally got it. It fits my waist like a glove. The double layer makes it feel nice and sturdy  good for fall. The length is a bit long for me as I'm petite. But that was to be expected. Definitely a great purchase!

review_summary: I loooove this. It fits p
review_text: I loooove this. It fits perfectly, and the quality is exceptional, expecially for Modcloth. I often times feel a lot of the clothing on here is over priced for the quality, but not this one! The only issue is I have is that I have to be careful how I style it or I end up looking like a 50's housewife, not the look I'm going for.
Very well constructed. The fabric is nice, and there is a lot of it! It fits well at the waist and flares out nicely at the hips.
The material was great and so was the length. If you have larger hips, like I do, then it might make you look a little bulgy around that area. I returned this item.

review_summary: This is a great skirt. Fo
review_text: This is a great skirt. For me, it flares out too much. I love the full skirt etc., but it was more of a 'character' skirt, more difficult to wear to work and so on. But I would highly recommend it.
This skirt is just perfect. It's such a lovely style and very full. I'm so in love with it.

Love the quality and the feel of the material. I am in the process of losing some weight so I can not accurately say how the fit is but I am confident that it will be perfect and it provides great motivation! I am 5'1'' and have always been a small.

review_summary: Of all the garments I ord
review_text: Of all the garments I ordered from ModCloth during my trail run, this had the highest quality and yet the construction of this garment was simply poor and illogical. The skirt is cotton through and through and thus has no stretch anywhere, so why make 1.5 inch thick waistband that won't conform to a woman's waist unless it's perfectly tailored for her and she never loses or gains a pound? This gapped and laid all wrong on me even though the size was fine.

This skirt is excellent quality.  The material is heavy and warm and the shape is excellent.  I was initially worried that it would be too long, but I think I like the length too.  The only problem is that the skirt is just a bit too large around the waist, so I would have to wear a belt (see picture) to make it sit properly.  I would try exchanging it for a small, but I'm leaving for school in a few days.  Currently undecided as to whether I'll keep it; other than the the waist issue, the skirt is awesome and very flattering!

I really love this dress, but I'm currently exchanging mine for a Medium because it runs small. I was expecting the material to not be as thin as it was from the review, not that I am unhappy it was just unexpected. It's perfect for working in the classroom and it gives a classy vintage feel.

So incredibly gorgeous! This skirt is beautiful, full, and superversatile. I ordered a size medium, which is about an inch large on my waist. However, I've found that cardigans look extracute when tucked into this skirt, so I'm okay with the extra room! The length is lovely and not too overwhelming on my small frame. Yay! Another successful Modcloth purchase!

review_summary: This skirt was a huge dis
review_text: This skirt was a huge disappointment for me. The material it is made out of wrinkles very easily and is very heavy. The way the waist fits is odd, to say the least. I tried it with different shirts... tucked in, not tucked in. It's hard to explain, but I found it extremely irritating.Honestly, I would never pay almost seventy dollars for a skirt this unimpressive. I have already shipped it for return, I want my money back.

review_summary: I made the mistake of ord
review_text: I made the mistake of ordering a size up... Oh well, it still works if you have a heavier shirt to tuck into it. I found it to be a little long, hitting me a couple inches before midcalf, but then again that might just be the sizing mishap. Fixable, no problem. Love it though, it's a heavy, good weight for fall and has a heck of a FULL skirt. Beautiful and goes with everything. Buy it if you're on the fence, you'll be glad you did, trust me.

review_summary: I was surprised at how ti
review_text: I was surprised at how tight this was for a 3X item. I sized up, because I have large hips and I usually have to take in the waist of most things I buy. But this waist is SMALL, and with no give in the fabric. It fits, but it's incredibly tight. I'm hoping to fit it better in a month or two, so I'm keeping it, but plus size girls should be aware that this nogive fabric might not work for them if they're pear shaped like me, even though your waist may be small.

review_summary: I love this skirt but it
review_text: I love this skirt but it can be hard to style because it's SO full. You'll need something lightweight and closefitting to tuck in; that said, I get a ton of compliments whenever I do wear it out.

review_summary: This is my new goto skirt
review_text: This is my new goto skirt. It goes just below my knee and is great for work. The skirt sits high on the waist and great to combine with a retro sheer secretary blouse.

I really, really wanted to love this skirt, but it just didn't work for me. My measurements are between 1X and 2X and I went with the larger size based on previous reviews, but the waist was still too small, plus it poofed out unflatteringly just below the waistband. The fabric is lovely and the length was perfect for a tall girl like me, but it just wasn't the sleek, comfortable Aline skirt that I had hoped for.

review_summary: This skirt has the most a
review_text: This skirt has the most amazing drape. I wore it to swing dance class, and it makes a fantastic noise (a friend commented it sounds like batman's cape?!) when you spin around.  I can't wait to buy this in other colors, although I'd go up a size, even though I like to wear it high, I should have gone for my regular size.

I. Love. This. Skirt.  It's full and flippy and kicky and fun but still conservative enough to wear to work.  It also looks super with a crinoline underneath to add more volume.  I ordered a medium, but it was way too big in the waist.  The small fit me perfectly.  The only thing I'm not crazy about is that I'd like the black fabric to be a little blacker.  Otherwise it's a perfect 10!

review_summary: I love this skirt. It's h
review_text: I love this skirt. It's heavy, a little bit puffy, makes your waist look amazing. My favorite skirt in the world. But will not help you at all if you're a little bit chubby.

review_summary: I very much like this ski
review_text: I very much like this skirt! The doubletiered feature and the fullness of the skirt are very elegant. It truly does sit around the natural waistline, which, for shorttorsoed people like me, feels quite high. However, I do like that, as it gives it a vintage feel and helps the skirt to flare out in a flattering way (better covers my hips, etc.). It will definitely look best with a tuckedin blouse (something close fitting  bulky would not work with this!). It is made of a sturdyfeeling formal dress fabric, and has no stretch. I think it really could work in any season, depending on what you wear with it. I typically wear a size 68 skirt, and the medium fits just fine. Twirling will occur!

Sadly, this skirt is going back, but only because it made me look hippy where I didn't want to :) Even though it sits at my natural waist, so fairly high up, it just didn't drape nicely over the shape of my hipsnot sure if it was because of where the gathers are, or perhaps the thickness/stiffness of the material.  The fabric is quite heavy, particularly with the two layers, so it would make a great cooler weather basic.  Very sad that it wasn't flattering for me!

I really think I would've loved this skirt if it had fit. I'm usually a size 18 in pants, 16 in dresses/skirts, but I sized up to a 2X because I saw reviews say it was a little snug. I probably could've lived with it if it was a bit tight, but I couldn't even get the zipper to budge on this. Sad to return it, but I guess I'll order it again once I lose my college weight.

review_summary: This is now my favorite s
review_text: This is now my favorite skirt! I always feel so classy and elegant when I wear it! I love the length too because it is perfect for work. Great skirt for the price!
Love Love Love this skirt. Only thing is it's an absolute pain to iron. And as soon as you sit down...it's like you never ironed it to begin with. But it's a beautiful full skirt all the same :)
This skirt is super cute and is perfect for any occasion. The length is great as well. I just can't get over how awesome this skirt is. A must have wardrobe essential.

This skirt did not flatter my wide hips, it really accentuated them in a way I found unflattering.  It did make my waist look tiny but my hips just looked way too wide.  I think the look would be better on someone taller, also I think heels (as opposed to flats) would also help.

A fantastic skirt! I was in the market for a good, basic black skirt, and this one fit the bill perfectly. Good length, nice, weighty fabric that falls well (and makes the skirt great for biking), and twirls perfectly as a pinwheel.I ordered an XS and found the fit to be right where I needed it to be. Have already gotten a lot of mileage out of this piece, and plan to get much more. In short, this skirt earns plenty of gold sticker stars! I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.
The perfect circle skirt! Although the fabric is a bit heavy, it gives it a nice shape and hang. I lobe this skirt!

This skirt really is great! I wish I had ordered a size larger because I measured a little less carefully than I should have! Even though it's a little tight it still looks great though. The fabric is heavy and comfortable too. I would definitely recommend this, and I can't wait to wear it to work.

This skirt fits fairly well at the waist, though there is still a little bit of room left over after tucking in a shirt. Not so much room that it gapes, however, just enough to move comfortably. It is rather long, and on a frame as short as mine it looks a little silly, particularly as the double layers add extra bulk. It's like wearing a petticoat and a skirt, all in one. I'll definitely have to hem it before I wear it, but it is a lovely item so I have no doubt that it will look perfect once that's done.

review_summary: It is an ok item but noth
review_text: It is an ok item but nothing extraordinary about it.

review_summary: So, this skirt is quite n
review_text: So, this skirt is quite nice as most people have said, but I get the feeling some people might have been telling a few fibs about their waist size. My waist is about 3637 inches, and I had seen a lot of reviews by people with a smaller waist than me saying even the 1X was too small for them. I checked with customer care to see if they would recommend sizing up to a 2X in my case, and the girl I spoke to suggested it might be a good idea. So this is what I did. Mistake. with the skirt sitting on my natural waist (I say sitting, but I had to actually hold it there) I could fit myfist and arm down it there was that much extra room. As I'm an international customer I'm not sure I can be bothered returning this skirt, as I can't exchange so I'd have to go through the process of ordering a new one and paying another $30 or however much in shipping. I had my mother attempt to take it in with a flas pleat at the back, but because the skirt is so full, this makes it sit out strangely at the side with the zip. Also, just as a side note, even though I have bigger hips I think the skirt looks fine over them  until you try to pair it with some sort of hiplength jacket or cardigan, then it just kind of looks ridiculous.Anyway, I suspect if I'd ordered a 1X I'd have basically no complaints about this skirt.

This skirt is amazing. I've been looking for a versatile black skirt for a while, and i've finally found it! It's comfortable but dressy, and the fabric seems really durable. It was a bit longer on me than I expected, I'm  short, so it came down about 2 inches below my knees. Great shape, and great quality. A keeper.

I loved this skirt!It flows amazingly, and it goes great with the Pose for a portrait top! At least in my opinion!The material is a little shiny, but all in it its great! I highly recommend this skirt. It doesn't fit on your natural waist line, it fits just a bit below it but its still outstanding!!

As all the other reviewers have said, amazing skirt. The fabric is more slippery than I expected, but it makes it flow nicely. The body makes you feel like you are straight out of a fifties TV show. For me, the small ran a little large in the waist, but nothing a belt can't fix. The XS probably would have been to small. It's my new goto black skirt, and I love it!
LOVE this dress, very 50's esc. The material is good and thick but not too heavy, definitely something ill be wearing very often!

review_summary: This is my goto skirt for
review_text: This is my goto skirt for practically every top in my wardrobe. The quality is excellent, and it's really flattering. The only thing about it is it tends to bunch up at times, especially if I wear it with a longer coat. But that's a pretty minor issue otherwise, great!

review_summary: I love this skirt. It has
review_text: I love this skirt. It has just the perfect 50's feel to it. I received a lot of compliments when I first wore it!The fit is perfect as to the lenght of the skirt. Unfortunately, the fit of the waist is a little too large for me. I had to sew the button further away for it to fit perfectly. Still, I'm really happy with this purchase!A must for tall girls like me since it is really flattering!

I'm a pretty solid 18 at 5'8... Better yet, an 18 is generally a loose cut garment on me. I order 18's so I have a generous cut that can be altered to fit. However, this skirt was very tiny in the waist, I am sad to say. In ordering the 2x, I thought for sure I'd get something that I had a little extra room to breathe in... Not so. Yet, the skirt is lovely and the quality is impeccable. So, I'll be exchanging it for the next size up.
love this skirt. people talked about the material being too thick, but it seems perfect to me. i think it's because there are 2 layers and it's a longer skirt. i love it.

I really like this skirt  it hangs beautifully and sits just the right length.  The waist band is slightly too big so I wear it with a belt, which looks good anyway.  The material is a lovely weight but has a few small flaws in it, which are probably invisible to anyone else.  This skirt is a firm favourite of mine and is seeing me nicely through a very cold New Zealand winter!

review_summary: I can't say enough nice t

review_summary: This may be the most perf
review_text: This may be the most perfect piece of clothing I have ever owned. I either look like I'm trying to pass as a high schooler or like I'm trying to pass for one of my mom's friends.  Thank God for this skirt, though.  It's flirty and fun and gorgeously made.  Paired with a casual white buttonup shirt with the sleeves rolled up, it makes me feel like Audrey Hepburn.  I will wear it everyday and with everything.  Okay, so that's a stretch, but I will wear it at least once a week.  And when the new colors are released, I will buy them, too.  Consider this piece an investment in your wardrobe.  You will not regret this purchase.
