review_summary: I love this skirt! This w
review_text: I love this skirt! This was my first buy with Modcloth and I am very pleased. It fits my waist perfectly with enough room to tuck in a shirt. It is a circle skirt, meaning that if you spread it out in its entirety, it would form a perfect circle. For this reason, it is a very full skirt, which is just what I was hoping for. Thanks Modcloth!  :)

review_summary: I love this skirt! It is
review_text: I love this skirt! It is so classic and feminine! The fit was exactly right for my waist, with no stretch. So, take note girls with a bigger waist than 32 it barely fit me in an XL!

review_summary: I waited for a long time
review_text: I waited for a long time for this to be back in stock, and I was super disappointed to discover that this skirt is just too long for me. The waist fit just fine, and the cut and quality of the fabric was great, but I don't think this skirt is suited for shorter women. The fullness of the skirt mixed with the fact that it hit me midcalf (I was hoping for just below the knee)  looked too awkward for me to keep.
Well made, thick material. Waist was perfect, too much material in the hips (about 7 inches too much!) for my frame and it made me look really hippy. Saddly, will be returning.

This skirt will make you feel like Audrey Hepburn! It's so fun and fancy! The only downfall  as others have noted  is that the waistline does tend to gape. I wore it with the Each and Aviary Way Top. The combo was just too precious.

Juuuuust a bit too big... I was excited by all the reviews saying how high quality the fabric is, however I wasn't as impressed when I saw it in person. Quite nice, anyways. Also, the buttonhole on mine wasn't done properly... Looks like it was sewn too large, so they didn't bother cutting it all the way. Sad, cause it's a beautiful skirt. My only option is a return, since I'm international :( Bummer.

review_summary: I love this skirt! I am t
review_text: I love this skirt! I am tall and skinny and look for things to enhance my nearly nonexistent hips, and this skirt is great for that. It does have a lot of fabric (it actually has two layers of full skirt), which creates a little extra padding on my hips (in a good way) and stands out in a flattering Aline. The small fit my 28 waist perfectly. It is quite long below the knee on me, and I'm tall but because it sits at my natural waist and makes my legs look long, the length doesn't swamp me. I do think it might be a bit much for smaller women. But it's perfect for me, and it made my mom nostalgic for her high school days :)

Fooled by rave reviews again! I am not sure what the body type is on the girls that loved this dress, but certainly not the same as me. At 5'5, I still usually wear petite pants, since my legs are short. This skirt fell way too long and had way too much fabric. I felt like I was wearing part of a Halloween witch costume. I found the material dull and heavy and not at all flattering.

Ordered a medium (I am usually dress size 6 or 8) and it was so tiny that the waist barely zipped up.  So, I'm waiting patiently for a restock.  However, the fabric quality was great, and the very full layered skirt is retro without being costumeey.  Beware, it is MUCH fuller than it looks in the picture, so if volume isn't your style, you should pass on this one.  Looks really cute with a polka dot button up blouse and a wide headband.

review_summary: I was waiting to get this
review_text: I was waiting to get this skirt forever because of the hefty price tag, but once it went on sale, I had to grab it. My sister has it and I've adored it on her, so I had very high hopes. I was a bit unsure when it first came because I do find it makes me look a bit hippy, which I am naturally, so it has accentuated this a bit, BUT, I don't think it looks bad. It's a very full skirt, and it does accentuate my waist which is great. The material is great, and it's a very thick, full, heavy skirt. I don't have anything like it, so I've decided to keep it. Very happy with it though and can't wait to wear it!
Great skirt! A little on the tight side for me but I think the medium may have been too big. Quite long, so looks good with heels.

This is a gorgeous, versatile skirt. I love the double layering at the hem. It's very nice and full, and will flatter many different figures. It sits right at my waist and falls to just below my knees  perfect, and it's so hard to find skirts this length these days!
First mod cloth purchase and i am sooooooo happy!The skirt is beautiful and truly elegant :)

review_summary: This fit me just right, w
review_text: This fit me just right, with maybe a bit of wiggling room at the waist, but nothing I can't get fixed if need be. It does come out of the package quite wrinkled though, so you may want to invest in a steamer if you're a regular ModCloth customer, as I find a lot of their items come with deep wrinkles in it from packaging. Although a tumble in the dryer might work as well. Very pretty skirt, I like the layers very much, it gives it volume. Can't wait to wear it at the office!
This skirt is pretty warm, so it will be perfect for cold weather. I'm pretty short so the skirt is a little longer than I'd hope but I still love it so I'm definitely keeping it.

review_summary: I love this skirt! It's s
review_text: I love this skirt! It's so full and thick. I love twirling around in it. It does run a little large so I could have ordered an XS. But this can easily be fix with a belt.

review_summary: I'm usually a ML, so base
review_text: I'm usually a ML, so based on the other reviews I ordered a L. Turns out I should have gotten a M because the L was too loose and had so much extra, thick fabric to it that I looked like a black elephant. Returned, sadly. It is such a cute skirt and the quality was great.
Beautiful skirt. A little bit tight in the waist but I think that's just leftover Thanksgiving stuffing giving me trouble. I'm 5'9 and the L is a perfect length right at my knees.

This skirt is so flattering and versatile! It goes just below my knees and will be perfect for work, or going out with friends. I love that it has two layers, it really makes the skirt distinct from other black skirts.

review_summary: I LOVE this skirt, and I
review_text: I LOVE this skirt, and I am SO glad I bought it. I'm 5'8'', and wanted to find a skirt that hit me comfortably just below the knees, and this was perfect. I have since worn it with everything from army boots to seamed tights and heels, and it always looks classy. I even wore it with a crinoline underneath for a party I was hosting... so so adorable, and I got compliments all night. I do wish I had gotten the next size down. I ordered in my usual size, but it's a little bigger than I'd like. Even so, it's become one of my closet staples, and I always get compliments on it! A great buy!

Lovely, retroinspired skirt.  My waist is approximately 33 inches.  It's a TAD tight at the waist  but a bit of repositioning fixes that. Ultra fun to spin in and could be easily transformed into a super glamorous evening look.
Super cute retro skirt! I had to send mine back for an exchange because I'm not used to wearing skirts on my natural waist (usually I wear them on my hips) so the size I ordered was too big.

This skirt is stunning, probably one of my most well loved skirts. The quality is superb, probably the best of anything i've ordered on Modcloth, and the fit is perfect. This is a high waisted item on me, so the length is just below the knees worn like that. The draping is flattering, even with my larger hips.  This is worth every penny for it.

review_summary: I bought this skirt to we
review_text: I bought this skirt to wear to my first day of work at my new job and I absolutely ADORE it! It accentuates the waist perfectly and the length is excellent for work (hits right at the knee). It will transition seamlessly from a day at the office to a happy hour with friends. I can't wait to wear it!

Absolutely lovely skirt!  It's very elegant, and I'm sure it would pair well with flats or heels, cardigan or blouse.  The fabric and stitching both look of good quality.  The waist band does however pucker out a little bit from my sides.  The fabric doesn't wrap perfectly on my body.  I was nervous ordering an XS, for fear of the waist being too tight  so hopefully I can insert some boning, or possibly tighten the fabric?  Still figuring it out!  But other than that, a really pretty skirt.

I absolutely adore this skirt! I had been eying it for a while on the site and am so happy I went ahead with the purchase! I'm relatively tall so finding a skirt that has a decent length is quite a task I find. I'm a curvy girl so showing off a lot of leg isn't really my thing. This skirt is just perfect. It hits my knees and the quality is amazing. The only thing I found odd was that size wise there isn't much difference between an L and a XL. I ordered both because I tend to be in between sizes as I am currently on a weight loss mission. I couldn't quite zip up the L so I was expecting the XL to be much bigger. It really isn't. Only by a little bit. So I've decided to keep both sizes, I love this skirt so much, I want to still be able to wear it when I've lost more weight :)

review_summary: I ordered a medium but pr
review_text: I ordered a medium but probably could of gone with a small.  I'm 5ft 7in, and a size 6 on bottom.  Its relatively high waisted.

When spotted this beauty on modcloth it was love at first sight. What a goregous circle skirt! Perfect for swing dancing, the office. But even better than that  the BEST thing about this skirt as other reviews have mentioned is it's twirlability!!! So much fun, except it kind of makes you want do lots of unecessary spins. Love the double layer look and the length is perfect, not too long not too short. Very flattering and emphasises a small waist.

review_summary: I will admit that I retur
review_text: I will admit that I returned this. I mean, I agreed with most of the other reviewers in that it is a wonderfully made skirt. I adore the twirleffect, the high quality weight of the skirt, the length, the color (black goes with anything, after all)...but I returned it. It wasn't because I had a problem with the waist. I got a small, and it fit me well, and I didn't have a problem with the waist band like others did, but I just didn't think this was flattering on me. As my measurements suggest, I have generous hips and comparatively small waist. The waist of this skirt fit like it was made for me, but the skirt fell in such a way that, far from hiding my hips, as others found, it emphasized them. I felt like it looked like I'd slapped five pounds on each hip. So, as much as I wanted to love this, as much as I'm sure that many women will love it, it didn't work for me. I personally feel this is more flattering on someone with less hip, whether or not they have a tummy. In fact, I would say that if you want emphasize your stomach, by making it look smaller, this might be a good choice for you. Good Luck!
Beautiful skirt! Such a flattering cut, and nice quality. XS was perfect size.

Very good quality, and very full skirt!  It looks much fuller in real life than in the photo, in my opinion, and I'm actually having a bit of trouble coordinating it into my everyday wardrobe because of it.  But it's beautiful, especially when ironed out as it should be.  Should have no problem wearing it when I need to dress up a bit more than usual.

I followed the suggestions from previous reviewers to size down, and I am glad I did. There is plenty of room for wider hips.Even with the smaller waist, the band still gapes a bit and the skirt rotates around. I may have to employ a belt on top. I have been pairing it with buttoned blouses and Mary Janes for a easy retro look. The fabric has a bit of weight to it, especially with two layers. I noticed the black isn't dark enough to pair with other true blacks.
Beautiful skirt and has weight to it.  The waistline is a little on the small side, but it is still beautiful.

review_summary: Believe it or not, this s
review_text: Believe it or not, this skirt is worth the tremendous price tag!  It is a lovely, well made skirt.  I'm happy to report that the zipper was quality, mine didn't stick at all.  The fabric is thick and opaque; best of all, it cleans beautifully with a damp paper towel.  Originally, I bought this skirt in a Medium and was sad to discover it was far too big for my waist.  So I did a quick exchange (a Small came in 2 days, thanks Modcloth!) and the small is a bit big yet but should fit snugly with a thick sweater tucked in.  That being said, pear shaped girls  buy this skirt for your waist, not your hips!  Finally, a word to the wise: wear this skirt on days when you feel pretty.  This is a skirt that garners quite a bit of attention, so wear it wisely!

review_summary: This  skirt fits like a d
review_text: This  skirt fits like a dream! The skirt defines my waist and hides my derrière. It s, like everyone else said, made of heavy material and is of outstanding quality! I love spinning around in it to feel the weight of the skirt rise and fall. I can tell that this skirt will last me a long time; thus, it's absolutely worth the pricekeep 'em in stock Modcloth!

It's a beautiful skirt! The material is sturdy but not too stiff. I went with a small like a usually do but it ended up a little bit too big around the waist but that can be fixed with a belt or a little sewing. With size, I think that going one size smaller would be best for this skirt but if you end up going with your usual size then there is no big problem, there would be a little sewing needed. Besides that the skirt is great and you will not regret it if you enjoy twirling in dresses or a long skirt flowing in the wind and still having that classic look.
absolutely perfect! Has great Aline to it and is comfortable and good quality. Doesn't wrinkle easily either.

review_summary: This skirt is such a grea
review_text: This skirt is such a great buy, The fabric is a beautiful heavy weight. It's a fabulous twirling skirt, and one that I will wear at work, at play, as much as I possibly can!
Love this skirt! Versatile and all around wonderful. Only thing I have to fiddle with a bit is the top; it tends to flair out instead of sitting at your waist. Nothing a belt can't hide!
This skirt was everything I thought it would be. It sits right on my waist and there is enough room to tuck in what ever shirt I wish. It falls right on my knees and it is so twirl friendly! LOVE IT
I feel like Lucy Ricardo in this skirt  so retrochichousewife!  I heart the long length of the skirt and the double layers are an almost couture touch.  I wear this a lot.

review_summary: The small was too snug fo
review_text: The small was too snug for me to be comfortable. The medium is a bit too big, but that just means that it sits below the natural waist on me. However, with both sizes, the waist band did not sit flat against my body like it does on the product photo; it stuck straight up, gapping away from me. I read only a few other reviews with this issue, so I imagine it's not common. I'll have to have it tailored, but my interim solution has been to wear a wide black belt over the waistband to disguise the gap. This will work fine until I want to wear the skirt with a top untucked. The quality is high  very thick fabric with straight seams and no loose threads. When I first washed the skirt (by hand in cold water with Woolite), it bled quite a lot, so do be careful if you choose to machine wash this with other garments.The skirt does pick up lint pretty easily, so be aware of that if you have pets or work in a dusty environment. Also, when I ordered the skirt, I thought that the second layer at the bottom was only partial; both layers are the full length of the skirt (minus the 1 or 2 inch difference at the bottom), which meet at the waistband. This does make it a bit more difficult to iron, and also makes the skirt quite heavy. It's a stiff fabric, not flowy, so I'm really not sure why both layers are the full length... but I like the skirt regardless. Overall a great purchase, well worth the price. (I'm also wearing the Rose Hips Don't Lie Tights in the attached photos)

This skirt is very full!  I am 5'1 and I do like the fullness, even if it doesn't help me look tall.  I'm going to add pumps, a mustard shirt, and the velvet touch headband and go on a date with my husband!  LOVE this skirt.  Also, if my waist was any larger, I would have had to go with a Medium.

This skirt was fabulous but I couldn't help but feel as if I was attending a halloween party. It is very, very full, more so than what I was expecting. I couldn't picture myself wearing it in real life. Bummer.

I wanted this skirt since I first saw it on modcloth but could never really justify spending seventy dollars on a skirt. It was my birthday recently, so I bit the bullet and finally got it. I wish I had gotten it when I first saw it. It flows so perfectly and looks so fifties. It hits me below the knee, which is great because I like long skirts/dresses. I maybe should have ordered a small though because the top waist band is a tad loose on me, easy fix though. It still hits my hips perfectly. It's insanely versatile. I bought the Sail Into Splendor top to go with it. For my birthday outfit I wore the skirt with a pale pink cami under and slim fitting white vneck, with brown lace up ankle boots, gray cardigan, and navy hat. It is a piece that can work with so many things and the fabric is pretty sturdy and will last awhile.

So many people complaining about how high this skirt sits, but I love that it's high waisted! I  get a million compliments on this skirt, everyone wants to know where I got it. I'ts got a lot of fabric in it, so I can understand the price. Do it!

review_summary: I just got this skirt and
review_text: I just got this skirt and while I love the material and its fullness,  the waist seems really large. I got the medium and my waist is around 27.5, so I thought the medium would sit perfectly . . . unfortunately, there is a lot of room in the waist band even when I tuck a shirt into it. I'm not sure if I should keep it or not, because the small would almost definitely be way too small

review_summary: I should have ordered a s
review_text: I should have ordered a size up as it sits a little higher on me now than I'd like, but it falls at the perfect length. Lovely, though it will need to be ironed or steamed after it is shipped to remove wrinkling. It is thicker than most of the fabrics ModCloth deals in, but it isn't a heavy drape. Perfect for Fall weather, and can easily be transitioned into Winter wear with some sweater tights.
The best basic black skirt I could have ever asked for. It is warm for cooler months and just beautiful.
Very beautiful.  Well worth $70 as the fabric is thick and versatile.

I really REALLY wanted to like this skirt. But at 5'3 tall, I felt like it overpowered me. This skirt gave my slightly pearshaped body a huge bottomheavy fullness, while making my torso look abnormally short. I'm sure if I was taller or had smaller hips/butt, it would've been perfect. Quality was great though! Just wish it suited my body type :(

review_summary: I love, love, love this s
review_text: I love, love, love this skirt; it's quickly become my goto wardrobe staple and I get compliments all the time on it. I now sort of wish I'd gotten the XS, because the waist might be just a little roomy, but the space is good for tucking in a thicker top. All in all, pretty close to perfect.
This is the WORLDS GREATEST SKIRT!  Extremely flattering, matches everything, and SO cute!!!  It falls perfectly and I look great in it.

review_summary: What you see is what you
review_text: What you see is what you get with this skirt. The photos other reviewers have shown are very representative of the look and fit. It is a very full skirt with two layers of good quality material. Has a '50s housewife kinda feel. The medium was very snug on my 28 waist. If your waist is any larger than that, I would recommend sizing up.  The only complaint I have is that it is a bit long on me, about an inch below the knees. Though it looks great paired with heels. I recommend!

This skirt is just perfect! I wear a size 4 or 6 in jeans and followed the guide so I bought a small. It fits just right, not too tight or too loose and has just enough room to tuck in shirts. You will want to twirl nonstop in this skirt. It's such an amazing buy and I'm so glad i got it.

review_summary: This skirt is so worth th
review_text: This skirt is so worth the money.  I can already tell that it will last me for many years to come.  It fits right at my natural waist and extends to right below my knees.  In a word, it's perfect.

This skirt is wonderul! It fits my waist perfectly, hits right at the knee and is the perfect shape! It's actually a pretty heavy skirt and the fabric isn't exactly what i thought it would be, but it's better! When I saw the pictures, for some reason i thought the top layer would be a bit satiny, but it's not. It just has a bit of shine to it, which is good because satin can get ruined really easily but this seems pretty sturdy. This is my new favorite skirt for fall!

review_summary: I love this skirt! I have
review_text: I love this skirt! I have a feeling it is going to be a wardrobe staple FOREVER! Good quality fabric, classy and gives just the right shape :)

As other reviewers have noted the waistband is poorly constructed and tends to fold over on itself at the top. The material is also of lesser quality than I had expected. I love the overall look, but for the price I would have expected better quality. I have worn it a few times (both with casual wear and dressed up for work) and always get compliments.
Beautiful skirt, it doesn't drape on me wuite like in the photo, but i think after ironing out the packaging creases this will improve. Can't wait to wear it.

This is an incredibly flattering and comfortable skirt. I can see this becoming a favourite in my wardrobe because it is such a versatile basic. The quality of the fabric is good and the fit of the skirt was spot on the given measurements. However, I have noticed that the button eyelet has not been seamed at all so my button closure arrived very frayed, which was a strange defect in an otherwise perfect product.

Very flattering, very adaptable.  As everyone's said, it's rather voluminous, but depending on your proportions it's in a way that will reduce, rather than exaggerate.  The length hits an inch below the knee on me, and is perfect for those of middling height (imo, makes me look a tad taller), and I can't imagine it would look outofplace on anyone with a few more or few less inches on them.  It runs a tad small and has no stretch whatsoever, so if your waist is above 29 I'd go with a large  on my 28 waist, the medium leaves enough room to tuck things in, but not enough room to be entirely comfortable.  However, the fabric seems very high quality, it's heavy and warm (perfect for the inevitable wildly fluctuating fall weather here in the Ozarks), and the construction of the skirt appears sound (more than I can say for many pieces I've ordered from this site!).  Overall the versatility and quality make it well worth the price.
This skirt fits perfectly and goes nice with a pair of heels and a white blouse.

review_summary: This is too much skirt fo
review_text: This is too much skirt for someone my size. I am just too short... :) I think this would look great on anyone 5'3 and over. I think the material is high quality and the skirt is really cute, but be careful if you are extremely petite because it will puff out on you.

This skirt is amazing. It looks exactly as wonderful in reality as it does in the photo. I love wearing this skirt with stockings in winter as it is both practical and fashionable. Absolutely love it. Couldn't recommend it highly enough!
Very nice skirt, perfect for day or night.  Is still cute but modest.

review_summary: This skirt is very cute i
review_text: This skirt is very cute in person but very poofy  be warned. I am very short and it is kind of overwhelming  I will definitely need to wear heels. It's a nice thicker material though which will be perfect in the Fall. I got a size Medium which is a bit big. A small definitely would have fit too.
Modest, comfortable, thick, and easy on the eyes.

Best purchase. It fits true to size (I usually wear a small/size 2) It is the best classic skirt...definitely a staple for your wardrobe. It is the perfect vintage skirt and if you're debating whether or not to get it...do it. The price is worth it and I've gotten so many compliments on it.

review_summary: I love this skirt! It has
review_text: I love this skirt! It has a lovely 1950s feel to it. The length, weight and quality of the skirt are all very good. The only problem I had with it was that although the bottom of the waistband fit correctly, the waistband itself gaped a little bit. I had to get a small dart sewn in so that it would lie flat. Besides that small issue, though, this is a great skirt!
This skirt is dream, the only trouble is waiting for the summer heat to die down so I can wear it out!
I love this staple skirt so much.  I have yet to wear it out because it is a bit heavy for summer weather, but I know it will be in regular rotation come fall.

Great skirt.  Had originally ordered the large based on the estimate of 1214 (i'm a 14) but had to return it for the XL which is much much better.  I get constant complements when i wear this skirt and it pairs with just about every shirt I own

I feel like Audrey Hepburn in this skirt.Simple.  Classic.  Elegant.  Versatile.  Very flattering.  Even the most shapeless of bean poles can look like they have bangin' curves  specifically, a waist  to die for in this skirt.  The skirt does have some weight to it, but not necessarily in a negative way  the material is of very high quality, and despite its heaviness, I certainly wouldn't hesitate to wear it yearround (in Seattle, anyway).The only reason I give it 4/5 stars is because I am normally a 'small' in most things, and this size small seems to fit more naturally on my hips.  I will be exchanging it for an XS so it will sit more naturally on my waistline, but fret not  this skirt *will* be a staple of my wardrobe.  Well done, Moon Collection, and well done, Modcloth.

review_summary: Oh my do I ever LOVE this
review_text: Oh my do I ever LOVE this skirt. The minute I put it on, i just had to twirll around like Julie Andrews on a mountain top. I think i might end up having it hemmed a bit but that is something I have to do quite often so NBD. The material is really nice, it has a good weight to it without being too heavy or stiff. It is really is a full skirt so be warned, it has volume .... not like a tulle party dress but it does stand out from my body which I like. for the record I'm 5'4 or so and measure 403440

This is a beautiful, highquality skirt. I was worried the high waist would be too snug, but it was just exactly right, and the heavy fabric flared out in just the right way without poofing over the hips. I am heartbroken to have to send this back, but it's because of my bank account, not because of anything wrong with the skirt. Its unique length and great cut make it worth the price in my opinion.

I was very pleasantly surprised when this arrived.  It's a  very charming skirt, not to mention well made.  The skirt is actually much fuller than I expected  enough that I would suggest it's too heavy for hot summer weather.  But it gathers nicely at the waist and flows beautifully over the waist.  It has a very nice retro feel without looking too oldfashioned.The only thing I'd suggest people take into consideration is the sizing.  My waist tends to sit right between a 29/30.  (Size 8 in American.)  I originally planned to buy this in a large due to the comments, but went with the medium on a chance when it sold out.  It actually fits just right  but if I was a full 30in, I would've definitely needed a large.  The waist has absolutely no give.  Just be aware of that when making a decision, but otherwise I have no complaints.

This skirt is as beautiful in person as the picture suggests!  My only complaint is that the very top of the waistband (which sits nicely just above the natural waist) could have been a touch more snug, but I figure when I tuck a blouse into it this problem will be easily solved.  The fabric isn't satiny smooth but doesn't have a noticeable grain either, has a lovely heavy weight without being bulky and falls like a dream!  It twirls perfectly for dancers (I'm a lindy hopper) or those who just like twirling, although it is a true circle skirt, so be sure to pick out some cute bloomers to wear underneath.  It hits me right below knee length, which is fine because it accounts for a little sashay upswing when you walk.  The double layer sets this skirt apart and keeps it from ever looking frumpy.  It seems like it would go with just about anything, would transition from daywear to eveningwear easily, and wasn't wrinkled even after shipping.  Plus it's washable!  I'm thrilled with this choice :)

This piece fits perfectly in my Sookie StackhousemeetsStepford Wife wardrobe! There is a lot of material, but it just adds to the swishy, retro feel. I ordered true to size and had no problems fitting in the waist.

This is the definition of an essential style piece. It's so subtle and yet so stylish. It's  very versatile, and the stitching is really nice quality. You get what you pay for with this! A long life skirt you can practically wear anyway you like. Make your middle tiny, and hides your hips, which is what I like!

Really happy with this skirt. The quality of the cut is superb! The material falls well and swirls easily and the fabric is good thick cotton. I was a little disappointed that the material didn't look more luxurious, but admittedly cotton is pretty useful for everyday. Be warned that it requires a lot of ironing to look good! The skirt has a heavy feel to it, and is warm enough for winter. The length is perfect  it covers knees without being too long.  It looks great on, and is very flattering, particularly if you have big hips but a narrow waist.

review_summary: I love this skirt!  I had
review_text: I love this skirt!  I had been wanting it for a while and finally decided to buy it.  It was a great decision.  I wore it to work and got so many compliments.  I am very happy with it.
great quality
I probably could have purchased the small in this skirt, but no matter, will get the waist taken in a few inches and it will be absolutely perfect!Definitely worth the money :3

Received this skirt today and I could not be more pleased. It has a lovely, substantial weight right out of the box and the cut is absolutely perfect. I have a booty but my hips are proportional to my large bust, and this skirt really highlights my narrow waist without making my bottom half balloon out. It's rare that this hourglass girl gets to feel like Audrey Hepburn, but this skirt hits right at the knee with just the right flounce. The waist is the tiniest bit snug but loosens up just the right amount with wear. A winner!

review_summary: i wear my skirts quite hi
review_text: i wear my skirts quite high, and it was a little looser than i had hoped, but i still love it! perhaps i should have gotten an xs.

This skirt fits perfectly!!! I got an XL, and I'm usually somwhere between a L and and XL, so I'm really happy! I like the length, and when I wear it with a button down shirt and flats, I look straight out of Roman Holiday. This is something Audrey Hepburn would definately have in her closet.

review_summary: I was so happy when I tri
review_text: I was so happy when I tried on this skirt. Its perfect! sits right at my natural waist and is fits pretty snug but with enough give that I can still tuck in tops. The material is not as heavy as I through it would be, so it should work well for Australian winters but maybe not so great for the summer months.

I ordered this skirt because I'm going to a boarding school that requires neutralcolored skirts no more than an inch above the knee. review_summary: Size Up & Be Wary of The Bad Zipper!
review_text: This is a skirt that really made me sad. First, it's made from a beautiful material that looks so elegant, and the fit and style is so classy. But sadly, the zipper is a total bust when it reaches the belt section. Now, this skirt is by not stretchy or forgiving, in fact, it's quite structured. But I ordered this item in my usual size and it zipped up fine until I got to the the belt. Even when I took it off and tried zipping it, the same thing occurred every time: the zipper just got stuck at the belt. It leaves a full inch and a half of my lower back exposed. Perhaps it's just my own skirt that had this defect, but it's something to consider if you're thinking of buying it. Very, very sad because it's the perfect length, color, and material. I suppose I'll keep it and wear a long sweater with it all the time, while silently hoping that the zipper won't fly down as I'm walking! Lol.

review_summary: Great length, shape, and pockets! *READ SIZE
review_text: First, sizing:According to the size chart and notes it said I should use the exact size indicated. This would have put the skirt at a 3X, when I wear exclusively L/XL. The one pair of pants I keep for ?puffy days? are an 18 with no stretch. I went with my gut (har har) and at least ordered a 2XL because I know dress patterns can be tricky. It came! I can pull the skirt on without the stretchy part moving or the zipper being open. So, the waist fits without using the zipper or activating the stretch, at all, so I could?ve gone down to size XL (one of my usual sizes)  But, I like to have some extra room for laundry accidents. But, I wanted people to know the size chart is noted as being ?off? for small sizes, but it seems to run large at larger sizes, as well. (The description says there are a few inches of stretch, but it looks like over 6 inches of stretch on the waist.)Otherwise, SIT DOWN. This beautiful skirt has pockets! Hidden pockets in women?s clothes! A unicorn! The fabric is comfortable right out of the package and the way the skirt is constructed, it feels like it wouldn?t blow up easily in the wind. The fabric design is placed in an interesting way on the skirt shape that is flattering and looks like an actually Ouija! I am so happy I grabbed this skirt! I love it!

I really wanted this for October so I may try to doctor it up myself rather than exchange it.   But the fabric is cute!  I think it would be helpful for ModCloth to publish actual garment dimensions by size in addition to the sizing chart.  I have seen other online shops do this and it is very helpful  I have never had to return or alter a garment from those sites.

returning bc too wide at the bottom for me, otherwise fit well almost kept

These are my favorite jeans! I love everything about them. The only thing I would change is the pockets. The jean material doesn't go all the way down in the inside of the pocket so sometimes the white material they use sticks out instead. As long as you remember to adjust when putting them on then nobody knows.
These jeans are amazing and great quality. The design makes the butt look a little unflattering, but they are so comfortable and sexy otherwise I don't care.

These pants are too cute!  At first I got a size 15 in the regulars, and they fit but they dug into my stomach.  So I returned them for a 1X.  These ones were a little bigger so I must be a size in between.  Sometimes they fall down a bit, but if you tuck in your shirt they're fine.  They're also a little long on me, but I just roll them up a little or hide it with boots.  They're very comfortable and I like that it doesn't have a zipper, just four buttons.  Oh, and they have POCKETS!  Big pockets that you can fit your phone in.  Most women's jeans usually don't have front pockets or big pockets, so that is nice!

review_summary: Loose in the waist and lo
review_text: Loose in the waist and long in the legs.  But a belt and rolling up the bottoms help.

review_summary: I did not like the fit no
review_text: I did not like the fit nor quality of the material. very starchy and prone to wrinkles. had some issues in the crotch as well, almost saggy.

I owned the short version of these first and decided I needed the jeans for winter. I ordered the exact same size in the shorts since those fit me perfect, but the length is rather awkward and bunches at the bottom like a straight leg rather than a skinny, and the foot hole is pretty wide. The waist fit well, just like the shorts I have, but after a month or so I had two of the buttons fall off while walking. I believe the stud they attach to on the inside of the jean was poorly made, I had to superglue them together, so far so good. So all I ask is better fitting legs and buttons.
Fabric was too thin, fit was too large. Returned
Sized up to compensate for length...these were way too tight and not at all quality worth paying the money for. The pants went back. BuhBye!

review_summary: These were so, so tight a
review_text: These were so, so tight and awkward fitting. I sized up and the fit, but just barely and they were not comfortable at all, so I had to return them.  The button fly is very odd on these.

review_summary: Denim has a weird feel to
review_text: Denim has a weird feel to it, but they're great jeans.

Love these jeans. But I'm usually between a 14 and 16 and 1x feels a little big on me. Also I am 5''10 and I find these a little long! Otherwise they are so flattering AND comfortable. First jeans purchase from modcloth and I am happy! If you're on the fence, get them! :)
Love these jeans! They are slimming and just the right length for me

review_summary: I love this style, but th
review_text: I love this style, but these jeans aren't black. I would say they are just a very dark wash blue jean. I'm keeping them because I love the fit, I just wish they would have been actually black.

I'm a size 12/13 and the 1X was a tad too loose (for my preference) So I'm returning them to get a smaller size. However, these have a good stretch to them so you can like, cross your legs and bend your knees without feeling like your amputating a limb. I definitely highly suggest them!
A little thin and really long. I'm 5' 8 and I had to cuff these I would add a photo but the app is being buggy.

These were very very very long on my. I am short 4'11 so I'm going to have to hem them. But they look cute. And fit great and it's been impossible for me to find high waisted pants like these in my size (18) my only real complaint is no matter how many times I wash them they never lose that dye smell that new jeans have.

review_summary: Wish they were a little l
review_text: Wish they were a little longer in the waist and shorter in the leg. But I have a long torso. Fabric stretches which makes these co dotage even tho a bit right.

I have the cropped version of these jeans and absolutely love them so I ordered these in the same size. my mistake, these are much smaller but thats ok just means I have to get serious about my diet! apart from that the length is great for us tall gals (if youre a little on the short side you will need to hem them)

review_summary: Very sexy. I was a little
review_text: Very sexy. I was a little uncertain about buying them because 1. I've never like highwaisted, and, 2. my measurements sortof fall between 1x and 2x, but they're great. The fabric is very stretchy, which helps the pants be flattering, but also very thin, so I'd be careful about doing anything too active in them. The primary reason I love them, though, is my husband gets that wow look when I'm wearing them :)

These jeans were a little tight and exceptionally long.  I needed to have quite a bit taken off the bottom.  The fabric is also quite thin.  I have kept the jeans however but would not wear them in winter as I would get quite cold.

I have somewhat mixed feelings about these pants but I'm happy with them for the most part. I like the rise, comparable to my American eagle high rise jeggings so not very high waisted but it works on my short torso. The buttons gap just a tiny bit which is unfortunate but not enough to stop me from wearing short shirts or tucking in tops which is how I like to wear these pants. They do an odd thing where the front tends to fold over and roll down while I'm sitting, but if I'm honest that may be because they are slighty too small haha. Length was a bit long but not too bad
Fabric is thin unlike actual jeans

I ADORE these jeans. They are hands down my favorite pair I've ever owned. I'm a little on the tall side (5'8) and they are the perfect length. I definitely did size up, and they fit very well.  My only qualm is that the inner seam is extremely worn to the point of having multiple holes on either leg, and I've had them for less than six months. Granted I wear them as often as I possibly can, but I do wish they'd have lasted for more than two months before they started showing wear. Regardless I will be getting a new pair of jeans from Modcloth, because they are so so cute.

I really liked these jeans, but they ripped along the inner thigh within four wears. :( The length was perfect for me, and the waist was great at hiding my tummy! They almost looked more like dark wash blue than black because of the fading, but that wasn't really an issue for me. They fit perfectly, but didn't have much stretch. They did hinder my flexibility a bit at work, where i do a lot of bending, squatting, and lifting. Even tying shoes was a bit of a challenge! Once they stretched out, they were fine, but they ended up ripping along the inseam. I intend to have my aunt sew them back up, but be aware that these are not terribly durable. Cute for a night out, but I won't make the same mistake twice. These are not for regular wear.

These are nice and stretchy and are somewhere in between a legging and a jean. Unfortunately I ordered them a bit too small. Can't say whether a 3x would have been too big  at the waist though, and international returns are a pain, so I'm working on stretching these out (since they're mostly cotton it's working well).  Word to the wise, these sit low at the back so be prepared to show some skin unless you're wearing a longer shirt! Also the inseam is long for me, so if you're shorter than 5'6 you'll probably need to hem these. Overall though great quality and cute pants to dress up or down.

review_summary: I sized up based on the r
review_text: I sized up based on the reviews. I'm anywhere between a 12,14 or 16 normally but I got a 2x and they were just too big

review_summary: I sized up on purpose wit
review_text: I sized up on purpose with these jeans. I'm very wary of buying bottoms on the interwebz because my hips and arse don't agree with the rest of me.They certainly have plenty of stretch, which I thought would be a problem. The quality of the jeans really helps though. The stretchyness is combated by their insistence on holding their shape.I debated sending them back for the smaller size, as these are quite a bit longer than I like. I decided against it in the end and love wearing them now. I roll them up at the ends and wear them with flats. Adorable for the summer.
Love these jeans.
These are fab!! My second pair and I am definitely hooked!! For reference, I'm between a size 14 and 16 and the 1X fits good.

They are somehow too small and too big at the same time. (?) They are constantly riding down but there is a bit a gaping between the buttons as if they were too tight.  I think if the material was a bit thicker and structured I would be a lot happier with them.
My favorite pair of jeans they fit perfectly.

I really like these jeans and they look good on me too. The only thing is that the pocket lining keeps coming out (unsure if that's due to my figure though).They're a bit long, but I always have that problem with jeans anyway so I'm not phased by it. The fabric is a little thinner than I anticipated, but I've decided I don't mind that anymore, because it means I can breathe when I sit down.

review_summary: Gah! I had to return some
review_text: Gah! I had to return something for the first time! Typically for high waisted shorts I size up so I don't feel squished, but for pants I was dead wrong. They were waaaaay too big. These have amazing stretch so don't be afraid to do your actually size, you could almost size down! Alas, I returned and ordered a different pair.

review_summary: I'm a size 14 in most pan
review_text: I'm a size 14 in most pant sizes. These are not high waisted on me at all! I have more hips and thighs than I do a waist. They come up just below my belly button. I did the whole pants test to decide if I would keep them anyway. They didn't fall off when I sat or bent over, so I washed them. When I washed them they decided to do just that! Even with a belt they slide all over the place. This makes me very sad, as it was my last attempt at finding jeans.

review_summary: I was so excited to get t
review_text: I was so excited to get these jeans in the mail today. I sized up as recommended and am glad I did. They are on the long side but I am 5'8 so it doesn't look bad on me. I have very large calves and had no problems with them being too tight. I can't wait to wear them out!

I really like these jeans. The buttons are really cute and they're nice and soft. I'm a size 1416 and the 1X fits me well. The only problem is they're super long on me (I'm 5'3) and it's not a true black  more like a really, really dark blue. Overall though great jeans.

review_summary: The jeans fit true to siz
review_text: The jeans fit true to size, but the multiple buttons are unflattering.

review_summary: I wanted to keep these so
review_text: I wanted to keep these so badly, but they do not flatter any little bit of tummy whatsoever. Had to return! :(

I dont normally wear jeans but I figured maybe I could give them another try. I loved that these jeans had button up fly and were high waisted. When I received them I found them to be not as high waisted as I felt they should be or could be. I sized up like was suggested and they fit very well. My main issue though is that they are extremely long and not at all fitted from calf to ankle. I had to cuff the pants up 2x, making a very large cuff, to be able to see my feet. The cuff was so large and boxy that it just didn't look right. So I am returning them. I had high hopes.

review_summary: I love these jeans! I hav
review_text: I love these jeans! I have been searching for a great pair of jeans for what feels like forever, and I have finally some that prove that they do exist for people with my shape. I carry a lot of weight in my stomach and have fairly muscular thighs and calves, so jeans would always be too tight around my stomach while fitting my legs, or way too big on my legs while fitting my stomach, and skinny jeans were just straight out due to the size of my calves. These jeans fit me PERFECTLY. They are comfortable without being too casual, and they are very flattering. I will be ordering a pair in every color! I did follow the advice of other customers and went up a size (I am normally an 18 so I went up to 2X) and they are pretty perfect. The length is a bit long but it doesn't look bad to leave them be or to cuff them. The only issue I've really had is that even after a couple of washes, the dye is still rubbing off on my fingers, so be careful about what you wear with them for the first few wears or just wash them a few times before you put them on. Overall these jeans are fantastic and I couldn't be happier! Thank you for making me feel great about myself!

i bought theses previously in an 11 and for some reason when they weren't great on me, I opted for the 1x. They def go on.... but they are a bit large on me.  I am curvy and they are flattering for sure, I need to find a size inbetween for them to fit perfect. I typically wear a size 10 jean.

review_summary: I am very happy with thes
review_text: I am very happy with these jeans. I have recently gained a fair bit of weight and was sick of feeling awful in many of my nowtoosmall clothes. I had been holding off buying bigger jeans but buying these was a great option. They made me realise that clothes that fit you properly make you feel good regardless of your size. They give you a lovely streamline shape and are flattering to bigger hips. No regrets! :)

These jeans look great so I'm going to keep them, but what others have said about fitting strangely is true.  The waist comes up nice and high in the front, but the back of the waist gapes a little and seems to ride lower.  A smaller size wouldn't have worked for me, so the only option is to wear these with a longer shirt or tunic.  They are also less sturdily constructed than the other jeans I ordered here.  No tears yet, but the seams do not feel as well put together.
These are great looking on and really comfortable  the fabric has a lot of stretch to it.  Love the button fly.  The ankles are slim enough to tuck into boots.

I rarely wear jeans because I can never find any that I feel comfortable in. But I am IN LOVE with these!! I'm usually a 1X at modcloth but sized up since they run small, and they fit perfectly! They're a tad long but I don't think that'll be a problem. I love how stretchy they are and the rise is exactly what I was hoping it would be (: I'm definitely going to order them in blue! Thank you modcloth for helping me to finally find jeans that I feel comfortable and confident in!! :)

These jeans are pretty awesome. I love the high waist and the buttons. I have to roll them up or get them tailored though, which is annoying. Usually jeans aren't this long on me. The back pockets are also a little low and spread far apart, which I'm not a big fan of. You can see this in the picture. I love the versatility and the sexiness, though!

The material is a little thinner than I expected....maybe so they can stretch? At any rate, this is my new favorite pair of jeans!! They fit beautifully. I love where the waist hits. The four button front is gorgeous. My only negative is they had a funky smell at first. Almost like burning rubber? I washed them twice, prayed a lot, and I think they're better. DEFINITELY wash before you wear them.

review_summary: I've had my eyes on these
review_text: I've had my eyes on these for quite some time. When I finally had the means to purchase them, I was excited to get them in the mail! Unfortunately, they were too small, which came as no surprise. The other reviewers are right, just thought I could get away with a 2X since I'm a 2X everywhere else and I've been losing weight. So back they are going!I'm also disappointed in the highwaisted part. I've purchased regular ol' jeans from another clothing store (about half the price as these) and they came up higher than these did! I don't want to criticize too harshly, since they were a size too small on me. But I'm 5'6 and the length of the legs were pretty long. The pants seemed like good quality, from the 30 seconds I had them on. Not thick, bulky jeans. Instead, thin and stretchy. So if you're looking for a dark pair of stretchy jegging type jeans that barely go up to your belly button, look no further. Just make sure to size up.

review_summary: I got these in 2X and the
review_text: I got these in 2X and they fit pretty true to size. The only thing I was disappointed with was the material. It felt like a thick jegging rather than a jean material. I'd rather they were made out of a thicker material, but they still looked nice.

review_summary: I haven't worn jeans in s
review_text: I haven't worn jeans in so long because I hate trying them on and they never fit. I got the 3X and these jeans fit like a glove! I'm so happy.

LOVE these jeans! I usually wear them with the Swing Dancing Assistant Top, and they look amazing. They're incredibly flattering on a plus size body and hide my stomach incredibly well. The fabric is stretchy, so they create the perfect skinny jean look.

review_summary: I'm a size 14 women and t
review_text: I'm a size 14 women and these fit perfectly but since they are stretch, that means that I am not wearing them more than once.  I will go a size down next time.  They are really cute with boots, flats or heels and I've worn them with shirts tucked in an left out and they work either way.  They are extremely comfortable and shape everything nicely.  The only negative is that even after I washed these, they dyed my skin.  This only stopped after about three washes.

review_summary: It is so hard to find ama
review_text: It is so hard to find amazing jeans in a size 18, ModCloth, you've pulled it off! If I could be any more happy I do believe I would explode. They are a tad long for my height so ladies under 5'5 prepare to hem. I would like to sincerely thank you for giving me that extra boost of confidence.

These pants are FABULOUS. I usually wear a size 14 or 16 because I have such wide hips; since my waist is so much smaller than my hips, these fit perfectly without the waistgapping in the back [I am super pearshaped.] They are super stretchy, so you have good lenience in fit; however, the pants run very true to size. These pants hug where flattering and kind of suck you in if thats what you need/want.  They are super cute with a tucked in blouse, a highlow, or even a regular hem since you need not wear a belt! Overall, I am SO pleased with these...I'll be ordering them in the dark wash as well! Thanks Modcloth! :D

I'm not 100% sure how the sizing on these jeans work. In the regular jeans, they come up to a size 15. Usually, jeans come up to a size 13, and then 1x would be 15. At least, that's my understanding.Since the other ones run slightly small, I ordered up from a size 13 to a 15 and while they got loose after a day's wear, it was fine. I wanted these in black, so I ordered them in the 1x thinking it would be about the same size as the 15.  Not the case, these are too big for me. Luckily, they have the black in the 15 now, so I ordered those already. The thighs run wide, so if you need that, it's there. Just wanted to leave my size for other girls deciding what size to get.
If I could describe these jeans in one word, It would have to be PERFECT!!! The material is soft, and the length is just right! I will be back to buy them in blue!!

Super comfortable, fits me perfectly, and I love the detail and the length. This is a solid skirt that is really fun to mix and match the rest of my wardrobe with. I only wish that the buttons were fastened rather than popout, because there were a couple times where I?d lean over or sit down and the top button would come undone...

Just got this skirt today, and fell in love with it! I usually wear a medium, but I sized up to a large based on the reviews that it runs small. Not in my case! Returning it for a medium. Sometimes it's better to go with your gut feeling on the size you need.
Because it is UK the sizing is a little small. I would recommend sizing up if you are in between sizes.

Love the fit, length, texture, and pattern of this skirt. Looks great for fall. It looks great and usually skirts look a bit odd on me. The only complaint is that the buttons are super sensitive! They pop open very easily if you sit down or bend over too quickly. So ordering a larger size might benefit!

For anyone considering getting this skirt, be warned that it is in UK sizes. I got the medium which is a UK 12, (I'm usually a US 8/10 depending on the brand) and the medium is a bit too snug to be comfortable sitting down so I am going to size up. The skirt itself is super cute and soft and the pattern is gorgeous! The waist does not have any stretch but the skirt itself has movement and is a bit more structured than a similar style skirt at H&M so the price is definitely worth it for the quality and longevity I anticipate it having (the fabric is a bit thicker than most mall store skirts like this so I think it will hold up well). The only negative is that it does not have pockets, what a shocker, otherwise I would have given it 5 stars.

I love this! I was able to try it on at the ModCloth store, and I'm so glad I did. I typically wear a S (and sometimes an XS), but I got a M in this. The skirt part isn't the issue, but where it buttons at the waist is where it can be a bit tight. It's great quality though, and I have already gotten a ton of compliments on it!
I sized up after reading the reviews and it fit perfectly. The corduroy has a slight stretch to it and the length is good  a lot of dresses are too short on me.  Super cute and different.

Sweet mother of... the waist on this jumper is incredibly small! I'm normally a S or even an XS in the Modcloth brand but I could barely get the buttons to close. It also comes up a lot higher than it looks like on the model. Great fabric, beautiful color, but I'm worried about sizing up in case the rest of it ends up looking too big on my small frame. Bummed to be sending this back.

I ordered this in a 2x and it was the right size for me, the rest of my order I also ordered in a 2x and they turned out too big, so I would say this one runs smaller. This one is so so pretty and comfortable and just overal (hehe) stunning! I can't wait to wear it! I'm quite short (152 cm) so it was a bit long on me, but nothing a little hemming couldn't fix ^^

review_summary: Cute but not very well shaped and runs really small
review_text: Really cute dress, I hesitated for a long time before returning it. The color is great, the fabric is good quality and the general idea is really cute!But it doesn't fit very well : the main issue was the back pockets. Instead of being somewhere around my butt, they were all the way up to above it which looked really weird (and also made it look even bigger than it is :P).Another thing is it is very small : I'm usually a little L size in American sizes and quite often a medium one is enough but reading the other comments, I went for a large and it was barely enough so you might want to size up with this one.To try and arrange the back pockets situation, I used the second button on the straps to make them longer but then they would just fall of my shoulders. I fell like it was shaped for someone of average height (I'm 5'9), just like the model on the photos.

I was so excited to buy this jumper. I saw it pictured before I could actually find it on the website and searched daily for it until I finally found it. I am 5'1 and around 100 lbs and typically wear extra small and sometimes an extra extra small. I ordered an XS and I could only get one of the buttons done. I will likely need a medium in this which is extremely rare for me. The belt is also just a poorly made ribbon and doesn't look nearly as neat as in the picture.

I am 4'11 and 98 pounds and am an XS across the board but this runs very small. I even think a medium would work. Over all though the quality is good and well made.  I am not sure I will get the larger size though since perhaps because I am already small it made me look like a little girl.

review_summary: Not for girls with larger breasts
review_text: I ordered my usual size and the top button was difficult to button. But ignoring that, I couldn't even get the straps to go over my chest. There are only 2 button holes with which to adjust the straps and neither allowed the strap to be long enough to loosely lay atop my chest like in the photo. I think with a better design it would've worked, but alas, I had to return.

This skirt is corduroy so I knew it probably wouldn't have much stretch so i sized up. I usually wear a 2x. The 3x is still a little tight but it will do! The straps aren't adjustable, so if you have a long torso this isn't for you. The skirt comes just below my boobs, a little higher than I would like. It is kind of awkward looking at first but I really love it for fall! It's a unique look. Goes great with a striped long sleeve top.

I was so excited to get this, but sadly it runs pretty small. I'm a solid medium in ModCloth, sometimes a small. My normal medium was only a little tighter than I wanted in the skirt, but was REALLY tight up top. I could barely get it buttoned at the waist, and the straps were short or something  the skirt sat higher and pushed UP my boobs, and the straps were so tight across my chest, I just looked ridiculous! (I'm a 30DD but only ~36 around in the chest.) I've never had such an issue with MC sizing. I may try to size up but I'm feeling discouraged about this one, so I may just return.
I cannot wait to wear this with tights and a cute button down top! This is adorable and unique.

So happy with these! I was on the fence how often will I wear red pants? But Im so glad I got them. Stretchy, soft, and so flattering. Very fallish and also will suit me for holiday colors too. Note: buy one size larger if youre in between sizes or unsure. These are a tad small, but they do have stretch.

These pants are the best. THE. BEST. I love the front buttons, the color, and the fabric. If they came in other colors, I'd buy them all. I have such a hard time finding pants that fit me because I'm a short, curvy hourglass shape. You know the deal, if they fit my butt and hips, then they gape at the waist. Highwaisted pants usually avoid that issue, but they often dig in in the front due to the aforementioned big butt taking up space and the fact that I have a very short torso. So: these pants. I usually wear a medium in bottoms... The medium I ordered fit, but was very tight through the hips. So, I sized up to a large and I couldn't be happier. I was worried they might be too long since I'm only 5'2, but as long as I wear shoes with a bit of a heel, they're perfect. So, bottom line, get these pants! But think about sizing up if you're often between sizes or just very hipy like me.

These are great pants  stretchy, soft and lovely for fall. Fit well too. BUT, being shaped more like a cylinder than an hourglass, it just didn't suit me at all. My butt looked good, but my tummy not at all. It clung to all the wrong places. These pants cry for a tucked in or short blouse, to show off the button pockets. I just couldn't make them work.

review_summary: Runs a tad large! Not so
review_text: Runs a tad large! Not so much that I need to return it but  I would like to take it in a little bit. The material is also a bit thin so you need to wear a slip with it but nothing to complain about here!

review_summary: An adorable skirt for all shapes & sizes!
review_text: I love this skirt! It fits as expected with just a little give that makes it comfortable for sitting, standing, moving around, tucking a shirt in, etc. The length is nice, even on my 5' 1 frame. I got a large and normally wear a 12 and it was a perfect fit! Cant wait to wear this one out! The only issue I had is the zipper is a bit fussy but thats normal for a hidden zipper.
Love these pants. Super cute and the fit is great. They even have decent sized pockets. Becoming a fast favourite

To start, these look like skinny jeans. However, the legs are actually very baggy. I ordered these not knowing what my size actually is due to pretty decent weight loss, so I rolled the dice and ordered a medium. The waist did not fit me, because I have wide hips, but I kind of expected that. But I could not get over the pant legs! Since I couldn't button the waist, I figured the legs would also be tight but they were not. They were really lose and unflattering. Its a shame because I loved the floral print, but if I ordered a larger size the pant legs would be even baggier!

review_summary: Runs SUPER Large  Also Very Low Rider Waist
review_text: Baggy as heck and runs at least a size too large  does NOT look like a skinny jean as pictured. Beautiful print....I really wanted this to work and am bummed. Also, this is a super lowcut pant, so it reminds me of the 90's, when we all wore pants that ended right above our privates, then flaunted peekaboo thongs. Ugg, not a good look. I could see this pant causing even the skinniest lady to have a muffin top. I know every jean can't be a highwaisted 50's style, but this superlowriding look needed to die with the 90's.
Due to the sizing not being numbered I thought these would either not fit well or look too much like jeggings/leggings. Nope, they're just very cute, and very comfortable jeans.

Very happy with these, was nervous to buy them. The length is a little long even after first wash, but after second wash they were much better. I?m really short so this doesn?t affect my rating. They look extra cute rolled up and I love the dark wash!
So disappointed in this jean. The crotch was super long which is odd for a mid rise. Unfortunately I have to send them back.

I have to admit, I was a little disappointed about the material when I opened the box, at first it looked cheap and it was soooo wrinkled! But after some ironing  with steam and sprinkling water on it, instead of the 'cool iron' setting that was advised and didn't work at all  it looked ok, and putting it on it looked great!I got compliments everywhere I went, and I felt like a lady thanks to the good quality lining and the weight of the skirt (I love that it's not lightweight like some cheap stuff).Note that the color is not navy blue, it's more on the indigo side, a rich color but slightly different than my navy stuff, I guess thanks to Miranda Priestly?!And of course the best of all: pocketssss.I am 5'7 and it covers my knees. I am between S/M and got the S based on the comments  I have to say it felt tight first but I had no problems even after lunch which is usually when I want to die in some of my skirts.Great skirt, I'm happy I got it in two colors! The green color is on the cool side, so I would not match it with yellow stuff but looks good with pink!

This skirt's fabric is very thick, so it doesn't move much, and it feels like a tablecloth. Very poor quality, especially for $60, not at all worth it for such a simple design. Warning, no stretch either, so you need to be right on the dot for sizing. I got a small and it was JUST the tiniest bit tight at my waist but permissible. Returned for the poor quality.

I have this skirt in Navy and the now discontinued Mint. I have an XL in both. The XL is slightly large (I generally wear a 12 and have a thick torso) but that just makes the skirt very comfortable after I tuck in my shirt. I think a L might be a bit tight with a tucked in blouse. It has some stretch in the back so I think you'd be safe. This skirt is a true midi, hitting me below the knee. Because of the length and the weight of the skirt, when it's windy (and I live in Kansas so it's always windy) the skirt moves but has never blown up on me. review_summary: The beginning of a beautiful friendship
review_text: I love this skirt and have gotten so many compliments on it. I've been looking for a nice long skirt to wear to work when I'm sick of pants, and I'm pleased to see that this garment can easily be dressed down for the weekend as well. Like other reviewers said, it came to me wrinkled (what can you do?), but it steamed flat really easily. I love the pockets and the way the skirt moves when I walk. I'm super short, so luckily I didn't expect this to hit me right at the knee. In reality it hits me about midcalf (which is exactly what I was looking for). It seems like it would be easy to hem if I didn't like the length, though, which might be good news for other shorties who really do want a kneelength skirt.My only real gripe is the zipper. Invisible zippers are always a pain, and this was no different, especially because the top has no hook and eye. Maybe I just got lucky with my zipper, but at first it got so stuck that I thought the whole thing might be too small for me (in reality it's actually a tiny bit big). Maybe it will get easier after a few more wears, but for now it's pretty annoying. I'm grateful for the elastic back of the skirt because I think it would be too big on me without the slight cinching it provides. Still, I like a little breathing room in my clothes, so it's nice to know that if I eat a big lunch I won't explode out of it. Definitely seems like there's some room for minor weight fluctuations in this skirt.Sorry about this being The Worst Photo Ever, but I find the user pictures super helpful, so I want prospective buyers to have mine too. :)

Ignore the advice to size down!! Measure your waist and select your size based on the Modcloth size guide for your waist measurement. My waist is 33 inches, which is right in the middle of the XL size range, but my 39 inch hip measurement falls in the L size range. I often struggle to choose between an L or an XL, but quickly went for an L this time, given the number of reviews recommending sizing down. The skirt arrived today and it is too tight! The waist is elasticized, but it still measures at a standard L size of around 31 inches. The elastic is a thin band and not very stretchy, so while it does stretch over to fit my waist. it digs in and is quite uncomfortable. It's true that the rest of the skirt is quite roomy and flares out, so if your hips are on the large size you could probably go a size lower than your usual hip size. But beware that the sizing runs true around the waist. I am exchanging the L today for an XL.

review_summary: I'm so sad to be writing
review_text: I'm so sad to be writing a poor review for this skirt. I've bought a lot of clothing from Modcloth and was hoping to buy it in a few more colors if this one worked out. I pined over it for months and when I finally decided to get it I read most of the reviews to make sure the fit was perfect. I sized down and got an extra small which fits just how I wantedit even stays on my hips without a belt. There's just one problem that totally ruins this skirt for me.The design of the skirt is great, but the FABRIC QUALITY IS AWFUL! And trust me, I'm not super picky about fabric. I've only worn it once (to my college graduation) and when I took it off I noticed there were loose threads on the front of the skirt. I counted at least 15 pulled threads. I'm certain I did nothing to cause them since the most strenuous activity I did in the skirt was simply walking around. They were probably there when I first received the skirt but I removed the tags before I noticed so I can't return it. It's such a cute, professional skirt but for the price I was expecting much higher quality that wouldn't show wear for a few washes at least. The item was never washed, caught in a zipper, rubbed against, or anything so I really don't know how I could have caused this. I've had other polyester items that I bought for a fraction of this price that have never shown wear and tear like this skirt has after just one wear. I'm heartbroken since I had such high hopes for this item based on reviews.

this skirt is absolutely perfect! decent price, super cute, and it goes with everything. It's also very easy to winterize, and has a retro feel to it. couldn't be happier!

review_summary: I have a 27 inch waist bu
review_text: I have a 27 inch waist but I'm 5'10  this fit perfectly and is long enough (goes to my knees).

review_summary: I love this skirt! I've b

Wasn't too happy with this skirt  it's overly large and so I rarely wear it. The fabric is quite thin and flowy, but again because of the sizing I rarely wear it.

I would definitely go down a size (especially if you have a smaller waist)  I'm usually a size L and went with a M, and I still feel like there's a bit more fabric than necessary.
Absolutely beautiful skirt!

Note: the fabric does catch on things fairly easily. I have a few pulled threads and holes in mine (after numerous wears) but they're not that readily apparent to other people!

review_summary: I love this skirt. I had
review_text: I love this skirt. I had first ordered the Essential Elegance skirt in black, but it felt  too formal to get a lot of use out of. This one is perfect. It's nice enough to wear to work, but still casual enough to wear out shopping. The material is a bit sheer, so you'll need a slip, but that's my only complaint. It's swishy, hits just below the knee, and the waist is stretchy without doing that bunchy thing that a lot of stretchy skirts do. I think this skirt and I are going to have a lot of adventures together!

review_summary: When I first tried it on,
review_text: When I first tried it on, I was very hesitant. At 5'2 the skirt fell at midcalf. It wasn't what I was expecting. It would look great with a fitted stripped shirt or any fitted shirt. But whenever I try to pair it with a loose shirt (such as the Hosting for the Weekend Tunic in Merlot), it makes my short frame look very boxy and unflattering. Overall, I like this skirt. I plan on buying the other colors to build my teacher closet.

Probably should have sized down, but this is my goto skirts when I don't want to think about what to wear. Qualitywise, it snags REALLY easily, but a tug in the opposite direction usually fixes it right up!
Love these skirts!

Love this skirt! It's breezy and casual yet you can dress it up for a night out if you want. I was a little worried about the length because I'm 5'5 and have short legs but it's perfect. In the summer it's great with flip flops and a tee or pretty tank. In the colder months I throw on tall boots and a sweater or blouse. It's really a great staple for every wardrobe.

review_summary: This skirt is nice, but t

review_summary: Cute skirt! I like the el

It can appear dowdy unless you add some quirk, but since I tend to be too quirky I appreciate the basic quality of this skirt. Overall I am pleased with my purchase (I bought the orange too and it is a surprisingly versatile colour), because I wanted a longer midi skirt to wear with a patterned tanks and keds, and this will definitely work for everyday casual/cute. review_summary: I've been looking for a c

The belt is decent quality for a comeswith belt (usually included belts are cheap and flimsy) It does snag a bit when you're trying to get it through the loops but it's not a big deal. I think I love it the most because it has a very 60's feel to it, almost like a poodle skirt cut but obviously not as tacky. I've tried it on with a bunch of different tops since I opened it and haven't been disappointed yet. I'm sure I could easily dress it up for a fancier night out too if I wanted. This is DEFINITELY worth buying, it's going to be a staple piece in my closet for sure

I received the leggings in the mail not too long ago. I am 5'0 and 110 lbs and I ordered a S/m for reference on fit. I wanted to have a colorful pair of leggings because my collection is black and grey. The pros to the leggings are the design, color, and fit. The design is really good with the stars. The blues are bright and really pop with the Simply on a Saturday tunic that I paired with these leggings. The top is very long and covers up any chance of the lighter colors being a bit sheer. The fit is also very good for me. The leggings are supposed to be a bit tighter than regular pants. The M/L would have been way too big. The cons to the leggings are that they are long and not dryer friendly. I am short so pants are longer on me. I would use that for your context on whether or not to buy based on the length issue. I wore long fuzzy sleeper socks with them when I wore the leggings for the first time. It fixed the issue for me.  Also, you can wear boots with them to cover it up. The other is con is do not put them in the dryer because they are probably going to shrink. They do not provide a lot of stretch. I put them on the hand wash cycle and hung them out to dry in the bathroom. I don't put my leggings in the dryer anyway. Easy solution for that type of situation. I would recommend these leggings to anyone wanting to add uniqueness and color to their leggings collection. I found easy solutions to the very small cons. I love these leggings.

The reviews on the black/teal versions recommended sizing up, so I assumed I needed this in L (usually a M, 34C). Alas, it was sold out in everything but M...I decided to go for it anyway and I'm glad I did! IT LOOKS FABULOUS. The M fits PERFECTLY (even a bit of wiggle room!), and the color is a gorgeous rich burgundy (my photos make it look more red than it is). It's snug at the waist, but still super comfortable. I feel like a bombshell in this thing. The material is thick enough to drape beautifully, but not so thick that I couldn't wear it on a warm fall day by itself. It's very soft. Like a fabric hug. Only complaints: the belt is too big, surprisingly. It dangles a bit on the tightest notch. It's extremely long...I'm 5'4 and I'll have to hem a good 34 off so I can wear it in 2 heels. You also get a monster wedgie if you bend over too far, just a warning. Bottom line: ladies, if you're hesitating on this one, just go for it! The color and fit are going to be flattering on just about everybody.

review_summary: So, I switch between an X
review_text: So, I switch between an XL and a 1X in Modcloth sizing, and after reading the reviews, was fairly happy with purchasing these in 1X.  There is a *lot* of spandex in these, compared to other stretch denim I've owned, which is a mixed blessing.  On the one hand, they are very forgiving if you're packing a lot of junk in your trunk.  On the other, they tend to loosen and wiggle down over the course of the day.  One thing I find irksome is that the pockets are not welllined  the denim just barely dips into the front pocket, and so when the jeans wiggle down, the linings start to show and I find it unsightly.  I'm considering just taking a bit of thread and tacking the front pockets shut, as the jeans are otherwise flattering despite their flaws.

The actual inseam on on the XL is about 28, so the longer length comes from the torso area. The good part about the crotch being lower is that it does not really ride up when you sit down/bend over.  I feel like a pair of leggings or boy shorts would solve any discomfort. Overall, this was a GREAT purchase and I am already debating on ordering in another color. I would Highly Recommend.

But it doesn't show underneath my tunic dresses. there is *just* the right amount of extra fabric at the end of each leg to make it wrinkle nicely.As wonderfully as they work with my dresses, I would never wear these pants without at least a jacket  sitting down causes the waistline in the back to drop by at least 2.5. It goes from Mom jeans to moon jeans waaay too fast for my comfort. Also, the waistband really digs into your stomach. If you have a belly, do not plan to sit down in these jeans.
