Just received this in the mail today and tried it on and LOVED it. The color is pretty dark, so it's definitely a winey purple/red. It's always really hard for me to figure out what size I am and every time I order a small it's the tiniest bit too big, so I'm very glad I opted for the XS in this one.

I'm glad I got a size medium  for reference I normally wear a size 4 in dresses. Even with a medium though, this skirt is almost too tight. It sadly also makes me look like I'm having a baby. I'm hoping with a good ironing, this won't be so noticeable. Very cute otherwise.
Very cute and has a great weight for fall and winter! the inner skirt is really nice and silky too!

This is a really nice skirt. It looks great in person and is quality fabric. I like the bow on it, too. It looks very full when wearing it, more so than in the picture. I?m petite (5?0?) and the length was a bit longer than I wanted, it was a few inches past my knee. Overall great addition to your fall/winter wardrobe!

This skirt is everything I hoped it would be  true to color, comfortable, holds its shape well. It did arrive slightly wrinkled, but that is to be expected. No weird smells or crinkly sounds or restrictive inner layer like sometimes happens with Modcloth skirts. My only regret is that I was between sizes (waist closer to a small, hips closer to extra small) and at 5'3 I am on the shorter side and have trouble finding Aline skirts that don't look like midi skirts on me, so I took a gamble and sized down. The length is right (slightly below the knee) but the waist is too tight and I can barely zip it up. I think I'll be exchanging it for the next size up.

I absolutely love these pants! Like the other reviewers said, the waist is a bit snug, but I don't have much of a difference between my waist and hip measurements so the tightness and elastic actually carve out a bit of a waist for me.They are light and flowy and I love the shorts liner. The top printed fabric is seethrough, but the shorts liner comes down to my mid thigh. It makes the pants perfect for summer (I can imagine they would be too cold for winter wear). They are the perfect length for me in a slight heel.I wear them all the time and get tons of compliments! They are my favorite purchase from Modcloth.

I usually LOVE all things Modcloth, but this was my first real disappointment.  The material is terrible and the waist is TINY!!!!  I couldn't even try on the pants due to the cut, but I didn't even have too because once I saw them in person I was disappointed. Pass!

I knew I was taking a chance on these, but I loved the print so much. These pants are pleated and high waisted which doesn't flatter anyone with an apple figure.  On top of that, the fabric is sheer/see throw.  There is a lining, but it's only the length of shorts, which I fell adds to the bulk.On the plus side, the fabric is beautiful and the pants don't not feel cheap, they are just meant for a more slender figure than mine

I purchased this in both M & L. I'm a size 6 in pants, roughly a 32 waist with a 29/30 inseam. The M fit well in the waist  maybe just the slightest bit snug. The thighs fit fine. The calves are were ModCloth screws up all the freaking time. The right calf was fine, the left calf was about 1/4 smaller so the M just didn't work out. The L was way too large in the waist and clearly everything else was yuck baggy as a result. This is NOT A SHORT PANT leg. It went to my ankles easily and did NOT ride up when I sat down. Not sure why this model looks like she's wearing capris... Returned both sizes.

I wanted to love these pants so much, but I'm settling for liking. I ordered a large and they fit well and are comfortable, but I do have issues with them. For one, they are baggier about the bottom than I would prefer (or the photshoot led me to believe), they pick up lint like crazy, and they wrinkle quite a lot over the course of the dayso the polished trouser look I was hoping for isn't really what I'm getting. I will be keeping them, but for relaxed weekends more than work wear. Currently paired with navy loafers, an OutofPrint Space Cat tee, and a navy cardigan.

I brought these pants last week and they are very soft and form fitting. The cats are subtle. However the stiching on the sides of the pants is a little poor at certain areas which is not only visually meh but makes me question how long I'll be able to wear these pants.

This is the cutest Halloween/spooky themed clothing item I own! Previous reviews said it fit small so I ordered a large (cause I have a bubble butt) but in reality I could fit the medium (because it hits your natural waist) so probably should have ordered more true to size. The large just makes it a bit poofier! So it's all good!  There's also pockets which is adorable. The picture matches the product exactly!

As other reviewers have stated, the outer layer was thin and wrinkles easily, but it's such a cute skirt and perfect for Halloween. I actually liked the waistband, which is wider in the front and comes to a point  it didn't create a weird silhouette as other reviewers have said. I can't wait to wear it to the Halloween party I'm hosting!

I just got this in the mail today and I absolutely LOVE it!!! I got the xl, which is my go to size with modcloth, and it's a little loose but still works. I can't wait to wear this on Friday the 13th!!! And for so many October festivities

review_summary: Great Print, But Too Pricey for Quality
review_text: I bought this skirt and was extremely excited! I loved the print and bonus...it has pockets. However when I received the skirt, the quality was very poor and the material is prone to wrinkling. If the skirt was in the $40$50 price range, I would definitely keep it, but the price does not match the quality. Not to mention, the band around the waist is rather odd. At the front, it arches up (if you look closely at the models, you can see the band at the front doing it, but the arch looks very subtle on them in comparison to when I was wearing the skirt) which makes the outfit look rather strange when shirts/tops are tucked into it.The back part of the band is made of a stretchy material which makes the skirt look cheaper. I really wanted to like this skirt, but the skirt is made of a super thin material and feels very cheaply made.

I love the print on this skirt! It's a nice soft cotton. However....sizing...(this is my first purchase from Modcloth) I'm in the 46 range. A lot of stuff I buy is small. I've got some similar skirts from another company and I bought a medium. The measurements for this skirt said I should buy a large... it's a bit big so next time I think I'll go with a medium.

When I received this skirt, I was pleasantly surprised on the quality of the skirt. The buckle by the waist is a cute feature that makes the skirt unique. My only complaint is that the skirt is too long for my 5'4 stature. It reached about twothree inches above my ankles. Unfortunately, this skirt will be going back.

I liked the librarian look, with the plaid and strap details, however on, this skirt was not pretty.  I'm surprised at the cost with how cheaply made this skirt was.  I sent it back.  The length was great though, just wish it was a better quality.

review_summary: The skirt is made very we
review_text: The skirt is made very well but is comically long. I am only 4'10 so I expect things to be bigger on me but it goes to my ankles. The material is sturdy and thick but not like wool so it can be used in spring and early summer too. Overall a great find just very long.

I love this skirt. I paired it with the hound dog sweater and it's super cute! Fits true to size. I have this in purple, blue and pink would buy in other colors (maybe a forest green or black). Just lovely. Hits about knee level for me.

This skirt is perfect for work. Appropriate length and super cute print and fit. The plaid pattern is great and easy to pair with different tops and tights of all sorts of colors. I haven't worn this outside of work yet, but I totally would because it's just really fun even though it's modest. Definitely a snug fit at the waist, but I would say it's true to size. The material is excellent quality, very sturdy and thick.

review_summary: Beautiful piece, please make in more colors
review_text: I love this skirt, wore it for the first time yesterday. It is really nice for autumn/spring (maybe even winter) in northern climates, warm but breathable and the fabric is super soft and not too heavy. The drape is nice, and my only issue (a small one) is that the cut is such that the pockets gap just a bit at the sides (I have pretty wide hips so this may not be a problem for other people). Overall it's great, and I would love to get this in other colors/prints. :)
Such great quality. Quite comfortable. Very happy with the fit. Perfect!

review_summary: So in love with this skir
review_text: So in love with this skirt!!! So happy I got it. Not too warm. And the length just perfect

I am so excited about this skirt! The colors are just as pictured and the quality of the piece is even higher than I anticipated. It's a nice weighty fabric which excellent structure. The waist has very little give, however, so I would definitely recommend choosing the size closest to your measurements or one size up, just to be safe. I already know this is going to be one of my falls staples! Thanks, Modcloth!

review_summary: I love this skirt! It's a
review_text: I love this skirt! It's a absolute favorite of mine, perfect for the fall.

review_summary: I am absolutely in love w
review_text: I am absolutely in love with this skirt!!! It fits me perfectly (though I have short little legs so it is a little long). Just heavy enough material to take me from Autumn to Winter with some tights and little booties! Looks stunning with the Classroom Charisma Sweater (Turmeric), or the Endless Possibilities Tank (Navy), and the Set For The Solstice Jacket (Wine)!!! So pleased with this purchase!!

I really wanted to like this skirt because the print is so cute, but the length is awkward. It drops to the middle of the calf, so it can look a bit matronly. The fabric is decent quality (though there were a couple snags/knots in the skirt that was delivered to me), and it does have an adjustable waistline, which is very comfortable.I'm sure it works great for some women, but unfortunately it didn't for me.

review_summary: Cute, but pockets make it weird
review_text: I love the color/print of this skirt, and I bought it with a top and cardigan that matched perfectly. It was to be a perfect fall outfit, but the skirt disappointed. I bought a 1X (I'm always between an L1X in modcloth stuff, usually bigger on the bottom), and the waist was loose, so perhaps could have gone down to an XL. Unfortunately the pockets stuck out and made me look SUPER hipy. Made  my whole midsection look huge and overall just didn't work. Otherwise the skirt was soft, light and exactly as pictured. Bummed about those pockets!

I was captured by this skirt when I first saw it advertised. I bought a skirt from Modcloth before that I liked, but didn't love; so I hesitated before I purchased this one. The colors are just like you see in the picture with hints of navy blue, forest green, burnt orange, and sunflower yellow. Like other reviews, there is an awesome elastic band in the back to give a slight stretch for a snug fit and a zipper that is kind of hidden behind a pocket (Love the pockets!) for easier slipping into the skirt. The material is relatively thin, not see through thin, and there is a blue silk like slip underneath that layer which really adds to the quality, Definitely a must have skirt that can become a classic that I will wear for several years (only time will tell). The only downside I say about this is that I wished the length was just inch or so shorter as personal preference. If you purchase this, my recommendation would be to check your measurements for waist and go off the sizing chart; the elastic band only gives a little bit. Oh yes, the other down side is now I really look like a woman from England in the 1940s. ;)

I love that this skirt is lined and the construction feels like good quality. The pockets are a massive plus, although they do add a little to the bulk of my hips, but the way this skirt sets off my waist, I don't care. I bought it with the Attention, Everyone! Block Heel Bootie and it looks great. I am 5'5 though, so the skirt hits me well below the knee, which might make some look shorter  but I love it. I do recommend sizing up. I'm usually a small but thank goodness I ordered a medium because it's just right around the waist.
This is a really nice skirt, it fits well and has pockets and it's nice and light. I love the colors of the plaid and it will be great for fall time.

review_summary: For girls with a tiny waist
review_text: Am pretty bummed that the waist is too tight on me, despite the bit of elasticity. While I'm able to zip it up and fasten the hook, it goes up really high on the waist, and the side pockets then open too wide in order to accommodate my hips. Not a flattering look! Love the color and the fabric, it's a shame about the fit.

review_summary: I am SO thrilled with thi
review_text: I am SO thrilled with this skirt! I ordered an XL knowing I carry most of my weight in my belly so I don't have much of a waist. But it was a perfect fit and very comfortable. There is some elastic in the back (which is hard to see in the product photos) for extra comfort. I'm also only 5'1 tall so I was certain I'd have to have this skirt shortened at the tailor, but I'm thrilled to see it is the perfect length. The fabric is so pretty and looks very expensive but i don't think it'll be too warm. Overall I'm so happy with this purchase  I'm hoping they come out with the same skirt in other patterns and colors!

review_summary: Bold look for the right body type
review_text: I read the other reviews and decided the strange fit on other people might work perfectly for my body type. Worn with heals it was super comfy and cute. I'll wear it with my burgundy courderoy blazer in the winter. Works well with long legs, larger chest, and someone who carries their weight up top.

review_summary: SO CUTE, but sizing is a bit off!
review_text: When I pulled this out of the bag, I was in love.  I was able to put it on, but it is just a hair too snug in the hips and a bit too large up top.  I'm a 24 in dresses and a 6 in pants.  Legs were too long as well, but I would have hemmed if it fit elsewhere. Bummer!!!

I am normally a medium but often have to size up in jumpsuits, so I ordered a large. I could barely get it on and zipped. The design is cute, but it was so unflattering. Only purchase this if you are VERY tall and thin.
Great quality and very cute.  5'9, 135 ordered a L.  Runs small but real problem is it is short waisted.  Long torsoed gals might want to pass

Although i kind of felt like a couch from he 70's i did like the print and the fabric is nice and thick with some stretch. Great for fall weather. I'm tall 5'10 and it was a tad short in the crotch but livable since it had stretch. The legs are long and would need to wear heels. The issue i have is the waist. You have to be very thick in the middle. It fit my but perfect but was very baggy in the waist by several inches and looked very weird. Also this is not for big busted gals, perhaps if you're shorter and order a larger size there will be more room in the bust.

I was really excited about this purchase, but unfortunately it will be going back. The pants are about 4 inches too long, and I am 5'7. I usually wear a 10/12, so I got a large. The bottom part was very fitted, but the top was big around the arm holes. The fabric was fine. It was medium weight with stretch to it.

I agree with the reviewers who've gone before me  this is a great skirt. The material is soft without being too 'wrinkly', the skirt's lined, and the partially elasticized waistband is comfortable. It hits me a couple inches below the knee. I could have gone down a size to a L, as the elastic is forgiving, but I might 'grow' into it as the day progresses. The colours of the pattern are quite complimentary, more subdued in person. Colours: teal, medium blue, and fuchsia (nearly a warm purple).

review_summary: This is the best skirt i
review_text: This is the best skirt i have ever worn ever in my life.
As a lifelong Nancy Drew fan, I just had to have this skirt, and it does not disappoint! Such a fun print, soft fabric, and I love the pockets (of course!).

They are very comfy, and I do love them. They are definitely built with a longer torso and legs. I'm rather short 5'2 and they are about 45 inches to long at the bottom, and 1 inch to long at the top, but they still look rather great.  I'm going to see what it would cost to get it tailored, but if it is too much I will need to return them. Over all though these are beautiful pants and I wish they fit better, but being as small as I am pants rarely fit correctly. Also on a side note, there is a small pocket which is hilariously small.

review_summary: I ordered a 2x and it was
review_text: I ordered a 2x and it was unbelievably small! I couldn't even wear them.

review_summary: I have ordered in this br
review_text: I have ordered in this brand before and the fit was fine, but in these cut of pants, they are a bit snug.  The XXL is a size 18, but is tight around the waist.  I also expected the fern green to be a dark rich green and it is basically a regular khaki green.  I thought the material would be thick, especially for winter and it is not.  Overall, I don?t think this is an$80 pair of pants.

I was SO excited about these pants, but they were absolutely enormous in the pant width and length. I'm okay having to do some tailoring, but I would have had to hem a good 6 of fabric (and I'm 5'7). They did fit well on the waist, but nowhere else. The fabric was not good quality either.

I bought the pants the first day the fall collection was released. I am a huge fan of vintage, Modcloth and fall. They looked incredibly cute on the photo, and since I couldn't wait for fall fashion to start, I already wore them for my second day of college, which was today. The pants are very light, the color is perfect, and the waist fits perfectly. The only thing is that they are so.so. long. I am 5'7, size medium, and I don't usually have any problems with how my pants fit, but this is the second pair of Modcloth pants that are too long (I bought a burgundy jumpsuit from here too, and same thing, super long.) I love how the look and how the sit on my waist, but I do have to spend some extra dollars to make them shorter, which of coursen is a disadvantage to me as a student. Even with heels, I kept tripping and it was just not graceful. I even fell once. Anyway, the pants are great, just be cautious about your height. Hopefully, one day Modcloth will be able to make their sizes more diverse and suitable for average women.

I initially ordered a large and returned it for an XL, but when it fit  AHH! The material hangs perfectly and produces great movement when you walk  billow and ripple and twirl, you name it. The olive is a lovely color, just like the photo, and the button on the back is a fun detail to an otherwise perfectly plain staple wardrobe piece. Only downside is no pockets!
This is one of my favorite skirts to wear. I love the way it feels and how it looks on me.
This skirt was very cute but ran small according to the measurements online. I am usually an XL and it fit more like a Large in my opinion. Had to send back.

Beautiful skirt + amazing color! It's very hard to find a skirt that fits my waist and height but this one did! It was only about an inch too large but I just did a quick alteration and now it fits like a glove.

review_summary: So nice, just need to sho
review_text: So nice, just need to shorten it a bit because of how short I am.

review_summary: I loved this skirt so muc
review_text: I loved this skirt so much I bought a similar skirt from this brand in another color. Perfect silhouette and great fabric quality. The color is nice too, I consider it neutral and pair it with many different tops.

review_summary: I had this in another col
review_text: I had this in another color but in XL. That one was a little small even though most of the time XL fits well. This one in 1X and fits perfect!
I really like this skirt. It feels very feminine and has fit into my work wardrobe perfectly. The button closure is a cute detail.

review_summary: Love this skirt but it ra
review_text: Love this skirt but it ran really small. What a shame!
The material feels amazing and the color is gorgeous!
I'm normally a 1X or 2X in skirts, but I sized up and the 3X fits perfectly. Beautiful skirt. Love it!

review_summary: I LOVE this skirt! One of
review_text: I LOVE this skirt! One of my favorite staples. I want to get some more in different colors  but would size down for sure. Highly recommend!

review_summary: I think if you were avera
review_text: I think if you were average height of 5'7, this wouldn't be too long. But then I like skirts to hit me just above my knees and it's difficult to find ones that do, because I'm a bit shorter.
poofed in an unflattering way around my waist

review_summary: I'm usually a XL to 1X bu
review_text: I'm usually a XL to 1X but I bought one of these skirts before in a 2x and if I were to buy again I would have to go with a 4X which kinda sucks for me.
This was my second Bugle Joy skirt and it's absolutely perfect.  I love the vintage but understated look it gives.
I love this skirt, great color, great shape. only downside is the waistband has no structure so it folds or crumples on itself

review_summary: This is a nice and versat
review_text: This is a nice and versatile skirt.  I am 5'10 and this skirt comes right to the bottom of my knee.  It just needs a little iron to get the wrinkles out and it goes with many things.  A large has just enough room at the waist for me to tuck in my blouses.

review_summary: So this skirt is a nice q
review_text: So this skirt is a nice quality, and doesn't feel cheap at all. It's thick enough to not show panty lines or anything. I'm 5'3 and it hits me about 3 inches under my knees, so perhaps a tad long, but not bad.My only complaint is the waist. I know it's supposed to be high waisted, but I read the size chart and got the one to go with my measurements and the waist sits comfortably about 2 inches above my belly button, which is higher than I'd like. Also the button clasp doesn't feel very sturdy and I worry about it not holding. But I've worn the skirt twice and it hasn't broken yet, so maybe I'm worrying over nothing.

review_summary: Fits very true to size. T
review_text: Fits very true to size. The material is great and doesn't wrinkle too quickly which is a total plus. Love this skirt!

review_summary: I love it! I had to send
review_text: I love it! I had to send mine back and get bigger size, but other than that I'm in love!

review_summary: I just bought both this s
review_text: I just bought both this skirt and the somewhatsimilar Breathtaking Tiger Lilies skirt and have now worn both for a day each. I love both, although I'll say that while a big fan of the belt that came with the BTL skirt this one might slightly edge it out as my favorite?I think there's a little less volume at the top which I feel more comfortable in (all the pear shape gals, put your hands up). I also find the waist more comfortable and to have a hair more room.The skirt has a really nice weight and transitions well to fall weather and to pairing with leggings and tights. It dresses up but I also rock it with a graphic tee and some jewelry. For me the fit was perfect after using the size chart, though I'll note that I'm usually a smaller size in the waist than in the hips, so perhaps others will find the waistline tight.
Great basic skirt, a little tighter in the waist than I expected but not too much. It's not lined but the fabric is a good quality.

review_summary: It's a cute skirt but it
review_text: It's a cute skirt but it was not flattering on my figure at all.Too tight around my waist and made my hips looks huge

I adore these skirts.  I have about 5 in different colors and patterns.  This is a deep olive green which is perfect for fall.  I am all over the board when it comes to sizes on Modcloth, but the Bugle Joy skirts consistently fit me in M. #Review Contest

review_summary: This skirt is so cute! Ol
review_text: This skirt is so cute! Olive is almost like a neutral, it goes with everything while appearing unique. It always makes me feel like the hot librarian type.It comes in so many colors, get yourself one!
The fabric was poor quality and it def runs small.

Initially I tried this skirt out in a M, but I found that the band was a tad too tight even without a shirt tucked in. I think the sizing is just a bit shifted, so if you're on the upper end of M (size 8), I would get a L; similarly if you're on the upper end of S (size 4), you may want to order a M. Once I got it in the right size for me, I loved the skirt! It adds a fun swish to my workday. The fabric is pretty thick, and I can see wearing it yearround with the addition of tights in the winter.

I'm usually between a XS and S, and read this could be tight around the waist, so I ordered S. However, its still a bit tight on me, making the button stretch out. I'm still debating if I should keep this, cause I wouldn't go a size up, the skirt will be too long. Otherwise, its a really cute look and goes with so many of my tops!

review_summary: I sized up since j have a
review_text: I sized up since j have another one of these in medium, which fits but if I feel even slightly bloated, it's uncomfortable. So if you're a M/L, go for the L. Amazing quality and length, fabric is heavy enough that j don't have to worry about Marilyn Monroe accidents. Just love it! Wish the teal would come back again

This skirt is very nice ! I love the big single button closing at the back, the color is a nice olive one. Can't decide if I will hem it a little shorter or keep it bellow the knee as it is right now.
Slightly smaller in the waist than I expected but overall super comfortable and cute!

review_summary: I had to size up to get i
review_text: I had to size up to get it to fit at the waist, but it was worth it. Beautiful color and classic style.

Most importantly, size up in the waist considerably. I am normally an XL, so originally ordered a 1X, but had to exchange for a 2X. The fabric has a very nice, quality weight and thickness which makes for a great swing (along with the full, precise cut). The color is deep and rich, represented well by the photo. I agree with others that the style works well as a high waisted skirt, even ig you have wide hips and a little belly. It just sits well. Highly recommended!
Comfortable m
Skirt looked great on someone else. Guess I have a little too much hip for the style. Returning.

review_summary: I wear this skirt at leas
review_text: I wear this skirt at least once a week. Dressed up or down, it is super versatile. I wear it with boots, heels, sandals, blazers, tshirts, cardigans, jean jackets. Probably my favourite Modcloth purchase ever.
Lovely skirt! Flowy, light, and very forgiving! The material is great and doesn't wrinkle! For reference I am about 4'11 and I'm usually a size SM. This was true to size and it's in my rotation.
I'm usually a small, but this skirt was a couple inches to big to fit high on my waist. Going to exchange it for the XS and hope that is better.
It's fairly good quality for buying it on sale not lined. It sits a little high on my waist, but a large would have been too big.

review_summary: I was worried this was go
review_text: I was worried this was going to be a little snug in the hips/waist, as I've had that problem with skirt sizing on Modcloth before, so I almost sized up to a large. I'm so glad I didn't! The medium fits perfectly at my natural waist, a larger size would have fallen lower on my hips than I would have liked. I'm also a shorter girl (albeit high waisted), and the length is right below my knees. Serious twirl action, as well. Very tempted to buy this in several other colors!

review_summary: Great!  I have two of the
review_text: Great!  I have two of these skirts and will probably order a couple more.  Fit is perfect  I went one size up per suggestion.  Nice quality and good weight to the fabric.

review_summary: Thought it might be a lit
review_text: Thought it might be a little frumpy but I was pleasantly surprised! I'm tall with a relatively small waist and my usual size is a 6.. the medium fit perfect.

review_summary: Love this skirt. I have i
review_text: Love this skirt. I have it in multiple colors and they're all amazing!!!!

I absolutely adore this skirt! The one thing that would make it even better would be pockets. The quality is great, the only complaint I would have is that the thread on the button has been loose since I got it. I ordered the size I usually do and am happy with it. If only this was cheaper so I could buy every color!
Love this skirt, retro in just the right way. Lovely thick smooth fabric (much better quality than this skirt in black).
Great color but the stitching was coming out when it arrived and the fabric looks like it will wrinkle easily.
Size up!

I absolutely love this skirt. It is the perfect retro skirt and looks great with almost anything tucked in. Paired with some wedges (I need the extra height because I'm too short to wear this length in flats), it's become my staple. I want to buy it in every color.

Love this skirt! Love the color, the high waist, the length and lightness. I wear this dancing quite a bit (perfect skirt for turning and twirling) and always have people asking me where I got it and I point them right here. Everyone should get this skirt! I know I'll be getting more now =)  #ReviewContest

review_summary: So I agree, this skirt to
review_text: So I agree, this skirt totally runs a little small and I had to order an XL as opposed to my standard large but if you need my advice and order up, it will be perfect! Works well paired with a casual top or fancier blouse!
I have been changing shape almost daily, and this skirt makes me feel so beautiful every time I wear it! Great for those both petite and not so petite of figure. ?

review_summary: Fits really well on my wa
review_text: Fits really well on my waist. Enough room for my hips and is thick enough not to need a slip. Not too heavy to feel like I'm dying in LA heat. Great purchase.
Wonderful quality, but it's small in the waist.
Tighter around the waste then I was expecting but it's super cute so I'm going to make it work. A great skirt for the office.
Fabulous addition to my closet!
Loooooove it.  So flowy and comfy, fits perfectly on the waist.

review_summary: waist is so tiny! my wais
review_text: waist is so tiny! my waist is 29 inches and should have gone for a large. hopefully I can let it out a bit because it's really cute!
Love the quality and feel of this skirt. I have it in black as well, though the button closure is on the opposite side. Color is a rich olive.

This skirt is super flattering! I love the fit around the waist and how it flows when I walk. The fabric is comfortable and good quality. The button in the back adds a cute detail. It is below my knees, but most likely because I'm only 5 feet tall :)
The skirt is absolutely beautiful. The material is strong but still has a bit of stretch to it, so it's quite forgiving. The bottom hem hits me just below the knee, so it's a great skirt for work.

review_summary: I ordered this one by acc
review_text: I ordered this one by accident I was trying to order a different green skirt I'd picked out and I pulled up this one and clicked 'buy' realizing after shipment I'd ordered the wrong one. But I figured what the hey, let's see how it looks. It's very nice! Similar to the streak clearly skirt in looks (which is one of my favorite skirts). The length is lower end of knee length for me, or a smidge below the knee, and since I teach that is exactly what I need for work. I'm short so take that into consideration.  My problem... when they say the 1X runs small, they mean it. I ordered 1x and while I can get it on, it's snug! In dresses a small 1x or large XL fits me perfectly, but not in many skirts (I'm high waisted and the skirts sit lower where I'm a little wider). The 1X is just too snug for me. So I'll probably exchange for a 2X, even though that would normally be way too large for me (or I'll lose ten pounds and it will fit :)). But it's a very nice skirt, material is a good thickness not heavy but not way thin like many dresses and skirts. It hangs beautifully. The color is very nice not what I intended when ordering my green skirt, but it is more versatile in color than the skirt I'd originally intended getting. So other than being a little too snug, it's very nice and I recommend it. Just make sure you get the right size!

review_summary: On the quest for the perfect pant...
review_text: I am a huge fan of a great wide legged trouser, so when these beauties came into our Modcloth Austin store (...dark navy, tie belt, sumptuous feel) I knew I had to try them! I paired them with a simple white tie neck blouse (item number:153374) to give it an easy, professional feel. To push my 1940s inspired look over the top I grabbed a GORGEOUS red handbag (my signature red lip) and some patterned mules. I tried these on as a Modcloth Employee and having tried on quite a few similar pairs that didn't quite hit the mark I really like the fit on these pants. I have a naturally smaller waist compared to how curvy I am on the bottom so pants are usually problematic but with the tie, it helped the usual gaping I experience. They were exceptionally long, even on me as a taller gal at 57, which is why I only gave them 4 stars. However, if you're looking for a pair of trousers to make you feel like you walked straight out of Katherine Hepburn's closet these simple and soft trousers may be just what you're looking for.

There is also this strange black paneling inside the pants that make them look somewhat unfinished. I decided to take them with me on a trip because I had nothing else this thin and only had a backpack with me. review_summary: I want to start by saying
review_text: I want to start by saying I've bought these twice, and this is a review having worn them out, not like most reviews which give you an idea how it is straight out of the box. Fit? Lovely. Flattering? Absolutely. Comfortable? Most definitely.Durable? No. Each pair lasted me approximately three months. The fabric is not a durable denim. It's thinner, and has a lot of elastic to it. So if your thighs rub, that's where it will fall apart first. Mine also rubbed thin around the ankles, which is something I've only seen in jeans I've owned for years. Stretchy fabrics like this tend to be less durable anyway, though, so maybe I just can't have my cake and eat it too.I've also purchased them in black, and that one was a different brand. That one had slightly thicker material and lasted more like six months. So, overall I've owned three pairs of Sleeks for Itself pants, and none of them had much longevity. But for $40 you'll look good and feel good for ten weeks.

These are so amazingly comfortable! I could sleep in them, workout in them, do ninja kicks, whatever! The color is very dark, almost black. They are a little long, which is an issue I have with most pants, so it's more due to my height, not the pants. I usually wear them with ankle boots, so I can leave them a little mushed up at the bottom or roll them up a little and both works. I float between S and M. The reviews mentioned how tight they were, so I went for the M, but I could have totally gotten a S. I washed them in hot water in hopes that they would shrink slightly and they seem fine. I ordered more of these the day after I got them. No more pants shopping for me!

I'm a mediumsized girl who also happens to be quite hippy (as in having large hips, not as in smoking weed in the 70s). So I am all about the highwaisted skinny jean trend right now, because it is the only denim trend that has truly flattered my figure (screw you, lowrise muffintopinducing jeans of yore!!) and these jeans are a great addition to my highwasted skinny collection. First off, they're not really jeans per se, more like leggings in terms of fit (super tight and super stretchy) but they are also really sturdy like regular jeans, so you kind of get the best of both worlds. The sizing seems pretty accurate, I'm typically a size 68 and the mediums fit me fine. Honestly with these, it's better for them to be a little on the small side, since they will definitely stretch as you wear them.The only thing I wish is that they came in different lengths. I'm only 5'2 so they were a bit long on me, but it's fine, I'm used to everything being too long on me. I'll probably end up getting them hemmed eventually, but for now they look cute with the bottoms rolled up.

Bless Boom Boom Jeans for making these wonderous pants.  These are part Spanx, part jeans, and part magic.  I have a gut but live in a hot climate and hate wearing shapewear in the summer months, sweating to death while everyone else is comfortable.  These capris have a high rise, which for me (with a shorter torso) hits right at the waist, magically a half inch over where my longline bra hits.  The shapewear effect and miraculous stretch means no additional items necessary to have a pulledin waist, thinner thighs, and a more shapely butt. No, really  I initially laughed when I took them out of the box because they looked 34 sizes too small. I doubted that I'd be able to get them over one thigh, much less over my bum and onto my waist. As soon as you pick them up, though, you realize they are stretchy like thick yoga pants with a nice thick waistband that won't curl.  My only word of caution is that like yoga pants, you may see pantylines so keep that in mind if that kind of thing bothers you.  These capris are worth the splurge!  I can't wait to haul them out this summer.  The large fit me like a glove.

review_summary: Give me a moment, I'm get
review_text: Give me a moment, I'm getting emotional... okay. I haven't been comfortable leaving my house in shorts for years  YEARS. Despite being a huge fan of the body positivity movement, I'm very selfconscious about my legs and tummy sometimes, and I'm almost always wearing pants of some sort. These shorts literally changed everything. Even though I still wear leggings or tights underneath them usually, I will jump at every opportunity I get to wear these out  I'm wearing them right now! The waist hits right at my natural waist right under my belly button, the leg openings are comfy and not tight at all on my thighs, and even if they're short, they make me look and feel like a pinup. So magical are these shorts that I've actually purchased a few CROP TOPS and plan to wear them this summer. (That is REVOLUTIONARY for me.) I've also begun tucking all my shirts into them because of how cute it looks, and nothing serves as a better base for a great outfit than a good bodysuit and these shorts. WARNING: If you get these, follow the care instructions and do NOT tumbledry them! My dad threw them in the dryer with a bunch of other jeans and the hem dried up all crumply and mangled, and I actually cried because I thought they were ruined. A good soak of the hems in cool water, some careful adjusting, a vigorous press with a large book, and a few hours of laying flat to dry, and they were good as new. Don't make my laundry mistakes  but DEFINITELY buy these shorts.

For heels it is the perfect length. The top does not gape, though cleavage is displayed. But, I don't feel like I am falling out of it or that it is inappropriately scanty. A large will definitely work for an XL body with a bust.

review_summary: I am in LOVE with these j
review_text: I am in LOVE with these jeans! They are the best fitting jeans I have ever owned. I wore them all day today and received nothing but compliments because of how flattering they are. I am a very curvy girl who is pretty bottom heavy and they still fit wonderfully. The length is just slightly long as I am 5'2 but I just rolled them up one time and problem was solved. They come up right to my belly button and provide immense tummy control! I hope these jeans last me for a good while and keep their remarkable shape. I will be devastated if they wear out too soon.

I'm appleshaped with a high natural waist and a superflat buttI normally have nightmares about jeans shopping. NOT ANYMORE! :D I'm usually a size 10 in pants, so guessed on this one and went for the 11. I liked the size a lot and am hopeful that some of the extra wrinkling will shrink to the perfect fit after a run through the dryer. I agree with some of the other reviews that a) the color is not a 'true' black, but rather a very deep indigocolor and b) that the fabric is a little stretchy/thin for those expecting straightup denim. But, I am personally thrilled /because/ of those things, because it hid my extra tummy well and still worked great as a neutral color (I have a few bright blue shirts that look awkward with my mediumcolored blue denim jeans but is perfect with these). Plus, they're light enough that I can wear them in spring weather and not sweat like crazy, which can sometimes be an issue for me in thicker denim. Consider me completely wowed, and coming back for more colors when they're available!

After doing an indepth research study of these pants, I think I finally figured them out.  Someone said in another review that they are basically high waisted jeggings, and they are right.  If you order your size (which I did at first), they will fit you like a glove and hold in any pudge you might have, and make you look totally hot.  However, you might sacrifice a little comfort if you do this, having compacted all your flesh into a sausage casing, and there might be some bunching in places where the material is overstretched or looser than in other places.  I decided to order the 13s to see the difference because on me, a tall girl, the legs on the 11s bunched up a little too much, and they were on the short side in lenght.  When I got the 13s, I found that they were a little bit longer, (covering my ankle bone when standing), and didn't ride up my legs as much, as a result of having a little more room.  Also, they were truly high waisted on me, which wasn't the case on the 11s.  They didn't fit me like a glove in the butt and hips, however, and I can see how I might want to take them in at the waist if they stretch out a little.  Anyway, I decided to keep the 13s for the length and the extra room, sacrificing that legging look from the 11s.  The 13s are more like skinny jeans with a little room.  I could also see how you could order two sizes up in these and they would look like really comfy, stretchy jeans.

review_text: If you are on the fence about buying these jeans, then let me tell you, it's completely worth it. First of all, since my Modcloth measurements list me as size 14, I bought a size 15. The color, like another reviewer said, is not a pure black but a denim black, but they're gorgeously dark and flattering. I've never been a fan of tucking my shirt into my jeans, but with these babies, it's all I've been doing! I have a longer waist and shorter legs, and these pants make my legs look like they go for miles without devouring too much of the length of my waist in the process. Don't be afraid of the high waist  I assure you these look, feel, and fit nothing like mom jeans. I will definitely be buying these in other colors soon!

review_summary: I was unsure about what s
review_text: I was unsure about what size to get so I chatted with a customer service employee, who was very helpful and kind.Many reviews said to size up and I agree. Because the 1X was out of stock I ordered the 2X.The skirt was loose for my natural waist, which I expected, but it fit below my natural waist (around my belly button) with some room to eat comfortably. However, this did not help my figure at all. It caused my lower abdomen to have a more pronounced pouch than I already had (this in the morning before even eating when my stomach is more flat.)Also, as others have mentioned, the ribbon is definitely not white at all. In my eyes it is a pale/light yellow. I was hoping to wear this with something ivory/cream colored but I have nothing that would really work with yellow, as I don't look good in yellow. I suppose I could have made something work with it, but all the things i had originally planned to pair this with would not work and I was a bit disappointed with the yellow color of the ribbon.The quality is good, sturdy and soft. No complaints as far as quality, it wasn't the best I've seen, but for the price it is good enough.Overall I think this is a nice skirt for the right body type and fashion style. It just didn't work for me, but that's okay.I love Modcloth's free shipping and returns so I can return this with no cost to me and I just ordered something different I hope to love!

It does have a lot of stretch in it. I normally wear an XL, but I can get away with wearing this skirt at my natural waist. (which might be why it's too short)

review_summary: I'm happy I went with the
review_text: I'm happy I went with the large.  Well, really, I'm happy I went with it at all!  Being the weirdo I am, I was hesitant about buying something I could ONLY pair with a black top... but then I received it in person and think it goes fabulously with a slate blue tee, a rust orange turtleneck I have, etc.  I even think it'll work with a cream buttonup shirt I own, with navy pinstripes.  COOL BEANS.But yes  happy I went with the L.  My waist hovers from 29 to 30 inches at my natural (high) waist, and there's PLENTY of give, but I have a bit more in the lower tummy department than most, and this skims it all beautifully.  Seriously, it makes me look like even more of an hourglass than I already am, which is lovely.

review_text: I'm in love! This skirt is SO cute. I've been hoping to find a galaxy print that I liked for some time now, and this totally fit the bill. It's a nice length (a couple inches above the knees on me and I'm just shy of 5'7) and is very comfortable due to the elastic waist band. The quality is great for the price and it's true to size. I fall between sizes 810 so it's often a tossup whether a M or L suits me best. I opted for the large with this to be safe, but the waist has enough stretch that I think I can get away with exchanging for a medium. I seriously can't wait to wear this all the time!

This skirt might just be perfect because the elastic allows you to move like an actual person. I love the galaxy print, too! It's neutral enough to wear with almost anything. WINNER!

review_summary: This skirt is a MUST HAVE
review_text: This skirt is a MUST HAVE for anyone who likes a little fit and flare in their wardrobe! Its heavy fabric drapes so beautifully over the hips and swooshes behind you making you feel fabulous with every step!  The button and zipper in the back are excellent quality, and there is not need for a slip under this skirt (as there is with many others).  I am 5'7 and very high wasted.  it lands just at the knee on me which is a great length for the office / traveling where you don't want to wear something that might accidentally show off a little too much leg.  The grey colour is so versatile!  I personally like pairing it with rich blues or creams, but it would go well with just about any colour!Regarding the sizing, although the website says to size up, I did find that I probably could have bought the small (the size I usually order) as I took the skirt in on my sewing machine about an inch and a half after I bought it.  Of course it's always better to have something too big than too small and now if I gain a little weight I can always let it out slightly, but just thought I'd touch on it with my review.Enjoy Shopping!

review_summary: I LOVE this skirt! It's t

According to the measurements listed, I should be on the top end of a size L with my 31 waist, but this skirt would be better suited to someone with a 3436 waist. That is a huge difference and I won't be able to wear it, but I can't exchange it or do anything with it. A complete waste.

review_summary: It's long and fits true to size so don't size up

review_summary: I love this skirt. I trie

I can't wait to get my skirt!

review_summary: Casual skirt, not so casual pockets

The side zip is sturdy, and the waistband comfortable.The pockets are on the small side; creditcard size, not cellphone size. If the pockets were full, this skirt would probably slide off of someone with a fairly straight silhouette. Hips help!

review_summary: I really wanted to like t
review_text: I really wanted to like this piece, but it's going back. The fit was a little tight. It fit best at the very top of my waist, but I'm pretty sure it's supposed to be worn down closer to the hips. Because it only fit when I put it up high, it was a little shorter than I'd like and not as comfortable as I was hoping. Still, I was thinking about keeping it until I looked in the mirror. Somehow it made my stomach look weird, like it was drawing attention to the area.
I really like the stretchy waist band on this skirt. One downside, it seems like the material will wrinkle really easily. But other than that it's very cute!
I was expecting shorter(those models are so tall), but this skirt  is still an amazing fit. It flattens the tummy area, and the material is awesome. It was worth the price! It runs a little big.
This skirt is comfortable and fits really well, but the buttons are not quite in a perfectly straight line and it is hard to get it ironed to look as straight and symmetrical as in the photos.
Love these! I thought they would be a dress pant sort of material but they actually feel like gym shorts! Still look dressy though!
They fit perfectly! I am usually a 0/1 in regular shorts.

I have been an almost completely consistent medium for as long as I have been shopping on Modcloth.  So of course, I ordered a medium in this skirt.  This skirt had a completely inelastic waistband and zipper closure and I could barely get it to fit.  I could zip it, sure, but it was so tight I could barely sit down.  The pattern of the skirt is very cute, but the amount of fabric is misleading.  There is an overwhelming amount of fabric and it's very thick.  It's one layer but it's a thick layer.  However, I don't think it would be very hot because the skirt hardly touches you anywhere except the waistband.  I wouldn't really call it an Aline skirt.  It doesn't start close to you and then fan outward  it hits your waist and then immediately puckers out an inch; it's very boxy.
Really flattering, I get compliments on them. Maybe a tad small but pretty true to size overall.

I bought these because I need more bottoms with pockets, and I'm so glad I did! The flared legs are extremely flattering, and the material is nice and a little stretchy. I wish it had a little  more stretch at the waist, though.

I'm keeping it because I plan to lose weight and it fits if I just like don't eat...but definitely not the comfy, easy fit that I paid for. Still a cute style though!

I really like this skirt! The material is soft and slightly heavy, so it feels and hangs great. I read reviews that mentioned the inelastic waistband, but if you measure your waist and follow the sizing chart, you should be fine. As for length, I'm 5 foot and 1 inch tall, and the lowest part of the skirt hits right above my ankle.

I've been looking for a skirt like this and this is the perfect execution. The fabric is flowy and falls beautifully. It dips a little lower in back without being an extreme highlow. I ordered the XS and it fits my 24.5 waist perfectly. Photos are straight out of the package so it's a little wrinkly.

review_summary: I found this skirt to be

So this skirt...it looks like stretchy jersey material in all the photos. Well as another reviewer said, the waistband is definitely not stretchy! It has a hidden button and it is placed really small. I needed the button placed another inch and half forward. That being said I will just sew a new button on and adjust if I gain or lose any weight. I wish this had been designed with multiple buttons to accommodate different waist sizes.

I absolutely love this skirt. The fabric is a really nice, heavy cotton and it flows beautifully. However, I do agree with the other reviewer who mentioned the surprise button at the waist. I do wish it was a stretch waist, but I will have to size up for the full wrap skirt style to fit flattering and comfortably.

This skirt is very nice. However, nowhere in the description does it say that the waist has a button and is not at all the stretch jersey knit as the rest of the skirt is. I was under the impression that it was an elastic waist along with the wrap tie on the side. Very disappointed with the fit because of this issue. Going to end up returning as the waist is too tight and does not give as I was expecting.

These pants I was so excited for but I should have gone for the smaller size instead of M. They don't sit at the perfect spot above the ankles & as they are stretchy they look a little baggy. Great style  I just got the wrong size.

I bought these and loved them, but the zipper is cheap. I got a size medium and they were actually large fitting and the zipper came off the track, I got a new pair in the mail the other day, wore them (got a size small  fit way better), but the zipper broke again. Now I have to send a photo to support.

The black and white cording down the side is very subtle, but I get compliments on it every time I wear them!The pants are pretty long on me. I'm 5'5, and they just feel too long to be cropped, but too short to be fulllength. They hit just above midankle on me.I haven't bought from modcloth in a while, and I've gained some weight since the last time I did, so I ordered a size larger than I normally would (I ordered a 3X as opposed to a 2X). I feel like I'm swimming in these babies. I can still wear them with a belt, but the legs are very loose, almost like I'm wearing mens' slacks. I feel like I could have ordered even 2 sizes down. Unfortunately, they were final sale, so I can't send them back or exchange them.All that being said, I do think these are great pants. I wear them to work everyday, they're super cute, and the pockets are HUGE!! I'm talkin men's jeans pockets size, you guys. It's incredible. Just make sure to size down.

I bought these because the price was right.  They are slimming but a bit tight in the waist.  I usually wear a size 12, so I got a large.  I have gained some weight in that area, so if I lose a few pounds I'm sure they will be more comfortable.  They are slimming but do attract lint.

review_summary: It?s a little snug, but I

review_summary: I love skorts. You can We
review_text: I love skorts. You can Wear this with almost everything.

Exactly what I expected! Fits true to size and like a glove, pretty short but that's sort of the point right? It has some stretch which is nice, and the denim is pretty heavy duty which feels highquality.

I love mine! It's good quality and comfortable. I bought a medium I'm 5'9 and my waist is about 29. There was a little room in the waist but still fits well. They are about the length of normal jean shorts which I like. I recommend!

Although the quality was very good, I sent it back because it wasn't what I expected for two reasons.  First, as these are shorts, I thought that the denim would be on the thinner side, more like a chambray, but these were thick and sturdy, almost minerquality.  Too hot for summer.  Second, the fit was way off; I ordered an XL based on the ModCloth size chart, but these were too big.  I could also tell that even if they had been the correct size, they wouldn't have fit my particular shape.  I have a small waist and wide hips, and these would fit much better on someone with a straighter figure; they gaped hugely at the waist on me.  These would probably be great for fall with tights, but they weren't what I was looking for right now.

I wore this all day the second it arrived. It's so comfy and fits like a dream. Hugs my curves in the back, and isn't too tight in the waist. The front flap looks kind of like an apron, which I think is cute and unique. It's Very Very short, so the skirt part also makes it more comfortable for sitting. Unlike some other Modcloth brand items, this one is very good qualitythick fabric and nice touches with actual pockets and cute lining fabric.
Holy moly!  These pants fit me like a glove!!! I am a tall 5'9 but my legs aren't super long (long torso) and these are the perfect length to wear with flats.

Reminds me of the material my grandma used to buy to make me clothes as a kid. My grandma could actually make a skirt like that! Elastic waistband; made me look wider than I am, and I'm pretty wide. I might of been able to pull this off as a kid but the material doesn't suit a 30 year old !! (:

Overall, I'm happy with it. I found the colors to be less bright than they appear on my monitor. The blue is a bit darker and the yellow more of a pale gold. I'm pretty short, so it's way too long for me. I wore it at my natural waist and it fell to a few inches below my knee, so I'm going to have to hem it before I can wear it.

The material is so incredibly stiff, made more awkward by the prominence of the front pockets, that a M would never have fit my wide hips. However, the large is also very large in the waist so it tends to fall down a bit and look longer in length and less highwaisted than anticipated. They're cute enough that I'm still keeping them, but they're definitely not the most comfortable or flattering shorts ModCloth has ever sold.

The waist fit really well, and it makes my butt look great, but it pooches out a little in the front for me, rather than staying flat, especially when I'm walking.  The fabric is thinner than I expected. Also, the placement of the buttons are a little weird for me. They still look adorable when I am just standing, and they are pretty comfy, so I'll be keeping them, but I will make some alterations to them to suit my body a little better.

Great shorts, love the color and pattern. The fit was off as it fit great in the hips but there's a gap around the waist area. I have to use a safety pin to fix the gap.

I'm an average size 12, sometimes 10, so I ordered the XL because they seemed to run a little small. They fit nearly perfectly (just a little loose on the top, but a tucked shirt solves that issue)! Not too tight and not too loose from waist to hem, a classic retro fit. I HIGHLY recommend these shorts!

review_summary: It's a nice skirt, and a
review_text: It's a nice skirt, and a good length. The colors and quality is nice, and it is lined. The only problem I had was it was a little to loose in the waist, and just hung loosely on my hips. Luckily I know how to sew, and I just added two darts in the back to bring it in a little. Fits perfectly now!

review_summary: But this skirt! I get not

The pockets are great but they stuck out from my hips and with the way the skirt is long and flares out, I didn't think the pockets helped. They added width to the A line shape of the skirt. The colors are pretty. Be prepared to tuck your top in so you can see the asymmetrical line of the fabric. I could size up to 3x but it could make the skirt too long.
Such a cute skirt, lightweight wonderful for summer, and good quality.

I did get it on and I think I like it.  It's extremely wrinkley especially in the ruffle area but that's fine.  The main concern I wanted to share was that the fit in the butt is a little strange?  It seems to poof out right away from the waistband but it's tight around my actual backside which is p much completely flat.  I mean,  maybe it stretches there? review_summary: I love these pants! I am
review_text: I love these pants! I am 100% a skirts/dresses girl and haven't bought any real pants in years. These were too cute to resist! Fortunately, however, these pants hit right at my waist instead of right under my boobs like I thought when I pulled them out of the box.  I did order these according to the measurements provided.  They were a smidgen too small, but that was probably user error more than the fault of the pants.  In any cases, these pants do a remarkable job of sucking in my stomach.  No lumps here!  One other thing that I think I should mention, the back pockets are oddly placed. They land more on my lower back then they do on my butt and they make it look smaller than it already is. review_summary: There are so many super c
review_text: There are so many super cute outfit photos for this skirt, I just had to have it. It arrived today and unfortunately it did not look nearly as good on me as it did on any of the girls in those photos.  I am not sure if it is because my legs are too long (I am mostly leg) or because my hips are too wide or a combination of both, but it was not flattering.  I did not hate it at first, but my boyfriend (who thinks I am the hottest thing in the world) kinda gave an eh response.  Said it was too poofy for the shortness of it and looked like a costume (and for reference, he never complains about my clothing being too short).  At first I was not sure I agreed, but when I put on some pumps with it, I felt that I looked like a doll... and not in a good way.  The skirt did arrive wrinkled and the pleats had to be fussed with.  Perhaps if I were to fuss some more I could have brought some of the poof down, but I really don't want to spend that much time fussing with my clothes, so I am returning it.  If you are built like me (long legs / wide hips) you may want to be cautious with this one.  If you are built differently, it may look great on you!  For size reference, in dresses I generally wear a 6, sometimes a 4.  For Modcloth, I am either a small or medium depending on the item.  I got a medium in this skirt and it was the right choice, but still a little snug.  Large would have been too large.

review_summary: I love this skirt! And it
review_text: I love this skirt! And it does run small, so be careful when you order! Hence it looks a lot less chic and classy than I hoped. The skirt is offwhite and not as sturdy as it seems in the picture and the stitching could be a little better but overall I'm content. I would recommend sizing up when this becomes available again.However, it just...doesn't have the beauty of the stock photo. I can't tell you how badly I wanted this to work, but I can't help but dislike it.For one, this is not black and white. It's more of a black and cream. It doesn't sound like a big deal, but I look awful in ivories/creams, and I was banking on this being my fave color combo, black and white. Second, I did not realize the entire skirt was going to be made of a stretchy, spandex material. I was expecting more of a crisp material to keep the flared look as is shown. Instead, it automatically forms into a sort of awkward bubble. It doesn't flow or move well.It's not a terrible skirt and it is somewhat cute, but it's not what I was expecting after checking the New Arrivals section for months. Unfortunately, this going to go back.

I bought them in a size 14 because I read they ran small and narrow in the hips , but I probably could have used a size 12 and I am curvy so  they are very true to size. review_text: This skirt is my first purchase from Modcloth  and I couldn't be happier! In the three weeks that it took this beauty to arrive, I had time to fear the worst  awful texture, wrong size and whatnot  but I'm so glad none of my worries came true! The fabric has a nice, slightly rough texture to it, and all the seams look very neat and strong. I was especially surprised to find out how well the skirt fits me! I'm rather tall, so I have troubles finding skirts that are the right length, but the hem on this skirt falls just below my knee  perfect! Another pleasant surprise was the elastic waistband on the back. Since my hips are quite wide but I have a narrowish waist, most skirts tend to be loose around my midsection, but thanks to the waistband I won't be having that problem with this skirt! And the best part? Pockets.

review_summary: I love the fabric and the look, super comfortable.
review_text: I tried both the medium and the large, and I think these would be good for a person with a somewhat straight waist, and average to tall height. I am pretty curvy on the bottom, with a 12inch difference between my waist (29) and hips (41), so I did have to get the L and have them tailored. The medium fit, but was a bit tight through my bum. The large was perfect around my hips, but a bit loose through my waist. Once a couple darts were sewn into the waistband, these were a dream. The fabric is comfy and moves with me well when I'm out romping around. The pockets are perfect. The buttons are attached well. I imagine these may be a little long on someone shorter, but they were perfect for me. I often struggle to find shorts long enough. They look cute rolled up, so that would be an option for a shorter girl.

I'm so glad I bought the L. If you saw me you'd most likely say, large, no way! I'm fine boned and tall but have wider hip bones and also full thighs and seat. Anyway, I've recently graduated to a size US8 dress size, but sometimes find jeans a wee bit squeezy in size 8. The L in this model is near perfect for me  no muffin tops or tightness anywhere, just a nice formfitting feel. The only 'con' with the L for me is quite a bit of gaping at the back waist, which I'll fix with a bit of elastic inserted on the inside of the back waistband. For reference, I'm 29 (ish) waist, 39 hips, and 34 mid abdomen, which is where this waistband sits. The denim has a small amount of stretch and is quite soft.I had hoped these jeans would be high waisted, as they looked to be in the photos, but they are not, they are mid rise. I do think it would be useful if the front rise measurement were provided on all pants (front rise on these is 10, high waist would have to be 11.512). Another wee drawback is a too short zipper  4 zip on a 10 rise looks a bit odd, imo.NB Short girls  yes, these are long, but don't begrudge us tall girls much needed length! You can have your jeans taken up, but we tall girls can't add length to our jeans!

When I tried on this skirt at the ModCloth store in Austin, I immediately thought: Where has this skirt been all my life?! I'd been looking for one just like this and was so happy to have found it! Lightweight, flowy, feminine... Be warned, though: the waist is snug (even taking into account that it ought to sit at your natural waist); you might want to size up.

I am really enjoying this skirt and think it is going to pair well with many of my existing wardrobe staples.  I unlike some others like the feel of the material because it is a nice midweight.  I think it would be nice to wear in the winter with tights, but it isn't so thick that it will be too hot to wear in the summer. I only have two problems.  The first is that the skirt is somewhat thin in the way the material is weaved if that makes sense.  When the light hits it at a certain angle you can see through the fabric.  I don't think the skirt would ever be called sheer, but it makes me a tad self conscious nonetheless.  My only other complaint is that the belt comes with every of the skirts.  I would love to buy a couple more colors of the skirts, but I'm not quite sure what I am going to do with all the extra belts!

As many reviewers have said, this is a great and versatile skirt. It is a tad long, but I think that is to be expected and the Polyester feel of the material is actually pretty light and comfortable so I imagine this will be good for both cooler and summer months. Looks great with other ModCloth tops. It has an elastic waistband, which is not all bad and the belt is extremely long for some reason, but still cute.

This skirt is kind of nice, but there are definitely some a couple of down points that make me hesitate to keep it. The material itself feels pretty darn cheapit's a rough polyester weave, and it shows wrinkles very, very  easily. The details section says to handwash, and I have a sneaking suspicion that if I end up keeping this I will wash it most gingerly indeed, because it does not feel like it will wash well. It might even be worth drycleaning if you're into that kind of thing? The rough weave also makes me worry a little about how well it will wear, since it will show snags or pulls really obviously. The pockets are nice but a bit on the shallower side, so make sure not to put anything too heavy in there!I wear between a US size 8 or 10 in pants, size 6 in dresses, and the size medium juuust fits with enough room to breathe a little. I think a large might have been too big to sit at my natural waist without cinching, though. It's a little dicey getting over the widest part of my hips, but the elastic *will* stretch as long as you leave the belt off or very, very loose; the skirt just slips on, and I found it a bit easier if I gripped more towards the back, where the elastic is (especially if you have any amount of booty).  I wonder a bit if a zipper might not have been a bit easier for putting on and off, but the elastic isn't obnoxious, and it does give it a bit of a more casual feel, which is nice. I am 5'9, and the skirt hits me about where it does on the model (just below the knee) when sitting at my natural waist, so fellow longerlegged people might enjoy that bonusthat's what saves this from three stars! You can see through the fabric a little bit, but only in certain lighting conditions and not enough to see the pattern on your underwear. Because of the aforementioned thinness, I would say that this skirt would be best in spring or summer, but I think it'll be fine with thick tights or high socks. The belt is very cheap (still reasonably cute!), but it is removableit feels like it's made of the usual vegan leather substitute one sees often, and looks just as plasticky as it really is.The sale price seems about appropriate. Regular price seems a little bit high for what you're getting, honestly.

HAVING SAID THAT...am I the only one who finds the waistband slightly binding? Part of it I think was I was trying to wear it at my true waist rather than allowing it to sit on my ribcage, which is apparently where these leggings like to be. I just wanted the option TO wear them like pants, like I saw some gals do in the pics here, and I think it would look lumpy and unflattering, because it definitely feels that way. ALSO, while initially they're quite snug, in a couple of hours they're kind of loose. I have stupid skinny legs from like, midthigh down, so this might not be a problem for everyone, but trust, it's nagl. I was going to size up to a M/L for the waistband, and get another pair bc I wear them so much, but bc of the loose legs...... it seems like I'll just continue to cope with these really fairly innocuous things. They're worth the money, both sale and regular price.

I had hoped because the fabric was thicker it would keep the waistband from digging in and causing the dreaded muffin top, but alas, it still happens because NO leggings should be made without a two inch wide waistband, EVER. If you wear them how they are in the photo, right above the belly button, and you have ANY extra weight around your tummy, these will cause unflattering bulges. I also need to pull these up to midribcage to have the crotch not hang down too low (or cause any gross bulging of my fat). I am going to keep these, because I'm in the midst of losing weight and hope that these will fit better soon, but girls, if you are normally a M/L in leggings SIZE UP. For real.

It will compliment your curves.

This skirt is the perfect length, and the shade is just the same copper rust as in the picture. I love that it's light and flowy. Just a note that you might want to be careful when standing near subway vents to avoid a Marilyn moment. Also, the skirt material catches easily. Being a complete klutz, I've already gotten to or three catches, but nothing that can't be smoothed out.

The material is heavier than I had anticipated. I thought it would be more of a summery skirt but I think it could easily be a fall or spring skirt. The colour was also darker than pictured. I did not size down since I am between sizes and it was just a tad big but nothing dramatic. It ironed out very easily and the material seems very durable. I bought the Festive for Lunch Top, which is pictured with it in this pic and really like the combination. The elastic band in the back makes it very comfortable. For anyone that has some love handles: unfortunately I am still in the process of losing weight and not where I want to be, and this skirt does enhance the look of any bit of love handle you might have. If you have quite a bit, this skirt is probably not for you. You may want to go with something more structured.

review_summary: Oh my goodness. This is b
review_text: Oh my goodness. This is by far my favorite Modcloth purchase. I don't normally go for longer skirts, but this is super flattering. It hits about two inches below my knees and the way it hangs is slimming and sleek. I need to iron it, though. It's a bit wrinkled from shipping and steam isn't taking the wrinkles out (my normal method of straightening garments).The color is pretty vibrant and is definitely orange. The material is slightly coarse but feels nice on my legs, rather than scratchy. It has a good weight to it, as well. I can wear it in both cooler and warmer weather and the material seems to adjust accordingly, which is awesome!One note: The belt is pretty terrible quality. It's everything I hate about fake leather. It both looks and feels plastic. It also smells pretty bad and holds its original shape too awkwardly to be wearable. I'll be giving it to my local thrift store to see if someone else can make use of it. Instead I'm pairing the skirt with my other belts. I'm not that upset though. I didn't get it for the belt!Do size down. I'm normally a M in skirts (sometimes a L, depending on brand), but the S fits perfectly. It can be worn at my natural waist with a belt to hold it in slightly or it sits comfortably at the top of my hips. For someone smaller than my measurements, I could see the S still being too large.
LOVE THIS SKIRT!!! I have a great time picking out different outfits for this skirt. It is so much fun to wear!

review_summary: Oh golly gosh, I need to

It looks great though, and I'm all for highwaisted skirts/pants. It looks great with white and brown and cream colored tops/cardigans, and many other colors I'm sure. The fabric (polyester) is pretty light weight and isn't the most luxurious thing ever, but it doesn't feel or look cheap either.

The length of the skirt is great, just at the bottom of my knees. The material is swishy and I love the pockets! I definitely think I'll be getting a lot of use out of them. However, there are definitely some drawbacks that I wanted to share.I originally ordered an 11. When they arrived, the fit was the very snug, skinny jeans with a retro flair sort that I wanted. The length was perfect. However, the buttons on the fly had gaps/bulges even when I was standing up, so I exchanged for a 13. The 13 fits more like a traditional slim fit than a skinny jean. They're quite a bit longer, so I'll probably be cuffing them most of the time. The thing that bothers me the most, though, is that I still get a sizable button gap between the second and third button. I feel like this is a flaw in the design rather than a sizing issue  The fabric is on the thinner side because it's stretchy, and I think the bottom three buttons would be better off as false buttons over a zipper fly. The buttons also are a bit more on the cheap side  I have $20 jeans with heftier buttons. I also agree with the comments about the waistband needing to be stiffer  It does roll anytime I sit. Also, I would have preferred that the denim on the pockets extend a bit further in, as I have to check my pockets to see if they're untucked anytime I stand up.Overall, good jeans, but for $60, I would have expected better quality.

Others have said that they run small so order a size up, but I decided to order my size (3) because I wanted them to be tight. I would suggest if you want that formfitted look you order your size. I love the dark color of the jeans and the buttons. I am now thinking about ordering this in other colors/lengths. review_summary: It pains me to write this
review_text: It pains me to write this, as these jeans are absolutely perfect when first tried on, but after having bought several pairs I've come to some unfortunate conclusions. These are not the same Karaoke Songstress jeans that were originally found on ModCloth. While they're still made by Judy Blue, the fabric content has changed. They've become stretchier which is good  for minimal wear, but they have no durability whatsoever. Of the three pairs I've either purchased or received as gifts, none has resisted stretching. Within a month or two of regular wear, the fabric begins to stretch out around my crotch and upper thighs, leaving a very unflattering pouch of fabric. This has occurred whether I've hand washed, washed on delicate in the machine and hung to dry, or allowed it to dry in the dryer to try and shrink them back into shape. The bottom line is that if you only wear jeans occasionally, or are curvy enough that this sort of stretch is necessary, go for it. They are the perfect rise, they're comfy, and they're very flattering. Just don't expect them to last. And for girls who wear jeans often, save yourself the heartbreak and cash and invest in a higher quality pair with a lower spandex content. You'll thank me, I promise.

review_summary: I was very excited when I
review_text: I was very excited when I first saw these jeans.  I loved everything about them!  They had the high rise and the buttonup style that I have wanted for years. When they came in the mail, I was really excited to finally wear them, and when I put them on they fit like a dream!  Except for the fact that the top button on the jeans was completely missing.  So I contact modcloth, got them to exchange it (the exchange policy on this website is really nice), and waited for the new ones to come in.  When they finally arrived, I was so excited to finally get the jeans of my dreams, and they fit perfectly.  I wore them out one day and was so happy with how they fit. But when I went home I noticed that one of the small metal buttonattachment things by the pocket had come of *before I'd even put them on* I noticed the 2 pieces to it sitting by the container it had come in.  Part of me wanted to exchange it again, but I figured out a way to glue it back on so it stays on through the wash, and I don't think I'll exchange them again. So I guess I just wanted to leave this review to let anybody else who wants these jeans that they are very cute, but that they are also pretty low quality considering the price.
