So I could go size 11, but the 13 is so comfortable, without any saggy awkward parts, so it is really the better size for me. Also I have a narrow waist relative to my hips and butt, and these  pants aren't baggy on my waist to accommodate my butt. That's hard to find in most high waisted pants.

These jeans are pretty long even though I'm 5'9, but they look cute cuffed. The pros: These jeans are adorable and fit pretty well. I've washed them again and the smell is still there, so who knows how many washes it's going to take to get the odor out. So weird. review_summary: In my opinion, the only t
review_text: In my opinion, the only thing that makes these jeans truly special is that they are made in the US. They fit me just fine, but they're the thinner stretchy denim I usually avoid because it wears out more quickly. I saw that some reviewers were quite upset about that, but they're not so thin they're leggings, just the same as any other stretch jeans.I was worried the waist would be tight on me, but if anything it's a little loose. These would be worth the price to me if the people who made them were paid well for their time. I asked the experts via the mod chat and they knew nothing more than that they are made in USA, which is a good start. I contacted the manufacturer to learn more, but they have not responded to me and it's been nearly a week.The high waist doesn't magically change my shape like I sort of expected it to based on the other reviews, but it's comfortable. I wear a sturdy leather belt with all jeans, but it looks a little bulky up at my waist. For now I'm going beltless or trying them out with a skinnier belt I would normally wear with a dress. I will hem these soon, but that's actually easier to do on this thinner material than thick denim jeans.

I am not short, but I felt I needed about another 6 inches for these to work well. Too bad, i liked the unique retro design.

review_summary: I was so excited for thes
review_text: I was so excited for these to come in! Unfortunately I wasn't quite as excited when I put them on. It was suggested to size up. I normally wear a 10 or 12 in jeans so I went with the 13. They fit well in the legs which is nice because I'm 5'9 and jeans tend to be short on me.    They were a somewhat looser fit than most skinny jeans. But they are so stretchy and the waist was just way too big! Also maybe it's just because I have a bit of a booty, but the waist  was shorter in the back than in the front and it was a little uncomfortable. That wasn't too bad.   But the thing that I can't forgive is this; where the seam meets in between the top two and bottom two front buttons, the fabric pulls apart and buckles. This is not flattering at all and draws attention where I least want it.  It seems like there should be another button here, as the most support is needed in that exact spot. It doesn't quite make sense that it buckles either, because the waist is so loose on me. I have to imagine that if I sized down to the 11 the jeans would hold me how I want them to, but I also believe that if the fabric bunches when they are loose, it would bunch up even more when they fit more snugly.    Hence, I have to send them back. I wanted them to fit so badly, but there must be function before form for me.

And do size up, I typicality wear a 12 or 14 in pants. I will never again have to worry about my belt line showing though a shirt. I am really looking forward to getting some cute tops to wear with these pants. If you are thinking of getting these, do it!

review_summary: These were just as I want
review_text: These were just as I wanted, I wish a little less stretch, just to hold your thigh in better shape but I can't complain they are cute and comfortable, they sit right where I wanted them.  I love them and want more colors!! I got a size 7 and I wear a size 4 at Gap.  So I would size up but not any more than that,  I could have gone down a size maybe if I didn't dry them.  :)

These jeans are awesome! I did expect them to be a little higher wasted than they are, but I still love them.  Also, I have a little extra junk in the trunk, so imagine that attributes a bit to wear they hit on my body.  Do size up. I usually wear a 12, and the 15 fit just right. I love these!!!

Jeans were definitely on my don'tbuyitonline list.. until I purchased this baby!! I could have sized down for a skinnier fit, but the one I ordered just fits me perfectly and feels wonderfully comfortable (plus enough space to tuck in tops with thicker material too). I have to fold it twice because I'm short, but it gives a cute cropped look. Looks good with any shoes  boots, oxfords, high heels.. you name it! I wear it almost everyday these days :)
These are my new favorite jeans! They fit perfectly! I decided to order a size up after reading the reviews and I'm glad I did. They fit just right in all the right places. I feel so sexy in these!

review_summary: These pants are my new be
review_text: These pants are my new best friend. I took the advice of the reviews and sized up from a 6 to a 9. They are long cause I am only 5'2, but I don't mind rolling them up and I can always get them hemmed.  Now I just want to buy a backup pair!

I absolutely love these jeans.  I'm definitely someone on the hippier side, and these jeans are fantastic.  Just to note, the second to top button did tend to pull slightly, but these are definitely up there in my favorite jean pile.
These jeans are very flattering and comfortable, but as mentioned by another reviewer, I also had an issue with the top button falling off as I unpacked the jeans, before I even put them on.

review_summary: I was a little nervous ab
review_text: I was a little nervous about ordering jeans offline since I feel my proportions are so weird sometimes and it's hard to get a PERFECT fit. I am 5'9, my waist is a 34 and my hips are a 41. A size 13 in these jeans fit AMAZING! I am so thrilled. I can't wait to rock them with my new wedge booties! The material, although a bit stretchy, is very durable. They don't feel like cheap jeggings. I would definitely size up as recommended. I feel if I went with my normal jean size, it wouldn't have worked out so well.

I've never ordered jeans online, but the reviews on these jeans convinced me. I did expect to have to send them back. I did size up (I'm usually an 8/9, but I went with an 11 in these) and I was shocked (and awed) when I tried these on and they fit perfectly. Not only that, but the style is very flattering on my pearshape. FINALLY, a pair of skinny jeans that don't make me feel like a plumber. I absolutely love these jeans.

I'm normally a size 4 in jeans and I sized up to the 7 as instructed. The fit is a tad loose on me but not enough for me to want to exchange for a smaller size. I'm a pear shape and I have thicker thighs so I don't think a size 5 would fit. The fabric is a bit thin but overall I am happy with my purchase.

review_summary: I so badly wanted to love
review_text: I so badly wanted to love these, but the pockets were too far apart on my butt, making it look extra wide...I should mention I have a pretty large behind to begin with. The size up was just too baggy. If it weren't for the pockets I would have kept them, they are great quality
Very cute jeans. Love the high waist and buttons.

review_summary: I love these! I'm very gl
review_text: I love these! I'm very glad I bought them, but I sized up like suggested and wish I didn't. Pants always vary by brand so I'm never sure what size to choose. I bought these in a 7, and while they are still wearable, I wish I would have gotten them in a 5. The rise for me comes just under my bellybutton, they feel higher than they look. I get plenty of compliments when I wear these, and plan on buying more!

I originally got these jeans in a 9, sizing up as suggested, but they were too big (as indicated by extra fabric gathering in the crotch area just below the buttons  thanks, What Not To Wear!). I exchanged them for a 7, which fit well in the crotch but had a little gapping between the 2nd and 3rd buttons (thanks, tummy!). I doubt I'll be wearing them with a shirt tucked in so that's OK  no one will notice. The one thing that did bother me, though, is that they were really pretty itchy  another reviewer mentioned a rash on the inside of her legs, so probably a similar problem. I've tossed them in the wash (inside out, with some vinegar, as you should always do for super bright or saturated denim) so hopefully that'll do the trick. Fingers crossed!

These jeans are excellent! The length and fit are perfect. Only thing is that if you're ordering from Canada, beware of customs! These ended up being seventyfive dollar jeans, and as much as I like them... That's a lot of money, especially when unexpected.

I normally wear a size 2/3 in jeans but I sized up to a 5 based on reviews.  They fit nicely but there was some extra fabric around the bum and knees.  They were also fairly loose in the waist.  These jeans are very stretchy.  I like the look and they seem to be good quality so I think I'm just going to exchange them for my normal size.  They need to be snug for this look to work.

review_summary: When I first saw these je
review_text: When I first saw these jeans, I thought they were too good to be true. On a whim, I ordered them, thinking they wouldn't fit in any way and I'd have to return them. Boy, was I pleasantly surprised! Jeans are always long for me so I know I have to cuff them, but I didn't have to do much cuffing. The high waist is so roomy and comfortable and conceals my worst area. The material feels soft yet thicker than I imagined. So very happy with my purchase. 3

I received these jeans as a Christmas gift, and they are awesome!  The copper buttons are probably (surprisingly) my favorite part; I didn't think they'd be so bright, but they are like shiny new pennies, and they look completely awesome against the dark wash of these jeans.  These pants do run small, I am usually a 3 but got a 5 and they fit perfectly.  I was prepared for them to be long since I am very short and everything is long on me, but they look super cute with the bottoms rolled up, so I'm happy.  The only thing that was an issue was that, similar to another reviewer, I didn't wash them before wearing and got a small skin reaction after wearing them all day.  It disappeared quickly, but if you have sensitive skin like I do I definitely recommend washing before wearing.  Overall though, awesome jeans!

review_summary: I was afraid to buy pants
review_text: I was afraid to buy pants online, but these were a perfect fit. Pants are always too short on me, but these are long enough. Flattering through the bum and belly areas, looks awesome with a shirt tucked in. Most of my jeans are 27/34, the 7 fits perfectly.

review_summary: I'm going to start by say
review_text: I'm going to start by saying that I haven't bought a pair of jeans in about three years. I haven't found a pair of jeans that I liked in over five years. I saw these while browsing, and I had to have them. I'm glad I took the risk, because I'm absolutely in love with these jeans. They are so flattering. While most jeans emphasize my problem areas, these tucked them in and made those areas look FLATTERING. I'm so over the moon with these jeans. You will not be disappointed.

This is my first purchase at ModCloth. I wore these to school today with a peter pan collar top and black mary jane heels, I got ton of compliments. They are a bit long on me and scrunchy at the bottom, but that usually happens with skinny jeans on me. the bottons are shiny, plus they were made in the USA. I will definitely be buying from ModCloth sometime in the near future

These fit pretty great! I definitely agree with sizing up. I'm usually a 9 but the 13 fits perfectly. Definitely a GREAT summer/spring time pair of jeans. My only complaint would be that they're a little thin for the winter but otherwise they're a pretty fun pair of jeans.

review_summary: I love these pants in the
review_text: I love these pants in theory and will keep them, but I think these pants are probably much more flattering on someone taller.  The pants fit great around the butt but there was extra fabric in the waist area for me.  That said, my butt is larger than the rest of me, so it might have just been my body.  Overall, I love the style and stretchy material!  I uploaded pictures before going to the tailors fyi.

I've been eyeing these jeans for a while, and was so excited when they showed up under the tree on Christmas (thanks Mom!). My mom followed the instructions and sized up (I'm normally a size 5). Besides being a tiny bit long (most pants are, I'm kind of short :) ), these pants fit amazingly well, are very flattering, and look cute with long or short shirts.

I normally wear a 10 (but lately its seeming more like a 12 would fit nicely) so when I read some of the reviews saying it runs small I thought a 13 would do it. They fit, but I probably could have sized down. Also, when I washed them for the first time, a grommet fell out. Thankfully it was a decorative one near my hip on the front pockets, but it's still dissappointing.

I bought these jeans because I have been looking for a pair of jeggingfit jeans for months.  I wanted something that I could tuck into boots.  After reading the reviews that the jeans ran small, I bought a size 5 (normally would probably have bought a 3).  The waist/hips fit perfectly and did not sit too low, but the length was about 6 inches too long (though with my height, I had expected that), and they were very baggy in the thighs and not snug enough around the lower leg.  As a result, they looked more like a pair of slightlytoobig boot cut pair of jeans, and looked odd tucked into boots.  I returned them, and didn't bother exchanging for a smaller size because the waist probably would have been borderline too small, and they were so baggy on me that I don't think one size down would have made a difference.  I will say, though, that the stretchy fabric and the color were exactly what I had expected, and I think the pants are overall good quality.  It's too bad that the fit is just so disproportionate.

review_summary: On a Lark I bought these
review_text: On a Lark I bought these jeans. I tend to be rounder in my hip area so I usually do not like buying pants online. But I was impressed to find that these pants worked out just perfectly. While I am on the short side, the pants did fit a bit long on me, but I just it expect it, I just roll them under at the leg and they keep the skinny jean look. Also I have to say that I love the highwaist on this too! That was another risk I choose to take with these pants, and again I am not disappointed. These jeans fit perfectly all over, they give me a slimming look and the skinny leg has enough stretch where it doesn't suffocate my leg(calf). I played soccer for years so that can be an issue sometimes. A Note on color though; it is a beautiful dark blue wash. Just be careful what you sit on and those white  undies  you might want to wear underneath,  you might find them unexpected blue, until the jeans have a good washing.  Overall, love them!
These jeans fit better than many other pairs of skinnies that I've tried on.  They are dark, have stretch and the high waist looks awesome.

Amazing does not even begin to describe these jeans! Judy Blue nailed the design and the fit. First off, they fit like a glove; like a second skin but not so tight as to look strange or be uncomfortable. The high waist smooths everything out nicely (I just had a baby 5 months ago so no more low rise for awhile), but in no way looks like mom jeans. My husband complements me every time I put these on. HIGHLY recommend!

review_summary: Great cut. Length is a li
review_text: Great cut. Length is a little long, but rolling up the hem still looks good.

review_summary: I never thought that I wo
review_text: I never thought that I would order jeans online. As a small, but still a little curvy woman, jean shopping tends to make me cry. But I LOVE these jeans. I gave them a try because I thought a higher rise might be a solution to my jean problems (although I was concerned about the fit of the waist). I am so glad I ordered these. This is the first pair of jeans I have EVER worn that don't end up showing off my underwear in the back. They are also incredibly flattering to my figure. I am glad I ordered the 1 instead of sizing up in order to get a smaller fit in the waist, but if your hip/waist ratio is less extreme, I'd say the instruction to size up is a good one. They don't feel small, but because it is a button closure it does gap a little where the jeans are stretching on my hips. This doesn't bother me since they fit in the waist properly, but I can see it being a concern for others. They are also a little long as many reviewers have noted, but the ankle is skinny enough to wear a little bit bunched and they are also cute cuffed. These are amazing jeans and I am once again thrilled with my ModCloth purchase.
So flattering! I'm glad I sized up. I'm usually a 8 or 10 in jeans so instead of the 9, I went with the 11. Perfect fit! Just a little long so I may have to cuff them. Great purchase!

I just received these and I love them!  The style is more funkier than your average pair of jeans, and the fit is really flattering (but definitely size up if you're between sizes  I'm usually between a 4 and a 6, and the size 7 is snug on me).  Could be sexy or casual.  Better quality than I was expecting for the price, too.  I'm excited to wear these out!

Love these! I've been looking for high waisted jeans for a while and it has been hard because I am both hippy and short...after reading reviews I took a chance with these and opted for a size 3 although I was worried they'd be tight. There is more stretch in these than I would have thought so they are actually a bit large and I am hoping they shrink a tad. The length is long on me, as always, but not so bad that I have a huge excess of fabric. Quality is great, although I've only worn once and have not washed yet. Buttons lay nicely even while sitting.

review_summary: Over all I'm happy with t
review_text: Over all I'm happy with the purchase, not over the moon though. They're aren't as high waisted as I was hoping they'd be, so my search still continues. The fit is nice, there's no doubt about that. I usually wear a 12, so I decided to play it safe and get a 15, glad I did. One of the cosmetic rivets fell off but that's something I can fix at work.Also I thought they'd be actual jeans too, but because of the thin and stretchy fabric it feels more like glorified Jeggings, Which was a tad disappointing since I've never spent this much on jeans before. I'm keeping these, but I will no longer be wanting to purchase the lighter color. Good product for being American Made.

review_summary: It was a little long so I
review_text: It was a little long so I'll have to get it hemmed. Other then that it fit perfect.

Curvy girls, don't be scared! I had been eyeing these for months, but wasn't too sure if the high waisted skinny jeans were right for me. I am so glad that I was wrong. perfect, comfy sit on the waist, amazing color, everything was just right. Buy yourself a pair, and shake what the good lord gave you. seriously.

I really like these jeans. I love the look and the quality is great for the price. I really wish I would not have sized up. My Normal size would have fit perfect. I wear a 29 in designer jeans which would convert to an 8 or in this brand a 9. I ordered an 11 after reading so many reviews where people who wear as low as a 4 had to buy a 9.  I would return, but there are only three left and none in my size. Right now I am praying that they shrink. The only thing I can think is that other reviewers are used to vanity sizing which is fairly typical in lower cost jeans. If you tend to buy higher end brands and are used to that type of sizing, go with your usual size.

I don't usually buy jeans online, but these were too cute to pass up. I'm so glad I decided to go for it, I'm in love. I tend to hover between a 4 and a 6 in US sizes, and the 7s fit perfectly. The wash is beautiful. There's a little bit of stretch, so they're still comfortable when you sit. If you're thinking about them, buy them.

I am *so* happy I ordered these pants. I love them to death. I sized up (as suggested) and they were a bit loose, but they shrank to the perfect size in the wash. They look great on, and actually have usable front pockets, unlike most girl's jeans. :] Love them to death.
These jeans fit me absolutely perfectly, and I have zero complaints.

Love these jeans! I don't buy jeans often because I have a big behind and a smaller waist, so they tend to fit me weird, but these provide stretch and are very flattering! Only reason I give it four stars is because I took the size up advice. I'm usually a size 68 in jeans, so I ordered a size 11, but I do have thin legs and a smaller bottom half, so theyre a little bit loose. Not too bad, though. They'll probably shrink in the wash a bit, and then they'll be perfect. Love them!
These jeans are awesome.  They look like the picture shown on modcloth, nice!

This was my first purchase for myself from Modcloth and I was happily surprised! I don't usually fill out reviews, but this is an exception. As a person, who finds it so difficult to find a pair of jeans and dreads shopping for pants in general, I found these to be a perfect fit. My shape is somewhat pearish so high waisted really works for me. I usually wear a size 67 in pants and am not a big fan of uber tight jeans or low rise so I sized up to a 9 and the size fits exactly how I like. The length was a little long but not too much.  Also, the pants are a wellmade garment and made in the USA something I definitely appreciate. I have yet to wear these jeans out for its first full day, but I think things will bode well. This is my first pair of high waisted jeans and I will probably invest in more...after I save some money ;)

review_summary: It's been a long time sin
review_text: It's been a long time since I've gotten such an immediate yes item! These jeans are gorgeous. The high waist, as mentioned often, is very flattering, and the buttons look great. I didn't size up, and I've never gotten such a perfect fit. My figure is a pretty exaggerated hourglass, and these jeans are absolutely incredible.
Super cute and flattering but just a bit itchy

I am a size 12 or 14 so I took the advice and sized up a bit to the 15.  It was a good call because these jeans would not fit right in the smaller size.

I followed the advice of other reviewers and ordered up a size and they fit perfectly. I'm typically between size 78 in pants so the 9 was a good choice. I've gotten lots of compliments on these and wish they came in more colors!

I'm always nervous about buying jeans online but these ended up being perfect. Stretchy and not tight in a leggings kind of way. Love how it's high waisted to disguise my tummy. The length is kind of long in that it bunches up and makes it a bit difficult to zip up boots. But these are cute with ballet flats or wedges.

I ordered these specifically for the high waist, and I was a little hesitant at first... but they are amazing.  They're very flattering.  I normally take a size 8, so I sized up to the 11 just to be safe, and they fit perfectly.  I also have long legs and have a hard time finding long length jeans, and these are great.  If you're hesitating, don't. These jeans are well worth the $50 price tag!! :)

These are great, nice dark wash and shiny buttons. The high waist is very flattering, even if you don't wear a shirt tucked in it creates a sleek line down the back. I'll keep the 9, but I'm sure the 7 would have been a good fit for my proportions. The only other comment I have is that I rarely wash new clothes before wearing them, even though I know dark jeans like these can bleed a little dye at first, but after wearing these for a full day I had a slight skin reaction along the inner seams on my legs. Nothing serious, but it's never happened before, so I'd suggest washing them before wearing them. I'm hoping it resolves the issue for me.

The quality is great. They're super cute, and I love the 4 button, high waist. They will be a little long on me still even with sizing down one, but I don't mind a cuff at the bottom. All in all, a great pair of pants that are great quality, it just took some getting use to the look of them. And while I was afraid I would look heavy because of my larger hips, that wasn't the case at all!

I'm short, only 5 feet, so the length of course is long but they look cute cuffed. Overall they're comfortable and cute. They look cute with hilo tops and sweaters and peplums!

review_summary: I wish I could wear these

Thank you ModCloth for my new favorite pair of jeans!

review_text: So, so cozy. And cute! The damask print is a really nice touch, makes them look much nicer than plain black leggings (which I live in).

review_summary: I love these so much, but
review_text: I love these so much, but I feel like they're wearing down way too quickly with each wash. I'm 5'1 and I have to roll the ends under about 3 inches but this isn't any different than every other pair of leggings or skinny jeans I've bought. However despite these small drawbacks I LOVE these and they're my favorite leggings in my closet now. I'm seriously considering another pair.

review_summary: I dithered for so long ab
review_text: I dithered for so long about getting this jumpsuit b/c it was so different from anything I'd ever tried, but I really wanted to try it so when the right sale came around I knew I had to get it. Honestly it was the best decision I ever made. This jumpsuit is AWESOME and so flattering on my curvy body and it's my new favorite item of clothing. The fabric has a good weight and falls in a nice way, and the pleating on the bust is very flattering (it is a wee bit lowcut, so someone who is very amplebusted may find it necessary to put a pin or a stitch in for their personal comfort). I found it to run true to size (I'm normally an XL) and it's very comfortable but I'm 5'4 and I found it very long and needed to be hemmed. Honestly if you are on the fence about this jumpsuit I cannot urge you strongly enough to buy it b/c it may be my favorite purchase I've ever made.
I love this jumpsuit but unfortunately because I am 5'3 it was much too long for me

review_text: It's my second and I love them.  I have to get the legs hemmed at 5'5 they are long.

review_summary: I really wanted to love t
review_text: I really wanted to love this, but it was not meant to be. I usually wear a ModCloth XXL or 1X, and even the 3X in this jumpsuit was too snug for comfort in the bust and midsection. Also, the proportions didn't work for my short torso at all. The very wide and extra long trousers made me look super short. The darting around the bust also made my chest look nonexistent, and minimized any semblance of a waist, so there was no balance for the enormous trousers. Disappointed, and quite envious of those who rock this jumpsuit in the Style Gallery!

This jumpsuit is gorgeous and flattering. I love the 40s details, and it is a highquality product. However, I found the fit quite small. I am normally a 16/18, but I had to return the 2x for a 3x, which I *barely* fit into. I hoped I wouldn't have to wear Spanx/shapewear under this, but alas, it is cut close to the oft on top, so if you are an appleshape or heavy through the waist, size up!
Love this skirt! The pockets are wonderful. It fits really well and I love the color. My only complaint is the wrinkles.

This is an absolutely lovely skirt. It's sturdy, but not too heavy with a nice partial elastic in the back. It zips up the side and it has pockets! It's fullylined, but it does wrinkle easily so you will find yourself ironing it every time you go to wear it. The green color is a bit lighter than shown in the photo. This skirt looks best when worn at the waist, so if you're not comfortable wearing skirts at your natural waist, then I wouldn't recommend it for you.

review_summary: Love the skirt but does r
review_text: Love the skirt but does run slightly large. You can definitely get away with sizing down since the waistband is elastic. I got a medium and it fits fine but I definitely would have preferred a small. I'm a kindergarten teacher so the length is great, especially when I have to sit on the rug with my kiddos!
The perfect flowy skirt! The green color is just divine.

This skirt is so perfect for working, whether in hot or cool weather. The color is gorgeous (I got the emerald), and the material of both the shell and the lining felt really nice. I did find some loose threads, though, and it was incredibly wrinkled when I opened it. Nothing a pair of scissors and a lowtemperature iron couldn't fix.

Pros:Lining is silky, there are pockets, the shape is really beautiful, jewel toned greenCons:Will need to do some minor ironing between usesWhen sizing: I'd take into account the elastic in the back of this skirt... I didn't and I got a large and it makes it a smidge bigger than I'd like. But I'm scared if I get a medium I'll pooch out the front! Overall, this is a lovely skirt and I've gotten compliments on it already.

I have this in mint and the emerald green now, and wish I had it in every color. Good quality material, fully lined, and even pockets! The bit of elastic in the back or the skirt's fullness may not be for everyone, but for me it's comfortable and elegant.

It is longer than I expected, hitting midcalf on me, but I actually really like how this length looks and feels. I plan on buying this in other colors!

This review is for the black pants. I haven't tried the navy blue, so I can't speak to those.I absolutely love these pants. They wear more like jeggings, but they look just like a fitted professional pant! The elastic at the waist is a perfect touch to make sitting in an office all day less uncomfortable than usual! An added bonus to the elastic at the waist is that the top of the pants is sleek and doesn't pucker or bunch under tops & tunics. No fasteners = no lumps & bumps!My one complaint is that the quality is lessthanstellar at the stitches. I've only had these pants for a couple weeks, worn them maybe 3 times, and the stitching at the top of one of the back pockets is already coming out! If the manufacturer could bump up the quality in those areas, I'd definitely get myself another pair :)But if you're looking for a comfy work or city pant with lots of nice stretch & elasticity that doesn't have bumpy zippers, buttons, and belt loops, these are definitely the pants for you! (just make sure you're wearing noshow undies, as you'll definitely get some serious VPL's from the thin fabric otherwise)

The other reviewers are right that these shorts are too thin to be worn on their own, but they work perfectly as undershorts to avoid the dreaded chub rub when wearing skirts and dresses in the summer. These shorts actually stay in place and don't ride up OR down while walking (and living in NYC, I do a LOT of walking!), yet they're thin enough that they don't feel like an extra layer of clothing underneath, like compression shorts can sometimes feel like on a hot, humid day.  I also found you don't need a slip with these to avoid static cling, unlike with compression shorts. If you're going to use them as undershorts, I suggest sizing down so they have a more fitted fit, and because they provide a LOT of stretch. (I'm usually a 2X in Mod Cloth pants/shorts.) I can't wait to buy more, as these are the only noncompression undershorts that actually stay in place on me all day!

The hood is oversized, but I kinda like that, I have curly hair so when I put the hood on it doesn't crush my curls :) The jacket has a zipper, snap buttons and toggles. The snap buttons are to hide the zipper and keep the flap (that hides the zipper) straight so the toggles can be done up properly, however, you don't need to do everything up. The shoulders are a little big, and I kinda have wide shoulders. The seam of the shoulders sits a bit lower down my arms, so it makes it a bit hard to move my arms, but not enough to return it. If I pull the shoulders up to where they're suppose to sit, it makes the sleeves a little short. I may try to fix it but not sure, it fits good enough that I can wear it as is. Overall I am very happy with this coat,  it's comfortable, beautiful and figure flattering. It's a nice coat to wear with jeans, but it can also be dressed up a bit and look stunning!

The XL was sold out, so I tried the 1X but that was just wishful thinking. I reluctantly sent them both back and the XL was never restocked. This year I snatched up the XL as soon as it was listed, certain that this would finally be the perfect fit, but... it's like a tent on me. Bigger than last year's 1X. I can work the Paddington Bear look if I must, but I was hoping for something slightly more fitted. It's clear that the measurements vary from year to year on this piece  as evidenced by the photos of 5'4 ladies where the coat just hits the hips. I'm 5'10 and have a long torso, but the XL I was sent this year comes right past my butt. I'm holding on to it while I order the L and will just keep whichever of the two looks the best. I agree with everyone that the sleeves are short, but I love the crafty solution proposed by reviewer Antonia: sewing in legwarmers! I might even knit some cuffs in a luxurious wool. review_text: So I didn't think it ran small at all. I usually order small sizes and had to size up to a medium, which was fine.  The coat is super cute and comfortable and goes with a lot of outfits, but my only gripe is the quality.  Two of the snaps fell off already, and I've only had it a couple of weeks. One of them I was able to superglue back on, and the other one is lost.  luckily the coat also has zipper and the large buttons, making the snaps optional, but it still isn't a sign of great quality!

review_summary: I LOVE this coat!It is mu
review_text: I LOVE this coat!It is much warmer than anticipated. It offers all of the style of a fashion jacket and the warmth of a winter coat. It is very well made. No loose stitches.  The material is not cheap looking. The color is a deep orange but looks red at night. The sleeves are nice and long and the length is perfect. It just covers my butt without looking like a skirted pea coat. The fur trim  is very thick and soft. Definitely worth the money!

review_summary: I am so in love with this
review_text: I am so in love with this coat! The color is more interesting than a basic black or brown, but it's not so bright that I am uncomfortable (I like a pretty basic color palette). I'd call it a cross between a brick red and burnt orange. The length is perfect on me and I am rather short (5'35'4). It hits me right under where a jeans pocket would end, if that makes sense. A tad bit below where it's shown on the model. I got the 1x, my normal ModCloth size, and it is perfect. I have enough room for layering and it still gives me a very flattering shape. My one complaint is that it is a bit of a hassle to get in and out of with the zipper, then buttons, and then the toggles.  That being said, it's not enough of a problem for me to care that much. I will say that I am very impressed with the zipper. It is plastic. I love plastic zippers because they stick less than metal zippers. Overall I am very pleased with my purchase :)

As a pear shaped person, finding coats that fit well can always be a challenge; they look silly if they are cropped, giving me the appearance of a pear all askew, but if they hit right at my hips, they typically will either be tight on bottom and just right on top, or loose on top and just right on bottom. Thus, the best fitting coat is one that is longer and fits at the waist, while being loose in the hips and legs. I took a gamble with this coat, and was a little disappointed when I first tried it on. While it was perfect around my hips, it was loose and baggy in my chest and shoulders. The hood was overly generous and swamped my head. I thought I would be sending it back. Then I thought to try it on with a sweater, and realized that it helped tons! While the quality of the fabric is just okay for the price, the construction seems well done (no problems with snaps here), and the rusty orange color is absolutely gorgeous. I might take it in to have the sleeves shortened a tad and the chest taken in some, but for now I think it's a keeper! (Sorry about the photo quality, my apartment lighting is phenomenally awful. I thought to include it to help similarly sized ladies!)

review_summary: I LOVE this coat. I order
review_text: I LOVE this coat. I ordered it one or two sizes too large, but I can't stand to be seperated from it for several weeks while I order a new one, so I'm going to keep it. Plus this way I can layer many jumpers underneath and still be comfortable. It's in a gorgeous autumn colour, is made of good material and is just perfect!

review_summary: The lining is a little th
review_text: The lining is a little thin, and it isn't the warmest coat I've ever had, but it is very cute and flattering. The color is beautiful  not pumpkin orange, but dark autumn leaf orange. Usually I have problems with hoods being too small (I have a long neck) ...but here I had the opposite problem! The hood is huge and kinda floppy, so if you don't have a mass of thick, curly hair, or a hat on underneath, the fur flops right over your eyes. The fit is tighter in the shoulders, bust and across the back, looser in the hips (as you can see on the model). Which I like, because it forces me to have good posture. The fasteners and the zipper are both very high quality, none of the stitching has come undone, and overall it seems this coat will last a long time in good condition. Perfect pockets to put your hands in as well.

review_summary: I love this coat! I read
review_text: I love this coat! I read a bunch of reviews for a few different coats on Modcloth, and actually chose this coat because everybody else said the sleeves were short! I am short, with short arms and short legs so it is usually a chore to find nonpetite coats with short enough arms. Color is rich and beautiful; certainly bold enough to brighten up a cold winter day. Coat is thin, but I didn't live in the tundra. So far it is working out great for the east coast winter! Large size fits me great with room for a light sweater.

I was really surprised at the iffy quality of the coat given that there are so many fabulous reviews. The quality of nearly everything else I've bought off ModCloth has been quite good! This coat wasn't terribly poor, but it wasn't as I would have expected for the price. One of the snaps pulled right out of the fabric the first time I unsnapped it to try the coat on. The color of the jacket wasn't quite as pictured; I was expecting something the color of a cooked sweet potato (the description did say burnt orange) but it was closer to a Crayola redorange crayon. A vibrant and unusual color, but not quite what I was looking for or expected. It was also far too complicated to zip, snap, and do the toggles on the coat, particularly when this would be a coat that I would be putting on and taking off all day long. If you're only putting it on and taking it off a couple of times a day, this might not be so much of an issue. I might still have kept it except for the fact that the upper back was too tight and I don't have particularly broad shoulders. If my arms weren't to move much, it would be fine, but I was afraid I would rip a seam if I moved my arms forward too far. It was definitely the right size, though, because there was plenty of room in the midsection and bust, plus the arms were the right length. It's unfortuate that this didn't work out, but I did have to send it back.

review_summary: I love this coat!  I got
review_text: I love this coat!  I got it as soon as it came back in stock and I'm so glad I did and I have gotten lots of compliments on it so far.

I don't think its possible for me to love this coat anymore than I already do. It's such an amazing color and it fits like a dream! It's totally comfortable and warm, and I have trouble talking myself out of wearing on days that are too warm for coats.

review_summary: I was advised to order a
review_text: I was advised to order a size down and it was just way to small in the sleeves! It was too snug but the length and color are true to picture, so I will be reordering a medium!

review_summary: I got a large because it
review_text: I got a large because it said to size down, and it was too small to wear a sweater under  :( I It was too narrow in the shoulders, fit perfectly in the waist, and was too small in the hips (story of my life). The coat is beautiful, though, so I am exchanging it for an XL. It is rather thin, like other reviewers have noted, so I think layering will be important.

Literally my favorite ModCloth purchase, and I've purchased a lot! This coat is so perfect, its the perfect weight for a California winter, the fabric is soft and wonderful, the hood is a little big but aren't they always? I love that its removable as well. Just a really great really cute coat, and the sizing is absolutely perfect  flatteringly trim cut, but not too tight to wear something warm underneath. 100% worth the price, if you are debating whether or not to buy this coat, I definitely suggest you go for it!

review_summary: I wanted this coat to fit
review_text: I wanted this coat to fit so, so, so badly. I'm somewhere between a medium and a large depending on how things fit and whether there's stretch to the fabric, due to being built on roughly the same lines as a tank. So when ordering, I decided to go with a large. When it came, I was thrilled, and then very quickly disappointed, because even on a large the arms were tiny, and wouldn't even over fit over a light sweater. The real dealbreaker, though, was the shoulders, which were insanely tight. Since I need to be able to move around and be active while outside for my job, it was out of the question.I consulted with a modstylist and she confirmed that an XL would probably fit me fine.  So I ordered it, and the sleeves and shoulder were perfect, but I was swimming in the torso.  Much to my dismay, it will have to go back.Also, both coats I received had small quality issues. The first had a split seam in the armpit, and the second had a snap missing.

I really love the jacket. The fit accentuates in all the right places. I read that some areas run large, but that wasn't the case for me. It actually is a little snug around the chest and  bicep area. The one thing I would change about the coat is the material of the faux fur; it's not as soft as I would have liked. Other than that, everything thing else is great. I like the zipper, buttons, and toggles (the extra closures keep things really warm).

review_summary: I was so excited to order
review_text: I was so excited to order this coat, I was looking for a new fall coat to wear that flattered yet was a little different and this coat fit the bill! The color is gorgeous (on my computer screen, the color of the coat is true) and the cut is pretty much perfect. My only complaint is that I feel like the sleeves are a little too short and tight.  I ordered a Large (which is my normal modcloth size and it said it ran a little big) and debated exchanging it for an XL.  I like to be able to layer underneath...so after trying it on with a HUGE sweater underneath, decided the XL would most likely be too large and the arm movement was workable. (I feel it's tight but not so tight you can't move). The pockets are also not very deep but I serve their purpose.It's not the warmest coat (but that says that in the description) but it's perfect for fall or mild winter weather. Overall, I'm incredibly happy with this purchase!

This is my first purchase from Modcloth! I was really nervous about the sizing, because I'm plussize and rather busty. I had a ModStylist help me with sizing, and ended up going with the 2x. I'm really glad I did, as I would have been swimming in the 3x. Even with the 2x, I have plenty of room for layering so I can wear this coat all winter long. I think my favorite thing about this coat, besides the color and detachable hood, is the fact that it has a full hidden zipper. Keeps you toasty, but doesn't detract from the style :) I hope this helps other larger/bustier ladies! It's a great coat and looks beautiful on any body type.

Couldn't decide between 4 different coats on here, and I'll be honest. I chose this one mostly for its price. But now that I have it I'm SO happy I did. The colour is amazing! It's exactly as shown (on my screen its a burnt orange) and I love it. The detailing is fantastic  even though you have to zip, button and buckle. The pockets are a bit small but so cute. I love that the hood comes off, and is zippered on because button on hoods always get drafty. The hood does make the collar a little funny looking but it's not a deal breaker. The length is perfect for jeans or a dress. The sleeve length could be about 1/2 longer but who's complaining? The thread broke once I put my hands in the one pocket but it's nothing a needle and thread can't fix. Wore this coat out for a long walk and a bike ride and was very warm, and today is pretty cold, so I can expect it to be warm enough for a winter in rural Ontario, Canada. We live right by a lake so I've got pretty thick skin. Got this in a 1X and it was perfect for me, although I'm sure if I got a 2X it would have been good too, for layering. Bought these with a pair of boots and paid $58 COD on top of a $31 shipping fee, but as a Canadian it was to be expected. I had a coupon anyway so it wasn't so bad. I would have still paid $160 for this coat anyways because it's perfect in every way.

review_summary: I loved this coat when I
review_text: I loved this coat when I first saw it and I couldn't be happier. I hate how most plus sized coats look like their all duffel bags, but not this one! I ordered my true size 3x and found it fit wonderfully. It's tight enough to give me a figure, but enough room to layer up with sweaters. I have 2 minor qualms: the chest area is a touch big for a smaller chested lady like myself. Also because I'm rather short too, the jacket is a touch long in the length and sleeves. But the latter issue is kinda normal for me. As a Canadian lady, this replaces my fall coat, but I don't think it'll be warm enough for deep winter. I'd recommend this highly to other plus sized ladies who are on the fence!

review_summary: Received this coat as a p
review_text: Received this coat as a present and it's perfect. Cozy and warm. The people who are surprised by the color may want to calibrate their computers, because the coat is clearly orange, which is what caught my attention in the first place. Lovely fall/winter coat!

review_summary: I love, love, love this c
review_text: I love, love, love this coat  however, I ordered a L based on the fit details saying that the SXL sizes ran large. I normally wear XL tops, so I sized down to a L and it was too small. I'm busty and have broad shoulders, so perhaps that's the culprit. Am exchanging for an XL and cannot WAIT to get the correct size back. This coat rocks.

review_summary: I have found my perfect c

It fits my chest area without squishing it but it's tailored so that it doesn't look boxy at all in the waist and hips!  I would highly recommend this coat for curvy ladies.  It's also a really nice weight that is perfect for fall and i think with a sweater underneath it will get me through out NE winter.  The hood is also huge and cozy which is awesome.  I'm so happy this is back in stock!!!!!!!!

review_summary: This is by far the best c
review_text: This is by far the best coat I've owned. It's more of a pumpkin color, but I still love it. It's not super heavy, but I live in the south so that's not an issue for me. The fit is perfect.

Gorgeous coat. Colour is closer to orange than red as others have pointed out. As a UK 1416 the L size was perfect and it's v flattering to hourglass/slight pear shapes. Will definitely be wearing a lot!

This coat is awesome! It's not a very heavy coat, so if you live in the far north or something, you're going to want to layer it or save it for spring or fall. The color is a really pretty orange (don't let orange scare you, I promise it's nice, and it's flattering)  it is NOT red. The details (the toggles, the cute pockets, the buttons on the sleeves, the little darts on the shoulders, etc.) really make this coat fun and girly, and I love the removable hood. Bottom line? Love it. Had to have it. Glad I got it. I wear it all the time (which, in Colorado Front Range winters, except for the very coldest days, works for the weather). Buy it. You won't regret it.

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this coat and knew I had to get it. I was a little unsure how it would fit since I have wide shoulders and usually have problems with outerwear. (I've never bought a jacket without trying it on until now) It fits perfectly though. The user comments are true that it's really more of an orange than a red, however it's still an awesome jacket.Some reviews say the jacket is a bit thin, but the city I'm in is notorious for having 40 winters, and so far I've been able to wear the jacket without getting cold, and just layer with a hoodie. I've received tons of compliments on this jacket, and am so happy I bought it.

review_summary: LOVE this coat! It is def
review_text: LOVE this coat! It is definitely a deep ruddy orange, but thanks to the reviews I knew that going in to the purchase. :) I bought the large to have a little room to layer and it's perfect. The faux fur needs a little care as mine got a bit matted in the plastic bag, but other than that, totally happy.

review_summary: Every one is was like siz

They were out of smalls and I decided I couldn't settle for another coat so I went ahead with the Medium and am happy to say that it is not only the perfect length but I can comfortably fit a sweater inside. (Which is good since the coat itself isn't very warm) The arms are just right, it's very comfortable and flattering. I just love it! I'm glad I went with the Medium. I'm sure a small would have fit but then I wouldn't be able to wear a sweater inside and the arms would have been too short!

review_summary: I love the coat  it's my
review_text: I love the coat  it's my new fall/winter coat. There are some problems with it, however. One, it sheds orange threads and puffs of fabric. Two, it's a little tight. I'm almost always a small, but this was just a tad too tight, but the medium would be too large. Three, the hood messes with the collar causing one side to pop up at times and the hood also doesn't have any tie so a slight breeze will blow it back off your head. Those are annoying quirks about this coat, but I still love it.
This coat fits perfectly. Every time I put it on I get a compliment on it. It gives you a very nice shape and I love the hood on it.

review_summary: The only thing I'm not ha
review_text: The only thing I'm not happy about is the color. It wasn't as bright as I had seen in the photos. It comes out to look more like a dark red/orange color.

This is a beautiful coat that is more of a brick orange than red.  I initially ordered a small because of the recommendation to size down, but it was super tight.  The medium is perfect.  I've had it for two weeks and get complimented everyday.

The color for the images on this coat are way off, but if you read the description of it  and some of the reviews  you'll have a better idea of the color. I'd say  it's a burnt orange and it's beautiful  way cuter in than the red is. Absolutely gorgeous! I love it. I ordered a small, which I was nervous about because the width of my shoulders is about 15 (when you look at the sizing chart it says small is at 14), but I shouldn't have been. It fits perfectly. So definitely go with the website's advice and size down!   Some of the other reviewers had problems with quality, but I haven't had any issues so far. It's a beautiful coat and, if you think the images on the site are cute, wait until it arrives!! That is unless you really wanted a red coat. ^___^V

review_summary: I love the quality and co
review_text: I love the quality and color of this coat!! The Rust Orange looks really cute! However, I am 5 '11 and it fit perfectly in the body but the arm length was much too short. I'm exchanging it for an XL to see if it will be a better fit, but I don't know if it will be too big in the body then. Oh well :)  Hopefully this review will help some of you other taller gals out there!

review_summary: I love, love, love this c
review_text: I love, love, love this coat. Be warned: it's orange, not  red. But it's a nice festive sort of autumn orange and it doesn't clash with anything. It's very flattering on curvier women and it has a zipper, which I didn't notice before I took it out of the box. Only trouble is, I've had it for a week and already the left pocket is torn! It's worth it to me to go through the trouble of getting it fixed, but it was sort of a bummer that it started falling apart so early. Still, though, the rip could very well have been my own fault and I wouldn't let that deter you from getting the coat. I recommend it!

This coat is gorgeous. Until you actually wear it.The pluses  it's VERY heavy, awesome for Wisconsin winters. And it looks BEAUTIFUL on.Unfortunately, that's where the good things end.The minuses  This coat snags on EVERYTHING. The amount of pulls I got in this coat from simply wearing it to and from work is ridiculous. And it pills like crazy. To the point where I will be buying a new coat this winter.The buttons all fall off. I've had to resew the buttons on the sleeve, on the belt, and the ones that button up the front. And again  I only really wore it to work in back. I'm sorry but this coat is just not well made. Especially not for the price. Very disappointing.

I'm a size 18, 38 DDD, 5'7. I carry weight on my midsection (my waist is 47 when I'm resting/slouching/not sucking in :P). I was worried that the 1x would be too snug, other reviews seem to lean towards it being true to size or small. Well, it's not. It's at least 6 inches too large in the stomach, the shoulder seams hang down an inch and a half from where they should be. The sleeves are very loose and baggy. The back/shoulder blade area puffs out a lot. It's just way too big. Probably more like a size 22?  Other than the fit, it's cute. The color is nice, it's a good weight. It did arrive with 3 very large picks in it, though. 2 on the hood, and one near the buttons. The lining isn't great quality, it's crunchy, not smooth and satiny.I'm torn between keeping and returning. :(

review_summary: So warm, so comfy and the
review_text: So warm, so comfy and the hood is huge and cosy. This jacket has taken me overseas three times now and looks as good as new. it's even surprisingly waterproof!

I am totally in love with this coat! I stalked the sure for months until a small became available in green. The oversized buttons are adorable and the oversized hood is to die for and the color and flair at the waist are exquisite! I get compliments everywhere I go in this coat. I am 5'6 135 lbs 32D chest and 27 inch waist and the small fits me perfectly, however I wish I had sized up to a medium so I could wear thicker sweaters under it without my shoulders feeling so tight. However, it's plenty warm enough with a light sweater underneath as it's heavier and warmer than it looks in the pictures.

review_summary: I love this coat. One of
review_text: I love this coat. One of my favorite purchases from ModCloth to date. The only issue is that the threads can get caught easily which causes a pull. It is easily overlooked because this of the beautiful hood on this coat. Worth its weight in gold.

Not having ordered from ModCloth before, I ordered a size larger than I normally wear and I shouldn't have. I ended up sending it back to get my normal size which fits beautifully! A fantastic style coat by Steve Madden. A moderately heavy fabric with a nice lining inside the coat. The side pockets are really more front pockets where they are placed, but will work great to keep your hands warm. As others have mentioned, the hood is kind of ridiculously large, but is part of the fun of the coat. Love it!
very cute worth every penny

review_summary: This coat is as cute as I

review_summary: This coat is so warm!!! I

What a fantastic coat. It's heavy, but not too heavy. The color is to die for. The only notes I'd give to potential buyers: (1) the pockets are way up front. It took me a minute to find them. Gorgeous color. Great quality. Warm. It's a bit longer than I thought coming at sort of an awkward length for my height (also the hem is longer in the back). Still like it though. I wish I'd gone for L, but I guess this way I can layer more underneath if I have to.

review_summary: 1x is too big. I should h

I've been eyeing these coats for over a year, and finally could justify needing such a heavy winter coat! I love it! The hood is amazing, definitely makes me feel like I'm in a fantasy setting. Super cute. The brand is Steve Madden in case that helps anyone for fit. There were a few hanging strings that needed to be cut off right off the bat. The hood is large and fairytalelike as the other reviews stated but I like that so it's a plus for me :)

This coat is beautifully colored and extremely flattering. I highly recommend it for a nice work or dress coat for the winter, or even as a top layer over a wedding dress, which is what I initially ordered it for. I would only advise against taking it with you on long trips unless you're planning on wearing it every day, as it does not pack down to a particularly compact size. Otherwise it's perfect!
This is a great colorful coat. The material pulls easily and the buttons come loose easily  be careful and reinforce  totally worth it!

I absolutely adore this coat. It is gorgeous. I get tons of compliments and it is remarkably unique. I live in Brooklyn, and this coat is perfect for late fall ~4050 degree weather. This coat is beautiful! I love the fabric, the color, THE HOOD! I typically wear a size 16 or an XL, depending on a number of factors. I decided to size up to a 1X, since a number of the XLs I've ordered from Modcloth have been just the tiniest bit too small (wearable, but snug), and some of the reviews suggested sizing up. I swim in the 1X size, but it's too late to exchange it, as I need it for a trip to Oregon next week (I live in Arizona, and haven't needed a coat for a long time). The waist tie is high, but I have a very high waist, so it doesn't bother me. Ladies with longer torsos ma find this odd though.Overall, I feel like this coat is going to keep me warm and happy and feeling pretty even with the sizing issue.

The coat is beautiful, heavy, and awesome. However, the buttons fall off almost immediately. For the price of the coat, the buttons should not come off. I've had my previous coat for 8 years and never had to replace a coat.

This is awesome!!!! The material is thick and warm, good for down to about 2 degrees Celsius. The fit is a little big, according to the size chart I'm a large but ordered a medium based on reviews and it fits perfectly with room for a thick jumper underneath. I don't think they detract from the coat too much, but I might see if I can find some smaller wooden ones for my tastes. All in all great purchase. :)

review_text: This coat is very comfy and warm. The first day I got it the button on the arm broke but it's not a huge deal.

I was so nervous ordering this as I'm in the UK but it was so worth the wait.FYI I did have to pay import tax so anyone buying in the UK be warned.I was also nervous as I am smaller than the smallest size, but the fit is great. It is perfectly structured through the shoulders and because of the tie waist, it can be made to fit any frame. There is enough room to wear a good jumper underneath as well.Oh the hood, what a treat, I feel like a wood elf mixed with a fairy princess. If you were looking for a modern hobbit coat, this is it.It comes to just above the knee and flares out in a wonderful way, Pockets are hidden deep in the front, and are substantial enough for a phone. It is a great piece, with red piping in the lining and a little dash of colour fabric lining at the neck, I feel like I'm wear a coat worth hundreds from Savile Row.

The buttons did fall off in my hands before I even got the coat on but I reinforced them and I'll reinforce them every day if I have to because I love this coat so dang much.

The fabric is heavy weight, the lining is silky. This really is a beautiful coat! the only think I have a tiny bit of an issue with are the buttons, they feel a bit cheap. They're easy to replace with something I like better though.

review_summary: LOVE this coat! I love th
review_text: LOVE this coat! I love the bright green, and the hood is fantastic! I struggled trying to decide between a medium, and a large. ( I have broad shoulders, and I also wanted to be able to fit in it if I'm wearing a sweater.  I decided to start with the medium, and go from there.) I'm really happy with the medium! It fits perfectly!! Plenty of room for my broad shoulders! I can drive my car without feeling restricted by the coat sleeves!!  I haven't tried wearing my thick sweaters under it yet, but even if they don't I'm still happy! Some others reviewers mentioned there being no pockets, but that's not true. It DOES have pockets! They're beautifully designed right into the front pleats. They're nice deep pockets too, so you can put your gloves in there and they won't fall out easily the way they do in some of my previous winter coats. (Which is obviously a good thing! ) The buttons may need to be sewn on a little better, but no biggie. So happy with this coat! ( I only wish it came in red. I'd totally buy this coat again in red if it was an option.)

review_summary: I LOVE this coat!  The fi
review_text: I LOVE this coat!  The first day I wore it a coworker ran up to me and called me The Green Arrow.The hood is big and beautiful, the silhouette is feminine, fun, and allows plenty of room for swing skirts.  While the coat is listed as warmest, I'd wager that any temperature below 40? F might require a fleece in addition to the coat, so make sure you have plenty of room for layers.  I chose to go up from a small to a medium and I can fit about three sweaters without it looking too too bulky, so I'd suggest sizing up in colder climates.Look out for some pebbling in the fabric it can get kind of bad.Otherwise, it's a great coat that is cute, flattering, and great for cool seasons.

review_summary: I bought this for a recen
review_text: I bought this for a recent trip to NYC since the fall can be quite cold on the East Coast. It arrived when I was already half way through my trip, but it turns out I didn't really need it because the weather was beautiful! I am normally a small but after reading some of the reviews that stated it ran large I decided on a medium. Also I wanted room to layer but I definitely could have fit a few layers under this coat because it was WAY too big. Nonetheless I was really impressed with the quality and heft of this coat; the only thing I don't like is the buttons are loose but that's an easy fix. The color is beautifully rich and the hood is fabulous! Sadly, I had to send it back and the size small is sold out. I will definitely order this again if my size comes back in stock.

I ordered the 1X, which was just a little too large, so I returned it for the XL, and boy that made a huge difference! I LOVE this jacket, I have received so many compliments. It is really warm, a little tight around the chest, but so worth it! I will be repositioning the buttons to make the chestal area a little more relaxed.

review_summary: I've had this coat for th
review_text: I've had this coat for the last two winters. In that time, many people have complimented it, so that's definitely nice. It hits a few inches above the knees in the front and is a bit longer in the back. The sleeves are roomy without being too big.  I have been quite happy with the fit overall, though I will say that the coat is a bit heavy when you carry it around once inside someplace warm. It was perfect for winters in the South  warm enough to need only a thin sweater and tshirt under it. I've since moved to Pittsburgh where it is less ideal as a winter coat. When the temp drops down below freezing, it is not quite warm enough for my comfort even with thermals, a shirt, and a sweater under it.

review_summary: I love the way this coat
review_text: I love the way this coat looks and feels. It is thick, so perfect for cold weather. I usually wear a 1X but this coat leaves plenty of room for layers. I could size down and still have it fit comfortably. My main gripe is that it had all of these loose strings that I had to cut off. I bet I'll end up sewing holes near the seams in the future. Moreover, it snags really easily, so I'll have to be extra careful when wearing jewelry (especially my engagement ring).

This coat is BEAUTIFUL! It's oversized hood is magical, like a fairytale. The forest green ups the fairytale character of the coat, as well. It seems like it will be very warm in the winter; it's surprisingly heavy. Unfortunately, this coat, as is, does not button across my chest. I have a broader chest and shoulders, not to mention I'm wellendowed (UGH!), so this probably won't be a problem with smallerchested ladies (lucky!). I would exchange the coat, but since the next size up is sold out, I will just move the buttons in a bit, there's plenty of room to do so. I just love the coat too much to give up on it completely. *swoon*

review_summary: I hesitated for a few wee
review_text: I hesitated for a few weeks before buying this coat, but I'm so glad I finally caved! It's the most flattering coat I've ever owned, and allows enough room for some extra layers underneath (it is a little too big, but once the belt is tightened its perfect). The color is gorgeous, and I love the longer length. Wearing it makes me feel like I belong in a fairytale. The buttons do feel a little loose, but appear to be sewn on well enough (an easy fix anyways). The fabric does snag pretty easily, but with tweezers you can push the threads back into place.

I'm fairly certain this coat is magical. I actually layered a giant oversized Irish Fisherman's sweater underneath and it didn't make me look bulky at all. The shoulder seams were actually perfect for once, not hanging off my shoulders because I have pretty narrow shoulders for being such a plussize girl. The hood pulled up made me feel like a part of Lord of the Rings. The hood hanging down gave it a nice shawlcollar effect that made it look very elegant. Usually I'm a size 2 in shirts from Torrid, and a 34 in pants, 44C for reference. This is very warm, and gorgeous. I wasn't expecting the tweed outer shell to be quite so heavy, which was wonderful, and the green lining is smooth and silky. I guess my only complaint is that i'll have to have a seamstress take up the arms, but I'm only 52, so that's not a huge deal since I'm short. I'd also have loved to see this with natural fasteners, like wooden toggles or metalcolored buttons instead of very shiny black plastic buttons just to keep with this woodland spirit thing. All in all, I think I'm going to buy the white colored one in a size down, too, for when I layer a little less. Absolutely worth the money, absolutely gorgeous.

This coat is cute, cute, cute. It's a nice heavy wool blend, nice and soft to the touch. The color is a lovely Kelly Green. The fit is good. I will have to move the belt loops down an inch or so, but that is normal for myself with my long torso. And I will have to replace the buttons, just because of personal preference and I do not like them much. Overall fit is great, I generally wear a medium because I have broad shoulders and it fits perfect. The hem line is flattering. Oh, and there is pockets they are closer to the front of the coat, I found them right away. This is going to be one of my regular coats, I'm happy I purchased it!

This coat is gorgeous! The colour is so much better in person, it's got such depth to it and the coat itself is so heavy and warm it's just perfect for winter. I wish I'd ordered it months ago so I could get more wear out of it this year. The coat is a little on the big side, I suppose it's perfect for a big jumper underneath but I generally overheat especially walking into university so I would only naturally pair this with a thin jumper or t shirt. I would exchange for the  size down if it weren't for the ?67 customs ($100 ish) I had to pay for it and my two other purchases to be delivered. Overall this is my dream coat. And the hood is just the perfect addition. I feel like a fairytale princess every time I wear this. It is so well made and the fabric is so soft. Love love love it. But If you're ordering from outside of the US just make sure you look into how much customs and VAT you will have to pay because it can really mount up. I'm going to have to be a bit more cautious and picky with my future modcloth purchases ( which is painful seeing as I want yo buy everything!) .

This coat is PERFECTION.  Comfortable, proper sleeve length (which can be tricky in plus size), very warm, awesome hood.  Cannot wait for it to be cold enough to wear!  The only odd part, as others had mentioned, is the pocket placement, but I'm sure after a couple of wearings it won't feel awkward.

So, I'll stick with my XL in green, looking well rugged up in our cold winters, and when i look at buying this in salt and pepper (because this design is soooo pretty!), I'll probably get the L.
