review_summary: Maybe this review is a bi
review_text: Maybe this review is a bit premature, since I haven't actually worn the coat yet, but I just got it and I am so excited! It is SO cute and comfortable. Feels heavy and I suspect quite warm. The buttons are adorable, as is the hood and the overall color, which I suspect will look good with nearly any other color I wear. I didn't realize when I purchased the coat, but it is a bit longer in the back than in the front. Maybe it is just because I have such a flat rear. Regardless of the reason I think that the extra length in the back actually looks very elegant and quite lovely with how the fabric drapes and flows. After reading other reviews and seeing the fabric of the coat in person, I am concerned about the material snagging but it seems like really good quality otherwise so I will just be careful with it.

This coat is gorgeous! I have been looking for a fairytaleesque hooded coat for a very long time and this was a dream come true! The color is stunning; a much darker, emerald green than pictured. The highlow cut of the hem is very flattering, as is the tie waist. The hood falls perfectly and is my favorite part of the coat. I was concerned that the large would be tight on my bust and shoulders but it fits perfectly. The arms are a tad short but the only real complaint I have is the same as most other reviewers and that is the quality of the buttons and the way that they were sewn on. As soon as I pulled the coat out of the box I could feel how loose they were. I reinforced them just to be on the safe side. The quality of the actual buttons seems very poor to me. They feel like very cheap plastic and that they might crack at any second. If you plan on buying this I would also plan on having to replace the buttons in the future. Other than that this coat is just wonderful and I highly recommend it!
It's slightly shorter on me than I would like  but I am 6'2 and expected that. It's a beautifully made coat. I love it!

I'm so happy I purchased this coat. It's a stunning green color and the hood is phenomenal! I was even teased that the hood is reminiscent of the witches from Hocus Pocus...which is totally awesome in my books! ;) Can't recommend this coat enough.

review_summary: I love this coat so much!
review_text: I love this coat so much!  The color is gorgeous and the hood makes my heart sing.  As other reviewers have mentioned the front buttons weren't off center or angled on my coat.  Maybe that's just a design feature on the smaller sizes.  I was afraid that the 3X might be too snug across the bust  a problem I often run into  but it's actually loose.  There's plenty of room to layer over thick sweaters.  I debated trading it for a 2X but it's out of stock now and it's not so loose that it looks bad.  One minor quibble, the pockets are very oddly placed  they are almost in the center front of the coat and very low.  I have to kind of slump over to use them  thank goodness for gloves!  As for quality  the fabric and buttons are beautiful and I haven't had a problem with losing buttons or snagging fabric.  However, there were LOTS of loose threads hanging out at the seams and hems that I had to trim before wearing.  This isn't a super expensive coat but at this price point I really don't think you should have to give it a haircut before wearing it.

This coat is gorgeous in person, just like in the photos. The oversided, domed buttons are a really nice touch, and luckily it comes with an extra because if you lose one, I doubt you could find a replacement at a fabric store. The weight is extremely heavy, and I don't mean the warmth. It was pretty shocking when I picked it up out of the bag. The fit is really good. I was worried the XL wouldn't close over my chest (36DD) but that wasn't an issue at all wearing a tshirt. Might be snug if you're wearing a thick shirt with a sweater over it. The waist isn't very fitted but the belt helps a lot, and this will be a benefit if you wear a lot of layers underneath. The hood is beautifully oversized, but I had trouble getting it to lay flat behind my shoulders like in the photo. The only real issue I had with this coat is the pocket placement  it's right in the front and your hands will cross over your crotch which isn't very flattering or demure. Overall a great coat. Definitely keeping it.

review_summary: Cute but I can't get pass
review_text: Cute but I can't get passed the coat not having pockets! Returning

I have gotten MANY compliments on this jacket. Winters are cold here in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. It does snag if it gets hooked on something but that's due to the weave of the fabric and me not paying attention. It's got a great 1950's 1960's look in the fabric. Love the coat!!

The coat is heavier than I expected,  which was a nice surprise. The hood is awesome, but in order to get it to fall right you have to have the top burton buttoned. Very cute shape, looks especially cute with dresses, feels high quality and nice on. However, I agree with other reviewers that the buttons are weak and the coat pulls easily I had it on for an hour before there was a pull in the arm.  The sleeves are a bit shorter than I'd prefer also, but that's something I commonly have a problem with so I wasn't surprised. Overall, I'm pretty happy with it! Just wish the sleeves were longer.

I have mixed feelings about this coat! I have a really really hard time finding coats that fit around my large hips without looking like an ugly sack. This one fits beautifully. It looks fantastic, the color is gorgeous, and I love the length. The hood is also great and makes me feel like a forest witch. The buttons are oldfashioned looking, and I like them for now, but could see myself wanting to replace them in the future. The main problem is that it isn't very warm at all. It has just started getting chilly here (mid 30slow 40s) and even when I'm wearing this over another jacket or sweater, I'm still cold. I knew this wasn't supposed to be the warmest coat according to Modcloth's rating system, but this is worse than I expected. I'll have to do some heavy layering under this, and I'm really disappointed that I spent so much on a coat that won't get me through the Northwest's mild winters. It looks heavy and warm, but really really isn't. But the look and fit are so great, it is honestly the most attractive coat I've tried on that fits me in years. The only other bad thing I can say about it is the pocket placement is odd. The pockets are way towards the front of the coat, so when you put your hands in them you have to hunch your shoulders forward. But aside from awkward pocket placement and lack of warmth, it's a very nice coat. Since finding a good fit is so hard for me, perhaps I can't be too picky.

review_summary: LOVE IT! Just a titch big
review_text: LOVE IT! Just a titch bigger for a medium than I thought it would be, definitely have some extra room for layers. I could actually easily get away with a small and I've never purchased a small. I like the medium though. Great deep green color, already received a ton of compliments. The hood.... Oh the hood. Straight out of an Elf from Lord of the Rings closet. Or Volturi vampires from twilight. It's epic. Very fairytale. I'm incredibly happy with this purchase, worth every penny.
This is my favorite coat of all time!  The green is a really pretty color, and with a sweater it's nice and warm.  I've had this coat for three days and I've gotten like 20 compliments on it already.

I absolutely love this coat. I've been looking for the perfect coat in the perfect green for so long and this one is just right. It is good quality but not too heavy which is good for me cause I live in the south and the fit is perfect. I am very happy with this buy.

review_summary: It is exactly what I thou
review_text: It is exactly what I thought I was buying. Warm long and beautiful. I can't wait for a cold day to wear it. I am not a very tall person and the length of the coat and sleeves is just right. The buttons need reinforced for sure.

This coat is adorable, the color is better in person. The hood is what sold me and I'm so not disappointed. It will cover your face for blowing wind or rain. It's well made, slightly thick and lined. I wear a large in coats so its true to size. The arms are a little roomy but that will work better for layering. So glad my bf told me it was on sale as I had eyed this one for some time!

After reading other buyers comments (seeing their measurements) I chose to buy the size 2X instead of the 1X I usually wear at modcloth. The coat is unfortunately too big for me, I have alot of extra room, like 56 inches more, I think it's made a little larger than usual. Although because of the skirt the coat is very forgiving once the belt is tied. If I'd live in the Us I'd just return it and get a smaller size, a 1X or an XL. Since I don't and I paid taxes and custom fees I'll just move the buttons a little to the left and by arranging the creases in the coat when the sash is tied it looks pretty good. Others mentioned the coat is very warm, I'm not so sure about that, it's heavy, but not so thick. Obviously it depends where you live, so considering temperatures in Montreal, I'd say it's warm enough for fall ( coldest temperature being near 0 Celsius) but no way it could be warm enough for winter, unless you always take your car and don't walk outside.Overall I'm satisfied with my purchase, I think the price I paid (including taxes and customs) is fair for the qualityof the product and the style.

review_summary: I am in love with this ja
review_text: I am in love with this jacket! I bought it last year in a medium but by the time I tried to exchange it for a small they were sold out. So happy they brought it back. The hood is so glorious. ISSUE: buttons are horrible. I wore the thing for two hours last night and THREE buttons fell off. One from each sleeve and the second to top button. Unfortunately I was unable to find the missing closure button. Seriously, if I am spending that much on a coat things shouldn't be falling off so quickly.

OOOOOHHH MYYYY GOOODDDNNEESSS!!!! This coat is awesome. And I'm a certified coataholic/winter gear connoisseur(seuse...). Anyway, the color is so rich and lovely. It's my favorite type of green, deep and foresty with a tinge of blue. The textured/basketweave fabric is a nice departure from the smooth wool blends of my other coats. The hood I have to admit is a little much, but I like the way it drapes across the shoulders. The buttons are a little large and bulbous, but I think they work with the style. I'm also not crazy about highlow hems, but this one isn't too pronounced, plus the view of the back of this coat is so cute. I think the fit is true to size, it all depends how much you want to wear underneath I guess... It seems quite warm. Will have to find out for sure in a bit when it's cold enough.
I think the buttons could easily be pulled off, and it is a tad too large, and the hood is  very big. other than that it's seriously the best coat ever. I get a lot of compliments on it.

review_summary: I'm in love with this coa
review_text: I'm in love with this coat. The color is a richer, darker green than I expected from the photos but it's even lovelier than I was expecting. It's a decent quality fabric and construction but my one concern is that the buttons  won't last the entire season because they don't seem attached by much. I've got a thick middle (apple shape) and often have a hard time getting a coat that fits my shoulders. I bought the XL and it fits great. Very pleased with it!

This is a very beautiful and wellmade coat.  I would say that it is true to size and leaves a little room for a sweater or longsleeved shirt.  Being from the Midwest, I don't tend to do a lot of layering, I just buy coats in graduating warmth because you really never know what the weather is going to be like here.  I would say, as many have said, to order a size up if you plan on doing a lot of layering.  This coat is in a beautiful hunter green, and the hood is magically large and beautiful.  The buttons are large but quite cute.  It hits me right around the knee, so it's long enough that you could wear a dress with it and it would still look quite nice.  No complaints here!

review_summary: I love this coat! I feel
review_text: I love this coat! I feel like a modern day elf!!

This coat is wonderful. It fits quite nicely. It's a little tight around the shoulders so I can't wear layers but if I got a larger size then I would be swimming in fabric. There are a few loose threads but nothing to complain about. One of the buttons fell off but it's an easy fix.All in all really happy with the purchase.

review_summary: I got this coat last year
review_text: I got this coat last year for 50% off. I'm not sure I would have paid full price for it, but I love it for the price I did pay. The color is a gorgeous deep green and the hood makes it truly unique. The only two problems I've had over the last year are that the buttons aren't sewn on very tightly, so I've had to reattach two of them and the hood makes it too heavy for some hooks. But otherwise, I've been very happy with this coat.

review_summary: I love this coat. The col
review_text: I love this coat. The color is beautiful and the hood is magnificent. It's a bit snug but I love it too much to return. I'm optimistic that I can lose another inch to make it perfect. I'm big chested and apple shaped so it should work on most. A bit long but I'm only 5'3'' so I expect that. Love it!

review_summary: This coat fits like a dre
review_text: This coat fits like a dream!  Just the right length too.

review_summary: I love this coat so much!
review_text: I love this coat so much!! Classy, comfy, and stylish!! Good length and great for the weather and wearing to work!

I have never received as many compliments on a coat as I have with this. Not just from my friends but from cashiers, random women sitting in coffeeshops, even a homeless anarchist guy. And I love it! It makes me feel like an elven princess (but it's not like costumey or anything) and it's ohsocosy. The hood can get in the way of purse straps and the shoulders and bust are a tad bit tight on my proportions, but no biggy. The only issue I had is the first one I got seemed like a factory extra...plastic lining peeling off buttons and the loop to hang it on a hook (in this case, a chain) was broken. I called ModCloth and they sent out a new one right away that was in great shape using a faster shipping method. Probably just an inspection overlook at the time of packing, and ModCloth customer service were great, but the hassle of going to buy packing tape and getting the return box back to the post office was a bit of a bummer (esp as this was my first purchase). Still, impressive customer service and I am sure they will be more careful inspecting this item now that they know they had some duds.

This coat really is wonderful, but its rather delicate. The weave, while being perfect in appearance, is incredibly easy to snag. I managed to get it caught on something, unbeknownst to me, the very first time I wore it. The buttons are also no sturdy enough to support the weight of the coat, and could do with some reinforcing with a heavier duty thread. However, the flaws are almost worth it due to the magical nature of the coat. The hood really is a thing of beauty, and looks incredible down around your shoulders as well. It's much warmer than I expected it to be and tall ladies rejoice! the sleeves are wonderfully long. As mentioned, the color is a deep, Emerald green and really pops against all the other black coats on the street. All in all, I'd definitely recommend. #forgoodmeasure
The fabric is beautiful and the color is a glorious rich green. This runs a touch small through the shoulders I'm usually a small and the medium fits me perfectly.

review_summary: I usually wear a small or
review_text: I usually wear a small or medium, and with coats I go larger so I can wear a sweater. Glad I went with the medium, fits well over my sweater but isn't too large, though a little more snug than I was expecting. Still love the fit and style, with the asymmetrical hemline and large hood. I needed a hooded jacket and this is definitely warm!

review_summary: This has been my goto win
review_text: This has been my goto winter coat for a couple of years now. It's warm enough for most chilly days, but you'll want to layer it with an extra sweater for the brutally cold ones.It's designed really well, I love the asymmetrical buttons and the hood is beautiful. My favorite way to wear it is buttonedup with the hood gathered around my neck no need for a scarf!Some things to watch out for: the threads can snag easily after a while, so take care with it. Also, the minute you get it, reinforce the buttons with some extra thread. They'll pop off easily otherwise.

This coat is beautiful! Such a lovely, flattering colour and cut, and the hood is so pretty! It is a tad bigger than I usually like in coats, I'm usually an xs, but the shoulders fit well so with the belt tied it is good, and plenty of room to layer.  The coat looks and feels warm, very heavy, though because the material is woven, may let some wind through  haven't gotten a chance to test that out yet, but overall very happy with this!

I've been drooling over this coat for what seems like years, so I immediately snatched it up when it came back in stock. I was a little anxious spending so much, but this coat is well worth it. The color is richer in person and, although it fits a smidge looser than I expected, the cut leaves room for layering and the waist detailing hits me in the right spots. Overall, I'm as in love with it as I was online. Thank you for bringing this one back, ModCloth!

review_summary: I love this coat! The col
review_text: I love this coat! The color is a beautiful emerald. I love the fabric it is made out of and it is super warm. I usually wear a medium and that it what I ordered. The coat is a little snug especially in the chest and shoulders. I wouldn't be able to wear a big sweater underneath. I still love this coat though and I'm glad I got it!

review_summary: I am very pleased with th
review_text: I am very pleased with this coat.  It isn't the warmest coat, but I think it will function fine for late fall/early winter in Canada.  It'll do fine if you live in the south.  The only thing that surprised me at all about the coat was how big the buttons were (and numerous).  I ended up replacing them with some wood ones that look much nicer.  Due to the rough appearance of the weave of this coat, it is not a sleek, polished look, but rather a bit rustic.  I love the cut  it is very cute!  The size small is good for me  I can wear a sweater and a tshirt underneath and have no problem in terms of room  though it is a bit smaller than usual  I often take an xs in coats, but I have broad shoulders and this wasn't quite as accommodating as other coats I have (and there isn't an xs  but there is a belt!).  The pockets are nice  took me a minute to find (more in the front).  The hood is quite floppy, so you may have to fiddle with how to put it up to look as you'd like (I've been folding it over a wee bit so far  to give the front more structure).  Excuse my pallor and accompanying fashion in the pictures  I only added them so you can see the coat (not me).

review_summary: I LOVE this coat. It fits
review_text: I LOVE this coat. It fits perfectly  it's definitely fitted though, so you can't wear a super thick sweater under it. It's super cute, and the hood is wonderful. I often have trouble getting a coat that isn't too big for me... this one is just right!

review_summary: This is my very first Mod
review_text: This is my very first Modcloth purchase. I am happy. It is almost as if this coat was made for me. I am normally an XL in everything I buy except coats. I find them too large if I get XL. So I crossed my fingers and sized down and it worked. I don't have much room to layer. I can wear a light sweater underneath. But I bought this for fashion rather then function. Most of my weight is in my hips and thighs and this gave me lots of room in those areas. It pulls slightly across the chest but If I wear a different bra this fixes the problem. It leaves me a bit of extra length in the arms. It come to my knuckles.I don't love the buttons, they are a lil more ball like then I thought. Easy enough to change if I really wanted. I can see it pilling with wear but I have only had it a few hours so I cant say for sure. I paid 41.19 on top of shipping. Which seemed a little steep to Calgary, Alberta, Canada. I wonder if that would have been different had I not used UPS?All in all I paid almost 200 Canadian for this coat. It is a beautiful coat and I might have even spent that in store for it. Just be aware of the extra rate when purchasing outside of the USA. That alone will probably stop me from buying too much form this site. The shipping was fast, I bought on Thursday and received the following Wednesday.

Everything was great!  I love the way it looks and fits.  The only issue is what other people have already mentioned and that's that the buttons are a bit loose, and will probably need to be resewn at some point.  But for now they're fine.

This coat is the cutest. I was worried it'd be a little too foresty/elven for my liking (I really just wanted a belted colorful coat) but I love it in person and have received tons of compliments. I don't typically put up the hood since it's so big and floppy, but it works great in lieu of a scarf since there's so much material around the neck. The small fit me perfectly (I measure at a medium, but wanted a coat that was a bit more form fitting). It keeps me warm in weather ranging from 20 to 50 degrees  so versatile. The only issue is, as others have mentioned, the front buttons are extremely loose to the point where you need to be really careful with them to make sure you don't pull one off. However, if you're not handy with a needle, just take it to your local seamstress for a quick and cheap fix.

review_summary: So I bought this coat on
review_text: So I bought this coat on a whim because a) it was on sale and b) i have wanted a jacket with a fairy tale esque hood for a hot minute. Now I am usually a size 8 in everything but since they only had a large I decided to go ahead and hey if I don't like it modcloth has an amazing return policy. Well just got it and it's amazing!! Holy crap I am so glad I went with a large perfect length and I love that it's loose enough to put a thick sweater underneath. The hood is amazing! I look like red riding hood in a fairy tale. I love that it's long enough to almost be a dress so it will be super cute over a dress with tights. Definitely a lot heavier than i imagined but considering it was 18 degrees outside today I'd say it's perfect. The only thing is that the buttons like other reviewers mentioned are a bit too fragile for my taste.  Get it!

review_summary: I love the style of this
review_text: I love the style of this coat but the fit and quality are really lacking. The day I got it a button broke off and I don't mean the stitching came undone. I mean the button itself broke. In addition, the coat is pilling already and I've only had it a couple of weeks. Finally, some of the seams are coming apart. *sigh* As other reviewers stated the fit is not perfect. For me, it fits my shoulders pretty well but is really quite big everywhere else. I am used to an XL fitting pretty much perfectly. I am keeping the coat because I live in Canada, had to pay duty and tax and all that jazz that comes with international shipping. The money lost on that and the cost of shipping the return do not seem worth it to me. I'm a handy girl, so I will fix the coat myself and I'll wear it out  unfortunately, that part is likely to happen quicker than I'd like for something at this price point (see above comment re: pilling).

review_summary: This coat is great! It is
review_text: This coat is great! It is a little snug around the shoulders becuase of the hood but nothing I can't deal with. I love the color and it makes feel amazing in it!

review_summary: This coat is THE BEST! Th
review_text: This coat is THE BEST! The huge, fairytalelike hood is the icing on the cake. I have narrow shoulders so it fit perfectly rolled down around them (as shown in the pictures), but if you have wide shoulders it might be too tight. The coat is heavy and warm, and the fabric and buttons are gorgeous. The color is even better in person. The sleeves and length are a little long for a person of my height, but would probably fall perfectly if you are taller.

review_summary: I LOVE this coat. I've on
review_text: I LOVE this coat. I've only had it 3 days, and I keep getting random strangers asking about it or telling me it's really cute! The sleeves are the perfect length to keep the tops of my hands warm and not show my wrist/forearm when I raise my arms, and I was SO pleased that it actually buttons comfortably over my bust! The belt IS a little high (pretty much right under my bustline) but it isn't bad looking at all. I think in general it could be a few inches longer, but that tends to happen with anything I buy because of my boobs. The buttons don't FEEL that secure, but on visual inspection they are very well stitched so I'm not worried about them popping off. The hood is an absolute DREAM, I feel like a woodland princess or something in it. If it were red, I'd be making Little Red Riding Hood comparisons. The shade of green is beautiful, very lush, and the texture keeps it interesting and visually appealing. It's also heavier/warmer than expected, which is nice! It has a pretty good heft to it when you pick it up.

review_summary: I had been eyeing this co
review_text: I had been eyeing this coat for a while, and when I saw there was one left in stock in my size, I knew it was a sign. This coat is so much more than I expected! The dark green is beautiful and there are so many great details to this coat, from the pleated longer back to the big round buttons to the pockets almost hidden in the front pleats of the jacket.  And the best part, the cape/hood which you can either wear flattened down, up over your head, OR my favorite, folded up in the middle as if it's a huge cowlneck.  Even in chilly weather, sometimes I don't even need a scarf.  The inside is also fully lined, so surprisingly, my thick sweaters fit just fine.  So worth it!!!
Gorgeous jewel green coat!  I loved every detail of it.  My one complaint is that were were several loose threads I had to cut.

review_summary: This coat is a great colo
review_text: This coat is a great color and texture. The back is gorgeous and the hood is unique, huge, and awesome. I fell in love when I saw it online and wanted to love it so badly, mostly because of the awesome hood. The medium was a good size for me, because I wanted to wear the coat over cozy sweaters. It is very flattering on a curvy figure, and I love the way the hood drapes over the shoulders in a fairy tale capelike way.However, a couple things made me decide to return it: 1. The buttons are huge and loosely sewn on. They just feel kinda cheap and I imagine them falling off pretty easily. They are also offcentered. Being a little OCD this bothered me. They go in a diagonal, but not so much diagonal to be obviously intentional. IMO, they should be straight up and down or sharply diagonal, but these buttons were awkwardly SLIGHTLY diagonal.2. The lining is also kinda plasticlike and just felt a bit cheap. It sounds swishy when I put it on. 3. After trying it on a couple times, I decided that while the huge hood is pretty stunning, it isn't really functional. It's actually too big to really wear in the rain or snow, it droops over my head. I thought about keeping it, folding the hood over, and sewing on new buttons... but I think for the price, I should love everything about it. I would love to see more coats of this style, with a big hood, though!!

review_summary: I was surprised at how he
review_text: I was surprised at how heavy this coat is! I was expecting a little more fashion than function, but it is quite warm! I'm in Indiana, east of Chicago. It gets quite cold. I expected to need to layer (and I probably will when it gets into the teens and below) so I bought big. I usually have problems with sleeves being too short, shoulders being too long and no room in the bust. This was not the case. In fact, it was way too big! Even with my heaviest sweater underneath, I'm still swimming in it  in the waist especially. I am returning and will be buying a smaller size as soon as they're back in stock!

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this coat as soon as I saw it online. and I wanted to love it when it came in the mail, but I was extremely disappointed. The jacket was cute but the fit was terrible. It was really tight across the back/in the shoulder area, which is surprising because that is not a problem I've ever had before. The sleeves were a good length but they were too tight to wear long sleeve shirt underneath comfortably. Furthermore, while this was not the most expensive jacket, it was still enough money that it should have arrived in better condition. As soon as I put it on the top button shot off. I know buttons are an easy fix but I think something that costs over $100 should not require patchwork after less than thirty seconds of wear. I love Modcloth, but I am sending back everything that came with this order because the sizing was all off.

After searching far and wide for a beautiful but interesting coat, I have finally found it! I love the color and the cape/hood on the back. It is a bit longer than ideal on my 5'2 frame, but I usually expect that for most clothes. Also, the buttons are a bit bulky and cheap looking, but they can easily be replaced. My only true disappointment is the hem on the coat. I wish it was a traditional straight hem, instead longer in the back. It literally hits me almost midcalf.

I absolutely love this coat. I recommend sizing up if in doubt because while it's perfect as a lateautumn coat, you'll want the extra room to layer and/or put on a thick scarf for the winter. The color is more of a forest green (a richer, slightly brighter green) than what's pictured, but if anything, I think the actual color is better. I get tons of compliments, especially in NYC, the land of plain, black coats. The hood is awesome...I do feel like a fairy tale character, or maybe a little like Yoda :) ?

review_summary: I love my new coat! This
review_text: I love my new coat! This coat is much warmer than I expected. I live in NYC and it is my new winter coat. I've gotten lots of compliments on it. The hood is magical. I bought the XL but probably could have worn an L. (I'm 5'10, 190 lbs). I love the hourglass shape it gives me. It looks especially nice with a dress or skirt  and the color is divine. You wont regret it!

Love this coat! It's perfect for winters in the Bay area, the fabric is warm and thick enough without being bulky, and there's still plenty of room for a sweater underneath.  The waist is tailored very nicely, actually pulls in, so it does give that hourglass shape.  It's also plenty long and hit me at the right point on my waist which is hard to find for my height.  Overall, loved it and I get tons of compliments on it!

This is the most stunning coat and I am so happy with it. I was a bit worried initially that the pleats in the back would look bulky or that it would be too long on me, but neither is a problem at all the pleats lie flat and it hits just above my knees. It is a beautiful dark emerald green color and, as everyone has mentioned, the hood is absolutely adorable. I never want to take it off!

As other comments said, the hood is divine! Unfortunately I found the rest of the coat a bit snug, and would suggest sizing up. I have a larger bust and the tie was a little bit higher than I would have liked. In addition, the asymmetrical length of the back of the coat accented my bottom in a way I'm not crazy about. That being said, I decided to keep it because it's warmer than expected and an ok fit.

review_summary: I loved this coat and wan
review_text: I loved this coat and wanted to keep it, but it was snug in the shoulders with only a thin tshirt underneath  definitely would not have worked with a sweater.  The fabric is very heavy, as described by a previous poster, but the coat is absolutely gorgeous, just too tight in the shoulders and back.  A larger size, however, would have been too large overall.  Sadly, I am returning it, but I wish I did not have to.

I was nervous about ordering online, because I have a particularly rough time trying on coats (too tight in the shoulders, usually), but this was too good to pass up.  It fits like it was made for my body, especially in the shoulders and bust.  Not so tight that I can't move, but just tailored enough that it doesn't look too bulky.I'd also like to chime in with the other reviewers about this amazing hood that wasn't pictured.  It is DIVINE.  It screams fairy tale in a way that is not cloying, but really chic and really sharply styled.  It is fantastic.Another thing I was curious about was whether or not this coat had pockets it does, and they're very subtle.I'd strongly recommend this for people who have a tough time finding THE coat.  This is the one.  Consider sizing up if you are going to layer underneath (which I accounted for before ordering good call!).

review_summary: This coat is of a much be
review_text: This coat is of a much better quality than I expected. The fabric is quite heavy. The weave of the fabric is beautiful and it has nice detailing. The color is great. One of the best features, Modcloth overlooked showing a photo of: the hood. Really fairytale like. My only complaint is that the sleeves are so long. They hang close to my fingertips, and I would size down, but due to my bust I think the large would be too small. Also the back of sleeve at the shoulder fits well in the XL, but would likely be too snug for my comfort in the large. It's really quite warm, and the color is so rich. I look forward to flaunting it.

This coat is absolutely stunning.  The color is even more vibrant in person  more jewel green than the forest green of the photo.  The back is darling, and I love the capelike detailing.  The hood, however, is what sold me.  I will say that if you like to layer a lot, you may want to size up, but for me it was perfect.

First ordered in 1x based on sized chart, but that size was huge. I decided to size down two sizes to the L. This fit me pretty perfectly in the body, but of course the arms are too small to move comfortably (not a rare occurrence for me, as I have large upper arms). Since I have no patience to return again, I plan to undo the stitching in the armpits and add some patches to help it fit better. I'm also not super thrilled with the liningIt feels like it might get really sweaty if I wore this coat over a top or dress without full sleeves. But over all, the shape and design of the coat itself is very cute. I love the skirt and belt. I'm also happy with ModClothI originally purchased this coat with a coupon code, and decided to return and buy a new size rather than exchange (as they suggest on the returns page), but I didn't have another code to make the price the same. I chatted with customer service and was given another code right away. That was awesome!
Fits small in the shoulders and arms, I exchanged this and ordered up a size. Beautiful coat though! Looking forward to trying it on in size L.
Beautiful coat, but I'd say a runs a little big in the body.

The best coat ever!!! This is my second purchase of this coat style. I already own it in red. It is so flattering. I get compliments every time I wear it. It is perfectly warm for west coat winters. I'm not sure is would be warm enough for a subzero place, but works well in the 30's50's. Keep the new colors coming.
The jacket is very large in many places. It needs to be tailored. So disappointed!

Please mind you I bought this coat a year ago when I was a 32 b, now I'm a 32 DD. The coat still fits well, although can be a bit tight in the chest if I'm wearing an oversized sweater. That being said I love this coat!
Love! Fits almost perfectly but would not go up or down in size. Lovely material!

review_summary: I want to love it, I do.
review_text: I want to love it, I do. This is like going out on a date with a guy you had a crush on forever and thought was perfect, but halfway through you realize he is useless So first off, the hood zips back into the jacket, this sounds like a good idea, but it isn't. If you have long hair, it will tangle in the zipper with the hood out. And it looks rather stupid if you man auto get the hood zipped inNext we will look at pockets. There are 2 pockets only. The zippers in the chest are pure decorations (useless) the two normal pockets that LOOK like they close up do NOT. There is literally a flap with a functioning pop button that is attached to the outer flap for the illusion of securing your stuff in your pocket Okay now, the sleeves. What were you thinking? There is an extra strap that looks like it will help to close the sleeves up to keep the cold air from getting in. It doesn't. All it does is create an odd triple layered bulky wrist issue. So if you are getting this because you like a bunch of odd looking, bizarrely useless features then go for it If you are looking for something that will help you on your bike when the weather gets cooler? Skip it

review_summary: Zipper takes PATIENCE; Pocket openings curl out, require sew
review_text: I recently ordered this in green (on sale) and returned it, and then ordered it in black (not on sale but with a coupon) so I will discuss both here.BLACK: This is a lot of money for what it is: a mediumweight hoodie with some nice but cheapfeeling embellishments. The zipper is the worst part  you need to exert a bit of muscle to click the two sides of the zipper teeth together and have them snap before you can move the zipper up. When unzipping you need to jiggle and exert pressure in just the right way to unclasp the last of it. It takes PATIENCE and is frustrating given the price point. When I asked customer care if this is considered a product defect, they said no, all of the [black] jackets are like this and that my options were to take it as or return it. (If it breaks, however, I was told I could call back and return it then; but when I asked about a statue of limitations on such a warranty they said that would be decided on a casebycase basis). The straps around the wrists don't bother me at all as they do some other reviewers. It is warmer than your garden variety hoodie but also less soft. Once the weather started to get in the 40s, I'd have to wear this with a lot of layers. Thankfully the jacket is warm enough to do this (I'm typically a 2x3x and I ordered a 3x). Then after wearing it maybe just a few times a week, it quickly started to fall apart. A few days after it arrived, one of the snaps on the wrist came completely detached, so I had this awkward piece of fabric hanging from my wrist. Everyone seems to be giving this jacket raving reviews. I just received it today so I'll weigh in on some of the problems. 1) I found the inside of the sleeves to be a little itchy. Maybe that's just because it's new. 2) The sleeves feel a lot thinner than the rest of the jacket. I live in a windy city and went outside with it one and the wind went right through it. 3) the sleeves are pretty long and there's a cuff that goes around the wrists that is very bulky and loose. Doesn't add anything to the look or functionality and kind of weighs it down. 4) Like others have said, the zipper is badly made. Struggling to get the thing zipped and feeling like I'm going to break something in the process definitely cheapens it. 5) If there's one thing I can't stand about clothing it's when there are FAKE POCKETS. This coat is a mastermind of illusion. The 2 vertical pockets on the chest are fake. Also, the pockets on the tummy don't actually close. the buttons/'pocket' look is are decorative. Should have looked at the 'details' tab closer.I will say though, this jacket gets A LOT more handsome when you tuck the hood into the zipper. it gives the collar this really cool stiff structure and suddenly looks a lot classier. Overall I don't really have a problem about how it looks. It definitely looks a little tackier in real life than in the photos  but I've been searching for a unique black jacket for such a long time I might just grit my teeth and keep it.

I have the Brunch on the Patio jacket that is the same length at this one, but feels longer to me than this hoodie. It feels like the bust on this jacket is somewhat tighter than the Brunch jacket so that could possibly be the cause. It's interesting though because this same hoodie in the mustard color is either .5 or 1 longer so I would suggest making it the same length in all colors. And 3) I think this jacket should probably run between $3545 not $64. Like I said above, the quality is great and doesn't look cheap but if I saw this on someone else or in a store I wouldn't think it would come with a $64 price tag. Despite all this I'm pretty pleased and will definitely keep it.
