It's the perfect weight to wear over a tshirt in a San Francisco winterI wear it open during the day and zip it up when it gets cool in the evening. It's structured enough to look fairly puttogether (I've gotten lots of compliments!) but is deceptively cozy. Cons: The wrists are tight enough that you can't push up your sleeves when it gets a little too warm. And after 2 years of frequent wear, the zipper has started to stick occasionally and one of the wrist snaps has unsnapped itself a few times. The zipper isn't a huge pain, but I might just sew the wrist piece so it doesn't end up in the sink someday.

review_summary: I was torn between a 3 an
review_text: I was torn between a 3 and 4 star rating on this. I really like it for the most part, but as others have said, the sleeves and the bottom of the hoodie feel too short. This hoodie rides up constantly and I have to pull it back down. However, when it's actually in place, it does look really good and has a slimming effect. The material seems high quality and still looks great after several washings.
Great hoodie, love everything about it!!!

review_summary: I love this hoodie! I bou
review_text: I love this hoodie! I bought it for my trip to Scandinavia this summer and it was the perfect cross between a jacket and a sweatshirt. The black faded after only a couple of washes (even with special dark detergent) and a hole developed near the pocket sooner than it should have.

review_summary: I am in such love with th
review_text: I am in such love with this jacket. I actually had to send the medium back and order the large because I'm pretty tall (5'11) and my shoulders are a little wide, and the large has more room for an outfit underneath. It's also long, which is really great for me. I just figured out the hood yesterday it doesn't zip off, like I was expecting, but instead zips into the collar, which is something I've never seen before. I haven't worn it like that yet, but it could be helpful when it gets cold. The sleeves are also long which made me really happy because it's so hard to find jackets with sleeves that fit me nowadays. I probably won't be using the double zipper feature very often one is enough for me. The front two zippers don't zip down to anything, which would have been cool, but that's okay. I've never had a jacket with a collar like this, but I really like it. I think it'll keep me pretty warm on colder days. The material is like a thin sweatshirt, and in places there are a few more layers on. Overall, it was exactly what I was looking for and what I though it would be, and I'm really happy I decided to get the larger size and not give up on it.
This is an amazing jacket! I love it so much. The only problem with it was that it was a little short, but I don't really mind. Great product ModCloth!

review_summary: I'm torn on this one beca
review_text: I'm torn on this one because I love the way it looks on, but for the price this hoodie isn't the quality I would expect.  The material is kind of thin and the hardware is somewhat junky. It does fit really well and is the perfect length. I'll probably end up keeping it because it's exactly what I wanted as far as style; I just don't think it is worth over $60.
Love the jacket. It's surprisingly warm and the perfect length of preference. For me there's room to wear a sweater underneath and I haven't run into any quality issues with buttons, zipper etc.

First ever ModCloth purchase.  There were a lot of obstacles that happened between the order placement and the hoodie actually appearing on my doorstep, but ModCloth's customer service was amazing the whole way through.  The first Leipzig hoodie I received actually had many of the problems identified throughout these 700+ (!!) reviews: a weird chemical smell, numerous frayed threads, a very rough feel, tight fit, and worst of all, multiple holes in the sleeves akin to those that form after a few washes, or numerous moth attacks.  It felt like a mockup of the actual product.However,  ModCloth's AMAZING customer service responded almost immediately and overnighted me a new one, which is in much better condition.  It's almost unbelievable how different the two jackets were.Still, the quality is lessthanideal for such an expensive item, and it isn't terribly warm; but it is comfortable, and I am enjoying wearing it.No regrets here.  Thanks, ModCloth.

Got this for Christmas and I love it!  The perfect stylish hoodie I was looking for.  Great for looking awesome while casual.  It is supposed to fit and is not made to fit loose FYI.  I usually am between a small and medium.  Ordered a medium and it fit perfectly!

review_summary: This jacket is a little s
review_text: This jacket is a little short in my torso and arms, and I am not a tall person, but it would be too bit everywhere else if I sized up. I have taken to calling this my assassin jacket because it just looks that awesome. I would definitely recommend purchasing this jacket.

review_summary: I got the largest size av
review_text: I got the largest size available because I read that it runs small and it barely fits but since there isn't another option I decided to keep it.I mostly wear it in situations where I wouldn't be taking it off, with a small tshirt underneath and another jacket over it, which I take off when I go inside anywhere. It's not as warm as I had hoped it would be, but when I ordered it I wasn't familiar with the warmth ratings on the site so I wasn't sure what to expect in that regard. It fits snug, so I feel more like I'm wearing a shirt than a jacket. It's a bit short for my comfort level, but I do make it work, I have very large hips so that could just be me.The hood is nice, I was disappointed to learn the zippers aren't real pockets, but I read that in a review before mine even arrived so that was something else I was also prepared for.Overall I think this is a great little jacket, perfect for layering and warmer autumn type weather. I would absolutely love it in an extra large, so if one ever comes out I would rebuy, but I do not regret this purchase at all!Beautiful quaity, definitely worth it if you're looking for a lightweight jacket for fashion more than warmth! Very comfortable too, one of my favorite things about Modcloth is I have a hard time finding girly items that are comfortable and fit with my body type and so far I've done really well on this site!

review_summary: I'm a true XS so when the
review_text: I'm a true XS so when the description said this jacket ran small I thought I'd give it a whirl. Well, the S is certainly no XS in reality, but since its actually pretty light weight for a Detroit winter I appreciate the layering potential. I bought it hoping it could be my biking jacket for warmer winter days into springtime and I think this will work just like I wanted. Yay!

Very cool hoodie. The front zippers are of no use and I find that dissapointing with the price that is charged. I had read there were problems with the sleeves and buckle at the wrists but I had no problems. It was put together very well. The length of the arms were good but at the waist it was a little short. The hood is very difficult to tuck away and zip up and I found that I needed to put away the hood because my hair would get snagged in the zipper when it was opened. Overall very sharp looking hoodie but the quality could be a little better with the price that is taged to it.

Love this jacket. The overall look of this jacket is perfect for chilly summer days, or a good top layer for slightly warmer fall days. I love the military hardware look, with the zippers and silverware buttons. The only quibble I have is the collar  the attached hoodie will not fit into the collar no matter how hard I try. A sole complaint in an otherwise perfect jacket.

this is the coolest looking sweatshirt/jacket ever! i love love LOVE it, but i think it's a little tight on me, which is strange, because I got a medium and i'm usually a small. so i'd order at least one size up. but i feel like a secret agent in it and it's so cool!

I bought this sweater 2 years previously.  It has been my perfect go to sweater for all occasions.  I even have multiple colors.  I wore it out over a year and it has holes in the sleeves and the cuff is almost shredded off.  it did not last long or well, but  love it so much I still wear it and wanted to replace it.  My boyfriend bought another sweater for me this christmas and I was thrilled, but sad to say I HATE the new changes they have made to the jacket.  The hardware that is used is cheaper, but i still loved the jacket.  HOWEVER it is almost 4 inches shorter on me than my previous identical jacket.  What was a perfect comfy jacket that laid just below my belt and kept my back warm even as i bent, not hits just above my belt.  It cannot keep me warm since it leaves my back exposed as i move.  I guess i have to wear very long shirts to do the job my sweater should be doing.  I am severely dissapointed in these changes that have turned my favorite jacket ever into one I really hate.  I think Ill be returning the jacket and prefer to wear the ripped to shred old version that at least can cover your torso.

Good hoodie; it's warm and fashionable and I love it!  Everybody else loves it too, and friends often comment on it.  The snap on the right pocket broke off after about a year of use, but that is easily fixable, and not bad for a year of wear and tear (I am not always gentle with my outerwear).  I would highly recommend this.

review_summary: I love this hoodie and th
review_text: I love this hoodie and the quality so far seems to be very good. Heavy weight and warm. I normally wear a 02 or XS in tops so I ordered the small which was too small for my measurements 5' 4 107 lbs exposing a bit of wrist and hit at the top of my belt line [wearing regular rise jeans] so I gifted it to a friend [who loves it] and ordered a medium which covers just to the end of my wrists and the bottom hits just below my beltline.The picture looks like it's a longer style hoodie which is why I ordered it. It's actually an regular length hoodie but I kept it anyway, it's cute and I wear it all the time!

I'm very happy with this hoodie. It is a bit thinner than I expected, but it is very comfortable. Also, the zipper doesn't work very smoothly, but a little wax should help with that. Regarding the size, I usually wear an XS and the S fits just right. The details make it unique and I really enjoy wearing it.

review_summary: I'm so glad I got a large
review_text: I'm so glad I got a large as this was barely comfortable over my chest. A fabric with a little less give to it and it would've been too constricting. (this might not have been helped by the bra I was wearing, but hey). The details on this are absolutely perfect and the quality would have been perfect if not for the inside sleeves being a weird scratchy sort of texture. I'm hoping with time this sorts itself out. Also the length was about t shirt length on me, although the sleeves were perfect, coming just past my wrist while standing straight. It's not as thick as I was led to believe from some of the other reviews, but it will do for South Carolina winters. (winter? what winter?) This is very figure flattering and looks great with anything!

I love this hoodie! I'm 5' 4, 119lbs and although some of the reviews said it ran small, I went with my normal size (small) and the fit is great. There's still plenty of room for layering. I was surprised it was a little more heavy duty than just a normal sweatshirt. You could totally get away with wearing it as a light jacket in the fall.
Very Eurochic...makes me feel like the Girl with the Dragon Tattoo.  Very cool.

review_summary: I wore it once and the si
review_text: I wore it once and the silver button has already popped off the front.  So that's a bummer.  Also, I'm not sure I'd describe this as running small.  The sleeves are very long and go to my hands, and I have long arms, and it's fairly baggy on me.  Also, I didn't realize before buying that the zippers on the chest are fashion zippers (aka, they don't reveal pockets or anything), which I always find kind of tacky.  This might be in the description and I didn't read closely enough, so just fyi.

Definitely priced too high for the quality. Very thin sleeves, not warm at all and the collar looked really sloppy when it was unzipped (which is how I'd probably end up wearing it in southern CA). Have to send it back.

I misplaced my old black hoodie, and didn't think it would be that hard. Wrong. Finding a slimfitting hoodie has proven nearly impossible.Until now!This hoodie fits close to the body and offers a hood that drapes nicely, as well as nicely placed pockets. The zipper sticks a bit, but is otherwise sturdy.

This hoodie is super cute and fits well. The large is a little big for me, but I'm happy with it nonetheless (the medium was too small). The zipper is very hard to zip up. Aside from the poor zipper quality, however, this is a very good buy for the price.

This hoodie is wonderful!  The website warns that the hoodie runs small, so I decided to go with a medium and I am so glad that I did.  The hoodie is made of a thicker material than normal hoodies  I would say it is a cross between a hoodie and a jacket.  It looks extremely stylish and I just absolutely love all of the zippers.  They add a great, artsy touch!  I do not regret this buy at all and would definitely recommend this for a friend!

review_summary: This is my new favorite s
review_text: This is my new favorite sweatshirt. I had been  looking at it for awhile and so glad I decided to get it!! I ordered a large and it's not too snug around my larger chest.

review_summary: I like the details on thi
review_text: I like the details on this, and it's nice and heavy.  It runs a bit big, or maybe one would just call it boyfriend cut, but I would size down if you want it to be a tad curvehugging.

review_summary: I've been looking for a c
review_text: I've been looking for a coat like this since I got back from New Zealand, something with a hood and pockets and a little hardware and this was perfect. It's got a flattering cut and it's a decently warm layer?I can fit it over a sweater or under a larger jacket or both.I was under the impression that it was going to be navy, but that may have just been my bad. This jacket is black. A really solid piece.
I was concerned that this jacket was too busy, but ordered it anyway after reading all the glowing reviews. It's much too busy, for me, at least.

review_summary: I've had this for a coupl
review_text: I've had this for a couple of months now, and while it's one of my favourite sweaters, it was a little disappointing. It fit perfectly when I first got it: the sleeves were nice and long, the belly fit nice and snug... but it kind of stretched out in the belly. I'm always putting it in the dryer to shrink it back. The good thing is, you can kind of hide it by wearing a purse with a long strap across your body, and even without it, it's not terribly noticeable.I wish it was about an inch or two longer, but that's just because I like my tops to go well below my pants zipper but it's long enough to look okay.I wash and dry it like everything else, but make sure you put it inside out and undo the snaps on the sleeves (they don't dry well and the fabric will fade a little).The quality has been an issue. The first one I bought, the hood wouldn't zip up because the zipper kept splitting. The second one I got, the front zipper keeps getting stuck because the fabric wasn't sewn properly there. The second I can fix just with a few stitches to hold the fabric back, but keep in mind that the zippers tend to be funny on this sweater. I think I may also sew in a couple of breast pockets and maybe zippers on the hand pockets. While I haven't lost anything out of them, I would feel more comfortable with some reinforcements.While I love this sweater, I just think that the quality could have been much better than it was, hence the two point takedown.

I was really worried about how this would fit length wise. I am really thin and tall. So I sized up to a medium and it's a perfect fit. It's a little roomy so I can layer with it. It's not the comfiest but I am happy with the purchase. It will be an great florida winter piece.

Like many have said, order a size larger than you usually do! I went with the medium and it fits great. Overall, I love this jacket and will be wearing it in the fall and spring. The fabric around the neck and hoddie are super thick, but everywhere else it's pretty thin. It keeps me warm enough when it's 45/50 F outside, but anything colder than that and I find myself needing to layer or use a warmer coat. Take note too that the button pockets don't snap open! It's just an ordinary open pocket for your hands, with a decorative snapbutton flap that doesn't work. This wasn't a deal breaker for me, but it was a little disappointing.

Love the structured look of this hoodie. It's thick and fitted by design, so I wouldn't recommend sizing up. As others have mentioned: the cuffs are a little more restrictive than most of us are used to, but it works aesthetically. My only gripe it that the hood is a total pain to roll up and zip into the collar. I struggled with it for, like, 20 minutes. I know, I know, what a harrowing experience worthy of complaint in the greater context of the world's suffering. But, seriously, it was tough work, and I thought I was going to bust the zipper. I have been wearing clothes for most of my life, so it's not like I wasn't 'getting' something. When I finally got it all zipped in the collar looked pretty lumpy. I'd recommend Modcloth ship it with the collar rolled up, since it would be much easier to unzip it for those who prefer that style.

Love!!  Mom of 2 boys, easy layering, normally a Small; I chose a Medium due to random weight gain/ Pregancies aswell layering with scarves and other light cardigians. Otherwise perfect Fall wear, keeps you warm with no layering needed. Fits comfortably, impressed

love the style to death. had to get the zipper replaced after about a year, though, which was sad. still a great, comfy, badass lightweight jacket  I sized up to a medium and it fits great over layers.

I REALLY like this jacket. The zippers are more decoration than function, but it works for this design. However! One of my pockets wasn't fully attached, so I had to go in and fix that before it fell completely apart. :\\ Still love it, though!

review_summary: This coat is PERFECT! I a
review_text: This coat is PERFECT! I absolutely love every single thing about it. The only downfall...your hair will get caught in the zipper for the hood if you don't have the hood rolled up. Small price to pay in my book!

review_summary: I thought this hood was g
review_text: I thought this hood was going to be a bit thicker, it actually turned out to be seethrough in the back. Despite that it's kept me quite warm. I also wanted to note that the draw strings around the neck do absolutely nothing. Is great against the colder fall weather, not yet sure how it's going to hold up in the winter but there's room for extra layers such as thick sweaters and whatnot.

review_summary: The fit runs just a bit s
review_text: The fit runs just a bit small, but looks really cute. Kinda fitted, but you could still where it over a long sleeved shirt or a thin sweater. At first the zipper didn't want to work, but it loosened after a few tries. I love the look! Very sharp!
Love this, its fitted and comfy and perfect.

I'm 5'10 and 165 lbs. I love this hoodie. I love the style, I love the heavy duty fabric, and I love the asymmetrical accents. Unfortunately, it is WAY too short. Yes, I do have along torso, but I'm used to hoodies being a little shorter than I like. This one, however, sits about two inches above the waistband on my jeans. The rest of the hoodie fits perfectly, but it's way too short to ever be wearable for me. I wish I could find a hoodie similar to this that isn't so short!

review_summary: I want to love this. I ha
review_text: I want to love this. I have been waiting to order this for over a year, and when I first received I was totally pumped to wear it all the time. The problems started after the second time wearing it: There are little straps that go around the wrists that are always sliding over my hand or coming un snapped. After resnapping for the thousandth time, the snap came off of one side. I was really disappointed since I had only worn it 23 times. The length is on the shorter side for me (long torso) so I'm pulling it down a lot. The pockets are shallow and angled at the perfect stuff is going to fall out of this angle  so I wouldn't put anything valuable in them (i.e. phone) just gloves or something. The side zippers are just decoration (would have been handy to have a phone pocked up there, but alas) The thickness and quality of the fabric is great though. It is definitely a unique look.  The hood is nice, too.  So, I will still wear this, but more as a cardigan type sweater, rather than for an outdoors light jacket, which is what I had been hoping for.

review_summary: I was eyeing this for a w
review_text: I was eyeing this for a while, and finally decided to buy it before my trip to Colorado. It surprisingly arrived 3 days after ordering and it fits AMAZINGLY. The large fits just right. (I'm 5'1 and 145lbs.) It's so warm and comfortable. Thank you ModCloth!!

I was really excited when I finally got my leipzig hoodie! When I tried it on, I was a small bit disappointed by the size. I expected it to be tighter and more fitting. In retrospect, I could have bought the smaller size, but the length of the hoodie is good and I was afraid it would be too small if I went down a size. I  was really sad to realize almost all the zippers and pockets are fake, but I was really impressed by the hood part being able to sip into the collar. All in all, this jacket is fashionable, but I can wear it everyday if wanted! I got a lot of compliments about this cool coat. Also is warm enough for the fall weather!

Good jacket, not very warm FYI, I thought it would be more of a sweater material, but that's okay. I love I can still layer another hoodie underneath. Love the look of it but it doesn't fit quite right, maybe my measurements are weird. I have wide shoulders and smaller chest and waist, so I went for a large but I do find it big around the waist area. Otherwise nice jacket!
Perfect fall jacket!  I love the weight of the material, great for chilly days and the hood is sized perfectly!  I want one in every color :)

I have received a number of compliments about this jacket and am happy with my purchase. I am a bit taller with a longer torso so the jacket is a little bit on the short side (sleeves too) but it's not so short that I can't wear it. The material is OK but not incredibly warm (you will be happy as long as you're not expecting a really thick, warm hoodie).

review_summary: I like this hoodie  it is
review_text: I like this hoodie  it is very thick an seems to be sturdy and wellmade.  There are a few things about it that I didn't quite expect, though.  The material is thick and heavy, but not very soft and kind of stiff.  I love all of the zippers and details, but not all of the zipper accents are pockets  it would be nice if there were more pockets because it would be very functional.  It runs small.  The large fits me perfectly.  It is ran any smaller I'd be returning it, though.  The sleeves have detailing around the cuffs that make the cuffs a little heavy and slightly tight.  I do think the price is a bit high for what you get.  However, I do like it enough and think I'll get enough use out of it that I will keep it.

Love this jacket, I don't think it's as heavy as some of the other reviewers have said. But it definitely runs small so I ordered the next size up and it's basically perfect. My only complaint is that it is slightly tight in the armpit/shoulder area which would make it hard to layer anything but tshirts underneath. And I by no means have broad shoulders. Otherwise love it.

I was extremely excited to receive this hoodie and was sorely disappointed when I finally got it. Everything about the fit was great, but I noticed the material was very coarse and appeared to be of a low quality. In addition, the zipper also seemed to be very low quality and was difficult to use. Because of this, I made the decision to return the jacket and search for one elsewhere. Normally, I don't have any problem with the quality of ModCloth's clothing, but I wouldn't suggest purchasing this jacket.

review_summary: I bought this coat, and w
review_text: I bought this coat, and wore it so much that when I accidentally ripped the pocket, I had to buy another one. I haven't worn this jacket once without getting a compliment. Unzipped it looks very casual, and if you zip it up all the way to the neck, it transforms into a more polished, metropolitan look, making the jacket very versatile.
it's cute, comfortable, and warm :)

review_summary: This is such a great hood
review_text: This is such a great hoodie for the fall, a bit thicker and warmer than most you can find. I really love all the little details. The wrist were a little tight but not too bad.

review_summary: No lining  I wish I had k
review_text: No lining  I wish I had known that. Where the hood zips in is a little bulky, but I like the look of this hoodie.
I LOVE my Leipzig Hoodie!  It's warm, fashionable, and not too bulky  perfect for fall in New England! :)

This jacket was my first purchase here and I was not disappointed. The quality of this jacket is great for the type of material. It's got the comfy feel of a sweatshirt but it's also thick enough to be a nice early fall or spring jacket. I love to bring this with me to the airport because it's great for the airplane. There are only a few drawbacks I can figure after a couple years of use. Yes, the wrists are a bit tight and the buttons tend to pop open when I'm putting on the jacket, especially if I have a watch on. Also, the drawstrings are SUPER long and they get caught really easily to a backpack strap or anything hanging over your shoulder. The last minor thing is that the buttons on the side pockets will scratch your hands a little bit when you put your hands in there since the other side of the button isn't covered. Other than that, the jacket is awesome and I love it as my go to accessory!
i love this sweater!! it fits perfect every where and the quality is great! can't wait for the other ones to come back in stock

Like some other people, there was a quality issue  the zipper doesn't go all the way to the top of the collar. It seems to get caught about 2 inches up, at the seam. I'll definitely be exchanging it though, because the hoodie itself is pretty great. Very thick fabric, cute design, great fit. This is more hoodie than jacket, but for those early fall or late spring days in the northeast US, it's perfect.

review_summary: Love it! I'm so glad I bo
review_text: Love it! I'm so glad I bought the medium instead of the small, even though I usually wear a small. I have really long arms (around 2 inches longer than I am tall) so it's hard to find sweaters/sweatshirts/jackets that fit my waist and my arms. This jacket definitely has long enough arms. Yes, it's not super thick but that doesn't bother me. I like to layer anyway. Super cute for someone like me who likes to wear jackets and sweatshirts but doesn't like to look grungy.

I took modcloths and many reviewers advice and ordered a size up.  The large fit me loosely in the hips and was large in the shoulders and chest, and huge in the arms.  Normally I'm a mediumlarge in modcloth's clothing.  I'm exchanging for the medium, but frankly I was a little disappointed in the quality of this sweatshirt.  I was expecting it to be a little warmer and of thicker materials than the terry cloth it is comprised.  I also for some idiotic reason though the zippers would be functional and not decorative.  It is, however, a very cute sweatshirt, and I hope the medium will fit.

This hoodie is perfect for autumn in NY. Looks great and is nice and warm for chilly fall days. I'm usually a small  but the medium fit perfectly. Do size up on this one. The small would have fit tight under my arms and the sleeves and the waist would have been short. The medium wasn't loose fitting at all. This is will fit tall, thin girls very nicely.

I have been wearing this everyday over whatever I can throw on to drop my kids off at school.  Nice and warm and comfortable.  The only thing I don't like about it is the snaps that hold the sleeve cuffs on keep unsnapping and I have to resnap often.

Perfect fit, although this is a bit short for me (if I didn't tend to like long tees this would ride up enough in the back to expose skin).  Quality is good, with the caveat that the metal accents on the draw strings look like they are plastic and may shed paint chips with time (I assume  I had a similar hoodie from Japan that did this).  Otherwise, the design is great and this is a great look for the early fall/late spring  I live in Boston  when you want to wear a hoodie but like to dress it up a bit.  The cuffs are a bit heavy, but I like this feature; it adds to the coziness factor.

I love these jackets.  I have 3 of them in olive, black, and oatmeal.  I purchased the olive in large and it was a perfect fit for my long body but when I purchased the black one, I didn't notice the runs small disclaimer on the black one.  Well it's definitely too small and I have to stretch the sleeves and hold them in place when I wear it, but I still like the jacket.  I've got long arms and this happens to me all the time, so I'm not too annoyed by it (partially because its my fault for not noticing the size is smaller than it should), but hey there's nothing bigger than large in these so I'll keep it and deal with it.  The large feels like a medium so be careful when purchasing this black one.

LOVE this hoodie. It's perfect. Super happy I sized up and did the large. It is very roomy but also still fitted. I am short and kinda boxy but it made me look much better than I thought. I have no problems with it so far and can't wait to start wearing it a lot in the fall and winter. The cuffs are heavier and a bit tight but I have small hands and wrists so its not a problem for me. I heard other reviews say that theirs arrived with a chemical smell but mine had none at all. The zipper could be better but I haven't had any problems with it getting stuck or fraying. The structure of it is great, thick but not too thick, and feels well made altogether. Overall probably my favorite purchase so far from Modcloth. :D

review_summary: Just in case you really w
review_text: Just in case you really want to be able to roll up the hood and hide it, like I did, it's not practical. You end up with a thick roll that is almost impossible to zip over. The added detail a the sleeve cuffs make for some extra bulk around the wrists that is kind of annoying. Cute light jacket/hoodie though. I'd say it has the same warmth as an average hoodie, maybe slightly thicker. I thought it would be more sleek from the photos, but I still like it.

review_summary: When I put this hoodie on
review_text: When I put this hoodie on, I go from normal me to awesomeness in seconds. It just drips confidence. It is not lined on the inside, so you will know the seams are there, but it hasn't been a problem for me.  I know other reviewers were disappointed by the quality; mine has been just great.  No worries there. As I said before, the real charming power of this piece stems from the way it looks when you wear it. Love love!

review_summary: Just a teensy bit on the
review_text: Just a teensy bit on the big side (the sleeves come down over my hands, and I got a medium (I'm usually a medium).  Otherwise everything fits great.The material is thinner than I thought it would be, leaving me colder than I had been expecting from the Leipzig Hoodie.All in all, I sill like it a lot!

I absolutely adore this!  It's super comfortable, fits me really well, and has gotten a lot of compliments.  It has just the right amount of warmth for a nice fall/spring outer layer, and it's not too bulky.  Love!
Totally cute.  Was a little shorter than I expected.  It's actually a little heavy...not heavy like material thickness, but actually heavy.  But, all in all..cute.

review_summary: As soon as I saw this, I
review_text: As soon as I saw this, I knew I wanted it.  It is made out of a french terry material and it works really well with many outfits; dressing up with a nice pair of denim and heels, as well as dressing down with a tshirt and flats.  All the little details really set this jacket apart from just another boring jacket.  The only thing I wish was that the zippers on the chest weren't just decorative, but I can understand if it would ruin the shape/aesthetic of the jacket.  The hood is detachable, too.  I'm 5'8 and the length was just right. Love it!

I read through many reviews seeing who had my measurements and I'm glad I went with the small. It's snug around the wrists but if you need, just unbutton the tab and wrap around after you put it on. I have enough room for a thin sweater underneath if needed.
I usually order a medium in mod cloth shirts and this time i ordered a large for this item. im glad i did. overall great hoodie but a bit disappointed that most of the pockets arent real.

FIT:First off, I was wrong in ordering a L. I usually order a medium or a small, but I wanted to be able to layer it (which I can, so that's nice) and I wanted to make sure it would be long enough. LENGTH: I don't like hoodies to be shorter than the button of my pants and even the L is just barely cutting it.. the thing is, if I were to get a M, it would probably be at the same level because the L is so loose at the bottom (which is my own fault, THANKS GOODNESS for the elasticized waist!!) That being said, the arms are the perfect length! I like any longsleeved shirts to perfectly tucked into my hands and these ones are chunky and awesome to boot! QUALITY: The quality is amazing. The only thing I didn't like is the zipper that holds the hood in the collar; I find that it gets caught when you tried to close it, but if you try to squeeze the zipper together while you close it, it's not so bad. Also, I think I may cut open the seams of the decorative zippers on the chest to put pockets in. The main pockets are big and though they seem like they wouldn't be, they're at the right angle where things don't drop out (the button flaps don't cover the pockets, oddly). But other than that, it's just like I imagined; a really nice, thick sweater for the colder months. I wouldn't recommend wearing this in the winter where I live (Canada), but it would work for warmer fall/spring days.Overall, I'm happy I bought this.. just buy it in your normal size!
Overall, I'm happy with it. It might be a little small around the chest area.

review_summary: I like the punky feel of
review_text: I like the punky feel of this hoodie. It's not very heavy so I wouldn't use it past the fall if you live anywhere where winter is actually cold. I also think it's pretty tight fitting and runs on the small side but it's worth buying for style purposes.

review_summary: I was iffy about this pur
review_text: I was iffy about this purchase. I thought that it was very pretty, but it looked maybe a bit too long and thin for what I wanted. I bought it knowing I could easily return it if I didn't like it. I immediately fell in love with it the moment I tried it on. Perfect length for sleeves and torso, gorgeous style, thick and warm enough to withstand the pseudo California winter that rears it's unthreatening head a few months of the year. The material is great quality. Worth every penny, and very flattering. I have a somewhat curvier frame, so the large fits me incredibly well. Loose enough I don't feel suffocated, but tight enough to still feel flattering. You simply can't go wrong with this jacket!

I really, really, really wanted this jacket. It was my first Modcloth order ever (I'm waiting for my next one to come in 2 days from now) (!!!) It is a bit small for my size, especially in the shoulders. The length of the arms is perfect, I just wish the torso was 2 inches longer. It fits my bust and waist perfectly, but I hate to have to pull it down. I'm tempted to return it, but I love it too much to ever part ways.

review_summary: On one hand, the last thi
review_text: On one hand, the last thing I needed was a hoodie, but on the other, I thought this was the perfect replacement for the faded black hoodie I had loved for so long.  I am quite pleased with the quality of this.The fit is great. I am an hourglass shape and more often than not, casual items fit great on top, but look dowdy and baggy on my waist.  This hoodie is cut nicely, so I still feel like my curves show without being disproportionate.The material is a midtoheavy weight. It's not the softest fabric I've felt from a MC item, but it's what you'd expect.  The color is rich and black. I anticipate it will fade greatly over the wash cycle, but every 10 or so washings, I'll just put it into a dye bath of RIT black to refresh it like I have with other items that tend to fade.I felt the detail was true to the picture and while some reviewers have complained about the tight wrists, I happen to feel that they are just right.  One of my least favorite things is having cuffs that stretch out long before the garment is ready to go, and I do not have that fear with the way this is constructed.I like enough that I will likely order another one in the near future.

Love this hoodie! It's super comfy and stylish. You can wear it when you'd wear a regular hoodie, but look way nicer.Fit: I haven't had any problems with the wrists being too small. They fit me great  though I do have rather petite hands. I have fairly broad shoulders and the large fits me perfectly. Roomy enough to be comfy but still fitted enough to look good. I have a longish torso for my height and it's long enough to handle that without scooting up around my hips too much.Quality: It doesn't feel superbly made, but it's not bad. I don't think it'll fall apart immediately. I plan on not putting it in the dryer to avoid fading. The material is thin terry hoodie material, rather than being the super soft fleece hoodies are usually made of. As others have mentioned, the hood itself is even thinner than the rest of the material, because it tucks into the neck. I suspect I'll mostly keep it zipped away. The button pockets on the bottom are real pockets, but the button flaps are just for show. As others have mentioned, the zipper pockets up top are fake.Overall, I'm very pleased and happy to have an interesting hoodie that fits me well!

review_summary: First off, I need to say
review_text: First off, I need to say that randomly posting that an article of clothing fits wrong! without offering your measurements and the size of the item you bought is, to quote Jack Sparrow, maddeningly unhelpful, and I wish you wouldn't. Okay, as for this hooded sweater... It is very heavyweight. I don't find the hood to be flimsy, it's the same as any other hooded sweater, but compared to the thickness of the sweater itself, it may seem thin. The shirt did not come to me with an odd smell or anything of the sort, thankfully. It isn't as long as I thought, but it's about the same as every other hoodie I've bought. To me, the medium fits like a medium, so you have to just try it, I guess.  I have somewhat long arms, and the sleeves hit at the wrist. In the pictures, I'm wearing size 4 LEVI'S that are midlength, and the hoodie sits about halfway over my belt loops, just for length and size reference.  I agree with all the others who say the hardware is cheap  I haven't had anything fall off yet, but so far I'm treating it with kid gloves because I can see how the snaps are simply shoved through the fabric. The zipper is metal and does seem a bit sticky, so I'm being careful with it.  The cuffs are not at all too tight for me, so I haven't needed to snap or unsnap anything.  I like the metal detailing, and I think it's possible that the hoodie could be used as a layering piece, but for me it is already very warm.

Very happy with the purchase. The only two things I wasn't happy about were that the opening zipper is actually TWO zippers, and doesn't fully come undone: meaning you have to slide the hoodie over your head or down your legs to get it off or on. I frequently prefer to wear my hoodies open so that part sucks.The second thing is that no sooner had the item gotten back in stock and I snatched it up, but ModCloth came out with 2 new colors for this item and decided to notify me of such. I was very disappointed that I now had the  brown one when I would have rather had the cream one. But I'm already hassling with several returns/exchanges so I can't be bothered.Oh well, I'm happy overall. :)

review_summary: This reminds me of the ja
review_text: This reminds me of the jackets in Germany that I saw when I was studying abroad there.  I absolutely love the look and fit.  At first I thought the material was thinner than some of the other reviews led me to believe, but after wearing the jacket once or twice I realized that the jacket was much heavier and warmer than I originally thought.  It's perfect for a fall to early winterish temperatures, or for those crisp and chilly but dry days.

I absolutely LOVE this! Unlike some others, I have no problem with the wrist size, it's perfect. I thought that the hood zipping away would make it bulky, but I like it better with the hood tucked away. I have nothing bad to say about it.

review_summary: The fabric is thin in the
review_text: The fabric is thin in the torso area, I wasn't expecting that kind of a thick waffle knit. The sleeves are heavier cotton construction, though the wrist cuff is exceptionally clunky and much wider than the sleeve.I think I'll be able to hide that or move the button to make them tighter, and I do like the silhouette.

review_summary: I love this hoodie, and d
review_text: I love this hoodie, and discovered that it was tagged pretty true to size. Initially I ordered a medium, but by some twist of fate, a small was shipped and it fit perfectly. Great quality, with a nice dense fabric that will be perfect for our PNW fall weather. Thanks! :)
Very nice jacket. I love the look, very military/steampunk. Fits nicely. I just wish the interior were a little softer.

review_summary: I love the look of this h
review_text: I love the look of this hoodie, but I wish the body was a bit longer. This is my new favorite piece of clothing regardless. Thanks!

review_summary: I've been in love with th
review_text: I've been in love with this hoodie for YEARS (has it even been around that long? Maybe it just felt like years...) and impulse bought it the moment it was back in stock. It was only after I purchased it that I read the reviews and was immediately a little nervous about the impending quality. But! Everything is intact, seems sturdy, and the hoodie fits PERFECT. I can't wait for fall to happen so I can wear this everywhere.

review_summary: So Ive had this jacket si
review_text: So Ive had this jacket since Christmas 2011...I love this jacket! It goes well with so many things. The downside is the pockets make it sorta look like you have a spare tire around the midsection. The odd smell some people have mentioned does linger a bit but some perfume sprayed on it helps. I basically wore this every day of winter and in Ireland (the picture I've included has me wearing it at the Kingshead in Galway Ireland in march)...and with so much wear its gotten holes but when I say i wear it a lot, i mean A LOT. My favorite bit is that the hood i big enough to actually fit like a hood rather then barely graze ones head like many hoods do. I definitely plan on buying another one of these!

review_summary: One of my most favorite j
review_text: One of my most favorite jackets!  It is a thick sweater shirt and definitely good quality.  I hesitated at purchasing such an expensive sweat shirt, but every time I visited Modcloth I kept eyeing it.  So finally I decided to get it and do not regret it!  I sized up to Medium and am very glad I did so.  A small would have been skin tight on me and impossible for layering.

I've been waiting for this hoodie to come back in stock for almost a year, and I'm in love with it! It's a heavy cotton material gives me a cozy warm feeling when I put it on and I Love the zipper and pocket accents. Definitely something worth the wait!

review_summary: Ah, I am bummed it didn't
review_text: Ah, I am bummed it didn't work out. The hoodie was too short for my torso. I like it when I reach up it still covers my stomach and doesn't take my shirt up too much. The hoodie didn't sit well on me when I wore jeans either.  The sleeves didn't fit up against my armpit area, or against my body very well. The quality is good. The fit just wasn't for me though. I wanted something more form fitting that stayed in place.My shoulder length is about 16.

review_summary: I usually buy a medium in
review_text: I usually buy a medium in Modcloth items, but because it was a jacket, and I planned on layering, I sized up. Turned out to be a good idea, because it does run a little small, from what I can tell.This was, hands down, the best item of clothing I packed for my midMay honeymoon. It was perfect to throw over a tee shirt (or a tee and thin cardigan), the black paired with skinny jeans kept me from looking sloppy while wearing a hoodie, and the hood/no hood option came in handy during a couple of surprise rain showers.It's a perfect transition weather jacket. I wouldn't wear this out when it's below 45, but for chilly spring or autumn days, this is going to be my goto overshirt.I'm looking forward to the new color!

review_summary: Runs large. I like the lo
review_text: Runs large. I like the look and length of this jacket, my only complaint is that it has an odor that does not wash out. It is a chemically smell, perhaps from the dye, but in any case it prevents me from wearing it on most occasions because it is so strong. No one has commented on the smell, but I can smell it and it bothers me.

This is the perfect jacket.  It goes over anything and can range from casual to dressed up.  It is super warm.  I find the hoodie to be a little thin and small and impractical so I don't wear that portion much.  I also find the arms aren't as long as the other reviews made me thing they might be.  I actually hoped they would be a little longer. This jacket is worth the buy!

I absolutely LOVE this hoodie. It's so great for chilly spring mornings! Probably my favorite hoodie I've ever had. By the way, if you're buying this (and you should!) remember that the hoodie is hidden in a zipper compartment. When I first got this jacket, I was so amazed, I kept finding pockets and zippers everywhere ^_^

review_summary: This is the best hoodie I
review_text: This is the best hoodie I have ever bought!  Perfect for rainy, cool days when you don't want to wear a full coat.  It does bunch around the waist sometimes, but nothing a quick pull down can't fix.  The snaps on the wrist sometimes fling off if I catch it on something, but that is also a quick fix.  I do wish there were full pockets that keep stuff secure, but I can put my iphone in them and it stays, (although I probably wouldn't ride around on a bike or run with it in there).  It looks super bad ass, and looks awesome with cute flats, skinny jeans and the headband ModCloth sent with it!

review_summary: I bought this in a Medium
review_text: I bought this in a Medium and was super pleased with my purchase...for about a week.  That's when I noticed that a the stitching that attaches the pocket on the left side had come out leaving a hole behind.  And because this is a knit item, that hole is just getting bigger and bigger.  Plus the right one looks equally poorly put together and is about to come out as well.  Meaning that in a short while I will have a once cool jacket with two giant holes in it.  And I've only had the thing for two weeks!  I'm so ticked off about how poorly these are made!

PERFECT jacket with attitude. Worried about the fit  but Small was perfect for me despite a larger chest. Wrists aren't tight persay, but the cuffs are stiff.  I have a ridiculous never ending torso  the jacket still hits me right above the hips.  There is a whiff of...plastic? Storage? when you take it out of the bag, nothing that won't dissipate over time.  All in all, I am thrilled with this purchase.

When Modcloth says size up here, they mean size WAY up. Thankfully, I opted for the large. I'd coveted this for nearly a year before finally pulling the trigger and boy am I glad that I did!  This is warm. I almost feel like it hugs me. Keep in mind that I bought the large and it is very tight in the chest. I am thin  about 115 pounds  and barely a C cup. If you are any larger, even the large may be too tight for you.  If you can get into this, you will never regret the purchase.

review_summary: I love this jacket.  My f
review_text: I love this jacket.  My friend purchased one and the snaps on the wrists broke.  But because I'm not afriad to repair my own clothes I bought it anyway. The quality is fine, all the seams are sewn well etc.  It does run a little big, but I bought the Large just in case in shrunk in the wash.  My only complaint is that the fabric around the wrists is a bit bulky and awkward.
Warm and stylish :). I didn't find the sleeves to be excessively smallthey're meant to be cuffed, and complement the structure of the collar well.

Great sweater with a very good fit. My only minor issues were that the cuffs on the sleeves are a little bulky, and the hood is more or less nonfunctional. I always keep the hood rolled into the collar because I can't imagine it being of much practical use (it's very thin and small), but this doesn't affect the amount of use I get out of the garment :)

I didn't realize that most of the zippers and buttons are decorative, but nonetheless I love this jacket. It's very flattering and I feel very sophisticated yet still casual wearing it. It's not particularly warm, but now that the weather is heating up in San Francisco, it'll be perfect.
This jacket is amazing, It will keep you pretty warm considering it's only cotton. It has been and still is a good investment.

review_summary: im normally a medium in t
review_text: im normally a medium in tops, but defiantly size up!! i got a large, anything smaller would be too tight. its excellent quality, really thick. shorter than it looks in the picture though.

I bought this hoodie along with the olive skinny jeans and both are perfect. The hoodie is a great layering piece.  It will be great jacket in the warmer weather and is thin enough to wear under my coat in the winter.

review_summary: I am very happy with this
review_text: I am very happy with this jacket! I am usually a size small, but reading the comment left by modcloth, I sized up to a medium. Fits great! Still enough room for me to layer underneath. Wish the upper zippers were useable, but I am fine with that!

This was my first purchase from ModCloth, so I wasn't entirely sure what to expect. I had had my eye on this for quite some time, so when it came back in stock, I decided to buy it. After reading the other buyers' reviews, I was a little bit wary about the possible length problem, since I am over 5'9 and very skinny. My biggest issue with most clothing is the length (including sleeve length, since I have long arms). It is hard for me to find clothing that is long enough AND slim enough. To be on the safe side, I purchased a large, figuring I could always take it in if it were too wide. Luckily, I didn't have to. When the hoodie came today, I was excited and curious to see how it fit and looked. As soon as I took it out of the package, I was in love. The material was nice, and it was so gosh darn cute! When I put it on, it fit me perfectly, resting halfway down my hips. The sleeves were long enough, coming a couple of inches down my hand. It was slim enough to look attractive, even on my tiny frame, yet loose enough to be comfortable. My advice for anyone looking to buy this  SIZE UP. If a large can fit a string bean like me, then sizing up should be no problem for anyone else. Appearancewise, this is now one of my favorite articles of clothing. It's edgy and unique, quite different than a lot of jackets you see in the store. I wore it with a pair of red skinny jeans and a gray tee shirt. Definitely wellworth the price.

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this jacket the moment I saw it. I have to say I was really torn between a M and a L and ended up going M. I am happy with the size. I like my jackets more form fitting and the M is just that on me. I still have enough room in the jacket to wear a light sweater under it as well. So I would say if you are around my size and want a tighter fit, go M, a more roomy fit, go L. I would label this jacket as only a little runs small for the most part I would call it more true to size. My only pet peeve is I wish it was a few inches longer. If you are really tall (I'm 5'2) I would imagine the sleeves will be too short. On my small height the sleeves are just right. Also as some others have mentioned I did not have any problems with buttons falling off nor do I find the sleeve cuffs to be tight. Came in perfect condition and the quality is top notch. I also love that the hood will roll up into a zipper pouch at the neck line if you want. Go for it. You will love it!

review_summary: I bought this Jacket a wh
review_text: I bought this Jacket a while ago and I love it so much! I just noticed it has been restocked so don't miss out. I truly love this sweater/jacket. It is comfy and has a very cool look. Always get compliments!

Definitely do what ModCloth recommends: size up! I'm normally a small/medium and had to get a large. Granted, I do have broad shoulders but it fits PERFECTLY in a large for me. Love this hoodie. Normally, I would never spend this much on this type of garment but it's unique and made well enough that it is worth it ;) On a warmth scale, I'd say 3 out of 5. There are snaps on the sleeves to tighten it to your wrists which is really nice for chilly breezy days. The hood is hidden in a zipped pocket. It's very stealth looking on and in person. The collar sits high.
Love it! Great fit.

review_summary: I loved this hoodie for a
review_text: I loved this hoodie for almost exactly 1 year before the zipper broke. I am waiting for them to restock it in my size so I can buy it again. If they don't do it soon I may have to stop being lazy and go replace the zipper on my own. Much cuter than an average hoodie, but not much warmer.

I love this jacket! It's more of a coat than a hoodie, really, but I wear it a lot since it has a much more polished look to it than a typical hoodie. The only thing I didn't like were these snap things around the cuffs of the sleeves, but I just carefully snipped them off and now it's perfect.

Easily my best purchase at Modcloth. Not only is this hoodie warm, but incredibly unique and stylish. A nice change from boring hoodies you might normally wear. Also, the quality is fantastic. This is worth every penny!

review_summary: I should have sized up! I
review_text: I should have sized up! It was a bit snug on me, so I ended up giving it to my sister as a present. She loves it! and it looks great on her.
This hoodie is super comfy and nicely form fitted. Love it!

I really loved this jacket when I first got it. The fit was so perfect and so was the length. It looked really good on me. But, the second day I wore it the button on the cuff broke off. I had it fixed, assuming it was just an accident. Then a week later the zipper broke. It's a shame that that it was constructed so poorly because it really is a beautiful jacket..

I'm a size 4, and always have issues finding jackets that fit due to my broader shoulders and more muscular arms, hence I got a medium, and it fits wonderfully!  Don't expect it to keep you super warm on cold days, but it certainly works in overly air conditioned buildings. :)  My only complaint is the wrists are little small preventing any pushing up of the sleeves.  The quality and style are awesome and I love the hideaway hood.

I was really impressed when I received this jacket  the material is very heavy and all of the adornments are well crafted and securely attached.  Seams are solid.  And amazingly the hood really does pack into the little zipper pouch without looking bulky or bunchy.  I will order any other items from this label again.  Great purchase for the price.

review_summary: This is a crazy cute jack
review_text: This is a crazy cute jacket that I liked for lots of reasons (the sleeves were long, just how I like them). Unfortunately, the jacket fell a tad short on me (I'm 5'8), but it wouldn't have been a dealbreaker EXCEPT that the zipper broke two weeks after I started wearing it. I'm sure I could get it fixed, but it's a huge disappointment.

review_text: I had to buy a large. But I can't get the hoodie out, I just got this item today and the zipper is stuck and I really want to see the hoodie. How can I do that?

review_text: I had to buy a large. But I can't get the hoodie out, I just got this item today and the zipper is stuck and I really want to see the hoodie. How can I do that?

review_summary: I love my jacket, it's wa
review_text: I love my jacket, it's warm, it's convertible, it matches with everything. The only downside is the snap on buttons fall off and the zippers lead no where. I'm gonna have to take it in to get new buttons and add pockets to the zippers.

It was super warm (and I'm chronically cold) and looked perfectly fitted while still leaving enough room for my hands in my pockets (it didn't get tight in the middle or get that funnylooking bulge). I wish I could get it in olive too!

review_summary: So here's the thing:  I h
review_text: So here's the thing:  I have been stalking this hoodie since it went out of stock a few months ago, and I bought it as soon as it was available again.  I love everything about it  it fits perfectly, looks great, cool pockets and details, warm enough for chilly autumn days  EXCEPT the snaps are made out of some cheapo metal and the one of my left wrist broke off the first time I unsnapped it.  (I know, ModCloth, you're going to say I should contact customer service, but I love the hoodie and want to wear it and didn't want to deal with returns, so I just safetypinned it instead...).  Also, the hood is not really substantial enough to be a hood (in case you want to keep your head supercozy).  That said, I still would easily recommend this item.  In fact, I'm wearing it right now (so maybe I'm a little biased).

Overall this jacket looks great. I do have a few gripes, however. The cuffs are a bit bulky, the hood is useless, and there is a string that looks like it would be used for the hood to make it tight but it's actually just for show. These things didn't stop me from buying it because it fits nicely and I really like the high neck.

love this jacket, though since I'm an elbowleaner, I wore a hole through it fairly quickly within a year. Still holds up well. No actual pockets where the zippers are located. Easy enough to fix that. :)

I love this hoodie! It's a lot warmer than I was expecting it to be, and the wrists actually fit pretty well. However, the stitching is pretty weak, especially for the price. The buttons were poor quality as well; two of them wouldn't button and fell off.

review_summary: I was waiting all year fo
review_text: I was waiting all year for this to come back in stock! I absolutely love this purchase, though a little disappointed that the pockets and zippers were just for show and the buttons are fragile. I also want to comment on ModCloth's speedy shipping I had to return this item at first because they sent a large, but my correct size arrived shortly after I put the exchange in the mail.

I absolutely love this hoody! Its adorable and sliming, fits perfect! However, it being my first purchase from modcloth, I was a little disappointed with the quality! The first time I wore it the button on the sleeve broke and when its not buttoned theres an awkward strap that hangs from the sleeve! Reading the reviews now, I realized that I am not the only one that has had this issue!

review_summary: So I'm the tall and gangl
review_text: So I'm the tall and gangly type and I was really worried going in that a small wouldn't cover my long arms but this coat works perfectly. It has instantly gone up to the favorite coat in my closet. I get so many compliments when I wear it. It's so comfortable and I couldn't love it enough!

I bought this jacket close to a year ago and it was my absolute favourite  I wore it everywhere! Many people asked me where I purchased it, and I sent them all to ModCloth :) It fits very well, however, the zipper isn't the best quality. After struggling with it for a few months, it finally broke and will no longer zip up (keeps on unzipping from the bottom up). I'm heartbroken, as I wore it everywhere for 8+ months, however I cannot justify buying it again just to have the zipper break. Be careful with the zipper if you do purchase!!

review_summary: It runs just a little bit
review_text: It runs just a little bit snug currently but I figure I should have taken a slightly bigger size. I can't wear it with anything else than short sleeves or sleeveless underneath for the snug of the sleeves. Otherwise it's comfortable, it's just warm enough and I wear it whenever I can. Perfect for a motorcycle ride.

What a bummer! This sweatshirt is absolutely adorable all of the metal detailing is fun and unique unfortunately, I have already been through two of these because the snaps keep popping off. Super cute, but the quality of the snaps is a total disappointment. The material is great, though. It is nice and thick. I would recommend if I hadn't been through two defective ones already.

I love this jacket. It's perfect for fall weather. When it arrived the snap buttons on the wrist part of the sleeves had fallen off. I sewed them back on it was no big deal. It does fit on the smaller side but for me its perfect.
Love it!
Love this piece, slimming, great details and warm

I love this hoodie!  Like other reviewers, I noticed a chemical smell when I first opened the bag, but this went away when I washed it.  There were some loose threads on the hoodie when it arrived, but I sniped them off the material has held up very well after multiple washings.  The wrists are fitted (you won't be able to push your sleeves up) but not tight or overly restrictive.  I'm very happy with this purchase!

review_summary: wore it a couple times, w
review_text: wore it a couple times, washed it a couple times and the zipper is done. It wasnt great to begin, very sticky, but now it is completely done. I dont think I rec'd a defective one since the zippers on the pockets were of the same quality.  Love it, super cute, but it wont zip :(

review_summary: I love the way this hoody
review_text: I love the way this hoody looks.  I also love the way I feel when I wear it.  My only slight complaint is that the cuffs around the wrists are really tight, thereby making putting the coat on a smidge difficult.  But that is not something that would sway me from buying a product.  Oh, it also took 2 restocks of this coat before there was finally one available to buy, haha.  But the wait was worth it!

review_summary: I love love love this jac
review_text: I love love love this jacket!!! Its very form fitting and long (great for a tall girl like myself). I ordered a size up and the fit is perfect.

I've waited for this jacket for months before it came back out and i couldn't be happier with it. :) It fits snug which i prefer. So glad i finally got this jacket. Can't wait for fall to get here so my jacket can makes it's appearance.

review_summary: I've had my eye on this j
review_text: I've had my eye on this jacket for over a year, and finally grabbed in while it was back in stock. I wore it out once and got many compliments! I am in LOVE with it and I'm sure it's going to be an essential part of my wardrobe come fall/winter. My only complaint is that when zipped up, its a bit tight in the chest area, which is almost always a problem for me (being a 32F). Its an easy fix, I just won't zip it up all the way. Leaving a review in case this is restocked. I fell in love with this hoodie the second I saw it. I keep a stock of structured black hoodies for those chilly mornings when I wake up late and have no time to throw together a real outfit. Hoodie, skinny jeans, boots, keys, out the door. So, in my case, 64 dollars is a morethanfair price for a goto item. Or, rather, it would have been if the zipper hadn't broken the second time I wore it. Otherwise the jacket is solid, but the zipper was junk. Thankfully, Modcloth Customer Service refunded me a portion of the cost to have the zipper repaired. I had it replaced with a betterlooking and, er, functional black zipper and can't wait until it's cool enough outside to wear it again. Oh, in case it matters: the only other possible downside is that the zipped pockets on the chest are not functional and I wouldn't dare to put anything in the loose hippockets. But this hoodie is so slick that I don't mind.

review_summary: I LOVE this hoodie.  I am
review_text: I LOVE this hoodie.  I am a very athletic girl, I am 5'8 with broad shoulders and a sizable bust (a D cup).  My Large Leipzig Hoodie fits like a glove.  The materiel has enough give that I can zip it up all the way and still comfortably go about my day, moving my arms, breathing, looking fantastic... you know, the usual.  It is really more of a jacket then a basic hoodie, yet still light enough to wear indoors and out.  You can dress it up with a skirt or keep it casual with jeans, I've paired it with a wide gambit of outfits and it always looks good.   From your favorite band's gig, to camping with your friends and back to that hole in the wall bar you frequent this hoddie fits everywhere.  One of the best things about the Leipzig is its tailored fit, you get the comfort of a hoodie with the structure of a blazer.  It comes in at the waist to accentuate your curves in all the right ways.  This jacket QUICKLY became my favorite cozy cover up.  To be completely honest I was sad to pack it away with my sweaters for the summer, but find myself looking forward to that first chilly spell and the opportunity to ROCK this hoodie again and again.

LOVE this jacket! I have a long torso so I often find that most hoodies are too square and short for me but this one is perfect! Its very slimming and perfect for fall. One of the snaps for the wrist cuff fell off but that was an easy fix so otherwise I'm happy!

It fits perfectly and hugs just right at the waist.  It goes with everything and is super flattering.  Also, it's much warmer than it looks.  I recommend it to everyone.

review_summary: Wow!!  I got an email at
review_text: Wow!!  I got an email at work 2 days ago that this hoodie was back in stock.  Within ten minutes when I logged on to place my order, there was only one left AND it was in my size! I only plan on wearing tees or lighter type shirts underneath. Also, there was mention of a chemical type smell or dampness  no dampness, I detected a little odor I guess, but I chalk it up to processed fabric.  Nothing harmful or obnoxious or that the first wash won't fix.  Overall, amazing, everything I wanted it to be AND it was here in TWO days!!!  First Modcloth purchase = SUCCESS!

review_summary: I had been looking at thi
review_text: I had been looking at this item for awhile and wasn't sure if I wanted to buy it or not. I ended up getting it as a Christmas present, and I am so glad I did. As far as quality goes, outside of a few stray threads that needed trimming, the biggest problem I've had is the metal zipper, although not defective, is difficult to use easily, particularly at the connecting point at the bottom.  As far as fit goes, I ordered the Medium, my normal size, and I'm 5'4 and 130135 lbs. 34 bust, 30 waist. It's become my daily outerwear for these 65 degree weather days, although I wouldn't trust it to keep me warm below 60 without additional thin thermal layering, not much extra bulk would be able to fit under it. review_text: Wow!  This is my third purchase from ModCloth so far, and by far my favorite!  It fits perfectly  I am 5'7 and 150 pounds. I can have a seamstress or tailor very inexpensively add some pockets in for me though, as the pockets that rest on the hip are not very deep, and things will easily fall out of those.  My other issue was that the main zipper of the jacket seems a little cheap  it didn't zip up and down super easily and got caught sometimes.  Other than those 2 small items, this jacket is just wonderful, and I look really sharp in it.

Its even cheaper now than it was when I bought it, id say to anyone considering this to definitely order it.

review_summary: I want to love this coat,
review_text: I want to love this coat, I really do but the quality is horrible. It's not that if was made with cheap material. It was if the quality control team (If there is one) didn't assess this coat before it was sent out to me. When I first opened the box I was very excited and than it slowly diminished after I realize that a button was sewn on poorly. The middle right button is stitched on through on hole, making not secure. It's hanging on one piece of thread. On the left side the seam is coming undone and there is also a hole in my pocket. When you buy an item over a hundred dollars you don't expect to have to spend more money to fix damages. Also I found the arms really short compared to the length of the coat, which I don't really mind because I know I have long appendages. However I am usually a small extra small in size so when I went a size up you expect the arms to be a bit longer. The color is beautiful and I love the oversized hood.

review_summary: Every time I leave the ho

The only thing I'm not really happy about is how easily the lining tears. Within a few days of wearing it, the lining had begun separating from the exterior of the coat at one of the wrists, and now one of the pockets has a fistsized hole in it. I tend to lose change into the body of the coat and jingle until I take the time to fish it out. It's not something I would ever send it back over, because a good coat is hard to find, but keep this in mind when purchasing this coat: the lining is much lower quality than it could be.

review_summary: I LOVE this coat! Love it

The coat keeps me nice and warm, too: on a normal Minnesota winter day, I can wear it with or without a scarf (because the hood kind of acts as its own scarf!) over my normal clothes and stay perfectly warm. On a really really cold day, I wear a hat under the hood and wear layers, but that's no different than any other cold weather outfit I would wear with any winter coat. Seriously, you need this coat!

review_summary: Oh. Em. Gee. This coat is
review_text: Oh. Em. Gee. This coat is PERFECT! I was stalking modcloth's website until they listed more and lo and behold, they did. I consulted with a stylist because I was unsure of the proper size for me. I'll admit, I was a little skeptical when she told me to go for an XL but I'm glad I did. I definitely dont' have super broad shoulders but my, ehm, girls make buttoning most shirts impossible. The coat fits over them but isn't a complete potato sack in the waist, the tie is perfect in that respect. The arms are perfect length. It's a bit heavy, like other reviewers have said, but I think for a winter in Philly I will be grateful to have such snuggly and adorable outerwear! I initially thought the color online looked a bit frumpy, but it's better in person. And the hood...so amazing. Its like  a built in scarf around your neck and whimsically adorable when you wear it on your head. All in all, I wish it were colder now so I could wear it asap!

review_text: This is a great coat! I wore it out today in 30C weather and was fine. I love that it combines brown and black, and the fabric is soft and kind of 70s couchlike up close but still nice? The hood on it is HUGE! If I just pull it up, it hangs right over my face, but folding it back it's a little like a fairy tale cloak! I'm a busty 1x and bought this in a 2x and it fits with no gaping of the buttons, even when I'm wearing a sweater underneath.

review_summary: I was really needing a wi
review_text: I was really needing a winter coat and fell in love with this one when I saw it online. I usually wear xsmall and smalls in modcloth clothes, but I ended up getting a medium. Since it was a coat I knew I'd size up to make room for thick sweaters, plus it was sold out in smalls anyway. The medium fits perfect. It's roomy enough to fit the thickest of my winter layers yet it still allows me to have the appearance of a slender figure. I love how soft it is, and especially how warm, the built in hood/neck warmer is a nice touch, too! I'm not sure why there is so many complaints about the buttons being loose, mine feel like they're sewn on pretty sturdy (I agree with the reviewer who said if the buttons were any tighter you wouldn't be able to button the coat). The color is great too, I love that I can wear this with blacks and browns. Overall, I am very happy with this coat and I would definitely recommend it to everyone, especially people who get cold easily and tend to run out the door and forget your scarf/hat/ear warmer headband.

review_summary: Cute jacket but not navy as represented (check plus pics for
review_text: I ordered this based on what appeared on both of my computer screens (at work and home) to be a lovely dusty navy color, as well as the cute style.  Unfortunately, what arrived is more of a royal blue than a navy, a bright color that's not at all muted.  If you're looking for the accurate color, look at the plus size pics.  I'm still on the fence about keeping it, as I wear fairly greyed, muted tones, and this doesn't seem to go with anything in my wardrobe.  It's just such a cute style, though.  I am usually about an 8, so order either M or L.  I sized up to L because of my height, and found that it's an exact fit, but almost too exact  as in I have no extra room in the shoulders, and the sleeves are on the verge of being too short.  So I've ordered an XL to see if that fits better.  Overall, if you like the color and are not tall like me, I think you'll love this jacket.  I'm only sad it's not the muted navy shown in the photos.

The reason I am not giving it 5 stars is because there is no lining and the fabric started getting pilly within a week or two. I hand wash and air dry it because I'm afraid of it getting wrecked in a machine. review_summary: The size small fit me per
review_text: The size small fit me perfect at the shoulders and bust, but the waist was too large and shapeless on me. I also felt that the material was thinner and cheaper feeling than this style of coat warrants. If you are going to wear a bright red coat with fur lined cuffs and a hood, it will probably be in fairly cold and snowy weather, and this coat didn't feel thick or warm enough for that.

I was a little nervous about this coat because I'm often between sizes and have trouble finding things that fit me well (especially with other reviewers saying this coat ran small), but I took a gamble and ordered my usual size. It totally exceeded my expectations! It gives me plenty of room while still hugging me in a flattering way, and the arms aren't so tight that I won't be able to hug people. Plus it made me feel like a Russian countess, which I totally dig.     It IS a little longthe hand pockets fall slightly below where my hands naturally hangbut not so much that the pockets are unusable. Also, I might reinforce the buttons; these felt like they would fly off if I undid them too quickly. The fabric and faux fur felt pretty highquality, not overly felty like some manmade materials (I'm vegan and can't wear wool, so this has been a long quest). Overall I'm really happy. So much so that I had to come write my firstever Modcloth review! :)

This jacket looks fantastic. It's truly warm and will make a great winter coat. However, it's flawed in that in does run small. I sized up, but I can't button the top button and the arms are a bit tight. However, it fits perfectly everywhere else, so going up another size isn't a good idea. Other people love the way it looks on me so I don't think the one button will be an issue. I wish it had the perfect fit, but I'm still so glad I bought!!

Now I've got to admit, I've bought this coat 2 times.  Once in the Emerald and once in the Midnight blue so it's save to say I like the coat a lot.  It's adorable. The oversized hood, big buttons, flare over the waist and high/low hemline make it unique and eye catching.  However it snags and pills terribly.   If you are going to use this coat for special occasions then you can get away with it but if you are using it as your every day winter coat and you live some place like MN, it's going to look real shabby in about a month.  I still loved the style so much that I got the Midnight blue hoping that the dark color would help hide those imperfections.  It did to a degree but still after 6 weeks the coat looked shabby.  If it had a more durable fabric I would buy this coat over and over again.

I know 1X would be much too baggy on me, so for me I guess it's just not possible for this jacket to fit and I'm going to be returning it.  Maybe I should have noticed this before I bought it, but I was hoping the L would be fine because it's not a fitted jacket... I'm a clothing designer and seamstress...when something fits weird, it REALLY bugs me. So, here are my two biggest issues with this jacket  I'll let you decide for yourself if it's worth the $55 + tax and shipping.1) I ordered a Small, and despite being fairly true to size in all other proportions, the fit in the shoulders and armholes was off by enough that I not only noticed it, but couldn't keep wearing it because it bothered me so much. The armholes are cut improperly, which feels really awkward when worn, like my shoulders are being forced back because there's not enough room in the front of the armscye and too much in the back. I was tempted to rip the sleeves out and recut the armscye myself, but that's opening a whole other can of worms and I'd rather just order a size Medium and see if the fit across the shoulders doesn't improve when I go up a size.2) The quality of the material is not as nice as I would have expected for something of this price. The trouble is that this jacket has a synthetic type of jersey knit that makes me worry that it's going to start pilling anywhere there's friction (under the arms mainly). Sure it looks nice when you pull it out of the bag, but check the armpits after a month of regular wear and tell me it's not pill city under there. Since fit and quality are my two most important expectations from a garment, I'm sad to say this jacket did not deliver on either account so it's going back.
