I very much like military style jackets and coats. This blazer is super cute, but first things first. It doesn't have proper buttons. It has a single hook closure at the waist. This is perfectly acceptable to me, but I know that some people like to button up at least partway. These buttons are decorative. Another thing it has is shoulder pads. For those people like me who detest shoulder pads, these are made of felt and are easily removed (you can snip them at one end and carefully cut along the seam on the other; the remaining felt along that seam can be yanked out without damaging the stitching). Other than these two specifics, this is a wellmade piece. The fabric is soft, but the cut doesn't suffer from the removal of padding and maintains flattering form. I already have a short white military jacket or I would have gotten this one in a different color as well. In terms of warmth, this is a light to medium blazer, good for layering on cool summer evenings or warm autumn afternoons.

review_summary: The hilow cut of this bla
review_text: The hilow cut of this blazer makes this a great piece for throwing over dresses.  With fit and flare type dresses, a regular blazer sometimes makes me look shapeless, even when I button.  This blazer comes up high enough in the front, though, that you can usually see the definition in the waist.  At the same time back swoops down low enough to provide a little bit more coverage for dresses with a clingy cut.  Because of this, this has become my very favorite blazer (I own at least a dozen) and is a goto when my other attempts at layering look funny.I was worried about the shoulder pads when I ordered, but didn't end up minding them at all.  They're subtle, and if anything add a bit of dressiness to the knit blazer.The fabric is a good solid black, and very comfortable.  However, out of every single article of clothing that I own (including lots of other black things and plenty of knits), this is the biggest lint magnet.  Something about the blazer fabric makes it grab every hair, crumb, and dust particle and hold on for dear life.  I've invested in a lint roller just for this jacket.  The trade off is well worth it, though, to feel so comfy at work.

review_summary: Though I'm a bit on the l
review_text: Though I'm a bit on the larger side, I have a proportionally small waist and my top half is smaller than my bottom half. Because of this, I'm really picky about my blazers, as a lot of them hide my waist and just make me look large all over. This is a nice, thick, soft blazer that actually hits at my waist and is very comfortable. I also really like the hint of tails. I originally got a large in the black and it's a *little* loose for my taste (I'm very selfconscious about adding volume), but it's definitely good for going over dresses or tighter pants to balance out the proportions. I also got the green in medium to see if I liked the fit better. I do think it fits my waist a bit better, but it is a bit tight in the arms and across the back. I wore it out today and it split about an inch along the seam of the liner. As it's on the inside, I really don't mind and it did make mobility a bit easier. However, if you like slightly looser garments, I would go with the sizing chart.I attached sidebyside pictures of the medium (green) and large (black). There's really not that much difference, but the waist on the large is a bit lower, though not enough for a very shortwaisted girl like me to be particularly bothered by it. I styled it with the Why So Cirrus? dress. (Sorry about the messgrad school life does not lend itself to much motivation for cleaning.)All in all, I really love this blazer, especially because of how soft and thick it is and the cool tails effect.

I do wish the button was an inch lower  it's a smidge high enough to pull slightly but not enough to not wear buttoned. The sleeve length and detail looks good and natural (I've tried on some ruched 3/4 sleeve blazers that were bunchy). However, the big problem with this blazer is the small size through the sleeves. It is tight on me! I have no problem admitting that I don't have small, toned arms, but they aren't particularly overlarge either. I can wear the blazer and reach forward to a degree but I can feel the stitches start to strain if I go too far. I do not have full range of arm motion in this blazer and could see myself popping stitches if I tried to do something like put my hair up wearing it. I was really excited about this jacket and thought that the only thing that could possibly be bad about it was maybe the fit I was wrong. As soon as I pulled it out of the box, I said what the heck is that?! Because it didn't look anything like the pictures. The faux leather has an oddly metallic sheen; it's more of a gun metal gray than a black (see picture). I was pretty disappointed by this, but thought maybe I was overreacting and tried it on anyway. The fit was a little tight, but overall okay and not too uncomfortable. But after I put it on, I really looked at it and realized the the zipout hoodie layer is the most bizarre thing. It's not just a hoodie that you can take out and it's not a hood that you can zip off it's a 2inch wide stretch of hoodie material the runs the length of the jacket with a second zipper to make it look like you're wearing a hoodie underneath. Essentially the only point of it is for looks, not for warmth or versatility or anything useful. Which would be one thing. Except that the bottom like 6inches of the sleeves are hoodie material and they don't zip off. Which means you can zip off the extra strip of hoodie fabric to get rid of the second zipper (and why should I have to doublezipper a single jacket?), but you will be left with these confusing sleeves that make it look sort of like you're wearing two jackets when you're very obviously not.Overall, really disappointing and confusing. This could have been a really nice jacket, but it feels to me like they cheaped out.

It does need some ironing after a wash, but one doesn't have to wash a blazer that frequently and this is tied to its being made from a nicer fabric, so I'll deal with the little bit of ironing. (I haven't tried this yet, but I assume if I hang dry it it'll need no or way less ironing, and keeping clothes out of the dryer makes them last way better anyhow.) The fit is really good for me  I have narrowish shoulders but while it would definitely still fit someone with shoulders a bit more normally wide, it doesn't look oddly bulky or wide on me either, which is great. It has a very flattering fit at the waist and over the chest (not too tight, not too loose). I did have to put a couple stitches in the back flap (that one that's stitched closed at the bottom on blazers in the middle of the back) because it bulged badly since I have a very notflat rear end, but that took about a minute to fix and it sits just fine now, and I really have yet to meet a fitted blazer I could avoid stitching that flap closed on anyway. Overall I'm very satisfied with this purchase and it's become a favourite new part of my work wardrobe. My husband commented on how cute and professional I looked when I put it on getting ready for work this morning. :)

review_summary: True to pictures, somewhat odd features

The front is boxy and somewhat minimalist but with tiny feminine ruffles towards the top. Then, in the back, there's this weird ducktail bit. What is this for? It could be good for someone who is shortwaisted who has trouble with jackets fitting in the back, but then it's still long in the front. I think I would have preferred it without the ruffles and more of a structured look. The ruffle thing in the back does provide a lot of give in the stomach area, which could make this a good option for someone who is pregnant or is more of an apple shape. I do like the color and the cut doesn't bother me enough to keep me from wearing it on occasion, but it's not a favorite piece. Given the chance to return it, I probably would have.

Pros:   Sturdy with the weight of a sweatshirt, yet thin and wide enough in the shoulders to wear over layers; looks best when zipped to the bust line, or just above. Cons:  The sleeve cuffs and bottom cuff (?) do not keep the same quality of the jacket itself. The sleeve cuffs are at most only half the length shown in the presented photo. They are also at least a size smaller than the sleeves which creates a mushroom effect of slight puckering at the cuff followed by an over abundance of sleeve. review_text: This is my very first purchase from Modcloth.  I was a little hesitant to purchase this jacket because of some of the reviews stating that it's not soft, that it's scratchy, not warm and that the zipper is a pain.  First of all, I am the first to admit that I'm always cold.  I live in Massachusetts.  I walked to my sons' bus stop in this jacket today in 45F degree weather and found it to be warm enough for the weather.  I don't find the inside of the jacket to be at all scratchy.  The zipper is asymmetrical, so if you're going to zip up the jacket, you shouldn't try to zip it straight up but asymmetrically.  I've had no problems with it. The only two issues I have is that in the review it says it's all cotton when it isn't (although it's still very soft) and I'm not particularly too thrilled with the cuffs.  I really liked my purchase.

I also have large chest 38G (blessing and a curse!) which means finding a coat which buttons or zips over it is near impossible. Not with this little beauty! I bought a 2x as I usually wear UK size 20/22 as I wasn't sure how this would fit on the arms etc. Some reviewers have said it is loose and it is roomy even for me but I like that. I like the option of wearing thick jumpers underneath and a scarf and being able to do up the buttons. It reminds of a little red riding hood style coat/cape but it is still nicely fitted at the waist so there is shape there which is important for a curvy woman like me. Length is perfect and the back is just around the back of my knees so it isn't overly short. The hood is lovely and while not practical for heavy wintery weather it is nice to have and will protect my hair from rain and light snow. The quality of the material is good and softer that I expected, it is a litte thin but our winters here are not extreme so it is a perfect compromise and light enough to wear in Autumn/Fall and Spring. Really nicely designed coat and I can't wait to wear it and show it off!

I think it will hold up nicely in the winters where I live.  I haven't had a chance to test it in the rain yet. Overall I am very pleased with this coat.

review_summary: I went to Seattle and Vic
review_text: I went to Seattle and Victoria, BC this month (December), and it was unusually cold for that time of year. I'm really glad I had this coat, because it was the perfect thing to have! I usually wear between an XL and a 1X, and since I wanted to be able to layer comfortably, I went with a 1X. There is a LOT of room in it, in both the arms and the waist. That's great for me, since I have really large arms, but I would have liked it to be a little more tailored in the waist. I would say it fits slightly larger, so keep that in mind. This coat is really warm, comes with a detachable collar, covered my butt, and the diagonal zipper really sets this coat apart from other plain black coats. The downsides is that It's really heavy, not waterproof, and does not come with a hood. That might just be nitpicky things, but just FYI. I'm a little bummed I had to buy it at full price (looking at this sale price of $98.00), so if you want it, this is DEFINITELY the time to get this coat!
Warm and versatile.

review_summary: Ok, I first want to say t
review_text: Ok, I first want to say that I LOVE and am obsessed with this coat. I've worn it every day since it arrived about 2 weeks ago. That being said, there's some things about it that almost made me return it. 1. It's very boxy. I have an hourglass shape and it's kind of lost in how straight the midsection of this coat is. I contemplated exchanging it for a size smaller for that very reason but didn't because....2. The arms are incredibly short. They just barely cover my wrists, and I have pretty short arms to begin with, so I figured if I sized down, the sleeves would be even shorter than the 2x. 3. Also, this coat turns my nails blackish blue! Took me a week to realize it was the coat that was doing that to my nails because I work in a tattoo shop and just assumed I kept touching transfer paper or something that was turning them blue... then one day I carried a white bag while wearing the coat and noticed it also got stained from rubbing on the coat. All in all, the coat is amazing quality and super cozy! Love the length too! I intend on having it taken in just a tiny bit to make it more shapely :) I look forward to wearing this coat for many winters!

I wish the sleeves were a little longer, but that's been a lifelong struggle for me, and so long as you do wear long sleeves and/or gloves with it, you're good to go. I live in Oregon. It doesn't get as cold as some places, but on a recent 20degree day I had only this coat with a sweater underneath and a scarf and I was perfectly comfortable! review_summary: I was so excited when I s
review_text: I was so excited when I saw this coat go on sale as I couldn't justify the original $140 cost. I went with a small, and it fits very well, though it is a little bit looser around the waist than I had expected. It is a beautiful coat, and I was very happy with it at first. However, only a few days after I bought it, the hook that is used to hang the coat broke. It's not a normal cloth hook and is made out of a small chain, so I'm not really surprised that it broke so quickly as the coat is heavy. A few days later, one of the buttons attaching the knit part of the collar popped off (must have come off during the day because I was unable to find it). The coat did not come with any extra buttons so the collar is currently not attached on one side until I can find a similar button. Finally, after only having this coat for about a month, the insides of the pockets have begun to develop holes. The material the pockets are made of is very thin, and again, I'm not terribly surprised. The inner lining of the coat is made of the same material and has also torn in several places. Overall I am a bit disappointed in this coat. It looks very nice and is comfortable, but seems to be very cheaply made. I would have expected a $100 coat to hold up better. I was hoping to have this coat for years to come, but based on the amount of wear and tear it was already begun to show after just a few weeks, I doubt that will be likely. It's a shame, it really is a unique and beautiful coat.

Love love love

It fits great in the arms, but it's quite baggy around the chest and stomach areas for me. Which wouldn't be a bad thing if I wanted to wear a thick sweater/sweatshirt underneath it...but then it would be too tight in the arms. Anyway, it's a beautiful coat and the quality and style are great. Lots of compliments, too!

review_summary: LOVE this coat. I live in
review_text: LOVE this coat. I live in Arizona, so I don't have much need for something this heavy, but on a recent winter trip to Europe needed something to keep this desert dweller warm! The insert of the collar is a great detail and is very cute, but if you were to functionally use it to keep your neck warm it gets sort of weirdyou'd have to zip the coat up to hold it in place (it kind of lays flat generally) and I think it would look awkward. For the days I wanted to stay extra bundled I just popped the knit insert off (buttons are tiny bit of a hassle so I wouldn't want to do this daily but it wasn't a deal breaker) and added a scarf. Still got the cute detail of the big collar but stayed warm. Boom!The fit is great. If you're curvy, you should know it's a pretty straight fit from bust to hips, but for me it worked really well (even though I'm plus size I have zero hips and the cut was perfect for me). It worked with everything from a tshirt to a light sweater underneath.  I would buy this coat again in a heartbeat!

review_summary: I was looking for a coat
review_text: I was looking for a coat to replace a severely overused peacoat, and this was beyond perfect in fit and durability. I have worn it nearly every day for the last month and a half, and it has held up and kept me warm in the freezing new england weather! The detachable collar is a great feature (I prefer it without the insert) and the snaps on both the sleeves and pockets are very strong! The only con to this coat is that I wouldn't recommend hanging it up from the chain loop at the collar, as mine broke after a couple times (Easily fixed but still annoying). Overall the perfect coat that can be dressed up or down and high quality for the price!
Adorable. Fits perfect.

review_text: I love this coat and it's a perfect way to have your winter peacoat and unique style as well!  I always get compliments on it and it's as stylish as it looks. I highly recommend this coat.

I'm a fan!

review_summary: I always get a size up in

I love this jacket!!!! It works with everything!

This jacket looks pretty cute, but the fabric is very cheap. I'm shocked that Steve Madden would use such cheap material. The second it gets near any lint or pet hair you will be done, so beware!! Plus, when you lint roll this, parts of the fabric actually come off on the roller, too, which makes it even harder to keep this jacket clean. Like I said, it looks pretty cute, so that's the only plus. It isn't that warm, so it's more for Spring or Fall. It also fits pretty snug in the bust area. I ordered a Medium and a Large. The Large was way too big on me, but the medium was very tight in the bust, so I opted for the Medium. Now I can't wear a heavy sweater or anything like that underneath. The sale price is the only reason I kept this jacket. If you don't get it on sale, I wouldn't pay full price for it.

Wasn't too sure about this coat when I ordered it, but I am glad I did! The quality is very good and is a lovely material that is also warm. Coats usually look massive on me with no shape but Thai fits perfectly and is a nice length.

review_summary: I have been keeping an ey

I can't say how happy I feel on finally getting this coat!I live in Southern California (and yes we do get cold where I live, by the mountains) and I have to say I honestly cannot wait until the cold weather (finally) gets here so I can wear my coat and show it off!

review_summary: The coat fits well. It is

Love this coat ! So cute and comfy! Perfect fit !

review_summary: I wanted a basic black wi
review_text: I wanted a basic black winter coat that was anything but basic, and this was the perfect one! This coat fit better than I anticipated, as I have trouble finding coats that fit my shoulders and upper arms, but this one is great. The sleeves are long enough so that the hem touches the back of my hand when I raise them. I like that the cuffs can be unbuttoned and rolled back for a more casual look!The zipper is definitely on a diagonal and the pointed front and back are very flattering for a curvaceous figure like mine. The length was great, too, hitting at midthigh. The slash pockets are positioned comfortably low and can also be snapped closed to hold stuff like keys.I love the detachable knit collar and have used it every time in these belowfreezing polar vortex temps! The collar fits comfortably when zipped up with the knit one attached.Overall, this is a quality garment with welldone seams and is fully lined with contrasting red piping.  A winner for sure!

review_summary: The large is a little too

This coat is great :) It's a little long on me, since I'm only 5 foot so it looks more like a trench coat. The collar is amazing and I've gotten compliments already. If you're used to comfy stretchy coats, you might want to size up. My stomach is far from flat and I pretty much have to unzip it to not have lumps happen. I'm going to keep it because standing I have enough room in the front AND if I size up the length might make me look even shorter. Overall, hooray ModCloth!!

review_summary: This coat is so much more

Slight room, enough for another light sweater if necessary. LOVE this coat. I do wish there was some kind of seam or cover for the buttons after removing the ribbed collar.  When my hair is down, it sometimes gets stuck around the buttons. I love that I can wear a medium weight sweater under this and my arms aren't being strangled. This has become my new favorite jacket!

After reading reviews I decided to order a size up in order to wear big, comfy sweaters underneath. The jacket fits perfectly with just the right amount of wiggle room. I wish the pockets were made out of the same material as the rest of the jacket so my hands would be just as warm, but no real complaints. Great material and cute cut on just about anyone.

FYI. If you wear glasses, it may cause fog. Today's temperature in Boston is 17?F but feels like 3?. But I'm really glad I tried it  everyone on here loves it, and now I understand why. I'll be keeping an eye out for Steve Madden coats in the future.

My complaint so far: I've only had the coat a few weeks and there's at least two rips in the lining, along seams. One is in the pocket, which can get super annoying. I purchased a medium so I could layer if I wanted to and it's not too big if I don't layer.  The detachable sweater cuff around the neck keeps me incredibly warm and the collar comes up very high and is perfect for blocking out the wind from my face.

review_summary: I love this coat! It is a
review_text: I love this coat! It is a great length for me, lengthwise and in the sleeves. The lining in the collar adds extra warmth, so the coat is a lot warmer than regular wool coats.

review_summary: I've had this coat for ju
review_text: I've had this coat for just over a year now, and have worn it spring and fall and some of the (warmer) winter months.  It fits me perfectly and snugly  this means that I can't really fit a heavy sweater underneath so it's not suitable for smalltown Southern Ontario winter (and certainly not for Montreal winters!).  I did work one year in Toronto and wore this jacket almost all winter taking public transit.  I like that the collar can stand up against the wind, and that part of it is removable  this makes the jacket very wearable in the spring.  The only negatives about the jacket are: (a) the pockets are VERY shallow.  I lost my iPod nano when it fell out on the subway...so I would not keep anything important in the pockets (not even mitts!), and (b) after about a week, the metal loop on the back of the neck tore off so that I can no longer hang it on a hook off the loop.  Arms are long enough for gangly me (unlike many jackets) and the bust is not too big for my boyish frame.  I wore a backpack most of last year and have not notice any marks on the shoulders (as I do with some jackets)  so the material seems to be durable and good quality.  I'm very happy with this jacket!
LOVE this jacket! I always get compliments on it and it fits great for such a warm cozy jacket. Get it NOW the sale price is a STEAL.

review_summary: The 1X is a wee bit big o

It's a decent coat: I like the zip and the collar, and the sleeves are just the right length. I wish the pockets were a little deeper; I keep my mittens in them when I'm not wearing them and I feel like they'll fall right out of these pockets. It's a bit light for a Wisconsin winter, but it allows enough space for a bulky sweater so it will do. Nabbed it during the halfprice sale so I can't really complain!

I figured, well, it happens, this one pocket just got messed up, I can sew it! But the next day the pocket on the other side also got a huge hole. Annoying, yes, but fixable and invisible. I'm still very pleased with the fit, style and quality of the rest of the coat.

review_summary: Great coat! I bought a la

Coat is nice and thick and does well in near freezing temps and even stands up to a lighter rain without getting that wet animal smell when wet.  Diagonal zipper is so cute, gives coat a unique look while still remaining functional.  Also like the asymmetrical sleeves too and detachable inner collar to give coat a slightly different look or just to allow more breathing room around the neck for days that aren't quite freezing.  Kinda bummed that the coat is now 50% off.  Thought it was a bit pricey when I got it but still love the product.  Economics at its best I suppose...got me!

review_summary: I love how unique this ja

review_summary: I fell in love with this

The weight and overall feel of the fabric when you shrug it on is very smooth and has such an elegant style while being completely comfortable! But the sad news was for a someone who is petite as I am,  I looked like I was swimming in this coat. It would be amazing if some coats on Modcloth were available in an XS!!! review_summary: At first, I had a few qua
review_text: At first, I had a few qualms about the asymmetry, but it turned out to be much less complicated than anticipated.  I was also concerned it wouldn't be warm enough, but steady cold winds and snow in the two days since I've gotten the coat haven't penetrated the shell.  I definitely still needs a few layers underneath (I'm typically an XS, but that wasn't an option here.  Layers do help take up the space between the lining and anything else though.)  The design is beautiful, and I was getting compliments on it immediately, including one from the boyfriend, which cinched the deal!  A hood would have made this completely perfect, but oh well!  Can't have everything.The only real negatives are in regards to the quality.  There were a few stray threads hanging off the collar when it arrived, and I'm not confident in the pocket lining.  It feels as if I put my keys in the pocket one or two more times, they can rip right through.  Most disappointing, however, is that I've only had this coat for two days and the chain has already broken after just one use (The ring detached between the ribbon charm and the chain itself and is now nowhere to be found.)  I probably won't use that feature again.

Based on customer service's advice I got an XL which fit, but I couldn't comfortably wear much underneath thanks to my chest. The coat was very cute, however, and I wanted it to work. I tried a size up to 1X which was also way too big and the coat lost it's cute shape when that big on me. It's a shame, because I truly wanted it to work. The size difference between the XL and 1X was pretty inconvenient.
This is the first jacket that has really fit the way i wanted. Its beautiful!

I bought my usual size since I live in California and don't need to layer when it's cold (unless it gets to our freezing temps of 50 degrees haha). The material is nice but not as thick as you'd expect.I purchased both red and black versions and went with the red one since the black one swallowed me up since it was loose where stated above. Red was gorgeous and  looked great.

I was really excited about this coat, and wanted to make sure I ordered the correct size. I had read several reviews, and noted that many mentioned the coat running large. She assured me that I should order the 2x. Well it finally arrived, I put it on, and I am swimming in it. More frustrating, is that the coat is now out of stock, so I cannot exchange it for a smaller size. I'm really disappointed.... My 1 star rating is less for the coat, and more for ModCloth's less than stellar execution of a wonderful idea for a service..... * pout *

Little tight in bust but good quality

review_summary: I run between an XL and a
review_text: I run between an XL and a 1X and played it safe with this jacket and ordered up.  The sleeves are a bit long and I have some extra room in the torso, but it fits over my wider hips and leaves plenty of room for layers.  I love the neckline and it looks great with or without a scarf!

I was pleasantly surprised when the small still left room for a sweater.  The knitted collar is a  great  feature, especially when I forgot a scarf!  It is removable, which I like.The warmth isn't TOO warm, but it does the job for short walks when it's freezing out.  The pockets are great, and big enough to hold a phone, wallet, and some gloves without popping out.  The back hangs right below my bum, which is perfect.  I love the diagonal zipper, too. I've had many  positive comments on this. The material is nice, and reminds me of a peacoat.Cons:  the chain inside  (for hanging the jacket) broke on the first use. I'll have to fix it.  I was disappointed since it's a Steve Madden, and there were strings hanging off everywhere, and that chain snapped. But nothing I can't fixAllinall, I recommend this jacket to anyone who is looking for a stylish, different, warm coat.

Also, I wound up the cuffs a little and decided to give it a go. Although I still think it is a bit on the large side, it has been invaluable over the holiday period. It look great over jeans, but also so as good with a dress and boots. It is just what I wanted, the quality is great, it is think and heavy and warm. My only advice it to triple check the measurements and that they are what you want rather than going by size. On the plus side  the extra room allowed me to wear this coat over the top of three jumpers, another parka and a bunch of scarf/gloves etc when I went hot air ballooning in the middle of winter ;)

review_summary: I love this coat. Got it
review_text: I love this coat. Got it 2 winters ago when I needed a new winter coat. Still in love with it. Still bring it out when the temp drops. It's warm enough for me to wear without getting too crazy with layers; the winters get to around around 30 degrees Fahrenheit. The only downfall for me is the coat raises drastically whenever I raise or lift my arms.It's roomy enough for me to layer underneath and it doesn't look big or chunky. Nicely made. I love the metal part of the coat that you use to hang it on hooks, so cute. And I like the collar, it's a great and fun feature to get different looks with.It's been dry cleaned a few times and worn for 2 winters, going on its 3rd. Still holding up great. Those pockets can hold a lot. I'll shove my gloves and winter scarf in there when I don't need them and they fit.I like winter coats that cover my butt (more warmth!) but being very short, most winter coats swallow me up and I look ridiculous and shorter than my 4' 10. I don't know, I think it might be the cut but this coat doesn't make me looks shorter than I am. The arms are a bit long for me, but if I fold the sleeves back, they're perfect and it also add more character to the coat.Just get used to zipping it up, the zipper doesn't go straight up and down the middle of your body like many zippers do. It goes up and down at a diagonal.I love this coat. If you get it, I hope you love it too.

It has real pockets which I am thrilled about as the last black coat I purchased through ModCloth did not have real ones and for a coat, I realized this is a really important attribute to me. The diagonal zipper adds uniqueness and fun and the extra warm fabric around the neck is very helpful on the colder nights. Love it and would buy it right now in red if I could still get it for half off!!

review_summary: I love this coat.  It's v

I sized up and went with a medium (more for sleeve length than anything else) and overall I'm happy with the size. It's pretty roomy, but I think this will be perfect for winter so that I can put heavier layers underneath  the coat itself is not very thick but it does hold in heat pretty well. I am 5'8 and I've found that the sleeves on many jackets are often a bit short on me. As you can see from the picture, these sleeves stop just at my wrist which is fine, though I prefer for my sleeves to end midway down my hands so I have been wearing a cardigan underneath. The material doesn't provide any stretch so the arms and shoulders can feel a bit stiff if you're reaching up. I think bustier girls might want to go ahead and go with the size up as well  I am a 34D and this fits with just enough room to be comfortable and doesn't restrict my breathing ability (it happens with some jackets). The inner neck... flapthing (?) connects to the jacket with several buttons placed along the collar and it looks nice on or off. I really like the asymmetry of the jacket (which is much easier to see when you're wearing light colors underneath) as it makes for a very feminine shape. I highly recommend this jacket if you're looking for something cute, versatile and stylish for the winter!
Love it!

Unfortunately this was not the miracle coat for me that it was for everyone else. I'm petite and pearshaped, and while the bottom fit fine, I was swimming in the top of the coat. And the sharp shoulder pads just emphasized that fact. It wasn't the worst fitting coat in the world, but for the price, I can do better. Back it goes. :(

My measurements are ridiculous, so this coat looks like a nun's habit on me. It fits a tad small in the chest, and billows out everywhere else. However, despite the thinness, the quality is what I would expect from Steve Madden, which is good. I'm keeping it, because it's so huge on me that I can definitely layer under it multiple times when it gets too cold to wear it alone.

review_summary: I am very happy with this
review_text: I am very happy with this coat.  It will be a wonderful winter coat for winters in Nebraska.  Even though it is a black winter coat it still stands out with its interesting diagonal shape.  Very pleased with this purchase!

This was such an adorable coat. The small was just too big for my frame (even with sweaters). I wish it came smaller, as I wanted it to fit so badly. It was super cute, warm and of such quality. I ended up having to return it after my seamstress/tailor told me it would cost as much as I spent on the coat to have it fitted.

review_summary: I love this coat! With au
review_text: I love this coat! With autumn finally here I've had a couple of chances to try it and I'm so glad I bought it. My size is 2X and I bought the coat in 2X and it is a good fit. I still feel I have plenty of room for additional or thicker layers of clothing underneath. I like how the zipper continues up under the collar, it really helps block the cold wind! The best part about the coat are the sleeves  I have long arms and I was concerned that they wouldn't be long enough, but it's totally not an issue. Keep in mind this is without folding the sleeves back! The back of the coat just covers my bum. Overall, a great buy!

Easily one of the nicest jackets.. or even articles of clothing that I've ever owned. Worth every penny! It's such a flattering jacket for women of any shape or size. The quality is extremely high for a jacket that's only $140. The detachable collar is a nice touch, and I love how this jacket fits a bit longer. Arm mobility isn't great in this jacket, but that's been the case with any peacoat style jacket I've ever owned. I love this jacket to bits and highly recommend!

The quality is excellentlots of little finishing details and lovely fabric.  But I am sending this back for a few reasons.  I needed a transitional coat, and this is actually too warm and heavy for a Michigan autumn ( it would be great for winter).  Getting the zipper started was really difficultbecause of the extra flaps of fabric beneath the zipper, getting everything lined up took several tries.  But mostly, it was the shape.  I'm always a size 18, and the 2x seemed boxy and oversizedthe cool diagonal angles were lost and ( on me) it looked like an ordinary pea coat, without the cool edgy vibe in the photo.

review_summary: I am soooo in love with t
review_text: I am soooo in love with this coat!!

I just received this coat and am SOOOO happy with it.  The fit is perfect and the quality, as you would expect from Steve Madden is awesome.  I have had so many compliments on it.  I love the fact that the fabric collar can be zipped in and out if you want and that the neck does all the way up keeping you nice and toasty warm.  I'm tall so I was worried it was going to be too short but it fits under my bum just perfectly!!  Would love this coat in red to but can't justify it!!!

review_summary: I love this coat. Fits pe
review_text: I love this coat. Fits perfect! The quality is amazing.  I love the way it looks on my short, hourglass figure. Thanks Modcloth!!!!!
This coat is adorable!

review_summary: I usually wear a 2x in mo
review_text: I usually wear a 2x in modcloth dresses, I got this in a 1x but it's pretty big. I'm exchanging it for a large but almost wonder if a medium would be ok? Other than that it's super cute, just the right jacket for Texas winters, can be worn over a fancy dress or with a hoodie underneath. Simple but not plain. All of my other Steve Madden shoes/bags have lasted forever so I assume the same for this jacket.
Great coat! Will fit with winter layers

review_summary: I fell in love with this
review_text: I fell in love with this jacket once I saw it and had to buy it. Just wanted to say I placed the order on a Sunday, it was shipped on Tuesday and with the Savvy Saver shipping, I was delivered that following Saturday. I typically don't wear a lot of layers because I get hot really easily so I ordered a medium. It is a bit tight in the shoulders and a bit snug when I go to zip it up but all that is okay with me. When I need a jacket like this I wear something light underneath of it. This jacket is really warm to me. I also took out the collar piece. Honestly don't think I would ever use it/wear it.The sleeves are just right for me. However, the jacket seems a bit cheap on the outside. It's rough and has that starchy feel. I am sure that will diminish once the jacket is broken in. I also feel this jacket is worth more in the $100 range vs $139. The zipper is a bit hard to put together because the male piece, there isn't anything to grab onto. I do wish this came in more colors. Maybe a brown or a mossy green. Overall, I do like this jacket a lot. I do plan on keeping it and hope it lasts me a good while.

yup. This coat is amazing. It fits snug in all the right areas and is loose in all the right areas. I got a Medium (did not size up) because I wanted it to have a snugger silhouette, which means I'm probably not going to be wearing it in the dead of winter because I can't fit a sweater underneath but that's ok. It's all snowy up here in Boston at that time of the year anyway so I'll probably be wearing a coat that wicks ice and sleet. I also got rid of the corded collar. I found it a little unwieldy. The only way I thought it looked nice was if I curled it under because otherwise it looked like it was devouring my face! Plus, since variety is the spice of life, I can always choose a new scarf to go with it! It's well made and i like the leopard print detailing on the inside. It looks great open or closed and I'm definitely a fan :)

This is my first Modcloth purchase, and I couldn't be happier. I normally don't buy clothes online because I'm one of those people who needs to try on clothes to make sure they fit right. I have fairly broad shoulders and a big chest, so coats are usually a pain. But, this coat fits like a dream. It seems like a great quality for the price. Absolutely perfect. Thanks Modcloth!
My most favorite winter coat ever. I get compliments like crazy! It gives a great shape even with a sweater underneath. I have dressed this up and have dressed it down and it's perfect every time.

I have very broad shoulders and always have to size up. I did so with this but it was a little snug when I lifted my arms at shoulder level but it's something I can live with. Otherwise it's a bit long for me but I absolutely love it and looks amazing with Skinniest and heels. Love

review_summary: I love this coat.  When y
review_text: I love this coat.  When you pull the collar up, it goes all the way up, past your nose, almost to the base of your eyes! (at least it does, for me).  The diagonal zipper is very flattering, as is the weight of the fabric and the lines of the coat itself.  Has enough room to layer things underneath, which, if you live in a very cold climate, I'd imagine you'd need to; this coat, while warm, still just has a silk/cloth lining.

review_summary: I love this coat! I got i
review_text: I love this coat! I got it last winter and have gotten so many compliments on it.  It is nice and cozy, the length is great with almost everything and the slightly diagonal cut makes it just interesting enough to be different.  So happy I bought it!

Gorgeous. the sleaves can be worn down or cuffed and the length on me is perfect falling just below my bottom . Im about 160cm so not very tall. great quality and excellent design. Very versitle and I couldn't be happier.
Beautiful coat! I'm actually excited for winter now that I have this...

review_summary: This is a really lovely p
review_text: This is a really lovely piece. I'm impressed by the fabric quality: it's smooth and soft, and the cut lets it fall beautifully. The details are nice as well. The metal pocket snaps look nice and seem wellconstructed, and the removable collar adds a lot of versatility to the coat.Regarding the size choice  I almost always choose a small for things like this because I dislike jackets that obliterate my silhouette. Here, though, I think the medium was a good choice. The sleeves are just the right length, I can wear a couple of layers underneath without having to squirm into it, and the cut of the coat still creates a great silhouette. My only complaint is that the little chain for hanging the coat fell off the first time I wore the coat out of the house.

According to the size chart, I would be a 1X, but this coat is swimming on me, and very boxy. I'm already a big girl, I don't need a coat to make me look even bigger. I would size down, but I'm afraid the sleeves will be too short, as they are already borderline in the 1X.  Also, when the coat arrived it smelled horrible. Not a deal breaker since it could be cleaned, but I shouldn't really have to clean a brand new coat right away.  There's also gaudy leopard print in the lining which I am not a fan of, and I don't remember seeing in the description but maybe I missed it.  This coat is going back for sure. Disappointing because I was really excited to get it.

review_summary: I love this jacket. I wor
review_text: I love this jacket. I wore it all last winter and didn't even need a scarf because of the high angled collar...and I live in Chicago...so that means a lot lol.  I did add a big flower brooch to offset the angle of the jacket for aesthetic purposes which looks really cute. The nice thing about this jacket is it fits right so you can wear a couple layers and still have some shape when you wear it. The collar liner was so warm and comfy, it also detaches should you get too warm with it on. The only challenge to this jacket is learning to line up the jacket zipper when it is asymmetrical lol. I found my self having to look down and focus to get it right at first...otherwise it is worth it considering how cute it is in the end.

review_summary: I was so tired of boxy pl
review_text: I was so tired of boxy plus sized pea coats that I fell in love with this coat when I saw it. I was nervous about ordering this because after reading the reviews, I didn't see any from the larger ladies. HOWEVER, this coat is epic. It's gorgeous and very flattering. Its structured unlike most big girl coats. I feel like it's a little long in the back, but I tried it with a tank top and not a winter sweater, which I'm only slightly concerned about the arms being a little snug if I layer. Anyway very pleased with this purchase and I can't wait for the cold weather because I know I'll look stylish instead of bulky!

Perfect in between jacket and full on parka. It's not a hot 100% wool peacoat but will keep you warm And not a light cheaply made knock off peacoat. The weight of the jacket is nice and so are all the nice details, red piping on the inside soft lining etc. so glad i got this coat!! Definitely worth every penny and wait. Can't wait 'til it gets cold!!
This coat is amazing! It fits well and is super warm. It's definitely the best coat I've ever had.

review_summary: I love, love, love this c
review_text: I love, love, love this coat! I have some wonky measurements going on, mixing an hourglass shape with a larger pear shaped lower half, and this makes finding things like longer coats or jackets a nightmare. If they fit up top (where I can get away with anywhere between XL3X depending on the brand. I'm serious), than it's unattractively tight around the waist. And if it fits the waist, than it's sloppy and frumpy up top. Not so with this coat! Very flattering and I didn't find my body type distorted the asymmetrical look of the coat either. The I think I could have gone down to a 2X, as it was a little loose in the waist and not too tight in the bust or hips, but that's only because I was hoping for a more tailored fall/winter jacket: it's really nice as is and I won't bother swapping it out for the smaller size.

review_summary: I live in Wisconsin and t
review_text: I live in Wisconsin and this coat keeps me plenty warm all winter long. I love being able to zip up the neck when the unexpected gust of frigid air smacks me in the face. I'm quite petite and the torso seems a tad long on me (12). I could've gotten away with a small, but I bought the medium to allow room for thicker sweaters. I had my seamstress shorten the sleeves by 1 and the wool has stretched enough that I don't notice the torso being too long anymore. Maybe it's because I'm distracted by how European/rock n' roll I look instead. Don't be afraid to pop that collar and show a bit of sass, ladies.
Love this coat! Warm and super cute!

review_summary: My favorite coat that I h
review_text: My favorite coat that I have ever owned.

review_summary: I'm in love love love wit
review_text: I'm in love love love with this coat! I can't wait for it to get cold just so I can wear this. It is wonderfully slimming and is great for layering, plus the collar is so warm that you don't even really need a scarf.

review_summary: I dearly wish this item w
review_text: I dearly wish this item would return. I've never loved a jacket so much! Alas, after drawing many compliments from my roommates, it conveniently disappeared when I moved out of a crowded house in the middle of winter. I would pay every cent to buy one again if I could.

review_summary: I love love love this coa
review_text: I love love love this coat! I do wish that it were offered in XS because the only imperfection as far as my body type is concerned is the extra room in the arms and shoulders. That said I still wear it all winter and think the quality is great!

review_summary: I love this jacket, too m
review_text: I love this jacket, too mad our winter was so mild. I don't have a problem snapping the neck part closed even with the insert attached. It's a bit big in the waist area on me, but that's my problem and not the coat's.
Fit better than expected, looked better than expected, functioned better than expected. And I had high expectations.

One of the most flattering pieces of clothing I've ever had. Jackets are hard for me because I have a relatively small waste, but my shoulders are fairly broad so most jackets do that uncomfortable lifting thing around the neck. This one fits like it was made for me, and the cut seems to flatter every part of my body.

I am extremely disappointed in this jacket. I practically read all of the reviews and thought it would work for me.It was just way too small for me in the chest area, the arm pits, the shoulders, and the arm length was too short. I have a large chest, I'm short, and fairly small. I usually run between a small and medium... Sometimes even an extra small in certain items. But this jacket was just impossible to move in. I literally could not raise my arms. There was barely any movement for me. I've never had such an issue fitting into a small. There was no pretending the size would work. It seemed to be the chest area that was the issue, but I really think it had more to do with the cut of the shoulder/chest/armpit are that was the issue rather than the size of my chest. When I read other reviews that said that the horizontal zipper bothered them, or that the collar was annoying, etc: I ignored them. But it was... Totally annoying... I think it might have to do with the way it angles, and the fact that I'm right handed. It didn't feel natural or easy. And I couldn't figure out how to make the collar lay naturally, and felt strangled when trying to button it all the way up. I tried removing the collar, but it really didn't matter. It was awkward. But the crazy thing is that I still think it's an adorable jacket and I imagine that if a medium comes back in stock then I might order it... If only it would just fit a little better. It really is gorgeous and very warm.

This coat is perfection. It is super chic and goes with pretty much everything in my wardrobe. I was not a fan of the sweater collar, but it's removable so it was not a problem! This coat looks best with a light scarf showing underneath, because the detail on the collar is so awesome, I didn't want to cover it up with an outer scarf. It is very form fitting, so if you want to wear heavy sweaters or anything underneath, I would suggest sizing up. However, I intend to wear it with lighter blouses or dresses, so the small fits perfectly. Best part is that for curvy girls like me (I have a small waist but huge butt/hips), this coat is a great fit. it has a separation at the bottom to allow for easy motion, without it looking too big or bulging out at the butt. It's the perfect length and fit! This coat will undoubtedly be a staple of my wardrobe for a long time. :)

review_summary: It was big for me, I was
review_text: It was big for me, I was very satisfied with the high quality coat! S size would be probably the best size.

review_summary: This jacket fits like a g
review_text: This jacket fits like a glove, I absolutely love it! Love Steve Madden and was ecstatic when I found out he was the designer. I'm going to have this coat for years to come! My husband love the cut and says I look great in it and that feels wonderful :)

review_summary: This is now my favorite j
review_text: This is now my favorite jacket. It's perfect for nippy San Francisco weather without being too bulky. The slight taper gives me shape without being too snug. The sleeves are ohmygod the perfect length. The zipper is a little bit tricky but manageable. The asymmetrical quality of the front doesn't stand out as much when I wear it as in the picture, but that's not a big deal. Get this jacket, I think it's worth the price.

I've been eyeballing this coat for months, and I finally bought it, and I couldn't be happier.  The coat is a nice weight and quality for the price, and the lining has pretty details like some red piping and an orangy snake skin pattern up near the neck inside.  The coat is just as beautiful and cool as in the picture, and it fits like it was tailored for me.  I can comfortably wear a thick sweater underneath if I want to for when it's a bit chillier.  For bustier girls, I would highly suggest going up a size... a medium is pretty snug in the chest area, and I'm only a 36c.  It's a very fitted coat (which I loveeee) without being overly confining.  Overall, it's the perfect coat  casual enough for everyday wear, and fancy enough that after removing the ribbed collar, I could wear it for nicer occasions.  Best modcloth purchase to date!

Great coat for how little it cost.  I'm tall and busty but this coat is long enough in the sleeves and roomy enough in the chest that it doesn't look silly on me at all.  I went with the large for those very reasons, and though it is a bit big in the shoulders and waist, I'm very happy with it (makes room for a thick sweater..  I'm from Canada, after all!) Very flattering coat.  My sister tried it on and so as not to have her steal it from me, I ordered one for her (but in the red) for her Christmas gift.  Tada!

I'm so impressed by this coat, and love that it's very simply styled. Although I'm quite small chested I have quite broad shoulders so I was worried the medium might be too small but I can comfortably wear a medium knit jumper under it (and without boiling over!). The wool collar is a bit stifling when turned up so I generally take that out if I want the collar up, but the quality is excellent.

This coat is amazing!! I love it's classic design with a twist. The material is great quality, and heavy enough to battle the Midwest cold. I've received several compliments on the diagonal zipper because it just spices it up. The removable collar is a great feature because it, again, spices it up. I did order a medium so that sweaters can fit over it, and it's the perfect fit  enough room for layers, yet definitely slimming in the waist and hip area. The length goes to a little above midthigh. The only thing I would complain about is that I received my jacket with a hole in the pocket lining  just like several other reviewers. For the price of the coat, this shouldn't be happening! However, it's a beautiful, trendy coat and I'd definitely recommend!
LOVE THIS COAT!! I usually love anything Steve Madden. It fits perfectly, really warm, and stylish. Don't hesitate to buy this if you like it. It will be worth it.
Love it! Perfect fit and beautiful!

review_summary: This coat is amazing. I j
review_text: This coat is amazing. I just opened the box literally twenty minutes ago and I am in love with this coat. Normally when I buy I coat, I don't order it online because I have to make sure it fits my shoulders and it usually ONLY fits my shoulders, nowhere else. This coat fits PERFECTLY. It's amazing. I haven't even taken it off yet. I have to move the buttons over on my other coat so it'll fit. This one fits perfectly without alterations. I love that ModCloth puts the shoulder size in the description. That was beyond helpful. I got the large that has a 16.5 shoulder and it's exactly the size I needed. Granted, I can't wear a bunch of thick, bulky sweaters underneath it, but I wouldn't do that with any coat. Honestly this coat is beyond perfect. It has exceeded my expectations. And the shipping was so fast! Got here in exactly four days. Perfect. Perfect. Perfect.
Best winter jacket ever. You will not be disappointed.

review_summary: The coat fits very well a
review_text: The coat fits very well and is great quality for the price. ^_^ I tend to have issues with sleeves being either too long or too short. For me, the sleeves are about an inch too long so keep this in mind if you also have this problem. The only other thing I noticed is that the picture shows the coat being more diagonal. This ?look? sold me so I was a little disappointed when it wasn?t so pronounced when I tried it on. Nonetheless the coat is very unique.

review_summary: I wish this came in XXL c
review_text: I wish this came in XXL cause my shoulders are just a bit too big for this coat. I'm a rower, so my shoulders aren't exactly proportional. :/ It fits, just a bit tight in the shoulders, but I loved it so much that I couldn't send it back. Great quality.

I finally got this coat. I ordered a Large because of other people's reviews... The shoulders were saggy and the coat lost its classiness. I returned it for a Medium which is much more flattering. Check my measurements and if you are similar to me I would advise ordering a Medium. It is just the right amount of room for a sweater underneath while still showing off some of your figure instead of being boxy. Overall, awesome coat.

review_summary: The medium coat fits me v
review_text: The medium coat fits me very well and there is just enough space under it for a light sweater. I think I would have been swimming in the large, but I also believe the small would have fit (snug with no extra layering underneath). I love that the neck flips up for extra warmth on cold, windy days, and I like that I can wear with with everything from a nice evening dress to a pair of skinny jeans and boots.I believe it is the perfect coat for temperatures from 3050 degrees F, depending on how much I layer. Anything colder than that and it's not warm enough for me...I am a bit of a wimp when it comes to cold weather though, so it may be different for you. All in all, I'm super happy with the purchase of this good quality, versatile coat.
LOVE this jacket. So glad I ordered it. I'm not sure it'll provide great warmth in NYC weather when it's below 30 degrees, but until then, this is a great, classy jacket!

review_summary: I knew I needed this coat
review_text: I knew I needed this coat the minute I found it on the site and instantly ordered it. I tend to stick with basics, neutral colors, and interesting angles  this certainly fit the bill. I'm about as pearshaped as possible, so I usually hesitate with coats that don't have a waistcinching tie. But this suits me just fine  the cut is very complimentary. My only complaint thus far is that within a day, the small metal chain for hanging the coat up snapped.It's not the warmest coat in the world, but I didn't buy it to be my heaviest piece of outerwear anyway. Besides, it has plenty of room for layering! Overall, I'm really pleased.  Also: I need to tip my hat to ModCloth! FedEx really messed up my order which resulted in a few weeks of radio silence on the shipping end. Both times I contacted customer service were wonderfully helpful, and I received my coat within two days of it being returned to ModCloth by FedEx.

review_summary: I am short and curvy, and
review_text: I am short and curvy, and this was odd on me. It sat funny so it didn't look asymmetrical (which is one of the things I loved about it!), and the back was too small. I felt like fat man in a little coat. Couldn't raise my arms up. I was so sad to return it :(

Thanks to the wishlist on Modcloth, my husband just got me this coat for my birthday. Because he read the reviews, he sized up for me as even though I wear a medium/size 8 usually, I am large in the chest and would also likely wear a sweater/layers under it.  He made the right choice! I'm so happy with it and love how it fits.
Great Coat! Really nice detailing including the uneven sleeves. The cut is really flattering and the detachable collar lining is great! I hope it is warm enough for my winter trip to Beijing.

review_summary: This coat is so great! It
review_text: This coat is so great! It's way warmer than I thought, and the lining is beautiful and highquality. I would never have expected this level of quality for the price I paid. My only issue is that the diagonal zipper is a little bit awkwardly placed, so it's hard to get it together, and there's a little V at the bottom where the bottom part of the coat fits unevenly. This has its own charm, but I didn't expect it. Otherwise, excellent purchase!

review_summary: I love this coat!  Very p
review_text: I love this coat!  Very pretty to dress up or dress down, nice length and all the pretty little details.  Sadly, it was a bit lighter material than I expected, which I could live with, but it was definitely to small for me to wear for a Canadian winter.  I never would have been able to layer anything bulky under it, let alone a thin sweater.  And since I live in Canada, it does not seem to be an easy exchange process either.  I shipped mine back the day it arrived and ordered the large but that shipment has been pending for two days.  I am hoping it will still ship soon as it is something I can see myself wearing daily.  I only paid $27 in brokerage fees and tax for it to be shipped to Ontario so it was worth it.  Maybe my shipment charges were less than others as I did not do the express shipping.

review_summary: I LOVE this coat, but it
review_text: I LOVE this coat, but it was too tight in the bust because of the way it zips.  I had to return it, and sadly they were sold out of the xl.  I'm so bummed because it would have been the perfect winter coat this year.

review_summary: I usually have to size up
review_text: I usually have to size up in dresses from ModCloth, so I sized up and ordered a large, thinking I'd want room to layer.  Well, the large was really too big, so I exchanged it for a medium, and that was just right!  The fit is very flattering, and still has room to layer underneath. The collar and the sleeves are fun and adorable.  It's a little heavier than I expected, so it's more of a winter coat than a fall coat, but that's fine with me...now I just wish it was colder so I could wear it!!  I am so pleased with this purchase.  As an aside, the exchange couldn't have been easier...I had the new coat within a week of sending the first one back, and they also included a free gift! Love ModCloth!

Absolutely love this coat! It is so comfortable!  I am glad the collar is detachable to be able to have more or less warmth as needed. I am a size 12 pant, LXL top and I was worried this would be too small but it is wonderful! I'm so glad I bought this coat.

review_summary: I am a very petite person
review_text: I am a very petite person at 4'11, but I love this coat. I will have to have the arms tailored shorter, but that is something normal for me. It fits perfectly in the waist and shoulders, and I can wear sweaters under it. Very pleased!

This coat is great! Ordered a large since I have long arms and strong shoulders and it fits right, M would have been too small.  But the waist runs large, even with a sweater under. I bought it for my trip to France this winter and it will be just fine, but not warm enough for some days of the cold weather we have in Quebec!

review_summary: I do adore this coat. I w
review_text: I do adore this coat. I was skeptical when I first tried it on, thinking that the arms might be a little tight fitting and uncomfortable. I ordered a Large even though I felt like I should wait until an XL became available, but I gave it some time and I love it. I was slightly disappointed that it doesn't quite achieve the diagonal affect that the photo does, but it's still great.

I was nervous about purchasing a coat online without trying it on for sizing and quality. I went ahead and purchased the coat in Large after reading other reviews. It fits perfectly and is of excellent quality! It is perfect for Chicago fall weather.

Was really excited for this coat, but the shape is not flattering at all  it's very straight and removes all curves. The sizing is fine  I ordered a medium after reading other reviews, and I guess it's okay... a little big, even with a sweater on, but not big enough to warrant buying a small. Definitely returning this to ModCloth and hunting further for a real winter coat.

review_summary: I wanted to love this jac
review_text: I wanted to love this jacket SO much, however, when it arrived and I eagerly threw it on, it was about a size too big I assume this would be great if you wanted to wear a bulky sweater under it, however, I was hoping for something more fitted/ tailored. I am returning it, but still excited about future purchases with Modcloth!

review_summary: As cute as this coat was
review_text: As cute as this coat was I ended up returning it, as it was just too big on me.

review_summary: What can I say that hasn'
review_text: What can I say that hasn't already been said by other reviewers?  It's an awesome coat!  My favorite one that I've ever owned so far.  It's slimming, it's warm without being to heavy.  The collar looks great down, up and with or without the in scarf thing.  And the diagonal zipper makes it more visually intersting.  It seems very well made and will hold up for a long time.  The pockets are roomy as well.  If you are looking for a fall/winter coat I don't see a reason not to buy it.

review_summary: To be fair, it's not quit
review_text: To be fair, it's not quite winter yet so this review isn't after any real use. However, as soon as I put it on, I was in love! It's incredibly flattering and the medium leaves enough room for winter clothing underneath. It makes me almost excited for the cold weather (almost).

review_summary: I am very happy I got the
review_text: I am very happy I got the medium! It still has plenty of room for layers yet is still form fitting. I am glad I waited for this coat to come back in stock.

This coat is wonderful. The sleeves are just the right length for me (a bit past my wrists), and it's both warm and stylish! I tend to have trouble fitting into coats because I have a narrower waist and more petite build, but this small in this one fit perfectly! Not too baggy but still leaves room for layering. I purchased this as a ModCloth employee.

Goodness, this coat is gorgeous! I fell in love with it as soon as I saw it! I've been needing a new winter coat for ages and I new this was the one. This coat has some weight to it and it's definitely super thick so it'll be great when winter finally hits. As others have noted, the knit collar is detachable so if you don't like the bulk, you can remove it. I purchased a larger size so I could layer sweaters during the season so I feel like I might be swimming a tad when I'm not layered to the max. The angle of the zipper is definitely not as extreme as shown but it's still a nice change from the regular straight up and down zipper. It will take a bit of finesse to zip it up all the way with the knit collar still attached but it'll keep you snug once you have. Having the collar straight up looks a bit weird but there are the two buttons up top to keep them up if you feel the need to. The price for this coat isn't bad if you consider that you could wear this for the next 10 years. Now I'm all ready for the snow to arrive :)

review_summary: Love the jacket but I had
review_text: Love the jacket but I had to pay $50 in duty fees and a brokerage fee as well :( I live in Canada and had it shipped USPS/Canada Post.  I know this isn't ModCloth's fault but I just thought people should be prepared just in case.The only thing I'm not in love with about the jacket's fit is the way it sits on my shoulders.  I would switch to a medium but after paying over $50 extra I won't go through the process of returning/exchanging it.

This coat is absolutely perfect for winters in Maine. Although, were not quite to the bitter cold stage of winter that comes about mid January, it still gets a bit nippy. This coat keeps out the chill and the collar protects against the neck. I fear it won't be as warm as a I need later in the winter, as it is a tad snug with just a cardigan underneath. However,  that doesn't really matter to me, since I didn't buy it to put bulky sweatshirts underneath lol. I needed a nice coat that didn't make me look like a guy, and this one fits that bill, AND hints at my favorite wizard? I had one word = MINE. :) Very happy with this jacket, it will get a lot of wear and love :D

This coat is fantastic. It looks beautiful, gives you the option to detach the top if you want, and it is incredibly warm. The only qualm I have, you might want to consider sizing down a tad bit. It fits kind of big on me, but I'm okay with that since I'll most likely be layering underneath it. So keep that in mind, if you favor a very fitted coat.

review_summary: I was a little hesitant o
review_text: I was a little hesitant ordering a medium instead of a small because I didn't want it to make me look bulky. I'm so glad I got the medium! It fits perfect but not snug so I can still wear layers underneath. I didn't have a problem with the diagonal zipper, I think you can very much see the detail. The quality is amazing with lots if little added details all over. I couldn't be happier with this coat and I can't wait for it to get colder so I can wear it!
My new favorite coat.  Great fit, but can still fit a sweater underneath.  I'm looking forward to another NY winter now that I own this.

i really really realllly wished modcloth carried an xsmall ): because of my petite and short size, winter coats often run long on me. i read in the description that it was 30 inches and i was really happy because 3032 inches would be perfect for my 5ft height. but when i received it, the measurements seemed kinda off. i think its because the front is longer than the rest of the coat(compared to the sides and back), the front seems to look like its 3334 inches on me as the sidesandthe back is like 32inches. overall, i really do love the coat because of the way it looks, especially the cute collar. but warning, when zipping, you might have a bit of a little time wasting because the zipper is not from the bottom of the coat, its from midwayish to the bottom. also, the quality felt kinda cheap for a coat over $100. just thought steve madden would sell a higher quality coat for this price. but as of now im very iffy about sending it back since the length and material are bothering me a bit. but overall the coat is really cute, i think its perfect for people over 5ft 2inches. also, the small felt kind of baggy, like normally my chest fits a small and my waist and hips needs an xs, but this coat felt like it was an S/M size, not a full small.

review_summary: I LOVE THIS JACKET! I am
review_text: I LOVE THIS JACKET! I am alway weary ordering online because the things hardly ever fit right. I have room for some layers underneath even though it is a little bit tight on the chest, but not bad at all. . It is sheek and flattering. I wear it all the time. I don't write reviews often on things, but this jacket made me want to because it was such a great buy!

I love the jacket however I do wish that the collar wasn't as high as it is. It looks as if it can be worn with the collar up but because it is very tall and not as stiff as the picture portrays therefore leaving it up is not as stylish as I assumed it would have been. Despite the collar issue it is amazing. I have rather large arms and broad shoulders for a thin woman and it doesn't hug too tight, it's warm and looks amazing with dresses as well as jeans.

Sadly, the sizing didn't work for me. I ordered a large to accommodate sweaters, etc., and it was too big. However, if I had ordered my truetosize medium, it would have been too small. Even the large felt a little too tight in the shoulders and arms for me. I often have trouble finding coats with sleeves that don't cut into the biceps when you try to raise your arms. This coat does cut in and in the process shortens the sleeves too much (I have long arms), and the wide cuffs pull up to high on the forearm in an uncomfortable fashion.Despite the sizing issues with the sleeves, the rest of the coat was too big on my large frame. The coat fit fine over my large chest and hips, but my waist was shapeless and my shoulders too boxy.The material/wool is really nice and the coat seems very durable. And it is warm. Just trying it on got me really warm. The coat and sleeves are line, so the wool isn't itchy there, but I'd keep the knit collar in to avoid any neck itchiness. I did find that the unlined cuffs brushing against my wrists was a little itchy.

Beautiful coat, long enough to work well in winter. I was expecting it to be more fitted from reading the other reviews  it is a little large through the body  but it still looks stylish. The fact that the ribbed collar is removable is a plus. Great structure through the shoulders.

I love this jacket!!! It's so stylish and very appropriate for winter. It hasn't gotten very cold yet so it'll be a little bit before I can really try it out, but it seems very heavy and warm. The medium I ordered is just the tiniest bit snug around my hips, but I'm on a diet anyway so that shouldn't be a problem for long! lol...

Seems like a great quality coat. I, too, was surprised the diagonal zipper didn't really stand out too much. I decided to return it because it fit me a little strange on the sides/under arms and it just wasn't the special looking coat I was hoping for. Definitely can't say anything bad about the style or quality. Just wasn't right for me.

This jacket is stylish and flattering, even for wideshouldered (inverted V shape) ladies.  I am tall and longtorsoed; this jacket fits me *perfectly*.  The jacket is fully lined and the buttons/zippers are sturdily constructed.

review_summary: I love this coat  It's su
review_text: I love this coat  It's super warm and nice to wear. My only issue is that the fit in the Large is just right across the shoulders/bust but swimming on me around the waist/hips. Could be an issue with my proportions rather than the coat, but just be aware that it won't fit in on a hourglass figure.

This jacket is amazing. It fits true to size, like a glove. I bought a large cause I was concerned about it fitting to tight on my chest, but it fit perfect with room to spare around the waist and hips. It compliments my curves very well and generally just gives me a nice shape.It's heavy but not to heavy and it will be perfect for keeping the winter chill out when it hits.

review_summary: Love this jacket! I was a
review_text: Love this jacket! I was a bit nervous about ordering the large at first, as there was a significant increase in the waist measurement between the medium and the large. However after reading the (many) reviews I decided to order it. I'm 100% happy that I did, the large allows me to fit a fleece sweater under it for those cold winter days. This jacket is surprisingly warm, doesn't feel bulky and the cut is flattering. I personally love how versatile the collar is. The jacket also falls nicely unzipped which is a bonus. I think this is my favorite Mod Cloth purchase to date.

review_summary: I bought this coat to act
review_text: I bought this coat to act as a fall/warmish winter day coat. It really ended up being perfect. I am 5'10 and weigh about 190 lbs, and usually wear an XL in coats/outerwear. I was worried that this coat would be too big for me in an XL, but it fits perfectly. It's really simple and pretty classic, which is what I need. It will basically go with everything. The diagonal part of it is not super noticeable, but I'm okay with that. Note that the zipper does not go all the way down. It starts sort of high up on the jacket, so that the area below your waist is not zipped. I thought this was weird at first but it seems like it's going to be fine. All in all, it's a nice coat! Can't wait for it to get cool enough to wear it.

What can I say? Perfect! Versatile, stylish, great fit. Love, love, love. I take XL even if I'm usually a L just in case and it still fit right and give me the freedom to wear it about any way I need in the freezing cold winter of Montreal.

Lovely warm winter coat, and the diagonal zipper is such a cool detail. Unfortunately, the shoulders are very broad, so it looked a bit too Russian military for my smaller frame. Too bad; it's a great design except for that!

review_summary: I must admit, I was a lit

review_summary: I was so excited to final

I wouldn't exactly say that it runs small, but if you are on the edge between being a medium or a large, go with the large, since it'll probably fit you better.Someone else mentioned that the zipper doesn't look so dramatically diagonal as it does in the photo, and I agree, but it still looks really good. It ultimately ends up looking more like a zipper off to the side instead up straight up the middle, at least on me. I bet if you're really skinny though, like the mannequin, it'll look just like the photo!

This coat is simply perfect. I have been looking all over for a high collared coat, and came across this one. I am 5'10 with a DD bust and it fits perfectly. Even long enough in the sleeves where i have a huge problem because I have very long arms. i high recommend this coat, and its a great price for a winter jacket.

review_summary: I love this coat, it is j

This jacket is AWESOME. I tried every single size, and waited months between each restock, but I finally decided on the large so I can wear layers underneath the jacket during cold Boston winters.For people who just want this as a fall jacket, I wouldn't recommend the large as it is a little baggy on its own  the medium would have been perfect in every way if I hadn't wanted to layer underneath. review_summary: I can haz warm winter coa

Can't wait for fall season!

Perfection.  The only spot where the fit is a little tight is in the wrists, if you are wearing anything thicker than a featherweight cardigan.

I would have fit a medium but I am glad I got the large as with previous reviews  I wanted to be able to fit a thick sweater underneath. review_summary: I am usually a small in m
review_text: I am usually a small in most tops, so I ordered a small. But it was very small (I wanted to be able to wear at least a sweater underneath), so I bought a medium. It still runs a bit small in the elbows and shoulders, but as long as you are not planning to wear it to a snowball fight, it works just fine. Looks great, seems really warm, although I live in Australia and it is summer at the moment, so I may not be the best judge of that. Fits my hips well, has a bit of extra room in the bust for me. The sleeves do seem a little off somehow, but I don't think other people will notice that just from looking at it. I love the collar and the zipper.

review_summary: I love this coat!! It jus
review_text: I love this coat!! It just arrived this morning and I couldn't be happier about it! The style is very classic, so I can't ever see it going out of style. It's made of heavy, thick material and the seams are all neat and well done. I read a review saying that the diagonal zip looked strange, but I think it really adds to the design and helps make the coat appear more slimming. I wasn't too sure about the collar after having read a number of reviews about people removing the ribbed bit, but I love the way it looks both on and off. I was slightly apprehensive about the sizing of this coat, as I have large hips and I've noticed that normally coats on me are very tight across the hips and far too baggy around the waist. I was so happy to see that the zip of this doesn't actually start at the bottom of the coat, it starts 25cm (9inches) from the bottom, which means that it doesn't pull around you and give you an odd shape (it also makes it much easier to sit in.) As I live in Australia I got the large (which is quite fitted on me) because I won't have the need of wearing anything bulky underneath to keep me warm. If you do live in a colder climate, I would definitely consider sizing up, just so you can fit jumpers underneath. The coat does run true to size though.

review_summary: The fit on this coat is v

My only slight complaint is that the zipper would get stuck a lot when I first got the coat, but for some reason it's worked better over time.

review_summary: At first I was a bit worr

review_summary: I needed to leave a revie

This coat rocks.

review_summary: I was in love with this c

review_summary: I fell in love with this

I waited 3 restocks to get this item, and it was totally worth the wait!  A quality jacket with a nice dose of attitude.  The ribbed collar is a great addition for those cold days, and the length is just perfect.  Could not be more pleased, thanks ModCloth!

review_summary: I LOVE this coat! It is h
