review_text: This coat is ever so warm and stylish. As a commuter I use a crossbody bag that usually starts to wear down the buttons of my other coats. This one is so minimalistic modern and helps keep a slim waist line while keeping me warm.

The rest of the Jacket fits perfectly length wise and is flattering to a curvy figure. And the collar is perfect if you have winter breathing problems like asthma set of by cold air... Warm enough for Missouri winter when worn with a mid weight sweater or hoodie.  I have already received several compliments.  Well worth the $140.

review_text: Love cut and style of this coat; however, did not wash before wear and black dye got on scarf, gloves, car seat!  Also, not so warm in windy weather unless paired with a hoody.  Still like coat just expected better insulation for the price ...

I LOVE this coat!!!! And not just because it hints at my favorite wizard!! I love this and have gotten so many compliments on it! Love, love Love this coat!!!  It's the perfect dress up or casual coat.  It fits very nicely and when it gets super cold, just put on a scarf and your set!

review_summary: In it, I spiral away to a
review_text: In it, I spiral away to a perilous double life. review_summary: I love this coat. The fit
review_text: I love this coat. The fit is just right, so if you like a little wiggle room, I would consider a size larger. However, I've worn this with a sweater, and it didn't feel too tight. The sweater collar is removable, but I think this is a perfect attachment for cold winters. The coat zips up to your shoulder and the collar flips up and snaps, the sweater part will cover your ears and mouth, which if a cold wind comes up... is awesome! The cut of this coat is very slimming with those of us with wider hips, and the large collar balances everything out. It's a perfect black wool coat that doesn't look like every other coat you see out there. I do wish the wool was a little thicker, but that's not due to quality (which is good) it's just really cold where I live and I don't really want a poofy coat. I think this coat will do fine until we get below zero and then I'll will have to wear more layers, but that really is nothing new.

review_summary: I had to have this coat a

I attempted to buy this coat three times and it was sold out from under me even during the check out process. Twice this happened! Love, love, love this coat!  This coat is a more structured peice than I'm used to, but it's perfect.  The fit for me (being on the short side) was pretty perfect.  The length comes to just over my hips and butt. I'm a little curvy for my height, but it does not over accentuate that at all. I was just a bit afraid that the hip area wasn't going to fit but it's an amazing fit. I have enough room for a long sleeve and a sweater underneath. I just wished I had made my purchase now that they have the free shipping, oh well.

This is the most perfect coat. I wanted something simple and classic, with a bit of a twist. I am 5'4 114 lbs and the size Small fits me like a glove. It is a good length, and it is great quality. It keeps me toasty warm, and it will be a staple part of my wardrobe in the cooler months to come. Also, I love that it doesn't have a lot of buttons, or belts, or anything to fuss with. Just so perfect. A+++

review_summary: When I first saw this coa
review_text: When I first saw this coat, it was love. I waited patiently for ModCloth to put this beauty up for purchase after the initial Coming Soon preview. And when it finally arrived, I didn't hesitate to order. Unfortunately, I couldn't quite make heads or tails of the shoulder measurements offered, so I just went for the size that I typically get: Medium. Turned out that was too small. The coat is very fitted and while I could get in and out, I wouldn't have been able to wear anything underneath. So I sent it back and waited for a Large. Perfection! Still very fitted, but with the additional room necessary for clothing. It's warm, but not overbearing. I love that the collar buttons up and stands up straight to keep the wind out. The only slight complaint is that the knitted neck piece, which is removable, is a bit of a pain to put on and take off. Not the biggest deal since I prefer my scarves, but just to put that out there. I'm super satisfied with this piece and can't wait for winter to arrive!

review_summary: Love this coat  it is so
review_text: Love this coat  it is so slimming and warm and comfortable!  The large fits perfectly and the removable knitted interior scarf/collar piece is a really nice touch money very well spent; certainly I haven't seen anything in a store I liked better for a basic, classic black coat

I rarely give anything 5 stars, but I really can't think of anything wrong with this coat. It's stylish, flattering, and warm. I removed the ribbed collar because I liked the cleaner, more classic look without it (see photos).

Very happy with this coat overall. I was looking for a sleek, fitted winter coat and this fits the bill. I love that the collar can be pulled up and buttoned around the neck, eliminating the need for a scarf on super cold days. Be warned, because it is a snug fit, it does run slightly smaller and does not leave a lot of wiggle room I really probably could've afforded to get a M but I am fine with a S because I did not intend to wear this with bulkier sweaters anyway. It is slightly flared at the bottom, but it still manages to project a pleasing slimmer silhouette.

review_summary: I had been looking for a
review_text: I had been looking for a really great black coat for a while and I'm so glad I bought this. It's really versatile because of the different ways that you can wear the collar and I get a lot of compliments on it! It's well made and warm. My only wish is that it was a tad bit shorter, but I'm a fairly short person so this isn't a surprise.

This coat is gorgeous, wellmade, and the perfect mix of hip and classic.  I found that it runs a tiny bit on the small side  I'm a size 6 with an athletic build and though the Medium fits me well, I don't think I could wear it comfortably over a bulkyweight sweater.  Still, it's worth the money and I'm so glad I own it!
Based on other reviews I got the XL. It is a big big, which means you can fit a thick sweater underneath. Which is what you want in a winter coat, especially in the Manitoba winters.

review_summary: I was so fortunate to sna
review_text: I was so fortunate to snag this coat when it came back in stock! First the quality is amazing and second the coat is beyond adorable and unique. It is the perfect weight for my TN winters. I don't see many unique or different style coats or jackets, may be the reason this one stood out to me.

review_summary: I was so excited when thi
review_text: I was so excited when this coat came back in stock.  I was a little hesitant to buy it at first because of the steep price tag, but I decided to take the plunge!  And I'm glad I did.  I definitely wish it were a little less expensive, but hopefully it'll last me for a few winters :)  Its a beautiful coat and fits perfectly!

review_summary: No foolin', I am in LOVE
review_text: No foolin', I am in LOVE with this coat. It fits my body in a very flattering way and it's incredibly comfortable, too! If you're looking for a black coat in the less expensive category, choosing this one will not bring a single regret.

review_summary: This coat is great! The s
review_text: This coat is great! The shoulders fit me just right, but I have a pretty small frame so I'm not really sure how they would work out for someone with broader shoulders. I'm also not very tall, so the waistline is a bit low for me, but I'm sure it would look great on someone a few inches taller! There is plenty of room for layers underneath, and it has kept me very warm so far as the weather gets colder. Very happy with this purchase.
So perfect! I have never been happier with an online clothing purchase!

Very happy! I  missed the first round and impatiently waited for a restock. The fit is quite snug, which I wanted and is why I went for the small. A medium would allow layering, but I don't live in a super cold climate so it's not an issue. I will say that the zipper is tricky to engage, but practice should make that easier.  Overall a fab coat that looks great and will keep me toasty all winter.

This coat is fantastic! Very nice quality, and heavier than expected with 3.5 warmth rating. The lining is well structured, and I love the stylish diagonal zip. I went up to a large for my broad shoulders, and it is a little roomy in the torso but will allow for multiple layers which is good. The sleeve length is perfect as is the coat length, and I love the collar. It can be a tiny bit awkward to zip diagonally at first, but it's worth it! LOVE this coat! So stylish!

review_summary: I saw this coat and fell
review_text: I saw this coat and fell in love. I love the asymmetrical zipper and the collar. My problem is i have very broad shoulders. I also have decent bust which has recently gotten larger. I bought an XL in this coat because of my shoulders and it fits my shoulders perfectly. It is a bit large everywhere else though. I love it so much I don't want to send it back and I don't think I will. I am going to be able to layer well under it and I'm quite happy overall. Just wish smaller coats were made for people with very broad shoulders.

review_summary: I just got this coat in t
review_text: I just got this coat in the mail today and it's adorable! Unfortunately it is not very heavy, and the small did not leave me enough room to wear a sweatshirt underneath, so I will be exchanging it for a medium. The other reviews seemed to say it ran a little big, but I would go at least a size up if you'll be layering it. I live in the northeast and lit would definitely not be warm enough on its own. All of the details on the coat are great, especially the asymmetrical zipper and thick collar. I hope they are back in stock soon so I can get the right size before it starts snowing!

review_summary: I was so thrilled when th
review_text: I was so thrilled when this coat was FINALLY in stock  I swear I was checking every day (even though I had the email alert all set up). It is definitely a fantastic, quality jacket that keeps me just the right amount of warm. I know California beach cities' winters don't do much to rival the east coast but it does get cold out here and it's great for the upcoming season. Zipping it is a little awkward (because of the angle) but it's definitely worth it as I was sold on the asymmetry of the coat before anything else. It does get a little tight in the chest area if I zip it all the way up but it's not unbearably uncomfortable. The shoulder and back area were a tad bit tight but it's something I noticed only because I was driving with the coat on. I was still able to move, however, and the pluses of the coat outweigh any minor issues 10 times over. I'm very happy with my purchase!

review_summary: The coat is very warm and
review_text: The coat is very warm and I love the style.  I've worn it once and already gotten a ton of compliments.  I wish it were a little more fitted around the waist but besides that it's perfect!

review_summary: I love this coat, it fits
review_text: I love this coat, it fits great and the quality is awesome, I feel so fancy wearing it. :D

Wanted a good fall/spring coat for New England, seems like a winner. Doesn't swim over a Tshirt, isn't too tight over light layers/sweater. Collar: Must adjust for the coat to be zipped up enough to keep a draft out. A scarf would solve that problem but adds too much bulk. Love the look of the knit insert, hoped it could replace a scarf, but I?ll ditch it for better functionality. The collar up, expected in chin area, it covers half of my face. Seems a bit much. Collar construction is fantastic tho, can be flat, bunched up, or standing in different positions (dramatic). Shoulders: I have muscled/broad shoulders, afraid I'd need XL, L is fine. Has odd construction. Armpit needs to be higher. When it's too low (w/fitted arm) the whole coat rides up drastically when you move your arms around. Noticed this a lot lately (from countless brands and stores). Can?t see using a messenger bag. The feel of it hiking up is a minus, the overabundant collar situation riding up makes it worse. May end up being a fancy dressup coat for special occasions rather than everyday.Mine doesn?t look asymmetrical. Hem is even taking away the most interesting feature that attracted me to the coat. Hard to notice it really zips at an angle if your eye doesn't catch that line. In the photo those seams that don't meet (between pockets), look off by an inch. Mine practically line up, again, no visual indication it's on a slant, just looks like the zipper is off to the side.

Worth the wait, this coat is perfect. Warm without being too much for a Georgia winter but just enough room to layer for trips to colder climate. Glad I got the large as it runs very true to size. The collar is detachable and I plan to crochet an oversized hood to attach to the buttons. I wish the liner was a better material but overall very happy with the purchase.

review_summary: Haven't had a chance to w

review_text: I just got my coat today and I'm already in love. The length, the fitit's all very flattering, especially for a curvier body. I'm very excited about this coat!

review_summary: I ran my old winter coat
review_text: I ran my old winter coat into the ground with 10 years of wear. Looking for a new, versatile, and stylish coat that can last just as long  this is it! Pounced on it right away, and it fits like a dream. I have a larger bust, which is my primary sizing concern, but this is fitted without being super tight in the bust. Enough room for layers underneath, perfect for a Minnesota winter!

review_summary: I got to wear this alread
review_text: I got to wear this already during the first snow fall of winter (fall?) here in Pittsburgh. It's actually quite warm! The collar is pretty intense when worn zipped all the way up, but I know that will come in handy (the inner ribbed collar is detachable in the event you don't need the extra warmth). It's very flattering for my curvy hips even though I am petite. I've gotten several compliments on it. Very excited to wear this more once it really gets wintery. :D

I wear an 8/10 pant and some coats don't have enough room in the hips.. .but this one does! The ribbed collar is detachable, which is awesome, and the fabric is warm. This coat is totally worth the money. If the choice is between an okay coat for under $100 or this one for a bit more, I'd say definitely go with this one!

ModCloth has the most amazing shipping ever! I've been waiting for this coat to come out for a while and when it did I bought it right away! To my absolute delight it was shipped that same day! I received it two days later. The coat itself is AMAZING and everything I thought it would be! It's wonderful quality and so unique in a good way. I love it and can't wait to wear it!

review_summary: This coat is great.  I ho

I honestly wish it was slightly (an inch or two?) longer, but overall it's stylish and pretty warm without being bulky  (it's not all that warm though... will not work for a Montana winter).The collar is removeable... the zipper is a little weird in that it doesn't come down as far as it seems like it would/should.  Didn't bother me, but something to keep in mind.  Overall, very happy with this purchase...

I bought this coat 2 years ago when I moved from Houston (not much of a winter) to Denver (definitely a place that has winter). It has been 2 years and I still love it. The sleeves are a perfect length. The color is lovely and has brought me many compliments. The coat itself still looks great and keeps me warm. This was definitely a great choice for me. And the pockets! So many women's things have sad little useless pockets. The amount of stuff I can fit in the pockets of this coat is astounding. And because of the pleated skirt nature of the lower half of the coat, it doesn't make it look like my pockets are bulging and overstuffed (unless I REALLY overstuff them).
love this jacket. its good quality and very flattering

I had been looking for a good quality coat for chilly days in the pacific northwest, and this is the one! Nice warm thick material, beautifully made, great craftsmanship, the color is goregous, perfect length for layering over dresses/skirts with tights in the winter, and it has POCKETS! I ordered it in a 2X but I had lost quite a bit of weight (and accidently ordered my preweight loss size) which resulted in the coat being aboslutely MASSIVE on me! Thankfully, because I got the coat on such a sale, I was able to afford to have a local seamstress alter the coat to fit my body perfectly. That's the beauty of finding great items on sale! Couldn't reccomend this coat more, and I would have HAPPILY paid the full price for this beautiful burgandy coat!!!

This jacket fits very well and has room for a sweater underneath. The colour and shape are exactly as I expected from the photos. Very happy with this purchase!

review_summary: can i get a heck yeah Ste
review_text: can i get a heck yeah Steve Madden? after getting the green version of the Thyme coat last year (which turned out to be way too big but still adorable) i knew i had to jump on the chance for this one.  i was worried about the arms, as some people have said that they're tight.  i'm in the process of losing weight (140 gone btw) so i have a lot of extra flab on my arms wobbling around.  this was my biggest concern for the coat and i honestly didn't have to worry too much.  they're a little tight if i wear an HandM plain zip up hoodie with it or maybe a thicker sweater but it's not terrible.  ladies with bigger arms, don't worry too much.  the coat is a beautiful silhouette and classic.

This coat is just fabulous. I procrastinated on it last year and was sad it sold out. I don't need another coat but when I saw it was back in stock I snagged one fast!  Love the feminine style and color
Warm, flattering, and with a fun cut and versatility of wear. The material is soft without feeling flimsy. I love it and I've already gotten compliments.

review_summary: I love how this coat fits
review_text: I love how this coat fits on me, very warm and comfortable.

This is a beautiful coat. It is soft and very flattering. I'm short, 5'1, and it is a good length for me, falling right at the knee area. I do feel this coat runs slightly large because it fits me in the bust with a bit of room to spare and I usually have an issue with clothing being too snug on my large bust. With that said, it does not by any means look too large, or baggy. The only suggestions I would make to improve this coat are to sew the buttons on a bit tighter (none have fallen off, but they are large buttons and I can see needing to resew them on in the future), and also possibly making the shoulder pads removable. The broad shoulders are flattering to the waistline, but are a bit aggressive looking on me. I wish I were able to snap them in and out. Otherwise, the coat is beautiful and the color is gorgeous. I will get a lot of wear from this this winter!

review_summary: I was a little weary of t
review_text: I was a little weary of this jacket without trying it on before purchasing. But I can honestly say I have absolutely fallen in love. The burgundy color is perfect and it's quite warm! It was a little longer than expected but it's absolutely alright. I'm of a taller curvy build and it accentuates my curves in all of the right places! I have never been more happy with a purchase in my entire life and I can't wait to wear this all chilly season! (I also received it on Halloween which just added to my thrill of being a vampire as well)  I have never found a jacket more suitable for myself!

My goodness, I love this coat  between the cut and color, it's very striking (lots of compliments) but still classic enough to wear anywhere. The material is heavy and warm. The pockets are really wellplaced for your hands, although might look strange with lots of gloves tucked away. I'm not sure about the collar button, which is difficult to fasten, but the collar stands up without the button, and I'm so glad there wasn't a snap there instead, which would have looked unsightly when unsnapped.I often have trouble getting a coat. I have a small back and a large chest, so my usual size (medium) means that the coat looks good...but I can't lift my arms. Not so with this coat! I purchased a medium and it fits well, even with room for a bulky sweater underneath.All in all, if you're looking for a light winter coat (think: a sprinkle of snow), this one is a winner.

I always have trouble finding coats that fit both my chest and hips (I have a coke bottle shape), and the majority of pea coats or military style coats are straightcut, which makes it ... well, you know, super sucky to find coats. But then, I found THIS coat! It cinches in just right the way around the waist, flares out to hide hips, and is generous in the chest and arms. SO, SO CUTE. My only beef with it is that, despite being wool, it's  little thin. I'm worried it won't be as warm as, say, a fleecelined pea coat, but ... it's okay, I can layer. ALSO, if you're very concerned about concealing hip/butt sizes, I'd look at another style   it really emphasises curves. But I'm cool with it, so I'll be wearing this on my tour in Ireland over the Holiday :)

I really wanted the Baker Street coat, but it didn't come in my size. When I saw this one, I thought it was also very pretty and a great option. I love that longerintheback look. I'm right on the straight sizing/plus sizing border, but to allow for sweaters and such I ordered the 1X instead of the XL. The XL would've been better, I think, but I stuck with the 1X since the sash meant I could tighten it at the waist. The back is very nice and long and the coat is twirly. There were some weirdlyplaced loose stitches in the back that kept it from reaching its full flowy potential, so I undid them and it was just fine. The fabric is very nice and warm, but I found some of the stitching was poorquality. One of the seams on the side tore after maybe three months of regular wear (HEAVY regular wear...Snowmageddon was rough) when I tied it one day. I was able to fix it myself, since I'm fat and thus have to be craft with clothes, but it was disappointing in a coat of this price. It also pills pretty severely where it rubs up against my backpack and under my arms. Still, it's a very nice coat. I like having options with the collar. You can leave it unbuttoned and open and wear it with a scarf, or button it up and be able to duck your head down and tuck your face into it when it's very windy. Plus, it's an awfully pretty coat. I definitely don't regret the purchase, though for that price I feel like they could improve some on the manufacturing.

review_summary: I love this coat more tha

review_summary: Order a size down! I orig
review_text: Order a size down! I originally ordered this in an XL from looking at the size chart but it was far too large for me. I could almost fit another person inside the front of the coat. I exchanged the XL for a L and this one fits much better. This coat is such an amazing dark berry red color; it looks so great against the snow! The longer back bottom flares out just enough that I get a little drama and the differing lengths looks really nice. I love the contrast that the black belt holders and buttons add. However, this coat isn?t perfect. The first complaint I have is that one of the sleeves is a little too tight; it cuts into my skin a little bit underneath my arm. The second is that the cut of the coat an A Line; the top is skinnier then it keeps expanding to the bottom. I wish it was more of an hourglass shape where it?s a little large in the top, skinny at the waist, then larger at the bottom. The third complaint I have is that it?s a little hard to sit down in just because of the layers of fabric in the bottom. All in all, I really love this coat and plan on wearing it for a long time. It?s not perfect, but it?s what I was looking for and I really would recommend this to anyone.

I think this is my favorite modcloth purchase to datedefinitely worth the price, especially if you catch a sale (like I did)!

review_summary: I want to like this coat
review_text: I want to like this coat more than I do, but I can see myself wearing it when it gets really cold, just because there will be more room under for big sweaters. It's very bulky, and that's even after I returned it for a smaller size. I was swimming in 2X and I'm pretty much still swimming in the 1X. I'm not getting the boxiness across the shoulders like other reviewers, either (and I don't have T Rex arms or anything). I would also prefer the belt to have some sort of buckle, but I plan on adding this myself (and moving the buttons in to be tighter).
Beautiful coat!! The buttons are already loose after 3 wearings, but everything else is so nice I don't mind getting those fixed when they do finally fall off. I get compliments every time I wear it!

This coat is absolutely perfect! I love the deep, rich color, it is well constructed, plush, and gorgeous in person. I have only had it for about a week (after eyeing it for weeks and debating if I should buy it) and I have already received a ton of compliments. It is worth the price! I thought the longer length in the back would bother me (I am not a fan of uneven cut dresses) but it looks fantastic. I usually wear a size 18 around my hips, 16 if it is fit around my waist, and need plenty of boobroom.
I absolutely love this coat. Everyone should buy it.

review_summary: I have received TONS of c
review_text: I have received TONS of compliments on this coat!

This is probably my favourite winter coat ever! The colour is perfect, not tomato, just a very nice rich red. The belt gives you a nice shape but really shape isn't a big concern when its a winter coat in Canada. It keeps me very warm and believe me it gets cold up here. I've already been stopped by strangers every where I go complimenting it and asking where they can get one!

I absolutely love this coat! I get so many compliments when I wear it. My only complaint is I've seen some loose threads in the seams. I bought this on sale so I don't mind, but if I would have paid full price I would be a little upset.

Love, love, love this coat! So glad I bought it. I do find it a little large in the waist. When the buttons are done up there is lots of extra room, which would be good for bulky sweaters underneath I suppose. But I have to cinch up the tie quite tight in order to get a closer fit. I debated about getting the medium, but my shoulders are a little broad, and the large fits perfect across my shoulders, so I'm sticking with the large. Overall, I'm still very happy with this coat and I know I will be wearing it all winter!

This coat fits me perfectly! I love it!  Given my measurements, I am generally a medium in Modcloth clothing. The medium in this coat is roomy enough for me to wear a bulky sweater under it, but not so big I can't get away with just a Tshirt.I have already received several compliments on it. This coat is very well made, and it's a nice heavy material that will keep me warm during the yucky Wisconsin winters I have to endure. I also love the pockets in the front of the coat. They keep my hands nice and toasty, and you can hide a plethora of tissues, phones, chapstick, etc. in them without anyone noticing. I provided pictures to show how it fits, but please note that the coloring in the pictures makes it look a little more red than it actually is. The burgundy color in Modcloth's pictures is much more accurate (and it's gorgeous!!).You won't regret ordering this coat!

review_summary: I love, love, love this c
review_text: I love, love, love this coat!!! I get tons of compliments!

review_summary: I love this coat! The col
review_text: I love this coat! The color is beautiful and the quality seems really good. It just started getting cold here, and so far it's kept me nice and warm. I was torn between the S and M so I ordered both. Turns out the small was a better fit as the medium looked bulky. The arms are a bit tight in the shoulder/underarm areas, but it's manageable.

review_summary: I love this coat! The qua
review_text: I love this coat! The quality of materials and construction is undeniable, and the pleats are perfectly placed in the skirt. The top is roomy enough to wear thick sweaters underneath, while the belt slims the waist. I get so many compliments on this coat; it makes me want more cold weather!

review_summary: Oh. My. Gosh. I love this
review_text: Oh. My. Gosh. I love this coat! It is amazing.  Idrooled for momths over this until one magical day it went on sale!  It is truly amazing  I feel so great in this coat. Only two concerns: 1. The sleeves could be a bit longer 2. The buttons come loose so you may need to secure them more after the few joy rides in this baby

I'm usually a US size 18/20, but I ordered a size 3x because ModCloth plus sizes tend to run small. The 3x was enormous on me. The collar (shown buttoned in the photo) is very wide, think 70's disco collars. The buttons stop halfway down the jacket at my natural waist. I sent this one back.

This coat is beautiful, warm and comfortable. I should have got a small because there is still room around my waist. not for rain though, I live in Portland, Oregon so I will on be wearing it on the lighter rainy days. but goes great with jeans and brown riding boots.
I absolutely adore this coat. I love everything about it, from its soft feltlike texture, to its beautiful burgundy color. This coat is warm, cozy, and very comfortable! Worth every penny!

review_summary: I love this coat!! I was
review_text: I love this coat!! I was a little hesitant to buy a coat without trying it on but it fits perfectly! I'm 6ft tall and the sleeve and hem lengths hit me at all the right spots. The fabric is so soft and comfy and it's so warm, I just love wearing it. Buy it!!

I absolutely adore this coat! I got it a few weeks ago and I already love it. The fit is true to size. The color is true to what is shown (and absolutely gorgeous, might I add). The fabric is delightfully ohsosoft. The coat is just heavy enough to keep me warm without being too heavy/bulky. I love the pleating in the back. Being a girl with a bit of a booty, I appreciate that the pleats and skirtlike lower half of the coat actually allow for a bit of give in that area. Other coats I've had have been tight around the butt/hips, but not this one! Another plus of this coat... I often find that when shirts, dresses, jackets, etc. have a defined waist with an attached belt, the waistline is way too high for my body! I guess my torso tends to be on the longer side, and this coat seems to be tailored for someone with a more average/longer torso. Love it! I truly couldn't be happier with my purchase.

Love this coat! The fabric is delightfully smooth and soft, the color is gorgeously rich, and it feels really well constructed. The top of the torso runs a bit big and blousey (you can actually see that in the picture). I usually wear a 1X, but since the reviews said this ran large I tried both an XL and a 1X.  The arms of the XL were way too tiny. The 1X was a little big but still cinched nicely with the belt at the waist so I'm keeping it. I love the contrasting color of the belt loop, the the pockets set into the front pleats. It really is a beautiful coat. My only issue is that I found the top button to be impossible to close. I had to have someone else do it for me. Hopefully this will loosen up over time. I'm very pear shaped, but this fit well on my smaller torso and wider hips while the slight highlow hem keeps it from being too short in the back. I have been looking for a coat like this for years. I love it so much!

review_summary: Love the color and cut of
review_text: Love the color and cut of this coat! I'm a bigger girl but still find the flow of this coat flattering. Tempted to buy it it black too!

review_summary: I LOVE this coat! It's be
review_text: I LOVE this coat! It's beautiful, it's soft, and the lining is perfect. I can't find one visual I dislike with this coat, and even with the complaints of the back making your butt look huge, I find it to be perfect. My rear is already pretty big, but the coat doesn't it bad. I feel very feminine and lovely when I wear it. The only downside is the fit in the shoulders. It's snug, and I can't cross my arms all the way, but it's not a deal breaker.  I'm tall, and the sleeves are a TINY bit short, but not enough to look bad. I want everyone to feel as beautiful as I do in this coat!

This coat is gorgeous in person and it's thick.  The style is so flattering but if you have a big butt, it may not work for you.  I am more of an apple shape and am thinner on the bottom so it works for me.  I normally wear a size 18 bottom and 2x or 18/20 top.  I love love love this coat.  I'm short so I need to get the sleeves taken in, but that's totally not a problem.  Buy this coat, it's my first ModCloth purchase and I couldn't be happier, price is great too.  It looks like a very high end coat, simply gorgeous.

review_summary: I love the style of this
review_text: I love the style of this coat!! The skirt, the belt, the color...the whole package! My only complaint is that it is a bit on the large side, but it's not so large that I had to send it back. Overall, a great purchase!

My first mod cloth purchase and I love it! Love this coat! Perfect length for me, and I'm a tallish girl (5'10). Fits just like the pictures on the model. I haven't really tested it out in the super cold weather yet, but I don't expect it to be like a cold weather coat. More like a fall coat, good for 30 degrees or higher. :)
LOVE THIS COAT!!

Love this coat! The color is perfect and it really flatters my curves. Very warm and the belt is a great addition. The buttons started to get loose after a few wears, but thankfully I'm a Jane of all trades and fixed them :) I'm a solid size 8 and the medium was a perfect fit. I was nervous about my 34d fitting in a medium, but a larger would have swallowed my 5'4 frame :)
It's a beautiful coat!  Heavy and lined, perfect for winter!  I sized up because of my large bust, so the shoulders are a little big, but otherwise it is perfect.  Love it!

This coat is exceedingly cute.  I wish I could have kept it, however what I needed was a warm winter coat, and this is not it.It fit perfectly, and had I not already owned a number of other similar coats, I would have kept it in a heartbeat.It is not warm.  It is adorable.

review_summary: Fits just right on me and
review_text: Fits just right on me and is a really beautiful color. It's long, it goes down to my knees, but I like that about it. The high collar looks a little weird, but I like that I have the option to put it up like that if it's cold.

review_summary: Oh do I love this coat! I
review_text: Oh do I love this coat! I have another of a similar style from Steve Madden in camel and was hoping this one wold be just as perfect, and it is. The stand up collar with the button closure is awesome, requiring no scarf if you choose. The flare in the back lays pretty flat so it doesn't add any extra volume, just a neat touch. Definitely a winner that will last for many winters. I wear a 810 in dresses and the L fit perfect.

I get compliments on this coat every time I wear it! The fabric is soft and good quality, and the bottom of the coat flares out, which adds a touch of interest. The waist is a bit big, but I'm able to tie the belt tighter which makes up for that! The buttons aren't sewn on very well, so I will have to sew them back on a little tighter, but overall, a beautiful coat!

review_summary: This jacket is a bit long
review_text: This jacket is a bit longer and generally larger than I thought. It's very classy, and it's always complimented when I wear it, though. I love it.

I'm very happy with this coat, and I've gotten a ton of compliments.  I've also gotten a few Carmen Sandiego comparisons, but I'm choosing to ignore those!  I'm a bit busty, so I was a little worried about the fit in the chest, but, while it's snug, it's not unflattering or uncomfortable.

Absolutely gorgeous! I have gotten the best compliments on this coat. Make sure,however, that you cut the manufacturer stitches on the back/bottom of the coat. It definitely looks odd if you don't. I forgot about them and wore it, and kept wondering why my coat was not flaring as expected. Easy fix. You will not regret this coat, and the gorgeous red color goes with almost anything!

This coat is beautiful! I'm usually a medium or large on this site, so I went with the smaller size (M) as other reviewers suggested, and it fits perfectly. I'm also a curvy gal, so I was worried when other reviewers said it wasn't very flattering on ladies with curves. However, I just had to order it and find out for myself, and I'm glad I did! I love the way it fits my body  the tie belt cinches the coat in at my natural waistline, and the full skirt creates a beautiful hourglass shape. I also love the true cranberry red color. I receive compliments every time I wear it! If you're considering giving this coat a try, I urge you to go for it.
I was hesitant to purchase this coat because I have another that's of a similar color. I'm extremely pleased my roommate talked me into buying it. Wonderful fit, great shape, and beautiful color.

review_summary: The waist was a little bi
review_text: The waist was a little big on me, but it gathers in the back and looks fine. There's an effect in the back a bit like a bustle. The arm hole fit is a smidge loose, but I needed the large for the shoulder size. It looks really cute and oldfashioned without being costumey.

review_summary: This was cute but waaay t
review_text: This was cute but waaay too big on me. The length was very long too. Returning!

This coat is beautiful and very flattering.  The color is lovely and the shape is great.  My only complaint is that it's a bit tight in the sleeves for me.  Right now I can wear it with a thin shirt, but wouldn't be able to wear it with a sweater or suit.  It might be a good idea if ModCloth reports on the width of sleeves for coats.  I'd probably go up a size if I didn't have to do with international shipping for the return.

This coat is so beautiful. I stared at it for so long before deciding to splurge. This coat is pretty big on me since I guess I am pretty small (5'4 and 105 pounds.) It reaches my knees in the back and there's plenty of extra space after buttoning it up. Also, this does make your hips look pretty wide so if you lack curves like me, this could work. If only there was an XSmall, but I can't bear to give it up so hopefully it'll fit a little better once I start layering for winter.

review_summary: I wanted so badly to love
review_text: I wanted so badly to love this coat, but it just wasn't happening. I usually wear a small, but sized up based on the reviews. I don't think I have bulky arms at all, but the sleeves were so tight and I couldn't lift my arms without fear of tearing it. The rest of it fit nicely, so if I'd gone to a large, it would have drowned me. Also, the leather belt loops looked cute online, but in person look really cheap, and that's just not what you want in such an expensive coat. In the end, it just wasn't worth the money to me. On a positive note, customer service was very helpful in sending me a return label and putting a note in my order about no longer having the invoice (my efficienttoafault hubby took it out with the recycling).

review_summary: As soon as I saw this on
review_text: As soon as I saw this on Mod Cloth I loved it and I knew that I wanted it.  I read the review carefully and decided that the XL would be the right size for me.  It fits well everywhere but is a touch small in the arms.  I would not be able to wear very bulky sweaters with it.  It is fairly warm and will definitely be warm through out this winter!!!

review_summary: I so wanted this to love
review_text: I so wanted this to love this coat and I do! Just not quite on my slender body. It looks a bit too big around the waist and the top collar looks really odd and bulky on me when folded down. I've been wanting this coat for months and when the outerwear was on sale I jumped at the chance of buying it. Still not sure if I will return it, I'd hate to being that I saved so much on it! If only it came in and XS!!! Definitely recommended for those who aren't super thin.

This coat fabric and color are beautiful. It didn't fit me right unfortunately. The top made my shoulders look very broad and the back wasn't the most flattering. I thought I could make it work but I just can't. Sad to send it back.

This coat is so perfect! I am beyond happy with this purchase. I live in Maine and it gets FREEZING up here, so I wanted a nice coat to keep me warm. The lining is lovely and it's perfect for the New England winter (providing you have a sweater underneath). The fabric used is a gorgeous color, and extremely soft. The only reason that it got four stars was because the width of the upper arm was a bit on the small side, and the lower arm a bit on the big side for me (I have very slim wrists and lower arms). It is a lovely, (on the formal side) jacket and I plan on wearing it for years to come. Overall, I am very happy with this jacket!

Love love love this coat. The shoulders are slightly tight but I've never had a coat that wasn't. Everything else is just right. The color is brighter than it looks, more red, less berry but that just makes me like it even more.
Absolutely love this coat!

review_summary: I love this jacket!  It l
review_text: I love this jacket!  It looks great on, and fits perfectly! The belt means that I can cinch it when I need to, or leave more room for layering. The bottom hits me midthigh, and the sleeves are long enough so it works for the taller ladies.
Super cute coat! Perfect color for any outfit!

This coat is everything I dreamed of and more! I know...sounds corny. But in all honesty it fits me (as you can see in my picture) exactly like it does in the picture on the model. I never know, especially with jackets how it will look/fit on me, but I am pleasantly surprised that this one is perfection. Now, I can't speak for all women because I imagine women with larger chests might have some issues with the buttons up top, etc. but I love the shape of the coat, it really creates a nice hour glass figure. As far as how warm it will actually be, I won't be able to tell until winter, but the coat left me enough room to fit a sweater underneath so at least there's that! Overall I think it's a very good quality coat...and unique too!!

For the price, I'm pleased with this coat. It's a soft felt, not of the best quality, but it's so cute! We're only in the 40's here, and it has been warm with a medium weight sweater underneath. The pleats and angled hem of the skirt are flattering to my figure. Who knew I'd end up with great statement coats from Modcloth!?

I adore this coat, though I am very disappointed with the buttons. I've had the coat a little over a month and all three main buttons have already come loose! Definitely be prepared to reinforce them. The silhouette is extremely flattering, and I get compliments everywhere I go.

review_summary: I love this jacket! The f
review_text: I love this jacket! The fit is great except for in the shoulders (a little tight, slightly uncomfortable) which I was not expecting! The fit everywhere else was perfect. I will be keeping it but will only be able to wear it with dresses or shirts with no sleeves, which is unfortunate.
Love this coat! Fantastic quality and fits very well. The color is beautiful and the fabric is very soft.
gorgeous coat which looks just as great on as it does in the picture! the fabric is beautiful and very soft. can't wait to wear it! worth every penny :)
LOVE THIS COAT! It's amazing! The color is so rich, and its so warm. The fit is great, even on my tiny frame. Even with a sweaters had no problem. I fully recommend this coat!!!!!!!

review_summary: I have been eyeing this c
review_text: I have been eyeing this coat for sooooo long. I'm so glad I finally went for it and purchased it. It is just the right color and such great quality. Hugs my waist and is really flattering. I'm in love! Seems like it will be quite warm for the winter too!

Love love love this coat! I ordered a small, and it fits perfectly! I'm barely five three, so I was a little concerned when I read a few reviews saying it wasn't a good style for petite girls, but it fits perfectly. I don't know my exact measurements, but I'm usually around a 4/6, and the Small fit perfectly. The coat is a little snug in the shoulders, so I can't raise my arms all the way, but it's not really an issue unless I'm trying to have a snowball fight. It's a beautiful coat, can't wait until it's cold enough to wear it!

review_summary: I love the color and feel
review_text: I love the color and feel of this coat (mine is not floral on the interior, as these pictures show, btw) but the flare is fairly extremem at the bottom. I'm guessing the model [photo] hadn't unthreaded the bottom's factorystitching yet. It's almost flouncy at the bottom. That said, it complements skirts or flared dresses nicely.

review_summary: This is exactly what I wa
review_text: This is exactly what I wanted in a winter coat! Can't wait to wear it! It is a little snug in the shoulders but fits well everywhere else, pretty much true to size.
Love this!
Beautiful jacket. I have received many compliments.
This coat is worth every penny! It is great quality material and fits like a glove. It's also very flattering and very warm. I'm looking forward to winter with this coat.

I've been obsessed with this coat since I saw it was in stock. I just got the coat today and I love the fabric and color. You can definitely tell its a quality coat but its way too big! I normally buy 2x and I was swimming in the coat! I'm totally exchanging this coat for a size down. Other than needing to get the right size, the coat is beautiful!

review_summary: I loved the way it looks
review_text: I loved the way it looks on me, very flattering! I like the fabric, it's very soft. I'm not sure about the X stitches at the bottom of the coat, they look like they gonna tear... Anyway, can't wait 'till winter comes!

review_summary: I was so excited when I g
review_text: I was so excited when I got this in the mail. I tried it on as soon as I got to my car. It is perfect. My boyfriend loves it because it's so ME! I was prepared for the coat to be longer since I'm short, but at 5'2, the front ends at just above my knees. It is tight around the armpits when I try to lift my arms, but it isn't that bad, and my hands will barely be up often anyway. I'm usually a size small (and size 5) at every place I shop, and ModCloth was no different. A wonderful investment!!
This jacket is just what I have been looking for for a winter coat!!!! And it goes perfect with most all my dressy clothes as well as jeans!

review_summary: I was so excited to get t
review_text: I was so excited to get this jacket! But alas, it was not meant to me. Firstly, it was too big. I ordered a 2x because I was afraid of it being too tight. I am size 16 jeans. Top runs any where from LXXL. In dresses 1620. So, I was all over the spectrum and went with the 2x, it dwarfed me. Also, my backside is rather large and like others said, it did not compliment. I will not be ordering this in a smaller size, I'm thinking about getting the Pep Rally Perfection Coat in Plus Size, just waiting for reviews to pop up to see if I should get a 1x or 2x.

Oh dear, large bottomed ladies, pass this one by. The coat is cut longer in back, so since I'm shortish it was weirdly long. But the rear! It's pleated in a way that actually made me look like I was wearing an Edwardian bustle. Loved the feel, the color, the belt, and actually everything else, and almost kept it, but decided there were other coats in the world.
I adore this beautiful coat. It's so warm and comfortable!

review_summary: This is destined to be th
review_text: This is destined to be the saddest return I've ever made. I waited so long for it to come back into stock and the day it became available I placed my order like a giddy school girl. I received it today and could hardly contain my excitement as I opened the box. And I wasn't disappointed. The coat is BEAUTIFUL! The color is lovely, the quality is top notch, it's warm, it's very nearly perfect. Unfortunately (for me at least) it was to big and since there's not a smaller size offered I'm going to have to accept defeat and return it. So, if you're waffling on weather or not to buy it, you should, it's fabulous.

review_summary: I JUST tried it on and it
review_text: I JUST tried it on and its beautiful! albeit a little big. Im a plus size, tall, busty girl and its plently large. However, Im unsure if a size down would be too tight. The coat is just gorgeous. beautiful lining, the color is slightly darker than it appears in the picture and for me, the difference between the length in back and front are closer together than the picturewhich is fine, considering its just...so...pretty. Im fair and blonde and usually avoid lots of red because I feel like it makes me look strangenot this coat. Now, if Metro Detroit would just get cold....

review_summary: I was so inlove with this
review_text: I was so inlove with this coat for a few months, I couldn't get it out of my head. So I decided to buy it and it was one of my best fashion decisions. I only receive complements while wearing it. It's super comfy, always stylish and quite warm.I love that I can always turn up the collar and there's another button to close it, so I don't need a scarf.The only thing that's a bit annoying is that the pockets tend to rip and then you have to sew them again, but that's nothing compared to a perfect coat.

This coat is SO beautiful! My husband bought it for me as a Christmas present (and I don't think I was supposed to open the box! OOPS) and it is perfect! Great color, very accurate to the picture! Love it !!!!

review_summary: I love this coat! I have
review_text: I love this coat! I have gotten SO many compliments from random strangers on it, and I love how unique it is. The only problem I have had thus far is that the top button came loose, but tightening it back up shouldn't be a problem.

review_summary: I love this coat! It is t
review_text: I love this coat! It is thick enough for warmth and long enough to cover cold thighs. The asymmetrical cut gets lots of compliments. It has a little more material in the bust than I would like (pouches a little), but overall not something I think is noticeable to others. Beautiful coat.
Lovely! Was worried it was going to be too small up top, but it fits like a dream.

Pros: Stay warm without the I can't put my arms down! hassle.  You're going to look amazing.OMG Pockets. They're huge and hidden right in the front folds of the coat so nobody even notices they're A) there and B) stuffed to the max with gloves and tissues and iPods.  I felt like Mary Poppins.Cons: That adorable chain to hang the coat on broke 1 day into owning it. It really was only as strong as its weakest link and this is one heavy coat.The sleeves were juuuust a bit too long, but they keep your wrists warm and you'll be hiding them in those OMG pockets anyway.It's gorgeous, and totally worth it.  I'm actually sad winter hasn't been colder where I am to wear it more.

review_summary: Overall I like how this c
review_text: Overall I like how this coat fits. Normally I am a M but I got the L so I could put some heavy sweaters on under it. I agree about the waist issue. The whole thing looks a little bulky but overall I really love it!

review_summary: I bought this coat last y
review_text: I bought this coat last year in white in an XL.  I lost some weight over the summer, but when I tried on the large I realized that my shoulders were just too broad for it.  While the hip and stomach area fit better in the large, I was able to move around more with the XL.  I noticed other reviewers saying they had trouble with the shoulder width, but this seems to be common for winter coats.  This is hands down the best coat I have ever bought, and I will buy it in every color that comes out!
I purchased this coat on 11/16/11 and I just have two wordsLOVE IT!! It was everything i wanted in a coat!! Thanks Steve Madden!! Modcloth as well!!:)

review_summary: I'd been dying to get thi
review_text: I'd been dying to get this coat for ages, unfortunately the smalls were sold out within an hour so I had to get the medium. Being 510 and a size small makes finding coats very difficult but the length and sleeves fit well. It just sucked having to pay extra and wait longer to get the waist taken in. It's worth it though! This coat is gorgeous.

This Steve Madden Coat is super luxurious! The texture was so soft, but didn't feel like it would pill up too bad or too quickly.  The leatherlike  belt loops make a fancy contrast with the buttons.  I said the fit was a little small only because my shoulders and arms were snug, but that also happens in a lot of coats so if you don't typically have that issue than it will likely be a great fit for you!I will sadly be returning it because my chest is just a tad too big when paired with my broader shoulders causing the top button or two to pull funny.  But I would still say this coat is a fantastic piece!

review_summary: I love the color of this
review_text: I love the color of this coat, and it's quite warm. I'm not crazy about the faux leather accents, and the way it flares in the back definitely makes the hips look big!

This is my favorite coat. It is warm, and I love the color! The color is a winehue, very similar to the photo! I love the full skirt and leather detail as well! The buttons are sturdy and the belt really shows off your shape! Great purchase!
Great coat! LOVE it! Good quality and a gorgeous deep cranberry/ruby color.

review_summary: I agree with the other re
review_text: I agree with the other reviewers that this coat is not meant for most petite ladies.  I too stalked this coat for weeks and whipped my credit card out as soon as it was back in stock.  I received it last weekend and it is just as gorgeous in person as it is in the photo, however, just not flattering on me.  I am going to try it on one more time tomorrow with heels and tights (or something sleeker than jeans on the bottom), but in reality I'm looking for an everyday coat to replace my peacoat, not a special occasion coat.  So, if any of you are waiting for a Medium, check back in a few weeks!  Happy shopping!!
Beautiful color, fit, length and overall look.

review_summary: I cant decide if this was
review_text: I cant decide if this was a hit or a miss... I don't even know how to rate it so I just rated it down the middle.I have a large bust (between a 34 DDE and DDDF) so I have coverage which is always great to have and hard to find but I am short and for some reason the coat makes me look even shorter. AND it makes me look like I have a much larger rear than I actually do. I was also a bit disappointed that its polyester blend and not wool or wool blend  but that's my fault for not reading the details closer before ordering  it would have been worth the little annoyances in wool/wool blend especially for the $$$. I love the cut and the color but I just cant decide whether or not this coat is really for me. I'm trying so hard to love it. I wish I could try it one size down but the M is all sold out now. Its getting colder and I really need to settle on a coat that will get me through the winter but won't make me feel like I'm actually settling...

I absolutely adore this coat!  I don't have any pictures in it, but I would post them if I did.  I am so happy with this purchase, it turned out so lovely and fits so well.  I feel very elegant in it.

This was my first official ModCloth purchase and I got the wrong size! I followed the sizing chart to a t and according to it, I'm a large. Well at 5'3 and a half, 146 lbs, and 34B, the large turned out to be waaay too big! Becaus ethis was such an amazing coat, of course it sold out! I then spent the next three weeks stalking this website waiting for ModCloth Lover Mary down below to return the coveted Medium that didn't fit her properly... and it paid off!! I got my coat and I couldn't be more happy! It's absolutely stunning! The moment you pick up the coat you can feel the quality of the material, nice and heavy! The color is this amazing crimson red, true to the picture! The flared skirt of the coat is to die for! I would say though, you can't wear this coat by itself, you have to at least wear some stockings if you're planning on wearing it as a dress on account that the front part is short! But, overall I'm so, extremely, happy that I bought this! Oh, the only downside, it seems to be a bit of a lint magnet but who cares!

The color matches the photo on the site perfectly. It's supremely soft. The front goes about to my midthigh and the back right above my knee. I normally wear a medium, and so I got one. Great news, it fits well on all accounts. I'm not sure exactly how they did their tie in the photo, I can't quite figure it out. It's adorable, femine and I've already gotten compliments on it from strangers. It has just enough room underneath for a top and a light jacket. I prefer longer sleeves, so I'll be wearing those underneath.Heads up, If you got a booty, be careful as this may make it look a bit bigger.This was my first nonsale item I've purchased and trust me, you'll love it.

review_summary: Over all I'm happy with t
review_text: Over all I'm happy with this coat. It was a tad off on sizing for me. I have a longer than average torso, so the belt hits me just above the place it should. I got a large because i have a larger bust and wider shoulders. In those places it fits great, however i have a smaller waist (28 in) so its a little big. It looks right if i leave the last button undone and pull it tighter though. Its made well, its heavy (the package was 4 lbs and all i got was the coat and a small necklace) so that should be good for northern illinois winters.

I really, really wanted this coat to work for me cuz it is adorable!  But sadly, this is not for petite girls. : (  I'm 5'2 and 115 pounds and the small was just way too big for me.  I looked like a pirate or something in it.  Just thought I'd post a review in case other petite ladies are eyeing this one!  It really is gorgeous and well made!

Bigger sized gals need to know that this is not a flattering cut at all  the pleats are a deeper cut than the picture and they are not flattering to anyone who has a bigger booty they want to minimize.  I have a smaller chest so it fit on top, but anyone bigger than a B/C cup may have difficulty.  Also, the longer in the back cut seemed like a good idea...until I put it on.  Then it just looked off, probably because we are not used to seeing that style.  Looks like this is probably something tiny girls can get away with.  Lastly, the color red was faded in some areas  it even looked orange at parts instead the beautiful ruby red.  I was really excited to get this in the mail because of all the good reviews.  But in the end, the overall coat was disappointing.  The faded color made me doubt ModCloth, but I have had great success with them before so I am going to try another purchase.

review_summary: It's a nice color and I l
review_text: It's a nice color and I love the neck and the big buttons, but a couple of things you may want to keep in mind if you're thinking of buying it: (1) the bottom half is pleated and therefore makes your bottom look bigger, and that is not very flattering on me in the front or the back (2) be sure you like the asymmetrical cut, shorter in the front and longer in the back, I'm not too crazy about that esp because it gives a shorter look.

review_summary: I'm so glad I ordered thi
review_text: I'm so glad I ordered this coat.  I've been eyeing a red coat forever and just hadn't found one that I really liked.  Enter the Winterberry Tart Coat, great length, flattering shape, warm....I feel like I'm wearing a pretty red dress over my clothes!

I ordered this coat right away when it was for sale the first day!  The actual color is a perfect shade of dark red!  The craftsmanship and details are superb.  The lining is nicely stitched to the shell with a piping of contrasting color, and the coat can be hung at the collar by a cute metal chain with a little bow charm. The slightly oversized buttons go really well with the belt loops.  The shell material is sturdy and heavy.  The shape of the coat came right back after it was unfold from the box.

review_summary: First of all this is a be
review_text: First of all this is a beautiful coat. The ruby color is lovely, and the quality of the coat is top notch. Unfortunately, the fit just didn't work for me. I am normally a Small, but that was sold out, so I tried the Medium. As soon as I slipped it on I thought the Medium would be perfect because it was slightly snug in the shoulders, and I only had a light shirt on  not a bulky sweater. But when I went to button the coat I realized it was just too big overall. I tied the belt to see if that masked the size issue but it didn't. For me, the appeal of this coat was not only the style and color, but also how it comes in nicely to highlight the waist. In my case the Medium doesn't do this, and the Small will likely be too tight in the shoulders. Sadly, this beautiful coat is going right back.

i got the 1x in mustard. beautiful material, textured like upholstery (i like that) but very soft. i have freakishly fat arms so it's a little tight but for nonmutants it's probably perfect to size. i want more colors, i think... :)

Very beautiful coat! Well fitted, nice texture and rather cozy!
Much too large. Swalled up in the fabric. Hood is very large, on purpose for the fairytale style impact. But, too much material for me. Returning.

I always get compliments on this coat. The way the hood drapes is just gorgeous. The buttons make me a little nervous  they're not as tightly attached as I'd prefer  but haven't had any mishaps yet. I ordered a size lower than I normally would and it fits great. Overall, I am happy with this purchase.

Really cute coat. I love the silhouette and the hood. I need to see all but 1 of the buttons back on (fortunately they all fell off while I noticed so I didn't lose any, but for the price, I would expect them to be sewed on well.) Love this coat! Wished they had XS when I purchased it!

review_text: Oh I wish this existed in a small and I could exchange. It's just a wee bit too big. Not enough to return it because I'm obsessed, but just enough to look slightly frumpy. I don't know if it's worth the full price, but I bought it on sale.

review_summary: I love the fit and look o
review_text: I love the fit and look of this coat! It looks perfect with both dresses and jeans. I lost 2 buttons within an hour of first wearing it, and I now have 2 more buttons barely hanging on. I love it overall though, so I plan on just reinforcing the remaining buttons and sewing the others back on.

review_summary: I took the advice of many
review_text: I took the advice of many who have reviewed this coat and I purchased a size down from my normal size. I'm normally a medium (about a 6), so I bought a small. I'm very happy that I did so! This coat fits beautifully in a size down. The quality is just lovely. The material is even nicer than I expected. I also love that it is a highlow coat  very flattering and different from your average peacoat. I have a short square torso and a large bust, so it doesn't quite look like it does on the mannequin, but it does help me in giving me a flattering shape, considering what I have to work with as far as my body's shape. To anyone who has red hair, I HIGHLY recommend purchasing this coat for the color alone! The mustard looks so awesome with red hair, as well as red lips. I feel like the girl from The Village in this coat, just a modern twist. Super fun, super cute, great quality!

review_summary: So far I'm very happy wit
review_text: So far I'm very happy with this coat.  One of the buttons fell off the first day I wore it  luckily I found it and was able to sew it back on, as well as resew all the other buttons to hopefully avoid losing more of them.I wish there was an inside pocket  the outside pocket placement is a little strange, but I'll get used to it, it is a tiny bit snug across my shoulders, but not enough that I can't wear a sweater under it.. Overall I'm loving this coat.

Beautiful coat!  I love the hoodplenty of room for a nice thick scarf, even with the hood up.  The color is a little darker and more mustardy than it looked on my computer screen, but still gorgeous!  I'm very excited to look good AND be prepared for the stormy El Ni?o winter this year.

I would normally have ordered a medium by default but the small fits me like a glove.

The coat is absolutely beautiful. The material looks authentically vintage. I get compliments from random strangers frequently. The only issue, however, is that the buttons are not sewed on well. All I did was unbutton it gently and it started to come loose, eventually falling off at a later time when removing it. I'm going to have the remaining buttons sewed reinforced, because I really love this jacket. The fit is perfect.
Beautiful color and just heavy enough for the cold southern days.
Love it! What everyone said was true! Size down (got an xl instead of the 1x ) and reinforce the buttons! What a great color and original coat, so many compliments!

review_summary: This coat is lovely and w
review_text: This coat is lovely and warm.  The bias cut is very cute, and looks great with heels. The two negatives are that the hood is so massive, it's completely impractical (unless you want to run through the woods in a Victorian romance novel, then it's perfect), and it's very thick, which makes my back hot.  Also,  a button fell off the third time I wore it,  so I've had to reinforce all of them.
So warm, comfortable and I love the deep pockets! It's had some pulling of fabric on the sleeves, but it's still beautiful! Everyone compliments it!

review_summary: First I have to say I LOV
review_text: First I have to say I LOVE this coat. The color, the cut, the style is perfect mix of sexy and adorable. The hood is my favorite part. I have broad shoulders and long arms but this coat fits comfortably even with a thick sweater or hoodie on. The color in person is just as pictured above. This thick enough for cold days however I wouldn't wear if below freezing. I will say the quality does NOT match the price tag. I've worn it a handful of times and it's lost 3 buttons, snagged threads and started pilling. Luckily I found the buttons and I've been able to sew them back on. At $160 though the coat shouldn't be doing this after just a few wears. I seriously love the color and style so I don't regret purchasing but buyer should beware quality is probably $75.

This coat is very lovely. The color is more of a subdued mustard than it looks in the picture, but still very pretty. I usually wear between a 2X and 4X in modcloth dresses so I ordered this coat in a 2X noticing it ran large. The coat is still way too big on me. I honestly probably could have gotten away with an XL and I am definitely going to exchange it for a smaller size. It comes to about my knee, but I am only a whopping 5'2 so it being a little long does not surprise me. Lastly the material is very textured and thick but the coat itself could be a little warmer. All in all I am happy with my purchase.

review_summary: I love this coat! Sadly I
review_text: I love this coat! Sadly I got it and realize my curse for big shoulders and arms didn't agree with the sizing. Otherwise it would have fit perfectly. So I'm returning it for a size up.

This coat is beautiful and warmer than I expected. It is a little snug in chest area for me and I probably should have gotten a medium for my chest size. The quality of the coat is not great. It had a snag already when I first opened up my package. I've worn it once and it already has multiple snags. :( This will have to be a coat that I just wear for special occasions as it is not very durable.
This is amazing, and will do really nicely as my winter coat

This coat is BEAUTIFUL! But then I put it on and the top button feel off almost immediately and the second button dangled loosely from one thread. The bottom of the jacket also snagged and left loose threads along the bottom of it. Needles to say it was so disappointing. For the price, I could not keep it with the poor quality.

I adore this coat!!! It's beautiful, classy, and so cozy! Fits perfectly  I got a Small (my usual size), and it was still roomy enough for sweaters or layers.  I felt so wonderful wearing this coat out and about. I love that it's belted, and I adore how the hood folds over the shoulders like a capelet. The hilo hemline is beautiful, and the buttonup sleeve cuffs are great for getting gloves and mittens on. My one complaint it that it sheds everywhere. I left a trail of yellow lint everywhere I went. I'm sure this will stop eventually, but for now, I feel the need to travel with a lint roller.
Very bulky and unflattering. The belt hits too low and does not help define the waist.

Beautiful cost that will keep me nice and warm during a Canadian winter. The pockets are a bit awkward  they are very close to the front of the jacket. Other than that this coat is unique and just what I was looking for.

Wow, where to begin with this coat? The length is perfect, the hood is magical, the color is fabulous, the buttons are adorable, the cut is just right.. And so on! I simply love it! I literally purr like a cat everytime I put it on. But (there's always a but, isn't it?), it runs a bit large; my guess would be about a size. I talked to a Modstylist because I was so unsure of which size to get, and we reached the conclusion that the XL would be just right. But no. It's not catastrophically large, but large enough that I will swim in it if I lose weight (which is the plan). I'm hoping I can fix that by simply moving the buttons, but time will tell. Also the stitching isn't the best. After just one use there was a hole in the right pocket, and even though that's an easy fix, in my mind it's something that simply shouldn't happen to a coat this expensive. There's also some loose threads here and there. And it gives of some lint, but I'm hoping to fix that by going over it with a lintremover.So yeah. Despite these childsicknesses (none of them are really _that_ big a deal), it's a really gorgeous coat and definitely the most beautiful thing I own!

After stalking this coat online for ages I decided to just take the plunge and buy it. I purchased the 3X and after reading previous reviews I went all in. Some reviewers mentioned it fit perfect, others talked about the arms being tight. Unfortunately for me, I fall into the tight arms category, everything else however fits like a dream. The material is amazing and high quality and the colour is exactly what I wanted. Ontario winters have been so dismal last few years, I am counting on this coat to brighten my days. For the other girls in my situation with the right arms; I am considering buying some arm shape wear just to kinda make things a little smoother, maybe that might help?

review_summary: One of the buttons was al

I expected that I would need to get it adjusted (as most petite girls will understand) but I look like I'm a little girl playing dressup in my mother's coat. I'm going to try exchanging it for a size down to see if this helps, but I think I'm going to need the help of an exceptional tailor to make this coat work for me.

I may still keep it, but for the price, I was looking for a slightly more polished look on me.

I live in the upper Midwest, so this is not a midwinter coat, but nice for fall and spring.

My only issue is that the buttons were already falling off when I got it :( For this price, that's extremely disappointing. Otherwise it's a beautiful and unique coat. Fit perfectly and I love the dresslike silhouette and giant buttons/hood.

I was very excited to get this coat. I'm glad that I bought it and look forward to the weather cooling down a bit more. The material is very heavy and feels tough.I bought a 2X and it fits well, but I wish I had sized up one. I found a lot of the reviews said that the coat fits big but I have large shoulders and long arms. One size up would make it fit best so I could wear a sweater underneath. Everywhere other than my arms it fits well so I'll be keeping this.  It's a great coat and would highly recommend, but if you have wide shoulders and bigger arms size up one.

I just received this coat in Basil today. The fit is wonderful ( I am 5'3'', 150lbs), I ordered it in a Medium. I can fit a sweater underneath, and even with no sweater it is not too big. The oversized hood is romantic (and good for pretending you're little red ridding hood) while still being quite functional; I was quite happy to have it when caught in some rain while walking my dog. If you're handy with button sewing, this isn't a problem. Since reattaching that button and one other, the coat has been quite nice.

I expect to get a lot of wear out of this coat!

review_summary: I like this coat I just w
review_text: I like this coat I just wish I got it a bit smaller. So cute very comfy and cozy. It feels very Little Red Riding Hood and it's a rusty orange. Great to layer but I feel a bit weary about the buttons I'll try and reinforce them just in case.

review_summary: it is a nice heavy warm c

ONLY downfall, and only reason this got 4 stars instead of 5, the buttons are awful. They are massive and not even sewn on, more like loosely tied on. I lost the first button within 2 minutes and the 2nd fell off shortly after that but in a parking lot so who knows where it is, and a 3rd is getting ready to go. I will have to replace all the buttons and really sew them on, but that is the only downfall of this coat. Love this coat! The color is gorgeous and it fits me perfectly! Like other reviews, the buttons do seem a bit floppy but it's nothing a needle and thread can't fix. The sleeves are a good length. They are a little long on me, but I'm short. They are not so long though that I feel I have to get them taken up.

The fit is perfect; the tie and flared skirt are so flattering, and I can move my arms around without restriction. I took off one star because there were a few minor problems with the construction (a few loose threads in the actual weave and one cuff had come undone). Fortunately these were pretty easy fixes, and I kept the coat. I've gotten complements every time I've worn it thus far, and have been toasty warm.
